1:1 In the beginning GOD[JESUS] created the heaven and the earth.

1:2 And the earth was without form, and void; and darkness was upon the
face of the deep. And the Spirit of GOD[JESUS] moved upon the face of the
waters.

1:3 And GOD[JESUS] said, Let there be light: and there was light.

1:4 And GOD[JESUS] saw the light, that it was good: and GOD[JESUS] divided the light
from the darkness.

1:5 And GOD[JESUS] called the light Day, and the darkness HE[JESUS] called Night. And
the evening and the morning were the first day.

1:6 And GOD[JESUS] said, Let there be a firmament in the midst of the waters,
and let it divide the waters from the waters.

1:7 And GOD[JESUS] made the firmament, and divided the waters which were under
the firmament from the waters which were above the firmament: and it was
so.

1:8 And GOD[JESUS] called the firmament Heaven. And the evening and the morning
were the second day.

1:9 And GOD[JESUS] said, Let the waters under the heaven be gathered together
unto one place, and let the dry land appear: and it was so.

1:10 And GOD[JESUS] called the dry land Earth; and the gathering together of
the waters called HE[JESUS] Seas: and GOD[JESUS] saw that it was good.

1:11 And GOD[JESUS] said, Let the earth bring forth grass, the herb yielding
SEED[JESUS], and the fruit tree yielding fruit after HIS[JESUS] kind, whose SEED[JESUS] is in
itself, upon the earth: and it was so.

1:12 And the earth brought forth grass, and herb yielding SEED[JESUS] after HIS[JESUS]
kind, and the tree yielding fruit, whose SEED[JESUS] was in itself, after HIS[JESUS]
kind: and GOD[JESUS] saw that it was good.

1:13 And the evening and the morning were the third day.

1:14 And GOD[JESUS] said, Let there be lights in the firmament of the heaven to
divide the day from the night; and let them be for signs, and for
seasons, and for days, and years:

1:15 And let them be for lights in the firmament of the heaven to give
light upon the earth: and it was so.

1:16 And GOD[JESUS] made two great lights; the greater light to rule the day,
and the lesser light to rule the night: HE[JESUS] made the stars also.

1:17 And GOD[JESUS] set them in the firmament of the heaven to give light upon
the earth,

1:18 And to rule over the day and over the night, and to divide the
light from the darkness: and GOD[JESUS] saw that it was good.

1:19 And the evening and the morning were the fourth day.

1:20 And GOD[JESUS] said, Let the waters bring forth abundantly the moving
creature that has life, and fowl that may fly above the earth in the
open firmament of heaven.

1:21 And GOD[JESUS] created great whales, and every living creature that
moveth, which the waters brought forth abundantly, after their kind, and
every winged fowl after HIS[JESUS] kind: and GOD[JESUS] saw that it was good.

1:22 And GOD[JESUS] blessed them, saying, Be fruitful, and multiply, and fill
the waters in the seas, and let fowl multiply in the earth.

1:23 And the evening and the morning were the fifth day.

1:24 And GOD[JESUS] said, Let the earth bring forth the living creature after
HIS[JESUS] kind, cattle, and creeping thing, and beast of the earth after HIS[JESUS]
kind: and it was so.

1:25 And GOD[JESUS] made the beast of the earth after HIS[JESUS] kind, and cattle
after their kind, and every thing that creepeth upon the earth after HIS[JESUS]
kind: and GOD[JESUS] saw that it was good.

1:26 And GOD[JESUS] said, Let us make man in our image, after our likeness: and
let them have dominion over the fish of the sea, and over the fowl of
the air, and over the cattle, and over all the earth, and over every
creeping thing that creepeth upon the earth.

1:27 So GOD[JESUS] created man in HIS[JESUS] own image, in the image of GOD[JESUS] created HE[JESUS]
HIM[JESUS]; male and female created HE[JESUS] them.

1:28 And GOD[JESUS] blessed them, and GOD[JESUS] said unto them, Be fruitful, and
multiply, and replenish the earth, and subdue it: and have dominion over
the fish of the sea, and over the fowl of the air, and over every living
thing that moveth upon the earth.

1:29 And GOD[JESUS] said, Behold, I have given you every herb bearing SEED[JESUS],
which is upon the face of all the earth, and every tree, in the which is
the fruit of a tree yielding SEED[JESUS]; to you it shall be for meat.

1:30 And to every beast of the earth, and to every fowl of the air, and
to every thing that creepeth upon the earth, wherein there is life, I
have given every green herb for meat: and it was so.

1:31 And GOD[JESUS] saw every thing that HE[JESUS] had made, and, behold, it was very
good. And the evening and the morning were the sixth day.


2:1 Thus the heavens and the earth were finished, and all the host of
them.

2:2 And on the seventh day GOD[JESUS] ended HIS[JESUS] work which HE[JESUS] had made; and HE[JESUS]
rested on the seventh day from all HIS[JESUS] work which HE[JESUS] had made.

2:3 And GOD[JESUS] blessed the seventh day, and sanctified it: because that in
it HE[JESUS] had rested from all HIS[JESUS] work which GOD[JESUS] created and made.

2:4 These are the generations of the heavens and of the earth when they
were created, in the day that the LORD[JESUS] GOD[JESUS] made the earth and the
heavens,

2:5 And every plant of the field before it was in the earth, and every
herb of the field before it grew: for the LORD[JESUS] GOD[JESUS] had not caused it to
rain upon the earth, and there was not a man to till the ground.

2:6 But there went up a mist from the earth, and watered the whole face
of the ground.

2:7 And the LORD[JESUS] GOD[JESUS] formed man of the dust of the ground, and breathed
into HIS[JESUS] nostrils the breath of life; and man became a living soul.

2:8 And the LORD[JESUS] GOD[JESUS] planted a garden eastward in Eden; and there HE[JESUS] put
the man whom HE[JESUS] had formed.

2:9 And out of the ground made the LORD[JESUS] GOD[JESUS] to grow every tree that is
pleasant to the sight, and good for food; the tree of life also in the
midst of the garden, and the tree of knowledge of good and evil.

2:10 And a river went out of Eden to water the garden; and from thence
it was parted, and became into four heads.

2:11 The name of the first is Pison: that is it which compasseth the
whole land of Havilah, where there is gold;

2:12 And the gold of that land is good: there is bdellium and the onyx
stone.

2:13 And the name of the second river is Gihon: the same is it that
compasseth the whole land of Ethiopia.

2:14 And the name of the third river is Hiddekel: that is it which goes
toward the east of Assyria. And the fourth river is Euphrates.

2:15 And the LORD[JESUS] GOD[JESUS] took the man, and put HIM[JESUS] into the garden of Eden
to dress it and to keep it.

2:16 And the LORD[JESUS] GOD[JESUS] commanded the man, saying, Of every tree of the
garden you mayest freely eat:

2:17 But of the tree of the knowledge of good and evil, you shalt not
eat of it: for in the day that you eatest thereof you shalt surely
die.

2:18 And the LORD[JESUS] GOD[JESUS] said, It is not good that the man should be alone;
I will make HIM[JESUS] an help meet for HIM[JESUS].

2:19 And out of the ground the LORD[JESUS] GOD[JESUS] formed every beast of the field,
and every fowl of the air; and brought them unto Adam to see what HE[JESUS]
would call them: and whatsoever Adam called every living creature, that
was the name thereof.

2:20 And Adam gave names to all cattle, and to the fowl of the air, and
to every beast of the field; but for Adam there was not found an help
meet for HIM[JESUS].

2:21 And the LORD[JESUS] GOD[JESUS] caused a deep sleep to fall upon Adam, and HE[JESUS]
slept: and HE[JESUS] took one of HIS[JESUS] ribs, and closed up the flesh instead
thereof;

2:22 And the rib, which the LORD[JESUS] GOD[JESUS] had taken from man, made HE[JESUS] a
woman, and brought her unto the man.

2:23 And Adam said, This is now bone of my bones, and flesh of my flesh:
she shall be called Woman, because she was taken out of Man.

2:24 Therefore shall a man leave HIS[JESUS] father and HIS[JESUS] mother, and shall
cleave unto HIS[JESUS] wife: and they shall be one flesh.

2:25 And they were both naked, the man and HIS[JESUS] wife, and were not
ashamed.


3:1 Now the serpent was more subtil than any beast of the field which
the LORD[JESUS] GOD[JESUS] had made. And HE[JESUS] said unto the woman, Yea, has GOD[JESUS] said,
you shall not eat of every tree of the garden?

3:2 And the woman said unto the serpent, We may eat of the fruit of the
trees of the garden:

3:3 But of the fruit of the tree which is in the midst of the garden,
GOD[JESUS] has said, you shall not eat of it, neither shall you touch it, lest
you die.

3:4 And the serpent said unto the woman, you shall not surely die:

3:5 For GOD[JESUS] does know that in the day you eat thereof, then your eyes
shall be opened, and you shall be as gods, knowing good and evil.

3:6 And when the woman saw that the tree was good for food, and that it
was pleasant to the eyes, and a tree to be desired to make one wise, she
took of the fruit thereof, and did eat, and gave also unto her husband
with her; and HE[JESUS] did eat.

3:7 And the eyes of them both were opened, and they knew that they were
naked; and they sewed fig leaves together, and made themselves aprons.

3:8 And they heard the voice of the LORD[JESUS] GOD[JESUS] walking in the garden in
the cool of the day: and Adam and HIS[JESUS] wife hid themselves from the
presence of the LORD[JESUS] GOD[JESUS] amongst the trees of the garden.

3:9 And the LORD[JESUS] GOD[JESUS] called unto Adam, and said unto HIM[JESUS], Where art
you?

3:10 And HE[JESUS] said, I heard your voice in the garden, and I was afraid,
because I was naked; and I hid myself.

3:11 And HE[JESUS] said, Who told you that you wast naked? Hast you eaten of
the tree, whereof I commanded you that you shouldest not eat?

3:12 And the man said, The woman whom you gavest to be with me, she
gave me of the tree, and I did eat.

3:13 And the LORD[JESUS] GOD[JESUS] said unto the woman, What is this that you hast
done? And the woman said, The serpent beguiled me, and I did eat.

3:14 And the LORD[JESUS] GOD[JESUS] said unto the serpent, Because you hast done
this, you art cursed above all cattle, and above every beast of the
field; upon your belly shalt you go, and dust shalt you eat all the
days of your life:

3:15 And I will put enmity between you and the woman, and between your
SEED[JESUS] and her SEED[JESUS]; it shall bruise your head, and you shalt bruise HIS[JESUS]
heel.

3:16 Unto the woman HE[JESUS] said, I will greatly multiply your sorrow and your
conception; in sorrow you shalt bring forth children; and your desire
shall be to your husband, and HE[JESUS] shall rule over you.

3:17 And unto Adam HE[JESUS] said, Because you hast hearkened unto the voice
of your wife, and hast eaten of the tree, of which I commanded you,
saying, you shalt not eat of it: cursed is the ground for your sake; in
sorrow shalt you eat of it all the days of your life;

3:18 Thorns also and thistles shall it bring forth to you; and you
shalt eat the herb of the field;

3:19 In the sweat of your face shalt you eat bread, till you return
unto the ground; for out of it wast you taken: for dust you art, and
unto dust shalt you return.

3:20 And Adam called HIS[JESUS] wife's name Eve; because she was the mother of
all living.

3:21 Unto Adam also and to HIS[JESUS] wife did the LORD[JESUS] GOD[JESUS] make coats of
skins, and clothed them.

3:22 And the LORD[JESUS] GOD[JESUS] said, Behold, the man is become as one of us, to
know good and evil: and now, lest HE[JESUS] put forth HIS[JESUS] hand, and take also
of the tree of life, and eat, and live for ever:

3:23 Therefore the LORD[JESUS] GOD[JESUS] sent HIM[JESUS] forth from the garden of Eden, to
till the ground from whence HE[JESUS] was taken.

3:24 So HE[JESUS] drove out the man; and HE[JESUS] placed at the east of the garden of
Eden Cherubims, and a flaming sword which turned every way, to keep the
way of the tree of life.


4:1 And Adam knew Eve HIS[JESUS] wife; and she conceived, and bare Cain, and
said, I have gotten a man from the LORD[JESUS].

4:2 And she again bare HIS[JESUS] brother Abel. And Abel was a keeper of sheep,
but Cain was a tiller of the ground.

4:3 And in process of time it came to pass, that Cain brought of the
fruit of the ground an offering unto the LORD[JESUS].

4:4 And Abel, HE[JESUS] also brought of the firstlings of HIS[JESUS] flock and of the
fat thereof. And the LORD[JESUS] had respect unto Abel and to HIS[JESUS] offering:

4:5 But unto Cain and to HIS[JESUS] offering HE[JESUS] had not respect. And Cain was
very wroth, and HIS[JESUS] countenance fell.

4:6 And the LORD[JESUS] said unto Cain, Why art you wroth? and why is your
countenance fallen?

4:7 If you doest well, shalt you not be accepted? and if you doest
not well, sin lieth at the door. And unto you shall be HIS[JESUS] desire, and
you shalt rule over HIM[JESUS].

4:8 And Cain talked with Abel HIS[JESUS] brother: and it came to pass, when
they were in the field, that Cain rose up against Abel HIS[JESUS] brother, and
slew HIM[JESUS].

4:9 And the LORD[JESUS] said unto Cain, Where is Abel your brother? And HE[JESUS] said,
I know not: Am I my brother's keeper?

4:10 And HE[JESUS] said, What hast you done? the voice of your brother's blood
crieth unto me from the ground.

4:11 And now art you cursed from the earth, which has opened her mouth
to receive your brother's blood from your hand;

4:12 When you tillest the ground, it shall not henceforth yield unto
you her strength; a fugitive and a vagabond shalt you be in the earth.

4:13 And Cain said unto the LORD[JESUS], My punishment is greater than I can
bear.

4:14 Behold, you hast driven me out this day from the face of the
earth; and from your face shall I be hid; and I shall be a fugitive and a
vagabond in the earth; and it shall come to pass, that every one that
findeth me shall slay me.

4:15 And the LORD[JESUS] said unto HIM[JESUS], Therefore whoever slayeth Cain,
vengeance shall be taken on HIM[JESUS] sevenfold. And the LORD[JESUS] set a mark upon
Cain, lest any finding HIM[JESUS] should kill HIM[JESUS].

4:16 And Cain went out from the presence of the LORD[JESUS], and dwelt in the
land of Nod, on the east of Eden.

4:17 And Cain knew HIS[JESUS] wife; and she conceived, and bare Enoch: and HE[JESUS]
builded a city, and called the name of the city, after the name of HIS[JESUS]
SON[JESUS], Enoch.

4:18 And unto Enoch was born Irad: and Irad begat Mehujael: and Mehujael
begat Methusael: and Methusael begat Lamech.

4:19 And Lamech took unto HIM[JESUS] two wives: the name of the one was Adah,
and the name of the other Zillah.

4:20 And Adah bare Jabal: HE[JESUS] was the father of such as dwell in tents,
and of such as have cattle.

4:21 And HIS[JESUS] brother's name was Jubal: HE[JESUS] was the father of all such as
handle the harp and organ.

4:22 And Zillah, she also bare Tubalcain, an instructor of every
artificer in brass and iron: and the sister of Tubalcain was Naamah.

4:23 And Lamech said unto HIS[JESUS] wives, Adah and Zillah, Hear my voice; you
wives of Lamech, hearken unto my speech: for I have slain a man to my
wounding, and a young man to my hurt.

4:24 If Cain shall be avenged sevenfold, truly Lamech seventy and
sevenfold.

4:25 And Adam knew HIS[JESUS] wife again; and she bare a SON[JESUS], and called HIS[JESUS]
name Seth: For GOD[JESUS], said she, has appointed me another SEED[JESUS] instead of
Abel, whom Cain slew.

4:26 And to Seth, to HIM[JESUS] also there was born a SON[JESUS]; and HE[JESUS] called HIS[JESUS]
name Enos: then began men to call upon the name of the LORD[JESUS].


5:1 This is the book of the generations of Adam. In the day that GOD[JESUS]
created man, in the likeness of GOD[JESUS] made HE[JESUS] HIM[JESUS];

5:2 Male and female created HE[JESUS] them; and blessed them, and called their
name Adam, in the day when they were created.

5:3 And Adam lived an hundred and thirty years, and begat a SON[JESUS] in HIS[JESUS]
own likeness, and after HIS[JESUS] image; and called HIS[JESUS] name Seth:

5:4 And the days of Adam after HE[JESUS] had begotten Seth were eight hundred
years: and HE[JESUS] begat sons and daughters:

5:5 And all the days that Adam lived were nine hundred and thirty years:
and HE[JESUS] died.

5:6 And Seth lived an hundred and five years, and begat Enos:

5:7 And Seth lived after HE[JESUS] begat Enos eight hundred and seven years,
and begat sons and daughters:

5:8 And all the days of Seth were nine hundred and twelve years: and HE[JESUS]
died.

5:9 And Enos lived ninety years, and begat Cainan:

5:10 And Enos lived after HE[JESUS] begat Cainan eight hundred and fifteen
years, and begat sons and daughters:

5:11 And all the days of Enos were nine hundred and five years: and HE[JESUS]
died.

5:12 And Cainan lived seventy years and begat Mahalaleel:

5:13 And Cainan lived after HE[JESUS] begat Mahalaleel eight hundred and forty
years, and begat sons and daughters:

5:14 And all the days of Cainan were nine hundred and ten years: and HE[JESUS]
died.

5:15 And Mahalaleel lived sixty and five years, and begat Jared:

5:16 And Mahalaleel lived after HE[JESUS] begat Jared eight hundred and thirty
years, and begat sons and daughters:

5:17 And all the days of Mahalaleel were eight hundred ninety and five
years: and HE[JESUS] died.

5:18 And Jared lived an hundred sixty and two years, and HE[JESUS] begat Enoch:

5:19 And Jared lived after HE[JESUS] begat Enoch eight hundred years, and begat
sons and daughters:

5:20 And all the days of Jared were nine hundred sixty and two years:
and HE[JESUS] died.

5:21 And Enoch lived sixty and five years, and begat Methuselah:

5:22 And Enoch walked with GOD[JESUS] after HE[JESUS] begat Methuselah three hundred
years, and begat sons and daughters:

5:23 And all the days of Enoch were three hundred sixty and five years:

5:24 And Enoch walked with GOD[JESUS]: and HE[JESUS] was not; for GOD[JESUS] took HIM[JESUS].

5:25 And Methuselah lived an hundred eighty and seven years, and begat
Lamech.

5:26 And Methuselah lived after HE[JESUS] begat Lamech seven hundred eighty and
two years, and begat sons and daughters:

5:27 And all the days of Methuselah were nine hundred sixty and nine
years: and HE[JESUS] died.

5:28 And Lamech lived an hundred eighty and two years, and begat a SON[JESUS]:

5:29 And HE[JESUS] called HIS[JESUS] name Noah, saying, This same shall comfort us
concerning our work and toil of our hands, because of the ground which
the LORD[JESUS] has cursed.

5:30 And Lamech lived after HE[JESUS] begat Noah five hundred ninety and five
years, and begat sons and daughters:

5:31 And all the days of Lamech were seven hundred seventy and seven
years: and HE[JESUS] died.

5:32 And Noah was five hundred years old: and Noah begat Shem, Ham, and
Japheth.


6:1 And it came to pass, when men began to multiply on the face of the
earth, and daughters were born unto them,

6:2 That the sons of GOD[JESUS] saw the daughters of men that they were fair;
and they took them wives of all which they chose.

6:3 And the LORD[JESUS] said, My spirit shall not always strive with man, for
that HE[JESUS] also is flesh: yet HIS[JESUS] days shall be an hundred and twenty
years.

6:4 There were giants in the earth in those days; and also after that,
when the sons of GOD[JESUS] came in unto the daughters of men, and they bare
children to them, the same became mighty men which were of old, men of
renown.

6:5 And GOD[JESUS] saw that the wickedness of man was great in the earth, and
that every imagination of the thoughts of HIS[JESUS] heart was only evil
continually.

6:6 And it repented the LORD[JESUS] that HE[JESUS] had made man on the earth, and it
grieved HIM[JESUS] at HIS[JESUS] heart.

6:7 And the LORD[JESUS] said, I will destroy man whom I have created from the
face of the earth; both man, and beast, and the creeping thing, and the
fowls of the air; for it repenteth me that I have made them.

6:8 But Noah found grace in the eyes of the LORD[JESUS].

6:9 These are the generations of Noah: Noah was a just man and perfect
in HIS[JESUS] generations, and Noah walked with GOD[JESUS].

6:10 And Noah begat three sons, Shem, Ham, and Japheth.

6:11 The earth also was corrupt before GOD[JESUS], and the earth was filled
with violence.

6:12 And GOD[JESUS] looked upon the earth, and, behold, it was corrupt; for all
flesh had corrupted HIS[JESUS] way upon the earth.

6:13 And GOD[JESUS] said unto Noah, The end of all flesh is come before me; for
the earth is filled with violence through them; and, behold, I will
destroy them with the earth.

6:14 Make you an ark of gopher wood; rooms shalt you make in the ark,
and shalt pitch it within and without with pitch.

6:15 And this is the fashion which you shalt make it of: The length of
the ark shall be three hundred cubits, the breadth of it fifty cubits,
and the height of it thirty cubits.

6:16 A window shalt you make to the ark, and in a cubit shalt you
finish it above; and the door of the ark shalt you set in the side
thereof; with lower, second, and third stories shalt you make it.

6:17 And, behold, I, even I, do bring a flood of waters upon the earth,
to destroy all flesh, wherein is the breath of life, from under heaven;
and every thing that is in the earth shall die.

6:18 But with you will I establish my covenant; and you shalt come
into the ark, you, and your sons, and your wife, and your sons' wives with
you.

6:19 And of every living thing of all flesh, two of every sort shalt
you bring into the ark, to keep them alive with you; they shall be
male and female.

6:20 Of fowls after their kind, and of cattle after their kind, of every
creeping thing of the earth after HIS[JESUS] kind, two of every sort shall come
unto you, to keep them alive.

6:21 And take you unto you of all food that is eaten, and you shalt
gather it to you; and it shall be for food for you, and for them.

6:22 Thus did Noah; according to all that GOD[JESUS] commanded HIM[JESUS], so did HE[JESUS].


7:1 And the LORD[JESUS] said unto Noah, Come you and all your house into the
ark; for you have I seen righteous before me in this generation.

7:2 Of every clean beast you shalt take to you by sevens, the male and
HIS[JESUS] female: and of beasts that are not clean by two, the male and HIS[JESUS]
female.

7:3 Of fowls also of the air by sevens, the male and the female; to keep
SEED[JESUS] alive upon the face of all the earth.

7:4 For yet seven days, and I will cause it to rain upon the earth forty
days and forty nights; and every living substance that I have made will
I destroy from off the face of the earth.

7:5 And Noah did according unto all that the LORD[JESUS] commanded HIM[JESUS].

7:6 And Noah was six hundred years old when the flood of waters was upon
the earth.

7:7 And Noah went in, and HIS[JESUS] sons, and HIS[JESUS] wife, and HIS[JESUS] sons' wives
with HIM[JESUS], into the ark, because of the waters of the flood.

7:8 Of clean beasts, and of beasts that are not clean, and of fowls, and
of every thing that creepeth upon the earth,

7:9 There went in two and two unto Noah into the ark, the male and the
female, as GOD[JESUS] had commanded Noah.

7:10 And it came to pass after seven days, that the waters of the flood
were upon the earth.

7:11 In the six hundredth year of Noah's life, in the second month, the
seventeenth day of the month, the same day were all the fountains of the
great deep broken up, and the windows of heaven were opened.

7:12 And the rain was upon the earth forty days and forty nights.

7:13 In the selfsame day entered Noah, and Shem, and Ham, and Japheth,
the sons of Noah, and Noah's wife, and the three wives of HIS[JESUS] sons with
them, into the ark;

7:14 They, and every beast after HIS[JESUS] kind, and all the cattle after
their kind, and every creeping thing that creepeth upon the earth after
HIS[JESUS] kind, and every fowl after HIS[JESUS] kind, every bird of every sort.

7:15 And they went in unto Noah into the ark, two and two of all flesh,
wherein is the breath of life.

7:16 And they that went in, went in male and female of all flesh, as GOD[JESUS]
had commanded HIM[JESUS]: and the LORD[JESUS] shut HIM[JESUS] in.

7:17 And the flood was forty days upon the earth; and the waters
increased, and bare up the ark, and it was lift up above the earth.

7:18 And the waters prevailed, and were increased greatly upon the
earth; and the ark went upon the face of the waters.

7:19 And the waters prevailed exceedingly upon the earth; and all the
high hills, that were under the whole heaven, were covered.

7:20 Fifteen cubits upward did the waters prevail; and the mountains
were covered.

7:21 And all flesh died that moved upon the earth, both of fowl, and of
cattle, and of beast, and of every creeping thing that creepeth upon the
earth, and every man:

7:22 All in whose nostrils was the breath of life, of all that was in
the dry land, died.

7:23 And every living substance was destroyed which was upon the face of
the ground, both man, and cattle, and the creeping things, and the fowl
of the heaven; and they were destroyed from the earth: and Noah only
remained alive, and they that were with HIM[JESUS] in the ark.

7:24 And the waters prevailed upon the earth an hundred and fifty days.


8:1 And GOD[JESUS] remembered Noah, and every living thing, and all the cattle
that was with HIM[JESUS] in the ark: and GOD[JESUS] made a wind to pass over the
earth, and the waters asswaged;

8:2 The fountains also of the deep and the windows of heaven were
stopped, and the rain from heaven was restrained;

8:3 And the waters returned from off the earth continually: and after
the end of the hundred and fifty days the waters were abated.

8:4 And the ark rested in the seventh month, on the seventeenth day of
the month, upon the mountains of Ararat.

8:5 And the waters decreased continually until the tenth month: in the
tenth month, on the first day of the month, were the tops of the
mountains seen.

8:6 And it came to pass at the end of forty days, that Noah opened the
window of the ark which HE[JESUS] had made:

8:7 And HE[JESUS] sent forth a raven, which went forth to and fro, until the
waters were dried up from off the earth.

8:8 Also HE[JESUS] sent forth a dove from HIM[JESUS], to see if the waters were abated
from off the face of the ground;

8:9 But the dove found no rest for the sole of her foot, and she
returned unto HIM[JESUS] into the ark, for the waters were on the face of the
whole earth: then HE[JESUS] put forth HIS[JESUS] hand, and took her, and pulled her in
unto HIM[JESUS] into the ark.

8:10 And HE[JESUS] stayed yet other seven days; and again HE[JESUS] sent forth the
dove out of the ark;

8:11 And the dove came in to HIM[JESUS] in the evening; and, lo, in her mouth
was an olive leaf pluckt off: so Noah knew that the waters were abated
from off the earth.

8:12 And HE[JESUS] stayed yet other seven days; and sent forth the dove; which
returned not again unto HIM[JESUS] any more.

8:13 And it came to pass in the six hundredth and first year, in the
first month, the first day of the month, the waters were dried up from
off the earth: and Noah removed the covering of the ark, and looked,
and, behold, the face of the ground was dry.

8:14 And in the second month, on the seven and twentieth day of the
month, was the earth dried.

8:15 And GOD[JESUS] spake unto Noah, saying,

8:16 Go forth of the ark, you, and your wife, and your sons, and your
sons' wives with you.

8:17 Bring forth with you every living thing that is with you, of all
flesh, both of fowl, and of cattle, and of every creeping thing that
creepeth upon the earth; that they may breed abundantly in the earth,
and be fruitful, and multiply upon the earth.

8:18 And Noah went forth, and HIS[JESUS] sons, and HIS[JESUS] wife, and HIS[JESUS] sons'
wives with HIM[JESUS]:

8:19 Every beast, every creeping thing, and every fowl, and whatsoever
creepeth upon the earth, after their kinds, went forth out of the ark.

8:20 And Noah builded an altar unto the LORD[JESUS]; and took of every clean
beast, and of every clean fowl, and offered burnt offerings on the
altar.

8:21 And the LORD[JESUS] smelled a sweet savour; and the LORD[JESUS] said in HIS[JESUS]
heart, I will not again curse the ground any more for man's sake; for
the imagination of man's heart is evil from HIS[JESUS] youth; neither will I
again smite any more every thing living, as I have done.

8:22 While the earth remaineth, seedtime and harvest, and cold and heat,
and summer and winter, and day and night shall not cease.


9:1 And GOD[JESUS] blessed Noah and HIS[JESUS] sons, and said unto them, Be fruitful,
and multiply, and replenish the earth.

9:2 And the fear of you and the dread of you shall be upon every beast
of the earth, and upon every fowl of the air, upon all that moveth upon
the earth, and upon all the fishes of the sea; into your hand are they
delivered.

9:3 Every moving thing that liveth shall be meat for you; even as the
green herb have I given you all things.

9:4 But flesh with the life thereof, which is the blood thereof, shall
you not eat.

9:5 And surely your blood of your lives will I require; at the hand of
every beast will I require it, and at the hand of man; at the hand of
every man's brother will I require the life of man.

9:6 whoever sheddeth man's blood, by man shall HIS[JESUS] blood be shed: for in
the image of GOD[JESUS] made HE[JESUS] man.

9:7 And you, be you fruitful, and multiply; bring forth abundantly in the
earth, and multiply therein.

9:8 And GOD[JESUS] spake unto Noah, and to HIS[JESUS] sons with HIM[JESUS], saying,

9:9 And I, behold, I establish my covenant with you, and with your SEED[JESUS]
after you;

9:10 And with every living creature that is with you, of the fowl, of
the cattle, and of every beast of the earth with you; from all that go
out of the ark, to every beast of the earth.

9:11 And I will establish my covenant with you, neither shall all flesh
be cut off any more by the waters of a flood; neither shall there any
more be a flood to destroy the earth.

9:12 And GOD[JESUS] said, This is the token of the covenant which I make
between me and you and every living creature that is with you, for
perpetual generations:

9:13 I do set my bow in the cloud, and it shall be for a token of a
covenant between me and the earth.

9:14 And it shall come to pass, when I bring a cloud over the earth,
that the bow shall be seen in the cloud:

9:15 And I will remember my covenant, which is between me and you and
every living creature of all flesh; and the waters shall no more become
a flood to destroy all flesh.

9:16 And the bow shall be in the cloud; and I will look upon it, that I
may remember the everlasting covenant between GOD[JESUS] and every living
creature of all flesh that is upon the earth.

9:17 And GOD[JESUS] said unto Noah, This is the token of the covenant, which I
have established between me and all flesh that is upon the earth.

9:18 And the sons of Noah, that went forth of the ark, were Shem, and
Ham, and Japheth: and Ham is the father of Canaan.

9:19 These are the three sons of Noah: and of them was the whole earth
overspread.

9:20 And Noah began to be an husbandman, and HE[JESUS] planted a vineyard:

9:21 And HE[JESUS] drank of the wine, and was drunken; and HE[JESUS] was uncovered
within HIS[JESUS] tent.

9:22 And Ham, the father of Canaan, saw the nakedness of HIS[JESUS] father, and
told HIS[JESUS] two brethren without.

9:23 And Shem and Japheth took a garment, and laid it upon both their
shoulders, and went backward, and covered the nakedness of their father;
and their faces were backward, and they saw not their father's
nakedness.

9:24 And Noah awoke from HIS[JESUS] wine, and knew what HIS[JESUS] younger SON[JESUS] had
done unto HIM[JESUS].

9:25 And HE[JESUS] said, Cursed be Canaan; a SERVANT[JESUS] of servants shall HE[JESUS] be
unto HIS[JESUS] brethren.

9:26 And HE[JESUS] said, Blessed be the LORD[JESUS] GOD[JESUS] of Shem; and Canaan shall be
HIS[JESUS] SERVANT[JESUS].

9:27 GOD[JESUS] shall enlarge Japheth, and HE[JESUS] shall dwell in the tents of Shem;
and Canaan shall be HIS[JESUS] SERVANT[JESUS].

9:28 And Noah lived after the flood three hundred and fifty years.

9:29 And all the days of Noah were nine hundred and fifty years: and HE[JESUS]
died.


10:1 Now these are the generations of the sons of Noah, Shem, Ham, and
Japheth: and unto them were sons born after the flood.

10:2 The sons of Japheth; Gomer, and Magog, and Madai, and Javan, and
Tubal, and Meshech, and Tiras.

10:3 And the sons of Gomer; Ashkenaz, and Riphath, and Togarmah.

10:4 And the sons of Javan; Elishah, and Tarshish, Kittim, and Dodanim.

10:5 By these were the isles of the Gentiles divided in their lands;
every one after HIS[JESUS] tongue, after their families, in their nations.

10:6 And the sons of Ham; Cush, and Mizraim, and Phut, and Canaan.

10:7 And the sons of Cush; Seba, and Havilah, and Sabtah, and Raamah,
and Sabtechah: and the sons of Raamah; Sheba, and Dedan.

10:8 And Cush begat Nimrod: HE[JESUS] began to be a mighty one in the earth.

10:9 HE[JESUS] was a mighty hunter before the LORD[JESUS]: wherefore it is said, Even
as Nimrod the mighty hunter before the LORD[JESUS].

10:10 And the beginning of HIS[JESUS] kingdom was Babel, and Erech, and Accad,
and Calneh, in the land of Shinar.

10:11 Out of that land went forth Asshur, and builded Nineveh, and the
city Rehoboth, and Calah,

10:12 And Resen between Nineveh and Calah: the same is a great city.

10:13 And Mizraim begat Ludim, and Anamim, and Lehabim, and Naphtuhim,

10:14 And Pathrusim, and Casluhim, (out of whom came Philistim,) and
Caphtorim.

10:15 And Canaan begat Sidon HIS[JESUS] first born, and Heth,

10:16 And the Jebusite, and the Amorite, and the Girgasite,

10:17 And the Hivite, and the Arkite, and the Sinite,

10:18 And the Arvadite, and the Zemarite, and the Hamathite: and
afterward were the families of the Canaanites spread abroad.

10:19 And the border of the Canaanites was from Sidon, as you comest to
Gerar, unto Gaza; as you goest, unto Sodom, and Gomorrah, and Admah,
and Zeboim, even unto Lasha.

10:20 These are the sons of Ham, after their families, after their
tongues, in their countries, and in their nations.

10:21 Unto Shem also, the father of all the children of Eber, the
brother of Japheth the elder, even to HIM[JESUS] were children born.

10:22 The children of Shem; Elam, and Asshur, and Arphaxad, and Lud, and
Aram.

10:23 And the children of Aram; Uz, and Hul, and Gether, and Mash.

10:24 And Arphaxad begat Salah; and Salah begat Eber.

10:25 And unto Eber were born two sons: the name of one was Peleg; for
in HIS[JESUS] days was the earth divided; and HIS[JESUS] brother's name was Joktan.

10:26 And Joktan begat Almodad, and Sheleph, and Hazarmaveth, and Jerah,

10:27 And Hadoram, and Uzal, and Diklah,

10:28 And Obal, and Abimael, and Sheba,

10:29 And Ophir, and Havilah, and Jobab: all these were the sons of
Joktan.

10:30 And their dwelling was from Mesha, as you goest unto Sephar a
mount of the east.

10:31 These are the sons of Shem, after their families, after their
tongues, in their lands, after their nations.

10:32 These are the families of the sons of Noah, after their
generations, in their nations: and by these were the nations divided in
the earth after the flood.


11:1 And the whole earth was of one language, and of one speech.

11:2 And it came to pass, as they journeyed from the east, that they
found a plain in the land of Shinar; and they dwelt there.

11:3 And they said one to another, Go to, let us make brick, and burn
them thoroughly. And they had brick for stone, and slime had they for
morter.

11:4 And they said, Go to, let us build us a city and a tower, whose top
may reach unto heaven; and let us make us a name, lest we be scattered
abroad upon the face of the whole earth.

11:5 And the LORD[JESUS] came down to see the city and the tower, which the
children of men builded.

11:6 And the LORD[JESUS] said, Behold, the people is one, and they have all one
language; and this they begin to do: and now nothing will be restrained
from them, which they have imagined to do.

11:7 Go to, let us go down, and there confound their language, that they
may not understand one another's speech.

11:8 So the LORD[JESUS] scattered them abroad from thence upon the face of all
the earth: and they left off to build the city.

11:9 Therefore is the name of it called Babel; because the LORD[JESUS] did
there confound the language of all the earth: and from thence did the
LORD[JESUS] scatter them abroad upon the face of all the earth.

11:10 These are the generations of Shem: Shem was an hundred years old,
and begat Arphaxad two years after the flood:

11:11 And Shem lived after HE[JESUS] begat Arphaxad five hundred years, and
begat sons and daughters.

11:12 And Arphaxad lived five and thirty years, and begat Salah:

11:13 And Arphaxad lived after HE[JESUS] begat Salah four hundred and three
years, and begat sons and daughters.

11:14 And Salah lived thirty years, and begat Eber:

11:15 And Salah lived after HE[JESUS] begat Eber four hundred and three years,
and begat sons and daughters.

11:16 And Eber lived four and thirty years, and begat Peleg:

11:17 And Eber lived after HE[JESUS] begat Peleg four hundred and thirty years,
and begat sons and daughters.

11:18 And Peleg lived thirty years, and begat Reu:

11:19 And Peleg lived after HE[JESUS] begat Reu two hundred and nine years, and
begat sons and daughters.

11:20 And Reu lived two and thirty years, and begat Serug:

11:21 And Reu lived after HE[JESUS] begat Serug two hundred and seven years,
and begat sons and daughters.

11:22 And Serug lived thirty years, and begat Nahor:

11:23 And Serug lived after HE[JESUS] begat Nahor two hundred years, and begat
sons and daughters.

11:24 And Nahor lived nine and twenty years, and begat Terah:

11:25 And Nahor lived after HE[JESUS] begat Terah an hundred and nineteen
years, and begat sons and daughters.

11:26 And Terah lived seventy years, and begat Abram, Nahor, and Haran.

11:27 Now these are the generations of Terah: Terah begat Abram, Nahor,
and Haran; and Haran begat Lot.

11:28 And Haran died before HIS[JESUS] father Terah in the land of HIS[JESUS]
nativity, in Ur of the Chaldees.

11:29 And Abram and Nahor took them wives: the name of Abram's wife was
Sarai; and the name of Nahor's wife, Milcah, the daughter of Haran, the
father of Milcah, and the father of Iscah.

11:30 But Sarai was barren; she had no child.

11:31 And Terah took Abram HIS[JESUS] SON[JESUS], and Lot the SON[JESUS] of Haran HIS[JESUS] SON[JESUS]'s
SON[JESUS], and Sarai HIS[JESUS] daughter in law, HIS[JESUS] SON[JESUS] Abram's wife; and they went
forth with them from Ur of the Chaldees, to go into the land of Canaan;
and they came unto Haran, and dwelt there.

11:32 And the days of Terah were two hundred and five years: and Terah
died in Haran.


12:1 Now the LORD[JESUS] had said unto Abram, Get you out of your country, and
from your kindred, and from your father's house, unto a land that I will
shew you:

12:2 And I will make of you a great nation, and I will bless you, and
make your name great; and you shalt be a blessing:

12:3 And I will bless them that bless you, and curse HIM[JESUS] that curseth
you: and in you shall all families of the earth be blessed.

12:4 So Abram departed, as the LORD[JESUS] had spoken unto HIM[JESUS]; and Lot went
with HIM[JESUS]: and Abram was seventy and five years old when HE[JESUS] departed out
of Haran.

12:5 And Abram took Sarai HIS[JESUS] wife, and Lot HIS[JESUS] brother's SON[JESUS], and all
their substance that they had gathered, and the souls that they had
gotten in Haran; and they went forth to go into the land of Canaan; and
into the land of Canaan they came.

12:6 And Abram passed through the land unto the place of Sichem, unto
the plain of Moreh. And the Canaanite was then in the land.

12:7 And the LORD[JESUS] appeared unto Abram, and said, Unto your SEED[JESUS] will I
give this land: and there builded HE[JESUS] an altar unto the LORD[JESUS], who
appeared unto HIM[JESUS].

12:8 And HE[JESUS] removed from thence unto a mountain on the east of Bethel,
and pitched HIS[JESUS] tent, having Bethel on the west, and Hai on the east:
and there HE[JESUS] builded an altar unto the LORD[JESUS], and called upon the name of
the LORD[JESUS].

12:9 And Abram journeyed, going on still toward the south.

12:10 And there was a famine in the land: and Abram went down into Egypt
to sojourn there; for the famine was grievous in the land.

12:11 And it came to pass, when HE[JESUS] was come near to enter into Egypt,
that HE[JESUS] said unto Sarai HIS[JESUS] wife, Behold now, I know that you art a
fair woman to look upon:

12:12 Therefore it shall come to pass, when the Egyptians shall see
you, that they shall say, This is HIS[JESUS] wife: and they will kill me, but
they will save you alive.

12:13 Say, I pray you, you art my sister: that it may be well with me
for your sake; and my soul shall live because of you.

12:14 And it came to pass, that, when Abram was come into Egypt, the
Egyptians beheld the woman that she was very fair.

12:15 The princes also of Pharaoh saw her, and commended her before
Pharaoh: and the woman was taken into Pharaoh's house.

12:16 And HE[JESUS] entreated Abram well for her sake: and HE[JESUS] had sheep, and
oxen, and HE[JESUS] asses, and menservants, and maidservants, and she asses,
and camels.

12:17 And the LORD[JESUS] plagued Pharaoh and HIS[JESUS] house with great plagues
because of Sarai Abram's wife.

12:18 And Pharaoh called Abram and said, What is this that you hast
done unto me? why didst you not tell me that she was your wife?

12:19 Why saidst you, She is my sister? so I might have taken her to me
to wife: now therefore behold your wife, take her, and go your way.

12:20 And Pharaoh commanded HIS[JESUS] men concerning HIM[JESUS]: and they sent HIM[JESUS]
away, and HIS[JESUS] wife, and all that HE[JESUS] had.


13:1 And Abram went up out of Egypt, HE[JESUS], and HIS[JESUS] wife, and all that HE[JESUS]
had, and Lot with HIM[JESUS], into the south.

13:2 And Abram was very rich in cattle, in silver, and in gold.

13:3 And HE[JESUS] went on HIS[JESUS] journeys from the south even to Bethel, unto the
place where HIS[JESUS] tent had been at the beginning, between Bethel and Hai;

13:4 Unto the place of the altar, which HE[JESUS] had make there at the first:
and there Abram called on the name of the LORD[JESUS].

13:5 And Lot also, which went with Abram, had flocks, and herds, and
tents.

13:6 And the land was not able to bear them, that they might dwell
together: for their substance was great, so that they could not dwell
together.

13:7 And there was a strife between the herdmen of Abram's cattle and
the herdmen of Lot's cattle: and the Canaanite and the Perizzite dwelled
then in the land.

13:8 And Abram said unto Lot, Let there be no strife, I pray you,
between me and you, and between my herdmen and your herdmen; for we be
brethren.

13:9 Is not the whole land before you? separate thyself, I pray you,
from me: if you wilt take the left hand, then I will go to the right;
or if you depart to the right hand, then I will go to the left.

13:10 And Lot lifted up HIS[JESUS] eyes, and beheld all the plain of Jordan,
that it was well watered every where, before the LORD[JESUS] destroyed Sodom
and Gomorrah, even as the garden of the LORD[JESUS], like the land of Egypt, as
you comest unto Zoar.

13:11 Then Lot chose HIM[JESUS] all the plain of Jordan; and Lot journeyed
east: and they separated themselves the one from the other.

13:12 Abram dwelled in the land of Canaan, and Lot dwelled in the cities
of the plain, and pitched HIS[JESUS] tent toward Sodom.

13:13 But the men of Sodom were wicked and sinners before the LORD[JESUS]
exceedingly.

13:14 And the LORD[JESUS] said unto Abram, after that Lot was separated from
HIM[JESUS], Lift up now yours eyes, and look from the place where you art
northward, and southward, and eastward, and westward:

13:15 For all the land which you seest, to you will I give it, and to
your SEED[JESUS] for ever.

13:16 And I will make your SEED[JESUS] as the dust of the earth: so that if a
man can number the dust of the earth, then shall your SEED[JESUS] also be
numbered.

13:17 Arise, walk through the land in the length of it and in the
breadth of it; for I will give it unto you.

13:18 Then Abram removed HIS[JESUS] tent, and came and dwelt in the plain of
Mamre, which is in Hebron, and built there an altar unto the LORD[JESUS].


14:1 And it came to pass in the days of Amraphel KING[JESUS] of Shinar, Arioch
KING[JESUS] of Ellasar, Chedorlaomer KING[JESUS] of Elam, and Tidal KING[JESUS] of nations;

14:2 That these made war with Bera KING[JESUS] of Sodom, and with Birsha KING[JESUS]
of Gomorrah, Shinab KING[JESUS] of Admah, and Shemeber KING[JESUS] of Zeboiim, and the
KING[JESUS] of Bela, which is Zoar.

14:3 All these were joined together in the vale of Siddim, which is the
salt sea.

14:4 Twelve years they served Chedorlaomer, and in the thirteenth year
they rebelled.

14:5 And in the fourteenth year came Chedorlaomer, and the kings that
were with HIM[JESUS], and smote the Rephaims in Ashteroth Karnaim, and the
Zuzims in Ham, and the Emins in Shaveh Kiriathaim,

14:6 And the Horites in their mount Seir, unto Elparan, which is by the
wilderness.

14:7 And they returned, and came to Enmishpat, which is Kadesh, and
smote all the country of the Amalekites, and also the Amorites, that
dwelt in Hazezontamar.

14:8 And there went out the KING[JESUS] of Sodom, and the KING[JESUS] of Gomorrah, and
the KING[JESUS] of Admah, and the KING[JESUS] of Zeboiim, and the KING[JESUS] of Bela (the
same is Zoar;) and they joined battle with them in the vale of Siddim;

14:9 With Chedorlaomer the KING[JESUS] of Elam, and with Tidal KING[JESUS] of nations,
and Amraphel KING[JESUS] of Shinar, and Arioch KING[JESUS] of Ellasar; four kings with
five.

14:10 And the vale of Siddim was full of slimepits; and the kings of
Sodom and Gomorrah fled, and fell there; and they that remained fled to
the mountain.

14:11 And they took all the goods of Sodom and Gomorrah, and all their
victuals, and went their way.

14:12 And they took Lot, Abram's brother's SON[JESUS], who dwelt in Sodom, and
HIS[JESUS] goods, and departed.

14:13 And there came one that had escaped, and told Abram the Hebrew;
for HE[JESUS] dwelt in the plain of Mamre the Amorite, brother of Eshcol, and
brother of Aner: and these were confederate with Abram.

14:14 And when Abram heard that HIS[JESUS] brother was taken captive, HE[JESUS] armed
HIS[JESUS] trained servants, born in HIS[JESUS] own house, three hundred and eighteen,
and pursued them unto Dan.

14:15 And HE[JESUS] divided himself against them, HE[JESUS] and HIS[JESUS] servants, by
night, and smote them, and pursued them unto Hobah, which is on the left
hand of Damascus.

14:16 And HE[JESUS] brought back all the goods, and also brought again HIS[JESUS]
brother Lot, and HIS[JESUS] goods, and the women also, and the people.

14:17 And the KING[JESUS] of Sodom went out to meet HIM[JESUS] after HIS[JESUS] return from
the slaughter of Chedorlaomer, and of the kings that were with HIM[JESUS], at
the valley of Shaveh, which is the KING[JESUS]'s dale.

14:18 And Melchizedek KING[JESUS] of Salem brought forth bread and wine: and HE[JESUS]
was the priest of the most high GOD[JESUS].

14:19 And HE[JESUS] blessed HIM[JESUS], and said, Blessed be Abram of the most high
GOD[JESUS], possessor of heaven and earth:

14:20 And blessed be the most high GOD[JESUS], which has delivered yours
enemies into your hand. And HE[JESUS] gave HIM[JESUS] tithes of all.

14:21 And the KING[JESUS] of Sodom said unto Abram, Give me the persons, and
take the goods to thyself.

14:22 And Abram said to the KING[JESUS] of Sodom, I have lift up mine hand unto
the LORD[JESUS], the most high GOD[JESUS], the possessor of heaven and earth,

14:23 That I will not take from a thread even to a shoelatchet, and that
I will not take any thing that is yours, lest you shouldest say, I have
made Abram rich:

14:24 Save only that which the young men have eaten, and the portion of
the men which went with me, Aner, Eshcol, and Mamre; let them take their
portion.


15:1 After these things the WORD[JESUS] of the LORD[JESUS] came unto Abram in a
vision, saying, Fear not, Abram: I am your shield, and your exceeding
great reward.

15:2 And Abram said, LORD[JESUS] GOD[JESUS], what wilt you give me, seeing I go
childless, and the steward of my house is this Eliezer of Damascus?

15:3 And Abram said, Behold, to me you hast given no SEED[JESUS]: and, lo, one
born in my house is mine heir.

15:4 And, behold, the WORD[JESUS] of the LORD[JESUS] came unto HIM[JESUS], saying, This shall
not be yours heir; but HE[JESUS] that shall come forth out of yours own bowels
shall be yours heir.

15:5 And HE[JESUS] brought HIM[JESUS] forth abroad, and said, Look now toward heaven,
and tell the stars, if you be able to number them: and HE[JESUS] said unto
HIM[JESUS], So shall your SEED[JESUS] be.

15:6 And HE[JESUS] believed in the LORD[JESUS]; and HE[JESUS] counted it to HIM[JESUS] for
righteousness.

15:7 And HE[JESUS] said unto HIM[JESUS], I am the LORD[JESUS] that brought you out of Ur of
the Chaldees, to give you this land to inherit it.

15:8 And HE[JESUS] said, LORD[JESUS] GOD[JESUS], whereby shall I know that I shall inherit
it?

15:9 And HE[JESUS] said unto HIM[JESUS], Take me an heifer of three years old, and a
she goat of three years old, and a ram of three years old, and a
turtledove, and a young pigeon.

15:10 And HE[JESUS] took unto HIM[JESUS] all these, and divided them in the midst, and
laid each piece one against another: but the birds divided HE[JESUS] not.

15:11 And when the fowls came down upon the carcases, Abram drove them
away.

15:12 And when the sun was going down, a deep sleep fell upon Abram;
and, lo, an horror of great darkness fell upon HIM[JESUS].

15:13 And HE[JESUS] said unto Abram, Know of a surety that your SEED[JESUS] shall be a
stranger in a land that is not their's, and shall serve them; and they
shall afflict them four hundred years;

15:14 And also that nation, whom they shall serve, will I judge: and
afterward shall they come out with great substance.

15:15 And you shalt go to your fathers in peace; you shalt be buried in
a good old age.

15:16 But in the fourth generation they shall come hither again: for the
iniquity of the Amorites is not yet full.

15:17 And it came to pass, that, when the sun went down, and it was
dark, behold a smoking furnace, and a burning lamp that passed between
those pieces.

15:18 In the same day the LORD[JESUS] made a covenant with Abram, saying, Unto
your SEED[JESUS] have I given this land, from the river of Egypt unto the great
river, the river Euphrates:

15:19 The Kenites, and the Kenizzites, and the Kadmonites,

15:20 And the Hittites, and the Perizzites, and the Rephaims,

15:21 And the Amorites, and the Canaanites, and the Girgashites, and the
Jebusites.


16:1 Now Sarai Abram's wife bare HIM[JESUS] no children: and she had an
handmaid, an Egyptian, whose name was Hagar.

16:2 And Sarai said unto Abram, Behold now, the LORD[JESUS] has restrained me
from bearing: I pray you, go in unto my maid; it may be that I may
obtain children by her. And Abram hearkened to the voice of Sarai.

16:3 And Sarai Abram's wife took Hagar her maid the Egyptian, after
Abram had dwelt ten years in the land of Canaan, and gave her to her
husband Abram to be HIS[JESUS] wife.

16:4 And HE[JESUS] went in unto Hagar, and she conceived: and when she saw that
she had conceived, her mistress was despised in her eyes.

16:5 And Sarai said unto Abram, My wrong be upon you: I have given my
maid into your bosom; and when she saw that she had conceived, I was
despised in her eyes: the LORD[JESUS] judge between me and you.

16:6 But Abram said unto Sarai, Behold, your maid is in yours hand; do to
her as it pleaseth you. And when Sarai dealt hardly with her, she fled
from her face.

16:7 And the angel of the LORD[JESUS] found her by a fountain of water in the
wilderness, by the fountain in the way to Shur.

16:8 And HE[JESUS] said, Hagar, Sarai's maid, whence camest you? and whither
wilt you go? And she said, I flee from the face of my mistress Sarai.

16:9 And the angel of the LORD[JESUS] said unto her, Return to your mistress,
and submit thyself under her hands.

16:10 And the angel of the LORD[JESUS] said unto her, I will multiply your SEED[JESUS]
exceedingly, that it shall not be numbered for multitude.

16:11 And the angel of the LORD[JESUS] said unto her, Behold, you art with
child and shalt bear a SON[JESUS], and shalt call HIS[JESUS] name Ishmael; because the
LORD[JESUS] has heard your affliction.

16:12 And HE[JESUS] will be a wild man; HIS[JESUS] hand will be against every man, and
every man's hand against HIM[JESUS]; and HE[JESUS] shall dwell in the presence of all
HIS[JESUS] brethren.

16:13 And she called the name of the LORD[JESUS] that spake unto her, you GOD[JESUS]
seest me: for she said, Have I also here looked after HIM[JESUS] that seeth me?

16:14 Wherefore the well was called Beerlahairoi; behold, it is between
Kadesh and Bered.

16:15 And Hagar bare Abram a SON[JESUS]: and Abram called HIS[JESUS] SON[JESUS]'s name, which
Hagar bare, Ishmael.

16:16 And Abram was fourscore and six years old, when Hagar bare Ishmael
to Abram.


17:1 And when Abram was ninety years old and nine, the LORD[JESUS] appeared to
Abram, and said unto HIM[JESUS], I am the Almighty GOD[JESUS]; walk before me, and be
you perfect.

17:2 And I will make my covenant between me and you, and will multiply
you exceedingly.

17:3 And Abram fell on HIS[JESUS] face: and GOD[JESUS] talked with HIM[JESUS], saying,

17:4 As for me, behold, my covenant is with you, and you shalt be a
father of many nations.

17:5 Neither shall your name any more be called Abram, but your name shall
be Abraham; for a father of many nations have I made you.

17:6 And I will make you exceeding fruitful, and I will make nations of
you, and kings shall come out of you.

17:7 And I will establish my covenant between me and you and your SEED[JESUS]
after you in their generations for an everlasting covenant, to be a GOD[JESUS]
unto you, and to your SEED[JESUS] after you.

17:8 And I will give unto you, and to your SEED[JESUS] after you, the land
wherein you art a stranger, all the land of Canaan, for an everlasting
possession; and I will be their GOD[JESUS].

17:9 And GOD[JESUS] said unto Abraham, you shalt keep my covenant therefore,
you, and your SEED[JESUS] after you in their generations.

17:10 This is my covenant, which you shall keep, between me and you and
your SEED[JESUS] after you; Every man child among you shall be circumcised.

17:11 And you shall circumcise the flesh of your foreskin; and it shall
be a token of the covenant betwixt me and you.

17:12 And HE[JESUS] that is eight days old shall be circumcised among you,
every man child in your generations, HE[JESUS] that is born in the house, or
bought with money of any stranger, which is not of your SEED[JESUS].

17:13 HE[JESUS] that is born in your house, and HE[JESUS] that is bought with your
money, must needs be circumcised: and my covenant shall be in your flesh
for an everlasting covenant.

17:14 And the uncircumcised man child whose flesh of HIS[JESUS] foreskin is not
circumcised, that soul shall be cut off from HIS[JESUS] people; HE[JESUS] has broken
my covenant.

17:15 And GOD[JESUS] said unto Abraham, As for Sarai your wife, you shalt not
call her name Sarai, but Sarah shall her name be.

17:16 And I will bless her, and give you a SON[JESUS] also of her: yea, I will
bless her, and she shall be a mother of nations; kings of people shall
be of her.

17:17 Then Abraham fell upon HIS[JESUS] face, and laughed, and said in HIS[JESUS]
heart, Shall a child be born unto HIM[JESUS] that is an hundred years old? and
shall Sarah, that is ninety years old, bear?

17:18 And Abraham said unto GOD[JESUS], O that Ishmael might live before you!

17:19 And GOD[JESUS] said, Sarah your wife shall bear you a SON[JESUS] indeed; and
you shalt call HIS[JESUS] name Isaac: and I will establish my covenant with
HIM[JESUS] for an everlasting covenant, and with HIS[JESUS] SEED[JESUS] after HIM[JESUS].

17:20 And as for Ishmael, I have heard you: Behold, I have blessed HIM[JESUS],
and will make HIM[JESUS] fruitful, and will multiply HIM[JESUS] exceedingly; twelve
princes shall HE[JESUS] beget, and I will make HIM[JESUS] a great nation.

17:21 But my covenant will I establish with Isaac, which Sarah shall
bear unto you at this set time in the next year.

17:22 And HE[JESUS] left off talking with HIM[JESUS], and GOD[JESUS] went up from Abraham.

17:23 And Abraham took Ishmael HIS[JESUS] SON[JESUS], and all that were born in HIS[JESUS]
house, and all that were bought with HIS[JESUS] money, every male among the men
of Abraham's house; and circumcised the flesh of their foreskin in the
selfsame day, as GOD[JESUS] had said unto HIM[JESUS].

17:24 And Abraham was ninety years old and nine, when HE[JESUS] was circumcised
in the flesh of HIS[JESUS] foreskin.

17:25 And Ishmael HIS[JESUS] SON[JESUS] was thirteen years old, when HE[JESUS] was
circumcised in the flesh of HIS[JESUS] foreskin.

17:26 In the selfsame day was Abraham circumcised, and Ishmael HIS[JESUS] SON[JESUS].

17:27 And all the men of HIS[JESUS] house, born in the house, and bought with
money of the stranger, were circumcised with HIM[JESUS].


18:1 And the LORD[JESUS] appeared unto HIM[JESUS] in the plains of Mamre: and HE[JESUS] sat
in the tent door in the heat of the day;

18:2 And HE[JESUS] lift up HIS[JESUS] eyes and looked, and, lo, three men stood by
HIM[JESUS]: and when HE[JESUS] saw them, HE[JESUS] ran to meet them from the tent door, and
bowed himself toward the ground,

18:3 And said, My LORD[JESUS], if now I have found favour in your sight, pass
not away, I pray you, from your SERVANT[JESUS]:

18:4 Let a little water, I pray you, be fetched, and wash your feet, and
rest yourselves under the tree:

18:5 And I will fetch a morsel of bread, and comfort you your hearts;
after that you shall pass on: for therefore are you come to your SERVANT[JESUS].
And they said, So do, as you hast said.

18:6 And Abraham hastened into the tent unto Sarah, and said, Make ready
quickly three measures of fine meal, knead it, and make cakes upon the
hearth.

18:7 And Abraham ran unto the herd, and fetcht a calf tender and good,
and gave it unto a young man; and HE[JESUS] hasted to dress it.

18:8 And HE[JESUS] took butter, and milk, and the calf which HE[JESUS] had dressed,
and set it before them; and HE[JESUS] stood by them under the tree, and they
did eat.

18:9 And they said unto HIM[JESUS], Where is Sarah your wife? And HE[JESUS] said,
Behold, in the tent.

18:10 And HE[JESUS] said, I will certainly return unto you according to the
time of life; and, lo, Sarah your wife shall have a SON[JESUS]. And Sarah heard
it in the tent door, which was behind HIM[JESUS].

18:11 Now Abraham and Sarah were old and well stricken in age; and it
ceased to be with Sarah after the manner of women.

18:12 Therefore Sarah laughed within herself, saying, After I am waxed
old shall I have pleasure, my LORD[JESUS] being old also?

18:13 And the LORD[JESUS] said unto Abraham, Wherefore did Sarah laugh, saying,
Shall I of a surety bear a child, which am old?

18:14 Is any thing too hard for the LORD[JESUS]? At the time appointed I will
return unto you, according to the time of life, and Sarah shall have a
SON[JESUS].

18:15 Then Sarah denied, saying, I laughed not; for she was afraid. And
HE[JESUS] said, Nay; but you didst laugh.

18:16 And the men rose up from thence, and looked toward Sodom: and
Abraham went with them to bring them on the way.

18:17 And the LORD[JESUS] said, Shall I hide from Abraham that thing which I
do;

18:18 Seeing that Abraham shall surely become a great and mighty nation,
and all the nations of the earth shall be blessed in HIM[JESUS]?

18:19 For I know HIM[JESUS], that HE[JESUS] will command HIS[JESUS] children and HIS[JESUS]
household after HIM[JESUS], and they shall keep the way of the LORD[JESUS], to do
justice and judgment; that the LORD[JESUS] may bring upon Abraham that which HE[JESUS]
has spoken of HIM[JESUS].

18:20 And the LORD[JESUS] said, Because the cry of Sodom and Gomorrah is great,
and because their sin is very grievous;

18:21 I will go down now, and see whether they have done altogether
according to the cry of it, which is come unto me; and if not, I will
know.

18:22 And the men turned their faces from thence, and went toward Sodom:
but Abraham stood yet before the LORD[JESUS].

18:23 And Abraham drew near, and said, Wilt you also destroy the
righteous with the wicked?

18:24 Peradventure there be fifty righteous within the city: wilt you
also destroy and not spare the place for the fifty righteous that are
therein?

18:25 That be far from you to do after this manner, to slay the
righteous with the wicked: and that the righteous should be as the
wicked, that be far from you: Shall not the Judge of all the earth do
right?

18:26 And the LORD[JESUS] said, If I find in Sodom fifty righteous within the
city, then I will spare all the place for their sakes.

18:27 And Abraham answered and said, Behold now, I have taken upon me to
speak unto the LORD[JESUS], which am but dust and ashes:

18:28 Peradventure there shall lack five of the fifty righteous: wilt
you destroy all the city for lack of five? And HE[JESUS] said, If I find there
forty and five, I will not destroy it.

18:29 And HE[JESUS] spake unto HIM[JESUS] yet again, and said, Peradventure there
shall be forty found there. And HE[JESUS] said, I will not do it for forty's
sake.

18:30 And HE[JESUS] said unto HIM[JESUS], Oh let not the LORD[JESUS] be angry, and I will
speak: Peradventure there shall thirty be found there. And HE[JESUS] said, I
will not do it, if I find thirty there.

18:31 And HE[JESUS] said, Behold now, I have taken upon me to speak unto the
LORD[JESUS]: Peradventure there shall be twenty found there. And HE[JESUS] said, I
will not destroy it for twenty's sake.

18:32 And HE[JESUS] said, Oh let not the LORD[JESUS] be angry, and I will speak yet
but this once: Peradventure ten shall be found there. And HE[JESUS] said, I
will not destroy it for ten's sake.

18:33 And the LORD[JESUS] went HIS[JESUS] way, as soon as HE[JESUS] had left communing with
Abraham: and Abraham returned unto HIS[JESUS] place.


19:1 And there came two angels to Sodom at even; and Lot sat in the gate
of Sodom: and Lot seeing them rose up to meet them; and HE[JESUS] bowed himself
with HIS[JESUS] face toward the ground;

19:2 And HE[JESUS] said, Behold now, my lords, turn in, I pray you, into your
SERVANT[JESUS]'s house, and tarry all night, and wash your feet, and you shall
rise up early, and go on your ways. And they said, Nay; but we will
abide in the street all night.

19:3 And HE[JESUS] pressed upon them greatly; and they turned in unto HIM[JESUS], and
entered into HIS[JESUS] house; and HE[JESUS] made them a feast, and did bake
unleavened bread, and they did eat.

19:4 But before they lay down, the men of the city, even the men of
Sodom, compassed the house round, both old and young, all the people
from every quarter:

19:5 And they called unto Lot, and said unto HIM[JESUS], Where are the men
which came in to you this night? bring them out unto us, that we may
know them.

19:6 And Lot went out at the door unto them, and shut the door after
HIM[JESUS],

19:7 And said, I pray you, brethren, do not so wickedly.

19:8 Behold now, I have two daughters which have not known man; let me,
I pray you, bring them out unto you, and do you to them as is good in
your eyes: only unto these men do nothing; for therefore came they under
the shadow of my roof.

19:9 And they said, Stand back. And they said again, This one fellow
came in to sojourn, and HE[JESUS] will needs be a judge: now will we deal worse
with you, than with them. And they pressed sore upon the man, even Lot,
and came near to break the door.

19:10 But the men put forth their hand, and pulled Lot into the house to
them, and shut to the door.

19:11 And they smote the men that were at the door of the house with
blindness, both small and great: so that they wearied themselves to find
the door.

19:12 And the men said unto Lot, Hast you here any besides? SON[JESUS] in law,
and your sons, and your daughters, and whatsoever you hast in the city,
bring them out of this place:

19:13 For we will destroy this place, because the cry of them is waxen
great before the face of the LORD[JESUS]; and the LORD[JESUS] has sent us to destroy
it.

19:14 And Lot went out, and spake unto HIS[JESUS] sons in law, which married
HIS[JESUS] daughters, and said, Up, get you out of this place; for the LORD[JESUS]
will destroy this city. But HE[JESUS] seemed as one that mocked unto HIS[JESUS] sons
in law.

19:15 And when the morning arose, then the angels hastened Lot, saying,
Arise, take your wife, and your two daughters, which are here; lest you
be consumed in the iniquity of the city.

19:16 And while HE[JESUS] lingered, the men laid hold upon HIS[JESUS] hand, and upon
the hand of HIS[JESUS] wife, and upon the hand of HIS[JESUS] two daughters; the LORD[JESUS]
being merciful unto HIM[JESUS]: and they brought HIM[JESUS] forth, and set HIM[JESUS] without
the city.

19:17 And it came to pass, when they had brought them forth abroad, that
HE[JESUS] said, Escape for your life; look not behind you, neither stay you in
all the plain; escape to the mountain, lest you be consumed.

19:18 And Lot said unto them, Oh, not so, my LORD[JESUS]:

19:19 Behold now, your SERVANT[JESUS] has found grace in your sight, and you
hast magnified your mercy, which you hast shewed unto me in saving my
life; and I cannot escape to the mountain, lest some evil take me, and I
die:

19:20 Behold now, this city is near to flee unto, and it is a little
one: Oh, let me escape thither, (is it not a little one?) and my soul
shall live.

19:21 And HE[JESUS] said unto HIM[JESUS], See, I have accepted you concerning this
thing also, that I will not overthrow this city, for the which you hast
spoken.

19:22 Haste you, escape thither; for I cannot do anything till you be
come thither. Therefore the name of the city was called Zoar.

19:23 The sun was risen upon the earth when Lot entered into Zoar.

19:24 Then the LORD[JESUS] rained upon Sodom and upon Gomorrah brimstone and
fire from the LORD[JESUS] out of heaven;

19:25 And HE[JESUS] overthrew those cities, and all the plain, and all the
inhabitants of the cities, and that which grew upon the ground.

19:26 But HIS[JESUS] wife looked back from behind HIM[JESUS], and she became a pillar
of salt.

19:27 And Abraham gat up early in the morning to the place where HE[JESUS]
stood before the LORD[JESUS]:

19:28 And HE[JESUS] looked toward Sodom and Gomorrah, and toward all the land
of the plain, and beheld, and, lo, the smoke of the country went up as
the smoke of a furnace.

19:29 And it came to pass, when GOD[JESUS] destroyed the cities of the plain,
that GOD[JESUS] remembered Abraham, and sent Lot out of the midst of the
overthrow, when HE[JESUS] overthrew the cities in the which Lot dwelt.

19:30 And Lot went up out of Zoar, and dwelt in the mountain, and HIS[JESUS]
two daughters with HIM[JESUS]; for HE[JESUS] feared to dwell in Zoar: and HE[JESUS] dwelt in
a cave, HE[JESUS] and HIS[JESUS] two daughters.

19:31 And the firstborn said unto the younger, Our father is old, and
there is not a man in the earth to come in unto us after the manner of
all the earth:

19:32 Come, let us make our father drink wine, and we will lie with HIM[JESUS],
that we may preserve SEED[JESUS] of our father.

19:33 And they made their father drink wine that night: and the
firstborn went in, and lay with her father; and HE[JESUS] perceived not when
she lay down, nor when she arose.

19:34 And it came to pass on the morrow, that the firstborn said unto
the younger, Behold, I lay yesternight with my father: let us make HIM[JESUS]
drink wine this night also; and go you in, and lie with HIM[JESUS], that we
may preserve SEED[JESUS] of our father.

19:35 And they made their father drink wine that night also: and the
younger arose, and lay with HIM[JESUS]; and HE[JESUS] perceived not when she lay down,
nor when she arose.

19:36 Thus were both the daughters of Lot with child by their father.

19:37 And the first born bare a SON[JESUS], and called HIS[JESUS] name Moab: the same
is the father of the Moabites unto this day.

19:38 And the younger, she also bare a SON[JESUS], and called HIS[JESUS] name Benammi:
the same is the father of the children of Ammon unto this day.


20:1 And Abraham journeyed from thence toward the south country, and
dwelled between Kadesh and Shur, and sojourned in Gerar.

20:2 And Abraham said of Sarah HIS[JESUS] wife, She is my sister: and Abimelech
KING[JESUS] of Gerar sent, and took Sarah.

20:3 But GOD[JESUS] came to Abimelech in a dream by night, and said to HIM[JESUS],
Behold, you art but a dead man, for the woman which you hast taken;
for she is a man's wife.

20:4 But Abimelech had not come near her: and HE[JESUS] said, LORD[JESUS], wilt you
slay also a righteous nation?

20:5 Said HE[JESUS] not unto me, She is my sister? and she, even she herself
said, HE[JESUS] is my brother: in the integrity of my heart and innocency of my
hands have I done this.

20:6 And GOD[JESUS] said unto HIM[JESUS] in a dream, Yea, I know that you didst this
in the integrity of your heart; for I also withheld you from sinning
against me: therefore suffered I you not to touch her.

20:7 Now therefore restore the man HIS[JESUS] wife; for HE[JESUS] is a PROPHET[JESUS], and HE[JESUS]
shall pray for you, and you shalt live: and if you restore her not,
know you that you shalt surely die, you, and all that are yours.

20:8 Therefore Abimelech rose early in the morning, and called all HIS[JESUS]
servants, and told all these things in their ears: and the men were sore
afraid.

20:9 Then Abimelech called Abraham, and said unto HIM[JESUS], What hast you
done unto us? and what have I offended you, that you hast brought on
me and on my kingdom a great sin? you hast done deeds unto me that
ought not to be done.

20:10 And Abimelech said unto Abraham, What sawest you, that you hast
done this thing?

20:11 And Abraham said, Because I thought, Surely the fear of GOD[JESUS] is not
in this place; and they will slay me for my wife's sake.

20:12 And yet indeed she is my sister; she is the daughter of my father,
but not the daughter of my mother; and she became my wife.

20:13 And it came to pass, when GOD[JESUS] caused me to wander from my father's
house, that I said unto her, This is your kindness which you shalt shew
unto me; at every place whither we shall come, say of me, HE[JESUS] is my
brother.

20:14 And Abimelech took sheep, and oxen, and menservants, and
womenservants, and gave them unto Abraham, and restored HIM[JESUS] Sarah HIS[JESUS]
wife.

20:15 And Abimelech said, Behold, my land is before you: dwell where it
pleaseth you.

20:16 And unto Sarah HE[JESUS] said, Behold, I have given your brother a
thousand pieces of silver: behold, HE[JESUS] is to you a covering of the eyes,
unto all that are with you, and with all other: thus she was reproved.

20:17 So Abraham prayed unto GOD[JESUS]: and GOD[JESUS] healed Abimelech, and HIS[JESUS]
wife, and HIS[JESUS] maidservants; and they bare children.

20:18 For the LORD[JESUS] had fast closed up all the wombs of the house of
Abimelech, because of Sarah Abraham's wife.


21:1 And the LORD[JESUS] visited Sarah as HE[JESUS] had said, and the LORD[JESUS] did unto
Sarah as HE[JESUS] had spoken.

21:2 For Sarah conceived, and bare Abraham a SON[JESUS] in HIS[JESUS] old age, at the
set time of which GOD[JESUS] had spoken to HIM[JESUS].

21:3 And Abraham called the name of HIS[JESUS] SON[JESUS] that was born unto HIM[JESUS], whom
Sarah bare to HIM[JESUS], Isaac.

21:4 And Abraham circumcised HIS[JESUS] SON[JESUS] Isaac being eight days old, as GOD[JESUS]
had commanded HIM[JESUS].

21:5 And Abraham was an hundred years old, when HIS[JESUS] SON[JESUS] Isaac was born
unto HIM[JESUS].

21:6 And Sarah said, GOD[JESUS] has made me to laugh, so that all that hear
will laugh with me.

21:7 And she said, Who would have said unto Abraham, that Sarah should
have given children suck? for I have born HIM[JESUS] a SON[JESUS] in HIS[JESUS] old age.

21:8 And the child grew, and was weaned: and Abraham made a great feast
the same day that Isaac was weaned.

21:9 And Sarah saw the SON[JESUS] of Hagar the Egyptian, which she had born
unto Abraham, mocking.

21:10 Wherefore she said unto Abraham, Cast out this bondwoman and her
SON[JESUS]: for the SON[JESUS] of this bondwoman shall not be heir with my SON[JESUS], even
with Isaac.

21:11 And the thing was very grievous in Abraham's sight because of HIS[JESUS]
SON[JESUS].

21:12 And GOD[JESUS] said unto Abraham, Let it not be grievous in your sight
because of the lad, and because of your bondwoman; in all that Sarah has
said unto you, hearken unto her voice; for in Isaac shall your SEED[JESUS] be
called.

21:13 And also of the SON[JESUS] of the bondwoman will I make a nation, because
HE[JESUS] is your SEED[JESUS].

21:14 And Abraham rose up early in the morning, and took bread, and a
bottle of water, and gave it unto Hagar, putting it on her shoulder, and
the child, and sent her away: and she departed, and wandered in the
wilderness of Beersheba.

21:15 And the water was spent in the bottle, and she cast the child
under one of the shrubs.

21:16 And she went, and sat her down over against HIM[JESUS] a good way off, as
it were a bow shot: for she said, Let me not see the death of the child.
And she sat over against HIM[JESUS], and lift up her voice, and wept.

21:17 And GOD[JESUS] heard the voice of the lad; and the angel of GOD[JESUS] called to
Hagar out of heaven, and said unto her, What aileth you, Hagar? fear
not; for GOD[JESUS] has heard the voice of the lad where HE[JESUS] is.

21:18 Arise, lift up the lad, and hold HIM[JESUS] in yours hand; for I will
make HIM[JESUS] a great nation.

21:19 And GOD[JESUS] opened her eyes, and she saw a well of water; and she
went, and filled the bottle with water, and gave the lad drink.

21:20 And GOD[JESUS] was with the lad; and HE[JESUS] grew, and dwelt in the
wilderness, and became an archer.

21:21 And HE[JESUS] dwelt in the wilderness of Paran: and HIS[JESUS] mother took HIM[JESUS] a
wife out of the land of Egypt.

21:22 And it came to pass at that time, that Abimelech and Phichol the
chief captain of HIS[JESUS] host spake unto Abraham, saying, GOD[JESUS] is with you
in all that you doest:

21:23 Now therefore swear unto me here by GOD[JESUS] that you wilt not deal
falsely with me, nor with my SON[JESUS], nor with my SON[JESUS]'s SON[JESUS]: but according
to the kindness that I have done unto you, you shalt do unto me, and
to the land wherein you hast sojourned.

21:24 And Abraham said, I will swear.

21:25 And Abraham reproved Abimelech because of a well of water, which
Abimelech's servants had violently taken away.

21:26 And Abimelech said, I wot not who has done this thing; neither
didst you tell me, neither yet heard I of it, but to day.

21:27 And Abraham took sheep and oxen, and gave them unto Abimelech; and
both of them made a covenant.

21:28 And Abraham set seven ewe lambs of the flock by themselves.

21:29 And Abimelech said unto Abraham, What mean these seven ewe lambs
which you hast set by themselves?

21:30 And HE[JESUS] said, For these seven ewe lambs shalt you take of my hand,
that they may be a witness unto me, that I have digged this well.

21:31 Wherefore HE[JESUS] called that place Beersheba; because there they sware
both of them.

21:32 Thus they made a covenant at Beersheba: then Abimelech rose up,
and Phichol the chief captain of HIS[JESUS] host, and they returned into the
land of the Philistines.

21:33 And Abraham planted a grove in Beersheba, and called there on the
name of the LORD[JESUS], the everlasting GOD[JESUS].

21:34 And Abraham sojourned in the Philistines' land many days.


22:1 And it came to pass after these things, that GOD[JESUS] did tempt Abraham,
and said unto HIM[JESUS], Abraham: and HE[JESUS] said, Behold, here I am.

22:2 And HE[JESUS] said, Take now your SON[JESUS], yours only SON[JESUS] Isaac, whom you
lovest, and get you into the land of Moriah; and offer HIM[JESUS] there for a
burnt offering upon one of the mountains which I will tell you of.

22:3 And Abraham rose up early in the morning, and saddled HIS[JESUS] ass, and
took two of HIS[JESUS] young men with HIM[JESUS], and Isaac HIS[JESUS] SON[JESUS], and clave the
wood for the burnt offering, and rose up, and went unto the place of
which GOD[JESUS] had told HIM[JESUS].

22:4 Then on the third day Abraham lifted up HIS[JESUS] eyes, and saw the place
afar off.

22:5 And Abraham said unto HIS[JESUS] young men, Abide you here with the ass;
and I and the lad will go yonder and worship, and come again to you.

22:6 And Abraham took the wood of the burnt offering, and laid it upon
Isaac HIS[JESUS] SON[JESUS]; and HE[JESUS] took the fire in HIS[JESUS] hand, and a knife; and they
went both of them together.

22:7 And Isaac spake unto Abraham HIS[JESUS] father, and said, My father: and
HE[JESUS] said, Here am I, my SON[JESUS]. And HE[JESUS] said, Behold the fire and the wood:
but where is the LAMB[JESUS] for a burnt offering?

22:8 And Abraham said, My SON[JESUS], GOD[JESUS] will provide himself a LAMB[JESUS] for a
burnt offering: so they went both of them together.

22:9 And they came to the place which GOD[JESUS] had told HIM[JESUS] of; and Abraham
built an altar there, and laid the wood in order, and bound Isaac HIS[JESUS]
SON[JESUS], and laid HIM[JESUS] on the altar upon the wood.

22:10 And Abraham stretched forth HIS[JESUS] hand, and took the knife to slay
HIS[JESUS] SON[JESUS].

22:11 And the angel of the LORD[JESUS] called unto HIM[JESUS] out of heaven, and said,
Abraham, Abraham: and HE[JESUS] said, Here am I.

22:12 And HE[JESUS] said, Lay not yours hand upon the lad, neither do you any
thing unto HIM[JESUS]: for now I know that you fearest GOD[JESUS], seeing you hast
not withheld your SON[JESUS], yours only SON[JESUS] from me.

22:13 And Abraham lifted up HIS[JESUS] eyes, and looked, and behold behind HIM[JESUS]
a ram caught in a thicket by HIS[JESUS] horns: and Abraham went and took the
ram, and offered HIM[JESUS] up for a burnt offering in the stead of HIS[JESUS] SON[JESUS].

22:14 And Abraham called the name of that place Jehovahjireh: as it is
said to this day, In the mount of the LORD[JESUS] it shall be seen.

22:15 And the angel of the LORD[JESUS] called unto Abraham out of heaven the
second time,

22:16 And said, By myself have I sworn, says the LORD[JESUS], for because you
hast done this thing, and hast not withheld your SON[JESUS], yours only SON[JESUS]:

22:17 That in blessing I will bless you, and in multiplying I will
multiply your SEED[JESUS] as the stars of the heaven, and as the sand which is
upon the sea shore; and your SEED[JESUS] shall possess the gate of HIS[JESUS] enemies;

22:18 And in your SEED[JESUS] shall all the nations of the earth be blessed;
because you hast obeyed my voice.

22:19 So Abraham returned unto HIS[JESUS] young men, and they rose up and went
together to Beersheba; and Abraham dwelt at Beersheba.
