to Timnath to shear HIS[JESUS] sheep.

38:14 And she put her widow's garments off from her, and covered her
with a vail, and wrapped herself, and sat in an open place, which is by
the way to Timnath; for she saw that Shelah was grown, and she was not
given unto HIM[JESUS] to wife.

38:15 When Judah saw her, HE[JESUS] thought her to be an harlot; because she
had covered her face.

38:16 And HE[JESUS] turned unto her by the way, and said, Go to, I pray you,
let me come in unto you; (for HE[JESUS] knew not that she was HIS[JESUS] daughter in
law.) And she said, What wilt you give me, that you mayest come in
unto me?

38:17 And HE[JESUS] said, I will send you a kid from the flock. And she said,
Wilt you give me a pledge, till you send it?

38:18 And HE[JESUS] said, What pledge shall I give you? And she said, your
signet, and your bracelets, and your staff that is in yours hand. And HE[JESUS]
gave it her, and came in unto her, and she conceived by HIM[JESUS].

38:19 And she arose, and went away, and laid by her vail from her, and
put on the garments of her widowhood.

38:20 And Judah sent the kid by the hand of HIS[JESUS] friend the Adullamite,
to receive HIS[JESUS] pledge from the woman's hand: but HE[JESUS] found her not.

38:21 Then HE[JESUS] asked the men of that place, saying, Where is the harlot,
that was openly by the way side? And they said, There was no harlot in
this place.

38:22 And HE[JESUS] returned to Judah, and said, I cannot find her; and also
the men of the place said, that there was no harlot in this place.

38:23 And Judah said, Let her take it to her, lest we be shamed: behold,
I sent this kid, and you hast not found her.

38:24 And it came to pass about three months after, that it was told
Judah, saying, Tamar your daughter in law has played the harlot; and
also, behold, she is with child by whoredom. And Judah said, Bring her
forth, and let her be burnt.

38:25 When she was brought forth, she sent to her father in law, saying,
By the man, whose these are, am I with child: and she said, Discern, I
pray you, whose are these, the signet, and bracelets, and staff.

38:26 And Judah acknowledged them, and said, She has been more
righteous than I; because that I gave her not to Shelah my SON[JESUS]. And HE[JESUS]
knew her again no more.

38:27 And it came to pass in the time of her travail, that, behold,
twins were in her womb.

38:28 And it came to pass, when she travailed, that the one put out HIS[JESUS]
hand: and the midwife took and bound upon HIS[JESUS] hand a scarlet thread,
saying, This came out first.

38:29 And it came to pass, as HE[JESUS] drew back HIS[JESUS] hand, that, behold, HIS[JESUS]
brother came out: and she said, How hast you broken forth? this breach
be upon you: therefore HIS[JESUS] name was called Pharez.

38:30 And afterward came out HIS[JESUS] brother, that had the scarlet thread
upon HIS[JESUS] hand: and HIS[JESUS] name was called Zarah.


39:1 And Joseph was brought down to Egypt; and Potiphar, an officer of
Pharaoh, captain of the guard, an Egyptian, bought HIM[JESUS] of the hands of
the Ishmeelites, which had brought HIM[JESUS] down thither.

39:2 And the LORD[JESUS] was with Joseph, and HE[JESUS] was a prosperous man; and HE[JESUS]
was in the house of HIS[JESUS] master the Egyptian.

39:3 And HIS[JESUS] master saw that the LORD[JESUS] was with HIM[JESUS], and that the LORD[JESUS]
made all that HE[JESUS] did to prosper in HIS[JESUS] hand.

39:4 And Joseph found grace in HIS[JESUS] sight, and HE[JESUS] served HIM[JESUS]: and HE[JESUS] made
HIM[JESUS] overseer over HIS[JESUS] house, and all that HE[JESUS] had HE[JESUS] put into HIS[JESUS] hand.

39:5 And it came to pass from the time that HE[JESUS] had made HIM[JESUS] overseer in
HIS[JESUS] house, and over all that HE[JESUS] had, that the LORD[JESUS] blessed the
Egyptian's house for Joseph's sake; and the blessing of the LORD[JESUS] was
upon all that HE[JESUS] had in the house, and in the field.

39:6 And HE[JESUS] left all that HE[JESUS] had in Joseph's hand; and HE[JESUS] knew not ought
HE[JESUS] had, save the bread which HE[JESUS] did eat. And Joseph was a goodly person,
and well favoured.

39:7 And it came to pass after these things, that HIS[JESUS] master's wife cast
her eyes upon Joseph; and she said, Lie with me.

39:8 But HE[JESUS] refused, and said unto HIS[JESUS] master's wife, Behold, my master
wotteth not what is with me in the house, and HE[JESUS] has committed all that
HE[JESUS] has to my hand;

39:9 There is none greater in this house than I; neither has HE[JESUS] kept
back any thing from me but you, because you art HIS[JESUS] wife: how then can
I do this great wickedness, and sin against GOD[JESUS]?

39:10 And it came to pass, as she spake to Joseph day by day, that HE[JESUS]
hearkened not unto her, to lie by her, or to be with her.

39:11 And it came to pass about this time, that Joseph went into the
house to do HIS[JESUS] business; and there was none of the men of the house
there within.

39:12 And she caught HIM[JESUS] by HIS[JESUS] garment, saying, Lie with me: and HE[JESUS]
left HIS[JESUS] garment in her hand, and fled, and got HIM[JESUS] out.

39:13 And it came to pass, when she saw that HE[JESUS] had left HIS[JESUS] garment in
her hand, and was fled forth,

39:14 That she called unto the men of her house, and spake unto them,
saying, See, HE[JESUS] has brought in an Hebrew unto us to mock us; HE[JESUS] came in
unto me to lie with me, and I cried with a loud voice:

39:15 And it came to pass, when HE[JESUS] heard that I lifted up my voice and
cried, that HE[JESUS] left HIS[JESUS] garment with me, and fled, and got HIM[JESUS] out.

39:16 And she laid up HIS[JESUS] garment by her, until HIS[JESUS] LORD[JESUS] came home.

39:17 And she spake unto HIM[JESUS] according to these words, saying, The
Hebrew SERVANT[JESUS], which you hast brought unto us, came in unto me to mock
me:

39:18 And it came to pass, as I lifted up my voice and cried, that HE[JESUS]
left HIS[JESUS] garment with me, and fled out.

39:19 And it came to pass, when HIS[JESUS] master heard the words of HIS[JESUS] wife,
which she spake unto HIM[JESUS], saying, After this manner did your SERVANT[JESUS] to
me; that HIS[JESUS] wrath was kindled.

39:20 And Joseph's master took HIM[JESUS], and put HIM[JESUS] into the prison, a place
where the KING[JESUS]'s prisoners were bound: and HE[JESUS] was there in the prison.

39:21 But the LORD[JESUS] was with Joseph, and shewed HIM[JESUS] mercy, and gave HIM[JESUS]
favour in the sight of the keeper of the prison.

39:22 And the keeper of the prison committed to Joseph's hand all the
prisoners that were in the prison; and whatsoever they did there, HE[JESUS] was
the doer of it.

39:23 The keeper of the prison looked not to any thing that was under
HIS[JESUS] hand; because the LORD[JESUS] was with HIM[JESUS], and that which HE[JESUS] did, the LORD[JESUS]
made it to prosper.


40:1 And it came to pass after these things, that the butler of the KING[JESUS]
of Egypt and HIS[JESUS] baker had offended their LORD[JESUS] the KING[JESUS] of Egypt.

40:2 And Pharaoh was wroth against two of HIS[JESUS] officers, against the
chief of the butlers, and against the chief of the bakers.

40:3 And HE[JESUS] put them in ward in the house of the captain of the guard,
into the prison, the place where Joseph was bound.

40:4 And the captain of the guard charged Joseph with them, and HE[JESUS]
served them: and they continued a season in ward.

40:5 And they dreamed a dream both of them, each man HIS[JESUS] dream in one
night, each man according to the interpretation of HIS[JESUS] dream, the butler
and the baker of the KING[JESUS] of Egypt, which were bound in the prison.

40:6 And Joseph came in unto them in the morning, and looked upon them,
and, behold, they were sad.

40:7 And HE[JESUS] asked Pharaoh's officers that were with HIM[JESUS] in the ward of
HIS[JESUS] LORD[JESUS]'s house, saying, Wherefore look you so sadly to day?

40:8 And they said unto HIM[JESUS], We have dreamed a dream, and there is no
interpreter of it. And Joseph said unto them, Do not interpretations
belong to GOD[JESUS]? tell me them, I pray you.

40:9 And the chief butler told HIS[JESUS] dream to Joseph, and said to HIM[JESUS], In
my dream, behold, a vine was before me;

40:10 And in the vine were three branches: and it was as though it
budded, and her blossoms shot forth; and the clusters thereof brought
forth ripe grapes:

40:11 And Pharaoh's cup was in my hand: and I took the grapes, and
pressed them into Pharaoh's cup, and I gave the cup into Pharaoh's hand.

40:12 And Joseph said unto HIM[JESUS], This is the interpretation of it: The
three branches are three days:

40:13 Yet within three days shall Pharaoh lift up yours head, and
restore you unto your place: and you shalt deliver Pharaoh's cup into
HIS[JESUS] hand, after the former manner when you wast HIS[JESUS] butler.

40:14 But think on me when it shall be well with you, and shew
kindness, I pray you, unto me, and make mention of me unto Pharaoh, and
bring me out of this house:

40:15 For indeed I was stolen away out of the land of the Hebrews: and
here also have I done nothing that they should put me into the dungeon.

40:16 When the chief baker saw that the interpretation was good, HE[JESUS] said
unto Joseph, I also was in my dream, and, behold, I had three white
baskets on my head:

40:17 And in the uppermost basket there was of all manner of bakemeats
for Pharaoh; and the birds did eat them out of the basket upon my head.

40:18 And Joseph answered and said, This is the interpretation thereof:
The three baskets are three days:

40:19 Yet within three days shall Pharaoh lift up your head from off
you, and shall hang you on a tree; and the birds shall eat your flesh
from off you.

40:20 And it came to pass the third day, which was Pharaoh's birthday,
that HE[JESUS] made a feast unto all HIS[JESUS] servants: and HE[JESUS] lifted up the head of
the chief butler and of the chief baker among HIS[JESUS] servants.

40:21 And HE[JESUS] restored the chief butler unto HIS[JESUS] butlership again; and HE[JESUS]
gave the cup into Pharaoh's hand:

40:22 But HE[JESUS] hanged the chief baker: as Joseph had interpreted to them.

40:23 Yet did not the chief butler remember Joseph, but forgat HIM[JESUS].


41:1 And it came to pass at the end of two full years, that Pharaoh
dreamed: and, behold, HE[JESUS] stood by the river.

41:2 And, behold, there came up out of the river seven well favoured
kine and fatfleshed; and they fed in a meadow.

41:3 And, behold, seven other kine came up after them out of the river,
ill favoured and leanfleshed; and stood by the other kine upon the brink
of the river.

41:4 And the ill favoured and leanfleshed kine did eat up the seven well
favoured and fat kine. So Pharaoh awoke.

41:5 And HE[JESUS] slept and dreamed the second time: and, behold, seven ears
of corn came up upon one stalk, rank and good.

41:6 And, behold, seven thin ears and blasted with the east wind sprung
up after them.

41:7 And the seven thin ears devoured the seven rank and full ears. And
Pharaoh awoke, and, behold, it was a dream.

41:8 And it came to pass in the morning that HIS[JESUS] spirit was troubled;
and HE[JESUS] sent and called for all the magicians of Egypt, and all the wise
men thereof: and Pharaoh told them HIS[JESUS] dream; but there was none that
could interpret them unto Pharaoh.

41:9 Then spake the chief butler unto Pharaoh, saying, I do remember my
faults this day:

41:10 Pharaoh was wroth with HIS[JESUS] servants, and put me in ward in the
captain of the guard's house, both me and the chief baker:

41:11 And we dreamed a dream in one night, I and HE[JESUS]; we dreamed each man
according to the interpretation of HIS[JESUS] dream.

41:12 And there was there with us a young man, an Hebrew, SERVANT[JESUS] to the
captain of the guard; and we told HIM[JESUS], and HE[JESUS] interpreted to us our
dreams; to each man according to HIS[JESUS] dream HE[JESUS] did interpret.

41:13 And it came to pass, as HE[JESUS] interpreted to us, so it was; me HE[JESUS]
restored unto mine office, and HIM[JESUS] HE[JESUS] hanged.

41:14 Then Pharaoh sent and called Joseph, and they brought HIM[JESUS] hastily
out of the dungeon: and HE[JESUS] shaved himself, and changed HIS[JESUS] raiment, and
came in unto Pharaoh.

41:15 And Pharaoh said unto Joseph, I have dreamed a dream, and there is
none that can interpret it: and I have heard say of you, that you
canst understand a dream to interpret it.

41:16 And Joseph answered Pharaoh, saying, It is not in me: GOD[JESUS] shall
give Pharaoh an answer of peace.

41:17 And Pharaoh said unto Joseph, In my dream, behold, I stood upon
the bank of the river:

41:18 And, behold, there came up out of the river seven kine, fatfleshed
and well favoured; and they fed in a meadow:

41:19 And, behold, seven other kine came up after them, poor and very
ill favoured and leanfleshed, such as I never saw in all the land of
Egypt for badness:

41:20 And the lean and the ill favoured kine did eat up the first seven
fat kine:

41:21 And when they had eaten them up, it could not be known that they
had eaten them; but they were still ill favoured, as at the beginning.
So I awoke.

41:22 And I saw in my dream, and, behold, seven ears came up in one
stalk, full and good:

41:23 And, behold, seven ears, withered, thin, and blasted with the east
wind, sprung up after them:

41:24 And the thin ears devoured the seven good ears: and I told this
unto the magicians; but there was none that could declare it to me.

41:25 And Joseph said unto Pharaoh, The dream of Pharaoh is one: GOD[JESUS]
has shewed Pharaoh what HE[JESUS] is about to do.

41:26 The seven good kine are seven years; and the seven good ears are
seven years: the dream is one.

41:27 And the seven thin and ill favoured kine that came up after them
are seven years; and the seven empty ears blasted with the east wind
shall be seven years of famine.

41:28 This is the thing which I have spoken unto Pharaoh: What GOD[JESUS] is
about to do HE[JESUS] sheweth unto Pharaoh.

41:29 Behold, there come seven years of great plenty throughout all the
land of Egypt:

41:30 And there shall arise after them seven years of famine; and all
the plenty shall be forgotten in the land of Egypt; and the famine shall
consume the land;

41:31 And the plenty shall not be known in the land by reason of that
famine following; for it shall be very grievous.

41:32 And for that the dream was doubled unto Pharaoh twice; it is
because the thing is established by GOD[JESUS], and GOD[JESUS] will shortly bring it
to pass.

41:33 Now therefore let Pharaoh look out a man discreet and wise, and
set HIM[JESUS] over the land of Egypt.

41:34 Let Pharaoh do this, and let HIM[JESUS] appoint officers over the land,
and take up the fifth part of the land of Egypt in the seven plenteous
years.

41:35 And let them gather all the food of those good years that come,
and lay up corn under the hand of Pharaoh, and let them keep food in the
cities.

41:36 And that food shall be for store to the land against the seven
years of famine, which shall be in the land of Egypt; that the land
perish not through the famine.

41:37 And the thing was good in the eyes of Pharaoh, and in the eyes of
all HIS[JESUS] servants.

41:38 And Pharaoh said unto HIS[JESUS] servants, Can we find such a one as this
is, a man in whom the Spirit of GOD[JESUS] is?

41:39 And Pharaoh said unto Joseph, Forasmuch as GOD[JESUS] has shewed you
all this, there is none so discreet and wise as you art:

41:40 you shalt be over my house, and according unto your WORD[JESUS] shall all
my people be ruled: only in the throne will I be greater than you.

41:41 And Pharaoh said unto Joseph, See, I have set you over all the
land of Egypt.

41:42 And Pharaoh took off HIS[JESUS] ring from HIS[JESUS] hand, and put it upon
Joseph's hand, and arrayed HIM[JESUS] in vestures of fine linen, and put a gold
chain about HIS[JESUS] neck;

41:43 And HE[JESUS] made HIM[JESUS] to ride in the second chariot which HE[JESUS] had; and
they cried before HIM[JESUS], Bow the knee: and HE[JESUS] made HIM[JESUS] ruler over all the
land of Egypt.

41:44 And Pharaoh said unto Joseph, I am Pharaoh, and without you shall
no man lift up HIS[JESUS] hand or foot in all the land of Egypt.

41:45 And Pharaoh called Joseph's name Zaphnathpaaneah; and HE[JESUS] gave HIM[JESUS]
to wife Asenath the daughter of Potipherah priest of On. And Joseph went
out over all the land of Egypt.

41:46 And Joseph was thirty years old when HE[JESUS] stood before Pharaoh KING[JESUS]
of Egypt. And Joseph went out from the presence of Pharaoh, and went
throughout all the land of Egypt.

41:47 And in the seven plenteous years the earth brought forth by
handfuls.

41:48 And HE[JESUS] gathered up all the food of the seven years, which were in
the land of Egypt, and laid up the food in the cities: the food of the
field, which was round about every city, laid HE[JESUS] up in the same.

41:49 And Joseph gathered corn as the sand of the sea, very much, until
HE[JESUS] left numbering; for it was without number.

41:50 And unto Joseph were born two sons before the years of famine
came, which Asenath the daughter of Potipherah priest of On bare unto
HIM[JESUS].

41:51 And Joseph called the name of the firstborn Manasseh: For GOD[JESUS],
said HE[JESUS], has made me forget all my toil, and all my father's house.

41:52 And the name of the second called HE[JESUS] Ephraim: For GOD[JESUS] has caused
me to be fruitful in the land of my affliction.

41:53 And the seven years of plenteousness, that was in the land of
Egypt, were ended.

41:54 And the seven years of dearth began to come, according as Joseph
had said: and the dearth was in all lands; but in all the land of Egypt
there was bread.

41:55 And when all the land of Egypt was famished, the people cried to
Pharaoh for bread: and Pharaoh said unto all the Egyptians, Go unto
Joseph; what HE[JESUS] says to you, do.

41:56 And the famine was over all the face of the earth: and Joseph
opened all the storehouses, and sold unto the Egyptians; and the famine
waxed sore in the land of Egypt.

41:57 And all countries came into Egypt to Joseph for to buy corn;
because that the famine was so sore in all lands.


42:1 Now when Jacob saw that there was corn in Egypt, Jacob said unto
HIS[JESUS] sons, Why do you look one upon another?

42:2 And HE[JESUS] said, Behold, I have heard that there is corn in Egypt: get
you down thither, and buy for us from thence; that we may live, and not
die.

42:3 And Joseph's ten brethren went down to buy corn in Egypt.

42:4 But Benjamin, Joseph's brother, Jacob sent not with HIS[JESUS] brethren;
for HE[JESUS] said, Lest peradventure mischief befall HIM[JESUS].

42:5 And the sons of Israel came to buy corn among those that came: for
the famine was in the land of Canaan.

42:6 And Joseph was the governor over the land, and HE[JESUS] it was that sold
to all the people of the land: and Joseph's brethren came, and bowed
down themselves before HIM[JESUS] with their faces to the earth.

42:7 And Joseph saw HIS[JESUS] brethren, and HE[JESUS] knew them, but made himself
strange unto them, and spake roughly unto them; and HE[JESUS] said unto them,
Whence come you? And they said, From the land of Canaan to buy food.

42:8 And Joseph knew HIS[JESUS] brethren, but they knew not HIM[JESUS].

42:9 And Joseph remembered the dreams which HE[JESUS] dreamed of them, and said
unto them, you are spies; to see the nakedness of the land you are come.

42:10 And they said unto HIM[JESUS], Nay, my LORD[JESUS], but to buy food are your
servants come.

42:11 We are all one man's sons; we are true men, your servants are no
spies.

42:12 And HE[JESUS] said unto them, Nay, but to see the nakedness of the land
you are come.

42:13 And they said, your servants are twelve brethren, the sons of one
man in the land of Canaan; and, behold, the youngest is this day with
our father, and one is not.

42:14 And Joseph said unto them, That is it that I spake unto you,
saying, you are spies:

42:15 Hereby you shall be proved: By the life of Pharaoh you shall not go
forth hence, except your youngest brother come hither.

42:16 Send one of you, and let HIM[JESUS] fetch your brother, and you shall be
kept in prison, that your words may be proved, whether there be any
truth in you: or else by the life of Pharaoh surely you are spies.

42:17 And HE[JESUS] put them all together into ward three days.

42:18 And Joseph said unto them the third day, This do, and live; for I
fear GOD[JESUS]:

42:19 If you be true men, let one of your brethren be bound in the house
of your prison: go you, carry corn for the famine of your houses:

42:20 But bring your youngest brother unto me; so shall your words be
verified, and you shall not die. And they did so.

42:21 And they said one to another, We are truly guilty concerning our
brother, in that we saw the anguish of HIS[JESUS] soul, when HE[JESUS] besought us,
and we would not hear; therefore is this distress come upon us.

42:22 And Reuben answered them, saying, Spake I not unto you, saying, Do
not sin against the child; and you would not hear? therefore, behold,
also HIS[JESUS] blood is required.

42:23 And they knew not that Joseph understood them; for HE[JESUS] spake unto
them by an interpreter.

42:24 And HE[JESUS] turned himself about from them, and wept; and returned to
them again, and communed with them, and took from them Simeon, and bound
HIM[JESUS] before their eyes.

42:25 Then Joseph commanded to fill their sacks with corn, and to
restore every man's money into HIS[JESUS] sack, and to give them provision for
the way: and thus did HE[JESUS] unto them.

42:26 And they laded their asses with the corn, and departed thence.

42:27 And as one of them opened HIS[JESUS] sack to give HIS[JESUS] ass provender in
the inn, HE[JESUS] espied HIS[JESUS] money; for, behold, it was in HIS[JESUS] sack's mouth.

42:28 And HE[JESUS] said unto HIS[JESUS] brethren, My money is restored; and, lo, it
is even in my sack: and their heart failed them, and they were afraid,
saying one to another, What is this that GOD[JESUS] has done unto us?

42:29 And they came unto Jacob their father unto the land of Canaan, and
told HIM[JESUS] all that befell unto them; saying,

42:30 The man, who is the LORD[JESUS] of the land, spake roughly to us, and
took us for spies of the country.

42:31 And we said unto HIM[JESUS], We are true men; we are no spies:

42:32 We be twelve brethren, sons of our father; one is not, and the
youngest is this day with our father in the land of Canaan.

42:33 And the man, the LORD[JESUS] of the country, said unto us, Hereby shall I
know that you are true men; leave one of your brethren here with me, and
take food for the famine of your households, and be gone:

42:34 And bring your youngest brother unto me: then shall I know that you
are no spies, but that you are true men: so will I deliver you your
brother, and you shall traffick in the land.

42:35 And it came to pass as they emptied their sacks, that, behold,
every man's bundle of money was in HIS[JESUS] sack: and when both they and
their father saw the bundles of money, they were afraid.

42:36 And Jacob their father said unto them, Me have you bereaved of my
children: Joseph is not, and Simeon is not, and you will take Benjamin
away: all these things are against me.

42:37 And Reuben spake unto HIS[JESUS] father, saying, Slay my two sons, if I
bring HIM[JESUS] not to you: deliver HIM[JESUS] into my hand, and I will bring HIM[JESUS] to
you again.

42:38 And HE[JESUS] said, My SON[JESUS] shall not go down with you; for HIS[JESUS] brother is
dead, and HE[JESUS] is left alone: if mischief befall HIM[JESUS] by the way in the
which you go, then shall you bring down my gray hairs with sorrow to the
grave.


43:1 And the famine was sore in the land.

43:2 And it came to pass, when they had eaten up the corn which they had
brought out of Egypt, their father said unto them, Go again, buy us a
little food.

43:3 And Judah spake unto HIM[JESUS], saying, The man did solemnly protest unto
us, saying, you shall not see my face, except your brother be with you.

43:4 If you wilt send our brother with us, we will go down and buy you
food:

43:5 But if you wilt not send HIM[JESUS], we will not go down: for the man
said unto us, you shall not see my face, except your brother be with you.

43:6 And Israel said, Wherefore dealt you so ill with me, as to tell the
man whether you had yet a brother?

43:7 And they said, The man asked us straitly of our state, and of our
kindred, saying, Is your father yet alive? have you another brother? and
we told HIM[JESUS] according to the tenor of these words: could we certainly
know that HE[JESUS] would say, Bring your brother down?

43:8 And Judah said unto Israel HIS[JESUS] father, Send the lad with me, and we
will arise and go; that we may live, and not die, both we, and you, and
also our little ones.

43:9 I will be surety for HIM[JESUS]; of my hand shalt you require HIM[JESUS]: if I
bring HIM[JESUS] not unto you, and set HIM[JESUS] before you, then let me bear the
blame for ever:

43:10 For except we had lingered, surely now we had returned this second
time.

43:11 And their father Israel said unto them, If it must be so now, do
this; take of the best fruits in the land in your vessels, and carry
down the man a present, a little balm, and a little honey, spices, and
myrrh, nuts, and almonds:

43:12 And take double money in your hand; and the money that was brought
again in the mouth of your sacks, carry it again in your hand;
peradventure it was an oversight:

43:13 Take also your brother, and arise, go again unto the man:

43:14 And GOD[JESUS] Almighty give you mercy before the man, that HE[JESUS] may send
away your other brother, and Benjamin. If I be bereaved of my children,
I am bereaved.

43:15 And the men took that present, and they took double money in their
hand and Benjamin; and rose up, and went down to Egypt, and stood before
Joseph.

43:16 And when Joseph saw Benjamin with them, HE[JESUS] said to the ruler of
HIS[JESUS] house, Bring these men home, and slay, and make ready; for these men
shall dine with me at noon.

43:17 And the man did as Joseph bade; and the man brought the men into
Joseph's house.

43:18 And the men were afraid, because they were brought into Joseph's
house; and they said, Because of the money that was returned in our
sacks at the first time are we brought in; that HE[JESUS] may seek occasion
against us, and fall upon us, and take us for bondmen, and our asses.

43:19 And they came near to the steward of Joseph's house, and they
communed with HIM[JESUS] at the door of the house,

43:20 And said, O sir, we came indeed down at the first time to buy
food:

43:21 And it came to pass, when we came to the inn, that we opened our
sacks, and, behold, every man's money was in the mouth of HIS[JESUS] sack, our
money in full weight: and we have brought it again in our hand.

43:22 And other money have we brought down in our hands to buy food: we
cannot tell who put our money in our sacks.

43:23 And HE[JESUS] said, Peace be to you, fear not: your GOD[JESUS], and the GOD[JESUS] of
your father, has given you treasure in your sacks: I had your money.
And HE[JESUS] brought Simeon out unto them.

43:24 And the man brought the men into Joseph's house, and gave them
water, and they washed their feet; and HE[JESUS] gave their asses provender.

43:25 And they made ready the present against Joseph came at noon: for
they heard that they should eat bread there.

43:26 And when Joseph came home, they brought HIM[JESUS] the present which was
in their hand into the house, and bowed themselves to HIM[JESUS] to the earth.

43:27 And HE[JESUS] asked them of their welfare, and said, Is your father well,
the old man of whom you spake? Is HE[JESUS] yet alive?

43:28 And they answered, your SERVANT[JESUS] our father is in good health, HE[JESUS] is
yet alive. And they bowed down their heads, and made obeisance.

43:29 And HE[JESUS] lifted up HIS[JESUS] eyes, and saw HIS[JESUS] brother Benjamin, HIS[JESUS]
mother's SON[JESUS], and said, Is this your younger brother, of whom you spake
unto me? And HE[JESUS] said, GOD[JESUS] be gracious unto you, my SON[JESUS].

43:30 And Joseph made haste; for HIS[JESUS] bowels did yearn upon HIS[JESUS] brother:
and HE[JESUS] sought where to weep; and HE[JESUS] entered into HIS[JESUS] chamber, and wept
there.

43:31 And HE[JESUS] washed HIS[JESUS] face, and went out, and refrained himself, and
said, Set on bread.

43:32 And they set on for HIM[JESUS] by himself, and for them by themselves,
and for the Egyptians, which did eat with HIM[JESUS], by themselves: because
the Egyptians might not eat bread with the Hebrews; for that is an
abomination unto the Egyptians.

43:33 And they sat before HIM[JESUS], the firstborn according to HIS[JESUS]
birthright, and the youngest according to HIS[JESUS] youth: and the men
marvelled one at another.

43:34 And HE[JESUS] took and sent messes unto them from before HIM[JESUS]: but
Benjamin's mess was five times so much as any of their's. And they
drank, and were merry with HIM[JESUS].


44:1 And HE[JESUS] commanded the steward of HIS[JESUS] house, saying, Fill the men's
sacks with food, as much as they can carry, and put every man's money in
HIS[JESUS] sack's mouth.

44:2 And put my cup, the silver cup, in the sack's mouth of the
youngest, and HIS[JESUS] corn money. And HE[JESUS] did according to the WORD[JESUS] that
Joseph had spoken.

44:3 As soon as the morning was light, the men were sent away, they and
their asses.

44:4 And when they were gone out of the city, and not yet far off,
Joseph said unto HIS[JESUS] steward, Up, follow after the men; and when you
dost overtake them, say unto them, Wherefore have you rewarded evil for
good?

44:5 Is not this it in which my LORD[JESUS] drinketh, and whereby indeed HE[JESUS]
divineth? you have done evil in so doing.

44:6 And HE[JESUS] overtook them, and HE[JESUS] spake unto them these same words.

44:7 And they said unto HIM[JESUS], Wherefore says my LORD[JESUS] these words? GOD[JESUS]
forbid that your servants should do according to this thing:

44:8 Behold, the money, which we found in our sacks' mouths, we brought
again unto you out of the land of Canaan: how then should we steal out
of your LORD[JESUS]'s house silver or gold?

44:9 With whomsoever of your servants it be found, both let HIM[JESUS] die, and
we also will be my LORD[JESUS]'s bondmen.

44:10 And HE[JESUS] said, Now also let it be according unto your words: HE[JESUS] with
whom it is found shall be my SERVANT[JESUS]; and you shall be blameless.

44:11 Then they speedily took down every man HIS[JESUS] sack to the ground, and
opened every man HIS[JESUS] sack.

44:12 And HE[JESUS] searched, and began at the eldest, and left at the
youngest: and the cup was found in Benjamin's sack.

44:13 Then they rent their clothes, and laded every man HIS[JESUS] ass, and
returned to the city.

44:14 And Judah and HIS[JESUS] brethren came to Joseph's house; for HE[JESUS] was yet
there: and they fell before HIM[JESUS] on the ground.

44:15 And Joseph said unto them, What deed is this that you have done?
wot you not that such a man as I can certainly divine?

44:16 And Judah said, What shall we say unto my LORD[JESUS]? what shall we
speak? or how shall we clear ourselves? GOD[JESUS] has found out the iniquity
of your servants: behold, we are my LORD[JESUS]'s servants, both we, and HE[JESUS] also
with whom the cup is found.

44:17 And HE[JESUS] said, GOD[JESUS] forbid that I should do so: but the man in whose
hand the cup is found, HE[JESUS] shall be my SERVANT[JESUS]; and as for you, get you
up in peace unto your father.

44:18 Then Judah came near unto HIM[JESUS], and said, Oh my LORD[JESUS], let your
SERVANT[JESUS], I pray you, speak a WORD[JESUS] in my LORD[JESUS]'s ears, and let not yours
anger burn against your SERVANT[JESUS]: for you art even as Pharaoh.

44:19 My LORD[JESUS] asked HIS[JESUS] servants, saying, Have you a father, or a
brother?

44:20 And we said unto my LORD[JESUS], We have a father, an old man, and a
child of HIS[JESUS] old age, a little one; and HIS[JESUS] brother is dead, and HE[JESUS]
alone is left of HIS[JESUS] mother, and HIS[JESUS] father loveth HIM[JESUS].

44:21 And you saidst unto your servants, Bring HIM[JESUS] down unto me, that I
may set mine eyes upon HIM[JESUS].

44:22 And we said unto my LORD[JESUS], The lad cannot leave HIS[JESUS] father: for if
HE[JESUS] should leave HIS[JESUS] father, HIS[JESUS] father would die.

44:23 And you saidst unto your servants, Except your youngest brother
come down with you, you shall see my face no more.

44:24 And it came to pass when we came up unto your SERVANT[JESUS] my father, we
told HIM[JESUS] the words of my LORD[JESUS].

44:25 And our father said, Go again, and buy us a little food.

44:26 And we said, We cannot go down: if our youngest brother be with
us, then will we go down: for we may not see the man's face, except our
youngest brother be with us.

44:27 And your SERVANT[JESUS] my father said unto us, you know that my wife bare
me two sons:

44:28 And the one went out from me, and I said, Surely HE[JESUS] is torn in
pieces; and I saw HIM[JESUS] not since:

44:29 And if you take this also from me, and mischief befall HIM[JESUS], you
shall bring down my gray hairs with sorrow to the grave.

44:30 Now therefore when I come to your SERVANT[JESUS] my father, and the lad be
not with us; seeing that HIS[JESUS] life is bound up in the lad's life;

44:31 It shall come to pass, when HE[JESUS] seeth that the lad is not with us,
that HE[JESUS] will die: and your servants shall bring down the gray hairs of
your SERVANT[JESUS] our father with sorrow to the grave.

44:32 For your SERVANT[JESUS] became surety for the lad unto my father, saying,
If I bring HIM[JESUS] not unto you, then I shall bear the blame to my father
for ever.

44:33 Now therefore, I pray you, let your SERVANT[JESUS] abide instead of the
lad a bondman to my LORD[JESUS]; and let the lad go up with HIS[JESUS] brethren.

44:34 For how shall I go up to my father, and the lad be not with me?
lest peradventure I see the evil that shall come on my father.


45:1 Then Joseph could not refrain himself before all them that stood by
HIM[JESUS]; and HE[JESUS] cried, Cause every man to go out from me. And there stood no
man with HIM[JESUS], while Joseph made himself known unto HIS[JESUS] brethren.

45:2 And HE[JESUS] wept aloud: and the Egyptians and the house of Pharaoh
heard.

45:3 And Joseph said unto HIS[JESUS] brethren, I am Joseph; does my father yet
live? And HIS[JESUS] brethren could not answer HIM[JESUS]; for they were troubled at
HIS[JESUS] presence.

45:4 And Joseph said unto HIS[JESUS] brethren, Come near to me, I pray you. And
they came near. And HE[JESUS] said, I am Joseph your brother, whom you sold into
Egypt.

45:5 Now therefore be not grieved, nor angry with yourselves, that you
sold me hither: for GOD[JESUS] did send me before you to preserve life.

45:6 For these two years has the famine been in the land: and yet there
are five years, in the which there shall neither be earing nor harvest.

45:7 And GOD[JESUS] sent me before you to preserve you a posterity in the
earth, and to save your lives by a great deliverance.

45:8 So now it was not you that sent me hither, but GOD[JESUS]: and HE[JESUS] has
made me a father to Pharaoh, and LORD[JESUS] of all HIS[JESUS] house, and a ruler
throughout all the land of Egypt.

45:9 Haste you, and go up to my father, and say unto HIM[JESUS], Thus says your
SON[JESUS] Joseph, GOD[JESUS] has made me LORD[JESUS] of all Egypt: come down unto me, tarry
not:

45:10 And you shalt dwell in the land of Goshen, and you shalt be near
unto me, you, and your children, and your children's children, and your
flocks, and your herds, and all that you hast:

45:11 And there will I nourish you; for yet there are five years of
famine; lest you, and your household, and all that you hast, come to
poverty.

45:12 And, behold, your eyes see, and the eyes of my brother Benjamin,
that it is my mouth that speaketh unto you.

45:13 And you shall tell my father of all my glory in Egypt, and of all
that you have seen; and you shall haste and bring down my father hither.

45:14 And HE[JESUS] fell upon HIS[JESUS] brother Benjamin's neck, and wept; and
Benjamin wept upon HIS[JESUS] neck.

45:15 Moreover HE[JESUS] kissed all HIS[JESUS] brethren, and wept upon them: and after
that HIS[JESUS] brethren talked with HIM[JESUS].

45:16 And the fame thereof was heard in Pharaoh's house, saying,
Joseph's brethren are come: and it pleased Pharaoh well, and HIS[JESUS]
servants.

45:17 And Pharaoh said unto Joseph, Say unto your brethren, This do you;
lade your beasts, and go, get you unto the land of Canaan;

45:18 And take your father and your households, and come unto me: and I
will give you the good of the land of Egypt, and you shall eat the fat of
the land.

45:19 Now you art commanded, this do you; take you wagons out of the
land of Egypt for your little ones, and for your wives, and bring your
father, and come.

45:20 Also regard not your stuff; for the good of all the land of Egypt
is your's.

45:21 And the children of Israel did so: and Joseph gave them wagons,
according to the commandment of Pharaoh, and gave them provision for the
way.

45:22 To all of them HE[JESUS] gave each man changes of raiment; but to
Benjamin HE[JESUS] gave three hundred pieces of silver, and five changes of
raiment.

45:23 And to HIS[JESUS] father HE[JESUS] sent after this manner; ten asses laden with
the good things of Egypt, and ten she asses laden with corn and bread
and meat for HIS[JESUS] father by the way.

45:24 So HE[JESUS] sent HIS[JESUS] brethren away, and they departed: and HE[JESUS] said unto
them, See that you fall not out by the way.

45:25 And they went up out of Egypt, and came into the land of Canaan
unto Jacob their father,

45:26 And told HIM[JESUS], saying, Joseph is yet alive, and HE[JESUS] is governor over
all the land of Egypt. And Jacob's heart fainted, for HE[JESUS] believed them
not.

45:27 And they told HIM[JESUS] all the words of Joseph, which HE[JESUS] had said unto
them: and when HE[JESUS] saw the wagons which Joseph had sent to carry HIM[JESUS], the
spirit of Jacob their father revived:

45:28 And Israel said, It is enough; Joseph my SON[JESUS] is yet alive: I will
go and see HIM[JESUS] before I die.

Beersheba, and offered sacrifices unto the GOD[JESUS] of HIS[JESUS] father Isaac.

46:2 And GOD[JESUS] spake unto Israel in the visions of the night, and said,

46:3 And HE[JESUS] said, I am GOD[JESUS], the GOD[JESUS] of your father: fear not to go down
into Egypt; for I will there make of you a great nation:

46:4 I will go down with you into Egypt; and I will also surely bring
you up again: and Joseph shall put HIS[JESUS] hand upon yours eyes.

46:5 And Jacob rose up from Beersheba: and the sons of Israel carried
Jacob their father, and their little ones, and their wives, in the

46:31 And Joseph said unto HIS[JESUS] brethren, and unto HIS[JESUS] father's house, I

46:33 And it shall come to pass, when Pharaoh shall call you, and shall

47:1 Then Joseph came and told Pharaoh, and said, My father and my
brethren, and their flocks, and their herds, and all that they have, are
come out of the land of Canaan; and, behold, they are in the land of
Goshen.

47:2 And HE[JESUS] took some of HIS[JESUS] brethren, even five men, and presented them
unto Pharaoh.

47:3 And Pharaoh said unto HIS[JESUS] brethren, What is your occupation? And
they said unto Pharaoh, your servants are shepherds, both we, and also
our fathers.

47:4 They said morever unto Pharaoh, For to sojourn in the land are we
come; for your servants have no pasture for their flocks; for the famine
is sore in the land of Canaan: now therefore, we pray you, let your
servants dwell in the land of Goshen.

47:5 And Pharaoh spake unto Joseph, saying, your father and your brethren
are come unto you:

47:6 The land of Egypt is before you; in the best of the land make your
father and brethren to dwell; in the land of Goshen let them dwell: and
if you knowest any men of activity among them, then make them rulers
over my cattle.

47:7 And Joseph brought in Jacob HIS[JESUS] father, and set HIM[JESUS] before Pharaoh:
and Jacob blessed Pharaoh.

47:8 And Pharaoh said unto Jacob, How old art you?

47:9 And Jacob said unto Pharaoh, The days of the years of my pilgrimage
are an hundred and thirty years: few and evil have the days of the years
of my life been, and have not attained unto the days of the years of the
life of my fathers in the days of their pilgrimage.

47:10 And Jacob blessed Pharaoh, and went out from before Pharaoh.

47:11 And Joseph placed HIS[JESUS] father and HIS[JESUS] brethren, and gave them a
possession in the land of Egypt, in the best of the land, in the land of
Rameses, as Pharaoh had commanded.

47:12 And Joseph nourished HIS[JESUS] father, and HIS[JESUS] brethren, and all HIS[JESUS]
father's household, with bread, according to their families.

47:13 And there was no bread in all the land; for the famine was very
sore, so that the land of Egypt and all the land of Canaan fainted by
reason of the famine.

47:14 And Joseph gathered up all the money that was found in the land of
Egypt, and in the land of Canaan, for the corn which they bought: and
Joseph brought the money into Pharaoh's house.

47:15 And when money failed in the land of Egypt, and in the land of
Canaan, all the Egyptians came unto Joseph, and said, Give us bread: for
why should we die in your presence? for the money faileth.

47:16 And Joseph said, Give your cattle; and I will give you for your
cattle, if money fail.

47:17 And they brought their cattle unto Joseph: and Joseph gave them
bread in exchange for horses, and for the flocks, and for the cattle of
the herds, and for the asses: and HE[JESUS] fed them with bread for all their
cattle for that year.

47:18 When that year was ended, they came unto HIM[JESUS] the second year, and
said unto HIM[JESUS], We will not hide it from my LORD[JESUS], how that our money is
spent; my LORD[JESUS] also has our herds of cattle; there is not ought left in
the sight of my LORD[JESUS], but our bodies, and our lands:

47:19 Wherefore shall we die before yours eyes, both we and our land?
buy us and our land for bread, and we and our land will be servants unto
Pharaoh: and give us SEED[JESUS], that we may live, and not die, that the land
be not desolate.

47:20 And Joseph bought all the land of Egypt for Pharaoh; for the
Egyptians sold every man HIS[JESUS] field, because the famine prevailed over
them: so the land became Pharaoh's.

47:21 And as for the people, HE[JESUS] removed them to cities from one end of
the borders of Egypt even to the other end thereof.

47:22 Only the land of the priests bought HE[JESUS] not; for the priests had a
portion assigned them of Pharaoh, and did eat their portion which
Pharaoh gave them: wherefore they sold not their lands.

47:23 Then Joseph said unto the people, Behold, I have bought you this
day and your land for Pharaoh: lo, here is SEED[JESUS] for you, and you shall
sow the land.

47:24 And it shall come to pass in the increase, that you shall give the
fifth part unto Pharaoh, and four parts shall be your own, for SEED[JESUS] of
the field, and for your food, and for them of your households, and for
food for your little ones.

47:25 And they said, you hast saved our lives: let us find grace in the
sight of my LORD[JESUS], and we will be Pharaoh's servants.

47:26 And Joseph made it a law over the land of Egypt unto this day,
that Pharaoh should have the fifth part, except the land of the priests
only, which became not Pharaoh's.

47:27 And Israel dwelt in the land of Egypt, in the country of Goshen;
and they had possessions therein, and grew, and multiplied exceedingly.

47:28 And Jacob lived in the land of Egypt seventeen years: so the whole
age of Jacob was an hundred forty and seven years.

47:29 And the time drew nigh that Israel must die: and HE[JESUS] called HIS[JESUS] SON[JESUS]
Joseph, and said unto HIM[JESUS], If now I have found grace in your sight, put,
I pray you, your hand under my thigh, and deal kindly and truly with me;
bury me not, I pray you, in Egypt:

47:30 But I will lie with my fathers, and you shalt carry me out of
Egypt, and bury me in their buryingplace. And HE[JESUS] said, I will do as you
hast said.

47:31 And HE[JESUS] said, Swear unto me. And HE[JESUS] sware unto HIM[JESUS]. And Israel
bowed himself upon the bed's head.


48:1 And it came to pass after these things, that one told Joseph,
Behold, your father is sick: and HE[JESUS] took with HIM[JESUS] HIS[JESUS] two sons, Manasseh
and Ephraim.

48:2 And one told Jacob, and said, Behold, your SON[JESUS] Joseph comes unto
you: and Israel strengthened himself, and sat upon the bed.

48:3 And Jacob said unto Joseph, GOD[JESUS] Almighty appeared unto me at Luz in
the land of Canaan, and blessed me,

48:4 And said unto me, Behold, I will make you fruitful, and multiply
you, and I will make of you a multitude of people; and will give this
land to your SEED[JESUS] after you for an everlasting possession.

48:5 And now your two sons, Ephraim and Manasseh, which were born unto
you in the land of Egypt before I came unto you into Egypt, are mine;
as Reuben and Simeon, they shall be mine.

48:6 And your issue, which you begettest after them, shall be yours, and
shall be called after the name of their brethren in their inheritance.

48:7 And as for me, when I came from Padan, Rachel died by me in the
land of Canaan in the way, when yet there was but a little way to come
unto Ephrath: and I buried her there in the way of Ephrath; the same is
Bethlehem.

48:8 And Israel beheld Joseph's sons, and said, Who are these?

48:9 And Joseph said unto HIS[JESUS] father, They are my sons, whom GOD[JESUS] has
given me in this place. And HE[JESUS] said, Bring them, I pray you, unto me,
and I will bless them.

48:10 Now the eyes of Israel were dim for age, so that HE[JESUS] could not see.
And HE[JESUS] brought them near unto HIM[JESUS]; and HE[JESUS] kissed them, and embraced
them.

48:11 And Israel said unto Joseph, I had not thought to see your face:
and, lo, GOD[JESUS] has shewed me also your SEED[JESUS].

48:12 And Joseph brought them out from between HIS[JESUS] knees, and HE[JESUS] bowed
himself with HIS[JESUS] face to the earth.

48:13 And Joseph took them both, Ephraim in HIS[JESUS] right hand toward
Israel's left hand, and Manasseh in HIS[JESUS] left hand toward Israel's right
hand, and brought them near unto HIM[JESUS].

48:14 And Israel stretched out HIS[JESUS] right hand, and laid it upon
Ephraim's head, who was the younger, and HIS[JESUS] left hand upon Manasseh's

48:15 And HE[JESUS] blessed Joseph, and said, GOD[JESUS], before whom my fathers
Abraham and Isaac did walk, the GOD[JESUS] which fed me all my life long unto

48:16 The Angel which redeemed me from all evil, bless the lads; and let

48:17 And when Joseph saw that HIS[JESUS] father laid HIS[JESUS] right hand upon the

48:18 And Joseph said unto HIS[JESUS] father, Not so, my father: for this is

48:19 And HIS[JESUS] father refused, and said, I know it, my SON[JESUS], I know it: HE[JESUS]
also shall become a people, and HE[JESUS] also shall be great: but truly HIS[JESUS]

48:20 And HE[JESUS] blessed them that day, saying, In you shall Israel bless,

before Manasseh.

48:21 And Israel said unto Joseph, Behold, I die: but GOD[JESUS] shall be with
you, and bring you again unto the land of your fathers.

48:22 Moreover I have given to you one portion above your brethren,
which I took out of the hand of the Amorite with my sword and with my

49:1 And Jacob called unto HIS[JESUS] sons, and said, Gather yourselves
together, that I may tell you that which shall befall you in the last
days.

49:2 Gather yourselves together, and hear, you sons of Jacob; and hearken
unto Israel your father.

49:3 Reuben, you art my firstborn, my might, and the beginning of my
strength, the excellency of dignity, and the excellency of power:

49:4 Unstable as water, you shalt not excel; because you wentest up to
your father's bed; then defiledst you it: HE[JESUS] went up to my couch.

49:5 Simeon and Levi are brethren; instruments of cruelty are in their
habitations.

49:6 O my soul, come not you into their secret; unto their assembly,
mine honour, be not you united: for in their anger they slew a man, and
in their selfwill they digged down a wall.

49:7 Cursed be their anger, for it was fierce; and their wrath, for it
was cruel: I will divide them in Jacob, and scatter them in Israel.

49:8 Judah, you art HE[JESUS] whom your brethren shall praise: your hand shall
be in the neck of yours enemies; your father's children shall bow down
before you.

49:9 Judah is a lion's whelp: from the prey, my SON[JESUS], you art gone up:
HE[JESUS] stooped down, HE[JESUS] couched as a lion, and as an old lion; who shall
rouse HIM[JESUS] up?

49:10 The sceptre shall not depart from Judah, nor a lawgiver from
between HIS[JESUS] feet, until SHILOH[JESUS] come; and unto HIM[JESUS] shall the gathering of
the people be.

49:11 Binding HIS[JESUS] foal unto the vine, and HIS[JESUS] ass's colt unto the choice
vine; HE[JESUS] washed HIS[JESUS] garments in wine, and HIS[JESUS] clothes in the blood of
grapes:

49:12 HIS[JESUS] eyes shall be red with wine, and HIS[JESUS] teeth white with milk.

49:13 Zebulun shall dwell at the haven of the sea; and HE[JESUS] shall be for
an haven of ships; and HIS[JESUS] border shall be unto Zidon.

49:14 Issachar is a strong ass couching down between two burdens:

49:15 And HE[JESUS] saw that rest was good, and the land that it was pleasant;
and bowed HIS[JESUS] shoulder to bear, and became a SERVANT[JESUS] unto tribute.

49:16 Dan shall judge HIS[JESUS] people, as one of the tribes of Israel.

49:17 Dan shall be a serpent by the way, an adder in the path, that
biteth the horse heels, so that HIS[JESUS] rider shall fall backward.

49:18 I have waited for your salvation, O LORD[JESUS].

49:19 Gad, a troop shall overcome HIM[JESUS]: but HE[JESUS] shall overcome at the
last.

49:20 Out of Asher HIS[JESUS] bread shall be fat, and HE[JESUS] shall yield royal
dainties.

49:21 Naphtali is a hind let loose: HE[JESUS] giveth goodly words.

49:22 Joseph is a fruitful bough, even a fruitful bough by a well; whose
branches run over the wall:

49:23 The archers have sorely grieved HIM[JESUS], and shot at HIM[JESUS], and hated
HIM[JESUS]:

49:24 But HIS[JESUS] bow abode in strength, and the arms of HIS[JESUS] hands were made
strong by the hands of the mighty GOD[JESUS] of Jacob; (from thence is the
SHEPHERD[JESUS], the stone of Israel:)

49:25 Even by the GOD[JESUS] of your father, who shall help you; and by the
Almighty, who shall bless you with blessings of heaven above, blessings
of the deep that lieth under, blessings of the breasts, and of the womb:

49:26 The blessings of your father have prevailed above the blessings of
my progenitors unto the utmost bound of the everlasting hills: they
shall be on the head of Joseph, and on the crown of the head of HIM[JESUS] that
was separate from HIS[JESUS] brethren.

49:27 Benjamin shall ravin as a wolf: in the morning HE[JESUS] shall devour the
prey, and at night HE[JESUS] shall divide the spoil.

49:28 All these are the twelve tribes of Israel: and this is it that
their father spake unto them, and blessed them; every one according to
HIS[JESUS] blessing HE[JESUS] blessed them.

49:29 And HE[JESUS] charged them, and said unto them, I am to be gathered unto
my people: bury me with my fathers in the cave that is in the field of
Ephron the Hittite,

49:30 In the cave that is in the field of Machpelah, which is before
Mamre, in the land of Canaan, which Abraham bought with the field of
Ephron the Hittite for a possession of a buryingplace.

49:31 There they buried Abraham and Sarah HIS[JESUS] wife; there they buried
Isaac and Rebekah HIS[JESUS] wife; and there I buried Leah.

49:32 The purchase of the field and of the cave that is therein was from
the children of Heth.

49:33 And when Jacob had made an end of commanding HIS[JESUS] sons, HE[JESUS] gathered
up HIS[JESUS] feet into the bed, and yielded up the ghost, and was gathered
unto HIS[JESUS] people.


50:1 And Joseph fell upon HIS[JESUS] father's face, and wept upon HIM[JESUS], and
kissed HIM[JESUS].

50:2 And Joseph commanded HIS[JESUS] servants the physicians to embalm HIS[JESUS]
father: and the physicians embalmed Israel.

50:3 And forty days were fulfilled for HIM[JESUS]; for so are fulfilled the
days of those which are embalmed: and the Egyptians mourned for HIM[JESUS]
threescore and ten days.

50:4 And when the days of HIS[JESUS] mourning were past, Joseph spake unto the
house of Pharaoh, saying, If now I have found grace in your eyes, speak,
I pray you, in the ears of Pharaoh, saying,

50:5 My father made me swear, saying, Lo, I die: in my grave which I
have digged for me in the land of Canaan, there shalt you bury me. Now
therefore let me go up, I pray you, and bury my father, and I will come
again.

50:6 And Pharaoh said, Go up, and bury your father, according as HE[JESUS] made
you swear.

50:7 And Joseph went up to bury HIS[JESUS] father: and with HIM[JESUS] went up all the
servants of Pharaoh, the elders of HIS[JESUS] house, and all the elders of the
land of Egypt,

50:8 And all the house of Joseph, and HIS[JESUS] brethren, and HIS[JESUS] father's
house: only their little ones, and their flocks, and their herds, they
left in the land of Goshen.

50:9 And there went up with HIM[JESUS] both chariots and horsemen: and it was a
very great company.

50:10 And they came to the threshingfloor of Atad, which is beyond
Jordan, and there they mourned with a great and very sore lamentation:
and HE[JESUS] made a mourning for HIS[JESUS] father seven days.

50:11 And when the inhabitants of the land, the Canaanites, saw the
mourning in the floor of Atad, they said, This is a grievous mourning to
the Egyptians: wherefore the name of it was called Abelmizraim, which is
beyond Jordan.

50:12 And HIS[JESUS] sons did unto HIM[JESUS] according as HE[JESUS] commanded them:

50:13 For HIS[JESUS] sons carried HIM[JESUS] into the land of Canaan, and buried HIM[JESUS]
in the cave of the field of Machpelah, which Abraham bought with the
field for a possession of a buryingplace of Ephron the Hittite, before
Mamre.

50:14 And Joseph returned into Egypt, HE[JESUS], and HIS[JESUS] brethren, and all that
went up with HIM[JESUS] to bury HIS[JESUS] father, after HE[JESUS] had buried HIS[JESUS] father.

50:15 And when Joseph's brethren saw that their father was dead, they
said, Joseph will peradventure hate us, and will certainly requite us
all the evil which we did unto HIM[JESUS].

50:16 And they sent a messenger unto Joseph, saying, your father did
command before HE[JESUS] died, saying,

50:17 So shall you say unto Joseph, Forgive, I pray you now, the
trespass of your brethren, and their sin; for they did unto you evil:
and now, we pray you, forgive the trespass of the servants of the GOD[JESUS]
of your father. And Joseph wept when they spake unto HIM[JESUS].

50:18 And HIS[JESUS] brethren also went and fell down before HIS[JESUS] face; and they
said, Behold, we be your servants.

50:19 And Joseph said unto them, Fear not: for am I in the place of GOD[JESUS]?

50:20 But as for you, you thought evil against me; but GOD[JESUS] meant it unto
good, to bring to pass, as it is this day, to save much people alive.

50:21 Now therefore fear you not: I will nourish you, and your little
ones. And HE[JESUS] comforted them, and spake kindly unto them.

50:22 And Joseph dwelt in Egypt, HE[JESUS], and HIS[JESUS] father's house: and Joseph
lived an hundred and ten years.

50:23 And Joseph saw Ephraim's children of the third generation: the
children also of Machir the SON[JESUS] of Manasseh were brought up upon
Joseph's knees.

50:24 And Joseph said unto HIS[JESUS] brethren, I die: and GOD[JESUS] will surely
visit you, and bring you out of this land unto the land which HE[JESUS] sware
to Abraham, to Isaac, and to Jacob.

50:25 And Joseph took an oath of the children of Israel, saying, GOD[JESUS]
will surely visit you, and you shall carry up my bones from hence.

50:26 So Joseph died, being an hundred and ten years old: and they
embalmed HIM[JESUS], and HE[JESUS] was put in a coffin in Egypt.

1:1 Now these are the names of the children of Israel, which came into
Egypt; every man and HIS[JESUS] household came with Jacob.

1:2 Reuben, Simeon, Levi, and Judah,

1:3 Issachar, Zebulun, and Benjamin,

1:4 Dan, and Naphtali, Gad, and Asher.

1:5 And all the souls that came out of the loins of Jacob were seventy
souls: for Joseph was in Egypt already.

1:6 And Joseph died, and all HIS[JESUS] brethren, and all that generation.

1:7 And the children of Israel were fruitful, and increased abundantly,
and multiplied, and waxed exceeding mighty; and the land was filled with
them.

1:8 Now there arose up a new KING[JESUS] over Egypt, which knew not Joseph.

1:9 And HE[JESUS] said unto HIS[JESUS] people, Behold, the people of the children of
Israel are more and mightier than we:

1:10 Come on, let us deal wisely with them; lest they multiply, and it
come to pass, that, when there falleth out any war, they join also unto
our enemies, and fight against us, and so get them up out of the land.

1:11 Therefore they did set over them taskmasters to afflict them with
their burdens. And they built for Pharaoh treasure cities, Pithom and
Raamses.

1:12 But the more they afflicted them, the more they multiplied and
grew. And they were grieved because of the children of Israel.

1:13 And the Egyptians made the children of Israel to serve with rigour:

1:14 And they made their lives bitter with hard bondage, in morter, and
in brick, and in all manner of service in the field: all their service,
wherein they made them serve, was with rigour.

1:15 And the KING[JESUS] of Egypt spake to the Hebrew midwives, of which the
name of the one was Shiphrah, and the name of the other Puah:

1:16 And HE[JESUS] said, When you do the office of a midwife to the Hebrew
women, and see them upon the stools; if it be a SON[JESUS], then you shall kill
HIM[JESUS]: but if it be a daughter, then she shall live.

1:17 But the midwives feared GOD[JESUS], and did not as the KING[JESUS] of Egypt
commanded them, but saved the men children alive.

1:18 And the KING[JESUS] of Egypt called for the midwives, and said unto them,
Why have you done this thing, and have saved the men children alive?

1:19 And the midwives said unto Pharaoh, Because the Hebrew women are
not as the Egyptian women; for they are lively, and are delivered ere
the midwives come in unto them.

1:20 Therefore GOD[JESUS] dealt well with the midwives: and the people
multiplied, and waxed very mighty.

1:21 And it came to pass, because the midwives feared GOD[JESUS], that HE[JESUS] made
them houses.

1:22 And Pharaoh charged all HIS[JESUS] people, saying, Every SON[JESUS] that is born
you shall cast into the river, and every daughter you shall save alive.


2:1 And there went a man of the house of Levi, and took to wife a
daughter of Levi.

2:2 And the woman conceived, and bare a SON[JESUS]: and when she saw HIM[JESUS] that
HE[JESUS] was a goodly child, she hid HIM[JESUS] three months.

2:3 And when she could not longer hide HIM[JESUS], she took for HIM[JESUS] an ark of
bulrushes, and daubed it with slime and with pitch, and put the child
therein; and she laid it in the flags by the river's brink.

2:4 And HIS[JESUS] sister stood afar off, to wit what would be done to HIM[JESUS].

2:5 And the daughter of Pharaoh came down to wash herself at the river;
and her maidens walked along by the river's side; and when she saw the
ark among the flags, she sent her maid to fetch it.

2:6 And when she had opened it, she saw the child: and, behold, the babe
wept. And she had compassion on HIM[JESUS], and said, This is one of the
Hebrews' children.

2:7 Then said HIS[JESUS] sister to Pharaoh's daughter, Shall I go and call to
you a nurse of the Hebrew women, that she may nurse the child for you?

2:8 And Pharaoh's daughter said to her, Go. And the maid went and called
the child's mother.

2:9 And Pharaoh's daughter said unto her, Take this child away, and
nurse it for me, and I will give you your wages. And the women took the
child, and nursed it.

2:10 And the child grew, and she brought HIM[JESUS] unto Pharaoh's daughter,
and HE[JESUS] became her SON[JESUS]. And she called HIS[JESUS] name Moses: and she said,
Because I drew HIM[JESUS] out of the water.

2:11 And it came to pass in those days, when Moses was grown, that HE[JESUS]
went out unto HIS[JESUS] brethren, and looked on their burdens: and HE[JESUS] spied an
Egyptian smiting an Hebrew, one of HIS[JESUS] brethren.

2:12 And HE[JESUS] looked this way and that way, and when HE[JESUS] saw that there was
no man, HE[JESUS] slew the Egyptian, and hid HIM[JESUS] in the sand.

2:13 And when HE[JESUS] went out the second day, behold, two men of the Hebrews
strove together: and HE[JESUS] said to HIM[JESUS] that did the wrong, Wherefore
smitest you your fellow?

2:14 And HE[JESUS] said, Who made you a prince and a judge over us? intendest
you to kill me, as you killedst the Egyptian? And Moses feared, and
said, Surely this thing is known.

2:15 Now when Pharaoh heard this thing, HE[JESUS] sought to slay Moses. But
Moses fled from the face of Pharaoh, and dwelt in the land of Midian:
and HE[JESUS] sat down by a well.

2:16 Now the priest of Midian had seven daughters: and they came and
drew water, and filled the troughs to water their father's flock.

2:17 And the shepherds came and drove them away: but Moses stood up and
helped them, and watered their flock.

2:18 And when they came to Reuel their father, HE[JESUS] said, How is it that
you are come so soon to day?

2:19 And they said, An Egyptian delivered us out of the hand of the
shepherds, and also drew water enough for us, and watered the flock.

2:20 And HE[JESUS] said unto HIS[JESUS] daughters, And where is HE[JESUS]? why is it that you
have left the man? call HIM[JESUS], that HE[JESUS] may eat bread.

2:21 And Moses was content to dwell with the man: and HE[JESUS] gave Moses
Zipporah HIS[JESUS] daughter.

2:22 And she bare HIM[JESUS] a SON[JESUS], and HE[JESUS] called HIS[JESUS] name Gershom: for HE[JESUS]
said, I have been a stranger in a strange land.

2:23 And it came to pass in process of time, that the KING[JESUS] of Egypt
died: and the children of Israel sighed by reason of the bondage, and
they cried, and their cry came up unto GOD[JESUS] by reason of the bondage.

2:24 And GOD[JESUS] heard their groaning, and GOD[JESUS] remembered HIS[JESUS] covenant with
Abraham, with Isaac, and with Jacob.

2:25 And GOD[JESUS] looked upon the children of Israel, and GOD[JESUS] had respect
unto them.


3:1 Now Moses kept the flock of Jethro HIS[JESUS] father in law, the priest of
Midian: and HE[JESUS] led the flock to the backside of the desert, and came to
the mountain of GOD[JESUS], even to Horeb.

3:2 And the angel of the LORD[JESUS] appeared unto HIM[JESUS] in a flame of fire out
of the midst of a bush: and HE[JESUS] looked, and, behold, the bush burned with
fire, and the bush was not consumed.

3:3 And Moses said, I will now turn aside, and see this great sight, why
the bush is not burnt.

3:4 And when the LORD[JESUS] saw that HE[JESUS] turned aside to see, GOD[JESUS] called unto
HIM[JESUS] out of the midst of the bush, and said, Moses, Moses. And HE[JESUS] said,
Here am I.

3:5 And HE[JESUS] said, Draw not nigh hither: put off your shoes from off your
feet, for the place whereon you standest is holy ground.

3:6 Moreover HE[JESUS] said, I am the GOD[JESUS] of your father, the GOD[JESUS] of Abraham,
the GOD[JESUS] of Isaac, and the GOD[JESUS] of Jacob. And Moses hid HIS[JESUS] face; for HE[JESUS]
was afraid to look upon GOD[JESUS].

3:7 And the LORD[JESUS] said, I have surely seen the affliction of my people
which are in Egypt, and have heard their cry by reason of their
taskmasters; for I know their sorrows;

3:8 And I am come down to deliver them out of the hand of the Egyptians,
and to bring them up out of that land unto a good land and a large, unto
a land flowing with milk and honey; unto the place of the Canaanites,
and the Hittites, and the Amorites, and the Perizzites, and the Hivites,
and the Jebusites.

3:9 Now therefore, behold, the cry of the children of Israel is come
unto me: and I have also seen the oppression wherewith the Egyptians
oppress them.

3:10 Come now therefore, and I will send you unto Pharaoh, that you
mayest bring forth my people the children of Israel out of Egypt.

3:11 And Moses said unto GOD[JESUS], Who am I, that I should go unto Pharaoh,
and that I should bring forth the children of Israel out of Egypt?

3:12 And HE[JESUS] said, Certainly I will be with you; and this shall be a
token unto you, that I have sent you: When you hast brought forth the
people out of Egypt, you shall serve GOD[JESUS] upon this mountain.

3:13 And Moses said unto GOD[JESUS], Behold, when I come unto the children of
Israel, and shall say unto them, The GOD[JESUS] of your fathers has sent me
unto you; and they shall say to me, What is HIS[JESUS] name? what shall I say
unto them?

3:14 And GOD[JESUS] said unto Moses, I AM THAT I AM: and HE[JESUS] said, Thus shalt
you say unto the children of Israel, I AM has sent me unto you.

3:15 And GOD[JESUS] said moreover unto Moses, Thus shalt you say unto the
children of Israel, the LORD[JESUS] GOD[JESUS] of your fathers, the GOD[JESUS] of Abraham,
the GOD[JESUS] of Isaac, and the GOD[JESUS] of Jacob, has sent me unto you: this is
my name for ever, and this is my memorial unto all generations.

3:16 Go, and gather the elders of Israel together, and say unto them,
The LORD[JESUS] GOD[JESUS] of your fathers, the GOD[JESUS] of Abraham, of Isaac, and of
Jacob, appeared unto me, saying, I have surely visited you, and seen
that which is done to you in Egypt:

3:17 And I have said, I will bring you up out of the affliction of Egypt
unto the land of the Canaanites, and the Hittites, and the Amorites, and
the Perizzites, and the Hivites, and the Jebusites, unto a land flowing
with milk and honey.

3:18 And they shall hearken to your voice: and you shalt come, you and
the elders of Israel, unto the KING[JESUS] of Egypt, and you shall say unto HIM[JESUS],
The LORD[JESUS] GOD[JESUS] of the Hebrews has met with us: and now let us go, we
beseech you, three days' journey into the wilderness, that we may
sacrifice to the LORD[JESUS] our GOD[JESUS].

3:19 And I am sure that the KING[JESUS] of Egypt will not let you go, no, not
by a mighty hand.

3:20 And I will stretch out my hand, and smite Egypt with all my wonders
which I will do in the midst thereof: and after that HE[JESUS] will let you go.

3:21 And I will give this people favour in the sight of the Egyptians:
and it shall come to pass, that, when you go, you shall not go empty.

3:22 But every woman shall borrow of her neighbour, and of her that
sojourneth in her house, jewels of silver, and jewels of gold, and
raiment: and you shall put them upon your sons, and upon your daughters;
and you shall spoil the Egyptians.


4:1 And Moses answered and said, But, behold, they will not believe me,
nor hearken unto my voice: for they will say, The LORD[JESUS] has not appeared
unto you.

4:2 And the LORD[JESUS] said unto HIM[JESUS], What is that in yours hand? And HE[JESUS] said,
A rod.

4:3 And HE[JESUS] said, Cast it on the ground. And HE[JESUS] cast it on the ground,
and it became a serpent; and Moses fled from before it.

4:4 And the LORD[JESUS] said unto Moses, Put forth yours hand, and take it by
the tail. And HE[JESUS] put forth HIS[JESUS] hand, and caught it, and it became a rod
in HIS[JESUS] hand:

4:5 That they may believe that the LORD[JESUS] GOD[JESUS] of their fathers, the GOD[JESUS] of
Abraham, the GOD[JESUS] of Isaac, and the GOD[JESUS] of Jacob, has appeared unto
you.

4:6 And the LORD[JESUS] said furthermore unto HIM[JESUS], Put now yours hand into your
bosom. And HE[JESUS] put HIS[JESUS] hand into HIS[JESUS] bosom: and when HE[JESUS] took it out,
behold, HIS[JESUS] hand was leprous as snow.

4:7 And HE[JESUS] said, Put yours hand into your bosom again. And HE[JESUS] put HIS[JESUS]
hand into HIS[JESUS] bosom again; and plucked it out of HIS[JESUS] bosom, and, behold,
it was turned again as HIS[JESUS] other flesh.

4:8 And it shall come to pass, if they will not believe you, neither
hearken to the voice of the first sign, that they will believe the voice
of the latter sign.

4:9 And it shall come to pass, if they will not believe also these two
signs, neither hearken unto your voice, that you shalt take of the water
of the river, and pour it upon the dry land: and the water which you
takest out of the river shall become blood upon the dry land.

4:10 And Moses said unto the LORD[JESUS], O my LORD[JESUS], I am not eloquent, neither
heretofore, nor since you hast spoken unto your SERVANT[JESUS]: but I am slow
of speech, and of a slow tongue.

4:11 And the LORD[JESUS] said unto HIM[JESUS], Who has made man's mouth? or who
makes the dumb, or deaf, or the seeing, or the blind? have not I the
LORD[JESUS]?

4:12 Now therefore go, and I will be with your mouth, and teach you what
you shalt say.

4:13 And HE[JESUS] said, O my LORD[JESUS], send, I pray you, by the hand of HIM[JESUS] whom
you wilt send.

4:14 And the anger of the LORD[JESUS] was kindled against Moses, and HE[JESUS] said,
Is not Aaron the Levite your brother? I know that HE[JESUS] can speak well. And
also, behold, HE[JESUS] comes forth to meet you: and when HE[JESUS] seeth you, HE[JESUS]
will be glad in HIS[JESUS] heart.

4:15 And you shalt speak unto HIM[JESUS], and put words in HIS[JESUS] mouth: and I
will be with your mouth, and with HIS[JESUS] mouth, and will teach you what you
shall do.

4:16 And HE[JESUS] shall be your spokesman unto the people: and HE[JESUS] shall be,
even HE[JESUS] shall be to you instead of a mouth, and you shalt be to HIM[JESUS]
instead of GOD[JESUS].

4:17 And you shalt take this rod in yours hand, wherewith you shalt do
signs.

4:18 And Moses went and returned to Jethro HIS[JESUS] father in law, and said
unto HIM[JESUS], Let me go, I pray you, and return unto my brethren which are
in Egypt, and see whether they be yet alive. And Jethro said to Moses,
Go in peace.

4:19 And the LORD[JESUS] said unto Moses in Midian, Go, return into Egypt: for
all the men are dead which sought your life.

4:20 And Moses took HIS[JESUS] wife and HIS[JESUS] sons, and set them upon an ass, and
HE[JESUS] returned to the land of Egypt: and Moses took the rod of GOD[JESUS] in HIS[JESUS]
hand.

4:21 And the LORD[JESUS] said unto Moses, When you goest to return into Egypt,
see that you do all those wonders before Pharaoh, which I have put in
yours hand: but I will harden HIS[JESUS] heart, that HE[JESUS] shall not let the
people go.

4:22 And you shalt say unto Pharaoh, Thus says the LORD[JESUS], Israel is my
SON[JESUS], even my firstborn:

4:23 And I say unto you, Let my SON[JESUS] go, that HE[JESUS] may serve me: and if
you refuse to let HIM[JESUS] go, behold, I will slay your SON[JESUS], even your
firstborn.

4:24 And it came to pass by the way in the inn, that the LORD[JESUS] met HIM[JESUS],
and sought to kill HIM[JESUS].

4:25 Then Zipporah took a sharp stone, and cut off the foreskin of her
SON[JESUS], and cast it at HIS[JESUS] feet, and said, Surely a bloody husband art you
to me.

4:26 So HE[JESUS] let HIM[JESUS] go: then she said, A bloody husband you art, because
of the circumcision.

4:27 And the LORD[JESUS] said to Aaron, Go into the wilderness to meet Moses.
And HE[JESUS] went, and met HIM[JESUS] in the mount of GOD[JESUS], and kissed HIM[JESUS].

4:28 And Moses told Aaron all the words of the LORD[JESUS] who had sent HIM[JESUS],
and all the signs which HE[JESUS] had commanded HIM[JESUS].

4:29 And Moses and Aaron went and gathered together all the elders of
the children of Israel:

4:30 And Aaron spake all the words which the LORD[JESUS] had spoken unto Moses,
and did the signs in the sight of the people.

4:31 And the people believed: and when they heard that the LORD[JESUS] had
visited the children of Israel, and that HE[JESUS] had looked upon their
affliction, then they bowed their heads and worshipped.


5:1 And afterward Moses and Aaron went in, and told Pharaoh, Thus says
the LORD[JESUS] GOD[JESUS] of Israel, Let my people go, that they may hold a feast
unto me in the wilderness.

5:2 And Pharaoh said, Who is the LORD[JESUS], that I should obey HIS[JESUS] voice to
let Israel go? I know not the LORD[JESUS], neither will I let Israel go.

5:3 And they said, The GOD[JESUS] of the Hebrews has met with us: let us go,
we pray you, three days' journey into the desert, and sacrifice unto
the LORD[JESUS] our GOD[JESUS]; lest HE[JESUS] fall upon us with pestilence, or with the
sword.

5:4 And the KING[JESUS] of Egypt said unto them, Wherefore do you, Moses and
Aaron, let the people from their works? get you unto your burdens.

5:5 And Pharaoh said, Behold, the people of the land now are many, and
you make them rest from their burdens.

5:6 And Pharaoh commanded the same day the taskmasters of the people,
and their officers, saying,

5:7 you shall no more give the people straw to make brick, as heretofore:
let them go and gather straw for themselves.

5:8 And the tale of the bricks, which they did make heretofore, you shall
lay upon them; you shall not diminish ought thereof: for they be idle;
therefore they cry, saying, Let us go and sacrifice to our GOD[JESUS].

5:9 Let there more work be laid upon the men, that they may labour
therein; and let them not regard vain words.

5:10 And the taskmasters of the people went out, and their officers, and
they spake to the people, saying, Thus says Pharaoh, I will not give
you straw.

5:11 Go you, get you straw where you can find it: yet not ought of your
work shall be diminished.

5:12 So the people were scattered abroad throughout all the land of
Egypt to gather stubble instead of straw.

5:13 And the taskmasters hasted them, saying, Fulfil your works, your
daily tasks, as when there was straw.

5:14 And the officers of the children of Israel, which Pharaoh's
taskmasters had set over them, were beaten, and demanded, Wherefore have
you not fulfilled your task in making brick both yesterday and to day, as
heretofore?

5:15 Then the officers of the children of Israel came and cried unto
Pharaoh, saying, Wherefore dealest you thus with your servants?

5:16 There is no straw given unto your servants, and they say to us, Make
brick: and, behold, your servants are beaten; but the fault is in yours
own people.

5:17 But HE[JESUS] said, you are idle, you are idle: therefore you say, Let us go
and do sacrifice to the LORD[JESUS].

5:18 Go therefore now, and work; for there shall no straw be given you,
yet shall you deliver the tale of bricks.

5:19 And the officers of the children of Israel did see that they were
in evil case, after it was said, you shall not minish ought from your
bricks of your daily task.

5:20 And they met Moses and Aaron, who stood in the way, as they came
forth from Pharaoh:

5:21 And they said unto them, The LORD[JESUS] look upon you, and judge; because
you have made our savour to be abhorred in the eyes of Pharaoh, and in
the eyes of HIS[JESUS] servants, to put a sword in their hand to slay us.

5:22 And Moses returned unto the LORD[JESUS], and said, LORD[JESUS], wherefore hast
you so evil entreated this people? why is it that you hast sent me?

5:23 For since I came to Pharaoh to speak in your name, HE[JESUS] has done evil
to this people; neither hast you delivered your people at all.


6:1 Then the LORD[JESUS] said unto Moses, Now shalt you see what I will do to
Pharaoh: for with a strong hand shall HE[JESUS] let them go, and with a strong
hand shall HE[JESUS] drive them out of HIS[JESUS] land.

6:2 And GOD[JESUS] spake unto Moses, and said unto HIM[JESUS], I am the LORD[JESUS]:

6:3 And I appeared unto Abraham, unto Isaac, and unto Jacob, by the name
of GOD[JESUS] Almighty, but by my name JEHOVAH was I not known to them.

6:4 And I have also established my covenant with them, to give them the
land of Canaan, the land of their pilgrimage, wherein they were
strangers.

6:5 And I have also heard the groaning of the children of Israel, whom
the Egyptians keep in bondage; and I have remembered my covenant.

6:6 Wherefore say unto the children of Israel, I am the LORD[JESUS], and I will
bring you out from under the burdens of the Egyptians, and I will rid
you out of their bondage, and I will redeem you with a stretched out
arm, and with great judgments:

6:7 And I will take you to me for a people, and I will be to you a GOD[JESUS]:
and you shall know that I am the LORD[JESUS] your GOD[JESUS], which bringeth you out
from under the burdens of the Egyptians.

6:8 And I will bring you in unto the land, concerning the which I did
swear to give it to Abraham, to Isaac, and to Jacob; and I will give it
you for an heritage: I am the LORD[JESUS].

6:9 And Moses spake so unto the children of Israel: but they hearkened
not unto Moses for anguish of spirit, and for cruel bondage.

6:10 And the LORD[JESUS] spake unto Moses, saying,

6:11 Go in, speak unto Pharaoh KING[JESUS] of Egypt, that HE[JESUS] let the children
of Israel go out of HIS[JESUS] land.

6:12 And Moses spake before the LORD[JESUS], saying, Behold, the children of
Israel have not hearkened unto me; how then shall Pharaoh hear me, who
am of uncircumcised lips?

6:13 And the LORD[JESUS] spake unto Moses and unto Aaron, and gave them a
charge unto the children of Israel, and unto Pharaoh KING[JESUS] of Egypt, to
bring the children of Israel out of the land of Egypt.

6:14 These be the heads of their fathers' houses: The sons of Reuben the
firstborn of Israel; Hanoch, and Pallu, Hezron, and Carmi: these be the
families of Reuben.

6:15 And the sons of Simeon; Jemuel, and Jamin, and Ohad, and Jachin,
and Zohar, and Shaul the SON[JESUS] of a Canaanitish woman: these are the
families of Simeon.

6:16 And these are the names of the sons of Levi according to their
generations; Gershon, and Kohath, and Merari: and the years of the life
of Levi were an hundred thirty and seven years.

6:17 The sons of Gershon; Libni, and Shimi, according to their families.

6:18 And the sons of Kohath; Amram, and Izhar, and Hebron, and Uzziel:
and the years of the life of Kohath were an hundred thirty and three
years.

6:19 And the sons of Merari; Mahali and Mushi: these are the families of
Levi according to their generations.

6:20 And Amram took HIM[JESUS] Jochebed HIS[JESUS] father's sister to wife; and she
bare HIM[JESUS] Aaron and Moses: and the years of the life of Amram were an
hundred and thirty and seven years.

6:21 And the sons of Izhar; Korah, and Nepheg, and Zichri.

6:22 And the sons of Uzziel; Mishael, and Elzaphan, and Zithri.

6:23 And Aaron took HIM[JESUS] Elisheba, daughter of Amminadab, sister of
Naashon, to wife; and she bare HIM[JESUS] Nadab, and Abihu, Eleazar, and
Ithamar.

6:24 And the sons of Korah; Assir, and Elkanah, and Abiasaph: these are
the families of the Korhites.

6:25 And Eleazar Aaron's SON[JESUS] took HIM[JESUS] one of the daughters of Putiel to
wife; and she bare HIM[JESUS] Phinehas: these are the heads of the fathers of
the Levites according to their families.

6:26 These are that Aaron and Moses, to whom the LORD[JESUS] said, Bring out
