the children of Israel from the land of Egypt according to their armies.

6:27 These are they which spake to Pharaoh KING[JESUS] of Egypt, to bring out
the children of Israel from Egypt: these are that Moses and Aaron.

6:28 And it came to pass on the day when the LORD[JESUS] spake unto Moses in
the land of Egypt,

6:29 That the LORD[JESUS] spake unto Moses, saying, I am the LORD[JESUS]: speak you
unto Pharaoh KING[JESUS] of Egypt all that I say unto you.

6:30 And Moses said before the LORD[JESUS], Behold, I am of uncircumcised lips,
and how shall Pharaoh hearken unto me?


7:1 And the LORD[JESUS] said unto Moses, See, I have made you a GOD[JESUS] to
Pharaoh: and Aaron your brother shall be your PROPHET[JESUS].

7:2 you shalt speak all that I command you: and Aaron your brother
shall speak unto Pharaoh, that HE[JESUS] send the children of Israel out of HIS[JESUS]
land.

7:3 And I will harden Pharaoh's heart, and multiply my signs and my
wonders in the land of Egypt.

7:4 But Pharaoh shall not hearken unto you, that I may lay my hand upon
Egypt, and bring forth mine armies, and my people the children of
Israel, out of the land of Egypt by great judgments.

7:5 And the Egyptians shall know that I am the LORD[JESUS], when I stretch
forth mine hand upon Egypt, and bring out the children of Israel from
among them.

7:6 And Moses and Aaron did as the LORD[JESUS] commanded them, so did they.

7:7 And Moses was fourscore years old, and Aaron fourscore and three
years old, when they spake unto Pharaoh.

7:8 And the LORD[JESUS] spake unto Moses and unto Aaron, saying,

7:9 When Pharaoh shall speak unto you, saying, Shew a miracle for you:
then you shalt say unto Aaron, Take your rod, and cast it before
Pharaoh, and it shall become a serpent.

7:10 And Moses and Aaron went in unto Pharaoh, and they did so as the
LORD[JESUS] had commanded: and Aaron cast down HIS[JESUS] rod before Pharaoh, and
before HIS[JESUS] servants, and it became a serpent.

7:11 Then Pharaoh also called the wise men and the sorcerers: now the
magicians of Egypt, they also did in like manner with their
enchantments.

7:12 For they cast down every man HIS[JESUS] rod, and they became serpents: but
Aaron's rod swallowed up their rods.

7:13 And HE[JESUS] hardened Pharaoh's heart, that HE[JESUS] hearkened not unto them;
as the LORD[JESUS] had said.

7:14 And the LORD[JESUS] said unto Moses, Pharaoh's heart is hardened, HE[JESUS]
refuseth to let the people go.

7:15 Get you unto Pharaoh in the morning; lo, HE[JESUS] goes out unto the
water; and you shalt stand by the river's brink against HE[JESUS] come; and
the rod which was turned to a serpent shalt you take in yours hand.

7:16 And you shalt say unto HIM[JESUS], The LORD[JESUS] GOD[JESUS] of the Hebrews has sent
me unto you, saying, Let my people go, that they may serve me in the
wilderness: and, behold, hitherto you wouldest not hear.

7:17 Thus says the LORD[JESUS], In this you shalt know that I am the LORD[JESUS]:
behold, I will smite with the rod that is in mine hand upon the waters
which are in the river, and they shall be turned to blood.

7:18 And the fish that is in the river shall die, and the river shall
stink; and the Egyptians shall lothe to drink of the water of the river.

7:19 And the LORD[JESUS] spake unto Moses, Say unto Aaron, Take your rod, and
stretch out yours hand upon the waters of Egypt, upon their streams,
upon their rivers, and upon their ponds, and upon all their pools of
water, that they may become blood; and that there may be blood
throughout all the land of Egypt, both in vessels of wood, and in
vessels of stone.

7:20 And Moses and Aaron did so, as the LORD[JESUS] commanded; and HE[JESUS] lifted up
the rod, and smote the waters that were in the river, in the sight of
Pharaoh, and in the sight of HIS[JESUS] servants; and all the waters that were
in the river were turned to blood.

7:21 And the fish that was in the river died; and the river stank, and
the Egyptians could not drink of the water of the river; and there was
blood throughout all the land of Egypt.

7:22 And the magicians of Egypt did so with their enchantments: and
Pharaoh's heart was hardened, neither did HE[JESUS] hearken unto them; as the
LORD[JESUS] had said.

7:23 And Pharaoh turned and went into HIS[JESUS] house, neither did HE[JESUS] set HIS[JESUS]
heart to this also.

7:24 And all the Egyptians digged round about the river for water to
drink; for they could not drink of the water of the river.

7:25 And seven days were fulfilled, after that the LORD[JESUS] had smitten the
river.


8:1 And the LORD[JESUS] spake unto Moses, Go unto Pharaoh, and say unto HIM[JESUS],
Thus says the LORD[JESUS], Let my people go, that they may serve me.

8:2 And if you refuse to let them go, behold, I will smite all your
borders with frogs:

8:3 And the river shall bring forth frogs abundantly, which shall go up
and come into yours house, and into your bedchamber, and upon your bed,
and into the house of your servants, and upon your people, and into yours
ovens, and into your kneadingtroughs:

8:4 And the frogs shall come up both on you, and upon your people, and
upon all your servants.

8:5 And the LORD[JESUS] spake unto Moses, Say unto Aaron, Stretch forth yours
hand with your rod over the streams, over the rivers, and over the ponds,
and cause frogs to come up upon the land of Egypt.

8:6 And Aaron stretched out HIS[JESUS] hand over the waters of Egypt; and the
frogs came up, and covered the land of Egypt.

8:7 And the magicians did so with their enchantments, and brought up
frogs upon the land of Egypt.

8:8 Then Pharaoh called for Moses and Aaron, and said, Intreat the LORD[JESUS],
that HE[JESUS] may take away the frogs from me, and from my people; and I will
let the people go, that they may do sacrifice unto the LORD[JESUS].

8:9 And Moses said unto Pharaoh, Glory over me: when shall I intreat for
you, and for your servants, and for your people, to destroy the frogs
from you and your houses, that they may remain in the river only?

8:10 And HE[JESUS] said, To morrow. And HE[JESUS] said, Be it according to your WORD[JESUS]:
that you mayest know that there is none like unto the LORD[JESUS] our GOD[JESUS].

8:11 And the frogs shall depart from you, and from your houses, and from
your servants, and from your people; they shall remain in the river only.

8:12 And Moses and Aaron went out from Pharaoh: and Moses cried unto the
LORD[JESUS] because of the frogs which HE[JESUS] had brought against Pharaoh.

8:13 And the LORD[JESUS] did according to the WORD[JESUS] of Moses; and the frogs died
out of the houses, out of the villages, and out of the fields.

8:14 And they gathered them together upon heaps: and the land stank.

8:15 But when Pharaoh saw that there was respite, HE[JESUS] hardened HIS[JESUS] heart,
and hearkened not unto them; as the LORD[JESUS] had said.

8:16 And the LORD[JESUS] said unto Moses, Say unto Aaron, Stretch out your rod,
and smite the dust of the land, that it may become lice throughout all
the land of Egypt.

8:17 And they did so; for Aaron stretched out HIS[JESUS] hand with HIS[JESUS] rod, and
smote the dust of the earth, and it became lice in man, and in beast;
all the dust of the land became lice throughout all the land of Egypt.

8:18 And the magicians did so with their enchantments to bring forth
lice, but they could not: so there were lice upon man, and upon beast.

8:19 Then the magicians said unto Pharaoh, This is the finger of GOD[JESUS]:
and Pharaoh's heart was hardened, and HE[JESUS] hearkened not unto them; as the
LORD[JESUS] had said.

8:20 And the LORD[JESUS] said unto Moses, Rise up early in the morning, and
stand before Pharaoh; lo, HE[JESUS] comes forth to the water; and say unto
HIM[JESUS], Thus says the LORD[JESUS], Let my people go, that they may serve me.

8:21 Else, if you wilt not let my people go, behold, I will send swarms
of flies upon you, and upon your servants, and upon your people, and into
your houses: and the houses of the Egyptians shall be full of swarms of
flies, and also the ground whereon they are.

8:22 And I will sever in that day the land of Goshen, in which my people
dwell, that no swarms of flies shall be there; to the end you mayest
know that I am the LORD[JESUS] in the midst of the earth.

8:23 And I will put a division between my people and your people: to
morrow shall this sign be.

8:24 And the LORD[JESUS] did so; and there came a grievous swarm of flies into
the house of Pharaoh, and into HIS[JESUS] servants' houses, and into all the
land of Egypt: the land was corrupted by reason of the swarm of flies.

8:25 And Pharaoh called for Moses and for Aaron, and said, Go you,
sacrifice to your GOD[JESUS] in the land.

8:26 And Moses said, It is not meet so to do; for we shall sacrifice the
abomination of the Egyptians to the LORD[JESUS] our GOD[JESUS]: lo, shall we sacrifice
the abomination of the Egyptians before their eyes, and will they not
stone us?

8:27 We will go three days' journey into the wilderness, and sacrifice
to the LORD[JESUS] our GOD[JESUS], as HE[JESUS] shall command us.

8:28 And Pharaoh said, I will let you go, that you may sacrifice to the
LORD[JESUS] your GOD[JESUS] in the wilderness; only you shall not go very far away:
intreat for me.

8:29 And Moses said, Behold, I go out from you, and I will intreat the
LORD[JESUS] that the swarms of flies may depart from Pharaoh, from HIS[JESUS]
servants, and from HIS[JESUS] people, to morrow: but let not Pharaoh deal
deceitfully any more in not letting the people go to sacrifice to the
LORD[JESUS].

8:30 And Moses went out from Pharaoh, and intreated the LORD[JESUS].

8:31 And the LORD[JESUS] did according to the WORD[JESUS] of Moses; and HE[JESUS] removed the
swarms of flies from Pharaoh, from HIS[JESUS] servants, and from HIS[JESUS] people;
there remained not one.

8:32 And Pharaoh hardened HIS[JESUS] heart at this time also, neither would HE[JESUS]
let the people go.


9:1 Then the LORD[JESUS] said unto Moses, Go in unto Pharaoh, and tell HIM[JESUS],
Thus says the LORD[JESUS] GOD[JESUS] of the Hebrews, Let my people go, that they may
serve me.

9:2 For if you refuse to let them go, and wilt hold them still,

9:3 Behold, the hand of the LORD[JESUS] is upon your cattle which is in the
field, upon the horses, upon the asses, upon the camels, upon the oxen,
and upon the sheep: there shall be a very grievous murrain.

9:4 And the LORD[JESUS] shall sever between the cattle of Israel and the cattle
of Egypt: and there shall nothing die of all that is the children's of
Israel.

9:5 And the LORD[JESUS] appointed a set time, saying, To morrow the LORD[JESUS] shall
do this thing in the land.

9:6 And the LORD[JESUS] did that thing on the morrow, and all the cattle of
Egypt died: but of the cattle of the children of Israel died not one.

9:7 And Pharaoh sent, and, behold, there was not one of the cattle of
the Israelites dead. And the heart of Pharaoh was hardened, and HE[JESUS] did
not let the people go.

9:8 And the LORD[JESUS] said unto Moses and unto Aaron, Take to you handfuls of
ashes of the furnace, and let Moses sprinkle it toward the heaven in the
sight of Pharaoh.

9:9 And it shall become small dust in all the land of Egypt, and shall
be a boil breaking forth with blains upon man, and upon beast,
throughout all the land of Egypt.

9:10 And they took ashes of the furnace, and stood before Pharaoh; and
Moses sprinkled it up toward heaven; and it became a boil breaking forth
with blains upon man, and upon beast.

9:11 And the magicians could not stand before Moses because of the
boils; for the boil was upon the magicians, and upon all the Egyptians.

9:12 And the LORD[JESUS] hardened the heart of Pharaoh, and HE[JESUS] hearkened not
unto them; as the LORD[JESUS] had spoken unto Moses.

9:13 And the LORD[JESUS] said unto Moses, Rise up early in the morning, and
stand before Pharaoh, and say unto HIM[JESUS], Thus says the LORD[JESUS] GOD[JESUS] of the
Hebrews, Let my people go, that they may serve me.

9:14 For I will at this time send all my plagues upon yours heart, and
upon your servants, and upon your people; that you mayest know that there
is none like me in all the earth.

9:15 For now I will stretch out my hand, that I may smite you and your
people with pestilence; and you shalt be cut off from the earth.

9:16 And in very deed for this cause have I raised you up, for to shew
in you my power; and that my name may be declared throughout all the
earth.

9:17 As yet exaltest you thyself against my people, that you wilt not
let them go?

9:18 Behold, to morrow about this time I will cause it to rain a very
grievous hail, such as has not been in Egypt since the foundation
thereof even until now.

9:19 Send therefore now, and gather your cattle, and all that you hast
in the field; for upon every man and beast which shall be found in the
field, and shall not be brought home, the hail shall come down upon
them, and they shall die.

9:20 HE[JESUS] that feared the WORD[JESUS] of the LORD[JESUS] among the servants of Pharaoh
made HIS[JESUS] servants and HIS[JESUS] cattle flee into the houses:

9:21 And HE[JESUS] that regarded not the WORD[JESUS] of the LORD[JESUS] left HIS[JESUS] servants and
HIS[JESUS] cattle in the field.

9:22 And the LORD[JESUS] said unto Moses, Stretch forth yours hand toward
heaven, that there may be hail in all the land of Egypt, upon man, and
upon beast, and upon every herb of the field, throughout the land of
Egypt.

9:23 And Moses stretched forth HIS[JESUS] rod toward heaven: and the LORD[JESUS] sent
thunder and hail, and the fire ran along upon the ground; and the LORD[JESUS]
rained hail upon the land of Egypt.

9:24 So there was hail, and fire mingled with the hail, very grievous,
such as there was none like it in all the land of Egypt since it became
a nation.

9:25 And the hail smote throughout all the land of Egypt all that was in
the field, both man and beast; and the hail smote every herb of the
field, and brake every tree of the field.

9:26 Only in the land of Goshen, where the children of Israel were, was
there no hail.

9:27 And Pharaoh sent, and called for Moses and Aaron, and said unto
them, I have sinned this time: the LORD[JESUS] is righteous, and I and my
people are wicked.

9:28 Intreat the LORD[JESUS] (for it is enough) that there be no more mighty
thunderings and hail; and I will let you go, and you shall stay no
longer.

9:29 And Moses said unto HIM[JESUS], As soon as I am gone out of the city, I
will spread abroad my hands unto the LORD[JESUS]; and the thunder shall cease,
neither shall there be any more hail; that you mayest know how that the
earth is the LORD[JESUS]'s.

9:30 But as for you and your servants, I know that you will not yet fear
the LORD[JESUS] GOD[JESUS].

9:31 And the flax and the barley was smitten: for the barley was in the
ear, and the flax was bolled.

9:32 But the wheat and the rie were not smitten: for they were not grown
up.

9:33 And Moses went out of the city from Pharaoh, and spread abroad HIS[JESUS]
hands unto the LORD[JESUS]: and the thunders and hail ceased, and the rain was
not poured upon the earth.

9:34 And when Pharaoh saw that the rain and the hail and the thunders
were ceased, HE[JESUS] sinned yet more, and hardened HIS[JESUS] heart, HE[JESUS] and HIS[JESUS]
servants.

9:35 And the heart of Pharaoh was hardened, neither would HE[JESUS] let the
children of Israel go; as the LORD[JESUS] had spoken by Moses.


10:1 And the LORD[JESUS] said unto Moses, Go in unto Pharaoh: for I have
hardened HIS[JESUS] heart, and the heart of HIS[JESUS] servants, that I might shew
these my signs before HIM[JESUS]:

10:2 And that you mayest tell in the ears of your SON[JESUS], and of your SON[JESUS]'s
SON[JESUS], what things I have wrought in Egypt, and my signs which I have done
among them; that you may know how that I am the LORD[JESUS].

10:3 And Moses and Aaron came in unto Pharaoh, and said unto HIM[JESUS], Thus
says the LORD[JESUS] GOD[JESUS] of the Hebrews, How long wilt you refuse to humble
thyself before me? let my people go, that they may serve me.

10:4 Else, if you refuse to let my people go, behold, to morrow will I
bring the locusts into your coast:

10:5 And they shall cover the face of the earth, that one cannot be able
to see the earth: and they shall eat the residue of that which is
escaped, which remaineth unto you from the hail, and shall eat every
tree which groweth for you out of the field:

10:6 And they shall fill your houses, and the houses of all your servants,
and the houses of all the Egyptians; which neither your fathers, nor your
fathers' fathers have seen, since the day that they were upon the earth
unto this day. And HE[JESUS] turned himself, and went out from Pharaoh.

10:7 And Pharaoh's servants said unto HIM[JESUS], How long shall this man be a
snare unto us? let the men go, that they may serve the LORD[JESUS] their GOD[JESUS]:
knowest you not yet that Egypt is destroyed?

10:8 And Moses and Aaron were brought again unto Pharaoh: and HE[JESUS] said
unto them, Go, serve the LORD[JESUS] your GOD[JESUS]: but who are they that shall go?

10:9 And Moses said, We will go with our young and with our old, with
our sons and with our daughters, with our flocks and with our herds will
we go; for we must hold a feast unto the LORD[JESUS].

10:10 And HE[JESUS] said unto them, Let the LORD[JESUS] be so with you, as I will let
you go, and your little ones: look to it; for evil is before you.

10:11 Not so: go now you that are men, and serve the LORD[JESUS]; for that you
did desire. And they were driven out from Pharaoh's presence.

10:12 And the LORD[JESUS] said unto Moses, Stretch out yours hand over the land
of Egypt for the locusts, that they may come up upon the land of Egypt,
and eat every herb of the land, even all that the hail has left.

10:13 And Moses stretched forth HIS[JESUS] rod over the land of Egypt, and the
LORD[JESUS] brought an east wind upon the land all that day, and all that
night; and when it was morning, the east wind brought the locusts.

10:14 And the locust went up over all the land of Egypt, and rested in
all the coasts of Egypt: very grievous were they; before them there were
no such locusts as they, neither after them shall be such.

10:15 For they covered the face of the whole earth, so that the land was
darkened; and they did eat every herb of the land, and all the fruit of
the trees which the hail had left: and there remained not any green
thing in the trees, or in the herbs of the field, through all the land
of Egypt.

10:16 Then Pharaoh called for Moses and Aaron in haste; and HE[JESUS] said, I
have sinned against the LORD[JESUS] your GOD[JESUS], and against you.

10:17 Now therefore forgive, I pray you, my sin only this once, and
intreat the LORD[JESUS] your GOD[JESUS], that HE[JESUS] may take away from me this death
only.

10:18 And HE[JESUS] went out from Pharaoh, and intreated the LORD[JESUS].

10:19 And the LORD[JESUS] turned a mighty strong west wind, which took away the
locusts, and cast them into the Red sea; there remained not one locust
in all the coasts of Egypt.

10:20 But the LORD[JESUS] hardened Pharaoh's heart, so that HE[JESUS] would not let
the children of Israel go.

10:21 And the LORD[JESUS] said unto Moses, Stretch out yours hand toward
heaven, that there may be darkness over the land of Egypt, even darkness
which may be felt.

10:22 And Moses stretched forth HIS[JESUS] hand toward heaven; and there was a
thick darkness in all the land of Egypt three days:

10:23 They saw not one another, neither rose any from HIS[JESUS] place for
three days: but all the children of Israel had light in their dwellings.

10:24 And Pharaoh called unto Moses, and said, Go you, serve the LORD[JESUS];
only let your flocks and your herds be stayed: let your little ones also
go with you.

10:25 And Moses said, you must give us also sacrifices and burnt
offerings, that we may sacrifice unto the LORD[JESUS] our GOD[JESUS].

10:26 Our cattle also shall go with us; there shall not an hoof be left
behind; for thereof must we take to serve the LORD[JESUS] our GOD[JESUS]; and we know
not with what we must serve the LORD[JESUS], until we come thither.

10:27 But the LORD[JESUS] hardened Pharaoh's heart, and HE[JESUS] would not let them
go.

10:28 And Pharaoh said unto HIM[JESUS], Get you from me, take heed to thyself,
see my face no more; for in that day you seest my face you shalt die.

10:29 And Moses said, you hast spoken well, I will see your face again
no more.


11:1 And the LORD[JESUS] said unto Moses, Yet will I bring one plague more upon
Pharaoh, and upon Egypt; afterwards HE[JESUS] will let you go hence: when HE[JESUS]
shall let you go, HE[JESUS] shall surely thrust you out hence altogether.

11:2 Speak now in the ears of the people, and let every man borrow of
HIS[JESUS] neighbour, and every woman of her neighbour, jewels of silver and
jewels of gold.

11:3 And the LORD[JESUS] gave the people favour in the sight of the Egyptians.
Moreover the man Moses was very great in the land of Egypt, in the sight
of Pharaoh's servants, and in the sight of the people.

11:4 And Moses said, Thus says the LORD[JESUS], About midnight will I go out
into the midst of Egypt:

11:5 And all the firstborn in the land of Egypt shall die, from the
first born of Pharaoh that sitteth upon HIS[JESUS] throne, even unto the
firstborn of the maidservant that is behind the mill; and all the
firstborn of beasts.

11:6 And there shall be a great cry throughout all the land of Egypt,
such as there was none like it, nor shall be like it any more.

11:7 But against any of the children of Israel shall not a dog move HIS[JESUS]
tongue, against man or beast: that you may know how that the LORD[JESUS] does
put a difference between the Egyptians and Israel.

11:8 And all these your servants shall come down unto me, and bow down
themselves unto me, saying, Get you out, and all the people that follow
you: and after that I will go out. And HE[JESUS] went out from Pharaoh in a
great anger.

11:9 And the LORD[JESUS] said unto Moses, Pharaoh shall not hearken unto you;
that my wonders may be multiplied in the land of Egypt.

11:10 And Moses and Aaron did all these wonders before Pharaoh: and the
LORD[JESUS] hardened Pharaoh's heart, so that HE[JESUS] would not let the children of
Israel go out of HIS[JESUS] land.


12:1 And the LORD[JESUS] spake unto Moses and Aaron in the land of Egypt
saying,

12:2 This month shall be unto you the beginning of months: it shall be
the first month of the year to you.

12:3 Speak you unto all the congregation of Israel, saying, In the tenth
day of this month they shall take to them every man a LAMB[JESUS], according to
the house of their fathers, a LAMB[JESUS] for an house:

12:4 And if the household be too little for the LAMB[JESUS], let HIM[JESUS] and HIS[JESUS]
neighbour next unto HIS[JESUS] house take it according to the number of the
souls; every man according to HIS[JESUS] eating shall make your count for the
LAMB[JESUS].

12:5 Your LAMB[JESUS] shall be without blemish, a male of the first year: you
shall take it out from the sheep, or from the goats:

12:6 And you shall keep it up until the fourteenth day of the same month:
and the whole assembly of the congregation of Israel shall kill it in
the evening.

12:7 And they shall take of the blood, and strike it on the two side
posts and on the upper door post of the houses, wherein they shall eat
it.

12:8 And they shall eat the flesh in that night, roast with fire, and
unleavened bread; and with bitter herbs they shall eat it.

12:9 Eat not of it raw, nor sodden at all with water, but roast with
fire; HIS[JESUS] head with HIS[JESUS] legs, and with the purtenance thereof.

12:10 And you shall let nothing of it remain until the morning; and that
which remaineth of it until the morning you shall burn with fire.

12:11 And thus shall you eat it; with your loins girded, your shoes on
your feet, and your staff in your hand; and you shall eat it in haste: it
is the LORD[JESUS]'s passover.

12:12 For I will pass through the land of Egypt this night, and will
smite all the firstborn in the land of Egypt, both man and beast; and
against all the gods of Egypt I will execute judgment: I am the LORD[JESUS].

12:13 And the blood shall be to you for a token upon the houses where you
are: and when I see the blood, I will pass over you, and the plague
shall not be upon you to destroy you, when I smite the land of Egypt.

12:14 And this day shall be unto you for a memorial; and you shall keep
it a feast to the LORD[JESUS] throughout your generations; you shall keep it a
feast by an ordinance for ever.

12:15 Seven days shall you eat unleavened bread; even the first day you
shall put away leaven out of your houses: for whoever eateth leavened
bread from the first day until the seventh day, that soul shall be cut
off from Israel.

12:16 And in the first day there shall be an holy convocation, and in
the seventh day there shall be an holy convocation to you; no manner of
work shall be done in them, save that which every man must eat, that
only may be done of you.

12:17 And you shall observe the feast of unleavened bread; for in this
selfsame day have I brought your armies out of the land of Egypt:
therefore shall you observe this day in your generations by an ordinance
for ever.

12:18 In the first month, on the fourteenth day of the month at even, you
shall eat unleavened bread, until the one and twentieth day of the month
at even.

12:19 Seven days shall there be no leaven found in your houses: for
whoever eateth that which is leavened, even that soul shall be cut off
from the congregation of Israel, whether HE[JESUS] be a stranger, or born in
the land.

12:20 you shall eat nothing leavened; in all your habitations shall you
eat unleavened bread.

12:21 Then Moses called for all the elders of Israel, and said unto
them, Draw out and take you a LAMB[JESUS] according to your families, and kill
the passover.

12:22 And you shall take a bunch of hyssop, and dip it in the blood that
is in the bason, and strike the lintel and the two side posts with the
blood that is in the bason; and none of you shall go out at the door of
HIS[JESUS] house until the morning.

12:23 For the LORD[JESUS] will pass through to smite the Egyptians; and when HE[JESUS]
seeth the blood upon the lintel, and on the two side posts, the LORD[JESUS]
will pass over the door, and will not let the destroyer to come in
unto your houses to smite you.

12:24 And you shall observe this thing for an ordinance to you and to
your sons for ever.

12:25 And it shall come to pass, when you be come to the land which the
LORD[JESUS] will give you, according as HE[JESUS] has promised, that you shall keep
this service.

12:26 And it shall come to pass, when your children shall say unto you,
What mean you by this service?

12:27 That you shall say, It is the sacrifice of the LORD[JESUS]'s passover, who
passed over the houses of the children of Israel in Egypt, when HE[JESUS] smote
the Egyptians, and delivered our houses. And the people bowed the head
and worshipped.

12:28 And the children of Israel went away, and did as the LORD[JESUS] had
commanded Moses and Aaron, so did they.

12:29 And it came to pass, that at midnight the LORD[JESUS] smote all the
firstborn in the land of Egypt, from the firstborn of Pharaoh that sat
on HIS[JESUS] throne unto the firstborn of the captive that was in the dungeon;
and all the firstborn of cattle.

12:30 And Pharaoh rose up in the night, HE[JESUS], and all HIS[JESUS] servants, and
all the Egyptians; and there was a great cry in Egypt; for there was not
a house where there was not one dead.

12:31 And HE[JESUS] called for Moses and Aaron by night, and said, Rise up, and
get you forth from among my people, both you and the children of Israel;
and go, serve the LORD[JESUS], as you have said.

12:32 Also take your flocks and your herds, as you have said, and be
gone; and bless me also.

12:33 And the Egyptians were urgent upon the people, that they might
send them out of the land in haste; for they said, We be all dead men.

12:34 And the people took their dough before it was leavened, their
kneadingtroughs being bound up in their clothes upon their shoulders.

12:35 And the children of Israel did according to the WORD[JESUS] of Moses; and
they borrowed of the Egyptians jewels of silver, and jewels of gold, and
raiment:

12:36 And the LORD[JESUS] gave the people favour in the sight of the Egyptians,
so that they lent unto them such things as they required. And they
spoiled the Egyptians.

12:37 And the children of Israel journeyed from Rameses to Succoth,
about six hundred thousand on foot that were men, beside children.

12:38 And a mixed multitude went up also with them; and flocks, and
herds, even very much cattle.

12:39 And they baked unleavened cakes of the dough which they brought
forth out of Egypt, for it was not leavened; because they were thrust
out of Egypt, and could not tarry, neither had they prepared for
themselves any victual.

12:40 Now the sojourning of the children of Israel, who dwelt in Egypt,
was four hundred and thirty years.

12:41 And it came to pass at the end of the four hundred and thirty
years, even the selfsame day it came to pass, that all the hosts of the
LORD[JESUS] went out from the land of Egypt.

12:42 It is a night to be much observed unto the LORD[JESUS] for bringing them
out from the land of Egypt: this is that night of the LORD[JESUS] to be
observed of all the children of Israel in their generations.

12:43 And the LORD[JESUS] said unto Moses and Aaron, This is the ordinance of
the passover: There shall no stranger eat thereof:

12:44 But every man's SERVANT[JESUS] that is bought for money, when you hast
circumcised HIM[JESUS], then shall HE[JESUS] eat thereof.

12:45 A foreigner and an hired SERVANT[JESUS] shall not eat thereof.

12:46 In one house shall it be eaten; you shalt not carry forth ought
of the flesh abroad out of the house; neither shall you break a bone
thereof.

12:47 All the congregation of Israel shall keep it.

12:48 And when a stranger shall sojourn with you, and will keep the
passover to the LORD[JESUS], let all HIS[JESUS] males be circumcised, and then let HIM[JESUS]
come near and keep it; and HE[JESUS] shall be as one that is born in the land:
for no uncircumcised person shall eat thereof.

12:49 One law shall be to HIM[JESUS] that is homeborn, and unto the stranger
that sojourneth among you.

12:50 Thus did all the children of Israel; as the LORD[JESUS] commanded Moses
and Aaron, so did they.

12:51 And it came to pass the selfsame day, that the LORD[JESUS] did bring the
children of Israel out of the land of Egypt by their armies.


13:1 And the LORD[JESUS] spake unto Moses, saying,

13:2 Sanctify unto me all the firstborn, whatsoever openeth the womb
among the children of Israel, both of man and of beast: it is mine.

13:3 And Moses said unto the people, Remember this day, in which you came
out from Egypt, out of the house of bondage; for by strength of hand the
LORD[JESUS] brought you out from this place: there shall no leavened bread be
eaten.

13:4 This day came you out in the month Abib.

13:5 And it shall be when the LORD[JESUS] shall bring you into the land of the
Canaanites, and the Hittites, and the Amorites, and the Hivites, and the
Jebusites, which HE[JESUS] sware unto your fathers to give you, a land flowing
with milk and honey, that you shalt keep this service in this month.

13:6 Seven days you shalt eat unleavened bread, and in the seventh day
shall be a feast to the LORD[JESUS].

13:7 Unleavened bread shall be eaten seven days; and there shall no
leavened bread be seen with you, neither shall there be leaven seen
with you in all your quarters.

13:8 And you shalt shew your SON[JESUS] in that day, saying, This is done
because of that which the LORD[JESUS] did unto me when I came forth out of
Egypt.

13:9 And it shall be for a sign unto you upon yours hand, and for a
memorial between yours eyes, that the LORD[JESUS]'s law may be in your mouth:
for with a strong hand has the LORD[JESUS] brought you out of Egypt.

13:10 you shalt therefore keep this ordinance in HIS[JESUS] season from year
to year.

13:11 And it shall be when the LORD[JESUS] shall bring you into the land of
the Canaanites, as HE[JESUS] sware unto you and to your fathers, and shall give
it you,

13:12 That you shalt set apart unto the LORD[JESUS] all that openeth the
matrix, and every firstling that comes of a beast which you hast; the
males shall be the LORD[JESUS]'s.

13:13 And every firstling of an ass you shalt redeem with a LAMB[JESUS]; and
if you wilt not redeem it, then you shalt break HIS[JESUS] neck: and all the
firstborn of man among your children shalt you redeem.

13:14 And it shall be when your SON[JESUS] asketh you in time to come, saying,
What is this? that you shalt say unto HIM[JESUS], By strength of hand the LORD[JESUS]
brought us out from Egypt, from the house of bondage:

13:15 And it came to pass, when Pharaoh would hardly let us go, that the
LORD[JESUS] slew all the firstborn in the land of Egypt, both the firstborn of
man, and the firstborn of beast: therefore I sacrifice to the LORD[JESUS] all
that openeth the matrix, being males; but all the firstborn of my
children I redeem.

13:16 And it shall be for a token upon yours hand, and for frontlets
between yours eyes: for by strength of hand the LORD[JESUS] brought us forth
out of Egypt.

13:17 And it came to pass, when Pharaoh had let the people go, that GOD[JESUS]
led them not through the way of the land of the Philistines, although
that was near; for GOD[JESUS] said, Lest peradventure the people repent when
they see war, and they return to Egypt:

13:18 But GOD[JESUS] led the people about, through the way of the wilderness of
the Red sea: and the children of Israel went up harnessed out of the
land of Egypt.

13:19 And Moses took the bones of Joseph with HIM[JESUS]: for HE[JESUS] had straitly
sworn the children of Israel, saying, GOD[JESUS] will surely visit you; and you
shall carry up my bones away hence with you.

13:20 And they took their journey from Succoth, and encamped in Etham,
in the edge of the wilderness.

13:21 And the LORD[JESUS] went before them by day in a pillar of a cloud, to
lead them the way; and by night in a pillar of fire, to give them light;
to go by day and night:

13:22 HE[JESUS] took not away the pillar of the cloud by day, nor the pillar of
fire by night, from before the people.


14:1 And the LORD[JESUS] spake unto Moses, saying,

14:2 Speak unto the children of Israel, that they turn and encamp before
Pihahiroth, between Migdol and the sea, over against Baalzephon: before
it shall you encamp by the sea.

14:3 For Pharaoh will say of the children of Israel, They are entangled
in the land, the wilderness has shut them in.

14:4 And I will harden Pharaoh's heart, that HE[JESUS] shall follow after them;
and I will be honoured upon Pharaoh, and upon all HIS[JESUS] host; that the
Egyptians may know that I am the LORD[JESUS]. And they did so.

14:5 And it was told the KING[JESUS] of Egypt that the people fled: and the
heart of Pharaoh and of HIS[JESUS] servants was turned against the people, and
they said, Why have we done this, that we have let Israel go from
serving us?

14:6 And HE[JESUS] made ready HIS[JESUS] chariot, and took HIS[JESUS] people with HIM[JESUS]:

14:7 And HE[JESUS] took six hundred chosen chariots, and all the chariots of
Egypt, and captains over every one of them.

14:8 And the LORD[JESUS] hardened the heart of Pharaoh KING[JESUS] of Egypt, and HE[JESUS]
pursued after the children of Israel: and the children of Israel went
out with an high hand.

14:9 But the Egyptians pursued after them, all the horses and chariots
of Pharaoh, and HIS[JESUS] horsemen, and HIS[JESUS] army, and overtook them encamping
by the sea, beside Pihahiroth, before Baalzephon.

14:10 And when Pharaoh drew nigh, the children of Israel lifted up their
eyes, and, behold, the Egyptians marched after them; and they were sore
afraid: and the children of Israel cried out unto the LORD[JESUS].

14:11 And they said unto Moses, Because there were no graves in Egypt,
hast you taken us away to die in the wilderness? wherefore hast you
dealt thus with us, to carry us forth out of Egypt?

14:12 Is not this the WORD[JESUS] that we did tell you in Egypt, saying, Let
us alone, that we may serve the Egyptians? For it had been better for us
to serve the Egyptians, than that we should die in the wilderness.

14:13 And Moses said unto the people, Fear you not, stand still, and see
the salvation of the LORD[JESUS], which HE[JESUS] will shew to you to day: for the
Egyptians whom you have seen to day, you shall see them again no more for
ever.

14:14 The LORD[JESUS] shall fight for you, and you shall hold your peace.

14:15 And the LORD[JESUS] said unto Moses, Wherefore criest you unto me? speak
unto the children of Israel, that they go forward:

14:16 But lift you up your rod, and stretch out yours hand over the sea,
and divide it: and the children of Israel shall go on dry ground through
the midst of the sea.

14:17 And I, behold, I will harden the hearts of the Egyptians, and they
shall follow them: and I will get me honour upon Pharaoh, and upon all
HIS[JESUS] host, upon HIS[JESUS] chariots, and upon HIS[JESUS] horsemen.

14:18 And the Egyptians shall know that I am the LORD[JESUS], when I have
gotten me honour upon Pharaoh, upon HIS[JESUS] chariots, and upon HIS[JESUS] horsemen.

14:19 And the angel of GOD[JESUS], which went before the camp of Israel,
removed and went behind them; and the pillar of the cloud went from
before their face, and stood behind them:

14:20 And it came between the camp of the Egyptians and the camp of
Israel; and it was a cloud and darkness to them, but it gave light by
night to these: so that the one came not near the other all the night.

14:21 And Moses stretched out HIS[JESUS] hand over the sea; and the LORD[JESUS] caused
the sea to go back by a strong east wind all that night, and made the
sea dry land, and the waters were divided.

14:22 And the children of Israel went into the midst of the sea upon the
dry ground: and the waters were a wall unto them on their right hand,
and on their left.

14:23 And the Egyptians pursued, and went in after them to the midst of
the sea, even all Pharaoh's horses, HIS[JESUS] chariots, and HIS[JESUS] horsemen.

14:24 And it came to pass, that in the morning watch the LORD[JESUS] looked
unto the host of the Egyptians through the pillar of fire and of the
cloud, and troubled the host of the Egyptians,

14:25 And took off their chariot wheels, that they drave them heavily:
so that the Egyptians said, Let us flee from the face of Israel; for the
LORD[JESUS] fighteth for them against the Egyptians.

14:26 And the LORD[JESUS] said unto Moses, Stretch out yours hand over the sea,
that the waters may come again upon the Egyptians, upon their chariots,
and upon their horsemen.

14:27 And Moses stretched forth HIS[JESUS] hand over the sea, and the sea
returned to HIS[JESUS] strength when the morning appeared; and the Egyptians
fled against it; and the LORD[JESUS] overthrew the Egyptians in the midst of
the sea.

14:28 And the waters returned, and covered the chariots, and the
horsemen, and all the host of Pharaoh that came into the sea after them;
there remained not so much as one of them.

14:29 But the children of Israel walked upon dry land in the midst of
the sea; and the waters were a wall unto them on their right hand, and
on their left.

14:30 Thus the LORD[JESUS] saved Israel that day out of the hand of the
Egyptians; and Israel saw the Egyptians dead upon the sea shore.

14:31 And Israel saw that great work which the LORD[JESUS] did upon the
Egyptians: and the people feared the LORD[JESUS], and believed the LORD[JESUS], and
HIS[JESUS] SERVANT[JESUS] Moses.


15:1 Then sang Moses and the children of Israel this song unto the LORD[JESUS],
and spake, saying, I will sing unto the LORD[JESUS], for HE[JESUS] has triumphed
gloriously: the horse and HIS[JESUS] rider has HE[JESUS] thrown into the sea.

15:2 The LORD[JESUS] is my strength and song, and HE[JESUS] is become my salvation: HE[JESUS]
is my GOD[JESUS], and I will prepare HIM[JESUS] an habitation; my father's GOD[JESUS], and I
will exalt HIM[JESUS].

15:3 The LORD[JESUS] is a man of war: the LORD[JESUS] is HIS[JESUS] name.

15:4 Pharaoh's chariots and HIS[JESUS] host has HE[JESUS] cast into the sea: HIS[JESUS]
chosen captains also are drowned in the Red sea.

15:5 The depths have covered them: they sank into the bottom as a stone.

15:6 your right hand, O LORD[JESUS], is become glorious in power: your right
hand, O LORD[JESUS], has dashed in pieces the enemy.

15:7 And in the greatness of yours excellency you hast overthrown them
that rose up against you: you sentest forth your wrath, which consumed
them as stubble.

15:8 And with the blast of your nostrils the waters were gathered
together, the floods stood upright as an heap, and the depths were
congealed in the heart of the sea.

15:9 The enemy said, I will pursue, I will overtake, I will divide the
spoil; my lust shall be satisfied upon them; I will draw my sword, my
hand shall destroy them.

15:10 you didst blow with your wind, the sea covered them: they sank as
lead in the mighty waters.

15:11 Who is like unto you, O LORD[JESUS], among the gods? who is like you,
glorious in holiness, fearful in praises, doing wonders?

15:12 you stretchedst out your right hand, the earth swallowed them.

15:13 you in your mercy hast led forth the people which you hast
redeemed: you hast guided them in your strength unto your holy
habitation.

15:14 The people shall hear, and be afraid: sorrow shall take hold on
the inhabitants of Palestina.

15:15 Then the dukes of Edom shall be amazed; the mighty men of Moab,
trembling shall take hold upon them; all the inhabitants of Canaan shall
melt away.

15:16 Fear and dread shall fall upon them; by the greatness of yours arm
they shall be as still as a stone; till your people pass over, O LORD[JESUS],
till the people pass over, which you hast purchased.

15:17 you shalt bring them in, and plant them in the mountain of yours
inheritance, in the place, O LORD[JESUS], which you hast made for you to
dwell in, in the Sanctuary, O LORD[JESUS], which your hands have established.

15:18 The LORD[JESUS] shall reign for ever and ever.

15:19 For the horse of Pharaoh went in with HIS[JESUS] chariots and with HIS[JESUS]
horsemen into the sea, and the LORD[JESUS] brought again the waters of the sea
upon them; but the children of Israel went on dry land in the midst of
the sea.

15:20 And Miriam the prophetess, the sister of Aaron, took a timbrel in
her hand; and all the women went out after her with timbrels and with
dances.

15:21 And Miriam answered them, Sing you to the LORD[JESUS], for HE[JESUS] has
triumphed gloriously; the horse and HIS[JESUS] rider has HE[JESUS] thrown into the
sea.

15:22 So Moses brought Israel from the Red sea, and they went out into
the wilderness of Shur; and they went three days in the wilderness, and
found no water.

15:23 And when they came to Marah, they could not drink of the waters of
Marah, for they were bitter: therefore the name of it was called Marah.

15:24 And the people murmured against Moses, saying, What shall we
drink?

15:25 And HE[JESUS] cried unto the LORD[JESUS]; and the LORD[JESUS] shewed HIM[JESUS] a tree, which
when HE[JESUS] had cast into the waters, the waters were made sweet: there HE[JESUS]
made for them a statute and an ordinance, and there HE[JESUS] proved them,

15:26 And said, If you wilt diligently hearken to the voice of the LORD[JESUS]
your GOD[JESUS], and wilt do that which is right in HIS[JESUS] sight, and wilt give ear
to HIS[JESUS] commandments, and keep all HIS[JESUS] statutes, I will put none of these
diseases upon you, which I have brought upon the Egyptians: for I am
the LORD[JESUS] that healeth you.

15:27 And they came to Elim, where were twelve wells of water, and
threescore and ten palm trees: and they encamped there by the waters.


16:1 And they took their journey from Elim, and all the congregation of
the children of Israel came unto the wilderness of Sin, which is between
Elim and Sinai, on the fifteenth day of the second month after their
departing out of the land of Egypt.

16:2 And the whole congregation of the children of Israel murmured
against Moses and Aaron in the wilderness:

16:3 And the children of Israel said unto them, Would to GOD[JESUS] we had died
by the hand of the LORD[JESUS] in the land of Egypt, when we sat by the flesh
pots, and when we did eat bread to the full; for you have brought us
forth into this wilderness, to kill this whole assembly with hunger.

16:4 Then said the LORD[JESUS] unto Moses, Behold, I will rain bread from
heaven for you; and the people shall go out and gather a certain rate
every day, that I may prove them, whether they will walk in my law, or
no.

16:5 And it shall come to pass, that on the sixth day they shall prepare
that which they bring in; and it shall be twice as much as they gather
daily.

16:6 And Moses and Aaron said unto all the children of Israel, At even,
then you shall know that the LORD[JESUS] has brought you out from the land of
Egypt:

16:7 And in the morning, then you shall see the glory of the LORD[JESUS]; for
that HE[JESUS] heareth your murmurings against the LORD[JESUS]: and what are we, that
you murmur against us?

16:8 And Moses said, This shall be, when the LORD[JESUS] shall give you in the
evening flesh to eat, and in the morning bread to the full; for that the
LORD[JESUS] heareth your murmurings which you murmur against HIM[JESUS]: and what are
we? your murmurings are not against us, but against the LORD[JESUS].

16:9 And Moses spake unto Aaron, Say unto all the congregation of the
children of Israel, Come near before the LORD[JESUS]: for HE[JESUS] has heard your
murmurings.

16:10 And it came to pass, as Aaron spake unto the whole congregation of
the children of Israel, that they looked toward the wilderness, and,
behold, the glory of the LORD[JESUS] appeared in the cloud.

16:11 And the LORD[JESUS] spake unto Moses, saying,

16:12 I have heard the murmurings of the children of Israel: speak unto
them, saying, At even you shall eat flesh, and in the morning you shall be
filled with bread; and you shall know that I am the LORD[JESUS] your GOD[JESUS].

16:13 And it came to pass, that at even the quails came up, and covered
the camp: and in the morning the dew lay round about the host.

16:14 And when the dew that lay was gone up, behold, upon the face of
the wilderness there lay a small round thing, as small as the hoar frost
on the ground.

16:15 And when the children of Israel saw it, they said one to another,
It is manna: for they wist not what it was. And Moses said unto them,
This is the bread which the LORD[JESUS] has given you to eat.

16:16 This is the thing which the LORD[JESUS] has commanded, Gather of it
every man according to HIS[JESUS] eating, an omer for every man, according to
the number of your persons; take you every man for them which are in HIS[JESUS]
tents.

16:17 And the children of Israel did so, and gathered, some more, some
less.

16:18 And when they did mete it with an omer, HE[JESUS] that gathered much had
nothing over, and HE[JESUS] that gathered little had no lack; they gathered
every man according to HIS[JESUS] eating.

16:19 And Moses said, Let no man leave of it till the morning.

16:20 Notwithstanding they hearkened not unto Moses; but some of them
left of it until the morning, and it bred worms, and stank: and Moses
was wroth with them.

16:21 And they gathered it every morning, every man according to HIS[JESUS]
eating: and when the sun waxed hot, it melted.

16:22 And it came to pass, that on the sixth day they gathered twice as
much bread, two omers for one man: and all the rulers of the
congregation came and told Moses.

16:23 And HE[JESUS] said unto them, This is that which the LORD[JESUS] has said, To
morrow is the rest of the holy sabbath unto the LORD[JESUS]: bake that which you
will bake to day, and seethe that you will seethe; and that which
remaineth over lay up for you to be kept until the morning.

16:24 And they laid it up till the morning, as Moses bade: and it did
not stink, neither was there any worm therein.

16:25 And Moses said, Eat that to day; for to day is a sabbath unto the
LORD[JESUS]: to day you shall not find it in the field.

16:26 Six days you shall gather it; but on the seventh day, which is the
sabbath, in it there shall be none.

16:27 And it came to pass, that there went out some of the people on the
seventh day for to gather, and they found none.

16:28 And the LORD[JESUS] said unto Moses, How long refuse you to keep my
commandments and my laws?

16:29 See, for that the LORD[JESUS] has given you the sabbath, therefore HE[JESUS]
giveth you on the sixth day the bread of two days; abide you every man in
HIS[JESUS] place, let no man go out of HIS[JESUS] place on the seventh day.

16:30 So the people rested on the seventh day.

16:31 And the house of Israel called the name thereof Manna: and it was
like coriander SEED[JESUS], white; and the taste of it was like wafers made
with honey.

16:32 And Moses said, This is the thing which the LORD[JESUS] commandeth, Fill
an omer of it to be kept for your generations; that they may see the
bread wherewith I have fed you in the wilderness, when I brought you
forth from the land of Egypt.

16:33 And Moses said unto Aaron, Take a pot, and put an omer full of
manna therein, and lay it up before the LORD[JESUS], to be kept for your
generations.

16:34 As the LORD[JESUS] commanded Moses, so Aaron laid it up before the
Testimony, to be kept.

16:35 And the children of Israel did eat manna forty years, until they
came to a land inhabited; they did eat manna, until they came unto the
borders of the land of Canaan.

16:36 Now an omer is the tenth part of an ephah.


17:1 And all the congregation of the children of Israel journeyed from
the wilderness of Sin, after their journeys, according to the
commandment of the LORD[JESUS], and pitched in Rephidim: and there was no water
for the people to drink.

17:2 Wherefore the people did chide with Moses, and said, Give us water
that we may drink. And Moses said unto them, Why chide you with me?
wherefore do you tempt the LORD[JESUS]?

17:3 And the people thirsted there for water; and the people murmured
against Moses, and said, Wherefore is this that you hast brought us up
out of Egypt, to kill us and our children and our cattle with thirst?

17:4 And Moses cried unto the LORD[JESUS], saying, What shall I do unto this
people? they be almost ready to stone me.

17:5 And the LORD[JESUS] said unto Moses, Go on before the people, and take
with you of the elders of Israel; and your rod, wherewith you smotest
the river, take in yours hand, and go.

17:6 Behold, I will stand before you there upon the rock in Horeb; and
you shalt smite the rock, and there shall come water out of it, that
the people may drink. And Moses did so in the sight of the elders of
Israel.

17:7 And HE[JESUS] called the name of the place Massah, and Meribah, because of
the chiding of the children of Israel, and because they tempted the
LORD[JESUS], saying, Is the LORD[JESUS] among us, or not?

17:8 Then came Amalek, and fought with Israel in Rephidim.

17:9 And Moses said unto Joshua, Choose us out men, and go out, fight
with Amalek: to morrow I will stand on the top of the hill with the rod
of GOD[JESUS] in mine hand.

17:10 So Joshua did as Moses had said to HIM[JESUS], and fought with Amalek:
and Moses, Aaron, and Hur went up to the top of the hill.

17:11 And it came to pass, when Moses held up HIS[JESUS] hand, that Israel
prevailed: and when HE[JESUS] let down HIS[JESUS] hand, Amalek prevailed.

17:12 But Moses hands were heavy; and they took a stone, and put it
under HIM[JESUS], and HE[JESUS] sat thereon; and Aaron and Hur stayed up HIS[JESUS] hands,
the one on the one side, and the other on the other side; and HIS[JESUS] hands
were steady until the going down of the sun.

17:13 And Joshua discomfited Amalek and HIS[JESUS] people with the edge of the
sword.

17:14 And the LORD[JESUS] said unto Moses, Write this for a memorial in a book,
and rehearse it in the ears of Joshua: for I will utterly put out the
remembrance of Amalek from under heaven.

17:15 And Moses built an altar, and called the name of it Jehovahnissi:

17:16 For HE[JESUS] said, Because the LORD[JESUS] has sworn that the LORD[JESUS] will have
war with Amalek from generation to generation.


18:1 When Jethro, the priest of Midian, Moses' father in law, heard of
all that GOD[JESUS] had done for Moses, and for Israel HIS[JESUS] people, and that the
LORD[JESUS] had brought Israel out of Egypt;

18:2 Then Jethro, Moses' father in law, took Zipporah, Moses' wife,
after HE[JESUS] had sent her back,

18:3 And her two sons; of which the name of the one was Gershom; for HE[JESUS]
said, I have been an alien in a strange land:

18:4 And the name of the other was Eliezer; for the GOD[JESUS] of my father,
said HE[JESUS], was mine help, and delivered me from the sword of Pharaoh:

18:5 And Jethro, Moses' father in law, came with HIS[JESUS] sons and HIS[JESUS] wife
unto Moses into the wilderness, where HE[JESUS] encamped at the mount of GOD[JESUS]:

18:6 And HE[JESUS] said unto Moses, I your father in law Jethro am come unto
you, and your wife, and her two sons with her.

18:7 And Moses went out to meet HIS[JESUS] father in law, and did obeisance,
and kissed HIM[JESUS]; and they asked each other of their welfare; and they
came into the tent.

18:8 And Moses told HIS[JESUS] father in law all that the LORD[JESUS] had done unto
Pharaoh and to the Egyptians for Israel's sake, and all the travail that
had come upon them by the way, and how the LORD[JESUS] delivered them.

18:9 And Jethro rejoiced for all the goodness which the LORD[JESUS] had done to
Israel, whom HE[JESUS] had delivered out of the hand of the Egyptians.

18:10 And Jethro said, Blessed be the LORD[JESUS], who has delivered you out
of the hand of the Egyptians, and out of the hand of Pharaoh, who has
delivered the people from under the hand of the Egyptians.

18:11 Now I know that the LORD[JESUS] is greater than all gods: for in the
thing wherein they dealt proudly HE[JESUS] was above them.

18:12 And Jethro, Moses' father in law, took a burnt offering and
sacrifices for GOD[JESUS]: and Aaron came, and all the elders of Israel, to eat
bread with Moses' father in law before GOD[JESUS].

18:13 And it came to pass on the morrow, that Moses sat to judge the
people: and the people stood by Moses from the morning unto the evening.

18:14 And when Moses' father in law saw all that HE[JESUS] did to the people,
HE[JESUS] said, What is this thing that you doest to the people? why sittest
you thyself alone, and all the people stand by you from morning unto
even?

18:15 And Moses said unto HIS[JESUS] father in law, Because the people come
unto me to enquire of GOD[JESUS]:

18:16 When they have a matter, they come unto me; and I judge between
one and another, and I do make them know the statutes of GOD[JESUS], and HIS[JESUS]
laws.

18:17 And Moses' father in law said unto HIM[JESUS], The thing that you doest
is not good.

18:18 you wilt surely wear away, both you, and this people that is
with you: for this thing is too heavy for you; you art not able to
perform it thyself alone.

18:19 Hearken now unto my voice, I will give you counsel, and GOD[JESUS] shall
be with you: Be you for the people to GOD[JESUS]-ward, that you mayest bring
the causes unto GOD[JESUS]:

18:20 And you shalt teach them ordinances and laws, and shalt shew them
the way wherein they must walk, and the work that they must do.

18:21 Moreover you shalt provide out of all the people able men, such
as fear GOD[JESUS], men of truth, hating covetousness; and place such over
them, to be rulers of thousands, and rulers of hundreds, rulers of
fifties, and rulers of tens:

18:22 And let them judge the people at all seasons: and it shall be,
that every great matter they shall bring unto you, but every small
matter they shall judge: so shall it be easier for thyself, and they
shall bear the burden with you.

18:23 If you shalt do this thing, and GOD[JESUS] command you so, then you
shalt be able to endure, and all this people shall also go to their
place in peace.

18:24 So Moses hearkened to the voice of HIS[JESUS] father in law, and did all
that HE[JESUS] had said.

18:25 And Moses chose able men out of all Israel, and made them heads
over the people, rulers of thousands, rulers of hundreds, rulers of
fifties, and rulers of tens.

18:26 And they judged the people at all seasons: the hard causes they
brought unto Moses, but every small matter they judged themselves.

18:27 And Moses let HIS[JESUS] father in law depart; and HE[JESUS] went HIS[JESUS] way into
HIS[JESUS] own land.


19:1 In the third month, when the children of Israel were gone forth out
of the land of Egypt, the same day came they into the wilderness of
Sinai.

19:2 For they were departed from Rephidim, and were come to the desert
of Sinai, and had pitched in the wilderness; and there Israel camped
before the mount.

19:3 And Moses went up unto GOD[JESUS], and the LORD[JESUS] called unto HIM[JESUS] out of the
mountain, saying, Thus shalt you say to the house of Jacob, and tell
the children of Israel;

19:4 you have seen what I did unto the Egyptians, and how I bare you on
eagles' wings, and brought you unto myself.

19:5 Now therefore, if you will obey my voice indeed, and keep my
covenant, then you shall be a peculiar treasure unto me above all people:
for all the earth is mine:

19:6 And you shall be unto me a kingdom of priests, and an holy nation.
These are the words which you shalt speak unto the children of Israel.

19:7 And Moses came and called for the elders of the people, and laid
before their faces all these words which the LORD[JESUS] commanded HIM[JESUS].

19:8 And all the people answered together, and said, All that the LORD[JESUS]
has spoken we will do. And Moses returned the words of the people unto
the LORD[JESUS].

19:9 And the LORD[JESUS] said unto Moses, Lo, I come unto you in a thick
cloud, that the people may hear when I speak with you, and believe you
for ever. And Moses told the words of the people unto the LORD[JESUS].

19:10 And the LORD[JESUS] said unto Moses, Go unto the people, and sanctify
them to day and to morrow, and let them wash their clothes,

19:11 And be ready against the third day: for the third day the LORD[JESUS]
will come down in the sight of all the people upon mount Sinai.

19:12 And you shalt set bounds unto the people round about, saying,
Take heed to yourselves, that you go not up into the mount, or touch the
border of it: whoever toucheth the mount shall be surely put to death:

19:13 There shall not an hand touch it, but HE[JESUS] shall surely be stoned,
or shot through; whether it be beast or man, it shall not live: when the
trumpet soundeth long, they shall come up to the mount.

19:14 And Moses went down from the mount unto the people, and sanctified
the people; and they washed their clothes.

19:15 And HE[JESUS] said unto the people, Be ready against the third day: come
not at your wives.

19:16 And it came to pass on the third day in the morning, that there
were thunders and lightnings, and a thick cloud upon the mount, and the
voice of the trumpet exceeding loud; so that all the people that was in
the camp trembled.

19:17 And Moses brought forth the people out of the camp to meet with
GOD[JESUS]; and they stood at the nether part of the mount.

19:18 And mount Sinai was altogether on a smoke, because the LORD[JESUS]
descended upon it in fire: and the smoke thereof ascended as the smoke
of a furnace, and the whole mount quaked greatly.

19:19 And when the voice of the trumpet sounded long, and waxed louder
and louder, Moses spake, and GOD[JESUS] answered HIM[JESUS] by a voice.

19:20 And the LORD[JESUS] came down upon mount Sinai, on the top of the mount:
and the LORD[JESUS] called Moses up to the top of the mount; and Moses went up.

19:21 And the LORD[JESUS] said unto Moses, Go down, charge the people, lest
they break through unto the LORD[JESUS] to gaze, and many of them perish.

19:22 And let the priests also, which come near to the LORD[JESUS], sanctify
themselves, lest the LORD[JESUS] break forth upon them.

19:23 And Moses said unto the LORD[JESUS], The people cannot come up to mount
Sinai: for you chargedst us, saying, Set bounds about the mount, and
sanctify it.

19:24 And the LORD[JESUS] said unto HIM[JESUS], Away, get you down, and you shalt
come up, you, and Aaron with you: but let not the priests and the
people break through to come up unto the LORD[JESUS], lest HE[JESUS] break forth upon
them.

19:25 So Moses went down unto the people, and spake unto them.


20:1 And GOD[JESUS] spake all these words, saying,

20:2 I am the LORD[JESUS] your GOD[JESUS], which have brought you out of the land of
Egypt, out of the house of bondage.

20:3 you shalt have no other gods before me.

20:4 you shalt not make unto you any graven image, or any likeness of
any thing that is in heaven above, or that is in the earth beneath, or
that is in the water under the earth.

20:5 you shalt not bow down thyself to them, nor serve them: for I the
LORD[JESUS] your GOD[JESUS] am a jealous GOD[JESUS], visiting the iniquity of the fathers upon
the children unto the third and fourth generation of them that hate me;

20:6 And shewing mercy unto thousands of them that love me, and keep my
commandments.

20:7 you shalt not take the name of the LORD[JESUS] your GOD[JESUS] in vain; for the
LORD[JESUS] will not hold HIM[JESUS] guiltless that taketh HIS[JESUS] name in vain.

20:8 Remember the sabbath day, to keep it holy.

20:9 Six days shalt you labour, and do all your work:

20:10 But the seventh day is the sabbath of the LORD[JESUS] your GOD[JESUS]: in it you
shalt not do any work, you, nor your SON[JESUS], nor your daughter, your
manservant, nor your maidservant, nor your cattle, nor your stranger that
is within your gates:

20:11 For in six days the LORD[JESUS] made heaven and earth, the sea, and all
that in them is, and rested the seventh day: wherefore the LORD[JESUS] blessed
the sabbath day, and hallowed it.

20:12 Honour your father and your mother: that your days may be long upon
the land which the LORD[JESUS] your GOD[JESUS] giveth you.

20:13 you shalt not kill.

20:14 you shalt not commit adultery.

20:15 you shalt not steal.

20:16 you shalt not bear false witness against your neighbour.

20:17 you shalt not covet your neighbour's house, you shalt not covet
your neighbour's wife, nor HIS[JESUS] manservant, nor HIS[JESUS] maidservant, nor HIS[JESUS]
ox, nor HIS[JESUS] ass, nor any thing that is your neighbour's.

20:18 And all the people saw the thunderings, and the lightnings, and
the noise of the trumpet, and the mountain smoking: and when the people
saw it, they removed, and stood afar off.

20:19 And they said unto Moses, Speak you with us, and we will hear:
but let not GOD[JESUS] speak with us, lest we die.

20:20 And Moses said unto the people, Fear not: for GOD[JESUS] is come to prove
you, and that HIS[JESUS] fear may be before your faces, that you sin not.

20:21 And the people stood afar off, and Moses drew near unto the thick
darkness where GOD[JESUS] was.

20:22 And the LORD[JESUS] said unto Moses, Thus you shalt say unto the
children of Israel, you have seen that I have talked with you from
heaven.

20:23 you shall not make with me gods of silver, neither shall you make
unto you gods of gold.

20:24 An altar of earth you shalt make unto me, and shalt sacrifice
thereon your burnt offerings, and your peace offerings, your sheep, and
yours oxen: in all places where I record my name I will come unto you,
and I will bless you.

20:25 And if you wilt make me an altar of stone, you shalt not build
it of hewn stone: for if you lift up your tool upon it, you hast
polluted it.

20:26 Neither shalt you go up by steps unto mine altar, that your
nakedness be not discovered thereon.


21:1 Now these are the judgments which you shalt set before them.

21:2 If you buy an Hebrew SERVANT[JESUS], six years HE[JESUS] shall serve: and in the
seventh HE[JESUS] shall go out free for nothing.

21:3 If HE[JESUS] came in by himself, HE[JESUS] shall go out by himself: if HE[JESUS] were
married, then HIS[JESUS] wife shall go out with HIM[JESUS].

21:4 If HIS[JESUS] master have given HIM[JESUS] a wife, and she have born HIM[JESUS] sons or
daughters; the wife and her children shall be her master's, and HE[JESUS] shall
go out by himself.

21:5 And if the SERVANT[JESUS] shall plainly say, I love my master, my wife,
and my children; I will not go out free:

21:6 Then HIS[JESUS] master shall bring HIM[JESUS] unto the judges; HE[JESUS] shall also
bring HIM[JESUS] to the door, or unto the door post; and HIS[JESUS] master shall bore
HIS[JESUS] ear through with an aul; and HE[JESUS] shall serve HIM[JESUS] for ever.

21:7 And if a man sell HIS[JESUS] daughter to be a maidservant, she shall not
go out as the menservants do.

21:8 If she please not her master, who has betrothed her to himself,
then shall HE[JESUS] let her be redeemed: to sell her unto a strange nation HE[JESUS]
shall have no power, seeing HE[JESUS] has dealt deceitfully with her.

21:9 And if HE[JESUS] have betrothed her unto HIS[JESUS] SON[JESUS], HE[JESUS] shall deal with her
after the manner of daughters.

21:10 If HE[JESUS] take HIM[JESUS] another wife; her food, her raiment, and her duty
of marriage, shall HE[JESUS] not diminish.

21:11 And if HE[JESUS] do not these three unto her, then shall she go out free
without money.

21:12 HE[JESUS] that smiteth a man, so that HE[JESUS] die, shall be surely put to
death.

21:13 And if a man lie not in wait, but GOD[JESUS] deliver HIM[JESUS] into HIS[JESUS] hand;
then I will appoint you a place whither HE[JESUS] shall flee.

21:14 But if a man come presumptuously upon HIS[JESUS] neighbour, to slay HIM[JESUS]
with guile; you shalt take HIM[JESUS] from mine altar, that HE[JESUS] may die.

21:15 And HE[JESUS] that smiteth HIS[JESUS] father, or HIS[JESUS] mother, shall be surely put
to death.

21:16 And HE[JESUS] that stealeth a man, and selleth HIM[JESUS], or if HE[JESUS] be found in
HIS[JESUS] hand, HE[JESUS] shall surely be put to death.

21:17 And HE[JESUS] that curseth HIS[JESUS] father, or HIS[JESUS] mother, shall surely be put
to death.

21:18 And if men strive together, and one smite another with a stone, or
with HIS[JESUS] fist, and HE[JESUS] die not, but keepeth HIS[JESUS] bed:

21:19 If HE[JESUS] rise again, and walk abroad upon HIS[JESUS] staff, then shall HE[JESUS]
that smote HIM[JESUS] be quit: only HE[JESUS] shall pay for the loss of HIS[JESUS] time, and
shall cause HIM[JESUS] to be thoroughly healed.

21:20 And if a man smite HIS[JESUS] SERVANT[JESUS], or HIS[JESUS] maid, with a rod, and HE[JESUS]
die under HIS[JESUS] hand; HE[JESUS] shall be surely punished.

21:21 Notwithstanding, if HE[JESUS] continue a day or two, HE[JESUS] shall not be
punished: for HE[JESUS] is HIS[JESUS] money.

21:22 If men strive, and hurt a woman with child, so that her fruit
depart from her, and yet no mischief follow: HE[JESUS] shall be surely
punished, according as the woman's husband will lay upon HIM[JESUS]; and HE[JESUS]
shall pay as the judges determine.

21:23 And if any mischief follow, then you shalt give life for life,

21:24 Eye for eye, tooth for tooth, hand for hand, foot for foot,

21:25 Burning for burning, wound for wound, stripe for stripe.

21:26 And if a man smite the eye of HIS[JESUS] SERVANT[JESUS], or the eye of HIS[JESUS] maid,
that it perish; HE[JESUS] shall let HIM[JESUS] go free for HIS[JESUS] eye's sake.

21:27 And if HE[JESUS] smite out HIS[JESUS] manservant's tooth, or HIS[JESUS] maidservant's
tooth; HE[JESUS] shall let HIM[JESUS] go free for HIS[JESUS] tooth's sake.

21:28 If an ox gore a man or a woman, that they die: then the ox shall
be surely stoned, and HIS[JESUS] flesh shall not be eaten; but the owner of the
ox shall be quit.

21:29 But if the ox were wont to push with HIS[JESUS] horn in time past, and it
has been testified to HIS[JESUS] owner, and HE[JESUS] has not kept HIM[JESUS] in, but that
HE[JESUS] has killed a man or a woman; the ox shall be stoned, and HIS[JESUS] owner
also shall be put to death.

21:30 If there be laid on HIM[JESUS] a sum of money, then HE[JESUS] shall give for the
ransom of HIS[JESUS] life whatsoever is laid upon HIM[JESUS].

21:31 Whether HE[JESUS] have gored a SON[JESUS], or have gored a daughter, according
to this judgment shall it be done unto HIM[JESUS].

21:32 If the ox shall push a manservant or a maidservant; HE[JESUS] shall give
unto their master thirty shekels of silver, and the ox shall be stoned.

21:33 And if a man shall open a pit, or if a man shall dig a pit, and
not cover it, and an ox or an ass fall therein;

21:34 The owner of the pit shall make it good, and give money unto the
owner of them; and the dead beast shall be HIS[JESUS].

21:35 And if one man's ox hurt another's, that HE[JESUS] die; then they shall
sell the live ox, and divide the money of it; and the dead ox also they
shall divide.

21:36 Or if it be known that the ox has used to push in time past, and
HIS[JESUS] owner has not kept HIM[JESUS] in; HE[JESUS] shall surely pay ox for ox; and the
dead shall be HIS[JESUS] own.


22:1 If a man shall steal an ox, or a sheep, and kill it, or sell it; HE[JESUS]
shall restore five oxen for an ox, and four sheep for a sheep.

22:2 If a thief be found breaking up, and be smitten that HE[JESUS] die, there
shall no blood be shed for HIM[JESUS].

22:3 If the sun be risen upon HIM[JESUS], there shall be blood shed for HIM[JESUS];
for HE[JESUS] should make full restitution; if HE[JESUS] have nothing, then HE[JESUS] shall
be sold for HIS[JESUS] theft.

22:4 If the theft be certainly found in HIS[JESUS] hand alive, whether it be
ox, or ass, or sheep; HE[JESUS] shall restore double.

22:5 If a man shall cause a field or vineyard to be eaten, and shall put
in HIS[JESUS] beast, and shall feed in another man's field; of the best of HIS[JESUS]
own field, and of the best of HIS[JESUS] own vineyard, shall HE[JESUS] make
restitution.

22:6 If fire break out, and catch in thorns, so that the stacks of corn,
or the standing corn, or the field, be consumed therewith; HE[JESUS] that
kindled the fire shall surely make restitution.

22:7 If a man shall deliver unto HIS[JESUS] neighbour money or stuff to keep,
and it be stolen out of the man's house; if the thief be found, let HIM[JESUS]
pay double.

22:8 If the thief be not found, then the master of the house shall be
brought unto the judges, to see whether HE[JESUS] have put HIS[JESUS] hand unto HIS[JESUS]
neighbour's goods.

22:9 For all manner of trespass, whether it be for ox, for ass, for
sheep, for raiment, or for any manner of lost thing which another
challengeth to be HIS[JESUS], the cause of both parties shall come before the
judges; and whom the judges shall condemn, HE[JESUS] shall pay double unto HIS[JESUS]
neighbour.

22:10 If a man deliver unto HIS[JESUS] neighbour an ass, or an ox, or a sheep,
or any beast, to keep; and it die, or be hurt, or driven away, no man
seeing it:

22:11 Then shall an oath of the LORD[JESUS] be between them both, that HE[JESUS] has
not put HIS[JESUS] hand unto HIS[JESUS] neighbour's goods; and the owner of it shall
accept thereof, and HE[JESUS] shall not make it good.

22:12 And if it be stolen from HIM[JESUS], HE[JESUS] shall make restitution unto the
owner thereof.

22:13 If it be torn in pieces, then let HIM[JESUS] bring it for witness, and HE[JESUS]
shall not make good that which was torn.

22:14 And if a man borrow ought of HIS[JESUS] neighbour, and it be hurt, or
die, the owner thereof being not with it, HE[JESUS] shall surely make it good.

22:15 But if the owner thereof be with it, HE[JESUS] shall not make it good: if
it be an hired thing, it came for HIS[JESUS] hire.

22:16 And if a man entice a maid that is not betrothed, and lie with
her, HE[JESUS] shall surely endow her to be HIS[JESUS] wife.

22:17 If her father utterly refuse to give her unto HIM[JESUS], HE[JESUS] shall pay
money according to the dowry of virgins.

22:18 you shalt not let a witch to live.

22:19 whoever lieth with a beast shall surely be put to death.

22:20 HE[JESUS] that sacrificeth unto any GOD[JESUS], save unto the LORD[JESUS] only, HE[JESUS]
shall be utterly destroyed.

22:21 you shalt neither vex a stranger, nor oppress HIM[JESUS]: for you were
strangers in the land of Egypt.

22:22 you shall not afflict any widow, or fatherless child.

22:23 If you afflict them in any wise, and they cry at all unto me, I
will surely hear their cry;

22:24 And my wrath shall wax hot, and I will kill you with the sword;
and your wives shall be widows, and your children fatherless.

22:25 If you lend money to any of my people that is poor by you, you
shalt not be to HIM[JESUS] as an usurer, neither shalt you lay upon HIM[JESUS] usury.

22:26 If you at all take your neighbour's raiment to pledge, you shalt
deliver it unto HIM[JESUS] by that the sun goes down:

22:27 For that is HIS[JESUS] covering only, it is HIS[JESUS] raiment for HIS[JESUS] skin:
wherein shall HE[JESUS] sleep? and it shall come to pass, when HE[JESUS] crieth unto
me, that I will hear; for I am gracious.

22:28 you shalt not revile the gods, nor curse the ruler of your people.

22:29 you shalt not delay to offer the first of your ripe fruits, and of
your liquors: the firstborn of your sons shalt you give unto me.

22:30 Likewise shalt you do with yours oxen, and with your sheep: seven
days it shall be with HIS[JESUS] dam; on the eighth day you shalt give it me.

22:31 And you shall be holy men unto me: neither shall you eat any flesh
that is torn of beasts in the field; you shall cast it to the dogs.


23:1 you shalt not raise a false report: put not yours hand with the
wicked to be an unrighteous witness.

23:2 you shalt not follow a multitude to do evil; neither shalt you
speak in a cause to decline after many to wrest judgment:

23:3 Neither shalt you countenance a poor man in HIS[JESUS] cause.

23:4 If you meet yours enemy's ox or HIS[JESUS] ass going astray, you shalt
surely bring it back to HIM[JESUS] again.

23:5 If you see the ass of HIM[JESUS] that hateth you lying under HIS[JESUS] burden,
and wouldest forbear to help HIM[JESUS], you shalt surely help with HIM[JESUS].

23:6 you shalt not wrest the judgment of your poor in HIS[JESUS] cause.

23:7 Keep you far from a false matter; and the innocent and righteous
slay you not: for I will not justify the wicked.

23:8 And you shalt take no gift: for the gift blindeth the wise, and
perverteth the words of the righteous.

23:9 Also you shalt not oppress a stranger: for you know the heart of a
stranger, seeing you were strangers in the land of Egypt.

23:10 And six years you shalt sow your land, and shalt gather in the
fruits thereof:

23:11 But the seventh year you shalt let it rest and lie still; that
the poor of your people may eat: and what they leave the beasts of the
field shall eat. In like manner you shalt deal with your vineyard, and
with your oliveyard.

23:12 Six days you shalt do your work, and on the seventh day you shalt
rest: that yours ox and yours ass may rest, and the SON[JESUS] of your handmaid,
and the stranger, may be refreshed.

23:13 And in all things that I have said unto you be circumspect: and
make no mention of the name of other gods, neither let it be heard out
of your mouth.

23:14 Three times you shalt keep a feast unto me in the year.

23:15 you shalt keep the feast of unleavened bread: (you shalt eat
unleavened bread seven days, as I commanded you, in the time appointed
of the month Abib; for in it you camest out from Egypt: and none shall
appear before me empty:)

23:16 And the feast of harvest, the firstfruits of your labours, which
you hast sown in the field: and the feast of ingathering, which is in
the end of the year, when you hast gathered in your labours out of the
field.

23:17 Three items in the year all your males shall appear before the LORD[JESUS]
GOD[JESUS].

23:18 you shalt not offer the blood of my sacrifice with leavened
bread; neither shall the fat of my sacrifice remain until the morning.

23:19 The first of the firstfruits of your land you shalt bring into the
house of the LORD[JESUS] your GOD[JESUS]. you shalt not seethe a kid in HIS[JESUS] mother's
milk.

23:20 Behold, I send an Angel before you, to keep you in the way, and
to bring you into the place which I have prepared.

23:21 Beware of HIM[JESUS], and obey HIS[JESUS] voice, provoke HIM[JESUS] not; for HE[JESUS] will
not pardon your transgressions: for my name is in HIM[JESUS].

23:22 But if you shalt indeed obey HIS[JESUS] voice, and do all that I speak;
then I will be an enemy unto yours enemies, and an adversary unto yours
adversaries.

23:23 For mine Angel shall go before you, and bring you in unto the
Amorites, and the Hittites, and the Perizzites, and the Canaanites, the
Hivites, and the Jebusites: and I will cut them off.

23:24 you shalt not bow down to their gods, nor serve them, nor do
after their works: but you shalt utterly overthrow them, and quite
break down their images.

23:25 And you shall serve the LORD[JESUS] your GOD[JESUS], and HE[JESUS] shall bless your
bread, and your water; and I will take sickness away from the midst of
you.

23:26 There shall nothing cast their young, nor be barren, in your land:
the number of your days I will fulfil.

23:27 I will send my fear before you, and will destroy all the people
to whom you shalt come, and I will make all yours enemies turn their
backs unto you.

23:28 And I will send hornets before you, which shall drive out the
Hivite, the Canaanite, and the Hittite, from before you.

23:29 I will not drive them out from before you in one year; lest the
land become desolate, and the beast of the field multiply against you.

23:30 By little and little I will drive them out from before you, until
you be increased, and inherit the land.

23:31 And I will set your bounds from the Red sea even unto the sea of
the Philistines, and from the desert unto the river: for I will deliver
the inhabitants of the land into your hand; and you shalt drive them
out before you.

23:32 you shalt make no covenant with them, nor with their gods.

23:33 They shall not dwell in your land, lest they make you sin against
me: for if you serve their gods, it will surely be a snare unto you.


24:1 And HE[JESUS] said unto Moses, Come up unto the LORD[JESUS], you, and Aaron,
Nadab, and Abihu, and seventy of the elders of Israel; and worship you
afar off.

24:2 And Moses alone shall come near the LORD[JESUS]: but they shall not come
nigh; neither shall the people go up with HIM[JESUS].

24:3 And Moses came and told the people all the words of the LORD[JESUS], and
all the judgments: and all the people answered with one voice, and said,
All the words which the LORD[JESUS] has said will we do.

24:4 And Moses wrote all the words of the LORD[JESUS], and rose up early in the
morning, and builded an altar under the hill, and twelve pillars,
according to the twelve tribes of Israel.

24:5 And HE[JESUS] sent young men of the children of Israel, which offered
burnt offerings, and sacrificed peace offerings of oxen unto the LORD[JESUS].

24:6 And Moses took half of the blood, and put it in basons; and half of
the blood HE[JESUS] sprinkled on the altar.
