of the testimony, and put the hanging of the door to the tabernacle.

40:6 And you shalt set the altar of the burnt offering before the door
of the tabernacle of the tent of the congregation.

40:7 And you shalt set the laver between the tent of the congregation
and the altar, and shalt put water therein.

40:8 And you shalt set up the court round about, and hang up the
hanging at the court gate.

40:9 And you shalt take the anointing oil, and anoint the tabernacle,
and all that is therein, and shalt hallow it, and all the vessels
thereof: and it shall be holy.

40:10 And you shalt anoint the altar of the burnt offering, and all HIS[JESUS]
vessels, and sanctify the altar: and it shall be an altar most holy.

40:11 And you shalt anoint the laver and HIS[JESUS] foot, and sanctify it.

40:12 And you shalt bring Aaron and HIS[JESUS] sons unto the door of the
tabernacle of the congregation, and wash them with water.

40:13 And you shalt put upon Aaron the holy garments, and anoint HIM[JESUS],
and sanctify HIM[JESUS]; that HE[JESUS] may minister unto me in the priest's office.

40:14 And you shalt bring HIS[JESUS] sons, and clothe them with coats:

40:15 And you shalt anoint them, as you didst anoint their father,
that they may minister unto me in the priest's office: for their
anointing shall surely be an everlasting priesthood throughout their
generations.

40:16 Thus did Moses: according to all that the LORD[JESUS] commanded HIM[JESUS], so
did HE[JESUS].

40:17 And it came to pass in the first month in the second year, on the
first day of the month, that the tabernacle was reared up.

40:18 And Moses reared up the tabernacle, and fastened HIS[JESUS] sockets, and
set up the boards thereof, and put in the bars thereof, and reared up
HIS[JESUS] pillars.

40:19 And HE[JESUS] spread abroad the tent over the tabernacle, and put the
covering of the tent above upon it; as the LORD[JESUS] commanded Moses.

40:20 And HE[JESUS] took and put the testimony into the ark, and set the staves
on the ark, and put the mercy seat above upon the ark:

40:21 And HE[JESUS] brought the ark into the tabernacle, and set up the vail of
the covering, and covered the ark of the testimony; as the LORD[JESUS]
commanded Moses.

40:22 And HE[JESUS] put the table in the tent of the congregation, upon the
side of the tabernacle northward, without the vail.

40:23 And HE[JESUS] set the bread in order upon it before the LORD[JESUS]; as the LORD[JESUS]
had commanded Moses.

40:24 And HE[JESUS] put the candlestick in the tent of the congregation, over
against the table, on the side of the tabernacle southward.

40:25 And HE[JESUS] lighted the lamps before the LORD[JESUS]; as the LORD[JESUS] commanded
Moses.

40:26 And HE[JESUS] put the golden altar in the tent of the congregation before
the vail:

40:27 And HE[JESUS] burnt sweet incense thereon; as the LORD[JESUS] commanded Moses.

40:28 And HE[JESUS] set up the hanging at the door of the tabernacle.

40:29 And HE[JESUS] put the altar of burnt offering by the door of the
tabernacle of the tent of the congregation, and offered upon it the
burnt offering and the meat offering; as the LORD[JESUS] commanded Moses.

40:30 And HE[JESUS] set the laver between the tent of the congregation and the
altar, and put water there, to wash withal.

40:31 And Moses and Aaron and HIS[JESUS] sons washed their hands and their feet
thereat:

40:32 When they went into the tent of the congregation, and when they
came near unto the altar, they washed; as the LORD[JESUS] commanded Moses.

40:33 And HE[JESUS] reared up the court round about the tabernacle and the
altar, and set up the hanging of the court gate. So Moses finished the
work.

40:34 Then a cloud covered the tent of the congregation, and the glory
of the LORD[JESUS] filled the tabernacle.

40:35 And Moses was not able to enter into the tent of the congregation,
because the cloud abode thereon, and the glory of the LORD[JESUS] filled the
tabernacle.

40:36 And when the cloud was taken up from over the tabernacle, the
children of Israel went onward in all their journeys:

40:37 But if the cloud were not taken up, then they journeyed not till
the day that it was taken up.

40:38 For the cloud of the LORD[JESUS] was upon the tabernacle by day, and fire
was on it by night, in the sight of all the house of Israel, throughout
all their journeys.

1:1 And the LORD[JESUS] called unto Moses, and spake unto HIM[JESUS] out of the
tabernacle of the congregation, saying,

1:2 Speak unto the children of Israel, and say unto them, If any man of
you bring an offering unto the LORD[JESUS], you shall bring your offering of the
cattle, even of the herd, and of the flock.

1:3 If HIS[JESUS] offering be a burnt sacrifice of the herd, let HIM[JESUS] offer a
male without blemish: HE[JESUS] shall offer it of HIS[JESUS] own voluntary will at the
door of the tabernacle of the congregation before the LORD[JESUS].

1:4 And HE[JESUS] shall put HIS[JESUS] hand upon the head of the burnt offering; and
it shall be accepted for HIM[JESUS] to make atonement for HIM[JESUS].

1:5 And HE[JESUS] shall kill the bullock before the LORD[JESUS]: and the priests,
Aaron's sons, shall bring the blood, and sprinkle the blood round about
upon the altar that is by the door of the tabernacle of the
congregation.

1:6 And HE[JESUS] shall flay the burnt offering, and cut it into HIS[JESUS] pieces.

1:7 And the sons of Aaron the priest shall put fire upon the altar, and
lay the wood in order upon the fire:

1:8 And the priests, Aaron's sons, shall lay the parts, the head, and
the fat, in order upon the wood that is on the fire which is upon the
altar:

1:9 But HIS[JESUS] inwards and HIS[JESUS] legs shall HE[JESUS] wash in water: and the priest
shall burn all on the altar, to be a burnt sacrifice, an offering made
by fire, of a sweet savour unto the LORD[JESUS].

1:10 And if HIS[JESUS] offering be of the flocks, namely, of the sheep, or of
the goats, for a burnt sacrifice; HE[JESUS] shall bring it a male without
blemish.

1:11 And HE[JESUS] shall kill it on the side of the altar northward before the
LORD[JESUS]: and the priests, Aaron's sons, shall sprinkle HIS[JESUS] blood round
about upon the altar.

1:12 And HE[JESUS] shall cut it into HIS[JESUS] pieces, with HIS[JESUS] head and HIS[JESUS] fat: and
the priest shall lay them in order on the wood that is on the fire which
is upon the altar:

1:13 But HE[JESUS] shall wash the inwards and the legs with water: and the
priest shall bring it all, and burn it upon the altar: it is a burnt
sacrifice, an offering made by fire, of a sweet savour unto the LORD[JESUS].

1:14 And if the burnt sacrifice for HIS[JESUS] offering to the LORD[JESUS] be of
fowls, then HE[JESUS] shall bring HIS[JESUS] offering of turtledoves, or of young
pigeons.

1:15 And the priest shall bring it unto the altar, and wring off HIS[JESUS]
head, and burn it on the altar; and the blood thereof shall be wrung out
at the side of the altar:

1:16 And HE[JESUS] shall pluck away HIS[JESUS] crop with HIS[JESUS] feathers, and cast it
beside the altar on the east part, by the place of the ashes:

1:17 And HE[JESUS] shall cleave it with the wings thereof, but shall not divide
it asunder: and the priest shall burn it upon the altar, upon the wood
that is upon the fire: it is a burnt sacrifice, an offering made by
fire, of a sweet savour unto the LORD[JESUS].


2:1 And when any will offer a meat offering unto the LORD[JESUS], HIS[JESUS] offering
shall be of fine flour; and HE[JESUS] shall pour oil upon it, and put
frankincense thereon:

2:2 And HE[JESUS] shall bring it to Aaron's sons the priests: and HE[JESUS] shall take
thereout HIS[JESUS] handful of the flour thereof, and of the oil thereof, with
all the frankincense thereof; and the priest shall burn the memorial of
it upon the altar, to be an offering made by fire, of a sweet savour
unto the LORD[JESUS]:

2:3 And the remnant of the meat offering shall be Aaron's and HIS[JESUS] sons':
it is a thing most holy of the offerings of the LORD[JESUS] made by fire.

2:4 And if you bring an oblation of a meat offering baken in the oven,
it shall be unleavened cakes of fine flour mingled with oil, or
unleavened wafers anointed with oil.

2:5 And if your oblation be a meat offering baken in a pan, it shall be
of fine flour unleavened, mingled with oil.

2:6 you shalt part it in pieces, and pour oil thereon: it is a meat
offering.

2:7 And if your oblation be a meat offering baken in the fryingpan, it
shall be made of fine flour with oil.

2:8 And you shalt bring the meat offering that is made of these things
unto the LORD[JESUS]: and when it is presented unto the priest, HE[JESUS] shall bring
it unto the altar.

2:9 And the priest shall take from the meat offering a memorial thereof,
and shall burn it upon the altar: it is an offering made by fire, of a
sweet savour unto the LORD[JESUS].

2:10 And that which is left of the meat offering shall be Aaron's and
HIS[JESUS] sons': it is a thing most holy of the offerings of the LORD[JESUS] made by
fire.

2:11 No meat offering, which you shall bring unto the LORD[JESUS], shall be made
with leaven: for you shall burn no leaven, nor any honey, in any offering
of the LORD[JESUS] made by fire.

2:12 As for the oblation of the firstfruits, you shall offer them unto
the LORD[JESUS]: but they shall not be burnt on the altar for a sweet savour.

2:13 And every oblation of your meat offering shalt you season with
salt; neither shalt you let the salt of the covenant of your GOD[JESUS] to
be lacking from your meat offering: with all yours offerings you shalt
offer salt.

2:14 And if you offer a meat offering of your firstfruits unto the LORD[JESUS],
you shalt offer for the meat offering of your firstfruits green ears of
corn dried by the fire, even corn beaten out of full ears.

2:15 And you shalt put oil upon it, and lay frankincense thereon: it is
a meat offering.

2:16 And the priest shall burn the memorial of it, part of the beaten
corn thereof, and part of the oil thereof, with all the frankincense
thereof: it is an offering made by fire unto the LORD[JESUS].


3:1 And if HIS[JESUS] oblation be a sacrifice of peace offering, if HE[JESUS] offer it
of the herd; whether it be a male or female, HE[JESUS] shall offer it without
blemish before the LORD[JESUS].

3:2 And HE[JESUS] shall lay HIS[JESUS] hand upon the head of HIS[JESUS] offering, and kill it
at the door of the tabernacle of the congregation: and Aaron's sons the
priests shall sprinkle the blood upon the altar round about.

3:3 And HE[JESUS] shall offer of the sacrifice of the peace offering an
offering made by fire unto the LORD[JESUS]; the fat that covereth the inwards,
and all the fat that is upon the inwards,

3:4 And the two kidneys, and the fat that is on them, which is by the
flanks, and the caul above the liver, with the kidneys, it shall HE[JESUS] take
away.

3:5 And Aaron's sons shall burn it on the altar upon the burnt
sacrifice, which is upon the wood that is on the fire: it is an offering
made by fire, of a sweet savour unto the LORD[JESUS].

3:6 And if HIS[JESUS] offering for a sacrifice of peace offering unto the LORD[JESUS]
be of the flock; male or female, HE[JESUS] shall offer it without blemish.

3:7 If HE[JESUS] offer a LAMB[JESUS] for HIS[JESUS] offering, then shall HE[JESUS] offer it before
the LORD[JESUS].

3:8 And HE[JESUS] shall lay HIS[JESUS] hand upon the head of HIS[JESUS] offering, and kill it
before the tabernacle of the congregation: and Aaron's sons shall
sprinkle the blood thereof round about upon the altar.

3:9 And HE[JESUS] shall offer of the sacrifice of the peace offering an
offering made by fire unto the LORD[JESUS]; the fat thereof, and the whole
rump, it shall HE[JESUS] take off hard by the backbone; and the fat that
covereth the inwards, and all the fat that is upon the inwards,

3:10 And the two kidneys, and the fat that is upon them, which is by the
flanks, and the caul above the liver, with the kidneys, it shall HE[JESUS] take
away.

3:11 And the priest shall burn it upon the altar: it is the food of the
offering made by fire unto the LORD[JESUS].

3:12 And if HIS[JESUS] offering be a goat, then HE[JESUS] shall offer it before the
LORD[JESUS].

3:13 And HE[JESUS] shall lay HIS[JESUS] hand upon the head of it, and kill it before
the tabernacle of the congregation: and the sons of Aaron shall sprinkle
the blood thereof upon the altar round about.

3:14 And HE[JESUS] shall offer thereof HIS[JESUS] offering, even an offering made by
fire unto the LORD[JESUS]; the fat that covereth the inwards, and all the fat
that is upon the inwards,

3:15 And the two kidneys, and the fat that is upon them, which is by the
flanks, and the caul above the liver, with the kidneys, it shall HE[JESUS] take
away.

3:16 And the priest shall burn them upon the altar: it is the food of
the offering made by fire for a sweet savour: all the fat is the LORD[JESUS]'s.

3:17 It shall be a perpetual statute for your generations throughout all
your dwellings, that you eat neither fat nor blood.


4:1 And the LORD[JESUS] spake unto Moses, saying,

4:2 Speak unto the children of Israel, saying, If a soul shall sin
through ignorance against any of the commandments of the LORD[JESUS] concerning
things which ought not to be done, and shall do against any of them:

4:3 If the priest that is anointed do sin according to the sin of the
people; then let HIM[JESUS] bring for HIS[JESUS] sin, which HE[JESUS] has sinned, a young
bullock without blemish unto the LORD[JESUS] for a sin offering.

4:4 And HE[JESUS] shall bring the bullock unto the door of the tabernacle of
the congregation before the LORD[JESUS]; and shall lay HIS[JESUS] hand upon the
bullock's head, and kill the bullock before the LORD[JESUS].

4:5 And the priest that is anointed shall take of the bullock's blood,
and bring it to the tabernacle of the congregation:

4:6 And the priest shall dip HIS[JESUS] finger in the blood, and sprinkle of
the blood seven times before the LORD[JESUS], before the vail of the sanctuary.

4:7 And the priest shall put some of the blood upon the horns of the
altar of sweet incense before the LORD[JESUS], which is in the tabernacle of
the congregation; and shall pour all the blood of the bullock at the
bottom of the altar of the burnt offering, which is at the door of the
tabernacle of the congregation.

4:8 And HE[JESUS] shall take off from it all the fat of the bullock for the sin
offering; the fat that covereth the inwards, and all the fat that is
upon the inwards,

4:9 And the two kidneys, and the fat that is upon them, which is by the
flanks, and the caul above the liver, with the kidneys, it shall HE[JESUS] take
away,

4:10 As it was taken off from the bullock of the sacrifice of peace
offerings: and the priest shall burn them upon the altar of the burnt
offering.

4:11 And the skin of the bullock, and all HIS[JESUS] flesh, with HIS[JESUS] head, and
with HIS[JESUS] legs, and HIS[JESUS] inwards, and HIS[JESUS] dung,

4:12 Even the whole bullock shall HE[JESUS] carry forth without the camp unto a
clean place, where the ashes are poured out, and burn HIM[JESUS] on the wood
with fire: where the ashes are poured out shall HE[JESUS] be burnt.

4:13 And if the whole congregation of Israel sin through ignorance, and
the thing be hid from the eyes of the assembly, and they have done
somewhat against any of the commandments of the LORD[JESUS] concerning things
which should not be done, and are guilty;

4:14 When the sin, which they have sinned against it, is known, then the
congregation shall offer a young bullock for the sin, and bring HIM[JESUS]
before the tabernacle of the congregation.

4:15 And the elders of the congregation shall lay their hands upon the
head of the bullock before the LORD[JESUS]: and the bullock shall be killed
before the LORD[JESUS].

4:16 And the priest that is anointed shall bring of the bullock's blood
to the tabernacle of the congregation:

4:17 And the priest shall dip HIS[JESUS] finger in some of the blood, and
sprinkle it seven times before the LORD[JESUS], even before the vail.

4:18 And HE[JESUS] shall put some of the blood upon the horns of the altar
which is before the LORD[JESUS], that is in the tabernacle of the congregation,
and shall pour out all the blood at the bottom of the altar of the burnt
offering, which is at the door of the tabernacle of the congregation.

4:19 And HE[JESUS] shall take all HIS[JESUS] fat from HIM[JESUS], and burn it upon the altar.

4:20 And HE[JESUS] shall do with the bullock as HE[JESUS] did with the bullock for a
sin offering, so shall HE[JESUS] do with this: and the priest shall make an
atonement for them, and it shall be forgiven them.

4:21 And HE[JESUS] shall carry forth the bullock without the camp, and burn HIM[JESUS]
as HE[JESUS] burned the first bullock: it is a sin offering for the
congregation.

4:22 When a ruler has sinned, and done somewhat through ignorance
against any of the commandments of the LORD[JESUS] HIS[JESUS] GOD[JESUS] concerning things
which should not be done, and is guilty;

4:23 Or if HIS[JESUS] sin, wherein HE[JESUS] has sinned, come to HIS[JESUS] knowledge; HE[JESUS]
shall bring HIS[JESUS] offering, a kid of the goats, a male without blemish:

4:24 And HE[JESUS] shall lay HIS[JESUS] hand upon the head of the goat, and kill it in
the place where they kill the burnt offering before the LORD[JESUS]: it is a
sin offering.

4:25 And the priest shall take of the blood of the sin offering with HIS[JESUS]
finger, and put it upon the horns of the altar of burnt offering, and
shall pour out HIS[JESUS] blood at the bottom of the altar of burnt offering.

4:26 And HE[JESUS] shall burn all HIS[JESUS] fat upon the altar, as the fat of the
sacrifice of peace offerings: and the priest shall make an atonement for
HIM[JESUS] as concerning HIS[JESUS] sin, and it shall be forgiven HIM[JESUS].

4:27 And if any one of the common people sin through ignorance, while HE[JESUS]
doeth somewhat against any of the commandments of the LORD[JESUS] concerning
things which ought not to be done, and be guilty;

4:28 Or if HIS[JESUS] sin, which HE[JESUS] has sinned, come to HIS[JESUS] knowledge: then HE[JESUS]
shall bring HIS[JESUS] offering, a kid of the goats, a female without blemish,
for HIS[JESUS] sin which HE[JESUS] has sinned.

4:29 And HE[JESUS] shall lay HIS[JESUS] hand upon the head of the sin offering, and
slay the sin offering in the place of the burnt offering.

4:30 And the priest shall take of the blood thereof with HIS[JESUS] finger, and
put it upon the horns of the altar of burnt offering, and shall pour out
all the blood thereof at the bottom of the altar.

4:31 And HE[JESUS] shall take away all the fat thereof, as the fat is taken
away from off the sacrifice of peace offerings; and the priest shall
burn it upon the altar for a sweet savour unto the LORD[JESUS]; and the priest
shall make an atonement for HIM[JESUS], and it shall be forgiven HIM[JESUS].

4:32 And if HE[JESUS] bring a LAMB[JESUS] for a sin offering, HE[JESUS] shall bring it a
female without blemish.

4:33 And HE[JESUS] shall lay HIS[JESUS] hand upon the head of the sin offering, and
slay it for a sin offering in the place where they kill the burnt
offering.

4:34 And the priest shall take of the blood of the sin offering with HIS[JESUS]
finger, and put it upon the horns of the altar of burnt offering, and
shall pour out all the blood thereof at the bottom of the altar:

4:35 And HE[JESUS] shall take away all the fat thereof, as the fat of the LAMB[JESUS]
is taken away from the sacrifice of the peace offerings; and the priest
shall burn them upon the altar, according to the offerings made by fire
unto the LORD[JESUS]: and the priest shall make an atonement for HIS[JESUS] sin that
HE[JESUS] has committed, and it shall be forgiven HIM[JESUS].


5:1 And if a soul sin, and hear the voice of swearing, and is a witness,
whether HE[JESUS] has seen or known of it; if HE[JESUS] do not utter it, then HE[JESUS]
shall bear HIS[JESUS] iniquity.

5:2 Or if a soul touch any unclean thing, whether it be a carcase of an
unclean beast, or a carcase of unclean cattle, or the carcase of unclean
creeping things, and if it be hidden from HIM[JESUS]; HE[JESUS] also shall be unclean,
and guilty.

5:3 Or if HE[JESUS] touch the uncleanness of man, whatsoever uncleanness it be
that a man shall be defiled withal, and it be hid from HIM[JESUS]; when HE[JESUS]
knoweth of it, then HE[JESUS] shall be guilty.

5:4 Or if a soul swear, pronouncing with HIS[JESUS] lips to do evil, or to do
good, whatsoever it be that a man shall pronounce with an oath, and it
be hid from HIM[JESUS]; when HE[JESUS] knoweth of it, then HE[JESUS] shall be guilty in one
of these.

5:5 And it shall be, when HE[JESUS] shall be guilty in one of these things,
that HE[JESUS] shall confess that HE[JESUS] has sinned in that thing:

5:6 And HE[JESUS] shall bring HIS[JESUS] trespass offering unto the LORD[JESUS] for HIS[JESUS] sin
which HE[JESUS] has sinned, a female from the flock, a LAMB[JESUS] or a kid of the
goats, for a sin offering; and the priest shall make an atonement for
HIM[JESUS] concerning HIS[JESUS] sin.

5:7 And if HE[JESUS] be not able to bring a LAMB[JESUS], then HE[JESUS] shall bring for HIS[JESUS]
trespass, which HE[JESUS] has committed, two turtledoves, or two young
pigeons, unto the LORD[JESUS]; one for a sin offering, and the other for a
burnt offering.

5:8 And HE[JESUS] shall bring them unto the priest, who shall offer that which
is for the sin offering first, and wring off HIS[JESUS] head from HIS[JESUS] neck, but
shall not divide it asunder:

5:9 And HE[JESUS] shall sprinkle of the blood of the sin offering upon the side
of the altar; and the rest of the blood shall be wrung out at the bottom
of the altar: it is a sin offering.

5:10 And HE[JESUS] shall offer the second for a burnt offering, according to
the manner: and the priest shall make an atonement for HIM[JESUS] for HIS[JESUS] sin
which HE[JESUS] has sinned, and it shall be forgiven HIM[JESUS].

5:11 But if HE[JESUS] be not able to bring two turtledoves, or two young
pigeons, then HE[JESUS] that sinned shall bring for HIS[JESUS] offering the tenth part
of an ephah of fine flour for a sin offering; HE[JESUS] shall put no oil upon
it, neither shall HE[JESUS] put any frankincense thereon: for it is a sin
offering.

5:12 Then shall HE[JESUS] bring it to the priest, and the priest shall take HIS[JESUS]
handful of it, even a memorial thereof, and burn it on the altar,
according to the offerings made by fire unto the LORD[JESUS]: it is a sin
offering.

5:13 And the priest shall make an atonement for HIM[JESUS] as touching HIS[JESUS] sin
that HE[JESUS] has sinned in one of these, and it shall be forgiven HIM[JESUS]: and
the remnant shall be the priest's, as a meat offering.

5:14 And the LORD[JESUS] spake unto Moses, saying,

5:15 If a soul commit a trespass, and sin through ignorance, in the holy
things of the LORD[JESUS]; then HE[JESUS] shall bring for HIS[JESUS] trespass unto the LORD[JESUS] a
ram without blemish out of the flocks, with your estimation by shekels of
silver, after the shekel of the sanctuary, for a trespass offering.

5:16 And HE[JESUS] shall make amends for the harm that HE[JESUS] has done in the holy
thing, and shall add the fifth part thereto, and give it unto the
priest: and the priest shall make an atonement for HIM[JESUS] with the ram of
the trespass offering, and it shall be forgiven HIM[JESUS].

5:17 And if a soul sin, and commit any of these things which are
forbidden to be done by the commandments of the LORD[JESUS]; though HE[JESUS] wist it
not, yet is HE[JESUS] guilty, and shall bear HIS[JESUS] iniquity.

5:18 And HE[JESUS] shall bring a ram without blemish out of the flock, with your
estimation, for a trespass offering, unto the priest: and the priest
shall make an atonement for HIM[JESUS] concerning HIS[JESUS] ignorance wherein HE[JESUS]
erred and wist it not, and it shall be forgiven HIM[JESUS].

5:19 It is a trespass offering: HE[JESUS] has certainly trespassed against the
LORD[JESUS].


6:1 And the LORD[JESUS] spake unto Moses, saying,

6:2 If a soul sin, and commit a trespass against the LORD[JESUS], and lie unto
HIS[JESUS] neighbour in that which was delivered HIM[JESUS] to keep, or in fellowship,
or in a thing taken away by violence, or has deceived HIS[JESUS] neighbour;

6:3 Or have found that which was lost, and lieth concerning it, and
sweareth falsely; in any of all these that a man doeth, sinning therein:

6:4 Then it shall be, because HE[JESUS] has sinned, and is guilty, that HE[JESUS]
shall restore that which HE[JESUS] took violently away, or the thing which HE[JESUS]
has deceitfully gotten, or that which was delivered HIM[JESUS] to keep, or the
lost thing which HE[JESUS] found,

6:5 Or all that about which HE[JESUS] has sworn falsely; HE[JESUS] shall even restore
it in the principal, and shall add the fifth part more thereto, and give
it unto HIM[JESUS] to whom it appertaineth, in the day of HIS[JESUS] trespass
offering.

6:6 And HE[JESUS] shall bring HIS[JESUS] trespass offering unto the LORD[JESUS], a ram
without blemish out of the flock, with your estimation, for a trespass
offering, unto the priest:

6:7 And the priest shall make an atonement for HIM[JESUS] before the LORD[JESUS]: and
it shall be forgiven HIM[JESUS] for any thing of all that HE[JESUS] has done in
trespassing therein.

6:8 And the LORD[JESUS] spake unto Moses, saying,

6:9 Command Aaron and HIS[JESUS] sons, saying, This is the law of the burnt
offering: It is the burnt offering, because of the burning upon the
altar all night unto the morning, and the fire of the altar shall be
burning in it.

6:10 And the priest shall put on HIS[JESUS] linen garment, and HIS[JESUS] linen
breeches shall HE[JESUS] put upon HIS[JESUS] flesh, and take up the ashes which the
fire has consumed with the burnt offering on the altar, and HE[JESUS] shall
put them beside the altar.

6:11 And HE[JESUS] shall put off HIS[JESUS] garments, and put on other garments, and
carry forth the ashes without the camp unto a clean place.

6:12 And the fire upon the altar shall be burning in it; it shall not be
put out: and the priest shall burn wood on it every morning, and lay the
burnt offering in order upon it; and HE[JESUS] shall burn thereon the fat of
the peace offerings.

6:13 The fire shall ever be burning upon the altar; it shall never go
out.

6:14 And this is the law of the meat offering: the sons of Aaron shall
offer it before the LORD[JESUS], before the altar.

6:15 And HE[JESUS] shall take of it HIS[JESUS] handful, of the flour of the meat
offering, and of the oil thereof, and all the frankincense which is upon
the meat offering, and shall burn it upon the altar for a sweet savour,
even the memorial of it, unto the LORD[JESUS].

6:16 And the remainder thereof shall Aaron and HIS[JESUS] sons eat: with
unleavened bread shall it be eaten in the holy place; in the court of
the tabernacle of the congregation they shall eat it.

6:17 It shall not be baken with leaven. I have given it unto them for
their portion of my offerings made by fire; it is most holy, as is the
sin offering, and as the trespass offering.

6:18 All the males among the children of Aaron shall eat of it. It shall
be a statute for ever in your generations concerning the offerings of
the LORD[JESUS] made by fire: every one that toucheth them shall be holy.

6:19 And the LORD[JESUS] spake unto Moses, saying,

6:20 This is the offering of Aaron and of HIS[JESUS] sons, which they shall
offer unto the LORD[JESUS] in the day when HE[JESUS] is anointed; the tenth part of an
ephah of fine flour for a meat offering perpetual, half of it in the
morning, and half thereof at night.

6:21 In a pan it shall be made with oil; and when it is baken, you
shalt bring it in: and the baken pieces of the meat offering shalt you
offer for a sweet savour unto the LORD[JESUS].

6:22 And the priest of HIS[JESUS] sons that is anointed in HIS[JESUS] stead shall
offer it: it is a statute for ever unto the LORD[JESUS]; it shall be wholly
burnt.

6:23 For every meat offering for the priest shall be wholly burnt: it
shall not be eaten.

6:24 And the LORD[JESUS] spake unto Moses, saying,

6:25 Speak unto Aaron and to HIS[JESUS] sons, saying, This is the law of the
sin offering: In the place where the burnt offering is killed shall the
sin offering be killed before the LORD[JESUS]: it is most holy.

6:26 The priest that offereth it for sin shall eat it: in the holy place
shall it be eaten, in the court of the tabernacle of the congregation.

6:27 Whatsoever shall touch the flesh thereof shall be holy: and when
there is sprinkled of the blood thereof upon any garment, you shalt
wash that whereon it was sprinkled in the holy place.

6:28 But the earthen vessel wherein it is sodden shall be broken: and if
it be sodden in a brasen pot, it shall be both scoured, and rinsed in
water.

6:29 All the males among the priests shall eat thereof: it is most holy.

6:30 And no sin offering, whereof any of the blood is brought into the
tabernacle of the congregation to reconcile withal in the holy place,
shall be eaten: it shall be burnt in the fire.


7:1 Likewise this is the law of the trespass offering: it is most holy.

7:2 In the place where they kill the burnt offering shall they kill the
trespass offering: and the blood thereof shall HE[JESUS] sprinkle round about
upon the altar.

7:3 And HE[JESUS] shall offer of it all the fat thereof; the rump, and the fat
that covereth the inwards,

7:4 And the two kidneys, and the fat that is on them, which is by the
flanks, and the caul that is above the liver, with the kidneys, it shall
HE[JESUS] take away:

7:5 And the priest shall burn them upon the altar for an offering made
by fire unto the LORD[JESUS]: it is a trespass offering.

7:6 Every male among the priests shall eat thereof: it shall be eaten in
the holy place: it is most holy.

7:7 As the sin offering is, so is the trespass offering: there is one
law for them: the priest that makes atonement therewith shall have it.

7:8 And the priest that offereth any man's burnt offering, even the
priest shall have to himself the skin of the burnt offering which HE[JESUS]
has offered.

7:9 And all the meat offering that is baken in the oven, and all that is
dressed in the fryingpan, and in the pan, shall be the priest's that
offereth it.

7:10 And every meat offering, mingled with oil, and dry, shall all the
sons of Aaron have, one as much as another.

7:11 And this is the law of the sacrifice of peace offerings, which HE[JESUS]
shall offer unto the LORD[JESUS].

7:12 If HE[JESUS] offer it for a thanksgiving, then HE[JESUS] shall offer with the
sacrifice of thanksgiving unleavened cakes mingled with oil, and
unleavened wafers anointed with oil, and cakes mingled with oil, of fine
flour, fried.

7:13 Besides the cakes, HE[JESUS] shall offer for HIS[JESUS] offering leavened bread
with the sacrifice of thanksgiving of HIS[JESUS] peace offerings.

7:14 And of it HE[JESUS] shall offer one out of the whole oblation for an heave
offering unto the LORD[JESUS], and it shall be the priest's that sprinkleth the
blood of the peace offerings.

7:15 And the flesh of the sacrifice of HIS[JESUS] peace offerings for
thanksgiving shall be eaten the same day that it is offered; HE[JESUS] shall
not leave any of it until the morning.

7:16 But if the sacrifice of HIS[JESUS] offering be a vow, or a voluntary
offering, it shall be eaten the same day that HE[JESUS] offereth HIS[JESUS] sacrifice:
and on the morrow also the remainder of it shall be eaten:

7:17 But the remainder of the flesh of the sacrifice on the third day
shall be burnt with fire.

7:18 And if any of the flesh of the sacrifice of HIS[JESUS] peace offerings be
eaten at all on the third day, it shall not be accepted, neither shall
it be imputed unto HIM[JESUS] that offereth it: it shall be an abomination, and
the soul that eateth of it shall bear HIS[JESUS] iniquity.

7:19 And the flesh that toucheth any unclean thing shall not be eaten;
it shall be burnt with fire: and as for the flesh, all that be clean
shall eat thereof.

7:20 But the soul that eateth of the flesh of the sacrifice of peace
offerings, that pertain unto the LORD[JESUS], having HIS[JESUS] uncleanness upon HIM[JESUS],
even that soul shall be cut off from HIS[JESUS] people.

7:21 Moreover the soul that shall touch any unclean thing, as the
uncleanness of man, or any unclean beast, or any abominable unclean
thing, and eat of the flesh of the sacrifice of peace offerings, which
pertain unto the LORD[JESUS], even that soul shall be cut off from HIS[JESUS] people.

7:22 And the LORD[JESUS] spake unto Moses, saying,

7:23 Speak unto the children of Israel, saying, you shall eat no manner
of fat, of ox, or of sheep, or of goat.

7:24 And the fat of the beast that dieth of itself, and the fat of that
which is torn with beasts, may be used in any other use: but you shall in
no wise eat of it.

7:25 For whoever eateth the fat of the beast, of which men offer an
offering made by fire unto the LORD[JESUS], even the soul that eateth it shall
be cut off from HIS[JESUS] people.

7:26 Moreover you shall eat no manner of blood, whether it be of fowl or
of beast, in any of your dwellings.

7:27 Whatsoever soul it be that eateth any manner of blood, even that
soul shall be cut off from HIS[JESUS] people.

7:28 And the LORD[JESUS] spake unto Moses, saying,

7:29 Speak unto the children of Israel, saying, HE[JESUS] that offereth the
sacrifice of HIS[JESUS] peace offerings unto the LORD[JESUS] shall bring HIS[JESUS] oblation
unto the LORD[JESUS] of the sacrifice of HIS[JESUS] peace offerings.

7:30 HIS[JESUS] own hands shall bring the offerings of the LORD[JESUS] made by fire,
the fat with the breast, it shall HE[JESUS] bring, that the breast may be waved
for a wave offering before the LORD[JESUS].

7:31 And the priest shall burn the fat upon the altar: but the breast
shall be Aaron's and HIS[JESUS] sons'.

7:32 And the right shoulder shall you give unto the priest for an heave
offering of the sacrifices of your peace offerings.

7:33 HE[JESUS] among the sons of Aaron, that offereth the blood of the peace
offerings, and the fat, shall have the right shoulder for HIS[JESUS] part.

7:34 For the wave breast and the heave shoulder have I taken of the
children of Israel from off the sacrifices of their peace offerings, and
have given them unto Aaron the priest and unto HIS[JESUS] sons by a statute for
ever from among the children of Israel.

7:35 This is the portion of the anointing of Aaron, and of the anointing
of HIS[JESUS] sons, out of the offerings of the LORD[JESUS] made by fire, in the day
when HE[JESUS] presented them to minister unto the LORD[JESUS] in the priest's office;

7:36 Which the LORD[JESUS] commanded to be given them of the children of
Israel, in the day that HE[JESUS] anointed them, by a statute for ever
throughout their generations.

7:37 This is the law of the burnt offering, of the meat offering, and of
the sin offering, and of the trespass offering, and of the
consecrations, and of the sacrifice of the peace offerings;

7:38 Which the LORD[JESUS] commanded Moses in mount Sinai, in the day that HE[JESUS]
commanded the children of Israel to offer their oblations unto the LORD[JESUS],
in the wilderness of Sinai.


8:1 And the LORD[JESUS] spake unto Moses, saying,

8:2 Take Aaron and HIS[JESUS] sons with HIM[JESUS], and the garments, and the
anointing oil, and a bullock for the sin offering, and two rams, and a
basket of unleavened bread;

8:3 And gather you all the congregation together unto the door of the
tabernacle of the congregation.

8:4 And Moses did as the LORD[JESUS] commanded HIM[JESUS]; and the assembly was
gathered together unto the door of the tabernacle of the congregation.

8:5 And Moses said unto the congregation, This is the thing which the
LORD[JESUS] commanded to be done.

8:6 And Moses brought Aaron and HIS[JESUS] sons, and washed them with water.

8:7 And HE[JESUS] put upon HIM[JESUS] the coat, and girded HIM[JESUS] with the girdle, and
clothed HIM[JESUS] with the robe, and put the ephod upon HIM[JESUS], and HE[JESUS] girded HIM[JESUS]
with the curious girdle of the ephod, and bound it unto HIM[JESUS] therewith.

8:8 And HE[JESUS] put the breastplate upon HIM[JESUS]: also HE[JESUS] put in the breastplate
the Urim and the Thummim.

8:9 And HE[JESUS] put the mitre upon HIS[JESUS] head; also upon the mitre, even upon
HIS[JESUS] forefront, did HE[JESUS] put the golden plate, the holy crown; as the LORD[JESUS]
commanded Moses.

8:10 And Moses took the anointing oil, and anointed the tabernacle and
all that was therein, and sanctified them.

8:11 And HE[JESUS] sprinkled thereof upon the altar seven times, and anointed
the altar and all HIS[JESUS] vessels, both the laver and HIS[JESUS] foot, to sanctify
them.

8:12 And HE[JESUS] poured of the anointing oil upon Aaron's head, and anointed
HIM[JESUS], to sanctify HIM[JESUS].

8:13 And Moses brought Aaron's sons, and put coats upon them, and girded
them with girdles, and put bonnets upon them; as the LORD[JESUS] commanded
Moses.

8:14 And HE[JESUS] brought the bullock for the sin offering: and Aaron and HIS[JESUS]
sons laid their hands upon the head of the bullock for the sin offering.

8:15 And HE[JESUS] slew it; and Moses took the blood, and put it upon the horns
of the altar round about with HIS[JESUS] finger, and purified the altar, and
poured the blood at the bottom of the altar, and sanctified it, to make
reconciliation upon it.

8:16 And HE[JESUS] took all the fat that was upon the inwards, and the caul
above the liver, and the two kidneys, and their fat, and Moses burned it
upon the altar.

8:17 But the bullock, and HIS[JESUS] hide, HIS[JESUS] flesh, and HIS[JESUS] dung, HE[JESUS] burnt
with fire without the camp; as the LORD[JESUS] commanded Moses.

8:18 And HE[JESUS] brought the ram for the burnt offering: and Aaron and HIS[JESUS]
sons laid their hands upon the head of the ram.

8:19 And HE[JESUS] killed it; and Moses sprinkled the blood upon the altar
round about.

8:20 And HE[JESUS] cut the ram into pieces; and Moses burnt the head, and the
pieces, and the fat.

8:21 And HE[JESUS] washed the inwards and the legs in water; and Moses burnt
the whole ram upon the altar: it was a burnt sacrifice for a sweet
savour, and an offering made by fire unto the LORD[JESUS]; as the LORD[JESUS]
commanded Moses.

8:22 And HE[JESUS] brought the other ram, the ram of consecration: and Aaron
and HIS[JESUS] sons laid their hands upon the head of the ram.

8:23 And HE[JESUS] slew it; and Moses took of the blood of it, and put it upon
the tip of Aaron's right ear, and upon the thumb of HIS[JESUS] right hand, and
upon the great toe of HIS[JESUS] right foot.

8:24 And HE[JESUS] brought Aaron's sons, and Moses put of the blood upon the
tip of their right ear, and upon the thumbs of their right hands, and
upon the great toes of their right feet: and Moses sprinkled the blood
upon the altar round about.

8:25 And HE[JESUS] took the fat, and the rump, and all the fat that was upon
the inwards, and the caul above the liver, and the two kidneys, and
their fat, and the right shoulder:

8:26 And out of the basket of unleavened bread, that was before the
LORD[JESUS], HE[JESUS] took one unleavened cake, and a cake of oiled bread, and one
wafer, and put them on the fat, and upon the right shoulder:

8:27 And HE[JESUS] put all upon Aaron's hands, and upon HIS[JESUS] sons' hands, and
waved them for a wave offering before the LORD[JESUS].

8:28 And Moses took them from off their hands, and burnt them on the
altar upon the burnt offering: they were consecrations for a sweet
savour: it is an offering made by fire unto the LORD[JESUS].

8:29 And Moses took the breast, and waved it for a wave offering before
the LORD[JESUS]: for of the ram of consecration it was Moses' part; as the LORD[JESUS]
commanded Moses.

8:30 And Moses took of the anointing oil, and of the blood which was
upon the altar, and sprinkled it upon Aaron, and upon HIS[JESUS] garments, and
upon HIS[JESUS] sons, and upon HIS[JESUS] sons' garments with HIM[JESUS]; and sanctified
Aaron, and HIS[JESUS] garments, and HIS[JESUS] sons, and HIS[JESUS] sons' garments with HIM[JESUS].

8:31 And Moses said unto Aaron and to HIS[JESUS] sons, Boil the flesh at the
door of the tabernacle of the congregation: and there eat it with the
bread that is in the basket of consecrations, as I commanded, saying,
Aaron and HIS[JESUS] sons shall eat it.

8:32 And that which remaineth of the flesh and of the bread shall you
burn with fire.

8:33 And you shall not go out of the door of the tabernacle of the
congregation in seven days, until the days of your consecration be at an
end: for seven days shall HE[JESUS] consecrate you.

8:34 As HE[JESUS] has done this day, so the LORD[JESUS] has commanded to do, to make
an atonement for you.

8:35 Therefore shall you abide at the door of the tabernacle of the
congregation day and night seven days, and keep the charge of the LORD[JESUS],
that you die not: for so I am commanded.

8:36 So Aaron and HIS[JESUS] sons did all things which the LORD[JESUS] commanded by
the hand of Moses.


9:1 And it came to pass on the eighth day, that Moses called Aaron and
HIS[JESUS] sons, and the elders of Israel;

9:2 And HE[JESUS] said unto Aaron, Take you a young calf for a sin offering,
and a ram for a burnt offering, without blemish, and offer them before
the LORD[JESUS].

9:3 And unto the children of Israel you shalt speak, saying, Take you a
kid of the goats for a sin offering; and a calf and a LAMB[JESUS], both of the
first year, without blemish, for a burnt offering;

9:4 Also a bullock and a ram for peace offerings, to sacrifice before
the LORD[JESUS]; and a meat offering mingled with oil: for to day the LORD[JESUS] will
appear unto you.

9:5 And they brought that which Moses commanded before the tabernacle of
the congregation: and all the congregation drew near and stood before
the LORD[JESUS].

9:6 And Moses said, This is the thing which the LORD[JESUS] commanded that you
should do: and the glory of the LORD[JESUS] shall appear unto you.

9:7 And Moses said unto Aaron, Go unto the altar, and offer your sin
offering, and your burnt offering, and make an atonement for thyself, and
for the people: and offer the offering of the people, and make an
atonement for them; as the LORD[JESUS] commanded.

9:8 Aaron therefore went unto the altar, and slew the calf of the sin
offering, which was for himself.

9:9 And the sons of Aaron brought the blood unto HIM[JESUS]: and HE[JESUS] dipped HIS[JESUS]
finger in the blood, and put it upon the horns of the altar, and poured
out the blood at the bottom of the altar:

9:10 But the fat, and the kidneys, and the caul above the liver of the
sin offering, HE[JESUS] burnt upon the altar; as the LORD[JESUS] commanded Moses.

9:11 And the flesh and the hide HE[JESUS] burnt with fire without the camp.

9:12 And HE[JESUS] slew the burnt offering; and Aaron's sons presented unto HIM[JESUS]
the blood, which HE[JESUS] sprinkled round about upon the altar.

9:13 And they presented the burnt offering unto HIM[JESUS], with the pieces
thereof, and the head: and HE[JESUS] burnt them upon the altar.

9:14 And HE[JESUS] did wash the inwards and the legs, and burnt them upon the
burnt offering on the altar.

9:15 And HE[JESUS] brought the people's offering, and took the goat, which was
the sin offering for the people, and slew it, and offered it for sin, as
the first.

9:16 And HE[JESUS] brought the burnt offering, and offered it according to the
manner.

9:17 And HE[JESUS] brought the meat offering, and took an handful thereof, and
burnt it upon the altar, beside the burnt sacrifice of the morning.

9:18 HE[JESUS] slew also the bullock and the ram for a sacrifice of peace
offerings, which was for the people: and Aaron's sons presented unto HIM[JESUS]
the blood, which HE[JESUS] sprinkled upon the altar round about,

9:19 And the fat of the bullock and of the ram, the rump, and that which
covereth the inwards, and the kidneys, and the caul above the liver:

9:20 And they put the fat upon the breasts, and HE[JESUS] burnt the fat upon
the altar:

9:21 And the breasts and the right shoulder Aaron waved for a wave
offering before the LORD[JESUS]; as Moses commanded.

9:22 And Aaron lifted up HIS[JESUS] hand toward the people, and blessed them,
and came down from offering of the sin offering, and the burnt offering,
and peace offerings.

9:23 And Moses and Aaron went into the tabernacle of the congregation,
and came out, and blessed the people: and the glory of the LORD[JESUS] appeared
unto all the people.

9:24 And there came a fire out from before the LORD[JESUS], and consumed upon
the altar the burnt offering and the fat: which when all the people saw,
they shouted, and fell on their faces.


10:1 And Nadab and Abihu, the sons of Aaron, took either of them HIS[JESUS]
censer, and put fire therein, and put incense thereon, and offered
strange fire before the LORD[JESUS], which HE[JESUS] commanded them not.

10:2 And there went out fire from the LORD[JESUS], and devoured them, and they
died before the LORD[JESUS].

10:3 Then Moses said unto Aaron, This is it that the LORD[JESUS] spake, saying,
I will be sanctified in them that come nigh me, and before all the
people I will be glorified. And Aaron held HIS[JESUS] peace.

10:4 And Moses called Mishael and Elzaphan, the sons of Uzziel the uncle
of Aaron, and said unto them, Come near, carry your brethren from before
the sanctuary out of the camp.

10:5 So they went near, and carried them in their coats out of the camp;
as Moses had said.

10:6 And Moses said unto Aaron, and unto Eleazar and unto Ithamar, HIS[JESUS]
sons, Uncover not your heads, neither rend your clothes; lest you die,
and lest wrath come upon all the people: but let your brethren, the
whole house of Israel, bewail the burning which the LORD[JESUS] has kindled.

10:7 And you shall not go out from the door of the tabernacle of the
congregation, lest you die: for the anointing oil of the LORD[JESUS] is upon
you. And they did according to the WORD[JESUS] of Moses.

10:8 And the LORD[JESUS] spake unto Aaron, saying,

10:9 Do not drink wine nor strong drink, you, nor your sons with you,
when you go into the tabernacle of the congregation, lest you die: it
shall be a statute for ever throughout your generations:

10:10 And that you may put difference between holy and unholy, and
between unclean and clean;

10:11 And that you may teach the children of Israel all the statutes
which the LORD[JESUS] has spoken unto them by the hand of Moses.

10:12 And Moses spake unto Aaron, and unto Eleazar and unto Ithamar, HIS[JESUS]
sons that were left, Take the meat offering that remaineth of the
offerings of the LORD[JESUS] made by fire, and eat it without leaven beside the
altar: for it is most holy:

10:13 And you shall eat it in the holy place, because it is your due, and
your sons' due, of the sacrifices of the LORD[JESUS] made by fire: for so I am
commanded.

10:14 And the wave breast and heave shoulder shall you eat in a clean
place; you, and your sons, and your daughters with you: for they be your
due, and your sons' due, which are given out of the sacrifices of peace
offerings of the children of Israel.

10:15 The heave shoulder and the wave breast shall they bring with the
offerings made by fire of the fat, to wave it for a wave offering before
the LORD[JESUS]; and it shall be yours, and your sons' with you, by a statute
for ever; as the LORD[JESUS] has commanded.

10:16 And Moses diligently sought the goat of the sin offering, and,
behold, it was burnt: and HE[JESUS] was angry with Eleazar and Ithamar, the
sons of Aaron which were left alive, saying,

10:17 Wherefore have you not eaten the sin offering in the holy place,
seeing it is most holy, and GOD[JESUS] has given it you to bear the iniquity
of the congregation, to make atonement for them before the LORD[JESUS]?

10:18 Behold, the blood of it was not brought in within the holy place:
you should indeed have eaten it in the holy place, as I commanded.

10:19 And Aaron said unto Moses, Behold, this day have they offered
their sin offering and their burnt offering before the LORD[JESUS]; and such
things have befallen me: and if I had eaten the sin offering to day,
should it have been accepted in the sight of the LORD[JESUS]?

10:20 And when Moses heard that, HE[JESUS] was content.


11:1 And the LORD[JESUS] spake unto Moses and to Aaron, saying unto them,

11:2 Speak unto the children of Israel, saying, These are the beasts
which you shall eat among all the beasts that are on the earth.

11:3 Whatsoever parteth the hoof, and is clovenfooted, and cheweth the
cud, among the beasts, that shall you eat.

11:4 Nevertheless these shall you not eat of them that chew the cud, or
of them that divide the hoof: as the camel, because HE[JESUS] cheweth the cud,
but divideth not the hoof; HE[JESUS] is unclean unto you.

11:5 And the coney, because HE[JESUS] cheweth the cud, but divideth not the
hoof; HE[JESUS] is unclean unto you.

11:6 And the hare, because HE[JESUS] cheweth the cud, but divideth not the
hoof; HE[JESUS] is unclean unto you.

11:7 And the swine, though HE[JESUS] divide the hoof, and be clovenfooted, yet
HE[JESUS] cheweth not the cud; HE[JESUS] is unclean to you.

11:8 Of their flesh shall you not eat, and their carcase shall you not
touch; they are unclean to you.

11:9 These shall you eat of all that are in the waters: whatsoever has
fins and scales in the waters, in the seas, and in the rivers, them
shall you eat.

11:10 And all that have not fins and scales in the seas, and in the
rivers, of all that move in the waters, and of any living thing which is
in the waters, they shall be an abomination unto you:

11:11 They shall be even an abomination unto you; you shall not eat of
their flesh, but you shall have their carcases in abomination.

11:12 Whatsoever has no fins nor scales in the waters, that shall be an
abomination unto you.

11:13 And these are they which you shall have in abomination among the
fowls; they shall not be eaten, they are an abomination: the eagle, and
the ossifrage, and the ospray,

11:14 And the vulture, and the kite after HIS[JESUS] kind;

11:15 Every raven after HIS[JESUS] kind;

11:16 And the owl, and the night hawk, and the cuckow, and the hawk
after HIS[JESUS] kind,

11:17 And the little owl, and the cormorant, and the great owl,

11:18 And the swan, and the pelican, and the gier eagle,

11:19 And the stork, the heron after her kind, and the lapwing, and the
bat.

11:20 All fowls that creep, going upon all four, shall be an abomination
unto you.

11:21 Yet these may you eat of every flying creeping thing that goes
upon all four, which have legs above their feet, to leap withal upon the
earth;

11:22 Even these of them you may eat; the locust after HIS[JESUS] kind, and the
bald locust after HIS[JESUS] kind, and the beetle after HIS[JESUS] kind, and the
grasshopper after HIS[JESUS] kind.

11:23 But all other flying creeping things, which have four feet, shall
be an abomination unto you.

11:24 And for these you shall be unclean: whoever toucheth the carcase
of them shall be unclean until the even.

11:25 And whoever beareth ought of the carcase of them shall wash HIS[JESUS]
clothes, and be unclean until the even.

11:26 The carcases of every beast which divideth the hoof, and is not
clovenfooted, nor cheweth the cud, are unclean unto you: every one that
toucheth them shall be unclean.

11:27 And whatsoever goes upon HIS[JESUS] paws, among all manner of beasts
that go on all four, those are unclean unto you: whoever toucheth their
carcase shall be unclean until the even.

11:28 And HE[JESUS] that beareth the carcase of them shall wash HIS[JESUS] clothes,
and be unclean until the even: they are unclean unto you.

11:29 These also shall be unclean unto you among the creeping things
that creep upon the earth; the weasel, and the mouse, and the tortoise
after HIS[JESUS] kind,

11:30 And the ferret, and the chameleon, and the lizard, and the snail,
and the mole.

11:31 These are unclean to you among all that creep: whoever does
touch them, when they be dead, shall be unclean until the even.

11:32 And upon whatsoever any of them, when they are dead, does fall, it
shall be unclean; whether it be any vessel of wood, or raiment, or skin,
or sack, whatsoever vessel it be, wherein any work is done, it must be
put into water, and it shall be unclean until the even; so it shall be
cleansed.

11:33 And every earthen vessel, whereinto any of them falleth,
whatsoever is in it shall be unclean; and you shall break it.

11:34 Of all meat which may be eaten, that on which such water comes
shall be unclean: and all drink that may be drunk in every such vessel
shall be unclean.

11:35 And every thing whereupon any part of their carcase falleth shall
be unclean; whether it be oven, or ranges for pots, they shall be broken
down: for they are unclean and shall be unclean unto you.

11:36 Nevertheless a fountain or pit, wherein there is plenty of water,
shall be clean: but that which toucheth their carcase shall be unclean.

11:37 And if any part of their carcase fall upon any sowing SEED[JESUS] which
is to be sown, it shall be clean.

11:38 But if any water be put upon the SEED[JESUS], and any part of their
carcase fall thereon, it shall be unclean unto you.

11:39 And if any beast, of which you may eat, die; HE[JESUS] that toucheth the
carcase thereof shall be unclean until the even.

11:40 And HE[JESUS] that eateth of the carcase of it shall wash HIS[JESUS] clothes,
and be unclean until the even: HE[JESUS] also that beareth the carcase of it
shall wash HIS[JESUS] clothes, and be unclean until the even.

11:41 And every creeping thing that creepeth upon the earth shall be an
abomination; it shall not be eaten.

11:42 Whatsoever goes upon the belly, and whatsoever goes upon all
four, or whatsoever has more feet among all creeping things that creep
upon the earth, them you shall not eat; for they are an abomination.

11:43 you shall not make yourselves abominable with any creeping thing
that creepeth, neither shall you make yourselves unclean with them, that
you should be defiled thereby.

11:44 For I am the LORD[JESUS] your GOD[JESUS]: you shall therefore sanctify
yourselves, and you shall be holy; for I am holy: neither shall you defile
yourselves with any manner of creeping thing that creepeth upon the
earth.

11:45 For I am the LORD[JESUS] that bringeth you up out of the land of Egypt,
to be your GOD[JESUS]: you shall therefore be holy, for I am holy.

11:46 This is the law of the beasts, and of the fowl, and of every
living creature that moveth in the waters, and of every creature that
creepeth upon the earth:

11:47 To make a difference between the unclean and the clean, and
between the beast that may be eaten and the beast that may not be eaten.


12:1 And the LORD[JESUS] spake unto Moses, saying,

12:2 Speak unto the children of Israel, saying, If a woman have
conceived SEED[JESUS], and born a man child: then she shall be unclean seven
days; according to the days of the separation for her infirmity shall
she be unclean.

12:3 And in the eighth day the flesh of HIS[JESUS] foreskin shall be
circumcised.

12:4 And she shall then continue in the blood of her purifying three and
thirty days; she shall touch no hallowed thing, nor come into the
sanctuary, until the days of her purifying be fulfilled.

12:5 But if she bear a maid child, then she shall be unclean two weeks,
as in her separation: and she shall continue in the blood of her
purifying threescore and six days.

12:6 And when the days of her purifying are fulfilled, for a SON[JESUS], or for
a daughter, she shall bring a LAMB[JESUS] of the first year for a burnt
offering, and a young pigeon, or a turtledove, for a sin offering, unto
the door of the tabernacle of the congregation, unto the priest:

12:7 Who shall offer it before the LORD[JESUS], and make an atonement for her;
and she shall be cleansed from the issue of her blood. This is the law
for her that has born a male or a female.

12:8 And if she be not able to bring a LAMB[JESUS], then she shall bring two
turtles, or two young pigeons; the one for the burnt offering, and the
other for a sin offering: and the priest shall make an atonement for
her, and she shall be clean.


13:1 And the LORD[JESUS] spake unto Moses and Aaron, saying,

13:2 When a man shall have in the skin of HIS[JESUS] flesh a rising, a scab, or
bright spot, and it be in the skin of HIS[JESUS] flesh like the plague of
leprosy; then HE[JESUS] shall be brought unto Aaron the priest, or unto one of
HIS[JESUS] sons the priests:

13:3 And the priest shall look on the plague in the skin of the flesh:
and when the hair in the plague is turned white, and the plague in sight
be deeper than the skin of HIS[JESUS] flesh, it is a plague of leprosy: and the
priest shall look on HIM[JESUS], and pronounce HIM[JESUS] unclean.

13:4 If the bright spot be white in the skin of HIS[JESUS] flesh, and in sight
be not deeper than the skin, and the hair thereof be not turned white;
then the priest shall shut up HIM[JESUS] that has the plague seven days:

13:5 And the priest shall look on HIM[JESUS] the seventh day: and, behold, if
the plague in HIS[JESUS] sight be at a stay, and the plague spread not in the
skin; then the priest shall shut HIM[JESUS] up seven days more:

13:6 And the priest shall look on HIM[JESUS] again the seventh day: and,
behold, if the plague be somewhat dark, and the plague spread not in the
skin, the priest shall pronounce HIM[JESUS] clean: it is but a scab: and HE[JESUS]
shall wash HIS[JESUS] clothes, and be clean.

13:7 But if the scab spread much abroad in the skin, after that HE[JESUS] has
been seen of the priest for HIS[JESUS] cleansing, HE[JESUS] shall be seen of the
priest again.

13:8 And if the priest see that, behold, the scab spreadeth in the skin,
then the priest shall pronounce HIM[JESUS] unclean: it is a leprosy.

13:9 When the plague of leprosy is in a man, then HE[JESUS] shall be brought
unto the priest;

13:10 And the priest shall see HIM[JESUS]: and, behold, if the rising be white
in the skin, and it have turned the hair white, and there be quick raw
flesh in the rising;

13:11 It is an old leprosy in the skin of HIS[JESUS] flesh, and the priest
shall pronounce HIM[JESUS] unclean, and shall not shut HIM[JESUS] up: for HE[JESUS] is
unclean.

13:12 And if a leprosy break out abroad in the skin, and the leprosy
cover all the skin of HIM[JESUS] that has the plague from HIS[JESUS] head even to HIS[JESUS]
foot, wheresoever the priest looketh;

13:13 Then the priest shall consider: and, behold, if the leprosy have
covered all HIS[JESUS] flesh, HE[JESUS] shall pronounce HIM[JESUS] clean that has the
plague: it is all turned white: HE[JESUS] is clean.

13:14 But when raw flesh appeareth in HIM[JESUS], HE[JESUS] shall be unclean.

13:15 And the priest shall see the raw flesh, and pronounce HIM[JESUS] to be
unclean: for the raw flesh is unclean: it is a leprosy.

13:16 Or if the raw flesh turn again, and be changed unto white, HE[JESUS]
shall come unto the priest;

13:17 And the priest shall see HIM[JESUS]: and, behold, if the plague be turned
into white; then the priest shall pronounce HIM[JESUS] clean that has the
plague: HE[JESUS] is clean.

13:18 The flesh also, in which, even in the skin thereof, was a boil,
and is healed,

13:19 And in the place of the boil there be a white rising, or a bright
spot, white, and somewhat reddish, and it be shewed to the priest;

13:20 And if, when the priest seeth it, behold, it be in sight lower
than the skin, and the hair thereof be turned white; the priest shall
pronounce HIM[JESUS] unclean: it is a plague of leprosy broken out of the boil.

13:21 But if the priest look on it, and, behold, there be no white hairs
therein, and if it be not lower than the skin, but be somewhat dark;
then the priest shall shut HIM[JESUS] up seven days:

13:22 And if it spread much abroad in the skin, then the priest shall
pronounce HIM[JESUS] unclean: it is a plague.

13:23 But if the bright spot stay in HIS[JESUS] place, and spread not, it is a
burning boil; and the priest shall pronounce HIM[JESUS] clean.

13:24 Or if there be any flesh, in the skin whereof there is a hot
burning, and the quick flesh that burneth have a white bright spot,
somewhat reddish, or white;

13:25 Then the priest shall look upon it: and, behold, if the hair in
the bright spot be turned white, and it be in sight deeper than the
skin; it is a leprosy broken out of the burning: wherefore the priest
shall pronounce HIM[JESUS] unclean: it is the plague of leprosy.

13:26 But if the priest look on it, and, behold, there be no white hair
in the bright spot, and it be no lower than the other skin, but be
somewhat dark; then the priest shall shut HIM[JESUS] up seven days:

13:27 And the priest shall look upon HIM[JESUS] the seventh day: and if it be
spread much abroad in the skin, then the priest shall pronounce HIM[JESUS]
unclean: it is the plague of leprosy.

13:28 And if the bright spot stay in HIS[JESUS] place, and spread not in the
skin, but it be somewhat dark; it is a rising of the burning, and the
priest shall pronounce HIM[JESUS] clean: for it is an inflammation of the
burning.

13:29 If a man or woman have a plague upon the head or the beard;

13:30 Then the priest shall see the plague: and, behold, if it be in
sight deeper than the skin; and there be in it a yellow thin hair; then
the priest shall pronounce HIM[JESUS] unclean: it is a dry scall, even a
leprosy upon the head or beard.

13:31 And if the priest look on the plague of the scall, and, behold, it
be not in sight deeper than the skin, and that there is no black hair in
it; then the priest shall shut up HIM[JESUS] that has the plague of the scall
seven days:

13:32 And in the seventh day the priest shall look on the plague: and,
behold, if the scall spread not, and there be in it no yellow hair, and
the scall be not in sight deeper than the skin;

13:33 HE[JESUS] shall be shaven, but the scall shall HE[JESUS] not shave; and the
priest shall shut up HIM[JESUS] that has the scall seven days more:

13:34 And in the seventh day the priest shall look on the scall: and,
behold, if the scall be not spread in the skin, nor be in sight deeper
than the skin; then the priest shall pronounce HIM[JESUS] clean: and HE[JESUS] shall
wash HIS[JESUS] clothes, and be clean.

13:35 But if the scall spread much in the skin after HIS[JESUS] cleansing;

13:36 Then the priest shall look on HIM[JESUS]: and, behold, if the scall be
spread in the skin, the priest shall not seek for yellow hair; HE[JESUS] is
unclean.

13:37 But if the scall be in HIS[JESUS] sight at a stay, and that there is
black hair grown up therein; the scall is healed, HE[JESUS] is clean: and the
priest shall pronounce HIM[JESUS] clean.

13:38 If a man also or a woman have in the skin of their flesh bright
spots, even white bright spots;

13:39 Then the priest shall look: and, behold, if the bright spots in
the skin of their flesh be darkish white; it is a freckled spot that
groweth in the skin; HE[JESUS] is clean.

13:40 And the man whose hair is fallen off HIS[JESUS] head, HE[JESUS] is bald; yet is
HE[JESUS] clean.

13:41 And HE[JESUS] that has HIS[JESUS] hair fallen off from the part of HIS[JESUS] head
toward HIS[JESUS] face, HE[JESUS] is forehead bald: yet is HE[JESUS] clean.

13:42 And if there be in the bald head, or bald forehead, a white
reddish sore; it is a leprosy sprung up in HIS[JESUS] bald head, or HIS[JESUS] bald
forehead.

13:43 Then the priest shall look upon it: and, behold, if the rising of
the sore be white reddish in HIS[JESUS] bald head, or in HIS[JESUS] bald forehead, as
the leprosy appeareth in the skin of the flesh;

13:44 HE[JESUS] is a leprous man, HE[JESUS] is unclean: the priest shall pronounce HIM[JESUS]
utterly unclean; HIS[JESUS] plague is in HIS[JESUS] head.

13:45 And the leper in whom the plague is, HIS[JESUS] clothes shall be rent,
and HIS[JESUS] head bare, and HE[JESUS] shall put a covering upon HIS[JESUS] upper lip, and
shall cry, Unclean, unclean.

13:46 All the days wherein the plague shall be in HIM[JESUS] HE[JESUS] shall be
defiled; HE[JESUS] is unclean: HE[JESUS] shall dwell alone; without the camp shall HIS[JESUS]
habitation be.

13:47 The garment also that the plague of leprosy is in, whether it be a
woollen garment, or a linen garment;

13:48 Whether it be in the warp, or woof; of linen, or of woollen;
whether in a skin, or in any thing made of skin;

13:49 And if the plague be greenish or reddish in the garment, or in the
skin, either in the warp, or in the woof, or in any thing of skin; it is
a plague of leprosy, and shall be shewed unto the priest:

13:50 And the priest shall look upon the plague, and shut up it that
has the plague seven days:

13:51 And HE[JESUS] shall look on the plague on the seventh day: if the plague
be spread in the garment, either in the warp, or in the woof, or in a
skin, or in any work that is made of skin; the plague is a fretting
leprosy; it is unclean.

13:52 HE[JESUS] shall therefore burn that garment, whether warp or woof, in
woollen or in linen, or any thing of skin, wherein the plague is: for it
is a fretting leprosy; it shall be burnt in the fire.

13:53 And if the priest shall look, and, behold, the plague be not
spread in the garment, either in the warp, or in the woof, or in any
thing of skin;

13:54 Then the priest shall command that they wash the thing wherein the
plague is, and HE[JESUS] shall shut it up seven days more:

13:55 And the priest shall look on the plague, after that it is washed:
and, behold, if the plague have not changed HIS[JESUS] colour, and the plague
be not spread; it is unclean; you shalt burn it in the fire; it is fret
inward, whether it be bare within or without.

13:56 And if the priest look, and, behold, the plague be somewhat dark
after the washing of it; then HE[JESUS] shall rend it out of the garment, or
out of the skin, or out of the warp, or out of the woof:

13:57 And if it appear still in the garment, either in the warp, or in
the woof, or in any thing of skin; it is a spreading plague: you shalt
burn that wherein the plague is with fire.

13:58 And the garment, either warp, or woof, or whatsoever thing of skin
it be, which you shalt wash, if the plague be departed from them, then
it shall be washed the second time, and shall be clean.

13:59 This is the law of the plague of leprosy in a garment of woollen
or linen, either in the warp, or woof, or any thing of skins, to
pronounce it clean, or to pronounce it unclean.


14:1 And the LORD[JESUS] spake unto Moses, saying,

14:2 This shall be the law of the leper in the day of HIS[JESUS] cleansing: HE[JESUS]
shall be brought unto the priest:

14:3 And the priest shall go forth out of the camp; and the priest shall
look, and, behold, if the plague of leprosy be healed in the leper;

14:4 Then shall the priest command to take for HIM[JESUS] that is to be
cleansed two birds alive and clean, and cedar wood, and scarlet, and
hyssop:

14:5 And the priest shall command that one of the birds be killed in an
earthen vessel over running water:

14:6 As for the living bird, HE[JESUS] shall take it, and the cedar wood, and
the scarlet, and the hyssop, and shall dip them and the living bird in
the blood of the bird that was killed over the running water:

14:7 And HE[JESUS] shall sprinkle upon HIM[JESUS] that is to be cleansed from the
leprosy seven times, and shall pronounce HIM[JESUS] clean, and shall let the
living bird loose into the open field.

14:8 And HE[JESUS] that is to be cleansed shall wash HIS[JESUS] clothes, and shave off
all HIS[JESUS] hair, and wash himself in water, that HE[JESUS] may be clean: and after
that HE[JESUS] shall come into the camp, and shall tarry abroad out of HIS[JESUS] tent
seven days.

14:9 But it shall be on the seventh day, that HE[JESUS] shall shave all HIS[JESUS]
hair off HIS[JESUS] head and HIS[JESUS] beard and HIS[JESUS] eyebrows, even all HIS[JESUS] hair HE[JESUS]
shall shave off: and HE[JESUS] shall wash HIS[JESUS] clothes, also HE[JESUS] shall wash HIS[JESUS]
flesh in water, and HE[JESUS] shall be clean.

14:10 And on the eighth day HE[JESUS] shall take two HE[JESUS] lambs without blemish,
and one ewe LAMB[JESUS] of the first year without blemish, and three tenth
deals of fine flour for a meat offering, mingled with oil, and one log
of oil.

14:11 And the priest that makes HIM[JESUS] clean shall present the man that is
to be made clean, and those things, before the LORD[JESUS], at the door of the
tabernacle of the congregation:

14:12 And the priest shall take one HE[JESUS] LAMB[JESUS], and offer HIM[JESUS] for a
trespass offering, and the log of oil, and wave them for a wave offering
before the LORD[JESUS]:

14:13 And HE[JESUS] shall slay the LAMB[JESUS] in the place where HE[JESUS] shall kill the
sin offering and the burnt offering, in the holy place: for as the sin
offering is the priest's, so is the trespass offering: it is most holy:

14:14 And the priest shall take some of the blood of the trespass
offering, and the priest shall put it upon the tip of the right ear of
HIM[JESUS] that is to be cleansed, and upon the thumb of HIS[JESUS] right hand, and
upon the great toe of HIS[JESUS] right foot:

14:15 And the priest shall take some of the log of oil, and pour it into
the palm of HIS[JESUS] own left hand:

14:16 And the priest shall dip HIS[JESUS] right finger in the oil that is in
HIS[JESUS] left hand, and shall sprinkle of the oil with HIS[JESUS] finger seven times
before the LORD[JESUS]:

14:17 And of the rest of the oil that is in HIS[JESUS] hand shall the priest
put upon the tip of the right ear of HIM[JESUS] that is to be cleansed, and
upon the thumb of HIS[JESUS] right hand, and upon the great toe of HIS[JESUS] right
foot, upon the blood of the trespass offering:

14:18 And the remnant of the oil that is in the priest's hand HE[JESUS] shall
pour upon the head of HIM[JESUS] that is to be cleansed: and the priest shall
make an atonement for HIM[JESUS] before the LORD[JESUS].

14:19 And the priest shall offer the sin offering, and make an atonement
for HIM[JESUS] that is to be cleansed from HIS[JESUS] uncleanness; and afterward HE[JESUS]
shall kill the burnt offering:

14:20 And the priest shall offer the burnt offering and the meat
offering upon the altar: and the priest shall make an atonement for HIM[JESUS],
and HE[JESUS] shall be clean.

14:21 And if HE[JESUS] be poor, and cannot get so much; then HE[JESUS] shall take one
LAMB[JESUS] for a trespass offering to be waved, to make an atonement for HIM[JESUS],
and one tenth deal of fine flour mingled with oil for a meat offering,
and a log of oil;

14:22 And two turtledoves, or two young pigeons, such as HE[JESUS] is able to
get; and the one shall be a sin offering, and the other a burnt
offering.

14:23 And HE[JESUS] shall bring them on the eighth day for HIS[JESUS] cleansing unto
the priest, unto the door of the tabernacle of the congregation, before
the LORD[JESUS].

14:24 And the priest shall take the LAMB[JESUS] of the trespass offering, and
the log of oil, and the priest shall wave them for a wave offering
before the LORD[JESUS]:

14:25 And HE[JESUS] shall kill the LAMB[JESUS] of the trespass offering, and the
priest shall take some of the blood of the trespass offering, and put it
upon the tip of the right ear of HIM[JESUS] that is to be cleansed, and upon
the thumb of HIS[JESUS] right hand, and upon the great toe of HIS[JESUS] right foot:

14:26 And the priest shall pour of the oil into the palm of HIS[JESUS] own left
hand:

14:27 And the priest shall sprinkle with HIS[JESUS] right finger some of the
oil that is in HIS[JESUS] left hand seven times before the LORD[JESUS]:

14:28 And the priest shall put of the oil that is in HIS[JESUS] hand upon the
tip of the right ear of HIM[JESUS] that is to be cleansed, and upon the thumb
of HIS[JESUS] right hand, and upon the great toe of HIS[JESUS] right foot, upon the
place of the blood of the trespass offering:

14:29 And the rest of the oil that is in the priest's hand HE[JESUS] shall put
upon the head of HIM[JESUS] that is to be cleansed, to make an atonement for
HIM[JESUS] before the LORD[JESUS].

14:30 And HE[JESUS] shall offer the one of the turtledoves, or of the young
pigeons, such as HE[JESUS] can get;

14:31 Even such as HE[JESUS] is able to get, the one for a sin offering, and
the other for a burnt offering, with the meat offering: and the priest
shall make an atonement for HIM[JESUS] that is to be cleansed before the LORD[JESUS].

14:32 This is the law of HIM[JESUS] in whom is the plague of leprosy, whose
hand is not able to get that which pertaineth to HIS[JESUS] cleansing.

14:33 And the LORD[JESUS] spake unto Moses and unto Aaron, saying,

14:34 When you be come into the land of Canaan, which I give to you for a
possession, and I put the plague of leprosy in a house of the land of
your possession;

14:35 And HE[JESUS] that owneth the house shall come and tell the priest,
saying, It seemeth to me there is as it were a plague in the house:

14:36 Then the priest shall command that they empty the house, before
the priest go into it to see the plague, that all that is in the house
be not made unclean: and afterward the priest shall go in to see the
house:

14:37 And HE[JESUS] shall look on the plague, and, behold, if the plague be in
the walls of the house with hollow strakes, greenish or reddish, which
in sight are lower than the wall;

14:38 Then the priest shall go out of the house to the door of the
house, and shut up the house seven days:

14:39 And the priest shall come again the seventh day, and shall look:
and, behold, if the plague be spread in the walls of the house;

14:40 Then the priest shall command that they take away the stones in
which the plague is, and they shall cast them into an unclean place
without the city:

14:41 And HE[JESUS] shall cause the house to be scraped within round about, and
they shall pour out the dust that they scrape off without the city into
an unclean place:

14:42 And they shall take other stones, and put them in the place of
those stones; and HE[JESUS] shall take other morter, and shall plaister the
house.

14:43 And if the plague come again, and break out in the house, after
that HE[JESUS] has taken away the stones, and after HE[JESUS] has scraped the house,
and after it is plaistered;

14:44 Then the priest shall come and look, and, behold, if the plague be
spread in the house, it is a fretting leprosy in the house; it is
unclean.

14:45 And HE[JESUS] shall break down the house, the stones of it, and the
timber thereof, and all the morter of the house; and HE[JESUS] shall carry them
forth out of the city into an unclean place.

14:46 Moreover HE[JESUS] that goes into the house all the while that it is
shut up shall be unclean until the even.

14:47 And HE[JESUS] that lieth in the house shall wash HIS[JESUS] clothes; and HE[JESUS] that
eateth in the house shall wash HIS[JESUS] clothes.

14:48 And if the priest shall come in, and look upon it, and, behold,
the plague has not spread in the house, after the house was plaistered:
then the priest shall pronounce the house clean, because the plague is
healed.

14:49 And HE[JESUS] shall take to cleanse the house two birds, and cedar wood,
and scarlet, and hyssop:

14:50 And HE[JESUS] shall kill the one of the birds in an earthen vessel over
running water:

14:51 And HE[JESUS] shall take the cedar wood, and the hyssop, and the scarlet,
and the living bird, and dip them in the blood of the slain bird, and in
the running water, and sprinkle the house seven times:

14:52 And HE[JESUS] shall cleanse the house with the blood of the bird, and
with the running water, and with the living bird, and with the cedar
wood, and with the hyssop, and with the scarlet:

14:53 But HE[JESUS] shall let go the living bird out of the city into the open
fields, and make an atonement for the house: and it shall be clean.

14:54 This is the law for all manner of plague of leprosy, and scall,

14:55 And for the leprosy of a garment, and of a house,

14:56 And for a rising, and for a scab, and for a bright spot:

14:57 To teach when it is unclean, and when it is clean: this is the law
of leprosy.


15:1 And the LORD[JESUS] spake unto Moses and to Aaron, saying,

15:2 Speak unto the children of Israel, and say unto them, When any man
has a running issue out of HIS[JESUS] flesh, because of HIS[JESUS] issue HE[JESUS] is
unclean.

15:3 And this shall be HIS[JESUS] uncleanness in HIS[JESUS] issue: whether HIS[JESUS] flesh
run with HIS[JESUS] issue, or HIS[JESUS] flesh be stopped from HIS[JESUS] issue, it is HIS[JESUS]
uncleanness.

15:4 Every bed, whereon HE[JESUS] lieth that has the issue, is unclean: and
every thing, whereon HE[JESUS] sitteth, shall be unclean.

15:5 And whoever toucheth HIS[JESUS] bed shall wash HIS[JESUS] clothes, and bathe
himself in water, and be unclean until the even.

15:6 And HE[JESUS] that sitteth on any thing whereon HE[JESUS] sat that has the issue
shall wash HIS[JESUS] clothes, and bathe himself in water, and be unclean until
the even.

15:7 And HE[JESUS] that toucheth the flesh of HIM[JESUS] that has the issue shall
wash HIS[JESUS] clothes, and bathe himself in water, and be unclean until the
even.

15:8 And if HE[JESUS] that has the issue spit upon HIM[JESUS] that is clean; then HE[JESUS]
shall wash HIS[JESUS] clothes, and bathe himself in water, and be unclean until
the even.

15:9 And what saddle soever HE[JESUS] rideth upon that has the issue shall be
unclean.

15:10 And whoever toucheth any thing that was under HIM[JESUS] shall be
unclean until the even: and HE[JESUS] that beareth any of those things shall
wash HIS[JESUS] clothes, and bathe himself in water, and be unclean until the
even.

15:11 And whomsoever HE[JESUS] toucheth that has the issue, and has not
rinsed HIS[JESUS] hands in water, HE[JESUS] shall wash HIS[JESUS] clothes, and bathe himself
in water, and be unclean until the even.

15:12 And the vessel of earth, that HE[JESUS] toucheth which has the issue,
shall be broken: and every vessel of wood shall be rinsed in water.

15:13 And when HE[JESUS] that has an issue is cleansed of HIS[JESUS] issue; then HE[JESUS]
shall number to himself seven days for HIS[JESUS] cleansing, and wash HIS[JESUS]
clothes, and bathe HIS[JESUS] flesh in running water, and shall be clean.

15:14 And on the eighth day HE[JESUS] shall take to HIM[JESUS] two turtledoves, or two
young pigeons, and come before the LORD[JESUS] unto the door of the tabernacle
of the congregation, and give them unto the priest:

15:15 And the priest shall offer them, the one for a sin offering, and
the other for a burnt offering; and the priest shall make an atonement
for HIM[JESUS] before the LORD[JESUS] for HIS[JESUS] issue.

15:16 And if any man's SEED[JESUS] of copulation go out from HIM[JESUS], then HE[JESUS] shall
wash all HIS[JESUS] flesh in water, and be unclean until the even.

15:17 And every garment, and every skin, whereon is the SEED[JESUS] of
copulation, shall be washed with water, and be unclean until the even.

15:18 The woman also with whom man shall lie with SEED[JESUS] of copulation,
they shall both bathe themselves in water, and be unclean until the
even.

15:19 And if a woman have an issue, and her issue in her flesh be blood,
she shall be put apart seven days: and whoever toucheth her shall be
unclean until the even.

15:20 And every thing that she lieth upon in her separation shall be
