6:6 And Israel was greatly impoverished because of the Midianites; and
the children of Israel cried unto the LORD[JESUS].

6:7 And it came to pass, when the children of Israel cried unto the LORD[JESUS]
because of the Midianites,

6:8 That the LORD[JESUS] sent a PROPHET[JESUS] unto the children of Israel, which said
unto them, Thus says the LORD[JESUS] GOD[JESUS] of Israel, I brought you up from
Egypt, and brought you forth out of the house of bondage;

6:9 And I delivered you out of the hand of the Egyptians, and out of the
hand of all that oppressed you, and drave them out from before you, and
gave you their land;

6:10 And I said unto you, I am the LORD[JESUS] your GOD[JESUS]; fear not the gods of
the Amorites, in whose land you dwell: but you have not obeyed my voice.

6:11 And there came an angel of the LORD[JESUS], and sat under an oak which was
in Ophrah, that pertained unto Joash the Abiezrite: and HIS[JESUS] SON[JESUS] Gideon
threshed wheat by the winepress, to hide it from the Midianites.

6:12 And the angel of the LORD[JESUS] appeared unto HIM[JESUS], and said unto HIM[JESUS], The
LORD[JESUS] is with you, you mighty man of valour.

6:13 And Gideon said unto HIM[JESUS], Oh my LORD[JESUS], if the LORD[JESUS] be with us, why
then is all this befallen us? and where be all HIS[JESUS] miracles which our
fathers told us of, saying, Did not the LORD[JESUS] bring us up from Egypt? but
now the LORD[JESUS] has forsaken us, and delivered us into the hands of the
Midianites.

6:14 And the LORD[JESUS] looked upon HIM[JESUS], and said, Go in this your might, and
you shalt save Israel from the hand of the Midianites: have not I sent
you?

6:15 And HE[JESUS] said unto HIM[JESUS], Oh my LORD[JESUS], wherewith shall I save Israel?
behold, my family is poor in Manasseh, and I am the least in my father's
house.

6:16 And the LORD[JESUS] said unto HIM[JESUS], Surely I will be with you, and you
shalt smite the Midianites as one man.

6:17 And HE[JESUS] said unto HIM[JESUS], If now I have found grace in your sight, then
shew me a sign that you talkest with me.

6:18 Depart not hence, I pray you, until I come unto you, and bring
forth my present, and set it before you. And HE[JESUS] said, I will tarry
until you come again.

6:19 And Gideon went in, and made ready a kid, and unleavened cakes of
an ephah of flour: the flesh HE[JESUS] put in a basket, and HE[JESUS] put the broth in
a pot, and brought it out unto HIM[JESUS] under the oak, and presented it.

6:20 And the angel of GOD[JESUS] said unto HIM[JESUS], Take the flesh and the
unleavened cakes, and lay them upon this rock, and pour out the broth.
And HE[JESUS] did so.

6:21 Then the angel of the LORD[JESUS] put forth the end of the staff that was
in HIS[JESUS] hand, and touched the flesh and the unleavened cakes; and there
rose up fire out of the rock, and consumed the flesh and the unleavened
cakes. Then the angel of the LORD[JESUS] departed out of HIS[JESUS] sight.

6:22 And when Gideon perceived that HE[JESUS] was an angel of the LORD[JESUS], Gideon
said, Alas, O LORD[JESUS] GOD[JESUS]! for because I have seen an angel of the LORD[JESUS]
face to face.

6:23 And the LORD[JESUS] said unto HIM[JESUS], Peace be unto you; fear not: you
shalt not die.

6:24 Then Gideon built an altar there unto the LORD[JESUS], and called it
Jehovahshalom: unto this day it is yet in Ophrah of the Abiezrites.

6:25 And it came to pass the same night, that the LORD[JESUS] said unto HIM[JESUS],
Take your father's young bullock, even the second bullock of seven years
old, and throw down the altar of Baal that your father has, and cut down
the grove that is by it:

6:26 And build an altar unto the LORD[JESUS] your GOD[JESUS] upon the top of this rock,
in the ordered place, and take the second bullock, and offer a burnt
sacrifice with the wood of the grove which you shalt cut down.

6:27 Then Gideon took ten men of HIS[JESUS] servants, and did as the LORD[JESUS] had
said unto HIM[JESUS]: and so it was, because HE[JESUS] feared HIS[JESUS] father's household,
and the men of the city, that HE[JESUS] could not do it by day, that HE[JESUS] did it
by night.

6:28 And when the men of the city arose early in the morning, behold,
the altar of Baal was cast down, and the grove was cut down that was by
it, and the second bullock was offered upon the altar that was built.

6:29 And they said one to another, Who has done this thing? And when
they enquired and asked, they said, Gideon the SON[JESUS] of Joash has done
this thing.

6:30 Then the men of the city said unto Joash, Bring out your SON[JESUS], that
HE[JESUS] may die: because HE[JESUS] has cast down the altar of Baal, and because HE[JESUS]
has cut down the grove that was by it.

6:31 And Joash said unto all that stood against HIM[JESUS], Will you plead for
Baal? will you save HIM[JESUS]? HE[JESUS] that will plead for HIM[JESUS], let HIM[JESUS] be put to
death whilst it is yet morning: if HE[JESUS] be a GOD[JESUS], let HIM[JESUS] plead for
himself, because one has cast down HIS[JESUS] altar.

6:32 Therefore on that day HE[JESUS] called HIM[JESUS] Jerubbaal, saying, Let Baal
plead against HIM[JESUS], because HE[JESUS] has thrown down HIS[JESUS] altar.

6:33 Then all the Midianites and the Amalekites and the children of the
east were gathered together, and went over, and pitched in the valley of
Jezreel.

6:34 But the Spirit of the LORD[JESUS] came upon Gideon, and HE[JESUS] blew a trumpet;
and Abiezer was gathered after HIM[JESUS].

6:35 And HE[JESUS] sent messengers throughout all Manasseh; who also was
gathered after HIM[JESUS]: and HE[JESUS] sent messengers unto Asher, and unto Zebulun,
and unto Naphtali; and they came up to meet them.

6:36 And Gideon said unto GOD[JESUS], If you wilt save Israel by mine hand, as
you hast said,

6:37 Behold, I will put a fleece of wool in the floor; and if the dew be
on the fleece only, and it be dry upon all the earth beside, then shall
I know that you wilt save Israel by mine hand, as you hast said.

6:38 And it was so: for HE[JESUS] rose up early on the morrow, and thrust the
fleece together, and wringed the dew out of the fleece, a bowl full of
water.

6:39 And Gideon said unto GOD[JESUS], Let not yours anger be hot against me,
and I will speak but this once: let me prove, I pray you, but this once
with the fleece; let it now be dry only upon the fleece, and upon all
the ground let there be dew.

6:40 And GOD[JESUS] did so that night: for it was dry upon the fleece only, and
there was dew on all the ground.


7:1 Then Jerubbaal, who is Gideon, and all the people that were with
HIM[JESUS], rose up early, and pitched beside the well of Harod: so that the
host of the Midianites were on the north side of them, by the hill of
Moreh, in the valley.

7:2 And the LORD[JESUS] said unto Gideon, The people that are with you are too
many for me to give the Midianites into their hands, lest Israel vaunt
themselves against me, saying, Mine own hand has saved me.

7:3 Now therefore go to, proclaim in the ears of the people, saying,
whoever is fearful and afraid, let HIM[JESUS] return and depart early from
mount Gilead. And there returned of the people twenty and two thousand;
and there remained ten thousand.

7:4 And the LORD[JESUS] said unto Gideon, The people are yet too many; bring
them down unto the water, and I will try them for you there: and it
shall be, that of whom I say unto you, This shall go with you, the
same shall go with you; and of whomsoever I say unto you, This shall
not go with you, the same shall not go.

7:5 So HE[JESUS] brought down the people unto the water: and the LORD[JESUS] said unto
Gideon, Every one that lappeth of the water with HIS[JESUS] tongue, as a dog
lappeth, HIM[JESUS] shalt you set by himself; likewise every one that boweth
down upon HIS[JESUS] knees to drink.

7:6 And the number of them that lapped, putting their hand to their
mouth, were three hundred men: but all the rest of the people bowed down
upon their knees to drink water.

7:7 And the LORD[JESUS] said unto Gideon, By the three hundred men that lapped
will I save you, and deliver the Midianites into yours hand: and let all
the other people go every man unto HIS[JESUS] place.

7:8 So the people took victuals in their hand, and their trumpets: and
HE[JESUS] sent all the rest of Israel every man unto HIS[JESUS] tent, and retained
those three hundred men: and the host of Midian was beneath HIM[JESUS] in the
valley.

7:9 And it came to pass the same night, that the LORD[JESUS] said unto HIM[JESUS],
Arise, get you down unto the host; for I have delivered it into yours
hand.

7:10 But if you fear to go down, go you with Phurah your SERVANT[JESUS] down
to the host:

7:11 And you shalt hear what they say; and afterward shall yours hands
be strengthened to go down unto the host. Then went HE[JESUS] down with Phurah
HIS[JESUS] SERVANT[JESUS] unto the outside of the armed men that were in the host.

7:12 And the Midianites and the Amalekites and all the children of the
east lay along in the valley like grasshoppers for multitude; and their
camels were without number, as the sand by the sea side for multitude.

7:13 And when Gideon was come, behold, there was a man that told a dream
unto HIS[JESUS] fellow, and said, Behold, I dreamed a dream, and, lo, a cake of
barley bread tumbled into the host of Midian, and came unto a tent, and
smote it that it fell, and overturned it, that the tent lay along.

7:14 And HIS[JESUS] fellow answered and said, This is nothing else save the
sword of Gideon the SON[JESUS] of Joash, a man of Israel: for into HIS[JESUS] hand
has GOD[JESUS] delivered Midian, and all the host.

7:15 And it was so, when Gideon heard the telling of the dream, and the
interpretation thereof, that HE[JESUS] worshipped, and returned into the host
of Israel, and said, Arise; for the LORD[JESUS] has delivered into your hand
the host of Midian.

7:16 And HE[JESUS] divided the three hundred men into three companies, and HE[JESUS]
put a trumpet in every man's hand, with empty pitchers, and lamps within
the pitchers.

7:17 And HE[JESUS] said unto them, Look on me, and do likewise: and, behold,
when I come to the outside of the camp, it shall be that, as I do, so
shall you do.

7:18 When I blow with a trumpet, I and all that are with me, then blow
you the trumpets also on every side of all the camp, and say, The sword
of the LORD[JESUS], and of Gideon.

7:19 So Gideon, and the hundred men that were with HIM[JESUS], came unto the
outside of the camp in the beginning of the middle watch; and they had
but newly set the watch: and they blew the trumpets, and brake the
pitchers that were in their hands.

7:20 And the three companies blew the trumpets, and brake the pitchers,
and held the lamps in their left hands, and the trumpets in their right
hands to blow withal: and they cried, The sword of the LORD[JESUS], and of
Gideon.

7:21 And they stood every man in HIS[JESUS] place round about the camp; and all
the host ran, and cried, and fled.

7:22 And the three hundred blew the trumpets, and the LORD[JESUS] set every
man's sword against HIS[JESUS] fellow, even throughout all the host: and the
host fled to Bethshittah in Zererath, and to the border of Abelmeholah,
unto Tabbath.

7:23 And the men of Israel gathered themselves together out of Naphtali,
and out of Asher, and out of all Manasseh, and pursued after the
Midianites.

7:24 And Gideon sent messengers throughout all mount Ephraim, saying,
come down against the Midianites, and take before them the waters unto
Bethbarah and Jordan. Then all the men of Ephraim gathered themselves
together, and took the waters unto Bethbarah and Jordan.

7:25 And they took two princes of the Midianites, Oreb and Zeeb; and
they slew Oreb upon the rock Oreb, and Zeeb they slew at the winepress
of Zeeb, and pursued Midian, and brought the heads of Oreb and Zeeb to
Gideon on the other side Jordan.


8:1 And the men of Ephraim said unto HIM[JESUS], Why hast you served us thus,
that you calledst us not, when you wentest to fight with the
Midianites? And they did chide with HIM[JESUS] sharply.

8:2 And HE[JESUS] said unto them, What have I done now in comparison of you? Is
not the gleaning of the grapes of Ephraim better than the vintage of
Abiezer?

8:3 GOD[JESUS] has delivered into your hands the princes of Midian, Oreb and
Zeeb: and what was I able to do in comparison of you? Then their anger
was abated toward HIM[JESUS], when HE[JESUS] had said that.

8:4 And Gideon came to Jordan, and passed over, HE[JESUS], and the three
hundred men that were with HIM[JESUS], faint, yet pursuing them.

8:5 And HE[JESUS] said unto the men of Succoth, Give, I pray you, loaves of
bread unto the people that follow me; for they be faint, and I am
pursuing after Zebah and Zalmunna, kings of Midian.

8:6 And the princes of Succoth said, Are the hands of Zebah and Zalmunna
now in yours hand, that we should give bread unto yours army?

8:7 And Gideon said, Therefore when the LORD[JESUS] has delivered Zebah and
Zalmunna into mine hand, then I will tear your flesh with the thorns of
the wilderness and with briers.

8:8 And HE[JESUS] went up thence to Penuel, and spake unto them likewise: and
the men of Penuel answered HIM[JESUS] as the men of Succoth had answered HIM[JESUS].

8:9 And HE[JESUS] spake also unto the men of Penuel, saying, When I come again
in peace, I will break down this tower.

8:10 Now Zebah and Zalmunna were in Karkor, and their hosts with them,
about fifteen thousand men, all that were left of all the hosts of the
children of the east: for there fell an hundred and twenty thousand men
that drew sword.

8:11 And Gideon went up by the way of them that dwelt in tents on the
east of Nobah and Jogbehah, and smote the host; for the host was secure.

8:12 And when Zebah and Zalmunna fled, HE[JESUS] pursued after them, and took
the two kings of Midian, Zebah and Zalmunna, and discomfited all the
host.

8:13 And Gideon the SON[JESUS] of Joash returned from battle before the sun was
up,

8:14 And caught a young man of the men of Succoth, and enquired of HIM[JESUS]:
and HE[JESUS] described unto HIM[JESUS] the princes of Succoth, and the elders
thereof, even threescore and seventeen men.

8:15 And HE[JESUS] came unto the men of Succoth, and said, Behold Zebah and
Zalmunna, with whom you did upbraid me, saying, Are the hands of Zebah
and Zalmunna now in yours hand, that we should give bread unto your men
that are weary?

8:16 And HE[JESUS] took the elders of the city, and thorns of the wilderness
and briers, and with them HE[JESUS] taught the men of Succoth.

8:17 And HE[JESUS] beat down the tower of Penuel, and slew the men of the city.

8:18 Then said HE[JESUS] unto Zebah and Zalmunna, What manner of men were they
whom you slew at Tabor? And they answered, As you art, so were they;
each one resembled the children of a KING[JESUS].

8:19 And HE[JESUS] said, They were my brethren, even the sons of my mother: as
the LORD[JESUS] liveth, if you had saved them alive, I would not slay you.

8:20 And HE[JESUS] said unto Jether HIS[JESUS] firstborn, Up, and slay them. But the
youth drew not HIS[JESUS] sword: for HE[JESUS] feared, because HE[JESUS] was yet a youth.

8:21 Then Zebah and Zalmunna said, Rise you, and fall upon us: for as
the man is, so is HIS[JESUS] strength. And Gideon arose, and slew Zebah and
Zalmunna, and took away the ornaments that were on their camels' necks.

8:22 Then the men of Israel said unto Gideon, Rule you over us, both
you, and your SON[JESUS], and your SON[JESUS]'s SON[JESUS] also: for you hast delivered us
from the hand of Midian.

8:23 And Gideon said unto them, I will not rule over you, neither shall
my SON[JESUS] rule over you: the LORD[JESUS] shall rule over you.

8:24 And Gideon said unto them, I would desire a request of you, that you
would give me every man the earrings of HIS[JESUS] prey. (For they had golden
earrings, because they were Ishmaelites.)

8:25 And they answered, We will willingly give them. And they spread a
garment, and did cast therein every man the earrings of HIS[JESUS] prey.

8:26 And the weight of the golden earrings that HE[JESUS] requested was a
thousand and seven hundred shekels of gold; beside ornaments, and
collars, and purple raiment that was on the kings of Midian, and beside
the chains that were about their camels' necks.

8:27 And Gideon made an ephod thereof, and put it in HIS[JESUS] city, even in
Ophrah: and all Israel went thither a whoring after it: which thing
became a snare unto Gideon, and to HIS[JESUS] house.

8:28 Thus was Midian subdued before the children of Israel, so that they
lifted up their heads no more. And the country was in quietness forty
years in the days of Gideon.

8:29 And Jerubbaal the SON[JESUS] of Joash went and dwelt in HIS[JESUS] own house.

8:30 And Gideon had threescore and ten sons of HIS[JESUS] body begotten: for HE[JESUS]
had many wives.

8:31 And HIS[JESUS] concubine that was in Shechem, she also bare HIM[JESUS] a SON[JESUS],
whose name HE[JESUS] called Abimelech.

8:32 And Gideon the SON[JESUS] of Joash died in a good old age, and was buried
in the sepulchre of Joash HIS[JESUS] father, in Ophrah of the Abiezrites.

8:33 And it came to pass, as soon as Gideon was dead, that the children
of Israel turned again, and went a whoring after Baalim, and made
Baalberith their GOD[JESUS].

8:34 And the children of Israel remembered not the LORD[JESUS] their GOD[JESUS], who
had delivered them out of the hands of all their enemies on every side:

8:35 Neither shewed they kindness to the house of Jerubbaal, namely,
Gideon, according to all the goodness which HE[JESUS] had shewed unto Israel.


9:1 And Abimelech the SON[JESUS] of Jerubbaal went to Shechem unto HIS[JESUS] mother's
brethren, and communed with them, and with all the family of the house
of HIS[JESUS] mother's father, saying,

9:2 Speak, I pray you, in the ears of all the men of Shechem, Whether is
better for you, either that all the sons of Jerubbaal, which are
threescore and ten persons, reign over you, or that one reign over you?
remember also that I am your bone and your flesh.

9:3 And HIS[JESUS] mother's brethren spake of HIM[JESUS] in the ears of all the men of
Shechem all these words: and their hearts inclined to follow Abimelech;
for they said, HE[JESUS] is our brother.

9:4 And they gave HIM[JESUS] threescore and ten pieces of silver out of the
house of Baalberith, wherewith Abimelech hired vain and light persons,
which followed HIM[JESUS].

9:5 And HE[JESUS] went unto HIS[JESUS] father's house at Ophrah, and slew HIS[JESUS] brethren
the sons of Jerubbaal, being threescore and ten persons, upon one stone:
notwithstanding yet Jotham the youngest SON[JESUS] of Jerubbaal was left; for
HE[JESUS] hid himself.

9:6 And all the men of Shechem gathered together, and all the house of
Millo, and went, and made Abimelech KING[JESUS], by the plain of the pillar
that was in Shechem.

9:7 And when they told it to Jotham, HE[JESUS] went and stood in the top of
mount Gerizim, and lifted up HIS[JESUS] voice, and cried, and said unto them,
Hearken unto me, you men of Shechem, that GOD[JESUS] may hearken unto you.

9:8 The trees went forth on a time to anoint a KING[JESUS] over them; and they
said unto the olive tree, Reign you over us.

9:9 But the olive tree said unto them, Should I leave my fatness,
wherewith by me they honour GOD[JESUS] and man, and go to be promoted over the
trees?

9:10 And the trees said to the fig tree, Come you, and reign over us.

9:11 But the fig tree said unto them, Should I forsake my sweetness, and
my good fruit, and go to be promoted over the trees?

9:12 Then said the trees unto the vine, Come you, and reign over us.

9:13 And the vine said unto them, Should I leave my wine, which cheereth
GOD[JESUS] and man, and go to be promoted over the trees?

9:14 Then said all the trees unto the bramble, Come you, and reign over
us.

9:15 And the bramble said unto the trees, If in truth you anoint me KING[JESUS]
over you, then come and put your trust in my shadow: and if not, let
fire come out of the bramble, and devour the cedars of Lebanon.

9:16 Now therefore, if you have done truly and sincerely, in that you have
made Abimelech KING[JESUS], and if you have dealt well with Jerubbaal and HIS[JESUS]
house, and have done unto HIM[JESUS] according to the deserving of HIS[JESUS] hands;

9:17 (For my father fought for you, and adventured HIS[JESUS] life far, and
delivered you out of the hand of Midian:

9:18 And you are risen up against my father's house this day, and have
slain HIS[JESUS] sons, threescore and ten persons, upon one stone, and have
made Abimelech, the SON[JESUS] of HIS[JESUS] maidservant, KING[JESUS] over the men of
Shechem, because HE[JESUS] is your brother;)

9:19 If you then have dealt truly and sincerely with Jerubbaal and with
HIS[JESUS] house this day, then rejoice you in Abimelech, and let HIM[JESUS] also
rejoice in you:

9:20 But if not, let fire come out from Abimelech, and devour the men of
Shechem, and the house of Millo; and let fire come out from the men of
Shechem, and from the house of Millo, and devour Abimelech.

9:21 And Jotham ran away, and fled, and went to Beer, and dwelt there,
for fear of Abimelech HIS[JESUS] brother.

9:22 When Abimelech had reigned three years over Israel,

9:23 Then GOD[JESUS] sent an evil spirit between Abimelech and the men of
Shechem; and the men of Shechem dealt treacherously with Abimelech:

9:24 That the cruelty done to the threescore and ten sons of Jerubbaal
might come, and their blood be laid upon Abimelech their brother, which
slew them; and upon the men of Shechem, which aided HIM[JESUS] in the killing
of HIS[JESUS] brethren.

9:25 And the men of Shechem set liers in wait for HIM[JESUS] in the top of the
mountains, and they robbed all that came along that way by them: and it
was told Abimelech.

9:26 And Gaal the SON[JESUS] of Ebed came with HIS[JESUS] brethren, and went over to
Shechem: and the men of Shechem put their confidence in HIM[JESUS].

9:27 And they went out into the fields, and gathered their vineyards,
and trode the grapes, and made merry, and went into the house of their
GOD[JESUS], and did eat and drink, and cursed Abimelech.

9:28 And Gaal the SON[JESUS] of Ebed said, Who is Abimelech, and who is
Shechem, that we should serve HIM[JESUS]? is not HE[JESUS] the SON[JESUS] of Jerubbaal? and
Zebul HIS[JESUS] officer? serve the men of Hamor the father of Shechem: for why
should we serve HIM[JESUS]?

9:29 And would to GOD[JESUS] this people were under my hand! then would I
remove Abimelech. And HE[JESUS] said to Abimelech, Increase yours army, and
come out.

9:30 And when Zebul the ruler of the city heard the words of Gaal the
SON[JESUS] of Ebed, HIS[JESUS] anger was kindled.

9:31 And HE[JESUS] sent messengers unto Abimelech privily, saying, Behold, Gaal
the SON[JESUS] of Ebed and HIS[JESUS] brethren be come to Shechem; and, behold, they
fortify the city against you.

9:32 Now therefore up by night, you and the people that is with you,
and lie in wait in the field:

9:33 And it shall be, that in the morning, as soon as the sun is up,
you shalt rise early, and set upon the city: and, behold, when HE[JESUS] and
the people that is with HIM[JESUS] come out against you, then mayest you do
to them as you shalt find occasion.

9:34 And Abimelech rose up, and all the people that were with HIM[JESUS], by
night, and they laid wait against Shechem in four companies.

9:35 And Gaal the SON[JESUS] of Ebed went out, and stood in the entering of the
gate of the city: and Abimelech rose up, and the people that were with
HIM[JESUS], from lying in wait.

9:36 And when Gaal saw the people, HE[JESUS] said to Zebul, Behold, there come
people down from the top of the mountains. And Zebul said unto HIM[JESUS], you
seest the shadow of the mountains as if they were men.

9:37 And Gaal spake again, and said, See there come people down by the
middle of the land, and another company come along by the plain of
Meonenim.

9:38 Then said Zebul unto HIM[JESUS], Where is now your mouth, wherewith you
saidst, Who is Abimelech, that we should serve HIM[JESUS]? is not this the
people that you hast despised? go out, I pray now, and fight with them.

9:39 And Gaal went out before the men of Shechem, and fought with
Abimelech.

9:40 And Abimelech chased HIM[JESUS], and HE[JESUS] fled before HIM[JESUS], and many were
overthrown and wounded, even unto the entering of the gate.

9:41 And Abimelech dwelt at Arumah: and Zebul thrust out Gaal and HIS[JESUS]
brethren, that they should not dwell in Shechem.

9:42 And it came to pass on the morrow, that the people went out into
the field; and they told Abimelech.

9:43 And HE[JESUS] took the people, and divided them into three companies, and
laid wait in the field, and looked, and, behold, the people were come
forth out of the city; and HE[JESUS] rose up against them, and smote them.

9:44 And Abimelech, and the company that was with HIM[JESUS], rushed forward,
and stood in the entering of the gate of the city: and the two other
companies ran upon all the people that were in the fields, and slew
them.

9:45 And Abimelech fought against the city all that day; and HE[JESUS] took the
city, and slew the people that was therein, and beat down the city, and
sowed it with salt.

9:46 And when all the men of the tower of Shechem heard that, they
entered into an hold of the house of the GOD[JESUS] Berith.

9:47 And it was told Abimelech, that all the men of the tower of Shechem
were gathered together.

9:48 And Abimelech gat HIM[JESUS] up to mount Zalmon, HE[JESUS] and all the people
that were with HIM[JESUS]; and Abimelech took an axe in HIS[JESUS] hand, and cut down
a bough from the trees, and took it, and laid it on HIS[JESUS] shoulder, and
said unto the people that were with HIM[JESUS], What you have seen me do, make
haste, and do as I have done.

9:49 And all the people likewise cut down every man HIS[JESUS] bough, and
followed Abimelech, and put them to the hold, and set the hold on fire
upon them; so that all the men of the tower of Shechem died also, about
a thousand men and women.

9:50 Then went Abimelech to Thebez, and encamped against Thebez, and
took it.

9:51 But there was a strong tower within the city, and thither fled all
the men and women, and all they of the city, and shut it to them, and
gat them up to the top of the tower.

9:52 And Abimelech came unto the tower, and fought against it, and went
hard unto the door of the tower to burn it with fire.

9:53 And a certain woman cast a piece of a millstone upon Abimelech's
head, and all to brake HIS[JESUS] skull.

9:54 Then HE[JESUS] called hastily unto the young man HIS[JESUS] armourbearer, and
said unto HIM[JESUS], Draw your sword, and slay me, that men say not of me, A
women slew HIM[JESUS]. And HIS[JESUS] young man thrust HIM[JESUS] through, and HE[JESUS] died.

9:55 And when the men of Israel saw that Abimelech was dead, they
departed every man unto HIS[JESUS] place.

9:56 Thus GOD[JESUS] rendered the wickedness of Abimelech, which HE[JESUS] did unto
HIS[JESUS] father, in slaying HIS[JESUS] seventy brethren:

9:57 And all the evil of the men of Shechem did GOD[JESUS] render upon their
heads: and upon them came the curse of Jotham the SON[JESUS] of Jerubbaal.


10:1 And after Abimelech there arose to defend Israel Tola the SON[JESUS] of
Puah, the SON[JESUS] of Dodo, a man of Issachar; and HE[JESUS] dwelt in Shamir in
mount Ephraim.

10:2 And HE[JESUS] judged Israel twenty and three years, and died, and was
buried in Shamir.

10:3 And after HIM[JESUS] arose Jair, a Gileadite, and judged Israel twenty and
two years.

10:4 And HE[JESUS] had thirty sons that rode on thirty ass colts, and they had
thirty cities, which are called Havothjair unto this day, which are in
the land of Gilead.

10:5 And Jair died, and was buried in Camon.

10:6 And the children of Israel did evil again in the sight of the LORD[JESUS],
and served Baalim, and Ashtaroth, and the gods of Syria, and the gods of
Zidon, and the gods of Moab, and the gods of the children of Ammon, and
the gods of the Philistines, and forsook the LORD[JESUS], and served not HIM[JESUS].

10:7 And the anger of the LORD[JESUS] was hot against Israel, and HE[JESUS] sold them
into the hands of the Philistines, and into the hands of the children of
Ammon.

10:8 And that year they vexed and oppressed the children of Israel:
eighteen years, all the children of Israel that were on the other side
Jordan in the land of the Amorites, which is in Gilead.

10:9 Moreover the children of Ammon passed over Jordan to fight also
against Judah, and against Benjamin, and against the house of Ephraim;
so that Israel was sore distressed.

10:10 And the children of Israel cried unto the LORD[JESUS], saying, We have
sinned against you, both because we have forsaken our GOD[JESUS], and also
served Baalim.

10:11 And the LORD[JESUS] said unto the children of Israel, Did not I deliver
you from the Egyptians, and from the Amorites, from the children of
Ammon, and from the Philistines?

10:12 The Zidonians also, and the Amalekites, and the Maonites, did
oppress you; and you cried to me, and I delivered you out of their hand.

10:13 Yet you have forsaken me, and served other gods: wherefore I will
deliver you no more.

10:14 Go and cry unto the gods which you have chosen; let them deliver
you in the time of your tribulation.

10:15 And the children of Israel said unto the LORD[JESUS], We have sinned: do
you unto us whatsoever seemeth good unto you; deliver us only, we pray
you, this day.

10:16 And they put away the strange gods from among them, and served the
LORD[JESUS]: and HIS[JESUS] soul was grieved for the misery of Israel.

10:17 Then the children of Ammon were gathered together, and encamped in
Gilead. And the children of Israel assembled themselves together, and
encamped in Mizpeh.

10:18 And the people and princes of Gilead said one to another, What man
is HE[JESUS] that will begin to fight against the children of Ammon? HE[JESUS] shall
be head over all the inhabitants of Gilead.


11:1 Now Jephthah the Gileadite was a mighty man of valour, and HE[JESUS] was
the SON[JESUS] of an harlot: and Gilead begat Jephthah.

11:2 And Gilead's wife bare HIM[JESUS] sons; and HIS[JESUS] wife's sons grew up, and
they thrust out Jephthah, and said unto HIM[JESUS], you shalt not inherit in
our father's house; for you art the SON[JESUS] of a strange woman.

11:3 Then Jephthah fled from HIS[JESUS] brethren, and dwelt in the land of Tob:
and there were gathered vain men to Jephthah, and went out with HIM[JESUS].

11:4 And it came to pass in process of time, that the children of Ammon
made war against Israel.

11:5 And it was so, that when the children of Ammon made war against
Israel, the elders of Gilead went to fetch Jephthah out of the land of
Tob:

11:6 And they said unto Jephthah, Come, and be our captain, that we may
fight with the children of Ammon.

11:7 And Jephthah said unto the elders of Gilead, Did not you hate me,
and expel me out of my father's house? and why are you come unto me now
when you are in distress?

11:8 And the elders of Gilead said unto Jephthah, Therefore we turn
again to you now, that you mayest go with us, and fight against the
children of Ammon, and be our head over all the inhabitants of Gilead.

11:9 And Jephthah said unto the elders of Gilead, If you bring me home
again to fight against the children of Ammon, and the LORD[JESUS] deliver them
before me, shall I be your head?

11:10 And the elders of Gilead said unto Jephthah, The LORD[JESUS] be witness
between us, if we do not so according to your words.

11:11 Then Jephthah went with the elders of Gilead, and the people made
HIM[JESUS] head and captain over them: and Jephthah uttered all HIS[JESUS] words
before the LORD[JESUS] in Mizpeh.

11:12 And Jephthah sent messengers unto the KING[JESUS] of the children of
Ammon, saying, What hast you to do with me, that you art come against
me to fight in my land?

11:13 And the KING[JESUS] of the children of Ammon answered unto the messengers
of Jephthah, Because Israel took away my land, when they came up out of
Egypt, from Arnon even unto Jabbok, and unto Jordan: now therefore
restore those lands again peaceably.

11:14 And Jephthah sent messengers again unto the KING[JESUS] of the children
of Ammon:

11:15 And said unto HIM[JESUS], Thus says Jephthah, Israel took not away the
land of Moab, nor the land of the children of Ammon:

11:16 But when Israel came up from Egypt, and walked through the
wilderness unto the Red sea, and came to Kadesh;

11:17 Then Israel sent messengers unto the KING[JESUS] of Edom, saying, Let me,
I pray you, pass through your land: but the KING[JESUS] of Edom would not
hearken thereto. And in like manner they sent unto the KING[JESUS] of Moab: but
HE[JESUS] would not consent: and Israel abode in Kadesh.

11:18 Then they went along through the wilderness, and compassed the
land of Edom, and the land of Moab, and came by the east side of the
land of Moab, and pitched on the other side of Arnon, but came not
within the border of Moab: for Arnon was the border of Moab.

11:19 And Israel sent messengers unto Sihon KING[JESUS] of the Amorites, the
KING[JESUS] of Heshbon; and Israel said unto HIM[JESUS], Let us pass, we pray you,
through your land into my place.

11:20 But Sihon trusted not Israel to pass through HIS[JESUS] coast: but Sihon
gathered all HIS[JESUS] people together, and pitched in Jahaz, and fought
against Israel.

11:21 And the LORD[JESUS] GOD[JESUS] of Israel delivered Sihon and all HIS[JESUS] people into
the hand of Israel, and they smote them: so Israel possessed all the
land of the Amorites, the inhabitants of that country.

11:22 And they possessed all the coasts of the Amorites, from Arnon even
unto Jabbok, and from the wilderness even unto Jordan.

11:23 So now the LORD[JESUS] GOD[JESUS] of Israel has dispossessed the Amorites from
before HIS[JESUS] people Israel, and shouldest you possess it?

11:24 Wilt not you possess that which Chemosh your GOD[JESUS] giveth you to
possess? So whomsoever the LORD[JESUS] our GOD[JESUS] shall drive out from before us,
them will we possess.

11:25 And now art you any thing better than Balak the SON[JESUS] of Zippor,
KING[JESUS] of Moab? did HE[JESUS] ever strive against Israel, or did HE[JESUS] ever fight
against them,

11:26 While Israel dwelt in Heshbon and her towns, and in Aroer and her
towns, and in all the cities that be along by the coasts of Arnon, three
hundred years? why therefore did you not recover them within that time?

11:27 Wherefore I have not sinned against you, but you doest me wrong
to war against me: the LORD[JESUS] the Judge be judge this day between the
children of Israel and the children of Ammon.

11:28 Howbeit the KING[JESUS] of the children of Ammon hearkened not unto the
words of Jephthah which HE[JESUS] sent HIM[JESUS].

11:29 Then the Spirit of the LORD[JESUS] came upon Jephthah, and HE[JESUS] passed over
Gilead, and Manasseh, and passed over Mizpeh of Gilead, and from Mizpeh
of Gilead HE[JESUS] passed over unto the children of Ammon.

11:30 And Jephthah vowed a vow unto the LORD[JESUS], and said, If you shalt
without fail deliver the children of Ammon into mine hands,

11:31 Then it shall be, that whatsoever comes forth of the doors of my
house to meet me, when I return in peace from the children of Ammon,
shall surely be the LORD[JESUS]'s, and I will offer it up for a burnt offering.

11:32 So Jephthah passed over unto the children of Ammon to fight
against them; and the LORD[JESUS] delivered them into HIS[JESUS] hands.

11:33 And HE[JESUS] smote them from Aroer, even till you come to Minnith, even
twenty cities, and unto the plain of the vineyards, with a very great
slaughter. Thus the children of Ammon were subdued before the children
of Israel.

11:34 And Jephthah came to Mizpeh unto HIS[JESUS] house, and, behold, HIS[JESUS]
daughter came out to meet HIM[JESUS] with timbrels and with dances: and she was
HIS[JESUS] only child; beside her HE[JESUS] had neither SON[JESUS] nor daughter.

11:35 And it came to pass, when HE[JESUS] saw her, that HE[JESUS] rent HIS[JESUS] clothes,
and said, Alas, my daughter! you hast brought me very low, and you art
one of them that trouble me: for I have opened my mouth unto the LORD[JESUS],
and I cannot go back.

11:36 And she said unto HIM[JESUS], My father, if you hast opened your mouth
unto the LORD[JESUS], do to me according to that which has proceeded out of
your mouth; forasmuch as the LORD[JESUS] has taken vengeance for you of yours
enemies, even of the children of Ammon.

11:37 And she said unto her father, Let this thing be done for me: let
me alone two months, that I may go up and down upon the mountains, and
bewail my virginity, I and my fellows.

11:38 And HE[JESUS] said, Go. And HE[JESUS] sent her away for two months: and she went
with her companions, and bewailed her virginity upon the mountains.

11:39 And it came to pass at the end of two months, that she returned
unto her father, who did with her according to HIS[JESUS] vow which HE[JESUS] had
vowed: and she knew no man. And it was a custom in Israel,

11:40 That the daughters of Israel went yearly to lament the daughter of
Jephthah the Gileadite four days in a year.


12:1 And the men of Ephraim gathered themselves together, and went
northward, and said unto Jephthah, Wherefore passedst you over to fight
against the children of Ammon, and didst not call us to go with you? we
will burn yours house upon you with fire.

12:2 And Jephthah said unto them, I and my people were at great strife
with the children of Ammon; and when I called you, you delivered me not
out of their hands.

12:3 And when I saw that you delivered me not, I put my life in my hands,
and passed over against the children of Ammon, and the LORD[JESUS] delivered
them into my hand: wherefore then are you come up unto me this day, to
fight against me?

12:4 Then Jephthah gathered together all the men of Gilead, and fought
with Ephraim: and the men of Gilead smote Ephraim, because they said, you
Gileadites are fugitives of Ephraim among the Ephraimites, and among the
Manassites.

12:5 And the Gileadites took the passages of Jordan before the
Ephraimites: and it was so, that when those Ephraimites which were
escaped said, Let me go over; that the men of Gilead said unto HIM[JESUS], Art
you an Ephraimite? If HE[JESUS] said, Nay;

12:6 Then said they unto HIM[JESUS], Say now Shibboleth: and HE[JESUS] said Sibboleth:
for HE[JESUS] could not frame to pronounce it right. Then they took HIM[JESUS], and
slew HIM[JESUS] at the passages of Jordan: and there fell at that time of the
Ephraimites forty and two thousand.

12:7 And Jephthah judged Israel six years. Then died Jephthah the
Gileadite, and was buried in one of the cities of Gilead.

12:8 And after HIM[JESUS] Ibzan of Bethlehem judged Israel.

12:9 And HE[JESUS] had thirty sons, and thirty daughters, whom HE[JESUS] sent abroad,
and took in thirty daughters from abroad for HIS[JESUS] sons. And HE[JESUS] judged
Israel seven years.

12:10 Then died Ibzan, and was buried at Bethlehem.

12:11 And after HIM[JESUS] Elon, a Zebulonite, judged Israel; and HE[JESUS] judged
Israel ten years.

12:12 And Elon the Zebulonite died, and was buried in Aijalon in the
country of Zebulun.

12:13 And after HIM[JESUS] Abdon the SON[JESUS] of Hillel, a Pirathonite, judged
Israel.

12:14 And HE[JESUS] had forty sons and thirty nephews, that rode on threescore
and ten ass colts: and HE[JESUS] judged Israel eight years.

12:15 And Abdon the SON[JESUS] of Hillel the Pirathonite died, and was buried
in Pirathon in the land of Ephraim, in the mount of the Amalekites.


13:1 And the children of Israel did evil again in the sight of the LORD[JESUS];
and the LORD[JESUS] delivered them into the hand of the Philistines forty
years.

13:2 And there was a certain man of Zorah, of the family of the Danites,
whose name was Manoah; and HIS[JESUS] wife was barren, and bare not.

13:3 And the angel of the LORD[JESUS] appeared unto the woman, and said unto
her, Behold now, you art barren, and bearest not: but you shalt
conceive, and bear a SON[JESUS].

13:4 Now therefore beware, I pray you, and drink not wine nor strong
drink, and eat not any unclean thing:

13:5 For, lo, you shalt conceive, and bear a SON[JESUS]; and no razor shall
come on HIS[JESUS] head: for the child shall be a Nazarite unto GOD[JESUS] from the
womb: and HE[JESUS] shall begin to deliver Israel out of the hand of the
Philistines.

13:6 Then the woman came and told her husband, saying, A man of GOD[JESUS] came
unto me, and HIS[JESUS] countenance was like the countenance of an angel of
GOD[JESUS], very terrible: but I asked HIM[JESUS] not whence HE[JESUS] was, neither told HE[JESUS]
me HIS[JESUS] name:

13:7 But HE[JESUS] said unto me, Behold, you shalt conceive, and bear a SON[JESUS];
and now drink no wine nor strong drink, neither eat any unclean thing:
for the child shall be a Nazarite to GOD[JESUS] from the womb to the day of HIS[JESUS]
death.

13:8 Then Manoah intreated the LORD[JESUS], and said, O my LORD[JESUS], let the man of
GOD[JESUS] which you didst send come again unto us, and teach us what we shall
do unto the child that shall be born.

13:9 And GOD[JESUS] hearkened to the voice of Manoah; and the angel of GOD[JESUS] came
again unto the woman as she sat in the field: but Manoah her husband was
not with her.

13:10 And the woman made haste, and ran, and shewed her husband, and
said unto HIM[JESUS], Behold, the man has appeared unto me, that came unto me
the other day.

13:11 And Manoah arose, and went after HIS[JESUS] wife, and came to the man,
and said unto HIM[JESUS], Art you the man that spakest unto the woman? And HE[JESUS]
said, I am.

13:12 And Manoah said, Now let your words come to pass. How shall we
order the child, and how shall we do unto HIM[JESUS]?

13:13 And the angel of the LORD[JESUS] said unto Manoah, Of all that I said
unto the woman let her beware.

13:14 She may not eat of any thing that comes of the vine, neither let
her drink wine or strong drink, nor eat any unclean thing: all that I
commanded her let her observe.

13:15 And Manoah said unto the angel of the LORD[JESUS], I pray you, let us
detain you, until we shall have made ready a kid for you.

13:16 And the angel of the LORD[JESUS] said unto Manoah, Though you detain me,
I will not eat of your bread: and if you wilt offer a burnt offering,
you must offer it unto the LORD[JESUS]. For Manoah knew not that HE[JESUS] was an
angel of the LORD[JESUS].

13:17 And Manoah said unto the angel of the LORD[JESUS], What is your name, that
when your sayings come to pass we may do you honour?

13:18 And the angel of the LORD[JESUS] said unto HIM[JESUS], Why askest you thus
after my name, seeing it is secret?

13:19 So Manoah took a kid with a meat offering, and offered it upon a
rock unto the LORD[JESUS]: and the angel did wonderously; and Manoah and HIS[JESUS]
wife looked on.

13:20 For it came to pass, when the flame went up toward heaven from off
the altar, that the angel of the LORD[JESUS] ascended in the flame of the
altar. And Manoah and HIS[JESUS] wife looked on it, and fell on their faces to
the ground.

13:21 But the angel of the LORD[JESUS] did no more appear to Manoah and to HIS[JESUS]
wife. Then Manoah knew that HE[JESUS] was an angel of the LORD[JESUS].

13:22 And Manoah said unto HIS[JESUS] wife, We shall surely die, because we
have seen GOD[JESUS].

13:23 But HIS[JESUS] wife said unto HIM[JESUS], If the LORD[JESUS] were pleased to kill us,
HE[JESUS] would not have received a burnt offering and a meat offering at our
hands, neither would HE[JESUS] have shewed us all these things, nor would as at
this time have told us such things as these.

13:24 And the woman bare a SON[JESUS], and called HIS[JESUS] name Samson: and the
child grew, and the LORD[JESUS] blessed HIM[JESUS].

13:25 And the Spirit of the LORD[JESUS] began to move HIM[JESUS] at times in the camp
of Dan between Zorah and Eshtaol.


14:1 And Samson went down to Timnath, and saw a woman in Timnath of the
daughters of the Philistines.

14:2 And HE[JESUS] came up, and told HIS[JESUS] father and HIS[JESUS] mother, and said, I
have seen a woman in Timnath of the daughters of the Philistines: now
therefore get her for me to wife.

14:3 Then HIS[JESUS] father and HIS[JESUS] mother said unto HIM[JESUS], Is there never a
woman among the daughters of your brethren, or among all my people, that
you goest to take a wife of the uncircumcised Philistines? And Samson
said unto HIS[JESUS] father, Get her for me; for she pleaseth me well.

14:4 But HIS[JESUS] father and HIS[JESUS] mother knew not that it was of the LORD[JESUS],
that HE[JESUS] sought an occasion against the Philistines: for at that time the
Philistines had dominion over Israel.

14:5 Then went Samson down, and HIS[JESUS] father and HIS[JESUS] mother, to Timnath,
and came to the vineyards of Timnath: and, behold, a young lion roared
against HIM[JESUS].

14:6 And the Spirit of the LORD[JESUS] came mightily upon HIM[JESUS], and HE[JESUS] rent HIM[JESUS]
as HE[JESUS] would have rent a kid, and HE[JESUS] had nothing in HIS[JESUS] hand: but HE[JESUS] told
not HIS[JESUS] father or HIS[JESUS] mother what HE[JESUS] had done.

14:7 And HE[JESUS] went down, and talked with the woman; and she pleased Samson
well.

14:8 And after a time HE[JESUS] returned to take her, and HE[JESUS] turned aside to
see the carcase of the lion: and, behold, there was a swarm of bees and
honey in the carcase of the lion.

14:9 And HE[JESUS] took thereof in HIS[JESUS] hands, and went on eating, and came to
HIS[JESUS] father and mother, and HE[JESUS] gave them, and they did eat: but HE[JESUS] told
not them that HE[JESUS] had taken the honey out of the carcase of the lion.

14:10 So HIS[JESUS] father went down unto the woman: and Samson made there a
feast; for so used the young men to do.

14:11 And it came to pass, when they saw HIM[JESUS], that they brought thirty
companions to be with HIM[JESUS].

14:12 And Samson said unto them, I will now put forth a riddle unto you:
if you can certainly declare it me within the seven days of the feast,
and find it out, then I will give you thirty sheets and thirty change of
garments:

14:13 But if you cannot declare it me, then shall you give me thirty
sheets and thirty change of garments. And they said unto HIM[JESUS], Put forth
your riddle, that we may hear it.

14:14 And HE[JESUS] said unto them, Out of the eater came forth meat, and out
of the strong came forth sweetness. And they could not in three days
expound the riddle.

14:15 And it came to pass on the seventh day, that they said unto
Samson's wife, Entice your husband, that HE[JESUS] may declare unto us the
riddle, lest we burn you and your father's house with fire: have you
called us to take that we have? is it not so?

14:16 And Samson's wife wept before HIM[JESUS], and said, you dost but hate
me, and lovest me not: you hast put forth a riddle unto the children of
my people, and hast not told it me. And HE[JESUS] said unto her, Behold, I have
not told it my father nor my mother, and shall I tell it you?

14:17 And she wept before HIM[JESUS] the seven days, while their feast lasted:
and it came to pass on the seventh day, that HE[JESUS] told her, because she
lay sore upon HIM[JESUS]: and she told the riddle to the children of her
people.

14:18 And the men of the city said unto HIM[JESUS] on the seventh day before
the sun went down, What is sweeter than honey? And what is stronger than
a lion? and HE[JESUS] said unto them, If you had not plowed with my heifer, you
had not found out my riddle.

14:19 And the Spirit of the LORD[JESUS] came upon HIM[JESUS], and HE[JESUS] went down to
Ashkelon, and slew thirty men of them, and took their spoil, and gave
change of garments unto them which expounded the riddle. And HIS[JESUS] anger
was kindled, and HE[JESUS] went up to HIS[JESUS] father's house.

14:20 But Samson's wife was given to HIS[JESUS] companion, whom HE[JESUS] had used as
HIS[JESUS] friend.


15:1 But it came to pass within a while after, in the time of wheat
harvest, that Samson visited HIS[JESUS] wife with a kid; and HE[JESUS] said, I will go
in to my wife into the chamber. But her father would not let HIM[JESUS] to
go in.

15:2 And her father said, I truly thought that you hadst utterly hated
her; therefore I gave her to your companion: is not her younger sister
fairer than she? take her, I pray you, instead of her.

15:3 And Samson said concerning them, Now shall I be more blameless than
the Philistines, though I do them a displeasure.

15:4 And Samson went and caught three hundred foxes, and took
firebrands, and turned tail to tail, and put a firebrand in the midst
between two tails.

15:5 And when HE[JESUS] had set the brands on fire, HE[JESUS] let them go into the
standing corn of the Philistines, and burnt up both the shocks, and also
the standing corn, with the vineyards and olives.

15:6 Then the Philistines said, Who has done this? And they answered,
Samson, the SON[JESUS] in law of the Timnite, because HE[JESUS] had taken HIS[JESUS] wife,
and given her to HIS[JESUS] companion. And the Philistines came up, and burnt
her and her father with fire.

15:7 And Samson said unto them, Though you have done this, yet will I be
avenged of you, and after that I will cease.

15:8 And HE[JESUS] smote them hip and thigh with a great slaughter: and HE[JESUS] went
down and dwelt in the top of the rock Etam.

15:9 Then the Philistines went up, and pitched in Judah, and spread
themselves in Lehi.

15:10 And the men of Judah said, Why are you come up against us? And they
answered, To bind Samson are we come up, to do to HIM[JESUS] as HE[JESUS] has done to
us.

15:11 Then three thousand men of Judah went to the top of the rock Etam,
and said to Samson, Knowest you not that the Philistines are rulers
over us? what is this that you hast done unto us? And HE[JESUS] said unto
them, As they did unto me, so have I done unto them.

15:12 And they said unto HIM[JESUS], We are come down to bind you, that we may
deliver you into the hand of the Philistines. And Samson said unto
them, Swear unto me, that you will not fall upon me yourselves.

15:13 And they spake unto HIM[JESUS], saying, No; but we will bind you fast,
and deliver you into their hand: but surely we will not kill you. And
they bound HIM[JESUS] with two new cords, and brought HIM[JESUS] up from the rock.

15:14 And when HE[JESUS] came unto Lehi, the Philistines shouted against HIM[JESUS]:
and the Spirit of the LORD[JESUS] came mightily upon HIM[JESUS], and the cords that
were upon HIS[JESUS] arms became as flax that was burnt with fire, and HIS[JESUS]
bands loosed from off HIS[JESUS] hands.

15:15 And HE[JESUS] found a new jawbone of an ass, and put forth HIS[JESUS] hand, and
took it, and slew a thousand men therewith.

15:16 And Samson said, With the jawbone of an ass, heaps upon heaps,
with the jaw of an ass have I slain a thousand men.

15:17 And it came to pass, when HE[JESUS] had made an end of speaking, that HE[JESUS]
cast away the jawbone out of HIS[JESUS] hand, and called that place Ramathlehi.

15:18 And HE[JESUS] was sore athirst, and called on the LORD[JESUS], and said, you
hast given this great deliverance into the hand of your SERVANT[JESUS]: and now
shall I die for thirst, and fall into the hand of the uncircumcised?

15:19 But GOD[JESUS] clave an hollow place that was in the jaw, and there came
water thereout; and when HE[JESUS] had drunk, HIS[JESUS] spirit came again, and HE[JESUS]
revived: wherefore HE[JESUS] called the name thereof Enhakkore, which is in
Lehi unto this day.

15:20 And HE[JESUS] judged Israel in the days of the Philistines twenty years.


16:1 Then went Samson to Gaza, and saw there an harlot, and went in unto
her.

16:2 And it was told the Gazites, saying, Samson is come hither. And
they compassed HIM[JESUS] in, and laid wait for HIM[JESUS] all night in the gate of
the city, and were quiet all the night, saying, In the morning, when it
is day, we shall kill HIM[JESUS].

16:3 And Samson lay till midnight, and arose at midnight, and took the
doors of the gate of the city, and the two posts, and went away with
them, bar and all, and put them upon HIS[JESUS] shoulders, and carried them up
to the top of an hill that is before Hebron.

16:4 And it came to pass afterward, that HE[JESUS] loved a woman in the valley
of Sorek, whose name was Delilah.

16:5 And the lords of the Philistines came up unto her, and said unto
her, Entice HIM[JESUS], and see wherein HIS[JESUS] great strength lieth, and by what
means we may prevail against HIM[JESUS], that we may bind HIM[JESUS] to afflict HIM[JESUS];
and we will give you every one of us eleven hundred pieces of silver.

16:6 And Delilah said to Samson, Tell me, I pray you, wherein your great
strength lieth, and wherewith you mightest be bound to afflict you.

16:7 And Samson said unto her, If they bind me with seven green withs
that were never dried, then shall I be weak, and be as another man.

16:8 Then the lords of the Philistines brought up to her seven green
withs which had not been dried, and she bound HIM[JESUS] with them.

16:9 Now there were men lying in wait, abiding with her in the chamber.
And she said unto HIM[JESUS], The Philistines be upon you, Samson. And HE[JESUS]
brake the withs, as a thread of tow is broken when it toucheth the fire.
So HIS[JESUS] strength was not known.

16:10 And Delilah said unto Samson, Behold, you hast mocked me, and
told me lies: now tell me, I pray you, wherewith you mightest be
bound.

16:11 And HE[JESUS] said unto her, If they bind me fast with new ropes that
never were occupied, then shall I be weak, and be as another man.

16:12 Delilah therefore took new ropes, and bound HIM[JESUS] therewith, and
said unto HIM[JESUS], The Philistines be upon you, Samson. And there were
liers in wait abiding in the chamber. And HE[JESUS] brake them from off HIS[JESUS]
arms like a thread.

16:13 And Delilah said unto Samson, Hitherto you hast mocked me, and
told me lies: tell me wherewith you mightest be bound. And HE[JESUS] said unto
her, If you weavest the seven locks of my head with the web.

16:14 And she fastened it with the pin, and said unto HIM[JESUS], The
Philistines be upon you, Samson. And HE[JESUS] awaked out of HIS[JESUS] sleep, and
went away with the pin of the beam, and with the web.

16:15 And she said unto HIM[JESUS], How canst you say, I love you, when yours
heart is not with me? you hast mocked me these three times, and hast
not told me wherein your great strength lieth.

16:16 And it came to pass, when she pressed HIM[JESUS] daily with her words,
and urged HIM[JESUS], so that HIS[JESUS] soul was vexed unto death;

16:17 That HE[JESUS] told her all HIS[JESUS] heart, and said unto her, There has not
come a razor upon mine head; for I have been a Nazarite unto GOD[JESUS] from my
mother's womb: if I be shaven, then my strength will go from me, and I
shall become weak, and be like any other man.

16:18 And when Delilah saw that HE[JESUS] had told her all HIS[JESUS] heart, she sent
and called for the lords of the Philistines, saying, Come up this once,
for HE[JESUS] has shewed me all HIS[JESUS] heart. Then the lords of the Philistines
came up unto her, and brought money in their hand.

16:19 And she made HIM[JESUS] sleep upon her knees; and she called for a man,
and she caused HIM[JESUS] to shave off the seven locks of HIS[JESUS] head; and she
began to afflict HIM[JESUS], and HIS[JESUS] strength went from HIM[JESUS].

16:20 And she said, The Philistines be upon you, Samson. And HE[JESUS] awoke
out of HIS[JESUS] sleep, and said, I will go out as at other times before, and
shake myself. And HE[JESUS] wist not that the LORD[JESUS] was departed from HIM[JESUS].

16:21 But the Philistines took HIM[JESUS], and put out HIS[JESUS] eyes, and brought
HIM[JESUS] down to Gaza, and bound HIM[JESUS] with fetters of brass; and HE[JESUS] did grind
in the prison house.

16:22 Howbeit the hair of HIS[JESUS] head began to grow again after HE[JESUS] was
shaven.

16:23 Then the lords of the Philistines gathered them together for to
offer a great sacrifice unto Dagon their GOD[JESUS], and to rejoice: for they
said, Our GOD[JESUS] has delivered Samson our enemy into our hand.

16:24 And when the people saw HIM[JESUS], they praised their GOD[JESUS]: for they
said, Our GOD[JESUS] has delivered into our hands our enemy, and the destroyer
of our country, which slew many of us.

16:25 And it came to pass, when their hearts were merry, that they said,
Call for Samson, that HE[JESUS] may make us sport. And they called for Samson
out of the prison house; and HE[JESUS] made them sport: and they set HIM[JESUS]
between the pillars.

16:26 And Samson said unto the lad that held HIM[JESUS] by the hand, let me
that I may feel the pillars whereupon the house standeth, that I may
lean upon them.

16:27 Now the house was full of men and women; and all the lords of the
Philistines were there; and there were upon the roof about three
thousand men and women, that beheld while Samson made sport.

16:28 And Samson called unto the LORD[JESUS], and said, O LORD[JESUS] GOD[JESUS], remember
me, I pray you, and strengthen me, I pray you, only this once, O GOD[JESUS],
that I may be at once avenged of the Philistines for my two eyes.

16:29 And Samson took hold of the two middle pillars upon which the
house stood, and on which it was borne up, of the one with HIS[JESUS] right
hand, and of the other with HIS[JESUS] left.

16:30 And Samson said, Let me die with the Philistines. And HE[JESUS] bowed
himself with all HIS[JESUS] might; and the house fell upon the lords, and upon
all the people that were therein. So the dead which HE[JESUS] slew at HIS[JESUS] death
were more than they which HE[JESUS] slew in HIS[JESUS] life.

16:31 Then HIS[JESUS] brethren and all the house of HIS[JESUS] father came down, and
took HIM[JESUS], and brought HIM[JESUS] up, and buried HIM[JESUS] between Zorah and Eshtaol
in the buryingplace of Manoah HIS[JESUS] father. And HE[JESUS] judged Israel twenty
years.


17:1 And there was a man of mount Ephraim, whose name was Micah.

17:2 And HE[JESUS] said unto HIS[JESUS] mother, The eleven hundred shekels of silver
that were taken from you, about which you cursedst, and spakest of
also in mine ears, behold, the silver is with me; I took it. And HIS[JESUS]
mother said, Blessed be you of the LORD[JESUS], my SON[JESUS].

17:3 And when HE[JESUS] had restored the eleven hundred shekels of silver to
HIS[JESUS] mother, HIS[JESUS] mother said, I had wholly dedicated the silver unto the
LORD[JESUS] from my hand for my SON[JESUS], to make a graven image and a molten image:
now therefore I will restore it unto you.

17:4 Yet HE[JESUS] restored the money unto HIS[JESUS] mother; and HIS[JESUS] mother took two
hundred shekels of silver, and gave them to the founder, who made
thereof a graven image and a molten image: and they were in the house of
Micah.

17:5 And the man Micah had an house of gods, and made an ephod, and
teraphim, and consecrated one of HIS[JESUS] sons, who became HIS[JESUS] priest.

17:6 In those days there was no KING[JESUS] in Israel, but every man did that
which was right in HIS[JESUS] own eyes.

17:7 And there was a young man out of Bethlehemjudah of the family of
Judah, who was a Levite, and HE[JESUS] sojourned there.

17:8 And the man departed out of the city from Bethlehemjudah to sojourn
where HE[JESUS] could find a place: and HE[JESUS] came to mount Ephraim to the house
of Micah, as HE[JESUS] journeyed.

17:9 And Micah said unto HIM[JESUS], Whence comest you? And HE[JESUS] said unto HIM[JESUS],
I am a Levite of Bethlehemjudah, and I go to sojourn where I may find a
place.

17:10 And Micah said unto HIM[JESUS], Dwell with me, and be unto me a father
and a priest, and I will give you ten shekels of silver by the year,
and a suit of apparel, and your victuals. So the Levite went in.

17:11 And the Levite was content to dwell with the man; and the young
man was unto HIM[JESUS] as one of HIS[JESUS] sons.

17:12 And Micah consecrated the Levite; and the young man became HIS[JESUS]
priest, and was in the house of Micah.

17:13 Then said Micah, Now know I that the LORD[JESUS] will do me good, seeing
I have a Levite to my priest.


18:1 In those days there was no KING[JESUS] in Israel: and in those days the
tribe of the Danites sought them an inheritance to dwell in; for unto
that day all their inheritance had not fallen unto them among the tribes
of Israel.

18:2 And the children of Dan sent of their family five men from their
coasts, men of valour, from Zorah, and from Eshtaol, to spy out the
land, and to search it; and they said unto them, Go, search the land:
who when they came to mount Ephraim, to the house of Micah, they lodged
there.

18:3 When they were by the house of Micah, they knew the voice of the
young man the Levite: and they turned in thither, and said unto HIM[JESUS], Who
brought you hither? and what makest you in this place? and what hast
you here?

18:4 And HE[JESUS] said unto them, Thus and thus dealeth Micah with me, and
has hired me, and I am HIS[JESUS] priest.

18:5 And they said unto HIM[JESUS], Ask counsel, we pray you, of GOD[JESUS], that we
may know whether our way which we go shall be prosperous.

18:6 And the priest said unto them, Go in peace: before the LORD[JESUS] is your
way wherein you go.

18:7 Then the five men departed, and came to Laish, and saw the people
that were therein, how they dwelt careless, after the manner of the
Zidonians, quiet and secure; and there was no magistrate in the land,
that might put them to shame in any thing; and they were far from the
Zidonians, and had no business with any man.

18:8 And they came unto their brethren to Zorah and Eshtaol: and their
brethren said unto them, What say you?

18:9 And they said, Arise, that we may go up against them: for we have
seen the land, and, behold, it is very good: and are you still? be not
slothful to go, and to enter to possess the land.

18:10 When you go, you shall come unto a people secure, and to a large
land: for GOD[JESUS] has given it into your hands; a place where there is no
want of any thing that is in the earth.

18:11 And there went from thence of the family of the Danites, out of
Zorah and out of Eshtaol, six hundred men appointed with weapons of war.

18:12 And they went up, and pitched in Kirjathjearim, in Judah:
wherefore they called that place Mahanehdan unto this day: behold, it is
behind Kirjathjearim.

18:13 And they passed thence unto mount Ephraim, and came unto the house
of Micah.

18:14 Then answered the five men that went to spy out the country of
Laish, and said unto their brethren, Do you know that there is in these
houses an ephod, and teraphim, and a graven image, and a molten image?
now therefore consider what you have to do.

18:15 And they turned thitherward, and came to the house of the young
man the Levite, even unto the house of Micah, and saluted HIM[JESUS].

18:16 And the six hundred men appointed with their weapons of war, which
were of the children of Dan, stood by the entering of the gate.

18:17 And the five men that went to spy out the land went up, and came
in thither, and took the graven image, and the ephod, and the teraphim,
and the molten image: and the priest stood in the entering of the gate
with the six hundred men that were appointed with weapons of war.

18:18 And these went into Micah's house, and fetched the carved image,
the ephod, and the teraphim, and the molten image. Then said the priest
unto them, What do you?

18:19 And they said unto HIM[JESUS], Hold your peace, lay yours hand upon your
mouth, and go with us, and be to us a father and a priest: is it better
for you to be a priest unto the house of one man, or that you be a
priest unto a tribe and a family in Israel?

18:20 And the priest's heart was glad, and HE[JESUS] took the ephod, and the
teraphim, and the graven image, and went in the midst of the people.

18:21 So they turned and departed, and put the little ones and the
cattle and the carriage before them.

18:22 And when they were a good way from the house of Micah, the men
that were in the houses near to Micah's house were gathered together,
and overtook the children of Dan.

18:23 And they cried unto the children of Dan. And they turned their
faces, and said unto Micah, What aileth you, that you comest with such
a company?

18:24 And HE[JESUS] said, you have taken away my gods which I made, and the
priest, and you are gone away: and what have I more? and what is this
that you say unto me, What aileth you?

18:25 And the children of Dan said unto HIM[JESUS], Let not your voice be heard
among us, lest angry fellows run upon you, and you lose your life, with
the lives of your household.

18:26 And the children of Dan went their way: and when Micah saw that
they were too strong for HIM[JESUS], HE[JESUS] turned and went back unto HIS[JESUS] house.

18:27 And they took the things which Micah had made, and the priest
which HE[JESUS] had, and came unto Laish, unto a people that were at quiet and
secure: and they smote them with the edge of the sword, and burnt the
city with fire.

18:28 And there was no deliverer, because it was far from Zidon, and
they had no business with any man; and it was in the valley that lieth
by Bethrehob. And they built a city, and dwelt therein.

18:29 And they called the name of the city Dan, after the name of Dan
their father, who was born unto Israel: howbeit the name of the city was
Laish at the first.

18:30 And the children of Dan set up the graven image: and Jonathan, the
SON[JESUS] of Gershom, the SON[JESUS] of Manasseh, HE[JESUS] and HIS[JESUS] sons were priests to the
tribe of Dan until the day of the captivity of the land.

18:31 And they set them up Micah's graven image, which HE[JESUS] made, all the
time that the house of GOD[JESUS] was in SHILOH[JESUS].


19:1 And it came to pass in those days, when there was no KING[JESUS] in
Israel, that there was a certain Levite sojourning on the side of mount
Ephraim, who took to HIM[JESUS] a concubine out of Bethlehemjudah.

19:2 And HIS[JESUS] concubine played the whore against HIM[JESUS], and went away from
HIM[JESUS] unto her father's house to Bethlehemjudah, and was there four whole
months.

19:3 And her husband arose, and went after her, to speak friendly unto
her, and to bring her again, having HIS[JESUS] SERVANT[JESUS] with HIM[JESUS], and a couple
of asses: and she brought HIM[JESUS] into her father's house: and when the
father of the damsel saw HIM[JESUS], HE[JESUS] rejoiced to meet HIM[JESUS].

19:4 And HIS[JESUS] father in law, the damsel's father, retained HIM[JESUS]; and HE[JESUS]
abode with HIM[JESUS] three days: so they did eat and drink, and lodged there.

19:5 And it came to pass on the fourth day, when they arose early in the
morning, that HE[JESUS] rose up to depart: and the damsel's father said unto
HIS[JESUS] SON[JESUS] in law, Comfort yours heart with a morsel of bread, and
afterward go your way.

19:6 And they sat down, and did eat and drink both of them together: for
the damsel's father had said unto the man, Be content, I pray you, and
tarry all night, and let yours heart be merry.

19:7 And when the man rose up to depart, HIS[JESUS] father in law urged HIM[JESUS]:
therefore HE[JESUS] lodged there again.

19:8 And HE[JESUS] arose early in the morning on the fifth day to depart; and
the damsel's father said, Comfort yours heart, I pray you. And they
tarried until afternoon, and they did eat both of them.

19:9 And when the man rose up to depart, HE[JESUS], and HIS[JESUS] concubine, and HIS[JESUS]
SERVANT[JESUS], HIS[JESUS] father in law, the damsel's father, said unto HIM[JESUS], Behold,
now the day draweth toward evening, I pray you tarry all night: behold,
the day groweth to an end, lodge here, that yours heart may be merry;
and to morrow get you early on your way, that you mayest go home.

19:10 But the man would not tarry that night, but HE[JESUS] rose up and
departed, and came over against Jebus, which is Jerusalem; and there
were with HIM[JESUS] two asses saddled, HIS[JESUS] concubine also was with HIM[JESUS].

19:11 And when they were by Jebus, the day was far spent; and the
SERVANT[JESUS] said unto HIS[JESUS] master, Come, I pray you, and let us turn in into
this city of the Jebusites, and lodge in it.

19:12 And HIS[JESUS] master said unto HIM[JESUS], We will not turn aside hither into
the city of a stranger, that is not of the children of Israel; we will
pass over to Gibeah.

19:13 And HE[JESUS] said unto HIS[JESUS] SERVANT[JESUS], Come, and let us draw near to one of
these places to lodge all night, in Gibeah, or in Ramah.

19:14 And they passed on and went their way; and the sun went down upon
them when they were by Gibeah, which belongeth to Benjamin.

19:15 And they turned aside thither, to go in and to lodge in Gibeah:
and when HE[JESUS] went in, HE[JESUS] sat HIM[JESUS] down in a street of the city: for there
was no man that took them into HIS[JESUS] house to lodging.

19:16 And, behold, there came an old man from HIS[JESUS] work out of the field
at even, which was also of mount Ephraim; and HE[JESUS] sojourned in Gibeah:
but the men of the place were Benjamites.

19:17 And when HE[JESUS] had lifted up HIS[JESUS] eyes, HE[JESUS] saw a wayfaring man in the
street of the city: and the old man said, Whither goest you? and whence
comest you?

19:18 And HE[JESUS] said unto HIM[JESUS], We are passing from Bethlehemjudah toward
the side of mount Ephraim; from thence am I: and I went to
Bethlehemjudah, but I am now going to the house of the LORD[JESUS]; and there
is no man that receiveth me to house.

19:19 Yet there is both straw and provender for our asses; and there is
bread and wine also for me, and for your handmaid, and for the young man
which is with your servants: there is no want of any thing.

19:20 And the old man said, Peace be with you; howsoever let all your
wants lie upon me; only lodge not in the street.

19:21 So HE[JESUS] brought HIM[JESUS] into HIS[JESUS] house, and gave provender unto the
asses: and they washed their feet, and did eat and drink.

19:22 Now as they were making their hearts merry, behold, the men of the
city, certain sons of Belial, beset the house round about, and beat at
the door, and spake to the master of the house, the old man, saying,
Bring forth the man that came into yours house, that we may know HIM[JESUS].

19:23 And the man, the master of the house, went out unto them, and said
unto them, Nay, my brethren, nay, I pray you, do not so wickedly; seeing
that this man is come into mine house, do not this folly.

19:24 Behold, here is my daughter a maiden, and HIS[JESUS] concubine; them I
will bring out now, and humble you them, and do with them what seemeth
good unto you: but unto this man do not so vile a thing.

19:25 But the men would not hearken to HIM[JESUS]: so the man took HIS[JESUS]
concubine, and brought her forth unto them; and they knew her, and
abused her all the night until the morning: and when the day began to
spring, they let her go.

19:26 Then came the woman in the dawning of the day, and fell down at
the door of the man's house where her LORD[JESUS] was, till it was light.

19:27 And her LORD[JESUS] rose up in the morning, and opened the doors of the
house, and went out to go HIS[JESUS] way: and, behold, the woman HIS[JESUS] concubine
was fallen down at the door of the house, and her hands were upon the
threshold.

19:28 And HE[JESUS] said unto her, Up, and let us be going. But none answered.
Then the man took her up upon an ass, and the man rose up, and gat HIM[JESUS]
unto HIS[JESUS] place.

19:29 And when HE[JESUS] was come into HIS[JESUS] house, HE[JESUS] took a knife, and laid
hold on HIS[JESUS] concubine, and divided her, together with her bones, into
twelve pieces, and sent her into all the coasts of Israel.

19:30 And it was so, that all that saw it said, There was no such deed
done nor seen from the day that the children of Israel came up out of
the land of Egypt unto this day: consider of it, take advice, and speak
your minds.


20:1 Then all the children of Israel went out, and the congregation was
gathered together as one man, from Dan even to Beersheba, with the land
of Gilead, unto the LORD[JESUS] in Mizpeh.

20:2 And the chief of all the people, even of all the tribes of Israel,
presented themselves in the assembly of the people of GOD[JESUS], four hundred
thousand footmen that drew sword.

20:3 (Now the children of Benjamin heard that the children of Israel
were gone up to Mizpeh.) Then said the children of Israel, Tell us, how
was this wickedness?

20:4 And the Levite, the husband of the woman that was slain, answered
and said, I came into Gibeah that belongeth to Benjamin, I and my
concubine, to lodge.

20:5 And the men of Gibeah rose against me, and beset the house round
about upon me by night, and thought to have slain me: and my concubine
have they forced, that she is dead.

20:6 And I took my concubine, and cut her in pieces, and sent her
throughout all the country of the inheritance of Israel: for they have
committed lewdness and folly in Israel.

20:7 Behold, you are all children of Israel; give here your advice and
counsel.

20:8 And all the people arose as one man, saying, We will not any of us
go to HIS[JESUS] tent, neither will we any of us turn into HIS[JESUS] house.

20:9 But now this shall be the thing which we will do to Gibeah; we will
go up by lot against it;

20:10 And we will take ten men of an hundred throughout all the tribes
of Israel, and an hundred of a thousand, and a thousand out of ten
thousand, to fetch victual for the people, that they may do, when they
come to Gibeah of Benjamin, according to all the folly that they have
wrought in Israel.

20:11 So all the men of Israel were gathered against the city, knit
together as one man.

20:12 And the tribes of Israel sent men through all the tribe of
Benjamin, saying, What wickedness is this that is done among you?

20:13 Now therefore deliver us the men, the children of Belial, which
are in Gibeah, that we may put them to death, and put away evil from
Israel. But the children of Benjamin would not hearken to the voice of
their brethren the children of Israel.

20:14 But the children of Benjamin gathered themselves together out of
the cities unto Gibeah, to go out to battle against the children of
Israel.

20:15 And the children of Benjamin were numbered at that time out of the
cities twenty and six thousand men that drew sword, beside the
inhabitants of Gibeah, which were numbered seven hundred chosen men.

20:16 Among all this people there were seven hundred chosen men
lefthanded; every one could sling stones at an hair breadth, and not
miss.

20:17 And the men of Israel, beside Benjamin, were numbered four hundred
thousand men that drew sword: all these were men of war.

20:18 And the children of Israel arose, and went up to the house of GOD[JESUS],
and asked counsel of GOD[JESUS], and said, Which of us shall go up first to the
battle against the children of Benjamin? And the LORD[JESUS] said, Judah shall
go up first.

20:19 And the children of Israel rose up in the morning, and encamped
against Gibeah.

20:20 And the men of Israel went out to battle against Benjamin; and the
men of Israel put themselves in array to fight against them at Gibeah.

20:21 And the children of Benjamin came forth out of Gibeah, and
destroyed down to the ground of the Israelites that day twenty and two
thousand men.

20:22 And the people the men of Israel encouraged themselves, and set
their battle again in array in the place where they put themselves in
array the first day.

20:23 (And the children of Israel went up and wept before the LORD[JESUS] until
even, and asked counsel of the LORD[JESUS], saying, Shall I go up again to
battle against the children of Benjamin my brother? And the LORD[JESUS] said,
Go up against HIM[JESUS].)

20:24 And the children of Israel came near against the children of
Benjamin the second day.

20:25 And Benjamin went forth against them out of Gibeah the second day,
and destroyed down to the ground of the children of Israel again
eighteen thousand men; all these drew the sword.

20:26 Then all the children of Israel, and all the people, went up, and
came unto the house of GOD[JESUS], and wept, and sat there before the LORD[JESUS], and
fasted that day until even, and offered burnt offerings and peace
offerings before the LORD[JESUS].

20:27 And the children of Israel enquired of the LORD[JESUS], (for the ark of
the covenant of GOD[JESUS] was there in those days,

20:28 And Phinehas, the SON[JESUS] of Eleazar, the SON[JESUS] of Aaron, stood before
it in those days,) saying, Shall I yet again go out to battle against
the children of Benjamin my brother, or shall I cease? And the LORD[JESUS]
said, Go up; for to morrow I will deliver them into yours hand.

20:29 And Israel set liers in wait round about Gibeah.

20:30 And the children of Israel went up against the children of
Benjamin on the third day, and put themselves in array against Gibeah,
as at other times.

20:31 And the children of Benjamin went out against the people, and were
drawn away from the city; and they began to smite of the people, and
kill, as at other times, in the highways, of which one goes up to the
house of GOD[JESUS], and the other to Gibeah in the field, about thirty men of
Israel.

20:32 And the children of Benjamin said, They are smitten down before
us, as at the first. But the children of Israel said, Let us flee, and
draw them from the city unto the highways.

20:33 And all the men of Israel rose up out of their place, and put
themselves in array at Baaltamar: and the liers in wait of Israel came
forth out of their places, even out of the meadows of Gibeah.

20:34 And there came against Gibeah ten thousand chosen men out of all
Israel, and the battle was sore: but they knew not that evil was near
them.

20:35 And the LORD[JESUS] smote Benjamin before Israel: and the children of
Israel destroyed of the Benjamites that day twenty and five thousand and
an hundred men: all these drew the sword.

20:36 So the children of Benjamin saw that they were smitten: for the
men of Israel gave place to the Benjamites, because they trusted unto
the liers in wait which they had set beside Gibeah.

20:37 And the liers in wait hasted, and rushed upon Gibeah; and the
liers in wait drew themselves along, and smote all the city with the
edge of the sword.

20:38 Now there was an appointed sign between the men of Israel and the
liers in wait, that they should make a great flame with smoke rise up
out of the city.

20:39 And when the men of Israel retired in the battle, Benjamin began
to smite and kill of the men of Israel about thirty persons: for they
said, Surely they are smitten down before us, as in the first battle.

20:40 But when the flame began to arise up out of the city with a pillar
of smoke, the Benjamites looked behind them, and, behold, the flame of
the city ascended up to heaven.

20:41 And when the men of Israel turned again, the men of Benjamin were
amazed: for they saw that evil was come upon them.

20:42 Therefore they turned their backs before the men of Israel unto
the way of the wilderness; but the battle overtook them; and them which
came out of the cities they destroyed in the midst of them.

20:43 Thus they inclosed the Benjamites round about, and chased them,
and trode them down with ease over against Gibeah toward the sunrising.

20:44 And there fell of Benjamin eighteen thousand men; all these were
men of valour.

20:45 And they turned and fled toward the wilderness unto the rock of
