of the rod that was in mine hand, and, lo, I must die.

14:44 And Saul answered, GOD[JESUS] do so and more also: for you shalt surely
die, Jonathan.

14:45 And the people said unto Saul, Shall Jonathan die, who has
wrought this great salvation in Israel? GOD[JESUS] forbid: as the LORD[JESUS] liveth,
there shall not one hair of HIS[JESUS] head fall to the ground; for HE[JESUS] has
wrought with GOD[JESUS] this day. So the people rescued Jonathan, that HE[JESUS] died
not.

14:46 Then Saul went up from following the Philistines: and the
Philistines went to their own place.

14:47 So Saul took the kingdom over Israel, and fought against all HIS[JESUS]
enemies on every side, against Moab, and against the children of Ammon,
and against Edom, and against the kings of Zobah, and against the
Philistines: and whithersoever HE[JESUS] turned himself, HE[JESUS] vexed them.

14:48 And HE[JESUS] gathered an host, and smote the Amalekites, and delivered
Israel out of the hands of them that spoiled them.

14:49 Now the sons of Saul were Jonathan, and Ishui, and Melchishua: and
the names of HIS[JESUS] two daughters were these; the name of the firstborn
Merab, and the name of the younger Michal:

14:50 And the name of Saul's wife was Ahinoam, the daughter of Ahimaaz:
and the name of the captain of HIS[JESUS] host was Abner, the SON[JESUS] of Ner,
Saul's uncle.

14:51 And Kish was the father of Saul; and Ner the father of Abner was
the SON[JESUS] of Abiel.

14:52 And there was sore war against the Philistines all the days of
Saul: and when Saul saw any strong man, or any valiant man, HE[JESUS] took HIM[JESUS]
unto HIM[JESUS].


15:1 Samuel also said unto Saul, The LORD[JESUS] sent me to anoint you to be
KING[JESUS] over HIS[JESUS] people, over Israel: now therefore hearken you unto the
voice of the words of the LORD[JESUS].

15:2 Thus says the LORD[JESUS] of hosts, I remember that which Amalek did to
Israel, how HE[JESUS] laid wait for HIM[JESUS] in the way, when HE[JESUS] came up from Egypt.

15:3 Now go and smite Amalek, and utterly destroy all that they have,
and spare them not; but slay both man and woman, infant and suckling, ox
and sheep, camel and ass.

15:4 And Saul gathered the people together, and numbered them in Telaim,
two hundred thousand footmen, and ten thousand men of Judah.

15:5 And Saul came to a city of Amalek, and laid wait in the valley.

15:6 And Saul said unto the Kenites, Go, depart, get you down from among
the Amalekites, lest I destroy you with them: for you shewed kindness to
all the children of Israel, when they came up out of Egypt. So the
Kenites departed from among the Amalekites.

15:7 And Saul smote the Amalekites from Havilah until you comest to
Shur, that is over against Egypt.

15:8 And HE[JESUS] took Agag the KING[JESUS] of the Amalekites alive, and utterly
destroyed all the people with the edge of the sword.

15:9 But Saul and the people spared Agag, and the best of the sheep, and
of the oxen, and of the fatlings, and the lambs, and all that was good,
and would not utterly destroy them: but every thing that was vile and
refuse, that they destroyed utterly.

15:10 Then came the WORD[JESUS] of the LORD[JESUS] unto Samuel, saying,

15:11 It repenteth me that I have set up Saul to be KING[JESUS]: for HE[JESUS] is
turned back from following me, and has not performed my commandments.
And it grieved Samuel; and HE[JESUS] cried unto the LORD[JESUS] all night.

15:12 And when Samuel rose early to meet Saul in the morning, it was
told Samuel, saying, Saul came to Carmel, and, behold, HE[JESUS] set HIM[JESUS] up a
place, and is gone about, and passed on, and gone down to Gilgal.

15:13 And Samuel came to Saul: and Saul said unto HIM[JESUS], Blessed be you
of the LORD[JESUS]: I have performed the commandment of the LORD[JESUS].

15:14 And Samuel said, What meaneth then this bleating of the sheep in
mine ears, and the lowing of the oxen which I hear?

15:15 And Saul said, They have brought them from the Amalekites: for the
people spared the best of the sheep and of the oxen, to sacrifice unto
the LORD[JESUS] your GOD[JESUS]; and the rest we have utterly destroyed.

15:16 Then Samuel said unto Saul, Stay, and I will tell you what the
LORD[JESUS] has said to me this night. And HE[JESUS] said unto HIM[JESUS], Say on.

15:17 And Samuel said, When you wast little in yours own sight, wast
you not made the head of the tribes of Israel, and the LORD[JESUS] anointed
you KING[JESUS] over Israel?

15:18 And the LORD[JESUS] sent you on a journey, and said, Go and utterly
destroy the sinners the Amalekites, and fight against them until they be
consumed.

15:19 Wherefore then didst you not obey the voice of the LORD[JESUS], but
didst fly upon the spoil, and didst evil in the sight of the LORD[JESUS]?

15:20 And Saul said unto Samuel, Yea, I have obeyed the voice of the
LORD[JESUS], and have gone the way which the LORD[JESUS] sent me, and have brought
Agag the KING[JESUS] of Amalek, and have utterly destroyed the Amalekites.

15:21 But the people took of the spoil, sheep and oxen, the chief of the
things which should have been utterly destroyed, to sacrifice unto the
LORD[JESUS] your GOD[JESUS] in Gilgal.

15:22 And Samuel said, has the LORD[JESUS] as great delight in burnt offerings
and sacrifices, as in obeying the voice of the LORD[JESUS]? Behold, to obey is
better than sacrifice, and to hearken than the fat of rams.

15:23 For rebellion is as the sin of witchcraft, and stubbornness is as
iniquity and idolatry. Because you hast rejected the WORD[JESUS] of the LORD[JESUS],
HE[JESUS] has also rejected you from being KING[JESUS].

15:24 And Saul said unto Samuel, I have sinned: for I have transgressed
the commandment of the LORD[JESUS], and your words: because I feared the people,
and obeyed their voice.

15:25 Now therefore, I pray you, pardon my sin, and turn again with me,
that I may worship the LORD[JESUS].

15:26 And Samuel said unto Saul, I will not return with you: for you
hast rejected the WORD[JESUS] of the LORD[JESUS], and the LORD[JESUS] has rejected you from
being KING[JESUS] over Israel.

15:27 And as Samuel turned about to go away, HE[JESUS] laid hold upon the skirt
of HIS[JESUS] mantle, and it rent.

15:28 And Samuel said unto HIM[JESUS], The LORD[JESUS] has rent the kingdom of Israel
from you this day, and has given it to a neighbour of yours, that is
better than you.

15:29 And also the Strength of Israel will not lie nor repent: for HE[JESUS] is
not a man, that HE[JESUS] should repent.

15:30 Then HE[JESUS] said, I have sinned: yet honour me now, I pray you,
before the elders of my people, and before Israel, and turn again with
me, that I may worship the LORD[JESUS] your GOD[JESUS].

15:31 So Samuel turned again after Saul; and Saul worshipped the LORD[JESUS].

15:32 Then said Samuel, Bring you hither to me Agag the KING[JESUS] of the
Amalekites. And Agag came unto HIM[JESUS] delicately. And Agag said, Surely the
bitterness of death is past.

15:33 And Samuel said, As the sword has made women childless, so shall
your mother be childless among women. And Samuel hewed Agag in pieces
before the LORD[JESUS] in Gilgal.

15:34 Then Samuel went to Ramah; and Saul went up to HIS[JESUS] house to Gibeah
of Saul.

15:35 And Samuel came no more to see Saul until the day of HIS[JESUS] death:
nevertheless Samuel mourned for Saul: and the LORD[JESUS] repented that HE[JESUS] had
made Saul KING[JESUS] over Israel.


16:1 And the LORD[JESUS] said unto Samuel, How long wilt you mourn for Saul,
seeing I have rejected HIM[JESUS] from reigning over Israel? fill yours horn
with oil, and go, I will send you to Jesse the Bethlehemite: for I have
provided me a KING[JESUS] among HIS[JESUS] sons.

16:2 And Samuel said, How can I go? if Saul hear it, HE[JESUS] will kill me.
And the LORD[JESUS] said, Take an heifer with you, and say, I am come to
sacrifice to the LORD[JESUS].

16:3 And call Jesse to the sacrifice, and I will shew you what you
shalt do: and you shalt anoint unto me HIM[JESUS] whom I name unto you.

16:4 And Samuel did that which the LORD[JESUS] spake, and came to Bethlehem.
And the elders of the town trembled at HIS[JESUS] coming, and said, Comest you
peaceably?

16:5 And HE[JESUS] said, Peaceably: I am come to sacrifice unto the LORD[JESUS]:
sanctify yourselves, and come with me to the sacrifice. And HE[JESUS]
sanctified Jesse and HIS[JESUS] sons, and called them to the sacrifice.

16:6 And it came to pass, when they were come, that HE[JESUS] looked on Eliab,
and said, Surely the LORD[JESUS]'s anointed is before HIM[JESUS].

16:7 But the LORD[JESUS] said unto Samuel, Look not on HIS[JESUS] countenance, or on
the height of HIS[JESUS] stature; because I have refused HIM[JESUS]: for the LORD[JESUS]
seeth not as man seeth; for man looketh on the outward appearance, but
the LORD[JESUS] looketh on the heart.

16:8 Then Jesse called Abinadab, and made HIM[JESUS] pass before Samuel. And HE[JESUS]
said, Neither has the LORD[JESUS] chosen this.

16:9 Then Jesse made Shammah to pass by. And HE[JESUS] said, Neither has the
LORD[JESUS] chosen this.

16:10 Again, Jesse made seven of HIS[JESUS] sons to pass before Samuel. And
Samuel said unto Jesse, The LORD[JESUS] has not chosen these.

16:11 And Samuel said unto Jesse, Are here all your children? And HE[JESUS]
said, There remaineth yet the youngest, and, behold, HE[JESUS] keepeth the
sheep. And Samuel said unto Jesse, Send and fetch HIM[JESUS]: for we will not
sit down till HE[JESUS] come hither.

16:12 And HE[JESUS] sent, and brought HIM[JESUS] in. Now HE[JESUS] was ruddy, and withal of a
beautiful countenance, and goodly to look to. And the LORD[JESUS] said, Arise,
anoint HIM[JESUS]: for this is HE[JESUS].

16:13 Then Samuel took the horn of oil, and anointed HIM[JESUS] in the midst of
HIS[JESUS] brethren: and the Spirit of the LORD[JESUS] came upon David from that day
forward. So Samuel rose up, and went to Ramah.

16:14 But the Spirit of the LORD[JESUS] departed from Saul, and an evil spirit
from the LORD[JESUS] troubled HIM[JESUS].

16:15 And Saul's servants said unto HIM[JESUS], Behold now, an evil spirit from
GOD[JESUS] troubleth you.

16:16 Let our LORD[JESUS] now command your servants, which are before you, to
seek out a man, who is a cunning player on an harp: and it shall come to
pass, when the evil spirit from GOD[JESUS] is upon you, that HE[JESUS] shall play
with HIS[JESUS] hand, and you shalt be well.

16:17 And Saul said unto HIS[JESUS] servants, Provide me now a man that can
play well, and bring HIM[JESUS] to me.

16:18 Then answered one of the servants, and said, Behold, I have seen a
SON[JESUS] of Jesse the Bethlehemite, that is cunning in playing, and a mighty
valiant man, and a man of war, and prudent in matters, and a comely
person, and the LORD[JESUS] is with HIM[JESUS].

16:19 Wherefore Saul sent messengers unto Jesse, and said, Send me David
your SON[JESUS], which is with the sheep.

16:20 And Jesse took an ass laden with bread, and a bottle of wine, and
a kid, and sent them by David HIS[JESUS] SON[JESUS] unto Saul.

16:21 And David came to Saul, and stood before HIM[JESUS]: and HE[JESUS] loved HIM[JESUS]
greatly; and HE[JESUS] became HIS[JESUS] armourbearer.

16:22 And Saul sent to Jesse, saying, Let David, I pray you, stand
before me; for HE[JESUS] has found favour in my sight.

16:23 And it came to pass, when the evil spirit from GOD[JESUS] was upon Saul,
that David took an harp, and played with HIS[JESUS] hand: so Saul was
refreshed, and was well, and the evil spirit departed from HIM[JESUS].


17:1 Now the Philistines gathered together their armies to battle, and
were gathered together at Shochoh, which belongeth to Judah, and pitched
between Shochoh and Azekah, in Ephesdammim.

17:2 And Saul and the men of Israel were gathered together, and pitched
by the valley of Elah, and set the battle in array against the
Philistines.

17:3 And the Philistines stood on a mountain on the one side, and Israel
stood on a mountain on the other side: and there was a valley between
them.

17:4 And there went out a champion out of the camp of the Philistines,
named Goliath, of Gath, whose height was six cubits and a span.

17:5 And HE[JESUS] had an helmet of brass upon HIS[JESUS] head, and HE[JESUS] was armed with
a coat of mail; and the weight of the coat was five thousand shekels of
brass.

17:6 And HE[JESUS] had greaves of brass upon HIS[JESUS] legs, and a target of brass
between HIS[JESUS] shoulders.

17:7 And the staff of HIS[JESUS] spear was like a weaver's beam; and HIS[JESUS]
spear's head weighed six hundred shekels of iron: and one bearing a
shield went before HIM[JESUS].

17:8 And HE[JESUS] stood and cried unto the armies of Israel, and said unto
them, Why are you come out to set your battle in array? am not I a
Philistine, and you servants to Saul? choose you a man for you, and let
HIM[JESUS] come down to me.

17:9 If HE[JESUS] be able to fight with me, and to kill me, then will we be
your servants: but if I prevail against HIM[JESUS], and kill HIM[JESUS], then shall you
be our servants, and serve us.

17:10 And the Philistine said, I defy the armies of Israel this day;
give me a man, that we may fight together.

17:11 When Saul and all Israel heard those words of the Philistine, they
were dismayed, and greatly afraid.

17:12 Now David was the SON[JESUS] of that Ephrathite of Bethlehemjudah, whose
name was Jesse; and HE[JESUS] had eight sons: and the man went among men for an
old man in the days of Saul.

17:13 And the three eldest sons of Jesse went and followed Saul to the
battle: and the names of HIS[JESUS] three sons that went to the battle were
Eliab the firstborn, and next unto HIM[JESUS] Abinadab, and the third Shammah.

17:14 And David was the youngest: and the three eldest followed Saul.

17:15 But David went and returned from Saul to feed HIS[JESUS] father's sheep
at Bethlehem.

17:16 And the Philistine drew near morning and evening, and presented
himself forty days.

17:17 And Jesse said unto David HIS[JESUS] SON[JESUS], Take now for your brethren an
ephah of this parched corn, and these ten loaves, and run to the camp of
your brethren;

17:18 And carry these ten cheeses unto the captain of their thousand,
and look how your brethren fare, and take their pledge.

17:19 Now Saul, and they, and all the men of Israel, were in the valley
of Elah, fighting with the Philistines.

17:20 And David rose up early in the morning, and left the sheep with a
keeper, and took, and went, as Jesse had commanded HIM[JESUS]; and HE[JESUS] came to
the trench, as the host was going forth to the fight, and shouted for
the battle.

17:21 For Israel and the Philistines had put the battle in array, army
against army.

17:22 And David left HIS[JESUS] carriage in the hand of the keeper of the
carriage, and ran into the army, and came and saluted HIS[JESUS] brethren.

17:23 And as HE[JESUS] talked with them, behold, there came up the champion,
the Philistine of Gath, Goliath by name, out of the armies of the
Philistines, and spake according to the same words: and David heard
them.

17:24 And all the men of Israel, when they saw the man, fled from HIM[JESUS],
and were sore afraid.

17:25 And the men of Israel said, Have you seen this man that is come up?
surely to defy Israel is HE[JESUS] come up: and it shall be, that the man who
killeth HIM[JESUS], the KING[JESUS] will enrich HIM[JESUS] with great riches, and will give
HIM[JESUS] HIS[JESUS] daughter, and make HIS[JESUS] father's house free in Israel.

17:26 And David spake to the men that stood by HIM[JESUS], saying, What shall
be done to the man that killeth this Philistine, and taketh away the
reproach from Israel? for who is this uncircumcised Philistine, that HE[JESUS]
should defy the armies of the living GOD[JESUS]?

17:27 And the people answered HIM[JESUS] after this manner, saying, So shall it
be done to the man that killeth HIM[JESUS].

17:28 And Eliab HIS[JESUS] eldest brother heard when HE[JESUS] spake unto the men; and
Eliab's anger was kindled against David, and HE[JESUS] said, Why camest you
down hither? and with whom hast you left those few sheep in the
wilderness? I know your pride, and the naughtiness of yours heart; for
you art come down that you mightest see the battle.

17:29 And David said, What have I now done? Is there not a cause?

17:30 And HE[JESUS] turned from HIM[JESUS] toward another, and spake after the same
manner: and the people answered HIM[JESUS] again after the former manner.

17:31 And when the words were heard which David spake, they rehearsed
them before Saul: and HE[JESUS] sent for HIM[JESUS].

17:32 And David said to Saul, Let no man's heart fail because of HIM[JESUS];
your SERVANT[JESUS] will go and fight with this Philistine.

17:33 And Saul said to David, you art not able to go against this
Philistine to fight with HIM[JESUS]: for you art but a youth, and HE[JESUS] a man of
war from HIS[JESUS] youth.

17:34 And David said unto Saul, your SERVANT[JESUS] kept HIS[JESUS] father's sheep, and
there came a lion, and a bear, and took a LAMB[JESUS] out of the flock:

17:35 And I went out after HIM[JESUS], and smote HIM[JESUS], and delivered it out of
HIS[JESUS] mouth: and when HE[JESUS] arose against me, I caught HIM[JESUS] by HIS[JESUS] beard, and
smote HIM[JESUS], and slew HIM[JESUS].

17:36 your SERVANT[JESUS] slew both the lion and the bear: and this
uncircumcised Philistine shall be as one of them, seeing HE[JESUS] has defied
the armies of the living GOD[JESUS].

17:37 David said moreover, The LORD[JESUS] that delivered me out of the paw of
the lion, and out of the paw of the bear, HE[JESUS] will deliver me out of the
hand of this Philistine. And Saul said unto David, Go, and the LORD[JESUS] be
with you.

17:38 And Saul armed David with HIS[JESUS] armour, and HE[JESUS] put an helmet of
brass upon HIS[JESUS] head; also HE[JESUS] armed HIM[JESUS] with a coat of mail.

17:39 And David girded HIS[JESUS] sword upon HIS[JESUS] armour, and HE[JESUS] assayed to go;
for HE[JESUS] had not proved it. And David said unto Saul, I cannot go with
these; for I have not proved them. And David put them off HIM[JESUS].

17:40 And HE[JESUS] took HIS[JESUS] staff in HIS[JESUS] hand, and chose HIM[JESUS] five smooth
stones out of the brook, and put them in a SHEPHERD[JESUS]'s bag which HE[JESUS] had,
even in a scrip; and HIS[JESUS] sling was in HIS[JESUS] hand: and HE[JESUS] drew near to the
Philistine.

17:41 And the Philistine came on and drew near unto David; and the man
that bare the shield went before HIM[JESUS].

17:42 And when the Philistine looked about, and saw David, HE[JESUS] disdained
HIM[JESUS]: for HE[JESUS] was but a youth, and ruddy, and of a fair countenance.

17:43 And the Philistine said unto David, Am I a dog, that you comest
to me with staves? And the Philistine cursed David by HIS[JESUS] gods.

17:44 And the Philistine said to David, Come to me, and I will give your
flesh unto the fowls of the air, and to the beasts of the field.

17:45 Then said David to the Philistine, you comest to me with a sword,
and with a spear, and with a shield: but I come to you in the name of
the LORD[JESUS] of hosts, the GOD[JESUS] of the armies of Israel, whom you hast
defied.

17:46 This day will the LORD[JESUS] deliver you into mine hand; and I will
smite you, and take yours head from you; and I will give the carcases
of the host of the Philistines this day unto the fowls of the air, and
to the wild beasts of the earth; that all the earth may know that there
is a GOD[JESUS] in Israel.

17:47 And all this assembly shall know that the LORD[JESUS] saveth not with
sword and spear: for the battle is the LORD[JESUS]'s, and HE[JESUS] will give you into
our hands.

17:48 And it came to pass, when the Philistine arose, and came, and drew
nigh to meet David, that David hastened, and ran toward the army to meet
the Philistine.

17:49 And David put HIS[JESUS] hand in HIS[JESUS] bag, and took thence a stone, and
slang it, and smote the Philistine in HIS[JESUS] forehead, that the stone sunk
into HIS[JESUS] forehead; and HE[JESUS] fell upon HIS[JESUS] face to the earth.

17:50 So David prevailed over the Philistine with a sling and with a
stone, and smote the Philistine, and slew HIM[JESUS]; but there was no sword in
the hand of David.

17:51 Therefore David ran, and stood upon the Philistine, and took HIS[JESUS]
sword, and drew it out of the sheath thereof, and slew HIM[JESUS], and cut off
HIS[JESUS] head therewith. And when the Philistines saw their champion was
dead, they fled.

17:52 And the men of Israel and of Judah arose, and shouted, and pursued
the Philistines, until you come to the valley, and to the gates of
Ekron. And the wounded of the Philistines fell down by the way to
Shaaraim, even unto Gath, and unto Ekron.

17:53 And the children of Israel returned from chasing after the
Philistines, and they spoiled their tents.

17:54 And David took the head of the Philistine, and brought it to
Jerusalem; but HE[JESUS] put HIS[JESUS] armour in HIS[JESUS] tent.

17:55 And when Saul saw David go forth against the Philistine, HE[JESUS] said
unto Abner, the captain of the host, Abner, whose SON[JESUS] is this youth? And
Abner said, As your soul liveth, O KING[JESUS], I cannot tell.

17:56 And the KING[JESUS] said, Enquire you whose SON[JESUS] the stripling is.

17:57 And as David returned from the slaughter of the Philistine, Abner
took HIM[JESUS], and brought HIM[JESUS] before Saul with the head of the Philistine in
HIS[JESUS] hand.

17:58 And Saul said to HIM[JESUS], Whose SON[JESUS] art you, you young man? And
David answered, I am the SON[JESUS] of your SERVANT[JESUS] Jesse the Bethlehemite.


18:1 And it came to pass, when HE[JESUS] had made an end of speaking unto Saul,
that the soul of Jonathan was knit with the soul of David, and Jonathan
loved HIM[JESUS] as HIS[JESUS] own soul.

18:2 And Saul took HIM[JESUS] that day, and would let HIM[JESUS] go no more home to
HIS[JESUS] father's house.

18:3 Then Jonathan and David made a covenant, because HE[JESUS] loved HIM[JESUS] as
HIS[JESUS] own soul.

18:4 And Jonathan stripped himself of the robe that was upon HIM[JESUS], and
gave it to David, and HIS[JESUS] garments, even to HIS[JESUS] sword, and to HIS[JESUS] bow,
and to HIS[JESUS] girdle.

18:5 And David went out whithersoever Saul sent HIM[JESUS], and behaved himself
wisely: and Saul set HIM[JESUS] over the men of war, and HE[JESUS] was accepted in the
sight of all the people, and also in the sight of Saul's servants.

18:6 And it came to pass as they came, when David was returned from the
slaughter of the Philistine, that the women came out of all cities of
Israel, singing and dancing, to meet KING[JESUS] Saul, with tabrets, with joy,
and with instruments of musick.

18:7 And the women answered one another as they played, and said, Saul
has slain HIS[JESUS] thousands, and David HIS[JESUS] ten thousands.

18:8 And Saul was very wroth, and the saying displeased HIM[JESUS]; and HE[JESUS]
said, They have ascribed unto David ten thousands, and to me they have
ascribed but thousands: and what can HE[JESUS] have more but the kingdom?

18:9 And Saul eyed David from that day and forward.

18:10 And it came to pass on the morrow, that the evil spirit from GOD[JESUS]
came upon Saul, and HE[JESUS] prophesied in the midst of the house: and David
played with HIS[JESUS] hand, as at other times: and there was a javelin in
Saul's hand.

18:11 And Saul cast the javelin; for HE[JESUS] said, I will smite David even to
the wall with it. And David avoided out of HIS[JESUS] presence twice.

18:12 And Saul was afraid of David, because the LORD[JESUS] was with HIM[JESUS], and
was departed from Saul.

18:13 Therefore Saul removed HIM[JESUS] from HIM[JESUS], and made HIM[JESUS] HIS[JESUS] captain over
a thousand; and HE[JESUS] went out and came in before the people.

18:14 And David behaved himself wisely in all HIS[JESUS] ways; and the LORD[JESUS] was
with HIM[JESUS].

18:15 Wherefore when Saul saw that HE[JESUS] behaved himself very wisely, HE[JESUS]
was afraid of HIM[JESUS].

18:16 But all Israel and Judah loved David, because HE[JESUS] went out and came
in before them.

18:17 And Saul said to David, Behold my elder daughter Merab, her will I
give you to wife: only be you valiant for me, and fight the LORD[JESUS]'s
battles. For Saul said, Let not mine hand be upon HIM[JESUS], but let the hand
of the Philistines be upon HIM[JESUS].

18:18 And David said unto Saul, Who am I? and what is my life, or my
father's family in Israel, that I should be SON[JESUS] in law to the KING[JESUS]?

18:19 But it came to pass at the time when Merab Saul's daughter should
have been given to David, that she was given unto Adriel the Meholathite
to wife.

18:20 And Michal Saul's daughter loved David: and they told Saul, and
the thing pleased HIM[JESUS].

18:21 And Saul said, I will give HIM[JESUS] her, that she may be a snare to
HIM[JESUS], and that the hand of the Philistines may be against HIM[JESUS]. Wherefore
Saul said to David, you shalt this day be my SON[JESUS] in law in the one of
the twain.

18:22 And Saul commanded HIS[JESUS] servants, saying, Commune with David
secretly, and say, Behold, the KING[JESUS] has delight in you, and all HIS[JESUS]
servants love you: now therefore be the KING[JESUS]'s SON[JESUS] in law.

18:23 And Saul's servants spake those words in the ears of David. And
David said, Seemeth it to you a light thing to be a KING[JESUS]'s SON[JESUS] in law,
seeing that I am a poor man, and lightly esteemed?

18:24 And the servants of Saul told HIM[JESUS], saying, On this manner spake
David.

18:25 And Saul said, Thus shall you say to David, The KING[JESUS] desireth not
any dowry, but an hundred foreskins of the Philistines, to be avenged of
the KING[JESUS]'s enemies. But Saul thought to make David fall by the hand of
the Philistines.

18:26 And when HIS[JESUS] servants told David these words, it pleased David
well to be the KING[JESUS]'s SON[JESUS] in law: and the days were not expired.

18:27 Wherefore David arose and went, HE[JESUS] and HIS[JESUS] men, and slew of the
Philistines two hundred men; and David brought their foreskins, and they
gave them in full tale to the KING[JESUS], that HE[JESUS] might be the KING[JESUS]'s SON[JESUS] in
law. And Saul gave HIM[JESUS] Michal HIS[JESUS] daughter to wife.

18:28 And Saul saw and knew that the LORD[JESUS] was with David, and that
Michal Saul's daughter loved HIM[JESUS].

18:29 And Saul was yet the more afraid of David; and Saul became David's
enemy continually.

18:30 Then the princes of the Philistines went forth: and it came to
pass, after they went forth, that David behaved himself more wisely than
all the servants of Saul; so that HIS[JESUS] name was much set by.


19:1 And Saul spake to Jonathan HIS[JESUS] SON[JESUS], and to all HIS[JESUS] servants, that
they should kill David.

19:2 But Jonathan Saul's SON[JESUS] delighted much in David: and Jonathan told
David, saying, Saul my father seeketh to kill you: now therefore, I
pray you, take heed to thyself until the morning, and abide in a secret
place, and hide thyself:

19:3 And I will go out and stand beside my father in the field where
you art, and I will commune with my father of you; and what I see,
that I will tell you.

19:4 And Jonathan spake good of David unto Saul HIS[JESUS] father, and said
unto HIM[JESUS], Let not the KING[JESUS] sin against HIS[JESUS] SERVANT[JESUS], against David;
because HE[JESUS] has not sinned against you, and because HIS[JESUS] works have been
to you-ward very good:

19:5 For HE[JESUS] did put HIS[JESUS] life in HIS[JESUS] hand, and slew the Philistine, and
the LORD[JESUS] wrought a great salvation for all Israel: you sawest it, and
didst rejoice: wherefore then wilt you sin against innocent blood, to
slay David without a cause?

19:6 And Saul hearkened unto the voice of Jonathan: and Saul sware, As
the LORD[JESUS] liveth, HE[JESUS] shall not be slain.

19:7 And Jonathan called David, and Jonathan shewed HIM[JESUS] all those
things. And Jonathan brought David to Saul, and HE[JESUS] was in HIS[JESUS] presence,
as in times past.

19:8 And there was war again: and David went out, and fought with the
Philistines, and slew them with a great slaughter; and they fled from
HIM[JESUS].

19:9 And the evil spirit from the LORD[JESUS] was upon Saul, as HE[JESUS] sat in HIS[JESUS]
house with HIS[JESUS] javelin in HIS[JESUS] hand: and David played with HIS[JESUS] hand.

19:10 And Saul sought to smite David even to the wall with the javelin:
but HE[JESUS] slipped away out of Saul's presence, and HE[JESUS] smote the javelin
into the wall: and David fled, and escaped that night.

19:11 Saul also sent messengers unto David's house, to watch HIM[JESUS], and to
slay HIM[JESUS] in the morning: and Michal David's wife told HIM[JESUS], saying, If
you save not your life to night, to morrow you shalt be slain.

19:12 So Michal let David down through a window: and HE[JESUS] went, and fled,
and escaped.

19:13 And Michal took an image, and laid it in the bed, and put a pillow
of goats' hair for HIS[JESUS] bolster, and covered it with a cloth.

19:14 And when Saul sent messengers to take David, she said, HE[JESUS] is sick.

19:15 And Saul sent the messengers again to see David, saying, Bring HIM[JESUS]
up to me in the bed, that I may slay HIM[JESUS].

19:16 And when the messengers were come in, behold, there was an image
in the bed, with a pillow of goats' hair for HIS[JESUS] bolster.

19:17 And Saul said unto Michal, Why hast you deceived me so, and sent
away mine enemy, that HE[JESUS] is escaped? And Michal answered Saul, HE[JESUS] said
unto me, Let me go; why should I kill you?

19:18 So David fled, and escaped, and came to Samuel to Ramah, and told
HIM[JESUS] all that Saul had done to HIM[JESUS]. And HE[JESUS] and Samuel went and dwelt in
Naioth.

19:19 And it was told Saul, saying, Behold, David is at Naioth in Ramah.

19:20 And Saul sent messengers to take David: and when they saw the
company of the prophets prophesying, and Samuel standing as appointed
over them, the Spirit of GOD[JESUS] was upon the messengers of Saul, and they
also prophesied.

19:21 And when it was told Saul, HE[JESUS] sent other messengers, and they
prophesied likewise. And Saul sent messengers again the third time, and
they prophesied also.

19:22 Then went HE[JESUS] also to Ramah, and came to a great well that is in
Sechu: and HE[JESUS] asked and said, Where are Samuel and David? And one said,
Behold, they be at Naioth in Ramah.

19:23 And HE[JESUS] went thither to Naioth in Ramah: and the Spirit of GOD[JESUS] was
upon HIM[JESUS] also, and HE[JESUS] went on, and prophesied, until HE[JESUS] came to Naioth
in Ramah.

19:24 And HE[JESUS] stripped off HIS[JESUS] clothes also, and prophesied before Samuel
in like manner, and lay down naked all that day and all that night.
Wherefore they say, Is Saul also among the prophets?


20:1 And David fled from Naioth in Ramah, and came and said before
Jonathan, What have I done? what is mine iniquity? and what is my sin
before your father, that HE[JESUS] seeketh my life?

20:2 And HE[JESUS] said unto HIM[JESUS], GOD[JESUS] forbid; you shalt not die: behold, my
father will do nothing either great or small, but that HE[JESUS] will shew it
me: and why should my father hide this thing from me? it is not so.

20:3 And David sware moreover, and said, your father certainly knoweth
that I have found grace in yours eyes; and HE[JESUS] says, Let not Jonathan
know this, lest HE[JESUS] be grieved: but truly as the LORD[JESUS] liveth, and as your
soul liveth, there is but a step between me and death.

20:4 Then said Jonathan unto David, Whatsoever your soul desireth, I will
even do it for you.

20:5 And David said unto Jonathan, Behold, to morrow is the new moon,
and I should not fail to sit with the KING[JESUS] at meat: but let me go, that
I may hide myself in the field unto the third day at even.

20:6 If your father at all miss me, then say, David earnestly asked leave
of me that HE[JESUS] might run to Bethlehem HIS[JESUS] city: for there is a yearly
sacrifice there for all the family.

20:7 If HE[JESUS] say thus, It is well; your SERVANT[JESUS] shall have peace: but if HE[JESUS]
be very wroth, then be sure that evil is determined by HIM[JESUS].

20:8 Therefore you shalt deal kindly with your SERVANT[JESUS]; for you hast
brought your SERVANT[JESUS] into a covenant of the LORD[JESUS] with you:
notwithstanding, if there be in me iniquity, slay me thyself; for why
shouldest you bring me to your father?

20:9 And Jonathan said, Far be it from you: for if I knew certainly
that evil were determined by my father to come upon you, then would not
I tell it you?

20:10 Then said David to Jonathan, Who shall tell me? or what if your
father answer you roughly?

20:11 And Jonathan said unto David, Come, and let us go out into the
field. And they went out both of them into the field.

20:12 And Jonathan said unto David, O LORD[JESUS] GOD[JESUS] of Israel, when I have
sounded my father about to morrow any time, or the third day, and,
behold, if there be good toward David, and I then send not unto you,
and shew it you;

20:13 The LORD[JESUS] do so and much more to Jonathan: but if it please my
father to do you evil, then I will shew it you, and send you away,
that you mayest go in peace: and the LORD[JESUS] be with you, as HE[JESUS] has been
with my father.

20:14 And you shalt not only while yet I live shew me the kindness of
the LORD[JESUS], that I die not:

20:15 But also you shalt not cut off your kindness from my house for
ever: no, not when the LORD[JESUS] has cut off the enemies of David every one
from the face of the earth.

20:16 So Jonathan made a covenant with the house of David, saying, Let
the LORD[JESUS] even require it at the hand of David's enemies.

20:17 And Jonathan caused David to swear again, because HE[JESUS] loved HIM[JESUS]:
for HE[JESUS] loved HIM[JESUS] as HE[JESUS] loved HIS[JESUS] own soul.

20:18 Then Jonathan said to David, To morrow is the new moon: and you
shalt be missed, because your seat will be empty.

20:19 And when you hast stayed three days, then you shalt go down
quickly, and come to the place where you didst hide thyself when the
business was in hand, and shalt remain by the stone Ezel.

20:20 And I will shoot three arrows on the side thereof, as though I
shot at a mark.

20:21 And, behold, I will send a lad, saying, Go, find out the arrows.
If I expressly say unto the lad, Behold, the arrows are on this side of
you, take them; then come you: for there is peace to you, and no
hurt; as the LORD[JESUS] liveth.

20:22 But if I say thus unto the young man, Behold, the arrows are
beyond you; go your way: for the LORD[JESUS] has sent you away.

20:23 And as touching the matter which you and I have spoken of,
behold, the LORD[JESUS] be between you and me for ever.

20:24 So David hid himself in the field: and when the new moon was come,
the KING[JESUS] sat HIM[JESUS] down to eat meat.

20:25 And the KING[JESUS] sat upon HIS[JESUS] seat, as at other times, even upon a
seat by the wall: and Jonathan arose, and Abner sat by Saul's side, and
David's place was empty.

20:26 Nevertheless Saul spake not any thing that day: for HE[JESUS] thought,
Something has befallen HIM[JESUS], HE[JESUS] is not clean; surely HE[JESUS] is not clean.

20:27 And it came to pass on the morrow, which was the second day of the
month, that David's place was empty: and Saul said unto Jonathan HIS[JESUS]
SON[JESUS], Wherefore comes not the SON[JESUS] of Jesse to meat, neither yesterday,
nor to day?

20:28 And Jonathan answered Saul, David earnestly asked leave of me to
go to Bethlehem:

20:29 And HE[JESUS] said, Let me go, I pray you; for our family has a
sacrifice in the city; and my brother, HE[JESUS] has commanded me to be there:
and now, if I have found favour in yours eyes, let me get away, I pray
you, and see my brethren. Therefore HE[JESUS] comes not unto the KING[JESUS]'s
table.

20:30 Then Saul's anger was kindled against Jonathan, and HE[JESUS] said unto
HIM[JESUS], you SON[JESUS] of the perverse rebellious woman, do not I know that you
hast chosen the SON[JESUS] of Jesse to yours own confusion, and unto the
confusion of your mother's nakedness?

20:31 For as long as the SON[JESUS] of Jesse liveth upon the ground, you shalt
not be established, nor your kingdom. Wherefore now send and fetch HIM[JESUS]
unto me, for HE[JESUS] shall surely die.

20:32 And Jonathan answered Saul HIS[JESUS] father, and said unto HIM[JESUS],
Wherefore shall HE[JESUS] be slain? what has HE[JESUS] done?

20:33 And Saul cast a javelin at HIM[JESUS] to smite HIM[JESUS]: whereby Jonathan knew
that it was determined of HIS[JESUS] father to slay David.

20:34 So Jonathan arose from the table in fierce anger, and did eat no
meat the second day of the month: for HE[JESUS] was grieved for David, because
HIS[JESUS] father had done HIM[JESUS] shame.

20:35 And it came to pass in the morning, that Jonathan went out into
the field at the time appointed with David, and a little lad with HIM[JESUS].

20:36 And HE[JESUS] said unto HIS[JESUS] lad, Run, find out now the arrows which I
shoot. And as the lad ran, HE[JESUS] shot an arrow beyond HIM[JESUS].

20:37 And when the lad was come to the place of the arrow which Jonathan
had shot, Jonathan cried after the lad, and said, Is not the arrow
beyond you?

20:38 And Jonathan cried after the lad, Make speed, haste, stay not. And
Jonathan's lad gathered up the arrows, and came to HIS[JESUS] master.

20:39 But the lad knew not any thing: only Jonathan and David knew the
matter.

20:40 And Jonathan gave HIS[JESUS] artillery unto HIS[JESUS] lad, and said unto HIM[JESUS],
Go, carry them to the city.

20:41 And as soon as the lad was gone, David arose out of a place toward
the south, and fell on HIS[JESUS] face to the ground, and bowed himself three
times: and they kissed one another, and wept one with another, until
David exceeded.

20:42 And Jonathan said to David, Go in peace, forasmuch as we have
sworn both of us in the name of the LORD[JESUS], saying, The LORD[JESUS] be between me
and you, and between my SEED[JESUS] and your SEED[JESUS] for ever. And HE[JESUS] arose and
departed: and Jonathan went into the city.


21:1 Then came David to Nob to Ahimelech the priest: and Ahimelech was
afraid at the meeting of David, and said unto HIM[JESUS], Why art you alone,
and no man with you?

21:2 And David said unto Ahimelech the priest, The KING[JESUS] has commanded
me a business, and has said unto me, Let no man know any thing of the
business whereabout I send you, and what I have commanded you: and I
have appointed my servants to such and such a place.

21:3 Now therefore what is under yours hand? give me five loaves of
bread in mine hand, or what there is present.

21:4 And the priest answered David, and said, There is no common bread
under mine hand, but there is hallowed bread; if the young men have kept
themselves at least from women.

21:5 And David answered the priest, and said unto HIM[JESUS], Of a truth women
have been kept from us about these three days, since I came out, and the
vessels of the young men are holy, and the bread is in a manner common,
yea, though it were sanctified this day in the vessel.

21:6 So the priest gave HIM[JESUS] hallowed bread: for there was no bread there
but the shewbread, that was taken from before the LORD[JESUS], to put hot bread
in the day when it was taken away.

21:7 Now a certain man of the servants of Saul was there that day,
detained before the LORD[JESUS]; and HIS[JESUS] name was Doeg, an Edomite, the
chiefest of the herdmen that belonged to Saul.

21:8 And David said unto Ahimelech, And is there not here under yours
hand spear or sword? for I have neither brought my sword nor my weapons
with me, because the KING[JESUS]'s business required haste.

21:9 And the priest said, The sword of Goliath the Philistine, whom you
slewest in the valley of Elah, behold, it is here wrapped in a cloth
behind the ephod: if you wilt take that, take it: for there is no other
save that here. And David said, There is none like that; give it me.

21:10 And David arose and fled that day for fear of Saul, and went to
Achish the KING[JESUS] of Gath.

21:11 And the servants of Achish said unto HIM[JESUS], Is not this David the
KING[JESUS] of the land? did they not sing one to another of HIM[JESUS] in dances,
saying, Saul has slain HIS[JESUS] thousands, and David HIS[JESUS] ten thousands?

21:12 And David laid up these words in HIS[JESUS] heart, and was sore afraid of
Achish the KING[JESUS] of Gath.

21:13 And HE[JESUS] changed HIS[JESUS] behaviour before them, and feigned himself mad
in their hands, and scrabbled on the doors of the gate, and let HIS[JESUS]
spittle fall down upon HIS[JESUS] beard.

21:14 Then said Achish unto HIS[JESUS] servants, Lo, you see the man is mad:
wherefore then have you brought HIM[JESUS] to me?

21:15 Have I need of mad men, that you have brought this fellow to play
the mad man in my presence? shall this fellow come into my house?


22:1 David therefore departed thence, and escaped to the cave Adullam:
and when HIS[JESUS] brethren and all HIS[JESUS] father's house heard it, they went
down thither to HIM[JESUS].

22:2 And every one that was in distress, and every one that was in debt,
and every one that was discontented, gathered themselves unto HIM[JESUS]; and
HE[JESUS] became a captain over them: and there were with HIM[JESUS] about four
hundred men.

22:3 And David went thence to Mizpeh of Moab: and HE[JESUS] said unto the KING[JESUS]
of Moab, Let my father and my mother, I pray you, come forth, and be
with you, till I know what GOD[JESUS] will do for me.

22:4 And HE[JESUS] brought them before the KING[JESUS] of Moab: and they dwelt with
HIM[JESUS] all the while that David was in the hold.

22:5 And the PROPHET[JESUS] Gad said unto David, Abide not in the hold; depart,
and get you into the land of Judah. Then David departed, and came into
the forest of Hareth.

22:6 When Saul heard that David was discovered, and the men that were
with HIM[JESUS], (now Saul abode in Gibeah under a tree in Ramah, having HIS[JESUS]
spear in HIS[JESUS] hand, and all HIS[JESUS] servants were standing about HIM[JESUS];)

22:7 Then Saul said unto HIS[JESUS] servants that stood about HIM[JESUS], Hear now, you
Benjamites; will the SON[JESUS] of Jesse give every one of you fields and
vineyards, and make you all captains of thousands, and captains of
hundreds;

22:8 That all of you have conspired against me, and there is none that
sheweth me that my SON[JESUS] has made a league with the SON[JESUS] of Jesse, and
there is none of you that is sorry for me, or sheweth unto me that my
SON[JESUS] has stirred up my SERVANT[JESUS] against me, to lie in wait, as at this
day?

22:9 Then answered Doeg the Edomite, which was set over the servants of
Saul, and said, I saw the SON[JESUS] of Jesse coming to Nob, to Ahimelech the
SON[JESUS] of Ahitub.

22:10 And HE[JESUS] enquired of the LORD[JESUS] for HIM[JESUS], and gave HIM[JESUS] victuals, and
gave HIM[JESUS] the sword of Goliath the Philistine.

22:11 Then the KING[JESUS] sent to call Ahimelech the priest, the SON[JESUS] of
Ahitub, and all HIS[JESUS] father's house, the priests that were in Nob: and
they came all of them to the KING[JESUS].

22:12 And Saul said, Hear now, you SON[JESUS] of Ahitub. And HE[JESUS] answered, Here
I am, my LORD[JESUS].

22:13 And Saul said unto HIM[JESUS], Why have you conspired against me, you and
the SON[JESUS] of Jesse, in that you hast given HIM[JESUS] bread, and a sword, and
hast enquired of GOD[JESUS] for HIM[JESUS], that HE[JESUS] should rise against me, to lie in
wait, as at this day?

22:14 Then Ahimelech answered the KING[JESUS], and said, And who is so faithful
among all your servants as David, which is the KING[JESUS]'s SON[JESUS] in law, and
goes at your bidding, and is honourable in yours house?

22:15 Did I then begin to enquire of GOD[JESUS] for HIM[JESUS]? be it far from me: let
not the KING[JESUS] impute any thing unto HIS[JESUS] SERVANT[JESUS], nor to all the house of
my father: for your SERVANT[JESUS] knew nothing of all this, less or more.

22:16 And the KING[JESUS] said, you shalt surely die, Ahimelech, you, and all
your father's house.

22:17 And the KING[JESUS] said unto the footmen that stood about HIM[JESUS], Turn, and
slay the priests of the LORD[JESUS]: because their hand also is with David, and
because they knew when HE[JESUS] fled, and did not shew it to me. But the
servants of the KING[JESUS] would not put forth their hand to fall upon the
priests of the LORD[JESUS].

22:18 And the KING[JESUS] said to Doeg, Turn you, and fall upon the priests.
And Doeg the Edomite turned, and HE[JESUS] fell upon the priests, and slew on
that day fourscore and five persons that did wear a linen ephod.

22:19 And Nob, the city of the priests, smote HE[JESUS] with the edge of the
sword, both men and women, children and sucklings, and oxen, and asses,
and sheep, with the edge of the sword.

22:20 And one of the sons of Ahimelech the SON[JESUS] of Ahitub, named
Abiathar, escaped, and fled after David.

22:21 And Abiathar shewed David that Saul had slain the LORD[JESUS]'s priests.

22:22 And David said unto Abiathar, I knew it that day, when Doeg the
Edomite was there, that HE[JESUS] would surely tell Saul: I have occasioned the
death of all the persons of your father's house.

22:23 Abide you with me, fear not: for HE[JESUS] that seeketh my life seeketh
your life: but with me you shalt be in safeguard.


23:1 Then they told David, saying, Behold, the Philistines fight against
Keilah, and they rob the threshingfloors.

23:2 Therefore David enquired of the LORD[JESUS], saying, Shall I go and smite
these Philistines? And the LORD[JESUS] said unto David, Go, and smite the
Philistines, and save Keilah.

23:3 And David's men said unto HIM[JESUS], Behold, we be afraid here in Judah:
how much more then if we come to Keilah against the armies of the
Philistines?

23:4 Then David enquired of the LORD[JESUS] yet again. And the LORD[JESUS] answered
HIM[JESUS] and said, Arise, go down to Keilah; for I will deliver the
Philistines into yours hand.

23:5 So David and HIS[JESUS] men went to Keilah, and fought with the
Philistines, and brought away their cattle, and smote them with a great
slaughter. So David saved the inhabitants of Keilah.

23:6 And it came to pass, when Abiathar the SON[JESUS] of Ahimelech fled to
David to Keilah, that HE[JESUS] came down with an ephod in HIS[JESUS] hand.

23:7 And it was told Saul that David was come to Keilah. And Saul said,
GOD[JESUS] has delivered HIM[JESUS] into mine hand; for HE[JESUS] is shut in, by entering
into a town that has gates and bars.

23:8 And Saul called all the people together to war, to go down to
Keilah, to besiege David and HIS[JESUS] men.

23:9 And David knew that Saul secretly practised mischief against HIM[JESUS];
and HE[JESUS] said to Abiathar the priest, Bring hither the ephod.

23:10 Then said David, O LORD[JESUS] GOD[JESUS] of Israel, your SERVANT[JESUS] has certainly
heard that Saul seeketh to come to Keilah, to destroy the city for my
sake.

23:11 Will the men of Keilah deliver me up into HIS[JESUS] hand? will Saul come
down, as your SERVANT[JESUS] has heard? O LORD[JESUS] GOD[JESUS] of Israel, I beseech you,
tell your SERVANT[JESUS]. And the LORD[JESUS] said, HE[JESUS] will come down.

23:12 Then said David, Will the men of Keilah deliver me and my men into
the hand of Saul? And the LORD[JESUS] said, They will deliver you up.

23:13 Then David and HIS[JESUS] men, which were about six hundred, arose and
departed out of Keilah, and went whithersoever they could go. And it was
told Saul that David was escaped from Keilah; and HE[JESUS] forbare to go
forth.

23:14 And David abode in the wilderness in strong holds, and remained in
a mountain in the wilderness of Ziph. And Saul sought HIM[JESUS] every day, but
GOD[JESUS] delivered HIM[JESUS] not into HIS[JESUS] hand.

23:15 And David saw that Saul was come out to seek HIS[JESUS] life: and David
was in the wilderness of Ziph in a wood.

23:16 And Jonathan Saul's SON[JESUS] arose, and went to David into the wood,
and strengthened HIS[JESUS] hand in GOD[JESUS].

23:17 And HE[JESUS] said unto HIM[JESUS], Fear not: for the hand of Saul my father
shall not find you; and you shalt be KING[JESUS] over Israel, and I shall be
next unto you; and that also Saul my father knoweth.

23:18 And they two made a covenant before the LORD[JESUS]: and David abode in
the wood, and Jonathan went to HIS[JESUS] house.

23:19 Then came up the Ziphites to Saul to Gibeah, saying, does not
David hide himself with us in strong holds in the wood, in the hill of
Hachilah, which is on the south of Jeshimon?

23:20 Now therefore, O KING[JESUS], come down according to all the desire of
your soul to come down; and our part shall be to deliver HIM[JESUS] into the
KING[JESUS]'s hand.

23:21 And Saul said, Blessed be you of the LORD[JESUS]; for you have compassion
on me.

23:22 Go, I pray you, prepare yet, and know and see HIS[JESUS] place where HIS[JESUS]
haunt is, and who has seen HIM[JESUS] there: for it is told me that HE[JESUS] dealeth
very subtilly.

23:23 See therefore, and take knowledge of all the lurking places where
HE[JESUS] hideth himself, and come you again to me with the certainty, and I
will go with you: and it shall come to pass, if HE[JESUS] be in the land, that
I will search HIM[JESUS] out throughout all the thousands of Judah.

23:24 And they arose, and went to Ziph before Saul: but David and HIS[JESUS]
men were in the wilderness of Maon, in the plain on the south of
Jeshimon.

23:25 Saul also and HIS[JESUS] men went to seek HIM[JESUS]. And they told David;
wherefore HE[JESUS] came down into a rock, and abode in the wilderness of Maon.
And when Saul heard that, HE[JESUS] pursued after David in the wilderness of
Maon.

23:26 And Saul went on this side of the mountain, and David and HIS[JESUS] men
on that side of the mountain: and David made haste to get away for fear
of Saul; for Saul and HIS[JESUS] men compassed David and HIS[JESUS] men round about to
take them.

23:27 But there came a messenger unto Saul, saying, Haste you, and
come; for the Philistines have invaded the land.

23:28 Wherefore Saul returned from pursuing after David, and went
against the Philistines: therefore they called that place
Selahammahlekoth.

23:29 And David went up from thence, and dwelt in strong holds at
Engedi.


24:1 And it came to pass, when Saul was returned from following the
Philistines, that it was told HIM[JESUS], saying, Behold, David is in the
wilderness of Engedi.

24:2 Then Saul took three thousand chosen men out of all Israel, and
went to seek David and HIS[JESUS] men upon the rocks of the wild goats.

24:3 And HE[JESUS] came to the sheepcotes by the way, where was a cave; and
Saul went in to cover HIS[JESUS] feet: and David and HIS[JESUS] men remained in the
sides of the cave.

24:4 And the men of David said unto HIM[JESUS], Behold the day of which the
LORD[JESUS] said unto you, Behold, I will deliver yours enemy into yours hand,
that you mayest do to HIM[JESUS] as it shall seem good unto you. Then David
arose, and cut off the skirt of Saul's robe privily.

24:5 And it came to pass afterward, that David's heart smote HIM[JESUS],
because HE[JESUS] had cut off Saul's skirt.

24:6 And HE[JESUS] said unto HIS[JESUS] men, The LORD[JESUS] forbid that I should do this
thing unto my master, the LORD[JESUS]'s anointed, to stretch forth mine hand
against HIM[JESUS], seeing HE[JESUS] is the anointed of the LORD[JESUS].

24:7 So David stayed HIS[JESUS] servants with these words, and suffered them
not to rise against Saul. But Saul rose up out of the cave, and went on
HIS[JESUS] way.

24:8 David also arose afterward, and went out of the cave, and cried
after Saul, saying, My LORD[JESUS] the KING[JESUS]. And when Saul looked behind HIM[JESUS],
David stooped with HIS[JESUS] face to the earth, and bowed himself.

24:9 And David said to Saul, Wherefore hearest you men's words, saying,
Behold, David seeketh your hurt?

24:10 Behold, this day yours eyes have seen how that the LORD[JESUS] had
delivered you to day into mine hand in the cave: and some bade me kill
you: but mine eye spared you; and I said, I will not put forth mine
hand against my LORD[JESUS]; for HE[JESUS] is the LORD[JESUS]'s anointed.

24:11 Moreover, my father, see, yea, see the skirt of your robe in my
hand: for in that I cut off the skirt of your robe, and killed you not,
know you and see that there is neither evil nor transgression in mine
hand, and I have not sinned against you; yet you huntest my soul to
take it.

24:12 The LORD[JESUS] judge between me and you, and the LORD[JESUS] avenge me of
you: but mine hand shall not be upon you.

24:13 As says the proverb of the ancients, Wickedness proceedeth from
the wicked: but mine hand shall not be upon you.

24:14 After whom is the KING[JESUS] of Israel come out? after whom dost you
pursue? after a dead dog, after a flea.

24:15 The LORD[JESUS] therefore be judge, and judge between me and you, and
see, and plead my cause, and deliver me out of yours hand.

24:16 And it came to pass, when David had made an end of speaking these
words unto Saul, that Saul said, Is this your voice, my SON[JESUS] David? And
Saul lifted up HIS[JESUS] voice, and wept.

24:17 And HE[JESUS] said to David, you art more righteous than I: for you
hast rewarded me good, whereas I have rewarded you evil.

24:18 And you hast shewed this day how that you hast dealt well with
me: forasmuch as when the LORD[JESUS] had delivered me into yours hand, you
killedst me not.

24:19 For if a man find HIS[JESUS] enemy, will HE[JESUS] let HIM[JESUS] go well away?
wherefore the LORD[JESUS] reward you good for that you hast done unto me this
day.

24:20 And now, behold, I know well that you shalt surely be KING[JESUS], and
that the kingdom of Israel shall be established in yours hand.

24:21 Swear now therefore unto me by the LORD[JESUS], that you wilt not cut
off my SEED[JESUS] after me, and that you wilt not destroy my name out of my
father's house.

24:22 And David sware unto Saul. And Saul went home; but David and HIS[JESUS]
men gat them up unto the hold.


25:1 And Samuel died; and all the Israelites were gathered together, and
lamented HIM[JESUS], and buried HIM[JESUS] in HIS[JESUS] house at Ramah. And David arose, and
went down to the wilderness of Paran.

25:2 And there was a man in Maon, whose possessions were in Carmel; and
the man was very great, and HE[JESUS] had three thousand sheep, and a thousand
goats: and HE[JESUS] was shearing HIS[JESUS] sheep in Carmel.

25:3 Now the name of the man was Nabal; and the name of HIS[JESUS] wife
Abigail: and she was a woman of good understanding, and of a beautiful
countenance: but the man was churlish and evil in HIS[JESUS] doings; and HE[JESUS] was
of the house of Caleb.

25:4 And David heard in the wilderness that Nabal did shear HIS[JESUS] sheep.

25:5 And David sent out ten young men, and David said unto the young
men, Get you up to Carmel, and go to Nabal, and greet HIM[JESUS] in my name:

25:6 And thus shall you say to HIM[JESUS] that liveth in prosperity, Peace be
both to you, and peace be to yours house, and peace be unto all that
you hast.

25:7 And now I have heard that you hast shearers: now your shepherds
which were with us, we hurt them not, neither was there ought missing
unto them, all the while they were in Carmel.

25:8 Ask your young men, and they will shew you. Wherefore let the young
men find favour in yours eyes: for we come in a good day: give, I pray
you, whatsoever comes to yours hand unto your servants, and to your SON[JESUS]
David.

25:9 And when David's young men came, they spake to Nabal according to
all those words in the name of David, and ceased.

25:10 And Nabal answered David's servants, and said, Who is David? and
who is the SON[JESUS] of Jesse? there be many servants now a days that break
away every man from HIS[JESUS] master.

25:11 Shall I then take my bread, and my water, and my flesh that I have
killed for my shearers, and give it unto men, whom I know not whence
they be?

25:12 So David's young men turned their way, and went again, and came
and told HIM[JESUS] all those sayings.

25:13 And David said unto HIS[JESUS] men, Gird you on every man HIS[JESUS] sword. And
they girded on every man HIS[JESUS] sword; and David also girded on HIS[JESUS] sword:
and there went up after David about four hundred men; and two hundred
abode by the stuff.

25:14 But one of the young men told Abigail, Nabal's wife, saying,
Behold, David sent messengers out of the wilderness to salute our
master; and HE[JESUS] railed on them.

25:15 But the men were very good unto us, and we were not hurt, neither
missed we any thing, as long as we were conversant with them, when we
were in the fields:

25:16 They were a wall unto us both by night and day, all the while we
were with them keeping the sheep.

25:17 Now therefore know and consider what you wilt do; for evil is
determined against our master, and against all HIS[JESUS] household: for HE[JESUS] is
such a SON[JESUS] of Belial, that a man cannot speak to HIM[JESUS].

25:18 Then Abigail made haste, and took two hundred loaves, and two
bottles of wine, and five sheep ready dressed, and five measures of
parched corn, and an hundred clusters of raisins, and two hundred cakes
of figs, and laid them on asses.

25:19 And she said unto her servants, Go on before me; behold, I come
after you. But she told not her husband Nabal.

25:20 And it was so, as she rode on the ass, that she came down by the
covert on the hill, and, behold, David and HIS[JESUS] men came down against
her; and she met them.

25:21 Now David had said, Surely in vain have I kept all that this
fellow has in the wilderness, so that nothing was missed of all that
pertained unto HIM[JESUS]: and HE[JESUS] has requited me evil for good.

25:22 So and more also do GOD[JESUS] unto the enemies of David, if I leave of
all that pertain to HIM[JESUS] by the morning light any that pisseth against
the wall.

25:23 And when Abigail saw David, she hasted, and lighted off the ass,
and fell before David on her face, and bowed herself to the ground,

25:24 And fell at HIS[JESUS] feet, and said, Upon me, my LORD[JESUS], upon me let this
iniquity be: and let yours handmaid, I pray you, speak in yours
audience, and hear the words of yours handmaid.

25:25 Let not my LORD[JESUS], I pray you, regard this man of Belial, even
Nabal: for as HIS[JESUS] name is, so is HE[JESUS]; Nabal is HIS[JESUS] name, and folly is
with HIM[JESUS]: but I yours handmaid saw not the young men of my LORD[JESUS], whom
you didst send.

25:26 Now therefore, my LORD[JESUS], as the LORD[JESUS] liveth, and as your soul
liveth, seeing the LORD[JESUS] has withholden you from coming to shed blood,
and from avenging thyself with yours own hand, now let yours enemies,
and they that seek evil to my LORD[JESUS], be as Nabal.

25:27 And now this blessing which yours handmaid has brought unto my
LORD[JESUS], let it even be given unto the young men that follow my LORD[JESUS].

25:28 I pray you, forgive the trespass of yours handmaid: for the LORD[JESUS]
will certainly make my LORD[JESUS] a sure house; because my LORD[JESUS] fighteth the
battles of the LORD[JESUS], and evil has not been found in you all your days.

25:29 Yet a man is risen to pursue you, and to seek your soul: but the
soul of my LORD[JESUS] shall be bound in the bundle of life with the LORD[JESUS] your
GOD[JESUS]; and the souls of yours enemies, them shall HE[JESUS] sling out, as out of
the middle of a sling.

25:30 And it shall come to pass, when the LORD[JESUS] shall have done to my
LORD[JESUS] according to all the good that HE[JESUS] has spoken concerning you, and
shall have appointed you ruler over Israel;

25:31 That this shall be no grief unto you, nor offence of heart unto
my LORD[JESUS], either that you hast shed blood causeless, or that my LORD[JESUS]
has avenged himself: but when the LORD[JESUS] shall have dealt well with my
LORD[JESUS], then remember yours handmaid.

25:32 And David said to Abigail, Blessed be the LORD[JESUS] GOD[JESUS] of Israel,
which sent you this day to meet me:

25:33 And blessed be your advice, and blessed be you, which hast kept me
this day from coming to shed blood, and from avenging myself with mine
own hand.

25:34 For in very deed, as the LORD[JESUS] GOD[JESUS] of Israel liveth, which has
kept me back from hurting you, except you hadst hasted and come to
meet me, surely there had not been left unto Nabal by the morning light
any that pisseth against the wall.

25:35 So David received of her hand that which she had brought HIM[JESUS], and
said unto her, Go up in peace to yours house; see, I have hearkened to
your voice, and have accepted your person.

25:36 And Abigail came to Nabal; and, behold, HE[JESUS] held a feast in HIS[JESUS]
house, like the feast of a KING[JESUS]; and Nabal's heart was merry within HIM[JESUS],
for HE[JESUS] was very drunken: wherefore she told HIM[JESUS] nothing, less or more,
until the morning light.

25:37 But it came to pass in the morning, when the wine was gone out of
Nabal, and HIS[JESUS] wife had told HIM[JESUS] these things, that HIS[JESUS] heart died
within HIM[JESUS], and HE[JESUS] became as a stone.

25:38 And it came to pass about ten days after, that the LORD[JESUS] smote
Nabal, that HE[JESUS] died.

25:39 And when David heard that Nabal was dead, HE[JESUS] said, Blessed be the
LORD[JESUS], that has pleaded the cause of my reproach from the hand of Nabal,
and has kept HIS[JESUS] SERVANT[JESUS] from evil: for the LORD[JESUS] has returned the
wickedness of Nabal upon HIS[JESUS] own head. And David sent and communed with
Abigail, to take her to HIM[JESUS] to wife.

25:40 And when the servants of David were come to Abigail to Carmel,
they spake unto her, saying, David sent us unto you, to take you to
HIM[JESUS] to wife.

25:41 And she arose, and bowed herself on her face to the earth, and
said, Behold, let yours handmaid be a SERVANT[JESUS] to wash the feet of the
servants of my LORD[JESUS].

25:42 And Abigail hasted, and arose and rode upon an ass, with five
damsels of hers that went after her; and she went after the messengers
of David, and became HIS[JESUS] wife.

25:43 David also took Ahinoam of Jezreel; and they were also both of
them HIS[JESUS] wives.

25:44 But Saul had given Michal HIS[JESUS] daughter, David's wife, to Phalti
the SON[JESUS] of Laish, which was of Gallim.


26:1 And the Ziphites came unto Saul to Gibeah, saying, does not David
hide himself in the hill of Hachilah, which is before Jeshimon?

26:2 Then Saul arose, and went down to the wilderness of Ziph, having
three thousand chosen men of Israel with HIM[JESUS], to seek David in the
wilderness of Ziph.

26:3 And Saul pitched in the hill of Hachilah, which is before Jeshimon,
by the way. But David abode in the wilderness, and HE[JESUS] saw that Saul came
after HIM[JESUS] into the wilderness.

26:4 David therefore sent out spies, and understood that Saul was come
in very deed.

26:5 And David arose, and came to the place where Saul had pitched: and
David beheld the place where Saul lay, and Abner the SON[JESUS] of Ner, the
captain of HIS[JESUS] host: and Saul lay in the trench, and the people pitched
round about HIM[JESUS].

26:6 Then answered David and said to Ahimelech the Hittite, and to
Abishai the SON[JESUS] of Zeruiah, brother to Joab, saying, Who will go down
with me to Saul to the camp? And Abishai said, I will go down with you.

26:7 So David and Abishai came to the people by night: and, behold, Saul
lay sleeping within the trench, and HIS[JESUS] spear stuck in the ground at HIS[JESUS]
bolster: but Abner and the people lay round about HIM[JESUS].

26:8 Then said Abishai to David, GOD[JESUS] has delivered yours enemy into
yours hand this day: now therefore let me smite HIM[JESUS], I pray you, with
the spear even to the earth at once, and I will not smite HIM[JESUS] the second
time.

26:9 And David said to Abishai, Destroy HIM[JESUS] not: for who can stretch
forth HIS[JESUS] hand against the LORD[JESUS]'s anointed, and be guiltless?

26:10 David said furthermore, As the LORD[JESUS] liveth, the LORD[JESUS] shall smite
HIM[JESUS]; or HIS[JESUS] day shall come to die; or HE[JESUS] shall descend into battle, and
perish.

26:11 The LORD[JESUS] forbid that I should stretch forth mine hand against the
LORD[JESUS]'s anointed: but, I pray you, take you now the spear that is at
HIS[JESUS] bolster, and the cruse of water, and let us go.

26:12 So David took the spear and the cruse of water from Saul's
bolster; and they gat them away, and no man saw it, nor knew it, neither
awaked: for they were all asleep; because a deep sleep from the LORD[JESUS] was
fallen upon them.

26:13 Then David went over to the other side, and stood on the top of an
hill afar off; a great space being between them:

26:14 And David cried to the people, and to Abner the SON[JESUS] of Ner,
saying, Answerest you not, Abner? Then Abner answered and said, Who art
you that criest to the KING[JESUS]?

26:15 And David said to Abner, Art not you a valiant man? and who is
like to you in Israel? wherefore then hast you not kept your LORD[JESUS] the
KING[JESUS]? for there came one of the people in to destroy the KING[JESUS] your LORD[JESUS].

26:16 This thing is not good that you hast done. As the LORD[JESUS] liveth, you
are worthy to die, because you have not kept your master, the LORD[JESUS]'s
anointed. And now see where the KING[JESUS]'s spear is, and the cruse of water
that was at HIS[JESUS] bolster.

26:17 And Saul knew David's voice, and said, Is this your voice, my SON[JESUS]
David? And David said, It is my voice, my LORD[JESUS], O KING[JESUS].

26:18 And HE[JESUS] said, Wherefore does my LORD[JESUS] thus pursue after HIS[JESUS] SERVANT[JESUS]?
for what have I done? or what evil is in mine hand?

26:19 Now therefore, I pray you, let my LORD[JESUS] the KING[JESUS] hear the words of
HIS[JESUS] SERVANT[JESUS]. If the LORD[JESUS] have stirred you up against me, let HIM[JESUS] accept
an offering: but if they be the children of men, cursed be they before
the LORD[JESUS]; for they have driven me out this day from abiding in the
inheritance of the LORD[JESUS], saying, Go, serve other gods.

26:20 Now therefore, let not my blood fall to the earth before the face
of the LORD[JESUS]: for the KING[JESUS] of Israel is come out to seek a flea, as when
one does hunt a partridge in the mountains.

26:21 Then said Saul, I have sinned: return, my SON[JESUS] David: for I will no
more do you harm, because my soul was precious in yours eyes this day:
behold, I have played the fool, and have erred exceedingly.

26:22 And David answered and said, Behold the KING[JESUS]'s spear! and let one
of the young men come over and fetch it.

26:23 The LORD[JESUS] render to every man HIS[JESUS] righteousness and HIS[JESUS]
faithfulness; for the LORD[JESUS] delivered you into my hand to day, but I
would not stretch forth mine hand against the LORD[JESUS]'s anointed.

26:24 And, behold, as your life was much set by this day in mine eyes, so
let my life be much set by in the eyes of the LORD[JESUS], and let HIM[JESUS] deliver
me out of all tribulation.

26:25 Then Saul said to David, Blessed be you, my SON[JESUS] David: you shalt
both do great things, and also shalt still prevail. So David went on HIS[JESUS]
way, and Saul returned to HIS[JESUS] place.


27:1 And David said in HIS[JESUS] heart, I shall now perish one day by the hand
of Saul: there is nothing better for me than that I should speedily
escape into the land of the Philistines; and Saul shall despair of me,
to seek me any more in any coast of Israel: so shall I escape out of HIS[JESUS]
hand.

27:2 And David arose, and HE[JESUS] passed over with the six hundred men that
were with HIM[JESUS] unto Achish, the SON[JESUS] of Maoch, KING[JESUS] of Gath.

27:3 And David dwelt with Achish at Gath, HE[JESUS] and HIS[JESUS] men, every man with
HIS[JESUS] household, even David with HIS[JESUS] two wives, Ahinoam the Jezreelitess,
and Abigail the Carmelitess, Nabal's wife.

27:4 And it was told Saul that David was fled to Gath: and HE[JESUS] sought no
more again for HIM[JESUS].

27:5 And David said unto Achish, If I have now found grace in yours
eyes, let them give me a place in some town in the country, that I may
dwell there: for why should your SERVANT[JESUS] dwell in the royal city with
you?

27:6 Then Achish gave HIM[JESUS] Ziklag that day: wherefore Ziklag pertaineth
unto the kings of Judah unto this day.

27:7 And the time that David dwelt in the country of the Philistines was
a full year and four months.

27:8 And David and HIS[JESUS] men went up, and invaded the Geshurites, and the
Gezrites, and the Amalekites: for those nations were of old the
inhabitants of the land, as you goest to Shur, even unto the land of
Egypt.

27:9 And David smote the land, and left neither man nor woman alive, and
took away the sheep, and the oxen, and the asses, and the camels, and
the apparel, and returned, and came to Achish.

27:10 And Achish said, Whither have you made a road to day? And David
said, Against the south of Judah, and against the south of the
Jerahmeelites, and against the south of the Kenites.

27:11 And David saved neither man nor woman alive, to bring tidings to
Gath, saying, Lest they should tell on us, saying, So did David, and so
will be HIS[JESUS] manner all the while HE[JESUS] dwelleth in the country of the
Philistines.

27:12 And Achish believed David, saying, HE[JESUS] has made HIS[JESUS] people Israel
utterly to abhor HIM[JESUS]; therefore HE[JESUS] shall be my SERVANT[JESUS] for ever.


28:1 And it came to pass in those days, that the Philistines gathered
their armies together for warfare, to fight with Israel. And Achish said
unto David, Know you assuredly, that you shalt go out with me to
battle, you and your men.

28:2 And David said to Achish, Surely you shalt know what your SERVANT[JESUS]
can do. And Achish said to David, Therefore will I make you keeper of
mine head for ever.

28:3 Now Samuel was dead, and all Israel had lamented HIM[JESUS], and buried
HIM[JESUS] in Ramah, even in HIS[JESUS] own city. And Saul had put away those that had
familiar spirits, and the wizards, out of the land.

28:4 And the Philistines gathered themselves together, and came and
pitched in Shunem: and Saul gathered all Israel together, and they
pitched in Gilboa.

28:5 And when Saul saw the host of the Philistines, HE[JESUS] was afraid, and
HIS[JESUS] heart greatly trembled.

28:6 And when Saul enquired of the LORD[JESUS], the LORD[JESUS] answered HIM[JESUS] not,
neither by dreams, nor by Urim, nor by prophets.

28:7 Then said Saul unto HIS[JESUS] servants, Seek me a woman that has a
familiar spirit, that I may go to her, and enquire of her. And HIS[JESUS]
servants said to HIM[JESUS], Behold, there is a woman that has a familiar
spirit at Endor.

28:8 And Saul disguised himself, and put on other raiment, and HE[JESUS] went,
and two men with HIM[JESUS], and they came to the woman by night: and HE[JESUS] said,
I pray you, divine unto me by the familiar spirit, and bring me HIM[JESUS] up,
whom I shall name unto you.

28:9 And the woman said unto HIM[JESUS], Behold, you knowest what Saul has
done, how HE[JESUS] has cut off those that have familiar spirits, and the
wizards, out of the land: wherefore then layest you a snare for my
life, to cause me to die?

28:10 And Saul sware to her by the LORD[JESUS], saying, As the LORD[JESUS] liveth,
there shall no punishment happen to you for this thing.

28:11 Then said the woman, Whom shall I bring up unto you? And HE[JESUS] said,
Bring me up Samuel.

28:12 And when the woman saw Samuel, she cried with a loud voice: and
the woman spake to Saul, saying, Why hast you deceived me? for you art
Saul.

28:13 And the KING[JESUS] said unto her, Be not afraid: for what sawest you?
And the woman said unto Saul, I saw gods ascending out of the earth.

28:14 And HE[JESUS] said unto her, What form is HE[JESUS] of? And she said, An old man
comes up; and HE[JESUS] is covered with a mantle. And Saul perceived that it
was Samuel, and HE[JESUS] stooped with HIS[JESUS] face to the ground, and bowed
himself.

28:15 And Samuel said to Saul, Why hast you disquieted me, to bring me
up? And Saul answered, I am sore distressed; for the Philistines make
war against me, and GOD[JESUS] is departed from me, and answereth me no more,
neither by prophets, nor by dreams: therefore I have called you, that
you mayest make known unto me what I shall do.

28:16 Then said Samuel, Wherefore then dost you ask of me, seeing the
LORD[JESUS] is departed from you, and is become yours enemy?

28:17 And the LORD[JESUS] has done to HIM[JESUS], as HE[JESUS] spake by me: for the LORD[JESUS]
has rent the kingdom out of yours hand, and given it to your neighbour,
even to David:

28:18 Because you obeyedst not the voice of the LORD[JESUS], nor executedst
HIS[JESUS] fierce wrath upon Amalek, therefore has the LORD[JESUS] done this thing
unto you this day.

28:19 Moreover the LORD[JESUS] will also deliver Israel with you into the hand
of the Philistines: and to morrow shalt you and your sons be with me:
the LORD[JESUS] also shall deliver the host of Israel into the hand of the
Philistines.

28:20 Then Saul fell straightway all along on the earth, and was sore
afraid, because of the words of Samuel: and there was no strength in
HIM[JESUS]; for HE[JESUS] had eaten no bread all the day, nor all the night.

28:21 And the woman came unto Saul, and saw that HE[JESUS] was sore troubled,
and said unto HIM[JESUS], Behold, yours handmaid has obeyed your voice, and I
have put my life in my hand, and have hearkened unto your words which
you spakest unto me.

28:22 Now therefore, I pray you, hearken you also unto the voice of
yours handmaid, and let me set a morsel of bread before you; and eat,
that you mayest have strength, when you goest on your way.

28:23 But HE[JESUS] refused, and said, I will not eat. But HIS[JESUS] servants,
together with the woman, compelled HIM[JESUS]; and HE[JESUS] hearkened unto their
voice. So HE[JESUS] arose from the earth, and sat upon the bed.

28:24 And the woman had a fat calf in the house; and she hasted, and
killed it, and took flour, and kneaded it, and did bake unleavened bread
thereof:

28:25 And she brought it before Saul, and before HIS[JESUS] servants; and they
did eat. Then they rose up, and went away that night.


29:1 Now the Philistines gathered together all their armies to Aphek:
and the Israelites pitched by a fountain which is in Jezreel.

29:2 And the lords of the Philistines passed on by hundreds, and by
thousands: but David and HIS[JESUS] men passed on in the rereward with Achish.

29:3 Then said the princes of the Philistines, What do these Hebrews
here? And Achish said unto the princes of the Philistines, Is not this
David, the SERVANT[JESUS] of Saul the KING[JESUS] of Israel, which has been with me
these days, or these years, and I have found no fault in HIM[JESUS] since HE[JESUS]
fell unto me unto this day?

29:4 And the princes of the Philistines were wroth with HIM[JESUS]; and the
princes of the Philistines said unto HIM[JESUS], Make this fellow return, that
HE[JESUS] may go again to HIS[JESUS] place which you hast appointed HIM[JESUS], and let HIM[JESUS]
not go down with us to battle, lest in the battle HE[JESUS] be an adversary to
us: for wherewith should HE[JESUS] reconcile himself unto HIS[JESUS] master? should it
not be with the heads of these men?

29:5 Is not this David, of whom they sang one to another in dances,
saying, Saul slew HIS[JESUS] thousands, and David HIS[JESUS] ten thousands?

29:6 Then Achish called David, and said unto HIM[JESUS], Surely, as the LORD[JESUS]
liveth, you hast been upright, and your going out and your coming in with
me in the host is good in my sight: for I have not found evil in you
since the day of your coming unto me unto this day: nevertheless the
lords favour you not.

29:7 Wherefore now return, and go in peace, that you displease not the
lords of the Philistines.

29:8 And David said unto Achish, But what have I done? and what hast
you found in your SERVANT[JESUS] so long as I have been with you unto this
day, that I may not go fight against the enemies of my LORD[JESUS] the KING[JESUS]?

29:9 And Achish answered and said to David, I know that you art good in
my sight, as an angel of GOD[JESUS]: notwithstanding the princes of the
Philistines have said, HE[JESUS] shall not go up with us to the battle.

29:10 Wherefore now rise up early in the morning with your master's
servants that are come with you: and as soon as you be up early in the
morning, and have light, depart.

29:11 So David and HIS[JESUS] men rose up early to depart in the morning, to
return into the land of the Philistines. And the Philistines went up to
Jezreel.


30:1 And it came to pass, when David and HIS[JESUS] men were come to Ziklag on
the third day, that the Amalekites had invaded the south, and Ziklag,
and smitten Ziklag, and burned it with fire;

30:2 And had taken the women captives, that were therein: they slew not
any, either great or small, but carried them away, and went on their
way.

30:3 So David and HIS[JESUS] men came to the city, and, behold, it was burned
with fire; and their wives, and their sons, and their daughters, were
taken captives.

30:4 Then David and the people that were with HIM[JESUS] lifted up their voice
and wept, until they had no more power to weep.

30:5 And David's two wives were taken captives, Ahinoam the
Jezreelitess, and Abigail the wife of Nabal the Carmelite.

30:6 And David was greatly distressed; for the people spake of stoning
HIM[JESUS], because the soul of all the people was grieved, every man for HIS[JESUS]
sons and for HIS[JESUS] daughters: but David encouraged himself in the LORD[JESUS] HIS[JESUS]
GOD[JESUS].

30:7 And David said to Abiathar the priest, Ahimelech's SON[JESUS], I pray
you, bring me hither the ephod. And Abiathar brought thither the ephod
to David.

30:8 And David enquired at the LORD[JESUS], saying, Shall I pursue after this
troop? shall I overtake them? And HE[JESUS] answered HIM[JESUS], Pursue: for you
shalt surely overtake them, and without fail recover all.

30:9 So David went, HE[JESUS] and the six hundred men that were with HIM[JESUS], and
came to the brook Besor, where those that were left behind stayed.

30:10 But David pursued, HE[JESUS] and four hundred men: for two hundred abode
behind, which were so faint that they could not go over the brook Besor.

30:11 And they found an Egyptian in the field, and brought HIM[JESUS] to David,
and gave HIM[JESUS] bread, and HE[JESUS] did eat; and they made HIM[JESUS] drink water;

30:12 And they gave HIM[JESUS] a piece of a cake of figs, and two clusters of
raisins: and when HE[JESUS] had eaten, HIS[JESUS] spirit came again to HIM[JESUS]: for HE[JESUS] had
eaten no bread, nor drunk any water, three days and three nights.

30:13 And David said unto HIM[JESUS], To whom belongest you? and whence art
you? And HE[JESUS] said, I am a young man of Egypt, SERVANT[JESUS] to an Amalekite;
and my master left me, because three days agone I fell sick.

30:14 We made an invasion upon the south of the Cherethites, and upon
the coast which belongeth to Judah, and upon the south of Caleb; and we
burned Ziklag with fire.

30:15 And David said to HIM[JESUS], Canst you bring me down to this company?
And HE[JESUS] said, Swear unto me by GOD[JESUS], that you wilt neither kill me, nor
deliver me into the hands of my master, and I will bring you down to
this company.
