30:16 And when HE[JESUS] had brought HIM[JESUS] down, behold, they were spread abroad
upon all the earth, eating and drinking, and dancing, because of all the
great spoil that they had taken out of the land of the Philistines, and
out of the land of Judah.

30:17 And David smote them from the twilight even unto the evening of
the next day: and there escaped not a man of them, save four hundred
young men, which rode upon camels, and fled.

30:18 And David recovered all that the Amalekites had carried away: and
David rescued HIS[JESUS] two wives.

30:19 And there was nothing lacking to them, neither small nor great,
neither sons nor daughters, neither spoil, nor any thing that they had
taken to them: David recovered all.

30:20 And David took all the flocks and the herds, which they drave
before those other cattle, and said, This is David's spoil.

30:21 And David came to the two hundred men, which were so faint that
they could not follow David, whom they had made also to abide at the
brook Besor: and they went forth to meet David, and to meet the people
that were with HIM[JESUS]: and when David came near to the people, HE[JESUS] saluted
them.

30:22 Then answered all the wicked men and men of Belial, of those that
went with David, and said, Because they went not with us, we will not
give them ought of the spoil that we have recovered, save to every man
HIS[JESUS] wife and HIS[JESUS] children, that they may lead them away, and depart.

30:23 Then said David, you shall not do so, my brethren, with that which
the LORD[JESUS] has given us, who has preserved us, and delivered the company
that came against us into our hand.

30:24 For who will hearken unto you in this matter? but as HIS[JESUS] part is
that goes down to the battle, so shall HIS[JESUS] part be that tarrieth by the
stuff: they shall part alike.

30:25 And it was so from that day forward, that HE[JESUS] made it a statute and
an ordinance for Israel unto this day.

30:26 And when David came to Ziklag, HE[JESUS] sent of the spoil unto the
elders of Judah, even to HIS[JESUS] friends, saying, Behold a present for you
of the spoil of the enemies of the LORD[JESUS];

30:27 To them which were in Bethel, and to them which were in south
Ramoth, and to them which were in Jattir,

30:28 And to them which were in Aroer, and to them which were in
Siphmoth, and to them which were in Eshtemoa,

30:29 And to them which were in Rachal, and to them which were in the
cities of the Jerahmeelites, and to them which were in the cities of the
Kenites,

30:30 And to them which were in Hormah, and to them which were in
Chorashan, and to them which were in Athach,

30:31 And to them which were in Hebron, and to all the places where
David himself and HIS[JESUS] men were wont to haunt.


31:1 Now the Philistines fought against Israel: and the men of Israel
fled from before the Philistines, and fell down slain in mount Gilboa.

31:2 And the Philistines followed hard upon Saul and upon HIS[JESUS] sons; and
the Philistines slew Jonathan, and Abinadab, and Melchishua, Saul's
sons.

31:3 And the battle went sore against Saul, and the archers hit HIM[JESUS]; and
HE[JESUS] was sore wounded of the archers.

31:4 Then said Saul unto HIS[JESUS] armourbearer, Draw your sword, and thrust me
through therewith; lest these uncircumcised come and thrust me through,
and abuse me. But HIS[JESUS] armourbearer would not; for HE[JESUS] was sore afraid.
Therefore Saul took a sword, and fell upon it.

31:5 And when HIS[JESUS] armourbearer saw that Saul was dead, HE[JESUS] fell likewise
upon HIS[JESUS] sword, and died with HIM[JESUS].

31:6 So Saul died, and HIS[JESUS] three sons, and HIS[JESUS] armourbearer, and all HIS[JESUS]
men, that same day together.

31:7 And when the men of Israel that were on the other side of the
valley, and they that were on the other side Jordan, saw that the men of
Israel fled, and that Saul and HIS[JESUS] sons were dead, they forsook the
cities, and fled; and the Philistines came and dwelt in them.

31:8 And it came to pass on the morrow, when the Philistines came to
strip the slain, that they found Saul and HIS[JESUS] three sons fallen in mount
Gilboa.

31:9 And they cut off HIS[JESUS] head, and stripped off HIS[JESUS] armour, and sent
into the land of the Philistines round about, to publish it in the house
of their idols, and among the people.

31:10 And they put HIS[JESUS] armour in the house of Ashtaroth: and they
fastened HIS[JESUS] body to the wall of Bethshan.

31:11 And when the inhabitants of Jabeshgilead heard of that which the
Philistines had done to Saul;

31:12 All the valiant men arose, and went all night, and took the body
of Saul and the bodies of HIS[JESUS] sons from the wall of Bethshan, and came
to Jabesh, and burnt them there.

31:13 And they took their bones, and buried them under a tree at Jabesh,
and fasted seven days.

1:1 Now it came to pass after the death of Saul, when David was returned
from the slaughter of the Amalekites, and David had abode two days in
Ziklag;

1:2 It came even to pass on the third day, that, behold, a man came out
of the camp from Saul with HIS[JESUS] clothes rent, and earth upon HIS[JESUS] head:
and so it was, when HE[JESUS] came to David, that HE[JESUS] fell to the earth, and did
obeisance.

1:3 And David said unto HIM[JESUS], From whence comest you? And HE[JESUS] said unto
HIM[JESUS], Out of the camp of Israel am I escaped.

1:4 And David said unto HIM[JESUS], How went the matter? I pray you, tell me.
And HE[JESUS] answered, That the people are fled from the battle, and many of
the people also are fallen and dead; and Saul and Jonathan HIS[JESUS] SON[JESUS] are
dead also.

1:5 And David said unto the young man that told HIM[JESUS], How knowest you
that Saul and Jonathan HIS[JESUS] SON[JESUS] be dead?

1:6 And the young man that told HIM[JESUS] said, As I happened by chance upon
mount Gilboa, behold, Saul leaned upon HIS[JESUS] spear; and, lo, the chariots
and horsemen followed hard after HIM[JESUS].

1:7 And when HE[JESUS] looked behind HIM[JESUS], HE[JESUS] saw me, and called unto me. And I
answered, Here am I.

1:8 And HE[JESUS] said unto me, Who art you? And I answered HIM[JESUS], I am an
Amalekite.

1:9 HE[JESUS] said unto me again, Stand, I pray you, upon me, and slay me: for
anguish is come upon me, because my life is yet whole in me.

1:10 So I stood upon HIM[JESUS], and slew HIM[JESUS], because I was sure that HE[JESUS] could
not live after that HE[JESUS] was fallen: and I took the crown that was upon
HIS[JESUS] head, and the bracelet that was on HIS[JESUS] arm, and have brought them
hither unto my LORD[JESUS].

1:11 Then David took hold on HIS[JESUS] clothes, and rent them; and likewise
all the men that were with HIM[JESUS]:

1:12 And they mourned, and wept, and fasted until even, for Saul, and
for Jonathan HIS[JESUS] SON[JESUS], and for the people of the LORD[JESUS], and for the house
of Israel; because they were fallen by the sword.

1:13 And David said unto the young man that told HIM[JESUS], Whence art you?
And HE[JESUS] answered, I am the SON[JESUS] of a stranger, an Amalekite.

1:14 And David said unto HIM[JESUS], How wast you not afraid to stretch forth
yours hand to destroy the LORD[JESUS]'s anointed?

1:15 And David called one of the young men, and said, Go near, and fall
upon HIM[JESUS]. And HE[JESUS] smote HIM[JESUS] that HE[JESUS] died.

1:16 And David said unto HIM[JESUS], your blood be upon your head; for your mouth
has testified against you, saying, I have slain the LORD[JESUS]'s anointed.

1:17 And David lamented with this lamentation over Saul and over
Jonathan HIS[JESUS] SON[JESUS]:

1:18 (Also HE[JESUS] bade them teach the children of Judah the use of the bow:
behold, it is written in the book of Jasher.)

1:19 The beauty of Israel is slain upon your high places: how are the
mighty fallen!

1:20 Tell it not in Gath, publish it not in the streets of Askelon; lest
the daughters of the Philistines rejoice, lest the daughters of the
uncircumcised triumph.

1:21 you mountains of Gilboa, let there be no dew, neither let there be
rain, upon you, nor fields of offerings: for there the shield of the
mighty is vilely cast away, the shield of Saul, as though HE[JESUS] had not
been anointed with oil.

1:22 From the blood of the slain, from the fat of the mighty, the bow of
Jonathan turned not back, and the sword of Saul returned not empty.

1:23 Saul and Jonathan were lovely and pleasant in their lives, and in
their death they were not divided: they were swifter than eagles, they
were stronger than lions.

1:24 you daughters of Israel, weep over Saul, who clothed you in scarlet,
with other delights, who put on ornaments of gold upon your apparel.

1:25 How are the mighty fallen in the midst of the battle! O Jonathan,
you wast slain in yours high places.

1:26 I am distressed for you, my brother Jonathan: very pleasant hast
you been unto me: your love to me was WONDERFUL[JESUS], passing the love of
women.

1:27 How are the mighty fallen, and the weapons of war perished!


2:1 And it came to pass after this, that David enquired of the LORD[JESUS],
saying, Shall I go up into any of the cities of Judah? And the LORD[JESUS] said
unto HIM[JESUS], Go up. And David said, Whither shall I go up? And HE[JESUS] said,
Unto Hebron.

2:2 So David went up thither, and HIS[JESUS] two wives also, Ahinoam the
Jezreelitess, and Abigail Nabal's wife the Carmelite.

2:3 And HIS[JESUS] men that were with HIM[JESUS] did David bring up, every man with
HIS[JESUS] household: and they dwelt in the cities of Hebron.

2:4 And the men of Judah came, and there they anointed David KING[JESUS] over
the house of Judah. And they told David, saying, That the men of
Jabeshgilead were they that buried Saul.

2:5 And David sent messengers unto the men of Jabeshgilead, and said
unto them, Blessed be you of the LORD[JESUS], that you have shewed this kindness
unto your LORD[JESUS], even unto Saul, and have buried HIM[JESUS].

2:6 And now the LORD[JESUS] shew kindness and truth unto you: and I also will
requite you this kindness, because you have done this thing.

2:7 Therefore now let your hands be strengthened, and be you valiant: for
your master Saul is dead, and also the house of Judah have anointed me
KING[JESUS] over them.

2:8 But Abner the SON[JESUS] of Ner, captain of Saul's host, took Ishbosheth
the SON[JESUS] of Saul, and brought HIM[JESUS] over to Mahanaim;

2:9 And made HIM[JESUS] KING[JESUS] over Gilead, and over the Ashurites, and over
Jezreel, and over Ephraim, and over Benjamin, and over all Israel.

2:10 Ishbosheth Saul's SON[JESUS] was forty years old when HE[JESUS] began to reign
over Israel, and reigned two years. But the house of Judah followed
David.

2:11 And the time that David was KING[JESUS] in Hebron over the house of Judah
was seven years and six months.

2:12 And Abner the SON[JESUS] of Ner, and the servants of Ishbosheth the SON[JESUS] of
Saul, went out from Mahanaim to Gibeon.

2:13 And Joab the SON[JESUS] of Zeruiah, and the servants of David, went out,
and met together by the pool of Gibeon: and they sat down, the one on
the one side of the pool, and the other on the other side of the pool.

2:14 And Abner said to Joab, Let the young men now arise, and play
before us. And Joab said, Let them arise.

2:15 Then there arose and went over by number twelve of Benjamin, which
pertained to Ishbosheth the SON[JESUS] of Saul, and twelve of the servants of
David.

2:16 And they caught every one HIS[JESUS] fellow by the head, and thrust HIS[JESUS]
sword in HIS[JESUS] fellow's side; so they fell down together: wherefore that
place was called Helkathhazzurim, which is in Gibeon.

2:17 And there was a very sore battle that day; and Abner was beaten,
and the men of Israel, before the servants of David.

2:18 And there were three sons of Zeruiah there, Joab, and Abishai, and
Asahel: and Asahel was as light of foot as a wild roe.

2:19 And Asahel pursued after Abner; and in going HE[JESUS] turned not to the
right hand nor to the left from following Abner.

2:20 Then Abner looked behind HIM[JESUS], and said, Art you Asahel? And HE[JESUS]
answered, I am.

2:21 And Abner said to HIM[JESUS], Turn you aside to your right hand or to your
left, and lay you hold on one of the young men, and take you HIS[JESUS]
armour. But Asahel would not turn aside from following of HIM[JESUS].

2:22 And Abner said again to Asahel, Turn you aside from following me:
wherefore should I smite you to the ground? how then should I hold up
my face to Joab your brother?

2:23 Howbeit HE[JESUS] refused to turn aside: wherefore Abner with the hinder
end of the spear smote HIM[JESUS] under the fifth rib, that the spear came out
behind HIM[JESUS]; and HE[JESUS] fell down there, and died in the same place: and it
came to pass, that as many as came to the place where Asahel fell down
and died stood still.

2:24 Joab also and Abishai pursued after Abner: and the sun went down
when they were come to the hill of Ammah, that lieth before Giah by the
way of the wilderness of Gibeon.

2:25 And the children of Benjamin gathered themselves together after
Abner, and became one troop, and stood on the top of an hill.

2:26 Then Abner called to Joab, and said, Shall the sword devour for
ever? knowest you not that it will be bitterness in the latter end? how
long shall it be then, ere you bid the people return from following
their brethren?

2:27 And Joab said, As GOD[JESUS] liveth, unless you hadst spoken, surely then
in the morning the people had gone up every one from following HIS[JESUS]
brother.

2:28 So Joab blew a trumpet, and all the people stood still, and pursued
after Israel no more, neither fought they any more.

2:29 And Abner and HIS[JESUS] men walked all that night through the plain, and
passed over Jordan, and went through all Bithron, and they came to
Mahanaim.

2:30 And Joab returned from following Abner: and when HE[JESUS] had gathered
all the people together, there lacked of David's servants nineteen men
and Asahel.

2:31 But the servants of David had smitten of Benjamin, and of Abner's
men, so that three hundred and threescore men died.

2:32 And they took up Asahel, and buried HIM[JESUS] in the sepulchre of HIS[JESUS]
father, which was in Bethlehem. And Joab and HIS[JESUS] men went all night, and
they came to Hebron at break of day.


3:1 Now there was long war between the house of Saul and the house of
David: but David waxed stronger and stronger, and the house of Saul
waxed weaker and weaker.

3:2 And unto David were sons born in Hebron: and HIS[JESUS] firstborn was
Amnon, of Ahinoam the Jezreelitess;

3:3 And HIS[JESUS] second, Chileab, of Abigail the wife of Nabal the Carmelite;
and the third, Absalom the SON[JESUS] of Maacah the daughter of Talmai KING[JESUS] of
Geshur;

3:4 And the fourth, Adonijah the SON[JESUS] of Haggith; and the fifth,
Shephatiah the SON[JESUS] of Abital;

3:5 And the sixth, Ithream, by Eglah David's wife. These were born to
David in Hebron.

3:6 And it came to pass, while there was war between the house of Saul
and the house of David, that Abner made himself strong for the house of

3:7 And Saul had a concubine, whose name was Rizpah, the daughter of

3:8 Then was Abner very wroth for the words of Ishbosheth, and said, Am

3:9 So do GOD[JESUS] to Abner, and more also, except, as the LORD[JESUS] has sworn to
David, even so I do to HIM[JESUS];

3:10 To translate the kingdom from the house of Saul, and to set up the

3:11 And HE[JESUS] could not answer Abner a WORD[JESUS] again, because HE[JESUS] feared HIM[JESUS].

3:12 And Abner sent messengers to David on HIS[JESUS] behalf, saying, Whose is

3:13 And HE[JESUS] said, Well; I will make a league with you: but one thing I
require of you, that is, you shalt not see my face, except you first

3:14 And David sent messengers to Ishbosheth Saul's SON[JESUS], saying, Deliver

3:15 And Ishbosheth sent, and took her from her husband, even from

3:16 And her husband went with her along weeping behind her to Bahurim.

3:17 And Abner had communication with the elders of Israel, saying, you

3:18 Now then do it: for the LORD[JESUS] has spoken of David, saying, By the

3:19 And Abner also spake in the ears of Benjamin: and Abner went also
to speak in the ears of David in Hebron all that seemed good to Israel,

3:20 So Abner came to David to Hebron, and twenty men with HIM[JESUS]. And

3:21 And Abner said unto David, I will arise and go, and will gather all
Israel unto my LORD[JESUS] the KING[JESUS], that they may make a league with you, and
that you mayest reign over all that yours heart desireth. And David
sent Abner away; and HE[JESUS] went in peace.

3:22 And, behold, the servants of David and Joab came from pursuing a
troop, and brought in a great spoil with them: but Abner was not with
David in Hebron; for HE[JESUS] had sent HIM[JESUS] away, and HE[JESUS] was gone in peace.

3:23 When Joab and all the host that was with HIM[JESUS] were come, they told
Joab, saying, Abner the SON[JESUS] of Ner came to the KING[JESUS], and HE[JESUS] has sent
HIM[JESUS] away, and HE[JESUS] is gone in peace.

3:24 Then Joab came to the KING[JESUS], and said, What hast you done? behold,
Abner came unto you; why is it that you hast sent HIM[JESUS] away, and HE[JESUS] is
quite gone?

3:25 you knowest Abner the SON[JESUS] of Ner, that HE[JESUS] came to deceive you,
and to know your going out and your coming in, and to know all that you

3:26 And when Joab was come out from David, HE[JESUS] sent messengers after

3:27 And when Abner was returned to Hebron, Joab took HIM[JESUS] aside in the

that HE[JESUS] died, for the blood of Asahel HIS[JESUS] brother.

3:28 And afterward when David heard it, HE[JESUS] said, I and my kingdom are
guiltless before the LORD[JESUS] for ever from the blood of Abner the SON[JESUS] of

3:29 Let it rest on the head of Joab, and on all HIS[JESUS] father's house; and
let there not fail from the house of Joab one that has an issue, or

3:30 So Joab, and Abishai HIS[JESUS] brother slew Abner, because HE[JESUS] had slain
their brother Asahel at Gibeon in the battle.

3:31 And David said to Joab, and to all the people that were with HIM[JESUS],
Rend your clothes, and gird you with sackcloth, and mourn before Abner.
And KING[JESUS] David himself followed the bier.

3:32 And they buried Abner in Hebron: and the KING[JESUS] lifted up HIS[JESUS] voice,
and wept at the grave of Abner; and all the people wept.

3:33 And the KING[JESUS] lamented over Abner, and said, Died Abner as a fool
dieth?

3:34 your hands were not bound, nor your feet put into fetters: as a man
falleth before wicked men, so fellest you. And all the people wept
again over HIM[JESUS].

3:35 And when all the people came to cause David to eat meat while it
was yet day, David sware, saying, So do GOD[JESUS] to me, and more also, if I
taste bread, or ought else, till the sun be down.

3:36 And all the people took notice of it, and it pleased them: as
whatsoever the KING[JESUS] did pleased all the people.

3:37 For all the people and all Israel understood that day that it was
not of the KING[JESUS] to slay Abner the SON[JESUS] of Ner.

3:38 And the KING[JESUS] said unto HIS[JESUS] servants, Know you not that there is a
prince and a great man fallen this day in Israel?

3:39 And I am this day weak, though anointed KING[JESUS]; and these men the
sons of Zeruiah be too hard for me: the LORD[JESUS] shall reward the doer of
evil according to HIS[JESUS] wickedness.


4:1 And when Saul's SON[JESUS] heard that Abner was dead in Hebron, HIS[JESUS] hands
were feeble, and all the Israelites were troubled.

4:2 And Saul's SON[JESUS] had two men that were captains of bands: the name of
the one was Baanah, and the name of the other Rechab, the sons of Rimmon
a Beerothite, of the children of Benjamin: (for Beeroth also was
reckoned to Benjamin.

4:3 And the Beerothites fled to Gittaim, and were sojourners there until
this day.)

4:4 And Jonathan, Saul's SON[JESUS], had a SON[JESUS] that was lame of HIS[JESUS] feet. HE[JESUS]
was five years old when the tidings came of Saul and Jonathan out of
Jezreel, and HIS[JESUS] nurse took HIM[JESUS] up, and fled: and it came to pass, as
she made haste to flee, that HE[JESUS] fell, and became lame. And HIS[JESUS] name was
Mephibosheth.

4:5 And the sons of Rimmon the Beerothite, Rechab and Baanah, went, and
came about the heat of the day to the house of Ishbosheth, who lay on a
bed at noon.

4:6 And they came thither into the midst of the house, as though they
would have fetched wheat; and they smote HIM[JESUS] under the fifth rib: and
Rechab and Baanah HIS[JESUS] brother escaped.

4:7 For when they came into the house, HE[JESUS] lay on HIS[JESUS] bed in HIS[JESUS]
bedchamber, and they smote HIM[JESUS], and slew HIM[JESUS], and beheaded HIM[JESUS], and took
HIS[JESUS] head, and gat them away through the plain all night.

4:8 And they brought the head of Ishbosheth unto David to Hebron, and
said to the KING[JESUS], Behold the head of Ishbosheth the SON[JESUS] of Saul yours
enemy, which sought your life; and the LORD[JESUS] has avenged my LORD[JESUS] the KING[JESUS]
this day of Saul, and of HIS[JESUS] SEED[JESUS].

4:9 And David answered Rechab and Baanah HIS[JESUS] brother, the sons of Rimmon
the Beerothite, and said unto them, As the LORD[JESUS] liveth, who has
redeemed my soul out of all adversity,

4:10 When one told me, saying, Behold, Saul is dead, thinking to have
brought good tidings, I took hold of HIM[JESUS], and slew HIM[JESUS] in Ziklag, who
thought that I would have given HIM[JESUS] a reward for HIS[JESUS] tidings:

4:11 How much more, when wicked men have slain a righteous person in HIS[JESUS]
own house upon HIS[JESUS] bed? shall I not therefore now require HIS[JESUS] blood of
your hand, and take you away from the earth?

4:12 And David commanded HIS[JESUS] young men, and they slew them, and cut off
their hands and their feet, and hanged them up over the pool in Hebron.
But they took the head of Ishbosheth, and buried it in the sepulchre of
Abner in Hebron.


5:1 Then came all the tribes of Israel to David unto Hebron, and spake,
saying, Behold, we are your bone and your flesh.

5:2 Also in time past, when Saul was KING[JESUS] over us, you wast HE[JESUS] that
leddest out and broughtest in Israel: and the LORD[JESUS] said to you, you
shalt feed my people Israel, and you shalt be a captain over Israel.

5:3 So all the elders of Israel came to the KING[JESUS] to Hebron; and KING[JESUS]
David made a league with them in Hebron before the LORD[JESUS]: and they
anointed David KING[JESUS] over Israel.

5:4 David was thirty years old when HE[JESUS] began to reign, and HE[JESUS] reigned
forty years.

5:5 In Hebron HE[JESUS] reigned over Judah seven years and six months: and in
Jerusalem HE[JESUS] reigned thirty and three years over all Israel and Judah.

5:6 And the KING[JESUS] and HIS[JESUS] men went to Jerusalem unto the Jebusites, the
inhabitants of the land: which spake unto David, saying, Except you
take away the blind and the lame, you shalt not come in hither:
thinking, David cannot come in hither.

5:7 Nevertheless David took the strong hold of Zion: the same is the
city of David.

5:8 And David said on that day, whoever getteth up to the gutter, and
smiteth the Jebusites, and the lame and the blind that are hated of
David's soul, HE[JESUS] shall be chief and captain. Wherefore they said, The
blind and the lame shall not come into the house.

5:9 So David dwelt in the fort, and called it the city of David. And
David built round about from Millo and inward.

5:10 And David went on, and grew great, and the LORD[JESUS] GOD[JESUS] of hosts was
with HIM[JESUS].

5:11 And Hiram KING[JESUS] of Tyre sent messengers to David, and cedar trees,
and carpenters, and masons: and they built David an house.

5:12 And David perceived that the LORD[JESUS] had established HIM[JESUS] KING[JESUS] over
Israel, and that HE[JESUS] had exalted HIS[JESUS] kingdom for HIS[JESUS] people Israel's
sake.

5:13 And David took HIM[JESUS] more concubines and wives out of Jerusalem,
after HE[JESUS] was come from Hebron: and there were yet sons and daughters
born to David.

5:14 And these be the names of those that were born unto HIM[JESUS] in
Jerusalem; Shammuah, and Shobab, and Nathan, and Solomon,

5:15 Ibhar also, and Elishua, and Nepheg, and Japhia,

5:16 And Elishama, and Eliada, and Eliphalet.

5:17 But when the Philistines heard that they had anointed David KING[JESUS]
over Israel, all the Philistines came up to seek David; and David heard
of it, and went down to the hold.

5:18 The Philistines also came and spread themselves in the valley of
Rephaim.

5:19 And David enquired of the LORD[JESUS], saying, Shall I go up to the
Philistines? wilt you deliver them into mine hand? And the LORD[JESUS] said
unto David, Go up: for I will doubtless deliver the Philistines into
yours hand.

5:20 And David came to Baalperazim, and David smote them there, and
said, The LORD[JESUS] has broken forth upon mine enemies before me, as the
breach of waters. Therefore HE[JESUS] called the name of that place
Baalperazim.

5:21 And there they left their images, and David and HIS[JESUS] men burned
them.

5:22 And the Philistines came up yet again, and spread themselves in the
valley of Rephaim.

5:23 And when David enquired of the LORD[JESUS], HE[JESUS] said, you shalt not go up;
but fetch a compass behind them, and come upon them over against the
mulberry trees.

5:24 And let it be, when you hearest the sound of a going in the tops
of the mulberry trees, that then you shalt bestir thyself: for then
shall the LORD[JESUS] go out before you, to smite the host of the Philistines.

5:25 And David did so, as the LORD[JESUS] had commanded HIM[JESUS]; and smote the
Philistines from Geba until you come to Gazer.


6:1 Again, David gathered together all the chosen men of Israel, thirty
thousand.

6:2 And David arose, and went with all the people that were with HIM[JESUS]
from Baale of Judah, to bring up from thence the ark of GOD[JESUS], whose name
is called by the name of the LORD[JESUS] of hosts that dwelleth between the
cherubims.

6:3 And they set the ark of GOD[JESUS] upon a new cart, and brought it out of
the house of Abinadab that was in Gibeah: and Uzzah and Ahio, the sons
of Abinadab, drave the new cart.

6:4 And they brought it out of the house of Abinadab which was at
Gibeah, accompanying the ark of GOD[JESUS]: and Ahio went before the ark.

6:5 And David and all the house of Israel played before the LORD[JESUS] on all
manner of instruments made of fir wood, even on harps, and on
psalteries, and on timbrels, and on cornets, and on cymbals.

6:6 And when they came to Nachon's threshingfloor, Uzzah put forth HIS[JESUS]
hand to the ark of GOD[JESUS], and took hold of it; for the oxen shook it.

6:7 And the anger of the LORD[JESUS] was kindled against Uzzah; and GOD[JESUS] smote
HIM[JESUS] there for HIS[JESUS] error; and there HE[JESUS] died by the ark of GOD[JESUS].

6:8 And David was displeased, because the LORD[JESUS] had made a breach upon
Uzzah: and HE[JESUS] called the name of the place Perezuzzah to this day.

6:9 And David was afraid of the LORD[JESUS] that day, and said, How shall the
ark of the LORD[JESUS] come to me?

6:10 So David would not remove the ark of the LORD[JESUS] unto HIM[JESUS] into the
city of David: but David carried it aside into the house of Obededom the
Gittite.

6:11 And the ark of the LORD[JESUS] continued in the house of Obededom the
Gittite three months: and the LORD[JESUS] blessed Obededom, and all HIS[JESUS]
household.

6:12 And it was told KING[JESUS] David, saying, The LORD[JESUS] has blessed the house
of Obededom, and all that pertaineth unto HIM[JESUS], because of the ark of
GOD[JESUS]. So David went and brought up the ark of GOD[JESUS] from the house of
Obededom into the city of David with gladness.

6:13 And it was so, that when they that bare the ark of the LORD[JESUS] had
gone six paces, HE[JESUS] sacrificed oxen and fatlings.

6:14 And David danced before the LORD[JESUS] with all HIS[JESUS] might; and David was
girded with a linen ephod.

6:15 So David and all the house of Israel brought up the ark of the LORD[JESUS]
with shouting, and with the sound of the trumpet.

6:16 And as the ark of the LORD[JESUS] came into the city of David, Michal
Saul's daughter looked through a window, and saw KING[JESUS] David leaping and
dancing before the LORD[JESUS]; and she despised HIM[JESUS] in her heart.

6:17 And they brought in the ark of the LORD[JESUS], and set it in HIS[JESUS] place,
in the midst of the tabernacle that David had pitched for it: and David
offered burnt offerings and peace offerings before the LORD[JESUS].

6:18 And as soon as David had made an end of offering burnt offerings
and peace offerings, HE[JESUS] blessed the people in the name of the LORD[JESUS] of
hosts.

6:19 And HE[JESUS] dealt among all the people, even among the whole multitude
of Israel, as well to the women as men, to every one a cake of bread,
and a good piece of flesh, and a flagon of wine. So all the people
departed every one to HIS[JESUS] house.

6:20 Then David returned to bless HIS[JESUS] household. And Michal the daughter
of Saul came out to meet David, and said, How glorious was the KING[JESUS] of
Israel to day, who uncovered himself to day in the eyes of the handmaids
of HIS[JESUS] servants, as one of the vain fellows shamelessly uncovereth
himself!

6:21 And David said unto Michal, It was before the LORD[JESUS], which chose me
before your father, and before all HIS[JESUS] house, to appoint me ruler over
the people of the LORD[JESUS], over Israel: therefore will I play before the
LORD[JESUS].

6:22 And I will yet be more vile than thus, and will be base in mine own
sight: and of the maidservants which you hast spoken of, of them shall
I be had in honour.

6:23 Therefore Michal the daughter of Saul had no child unto the day of
her death.


7:1 And it came to pass, when the KING[JESUS] sat in HIS[JESUS] house, and the LORD[JESUS]
had given HIM[JESUS] rest round about from all HIS[JESUS] enemies;

7:2 That the KING[JESUS] said unto Nathan the PROPHET[JESUS], See now, I dwell in an
house of cedar, but the ark of GOD[JESUS] dwelleth within curtains.

7:3 And Nathan said to the KING[JESUS], Go, do all that is in yours heart; for
the LORD[JESUS] is with you.

7:4 And it came to pass that night, that the WORD[JESUS] of the LORD[JESUS] came unto
Nathan, saying,

7:5 Go and tell my SERVANT[JESUS] David, Thus says the LORD[JESUS], Shalt you build
me an house for me to dwell in?

7:6 Whereas I have not dwelt in any house since the time that I brought
up the children of Israel out of Egypt, even to this day, but have
walked in a tent and in a tabernacle.

7:7 In all the places wherein I have walked with all the children of
Israel spake I a WORD[JESUS] with any of the tribes of Israel, whom I commanded
to feed my people Israel, saying, Why build you not me an house of cedar?

7:8 Now therefore so shalt you say unto my SERVANT[JESUS] David, Thus says
the LORD[JESUS] of hosts, I took you from the sheepcote, from following the
sheep, to be ruler over my people, over Israel:

7:9 And I was with you whithersoever you wentest, and have cut off all
yours enemies out of your sight, and have made you a great name, like
unto the name of the great men that are in the earth.

7:10 Moreover I will appoint a place for my people Israel, and will
plant them, that they may dwell in a place of their own, and move no
more; neither shall the children of wickedness afflict them any more, as
beforetime,

7:11 And as since the time that I commanded judges to be over my people
Israel, and have caused you to rest from all yours enemies. Also the
LORD[JESUS] telleth you that HE[JESUS] will make you an house.

7:12 And when your days be fulfilled, and you shalt sleep with your
fathers, I will set up your SEED[JESUS] after you, which shall proceed out of
your bowels, and I will establish HIS[JESUS] kingdom.

7:13 HE[JESUS] shall build an house for my name, and I will stablish the throne
of HIS[JESUS] kingdom for ever.

7:14 I will be HIS[JESUS] father, and HE[JESUS] shall be my SON[JESUS]. If HE[JESUS] commit
iniquity, I will chasten HIM[JESUS] with the rod of men, and with the stripes
of the children of men:

7:15 But my mercy shall not depart away from HIM[JESUS], as I took it from
Saul, whom I put away before you.

7:16 And yours house and your kingdom shall be established for ever
before you: your throne shall be established for ever.

7:17 According to all these words, and according to all this vision, so
did Nathan speak unto David.

7:18 Then went KING[JESUS] David in, and sat before the LORD[JESUS], and HE[JESUS] said, Who
am I, O LORD[JESUS] GOD[JESUS]? and what is my house, that you hast brought me
hitherto?

7:19 And this was yet a small thing in your sight, O LORD[JESUS] GOD[JESUS]; but you
hast spoken also of your SERVANT[JESUS]'s house for a great while to come. And
is this the manner of man, O LORD[JESUS] GOD[JESUS]?

7:20 And what can David say more unto you? for you, LORD[JESUS] GOD[JESUS], knowest
your SERVANT[JESUS].

7:21 For your WORD[JESUS]'s sake, and according to yours own heart, hast you
done all these great things, to make your SERVANT[JESUS] know them.

7:22 Wherefore you art great, O LORD[JESUS] GOD[JESUS]: for there is none like you,
neither is there any GOD[JESUS] beside you, according to all that we have
heard with our ears.

7:23 And what one nation in the earth is like your people, even like
Israel, whom GOD[JESUS] went to redeem for a people to himself, and to make HIM[JESUS]
a name, and to do for you great things and terrible, for your land,
before your people, which you redeemedst to you from Egypt, from the
nations and their gods?

7:24 For you hast confirmed to thyself your people Israel to be a people
unto you for ever: and you, LORD[JESUS], art become their GOD[JESUS].

7:25 And now, O LORD[JESUS] GOD[JESUS], the WORD[JESUS] that you hast spoken concerning your
SERVANT[JESUS], and concerning HIS[JESUS] house, establish it for ever, and do as you
hast said.

7:26 And let your name be magnified for ever, saying, The LORD[JESUS] of hosts
is the GOD[JESUS] over Israel: and let the house of your SERVANT[JESUS] David be
established before you.

7:27 For you, O LORD[JESUS] of hosts, GOD[JESUS] of Israel, hast revealed to your
SERVANT[JESUS], saying, I will build you an house: therefore has your SERVANT[JESUS]
found in HIS[JESUS] heart to pray this prayer unto you.

7:28 And now, O LORD[JESUS] GOD[JESUS], you art that GOD[JESUS], and your words be true, and
you hast promised this goodness unto your SERVANT[JESUS]:

7:29 Therefore now let it please you to bless the house of your SERVANT[JESUS],
that it may continue for ever before you: for you, O LORD[JESUS] GOD[JESUS], hast
spoken it: and with your blessing let the house of your SERVANT[JESUS] be blessed
for ever.


8:1 And after this it came to pass that David smote the Philistines, and
subdued them: and David took Methegammah out of the hand of the
Philistines.

8:2 And HE[JESUS] smote Moab, and measured them with a line, casting them down
to the ground; even with two lines measured HE[JESUS] to put to death, and with
one full line to keep alive. And so the Moabites became David's
servants, and brought gifts.

8:3 David smote also Hadadezer, the SON[JESUS] of Rehob, KING[JESUS] of Zobah, as HE[JESUS]
went to recover HIS[JESUS] border at the river Euphrates.

8:4 And David took from HIM[JESUS] a thousand chariots, and seven hundred
horsemen, and twenty thousand footmen: and David houghed all the chariot
horses, but reserved of them for an hundred chariots.

8:5 And when the Syrians of Damascus came to succour Hadadezer KING[JESUS] of
Zobah, David slew of the Syrians two and twenty thousand men.

8:6 Then David put garrisons in Syria of Damascus: and the Syrians
became servants to David, and brought gifts. And the LORD[JESUS] preserved
David whithersoever HE[JESUS] went.

8:7 And David took the shields of gold that were on the servants of
Hadadezer, and brought them to Jerusalem.

8:8 And from Betah, and from Berothai, cities of Hadadezer, KING[JESUS] David
took exceeding much brass.

8:9 When Toi KING[JESUS] of Hamath heard that David had smitten all the host of
Hadadezer,

8:10 Then Toi sent Joram HIS[JESUS] SON[JESUS] unto KING[JESUS] David, to salute HIM[JESUS], and to
bless HIM[JESUS], because HE[JESUS] had fought against Hadadezer, and smitten HIM[JESUS]: for
Hadadezer had wars with Toi. And Joram brought with HIM[JESUS] vessels of
silver, and vessels of gold, and vessels of brass:

8:11 Which also KING[JESUS] David did dedicate unto the LORD[JESUS], with the silver
and gold that HE[JESUS] had dedicated of all nations which HE[JESUS] subdued;

8:12 Of Syria, and of Moab, and of the children of Ammon, and of the
Philistines, and of Amalek, and of the spoil of Hadadezer, SON[JESUS] of Rehob,
KING[JESUS] of Zobah.

8:13 And David gat HIM[JESUS] a name when HE[JESUS] returned from smiting of the
Syrians in the valley of salt, being eighteen thousand men.

8:14 And HE[JESUS] put garrisons in Edom; throughout all Edom put HE[JESUS] garrisons,
and all they of Edom became David's servants. And the LORD[JESUS] preserved
David whithersoever HE[JESUS] went.

8:15 And David reigned over all Israel; and David executed judgment and
justice unto all HIS[JESUS] people.

8:16 And Joab the SON[JESUS] of Zeruiah was over the host; and Jehoshaphat the
SON[JESUS] of Ahilud was recorder;

8:17 And Zadok the SON[JESUS] of Ahitub, and Ahimelech the SON[JESUS] of Abiathar,
were the priests; and Seraiah was the scribe;

8:18 And Benaiah the SON[JESUS] of Jehoiada was over both the Cherethites and
the Pelethites; and David's sons were chief rulers.


9:1 And David said, Is there yet any that is left of the house of Saul,
that I may shew HIM[JESUS] kindness for Jonathan's sake?

9:2 And there was of the house of Saul a SERVANT[JESUS] whose name was Ziba.
And when they had called HIM[JESUS] unto David, the KING[JESUS] said unto HIM[JESUS], Art
you Ziba? And HE[JESUS] said, your SERVANT[JESUS] is HE[JESUS].

9:3 And the KING[JESUS] said, Is there not yet any of the house of Saul, that I
may shew the kindness of GOD[JESUS] unto HIM[JESUS]? And Ziba said unto the KING[JESUS],
Jonathan has yet a SON[JESUS], which is lame on HIS[JESUS] feet.

9:4 And the KING[JESUS] said unto HIM[JESUS], Where is HE[JESUS]? And Ziba said unto the
KING[JESUS], Behold, HE[JESUS] is in the house of Machir, the SON[JESUS] of Ammiel, in
Lodebar.

9:5 Then KING[JESUS] David sent, and fetched HIM[JESUS] out of the house of Machir,
the SON[JESUS] of Ammiel, from Lodebar.

9:6 Now when Mephibosheth, the SON[JESUS] of Jonathan, the SON[JESUS] of Saul, was
come unto David, HE[JESUS] fell on HIS[JESUS] face, and did reverence. And David said,
Mephibosheth. And HE[JESUS] answered, Behold your SERVANT[JESUS]!

9:7 And David said unto HIM[JESUS], Fear not: for I will surely shew you
kindness for Jonathan your father's sake, and will restore you all the
land of Saul your father; and you shalt eat bread at my table
continually.

9:8 And HE[JESUS] bowed himself, and said, What is your SERVANT[JESUS], that you
shouldest look upon such a dead dog as I am?

9:9 Then the KING[JESUS] called to Ziba, Saul's SERVANT[JESUS], and said unto HIM[JESUS], I
have given unto your master's SON[JESUS] all that pertained to Saul and to all
HIS[JESUS] house.

9:10 you therefore, and your sons, and your servants, shall till the land
for HIM[JESUS], and you shalt bring in the fruits, that your master's SON[JESUS] may
have food to eat: but Mephibosheth your master's SON[JESUS] shall eat bread
alway at my table. Now Ziba had fifteen sons and twenty servants.

9:11 Then said Ziba unto the KING[JESUS], According to all that my LORD[JESUS] the
KING[JESUS] has commanded HIS[JESUS] SERVANT[JESUS], so shall your SERVANT[JESUS] do. As for
Mephibosheth, said the KING[JESUS], HE[JESUS] shall eat at my table, as one of the
KING[JESUS]'s sons.

9:12 And Mephibosheth had a young SON[JESUS], whose name was Micha. And all
that dwelt in the house of Ziba were servants unto Mephibosheth.

9:13 So Mephibosheth dwelt in Jerusalem: for HE[JESUS] did eat continually at
the KING[JESUS]'s table; and was lame on both HIS[JESUS] feet.


10:1 And it came to pass after this, that the KING[JESUS] of the children of
Ammon died, and Hanun HIS[JESUS] SON[JESUS] reigned in HIS[JESUS] stead.

10:2 Then said David, I will shew kindness unto Hanun the SON[JESUS] of Nahash,
as HIS[JESUS] father shewed kindness unto me. And David sent to comfort HIM[JESUS] by
the hand of HIS[JESUS] servants for HIS[JESUS] father. And David's servants came into
the land of the children of Ammon.

10:3 And the princes of the children of Ammon said unto Hanun their
LORD[JESUS], Thinkest you that David does honour your father, that HE[JESUS] has sent
comforters unto you? has not David rather sent HIS[JESUS] servants unto you,
to search the city, and to spy it out, and to overthrow it?

10:4 Wherefore Hanun took David's servants, and shaved off the one half
of their beards, and cut off their garments in the middle, even to their
buttocks, and sent them away.

10:5 When they told it unto David, HE[JESUS] sent to meet them, because the men
were greatly ashamed: and the KING[JESUS] said, Tarry at Jericho until your
beards be grown, and then return.

10:6 And when the children of Ammon saw that they stank before David,
the children of Ammon sent and hired the Syrians of Bethrehob and the
Syrians of Zoba, twenty thousand footmen, and of KING[JESUS] Maacah a thousand
men, and of Ishtob twelve thousand men.

10:7 And when David heard of it, HE[JESUS] sent Joab, and all the host of the
mighty men.

10:8 And the children of Ammon came out, and put the battle in array at
the entering in of the gate: and the Syrians of Zoba, and of Rehob, and
Ishtob, and Maacah, were by themselves in the field.

10:9 When Joab saw that the front of the battle was against HIM[JESUS] before
and behind, HE[JESUS] chose of all the choice men of Israel, and put them in
array against the Syrians:

10:10 And the rest of the people HE[JESUS] delivered into the hand of Abishai
HIS[JESUS] brother, that HE[JESUS] might put them in array against the children of
Ammon.

10:11 And HE[JESUS] said, If the Syrians be too strong for me, then you shalt
help me: but if the children of Ammon be too strong for you, then I
will come and help you.

10:12 Be of good courage, and let us play the men for our people, and
for the cities of our GOD[JESUS]: and the LORD[JESUS] do that which seemeth HIM[JESUS] good.

10:13 And Joab drew nigh, and the people that were with HIM[JESUS], unto the
battle against the Syrians: and they fled before HIM[JESUS].

10:14 And when the children of Ammon saw that the Syrians were fled,
then fled they also before Abishai, and entered into the city. So Joab
returned from the children of Ammon, and came to Jerusalem.

10:15 And when the Syrians saw that they were smitten before Israel,
they gathered themselves together.

10:16 And Hadarezer sent, and brought out the Syrians that were beyond
the river: and they came to Helam; and Shobach the captain of the host
of Hadarezer went before them.

10:17 And when it was told David, HE[JESUS] gathered all Israel together, and
passed over Jordan, and came to Helam. And the Syrians set themselves in
array against David, and fought with HIM[JESUS].

10:18 And the Syrians fled before Israel; and David slew the men of
seven hundred chariots of the Syrians, and forty thousand horsemen, and
smote Shobach the captain of their host, who died there.

10:19 And when all the kings that were servants to Hadarezer saw that
they were smitten before Israel, they made peace with Israel, and served
them. So the Syrians feared to help the children of Ammon any more.


11:1 And it came to pass, after the year was expired, at the time when
kings go forth to battle, that David sent Joab, and HIS[JESUS] servants with
HIM[JESUS], and all Israel; and they destroyed the children of Ammon, and
besieged Rabbah. But David tarried still at Jerusalem.

11:2 And it came to pass in an eveningtide, that David arose from off
HIS[JESUS] bed, and walked upon the roof of the KING[JESUS]'s house: and from the roof
HE[JESUS] saw a woman washing herself; and the woman was very beautiful to look
upon.

11:3 And David sent and enquired after the woman. And one said, Is not
this Bathsheba, the daughter of Eliam, the wife of Uriah the Hittite?

11:4 And David sent messengers, and took her; and she came in unto HIM[JESUS],
and HE[JESUS] lay with her; for she was purified from her uncleanness: and she
returned unto her house.

11:5 And the woman conceived, and sent and told David, and said, I am
with child.

11:6 And David sent to Joab, saying, Send me Uriah the Hittite. And Joab
sent Uriah to David.

11:7 And when Uriah was come unto HIM[JESUS], David demanded of HIM[JESUS] how Joab
did, and how the people did, and how the war prospered.

11:8 And David said to Uriah, Go down to your house, and wash your feet.
And Uriah departed out of the KING[JESUS]'s house, and there followed HIM[JESUS] a
mess of meat from the KING[JESUS].

11:9 But Uriah slept at the door of the KING[JESUS]'s house with all the
servants of HIS[JESUS] LORD[JESUS], and went not down to HIS[JESUS] house.

11:10 And when they had told David, saying, Uriah went not down unto HIS[JESUS]
house, David said unto Uriah, Camest you not from your journey? why then
didst you not go down unto yours house?

11:11 And Uriah said unto David, The ark, and Israel, and Judah, abide
in tents; and my LORD[JESUS] Joab, and the servants of my LORD[JESUS], are encamped in
the open fields; shall I then go into mine house, to eat and to drink,
and to lie with my wife? as you livest, and as your soul liveth, I will
not do this thing.

11:12 And David said to Uriah, Tarry here to day also, and to morrow I
will let you depart. So Uriah abode in Jerusalem that day, and the
morrow.

11:13 And when David had called HIM[JESUS], HE[JESUS] did eat and drink before HIM[JESUS];
and HE[JESUS] made HIM[JESUS] drunk: and at even HE[JESUS] went out to lie on HIS[JESUS] bed with
the servants of HIS[JESUS] LORD[JESUS], but went not down to HIS[JESUS] house.

11:14 And it came to pass in the morning, that David wrote a letter to
Joab, and sent it by the hand of Uriah.

11:15 And HE[JESUS] wrote in the letter, saying, Set you Uriah in the forefront
of the hottest battle, and retire you from HIM[JESUS], that HE[JESUS] may be smitten,
and die.

11:16 And it came to pass, when Joab observed the city, that HE[JESUS] assigned
Uriah unto a place where HE[JESUS] knew that valiant men were.

11:17 And the men of the city went out, and fought with Joab: and there
fell some of the people of the servants of David; and Uriah the Hittite
died also.

11:18 Then Joab sent and told David all the things concerning the war;

11:19 And charged the messenger, saying, When you hast made an end of
telling the matters of the war unto the KING[JESUS],

11:20 And if so be that the KING[JESUS]'s wrath arise, and HE[JESUS] say unto you,
Wherefore approached you so nigh unto the city when you did fight? knew you
not that they would shoot from the wall?

11:21 Who smote Abimelech the SON[JESUS] of Jerubbesheth? did not a woman cast
a piece of a millstone upon HIM[JESUS] from the wall, that HE[JESUS] died in Thebez?
why went you nigh the wall? then say you, your SERVANT[JESUS] Uriah the Hittite
is dead also.

11:22 So the messenger went, and came and shewed David all that Joab had
sent HIM[JESUS] for.

11:23 And the messenger said unto David, Surely the men prevailed
against us, and came out unto us into the field, and we were upon them
even unto the entering of the gate.

11:24 And the shooters shot from off the wall upon your servants; and
some of the KING[JESUS]'s servants be dead, and your SERVANT[JESUS] Uriah the Hittite
is dead also.

11:25 Then David said unto the messenger, Thus shalt you say unto Joab,
Let not this thing displease you, for the sword devoureth one as well
as another: make your battle more strong against the city, and overthrow
it: and encourage you HIM[JESUS].

11:26 And when the wife of Uriah heard that Uriah her husband was dead,
she mourned for her husband.

11:27 And when the mourning was past, David sent and fetched her to HIS[JESUS]
house, and she became HIS[JESUS] wife, and bare HIM[JESUS] a SON[JESUS]. But the thing that
David had done displeased the LORD[JESUS].


12:1 And the LORD[JESUS] sent Nathan unto David. And HE[JESUS] came unto HIM[JESUS], and said
unto HIM[JESUS], There were two men in one city; the one rich, and the other
poor.

12:2 The rich man had exceeding many flocks and herds:

12:3 But the poor man had nothing, save one little ewe LAMB[JESUS], which HE[JESUS]
had bought and nourished up: and it grew up together with HIM[JESUS], and with
HIS[JESUS] children; it did eat of HIS[JESUS] own meat, and drank of HIS[JESUS] own cup, and
lay in HIS[JESUS] bosom, and was unto HIM[JESUS] as a daughter.

12:4 And there came a traveller unto the rich man, and HE[JESUS] spared to take
of HIS[JESUS] own flock and of HIS[JESUS] own herd, to dress for the wayfaring man
that was come unto HIM[JESUS]; but took the poor man's LAMB[JESUS], and dressed it for
the man that was come to HIM[JESUS].

12:5 And David's anger was greatly kindled against the man; and HE[JESUS] said
to Nathan, As the LORD[JESUS] liveth, the man that has done this thing shall
surely die:

12:6 And HE[JESUS] shall restore the LAMB[JESUS] fourfold, because HE[JESUS] did this thing,
and because HE[JESUS] had no pity.

12:7 And Nathan said to David, you art the man. Thus says the LORD[JESUS] GOD[JESUS]
of Israel, I anointed you KING[JESUS] over Israel, and I delivered you out of
the hand of Saul;

12:8 And I gave you your master's house, and your master's wives into your
bosom, and gave you the house of Israel and of Judah; and if that had
been too little, I would moreover have given unto you such and such
things.

12:9 Wherefore hast you despised the commandment of the LORD[JESUS], to do
evil in HIS[JESUS] sight? you hast killed Uriah the Hittite with the sword,
and hast taken HIS[JESUS] wife to be your wife, and hast slain HIM[JESUS] with the
sword of the children of Ammon.

12:10 Now therefore the sword shall never depart from yours house;
because you hast despised me, and hast taken the wife of Uriah the
Hittite to be your wife.

12:11 Thus says the LORD[JESUS], Behold, I will raise up evil against you out
of yours own house, and I will take your wives before yours eyes, and
give them unto your neighbour, and HE[JESUS] shall lie with your wives in the
sight of this sun.

12:12 For you didst it secretly: but I will do this thing before all
Israel, and before the sun.

12:13 And David said unto Nathan, I have sinned against the LORD[JESUS]. And
Nathan said unto David, The LORD[JESUS] also has put away your sin; you shalt
not die.

12:14 Howbeit, because by this deed you hast given great occasion to
the enemies of the LORD[JESUS] to blaspheme, the child also that is born unto
you shall surely die.

12:15 And Nathan departed unto HIS[JESUS] house. And the LORD[JESUS] struck the child
that Uriah's wife bare unto David, and it was very sick.

12:16 David therefore besought GOD[JESUS] for the child; and David fasted, and
went in, and lay all night upon the earth.

12:17 And the elders of HIS[JESUS] house arose, and went to HIM[JESUS], to raise HIM[JESUS]
up from the earth: but HE[JESUS] would not, neither did HE[JESUS] eat bread with them.

12:18 And it came to pass on the seventh day, that the child died. And
the servants of David feared to tell HIM[JESUS] that the child was dead: for
they said, Behold, while the child was yet alive, we spake unto HIM[JESUS], and
HE[JESUS] would not hearken unto our voice: how will HE[JESUS] then vex himself, if we
tell HIM[JESUS] that the child is dead?

12:19 But when David saw that HIS[JESUS] servants whispered, David perceived
that the child was dead: therefore David said unto HIS[JESUS] servants, Is the
child dead? And they said, HE[JESUS] is dead.

12:20 Then David arose from the earth, and washed, and anointed himself,
and changed HIS[JESUS] apparel, and came into the house of the LORD[JESUS], and
worshipped: then HE[JESUS] came to HIS[JESUS] own house; and when HE[JESUS] required, they
set bread before HIM[JESUS], and HE[JESUS] did eat.

12:21 Then said HIS[JESUS] servants unto HIM[JESUS], What thing is this that you hast
done? you didst fast and weep for the child, while it was alive; but
when the child was dead, you didst rise and eat bread.

12:22 And HE[JESUS] said, While the child was yet alive, I fasted and wept: for
I said, Who can tell whether GOD[JESUS] will be gracious to me, that the child
may live?

12:23 But now HE[JESUS] is dead, wherefore should I fast? can I bring HIM[JESUS] back
again? I shall go to HIM[JESUS], but HE[JESUS] shall not return to me.

12:24 And David comforted Bathsheba HIS[JESUS] wife, and went in unto her, and
lay with her: and she bare a SON[JESUS], and HE[JESUS] called HIS[JESUS] name Solomon: and
the LORD[JESUS] loved HIM[JESUS].

12:25 And HE[JESUS] sent by the hand of Nathan the PROPHET[JESUS]; and HE[JESUS] called HIS[JESUS]
name Jedidiah, because of the LORD[JESUS].

12:26 And Joab fought against Rabbah of the children of Ammon, and took
the royal city.

12:27 And Joab sent messengers to David, and said, I have fought against
Rabbah, and have taken the city of waters.

12:28 Now therefore gather the rest of the people together, and encamp
against the city, and take it: lest I take the city, and it be called
after my name.

12:29 And David gathered all the people together, and went to Rabbah,
and fought against it, and took it.

12:30 And HE[JESUS] took their KING[JESUS]'s crown from off HIS[JESUS] head, the weight
whereof was a talent of gold with the precious stones: and it was set on
David's head. And HE[JESUS] brought forth the spoil of the city in great
abundance.

12:31 And HE[JESUS] brought forth the people that were therein, and put them
under saws, and under harrows of iron, and under axes of iron, and made
them pass through the brick-kiln: and thus did HE[JESUS] unto all the cities of
the children of Ammon. So David and all the people returned unto
Jerusalem.


13:1 And it came to pass after this, that Absalom the SON[JESUS] of David had a
fair sister, whose name was Tamar; and Amnon the SON[JESUS] of David loved her.

13:2 And Amnon was so vexed, that HE[JESUS] fell sick for HIS[JESUS] sister Tamar; for
she was a virgin; and Amnon thought it hard for HIM[JESUS] to do anything to
her.

13:3 But Amnon had a friend, whose name was Jonadab, the SON[JESUS] of Shimeah
David's brother: and Jonadab was a very subtil man.

13:4 And HE[JESUS] said unto HIM[JESUS], Why art you, being the KING[JESUS]'s SON[JESUS], lean from
day to day? wilt you not tell me? And Amnon said unto HIM[JESUS], I love
Tamar, my brother Absalom's sister.

13:5 And Jonadab said unto HIM[JESUS], Lay you down on your bed, and make
thyself sick: and when your father comes to see you, say unto HIM[JESUS], I
pray you, let my sister Tamar come, and give me meat, and dress the
meat in my sight, that I may see it, and eat it at her hand.

13:6 So Amnon lay down, and made himself sick: and when the KING[JESUS] was
come to see HIM[JESUS], Amnon said unto the KING[JESUS], I pray you, let Tamar my
sister come, and make me a couple of cakes in my sight, that I may eat
at her hand.

13:7 Then David sent home to Tamar, saying, Go now to your brother
Amnon's house, and dress HIM[JESUS] meat.

13:8 So Tamar went to her brother Amnon's house; and HE[JESUS] was laid down.
And she took flour, and kneaded it, and made cakes in HIS[JESUS] sight, and did
bake the cakes.

13:9 And she took a pan, and poured them out before HIM[JESUS]; but HE[JESUS] refused
to eat. And Amnon said, Have out all men from me. And they went out
every man from HIM[JESUS].

13:10 And Amnon said unto Tamar, Bring the meat into the chamber, that I
may eat of yours hand. And Tamar took the cakes which she had made, and
brought them into the chamber to Amnon her brother.

13:11 And when she had brought them unto HIM[JESUS] to eat, HE[JESUS] took hold of
her, and said unto her, Come lie with me, my sister.

13:12 And she answered HIM[JESUS], Nay, my brother, do not force me; for no
such thing ought to be done in Israel: do not you this folly.

13:13 And I, whither shall I cause my shame to go? and as for you, you
shalt be as one of the fools in Israel. Now therefore, I pray you,
speak unto the KING[JESUS]; for HE[JESUS] will not withhold me from you.

13:14 Howbeit HE[JESUS] would not hearken unto her voice: but, being stronger
than she, forced her, and lay with her.

13:15 Then Amnon hated her exceedingly; so that the hatred wherewith HE[JESUS]
hated her was greater than the love wherewith HE[JESUS] had loved her. And
Amnon said unto her, Arise, be gone.

13:16 And she said unto HIM[JESUS], There is no cause: this evil in sending me
away is greater than the other that you didst unto me. But HE[JESUS] would not
hearken unto her.

13:17 Then HE[JESUS] called HIS[JESUS] SERVANT[JESUS] that ministered unto HIM[JESUS], and said, Put
now this woman out from me, and bolt the door after her.

13:18 And she had a garment of divers colours upon her: for with such
robes were the KING[JESUS]'s daughters that were virgins apparelled. Then HIS[JESUS]
SERVANT[JESUS] brought her out, and bolted the door after her.

13:19 And Tamar put ashes on her head, and rent her garment of divers
colours that was on her, and laid her hand on her head, and went on
crying.

13:20 And Absalom her brother said unto her, has Amnon your brother been
with you? but hold now your peace, my sister: HE[JESUS] is your brother; regard
not this thing. So Tamar remained desolate in her brother Absalom's
house.

13:21 But when KING[JESUS] David heard of all these things, HE[JESUS] was very wroth.

13:22 And Absalom spake unto HIS[JESUS] brother Amnon neither good nor bad: for
Absalom hated Amnon, because HE[JESUS] had forced HIS[JESUS] sister Tamar.

13:23 And it came to pass after two full years, that Absalom had
sheepshearers in Baalhazor, which is beside Ephraim: and Absalom invited
all the KING[JESUS]'s sons.

13:24 And Absalom came to the KING[JESUS], and said, Behold now, your SERVANT[JESUS]
has sheepshearers; let the KING[JESUS], I beseech you, and HIS[JESUS] servants go
with your SERVANT[JESUS].

13:25 And the KING[JESUS] said to Absalom, Nay, my SON[JESUS], let us not all now go,
lest we be chargeable unto you. And HE[JESUS] pressed HIM[JESUS]: howbeit HE[JESUS] would
not go, but blessed HIM[JESUS].

13:26 Then said Absalom, If not, I pray you, let my brother Amnon go
with us. And the KING[JESUS] said unto HIM[JESUS], Why should HE[JESUS] go with you?

13:27 But Absalom pressed HIM[JESUS], that HE[JESUS] let Amnon and all the KING[JESUS]'s sons
go with HIM[JESUS].

13:28 Now Absalom had commanded HIS[JESUS] servants, saying, Mark you now when
Amnon's heart is merry with wine, and when I say unto you, Smite Amnon;
then kill HIM[JESUS], fear not: have not I commanded you? be courageous, and be
valiant.

13:29 And the servants of Absalom did unto Amnon as Absalom had
commanded. Then all the KING[JESUS]'s sons arose, and every man gat HIM[JESUS] up upon
HIS[JESUS] mule, and fled.

13:30 And it came to pass, while they were in the way, that tidings came
to David, saying, Absalom has slain all the KING[JESUS]'s sons, and there is
not one of them left.

13:31 Then the KING[JESUS] arose, and tare HIS[JESUS] garments, and lay on the earth;
and all HIS[JESUS] servants stood by with their clothes rent.

13:32 And Jonadab, the SON[JESUS] of Shimeah David's brother, answered and
said, Let not my LORD[JESUS] suppose that they have slain all the young men the
KING[JESUS]'s sons; for Amnon only is dead: for by the appointment of Absalom
this has been determined from the day that HE[JESUS] forced HIS[JESUS] sister Tamar.

13:33 Now therefore let not my LORD[JESUS] the KING[JESUS] take the thing to HIS[JESUS]
heart, to think that all the KING[JESUS]'s sons are dead: for Amnon only is
dead.

13:34 But Absalom fled. And the young man that kept the watch lifted up
HIS[JESUS] eyes, and looked, and, behold, there came much people by the way of
the hill side behind HIM[JESUS].

13:35 And Jonadab said unto the KING[JESUS], Behold, the KING[JESUS]'s sons come: as
your SERVANT[JESUS] said, so it is.

13:36 And it came to pass, as soon as HE[JESUS] had made an end of speaking,
that, behold, the KING[JESUS]'s sons came, and lifted up their voice and wept:
and the KING[JESUS] also and all HIS[JESUS] servants wept very sore.

13:37 But Absalom fled, and went to Talmai, the SON[JESUS] of Ammihud, KING[JESUS] of
Geshur. And David mourned for HIS[JESUS] SON[JESUS] every day.

13:38 So Absalom fled, and went to Geshur, and was there three years.

13:39 And the soul of KING[JESUS] David longed to go forth unto Absalom: for HE[JESUS]
was comforted concerning Amnon, seeing HE[JESUS] was dead.


14:1 Now Joab the SON[JESUS] of Zeruiah perceived that the KING[JESUS]'s heart was
toward Absalom.

14:2 And Joab sent to Tekoah, and fetched thence a wise woman, and said
unto her, I pray you, feign thyself to be a mourner, and put on now
mourning apparel, and anoint not thyself with oil, but be as a woman
that had a long time mourned for the dead:

14:3 And come to the KING[JESUS], and speak on this manner unto HIM[JESUS]. So Joab
put the words in her mouth.

14:4 And when the woman of Tekoah spake to the KING[JESUS], she fell on her
face to the ground, and did obeisance, and said, Help, O KING[JESUS].

14:5 And the KING[JESUS] said unto her, What aileth you? And she answered, I
am indeed a widow woman, and mine husband is dead.

14:6 And your handmaid had two sons, and they two strove together in the
field, and there was none to part them, but the one smote the other, and
slew HIM[JESUS].

14:7 And, behold, the whole family is risen against yours handmaid, and
they said, Deliver HIM[JESUS] that smote HIS[JESUS] brother, that we may kill HIM[JESUS], for
the life of HIS[JESUS] brother whom HE[JESUS] slew; and we will destroy the heir also:
and so they shall quench my coal which is left, and shall not leave to
my husband neither name nor remainder upon the earth.

14:8 And the KING[JESUS] said unto the woman, Go to yours house, and I will
give charge concerning you.

14:9 And the woman of Tekoah said unto the KING[JESUS], My LORD[JESUS], O KING[JESUS], the
iniquity be on me, and on my father's house: and the KING[JESUS] and HIS[JESUS] throne
be guiltless.

14:10 And the KING[JESUS] said, Whoever says ought unto you, bring HIM[JESUS] to me,
and HE[JESUS] shall not touch you any more.

14:11 Then said she, I pray you, let the KING[JESUS] remember the LORD[JESUS] your
GOD[JESUS], that you wouldest not let the revengers of blood to destroy any
more, lest they destroy my SON[JESUS]. And HE[JESUS] said, As the LORD[JESUS] liveth, there
shall not one hair of your SON[JESUS] fall to the earth.

14:12 Then the woman said, Let yours handmaid, I pray you, speak one
WORD[JESUS] unto my LORD[JESUS] the KING[JESUS]. And HE[JESUS] said, Say on.

14:13 And the woman said, Wherefore then hast you thought such a thing
against the people of GOD[JESUS]? for the KING[JESUS] does speak this thing as one
which is faulty, in that the KING[JESUS] does not fetch home again HIS[JESUS]
banished.

14:14 For we must needs die, and are as water spilt on the ground, which
cannot be gathered up again; neither does GOD[JESUS] respect any person: yet
does HE[JESUS] devise means, that HIS[JESUS] banished be not expelled from HIM[JESUS].

14:15 Now therefore that I am come to speak of this thing unto my LORD[JESUS]
the KING[JESUS], it is because the people have made me afraid: and your handmaid
said, I will now speak unto the KING[JESUS]; it may be that the KING[JESUS] will
perform the request of HIS[JESUS] handmaid.

14:16 For the KING[JESUS] will hear, to deliver HIS[JESUS] handmaid out of the hand of
the man that would destroy me and my SON[JESUS] together out of the inheritance
of GOD[JESUS].

14:17 Then yours handmaid said, The WORD[JESUS] of my LORD[JESUS] the KING[JESUS] shall now
be comfortable: for as an angel of GOD[JESUS], so is my LORD[JESUS] the KING[JESUS] to
discern good and bad: therefore the LORD[JESUS] your GOD[JESUS] will be with you.

14:18 Then the KING[JESUS] answered and said unto the woman, Hide not from me,
I pray you, the thing that I shall ask you. And the woman said, Let my
LORD[JESUS] the KING[JESUS] now speak.

14:19 And the KING[JESUS] said, Is not the hand of Joab with you in all this?
And the woman answered and said, As your soul liveth, my LORD[JESUS] the KING[JESUS],
none can turn to the right hand or to the left from ought that my LORD[JESUS]
the KING[JESUS] has spoken: for your SERVANT[JESUS] Joab, HE[JESUS] bade me, and HE[JESUS] put all
these words in the mouth of yours handmaid:

14:20 To fetch about this form of speech has your SERVANT[JESUS] Joab done this
thing: and my LORD[JESUS] is wise, according to the wisdom of an angel of GOD[JESUS],
to know all things that are in the earth.

14:21 And the KING[JESUS] said unto Joab, Behold now, I have done this thing:
go therefore, bring the young man Absalom again.

14:22 And Joab fell to the ground on HIS[JESUS] face, and bowed himself, and
thanked the KING[JESUS]: and Joab said, To day your SERVANT[JESUS] knoweth that I have
found grace in your sight, my LORD[JESUS], O KING[JESUS], in that the KING[JESUS] has
fulfilled the request of HIS[JESUS] SERVANT[JESUS].

14:23 So Joab arose and went to Geshur, and brought Absalom to
Jerusalem.

14:24 And the KING[JESUS] said, Let HIM[JESUS] turn to HIS[JESUS] own house, and let HIM[JESUS] not
see my face. So Absalom returned to HIS[JESUS] own house, and saw not the
KING[JESUS]'s face.

14:25 But in all Israel there was none to be so much praised as Absalom
for HIS[JESUS] beauty: from the sole of HIS[JESUS] foot even to the crown of HIS[JESUS] head
there was no blemish in HIM[JESUS].

14:26 And when HE[JESUS] polled HIS[JESUS] head, (for it was at every year's end that
HE[JESUS] polled it: because the hair was heavy on HIM[JESUS], therefore HE[JESUS] polled
it:) HE[JESUS] weighed the hair of HIS[JESUS] head at two hundred shekels after the
KING[JESUS]'s weight.

14:27 And unto Absalom there were born three sons, and one daughter,
whose name was Tamar: she was a woman of a fair countenance.

14:28 So Absalom dwelt two full years in Jerusalem, and saw not the
KING[JESUS]'s face.

14:29 Therefore Absalom sent for Joab, to have sent HIM[JESUS] to the KING[JESUS]; but
HE[JESUS] would not come to HIM[JESUS]: and when HE[JESUS] sent again the second time, HE[JESUS]
would not come.

14:30 Therefore HE[JESUS] said unto HIS[JESUS] servants, See, Joab's field is near
mine, and HE[JESUS] has barley there; go and set it on fire. And Absalom's
servants set the field on fire.

14:31 Then Joab arose, and came to Absalom unto HIS[JESUS] house, and said unto
HIM[JESUS], Wherefore have your servants set my field on fire?

14:32 And Absalom answered Joab, Behold, I sent unto you, saying, Come
hither, that I may send you to the KING[JESUS], to say, Wherefore am I come
from Geshur? it had been good for me to have been there still: now
therefore let me see the KING[JESUS]'s face; and if there be any iniquity in
me, let HIM[JESUS] kill me.

14:33 So Joab came to the KING[JESUS], and told HIM[JESUS]: and when HE[JESUS] had called for
Absalom, HE[JESUS] came to the KING[JESUS], and bowed himself on HIS[JESUS] face to the
ground before the KING[JESUS]: and the KING[JESUS] kissed Absalom.


15:1 And it came to pass after this, that Absalom prepared HIM[JESUS] chariots
and horses, and fifty men to run before HIM[JESUS].

15:2 And Absalom rose up early, and stood beside the way of the gate:
and it was so, that when any man that had a controversy came to the KING[JESUS]
for judgment, then Absalom called unto HIM[JESUS], and said, Of what city art
you? And HE[JESUS] said, your SERVANT[JESUS] is of one of the tribes of Israel.

15:3 And Absalom said unto HIM[JESUS], See, your matters are good and right; but
there is no man deputed of the KING[JESUS] to hear you.

15:4 Absalom said moreover, Oh that I were made judge in the land, that
every man which has any suit or cause might come unto me, and I would
do HIM[JESUS] justice!

15:5 And it was so, that when any man came nigh to HIM[JESUS] to do HIM[JESUS]
obeisance, HE[JESUS] put forth HIS[JESUS] hand, and took HIM[JESUS], and kissed HIM[JESUS].

15:6 And on this manner did Absalom to all Israel that came to the KING[JESUS]
for judgment: so Absalom stole the hearts of the men of Israel.

15:7 And it came to pass after forty years, that Absalom said unto the
KING[JESUS], I pray you, let me go and pay my vow, which I have vowed unto the
LORD[JESUS], in Hebron.

15:8 For your SERVANT[JESUS] vowed a vow while I abode at Geshur in Syria,
saying, If the LORD[JESUS] shall bring me again indeed to Jerusalem, then I
will serve the LORD[JESUS].

15:9 And the KING[JESUS] said unto HIM[JESUS], Go in peace. So HE[JESUS] arose, and went to
Hebron.

15:10 But Absalom sent spies throughout all the tribes of Israel,
saying, As soon as you hear the sound of the trumpet, then you shall say,
Absalom reigneth in Hebron.

15:11 And with Absalom went two hundred men out of Jerusalem, that were
called; and they went in their simplicity, and they knew not any thing.

15:12 And Absalom sent for Ahithophel the Gilonite, David's COUNSELLOR[JESUS],
from HIS[JESUS] city, even from Giloh, while HE[JESUS] offered sacrifices. And the
conspiracy was strong; for the people increased continually with
Absalom.

15:13 And there came a messenger to David, saying, The hearts of the men
of Israel are after Absalom.

15:14 And David said unto all HIS[JESUS] servants that were with HIM[JESUS] at
Jerusalem, Arise, and let us flee; for we shall not else escape from
Absalom: make speed to depart, lest HE[JESUS] overtake us suddenly, and bring
evil upon us, and smite the city with the edge of the sword.

15:15 And the KING[JESUS]'s servants said unto the KING[JESUS], Behold, your servants
are ready to do whatsoever my LORD[JESUS] the KING[JESUS] shall appoint.

15:16 And the KING[JESUS] went forth, and all HIS[JESUS] household after HIM[JESUS]. And the
KING[JESUS] left ten women, which were concubines, to keep the house.

15:17 And the KING[JESUS] went forth, and all the people after HIM[JESUS], and tarried
in a place that was far off.

15:18 And all HIS[JESUS] servants passed on beside HIM[JESUS]; and all the
Cherethites, and all the Pelethites, and all the Gittites, six hundred
men which came after HIM[JESUS] from Gath, passed on before the KING[JESUS].

15:19 Then said the KING[JESUS] to Ittai the Gittite, Wherefore goest you also
with us? return to your place, and abide with the KING[JESUS]: for you art a
stranger, and also an exile.

15:20 Whereas you camest but yesterday, should I this day make you go
up and down with us? seeing I go whither I may, return you, and take
back your brethren: mercy and truth be with you.

15:21 And Ittai answered the KING[JESUS], and said, As the LORD[JESUS] liveth, and as
my LORD[JESUS] the KING[JESUS] liveth, surely in what place my LORD[JESUS] the KING[JESUS] shall be,
whether in death or life, even there also will your SERVANT[JESUS] be.

15:22 And David said to Ittai, Go and pass over. And Ittai the Gittite
passed over, and all HIS[JESUS] men, and all the little ones that were with
HIM[JESUS].

15:23 And all the country wept with a loud voice, and all the people
passed over: the KING[JESUS] also himself passed over the brook Kidron, and all
the people passed over, toward the way of the wilderness.

15:24 And lo Zadok also, and all the Levites were with HIM[JESUS], bearing the
ark of the covenant of GOD[JESUS]: and they set down the ark of GOD[JESUS]; and
Abiathar went up, until all the people had done passing out of the city.

15:25 And the KING[JESUS] said unto Zadok, Carry back the ark of GOD[JESUS] into the
city: if I shall find favour in the eyes of the LORD[JESUS], HE[JESUS] will bring me
again, and shew me both it, and HIS[JESUS] habitation:

15:26 But if HE[JESUS] thus say, I have no delight in you; behold, here am I,
let HIM[JESUS] do to me as seemeth good unto HIM[JESUS].

15:27 The KING[JESUS] said also unto Zadok the priest, Art not you a seer?
return into the city in peace, and your two sons with you, Ahimaaz your
SON[JESUS], and Jonathan the SON[JESUS] of Abiathar.

15:28 See, I will tarry in the plain of the wilderness, until there come
WORD[JESUS] from you to certify me.

15:29 Zadok therefore and Abiathar carried the ark of GOD[JESUS] again to
Jerusalem: and they tarried there.

15:30 And David went up by the ascent of mount Olivet, and wept as HE[JESUS]
went up, and had HIS[JESUS] head covered, and HE[JESUS] went barefoot: and all the
people that was with HIM[JESUS] covered every man HIS[JESUS] head, and they went up,
weeping as they went up.

15:31 And one told David, saying, Ahithophel is among the conspirators
with Absalom. And David said, O LORD[JESUS], I pray you, turn the counsel of
Ahithophel into foolishness.

15:32 And it came to pass, that when David was come to the top of the
mount, where HE[JESUS] worshipped GOD[JESUS], behold, Hushai the Archite came to meet
HIM[JESUS] with HIS[JESUS] coat rent, and earth upon HIS[JESUS] head:

15:33 Unto whom David said, If you passest on with me, then you shalt
be a burden unto me:

15:34 But if you return to the city, and say unto Absalom, I will be
your SERVANT[JESUS], O KING[JESUS]; as I have been your father's SERVANT[JESUS] hitherto, so
will I now also be your SERVANT[JESUS]: then mayest you for me defeat the
counsel of Ahithophel.

15:35 And hast you not there with you Zadok and Abiathar the priests?
therefore it shall be, that what thing soever you shalt hear out of the
KING[JESUS]'s house, you shalt tell it to Zadok and Abiathar the priests.

15:36 Behold, they have there with them their two sons, Ahimaaz Zadok's
SON[JESUS], and Jonathan Abiathar's SON[JESUS]; and by them you shall send unto me
every thing that you can hear.

15:37 So Hushai David's friend came into the city, and Absalom came into
Jerusalem.


16:1 And when David was a little past the top of the hill, behold, Ziba
the SERVANT[JESUS] of Mephibosheth met HIM[JESUS], with a couple of asses saddled, and
upon them two hundred loaves of bread, and an hundred bunches of
raisins, and an hundred of summer fruits, and a bottle of wine.

16:2 And the KING[JESUS] said unto Ziba, What meanest you by these? And Ziba
said, The asses be for the KING[JESUS]'s household to ride on; and the bread
and summer fruit for the young men to eat; and the wine, that such as be
faint in the wilderness may drink.

16:3 And the KING[JESUS] said, And where is your master's SON[JESUS]? And Ziba said
unto the KING[JESUS], Behold, HE[JESUS] abideth at Jerusalem: for HE[JESUS] said, To day
shall the house of Israel restore me the kingdom of my father.

16:4 Then said the KING[JESUS] to Ziba, Behold, yours are all that pertained
unto Mephibosheth. And Ziba said, I humbly beseech you that I may find
grace in your sight, my LORD[JESUS], O KING[JESUS].

16:5 And when KING[JESUS] David came to Bahurim, behold, thence came out a man
of the family of the house of Saul, whose name was Shimei, the SON[JESUS] of
Gera: HE[JESUS] came forth, and cursed still as HE[JESUS] came.

16:6 And HE[JESUS] cast stones at David, and at all the servants of KING[JESUS] David:
and all the people and all the mighty men were on HIS[JESUS] right hand and on
HIS[JESUS] left.

16:7 And thus said Shimei when HE[JESUS] cursed, Come out, come out, you
bloody man, and you man of Belial:

16:8 The LORD[JESUS] has returned upon you all the blood of the house of
Saul, in whose stead you hast reigned; and the LORD[JESUS] has delivered the
kingdom into the hand of Absalom your SON[JESUS]: and, behold, you art taken in
your mischief, because you art a bloody man.

16:9 Then said Abishai the SON[JESUS] of Zeruiah unto the KING[JESUS], Why should this
dead dog curse my LORD[JESUS] the KING[JESUS]? let me go over, I pray you, and take
off HIS[JESUS] head.

16:10 And the KING[JESUS] said, What have I to do with you, you sons of Zeruiah?
so let HIM[JESUS] curse, because the LORD[JESUS] has said unto HIM[JESUS], Curse David. Who
shall then say, Wherefore hast you done so?

16:11 And David said to Abishai, and to all HIS[JESUS] servants, Behold, my
SON[JESUS], which came forth of my bowels, seeketh my life: how much more now
may this Benjamite do it? let HIM[JESUS] alone, and let HIM[JESUS] curse; for the LORD[JESUS]
has bidden HIM[JESUS].

16:12 It may be that the LORD[JESUS] will look on mine affliction, and that the
LORD[JESUS] will requite me good for HIS[JESUS] cursing this day.

16:13 And as David and HIS[JESUS] men went by the way, Shimei went along on the
hill's side over against HIM[JESUS], and cursed as HE[JESUS] went, and threw stones at
HIM[JESUS], and cast dust.

16:14 And the KING[JESUS], and all the people that were with HIM[JESUS], came weary,
and refreshed themselves there.

16:15 And Absalom, and all the people the men of Israel, came to
Jerusalem, and Ahithophel with HIM[JESUS].

16:16 And it came to pass, when Hushai the Archite, David's friend, was
come unto Absalom, that Hushai said unto Absalom, GOD[JESUS] save the KING[JESUS], GOD[JESUS]
save the KING[JESUS].

16:17 And Absalom said to Hushai, Is this your kindness to your friend?
why wentest you not with your friend?

16:18 And Hushai said unto Absalom, Nay; but whom the LORD[JESUS], and this
people, and all the men of Israel, choose, HIS[JESUS] will I be, and with HIM[JESUS]
will I abide.

16:19 And again, whom should I serve? should I not serve in the presence
of HIS[JESUS] SON[JESUS]? as I have served in your father's presence, so will I be in
your presence.

16:20 Then said Absalom to Ahithophel, Give counsel among you what we
shall do.

16:21 And Ahithophel said unto Absalom, Go in unto your father's
concubines, which HE[JESUS] has left to keep the house; and all Israel shall
hear that you art abhorred of your father: then shall the hands of all
that are with you be strong.

16:22 So they spread Absalom a tent upon the top of the house; and
Absalom went in unto HIS[JESUS] father's concubines in the sight of all Israel.

16:23 And the counsel of Ahithophel, which HE[JESUS] counselled in those days,
was as if a man had enquired at the oracle of GOD[JESUS]: so was all the
counsel of Ahithophel both with David and with Absalom.


17:1 Moreover Ahithophel said unto Absalom, Let me now choose out twelve
thousand men, and I will arise and pursue after David this night:

17:2 And I will come upon HIM[JESUS] while HE[JESUS] is weary and weak handed, and
will make HIM[JESUS] afraid: and all the people that are with HIM[JESUS] shall flee;
and I will smite the KING[JESUS] only:

17:3 And I will bring back all the people unto you: the man whom you
seekest is as if all returned: so all the people shall be in peace.

17:4 And the saying pleased Absalom well, and all the elders of Israel.

17:5 Then said Absalom, Call now Hushai the Archite also, and let us
hear likewise what HE[JESUS] says.

17:6 And when Hushai was come to Absalom, Absalom spake unto HIM[JESUS],
saying, Ahithophel has spoken after this manner: shall we do after HIS[JESUS]
saying? if not; speak you.

17:7 And Hushai said unto Absalom, The counsel that Ahithophel has
given is not good at this time.
