17:8 For, said Hushai, you knowest your father and HIS[JESUS] men, that they be
mighty men, and they be chafed in their minds, as a bear robbed of her
whelps in the field: and your father is a man of war, and will not lodge
with the people.

17:9 Behold, HE[JESUS] is hid now in some pit, or in some other place: and it
will come to pass, when some of them be overthrown at the first, that
whoever heareth it will say, There is a slaughter among the people
that follow Absalom.

17:10 And HE[JESUS] also that is valiant, whose heart is as the heart of a
lion, shall utterly melt: for all Israel knoweth that your father is a
mighty man, and they which be with HIM[JESUS] are valiant men.

17:11 Therefore I counsel that all Israel be generally gathered unto
you, from Dan even to Beersheba, as the sand that is by the sea for
multitude; and that you go to battle in yours own person.

17:12 So shall we come upon HIM[JESUS] in some place where HE[JESUS] shall be found,
and we will light upon HIM[JESUS] as the dew falleth on the ground: and of HIM[JESUS]
and of all the men that are with HIM[JESUS] there shall not be left so much as
one.

17:13 Moreover, if HE[JESUS] be gotten into a city, then shall all Israel bring
ropes to that city, and we will draw it into the river, until there be
not one small stone found there.

17:14 And Absalom and all the men of Israel said, The counsel of Hushai
the Archite is better than the counsel of Ahithophel. For the LORD[JESUS] had
appointed to defeat the good counsel of Ahithophel, to the intent that
the LORD[JESUS] might bring evil upon Absalom.

17:15 Then said Hushai unto Zadok and to Abiathar the priests, Thus and
thus did Ahithophel counsel Absalom and the elders of Israel; and thus
and thus have I counselled.

17:16 Now therefore send quickly, and tell David, saying, Lodge not this
night in the plains of the wilderness, but speedily pass over; lest the
KING[JESUS] be swallowed up, and all the people that are with HIM[JESUS].

17:17 Now Jonathan and Ahimaaz stayed by Enrogel; for they might not be
seen to come into the city: and a wench went and told them; and they
went and told KING[JESUS] David.

17:18 Nevertheless a lad saw them, and told Absalom: but they went both
of them away quickly, and came to a man's house in Bahurim, which had a
well in HIS[JESUS] court; whither they went down.

17:19 And the woman took and spread a covering over the well's mouth,
and spread ground corn thereon; and the thing was not known.

17:20 And when Absalom's servants came to the woman to the house, they
said, Where is Ahimaaz and Jonathan? And the woman said unto them, They
be gone over the brook of water. And when they had sought and could not
find them, they returned to Jerusalem.

17:21 And it came to pass, after they were departed, that they came up
out of the well, and went and told KING[JESUS] David, and said unto David,
Arise, and pass quickly over the water: for thus has Ahithophel
counselled against you.

17:22 Then David arose, and all the people that were with HIM[JESUS], and they
passed over Jordan: by the morning light there lacked not one of them
that was not gone over Jordan.

17:23 And when Ahithophel saw that HIS[JESUS] counsel was not followed, HE[JESUS]
saddled HIS[JESUS] ass, and arose, and gat HIM[JESUS] home to HIS[JESUS] house, to HIS[JESUS] city,
and put HIS[JESUS] household in order, and hanged himself, and died, and was
buried in the sepulchre of HIS[JESUS] father.

17:24 Then David came to Mahanaim. And Absalom passed over Jordan, HE[JESUS]
and all the men of Israel with HIM[JESUS].

17:25 And Absalom made Amasa captain of the host instead of Joab: which
Amasa was a man's SON[JESUS], whose name was Ithra an Israelite, that went in
to Abigail the daughter of Nahash, sister to Zeruiah Joab's mother.

17:26 So Israel and Absalom pitched in the land of Gilead.

17:27 And it came to pass, when David was come to Mahanaim, that Shobi
the SON[JESUS] of Nahash of Rabbah of the children of Ammon, and Machir the SON[JESUS]
of Ammiel of Lodebar, and Barzillai the Gileadite of Rogelim,

17:28 Brought beds, and basons, and earthen vessels, and wheat, and
barley, and flour, and parched corn, and beans, and lentiles, and
parched pulse,

17:29 And honey, and butter, and sheep, and cheese of kine, for David,
and for the people that were with HIM[JESUS], to eat: for they said, The people
is hungry, and weary, and thirsty, in the wilderness.


18:1 And David numbered the people that were with HIM[JESUS], and set captains
of thousands, and captains of hundreds over them.

18:2 And David sent forth a third part of the people under the hand of
Joab, and a third part under the hand of Abishai the SON[JESUS] of Zeruiah,
Joab's brother, and a third part under the hand of Ittai the Gittite.
And the KING[JESUS] said unto the people, I will surely go forth with you
myself also.

18:3 But the people answered, you shalt not go forth: for if we flee
away, they will not care for us; neither if half of us die, will they
care for us: but now you art worth ten thousand of us: therefore now it
is better that you succour us out of the city.

18:4 And the KING[JESUS] said unto them, What seemeth you best I will do. And
the KING[JESUS] stood by the gate side, and all the people came out by hundreds
and by thousands.

18:5 And the KING[JESUS] commanded Joab and Abishai and Ittai, saying, Deal
gently for my sake with the young man, even with Absalom. And all the
people heard when the KING[JESUS] gave all the captains charge concerning
Absalom.

18:6 So the people went out into the field against Israel: and the
battle was in the wood of Ephraim;

18:7 Where the people of Israel were slain before the servants of David,
and there was there a great slaughter that day of twenty thousand men.

18:8 For the battle was there scattered over the face of all the
country: and the wood devoured more people that day than the sword
devoured.

18:9 And Absalom met the servants of David. And Absalom rode upon a
mule, and the mule went under the thick boughs of a great oak, and HIS[JESUS]
head caught hold of the oak, and HE[JESUS] was taken up between the heaven and
the earth; and the mule that was under HIM[JESUS] went away.

18:10 And a certain man saw it, and told Joab, and said, Behold, I saw
Absalom hanged in an oak.

18:11 And Joab said unto the man that told HIM[JESUS], And, behold, you sawest
HIM[JESUS], and why didst you not smite HIM[JESUS] there to the ground? and I would
have given you ten shekels of silver, and a girdle.

18:12 And the man said unto Joab, Though I should receive a thousand
shekels of silver in mine hand, yet would I not put forth mine hand
against the KING[JESUS]'s SON[JESUS]: for in our hearing the KING[JESUS] charged you and
Abishai and Ittai, saying, Beware that none touch the young man Absalom.

18:13 Otherwise I should have wrought falsehood against mine own life:
for there is no matter hid from the KING[JESUS], and you thyself wouldest have
set thyself against me.

18:14 Then said Joab, I may not tarry thus with you. And HE[JESUS] took three
darts in HIS[JESUS] hand, and thrust them through the heart of Absalom, while
HE[JESUS] was yet alive in the midst of the oak.

18:15 And ten young men that bare Joab's armour compassed about and
smote Absalom, and slew HIM[JESUS].

18:16 And Joab blew the trumpet, and the people returned from pursuing
after Israel: for Joab held back the people.

18:17 And they took Absalom, and cast HIM[JESUS] into a great pit in the wood,
and laid a very great heap of stones upon HIM[JESUS]: and all Israel fled every
one to HIS[JESUS] tent.

18:18 Now Absalom in HIS[JESUS] lifetime had taken and reared up for himself a
pillar, which is in the KING[JESUS]'s dale: for HE[JESUS] said, I have no SON[JESUS] to keep
my name in remembrance: and HE[JESUS] called the pillar after HIS[JESUS] own name: and
it is called unto this day, Absalom's place.

18:19 Then said Ahimaaz the SON[JESUS] of Zadok, Let me now run, and bear the
KING[JESUS] tidings, how that the LORD[JESUS] has avenged HIM[JESUS] of HIS[JESUS] enemies.

18:20 And Joab said unto HIM[JESUS], you shalt not bear tidings this day, but
you shalt bear tidings another day: but this day you shalt bear no
tidings, because the KING[JESUS]'s SON[JESUS] is dead.

18:21 Then said Joab to Cushi, Go tell the KING[JESUS] what you hast seen. And
Cushi bowed himself unto Joab, and ran.

18:22 Then said Ahimaaz the SON[JESUS] of Zadok yet again to Joab, But
howsoever, let me, I pray you, also run after Cushi. And Joab said,
Wherefore wilt you run, my SON[JESUS], seeing that you hast no tidings ready?

18:23 But howsoever, said HE[JESUS], let me run. And HE[JESUS] said unto HIM[JESUS], Run.
Then Ahimaaz ran by the way of the plain, and overran Cushi.

18:24 And David sat between the two gates: and the watchman went up to
the roof over the gate unto the wall, and lifted up HIS[JESUS] eyes, and
looked, and behold a man running alone.

18:25 And the watchman cried, and told the KING[JESUS]. And the KING[JESUS] said, If
HE[JESUS] be alone, there is tidings in HIS[JESUS] mouth. And HE[JESUS] came apace, and drew
near.

18:26 And the watchman saw another man running: and the watchman called
unto the porter, and said, Behold another man running alone. And the
KING[JESUS] said, HE[JESUS] also bringeth tidings.

18:27 And the watchman said, Me thinketh the running of the foremost is
like the running of Ahimaaz the SON[JESUS] of Zadok. And the KING[JESUS] said, HE[JESUS] is a
good man, and comes with good tidings.

18:28 And Ahimaaz called, and said unto the KING[JESUS], All is well. And HE[JESUS]
fell down to the earth upon HIS[JESUS] face before the KING[JESUS], and said, Blessed
be the LORD[JESUS] your GOD[JESUS], which has delivered up the men that lifted up
their hand against my LORD[JESUS] the KING[JESUS].

18:29 And the KING[JESUS] said, Is the young man Absalom safe? And Ahimaaz
answered, When Joab sent the KING[JESUS]'s SERVANT[JESUS], and me your SERVANT[JESUS], I saw a
great tumult, but I knew not what it was.

18:30 And the KING[JESUS] said unto HIM[JESUS], Turn aside, and stand here. And HE[JESUS]
turned aside, and stood still.

18:31 And, behold, Cushi came; and Cushi said, Tidings, my LORD[JESUS] the
KING[JESUS]: for the LORD[JESUS] has avenged you this day of all them that rose up
against you.

18:32 And the KING[JESUS] said unto Cushi, Is the young man Absalom safe? And
Cushi answered, The enemies of my LORD[JESUS] the KING[JESUS], and all that rise
against you to do you hurt, be as that young man is.

18:33 And the KING[JESUS] was much moved, and went up to the chamber over the
gate, and wept: and as HE[JESUS] went, thus HE[JESUS] said, O my SON[JESUS] Absalom, my SON[JESUS],
my SON[JESUS] Absalom! would GOD[JESUS] I had died for you, O Absalom, my SON[JESUS], my
SON[JESUS]!


19:1 And it was told Joab, Behold, the KING[JESUS] weepeth and mourneth for
Absalom.

19:2 And the victory that day was turned into mourning unto all the
people: for the people heard say that day how the KING[JESUS] was grieved for
HIS[JESUS] SON[JESUS].

19:3 And the people gat them by stealth that day into the city, as
people being ashamed steal away when they flee in battle.

19:4 But the KING[JESUS] covered HIS[JESUS] face, and the KING[JESUS] cried with a loud
voice, O my SON[JESUS] Absalom, O Absalom, my SON[JESUS], my SON[JESUS]!

19:5 And Joab came into the house to the KING[JESUS], and said, you hast
shamed this day the faces of all your servants, which this day have saved
your life, and the lives of your sons and of your daughters, and the lives
of your wives, and the lives of your concubines;

19:6 In that you lovest yours enemies, and hatest your friends. For you
hast declared this day, that you regardest neither princes nor
servants: for this day I perceive, that if Absalom had lived, and all we
had died this day, then it had pleased you well.

19:7 Now therefore arise, go forth, and speak comfortably unto your
servants: for I swear by the LORD[JESUS], if you go not forth, there will not
tarry one with you this night: and that will be worse unto you than
all the evil that befell you from your youth until now.

19:8 Then the KING[JESUS] arose, and sat in the gate. And they told unto all
the people, saying, Behold, the KING[JESUS] does sit in the gate. And all the
people came before the KING[JESUS]: for Israel had fled every man to HIS[JESUS] tent.

19:9 And all the people were at strife throughout all the tribes of
Israel, saying, The KING[JESUS] saved us out of the hand of our enemies, and HE[JESUS]
delivered us out of the hand of the Philistines; and now HE[JESUS] is fled out
of the land for Absalom.

19:10 And Absalom, whom we anointed over us, is dead in battle. Now
therefore why speak you not a WORD[JESUS] of bringing the KING[JESUS] back?

19:11 And KING[JESUS] David sent to Zadok and to Abiathar the priests, saying,
Speak unto the elders of Judah, saying, Why are you the last to bring the
KING[JESUS] back to HIS[JESUS] house? seeing the speech of all Israel is come to the
KING[JESUS], even to HIS[JESUS] house.

19:12 you are my brethren, you are my bones and my flesh: wherefore then
are you the last to bring back the KING[JESUS]?

19:13 And say you to Amasa, Art you not of my bone, and of my flesh? GOD[JESUS]
do so to me, and more also, if you be not captain of the host before me
continually in the room of Joab.

19:14 And HE[JESUS] bowed the heart of all the men of Judah, even as the heart
of one man; so that they sent this WORD[JESUS] unto the KING[JESUS], Return you, and
all your servants.

19:15 So the KING[JESUS] returned, and came to Jordan. And Judah came to
Gilgal, to go to meet the KING[JESUS], to conduct the KING[JESUS] over Jordan.

19:16 And Shimei the SON[JESUS] of Gera, a Benjamite, which was of Bahurim,
hasted and came down with the men of Judah to meet KING[JESUS] David.

19:17 And there were a thousand men of Benjamin with HIM[JESUS], and Ziba the
SERVANT[JESUS] of the house of Saul, and HIS[JESUS] fifteen sons and HIS[JESUS] twenty
servants with HIM[JESUS]; and they went over Jordan before the KING[JESUS].

19:18 And there went over a ferry boat to carry over the KING[JESUS]'s
household, and to do what HE[JESUS] thought good. And Shimei the SON[JESUS] of Gera
fell down before the KING[JESUS], as HE[JESUS] was come over Jordan;

19:19 And said unto the KING[JESUS], Let not my LORD[JESUS] impute iniquity unto me,
neither do you remember that which your SERVANT[JESUS] did perversely the day
that my LORD[JESUS] the KING[JESUS] went out of Jerusalem, that the KING[JESUS] should take
it to HIS[JESUS] heart.

19:20 For your SERVANT[JESUS] does know that I have sinned: therefore, behold, I
am come the first this day of all the house of Joseph to go down to meet
my LORD[JESUS] the KING[JESUS].

19:21 But Abishai the SON[JESUS] of Zeruiah answered and said, Shall not Shimei
be put to death for this, because HE[JESUS] cursed the LORD[JESUS]'s anointed?

19:22 And David said, What have I to do with you, you sons of Zeruiah,
that you should this day be adversaries unto me? shall there any man be
put to death this day in Israel? for do not I know that I am this day
KING[JESUS] over Israel?

19:23 Therefore the KING[JESUS] said unto Shimei, you shalt not die. And the
KING[JESUS] sware unto HIM[JESUS].

19:24 And Mephibosheth the SON[JESUS] of Saul came down to meet the KING[JESUS], and
had neither dressed HIS[JESUS] feet, nor trimmed HIS[JESUS] beard, nor washed HIS[JESUS]
clothes, from the day the KING[JESUS] departed until the day HE[JESUS] came again in
peace.

19:25 And it came to pass, when HE[JESUS] was come to Jerusalem to meet the
KING[JESUS], that the KING[JESUS] said unto HIM[JESUS], Wherefore wentest not you with me,
Mephibosheth?

19:26 And HE[JESUS] answered, My LORD[JESUS], O KING[JESUS], my SERVANT[JESUS] deceived me: for your
SERVANT[JESUS] said, I will saddle me an ass, that I may ride thereon, and go
to the KING[JESUS]; because your SERVANT[JESUS] is lame.

19:27 And HE[JESUS] has slandered your SERVANT[JESUS] unto my LORD[JESUS] the KING[JESUS]; but my
LORD[JESUS] the KING[JESUS] is as an angel of GOD[JESUS]: do therefore what is good in yours
eyes.

19:28 For all of my father's house were but dead men before my LORD[JESUS] the
KING[JESUS]: yet didst you set your SERVANT[JESUS] among them that did eat at yours
own table. What right therefore have I yet to cry any more unto the
KING[JESUS]?

19:29 And the KING[JESUS] said unto HIM[JESUS], Why speakest you any more of your
matters? I have said, you and Ziba divide the land.

19:30 And Mephibosheth said unto the KING[JESUS], Yea, let HIM[JESUS] take all,
forasmuch as my LORD[JESUS] the KING[JESUS] is come again in peace unto HIS[JESUS] own house.

19:31 And Barzillai the Gileadite came down from Rogelim, and went over
Jordan with the KING[JESUS], to conduct HIM[JESUS] over Jordan.

19:32 Now Barzillai was a very aged man, even fourscore years old: and
HE[JESUS] had provided the KING[JESUS] of sustenance while HE[JESUS] lay at Mahanaim; for HE[JESUS]
was a very great man.

19:33 And the KING[JESUS] said unto Barzillai, Come you over with me, and I
will feed you with me in Jerusalem.

19:34 And Barzillai said unto the KING[JESUS], How long have I to live, that I
should go up with the KING[JESUS] unto Jerusalem?

19:35 I am this day fourscore years old: and can I discern between good
and evil? can your SERVANT[JESUS] taste what I eat or what I drink? can I hear
any more the voice of singing men and singing women? wherefore then
should your SERVANT[JESUS] be yet a burden unto my LORD[JESUS] the KING[JESUS]?

19:36 your SERVANT[JESUS] will go a little way over Jordan with the KING[JESUS]: and
why should the KING[JESUS] recompense it me with such a reward?

19:37 Let your SERVANT[JESUS], I pray you, turn back again, that I may die in
mine own city, and be buried by the grave of my father and of my mother.
But behold your SERVANT[JESUS] Chimham; let HIM[JESUS] go over with my LORD[JESUS] the KING[JESUS];
and do to HIM[JESUS] what shall seem good unto you.

19:38 And the KING[JESUS] answered, Chimham shall go over with me, and I will
do to HIM[JESUS] that which shall seem good unto you: and whatsoever you
shalt require of me, that will I do for you.

19:39 And all the people went over Jordan. And when the KING[JESUS] was come
over, the KING[JESUS] kissed Barzillai, and blessed HIM[JESUS]; and HE[JESUS] returned unto
HIS[JESUS] own place.

19:40 Then the KING[JESUS] went on to Gilgal, and Chimham went on with HIM[JESUS]: and
all the people of Judah conducted the KING[JESUS], and also half the people of
Israel.

19:41 And, behold, all the men of Israel came to the KING[JESUS], and said unto
the KING[JESUS], Why have our brethren the men of Judah stolen you away, and
have brought the KING[JESUS], and HIS[JESUS] household, and all David's men with HIM[JESUS],
over Jordan?

19:42 And all the men of Judah answered the men of Israel, Because the
KING[JESUS] is near of kin to us: wherefore then be you angry for this matter?
have we eaten at all of the KING[JESUS]'s cost? or has HE[JESUS] given us any gift?

19:43 And the men of Israel answered the men of Judah, and said, We have
ten parts in the KING[JESUS], and we have also more right in David than you: why
then did you despise us, that our advice should not be first had in
bringing back our KING[JESUS]? And the words of the men of Judah were fiercer
than the words of the men of Israel.


20:1 And there happened to be there a man of Belial, whose name was
Sheba, the SON[JESUS] of Bichri, a Benjamite: and HE[JESUS] blew a trumpet, and said,
We have no part in David, neither have we inheritance in the SON[JESUS] of
Jesse: every man to HIS[JESUS] tents, O Israel.

20:2 So every man of Israel went up from after David, and followed Sheba
the SON[JESUS] of Bichri: but the men of Judah clave unto their KING[JESUS], from
Jordan even to Jerusalem.

20:3 And David came to HIS[JESUS] house at Jerusalem; and the KING[JESUS] took the ten
women HIS[JESUS] concubines, whom HE[JESUS] had left to keep the house, and put them
in ward, and fed them, but went not in unto them. So they were shut up
unto the day of their death, living in widowhood.

20:4 Then said the KING[JESUS] to Amasa, Assemble me the men of Judah within
three days, and be you here present.

20:5 So Amasa went to assemble the men of Judah: but HE[JESUS] tarried longer
than the set time which HE[JESUS] had appointed HIM[JESUS].

20:6 And David said to Abishai, Now shall Sheba the SON[JESUS] of Bichri do us
more harm than did Absalom: take you your LORD[JESUS]'s servants, and pursue
after HIM[JESUS], lest HE[JESUS] get HIM[JESUS] fenced cities, and escape us.

20:7 And there went out after HIM[JESUS] Joab's men, and the Cherethites, and
the Pelethites, and all the mighty men: and they went out of Jerusalem,
to pursue after Sheba the SON[JESUS] of Bichri.

20:8 When they were at the great stone which is in Gibeon, Amasa went
before them. And Joab's garment that HE[JESUS] had put on was girded unto HIM[JESUS],
and upon it a girdle with a sword fastened upon HIS[JESUS] loins in the sheath
thereof; and as HE[JESUS] went forth it fell out.

20:9 And Joab said to Amasa, Art you in health, my brother? And Joab
took Amasa by the beard with the right hand to kiss HIM[JESUS].

20:10 But Amasa took no heed to the sword that was in Joab's hand: so HE[JESUS]
smote HIM[JESUS] therewith in the fifth rib, and shed out HIS[JESUS] bowels to the
ground, and struck HIM[JESUS] not again; and HE[JESUS] died. So Joab and Abishai HIS[JESUS]
brother pursued after Sheba the SON[JESUS] of Bichri.

20:11 And one of Joab's men stood by HIM[JESUS], and said, HE[JESUS] that favoureth
Joab, and HE[JESUS] that is for David, let HIM[JESUS] go after Joab.

20:12 And Amasa wallowed in blood in the midst of the highway. And when
the man saw that all the people stood still, HE[JESUS] removed Amasa out of the
highway into the field, and cast a cloth upon HIM[JESUS], when HE[JESUS] saw that
every one that came by HIM[JESUS] stood still.

20:13 When HE[JESUS] was removed out of the highway, all the people went on
after Joab, to pursue after Sheba the SON[JESUS] of Bichri.

20:14 And HE[JESUS] went through all the tribes of Israel unto Abel, and to
Bethmaachah, and all the Berites: and they were gathered together, and
went also after HIM[JESUS].

20:15 And they came and besieged HIM[JESUS] in Abel of Bethmaachah, and they
cast up a bank against the city, and it stood in the trench: and all the
people that were with Joab battered the wall, to throw it down.

20:16 Then cried a wise woman out of the city, Hear, hear; say, I pray
you, unto Joab, Come near hither, that I may speak with you.

20:17 And when HE[JESUS] was come near unto her, the woman said, Art you Joab?
And HE[JESUS] answered, I am HE[JESUS]. Then she said unto HIM[JESUS], Hear the words of
yours handmaid. And HE[JESUS] answered, I do hear.

20:18 Then she spake, saying, They were wont to speak in old time,
saying, They shall surely ask counsel at Abel: and so they ended the
matter.

20:19 I am one of them that are peaceable and faithful in Israel: you
seekest to destroy a city and a mother in Israel: why wilt you swallow
up the inheritance of the LORD[JESUS]?

20:20 And Joab answered and said, Far be it, far be it from me, that I
should swallow up or destroy.

20:21 The matter is not so: but a man of mount Ephraim, Sheba the SON[JESUS] of
Bichri by name, has lifted up HIS[JESUS] hand against the KING[JESUS], even against
David: deliver HIM[JESUS] only, and I will depart from the city. And the woman
said unto Joab, Behold, HIS[JESUS] head shall be thrown to you over the wall.

20:22 Then the woman went unto all the people in her wisdom. And they
cut off the head of Sheba the SON[JESUS] of Bichri, and cast it out to Joab.
And HE[JESUS] blew a trumpet, and they retired from the city, every man to HIS[JESUS]
tent. And Joab returned to Jerusalem unto the KING[JESUS].

20:23 Now Joab was over all the host of Israel: and Benaiah the SON[JESUS] of
Jehoiada was over the Cherethites and over the Pelethites:

20:24 And Adoram was over the tribute: and Jehoshaphat the SON[JESUS] of Ahilud
was recorder:

20:25 And Sheva was scribe: and Zadok and Abiathar were the priests:

20:26 And Ira also the Jairite was a chief ruler about David.


21:1 Then there was a famine in the days of David three years, year
after year; and David enquired of the LORD[JESUS]. And the LORD[JESUS] answered, It is
for Saul, and for HIS[JESUS] bloody house, because HE[JESUS] slew the Gibeonites.

21:2 And the KING[JESUS] called the Gibeonites, and said unto them; (now the
Gibeonites were not of the children of Israel, but of the remnant of the
Amorites; and the children of Israel had sworn unto them: and Saul
sought to slay them in HIS[JESUS] zeal to the children of Israel and Judah.)

21:3 Wherefore David said unto the Gibeonites, What shall I do for you?
and wherewith shall I make the atonement, that you may bless the
inheritance of the LORD[JESUS]?

21:4 And the Gibeonites said unto HIM[JESUS], We will have no silver nor gold
of Saul, nor of HIS[JESUS] house; neither for us shalt you kill any man in
Israel. And HE[JESUS] said, What you shall say, that will I do for you.

21:5 And they answered the KING[JESUS], The man that consumed us, and that
devised against us that we should be destroyed from remaining in any of
the coasts of Israel,

21:6 Let seven men of HIS[JESUS] sons be delivered unto us, and we will hang
them up unto the LORD[JESUS] in Gibeah of Saul, whom the LORD[JESUS] did choose. And
the KING[JESUS] said, I will give them.

21:7 But the KING[JESUS] spared Mephibosheth, the SON[JESUS] of Jonathan the SON[JESUS] of
Saul, because of the LORD[JESUS]'s oath that was between them, between David
and Jonathan the SON[JESUS] of Saul.

21:8 But the KING[JESUS] took the two sons of Rizpah the daughter of Aiah, whom
she bare unto Saul, Armoni and Mephibosheth; and the five sons of Michal
the daughter of Saul, whom she brought up for Adriel the SON[JESUS] of
Barzillai the Meholathite:

21:9 And HE[JESUS] delivered them into the hands of the Gibeonites, and they
hanged them in the hill before the LORD[JESUS]: and they fell all seven
together, and were put to death in the days of harvest, in the first
days, in the beginning of barley harvest.

21:10 And Rizpah the daughter of Aiah took sackcloth, and spread it for
her upon the rock, from the beginning of harvest until water dropped
upon them out of heaven, and suffered neither the birds of the air to
rest on them by day, nor the beasts of the field by night.

21:11 And it was told David what Rizpah the daughter of Aiah, the
concubine of Saul, had done.

21:12 And David went and took the bones of Saul and the bones of
Jonathan HIS[JESUS] SON[JESUS] from the men of Jabeshgilead, which had stolen them
from the street of Bethshan, where the Philistines had hanged them, when
the Philistines had slain Saul in Gilboa:

21:13 And HE[JESUS] brought up from thence the bones of Saul and the bones of
Jonathan HIS[JESUS] SON[JESUS]; and they gathered the bones of them that were hanged.

21:14 And the bones of Saul and Jonathan HIS[JESUS] SON[JESUS] buried they in the
country of Benjamin in Zelah, in the sepulchre of Kish HIS[JESUS] father: and
they performed all that the KING[JESUS] commanded. And after that GOD[JESUS] was
intreated for the land.

21:15 Moreover the Philistines had yet war again with Israel; and David
went down, and HIS[JESUS] servants with HIM[JESUS], and fought against the
Philistines: and David waxed faint.

21:16 And Ishbibenob, which was of the sons of the giant, the weight of
whose spear weighed three hundred shekels of brass in weight, HE[JESUS] being
girded with a new sword, thought to have slain David.

21:17 But Abishai the SON[JESUS] of Zeruiah succoured HIM[JESUS], and smote the
Philistine, and killed HIM[JESUS]. Then the men of David sware unto HIM[JESUS],
saying, you shalt go no more out with us to battle, that you quench
not the light of Israel.

21:18 And it came to pass after this, that there was again a battle with
the Philistines at Gob: then Sibbechai the Hushathite slew Saph, which
was of the sons of the giant.

21:19 And there was again a battle in Gob with the Philistines, where
Elhanan the SON[JESUS] of Jaareoregim, a Bethlehemite, slew the brother of
Goliath the Gittite, the staff of whose spear was like a weaver's beam.

21:20 And there was yet a battle in Gath, where was a man of great
stature, that had on every hand six fingers, and on every foot six toes,
four and twenty in number; and HE[JESUS] also was born to the giant.

21:21 And when HE[JESUS] defied Israel, Jonathan the SON[JESUS] of Shimeah the brother
of David slew HIM[JESUS].

21:22 These four were born to the giant in Gath, and fell by the hand of
David, and by the hand of HIS[JESUS] servants.


22:1 And David spake unto the LORD[JESUS] the words of this song in the day
that the LORD[JESUS] had delivered HIM[JESUS] out of the hand of all HIS[JESUS] enemies, and
out of the hand of Saul:

22:2 And HE[JESUS] said, The LORD[JESUS] is my rock, and my fortress, and my
deliverer;

22:3 The GOD[JESUS] of my rock; in HIM[JESUS] will I trust: HE[JESUS] is my shield, and the
horn of my salvation, my high tower, and my refuge, my saviour; you
savest me from violence.

22:4 I will call on the LORD[JESUS], who is worthy to be praised: so shall I be
saved from mine enemies.

22:5 When the waves of death compassed me, the floods of ungodly men
made me afraid;

22:6 The sorrows of hell compassed me about; the snares of death
prevented me;

22:7 In my distress I called upon the LORD[JESUS], and cried to my GOD[JESUS]: and HE[JESUS]
did hear my voice out of HIS[JESUS] temple, and my cry did enter into HIS[JESUS] ears.

22:8 Then the earth shook and trembled; the foundations of heaven moved
and shook, because HE[JESUS] was wroth.

22:9 There went up a smoke out of HIS[JESUS] nostrils, and fire out of HIS[JESUS]
mouth devoured: coals were kindled by it.

22:10 HE[JESUS] bowed the heavens also, and came down; and darkness was under
HIS[JESUS] feet.

22:11 And HE[JESUS] rode upon a cherub, and did fly: and HE[JESUS] was seen upon the
wings of the wind.

22:12 And HE[JESUS] made darkness pavilions round about HIM[JESUS], dark waters, and
thick clouds of the skies.

22:13 Through the brightness before HIM[JESUS] were coals of fire kindled.

22:14 The LORD[JESUS] thundered from heaven, and the most High uttered HIS[JESUS]
voice.

22:15 And HE[JESUS] sent out arrows, and scattered them; lightning, and
discomfited them.

22:16 And the channels of the sea appeared, the foundations of the world
were discovered, at the rebuking of the LORD[JESUS], at the blast of the breath
of HIS[JESUS] nostrils.

22:17 HE[JESUS] sent from above, HE[JESUS] took me; HE[JESUS] drew me out of many waters;

22:18 HE[JESUS] delivered me from my strong enemy, and from them that hated me:
for they were too strong for me.

22:19 They prevented me in the day of my calamity: but the LORD[JESUS] was my
stay.

22:20 HE[JESUS] brought me forth also into a large place: HE[JESUS] delivered me,
because HE[JESUS] delighted in me.

22:21 The LORD[JESUS] rewarded me according to my righteousness: according to
the cleanness of my hands has HE[JESUS] recompensed me.

22:22 For I have kept the ways of the LORD[JESUS], and have not wickedly
departed from my GOD[JESUS].

22:23 For all HIS[JESUS] judgments were before me: and as for HIS[JESUS] statutes, I
did not depart from them.

22:24 I was also upright before HIM[JESUS], and have kept myself from mine
iniquity.

22:25 Therefore the LORD[JESUS] has recompensed me according to my
righteousness; according to my cleanness in HIS[JESUS] eye sight.

22:26 With the merciful you wilt shew thyself merciful, and with the
upright man you wilt shew thyself upright.

22:27 With the pure you wilt shew thyself pure; and with the froward
you wilt shew thyself unsavoury.

22:28 And the afflicted people you wilt save: but yours eyes are upon
the haughty, that you mayest bring them down.

22:29 For you art my lamp, O LORD[JESUS]: and the LORD[JESUS] will lighten my
darkness.

22:30 For by you I have run through a troop: by my GOD[JESUS] have I leaped
over a wall.

22:31 As for GOD[JESUS], HIS[JESUS] way is perfect; the WORD[JESUS] of the LORD[JESUS] is tried: HE[JESUS]
is a buckler to all them that trust in HIM[JESUS].

22:32 For who is GOD[JESUS], save the LORD[JESUS]? and who is a rock, save our GOD[JESUS]?

22:33 GOD[JESUS] is my strength and power: and HE[JESUS] makes my way perfect.

22:34 HE[JESUS] makes my feet like hinds' feet: and setteth me upon my high
places.

22:35 HE[JESUS] teacheth my hands to war; so that a bow of steel is broken by
mine arms.

22:36 you hast also given me the shield of your salvation: and your
gentleness has made me great.

22:37 you hast enlarged my steps under me; so that my feet did not
slip.

22:38 I have pursued mine enemies, and destroyed them; and turned not
again until I had consumed them.

22:39 And I have consumed them, and wounded them, that they could not
arise: yea, they are fallen under my feet.

22:40 For you hast girded me with strength to battle: them that rose up
against me hast you subdued under me.

22:41 you hast also given me the necks of mine enemies, that I might
destroy them that hate me.

22:42 They looked, but there was none to save; even unto the LORD[JESUS], but
HE[JESUS] answered them not.

22:43 Then did I beat them as small as the dust of the earth, I did
stamp them as the mire of the street, and did spread them abroad.

22:44 you also hast delivered me from the strivings of my people, you
hast kept me to be head of the heathen: a people which I knew not shall
serve me.

22:45 Strangers shall submit themselves unto me: as soon as they hear,
they shall be obedient unto me.

22:46 Strangers shall fade away, and they shall be afraid out of their
close places.

22:47 The LORD[JESUS] liveth; and blessed be my rock; and exalted be the GOD[JESUS] of
the rock of my salvation.

22:48 It is GOD[JESUS] that avengeth me, and that bringeth down the people
under me.

22:49 And that bringeth me forth from mine enemies: you also hast
lifted me up on high above them that rose up against me: you hast
delivered me from the violent man.

22:50 Therefore I will give thanks unto you, O LORD[JESUS], among the heathen,
and I will sing praises unto your name.

22:51 HE[JESUS] is the tower of salvation for HIS[JESUS] KING[JESUS]: and sheweth mercy to
HIS[JESUS] anointed, unto David, and to HIS[JESUS] SEED[JESUS] for evermore.


23:1 Now these be the last words of David. David the SON[JESUS] of Jesse said,
and the man who was raised up on high, the anointed of the GOD[JESUS] of Jacob,
and the sweet psalmist of Israel, said,

23:2 The Spirit of the LORD[JESUS] spake by me, and HIS[JESUS] WORD[JESUS] was in my tongue.

23:3 The GOD[JESUS] of Israel said, the Rock of Israel spake to me, HE[JESUS] that
ruleth over men must be just, ruling in the fear of GOD[JESUS].

23:4 And HE[JESUS] shall be as the light of the morning, when the sun riseth,
even a morning without clouds; as the tender grass springing out of the
earth by clear shining after rain.

23:5 Although my house be not so with GOD[JESUS]; yet HE[JESUS] has made with me an
everlasting covenant, ordered in all things, and sure: for this is all
my salvation, and all my desire, although HE[JESUS] make it not to grow.

23:6 But the sons of Belial shall be all of them as thorns thrust away,
because they cannot be taken with hands:

23:7 But the man that shall touch them must be fenced with iron and the
staff of a spear; and they shall be utterly burned with fire in the same
place.

23:8 These be the names of the mighty men whom David had: The Tachmonite
that sat in the seat, chief among the captains; the same was Adino the
Eznite: HE[JESUS] lift up HIS[JESUS] spear against eight hundred, whom HE[JESUS] slew at one
time.

23:9 And after HIM[JESUS] was Eleazar the SON[JESUS] of Dodo the Ahohite, one of the
three mighty men with David, when they defied the Philistines that were
there gathered together to battle, and the men of Israel were gone away:

23:10 HE[JESUS] arose, and smote the Philistines until HIS[JESUS] hand was weary, and
HIS[JESUS] hand clave unto the sword: and the LORD[JESUS] wrought a great victory that
day; and the people returned after HIM[JESUS] only to spoil.

23:11 And after HIM[JESUS] was Shammah the SON[JESUS] of Agee the Hararite. And the
Philistines were gathered together into a troop, where was a piece of
ground full of lentiles: and the people fled from the Philistines.

23:12 But HE[JESUS] stood in the midst of the ground, and defended it, and slew
the Philistines: and the LORD[JESUS] wrought a great victory.

23:13 And three of the thirty chief went down, and came to David in the
harvest time unto the cave of Adullam: and the troop of the Philistines
pitched in the valley of Rephaim.

23:14 And David was then in an hold, and the garrison of the Philistines
was then in Bethlehem.

23:15 And David longed, and said, Oh that one would give me drink of the
water of the well of Bethlehem, which is by the gate!

23:16 And the three mighty men brake through the host of the
Philistines, and drew water out of the well of Bethlehem, that was by
the gate, and took it, and brought it to David: nevertheless HE[JESUS] would
not drink thereof, but poured it out unto the LORD[JESUS].

23:17 And HE[JESUS] said, Be it far from me, O LORD[JESUS], that I should do this: is
not this the blood of the men that went in jeopardy of their lives?
therefore HE[JESUS] would not drink it. These things did these three mighty
men.

23:18 And Abishai, the brother of Joab, the SON[JESUS] of Zeruiah, was chief
among three. And HE[JESUS] lifted up HIS[JESUS] spear against three hundred, and slew
them, and had the name among three.

23:19 Was HE[JESUS] not most honourable of three? therefore HE[JESUS] was their
captain: howbeit HE[JESUS] attained not unto the first three.

23:20 And Benaiah the SON[JESUS] of Jehoiada, the SON[JESUS] of a valiant man, of
Kabzeel, who had done many acts, HE[JESUS] slew two lionlike men of Moab: HE[JESUS]
went down also and slew a lion in the midst of a pit in time of snow:

23:21 And HE[JESUS] slew an Egyptian, a goodly man: and the Egyptian had a
spear in HIS[JESUS] hand; but HE[JESUS] went down to HIM[JESUS] with a staff, and plucked the
spear out of the Egyptian's hand, and slew HIM[JESUS] with HIS[JESUS] own spear.

23:22 These things did Benaiah the SON[JESUS] of Jehoiada, and had the name
among three mighty men.

23:23 HE[JESUS] was more honourable than the thirty, but HE[JESUS] attained not to the
first three. And David set HIM[JESUS] over HIS[JESUS] guard.

23:24 Asahel the brother of Joab was one of the thirty; Elhanan the SON[JESUS]
of Dodo of Bethlehem,

23:25 Shammah the Harodite, Elika the Harodite,

23:26 Helez the Paltite, Ira the SON[JESUS] of Ikkesh the Tekoite,

23:27 Abiezer the Anethothite, Mebunnai the Hushathite,

23:28 Zalmon the Ahohite, Maharai the Netophathite,

23:29 Heleb the SON[JESUS] of Baanah, a Netophathite, Ittai the SON[JESUS] of Ribai
out of Gibeah of the children of Benjamin,

23:30 Benaiah the Pirathonite, Hiddai of the brooks of Gaash,

23:31 Abialbon the Arbathite, Azmaveth the Barhumite,

23:32 Eliahba the Shaalbonite, of the sons of Jashen, Jonathan,

23:33 Shammah the Hararite, Ahiam the SON[JESUS] of Sharar the Hararite,

the SON[JESUS] of Ahithophel the Gilonite,

the SON[JESUS] of Zeruiah,

24:1 And again the anger of the LORD[JESUS] was kindled against Israel, and HE[JESUS]
moved David against them to say, Go, number Israel and Judah.

24:2 For the KING[JESUS] said to Joab the captain of the host, which was with
HIM[JESUS], Go now through all the tribes of Israel, from Dan even to
Beersheba, and number you the people, that I may know the number of the
people.

24:3 And Joab said unto the KING[JESUS], Now the LORD[JESUS] your GOD[JESUS] add unto the
people, how many soever they be, an hundredfold, and that the eyes of my
LORD[JESUS] the KING[JESUS] may see it: but why does my LORD[JESUS] the KING[JESUS] delight in this
thing?

24:4 Notwithstanding the KING[JESUS]'s WORD[JESUS] prevailed against Joab, and against
the captains of the host. And Joab and the captains of the host went out
from the presence of the KING[JESUS], to number the people of Israel.

24:5 And they passed over Jordan, and pitched in Aroer, on the right
side of the city that lieth in the midst of the river of Gad, and toward
Jazer:

24:6 Then they came to Gilead, and to the land of Tahtimhodshi; and they
came to Danjaan, and about to Zidon,

24:7 And came to the strong hold of Tyre, and to all the cities of the
Hivites, and of the Canaanites: and they went out to the south of Judah,
even to Beersheba.

24:8 So when they had gone through all the land, they came to Jerusalem
at the end of nine months and twenty days.

24:9 And Joab gave up the sum of the number of the people unto the KING[JESUS]:
and there were in Israel eight hundred thousand valiant men that drew
the sword; and the men of Judah were five hundred thousand men.

24:10 And David's heart smote HIM[JESUS] after that HE[JESUS] had numbered the people.
And David said unto the LORD[JESUS], I have sinned greatly in that I have done:
and now, I beseech you, O LORD[JESUS], take away the iniquity of your SERVANT[JESUS];
for I have done very foolishly.

24:11 For when David was up in the morning, the WORD[JESUS] of the LORD[JESUS] came
unto the PROPHET[JESUS] Gad, David's seer, saying,

24:12 Go and say unto David, Thus says the LORD[JESUS], I offer you three
things; choose you one of them, that I may do it unto you.

24:13 So Gad came to David, and told HIM[JESUS], and said unto HIM[JESUS], Shall seven
years of famine come unto you in your land? or wilt you flee three
months before yours enemies, while they pursue you? or that there be
three days' pestilence in your land? now advise, and see what answer I
shall return to HIM[JESUS] that sent me.

24:14 And David said unto Gad, I am in a great strait: let us fall now
into the hand of the LORD[JESUS]; for HIS[JESUS] mercies are great: and let me not
fall into the hand of man.

24:15 So the LORD[JESUS] sent a pestilence upon Israel from the morning even to
the time appointed: and there died of the people from Dan even to
Beersheba seventy thousand men.

24:16 And when the angel stretched out HIS[JESUS] hand upon Jerusalem to
destroy it, the LORD[JESUS] repented HIM[JESUS] of the evil, and said to the angel
that destroyed the people, It is enough: stay now yours hand. And the
angel of the LORD[JESUS] was by the threshingplace of Araunah the Jebusite.

24:17 And David spake unto the LORD[JESUS] when HE[JESUS] saw the angel that smote the
people, and said, Lo, I have sinned, and I have done wickedly: but these
sheep, what have they done? let yours hand, I pray you, be against me,
and against my father's house.

24:18 And Gad came that day to David, and said unto HIM[JESUS], Go up, rear an
altar unto the LORD[JESUS] in the threshingfloor of Araunah the Jebusite.

24:19 And David, according to the saying of Gad, went up as the LORD[JESUS]
commanded.

24:20 And Araunah looked, and saw the KING[JESUS] and HIS[JESUS] servants coming on
toward HIM[JESUS]: and Araunah went out, and bowed himself before the KING[JESUS] on
HIS[JESUS] face upon the ground.

24:21 And Araunah said, Wherefore is my LORD[JESUS] the KING[JESUS] come to HIS[JESUS]
SERVANT[JESUS]? And David said, To buy the threshingfloor of you, to build an
altar unto the LORD[JESUS], that the plague may be stayed from the people.

24:22 And Araunah said unto David, Let my LORD[JESUS] the KING[JESUS] take and offer
up what seemeth good unto HIM[JESUS]: behold, here be oxen for burnt sacrifice,
and threshing instruments and other instruments of the oxen for wood.

24:23 All these things did Araunah, as a KING[JESUS], give unto the KING[JESUS]. And
Araunah said unto the KING[JESUS], The LORD[JESUS] your GOD[JESUS] accept you.

24:24 And the KING[JESUS] said unto Araunah, Nay; but I will surely buy it of
you at a price: neither will I offer burnt offerings unto the LORD[JESUS] my
GOD[JESUS] of that which does cost me nothing. So David bought the
threshingfloor and the oxen for fifty shekels of silver.

24:25 And David built there an altar unto the LORD[JESUS], and offered burnt
offerings and peace offerings. So the LORD[JESUS] was intreated for the land,
and the plague was stayed from Israel.

1:1 Now KING[JESUS] David was old and stricken in years; and they covered HIM[JESUS]
with clothes, but HE[JESUS] gat no heat.

1:2 Wherefore HIS[JESUS] servants said unto HIM[JESUS], Let there be sought for my
LORD[JESUS] the KING[JESUS] a young virgin: and let her stand before the KING[JESUS], and let
her cherish HIM[JESUS], and let her lie in your bosom, that my LORD[JESUS] the KING[JESUS] may
get heat.

1:3 So they sought for a fair damsel throughout all the coasts of
Israel, and found Abishag a Shunammite, and brought her to the KING[JESUS].

1:4 And the damsel was very fair, and cherished the KING[JESUS], and ministered
to HIM[JESUS]: but the KING[JESUS] knew her not.

1:5 Then Adonijah the SON[JESUS] of Haggith exalted himself, saying, I will be
KING[JESUS]: and HE[JESUS] prepared HIM[JESUS] chariots and horsemen, and fifty men to run
before HIM[JESUS].

hast you done so? and HE[JESUS] also was a very goodly man; and HIS[JESUS] mother
bare HIM[JESUS] after Absalom.

priest: and they following Adonijah helped HIM[JESUS].

the PROPHET[JESUS], and Shimei, and Rei, and the mighty men which belonged to

you mayest save yours own life, and the life of your SON[JESUS] Solomon.

1:14 Behold, while you yet talkest there with the KING[JESUS], I also will
come in after you, and confirm your words.

1:15 And Bathsheba went in unto the KING[JESUS] into the chamber: and the KING[JESUS]

1:16 And Bathsheba bowed, and did obeisance unto the KING[JESUS]. And the KING[JESUS]

1:17 And she said unto HIM[JESUS], My LORD[JESUS], you swarest by the LORD[JESUS] your GOD[JESUS]
unto yours handmaid, saying, Assuredly Solomon your SON[JESUS] shall reign after

1:18 And now, behold, Adonijah reigneth; and now, my LORD[JESUS] the KING[JESUS], you
knowest it not:

1:19 And HE[JESUS] has slain oxen and fat cattle and sheep in abundance, and
has called all the sons of the KING[JESUS], and Abiathar the priest, and Joab

1:20 And you, my LORD[JESUS], O KING[JESUS], the eyes of all Israel are upon you,

1:21 Otherwise it shall come to pass, when my LORD[JESUS] the KING[JESUS] shall sleep
with HIS[JESUS] fathers, that I and my SON[JESUS] Solomon shall be counted offenders.

1:22 And, lo, while she yet talked with the KING[JESUS], Nathan the PROPHET[JESUS]
also came in.

1:23 And they told the KING[JESUS], saying, Behold Nathan the PROPHET[JESUS]. And when
HE[JESUS] was come in before the KING[JESUS], HE[JESUS] bowed himself before the KING[JESUS] with

1:24 And Nathan said, My LORD[JESUS], O KING[JESUS], hast you said, Adonijah shall
reign after me, and HE[JESUS] shall sit upon my throne?

1:25 For HE[JESUS] is gone down this day, and has slain oxen and fat cattle
and sheep in abundance, and has called all the KING[JESUS]'s sons, and the

1:26 But me, even me your SERVANT[JESUS], and Zadok the priest, and Benaiah the
SON[JESUS] of Jehoiada, and your SERVANT[JESUS] Solomon, has HE[JESUS] not called.

1:27 Is this thing done by my LORD[JESUS] the KING[JESUS], and you hast not shewed it

1:31 Then Bathsheba bowed with her face to the earth, and did reverence

1:32 And KING[JESUS] David said, Call me Zadok the priest, and Nathan the
PROPHET[JESUS], and Benaiah the SON[JESUS] of Jehoiada. And they came before the KING[JESUS].

1:33 The KING[JESUS] also said unto them, Take with you the servants of your

1:35 Then you shall come up after HIM[JESUS], that HE[JESUS] may come and sit upon my

1:36 And Benaiah the SON[JESUS] of Jehoiada answered the KING[JESUS], and said, Amen:
the LORD[JESUS] GOD[JESUS] of my LORD[JESUS] the KING[JESUS] say so too.

1:37 As the LORD[JESUS] has been with my LORD[JESUS] the KING[JESUS], even so be HE[JESUS] with

1:38 So Zadok the priest, and Nathan the PROPHET[JESUS], and Benaiah the SON[JESUS] of

1:39 And Zadok the priest took an horn of oil out of the tabernacle, and

1:40 And all the people came up after HIM[JESUS], and the people piped with

1:41 And Adonijah and all the guests that were with HIM[JESUS] heard it as they

1:42 And while HE[JESUS] yet spake, behold, Jonathan the SON[JESUS] of Abiathar the

1:43 And Jonathan answered and said to Adonijah, truly our LORD[JESUS] KING[JESUS]

1:44 And the KING[JESUS] has sent with HIM[JESUS] Zadok the priest, and Nathan the
PROPHET[JESUS], and Benaiah the SON[JESUS] of Jehoiada, and the Cherethites, and the

1:45 And Zadok the priest and Nathan the PROPHET[JESUS] have anointed HIM[JESUS] KING[JESUS]

1:46 And also Solomon sitteth on the throne of the kingdom.

1:47 And moreover the KING[JESUS]'s servants came to bless our LORD[JESUS] KING[JESUS] David,

2:1 Now the days of David drew nigh that HE[JESUS] should die; and HE[JESUS] charged
Solomon HIS[JESUS] SON[JESUS], saying,

2:2 I go the way of all the earth: be you strong therefore, and shew
thyself a man;

2:3 And keep the charge of the LORD[JESUS] your GOD[JESUS], to walk in HIS[JESUS] ways, to
keep HIS[JESUS] statutes, and HIS[JESUS] commandments, and HIS[JESUS] judgments, and HIS[JESUS]
testimonies, as it is written in the law of Moses, that you mayest
prosper in all that you doest, and whithersoever you turnest thyself:

2:4 That the LORD[JESUS] may continue HIS[JESUS] WORD[JESUS] which HE[JESUS] spake concerning me,
saying, If your children take heed to their way, to walk before me in
truth with all their heart and with all their soul, there shall not fail
you (said HE[JESUS]) a man on the throne of Israel.

2:5 Moreover you knowest also what Joab the SON[JESUS] of Zeruiah did to me,
and what HE[JESUS] did to the two captains of the hosts of Israel, unto Abner
the SON[JESUS] of Ner, and unto Amasa the SON[JESUS] of Jether, whom HE[JESUS] slew, and shed
the blood of war in peace, and put the blood of war upon HIS[JESUS] girdle that
was about HIS[JESUS] loins, and in HIS[JESUS] shoes that were on HIS[JESUS] feet.

2:6 Do therefore according to your wisdom, and let not HIS[JESUS] hoar head go
down to the grave in peace.

2:7 But shew kindness unto the sons of Barzillai the Gileadite, and let
them be of those that eat at your table: for so they came to me when I

2:8 And, behold, you hast with you Shimei the SON[JESUS] of Gera, a Benjamite
of Bahurim, which cursed me with a grievous curse in the day when I went
to Mahanaim: but HE[JESUS] came down to meet me at Jordan, and I sware to HIM[JESUS]
by the LORD[JESUS], saying, I will not put you to death with the sword.

2:9 Now therefore hold HIM[JESUS] not guiltless: for you art a wise man, and
knowest what you oughtest to do unto HIM[JESUS]; but HIS[JESUS] hoar head bring you
down to the grave with blood.

2:10 So David slept with HIS[JESUS] fathers, and was buried in the city of

2:11 And the days that David reigned over Israel were forty years: seven

2:12 Then sat Solomon upon the throne of David HIS[JESUS] father; and HIS[JESUS]

2:13 And Adonijah the SON[JESUS] of Haggith came to Bathsheba the mother of

2:14 HE[JESUS] said moreover, I have somewhat to say unto you. And she said,

2:15 And HE[JESUS] said, you knowest that the kingdom was mine, and that all

2:16 And now I ask one petition of you, deny me not. And she said unto

2:17 And HE[JESUS] said, Speak, I pray you, unto Solomon the KING[JESUS], (for HE[JESUS]
will not say you nay,) that HE[JESUS] give me Abishag the Shunammite to wife.

2:18 And Bathsheba said, Well; I will speak for you unto the KING[JESUS].

2:19 Bathsheba therefore went unto KING[JESUS] Solomon, to speak unto HIM[JESUS] for

2:20 Then she said, I desire one small petition of you; I pray you,
say me not nay. And the KING[JESUS] said unto her, Ask on, my mother: for I
will not say you nay.

2:21 And she said, Let Abishag the Shunammite be given to Adonijah your
brother to wife.

2:22 And KING[JESUS] Solomon answered and said unto HIS[JESUS] mother, And why dost
you ask Abishag the Shunammite for Adonijah? ask for HIM[JESUS] the kingdom
also; for HE[JESUS] is mine elder brother; even for HIM[JESUS], and for Abiathar the

2:23 Then KING[JESUS] Solomon sware by the LORD[JESUS], saying, GOD[JESUS] do so to me, and
