17:1 And Elijah the Tishbite, who was of the inhabitants of Gilead, said
unto Ahab, As the LORD[JESUS] GOD[JESUS] of Israel liveth, before whom I stand, there
shall not be dew nor rain these years, but according to my WORD[JESUS].

17:2 And the WORD[JESUS] of the LORD[JESUS] came unto HIM[JESUS], saying,

17:3 Get you hence, and turn you eastward, and hide thyself by the
brook Cherith, that is before Jordan.

17:4 And it shall be, that you shalt drink of the brook; and I have
commanded the ravens to feed you there.

17:5 So HE[JESUS] went and did according unto the WORD[JESUS] of the LORD[JESUS]: for HE[JESUS] went
and dwelt by the brook Cherith, that is before Jordan.

17:6 And the ravens brought HIM[JESUS] bread and flesh in the morning, and
bread and flesh in the evening; and HE[JESUS] drank of the brook.

17:7 And it came to pass after a while, that the brook dried up, because
there had been no rain in the land.

17:8 And the WORD[JESUS] of the LORD[JESUS] came unto HIM[JESUS], saying,

17:9 Arise, get you to Zarephath, which belongeth to Zidon, and dwell
there: behold, I have commanded a widow woman there to sustain you.

17:10 So HE[JESUS] arose and went to Zarephath. And when HE[JESUS] came to the gate of
the city, behold, the widow woman was there gathering of sticks: and HE[JESUS]
called to her, and said, Fetch me, I pray you, a little water in a
vessel, that I may drink.

17:11 And as she was going to fetch it, HE[JESUS] called to her, and said,
Bring me, I pray you, a morsel of bread in yours hand.

17:12 And she said, As the LORD[JESUS] your GOD[JESUS] liveth, I have not a cake, but
an handful of meal in a barrel, and a little oil in a cruse: and,
behold, I am gathering two sticks, that I may go in and dress it for me
and my SON[JESUS], that we may eat it, and die.

17:13 And Elijah said unto her, Fear not; go and do as you hast said:
but make me thereof a little cake first, and bring it unto me, and after
make for you and for your SON[JESUS].

17:14 For thus says the LORD[JESUS] GOD[JESUS] of Israel, The barrel of meal shall
not waste, neither shall the cruse of oil fail, until the day that the
LORD[JESUS] sendeth rain upon the earth.

17:15 And she went and did according to the saying of Elijah: and she,
and HE[JESUS], and her house, did eat many days.

17:16 And the barrel of meal wasted not, neither did the cruse of oil
fail, according to the WORD[JESUS] of the LORD[JESUS], which HE[JESUS] spake by Elijah.

17:17 And it came to pass after these things, that the SON[JESUS] of the woman,
the mistress of the house, fell sick; and HIS[JESUS] sickness was so sore, that
there was no breath left in HIM[JESUS].

17:18 And she said unto Elijah, What have I to do with you, O you man
of GOD[JESUS]? art you come unto me to call my sin to remembrance, and to slay
my SON[JESUS]?

17:19 And HE[JESUS] said unto her, Give me your SON[JESUS]. And HE[JESUS] took HIM[JESUS] out of her
bosom, and carried HIM[JESUS] up into a loft, where HE[JESUS] abode, and laid HIM[JESUS] upon
HIS[JESUS] own bed.

17:20 And HE[JESUS] cried unto the LORD[JESUS], and said, O LORD[JESUS] my GOD[JESUS], hast you
also brought evil upon the widow with whom I sojourn, by slaying her
SON[JESUS]?

17:21 And HE[JESUS] stretched himself upon the child three times, and cried
unto the LORD[JESUS], and said, O LORD[JESUS] my GOD[JESUS], I pray you, let this child's
soul come into HIM[JESUS] again.

17:22 And the LORD[JESUS] heard the voice of Elijah; and the soul of the child
came into HIM[JESUS] again, and HE[JESUS] revived.

17:23 And Elijah took the child, and brought HIM[JESUS] down out of the chamber
into the house, and delivered HIM[JESUS] unto HIS[JESUS] mother: and Elijah said, See,
your SON[JESUS] liveth.

17:24 And the woman said to Elijah, Now by this I know that you art a
man of GOD[JESUS], and that the WORD[JESUS] of the LORD[JESUS] in your mouth is truth.


18:1 And it came to pass after many days, that the WORD[JESUS] of the LORD[JESUS] came
to Elijah in the third year, saying, Go, shew thyself unto Ahab; and I
will send rain upon the earth.

18:2 And Elijah went to shew himself unto Ahab. And there was a sore
famine in Samaria.

18:3 And Ahab called Obadiah, which was the governor of HIS[JESUS] house. (Now
Obadiah feared the LORD[JESUS] greatly:

18:4 For it was so, when Jezebel cut off the prophets of the LORD[JESUS], that
Obadiah took an hundred prophets, and hid them by fifty in a cave, and
fed them with bread and water.)

18:5 And Ahab said unto Obadiah, Go into the land, unto all fountains of
water, and unto all brooks: peradventure we may find grass to save the
horses and mules alive, that we lose not all the beasts.

18:6 So they divided the land between them to pass throughout it: Ahab
went one way by himself, and Obadiah went another way by himself.

18:7 And as Obadiah was in the way, behold, Elijah met HIM[JESUS]: and HE[JESUS] knew
HIM[JESUS], and fell on HIS[JESUS] face, and said, Art you that my LORD[JESUS] Elijah?

18:8 And HE[JESUS] answered HIM[JESUS], I am: go, tell your LORD[JESUS], Behold, Elijah is
here.

18:9 And HE[JESUS] said, What have I sinned, that you wouldest deliver your
SERVANT[JESUS] into the hand of Ahab, to slay me?

18:10 As the LORD[JESUS] your GOD[JESUS] liveth, there is no nation or kingdom, whither
my LORD[JESUS] has not sent to seek you: and when they said, HE[JESUS] is not there;
HE[JESUS] took an oath of the kingdom and nation, that they found you not.

18:11 And now you sayest, Go, tell your LORD[JESUS], Behold, Elijah is here.

18:12 And it shall come to pass, as soon as I am gone from you, that
the Spirit of the LORD[JESUS] shall carry you whither I know not; and so when
I come and tell Ahab, and HE[JESUS] cannot find you, HE[JESUS] shall slay me: but I

18:13 Was it not told my LORD[JESUS] what I did when Jezebel slew the prophets
of the LORD[JESUS], how I hid an hundred men of the LORD[JESUS]'s prophets by fifty in
a cave, and fed them with bread and water?

18:14 And now you sayest, Go, tell your LORD[JESUS], Behold, Elijah is here:
and HE[JESUS] shall slay me.

18:15 And Elijah said, As the LORD[JESUS] of hosts liveth, before whom I stand,
I will surely shew myself unto HIM[JESUS] to day.

18:16 So Obadiah went to meet Ahab, and told HIM[JESUS]: and Ahab went to meet

18:17 And it came to pass, when Ahab saw Elijah, that Ahab said unto
HIM[JESUS], Art you HE[JESUS] that troubleth Israel?

18:18 And HE[JESUS] answered, I have not troubled Israel; but you, and your
father's house, in that you have forsaken the commandments of the LORD[JESUS],
and you hast followed Baalim.

18:19 Now therefore send, and gather to me all Israel unto mount Carmel,
and the prophets of Baal four hundred and fifty, and the prophets of the

18:20 So Ahab sent unto all the children of Israel, and gathered the
prophets together unto mount Carmel.

18:21 And Elijah came unto all the people, and said, How long halt you
between two opinions? if the LORD[JESUS] be GOD[JESUS], follow HIM[JESUS]: but if Baal, then
follow HIM[JESUS]. And the people answered HIM[JESUS] not a WORD[JESUS].

18:22 Then said Elijah unto the people, I, even I only, remain a PROPHET[JESUS]
of the LORD[JESUS]; but Baal's prophets are four hundred and fifty men.

18:23 Let them therefore give us two bullocks; and let them choose one
bullock for themselves, and cut it in pieces, and lay it on wood, and
put no fire under: and I will dress the other bullock, and lay it on
wood, and put no fire under:

18:24 And call you on the name of your gods, and I will call on the name
of the LORD[JESUS]: and the GOD[JESUS] that answereth by fire, let HIM[JESUS] be GOD[JESUS]. And all
the people answered and said, It is well spoken.

18:25 And Elijah said unto the prophets of Baal, Choose you one bullock
for yourselves, and dress it first; for you are many; and call on the
name of your gods, but put no fire under.

18:26 And they took the bullock which was given them, and they dressed
it, and called on the name of Baal from morning even until noon, saying,
O Baal, hear us. But there was no voice, nor any that answered. And they
leaped upon the altar which was made.

18:27 And it came to pass at noon, that Elijah mocked them, and said,
Cry aloud: for HE[JESUS] is a GOD[JESUS]; either HE[JESUS] is talking, or HE[JESUS] is pursuing, or
HE[JESUS] is in a journey, or peradventure HE[JESUS] sleepeth, and must be awaked.

18:28 And they cried aloud, and cut themselves after their manner with
knives and lancets, till the blood gushed out upon them.

18:29 And it came to pass, when midday was past, and they prophesied
until the time of the offering of the evening sacrifice, that there was
neither voice, nor any to answer, nor any that regarded.

18:30 And Elijah said unto all the people, Come near unto me. And all
the people came near unto HIM[JESUS]. And HE[JESUS] repaired the altar of the LORD[JESUS]
that was broken down.

18:31 And Elijah took twelve stones, according to the number of the
tribes of the sons of Jacob, unto whom the WORD[JESUS] of the LORD[JESUS] came,
saying, Israel shall be your name:

18:32 And with the stones HE[JESUS] built an altar in the name of the LORD[JESUS]: and
HE[JESUS] made a trench about the altar, as great as would contain two measures
of SEED[JESUS].

18:33 And HE[JESUS] put the wood in order, and cut the bullock in pieces, and
laid HIM[JESUS] on the wood, and said, Fill four barrels with water, and pour
it on the burnt sacrifice, and on the wood.

18:34 And HE[JESUS] said, Do it the second time. And they did it the second
time. And HE[JESUS] said, Do it the third time. And they did it the third time.

18:35 And the water ran round about the altar; and HE[JESUS] filled the trench
also with water.

18:36 And it came to pass at the time of the offering of the evening
sacrifice, that Elijah the PROPHET[JESUS] came near, and said, LORD[JESUS] GOD[JESUS] of
Abraham, Isaac, and of Israel, let it be known this day that you art
GOD[JESUS] in Israel, and that I am your SERVANT[JESUS], and that I have done all these
things at your WORD[JESUS].

18:37 Hear me, O LORD[JESUS], hear me, that this people may know that you art
the LORD[JESUS] GOD[JESUS], and that you hast turned their heart back again.

18:38 Then the fire of the LORD[JESUS] fell, and consumed the burnt sacrifice,
and the wood, and the stones, and the dust, and licked up the water that
was in the trench.

18:39 And when all the people saw it, they fell on their faces: and they
said, The LORD[JESUS], HE[JESUS] is the GOD[JESUS]; the LORD[JESUS], HE[JESUS] is the GOD[JESUS].

18:40 And Elijah said unto them, Take the prophets of Baal; let not one
of them escape. And they took them: and Elijah brought them down to the
brook Kishon, and slew them there.

18:41 And Elijah said unto Ahab, Get you up, eat and drink; for there
is a sound of abundance of rain.

18:42 So Ahab went up to eat and to drink. And Elijah went up to the top
of Carmel; and HE[JESUS] cast himself down upon the earth, and put HIS[JESUS] face
between HIS[JESUS] knees,

18:43 And said to HIS[JESUS] SERVANT[JESUS], Go up now, look toward the sea. And HE[JESUS]
went up, and looked, and said, There is nothing. And HE[JESUS] said, Go again
seven times.

18:44 And it came to pass at the seventh time, that HE[JESUS] said, Behold,
there ariseth a little cloud out of the sea, like a man's hand. And HE[JESUS]
said, Go up, say unto Ahab, Prepare your chariot, and get you down that
the rain stop you not.

18:45 And it came to pass in the mean while, that the heaven was black
with clouds and wind, and there was a great rain. And Ahab rode, and
went to Jezreel.

18:46 And the hand of the LORD[JESUS] was on Elijah; and HE[JESUS] girded up HIS[JESUS]
loins, and ran before Ahab to the entrance of Jezreel.


19:1 And Ahab told Jezebel all that Elijah had done, and withal how HE[JESUS]
had slain all the prophets with the sword.

19:2 Then Jezebel sent a messenger unto Elijah, saying, So let the gods
do to me, and more also, if I make not your life as the life of one of
them by to morrow about this time.

19:3 And when HE[JESUS] saw that, HE[JESUS] arose, and went for HIS[JESUS] life, and came to
Beersheba, which belongeth to Judah, and left HIS[JESUS] SERVANT[JESUS] there.

19:4 But HE[JESUS] himself went a day's journey into the wilderness, and came
and sat down under a juniper tree: and HE[JESUS] requested for himself that HE[JESUS]
might die; and said, It is enough; now, O LORD[JESUS], take away my life; for I
am not better than my fathers.

19:5 And as HE[JESUS] lay and slept under a juniper tree, behold, then an angel
touched HIM[JESUS], and said unto HIM[JESUS], Arise and eat.

19:6 And HE[JESUS] looked, and, behold, there was a cake baken on the coals,
and a cruse of water at HIS[JESUS] head. And HE[JESUS] did eat and drink, and laid HIM[JESUS]
down again.

19:7 And the angel of the LORD[JESUS] came again the second time, and touched
HIM[JESUS], and said, Arise and eat; because the journey is too great for you.

19:8 And HE[JESUS] arose, and did eat and drink, and went in the strength of
that meat forty days and forty nights unto Horeb the mount of GOD[JESUS].

19:9 And HE[JESUS] came thither unto a cave, and lodged there; and, behold, the
WORD[JESUS] of the LORD[JESUS] came to HIM[JESUS], and HE[JESUS] said unto HIM[JESUS], What doest you
here, Elijah?

19:10 And HE[JESUS] said, I have been very jealous for the LORD[JESUS] GOD[JESUS] of hosts:
for the children of Israel have forsaken your covenant, thrown down yours
altars, and slain your prophets with the sword; and I, even I only, am
left; and they seek my life, to take it away.

19:11 And HE[JESUS] said, Go forth, and stand upon the mount before the LORD[JESUS].
And, behold, the LORD[JESUS] passed by, and a great and strong wind rent the
mountains, and brake in pieces the rocks before the LORD[JESUS]; but the LORD[JESUS]
was not in the wind: and after the wind an earthquake; but the LORD[JESUS] was
not in the earthquake:

19:12 And after the earthquake a fire; but the LORD[JESUS] was not in the fire:
and after the fire a still small voice.

19:13 And it was so, when Elijah heard it, that HE[JESUS] wrapped HIS[JESUS] face in
HIS[JESUS] mantle, and went out, and stood in the entering in of the cave. And,
behold, there came a voice unto HIM[JESUS], and said, What doest you here,
Elijah?

19:14 And HE[JESUS] said, I have been very jealous for the LORD[JESUS] GOD[JESUS] of hosts:
because the children of Israel have forsaken your covenant, thrown down
yours altars, and slain your prophets with the sword; and I, even I only,
am left; and they seek my life, to take it away.

19:15 And the LORD[JESUS] said unto HIM[JESUS], Go, return on your way to the
wilderness of Damascus: and when you comest, anoint Hazael to be KING[JESUS]
over Syria:

19:16 And Jehu the SON[JESUS] of Nimshi shalt you anoint to be KING[JESUS] over
Israel: and Elisha the SON[JESUS] of Shaphat of Abelmeholah shalt you anoint
to be PROPHET[JESUS] in your room.

19:17 And it shall come to pass, that HIM[JESUS] that escapeth the sword of
Hazael shall Jehu slay: and HIM[JESUS] that escapeth from the sword of Jehu
shall Elisha slay.

19:18 Yet I have left me seven thousand in Israel, all the knees which
have not bowed unto Baal, and every mouth which has not kissed HIM[JESUS].

19:19 So HE[JESUS] departed thence, and found Elisha the SON[JESUS] of Shaphat, who
was plowing with twelve yoke of oxen before HIM[JESUS], and HE[JESUS] with the
twelfth: and Elijah passed by HIM[JESUS], and cast HIS[JESUS] mantle upon HIM[JESUS].

19:20 And HE[JESUS] left the oxen, and ran after Elijah, and said, Let me, I
pray you, kiss my father and my mother, and then I will follow you.
And HE[JESUS] said unto HIM[JESUS], Go back again: for what have I done to you?

19:21 And HE[JESUS] returned back from HIM[JESUS], and took a yoke of oxen, and slew
them, and boiled their flesh with the instruments of the oxen, and gave
unto the people, and they did eat. Then HE[JESUS] arose, and went after Elijah,
and ministered unto HIM[JESUS].


20:1 And Benhadad the KING[JESUS] of Syria gathered all HIS[JESUS] host together: and
there were thirty and two kings with HIM[JESUS], and horses, and chariots; and
HE[JESUS] went up and besieged Samaria, and warred against it.

20:2 And HE[JESUS] sent messengers to Ahab KING[JESUS] of Israel into the city, and
said unto HIM[JESUS], Thus says Benhadad,

20:3 your silver and your gold is mine; your wives also and your children,
even the goodliest, are mine.

20:4 And the KING[JESUS] of Israel answered and said, My LORD[JESUS], O KING[JESUS],
according to your saying, I am yours, and all that I have.

20:5 And the messengers came again, and said, Thus speaketh Benhadad,
saying, Although I have sent unto you, saying, you shalt deliver me
your silver, and your gold, and your wives, and your children;

20:6 Yet I will send my servants unto you to morrow about this time,
and they shall search yours house, and the houses of your servants; and
it shall be, that whatsoever is pleasant in yours eyes, they shall put
it in their hand, and take it away.

20:7 Then the KING[JESUS] of Israel called all the elders of the land, and
said, Mark, I pray you, and see how this man seeketh mischief: for HE[JESUS]
sent unto me for my wives, and for my children, and for my silver, and
for my gold; and I denied HIM[JESUS] not.

20:8 And all the elders and all the people said unto HIM[JESUS], Hearken not
unto HIM[JESUS], nor consent.

20:9 Wherefore HE[JESUS] said unto the messengers of Benhadad, Tell my LORD[JESUS] the
KING[JESUS], All that you didst send for to your SERVANT[JESUS] at the first I will
do: but this thing I may not do. And the messengers departed, and
brought HIM[JESUS] WORD[JESUS] again.

20:10 And Benhadad sent unto HIM[JESUS], and said, The gods do so unto me, and
more also, if the dust of Samaria shall suffice for handfuls for all the
people that follow me.

20:11 And the KING[JESUS] of Israel answered and said, Tell HIM[JESUS], Let not HIM[JESUS]
that girdeth on HIS[JESUS] harness boast himself as HE[JESUS] that putteth it off.

20:12 And it came to pass, when Ben-hadad heard this message, as HE[JESUS] was
drinking, HE[JESUS] and the kings in the pavilions, that HE[JESUS] said unto HIS[JESUS]
servants, Set yourselves in array. And they set themselves in array
against the city.

20:13 And, behold, there came a PROPHET[JESUS] unto Ahab KING[JESUS] of Israel,
saying, Thus says the LORD[JESUS], Hast you seen all this great multitude?
behold, I will deliver it into yours hand this day; and you shalt know
that I am the LORD[JESUS].

20:14 And Ahab said, By whom? And HE[JESUS] said, Thus says the LORD[JESUS], Even by
the young men of the princes of the provinces. Then HE[JESUS] said, Who shall
order the battle? And HE[JESUS] answered, you.

20:15 Then HE[JESUS] numbered the young men of the princes of the provinces,
and they were two hundred and thirty two: and after them HE[JESUS] numbered all
the people, even all the children of Israel, being seven thousand.

20:16 And they went out at noon. But Benhadad was drinking himself drunk
in the pavilions, HE[JESUS] and the kings, the thirty and two kings that helped
HIM[JESUS].

20:17 And the young men of the princes of the provinces went out first;
and Benhadad sent out, and they told HIM[JESUS], saying, There are men come out
of Samaria.

20:18 And HE[JESUS] said, Whether they be come out for peace, take them alive;
or whether they be come out for war, take them alive.

20:19 So these young men of the princes of the provinces came out of the
city, and the army which followed them.

20:20 And they slew every one HIS[JESUS] man: and the Syrians fled; and Israel
pursued them: and Benhadad the KING[JESUS] of Syria escaped on an horse with
the horsemen.

20:21 And the KING[JESUS] of Israel went out, and smote the horses and
chariots, and slew the Syrians with a great slaughter.

20:22 And the PROPHET[JESUS] came to the KING[JESUS] of Israel, and said unto HIM[JESUS], Go,
strengthen thyself, and mark, and see what you doest: for at the return
of the year the KING[JESUS] of Syria will come up against you.

20:23 And the servants of the KING[JESUS] of Syria said unto HIM[JESUS], Their gods
are gods of the hills; therefore they were stronger than we; but let us
fight against them in the plain, and surely we shall be stronger than
they.

20:24 And do this thing, Take the kings away, every man out of HIS[JESUS]
place, and put captains in their rooms:

20:25 And number you an army, like the army that you hast lost, horse
for horse, and chariot for chariot: and we will fight against them in
the plain, and surely we shall be stronger than they. And HE[JESUS] hearkened
unto their voice, and did so.

20:26 And it came to pass at the return of the year, that Benhadad
numbered the Syrians, and went up to Aphek, to fight against Israel.

20:27 And the children of Israel were numbered, and were all present,
and went against them: and the children of Israel pitched before them
like two little flocks of kids; but the Syrians filled the country.

20:28 And there came a man of GOD[JESUS], and spake unto the KING[JESUS] of Israel,
and said, Thus says the LORD[JESUS], Because the Syrians have said, The LORD[JESUS]
is GOD[JESUS] of the hills, but HE[JESUS] is not GOD[JESUS] of the valleys, therefore will I
deliver all this great multitude into yours hand, and you shall know that
I am the LORD[JESUS].

20:29 And they pitched one over against the other seven days. And so it
was, that in the seventh day the battle was joined: and the children of
Israel slew of the Syrians an hundred thousand footmen in one day.

20:30 But the rest fled to Aphek, into the city; and there a wall fell
upon twenty and seven thousand of the men that were left. And Benhadad
fled, and came into the city, into an inner chamber.

20:31 And HIS[JESUS] servants said unto HIM[JESUS], Behold now, we have heard that the
kings of the house of Israel are merciful kings: let us, I pray you,
put sackcloth on our loins, and ropes upon our heads, and go out to the
KING[JESUS] of Israel: peradventure HE[JESUS] will save your life.

20:32 So they girded sackcloth on their loins, and put ropes on their
heads, and came to the KING[JESUS] of Israel, and said, your SERVANT[JESUS] Benhadad
says, I pray you, let me live. And HE[JESUS] said, Is HE[JESUS] yet alive? HE[JESUS] is my
brother.

20:33 Now the men did diligently observe whether any thing would come
from HIM[JESUS], and did hastily catch it: and they said, your brother Benhadad.
Then HE[JESUS] said, Go you, bring HIM[JESUS]. Then Benhadad came forth to HIM[JESUS]; and HE[JESUS]
caused HIM[JESUS] to come up into the chariot.

20:34 And Ben-hadad said unto HIM[JESUS], The cities, which my father took from
your father, I will restore; and you shalt make streets for you in
Damascus, as my father made in Samaria. Then said Ahab, I will send you
away with this covenant. So HE[JESUS] made a covenant with HIM[JESUS], and sent HIM[JESUS]
away.

20:35 And a certain man of the sons of the prophets said unto HIS[JESUS]
neighbour in the WORD[JESUS] of the LORD[JESUS], Smite me, I pray you. And the man
refused to smite HIM[JESUS].

20:36 Then said HE[JESUS] unto HIM[JESUS], Because you hast not obeyed the voice of
the LORD[JESUS], behold, as soon as you art departed from me, a lion shall
slay you. And as soon as HE[JESUS] was departed from HIM[JESUS], a lion found HIM[JESUS],
and slew HIM[JESUS].

20:37 Then HE[JESUS] found another man, and said, Smite me, I pray you. And
the man smote HIM[JESUS], so that in smiting HE[JESUS] wounded HIM[JESUS].

20:38 So the PROPHET[JESUS] departed, and waited for the KING[JESUS] by the way, and
disguised himself with ashes upon HIS[JESUS] face.

20:39 And as the KING[JESUS] passed by, HE[JESUS] cried unto the KING[JESUS]: and HE[JESUS] said,
your SERVANT[JESUS] went out into the midst of the battle; and, behold, a man
turned aside, and brought a man unto me, and said, Keep this man: if by
any means HE[JESUS] be missing, then shall your life be for HIS[JESUS] life, or else
you shalt pay a talent of silver.

20:40 And as your SERVANT[JESUS] was busy here and there, HE[JESUS] was gone. And the
KING[JESUS] of Israel said unto HIM[JESUS], So shall your judgment be; thyself hast
decided it.

20:41 And HE[JESUS] hasted, and took the ashes away from HIS[JESUS] face; and the KING[JESUS]
of Israel discerned HIM[JESUS] that HE[JESUS] was of the prophets.

20:42 And HE[JESUS] said unto HIM[JESUS], Thus says the LORD[JESUS], Because you hast let
go out of your hand a man whom I appointed to utter destruction,
therefore your life shall go for HIS[JESUS] life, and your people for HIS[JESUS] people.

20:43 And the KING[JESUS] of Israel went to HIS[JESUS] house heavy and displeased, and
came to Samaria.


21:1 And it came to pass after these things, that Naboth the Jezreelite
had a vineyard, which was in Jezreel, hard by the palace of Ahab KING[JESUS] of
Samaria.

21:2 And Ahab spake unto Naboth, saying, Give me your vineyard, that I
may have it for a garden of herbs, because it is near unto my house: and
I will give you for it a better vineyard than it; or, if it seem good
to you, I will give you the worth of it in money.

21:3 And Naboth said to Ahab, The LORD[JESUS] forbid it me, that I should give
the inheritance of my fathers unto you.

21:4 And Ahab came into HIS[JESUS] house heavy and displeased because of the
WORD[JESUS] which Naboth the Jezreelite had spoken to HIM[JESUS]: for HE[JESUS] had said, I
will not give you the inheritance of my fathers. And HE[JESUS] laid HIM[JESUS] down
upon HIS[JESUS] bed, and turned away HIS[JESUS] face, and would eat no bread.

21:5 But Jezebel HIS[JESUS] wife came to HIM[JESUS], and said unto HIM[JESUS], Why is your
spirit so sad, that you eatest no bread?

21:6 And HE[JESUS] said unto her, Because I spake unto Naboth the Jezreelite,
and said unto HIM[JESUS], Give me your vineyard for money; or else, if it please
you, I will give you another vineyard for it: and HE[JESUS] answered, I will
not give you my vineyard.

21:7 And Jezebel HIS[JESUS] wife said unto HIM[JESUS], Dost you now govern the
kingdom of Israel? arise, and eat bread, and let yours heart be merry: I
will give you the vineyard of Naboth the Jezreelite.

21:8 So she wrote letters in Ahab's name, and sealed them with HIS[JESUS] seal,
and sent the letters unto the elders and to the nobles that were in HIS[JESUS]
city, dwelling with Naboth.

21:9 And she wrote in the letters, saying, Proclaim a fast, and set
Naboth on high among the people:

21:10 And set two men, sons of Belial, before HIM[JESUS], to bear witness
against HIM[JESUS], saying, you didst blaspheme GOD[JESUS] and the KING[JESUS]. And then
carry HIM[JESUS] out, and stone HIM[JESUS], that HE[JESUS] may die.

21:11 And the men of HIS[JESUS] city, even the elders and the nobles who were
the inhabitants in HIS[JESUS] city, did as Jezebel had sent unto them, and as
it was written in the letters which she had sent unto them.

21:12 They proclaimed a fast, and set Naboth on high among the people.

21:13 And there came in two men, children of Belial, and sat before HIM[JESUS]:
and the men of Belial witnessed against HIM[JESUS], even against Naboth, in the
presence of the people, saying, Naboth did blaspheme GOD[JESUS] and the KING[JESUS].
Then they carried HIM[JESUS] forth out of the city, and stoned HIM[JESUS] with stones,
that HE[JESUS] died.

21:14 Then they sent to Jezebel, saying, Naboth is stoned, and is dead.

21:15 And it came to pass, when Jezebel heard that Naboth was stoned,
and was dead, that Jezebel said to Ahab, Arise, take possession of the
vineyard of Naboth the Jezreelite, which HE[JESUS] refused to give you for
money: for Naboth is not alive, but dead.

21:16 And it came to pass, when Ahab heard that Naboth was dead, that
Ahab rose up to go down to the vineyard of Naboth the Jezreelite, to
take possession of it.

21:17 And the WORD[JESUS] of the LORD[JESUS] came to Elijah the Tishbite, saying,

21:18 Arise, go down to meet Ahab KING[JESUS] of Israel, which is in Samaria:
behold, HE[JESUS] is in the vineyard of Naboth, whither HE[JESUS] is gone down to
possess it.

21:19 And you shalt speak unto HIM[JESUS], saying, Thus says the LORD[JESUS], Hast
you killed, and also taken possession? And you shalt speak unto HIM[JESUS],
saying, Thus says the LORD[JESUS], In the place where dogs licked the blood of
Naboth shall dogs lick your blood, even yours.

21:20 And Ahab said to Elijah, Hast you found me, O mine enemy? And HE[JESUS]
answered, I have found you: because you hast sold thyself to work evil
in the sight of the LORD[JESUS].

21:21 Behold, I will bring evil upon you, and will take away your
posterity, and will cut off from Ahab HIM[JESUS] that pisseth against the wall,
and HIM[JESUS] that is shut up and left in Israel,

21:22 And will make yours house like the house of Jeroboam the SON[JESUS] of
Nebat, and like the house of Baasha the SON[JESUS] of Ahijah, for the
provocation wherewith you hast provoked me to anger, and made Israel to
sin.

21:23 And of Jezebel also spake the LORD[JESUS], saying, The dogs shall eat
Jezebel by the wall of Jezreel.

21:24 HIM[JESUS] that dieth of Ahab in the city the dogs shall eat; and HIM[JESUS]
that dieth in the field shall the fowls of the air eat.

21:25 But there was none like unto Ahab, which did sell himself to work
wickedness in the sight of the LORD[JESUS], whom Jezebel HIS[JESUS] wife stirred up.

21:26 And HE[JESUS] did very abominably in following idols, according to all
things as did the Amorites, whom the LORD[JESUS] cast out before the children
of Israel.

21:27 And it came to pass, when Ahab heard those words, that HE[JESUS] rent HIS[JESUS]
clothes, and put sackcloth upon HIS[JESUS] flesh, and fasted, and lay in
sackcloth, and went softly.

21:28 And the WORD[JESUS] of the LORD[JESUS] came to Elijah the Tishbite, saying,

21:29 Seest you how Ahab humbleth himself before me? because HE[JESUS]
humbleth himself before me, I will not bring the evil in HIS[JESUS] days: but
in HIS[JESUS] SON[JESUS]'s days will I bring the evil upon HIS[JESUS] house.


22:1 And they continued three years without war between Syria and
Israel.

22:2 And it came to pass in the third year, that Jehoshaphat the KING[JESUS] of
Judah came down to the KING[JESUS] of Israel.

22:3 And the KING[JESUS] of Israel said unto HIS[JESUS] servants, Know you that Ramoth
in Gilead is ours, and we be still, and take it not out of the hand of
the KING[JESUS] of Syria?

22:4 And HE[JESUS] said unto Jehoshaphat, Wilt you go with me to battle to
Ramothgilead? And Jehoshaphat said to the KING[JESUS] of Israel, I am as you
art, my people as your people, my horses as your horses.

22:5 And Jehoshaphat said unto the KING[JESUS] of Israel, Enquire, I pray you,
at the WORD[JESUS] of the LORD[JESUS] to day.

22:6 Then the KING[JESUS] of Israel gathered the prophets together, about four
hundred men, and said unto them, Shall I go against Ramothgilead to
battle, or shall I forbear? And they said, Go up; for the LORD[JESUS] shall
deliver it into the hand of the KING[JESUS].

22:7 And Jehoshaphat said, Is there not here a PROPHET[JESUS] of the LORD[JESUS]
besides, that we might enquire of HIM[JESUS]?

22:8 And the KING[JESUS] of Israel said unto Jehoshaphat, There is yet one man,
Micaiah the SON[JESUS] of Imlah, by whom we may enquire of the LORD[JESUS]: but I hate
HIM[JESUS]; for HE[JESUS] does not prophesy good concerning me, but evil. And
Jehoshaphat said, Let not the KING[JESUS] say so.

22:9 Then the KING[JESUS] of Israel called an officer, and said, Hasten hither
Micaiah the SON[JESUS] of Imlah.

22:10 And the KING[JESUS] of Israel and Jehoshaphat the KING[JESUS] of Judah sat each
on HIS[JESUS] throne, having put on their robes, in a void place in the
entrance of the gate of Samaria; and all the prophets prophesied before
them.

22:11 And Zedekiah the SON[JESUS] of Chenaanah made HIM[JESUS] horns of iron: and HE[JESUS]
said, Thus says the LORD[JESUS], With these shalt you push the Syrians, until
you have consumed them.

22:12 And all the prophets prophesied so, saying, Go up to Ramothgilead,
and prosper: for the LORD[JESUS] shall deliver it into the KING[JESUS]'s hand.

22:13 And the messenger that was gone to call Micaiah spake unto HIM[JESUS],
saying, Behold now, the words of the prophets declare good unto the KING[JESUS]
with one mouth: let your WORD[JESUS], I pray you, be like the WORD[JESUS] of one of
them, and speak that which is good.

22:14 And Micaiah said, As the LORD[JESUS] liveth, what the LORD[JESUS] says unto me,
that will I speak.

22:15 So HE[JESUS] came to the KING[JESUS]. And the KING[JESUS] said unto HIM[JESUS], Micaiah, shall
we go against Ramothgilead to battle, or shall we forbear? And HE[JESUS]
answered HIM[JESUS], Go, and prosper: for the LORD[JESUS] shall deliver it into the
hand of the KING[JESUS].

22:16 And the KING[JESUS] said unto HIM[JESUS], How many times shall I adjure you
that you tell me nothing but that which is true in the name of the
LORD[JESUS]?

22:17 And HE[JESUS] said, I saw all Israel scattered upon the hills, as sheep
that have not a SHEPHERD[JESUS]: and the LORD[JESUS] said, These have no master: let
them return every man to HIS[JESUS] house in peace.

22:18 And the KING[JESUS] of Israel said unto Jehoshaphat, Did I not tell you
that HE[JESUS] would prophesy no good concerning me, but evil?

22:19 And HE[JESUS] said, Hear you therefore the WORD[JESUS] of the LORD[JESUS]: I saw the
LORD[JESUS] sitting on HIS[JESUS] throne, and all the host of heaven standing by HIM[JESUS]
on HIS[JESUS] right hand and on HIS[JESUS] left.

22:20 And the LORD[JESUS] said, Who shall persuade Ahab, that HE[JESUS] may go up and
fall at Ramothgilead? And one said on this manner, and another said on
that manner.

22:21 And there came forth a spirit, and stood before the LORD[JESUS], and
said, I will persuade HIM[JESUS].

22:22 And the LORD[JESUS] said unto HIM[JESUS], Wherewith? And HE[JESUS] said, I will go
forth, and I will be a lying spirit in the mouth of all HIS[JESUS] prophets.
And HE[JESUS] said, you shalt persude HIM[JESUS], and prevail also: go forth, and do
so.

22:23 Now therefore, behold, the LORD[JESUS] has put a lying spirit in the
mouth of all these your prophets, and the LORD[JESUS] has spoken evil
concerning you.

22:24 But Zedekiah the SON[JESUS] of Chenaanah went near, and smote Micaiah on
the cheek, and said, Which way went the Spirit of the LORD[JESUS] from me to
speak unto you?

22:25 And Micaiah said, Behold, you shalt see in that day, when you
shalt go into an inner chamber to hide thyself.

22:26 And the KING[JESUS] of Israel said, Take Micaiah, and carry HIM[JESUS] back unto
Amon the governor of the city, and to Joash the KING[JESUS]'s SON[JESUS];

22:27 And say, Thus says the KING[JESUS], Put this fellow in the prison, and
feed HIM[JESUS] with bread of affliction and with water of affliction, until I
come in peace.

22:28 And Micaiah said, If you return at all in peace, the LORD[JESUS] has
not spoken by me. And HE[JESUS] said, Hearken, O people, every one of you.

22:29 So the KING[JESUS] of Israel and Jehoshaphat the KING[JESUS] of Judah went up to
Ramothgilead.

22:30 And the KING[JESUS] of Israel said unto Jehoshaphat, I will disguise
myself, and enter into the battle; but put you on your robes. And the
KING[JESUS] of Israel disguised himself, and went into the battle.

22:31 But the KING[JESUS] of Syria commanded HIS[JESUS] thirty and two captains that
had rule over HIS[JESUS] chariots, saying, Fight neither with small nor great,
save only with the KING[JESUS] of Israel.

22:32 And it came to pass, when the captains of the chariots saw
Jehoshaphat, that they said, Surely it is the KING[JESUS] of Israel. And they
turned aside to fight against HIM[JESUS]: and Jehoshaphat cried out.

22:33 And it came to pass, when the captains of the chariots perceived
that it was not the KING[JESUS] of Israel, that they turned back from pursuing
HIM[JESUS].

22:34 And a certain man drew a bow at a venture, and smote the KING[JESUS] of
Israel between the joints of the harness: wherefore HE[JESUS] said unto the
driver of HIS[JESUS] chariot, Turn yours hand, and carry me out of the host;
for I am wounded.

22:35 And the battle increased that day: and the KING[JESUS] was stayed up in
HIS[JESUS] chariot against the Syrians, and died at even: and the blood ran out
of the wound into the midst of the chariot.

22:36 And there went a proclamation throughout the host about the going
down of the sun, saying, Every man to HIS[JESUS] city, and every man to HIS[JESUS] own
country.

22:37 So the KING[JESUS] died, and was brought to Samaria; and they buried the
KING[JESUS] in Samaria.

22:38 And one washed the chariot in the pool of Samaria; and the dogs
licked up HIS[JESUS] blood; and they washed HIS[JESUS] armour; according unto the WORD[JESUS]
of the LORD[JESUS] which HE[JESUS] spake.

22:39 Now the rest of the acts of Ahab, and all that HE[JESUS] did, and the
ivory house which HE[JESUS] made, and all the cities that HE[JESUS] built, are they
not written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Israel?

22:40 So Ahab slept with HIS[JESUS] fathers; and Ahaziah HIS[JESUS] SON[JESUS] reigned in HIS[JESUS]
stead.

22:41 And Jehoshaphat the SON[JESUS] of Asa began to reign over Judah in the
fourth year of Ahab KING[JESUS] of Israel.

22:42 Jehoshaphat was thirty and five years old when HE[JESUS] began to reign;
and HE[JESUS] reigned twenty and five years in Jerusalem. And HIS[JESUS] mother's name
was Azubah the daughter of Shilhi.

22:43 And HE[JESUS] walked in all the ways of Asa HIS[JESUS] father; HE[JESUS] turned not
aside from it, doing that which was right in the eyes of the LORD[JESUS]:
nevertheless the high places were not taken away; for the people offered
and burnt incense yet in the high places.

22:44 And Jehoshaphat made peace with the KING[JESUS] of Israel.

22:45 Now the rest of the acts of Jehoshaphat, and HIS[JESUS] might that HE[JESUS]
shewed, and how HE[JESUS] warred, are they not written in the book of the
chronicles of the kings of Judah?

22:46 And the remnant of the sodomites, which remained in the days of
HIS[JESUS] father Asa, HE[JESUS] took out of the land.

22:47 There was then no KING[JESUS] in Edom: a deputy was KING[JESUS].

22:48 Jehoshaphat made ships of Tharshish to go to Ophir for gold: but
they went not; for the ships were broken at Eziongeber.

22:49 Then said Ahaziah the SON[JESUS] of Ahab unto Jehoshaphat, Let my
servants go with your servants in the ships. But Jehoshaphat would not.

22:50 And Jehoshaphat slept with HIS[JESUS] fathers, and was buried with HIS[JESUS]
fathers in the city of David HIS[JESUS] father: and Jehoram HIS[JESUS] SON[JESUS] reigned in
HIS[JESUS] stead.

22:51 Ahaziah the SON[JESUS] of Ahab began to reign over Israel in Samaria the
seventeenth year of Jehoshaphat KING[JESUS] of Judah, and reigned two years
over Israel.

22:52 And HE[JESUS] did evil in the sight of the LORD[JESUS], and walked in the way of
HIS[JESUS] father, and in the way of HIS[JESUS] mother, and in the way of Jeroboam the
SON[JESUS] of Nebat, who made Israel to sin:

22:53 For HE[JESUS] served Baal, and worshipped HIM[JESUS], and provoked to anger the
LORD[JESUS] GOD[JESUS] of Israel, according to all that HIS[JESUS] father had done.
