1:1 Then Moab rebelled against Israel after the death of Ahab.

1:2 And Ahaziah fell down through a lattice in HIS[JESUS] upper chamber that
was in Samaria, and was sick: and HE[JESUS] sent messengers, and said unto
them, Go, enquire of Baalzebub the GOD[JESUS] of Ekron whether I shall recover
of this disease.

1:3 But the angel of the LORD[JESUS] said to Elijah the Tishbite, Arise, go up
to meet the messengers of the KING[JESUS] of Samaria, and say unto them, Is it
not because there is not a GOD[JESUS] in Israel, that you go to enquire of
Baalzebub the GOD[JESUS] of Ekron?

1:4 Now therefore thus says the LORD[JESUS], you shalt not come down from
that bed on which you art gone up, but shalt surely die. And Elijah
departed.

1:5 And when the messengers turned back unto HIM[JESUS], HE[JESUS] said unto them, Why
are you now turned back?

1:6 And they said unto HIM[JESUS], There came a man up to meet us, and said
unto us, Go, turn again unto the KING[JESUS] that sent you, and say unto HIM[JESUS],
Thus says the LORD[JESUS], Is it not because there is not a GOD[JESUS] in Israel,
that you sendest to enquire of Baalzebub the GOD[JESUS] of Ekron? therefore
you shalt not come down from that bed on which you art gone up, but
shalt surely die.

1:7 And HE[JESUS] said unto them, What manner of man was HE[JESUS] which came up to
meet you, and told you these words?

1:8 And they answered HIM[JESUS], HE[JESUS] was an hairy man, and girt with a girdle
of leather about HIS[JESUS] loins. And HE[JESUS] said, It is Elijah the Tishbite.

1:9 Then the KING[JESUS] sent unto HIM[JESUS] a captain of fifty with HIS[JESUS] fifty. And
HE[JESUS] went up to HIM[JESUS]: and, behold, HE[JESUS] sat on the top of an hill. And HE[JESUS]
spake unto HIM[JESUS], you man of GOD[JESUS], the KING[JESUS] has said, Come down.

1:10 And Elijah answered and said to the captain of fifty, If I be a man
of GOD[JESUS], then let fire come down from heaven, and consume you and your
fifty. And there came down fire from heaven, and consumed HIM[JESUS] and HIS[JESUS]
fifty.

1:11 Again also HE[JESUS] sent unto HIM[JESUS] another captain of fifty with HIS[JESUS]
fifty. And HE[JESUS] answered and said unto HIM[JESUS], O man of GOD[JESUS], thus has the
KING[JESUS] said, Come down quickly.

1:12 And Elijah answered and said unto them, If I be a man of GOD[JESUS], let
fire come down from heaven, and consume you and your fifty. And the fire
of GOD[JESUS] came down from heaven, and consumed HIM[JESUS] and HIS[JESUS] fifty.

1:13 And HE[JESUS] sent again a captain of the third fifty with HIS[JESUS] fifty. And
the third captain of fifty went up, and came and fell on HIS[JESUS] knees
before Elijah, and besought HIM[JESUS], and said unto HIM[JESUS], O man of GOD[JESUS], I pray
you, let my life, and the life of these fifty your servants, be precious
in your sight.

1:14 Behold, there came fire down from heaven, and burnt up the two
captains of the former fifties with their fifties: therefore let my life
now be precious in your sight.

1:15 And the angel of the LORD[JESUS] said unto Elijah, Go down with HIM[JESUS]: be
not afraid of HIM[JESUS]. And HE[JESUS] arose, and went down with HIM[JESUS] unto the KING[JESUS].

1:16 And HE[JESUS] said unto HIM[JESUS], Thus says the LORD[JESUS], Forasmuch as you hast
sent messengers to enquire of Baalzebub the GOD[JESUS] of Ekron, is it not
because there is no GOD[JESUS] in Israel to enquire of HIS[JESUS] WORD[JESUS]? therefore you
shalt not come down off that bed on which you art gone up, but shalt
surely die.

1:17 So HE[JESUS] died according to the WORD[JESUS] of the LORD[JESUS] which Elijah had
spoken. And Jehoram reigned in HIS[JESUS] stead in the second year of Jehoram
the SON[JESUS] of Jehoshaphat KING[JESUS] of Judah; because HE[JESUS] had no SON[JESUS].

1:18 Now the rest of the acts of Ahaziah which HE[JESUS] did, are they not
written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Israel?


2:1 And it came to pass, when the LORD[JESUS] would take up Elijah into heaven
by a whirlwind, that Elijah went with Elisha from Gilgal.

2:2 And Elijah said unto Elisha, Tarry here, I pray you; for the LORD[JESUS]
has sent me to Bethel. And Elisha said unto HIM[JESUS], As the LORD[JESUS] liveth,
and as your soul liveth, I will not leave you. So they went down to
Bethel.

2:3 And the sons of the prophets that were at Bethel came forth to
Elisha, and said unto HIM[JESUS], Knowest you that the LORD[JESUS] will take away your
master from your head to day? And HE[JESUS] said, Yea, I know it; hold you your
peace.

2:4 And Elijah said unto HIM[JESUS], Elisha, tarry here, I pray you; for the
LORD[JESUS] has sent me to Jericho. And HE[JESUS] said, As the LORD[JESUS] liveth, and as
your soul liveth, I will not leave you. So they came to Jericho.

2:5 And the sons of the prophets that were at Jericho came to Elisha,
and said unto HIM[JESUS], Knowest you that the LORD[JESUS] will take away your master
from your head to day? And HE[JESUS] answered, Yea, I know it; hold you your
peace.

2:6 And Elijah said unto HIM[JESUS], Tarry, I pray you, here; for the LORD[JESUS]
has sent me to Jordan. And HE[JESUS] said, As the LORD[JESUS] liveth, and as your soul
liveth, I will not leave you. And they two went on.

2:7 And fifty men of the sons of the prophets went, and stood to view
afar off: and they two stood by Jordan.

2:8 And Elijah took HIS[JESUS] mantle, and wrapped it together, and smote the
waters, and they were divided hither and thither, so that they two went
over on dry ground.

2:9 And it came to pass, when they were gone over, that Elijah said unto
Elisha, Ask what I shall do for you, before I be taken away from you.
And Elisha said, I pray you, let a double portion of your spirit be upon
me.

2:10 And HE[JESUS] said, you hast asked a hard thing: nevertheless, if you
see me when I am taken from you, it shall be so unto you; but if not,
it shall not be so.

2:11 And it came to pass, as they still went on, and talked, that,
behold, there appeared a chariot of fire, and horses of fire, and parted
them both asunder; and Elijah went up by a whirlwind into heaven.

2:12 And Elisha saw it, and HE[JESUS] cried, My father, my father, the chariot
of Israel, and the horsemen thereof. And HE[JESUS] saw HIM[JESUS] no more: and HE[JESUS] took
hold of HIS[JESUS] own clothes, and rent them in two pieces.

2:13 HE[JESUS] took up also the mantle of Elijah that fell from HIM[JESUS], and went
back, and stood by the bank of Jordan;

2:14 And HE[JESUS] took the mantle of Elijah that fell from HIM[JESUS], and smote the
waters, and said, Where is the LORD[JESUS] GOD[JESUS] of Elijah? and when HE[JESUS] also had
smitten the waters, they parted hither and thither: and Elisha went
over.

2:15 And when the sons of the prophets which were to view at Jericho saw
HIM[JESUS], they said, The spirit of Elijah does rest on Elisha. And they came
to meet HIM[JESUS], and bowed themselves to the ground before HIM[JESUS].

2:16 And they said unto HIM[JESUS], Behold now, there be with your servants
fifty strong men; let them go, we pray you, and seek your master: lest
peradventure the Spirit of the LORD[JESUS] has taken HIM[JESUS] up, and cast HIM[JESUS] upon
some mountain, or into some valley. And HE[JESUS] said, you shall not send.

2:17 And when they urged HIM[JESUS] till HE[JESUS] was ashamed, HE[JESUS] said, Send. They
sent therefore fifty men; and they sought three days, but found HIM[JESUS] not.

2:18 And when they came again to HIM[JESUS], (for HE[JESUS] tarried at Jericho,) HE[JESUS]
said unto them, Did I not say unto you, Go not?

2:19 And the men of the city said unto Elisha, Behold, I pray you, the
situation of this city is pleasant, as my LORD[JESUS] seeth: but the water is
naught, and the ground barren.

2:20 And HE[JESUS] said, Bring me a new cruse, and put salt therein. And they
brought it to HIM[JESUS].

2:21 And HE[JESUS] went forth unto the spring of the waters, and cast the salt
in there, and said, Thus says the LORD[JESUS], I have healed these waters;
there shall not be from thence any more death or barren land.

2:22 So the waters were healed unto this day, according to the saying of
Elisha which HE[JESUS] spake.

2:23 And HE[JESUS] went up from thence unto Bethel: and as HE[JESUS] was going up by
the way, there came forth little children out of the city, and mocked
HIM[JESUS], and said unto HIM[JESUS], Go up, you bald head; go up, you bald head.

2:24 And HE[JESUS] turned back, and looked on them, and cursed them in the name
of the LORD[JESUS]. And there came forth two she bears out of the wood, and
tare forty and two children of them.

2:25 And HE[JESUS] went from thence to mount Carmel, and from thence HE[JESUS]
returned to Samaria.


3:1 Now Jehoram the SON[JESUS] of Ahab began to reign over Israel in Samaria
the eighteenth year of Jehoshaphat KING[JESUS] of Judah, and reigned twelve
years.

3:2 And HE[JESUS] wrought evil in the sight of the LORD[JESUS]; but not like HIS[JESUS]
father, and like HIS[JESUS] mother: for HE[JESUS] put away the image of Baal that HIS[JESUS]
father had made.

3:3 Nevertheless HE[JESUS] cleaved unto the sins of Jeroboam the SON[JESUS] of Nebat,
which made Israel to sin; HE[JESUS] departed not therefrom.

3:4 And Mesha KING[JESUS] of Moab was a sheepmaster, and rendered unto the KING[JESUS]
of Israel an hundred thousand lambs, and an hundred thousand rams, with
the wool.

3:5 But it came to pass, when Ahab was dead, that the KING[JESUS] of Moab
rebelled against the KING[JESUS] of Israel.

3:6 And KING[JESUS] Jehoram went out of Samaria the same time, and numbered all
Israel.

3:7 And HE[JESUS] went and sent to Jehoshaphat the KING[JESUS] of Judah, saying, The
KING[JESUS] of Moab has rebelled against me: wilt you go with me against Moab
to battle? And HE[JESUS] said, I will go up: I am as you art, my people as your
people, and my horses as your horses.

3:8 And HE[JESUS] said, Which way shall we go up? And HE[JESUS] answered, The way
through the wilderness of Edom.

3:9 So the KING[JESUS] of Israel went, and the KING[JESUS] of Judah, and the KING[JESUS] of
Edom: and they fetched a compass of seven days' journey: and there was
no water for the host, and for the cattle that followed them.

3:10 And the KING[JESUS] of Israel said, Alas! that the LORD[JESUS] has called these
three kings together, to deliver them into the hand of Moab!

3:11 But Jehoshaphat said, Is there not here a PROPHET[JESUS] of the LORD[JESUS], that
we may enquire of the LORD[JESUS] by HIM[JESUS]? And one of the KING[JESUS] of Israel's
servants answered and said, Here is Elisha the SON[JESUS] of Shaphat, which
poured water on the hands of Elijah.

3:12 And Jehoshaphat said, The WORD[JESUS] of the LORD[JESUS] is with HIM[JESUS]. So the KING[JESUS]
of Israel and Jehoshaphat and the KING[JESUS] of Edom went down to HIM[JESUS].

3:13 And Elisha said unto the KING[JESUS] of Israel, What have I to do with
you? get you to the prophets of your father, and to the prophets of your
mother. And the KING[JESUS] of Israel said unto HIM[JESUS], Nay: for the LORD[JESUS] has
called these three kings together, to deliver them into the hand of
Moab.

3:14 And Elisha said, As the LORD[JESUS] of hosts liveth, before whom I stand,
surely, were it not that I regard the presence of Jehoshaphat the KING[JESUS]
of Judah, I would not look toward you, nor see you.

3:15 But now bring me a minstrel. And it came to pass, when the minstrel
played, that the hand of the LORD[JESUS] came upon HIM[JESUS].

3:16 And HE[JESUS] said, Thus says the LORD[JESUS], Make this valley full of ditches.

3:17 For thus says the LORD[JESUS], you shall not see wind, neither shall you
see rain; yet that valley shall be filled with water, that you may drink,
both you, and your cattle, and your beasts.

3:18 And this is but a light thing in the sight of the LORD[JESUS]: HE[JESUS] will
deliver the Moabites also into your hand.

3:19 And you shall smite every fenced city, and every choice city, and
shall fell every good tree, and stop all wells of water, and mar every
good piece of land with stones.

3:20 And it came to pass in the morning, when the meat offering was
offered, that, behold, there came water by the way of Edom, and the
country was filled with water.

3:21 And when all the Moabites heard that the kings were come up to
fight against them, they gathered all that were able to put on armour,
and upward, and stood in the border.

3:22 And they rose up early in the morning, and the sun shone upon the
water, and the Moabites saw the water on the other side as red as blood:

3:23 And they said, This is blood: the kings are surely slain, and they
have smitten one another: now therefore, Moab, to the spoil.

3:24 And when they came to the camp of Israel, the Israelites rose up
and smote the Moabites, so that they fled before them: but they went
forward smiting the Moabites, even in their country.

3:25 And they beat down the cities, and on every good piece of land cast
every man HIS[JESUS] stone, and filled it; and they stopped all the wells of
water, and felled all the good trees: only in Kirharaseth left they the
stones thereof; howbeit the slingers went about it, and smote it.

3:26 And when the KING[JESUS] of Moab saw that the battle was too sore for HIM[JESUS],
HE[JESUS] took with HIM[JESUS] seven hundred men that drew swords, to break through
even unto the KING[JESUS] of Edom: but they could not.

3:27 Then HE[JESUS] took HIS[JESUS] eldest SON[JESUS] that should have reigned in HIS[JESUS] stead,
and offered HIM[JESUS] for a burnt offering upon the wall. And there was great
indignation against Israel: and they departed from HIM[JESUS], and returned to
their own land.


4:1 Now there cried a certain woman of the wives of the sons of the
prophets unto Elisha, saying, your SERVANT[JESUS] my husband is dead; and you
knowest that your SERVANT[JESUS] did fear the LORD[JESUS]: and the creditor is come to
take unto HIM[JESUS] my two sons to be bondmen.

4:2 And Elisha said unto her, What shall I do for you? tell me, what
hast you in the house? And she said, yours handmaid has not any thing
in the house, save a pot of oil.

4:3 Then HE[JESUS] said, Go, borrow you vessels abroad of all your neighbours,
even empty vessels; borrow not a few.

4:4 And when you art come in, you shalt shut the door upon you and
upon your sons, and shalt pour out into all those vessels, and you shalt
set aside that which is full.

4:5 So she went from HIM[JESUS], and shut the door upon her and upon her sons,
who brought the vessels to her; and she poured out.

4:6 And it came to pass, when the vessels were full, that she said unto
her SON[JESUS], Bring me yet a vessel. And HE[JESUS] said unto her, There is not a
vessel more. And the oil stayed.

4:7 Then she came and told the man of GOD[JESUS]. And HE[JESUS] said, Go, sell the
oil, and pay your debt, and live you and your children of the rest.

4:8 And it fell on a day, that Elisha passed to Shunem, where was a
great woman; and she constrained HIM[JESUS] to eat bread. And so it was, that
as oft as HE[JESUS] passed by, HE[JESUS] turned in thither to eat bread.

4:9 And she said unto her husband, Behold now, I perceive that this is
an holy man of GOD[JESUS], which passeth by us continually.

4:10 Let us make a little chamber, I pray you, on the wall; and let us
set for HIM[JESUS] there a bed, and a table, and a stool, and a candlestick:
and it shall be, when HE[JESUS] comes to us, that HE[JESUS] shall turn in thither.

4:11 And it fell on a day, that HE[JESUS] came thither, and HE[JESUS] turned into the
chamber, and lay there.

4:12 And HE[JESUS] said to Gehazi HIS[JESUS] SERVANT[JESUS], Call this Shunammite. And when
HE[JESUS] had called her, she stood before HIM[JESUS].

4:13 And HE[JESUS] said unto HIM[JESUS], Say now unto her, Behold, you hast been
careful for us with all this care; what is to be done for you? wouldest
you be spoken for to the KING[JESUS], or to the captain of the host? And she
answered, I dwell among mine own people.

4:14 And HE[JESUS] said, What then is to be done for her? And Gehazi answered,
truly she has no child, and her husband is old.

4:15 And HE[JESUS] said, Call her. And when HE[JESUS] had called her, she stood in the
door.

4:16 And HE[JESUS] said, About this season, according to the time of life, you
shalt embrace a SON[JESUS]. And she said, Nay, my LORD[JESUS], you man of GOD[JESUS], do not
lie unto yours handmaid.

4:17 And the woman conceived, and bare a SON[JESUS] at that season that Elisha
had said unto her, according to the time of life.

4:18 And when the child was grown, it fell on a day, that HE[JESUS] went out to
HIS[JESUS] father to the reapers.

4:19 And HE[JESUS] said unto HIS[JESUS] father, My head, my head. And HE[JESUS] said to a
lad, Carry HIM[JESUS] to HIS[JESUS] mother.

4:20 And when HE[JESUS] had taken HIM[JESUS], and brought HIM[JESUS] to HIS[JESUS] mother, HE[JESUS] sat on
her knees till noon, and then died.

4:21 And she went up, and laid HIM[JESUS] on the bed of the man of GOD[JESUS], and
shut the door upon HIM[JESUS], and went out.

4:22 And she called unto her husband, and said, Send me, I pray you,
one of the young men, and one of the asses, that I may run to the man of
GOD[JESUS], and come again.

4:23 And HE[JESUS] said, Wherefore wilt you go to HIM[JESUS] to day? it is neither
new moon, nor sabbath. And she said, It shall be well.

4:24 Then she saddled an ass, and said to her SERVANT[JESUS], Drive, and go
forward; slack not your riding for me, except I bid you.

4:25 So she went and came unto the man of GOD[JESUS] to mount Carmel. And it
came to pass, when the man of GOD[JESUS] saw her afar off, that HE[JESUS] said to
Gehazi HIS[JESUS] SERVANT[JESUS], Behold, yonder is that Shunammite:

4:26 Run now, I pray you, to meet her, and say unto her, Is it well
with you? is it well with your husband? is it well with the child? And
she answered, It is well:

4:27 And when she came to the man of GOD[JESUS] to the hill, she caught HIM[JESUS] by
the feet: but Gehazi came near to thrust her away. And the man of GOD[JESUS]
said, Let her alone; for her soul is vexed within her: and the LORD[JESUS] has
hid it from me, and has not told me.

4:28 Then she said, Did I desire a SON[JESUS] of my LORD[JESUS]? did I not say, Do not
deceive me?

4:29 Then HE[JESUS] said to Gehazi, Gird up your loins, and take my staff in
yours hand, and go your way: if you meet any man, salute HIM[JESUS] not; and if
any salute you, answer HIM[JESUS] not again: and lay my staff upon the face of
the child.

4:30 And the mother of the child said, As the LORD[JESUS] liveth, and as your
soul liveth, I will not leave you. And HE[JESUS] arose, and followed her.

4:31 And Gehazi passed on before them, and laid the staff upon the face
of the child; but there was neither voice, nor hearing. Wherefore HE[JESUS]
went again to meet HIM[JESUS], and told HIM[JESUS], saying, The child is not awaked.

4:32 And when Elisha was come into the house, behold, the child was
dead, and laid upon HIS[JESUS] bed.

4:33 HE[JESUS] went in therefore, and shut the door upon them twain, and prayed
unto the LORD[JESUS].

4:34 And HE[JESUS] went up, and lay upon the child, and put HIS[JESUS] mouth upon HIS[JESUS]
mouth, and HIS[JESUS] eyes upon HIS[JESUS] eyes, and HIS[JESUS] hands upon HIS[JESUS] hands: and
stretched himself upon the child; and the flesh of the child waxed warm.

4:35 Then HE[JESUS] returned, and walked in the house to and fro; and went up,
and stretched himself upon HIM[JESUS]: and the child sneezed seven times, and
the child opened HIS[JESUS] eyes.

4:36 And HE[JESUS] called Gehazi, and said, Call this Shunammite. So HE[JESUS] called
her. And when she was come in unto HIM[JESUS], HE[JESUS] said, Take up your SON[JESUS].

4:37 Then she went in, and fell at HIS[JESUS] feet, and bowed herself to the
ground, and took up her SON[JESUS], and went out.

4:38 And Elisha came again to Gilgal: and there was a dearth in the
land; and the sons of the prophets were sitting before HIM[JESUS]: and HE[JESUS] said
unto HIS[JESUS] SERVANT[JESUS], Set on the great pot, and seethe pottage for the sons
of the prophets.

4:39 And one went out into the field to gather herbs, and found a wild
vine, and gathered thereof wild gourds HIS[JESUS] lap full, and came and shred
them into the pot of pottage: for they knew them not.

4:40 So they poured out for the men to eat. And it came to pass, as they
were eating of the pottage, that they cried out, and said, O you man of
GOD[JESUS], there is death in the pot. And they could not eat thereof.

4:41 But HE[JESUS] said, Then bring meal. And HE[JESUS] cast it into the pot; and HE[JESUS]
said, Pour out for the people, that they may eat. And there was no harm
in the pot.

4:42 And there came a man from Baalshalisha, and brought the man of GOD[JESUS]
bread of the firstfruits, twenty loaves of barley, and full ears of corn
in the husk thereof. And HE[JESUS] said, Give unto the people, that they may
eat.

4:43 And HIS[JESUS] servitor said, What, should I set this before an hundred
men? HE[JESUS] said again, Give the people, that they may eat: for thus says
the LORD[JESUS], They shall eat, and shall leave thereof.

4:44 So HE[JESUS] set it before them, and they did eat, and left thereof,
according to the WORD[JESUS] of the LORD[JESUS].


5:1 Now Naaman, captain of the host of the KING[JESUS] of Syria, was a great
man with HIS[JESUS] master, and honourable, because by HIM[JESUS] the LORD[JESUS] had given
deliverance unto Syria: HE[JESUS] was also a mighty man in valour, but HE[JESUS] was a
leper.

5:2 And the Syrians had gone out by companies, and had brought away
captive out of the land of Israel a little maid; and she waited on
Naaman's wife.

5:3 And she said unto her mistress, Would GOD[JESUS] my LORD[JESUS] were with the
PROPHET[JESUS] that is in Samaria! for HE[JESUS] would recover HIM[JESUS] of HIS[JESUS] leprosy.

5:4 And one went in, and told HIS[JESUS] LORD[JESUS], saying, Thus and thus said the
maid that is of the land of Israel.

5:5 And the KING[JESUS] of Syria said, Go to, go, and I will send a letter unto
the KING[JESUS] of Israel. And HE[JESUS] departed, and took with HIM[JESUS] ten talents of
silver, and six thousand pieces of gold, and ten changes of raiment.

5:6 And HE[JESUS] brought the letter to the KING[JESUS] of Israel, saying, Now when
this letter is come unto you, behold, I have therewith sent Naaman my
SERVANT[JESUS] to you, that you mayest recover HIM[JESUS] of HIS[JESUS] leprosy.

5:7 And it came to pass, when the KING[JESUS] of Israel had read the letter,
that HE[JESUS] rent HIS[JESUS] clothes, and said, Am I GOD[JESUS], to kill and to make alive,
that this man does send unto me to recover a man of HIS[JESUS] leprosy?
wherefore consider, I pray you, and see how HE[JESUS] seeketh a quarrel against
me.

5:8 And it was so, when Elisha the man of GOD[JESUS] had heard that the KING[JESUS] of
Israel had rent HIS[JESUS] clothes, that HE[JESUS] sent to the KING[JESUS], saying, Wherefore
hast you rent your clothes? let HIM[JESUS] come now to me, and HE[JESUS] shall know
that there is a PROPHET[JESUS] in Israel.

5:9 So Naaman came with HIS[JESUS] horses and with HIS[JESUS] chariot, and stood at
the door of the house of Elisha.

5:10 And Elisha sent a messenger unto HIM[JESUS], saying, Go and wash in Jordan
seven times, and your flesh shall come again to you, and you shalt be
clean.

5:11 But Naaman was wroth, and went away, and said, Behold, I thought,
HE[JESUS] will surely come out to me, and stand, and call on the name of the
LORD[JESUS] HIS[JESUS] GOD[JESUS], and strike HIS[JESUS] hand over the place, and recover the leper.

5:12 Are not Abana and Pharpar, rivers of Damascus, better than all the
waters of Israel? may I not wash in them, and be clean? So HE[JESUS] turned and
went away in a rage.

5:13 And HIS[JESUS] servants came near, and spake unto HIM[JESUS], and said, My
father, if the PROPHET[JESUS] had bid you do some great thing, wouldest you
not have done it? how much rather then, when HE[JESUS] says to you, Wash, and
be clean?

5:14 Then went HE[JESUS] down, and dipped himself seven times in Jordan,
according to the saying of the man of GOD[JESUS]: and HIS[JESUS] flesh came again like
unto the flesh of a little child, and HE[JESUS] was clean.

5:15 And HE[JESUS] returned to the man of GOD[JESUS], HE[JESUS] and all HIS[JESUS] company, and
came, and stood before HIM[JESUS]: and HE[JESUS] said, Behold, now I know that there
is no GOD[JESUS] in all the earth, but in Israel: now therefore, I pray you,
take a blessing of your SERVANT[JESUS].

5:16 But HE[JESUS] said, As the LORD[JESUS] liveth, before whom I stand, I will
receive none. And HE[JESUS] urged HIM[JESUS] to take it; but HE[JESUS] refused.

5:17 And Naaman said, Shall there not then, I pray you, be given to your
SERVANT[JESUS] two mules' burden of earth? for your SERVANT[JESUS] will henceforth
offer neither burnt offering nor sacrifice unto other gods, but unto the
LORD[JESUS].

5:18 In this thing the LORD[JESUS] pardon your SERVANT[JESUS], that when my master
goes into the house of Rimmon to worship there, and HE[JESUS] leaneth on my
hand, and I bow myself in the house of Rimmon: when I bow down myself in
the house of Rimmon, the LORD[JESUS] pardon your SERVANT[JESUS] in this thing.

5:19 And HE[JESUS] said unto HIM[JESUS], Go in peace. So HE[JESUS] departed from HIM[JESUS] a little
way.

5:20 But Gehazi, the SERVANT[JESUS] of Elisha the man of GOD[JESUS], said, Behold, my
master has spared Naaman this Syrian, in not receiving at HIS[JESUS] hands
that which HE[JESUS] brought: but, as the LORD[JESUS] liveth, I will run after HIM[JESUS],
and take somewhat of HIM[JESUS].

5:21 So Gehazi followed after Naaman. And when Naaman saw HIM[JESUS] running
after HIM[JESUS], HE[JESUS] lighted down from the chariot to meet HIM[JESUS], and said, Is
all well?

5:22 And HE[JESUS] said, All is well. My master has sent me, saying, Behold,
even now there be come to me from mount Ephraim two young men of the
sons of the prophets: give them, I pray you, a talent of silver, and
two changes of garments.

5:23 And Naaman said, Be content, take two talents. And HE[JESUS] urged HIM[JESUS],
and bound two talents of silver in two bags, with two changes of
garments, and laid them upon two of HIS[JESUS] servants; and they bare them
before HIM[JESUS].

5:24 And when HE[JESUS] came to the tower, HE[JESUS] took them from their hand, and
bestowed them in the house: and HE[JESUS] let the men go, and they departed.

5:25 But HE[JESUS] went in, and stood before HIS[JESUS] master. And Elisha said unto
HIM[JESUS], Whence comest you, Gehazi? And HE[JESUS] said, your SERVANT[JESUS] went no
whither.

5:26 And HE[JESUS] said unto HIM[JESUS], Went not mine heart with you, when the man
turned again from HIS[JESUS] chariot to meet you? Is it a time to receive
money, and to receive garments, and oliveyards, and vineyards, and
sheep, and oxen, and menservants, and maidservants?

5:27 The leprosy therefore of Naaman shall cleave unto you, and unto
your SEED[JESUS] for ever. And HE[JESUS] went out from HIS[JESUS] presence a leper as white as
snow.


6:1 And the sons of the prophets said unto Elisha, Behold now, the place
where we dwell with you is too strait for us.

6:2 Let us go, we pray you, unto Jordan, and take thence every man a
beam, and let us make us a place there, where we may dwell. And HE[JESUS]
answered, Go you.

6:3 And one said, Be content, I pray you, and go with your servants. And
HE[JESUS] answered, I will go.

6:4 So HE[JESUS] went with them. And when they came to Jordan, they cut down
wood.

6:5 But as one was felling a beam, the axe head fell into the water: and
HE[JESUS] cried, and said, Alas, master! for it was borrowed.

6:6 And the man of GOD[JESUS] said, Where fell it? And HE[JESUS] shewed HIM[JESUS] the place.
And HE[JESUS] cut down a stick, and cast it in thither; and the iron did swim.

6:7 Therefore said HE[JESUS], Take it up to you. And HE[JESUS] put out HIS[JESUS] hand, and
took it.

6:8 Then the KING[JESUS] of Syria warred against Israel, and took counsel with
HIS[JESUS] servants, saying, In such and such a place shall be my camp.

6:9 And the man of GOD[JESUS] sent unto the KING[JESUS] of Israel, saying, Beware that
you pass not such a place; for thither the Syrians are come down.

6:10 And the KING[JESUS] of Israel sent to the place which the man of GOD[JESUS] told
HIM[JESUS] and warned HIM[JESUS] of, and saved himself there, not once nor twice.

6:11 Therefore the heart of the KING[JESUS] of Syria was sore troubled for this
thing; and HE[JESUS] called HIS[JESUS] servants, and said unto them, Will you not shew
me which of us is for the KING[JESUS] of Israel?

6:12 And one of HIS[JESUS] servants said, None, my LORD[JESUS], O KING[JESUS]: but Elisha,
the PROPHET[JESUS] that is in Israel, telleth the KING[JESUS] of Israel the words that
you speakest in your bedchamber.

6:13 And HE[JESUS] said, Go and spy where HE[JESUS] is, that I may send and fetch HIM[JESUS].
And it was told HIM[JESUS], saying, Behold, HE[JESUS] is in Dothan.

6:14 Therefore sent HE[JESUS] thither horses, and chariots, and a great host:
and they came by night, and compassed the city about.

6:15 And when the SERVANT[JESUS] of the man of GOD[JESUS] was risen early, and gone
forth, behold, an host compassed the city both with horses and chariots.
And HIS[JESUS] SERVANT[JESUS] said unto HIM[JESUS], Alas, my master! how shall we do?

6:16 And HE[JESUS] answered, Fear not: for they that be with us are more than
they that be with them.

6:17 And Elisha prayed, and said, LORD[JESUS], I pray you, open HIS[JESUS] eyes, that
HE[JESUS] may see. And the LORD[JESUS] opened the eyes of the young man; and HE[JESUS] saw:
and, behold, the mountain was full of horses and chariots of fire round
about Elisha.

6:18 And when they came down to HIM[JESUS], Elisha prayed unto the LORD[JESUS], and
said, Smite this people, I pray you, with blindness. And HE[JESUS] smote them
with blindness according to the WORD[JESUS] of Elisha.

6:19 And Elisha said unto them, This is not the way, neither is this the
city: follow me, and I will bring you to the man whom you seek. But HE[JESUS]
led them to Samaria.

6:20 And it came to pass, when they were come into Samaria, that Elisha
said, LORD[JESUS], open the eyes of these men, that they may see. And the LORD[JESUS]
opened their eyes, and they saw; and, behold, they were in the midst of
Samaria.

6:21 And the KING[JESUS] of Israel said unto Elisha, when HE[JESUS] saw them, My
father, shall I smite them? shall I smite them?

6:22 And HE[JESUS] answered, you shalt not smite them: wouldest you smite
those whom you hast taken captive with your sword and with your bow? set
bread and water before them, that they may eat and drink, and go to
their master.

6:23 And HE[JESUS] prepared great provision for them: and when they had eaten
and drunk, HE[JESUS] sent them away, and they went to their master. So the
bands of Syria came no more into the land of Israel.

6:24 And it came to pass after this, that Benhadad KING[JESUS] of Syria
gathered all HIS[JESUS] host, and went up, and besieged Samaria.

6:25 And there was a great famine in Samaria: and, behold, they besieged
it, until an ass's head was sold for fourscore pieces of silver, and the
fourth part of a cab of dove's dung for five pieces of silver.

6:26 And as the KING[JESUS] of Israel was passing by upon the wall, there cried
a woman unto HIM[JESUS], saying, Help, my LORD[JESUS], O KING[JESUS].

6:27 And HE[JESUS] said, If the LORD[JESUS] do not help you, whence shall I help
you? out of the barnfloor, or out of the winepress?

6:28 And the KING[JESUS] said unto her, What aileth you? And she answered,
This woman said unto me, Give your SON[JESUS], that we may eat HIM[JESUS] to day, and
we will eat my SON[JESUS] to morrow.

6:29 So we boiled my SON[JESUS], and did eat HIM[JESUS]: and I said unto her on the
next day, Give your SON[JESUS], that we may eat HIM[JESUS]: and she has hid her SON[JESUS].

6:30 And it came to pass, when the KING[JESUS] heard the words of the woman,
that HE[JESUS] rent HIS[JESUS] clothes; and HE[JESUS] passed by upon the wall, and the people
looked, and, behold, HE[JESUS] had sackcloth within upon HIS[JESUS] flesh.

6:31 Then HE[JESUS] said, GOD[JESUS] do so and more also to me, if the head of Elisha
the SON[JESUS] of Shaphat shall stand on HIM[JESUS] this day.

6:32 But Elisha sat in HIS[JESUS] house, and the elders sat with HIM[JESUS]; and the
KING[JESUS] sent a man from before HIM[JESUS]: but ere the messenger came to HIM[JESUS], HE[JESUS]
said to the elders, See you how this SON[JESUS] of a murderer has sent to take
away mine head? look, when the messenger comes, shut the door, and hold
HIM[JESUS] fast at the door: is not the sound of HIS[JESUS] master's feet behind HIM[JESUS]?

6:33 And while HE[JESUS] yet talked with them, behold, the messenger came down
unto HIM[JESUS]: and HE[JESUS] said, Behold, this evil is of the LORD[JESUS]; what should I
wait for the LORD[JESUS] any longer?


7:1 Then Elisha said, Hear you the WORD[JESUS] of the LORD[JESUS]; Thus says the LORD[JESUS],
To morrow about this time shall a measure of fine flour be sold for a
shekel, and two measures of barley for a shekel, in the gate of Samaria.

7:2 Then a LORD[JESUS] on whose hand the KING[JESUS] leaned answered the man of GOD[JESUS],
and said, Behold, if the LORD[JESUS] would make windows in heaven, might this
thing be? And HE[JESUS] said, Behold, you shalt see it with yours eyes, but
shalt not eat thereof.

7:3 And there were four leprous men at the entering in of the gate: and
they said one to another, Why sit we here until we die?

7:4 If we say, We will enter into the city, then the famine is in the
city, and we shall die there: and if we sit still here, we die also. Now
therefore come, and let us fall unto the host of the Syrians: if they
save us alive, we shall live; and if they kill us, we shall but die.

7:5 And they rose up in the twilight, to go unto the camp of the
Syrians: and when they were come to the uttermost part of the camp of
Syria, behold, there was no man there.

7:6 For the LORD[JESUS] had made the host of the Syrians to hear a noise of
chariots, and a noise of horses, even the noise of a great host: and
they said one to another, Lo, the KING[JESUS] of Israel has hired against us
the kings of the Hittites, and the kings of the Egyptians, to come upon
us.

7:7 Wherefore they arose and fled in the twilight, and left their tents,
and their horses, and their asses, even the camp as it was, and fled for
their life.

7:8 And when these lepers came to the uttermost part of the camp, they
went into one tent, and did eat and drink, and carried thence silver,
and gold, and raiment, and went and hid it; and came again, and entered
into another tent, and carried thence also, and went and hid it.

7:9 Then they said one to another, We do not well: this day is a day of
good tidings, and we hold our peace: if we tarry till the morning light,
some mischief will come upon us: now therefore come, that we may go and
tell the KING[JESUS]'s household.

7:10 So they came and called unto the porter of the city: and they told
them, saying, We came to the camp of the Syrians, and, behold, there was
no man there, neither voice of man, but horses tied, and asses tied, and
the tents as they were.

7:11 And HE[JESUS] called the porters; and they told it to the KING[JESUS]'s house
within.

7:12 And the KING[JESUS] arose in the night, and said unto HIS[JESUS] servants, I will
now shew you what the Syrians have done to us. They know that we be
hungry; therefore are they gone out of the camp to hide themselves in
the field, saying, When they come out of the city, we shall catch them
alive, and get into the city.

7:13 And one of HIS[JESUS] servants answered and said, Let some take, I pray
you, five of the horses that remain, which are left in the city,
(behold, they are as all the multitude of Israel that are left in it:
behold, I say, they are even as all the multitude of the Israelites that
are consumed:) and let us send and see.

7:14 They took therefore two chariot horses; and the KING[JESUS] sent after the
host of the Syrians, saying, Go and see.

7:15 And they went after them unto Jordan: and, lo, all the way was full
of garments and vessels, which the Syrians had cast away in their haste.
And the messengers returned, and told the KING[JESUS].

7:16 And the people went out, and spoiled the tents of the Syrians. So a
measure of fine flour was sold for a shekel, and two measures of barley
for a shekel, according to the WORD[JESUS] of the LORD[JESUS].

7:17 And the KING[JESUS] appointed the LORD[JESUS] on whose hand HE[JESUS] leaned to have the
charge of the gate: and the people trode upon HIM[JESUS] in the gate, and HE[JESUS]
died, as the man of GOD[JESUS] had said, who spake when the KING[JESUS] came down to
HIM[JESUS].

7:18 And it came to pass as the man of GOD[JESUS] had spoken to the KING[JESUS],
saying, Two measures of barley for a shekel, and a measure of fine flour
for a shekel, shall be to morrow about this time in the gate of Samaria:

7:19 And that LORD[JESUS] answered the man of GOD[JESUS], and said, Now, behold, if
the LORD[JESUS] should make windows in heaven, might such a thing be? And HE[JESUS]
said, Behold, you shalt see it with yours eyes, but shalt not eat
thereof.

7:20 And so it fell out unto HIM[JESUS]: for the people trode upon HIM[JESUS] in the
gate, and HE[JESUS] died.


8:1 Then spake Elisha unto the woman, whose SON[JESUS] HE[JESUS] had restored to life,
saying, Arise, and go you and yours household, and sojourn wheresoever
you canst sojourn: for the LORD[JESUS] has called for a famine; and it shall
also come upon the land seven years.

8:2 And the woman arose, and did after the saying of the man of GOD[JESUS]: and
she went with her household, and sojourned in the land of the
Philistines seven years.

8:3 And it came to pass at the seven years' end, that the woman returned
out of the land of the Philistines: and she went forth to cry unto the
KING[JESUS] for her house and for her land.

8:4 And the KING[JESUS] talked with Gehazi the SERVANT[JESUS] of the man of GOD[JESUS],
saying, Tell me, I pray you, all the great things that Elisha has
done.

8:5 And it came to pass, as HE[JESUS] was telling the KING[JESUS] how HE[JESUS] had restored
a dead body to life, that, behold, the woman, whose SON[JESUS] HE[JESUS] had restored
to life, cried to the KING[JESUS] for her house and for her land. And Gehazi
said, My LORD[JESUS], O KING[JESUS], this is the woman, and this is her SON[JESUS], whom
Elisha restored to life.

8:6 And when the KING[JESUS] asked the woman, she told HIM[JESUS]. So the KING[JESUS]
appointed unto her a certain officer, saying, Restore all that was hers,
and all the fruits of the field since the day that she left the land,
even until now.

8:7 And Elisha came to Damascus; and Benhadad the KING[JESUS] of Syria was
sick; and it was told HIM[JESUS], saying, The man of GOD[JESUS] is come hither.

8:8 And the KING[JESUS] said unto Hazael, Take a present in yours hand, and go,
meet the man of GOD[JESUS], and enquire of the LORD[JESUS] by HIM[JESUS], saying, Shall I
recover of this disease?

8:9 So Hazael went to meet HIM[JESUS], and took a present with HIM[JESUS], even of
every good thing of Damascus, forty camels' burden, and came and stood
before HIM[JESUS], and said, your SON[JESUS] Benhadad KING[JESUS] of Syria has sent me to
you, saying, Shall I recover of this disease?

8:10 And Elisha said unto HIM[JESUS], Go, say unto HIM[JESUS], you mayest certainly
recover: howbeit the LORD[JESUS] has shewed me that HE[JESUS] shall surely die.

8:11 And HE[JESUS] settled HIS[JESUS] countenance stedfastly, until HE[JESUS] was ashamed:
and the man of GOD[JESUS] wept.

8:12 And Hazael said, Why weepeth my LORD[JESUS]? And HE[JESUS] answered, Because I
know the evil that you wilt do unto the children of Israel: their
strong holds wilt you set on fire, and their young men wilt you slay
with the sword, and wilt dash their children, and rip up their women
with child.

8:13 And Hazael said, But what, is your SERVANT[JESUS] a dog, that HE[JESUS] should do
this great thing? And Elisha answered, The LORD[JESUS] has shewed me that you
shalt be KING[JESUS] over Syria.

8:14 So HE[JESUS] departed from Elisha, and came to HIS[JESUS] master; who said to
HIM[JESUS], What said Elisha to you? And HE[JESUS] answered, HE[JESUS] told me that you
shouldest surely recover.

8:15 And it came to pass on the morrow, that HE[JESUS] took a thick cloth, and
dipped it in water, and spread it on HIS[JESUS] face, so that HE[JESUS] died: and
Hazael reigned in HIS[JESUS] stead.

8:16 And in the fifth year of Joram the SON[JESUS] of Ahab KING[JESUS] of Israel,
Jehoshaphat being then KING[JESUS] of Judah, Jehoram the SON[JESUS] of Je hoshaphat
KING[JESUS] of Judah began to reign.

8:17 Thirty and two years old was HE[JESUS] when HE[JESUS] began to reign; and HE[JESUS]
reigned eight years in Jerusalem.

8:18 And HE[JESUS] walked in the way of the kings of Israel, as did the house
of Ahab: for the daughter of Ahab was HIS[JESUS] wife: and HE[JESUS] did evil in the
sight of the LORD[JESUS].

8:19 Yet the LORD[JESUS] would not destroy Judah for David HIS[JESUS] SERVANT[JESUS]'s sake,
as HE[JESUS] promised HIM[JESUS] to give HIM[JESUS] alway a light, and to HIS[JESUS] children.

8:20 In HIS[JESUS] days Edom revolted from under the hand of Judah, and made a
KING[JESUS] over themselves.

8:21 So Joram went over to Zair, and all the chariots with HIM[JESUS]: and HE[JESUS]
rose by night, and smote the Edomites which compassed HIM[JESUS] about, and the
captains of the chariots: and the people fled into their tents.

8:22 Yet Edom revolted from under the hand of Judah unto this day. Then
Libnah revolted at the same time.

8:23 And the rest of the acts of Joram, and all that HE[JESUS] did, are they
not written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Judah?

8:24 And Joram slept with HIS[JESUS] fathers, and was buried with HIS[JESUS] fathers
in the city of David: and Ahaziah HIS[JESUS] SON[JESUS] reigned in HIS[JESUS] stead.

8:25 In the twelfth year of Joram the SON[JESUS] of Ahab KING[JESUS] of Israel did
Ahaziah the SON[JESUS] of Jehoram KING[JESUS] of Judah begin to reign.

8:26 Two and twenty years old was Ahaziah when HE[JESUS] began to reign; and HE[JESUS]
reigned one year in Jerusalem. And HIS[JESUS] mother's name was Athaliah, the
daughter of Omri KING[JESUS] of Israel.

8:27 And HE[JESUS] walked in the way of the house of Ahab, and did evil in the
sight of the LORD[JESUS], as did the house of Ahab: for HE[JESUS] was the SON[JESUS] in law
of the house of Ahab.

8:28 And HE[JESUS] went with Joram the SON[JESUS] of Ahab to the war against Hazael
KING[JESUS] of Syria in Ramothgilead; and the Syrians wounded Joram.

8:29 And KING[JESUS] Joram went back to be healed in Jezreel of the wounds
which the Syrians had given HIM[JESUS] at Ramah, when HE[JESUS] fought against Hazael
KING[JESUS] of Syria. And Ahaziah the SON[JESUS] of Jehoram KING[JESUS] of Judah went down to
see Joram the SON[JESUS] of Ahab in Jezreel, because HE[JESUS] was sick.


9:1 And Elisha the PROPHET[JESUS] called one of the children of the prophets,
and said unto HIM[JESUS], Gird up your loins, and take this box of oil in yours

9:2 And when you comest thither, look out there Jehu the SON[JESUS] of
Jehoshaphat the SON[JESUS] of Nimshi, and go in, and make HIM[JESUS] arise up from
among HIS[JESUS] brethren, and carry HIM[JESUS] to an inner chamber;

9:3 Then take the box of oil, and pour it on HIS[JESUS] head, and say, Thus
says the LORD[JESUS], I have anointed you KING[JESUS] over Israel. Then open the
door, and flee, and tarry not.

9:4 So the young man, even the young man the PROPHET[JESUS], went to
Ramothgilead.

9:5 And when HE[JESUS] came, behold, the captains of the host were sitting; and

9:7 And you shalt smite the house of Ahab your master, that I may avenge

9:8 For the whole house of Ahab shall perish: and I will cut off from

9:9 And I will make the house of Ahab like the house of Jeroboam the SON[JESUS]
of Nebat, and like the house of Baasha the SON[JESUS] of Ahijah:

9:10 And the dogs shall eat Jezebel in the portion of Jezreel, and there

9:11 Then Jehu came forth to the servants of HIS[JESUS] LORD[JESUS]: and one said unto
HIM[JESUS], Is all well? wherefore came this mad fellow to you? And HE[JESUS] said

9:12 And they said, It is false; tell us now. And HE[JESUS] said, Thus and thus

9:13 Then they hasted, and took every man HIS[JESUS] garment, and put it under

9:14 So Jehu the SON[JESUS] of Jehoshaphat the SON[JESUS] of Nimshi conspired against
Joram. (Now Joram had kept Ramothgilead, HE[JESUS] and all Israel, because of
Hazael KING[JESUS] of Syria.

9:15 But KING[JESUS] Joram was returned to be healed in Jezreel of the wounds
which the Syrians had given HIM[JESUS], when HE[JESUS] fought with Hazael KING[JESUS] of
Syria.) And Jehu said, If it be your minds, then let none go forth nor
escape out of the city to go to tell it in Jezreel.

9:16 So Jehu rode in a chariot, and went to Jezreel; for Joram lay
there. And Ahaziah KING[JESUS] of Judah was come down to see Joram.

9:17 And there stood a watchman on the tower in Jezreel, and HE[JESUS] spied
the company of Jehu as HE[JESUS] came, and said, I see a company. And Joram
said, Take an horseman, and send to meet them, and let HIM[JESUS] say, Is it

9:18 So there went one on horseback to meet HIM[JESUS], and said, Thus says
the KING[JESUS], Is it peace? And Jehu said, What hast you to do with peace?
turn you behind me. And the watchman told, saying, The messenger came
to them, but HE[JESUS] comes not again.

9:19 Then HE[JESUS] sent out a second on horseback, which came to them, and
said, Thus says the KING[JESUS], Is it peace? And Jehu answered, What hast
you to do with peace? turn you behind me.

9:20 And the watchman told, saying, HE[JESUS] came even unto them, and comes
not again: and the driving is like the driving of Jehu the SON[JESUS] of
Nimshi; for HE[JESUS] driveth furiously.

9:21 And Joram said, Make ready. And HIS[JESUS] chariot was made ready. And
Joram KING[JESUS] of Israel and Ahaziah KING[JESUS] of Judah went out, each in HIS[JESUS]
chariot, and they went out against Jehu, and met HIM[JESUS] in the portion of

9:22 And it came to pass, when Joram saw Jehu, that HE[JESUS] said, Is it
peace, Jehu? And HE[JESUS] answered, What peace, so long as the whoredoms of
your mother Jezebel and her witchcrafts are so many?

9:23 And Joram turned HIS[JESUS] hands, and fled, and said to Ahaziah, There is
treachery, O Ahaziah.

9:24 And Jehu drew a bow with HIS[JESUS] full strength, and smote Jehoram
between HIS[JESUS] arms, and the arrow went out at HIS[JESUS] heart, and HE[JESUS] sunk down
in HIS[JESUS] chariot.

9:25 Then said Jehu to Bidkar HIS[JESUS] captain, Take up, and cast HIM[JESUS] in the
portion of the field of Naboth the Jezreelite: for remember how that,

burden upon HIM[JESUS];

9:26 Surely I have seen yesterday the blood of Naboth, and the blood of
HIS[JESUS] sons, says the LORD[JESUS]; and I will requite you in this plat, says
the LORD[JESUS]. Now therefore take and cast HIM[JESUS] into the plat of ground,
according to the WORD[JESUS] of the LORD[JESUS].

9:27 But when Ahaziah the KING[JESUS] of Judah saw this, HE[JESUS] fled by the way of
the garden house. And Jehu followed after HIM[JESUS], and said, Smite HIM[JESUS] also
in the chariot. And they did so at the going up to Gur, which is by

9:28 And HIS[JESUS] servants carried HIM[JESUS] in a chariot to Jerusalem, and buried
HIM[JESUS] in HIS[JESUS] sepulchre with HIS[JESUS] fathers in the city of David.

9:29 And in the eleventh year of Joram the SON[JESUS] of Ahab began Ahaziah to
reign over Judah.

9:30 And when Jehu was come to Jezreel, Jezebel heard of it; and she
painted her face, and tired her head, and looked out at a window.

9:31 And as Jehu entered in at the gate, she said, Had Zimri peace, who
slew HIS[JESUS] master?

9:32 And HE[JESUS] lifted up HIS[JESUS] face to the window, and said, Who is on my
side? who? And there looked out to HIM[JESUS] two or three eunuchs.

9:33 And HE[JESUS] said, Throw her down. So they threw her down: and some of
her blood was sprinkled on the wall, and on the horses: and HE[JESUS] trode her
under foot.

9:34 And when HE[JESUS] was come in, HE[JESUS] did eat and drink, and said, Go, see
now this cursed woman, and bury her: for she is a KING[JESUS]'s daughter.

9:35 And they went to bury her: but they found no more of her than the
skull, and the feet, and the palms of her hands.

9:36 Wherefore they came again, and told HIM[JESUS]. And HE[JESUS] said, This is the
WORD[JESUS] of the LORD[JESUS], which HE[JESUS] spake by HIS[JESUS] SERVANT[JESUS] Elijah the Tishbite,
saying, In the portion of Jezreel shall dogs eat the flesh of Jezebel:

9:37 And the carcase of Jezebel shall be as dung upon the face of the
field in the portion of Jezreel; so that they shall not say, This is
Jezebel.


10:1 And Ahab had seventy sons in Samaria. And Jehu wrote letters, and
sent to Samaria, unto the rulers of Jezreel, to the elders, and to them
that brought up Ahab's children, saying,

10:2 Now as soon as this letter comes to you, seeing your master's sons
are with you, and there are with you chariots and horses, a fenced city
also, and armour;

10:3 Look even out the best and meetest of your master's sons, and set
HIM[JESUS] on HIS[JESUS] father's throne, and fight for your master's house.

10:4 But they were exceedingly afraid, and said, Behold, two kings stood
not before HIM[JESUS]: how then shall we stand?

10:5 And HE[JESUS] that was over the house, and HE[JESUS] that was over the city, the
elders also, and the bringers up of the children, sent to Jehu, saying,
We are your servants, and will do all that you shalt bid us; we will not
make any KING[JESUS]: do you that which is good in yours eyes.

10:6 Then HE[JESUS] wrote a letter the second time to them, saying, If you be
mine, and if you will hearken unto my voice, take you the heads of the men
your master's sons, and come to me to Jezreel by to morrow this time.
Now the KING[JESUS]'s sons, being seventy persons, were with the great men of
the city, which brought them up.

10:7 And it came to pass, when the letter came to them, that they took
the KING[JESUS]'s sons, and slew seventy persons, and put their heads in
baskets, and sent HIM[JESUS] them to Jezreel.

10:8 And there came a messenger, and told HIM[JESUS], saying, They have brought
the heads of the KING[JESUS]'s sons. And HE[JESUS] said, Lay you them in two heaps at
the entering in of the gate until the morning.

10:9 And it came to pass in the morning, that HE[JESUS] went out, and stood,
and said to all the people, you be righteous: behold, I conspired against
my master, and slew HIM[JESUS]: but who slew all these?

10:10 Know now that there shall fall unto the earth nothing of the WORD[JESUS]
of the LORD[JESUS], which the LORD[JESUS] spake concerning the house of Ahab: for the
LORD[JESUS] has done that which HE[JESUS] spake by HIS[JESUS] SERVANT[JESUS] Elijah.

10:11 So Jehu slew all that remained of the house of Ahab in Jezreel,
and all HIS[JESUS] great men, and HIS[JESUS] kinsfolks, and HIS[JESUS] priests, until HE[JESUS] left
HIM[JESUS] none remaining.

10:12 And HE[JESUS] arose and departed, and came to Samaria. And as HE[JESUS] was at
the shearing house in the way,

10:13 Jehu met with the brethren of Ahaziah KING[JESUS] of Judah, and said, Who
are you? And they answered, We are the brethren of Ahaziah; and we go
down to salute the children of the KING[JESUS] and the children of the queen.

10:14 And HE[JESUS] said, Take them alive. And they took them alive, and slew
them at the pit of the shearing house, even two and forty men; neither
left HE[JESUS] any of them.

10:15 And when HE[JESUS] was departed thence, HE[JESUS] lighted on Jehonadab the SON[JESUS]
of Rechab coming to meet HIM[JESUS]: and HE[JESUS] saluted HIM[JESUS], and said to HIM[JESUS], Is
yours heart right, as my heart is with your heart? And Jehonadab
answered, It is. If it be, give me yours hand. And HE[JESUS] gave HIM[JESUS] HIS[JESUS] hand;
and HE[JESUS] took HIM[JESUS] up to HIM[JESUS] into the chariot.

10:16 And HE[JESUS] said, Come with me, and see my zeal for the LORD[JESUS]. So they
made HIM[JESUS] ride in HIS[JESUS] chariot.

10:17 And when HE[JESUS] came to Samaria, HE[JESUS] slew all that remained unto Ahab
in Samaria, till HE[JESUS] had destroyed HIM[JESUS], according to the saying of the
LORD[JESUS], which HE[JESUS] spake to Elijah.

10:18 And Jehu gathered all the people together, and said unto them,
Ahab served Baal a little; but Jehu shall serve HIM[JESUS] much.

10:19 Now therefore call unto me all the prophets of Baal, all HIS[JESUS]
servants, and all HIS[JESUS] priests; let none be wanting: for I have a great
sacrifice to do to Baal; whoever shall be wanting, HE[JESUS] shall not live.
But Jehu did it in subtilty, to the intent that HE[JESUS] might destroy the
worshippers of Baal.

10:20 And Jehu said, Proclaim a solemn assembly for Baal. And they
proclaimed it.

10:21 And Jehu sent through all Israel: and all the worshippers of Baal
came, so that there was not a man left that came not. And they came into
the house of Baal; and the house of Baal was full from one end to
another.

10:22 And HE[JESUS] said unto HIM[JESUS] that was over the vestry, Bring forth
vestments for all the worshippers of Baal. And HE[JESUS] brought them forth
vestments.

10:23 And Jehu went, and Jehonadab the SON[JESUS] of Rechab, into the house of
Baal, and said unto the worshippers of Baal, Search, and look that there
be here with you none of the servants of the LORD[JESUS], but the worshippers
of Baal only.

10:24 And when they went in to offer sacrifices and burnt offerings,
Jehu appointed fourscore men without, and said, If any of the men whom I
have brought into your hands escape, HE[JESUS] that letteth HIM[JESUS] go, HIS[JESUS] life
shall be for the life of HIM[JESUS].

10:25 And it came to pass, as soon as HE[JESUS] had made an end of offering the
burnt offering, that Jehu said to the guard and to the captains, Go in,
and slay them; let none come forth. And they smote them with the edge of
the sword; and the guard and the captains cast them out, and went to the
city of the house of Baal.

10:26 And they brought forth the images out of the house of Baal, and
burned them.

10:27 And they brake down the image of Baal, and brake down the house of
Baal, and made it a draught house unto this day.

10:28 Thus Jehu destroyed Baal out of Israel.

10:29 Howbeit from the sins of Jeroboam the SON[JESUS] of Nebat, who made
Israel to sin, Jehu departed not from after them, to wit, the golden
calves that were in Bethel, and that were in Dan.

10:30 And the LORD[JESUS] said unto Jehu, Because you hast done well in
executing that which is right in mine eyes, and hast done unto the house
of Ahab according to all that was in mine heart, your children of the
fourth generation shall sit on the throne of Israel.

10:31 But Jehu took no heed to walk in the law of the LORD[JESUS] GOD[JESUS] of Israel
with all HIS[JESUS] heart: for HE[JESUS] departed not from the sins of Jeroboam, which
made Israel to sin.

10:32 In those days the LORD[JESUS] began to cut Israel short: and Hazael smote
them in all the coasts of Israel;

10:33 From Jordan eastward, all the land of Gilead, the Gadites, and the
Reubenites, and the Manassites, from Aroer, which is by the river Arnon,
even Gilead and Bashan.

10:34 Now the rest of the acts of Jehu, and all that HE[JESUS] did, and all HIS[JESUS]
might, are they not written in the book of the chronicles of the kings
of Israel?

10:35 And Jehu slept with HIS[JESUS] fathers: and they buried HIM[JESUS] in Samaria.
And Jehoahaz HIS[JESUS] SON[JESUS] reigned in HIS[JESUS] stead.

10:36 And the time that Jehu reigned over Israel in Samaria was twenty
and eight years.


11:1 And when Athaliah the mother of Ahaziah saw that her SON[JESUS] was dead,
she arose and destroyed all the SEED[JESUS] royal.

11:2 But Jehosheba, the daughter of KING[JESUS] Joram, sister of Ahaziah, took
Joash the SON[JESUS] of Ahaziah, and stole HIM[JESUS] from among the KING[JESUS]'s sons which
were slain; and they hid HIM[JESUS], even HIM[JESUS] and HIS[JESUS] nurse, in the bedchamber
from Athaliah, so that HE[JESUS] was not slain.

11:3 And HE[JESUS] was with her hid in the house of the LORD[JESUS] six years. And
Athaliah did reign over the land.

11:4 And the seventh year Jehoiada sent and fetched the rulers over
hundreds, with the captains and the guard, and brought them to HIM[JESUS] into
the house of the LORD[JESUS], and made a covenant with them, and took an oath
of them in the house of the LORD[JESUS], and shewed them the KING[JESUS]'s SON[JESUS].

11:5 And HE[JESUS] commanded them, saying, This is the thing that you shall do;
A third part of you that enter in on the sabbath shall even be keepers
of the watch of the KING[JESUS]'s house;

11:6 And a third part shall be at the gate of Sur; and a third part at
the gate behind the guard: so shall you keep the watch of the house, that
it be not broken down.

11:7 And two parts of all you that go forth on the sabbath, even they
shall keep the watch of the house of the LORD[JESUS] about the KING[JESUS].

11:8 And you shall compass the KING[JESUS] round about, every man with HIS[JESUS]
weapons in HIS[JESUS] hand: and HE[JESUS] that comes within the ranges, let HIM[JESUS] be
slain: and be you with the KING[JESUS] as HE[JESUS] goes out and as HE[JESUS] comes in.

11:9 And the captains over the hundreds did according to all things that
Jehoiada the priest commanded: and they took every man HIS[JESUS] men that were
to come in on the sabbath, with them that should go out on the sabbath,
and came to Jehoiada the priest.

11:10 And to the captains over hundreds did the priest give KING[JESUS] David's
spears and shields, that were in the temple of the LORD[JESUS].

11:11 And the guard stood, every man with HIS[JESUS] weapons in HIS[JESUS] hand, round
about the KING[JESUS], from the right corner of the temple to the left corner
of the temple, along by the altar and the temple.

11:12 And HE[JESUS] brought forth the KING[JESUS]'s SON[JESUS], and put the crown upon HIM[JESUS],
and gave HIM[JESUS] the testimony; and they made HIM[JESUS] KING[JESUS], and anointed HIM[JESUS];
and they clapped their hands, and said, GOD[JESUS] save the KING[JESUS].

11:13 And when Athaliah heard the noise of the guard and of the people,
she came to the people into the temple of the LORD[JESUS].

11:14 And when she looked, behold, the KING[JESUS] stood by a pillar, as the
manner was, and the princes and the trumpeters by the KING[JESUS], and all the
people of the land rejoiced, and blew with trumpets: and Athaliah rent
her clothes, and cried, Treason, Treason.

11:15 But Jehoiada the priest commanded the captains of the hundreds,
the officers of the host, and said unto them, Have her forth without the
ranges: and HIM[JESUS] that followeth her kill with the sword. For the priest
had said, Let her not be slain in the house of the LORD[JESUS].

11:16 And they laid hands on her; and she went by the way by the which
the horses came into the KING[JESUS]'s house: and there was she slain.

11:17 And Jehoiada made a covenant between the LORD[JESUS] and the KING[JESUS] and the
people, that they should be the LORD[JESUS]'s people; between the KING[JESUS] also and
the people.

11:18 And all the people of the land went into the house of Baal, and
brake it down; HIS[JESUS] altars and HIS[JESUS] images brake they in pieces
thoroughly, and slew Mattan the priest of Baal before the altars. And
the priest appointed officers over the house of the LORD[JESUS].

11:19 And HE[JESUS] took the rulers over hundreds, and the captains, and the
guard, and all the people of the land; and they brought down the KING[JESUS]
from the house of the LORD[JESUS], and came by the way of the gate of the guard
to the KING[JESUS]'s house. And HE[JESUS] sat on the throne of the kings.

11:20 And all the people of the land rejoiced, and the city was in
quiet: and they slew Athaliah with the sword beside the KING[JESUS]'s house.

11:21 Seven years old was Jehoash when HE[JESUS] began to reign.


12:1 In the seventh year of Jehu Jehoash began to reign; and forty years
reigned HE[JESUS] in Jerusalem. And HIS[JESUS] mother's name was Zibiah of Beersheba.

12:2 And Jehoash did that which was right in the sight of the LORD[JESUS] all
HIS[JESUS] days wherein Jehoiada the priest instructed HIM[JESUS].

12:3 But the high places were not taken away: the people still
sacrificed and burnt incense in the high places.

12:4 And Jehoash said to the priests, All the money of the dedicated
things that is brought into the house of the LORD[JESUS], even the money of
every one that passeth the account, the money that every man is set at,
and all the money that comes into any man's heart to bring into the
house of the LORD[JESUS],

12:5 Let the priests take it to them, every man of HIS[JESUS] acquaintance: and
let them repair the breaches of the house, wheresoever any breach shall
be found.

12:6 But it was so, that in the three and twentieth year of KING[JESUS] Jehoash
the priests had not repaired the breaches of the house.

12:7 Then KING[JESUS] Jehoash called for Jehoiada the priest, and the other
priests, and said unto them, Why repair you not the breaches of the
house? now therefore receive no more money of your acquaintance, but
deliver it for the breaches of the house.

12:8 And the priests consented to receive no more money of the people,
neither to repair the breaches of the house.

12:9 But Jehoiada the priest took a chest, and bored a hole in the lid
of it, and set it beside the altar, on the right side as one comes into
the house of the LORD[JESUS]: and the priests that kept the door put therein
all the money that was brought into the house of the LORD[JESUS].

12:10 And it was so, when they saw that there was much money in the
chest, that the KING[JESUS]'s scribe and the high priest came up, and they put
up in bags, and told the money that was found in the house of the LORD[JESUS].

12:11 And they gave the money, being told, into the hands of them that
did the work, that had the oversight of the house of the LORD[JESUS]: and they
laid it out to the carpenters and builders, that wrought upon the house
of the LORD[JESUS],

12:12 And to masons, and hewers of stone, and to buy timber and hewed
stone to repair the breaches of the house of the LORD[JESUS], and for all that
was laid out for the house to repair it.

12:13 Howbeit there were not made for the house of the LORD[JESUS] bowls of
silver, snuffers, basons, trumpets, any vessels of gold, or vessels of
silver, of the money that was brought into the house of the LORD[JESUS]:

12:14 But they gave that to the workmen, and repaired therewith the
house of the LORD[JESUS].

12:15 Moreover they reckoned not with the men, into whose hand they
delivered the money to be bestowed on workmen: for they dealt
faithfully.

12:16 The trespass money and sin money was not brought into the house of
the LORD[JESUS]: it was the priests'.

12:17 Then Hazael KING[JESUS] of Syria went up, and fought against Gath, and
took it: and Hazael set HIS[JESUS] face to go up to Jerusalem.

12:18 And Jehoash KING[JESUS] of Judah took all the hallowed things that
Jehoshaphat, and Jehoram, and Ahaziah, HIS[JESUS] fathers, kings of Judah, had
dedicated, and HIS[JESUS] own hallowed things, and all the gold that was found
in the treasures of the house of the LORD[JESUS], and in the KING[JESUS]'s house, and
sent it to Hazael KING[JESUS] of Syria: and HE[JESUS] went away from Jerusalem.

12:19 And the rest of the acts of Joash, and all that HE[JESUS] did, are they
not written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Judah?

12:20 And HIS[JESUS] servants arose, and made a conspiracy, and slew Joash in
the house of Millo, which goes down to Silla.

12:21 For Jozachar the SON[JESUS] of Shimeath, and Jehozabad the SON[JESUS] of Shomer,
HIS[JESUS] servants, smote HIM[JESUS], and HE[JESUS] died; and they buried HIM[JESUS] with HIS[JESUS]
fathers in the city of David: and Amaziah HIS[JESUS] SON[JESUS] reigned in HIS[JESUS] stead.


13:1 In the three and twentieth year of Joash the SON[JESUS] of Ahaziah KING[JESUS] of
Judah Jehoahaz the SON[JESUS] of Jehu began to reign over Israel in Samaria,
and reigned seventeen years.

13:2 And HE[JESUS] did that which was evil in the sight of the LORD[JESUS], and
followed the sins of Jeroboam the SON[JESUS] of Nebat, which made Israel to
sin; HE[JESUS] departed not therefrom.

13:3 And the anger of the LORD[JESUS] was kindled against Israel, and HE[JESUS]
delivered them into the hand of Hazael KING[JESUS] of Syria, and into the hand
of Benhadad the SON[JESUS] of Hazael, all their days.

13:4 And Jehoahaz besought the LORD[JESUS], and the LORD[JESUS] hearkened unto HIM[JESUS]:
for HE[JESUS] saw the oppression of Israel, because the KING[JESUS] of Syria oppressed
them.

13:5 (And the LORD[JESUS] gave Israel a saviour, so that they went out from
under the hand of the Syrians: and the children of Israel dwelt in their
tents, as beforetime.

13:6 Nevertheless they departed not from the sins of the house of
Jeroboam, who made Israel sin, but walked therein: and there remained
the grove also in Samaria.)

13:7 Neither did HE[JESUS] leave of the people to Jehoahaz but fifty horsemen,
and ten chariots, and ten thousand footmen; for the KING[JESUS] of Syria had
destroyed them, and had made them like the dust by threshing.

13:8 Now the rest of the acts of Jehoahaz, and all that HE[JESUS] did, and HIS[JESUS]
might, are they not written in the book of the chronicles of the kings
of Israel?

13:9 And Jehoahaz slept with HIS[JESUS] fathers; and they buried HIM[JESUS] in
Samaria: and Joash HIS[JESUS] SON[JESUS] reigned in HIS[JESUS] stead.

13:10 In the thirty and seventh year of Joash KING[JESUS] of Judah began
Jehoash the SON[JESUS] of Jehoahaz to reign over Israel in Samaria, and reigned
sixteen years.

13:11 And HE[JESUS] did that which was evil in the sight of the LORD[JESUS]; HE[JESUS]
departed not from all the sins of Jeroboam the SON[JESUS] of Nebat, who made
Israel sin: but HE[JESUS] walked therein.

13:12 And the rest of the acts of Joash, and all that HE[JESUS] did, and HIS[JESUS]
might wherewith HE[JESUS] fought against Amaziah KING[JESUS] of Judah, are they not
written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Israel?

13:13 And Joash slept with HIS[JESUS] fathers; and Jeroboam sat upon HIS[JESUS]
throne: and Joash was buried in Samaria with the kings of Israel.

13:14 Now Elisha was fallen sick of HIS[JESUS] sickness whereof HE[JESUS] died. And
Joash the KING[JESUS] of Israel came down unto HIM[JESUS], and wept over HIS[JESUS] face, and
said, O my father, my father, the chariot of Israel, and the horsemen
thereof.

13:15 And Elisha said unto HIM[JESUS], Take bow and arrows. And HE[JESUS] took unto
HIM[JESUS] bow and arrows.

13:16 And HE[JESUS] said to the KING[JESUS] of Israel, Put yours hand upon the bow.
And HE[JESUS] put HIS[JESUS] hand upon it: and Elisha put HIS[JESUS] hands upon the KING[JESUS]'s
hands.

13:17 And HE[JESUS] said, Open the window eastward. And HE[JESUS] opened it. Then
Elisha said, Shoot. And HE[JESUS] shot. And HE[JESUS] said, The arrow of the LORD[JESUS]'s
deliverance, and the arrow of deliverance from Syria: for you shalt
smite the Syrians in Aphek, till you have consumed them.

13:18 And HE[JESUS] said, Take the arrows. And HE[JESUS] took them. And HE[JESUS] said unto
the KING[JESUS] of Israel, Smite upon the ground. And HE[JESUS] smote thrice, and
stayed.

13:19 And the man of GOD[JESUS] was wroth with HIM[JESUS], and said, you shouldest
have smitten five or six times; then hadst you smitten Syria till you
hadst consumed it: whereas now you shalt smite Syria but thrice.

13:20 And Elisha died, and they buried HIM[JESUS]. And the bands of the
Moabites invaded the land at the coming in of the year.

13:21 And it came to pass, as they were burying a man, that, behold,
they spied a band of men; and they cast the man into the sepulchre of
Elisha: and when the man was let down, and touched the bones of Elisha,
HE[JESUS] revived, and stood up on HIS[JESUS] feet.

13:22 But Hazael KING[JESUS] of Syria oppressed Israel all the days of
Jehoahaz.

13:23 And the LORD[JESUS] was gracious unto them, and had compassion on them,
and had respect unto them, because of HIS[JESUS] covenant with Abraham, Isaac,
and Jacob, and would not destroy them, neither cast HE[JESUS] them from HIS[JESUS]
presence as yet.

13:24 So Hazael KING[JESUS] of Syria died; and Benhadad HIS[JESUS] SON[JESUS] reigned in HIS[JESUS]
stead.

13:25 And Jehoash the SON[JESUS] of Jehoahaz took again out of the hand of
Benhadad the SON[JESUS] of Hazael the cities, which HE[JESUS] had taken out of the
hand of Jehoahaz HIS[JESUS] father by war. Three times did Joash beat HIM[JESUS], and
recovered the cities of Israel.


14:1 In the second year of Joash SON[JESUS] of Jehoahaz KING[JESUS] of Israel reigned
Amaziah the SON[JESUS] of Joash KING[JESUS] of Judah.

14:2 HE[JESUS] was twenty and five years old when HE[JESUS] began to reign, and
reigned twenty and nine years in Jerusalem. And HIS[JESUS] mother's name was
Jehoaddan of Jerusalem.

14:3 And HE[JESUS] did that which was right in the sight of the LORD[JESUS], yet not
like David HIS[JESUS] father: HE[JESUS] did according to all things as Joash HIS[JESUS]
father did.

14:4 Howbeit the high places were not taken away: as yet the people did
sacrifice and burnt incense on the high places.

14:5 And it came to pass, as soon as the kingdom was confirmed in HIS[JESUS]
hand, that HE[JESUS] slew HIS[JESUS] servants which had slain the KING[JESUS] HIS[JESUS] father.

14:6 But the children of the murderers HE[JESUS] slew not: according unto that
which is written in the book of the law of Moses, wherein the LORD[JESUS]
commanded, saying, The fathers shall not be put to death for the
children, nor the children be put to death for the fathers; but every
man shall be put to death for HIS[JESUS] own sin.

14:7 HE[JESUS] slew of Edom in the valley of salt ten thousand, and took Selah
by war, and called the name of it Joktheel unto this day.

14:8 Then Amaziah sent messengers to Jehoash, the SON[JESUS] of Jehoahaz SON[JESUS] of
Jehu, KING[JESUS] of Israel, saying, Come, let us look one another in the face.

14:9 And Jehoash the KING[JESUS] of Israel sent to Amaziah KING[JESUS] of Judah,
saying, The thistle that was in Lebanon sent to the cedar that was in
Lebanon, saying, Give your daughter to my SON[JESUS] to wife: and there passed
by a wild beast that was in Lebanon, and trode down the thistle.

14:10 you hast indeed smitten Edom, and yours heart has lifted you
up: glory of this, and tarry at home: for why shouldest you meddle to
your hurt, that you shouldest fall, even you, and Judah with you?

14:11 But Amaziah would not hear. Therefore Jehoash KING[JESUS] of Israel went
up; and HE[JESUS] and Amaziah KING[JESUS] of Judah looked one another in the face at
Bethshemesh, which belongeth to Judah.

14:12 And Judah was put to the worse before Israel; and they fled every
man to their tents.

14:13 And Jehoash KING[JESUS] of Israel took Amaziah KING[JESUS] of Judah, the SON[JESUS] of
Jehoash the SON[JESUS] of Ahaziah, at Bethshemesh, and came to Jerusalem, and
brake down the wall of Jerusalem from the gate of Ephraim unto the
corner gate, four hundred cubits.

14:14 And HE[JESUS] took all the gold and silver, and all the vessels that were
found in the house of the LORD[JESUS], and in the treasures of the KING[JESUS]'s
house, and hostages, and returned to Samaria.

14:15 Now the rest of the acts of Jehoash which HE[JESUS] did, and HIS[JESUS] might,
and how HE[JESUS] fought with Amaziah KING[JESUS] of Judah, are they not written in
the book of the chronicles of the kings of Israel?

14:16 And Jehoash slept with HIS[JESUS] fathers, and was buried in Samaria with
the kings of Israel; and Jeroboam HIS[JESUS] SON[JESUS] reigned in HIS[JESUS] stead.

14:17 And Amaziah the SON[JESUS] of Joash KING[JESUS] of Judah lived after the death
of Jehoash SON[JESUS] of Jehoahaz KING[JESUS] of Israel fifteen years.

14:18 And the rest of the acts of Amaziah, are they not written in the
book of the chronicles of the kings of Judah?

14:19 Now they made a conspiracy against HIM[JESUS] in Jerusalem: and HE[JESUS] fled
to Lachish; but they sent after HIM[JESUS] to Lachish, and slew HIM[JESUS] there.

14:20 And they brought HIM[JESUS] on horses: and HE[JESUS] was buried at Jerusalem
with HIS[JESUS] fathers in the city of David.

14:21 And all the people of Judah took Azariah, which was sixteen years
old, and made HIM[JESUS] KING[JESUS] instead of HIS[JESUS] father Amaziah.

14:22 HE[JESUS] built Elath, and restored it to Judah, after that the KING[JESUS]
slept with HIS[JESUS] fathers.

14:23 In the fifteenth year of Amaziah the SON[JESUS] of Joash KING[JESUS] of Judah
Jeroboam the SON[JESUS] of Joash KING[JESUS] of Israel began to reign in Samaria, and
reigned forty and one years.

14:24 And HE[JESUS] did that which was evil in the sight of the LORD[JESUS]: HE[JESUS]
departed not from all the sins of Jeroboam the SON[JESUS] of Nebat, who made
Israel to sin.

14:25 HE[JESUS] restored the coast of Israel from the entering of Hamath unto
the sea of the plain, according to the WORD[JESUS] of the LORD[JESUS] GOD[JESUS] of Israel,
which HE[JESUS] spake by the hand of HIS[JESUS] SERVANT[JESUS] Jonah, the SON[JESUS] of Amittai, the
PROPHET[JESUS], which was of Gathhepher.

14:26 For the LORD[JESUS] saw the affliction of Israel, that it was very
bitter: for there was not any shut up, nor any left, nor any helper for
Israel.

14:27 And the LORD[JESUS] said not that HE[JESUS] would blot out the name of Israel
from under heaven: but HE[JESUS] saved them by the hand of Jeroboam the SON[JESUS] of
Joash.

14:28 Now the rest of the acts of Jeroboam, and all that HE[JESUS] did, and HIS[JESUS]
might, how HE[JESUS] warred, and how HE[JESUS] recovered Damascus, and Hamath, which
belonged to Judah, for Israel, are they not written in the book of the
chronicles of the kings of Israel?

14:29 And Jeroboam slept with HIS[JESUS] fathers, even with the kings of
Israel; and Zachariah HIS[JESUS] SON[JESUS] reigned in HIS[JESUS] stead.


15:1 In the twenty and seventh year of Jeroboam KING[JESUS] of Israel began
Azariah SON[JESUS] of Amaziah KING[JESUS] of Judah to reign.

15:2 Sixteen years old was HE[JESUS] when HE[JESUS] began to reign, and HE[JESUS] reigned two
and fifty years in Jerusalem. And HIS[JESUS] mother's name was Jecholiah of
Jerusalem.

15:3 And HE[JESUS] did that which was right in the sight of the LORD[JESUS], according
to all that HIS[JESUS] father Amaziah had done;

15:4 Save that the high places were not removed: the people sacrificed
and burnt incense still on the high places.

15:5 And the LORD[JESUS] smote the KING[JESUS], so that HE[JESUS] was a leper unto the day of
HIS[JESUS] death, and dwelt in a several house. And Jotham the KING[JESUS]'s SON[JESUS] was
over the house, judging the people of the land.

15:6 And the rest of the acts of Azariah, and all that HE[JESUS] did, are they
not written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Judah?

15:7 So Azariah slept with HIS[JESUS] fathers; and they buried HIM[JESUS] with HIS[JESUS]
fathers in the city of David: and Jotham HIS[JESUS] SON[JESUS] reigned in HIS[JESUS] stead.

15:8 In the thirty and eighth year of Azariah KING[JESUS] of Judah did
Zachariah the SON[JESUS] of Jeroboam reign over Israel in Samaria six months.

15:9 And HE[JESUS] did that which was evil in the sight of the LORD[JESUS], as HIS[JESUS]
fathers had done: HE[JESUS] departed not from the sins of Jeroboam the SON[JESUS] of
Nebat, who made Israel to sin.

15:10 And Shallum the SON[JESUS] of Jabesh conspired against HIM[JESUS], and smote HIM[JESUS]
before the people, and slew HIM[JESUS], and reigned in HIS[JESUS] stead.

15:11 And the rest of the acts of Zachariah, behold, they are written in
the book of the chronicles of the kings of Israel.

15:12 This was the WORD[JESUS] of the LORD[JESUS] which HE[JESUS] spake unto Jehu, saying,
your sons shall sit on the throne of Israel unto the fourth generation.
And so it came to pass.

15:13 Shallum the SON[JESUS] of Jabesh began to reign in the nine and thirtieth
year of Uzziah KING[JESUS] of Judah; and HE[JESUS] reigned a full month in Samaria.

15:14 For Menahem the SON[JESUS] of Gadi went up from Tirzah, and came to
Samaria, and smote Shallum the SON[JESUS] of Jabesh in Samaria, and slew HIM[JESUS],
and reigned in HIS[JESUS] stead.

15:15 And the rest of the acts of Shallum, and HIS[JESUS] conspiracy which HE[JESUS]
made, behold, they are written in the book of the chronicles of the
kings of Israel.

15:16 Then Menahem smote Tiphsah, and all that were therein, and the
coasts thereof from Tirzah: because they opened not to HIM[JESUS], therefore HE[JESUS]
smote it; and all the women therein that were with child HE[JESUS] ripped up.

15:17 In the nine and thirtieth year of Azariah KING[JESUS] of Judah began
Menahem the SON[JESUS] of Gadi to reign over Israel, and reigned ten years in
Samaria.

15:18 And HE[JESUS] did that which was evil in the sight of the LORD[JESUS]: HE[JESUS]
departed not all HIS[JESUS] days from the sins of Jeroboam the SON[JESUS] of Nebat,
who made Israel to sin.

15:19 And Pul the KING[JESUS] of Assyria came against the land: and Menahem
gave Pul a thousand talents of silver, that HIS[JESUS] hand might be with HIM[JESUS]
to confirm the kingdom in HIS[JESUS] hand.

15:20 And Menahem exacted the money of Israel, even of all the mighty
men of wealth, of each man fifty shekels of silver, to give to the KING[JESUS]
of Assyria. So the KING[JESUS] of Assyria turned back, and stayed not there in
the land.

15:21 And the rest of the acts of Menahem, and all that HE[JESUS] did, are they
not written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Israel?

15:22 And Menahem slept with HIS[JESUS] fathers; and Pekahiah HIS[JESUS] SON[JESUS] reigned
in HIS[JESUS] stead.

15:23 In the fiftieth year of Azariah KING[JESUS] of Judah Pekahiah the SON[JESUS] of
Menahem began to reign over Israel in Samaria, and reigned two years.

15:24 And HE[JESUS] did that which was evil in the sight of the LORD[JESUS]: HE[JESUS]
departed not from the sins of Jeroboam the SON[JESUS] of Nebat, who made Israel
to sin.

15:25 But Pekah the SON[JESUS] of Remaliah, a captain of HIS[JESUS], conspired against
HIM[JESUS], and smote HIM[JESUS] in Samaria, in the palace of the KING[JESUS]'s house, with
Argob and Arieh, and with HIM[JESUS] fifty men of the Gileadites: and HE[JESUS] killed
HIM[JESUS], and reigned in HIS[JESUS] room.

15:26 And the rest of the acts of Pekahiah, and all that HE[JESUS] did, behold,
they are written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Israel.

15:27 In the two and fiftieth year of Azariah KING[JESUS] of Judah Pekah the
SON[JESUS] of Remaliah began to reign over Israel in Samaria, and reigned
twenty years.

15:28 And HE[JESUS] did that which was evil in the sight of the LORD[JESUS]: HE[JESUS]
departed not from the sins of Jeroboam the SON[JESUS] of Nebat, who made Israel
to sin.

15:29 In the days of Pekah KING[JESUS] of Israel came Tiglathpileser KING[JESUS] of
Assyria, and took Ijon, and Abelbethmaachah, and Janoah, and Kedesh, and
Hazor, and Gilead, and Galilee, all the land of Naphtali, and carried
