them captive to Assyria.

15:30 And Hoshea the SON[JESUS] of Elah made a conspiracy against Pekah the SON[JESUS]
of Remaliah, and smote HIM[JESUS], and slew HIM[JESUS], and reigned in HIS[JESUS] stead, in
the twentieth year of Jotham the SON[JESUS] of Uzziah.

15:31 And the rest of the acts of Pekah, and all that HE[JESUS] did, behold,
they are written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Israel.

15:32 In the second year of Pekah the SON[JESUS] of Remaliah KING[JESUS] of Israel
began Jotham the SON[JESUS] of Uzziah KING[JESUS] of Judah to reign.

15:33 Five and twenty years old was HE[JESUS] when HE[JESUS] began to reign, and HE[JESUS]
reigned sixteen years in Jerusalem. And HIS[JESUS] mother's name was Jerusha,
the daughter of Zadok.

15:34 And HE[JESUS] did that which was right in the sight of the LORD[JESUS]: HE[JESUS] did
according to all that HIS[JESUS] father Uzziah had done.

15:35 Howbeit the high places were not removed: the people sacrificed
and burned incense still in the high places. HE[JESUS] built the higher gate of
the house of the LORD[JESUS].

15:36 Now the rest of the acts of Jotham, and all that HE[JESUS] did, are they
not written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Judah?

15:37 In those days the LORD[JESUS] began to send against Judah Rezin the KING[JESUS]
of Syria, and Pekah the SON[JESUS] of Remaliah.

15:38 And Jotham slept with HIS[JESUS] fathers, and was buried with HIS[JESUS] fathers
in the city of David HIS[JESUS] father: and Ahaz HIS[JESUS] SON[JESUS] reigned in HIS[JESUS] stead.


16:1 In the seventeenth year of Pekah the SON[JESUS] of Remaliah Ahaz the SON[JESUS]
of Jotham KING[JESUS] of Judah began to reign.

16:2 Twenty years old was Ahaz when HE[JESUS] began to reign, and reigned
sixteen years in Jerusalem, and did not that which was right in the
sight of the LORD[JESUS] HIS[JESUS] GOD[JESUS], like David HIS[JESUS] father.

16:3 But HE[JESUS] walked in the way of the kings of Israel, yea, and made HIS[JESUS]
SON[JESUS] to pass through the fire, according to the abominations of the
heathen, whom the LORD[JESUS] cast out from before the children of Israel.

16:4 And HE[JESUS] sacrificed and burnt incense in the high places, and on the
hills, and under every green tree.

16:5 Then Rezin KING[JESUS] of Syria and Pekah SON[JESUS] of Remaliah KING[JESUS] of Israel
came up to Jerusalem to war: and they besieged Ahaz, but could not
overcome HIM[JESUS].

16:6 At that time Rezin KING[JESUS] of Syria recovered Elath to Syria, and
drave the Jews from Elath: and the Syrians came to Elath, and dwelt
there unto this day.

16:7 So Ahaz sent messengers to Tiglathpileser KING[JESUS] of Assyria, saying,
I am your SERVANT[JESUS] and your SON[JESUS]: come up, and save me out of the hand of
the KING[JESUS] of Syria, and out of the hand of the KING[JESUS] of Israel, which rise
up against me.

16:8 And Ahaz took the silver and gold that was found in the house of
the LORD[JESUS], and in the treasures of the KING[JESUS]'s house, and sent it for a
present to the KING[JESUS] of Assyria.

16:9 And the KING[JESUS] of Assyria hearkened unto HIM[JESUS]: for the KING[JESUS] of Assyria
went up against Damascus, and took it, and carried the people of it
captive to Kir, and slew Rezin.

16:10 And KING[JESUS] Ahaz went to Damascus to meet Tiglathpileser KING[JESUS] of
Assyria, and saw an altar that was at Damascus: and KING[JESUS] Ahaz sent to
Urijah the priest the fashion of the altar, and the pattern of it,
according to all the workmanship thereof.

16:11 And Urijah the priest built an altar according to all that KING[JESUS]
Ahaz had sent from Damascus: so Urijah the priest made it against KING[JESUS]
Ahaz came from Damascus.

16:12 And when the KING[JESUS] was come from Damascus, the KING[JESUS] saw the altar:
and the KING[JESUS] approached to the altar, and offered thereon.

16:13 And HE[JESUS] burnt HIS[JESUS] burnt offering and HIS[JESUS] meat offering, and poured
HIS[JESUS] drink offering, and sprinkled the blood of HIS[JESUS] peace offerings, upon
the altar.

16:14 And HE[JESUS] brought also the brasen altar, which was before the LORD[JESUS],
from the forefront of the house, from between the altar and the house of
the LORD[JESUS], and put it on the north side of the altar.

16:15 And KING[JESUS] Ahaz commanded Urijah the priest, saying, Upon the great
altar burn the morning burnt offering, and the evening meat offering,
and the KING[JESUS]'s burnt sacrifice, and HIS[JESUS] meat offering, with the burnt
offering of all the people of the land, and their meat offering, and
their drink offerings; and sprinkle upon it all the blood of the burnt
offering, and all the blood of the sacrifice: and the brasen altar shall
be for me to enquire by.

16:16 Thus did Urijah the priest, according to all that KING[JESUS] Ahaz
commanded.

16:17 And KING[JESUS] Ahaz cut off the borders of the bases, and removed the
laver from off them; and took down the sea from off the brasen oxen that
were under it, and put it upon the pavement of stones.

16:18 And the covert for the sabbath that they had built in the house,
and the KING[JESUS]'s entry without, turned HE[JESUS] from the house of the LORD[JESUS] for
the KING[JESUS] of Assyria.

16:19 Now the rest of the acts of Ahaz which HE[JESUS] did, are they not
written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Judah?

16:20 And Ahaz slept with HIS[JESUS] fathers, and was buried with HIS[JESUS] fathers
in the city of David: and Hezekiah HIS[JESUS] SON[JESUS] reigned in HIS[JESUS] stead.


17:1 In the twelfth year of Ahaz KING[JESUS] of Judah began Hoshea the SON[JESUS] of
Elah to reign in Samaria over Israel nine years.

17:2 And HE[JESUS] did that which was evil in the sight of the LORD[JESUS], but not as
the kings of Israel that were before HIM[JESUS].

17:3 Against HIM[JESUS] came up Shalmaneser KING[JESUS] of Assyria; and Hoshea became
HIS[JESUS] SERVANT[JESUS], and gave HIM[JESUS] presents.

17:4 And the KING[JESUS] of Assyria found conspiracy in Hoshea: for HE[JESUS] had sent
messengers to So KING[JESUS] of Egypt, and brought no present to the KING[JESUS] of
Assyria, as HE[JESUS] had done year by year: therefore the KING[JESUS] of Assyria shut
HIM[JESUS] up, and bound HIM[JESUS] in prison.

17:5 Then the KING[JESUS] of Assyria came up throughout all the land, and went
up to Samaria, and besieged it three years.

17:6 In the ninth year of Hoshea the KING[JESUS] of Assyria took Samaria, and
carried Israel away into Assyria, and placed them in Halah and in Habor
by the river of Gozan, and in the cities of the Medes.

17:7 For so it was, that the children of Israel had sinned against the
LORD[JESUS] their GOD[JESUS], which had brought them up out of the land of Egypt, from
under the hand of Pharaoh KING[JESUS] of Egypt, and had feared other gods,

17:8 And walked in the statutes of the heathen, whom the LORD[JESUS] cast out
from before the children of Israel, and of the kings of Israel, which
they had made.

17:9 And the children of Israel did secretly those things that were not
right against the LORD[JESUS] their GOD[JESUS], and they built them high places in all
their cities, from the tower of the watchmen to the fenced city.

17:10 And they set them up images and groves in every high hill, and
under every green tree:

17:11 And there they burnt incense in all the high places, as did the
heathen whom the LORD[JESUS] carried away before them; and wrought wicked
things to provoke the LORD[JESUS] to anger:

17:12 For they served idols, whereof the LORD[JESUS] had said unto them, you
shall not do this thing.

17:13 Yet the LORD[JESUS] testified against Israel, and against Judah, by all
the prophets, and by all the seers, saying, Turn you from your evil ways,
and keep my commandments and my statutes, according to all the law which
I commanded your fathers, and which I sent to you by my servants the
prophets.

17:14 Notwithstanding they would not hear, but hardened their necks,
like to the neck of their fathers, that did not believe in the LORD[JESUS]
their GOD[JESUS].

17:15 And they rejected HIS[JESUS] statutes, and HIS[JESUS] covenant that HE[JESUS] made with
their fathers, and HIS[JESUS] testimonies which HE[JESUS] testified against them; and
they followed vanity, and became vain, and went after the heathen that
were round about them, concerning whom the LORD[JESUS] had charged them, that
they should not do like them.

17:16 And they left all the commandments of the LORD[JESUS] their GOD[JESUS], and made
them molten images, even two calves, and made a grove, and worshipped
all the host of heaven, and served Baal.

17:17 And they caused their sons and their daughters to pass through the
fire, and used divination and enchantments, and sold themselves to do
evil in the sight of the LORD[JESUS], to provoke HIM[JESUS] to anger.

17:18 Therefore the LORD[JESUS] was very angry with Israel, and removed them
out of HIS[JESUS] sight: there was none left but the tribe of Judah only.

17:19 Also Judah kept not the commandments of the LORD[JESUS] their GOD[JESUS], but
walked in the statutes of Israel which they made.

17:20 And the LORD[JESUS] rejected all the SEED[JESUS] of Israel, and afflicted them,
and delivered them into the hand of spoilers, until HE[JESUS] had cast them out
of HIS[JESUS] sight.

17:21 For HE[JESUS] rent Israel from the house of David; and they made Jeroboam
the SON[JESUS] of Nebat KING[JESUS]: and Jeroboam drave Israel from following the
LORD[JESUS], and made them sin a great sin.

17:22 For the children of Israel walked in all the sins of Jeroboam
which HE[JESUS] did; they departed not from them;

17:23 Until the LORD[JESUS] removed Israel out of HIS[JESUS] sight, as HE[JESUS] had said by
all HIS[JESUS] servants the prophets. So was Israel carried away out of their
own land to Assyria unto this day.

17:24 And the KING[JESUS] of Assyria brought men from Babylon, and from Cuthah,
and from Ava, and from Hamath, and from Sepharvaim, and placed them in
the cities of Samaria instead of the children of Israel: and they
possessed Samaria, and dwelt in the cities thereof.

17:25 And so it was at the beginning of their dwelling there, that they
feared not the LORD[JESUS]: therefore the LORD[JESUS] sent lions among them, which
slew some of them.

17:26 Wherefore they spake to the KING[JESUS] of Assyria, saying, The nations
which you hast removed, and placed in the cities of Samaria, know not
the manner of the GOD[JESUS] of the land: therefore HE[JESUS] has sent lions among
them, and, behold, they slay them, because they know not the manner of
the GOD[JESUS] of the land.

17:27 Then the KING[JESUS] of Assyria commanded, saying, Carry thither one of
the priests whom you brought from thence; and let them go and dwell
there, and let HIM[JESUS] teach them the manner of the GOD[JESUS] of the land.

17:28 Then one of the priests whom they had carried away from Samaria
came and dwelt in Bethel, and taught them how they should fear the LORD[JESUS].

17:29 Howbeit every nation made gods of their own, and put them in the
houses of the high places which the Samaritans had made, every nation in
their cities wherein they dwelt.

17:30 And the men of Babylon made Succothbenoth, and the men of Cuth
made Nergal, and the men of Hamath made Ashima,

17:31 And the Avites made Nibhaz and Tartak, and the Sepharvites burnt
their children in fire to Adrammelech and Anammelech, the gods of
Sepharvaim.

17:32 So they feared the LORD[JESUS], and made unto themselves of the lowest of
them priests of the high places, which sacrificed for them in the houses
of the high places.

17:33 They feared the LORD[JESUS], and served their own gods, after the manner
of the nations whom they carried away from thence.

17:34 Unto this day they do after the former manners: they fear not the
LORD[JESUS], neither do they after their statutes, or after their ordinances,
or after the law and commandment which the LORD[JESUS] commanded the children
of Jacob, whom HE[JESUS] named Israel;

17:35 With whom the LORD[JESUS] had made a covenant, and charged them, saying,
you shall not fear other gods, nor bow yourselves to them, nor serve
them, nor sacrifice to them:

17:36 But the LORD[JESUS], who brought you up out of the land of Egypt with
great power and a stretched out arm, HIM[JESUS] shall you fear, and HIM[JESUS] shall you
worship, and to HIM[JESUS] shall you do sacrifice.

17:37 And the statutes, and the ordinances, and the law, and the
commandment, which HE[JESUS] wrote for you, you shall observe to do for
evermore; and you shall not fear other gods.

17:38 And the covenant that I have made with you you shall not forget;
neither shall you fear other gods.

17:39 But the LORD[JESUS] your GOD[JESUS] you shall fear; and HE[JESUS] shall deliver you out
of the hand of all your enemies.

17:40 Howbeit they did not hearken, but they did after their former
manner.

17:41 So these nations feared the LORD[JESUS], and served their graven images,
both their children, and their children's children: as did their
fathers, so do they unto this day.


18:1 Now it came to pass in the third year of Hoshea SON[JESUS] of Elah KING[JESUS] of
Israel, that Hezekiah the SON[JESUS] of Ahaz KING[JESUS] of Judah began to reign.

18:2 Twenty and five years old was HE[JESUS] when HE[JESUS] began to reign; and HE[JESUS]
reigned twenty and nine years in Jerusalem. HIS[JESUS] mother's name also was
Abi, the daughter of Zachariah.

18:3 And HE[JESUS] did that which was right in the sight of the LORD[JESUS], according
to all that David HIS[JESUS] father did.

18:4 HE[JESUS] removed the high places, and brake the images, and cut down the
groves, and brake in pieces the brasen serpent that Moses had made: for
unto those days the children of Israel did burn incense to it: and HE[JESUS]
called it Nehushtan.

18:5 HE[JESUS] trusted in the LORD[JESUS] GOD[JESUS] of Israel; so that after HIM[JESUS] was none
like HIM[JESUS] among all the kings of Judah, nor any that were before HIM[JESUS].

18:6 For HE[JESUS] clave to the LORD[JESUS], and departed not from following HIM[JESUS], but
kept HIS[JESUS] commandments, which the LORD[JESUS] commanded Moses.

18:7 And the LORD[JESUS] was with HIM[JESUS]; and HE[JESUS] prospered whithersoever HE[JESUS] went
forth: and HE[JESUS] rebelled against the KING[JESUS] of Assyria, and served HIM[JESUS] not.

18:8 HE[JESUS] smote the Philistines, even unto Gaza, and the borders thereof,
from the tower of the watchmen to the fenced city.

18:9 And it came to pass in the fourth year of KING[JESUS] Hezekiah, which was
the seventh year of Hoshea SON[JESUS] of Elah KING[JESUS] of Israel, that Shalmaneser
KING[JESUS] of Assyria came up against Samaria, and besieged it.

18:10 And at the end of three years they took it: even in the sixth year
of Hezekiah, that is in the ninth year of Hoshea KING[JESUS] of Israel, Samaria
was taken.

18:11 And the KING[JESUS] of Assyria did carry away Israel unto Assyria, and
put them in Halah and in Habor by the river of Gozan, and in the cities
of the Medes:

18:12 Because they obeyed not the voice of the LORD[JESUS] their GOD[JESUS], but
transgressed HIS[JESUS] covenant, and all that Moses the SERVANT[JESUS] of the LORD[JESUS]
commanded, and would not hear them, nor do them.

18:13 Now in the fourteenth year of KING[JESUS] Hezekiah did Sennacherib KING[JESUS]
of Assyria come up against all the fenced cities of Judah, and took
them.

18:14 And Hezekiah KING[JESUS] of Judah sent to the KING[JESUS] of Assyria to Lachish,
saying, I have offended; return from me: that which you puttest on me
will I bear. And the KING[JESUS] of Assyria appointed unto Hezekiah KING[JESUS] of
Judah three hundred talents of silver and thirty talents of gold.

18:15 And Hezekiah gave HIM[JESUS] all the silver that was found in the house
of the LORD[JESUS], and in the treasures of the KING[JESUS]'s house.

18:16 At that time did Hezekiah cut off the gold from the doors of the
temple of the LORD[JESUS], and from the pillars which Hezekiah KING[JESUS] of Judah
had overlaid, and gave it to the KING[JESUS] of Assyria.

18:17 And the KING[JESUS] of Assyria sent Tartan and Rabsaris and Rabshakeh
from Lachish to KING[JESUS] Hezekiah with a great host against Jerusalem. And
they went up and came to Jerusalem. And when they were come up, they
came and stood by the conduit of the upper pool, which is in the highway
of the fuller's field.

18:18 And when they had called to the KING[JESUS], there came out to them
Eliakim the SON[JESUS] of Hilkiah, which was over the household, and Shebna the
scribe, and Joah the SON[JESUS] of Asaph the recorder.

18:19 And Rabshakeh said unto them, Speak you now to Hezekiah, Thus says
the great KING[JESUS], the KING[JESUS] of Assyria, What confidence is this wherein
you trustest?

18:20 you sayest, (but they are but vain words,) I have counsel and
strength for the war. Now on whom dost you trust, that you rebellest
against me?

18:21 Now, behold, you trustest upon the staff of this bruised reed,
even upon Egypt, on which if a man lean, it will go into HIS[JESUS] hand, and
pierce it: so is Pharaoh KING[JESUS] of Egypt unto all that trust on HIM[JESUS].

18:22 But if you say unto me, We trust in the LORD[JESUS] our GOD[JESUS]: is not that
HE[JESUS], whose high places and whose altars Hezekiah has taken away, and
has said to Judah and Jerusalem, you shall worship before this altar in
Jerusalem?

18:23 Now therefore, I pray you, give pledges to my LORD[JESUS] the KING[JESUS] of
Assyria, and I will deliver you two thousand horses, if you be able on
your part to set riders upon them.

18:24 How then wilt you turn away the face of one captain of the least
of my master's servants, and put your trust on Egypt for chariots and for
horsemen?

18:25 Am I now come up without the LORD[JESUS] against this place to destroy
it? The LORD[JESUS] said to me, Go up against this land, and destroy it.

18:26 Then said Eliakim the SON[JESUS] of Hilkiah, and Shebna, and Joah, unto
Rabshakeh, Speak, I pray you, to your servants in the Syrian language;
for we understand it: and talk not with us in the Jews' language in the
ears of the people that are on the wall.

18:27 But Rabshakeh said unto them, has my master sent me to your
master, and to you, to speak these words? has HE[JESUS] not sent me to the
men which sit on the wall, that they may eat their own dung, and drink
their own piss with you?

18:28 Then Rabshakeh stood and cried with a loud voice in the Jews'
language, and spake, saying, Hear the WORD[JESUS] of the great KING[JESUS], the KING[JESUS]
of Assyria:

18:29 Thus says the KING[JESUS], Let not Hezekiah deceive you: for HE[JESUS] shall
not be able to deliver you out of HIS[JESUS] hand:

18:30 Neither let Hezekiah make you trust in the LORD[JESUS], saying, The LORD[JESUS]
will surely deliver us, and this city shall not be delivered into the
hand of the KING[JESUS] of Assyria.

18:31 Hearken not to Hezekiah: for thus says the KING[JESUS] of Assyria, Make
an agreement with me by a present, and come out to me, and then eat you
every man of HIS[JESUS] own vine, and every one of HIS[JESUS] fig tree, and drink you
every one the waters of HIS[JESUS] cistern:

18:32 Until I come and take you away to a land like your own land, a
land of corn and wine, a land of bread and vineyards, a land of oil
olive and of honey, that you may live, and not die: and hearken not unto
Hezekiah, when HE[JESUS] persuadeth you, saying, The LORD[JESUS] will deliver us.

18:33 has any of the gods of the nations delivered at all HIS[JESUS] land out
of the hand of the KING[JESUS] of Assyria?

18:34 Where are the gods of Hamath, and of Arpad? where are the gods of
Sepharvaim, Hena, and Ivah? have they delivered Samaria out of mine
hand?

18:35 Who are they among all the gods of the countries, that have
delivered their country out of mine hand, that the LORD[JESUS] should deliver
Jerusalem out of mine hand?

18:36 But the people held their peace, and answered HIM[JESUS] not a WORD[JESUS]: for
the KING[JESUS]'s commandment was, saying, Answer HIM[JESUS] not.

18:37 Then came Eliakim the SON[JESUS] of Hilkiah, which was over the
household, and Shebna the scribe, and Joah the SON[JESUS] of Asaph the
recorder, to Hezekiah with their clothes rent, and told HIM[JESUS] the words of
Rabshakeh.


19:1 And it came to pass, when KING[JESUS] Hezekiah heard it, that HE[JESUS] rent HIS[JESUS]
clothes, and covered himself with sackcloth, and went into the house of
the LORD[JESUS].

19:2 And HE[JESUS] sent Eliakim, which was over the household, and Shebna the
scribe, and the elders of the priests, covered with sackcloth, to Isaiah
the PROPHET[JESUS] the SON[JESUS] of Amoz.

19:3 And they said unto HIM[JESUS], Thus says Hezekiah, This day is a day of
trouble, and of rebuke, and blasphemy; for the children are come to the
birth, and there is not strength to bring forth.

19:4 It may be the LORD[JESUS] your GOD[JESUS] will hear all the words of Rabshakeh,
whom the KING[JESUS] of Assyria HIS[JESUS] master has sent to reproach the living
GOD[JESUS]; and will reprove the words which the LORD[JESUS] your GOD[JESUS] has heard:
wherefore lift up your prayer for the remnant that are left.

19:5 So the servants of KING[JESUS] Hezekiah came to Isaiah.

19:6 And Isaiah said unto them, Thus shall you say to your master, Thus
says the LORD[JESUS], Be not afraid of the words which you hast heard, with
which the servants of the KING[JESUS] of Assyria have blasphemed me.

19:7 Behold, I will send a blast upon HIM[JESUS], and HE[JESUS] shall hear a rumour,
and shall return to HIS[JESUS] own land; and I will cause HIM[JESUS] to fall by the
sword in HIS[JESUS] own land.

19:8 So Rabshakeh returned, and found the KING[JESUS] of Assyria warring
against Libnah: for HE[JESUS] had heard that HE[JESUS] was departed from Lachish.

19:9 And when HE[JESUS] heard say of Tirhakah KING[JESUS] of Ethiopia, Behold, HE[JESUS] is
come out to fight against you: HE[JESUS] sent messengers again unto Hezekiah,
saying,

19:10 Thus shall you speak to Hezekiah KING[JESUS] of Judah, saying, Let not your
GOD[JESUS] in whom you trustest deceive you, saying, Jerusalem shall not be
delivered into the hand of the KING[JESUS] of Assyria.

19:11 Behold, you hast heard what the kings of Assyria have done to all
lands, by destroying them utterly: and shalt you be delivered?

19:12 Have the gods of the nations delivered them which my fathers have
destroyed; as Gozan, and Haran, and Rezeph, and the children of Eden
which were in Thelasar?

19:13 Where is the KING[JESUS] of Hamath, and the KING[JESUS] of Arpad, and the KING[JESUS]
of the city of Sepharvaim, of Hena, and Ivah?

19:14 And Hezekiah received the letter of the hand of the messengers,
and read it: and Hezekiah went up into the house of the LORD[JESUS], and spread
it before the LORD[JESUS].

19:15 And Hezekiah prayed before the LORD[JESUS], and said, O LORD[JESUS] GOD[JESUS] of
Israel, which dwellest between the cherubims, you art the GOD[JESUS], even
you alone, of all the kingdoms of the earth; you hast made heaven and
earth.

19:16 LORD[JESUS], bow down yours ear, and hear: open, LORD[JESUS], yours eyes, and
see: and hear the words of Sennacherib, which has sent HIM[JESUS] to reproach
the living GOD[JESUS].

19:17 Of a truth, LORD[JESUS], the kings of Assyria have destroyed the nations
and their lands,

19:18 And have cast their gods into the fire: for they were no gods, but
the work of men's hands, wood and stone: therefore they have destroyed
them.

19:19 Now therefore, O LORD[JESUS] our GOD[JESUS], I beseech you, save you us out of
HIS[JESUS] hand, that all the kingdoms of the earth may know that you art the
LORD[JESUS] GOD[JESUS], even you only.

19:20 Then Isaiah the SON[JESUS] of Amoz sent to Hezekiah, saying, Thus says
the LORD[JESUS] GOD[JESUS] of Israel, That which you hast prayed to me against
Sennacherib KING[JESUS] of Assyria I have heard.

19:21 This is the WORD[JESUS] that the LORD[JESUS] has spoken concerning HIM[JESUS]; The
virgin the daughter of Zion has despised you, and laughed you to
scorn; the daughter of Jerusalem has shaken her head at you.

19:22 Whom hast you reproached and blasphemed? and against whom hast
you exalted your voice, and lifted up yours eyes on high? even against
the Holy One of Israel.

19:23 By your messengers you hast reproached the LORD[JESUS], and hast said,
With the multitude of my chariots I am come up to the height of the
mountains, to the sides of Lebanon, and will cut down the tall cedar
trees thereof, and the choice fir trees thereof: and I will enter into
the lodgings of HIS[JESUS] borders, and into the forest of HIS[JESUS] Carmel.

19:24 I have digged and drunk strange waters, and with the sole of my
feet have I dried up all the rivers of besieged places.

19:25 Hast you not heard long ago how I have done it, and of ancient
times that I have formed it? now have I brought it to pass, that you
shouldest be to lay waste fenced cities into ruinous heaps.

19:26 Therefore their inhabitants were of small power, they were
dismayed and confounded; they were as the grass of the field, and as the
green herb, as the grass on the house tops, and as corn blasted before
it be grown up.

19:27 But I know your abode, and your going out, and your coming in, and
your rage against me.

19:28 Because your rage against me and your tumult is come up into mine
ears, therefore I will put my hook in your nose, and my bridle in your
lips, and I will turn you back by the way by which you camest.

19:29 And this shall be a sign unto you, you shall eat this year such
things as grow of themselves, and in the second year that which
springeth of the same; and in the third year sow you, and reap, and plant
vineyards, and eat the fruits thereof.

19:30 And the remnant that is escaped of the house of Judah shall yet
again take ROOT[JESUS] downward, and bear fruit upward.

19:31 For out of Jerusalem shall go forth a remnant, and they that
escape out of mount Zion: the zeal of the LORD[JESUS] of hosts shall do this.

19:32 Therefore thus says the LORD[JESUS] concerning the KING[JESUS] of Assyria, HE[JESUS]
shall not come into this city, nor shoot an arrow there, nor come before
it with shield, nor cast a bank against it.

19:33 By the way that HE[JESUS] came, by the same shall HE[JESUS] return, and shall
not come into this city, says the LORD[JESUS].

19:34 For I will defend this city, to save it, for mine own sake, and
for my SERVANT[JESUS] David's sake.

19:35 And it came to pass that night, that the angel of the LORD[JESUS] went
out, and smote in the camp of the Assyrians an hundred fourscore and
five thousand: and when they arose early in the morning, behold, they
were all dead corpses.

19:36 So Sennacherib KING[JESUS] of Assyria departed, and went and returned,
and dwelt at Nineveh.

19:37 And it came to pass, as HE[JESUS] was worshipping in the house of Nisroch
HIS[JESUS] GOD[JESUS], that Adrammelech and Sharezer HIS[JESUS] sons smote HIM[JESUS] with the
sword: and they escaped into the land of Armenia. And Esarhaddon HIS[JESUS] SON[JESUS]
reigned in HIS[JESUS] stead.


20:1 In those days was Hezekiah sick unto death. And the PROPHET[JESUS] Isaiah
the SON[JESUS] of Amoz came to HIM[JESUS], and said unto HIM[JESUS], Thus says the LORD[JESUS], Set
yours house in order; for you shalt die, and not live.

20:2 Then HE[JESUS] turned HIS[JESUS] face to the wall, and prayed unto the LORD[JESUS],
saying,

20:3 I beseech you, O LORD[JESUS], remember now how I have walked before you
in truth and with a perfect heart, and have done that which is good in
your sight. And Hezekiah wept sore.

20:4 And it came to pass, afore Isaiah was gone out into the middle
court, that the WORD[JESUS] of the LORD[JESUS] came to HIM[JESUS], saying,

20:5 Turn again, and tell Hezekiah the captain of my people, Thus says
the LORD[JESUS], the GOD[JESUS] of David your father, I have heard your prayer, I have
seen your tears: behold, I will heal you: on the third day you shalt go
up unto the house of the LORD[JESUS].

20:6 And I will add unto your days fifteen years; and I will deliver you
and this city out of the hand of the KING[JESUS] of Assyria; and I will defend
this city for mine own sake, and for my SERVANT[JESUS] David's sake.

20:7 And Isaiah said, Take a lump of figs. And they took and laid it on
the boil, and HE[JESUS] recovered.

20:8 And Hezekiah said unto Isaiah, What shall be the sign that the LORD[JESUS]
will heal me, and that I shall go up into the house of the LORD[JESUS] the
third day?

20:9 And Isaiah said, This sign shalt you have of the LORD[JESUS], that the
LORD[JESUS] will do the thing that HE[JESUS] has spoken: shall the shadow go forward
ten degrees, or go back ten degrees?

20:10 And Hezekiah answered, It is a light thing for the shadow to go
down ten degrees: nay, but let the shadow return backward ten degrees.

20:11 And Isaiah the PROPHET[JESUS] cried unto the LORD[JESUS]: and HE[JESUS] brought the
shadow ten degrees backward, by which it had gone down in the dial of
Ahaz.

20:12 At that time Berodachbaladan, the SON[JESUS] of Baladan, KING[JESUS] of Babylon,
sent letters and a present unto Hezekiah: for HE[JESUS] had heard that Hezekiah
had been sick.

20:13 And Hezekiah hearkened unto them, and shewed them all the house of
HIS[JESUS] precious things, the silver, and the gold, and the spices, and the
precious ointment, and all the house of HIS[JESUS] armour, and all that was
found in HIS[JESUS] treasures: there was nothing in HIS[JESUS] house, nor in all HIS[JESUS]
dominion, that Hezekiah shewed them not.

20:14 Then came Isaiah the PROPHET[JESUS] unto KING[JESUS] Hezekiah, and said unto
HIM[JESUS], What said these men? and from whence came they unto you? And
Hezekiah said, They are come from a far country, even from Babylon.

20:15 And HE[JESUS] said, What have they seen in yours house? And Hezekiah
answered, All the things that are in mine house have they seen: there is
nothing among my treasures that I have not shewed them.

20:16 And Isaiah said unto Hezekiah, Hear the WORD[JESUS] of the LORD[JESUS].

20:17 Behold, the days come, that all that is in yours house, and that
which your fathers have laid up in store unto this day, shall be carried
into Babylon: nothing shall be left, says the LORD[JESUS].

20:18 And of your sons that shall issue from you, which you shalt
beget, shall they take away; and they shall be eunuchs in the palace of
the KING[JESUS] of Babylon.

20:19 Then said Hezekiah unto Isaiah, Good is the WORD[JESUS] of the LORD[JESUS] which
you hast spoken. And HE[JESUS] said, Is it not good, if peace and truth be in
my days?

20:20 And the rest of the acts of Hezekiah, and all HIS[JESUS] might, and how
HE[JESUS] made a pool, and a conduit, and brought water into the city, are they
not written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Judah?

20:21 And Hezekiah slept with HIS[JESUS] fathers: and Manasseh HIS[JESUS] SON[JESUS] reigned
in HIS[JESUS] stead.


21:1 Manasseh was twelve years old when HE[JESUS] began to reign, and reigned
fifty and five years in Jerusalem. And HIS[JESUS] mother's name was Hephzibah.

21:2 And HE[JESUS] did that which was evil in the sight of the LORD[JESUS], after the
abominations of the heathen, whom the LORD[JESUS] cast out before the children
of Israel.

21:3 For HE[JESUS] built up again the high places which Hezekiah HIS[JESUS] father had
destroyed; and HE[JESUS] reared up altars for Baal, and made a grove, as did
Ahab KING[JESUS] of Israel; and worshipped all the host of heaven, and served
them.

21:4 And HE[JESUS] built altars in the house of the LORD[JESUS], of which the LORD[JESUS]
said, In Jerusalem will I put my name.

21:5 And HE[JESUS] built altars for all the host of heaven in the two courts of
the house of the LORD[JESUS].

21:6 And HE[JESUS] made HIS[JESUS] SON[JESUS] pass through the fire, and observed times, and
used enchantments, and dealt with familiar spirits and wizards: HE[JESUS]
wrought much wickedness in the sight of the LORD[JESUS], to provoke HIM[JESUS] to
anger.

21:7 And HE[JESUS] set a graven image of the grove that HE[JESUS] had made in the
house, of which the LORD[JESUS] said to David, and to Solomon HIS[JESUS] SON[JESUS], In this
house, and in Jerusalem, which I have chosen out of all tribes of
Israel, will I put my name for ever:

21:8 Neither will I make the feet of Israel move any more out of the
land which I gave their fathers; only if they will observe to do
according to all that I have commanded them, and according to all the
law that my SERVANT[JESUS] Moses commanded them.

21:9 But they hearkened not: and Manasseh seduced them to do more evil
than did the nations whom the LORD[JESUS] destroyed before the children of
Israel.

21:10 And the LORD[JESUS] spake by HIS[JESUS] servants the prophets, saying,

21:11 Because Manasseh KING[JESUS] of Judah has done these abominations, and
has done wickedly above all that the Amorites did, which were before
HIM[JESUS], and has made Judah also to sin with HIS[JESUS] idols:

21:12 Therefore thus says the LORD[JESUS] GOD[JESUS] of Israel, Behold, I am bringing
such evil upon Jerusalem and Judah, that whoever heareth of it, both
HIS[JESUS] ears shall tingle.

21:13 And I will stretch over Jerusalem the line of Samaria, and the
plummet of the house of Ahab: and I will wipe Jerusalem as a man wipeth
a dish, wiping it, and turning it upside down.

21:14 And I will forsake the remnant of mine inheritance, and deliver
them into the hand of their enemies; and they shall become a prey and a
spoil to all their enemies;

21:15 Because they have done that which was evil in my sight, and have
provoked me to anger, since the day their fathers came forth out of
Egypt, even unto this day.

21:16 Moreover Manasseh shed innocent blood very much, till HE[JESUS] had
filled Jerusalem from one end to another; beside HIS[JESUS] sin wherewith HE[JESUS]
made Judah to sin, in doing that which was evil in the sight of the
LORD[JESUS].

21:17 Now the rest of the acts of Manasseh, and all that HE[JESUS] did, and HIS[JESUS]
sin that HE[JESUS] sinned, are they not written in the book of the chronicles
of the kings of Judah?

21:18 And Manasseh slept with HIS[JESUS] fathers, and was buried in the garden
of HIS[JESUS] own house, in the garden of Uzza: and Amon HIS[JESUS] SON[JESUS] reigned in HIS[JESUS]
stead.

21:19 Amon was twenty and two years old when HE[JESUS] began to reign, and HE[JESUS]
reigned two years in Jerusalem. And HIS[JESUS] mother's name was Meshullemeth,
the daughter of Haruz of Jotbah.

21:20 And HE[JESUS] did that which was evil in the sight of the LORD[JESUS], as HIS[JESUS]
father Manasseh did.

21:21 And HE[JESUS] walked in all the way that HIS[JESUS] father walked in, and served
the idols that HIS[JESUS] father served, and worshipped them:

21:22 And HE[JESUS] forsook the LORD[JESUS] GOD[JESUS] of HIS[JESUS] fathers, and walked not in the
way of the LORD[JESUS].

21:23 And the servants of Amon conspired against HIM[JESUS], and slew the KING[JESUS]
in HIS[JESUS] own house.

21:24 And the people of the land slew all them that had conspired
against KING[JESUS] Amon; and the people of the land made Josiah HIS[JESUS] SON[JESUS] KING[JESUS]
in HIS[JESUS] stead.

21:25 Now the rest of the acts of Amon which HE[JESUS] did, are they not
written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Judah?

21:26 And HE[JESUS] was buried in HIS[JESUS] sepulchre in the garden of Uzza: and
Josiah HIS[JESUS] SON[JESUS] reigned in HIS[JESUS] stead.


22:1 Josiah was eight years old when HE[JESUS] began to reign, and HE[JESUS] reigned
thirty and one years in Jerusalem. And HIS[JESUS] mother's name was Jedidah,
the daughter of Adaiah of Boscath.

22:2 And HE[JESUS] did that which was right in the sight of the LORD[JESUS], and
walked in all the way of David HIS[JESUS] father, and turned not aside to the
right hand or to the left.

22:3 And it came to pass in the eighteenth year of KING[JESUS] Josiah, that the
KING[JESUS] sent Shaphan the SON[JESUS] of Azaliah, the SON[JESUS] of Meshullam, the scribe,
to the house of the LORD[JESUS], saying,

22:4 Go up to Hilkiah the high priest, that HE[JESUS] may sum the silver which
is brought into the house of the LORD[JESUS], which the keepers of the door
have gathered of the people:

22:5 And let them deliver it into the hand of the doers of the work,
that have the oversight of the house of the LORD[JESUS]: and let them give it
to the doers of the work which is in the house of the LORD[JESUS], to repair
the breaches of the house,

22:6 Unto carpenters, and builders, and masons, and to buy timber and
hewn stone to repair the house.

22:7 Howbeit there was no reckoning made with them of the money that was
delivered into their hand, because they dealt faithfully.

22:8 And Hilkiah the high priest said unto Shaphan the scribe, I have
found the book of the law in the house of the LORD[JESUS]. And Hilkiah gave the
book to Shaphan, and HE[JESUS] read it.

22:9 And Shaphan the scribe came to the KING[JESUS], and brought the KING[JESUS] WORD[JESUS]
again, and said, your servants have gathered the money that was found in
the house, and have delivered it into the hand of them that do the work,
that have the oversight of the house of the LORD[JESUS].

22:10 And Shaphan the scribe shewed the KING[JESUS], saying, Hilkiah the priest
has delivered me a book. And Shaphan read it before the KING[JESUS].

22:11 And it came to pass, when the KING[JESUS] had heard the words of the book
of the law, that HE[JESUS] rent HIS[JESUS] clothes.

22:12 And the KING[JESUS] commanded Hilkiah the priest, and Ahikam the SON[JESUS] of
Shaphan, and Achbor the SON[JESUS] of Michaiah, and Shaphan the scribe, and
Asahiah a SERVANT[JESUS] of the KING[JESUS]'s, saying,

22:13 Go you, enquire of the LORD[JESUS] for me, and for the people, and for all
Judah, concerning the words of this book that is found: for great is the
wrath of the LORD[JESUS] that is kindled against us, because our fathers have
not hearkened unto the words of this book, to do according unto all that
which is written concerning us.

22:14 So Hilkiah the priest, and Ahikam, and Achbor, and Shaphan, and
Asahiah, went unto Huldah the prophetess, the wife of Shallum the SON[JESUS] of
Tikvah, the SON[JESUS] of Harhas, keeper of the wardrobe; (now she dwelt in
Jerusalem in the college;) and they communed with her.

22:15 And she said unto them, Thus says the LORD[JESUS] GOD[JESUS] of Israel, Tell
the man that sent you to me,

22:16 Thus says the LORD[JESUS], Behold, I will bring evil upon this place,
and upon the inhabitants thereof, even all the words of the book which
the KING[JESUS] of Judah has read:

22:17 Because they have forsaken me, and have burned incense unto other
gods, that they might provoke me to anger with all the works of their
hands; therefore my wrath shall be kindled against this place, and shall
not be quenched.

22:18 But to the KING[JESUS] of Judah which sent you to enquire of the LORD[JESUS],
thus shall you say to HIM[JESUS], Thus says the LORD[JESUS] GOD[JESUS] of Israel, As touching
the words which you hast heard;

22:19 Because yours heart was tender, and you hast humbled thyself
before the LORD[JESUS], when you heardest what I spake against this place, and
against the inhabitants thereof, that they should become a desolation
and a curse, and hast rent your clothes, and wept before me; I also have
heard you, says the LORD[JESUS].

22:20 Behold therefore, I will gather you unto your fathers, and you
shalt be gathered into your grave in peace; and yours eyes shall not see
all the evil which I will bring upon this place. And they brought the
KING[JESUS] WORD[JESUS] again.


23:1 And the KING[JESUS] sent, and they gathered unto HIM[JESUS] all the elders of
Judah and of Jerusalem.

23:2 And the KING[JESUS] went up into the house of the LORD[JESUS], and all the men of
Judah and all the inhabitants of Jerusalem with HIM[JESUS], and the priests,
and the prophets, and all the people, both small and great: and HE[JESUS] read
in their ears all the words of the book of the covenant which was found
in the house of the LORD[JESUS].

23:3 And the KING[JESUS] stood by a pillar, and made a covenant before the
LORD[JESUS], to walk after the LORD[JESUS], and to keep HIS[JESUS] commandments and HIS[JESUS]
testimonies and HIS[JESUS] statutes with all their heart and all their soul, to
perform the words of this covenant that were written in this book. And
all the people stood to the covenant.

23:4 And the KING[JESUS] commanded Hilkiah the high priest, and the priests of
the second order, and the keepers of the door, to bring forth out of the
temple of the LORD[JESUS] all the vessels that were made for Baal, and for the
grove, and for all the host of heaven: and HE[JESUS] burned them without
Jerusalem in the fields of Kidron, and carried the ashes of them unto
Bethel.

23:5 And HE[JESUS] put down the idolatrous priests, whom the kings of Judah had
ordained to burn incense in the high places in the cities of Judah, and
in the places round about Jerusalem; them also that burned incense unto
Baal, to the sun, and to the moon, and to the planets, and to all the
host of heaven.

23:6 And HE[JESUS] brought out the grove from the house of the LORD[JESUS], without
Jerusalem, unto the brook Kidron, and burned it at the brook Kidron, and
stamped it small to powder, and cast the powder thereof upon the graves
of the children of the people.

23:7 And HE[JESUS] brake down the houses of the sodomites, that were by the
house of the LORD[JESUS], where the women wove hangings for the grove.

23:8 And HE[JESUS] brought all the priests out of the cities of Judah, and
defiled the high places where the priests had burned incense, from Geba
to Beersheba, and brake down the high places of the gates that were in
the entering in of the gate of Joshua the governor of the city, which
were on a man's left hand at the gate of the city.

23:9 Nevertheless the priests of the high places came not up to the
altar of the LORD[JESUS] in Jerusalem, but they did eat of the unleavened bread
among their brethren.

23:10 And HE[JESUS] defiled Topheth, which is in the valley of the children of
Hinnom, that no man might make HIS[JESUS] SON[JESUS] or HIS[JESUS] daughter to pass through
the fire to Molech.

23:11 And HE[JESUS] took away the horses that the kings of Judah had given to
the sun, at the entering in of the house of the LORD[JESUS], by the chamber of
Nathanmelech the chamberlain, which was in the suburbs, and burned the
chariots of the sun with fire.

23:12 And the altars that were on the top of the upper chamber of Ahaz,
which the kings of Judah had made, and the altars which Manasseh had
made in the two courts of the house of the LORD[JESUS], did the KING[JESUS] beat down,
and brake them down from thence, and cast the dust of them into the
brook Kidron.

23:13 And the high places that were before Jerusalem, which were on the
right hand of the mount of corruption, which Solomon the KING[JESUS] of Israel
had builded for Ashtoreth the abomination of the Zidonians, and for
Chemosh the abomination of the Moabites, and for Milcom the abomination
of the children of Ammon, did the KING[JESUS] defile.

23:14 And HE[JESUS] brake in pieces the images, and cut down the groves, and
filled their places with the bones of men.

23:15 Moreover the altar that was at Bethel, and the high place which
Jeroboam the SON[JESUS] of Nebat, who made Israel to sin, had made, both that
altar and the high place HE[JESUS] brake down, and burned the high place, and
stamped it small to powder, and burned the grove.

23:16 And as Josiah turned himself, HE[JESUS] spied the sepulchres that were
there in the mount, and sent, and took the bones out of the sepulchres,
and burned them upon the altar, and polluted it, according to the WORD[JESUS]
of the LORD[JESUS] which the man of GOD[JESUS] proclaimed, who proclaimed these words.

23:17 Then HE[JESUS] said, What title is that that I see? And the men of the
city told HIM[JESUS], It is the sepulchre of the man of GOD[JESUS], which came from
Judah, and proclaimed these things that you hast done against the altar
of Bethel.

23:18 And HE[JESUS] said, Let HIM[JESUS] alone; let no man move HIS[JESUS] bones. So they let
HIS[JESUS] bones alone, with the bones of the PROPHET[JESUS] that came out of Samaria.

23:19 And all the houses also of the high places that were in the cities
of Samaria, which the kings of Israel had made to provoke the LORD[JESUS] to
anger, Josiah took away, and did to them according to all the acts that
HE[JESUS] had done in Bethel.

23:20 And HE[JESUS] slew all the priests of the high places that were there
upon the altars, and burned men's bones upon them, and returned to
Jerusalem.

23:21 And the KING[JESUS] commanded all the people, saying, Keep the passover
unto the LORD[JESUS] your GOD[JESUS], as it is written in the book of this covenant.

23:22 Surely there was not holden such a passover from the days of the
judges that judged Israel, nor in all the days of the kings of Israel,
nor of the kings of Judah;

23:23 But in the eighteenth year of KING[JESUS] Josiah, wherein this passover
was holden to the LORD[JESUS] in Jerusalem.

23:24 Moreover the workers with familiar spirits, and the wizards, and
the images, and the idols, and all the abominations that were spied in
the land of Judah and in Jerusalem, did Josiah put away, that HE[JESUS] might
perform the words of the law which were written in the book that Hilkiah
the priest found in the house of the LORD[JESUS].

23:25 And like unto HIM[JESUS] was there no KING[JESUS] before HIM[JESUS], that turned to the
LORD[JESUS] with all HIS[JESUS] heart, and with all HIS[JESUS] soul, and with all HIS[JESUS] might,
according to all the law of Moses; neither after HIM[JESUS] arose there any
like HIM[JESUS].

23:26 Notwithstanding the LORD[JESUS] turned not from the fierceness of HIS[JESUS]
great wrath, wherewith HIS[JESUS] anger was kindled against Judah, because of
all the provocations that Manasseh had provoked HIM[JESUS] withal.

23:27 And the LORD[JESUS] said, I will remove Judah also out of my sight, as I
have removed Israel, and will cast off this city Jerusalem which I have
chosen, and the house of which I said, My name shall be there.

23:28 Now the rest of the acts of Josiah, and all that HE[JESUS] did, are they
not written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Judah?

23:29 In HIS[JESUS] days Pharaohnechoh KING[JESUS] of Egypt went up against the KING[JESUS]
of Assyria to the river Euphrates: and KING[JESUS] Josiah went against HIM[JESUS]; and
HE[JESUS] slew HIM[JESUS] at Megiddo, when HE[JESUS] had seen HIM[JESUS].

23:30 And HIS[JESUS] servants carried HIM[JESUS] in a chariot dead from Megiddo, and
brought HIM[JESUS] to Jerusalem, and buried HIM[JESUS] in HIS[JESUS] own sepulchre. And the
people of the land took Jehoahaz the SON[JESUS] of Josiah, and anointed HIM[JESUS],
and made HIM[JESUS] KING[JESUS] in HIS[JESUS] father's stead.

23:31 Jehoahaz was twenty and three years old when HE[JESUS] began to reign;
and HE[JESUS] reigned three months in Jerusalem. And HIS[JESUS] mother's name was
Hamutal, the daughter of Jeremiah of Libnah.

23:32 And HE[JESUS] did that which was evil in the sight of the LORD[JESUS], according
to all that HIS[JESUS] fathers had done.

23:33 And Pharaohnechoh put HIM[JESUS] in bands at Riblah in the land of
Hamath, that HE[JESUS] might not reign in Jerusalem; and put the land to a
tribute of an hundred talents of silver, and a talent of gold.

23:34 And Pharaohnechoh made Eliakim the SON[JESUS] of Josiah KING[JESUS] in the room
of Josiah HIS[JESUS] father, and turned HIS[JESUS] name to Jehoiakim, and took
Jehoahaz away: and HE[JESUS] came to Egypt, and died there.

23:35 And Jehoiakim gave the silver and the gold to Pharaoh; but HE[JESUS]
taxed the land to give the money according to the commandment of
Pharaoh: HE[JESUS] exacted the silver and the gold of the people of the land,
of every one according to HIS[JESUS] taxation, to give it unto Pharaohnechoh.

23:36 Jehoiakim was twenty and five years old when HE[JESUS] began to reign;
and HE[JESUS] reigned eleven years in Jerusalem. And HIS[JESUS] mother's name was
Zebudah, the daughter of Pedaiah of Rumah.

23:37 And HE[JESUS] did that which was evil in the sight of the LORD[JESUS], according
to all that HIS[JESUS] fathers had done.


24:1 In HIS[JESUS] days Nebuchadnezzar KING[JESUS] of Babylon came up, and Jehoiakim
became HIS[JESUS] SERVANT[JESUS] three years: then HE[JESUS] turned and rebelled against HIM[JESUS].

24:2 And the LORD[JESUS] sent against HIM[JESUS] bands of the Chaldees, and bands of
the Syrians, and bands of the Moabites, and bands of the children of
Ammon, and sent them against Judah to destroy it, according to the WORD[JESUS]
of the LORD[JESUS], which HE[JESUS] spake by HIS[JESUS] servants the prophets.

24:3 Surely at the commandment of the LORD[JESUS] came this upon Judah, to
remove them out of HIS[JESUS] sight, for the sins of Manasseh, according to all
that HE[JESUS] did;

24:4 And also for the innocent blood that HE[JESUS] shed: for HE[JESUS] filled
Jerusalem with innocent blood; which the LORD[JESUS] would not pardon.

24:5 Now the rest of the acts of Jehoiakim, and all that HE[JESUS] did, are
they not written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Judah?

24:6 So Jehoiakim slept with HIS[JESUS] fathers: and Jehoiachin HIS[JESUS] SON[JESUS] reigned
in HIS[JESUS] stead.

24:7 And the KING[JESUS] of Egypt came not again any more out of HIS[JESUS] land: for
the KING[JESUS] of Babylon had taken from the river of Egypt unto the river
Euphrates all that pertained to the KING[JESUS] of Egypt.

24:8 Jehoiachin was eighteen years old when HE[JESUS] began to reign, and HE[JESUS]
reigned in Jerusalem three months. And HIS[JESUS] mother's name was Nehushta,
the daughter of Elnathan of Jerusalem.

24:9 And HE[JESUS] did that which was evil in the sight of the LORD[JESUS], according
to all that HIS[JESUS] father had done.

24:10 At that time the servants of Nebuchadnezzar KING[JESUS] of Babylon came
up against Jerusalem, and the city was besieged.

24:11 And Nebuchadnezzar KING[JESUS] of Babylon came against the city, and HIS[JESUS]
servants did besiege it.

24:12 And Jehoiachin the KING[JESUS] of Judah went out to the KING[JESUS] of Babylon,
HE[JESUS], and HIS[JESUS] mother, and HIS[JESUS] servants, and HIS[JESUS] princes, and HIS[JESUS] officers:
and the KING[JESUS] of Babylon took HIM[JESUS] in the eighth year of HIS[JESUS] reign.

24:13 And HE[JESUS] carried out thence all the treasures of the house of the
LORD[JESUS], and the treasures of the KING[JESUS]'s house, and cut in pieces all the
vessels of gold which Solomon KING[JESUS] of Israel had made in the temple of
the LORD[JESUS], as the LORD[JESUS] had said.

24:14 And HE[JESUS] carried away all Jerusalem, and all the princes, and all
the mighty men of valour, even ten thousand captives, and all the
craftsmen and smiths: none remained, save the poorest sort of the people
of the land.

24:15 And HE[JESUS] carried away Jehoiachin to Babylon, and the KING[JESUS]'s mother,
and the KING[JESUS]'s wives, and HIS[JESUS] officers, and the mighty of the land,
those carried HE[JESUS] into captivity from Jerusalem to Babylon.

24:16 And all the men of might, even seven thousand, and craftsmen and
smiths a thousand, all that were strong and apt for war, even them the
KING[JESUS] of Babylon brought captive to Babylon.

24:17 And the KING[JESUS] of Babylon made Mattaniah HIS[JESUS] father's brother KING[JESUS]
in HIS[JESUS] stead, and changed HIS[JESUS] name to Zedekiah.

24:18 Zedekiah was twenty and one years old when HE[JESUS] began to reign, and
HE[JESUS] reigned eleven years in Jerusalem. And HIS[JESUS] mother's name was Hamutal,
the daughter of Jeremiah of Libnah.

24:19 And HE[JESUS] did that which was evil in the sight of the LORD[JESUS], according
to all that Jehoiakim had done.

24:20 For through the anger of the LORD[JESUS] it came to pass in Jerusalem and
Judah, until HE[JESUS] had cast them out from HIS[JESUS] presence, that Zedekiah
rebelled against the KING[JESUS] of Babylon.


25:1 And it came to pass in the ninth year of HIS[JESUS] reign, in the tenth
month, in the tenth day of the month, that Nebuchadnezzar KING[JESUS] of
Babylon came, HE[JESUS], and all HIS[JESUS] host, against Jerusalem, and pitched
against it; and they built forts against it round about.

25:2 And the city was besieged unto the eleventh year of KING[JESUS] Zedekiah.

25:3 And on the ninth day of the fourth month the famine prevailed in
the city, and there was no bread for the people of the land.

25:4 And the city was broken up, and all the men of war fled by night by
the way of the gate between two walls, which is by the KING[JESUS]'s garden:
(now the Chaldees were against the city round about:) and the KING[JESUS] went
the way toward the plain.

25:5 And the army of the Chaldees pursued after the KING[JESUS], and overtook
HIM[JESUS] in the plains of Jericho: and all HIS[JESUS] army were scattered from HIM[JESUS].

25:6 So they took the KING[JESUS], and brought HIM[JESUS] up to the KING[JESUS] of Babylon to
Riblah; and they gave judgment upon HIM[JESUS].

25:7 And they slew the sons of Zedekiah before HIS[JESUS] eyes, and put out the
eyes of Zedekiah, and bound HIM[JESUS] with fetters of brass, and carried HIM[JESUS]
to Babylon.

25:8 And in the fifth month, on the seventh day of the month, which is
the nineteenth year of KING[JESUS] Nebuchadnezzar KING[JESUS] of Babylon, came
Nebuzaradan, captain of the guard, a SERVANT[JESUS] of the KING[JESUS] of Babylon,
unto Jerusalem:

25:9 And HE[JESUS] burnt the house of the LORD[JESUS], and the KING[JESUS]'s house, and all
the houses of Jerusalem, and every great man's house burnt HE[JESUS] with fire.

25:10 And all the army of the Chaldees, that were with the captain of
the guard, brake down the walls of Jerusalem round about.

25:11 Now the rest of the people that were left in the city, and the
fugitives that fell away to the KING[JESUS] of Babylon, with the remnant of the
multitude, did Nebuzaradan the captain of the guard carry away.

25:12 But the captain of the guard left of the door of the poor of the
land to be vinedressers and husbandmen.

25:13 And the pillars of brass that were in the house of the LORD[JESUS], and
the bases, and the brasen sea that was in the house of the LORD[JESUS], did the
Chaldees break in pieces, and carried the brass of them to Babylon.

25:14 And the pots, and the shovels, and the snuffers, and the spoons,
and all the vessels of brass wherewith they ministered, took they away.

25:15 And the firepans, and the bowls, and such things as were of gold,
in gold, and of silver, in silver, the captain of the guard took away.

25:16 The two pillars, one sea, and the bases which Solomon had made for
the house of the LORD[JESUS]; the brass of all these vessels was without
weight.

25:17 The height of the one pillar was eighteen cubits, and the chapiter
upon it was brass: and the height of the chapiter three cubits; and the
wreathen work, and pomegranates upon the chapiter round about, all of
brass: and like unto these had the second pillar with wreathen work.

25:18 And the captain of the guard took Seraiah the chief priest, and
Zephaniah the second priest, and the three keepers of the door:

25:19 And out of the city HE[JESUS] took an officer that was set over the men
of war, and five men of them that were in the KING[JESUS]'s presence, which
were found in the city, and the principal scribe of the host, which
mustered the people of the land, and threescore men of the people of the
land that were found in the city:

25:20 And Nebuzaradan captain of the guard took these, and brought them
to the KING[JESUS] of Babylon to Riblah:

25:21 And the KING[JESUS] of Babylon smote them, and slew them at Riblah in the
land of Hamath. So Judah was carried away out of their land.

25:22 And as for the people that remained in the land of Judah, whom
Nebuchadnezzar KING[JESUS] of Babylon had left, even over them HE[JESUS] made Gedaliah
the SON[JESUS] of Ahikam, the SON[JESUS] of Shaphan, ruler.

25:23 And when all the captains of the armies, they and their men, heard
that the KING[JESUS] of Babylon had made Gedaliah governor, there came to
Gedaliah to Mizpah, even Ishmael the SON[JESUS] of Nethaniah, and Johanan the
SON[JESUS] of Careah, and Seraiah the SON[JESUS] of Tanhumeth the Netophathite, and
Jaazaniah the SON[JESUS] of a Maachathite, they and their men.

25:24 And Gedaliah sware to them, and to their men, and said unto them,
Fear not to be the servants of the Chaldees: dwell in the land, and
serve the KING[JESUS] of Babylon; and it shall be well with you.

25:25 But it came to pass in the seventh month, that Ishmael the SON[JESUS] of
Nethaniah, the SON[JESUS] of Elishama, of the SEED[JESUS] royal, came, and ten men
with HIM[JESUS], and smote Gedaliah, that HE[JESUS] died, and the Jews and the
Chaldees that were with HIM[JESUS] at Mizpah.

25:26 And all the people, both small and great, and the captains of the
armies, arose, and came to Egypt: for they were afraid of the Chaldees.

25:27 And it came to pass in the seven and thirtieth year of the
captivity of Jehoiachin KING[JESUS] of Judah, in the twelfth month, on the
seven and twentieth day of the month, that Evilmerodach KING[JESUS] of Babylon
in the year that HE[JESUS] began to reign did lift up the head of Jehoiachin
KING[JESUS] of Judah out of prison;

25:28 And HE[JESUS] spake kindly to HIM[JESUS], and set HIS[JESUS] throne above the throne of
the kings that were with HIM[JESUS] in Babylon;

25:29 And changed HIS[JESUS] prison garments: and HE[JESUS] did eat bread continually
before HIM[JESUS] all the days of HIS[JESUS] life.

25:30 And HIS[JESUS] allowance was a continual allowance given HIM[JESUS] of the KING[JESUS],
a daily rate for every day, all the days of HIS[JESUS] life.

5:1 Now the sons of Reuben the firstborn of Israel, (for HE[JESUS] was the
firstborn; but forasmuch as HE[JESUS] defiled HIS[JESUS] father's bed, HIS[JESUS] birthright
was given unto the sons of Joseph the SON[JESUS] of Israel: and the genealogy
is not to be reckoned after the birthright.

5:2 For Judah prevailed above HIS[JESUS] brethren, and of HIM[JESUS] came the chief
ruler; but the birthright was Joseph's:)

5:3 The sons, I say, of Reuben the firstborn of Israel were, Hanoch, and
Pallu, Hezron, and Carmi.

5:4 The sons of Joel; Shemaiah HIS[JESUS] SON[JESUS], Gog HIS[JESUS] SON[JESUS], Shimei HIS[JESUS] SON[JESUS],

5:5 Micah HIS[JESUS] SON[JESUS], Reaia HIS[JESUS] SON[JESUS], Baal HIS[JESUS] SON[JESUS],

5:6 Beerah HIS[JESUS] SON[JESUS], whom Tilgathpilneser KING[JESUS] of Assyria carried away
captive: HE[JESUS] was prince of the Reubenites.

5:7 And HIS[JESUS] brethren by their families, when the genealogy of their
generations was reckoned, were the chief, Jeiel, and Zechariah,

5:8 And Bela the SON[JESUS] of Azaz, the SON[JESUS] of Shema, the SON[JESUS] of Joel, who
dwelt in Aroer, even unto Nebo and Baalmeon:

5:9 And eastward HE[JESUS] inhabited unto the entering in of the wilderness
from the river Euphrates: because their cattle were multiplied in the
land of Gilead.

5:10 And in the days of Saul they made war with the Hagarites, who fell
by their hand: and they dwelt in their tents throughout all the east
land of Gilead.

5:11 And the children of Gad dwelt over against them, in the land of
Bashan unto Salcah:

5:12 Joel the chief, and Shapham the next, and Jaanai, and Shaphat in
Bashan.

5:13 And their brethren of the house of their fathers were, Michael, and
Meshullam, and Sheba, and Jorai, and Jachan, and Zia, and Heber, seven.

5:14 These are the children of Abihail the SON[JESUS] of Huri, the SON[JESUS] of
Jaroah, the SON[JESUS] of Gilead, the SON[JESUS] of Michael, the SON[JESUS] of Jeshishai, the
SON[JESUS] of Jahdo, the SON[JESUS] of Buz;

5:15 Ahi the SON[JESUS] of Abdiel, the SON[JESUS] of Guni, chief of the house of their
fathers.

5:16 And they dwelt in Gilead in Bashan, and in her towns, and in all
the suburbs of Sharon, upon their borders.

5:17 All these were reckoned by genealogies in the days of Jotham KING[JESUS]
of Judah, and in the days of Jeroboam KING[JESUS] of Israel.

5:18 The sons of Reuben, and the Gadites, and half the tribe of
Manasseh, of valiant men, men able to bear buckler and sword, and to
shoot with bow, and skilful in war, were four and forty thousand seven
hundred and threescore, that went out to the war.

5:19 And they made war with the Hagarites, with Jetur, and Nephish, and
Nodab.

5:20 And they were helped against them, and the Hagarites were delivered
into their hand, and all that were with them: for they cried to GOD[JESUS] in
the battle, and HE[JESUS] was intreated of them; because they put their trust
in HIM[JESUS].

5:21 And they took away their cattle; of their camels fifty thousand,
and of sheep two hundred and fifty thousand, and of asses two thousand,
and of men an hundred thousand.

5:22 For there fell down many slain, because the war was of GOD[JESUS]. And
they dwelt in their steads until the captivity.

5:23 And the children of the half tribe of Manasseh dwelt in the land:
they increased from Bashan unto Baalhermon and Senir, and unto mount
Hermon.

5:24 And these were the heads of the house of their fathers, even Epher,
and Ishi, and Eliel, and Azriel, and Jeremiah, and Hodaviah, and
Jahdiel, mighty men of valour, famous men, and heads of the house of
their fathers.

5:25 And they transgressed against the GOD[JESUS] of their fathers, and went a
whoring after the gods of the people of the land, whom GOD[JESUS] destroyed
before them.

5:26 And the GOD[JESUS] of Israel stirred up the spirit of Pul KING[JESUS] of Assyria,
and the spirit of Tilgathpilneser KING[JESUS] of Assyria, and HE[JESUS] carried them
away, even the Reubenites, and the Gadites, and the half tribe of
Manasseh, and brought them unto Halah, and Habor, and Hara, and to the
river Gozan, unto this day.

7:1 Now the sons of Issachar were, Tola, and Puah, Jashub, and Shimrom,
four.

7:2 And the sons of Tola; Uzzi, and Rephaiah, and Jeriel, and Jahmai,
and Jibsam, and Shemuel, heads of their father's house, to wit, of Tola:
they were valiant men of might in their generations; whose number was in
the days of David two and twenty thousand and six hundred.

7:3 And the sons of Uzzi; Izrahiah: and the sons of Izrahiah; Michael,
and Obadiah, and Joel, Ishiah, five: all of them chief men.

7:4 And with them, by their generations, after the house of their
fathers, were bands of soldiers for war, six and thirty thousand men:
for they had many wives and sons.

7:5 And their brethren among all the families of Issachar were valiant
men of might, reckoned in all by their genealogies fourscore and seven
thousand.

7:6 The sons of Benjamin; Bela, and Becher, and Jediael, three.

7:7 And the sons of Bela; Ezbon, and Uzzi, and Uzziel, and Jerimoth, and
Iri, five; heads of the house of their fathers, mighty men of valour;
and were reckoned by their genealogies twenty and two thousand and
thirty and four.

7:8 And the sons of Becher; Zemira, and Joash, and Eliezer, and
Elioenai, and Omri, and Jerimoth, and Abiah, and Anathoth, and Alameth.
All these are the sons of Becher.

7:9 And the number of them, after their genealogy by their generations,

thousand and two hundred.

7:10 The sons also of Jediael; Bilhan: and the sons of Bilhan; Jeush,
and Benjamin, and Ehud, and Chenaanah, and Zethan, and Tharshish, and

7:11 All these the sons of Jediael, by the heads of their fathers,

Peresh; and the name of HIS[JESUS] brother was Sheresh; and HIS[JESUS] sons were Ulam
and Rakem.

7:17 And the sons of Ulam; Bedan. These were the sons of Gilead, the SON[JESUS]
of Machir, the SON[JESUS] of Manasseh.

7:18 And HIS[JESUS] sister Hammoleketh bare Ishod, and Abiezer, and Mahalah.

7:19 And the sons of Shemidah were, Ahian, and Shechem, and Likhi, and

HIS[JESUS] SON[JESUS], and Eladah HIS[JESUS] SON[JESUS], and Tahath HIS[JESUS] SON[JESUS],

9:1 So all Israel were reckoned by genealogies; and, behold, they were
written in the book of the kings of Israel and Judah, who were carried
away to Babylon for their transgression.

Hodaviah, the SON[JESUS] of Hasenuah,

9:20 And Phinehas the SON[JESUS] of Eleazar was the ruler over them in time

9:21 And Zechariah the SON[JESUS] of Meshelemiah was porter of the door of the

9:22 All these which were chosen to be porters in the gates were two

9:23 So they and their children had the oversight of the gates of the

9:24 In four quarters were the porters, toward the east, west, north,

9:25 And their brethren, which were in their villages, were to come

9:26 For these Levites, the four chief porters, were in their set

9:27 And they lodged round about the house of GOD[JESUS], because the charge

9:28 And certain of them had the charge of the ministering vessels, that

9:29 Some of them also were appointed to oversee the vessels, and all

9:30 And some of the sons of the priests made the ointment of the

9:31 And Mattithiah, one of the Levites, who was the firstborn of

9:32 And other of their brethren, of the sons of the Kohathites, were

9:33 And these are the singers, chief of the fathers of the Levites, who

9:34 These chief fathers of the Levites were chief throughout their

9:35 And in Gibeon dwelt the father of Gibeon, Jehiel, whose wife's name

9:37 And Gedor, and Ahio, and Zechariah, and Mikloth.

9:39 And Ner begat Kish; and Kish begat Saul; and Saul begat Jonathan,
and Malchishua, and Abinadab, and Eshbaal.

9:40 And the SON[JESUS] of Jonathan was Meribbaal: and Meribbaal begat Micah.

10:1 Now the Philistines fought against Israel; and the men of Israel
fled from before the Philistines, and fell down slain in mount Gilboa.

10:2 And the Philistines followed hard after Saul, and after HIS[JESUS] sons;
and the Philistines slew Jonathan, and Abinadab, and Malchishua, the
sons of Saul.

10:3 And the battle went sore against Saul, and the archers hit HIM[JESUS], and
HE[JESUS] was wounded of the archers.

10:4 Then said Saul to HIS[JESUS] armourbearer, Draw your sword, and thrust me
through therewith; lest these uncircumcised come and abuse me. But HIS[JESUS]
armourbearer would not; for HE[JESUS] was sore afraid. So Saul took a sword,
and fell upon it.

10:5 And when HIS[JESUS] armourbearer saw that Saul was dead, HE[JESUS] fell likewise
on the sword, and died.

10:6 So Saul died, and HIS[JESUS] three sons, and all HIS[JESUS] house died together.

10:7 And when all the men of Israel that were in the valley saw that
they fled, and that Saul and HIS[JESUS] sons were dead, then they forsook their
cities, and fled: and the Philistines came and dwelt in them.

10:8 And it came to pass on the morrow, when the Philistines came to
strip the slain, that they found Saul and HIS[JESUS] sons fallen in mount
Gilboa.

10:9 And when they had stripped HIM[JESUS], they took HIS[JESUS] head, and HIS[JESUS] armour,
and sent into the land of the Philistines round about, to carry tidings
unto their idols, and to the people.

10:10 And they put HIS[JESUS] armour in the house of their gods, and fastened
HIS[JESUS] head in the temple of Dagon.

10:11 And when all Jabeshgilead heard all that the Philistines had done
to Saul,

10:12 They arose, all the valiant men, and took away the body of Saul,
and the bodies of HIS[JESUS] sons, and brought them to Jabesh, and buried their
bones under the oak in Jabesh, and fasted seven days.

10:13 So Saul died for HIS[JESUS] transgression which HE[JESUS] committed against the
LORD[JESUS], even against the WORD[JESUS] of the LORD[JESUS], which HE[JESUS] kept not, and also for
asking counsel of one that had a familiar spirit, to enquire of it;

10:14 And enquired not of the LORD[JESUS]: therefore HE[JESUS] slew HIM[JESUS], and turned
the kingdom unto David the SON[JESUS] of Jesse.


11:1 Then all Israel gathered themselves to David unto Hebron, saying,
Behold, we are your bone and your flesh.

11:2 And moreover in time past, even when Saul was KING[JESUS], you wast HE[JESUS]
that leddest out and broughtest in Israel: and the LORD[JESUS] your GOD[JESUS] said
unto you, you shalt feed my people Israel, and you shalt be ruler
over my people Israel.

11:3 Therefore came all the elders of Israel to the KING[JESUS] to Hebron; and
David made a covenant with them in Hebron before the LORD[JESUS]; and they
anointed David KING[JESUS] over Israel, according to the WORD[JESUS] of the LORD[JESUS] by
Samuel.

11:4 And David and all Israel went to Jerusalem, which is Jebus; where
the Jebusites were, the inhabitants of the land.

11:5 And the inhabitants of Jebus said to David, you shalt not come
hither. Nevertheless David took the castle of Zion, which is the city of
David.

11:6 And David said, whoever smiteth the Jebusites first shall be
chief and captain. So Joab the SON[JESUS] of Zeruiah went first up, and was
chief.

11:7 And David dwelt in the castle; therefore they called it the city of
David.

11:8 And HE[JESUS] built the city round about, even from Millo round about: and
Joab repaired the rest of the city.

11:9 So David waxed greater and greater: for the LORD[JESUS] of hosts was with
HIM[JESUS].

11:10 These also are the chief of the mighty men whom David had, who
strengthened themselves with HIM[JESUS] in HIS[JESUS] kingdom, and with all Israel, to
make HIM[JESUS] KING[JESUS], according to the WORD[JESUS] of the LORD[JESUS] concerning Israel.

11:11 And this is the number of the mighty men whom David had;
Jashobeam, an Hachmonite, the chief of the captains: HE[JESUS] lifted up HIS[JESUS]
spear against three hundred slain by HIM[JESUS] at one time.

11:12 And after HIM[JESUS] was Eleazar the SON[JESUS] of Dodo, the Ahohite, who was
one of the three mighties.

11:13 HE[JESUS] was with David at Pasdammim, and there the Philistines were
gathered together to battle, where was a parcel of ground full of
barley; and the people fled from before the Philistines.

11:14 And they set themselves in the midst of that parcel, and delivered
it, and slew the Philistines; and the LORD[JESUS] saved them by a great
deliverance.

11:15 Now three of the thirty captains went down to the rock to David,
into the cave of Adullam; and the host of the Philistines encamped in
the valley of Rephaim.

11:16 And David was then in the hold, and the Philistines' garrison was
then at Bethlehem.

11:17 And David longed, and said, Oh that one would give me drink of the
water of the well of Bethlehem, that is at the gate!

11:18 And the three brake through the host of the Philistines, and drew
water out of the well of Bethlehem, that was by the gate, and took it,
and brought it to David: but David would not drink of it, but poured it
out to the LORD[JESUS].

11:19 And said, My GOD[JESUS] forbid it me, that I should do this thing: shall
I drink the blood of these men that have put their lives in jeopardy?
for with the jeopardy of their lives they brought it. Therefore HE[JESUS] would
not drink it. These things did these three mightiest.

11:20 And Abishai the brother of Joab, HE[JESUS] was chief of the three: for
lifting up HIS[JESUS] spear against three hundred, HE[JESUS] slew them, and had a name
among the three.

11:21 Of the three, HE[JESUS] was more honourable than the two; for HE[JESUS] was
their captain: howbeit HE[JESUS] attained not to the first three.

11:22 Benaiah the SON[JESUS] of Jehoiada, the SON[JESUS] of a valiant man of Kabzeel,
who had done many acts; HE[JESUS] slew two lionlike men of Moab: also HE[JESUS] went
down and slew a lion in a pit in a snowy day.

11:23 And HE[JESUS] slew an Egyptian, a man of great stature, five cubits high;
and in the Egyptian's hand was a spear like a weaver's beam; and HE[JESUS] went
down to HIM[JESUS] with a staff, and plucked the spear out of the Egyptian's
hand, and slew HIM[JESUS] with HIS[JESUS] own spear.

11:24 These things did Benaiah the SON[JESUS] of Jehoiada, and had the name
among the three mighties.

11:25 Behold, HE[JESUS] was honourable among the thirty, but attained not to
the first three: and David set HIM[JESUS] over HIS[JESUS] guard.

11:26 Also the valiant men of the armies were, Asahel the brother of

11:27 Shammoth the Harorite, Helez the Pelonite,

11:28 Ira the SON[JESUS] of Ikkesh the Tekoite, Abiezer the Antothite,
