12:1 Now these are they that came to David to Ziklag, while HE[JESUS] yet kept
himself close because of Saul the SON[JESUS] of Kish: and they were among the
mighty men, helpers of the war.

12:2 They were armed with bows, and could use both the right hand and
the left in hurling stones and shooting arrows out of a bow, even of
Saul's brethren of Benjamin.

12:3 The chief was Ahiezer, then Joash, the sons of Shemaah the
Gibeathite; and Jeziel, and Pelet, the sons of Azmaveth; and Berachah,
and Jehu the Antothite.

12:4 And Ismaiah the Gibeonite, a mighty man among the thirty, and over
the thirty; and Jeremiah, and Jahaziel, and Johanan, and Josabad the
Gederathite,

12:5 Eluzai, and Jerimoth, and Bealiah, and Shemariah, and Shephatiah
the Haruphite,

12:6 Elkanah, and Jesiah, and Azareel, and Joezer, and Jashobeam, the
Korhites,

12:7 And Joelah, and Zebadiah, the sons of Jeroham of Gedor.

12:8 And of the Gadites there separated themselves unto David into the
hold to the wilderness men of might, and men of war fit for the battle,
that could handle shield and buckler, whose faces were like the faces of
lions, and were as swift as the roes upon the mountains;

12:9 Ezer the first, Obadiah the second, Eliab the third,

12:10 Mishmannah the fourth, Jeremiah the fifth,

12:11 Attai the sixth, Eliel the seventh,

12:12 Johanan the eighth, Elzabad the ninth,

12:13 Jeremiah the tenth, Machbanai the eleventh.

12:14 These were of the sons of Gad, captains of the host: one of the
least was over an hundred, and the greatest over a thousand.

12:15 These are they that went over Jordan in the first month, when it
had overflown all HIS[JESUS] banks; and they put to flight all them of the
valleys, both toward the east, and toward the west.

12:16 And there came of the children of Benjamin and Judah to the hold
unto David.

12:17 And David went out to meet them, and answered and said unto them,
If you be come peaceably unto me to help me, mine heart shall be knit
unto you: but if you be come to betray me to mine enemies, seeing there
is no wrong in mine hands, the GOD[JESUS] of our fathers look thereon, and
rebuke it.

12:18 Then the spirit came upon Amasai, who was chief of the captains,
and HE[JESUS] said, yours are we, David, and on your side, you SON[JESUS] of Jesse:
peace, peace be unto you, and peace be to yours helpers; for your GOD[JESUS]
helpeth you. Then David received them, and made them captains of the
band.

12:19 And there fell some of Manasseh to David, when HE[JESUS] came with the
Philistines against Saul to battle: but they helped them not: for the
lords of the Philistines upon advisement sent HIM[JESUS] away, saying, HE[JESUS] will
fall to HIS[JESUS] master Saul to the jeopardy of our heads.

12:20 As HE[JESUS] went to Ziklag, there fell to HIM[JESUS] of Manasseh, Adnah, and
Jozabad, and Jediael, and Michael, and Jozabad, and Elihu, and Zilthai,
captains of the thousands that were of Manasseh.

12:21 And they helped David against the band of the rovers: for they
were all mighty men of valour, and were captains in the host.

12:22 For at that time day by day there came to David to help HIM[JESUS], until
it was a great host, like the host of GOD[JESUS].

12:23 And these are the numbers of the bands that were ready armed to
the war, and came to David to Hebron, to turn the kingdom of Saul to
HIM[JESUS], according to the WORD[JESUS] of the LORD[JESUS].

12:24 The children of Judah that bare shield and spear were six thousand
and eight hundred, ready armed to the war.

12:25 Of the children of Simeon, mighty men of valour for the war, seven
thousand and one hundred.

12:26 Of the children of Levi four thousand and six hundred.

12:27 And Jehoiada was the leader of the Aaronites, and with HIM[JESUS] were
three thousand and seven hundred;

12:28 And Zadok, a young man mighty of valour, and of HIS[JESUS] father's house
twenty and two captains.

12:29 And of the children of Benjamin, the kindred of Saul, three
thousand: for hitherto the greatest part of them had kept the ward of
the house of Saul.

12:30 And of the children of Ephraim twenty thousand and eight hundred,
mighty men of valour, famous throughout the house of their fathers.

12:31 And of the half tribe of Manasseh eighteen thousand, which were
expressed by name, to come and make David KING[JESUS].

12:32 And of the children of Issachar, which were men that had
understanding of the times, to know what Israel ought to do; the heads
of them were two hundred; and all their brethren were at their
commandment.

12:33 Of Zebulun, such as went forth to battle, expert in war, with all
instruments of war, fifty thousand, which could keep rank: they were not
of double heart.

12:34 And of Naphtali a thousand captains, and with them with shield and
spear thirty and seven thousand.

12:35 And of the Danites expert in war twenty and eight thousand and six
hundred.

12:36 And of Asher, such as went forth to battle, expert in war, forty
thousand.

12:37 And on the other side of Jordan, of the Reubenites, and the
Gadites, and of the half tribe of Manasseh, with all manner of
instruments of war for the battle, an hundred and twenty thousand.

12:38 All these men of war, that could keep rank, came with a perfect
heart to Hebron, to make David KING[JESUS] over all Israel: and all the rest
also of Israel were of one heart to make David KING[JESUS].

12:39 And there they were with David three days, eating and drinking:
for their brethren had prepared for them.

12:40 Moreover they that were nigh them, even unto Issachar and Zebulun
and Naphtali, brought bread on asses, and on camels, and on mules, and
on oxen, and meat, meal, cakes of figs, and bunches of raisins, and
wine, and oil, and oxen, and sheep abundantly: for there was joy in
Israel.


13:1 And David consulted with the captains of thousands and hundreds,
and with every leader.

13:2 And David said unto all the congregation of Israel, If it seem good
unto you, and that it be of the LORD[JESUS] our GOD[JESUS], let us send abroad unto
our brethren every where, that are left in all the land of Israel, and
with them also to the priests and Levites which are in their cities and
suburbs, that they may gather themselves unto us:

13:3 And let us bring again the ark of our GOD[JESUS] to us: for we enquired
not at it in the days of Saul.

13:4 And all the congregation said that they would do so: for the thing
was right in the eyes of all the people.

13:5 So David gathered all Israel together, from Shihor of Egypt even
unto the entering of Hemath, to bring the ark of GOD[JESUS] from Kirjathjearim.

13:6 And David went up, and all Israel, to Baalah, that is, to
Kirjathjearim, which belonged to Judah, to bring up thence the ark of
GOD[JESUS] the LORD[JESUS], that dwelleth between the cherubims, whose name is called
on it.

13:7 And they carried the ark of GOD[JESUS] in a new cart out of the house of
Abinadab: and Uzza and Ahio drave the cart.

13:8 And David and all Israel played before GOD[JESUS] with all their might,
and with singing, and with harps, and with psalteries, and with
timbrels, and with cymbals, and with trumpets.

13:9 And when they came unto the threshingfloor of Chidon, Uzza put
forth HIS[JESUS] hand to hold the ark; for the oxen stumbled.

13:10 And the anger of the LORD[JESUS] was kindled against Uzza, and HE[JESUS] smote
HIM[JESUS], because HE[JESUS] put HIS[JESUS] hand to the ark: and there HE[JESUS] died before GOD[JESUS].

13:11 And David was displeased, because the LORD[JESUS] had made a breach upon
Uzza: wherefore that place is called Perezuzza to this day.

13:12 And David was afraid of GOD[JESUS] that day, saying, How shall I bring
the ark of GOD[JESUS] home to me?

13:13 So David brought not the ark home to himself to the city of David,
but carried it aside into the house of Obededom the Gittite.

13:14 And the ark of GOD[JESUS] remained with the family of Obededom in HIS[JESUS]
house three months. And the LORD[JESUS] blessed the house of Obededom, and all
that HE[JESUS] had.


14:1 Now Hiram KING[JESUS] of Tyre sent messengers to David, and timber of
cedars, with masons and carpenters, to build HIM[JESUS] an house.

14:2 And David perceived that the LORD[JESUS] had confirmed HIM[JESUS] KING[JESUS] over
Israel, for HIS[JESUS] kingdom was lifted up on high, because of HIS[JESUS] people
Israel.

14:3 And David took more wives at Jerusalem: and David begat more sons
and daughters.

14:4 Now these are the names of HIS[JESUS] children which HE[JESUS] had in Jerusalem;
Shammua, and Shobab, Nathan, and Solomon,

14:5 And Ibhar, and Elishua, and Elpalet,

14:6 And Nogah, and Nepheg, and Japhia,

14:7 And Elishama, and Beeliada, and Eliphalet.

14:8 And when the Philistines heard that David was anointed KING[JESUS] over
all Israel, all the Philistines went up to seek David. And David heard
of it, and went out against them.

14:9 And the Philistines came and spread themselves in the valley of
Rephaim.

14:10 And David enquired of GOD[JESUS], saying, Shall I go up against the
Philistines? And wilt you deliver them into mine hand? And the LORD[JESUS]
said unto HIM[JESUS], Go up; for I will deliver them into yours hand.

14:11 So they came up to Baalperazim; and David smote them there. Then
David said, GOD[JESUS] has broken in upon mine enemies by mine hand like the
breaking forth of waters: therefore they called the name of that place
Baalperazim.

14:12 And when they had left their gods there, David gave a commandment,
and they were burned with fire.

14:13 And the Philistines yet again spread themselves abroad in the
valley.

14:14 Therefore David enquired again of GOD[JESUS]; and GOD[JESUS] said unto HIM[JESUS], Go
not up after them; turn away from them, and come upon them over against
the mulberry trees.

14:15 And it shall be, when you shalt hear a sound of going in the tops
of the mulberry trees, that then you shalt go out to battle: for GOD[JESUS] is
gone forth before you to smite the host of the Philistines.

14:16 David therefore did as GOD[JESUS] commanded HIM[JESUS]: and they smote the host
of the Philistines from Gibeon even to Gazer.

14:17 And the fame of David went out into all lands; and the LORD[JESUS]
brought the fear of HIM[JESUS] upon all nations.


15:1 And David made HIM[JESUS] houses in the city of David, and prepared a
place for the ark of GOD[JESUS], and pitched for it a tent.

15:2 Then David said, None ought to carry the ark of GOD[JESUS] but the
Levites: for them has the LORD[JESUS] chosen to carry the ark of GOD[JESUS], and to
minister unto HIM[JESUS] for ever.

15:3 And David gathered all Israel together to Jerusalem, to bring up
the ark of the LORD[JESUS] unto HIS[JESUS] place, which HE[JESUS] had prepared for it.

15:4 And David assembled the children of Aaron, and the Levites:

15:5 Of the sons of Kohath; Uriel the chief, and HIS[JESUS] brethren an hundred
and twenty:

15:6 Of the sons of Merari; Asaiah the chief, and HIS[JESUS] brethren two
hundred and twenty:

15:7 Of the sons of Gershom; Joel the chief and HIS[JESUS] brethren an hundred
and thirty:

15:8 Of the sons of Elizaphan; Shemaiah the chief, and HIS[JESUS] brethren two
hundred:

15:9 Of the sons of Hebron; Eliel the chief, and HIS[JESUS] brethren fourscore:

15:10 Of the sons of Uzziel; Amminadab the chief, and HIS[JESUS] brethren an
hundred and twelve.

15:11 And David called for Zadok and Abiathar the priests, and for the
Levites, for Uriel, Asaiah, and Joel, Shemaiah, and Eliel, and
Amminadab,

15:12 And said unto them, you are the chief of the fathers of the
Levites: sanctify yourselves, both you and your brethren, that you may
bring up the ark of the LORD[JESUS] GOD[JESUS] of Israel unto the place that I have
prepared for it.

15:13 For because you did it not at the first, the LORD[JESUS] our GOD[JESUS] made a
breach upon us, for that we sought HIM[JESUS] not after the due order.

15:14 So the priests and the Levites sanctified themselves to bring up
the ark of the LORD[JESUS] GOD[JESUS] of Israel.

15:15 And the children of the Levites bare the ark of GOD[JESUS] upon their
shoulders with the staves thereon, as Moses commanded according to the
WORD[JESUS] of the LORD[JESUS].

15:16 And David spake to the chief of the Levites to appoint their
brethren to be the singers with instruments of musick, psalteries and
harps and cymbals, sounding, by lifting up the voice with joy.

15:17 So the Levites appointed Heman the SON[JESUS] of Joel; and of HIS[JESUS]
brethren, Asaph the SON[JESUS] of Berechiah; and of the sons of Merari their
brethren, Ethan the SON[JESUS] of Kushaiah;

15:18 And with them their brethren of the second degree, Zechariah, Ben,
and Jaaziel, and Shemiramoth, and Jehiel, and Unni, Eliab, and Benaiah,
and Maaseiah, and Mattithiah, and Elipheleh, and Mikneiah, and Obededom,
and Jeiel, the porters.

15:19 So the singers, Heman, Asaph, and Ethan, were appointed to sound
with cymbals of brass;

15:20 And Zechariah, and Aziel, and Shemiramoth, and Jehiel, and Unni,
and Eliab, and Maaseiah, and Benaiah, with psalteries on Alamoth;

15:21 And Mattithiah, and Elipheleh, and Mikneiah, and Obededom, and
Jeiel, and Azaziah, with harps on the Sheminith to excel.

15:22 And Chenaniah, chief of the Levites, was for song: HE[JESUS] instructed
about the song, because HE[JESUS] was skilful.

15:23 And Berechiah and Elkanah were doorkeepers for the ark.

15:24 And Shebaniah, and Jehoshaphat, and Nethaneel, and Amasai, and
Zechariah, and Benaiah, and Eliezer, the priests, did blow with the
trumpets before the ark of GOD[JESUS]: and Obededom and Jehiah were doorkeepers
for the ark.

15:25 So David, and the elders of Israel, and the captains over
thousands, went to bring up the ark of the covenant of the LORD[JESUS] out of
the house of Obededom with joy.

15:26 And it came to pass, when GOD[JESUS] helped the Levites that bare the ark
of the covenant of the LORD[JESUS], that they offered seven bullocks and seven
rams.

15:27 And David was clothed with a robe of fine linen, and all the
Levites that bare the ark, and the singers, and Chenaniah the master of
the song with the singers: David also had upon HIM[JESUS] an ephod of linen.

15:28 Thus all Israel brought up the ark of the covenant of the LORD[JESUS]
with shouting, and with sound of the cornet, and with trumpets, and with
cymbals, making a noise with psalteries and harps.

15:29 And it came to pass, as the ark of the covenant of the LORD[JESUS] came
to the city of David, that Michal, the daughter of Saul looking out at a
window saw KING[JESUS] David dancing and playing: and she despised HIM[JESUS] in her
heart.


16:1 So they brought the ark of GOD[JESUS], and set it in the midst of the tent
that David had pitched for it: and they offered burnt sacrifices and
peace offerings before GOD[JESUS].

16:2 And when David had made an end of offering the burnt offerings and
the peace offerings, HE[JESUS] blessed the people in the name of the LORD[JESUS].

16:3 And HE[JESUS] dealt to every one of Israel, both man and woman, to every
one a loaf of bread, and a good piece of flesh, and a flagon of wine.

16:4 And HE[JESUS] appointed certain of the Levites to minister before the ark
of the LORD[JESUS], and to record, and to thank and praise the LORD[JESUS] GOD[JESUS] of
Israel:

16:5 Asaph the chief, and next to HIM[JESUS] Zechariah, Jeiel, and Shemiramoth,
and Jehiel, and Mattithiah, and Eliab, and Benaiah, and Obededom: and
Jeiel with psalteries and with harps; but Asaph made a sound with
cymbals;

16:6 Benaiah also and Jahaziel the priests with trumpets continually
before the ark of the covenant of GOD[JESUS].

16:7 Then on that day David delivered first this psalm to thank the LORD[JESUS]
into the hand of Asaph and HIS[JESUS] brethren.

16:8 Give thanks unto the LORD[JESUS], call upon HIS[JESUS] name, make known HIS[JESUS] deeds
among the people.

16:9 Sing unto HIM[JESUS], sing psalms unto HIM[JESUS], talk you of all HIS[JESUS] wondrous
works.

16:10 Glory you in HIS[JESUS] holy name: let the heart of them rejoice that seek
the LORD[JESUS].

16:11 Seek the LORD[JESUS] and HIS[JESUS] strength, seek HIS[JESUS] face continually.

16:12 Remember HIS[JESUS] marvellous works that HE[JESUS] has done, HIS[JESUS] wonders, and
the judgments of HIS[JESUS] mouth;

16:13 O you SEED[JESUS] of Israel HIS[JESUS] SERVANT[JESUS], you children of Jacob, HIS[JESUS] chosen
ones.

16:14 HE[JESUS] is the LORD[JESUS] our GOD[JESUS]; HIS[JESUS] judgments are in all the earth.

16:15 Be you mindful always of HIS[JESUS] covenant; the WORD[JESUS] which HE[JESUS] commanded
to a thousand generations;

16:16 Even of the covenant which HE[JESUS] made with Abraham, and of HIS[JESUS] oath
unto Isaac;

16:17 And has confirmed the same to Jacob for a law, and to Israel for
an everlasting covenant,

16:18 Saying, Unto you will I give the land of Canaan, the lot of your
inheritance;

16:19 When you were but few, even a few, and strangers in it.

16:20 And when they went from nation to nation, and from one kingdom to
another people;

16:21 HE[JESUS] suffered no man to do them wrong: yea, HE[JESUS] reproved kings for
their sakes,

16:22 Saying, Touch not mine anointed, and do my prophets no harm.

16:23 Sing unto the LORD[JESUS], all the earth; shew forth from day to day HIS[JESUS]
salvation.

16:24 Declare HIS[JESUS] glory among the heathen; HIS[JESUS] marvellous works among
all nations.

16:25 For great is the LORD[JESUS], and greatly to be praised: HE[JESUS] also is to be
feared above all gods.

16:26 For all the gods of the people are idols: but the LORD[JESUS] made the
heavens.

16:27 Glory and honour are in HIS[JESUS] presence; strength and gladness are in
HIS[JESUS] place.

16:28 Give unto the LORD[JESUS], you kindreds of the people, give unto the LORD[JESUS]
glory and strength.

16:29 Give unto the LORD[JESUS] the glory due unto HIS[JESUS] name: bring an offering,
and come before HIM[JESUS]: worship the LORD[JESUS] in the beauty of holiness.

16:30 Fear before HIM[JESUS], all the earth: the world also shall be stable,
that it be not moved.

16:31 Let the heavens be glad, and let the earth rejoice: and let men
say among the nations, The LORD[JESUS] reigneth.

16:32 Let the sea roar, and the fulness thereof: let the fields rejoice,
and all that is therein.

16:33 Then shall the trees of the wood sing out at the presence of the
LORD[JESUS], because HE[JESUS] comes to judge the earth.

16:34 O give thanks unto the LORD[JESUS]; for HE[JESUS] is good; for HIS[JESUS] mercy
endureth for ever.

16:35 And say you, Save us, O GOD[JESUS] of our salvation, and gather us
together, and deliver us from the heathen, that we may give thanks to
your holy name, and glory in your praise.

16:36 Blessed be the LORD[JESUS] GOD[JESUS] of Israel for ever and ever. And all the
people said, Amen, and praised the LORD[JESUS].

16:37 So HE[JESUS] left there before the ark of the covenant of the LORD[JESUS] Asaph
and HIS[JESUS] brethren, to minister before the ark continually, as every day's
work required:

16:38 And Obededom with their brethren, threescore and eight; Obededom
also the SON[JESUS] of Jeduthun and Hosah to be porters:

16:39 And Zadok the priest, and HIS[JESUS] brethren the priests, before the
tabernacle of the LORD[JESUS] in the high place that was at Gibeon,

16:40 To offer burnt offerings unto the LORD[JESUS] upon the altar of the burnt
offering continually morning and evening, and to do according to all
that is written in the law of the LORD[JESUS], which HE[JESUS] commanded Israel;

16:41 And with them Heman and Jeduthun, and the rest that were chosen,
who were expressed by name, to give thanks to the LORD[JESUS], because HIS[JESUS]
mercy endureth for ever;

16:42 And with them Heman and Jeduthun with trumpets and cymbals for
those that should make a sound, and with musical instruments of GOD[JESUS]. And
the sons of Jeduthun were porters.

16:43 And all the people departed every man to HIS[JESUS] house: and David
returned to bless HIS[JESUS] house.


17:1 Now it came to pass, as David sat in HIS[JESUS] house, that David said to
Nathan the PROPHET[JESUS], Lo, I dwell in an house of cedars, but the ark of
the covenant of the LORD[JESUS] remaineth under curtains.

17:2 Then Nathan said unto David, Do all that is in yours heart; for GOD[JESUS]
is with you.

17:3 And it came to pass the same night, that the WORD[JESUS] of GOD[JESUS] came to
Nathan, saying,

17:4 Go and tell David my SERVANT[JESUS], Thus says the LORD[JESUS], you shalt not
build me an house to dwell in:

17:5 For I have not dwelt in an house since the day that I brought up
Israel unto this day; but have gone from tent to tent, and from one
tabernacle to another.

17:6 Wheresoever I have walked with all Israel, spake I a WORD[JESUS] to any of
the judges of Israel, whom I commanded to feed my people, saying, Why
have you not built me an house of cedars?

17:7 Now therefore thus shalt you say unto my SERVANT[JESUS] David, Thus says
the LORD[JESUS] of hosts, I took you from the sheepcote, even from following
the sheep, that you shouldest be ruler over my people Israel:

17:8 And I have been with you whithersoever you hast walked, and have
cut off all yours enemies from before you, and have made you a name
like the name of the great men that are in the earth.

17:9 Also I will ordain a place for my people Israel, and will plant
them, and they shall dwell in their place, and shall be moved no more;
neither shall the children of wickedness waste them any more, as at the
beginning,

17:10 And since the time that I commanded judges to be over my people
Israel. Moreover I will subdue all yours enemies. Furthermore I tell
you that the LORD[JESUS] will build you an house.

17:11 And it shall come to pass, when your days be expired that you must
go to be with your fathers, that I will raise up your SEED[JESUS] after you,
which shall be of your sons; and I will establish HIS[JESUS] kingdom.

17:12 HE[JESUS] shall build me an house, and I will stablish HIS[JESUS] throne for
ever.

17:13 I will be HIS[JESUS] father, and HE[JESUS] shall be my SON[JESUS]: and I will not take
my mercy away from HIM[JESUS], as I took it from HIM[JESUS] that was before you:

17:14 But I will settle HIM[JESUS] in mine house and in my kingdom for ever:
and HIS[JESUS] throne shall be established for evermore.

17:15 According to all these words, and according to all this vision, so
did Nathan speak unto David.

17:16 And David the KING[JESUS] came and sat before the LORD[JESUS], and said, Who am
I, O LORD[JESUS] GOD[JESUS], and what is mine house, that you hast brought me
hitherto?

17:17 And yet this was a small thing in yours eyes, O GOD[JESUS]; for you hast
also spoken of your SERVANT[JESUS]'s house for a great while to come, and hast
regarded me according to the estate of a man of high degree, O LORD[JESUS] GOD[JESUS].

17:18 What can David speak more to you for the honour of your SERVANT[JESUS]?
for you knowest your SERVANT[JESUS].

17:19 O LORD[JESUS], for your SERVANT[JESUS]'s sake, and according to yours own heart,
hast you done all this greatness, in making known all these great
things.

17:20 O LORD[JESUS], there is none like you, neither is there any GOD[JESUS] beside
you, according to all that we have heard with our ears.

17:21 And what one nation in the earth is like your people Israel, whom
GOD[JESUS] went to redeem to be HIS[JESUS] own people, to make you a name of
greatness and terribleness, by driving out nations from before your
people whom you hast redeemed out of Egypt?

17:22 For your people Israel didst you make yours own people for ever;
and you, LORD[JESUS], becamest their GOD[JESUS].

17:23 Therefore now, LORD[JESUS], let the thing that you hast spoken
concerning your SERVANT[JESUS] and concerning HIS[JESUS] house be established for ever,
and do as you hast said.

17:24 Let it even be established, that your name may be magnified for
ever, saying, The LORD[JESUS] of hosts is the GOD[JESUS] of Israel, even a GOD[JESUS] to
Israel: and let the house of David your SERVANT[JESUS] be established before
you.

17:25 For you, O my GOD[JESUS], hast told your SERVANT[JESUS] that you wilt build HIM[JESUS]
an house: therefore your SERVANT[JESUS] has found in HIS[JESUS] heart to pray before
you.

17:26 And now, LORD[JESUS], you art GOD[JESUS], and hast promised this goodness unto
your SERVANT[JESUS]:

17:27 Now therefore let it please you to bless the house of your
SERVANT[JESUS], that it may be before you for ever: for you blessest, O LORD[JESUS],
and it shall be blessed for ever.


18:1 Now after this it came to pass, that David smote the Philistines,
and subdued them, and took Gath and her towns out of the hand of the
Philistines.

18:2 And HE[JESUS] smote Moab; and the Moabites became David's servants, and
brought gifts.

18:3 And David smote Hadarezer KING[JESUS] of Zobah unto Hamath, as HE[JESUS] went to
stablish HIS[JESUS] dominion by the river Euphrates.

18:4 And David took from HIM[JESUS] a thousand chariots, and seven thousand
horsemen, and twenty thousand footmen: David also houghed all the
chariot horses, but reserved of them an hundred chariots.

18:5 And when the Syrians of Damascus came to help Hadarezer KING[JESUS] of
Zobah, David slew of the Syrians two and twenty thousand men.

18:6 Then David put garrisons in Syriadamascus; and the Syrians became
David's servants, and brought gifts. Thus the LORD[JESUS] preserved David
whithersoever HE[JESUS] went.

18:7 And David took the shields of gold that were on the servants of
Hadarezer, and brought them to Jerusalem.

18:8 Likewise from Tibhath, and from Chun, cities of Hadarezer, brought
David very much brass, wherewith Solomon made the brasen sea, and the
pillars, and the vessels of brass.

18:9 Now when Tou KING[JESUS] of Hamath heard how David had smitten all the
host of Hadarezer KING[JESUS] of Zobah;

18:10 HE[JESUS] sent Hadoram HIS[JESUS] SON[JESUS] to KING[JESUS] David, to enquire of HIS[JESUS] welfare,
and to congratulate HIM[JESUS], because HE[JESUS] had fought against Hadarezer, and
smitten HIM[JESUS]; (for Hadarezer had war with Tou;) and with HIM[JESUS] all manner
of vessels of gold and silver and brass.

18:11 Them also KING[JESUS] David dedicated unto the LORD[JESUS], with the silver and
the gold that HE[JESUS] brought from all these nations; from Edom, and from
Moab, and from the children of Ammon, and from the Philistines, and from
Amalek.

18:12 Moreover Abishai the SON[JESUS] of Zeruiah slew of the Edomites in the
valley of salt eighteen thousand.

18:13 And HE[JESUS] put garrisons in Edom; and all the Edomites became David's
servants. Thus the LORD[JESUS] preserved David whithersoever HE[JESUS] went.

18:14 So David reigned over all Israel, and executed judgment and
justice among all HIS[JESUS] people.

18:15 And Joab the SON[JESUS] of Zeruiah was over the host; and Jehoshaphat the
SON[JESUS] of Ahilud, recorder.

18:16 And Zadok the SON[JESUS] of Ahitub, and Abimelech the SON[JESUS] of Abiathar,
were the priests; and Shavsha was scribe;

18:17 And Benaiah the SON[JESUS] of Jehoiada was over the Cherethites and the
Pelethites; and the sons of David were chief about the KING[JESUS].


19:1 Now it came to pass after this, that Nahash the KING[JESUS] of the
children of Ammon died, and HIS[JESUS] SON[JESUS] reigned in HIS[JESUS] stead.

19:2 And David said, I will shew kindness unto Hanun the SON[JESUS] of Nahash,
because HIS[JESUS] father shewed kindness to me. And David sent messengers to
comfort HIM[JESUS] concerning HIS[JESUS] father. So the servants of David came into
the land of the children of Ammon to Hanun, to comfort HIM[JESUS].

19:3 But the princes of the children of Ammon said to Hanun, Thinkest
you that David does honour your father, that HE[JESUS] has sent comforters
unto you? are not HIS[JESUS] servants come unto you for to search, and to
overthrow, and to spy out the land?

19:4 Wherefore Hanun took David's servants, and shaved them, and cut off
their garments in the midst hard by their buttocks, and sent them away.

19:5 Then there went certain, and told David how the men were served.
And HE[JESUS] sent to meet them: for the men were greatly ashamed. And the KING[JESUS]
said, Tarry at Jericho until your beards be grown, and then return.

19:6 And when the children of Ammon saw that they had made themselves
odious to David, Hanun and the children of Ammon sent a thousand talents
of silver to hire them chariots and horsemen out of Mesopotamia, and out
of Syriamaachah, and out of Zobah.

19:7 So they hired thirty and two thousand chariots, and the KING[JESUS] of
Maachah and HIS[JESUS] people; who came and pitched before Medeba. And the
children of Ammon gathered themselves together from their cities, and
came to battle.

19:8 And when David heard of it, HE[JESUS] sent Joab, and all the host of the
mighty men.

19:9 And the children of Ammon came out, and put the battle in array
before the gate of the city: and the kings that were come were by
themselves in the field.

19:10 Now when Joab saw that the battle was set against HIM[JESUS] before and
behind, HE[JESUS] chose out of all the choice of Israel, and put them in array
against the Syrians.

19:11 And the rest of the people HE[JESUS] delivered unto the hand of Abishai
HIS[JESUS] brother, and they set themselves in array against the children of
Ammon.

19:12 And HE[JESUS] said, If the Syrians be too strong for me, then you shalt
help me: but if the children of Ammon be too strong for you, then I
will help you.

19:13 Be of good courage, and let us behave ourselves valiantly for our
people, and for the cities of our GOD[JESUS]: and let the LORD[JESUS] do that which is
good in HIS[JESUS] sight.

19:14 So Joab and the people that were with HIM[JESUS] drew nigh before the
Syrians unto the battle; and they fled before HIM[JESUS].

19:15 And when the children of Ammon saw that the Syrians were fled,
they likewise fled before Abishai HIS[JESUS] brother, and entered into the
city. Then Joab came to Jerusalem.

19:16 And when the Syrians saw that they were put to the worse before
Israel, they sent messengers, and drew forth the Syrians that were
beyond the river: and Shophach the captain of the host of Hadarezer went
before them.

19:17 And it was told David; and HE[JESUS] gathered all Israel, and passed over
Jordan, and came upon them, and set the battle in array against them. So
when David had put the battle in array against the Syrians, they fought
with HIM[JESUS].

19:18 But the Syrians fled before Israel; and David slew of the Syrians
seven thousand men which fought in chariots, and forty thousand footmen,
and killed Shophach the captain of the host.

19:19 And when the servants of Hadarezer saw that they were put to the
worse before Israel, they made peace with David, and became HIS[JESUS]
servants: neither would the Syrians help the children of Ammon any more.


20:1 And it came to pass, that after the year was expired, at the time
that kings go out to battle, Joab led forth the power of the army, and
wasted the country of the children of Ammon, and came and besieged
Rabbah. But David tarried at Jerusalem. And Joab smote Rabbah, and
destroyed it.

20:2 And David took the crown of their KING[JESUS] from off HIS[JESUS] head, and found
it to weigh a talent of gold, and there were precious stones in it; and
it was set upon David's head: and HE[JESUS] brought also exceeding much spoil
out of the city.

20:3 And HE[JESUS] brought out the people that were in it, and cut them with
saws, and with harrows of iron, and with axes. Even so dealt David with
all the cities of the children of Ammon. And David and all the people
returned to Jerusalem.

20:4 And it came to pass after this, that there arose war at Gezer with
the Philistines; at which time Sibbechai the Hushathite slew Sippai,
that was of the children of the giant: and they were subdued.

20:5 And there was war again with the Philistines; and Elhanan the SON[JESUS]
of Jair slew Lahmi the brother of Goliath the Gittite, whose spear staff
was like a weaver's beam.

20:6 And yet again there was war at Gath, where was a man of great
stature, whose fingers and toes were four and twenty, six on each hand,
and six on each foot and HE[JESUS] also was the SON[JESUS] of the giant.

20:7 But when HE[JESUS] defied Israel, Jonathan the SON[JESUS] of Shimea David's
brother slew HIM[JESUS].

20:8 These were born unto the giant in Gath; and they fell by the hand
of David, and by the hand of HIS[JESUS] servants.


21:1 And Satan stood up against Israel, and provoked David to number
Israel.

21:2 And David said to Joab and to the rulers of the people, Go, number
Israel from Beersheba even to Dan; and bring the number of them to me,
that I may know it.

21:3 And Joab answered, The LORD[JESUS] make HIS[JESUS] people an hundred times so
many more as they be: but, my LORD[JESUS] the KING[JESUS], are they not all my LORD[JESUS]'s
servants? why then does my LORD[JESUS] require this thing? why will HE[JESUS] be a
cause of trespass to Israel?

21:4 Nevertheless the KING[JESUS]'s WORD[JESUS] prevailed against Joab. Wherefore Joab
departed, and went throughout all Israel, and came to Jerusalem.

21:5 And Joab gave the sum of the number of the people unto David. And
all they of Israel were a thousand thousand and an hundred thousand men
that drew sword: and Judah was four hundred threescore and ten thousand
men that drew sword.

21:6 But Levi and Benjamin counted HE[JESUS] not among them: for the KING[JESUS]'s
WORD[JESUS] was abominable to Joab.

21:7 And GOD[JESUS] was displeased with this thing; therefore HE[JESUS] smote Israel.

21:8 And David said unto GOD[JESUS], I have sinned greatly, because I have done
this thing: but now, I beseech you, do away the iniquity of your
SERVANT[JESUS]; for I have done very foolishly.

21:9 And the LORD[JESUS] spake unto Gad, David's seer, saying,

21:10 Go and tell David, saying, Thus says the LORD[JESUS], I offer you three
things: choose you one of them, that I may do it unto you.

21:11 So Gad came to David, and said unto HIM[JESUS], Thus says the LORD[JESUS],
Choose you

21:12 Either three years' famine; or three months to be destroyed before
your foes, while that the sword of yours enemies overtaketh you; or else
three days the sword of the LORD[JESUS], even the pestilence, in the land, and
the angel of the LORD[JESUS] destroying throughout all the coasts of Israel.
Now therefore advise thyself what WORD[JESUS] I shall bring again to HIM[JESUS] that
sent me.

21:13 And David said unto Gad, I am in a great strait: let me fall now
into the hand of the LORD[JESUS]; for very great are HIS[JESUS] mercies: but let me
not fall into the hand of man.

21:14 So the LORD[JESUS] sent pestilence upon Israel: and there fell of Israel
seventy thousand men.

21:15 And GOD[JESUS] sent an angel unto Jerusalem to destroy it: and as HE[JESUS] was
destroying, the LORD[JESUS] beheld, and HE[JESUS] repented HIM[JESUS] of the evil, and said
to the angel that destroyed, It is enough, stay now yours hand. And the
angel of the LORD[JESUS] stood by the threshingfloor of Ornan the Jebusite.

21:16 And David lifted up HIS[JESUS] eyes, and saw the angel of the LORD[JESUS] stand
between the earth and the heaven, having a drawn sword in HIS[JESUS] hand
stretched out over Jerusalem. Then David and the elders of Israel, who
were clothed in sackcloth, fell upon their faces.

21:17 And David said unto GOD[JESUS], Is it not I that commanded the people to
be numbered? even I it is that have sinned and done evil indeed; but as
for these sheep, what have they done? let yours hand, I pray you, O
LORD[JESUS] my GOD[JESUS], be on me, and on my father's house; but not on your people,
that they should be plagued.

21:18 Then the angel of the LORD[JESUS] commanded Gad to say to David, that
David should go up, and set up an altar unto the LORD[JESUS] in the
threshingfloor of Ornan the Jebusite.

21:19 And David went up at the saying of Gad, which HE[JESUS] spake in the name
of the LORD[JESUS].

21:20 And Ornan turned back, and saw the angel; and HIS[JESUS] four sons with
HIM[JESUS] hid themselves. Now Ornan was threshing wheat.

21:21 And as David came to Ornan, Ornan looked and saw David, and went
out of the threshingfloor, and bowed himself to David with HIS[JESUS] face to
the ground.

21:22 Then David said to Ornan, Grant me the place of this
threshingfloor, that I may build an altar therein unto the LORD[JESUS]: you
shalt grant it me for the full price: that the plague may be stayed from
the people.

21:23 And Ornan said unto David, Take it to you, and let my LORD[JESUS] the
KING[JESUS] do that which is good in HIS[JESUS] eyes: lo, I give you the oxen also
for burnt offerings, and the threshing instruments for wood, and the
wheat for the meat offering; I give it all.

21:24 And KING[JESUS] David said to Ornan, Nay; but I will truly buy it for
the full price: for I will not take that which is yours for the LORD[JESUS],
nor offer burnt offerings without cost.

21:25 So David gave to Ornan for the place six hundred shekels of gold
by weight.

21:26 And David built there an altar unto the LORD[JESUS], and offered burnt
offerings and peace offerings, and called upon the LORD[JESUS]; and HE[JESUS] answered
HIM[JESUS] from heaven by fire upon the altar of burnt offering.

21:27 And the LORD[JESUS] commanded the angel; and HE[JESUS] put up HIS[JESUS] sword again
into the sheath thereof.

21:28 At that time when David saw that the LORD[JESUS] had answered HIM[JESUS] in the
threshingfloor of Ornan the Jebusite, then HE[JESUS] sacrificed there.

21:29 For the tabernacle of the LORD[JESUS], which Moses made in the
wilderness, and the altar of the burnt offering, were at that season in
the high place at Gibeon.

21:30 But David could not go before it to enquire of GOD[JESUS]: for HE[JESUS] was
afraid because of the sword of the angel of the LORD[JESUS].


22:1 Then David said, This is the house of the LORD[JESUS] GOD[JESUS], and this is the
altar of the burnt offering for Israel.

22:2 And David commanded to gather together the strangers that were in
the land of Israel; and HE[JESUS] set masons to hew wrought stones to build the
house of GOD[JESUS].

22:3 And David prepared iron in abundance for the nails for the doors of
the gates, and for the joinings; and brass in abundance without weight;

22:4 Also cedar trees in abundance: for the Zidonians and they of Tyre
brought much cedar wood to David.

22:5 And David said, Solomon my SON[JESUS] is young and tender, and the house
that is to be builded for the LORD[JESUS] must be exceeding magnifical, of fame
and of glory throughout all countries: I will therefore now make
preparation for it. So David prepared abundantly before HIS[JESUS] death.

22:6 Then HE[JESUS] called for Solomon HIS[JESUS] SON[JESUS], and charged HIM[JESUS] to build an
house for the LORD[JESUS] GOD[JESUS] of Israel.

22:7 And David said to Solomon, My SON[JESUS], as for me, it was in my mind to
build an house unto the name of the LORD[JESUS] my GOD[JESUS]:

22:8 But the WORD[JESUS] of the LORD[JESUS] came to me, saying, you hast shed blood
abundantly, and hast made great wars: you shalt not build an house unto
my name, because you hast shed much blood upon the earth in my sight.

22:9 Behold, a SON[JESUS] shall be born to you, who shall be a man of rest;
and I will give HIM[JESUS] rest from all HIS[JESUS] enemies round about: for HIS[JESUS] name
shall be Solomon, and I will give peace and quietness unto Israel in HIS[JESUS]
days.

22:10 HE[JESUS] shall build an house for my name; and HE[JESUS] shall be my SON[JESUS], and I
will be HIS[JESUS] father; and I will establish the throne of HIS[JESUS] kingdom over
Israel for ever.

22:11 Now, my SON[JESUS], the LORD[JESUS] be with you; and prosper you, and build
the house of the LORD[JESUS] your GOD[JESUS], as HE[JESUS] has said of you.

22:12 Only the LORD[JESUS] give you wisdom and understanding, and give you
charge concerning Israel, that you mayest keep the law of the LORD[JESUS] your
GOD[JESUS].

22:13 Then shalt you prosper, if you takest heed to fulfil the
statutes and judgments which the LORD[JESUS] charged Moses with concerning
Israel: be strong, and of good courage; dread not, nor be dismayed.

22:14 Now, behold, in my trouble I have prepared for the house of the
LORD[JESUS] an hundred thousand talents of gold, and a thousand thousand
talents of silver; and of brass and iron without weight; for it is in
abundance: timber also and stone have I prepared; and you mayest add
thereto.

22:15 Moreover there are workmen with you in abundance, hewers and
workers of stone and timber, and all manner of cunning men for every
manner of work.

22:16 Of the gold, the silver, and the brass, and the iron, there is no
number. Arise therefore, and be doing, and the LORD[JESUS] be with you.

22:17 David also commanded all the princes of Israel to help Solomon HIS[JESUS]
SON[JESUS], saying,

22:18 Is not the LORD[JESUS] your GOD[JESUS] with you? and has HE[JESUS] not given you rest
on every side? for HE[JESUS] has given the inhabitants of the land into mine
hand; and the land is subdued before the LORD[JESUS], and before HIS[JESUS] people.

22:19 Now set your heart and your soul to seek the LORD[JESUS] your GOD[JESUS]; arise
therefore, and build you the sanctuary of the LORD[JESUS] GOD[JESUS], to bring the ark
of the covenant of the LORD[JESUS], and the holy vessels of GOD[JESUS], into the house
that is to be built to the name of the LORD[JESUS].


23:1 So when David was old and full of days, HE[JESUS] made Solomon HIS[JESUS] SON[JESUS]
KING[JESUS] over Israel.

23:2 And HE[JESUS] gathered together all the princes of Israel, with the
priests and the Levites.

23:3 Now the Levites were numbered from the age of thirty years and
upward: and their number by their polls, man by man, was thirty and
eight thousand.

23:4 Of which, twenty and four thousand were to set forward the work of
the house of the LORD[JESUS]; and six thousand were officers and judges:

23:5 Moreover four thousand were porters; and four thousand praised the
LORD[JESUS] with the instruments which I made, said David, to praise therewith.

23:6 And David divided them into courses among the sons of Levi, namely,
Gershon, Kohath, and Merari.

23:7 Of the Gershonites were, Laadan, and Shimei.

23:8 The sons of Laadan; the chief was Jehiel, and Zetham, and Joel,
three.

23:9 The sons of Shimei; Shelomith, and Haziel, and Haran, three. These
were the chief of the fathers of Laadan.

23:10 And the sons of Shimei were, Jahath, Zina, and Jeush, and Beriah.
These four were the sons of Shimei.

23:11 And Jahath was the chief, and Zizah the second: but Jeush and
Beriah had not many sons; therefore they were in one reckoning,
according to their father's house.

23:12 The sons of Kohath; Amram, Izhar, Hebron, and Uzziel, four.

23:13 The sons of Amram; Aaron and Moses: and Aaron was separated, that
HE[JESUS] should sanctify the most holy things, HE[JESUS] and HIS[JESUS] sons for ever, to
burn incense before the LORD[JESUS], to minister unto HIM[JESUS], and to bless in HIS[JESUS]
name for ever.

23:14 Now concerning Moses the man of GOD[JESUS], HIS[JESUS] sons were named of the
tribe of Levi.

23:15 The sons of Moses were, Gershom, and Eliezer.

23:16 Of the sons of Gershom, Shebuel was the chief.

23:17 And the sons of Eliezer were, Rehabiah the chief. And Eliezer had
none other sons; but the sons of Rehabiah were very many.

23:18 Of the sons of Izhar; Shelomith the chief.

23:19 Of the sons of Hebron; Jeriah the first, Amariah the second,
Jahaziel the third, and Jekameam the fourth.

23:20 Of the sons of Uzziel; Micah the first and Jesiah the second.

23:21 The sons of Merari; Mahli, and Mushi. The sons of Mahli; Eleazar,
and Kish.

23:22 And Eleazar died, and had no sons, but daughters: and their
brethren the sons of Kish took them.

23:23 The sons of Mushi; Mahli, and Eder, and Jeremoth, three.

23:24 These were the sons of Levi after the house of their fathers; even
the chief of the fathers, as they were counted by number of names by
their polls, that did the work for the service of the house of the LORD[JESUS],
from the age of twenty years and upward.

23:25 For David said, The LORD[JESUS] GOD[JESUS] of Israel has given rest unto HIS[JESUS]
people, that they may dwell in Jerusalem for ever:

23:26 And also unto the Levites; they shall no more carry the
tabernacle, nor any vessels of it for the service thereof.

23:27 For by the last words of David the Levites were numbered from
twenty years old and above:

23:28 Because their office was to wait on the sons of Aaron for the
service of the house of the LORD[JESUS], in the courts, and in the chambers,
and in the purifying of all holy things, and the work of the service of
the house of GOD[JESUS];

23:29 Both for the shewbread, and for the fine flour for meat offering,
and for the unleavened cakes, and for that which is baked in the pan,
and for that which is fried, and for all manner of measure and size;

23:30 And to stand every morning to thank and praise the LORD[JESUS], and
likewise at even:

23:31 And to offer all burnt sacrifices unto the LORD[JESUS] in the sabbaths,
in the new moons, and on the set feasts, by number, according to the
order commanded unto them, continually before the LORD[JESUS]:

23:32 And that they should keep the charge of the tabernacle of the
congregation, and the charge of the holy place, and the charge of the
sons of Aaron their brethren, in the service of the house of the LORD[JESUS].


24:1 Now these are the divisions of the sons of Aaron. The sons of
Aaron; Nadab, and Abihu, Eleazar, and Ithamar.

24:2 But Nadab and Abihu died before their father, and had no children:
therefore Eleazar and Ithamar executed the priest's office.

24:3 And David distributed them, both Zadok of the sons of Eleazar, and
Ahimelech of the sons of Ithamar, according to their offices in their
service.

24:4 And there were more chief men found of the sons of Eleazar than of
the sons of Ithamar, and thus were they divided. Among the sons of
Eleazar there were sixteen chief men of the house of their fathers, and
eight among the sons of Ithamar according to the house of their fathers.

24:5 Thus were they divided by lot, one sort with another; for the
governors of the sanctuary, and governors of the house of GOD[JESUS], were of
the sons of Eleazar, and of the sons of Ithamar.

24:6 And Shemaiah the SON[JESUS] of Nethaneel the scribe, one of the Levites,
wrote them before the KING[JESUS], and the princes, and Zadok the priest, and
Ahimelech the SON[JESUS] of Abiathar, and before the chief of the fathers of
the priests and Levites: one principal household being taken for
Eleazar, and one taken for Ithamar.

24:7 Now the first lot came forth to Jehoiarib, the second to Jedaiah,

24:8 The third to Harim, the fourth to Seorim,

24:9 The fifth to Malchijah, the sixth to Mijamin,

24:10 The seventh to Hakkoz, the eighth to Abijah,

24:11 The ninth to Jeshuah, the tenth to Shecaniah,

24:12 The eleventh to Eliashib, the twelfth to Jakim,

24:13 The thirteenth to Huppah, the fourteenth to Jeshebeab,

24:14 The fifteenth to Bilgah, the sixteenth to Immer,

24:15 The seventeenth to Hezir, the eighteenth to Aphses,

24:16 The nineteenth to Pethahiah, the twentieth to Jehezekel,

24:17 The one and twentieth to Jachin, the two and twentieth to Gamul,

24:18 The three and twentieth to Delaiah, the four and twentieth to
Maaziah.

24:19 These were the orderings of them in their service to come into the
house of the LORD[JESUS], according to their manner, under Aaron their father,
as the LORD[JESUS] GOD[JESUS] of Israel had commanded HIM[JESUS].

24:20 And the rest of the sons of Levi were these: Of the sons of Amram;
Shubael: of the sons of Shubael; Jehdeiah.

24:21 Concerning Rehabiah: of the sons of Rehabiah, the first was
Isshiah.

24:22 Of the Izharites; Shelomoth: of the sons of Shelomoth; Jahath.

24:23 And the sons of Hebron; Jeriah the first, Amariah the second,
Jahaziel the third, Jekameam the fourth.

24:24 Of the sons of Uzziel; Michah: of the sons of Michah; Shamir.

24:25 The brother of Michah was Isshiah: of the sons of Isshiah;
Zechariah.

24:26 The sons of Merari were Mahli and Mushi: the sons of Jaaziah;
Beno.

24:27 The sons of Merari by Jaaziah; Beno, and Shoham, and Zaccur, and
Ibri.

24:28 Of Mahli came Eleazar, who had no sons.

24:29 Concerning Kish: the SON[JESUS] of Kish was Jerahmeel.

24:30 The sons also of Mushi; Mahli, and Eder, and Jerimoth. These were
the sons of the Levites after the house of their fathers.

24:31 These likewise cast lots over against their brethren the sons of
Aaron in the presence of David the KING[JESUS], and Zadok, and Ahimelech, and
the chief of the fathers of the priests and Levites, even the principal
fathers over against their younger brethren.


25:1 Moreover David and the captains of the host separated to the
service of the sons of Asaph, and of Heman, and of Jeduthun, who should
prophesy with harps, with psalteries, and with cymbals: and the number
of the workmen according to their service was:

25:2 Of the sons of Asaph; Zaccur, and Joseph, and Nethaniah, and

25:3 Of Jeduthun: the sons of Jeduthun; Gedaliah, and Zeri, and

25:4 Of Heman: the sons of Heman: Bukkiah, Mattaniah, Uzziel, Shebuel,
and Jerimoth, Hananiah, Hanani, Eliathah, Giddalti, and Romamtiezer,

25:6 All these were under the hands of their father for song in the

25:7 So the number of them, with their brethren that were instructed in

25:8 And they cast lots, ward against ward, as well the small as the

25:15 The eighth to Jeshaiah, HE[JESUS], HIS[JESUS] sons, and HIS[JESUS] brethren, were

25:16 The ninth to Mattaniah, HE[JESUS], HIS[JESUS] sons, and HIS[JESUS] brethren, were

25:17 The tenth to Shimei, HE[JESUS], HIS[JESUS] sons, and HIS[JESUS] brethren, were twelve:

25:18 The eleventh to Azareel, HE[JESUS], HIS[JESUS] sons, and HIS[JESUS] brethren, were

25:19 The twelfth to Hashabiah, HE[JESUS], HIS[JESUS] sons, and HIS[JESUS] brethren, were

26:1 Concerning the divisions of the porters: Of the Korhites was
Meshelemiah the SON[JESUS] of Kore, of the sons of Asaph.

26:2 And the sons of Meshelemiah were, Zechariah the firstborn, Jediael
the second, Zebadiah the third, Jathniel the fourth,

26:3 Elam the fifth, Jehohanan the sixth, Elioenai the seventh.

26:4 Moreover the sons of Obededom were, Shemaiah the firstborn,
Jehozabad the second, Joah the third, and Sacar the fourth, and
Nethaneel the fifth.

26:5 Ammiel the sixth, Issachar the seventh, Peulthai the eighth: for
GOD[JESUS] blessed HIM[JESUS].

26:6 Also unto Shemaiah HIS[JESUS] SON[JESUS] were sons born, that ruled throughout
the house of their father: for they were mighty men of valour.

26:7 The sons of Shemaiah; Othni, and Rephael, and Obed, Elzabad, whose
brethren were strong men, Elihu, and Semachiah.

26:8 All these of the sons of Obededom: they and their sons and their
brethren, able men for strength for the service, were threescore and two
of Obededom.

26:9 And Meshelemiah had sons and brethren, strong men, eighteen.

26:10 Also Hosah, of the children of Merari, had sons; Simri the chief,
(for though HE[JESUS] was not the firstborn, yet HIS[JESUS] father made HIM[JESUS] the
chief;)

26:11 Hilkiah the second, Tebaliah the third, Zechariah the fourth: all
the sons and brethren of Hosah were thirteen.

26:12 Among these were the divisions of the porters, even among the
chief men, having wards one against another, to minister in the house of
the LORD[JESUS].

26:13 And they cast lots, as well the small as the great, according to
the house of their fathers, for every gate.

26:14 And the lot eastward fell to Shelemiah. Then for Zechariah HIS[JESUS]
SON[JESUS], a wise COUNSELLOR[JESUS], they cast lots; and HIS[JESUS] lot came out northward.

26:15 To Obededom southward; and to HIS[JESUS] sons the house of Asuppim.

26:16 To Shuppim and Hosah the lot came forth westward, with the gate
Shallecheth, by the causeway of the going up, ward against ward.

26:17 Eastward were six Levites, northward four a day, southward four a
day, and toward Asuppim two and two.

26:18 At Parbar westward, four at the causeway, and two at Parbar.

26:19 These are the divisions of the porters among the sons of Kore, and
among the sons of Merari.

26:20 And of the Levites, Ahijah was over the treasures of the house of
GOD[JESUS], and over the treasures of the dedicated things.

26:21 As concerning the sons of Laadan; the sons of the Gershonite
Laadan, chief fathers, even of Laadan the Gershonite, were Jehieli.

26:22 The sons of Jehieli; Zetham, and Joel HIS[JESUS] brother, which were over
the treasures of the house of the LORD[JESUS].

26:23 Of the Amramites, and the Izharites, the Hebronites, and the
Uzzielites:

26:24 And Shebuel the SON[JESUS] of Gershom, the SON[JESUS] of Moses, was ruler of the
treasures.

26:25 And HIS[JESUS] brethren by Eliezer; Rehabiah HIS[JESUS] SON[JESUS], and Jeshaiah HIS[JESUS]
SON[JESUS], and Joram HIS[JESUS] SON[JESUS], and Zichri HIS[JESUS] SON[JESUS], and Shelomith HIS[JESUS] SON[JESUS].

26:26 Which Shelomith and HIS[JESUS] brethren were over all the treasures of
the dedicated things, which David the KING[JESUS], and the chief fathers, the
captains over thousands and hundreds, and the captains of the host, had
dedicated.

26:27 Out of the spoils won in battles did they dedicate to maintain the
house of the LORD[JESUS].

26:28 And all that Samuel the seer, and Saul the SON[JESUS] of Kish, and Abner
the SON[JESUS] of Ner, and Joab the SON[JESUS] of Zeruiah, had dedicated; and
whoever had dedicated any thing, it was under the hand of Shelomith,
and of HIS[JESUS] brethren.

26:29 Of the Izharites, Chenaniah and HIS[JESUS] sons were for the outward
business over Israel, for officers and judges.

26:30 And of the Hebronites, Hashabiah and HIS[JESUS] brethren, men of valour,
a thousand and seven hundred, were officers among them of Israel on this
side Jordan westward in all the business of the LORD[JESUS], and in the service
of the KING[JESUS].

26:31 Among the Hebronites was Jerijah the chief, even among the
Hebronites, according to the generations of HIS[JESUS] fathers. In the fortieth
year of the reign of David they were sought for, and there were found
among them mighty men of valour at Jazer of Gilead.

26:32 And HIS[JESUS] brethren, men of valour, were two thousand and seven
hundred chief fathers, whom KING[JESUS] David made rulers over the Reubenites,
the Gadites, and the half tribe of Manasseh, for every matter pertaining
to GOD[JESUS], and affairs of the KING[JESUS].


27:1 Now the children of Israel after their number, to wit, the chief
fathers and captains of thousands and hundreds, and their officers that
served the KING[JESUS] in any matter of the courses, which came in and went out
month by month throughout all the months of the year, of every course
were twenty and four thousand.

27:2 Over the first course for the first month was Jashobeam the SON[JESUS] of
Zabdiel: and in HIS[JESUS] course were twenty and four thousand.

27:3 Of the children of Perez was the chief of all the captains of the
host for the first month.

27:4 And over the course of the second month was Dodai an Ahohite, and
of HIS[JESUS] course was Mikloth also the ruler: in HIS[JESUS] course likewise were
twenty and four thousand.

27:5 The third captain of the host for the third month was Benaiah the
SON[JESUS] of Jehoiada, a chief priest: and in HIS[JESUS] course were twenty and four
thousand.

27:6 This is that Benaiah, who was mighty among the thirty, and above
the thirty: and in HIS[JESUS] course was Ammizabad HIS[JESUS] SON[JESUS].

27:7 The fourth captain for the fourth month was Asahel the brother of
Joab, and Zebadiah HIS[JESUS] SON[JESUS] after HIM[JESUS]: and in HIS[JESUS] course were twenty and
four thousand.

27:8 The fifth captain for the fifth month was Shamhuth the Izrahite:
and in HIS[JESUS] course were twenty and four thousand.

27:9 The sixth captain for the sixth month was Ira the SON[JESUS] of Ikkesh the
Tekoite: and in HIS[JESUS] course were twenty and four thousand.

27:10 The seventh captain for the seventh month was Helez the Pelonite,
of the children of Ephraim: and in HIS[JESUS] course were twenty and four
thousand.

27:11 The eighth captain for the eighth month was Sibbecai the
Hushathite, of the Zarhites: and in HIS[JESUS] course were twenty and four
thousand.

27:12 The ninth captain for the ninth month was Abiezer the Anetothite,
of the Benjamites: and in HIS[JESUS] course were twenty and four thousand.

27:13 The tenth captain for the tenth month was Maharai the
Netophathite, of the Zarhites: and in HIS[JESUS] course were twenty and four
thousand.

27:14 The eleventh captain for the eleventh month was Benaiah the
Pirathonite, of the children of Ephraim: and in HIS[JESUS] course were twenty
and four thousand.

27:15 The twelfth captain for the twelfth month was Heldai the
Netophathite, of Othniel: and in HIS[JESUS] course were twenty and four

27:16 Furthermore over the tribes of Israel: the ruler of the Reubenites
was Eliezer the SON[JESUS] of Zichri: of the Simeonites, Shephatiah the SON[JESUS] of
Maachah:

27:17 Of the Levites, Hashabiah the SON[JESUS] of Kemuel: of the Aaronites,
Zadok:

27:18 Of Judah, Elihu, one of the brethren of David: of Issachar, Omri
the SON[JESUS] of Michael:

27:19 Of Zebulun, Ishmaiah the SON[JESUS] of Obadiah: of Naphtali, Jerimoth the
SON[JESUS] of Azriel:

27:20 Of the children of Ephraim, Hoshea the SON[JESUS] of Azaziah: of the half
tribe of Manasseh, Joel the SON[JESUS] of Pedaiah:

27:21 Of the half tribe of Manasseh in Gilead, Iddo the SON[JESUS] of
Zechariah: of Benjamin, Jaasiel the SON[JESUS] of Abner:

27:22 Of Dan, Azareel the SON[JESUS] of Jeroham. These were the princes of the
tribes of Israel.

27:23 But David took not the number of them from twenty years old and
under: because the LORD[JESUS] had said HE[JESUS] would increase Israel like to the
stars of the heavens.

27:24 Joab the SON[JESUS] of Zeruiah began to number, but HE[JESUS] finished not,
because there fell wrath for it against Israel; neither was the number
put in the account of the chronicles of KING[JESUS] David.

27:25 And over the KING[JESUS]'s treasures was Azmaveth the SON[JESUS] of Adiel: and
over the storehouses in the fields, in the cities, and in the villages,
and in the castles, was Jehonathan the SON[JESUS] of Uzziah:

27:26 And over them that did the work of the field for tillage of the
ground was Ezri the SON[JESUS] of Chelub:

27:27 And over the vineyards was Shimei the Ramathite: over the increase
of the vineyards for the wine cellars was Zabdi the Shiphmite:

27:28 And over the olive trees and the sycomore trees that were in the
low plains was Baalhanan the Gederite: and over the cellars of oil was
Joash:

27:29 And over the herds that fed in Sharon was Shitrai the Sharonite:
and over the herds that were in the valleys was Shaphat the SON[JESUS] of
Adlai:

27:30 Over the camels also was Obil the Ishmaelite: and over the asses
was Jehdeiah the Meronothite:

27:31 And over the flocks was Jaziz the Hagerite. All these were the
rulers of the substance which was KING[JESUS] David's.

27:32 Also Jonathan David's uncle was a COUNSELLOR[JESUS], a wise man, and a
scribe: and Jehiel the SON[JESUS] of Hachmoni was with the KING[JESUS]'s sons:

27:33 And Ahithophel was the KING[JESUS]'s COUNSELLOR[JESUS]: and Hushai the Archite
was the KING[JESUS]'s companion:

27:34 And after Ahithophel was Jehoiada the SON[JESUS] of Benaiah, and
Abiathar: and the general of the KING[JESUS]'s army was Joab.


28:1 And David assembled all the princes of Israel, the princes of the
tribes, and the captains of the companies that ministered to the KING[JESUS] by
course, and the captains over the thousands, and captains over the
hundreds, and the stewards over all the substance and possession of the
KING[JESUS], and of HIS[JESUS] sons, with the officers, and with the mighty men, and
with all the valiant men, unto Jerusalem.

28:2 Then David the KING[JESUS] stood up upon HIS[JESUS] feet, and said, Hear me, my
brethren, and my people: As for me, I had in mine heart to build an
house of rest for the ark of the covenant of the LORD[JESUS], and for the
footstool of our GOD[JESUS], and had made ready for the building:

28:3 But GOD[JESUS] said unto me, you shalt not build an house for my name,
because you hast been a man of war, and hast shed blood.

28:4 Howbeit the LORD[JESUS] GOD[JESUS] of Israel chose me before all the house of my
father to be KING[JESUS] over Israel for ever: for HE[JESUS] has chosen Judah to be
the ruler; and of the house of Judah, the house of my father; and among
the sons of my father HE[JESUS] liked me to make me KING[JESUS] over all Israel:

28:5 And of all my sons, (for the LORD[JESUS] has given me many sons,) HE[JESUS] has
chosen Solomon my SON[JESUS] to sit upon the throne of the kingdom of the LORD[JESUS]
over Israel.

28:6 And HE[JESUS] said unto me, Solomon your SON[JESUS], HE[JESUS] shall build my house and
my courts: for I have chosen HIM[JESUS] to be my SON[JESUS], and I will be HIS[JESUS] father.

28:7 Moreover I will establish HIS[JESUS] kingdom for ever, if HE[JESUS] be constant
to do my commandments and my judgments, as at this day.

28:8 Now therefore in the sight of all Israel the congregation of the
LORD[JESUS], and in the audience of our GOD[JESUS], keep and seek for all the
commandments of the LORD[JESUS] your GOD[JESUS]: that you may possess this good land,
and leave it for an inheritance for your children after you for ever.

28:9 And you, Solomon my SON[JESUS], know you the GOD[JESUS] of your father, and
serve HIM[JESUS] with a perfect heart and with a willing mind: for the LORD[JESUS]
searcheth all hearts, and understandeth all the imaginations of the
thoughts: if you seek HIM[JESUS], HE[JESUS] will be found of you; but if you
forsake HIM[JESUS], HE[JESUS] will cast you off for ever.

28:10 Take heed now; for the LORD[JESUS] has chosen you to build an house for
the sanctuary: be strong, and do it.

28:11 Then David gave to Solomon HIS[JESUS] SON[JESUS] the pattern of the porch, and
of the houses thereof, and of the treasuries thereof, and of the upper
chambers thereof, and of the inner parlours thereof, and of the place of
the mercy seat,

28:12 And the pattern of all that HE[JESUS] had by the spirit, of the courts of
the house of the LORD[JESUS], and of all the chambers round about, of the
treasuries of the house of GOD[JESUS], and of the treasuries of the dedicated
things:

28:13 Also for the courses of the priests and the Levites, and for all
the work of the service of the house of the LORD[JESUS], and for all the
vessels of service in the house of the LORD[JESUS].

28:14 HE[JESUS] gave of gold by weight for things of gold, for all instruments
of all manner of service; silver also for all instruments of silver by
weight, for all instruments of every kind of service:

28:15 Even the weight for the candlesticks of gold, and for their lamps
of gold, by weight for every candlestick, and for the lamps thereof: and
for the candlesticks of silver by weight, both for the candlestick, and
also for the lamps thereof, according to the use of every candlestick.

28:16 And by weight HE[JESUS] gave gold for the tables of shewbread, for every
table; and likewise silver for the tables of silver:

28:17 Also pure gold for the fleshhooks, and the bowls, and the cups:
and for the golden basons HE[JESUS] gave gold by weight for every bason; and
likewise silver by weight for every bason of silver:

28:18 And for the altar of incense refined gold by weight; and gold for
the pattern of the chariot of the cherubims, that spread out their
wings, and covered the ark of the covenant of the LORD[JESUS].

28:19 All this, said David, the LORD[JESUS] made me understand in writing by
HIS[JESUS] hand upon me, even all the works of this pattern.

28:20 And David said to Solomon HIS[JESUS] SON[JESUS], Be strong and of good courage,
and do it: fear not, nor be dismayed: for the LORD[JESUS] GOD[JESUS], even my GOD[JESUS],
will be with you; HE[JESUS] will not fail you, nor forsake you, until you
hast finished all the work for the service of the house of the LORD[JESUS].

28:21 And, behold, the courses of the priests and the Levites, even they
shall be with you for all the service of the house of GOD[JESUS]: and there
shall be with you for all manner of workmanship every willing skilful
man, for any manner of service: also the princes and all the people will
be wholly at your commandment.


29:1 Furthermore David the KING[JESUS] said unto all the congregation, Solomon
my SON[JESUS], whom alone GOD[JESUS] has chosen, is yet young and tender, and the
work is great: for the palace is not for man, but for the LORD[JESUS] GOD[JESUS].

29:2 Now I have prepared with all my might for the house of my GOD[JESUS] the
gold for things to be made of gold, and the silver for things of silver,
and the brass for things of brass, the iron for things of iron, and wood
for things of wood; onyx stones, and stones to be set, glistering
stones, and of divers colours, and all manner of precious stones, and
marble stones in abundance.

29:3 Moreover, because I have set my affection to the house of my GOD[JESUS], I
have of mine own proper good, of gold and silver, which I have given to
the house of my GOD[JESUS], over and above all that I have prepared for the
holy house.

29:4 Even three thousand talents of gold, of the gold of Ophir, and
seven thousand talents of refined silver, to overlay the walls of the
houses withal:

29:5 The gold for things of gold, and the silver for things of silver,
and for all manner of work to be made by the hands of artificers. And
who then is willing to consecrate HIS[JESUS] service this day unto the LORD[JESUS]?

29:6 Then the chief of the fathers and princes of the tribes of Israel
and the captains of thousands and of hundreds, with the rulers of the
KING[JESUS]'s work, offered willingly,

29:7 And gave for the service of the house of GOD[JESUS] of gold five thousand
talents and ten thousand drams, and of silver ten thousand talents, and
of brass eighteen thousand talents, and one hundred thousand talents of
iron.

29:8 And they with whom precious stones were found gave them to the
treasure of the house of the LORD[JESUS], by the hand of Jehiel the Gershonite.

29:9 Then the people rejoiced, for that they offered willingly, because
with perfect heart they offered willingly to the LORD[JESUS]: and David the
KING[JESUS] also rejoiced with great joy.

29:10 Wherefore David blessed the LORD[JESUS] before all the congregation: and
David said, Blessed be you, LORD[JESUS] GOD[JESUS] of Israel our father, for ever and
ever.

29:11 yours, O LORD[JESUS] is the greatness, and the power, and the glory, and
the victory, and the majesty: for all that is in the heaven and in the
earth is yours; yours is the kingdom, O LORD[JESUS], and you art exalted as
head above all.

29:12 Both riches and honour come of you, and you reignest over all;
and in yours hand is power and might; and in yours hand it is to make
great, and to give strength unto all.

29:13 Now therefore, our GOD[JESUS], we thank you, and praise your glorious
name.

29:14 But who am I, and what is my people, that we should be able to
offer so willingly after this sort? for all things come of you, and of
yours own have we given you.

29:15 For we are strangers before you, and sojourners, as were all our
fathers: our days on the earth are as a shadow, and there is none
abiding.

29:16 O LORD[JESUS] our GOD[JESUS], all this store that we have prepared to build you
an house for yours holy name comes of yours hand, and is all yours own.

29:17 I know also, my GOD[JESUS], that you triest the heart, and hast pleasure
in uprightness. As for me, in the uprightness of mine heart I have
willingly offered all these things: and now have I seen with joy your
people, which are present here, to offer willingly unto you.

29:18 O LORD[JESUS] GOD[JESUS] of Abraham, Isaac, and of Israel, our fathers, keep
this for ever in the imagination of the thoughts of the heart of your
people, and prepare their heart unto you:

29:19 And give unto Solomon my SON[JESUS] a perfect heart, to keep your
commandments, your testimonies, and your statutes, and to do all these
things, and to build the palace, for the which I have made provision.

29:20 And David said to all the congregation, Now bless the LORD[JESUS] your
GOD[JESUS]. And all the congregation blessed the LORD[JESUS] GOD[JESUS] of their fathers, and
bowed down their heads, and worshipped the LORD[JESUS], and the KING[JESUS].

29:21 And they sacrificed sacrifices unto the LORD[JESUS], and offered burnt
offerings unto the LORD[JESUS], on the morrow after that day, even a thousand
bullocks, a thousand rams, and a thousand lambs, with their drink
offerings, and sacrifices in abundance for all Israel:

29:22 And did eat and drink before the LORD[JESUS] on that day with great
gladness. And they made Solomon the SON[JESUS] of David KING[JESUS] the second time,
and anointed HIM[JESUS] unto the LORD[JESUS] to be the chief governor, and Zadok to be
priest.

29:23 Then Solomon sat on the throne of the LORD[JESUS] as KING[JESUS] instead of
David HIS[JESUS] father, and prospered; and all Israel obeyed HIM[JESUS].

29:24 And all the princes, and the mighty men, and all the sons likewise
of KING[JESUS] David, submitted themselves unto Solomon the KING[JESUS].

29:25 And the LORD[JESUS] magnified Solomon exceedingly in the sight of all
Israel, and bestowed upon HIM[JESUS] such royal majesty as had not been on any
KING[JESUS] before HIM[JESUS] in Israel.

29:26 Thus David the SON[JESUS] of Jesse reigned over all Israel.

29:27 And the time that HE[JESUS] reigned over Israel was forty years; seven
years reigned HE[JESUS] in Hebron, and thirty and three years reigned HE[JESUS] in
Jerusalem.

29:28 And HE[JESUS] died in a good old age, full of days, riches, and honour:
and Solomon HIS[JESUS] SON[JESUS] reigned in HIS[JESUS] stead.

29:29 Now the acts of David the KING[JESUS], first and last, behold, they are
written in the book of Samuel the seer, and in the book of Nathan the
PROPHET[JESUS], and in the book of Gad the seer,

29:30 With all HIS[JESUS] reign and HIS[JESUS] might, and the times that went over
HIM[JESUS], and over Israel, and over all the kingdoms of the countries.

1:1 And Solomon the SON[JESUS] of David was strengthened in HIS[JESUS] kingdom, and
the LORD[JESUS] HIS[JESUS] GOD[JESUS] was with HIM[JESUS], and magnified HIM[JESUS] exceedingly.

1:2 Then Solomon spake unto all Israel, to the captains of thousands and
of hundreds, and to the judges, and to every governor in all Israel, the
chief of the fathers.

1:3 So Solomon, and all the congregation with HIM[JESUS], went to the high
place that was at Gibeon; for there was the tabernacle of the
congregation of GOD[JESUS], which Moses the SERVANT[JESUS] of the LORD[JESUS] had made in the
wilderness.

1:4 But the ark of GOD[JESUS] had David brought up from Kirjathjearim to the
place which David had prepared for it: for HE[JESUS] had pitched a tent for it
at Jerusalem.

1:5 Moreover the brasen altar, that Bezaleel the SON[JESUS] of Uri, the SON[JESUS] of
Hur, had made, HE[JESUS] put before the tabernacle of the LORD[JESUS]: and Solomon and
the congregation sought unto it.

1:6 And Solomon went up thither to the brasen altar before the LORD[JESUS],
which was at the tabernacle of the congregation, and offered a thousand
burnt offerings upon it.

1:7 In that night did GOD[JESUS] appear unto Solomon, and said unto HIM[JESUS], Ask
what I shall give you.

1:8 And Solomon said unto GOD[JESUS], you hast shewed great mercy unto David
my father, and hast made me to reign in HIS[JESUS] stead.

1:9 Now, O LORD[JESUS] GOD[JESUS], let your promise unto David my father be
established: for you hast made me KING[JESUS] over a people like the dust of
the earth in multitude.

1:10 Give me now wisdom and knowledge, that I may go out and come in
before this people: for who can judge this your people, that is so great?

1:11 And GOD[JESUS] said to Solomon, Because this was in yours heart, and you
hast not asked riches, wealth, or honour, nor the life of yours enemies,
neither yet hast asked long life; but hast asked wisdom and knowledge
for thyself, that you mayest judge my people, over whom I have made
you KING[JESUS]:

1:12 Wisdom and knowledge is granted unto you; and I will give you
riches, and wealth, and honour, such as none of the kings have had that
have been before you, neither shall there any after you have the like.

1:13 Then Solomon came from HIS[JESUS] journey to the high place that was at
Gibeon to Jerusalem, from before the tabernacle of the congregation, and
reigned over Israel.

1:14 And Solomon gathered chariots and horsemen: and HE[JESUS] had a thousand
and four hundred chariots, and twelve thousand horsemen, which HE[JESUS] placed
in the chariot cities, and with the KING[JESUS] at Jerusalem.

1:15 And the KING[JESUS] made silver and gold at Jerusalem as plenteous as
stones, and cedar trees made HE[JESUS] as the sycomore trees that are in the
vale for abundance.

1:16 And Solomon had horses brought out of Egypt, and linen yarn: the
KING[JESUS]'s merchants received the linen yarn at a price.

1:17 And they fetched up, and brought forth out of Egypt a chariot for
six hundred shekels of silver, and an horse for an hundred and fifty:
and so brought they out horses for all the kings of the Hittites, and
for the kings of Syria, by their means.


2:1 And Solomon determined to build an house for the name of the LORD[JESUS],
and an house for HIS[JESUS] kingdom.

2:2 And Solomon told out threescore and ten thousand men to bear
burdens, and fourscore thousand to hew in the mountain, and three
thousand and six hundred to oversee them.

2:3 And Solomon sent to Huram the KING[JESUS] of Tyre, saying, As you didst
deal with David my father, and didst send HIM[JESUS] cedars to build HIM[JESUS] an
house to dwell therein, even so deal with me.

2:4 Behold, I build an house to the name of the LORD[JESUS] my GOD[JESUS], to dedicate
it to HIM[JESUS], and to burn before HIM[JESUS] sweet incense, and for the continual
shewbread, and for the burnt offerings morning and evening, on the
sabbaths, and on the new moons, and on the solemn feasts of the LORD[JESUS] our
GOD[JESUS]. This is an ordinance for ever to Israel.

2:5 And the house which I build is great: for great is our GOD[JESUS] above all
gods.

2:6 But who is able to build HIM[JESUS] an house, seeing the heaven and heaven
of heavens cannot contain HIM[JESUS]? who am I then, that I should build HIM[JESUS] an
house, save only to burn sacrifice before HIM[JESUS]?

2:7 Send me now therefore a man cunning to work in gold, and in silver,
and in brass, and in iron, and in purple, and crimson, and blue, and
that can skill to grave with the cunning men that are with me in Judah
and in Jerusalem, whom David my father did provide.

2:8 Send me also cedar trees, fir trees, and algum trees, out of
Lebanon: for I know that your servants can skill to cut timber in
Lebanon; and, behold, my servants shall be with your servants,

2:9 Even to prepare me timber in abundance: for the house which I am
about to build shall be WONDERFUL[JESUS] great.

2:10 And, behold, I will give to your servants, the hewers that cut
timber, twenty thousand measures of beaten wheat, and twenty thousand
measures of barley, and twenty thousand baths of wine, and twenty
thousand baths of oil.

2:11 Then Huram the KING[JESUS] of Tyre answered in writing, which HE[JESUS] sent to
Solomon, Because the LORD[JESUS] has loved HIS[JESUS] people, HE[JESUS] has made you KING[JESUS]
over them.

2:12 Huram said moreover, Blessed be the LORD[JESUS] GOD[JESUS] of Israel, that made
heaven and earth, who has given to David the KING[JESUS] a wise SON[JESUS], endued
with prudence and understanding, that might build an house for the LORD[JESUS],
and an house for HIS[JESUS] kingdom.

2:13 And now I have sent a cunning man, endued with understanding, of
Huram my father's,

2:14 The SON[JESUS] of a woman of the daughters of Dan, and HIS[JESUS] father was a
man of Tyre, skilful to work in gold, and in silver, in brass, in iron,
in stone, and in timber, in purple, in blue, and in fine linen, and in
crimson; also to grave any manner of graving, and to find out every
device which shall be put to HIM[JESUS], with your cunning men, and with the
cunning men of my LORD[JESUS] David your father.

2:15 Now therefore the wheat, and the barley, the oil, and the wine,
which my LORD[JESUS] has spoken of, let HIM[JESUS] send unto HIS[JESUS] servants:

2:16 And we will cut wood out of Lebanon, as much as you shalt need:
and we will bring it to you in floats by sea to Joppa; and you shalt
carry it up to Jerusalem.

2:17 And Solomon numbered all the strangers that were in the land of
Israel, after the numbering wherewith David HIS[JESUS] father had numbered
them; and they were found an hundred and fifty thousand and three
thousand and six hundred.

2:18 And HE[JESUS] set threescore and ten thousand of them to be bearers of
burdens, and fourscore thousand to be hewers in the mountain, and three
thousand and six hundred overseers to set the people a work.


3:1 Then Solomon began to build the house of the LORD[JESUS] at Jerusalem in
mount Moriah, where the LORD[JESUS] appeared unto David HIS[JESUS] father, in the
place that David had prepared in the threshingfloor of Ornan the
Jebusite.

3:2 And HE[JESUS] began to build in the second day of the second month, in the
fourth year of HIS[JESUS] reign.

3:3 Now these are the things wherein Solomon was instructed for the
building of the house of GOD[JESUS]. The length by cubits after the first
measure was threescore cubits, and the breadth twenty cubits.

3:4 And the porch that was in the front of the house, the length of it
was according to the breadth of the house, twenty cubits, and the height
was an hundred and twenty: and HE[JESUS] overlaid it within with pure gold.

3:5 And the greater house HE[JESUS] cieled with fir tree, which HE[JESUS] overlaid
with fine gold, and set thereon palm trees and chains.

3:6 And HE[JESUS] garnished the house with precious stones for beauty: and the
gold was gold of Parvaim.

3:7 HE[JESUS] overlaid also the house, the beams, the posts, and the walls
thereof, and the doors thereof, with gold; and graved cherubims on the
walls.

3:8 And HE[JESUS] made the most holy house, the length whereof was according to
the breadth of the house, twenty cubits, and the breadth thereof twenty
cubits: and HE[JESUS] overlaid it with fine gold, amounting to six hundred
talents.

3:9 And the weight of the nails was fifty shekels of gold. And HE[JESUS]
overlaid the upper chambers with gold.

3:10 And in the most holy house HE[JESUS] made two cherubims of image work, and
overlaid them with gold.

3:11 And the wings of the cherubims were twenty cubits long: one wing of
the one cherub was five cubits, reaching to the wall of the house: and
the other wing was likewise five cubits, reaching to the wing of the
other cherub.

3:12 And one wing of the other cherub was five cubits, reaching to the
wall of the house: and the other wing was five cubits also, joining to
the wing of the other cherub.

3:13 The wings of these cherubims spread themselves forth twenty cubits:
and they stood on their feet, and their faces were inward.

3:14 And HE[JESUS] made the vail of blue, and purple, and crimson, and fine
linen, and wrought cherubims thereon.

3:15 Also HE[JESUS] made before the house two pillars of thirty and five cubits
high, and the chapiter that was on the top of each of them was five
cubits.
