3:16 And HE[JESUS] made chains, as in the oracle, and put them on the heads of
the pillars; and made an hundred pomegranates, and put them on the
chains.

3:17 And HE[JESUS] reared up the pillars before the temple, one on the right
hand, and the other on the left; and called the name of that on the
right hand Jachin, and the name of that on the left Boaz.


4:1 Moreover HE[JESUS] made an altar of brass, twenty cubits the length
thereof, and twenty cubits the breadth thereof, and ten cubits the
height thereof.

4:2 Also HE[JESUS] made a molten sea of ten cubits from brim to brim, round in
compass, and five cubits the height thereof; and a line of thirty cubits
did compass it round about.

4:3 And under it was the similitude of oxen, which did compass it round
about: ten in a cubit, compassing the sea round about. Two rows of oxen
were cast, when it was cast.

4:4 It stood upon twelve oxen, three looking toward the north, and three
looking toward the west, and three looking toward the south, and three
looking toward the east: and the sea was set above upon them, and all
their hinder parts were inward.

4:5 And the thickness of it was an handbreadth, and the brim of it like
the work of the brim of a cup, with flowers of lilies; and it received
and held three thousand baths.

4:6 HE[JESUS] made also ten lavers, and put five on the right hand, and five on
the left, to wash in them: such things as they offered for the burnt
offering they washed in them; but the sea was for the priests to wash
in.

4:7 And HE[JESUS] made ten candlesticks of gold according to their form, and
set them in the temple, five on the right hand, and five on the left.

4:8 HE[JESUS] made also ten tables, and placed them in the temple, five on the
right side, and five on the left. And HE[JESUS] made an hundred basons of gold.

4:9 Furthermore HE[JESUS] made the court of the priests, and the great court,
and doors for the court, and overlaid the doors of them with brass.

4:10 And HE[JESUS] set the sea on the right side of the east end, over against
the south.

4:11 And Huram made the pots, and the shovels, and the basons. And Huram
finished the work that HE[JESUS] was to make for KING[JESUS] Solomon for the house of
GOD[JESUS];

4:12 To wit, the two pillars, and the pommels, and the chapiters which
were on the top of the two pillars, and the two wreaths to cover the two
pommels of the chapiters which were on the top of the pillars;

4:13 And four hundred pomegranates on the two wreaths; two rows of
pomegranates on each wreath, to cover the two pommels of the chapiters
which were upon the pillars.

4:14 HE[JESUS] made also bases, and lavers made HE[JESUS] upon the bases;

4:15 One sea, and twelve oxen under it.

4:16 The pots also, and the shovels, and the fleshhooks, and all their
instruments, did Huram HIS[JESUS] father make to KING[JESUS] Solomon for the house of
the LORD[JESUS] of bright brass.

4:17 In the plain of Jordan did the KING[JESUS] cast them, in the clay ground
between Succoth and Zeredathah.

4:18 Thus Solomon made all these vessels in great abundance: for the
weight of the brass could not be found out.

4:19 And Solomon made all the vessels that were for the house of GOD[JESUS],
the golden altar also, and the tables whereon the shewbread was set;

4:20 Moreover the candlesticks with their lamps, that they should burn
after the manner before the oracle, of pure gold;

4:21 And the flowers, and the lamps, and the tongs, made HE[JESUS] of gold, and
that perfect gold;

4:22 And the snuffers, and the basons, and the spoons, and the censers,
of pure gold: and the entry of the house, the inner doors thereof for
the most holy place, and the doors of the house of the temple, were of
gold.


5:1 Thus all the work that Solomon made for the house of the LORD[JESUS] was
finished: and Solomon brought in all the things that David HIS[JESUS] father
had dedicated; and the silver, and the gold, and all the instruments,
put HE[JESUS] among the treasures of the house of GOD[JESUS].

5:2 Then Solomon assembled the elders of Israel, and all the heads of
the tribes, the chief of the fathers of the children of Israel, unto
Jerusalem, to bring up the ark of the covenant of the LORD[JESUS] out of the
city of David, which is Zion.

5:3 Wherefore all the men of Israel assembled themselves unto the KING[JESUS]
in the feast which was in the seventh month.

5:4 And all the elders of Israel came; and the Levites took up the ark.

5:5 And they brought up the ark, and the tabernacle of the congregation,
and all the holy vessels that were in the tabernacle, these did the
priests and the Levites bring up.

5:6 Also KING[JESUS] Solomon, and all the congregation of Israel that were
assembled unto HIM[JESUS] before the ark, sacrificed sheep and oxen, which
could not be told nor numbered for multitude.

5:7 And the priests brought in the ark of the covenant of the LORD[JESUS] unto
HIS[JESUS] place, to the oracle of the house, into the most holy place, even
under the wings of the cherubims:

5:8 For the cherubims spread forth their wings over the place of the
ark, and the cherubims covered the ark and the staves thereof above.

5:9 And they drew out the staves of the ark, that the ends of the staves
were seen from the ark before the oracle; but they were not seen
without. And there it is unto this day.

5:10 There was nothing in the ark save the two tables which Moses put
therein at Horeb, when the LORD[JESUS] made a covenant with the children of
Israel, when they came out of Egypt.

5:11 And it came to pass, when the priests were come out of the holy
place: (for all the priests that were present were sanctified, and did
not then wait by course:

5:12 Also the Levites which were the singers, all of them of Asaph, of
Heman, of Jeduthun, with their sons and their brethren, being arrayed in
white linen, having cymbals and psalteries and harps, stood at the east
end of the altar, and with them an hundred and twenty priests sounding
with trumpets:)

5:13 It came even to pass, as the trumpeters and singers were as one, to
make one sound to be heard in praising and thanking the LORD[JESUS]; and when
they lifted up their voice with the trumpets and cymbals and instruments
of musick, and praised the LORD[JESUS], saying, For HE[JESUS] is good; for HIS[JESUS] mercy
endureth for ever: that then the house was filled with a cloud, even the
house of the LORD[JESUS];

5:14 So that the priests could not stand to minister by reason of the
cloud: for the glory of the LORD[JESUS] had filled the house of GOD[JESUS].


6:1 Then said Solomon, The LORD[JESUS] has said that HE[JESUS] would dwell in the
thick darkness.

6:2 But I have built an house of habitation for you, and a place for
your dwelling for ever.

6:3 And the KING[JESUS] turned HIS[JESUS] face, and blessed the whole congregation of
Israel: and all the congregation of Israel stood.

6:4 And HE[JESUS] said, Blessed be the LORD[JESUS] GOD[JESUS] of Israel, who has with HIS[JESUS]
hands fulfilled that which HE[JESUS] spake with HIS[JESUS] mouth to my father David,
saying,

6:5 Since the day that I brought forth my people out of the land of
Egypt I chose no city among all the tribes of Israel to build an house
in, that my name might be there; neither chose I any man to be a ruler
over my people Israel:

6:6 But I have chosen Jerusalem, that my name might be there; and have
chosen David to be over my people Israel.

6:7 Now it was in the heart of David my father to build an house for the
name of the LORD[JESUS] GOD[JESUS] of Israel.

6:8 But the LORD[JESUS] said to David my father, Forasmuch as it was in yours
heart to build an house for my name, you didst well in that it was in
yours heart:

6:9 Notwithstanding you shalt not build the house; but your SON[JESUS] which
shall come forth out of your loins, HE[JESUS] shall build the house for my name.

6:10 The LORD[JESUS] therefore has performed HIS[JESUS] WORD[JESUS] that HE[JESUS] has spoken: for
I am risen up in the room of David my father, and am set on the throne
of Israel, as the LORD[JESUS] promised, and have built the house for the name
of the LORD[JESUS] GOD[JESUS] of Israel.

6:11 And in it have I put the ark, wherein is the covenant of the LORD[JESUS],
that HE[JESUS] made with the children of Israel.

6:12 And HE[JESUS] stood before the altar of the LORD[JESUS] in the presence of all
the congregation of Israel, and spread forth HIS[JESUS] hands:

6:13 For Solomon had made a brasen scaffold of five cubits long, and
five cubits broad, and three cubits high, and had set it in the midst of
the court: and upon it HE[JESUS] stood, and kneeled down upon HIS[JESUS] knees before
all the congregation of Israel, and spread forth HIS[JESUS] hands toward
heaven.

6:14 And said, O LORD[JESUS] GOD[JESUS] of Israel, there is no GOD[JESUS] like you in the
heaven, nor in the earth; which keepest covenant, and shewest mercy unto
your servants, that walk before you with all their hearts:

6:15 you which hast kept with your SERVANT[JESUS] David my father that which
you hast promised HIM[JESUS]; and spakest with your mouth, and hast fulfilled
it with yours hand, as it is this day.

6:16 Now therefore, O LORD[JESUS] GOD[JESUS] of Israel, keep with your SERVANT[JESUS] David my
father that which you hast promised HIM[JESUS], saying, There shall not fail
you a man in my sight to sit upon the throne of Israel; yet so that your
children take heed to their way to walk in my law, as you hast walked
before me.

6:17 Now then, O LORD[JESUS] GOD[JESUS] of Israel, let your WORD[JESUS] be verified, which
you hast spoken unto your SERVANT[JESUS] David.

6:18 But will GOD[JESUS] in very deed dwell with men on the earth? behold,
heaven and the heaven of heavens cannot contain you; how much less this
house which I have built!

6:19 Have respect therefore to the prayer of your SERVANT[JESUS], and to HIS[JESUS]
supplication, O LORD[JESUS] my GOD[JESUS], to hearken unto the cry and the prayer
which your SERVANT[JESUS] prayeth before you:

6:20 That yours eyes may be open upon this house day and night, upon the
place whereof you hast said that you wouldest put your name there; to
hearken unto the prayer which your SERVANT[JESUS] prayeth toward this place.

6:21 Hearken therefore unto the supplications of your SERVANT[JESUS], and of your
people Israel, which they shall make toward this place: hear you from
your dwelling place, even from heaven; and when you hearest, forgive.

6:22 If a man sin against HIS[JESUS] neighbour, and an oath be laid upon HIM[JESUS] to
make HIM[JESUS] swear, and the oath come before yours altar in this house;

6:23 Then hear you from heaven, and do, and judge your servants, by
requiting the wicked, by recompensing HIS[JESUS] way upon HIS[JESUS] own head; and by
justifying the righteous, by giving HIM[JESUS] according to HIS[JESUS] righteousness.

6:24 And if your people Israel be put to the worse before the enemy,
because they have sinned against you; and shall return and confess your
name, and pray and make supplication before you in this house;

6:25 Then hear you from the heavens, and forgive the sin of your people
Israel, and bring them again unto the land which you gavest to them and
to their fathers.

6:26 When the heaven is shut up, and there is no rain, because they have
sinned against you; yet if they pray toward this place, and confess your
name, and turn from their sin, when you dost afflict them;

6:27 Then hear you from heaven, and forgive the sin of your servants,
and of your people Israel, when you hast taught them the good way,
wherein they should walk; and send rain upon your land, which you hast
given unto your people for an inheritance.

6:28 If there be dearth in the land, if there be pestilence, if there be
blasting, or mildew, locusts, or caterpillers; if their enemies besiege
them in the cities of their land; whatsoever sore or whatsoever sickness
there be:

6:29 Then what prayer or what supplication soever shall be made of any
man, or of all your people Israel, when every one shall know HIS[JESUS] own sore
and HIS[JESUS] own grief, and shall spread forth HIS[JESUS] hands in this house:

6:30 Then hear you from heaven your dwelling place, and forgive, and
render unto every man according unto all HIS[JESUS] ways, whose heart you
knowest; (for you only knowest the hearts of the children of men:)

6:31 That they may fear you, to walk in your ways, so long as they live
in the land which you gavest unto our fathers.

6:32 Moreover concerning the stranger, which is not of your people
Israel, but is come from a far country for your great name's sake, and
your mighty hand, and your stretched out arm; if they come and pray in
this house;

6:33 Then hear you from the heavens, even from your dwelling place, and
do according to all that the stranger calleth to you for; that all
people of the earth may know your name, and fear you, as does your people
Israel, and may know that this house which I have built is called by your
name.

6:34 If your people go out to war against their enemies by the way that
you shalt send them, and they pray unto you toward this city which
you hast chosen, and the house which I have built for your name;

6:35 Then hear you from the heavens their prayer and their
supplication, and maintain their cause.

6:36 If they sin against you, (for there is no man which sinneth not,)
and you be angry with them, and deliver them over before their enemies,
and they carry them away captives unto a land far off or near;

6:37 Yet if they bethink themselves in the land whither they are carried
captive, and turn and pray unto you in the land of their captivity,
saying, We have sinned, we have done amiss, and have dealt wickedly;

6:38 If they return to you with all their heart and with all their soul
in the land of their captivity, whither they have carried them captives,
and pray toward their land, which you gavest unto their fathers, and
toward the city which you hast chosen, and toward the house which I
have built for your name:

6:39 Then hear you from the heavens, even from your dwelling place,
their prayer and their supplications, and maintain their cause, and
forgive your people which have sinned against you.

6:40 Now, my GOD[JESUS], let, I beseech you, yours eyes be open, and let yours
ears be attent unto the prayer that is made in this place.

6:41 Now therefore arise, O LORD[JESUS] GOD[JESUS], into your resting place, you, and
the ark of your strength: let your priests, O LORD[JESUS] GOD[JESUS], be clothed with
salvation, and let your saints rejoice in goodness.

6:42 O LORD[JESUS] GOD[JESUS], turn not away the face of yours anointed: remember the
mercies of David your SERVANT[JESUS].


7:1 Now when Solomon had made an end of praying, the fire came down from
heaven, and consumed the burnt offering and the sacrifices; and the
glory of the LORD[JESUS] filled the house.

7:2 And the priests could not enter into the house of the LORD[JESUS], because
the glory of the LORD[JESUS] had filled the LORD[JESUS]'s house.

7:3 And when all the children of Israel saw how the fire came down, and
the glory of the LORD[JESUS] upon the house, they bowed themselves with their
faces to the ground upon the pavement, and worshipped, and praised the
LORD[JESUS], saying, For HE[JESUS] is good; for HIS[JESUS] mercy endureth for ever.

7:4 Then the KING[JESUS] and all the people offered sacrifices before the LORD[JESUS].

7:5 And KING[JESUS] Solomon offered a sacrifice of twenty and two thousand
oxen, and an hundred and twenty thousand sheep: so the KING[JESUS] and all the
people dedicated the house of GOD[JESUS].

7:6 And the priests waited on their offices: the Levites also with
instruments of musick of the LORD[JESUS], which David the KING[JESUS] had made to
praise the LORD[JESUS], because HIS[JESUS] mercy endureth for ever, when David praised
by their ministry; and the priests sounded trumpets before them, and all
Israel stood.

7:7 Moreover Solomon hallowed the middle of the court that was before
the house of the LORD[JESUS]: for there HE[JESUS] offered burnt offerings, and the fat
of the peace offerings, because the brasen altar which Solomon had made
was not able to receive the burnt offerings, and the meat offerings, and
the fat.

7:8 Also at the same time Solomon kept the feast seven days, and all
Israel with HIM[JESUS], a very great congregation, from the entering in of
Hamath unto the river of Egypt.

7:9 And in the eighth day they made a solemn assembly: for they kept the
dedication of the altar seven days, and the feast seven days.

7:10 And on the three and twentieth day of the seventh month HE[JESUS] sent the
people away into their tents, glad and merry in heart for the goodness
that the LORD[JESUS] had shewed unto David, and to Solomon, and to Israel HIS[JESUS]
people.

7:11 Thus Solomon finished the house of the LORD[JESUS], and the KING[JESUS]'s house:
and all that came into Solomon's heart to make in the house of the LORD[JESUS],
and in HIS[JESUS] own house, HE[JESUS] prosperously effected.

7:12 And the LORD[JESUS] appeared to Solomon by night, and said unto HIM[JESUS], I
have heard your prayer, and have chosen this place to myself for an house
of sacrifice.

7:13 If I shut up heaven that there be no rain, or if I command the
locusts to devour the land, or if I send pestilence among my people;

7:14 If my people, which are called by my name, shall humble themselves,
and pray, and seek my face, and turn from their wicked ways; then will I
hear from heaven, and will forgive their sin, and will heal their land.

7:15 Now mine eyes shall be open, and mine ears attent unto the prayer
that is made in this place.

7:16 For now have I chosen and sanctified this house, that my name may
be there for ever: and mine eyes and mine heart shall be there
perpetually.

7:17 And as for you, if you wilt walk before me, as David your father
walked, and do according to all that I have commanded you, and shalt
observe my statutes and my judgments;

7:18 Then will I stablish the throne of your kingdom, according as I have
covenanted with David your father, saying, There shall not fail you a
man to be ruler in Israel.

7:19 But if you turn away, and forsake my statutes and my commandments,
which I have set before you, and shall go and serve other gods, and
worship them;

7:20 Then will I pluck them up by the roots out of my land which I have
given them; and this house, which I have sanctified for my name, will I
cast out of my sight, and will make it to be a proverb and a byword
among all nations.

7:21 And this house, which is high, shall be an astonishment to every
one that passeth by it; so that HE[JESUS] shall say, Why has the LORD[JESUS] done
thus unto this land, and unto this house?

7:22 And it shall be answered, Because they forsook the LORD[JESUS] GOD[JESUS] of
their fathers, which brought them forth out of the land of Egypt, and
laid hold on other gods, and worshipped them, and served them: therefore
has HE[JESUS] brought all this evil upon them.


8:1 And it came to pass at the end of twenty years, wherein Solomon had
built the house of the LORD[JESUS], and HIS[JESUS] own house,

8:2 That the cities which Huram had restored to Solomon, Solomon built
them, and caused the children of Israel to dwell there.

8:3 And Solomon went to Hamathzobah, and prevailed against it.

8:4 And HE[JESUS] built Tadmor in the wilderness, and all the store cities,
which HE[JESUS] built in Hamath.

8:5 Also HE[JESUS] built Bethhoron the upper, and Bethhoron the nether, fenced
cities, with walls, gates, and bars;

8:6 And Baalath, and all the store cities that Solomon had, and all the
chariot cities, and the cities of the horsemen, and all that Solomon
desired to build in Jerusalem, and in Lebanon, and throughout all the
land of HIS[JESUS] dominion.

8:7 As for all the people that were left of the Hittites, and the
Amorites, and the Perizzites, and the Hivites, and the Jebusites, which
were not of Israel,

8:8 But of their children, who were left after them in the land, whom
the children of Israel consumed not, them did Solomon make to pay
tribute until this day.

8:9 But of the children of Israel did Solomon make no servants for HIS[JESUS]
work; but they were men of war, and chief of HIS[JESUS] captains, and captains
of HIS[JESUS] chariots and horsemen.

8:10 And these were the chief of KING[JESUS] Solomon's officers, even two
hundred and fifty, that bare rule over the people.

8:11 And Solomon brought up the daughter of Pharaoh out of the city of
David unto the house that HE[JESUS] had built for her: for HE[JESUS] said, My wife
shall not dwell in the house of David KING[JESUS] of Israel, because the places
are holy, whereunto the ark of the LORD[JESUS] has come.

8:12 Then Solomon offered burnt offerings unto the LORD[JESUS] on the altar of
the LORD[JESUS], which HE[JESUS] had built before the porch,

8:13 Even after a certain rate every day, offering according to the
commandment of Moses, on the sabbaths, and on the new moons, and on the
solemn feasts, three times in the year, even in the feast of unleavened
bread, and in the feast of weeks, and in the feast of tabernacles.

8:14 And HE[JESUS] appointed, according to the order of David HIS[JESUS] father, the
courses of the priests to their service, and the Levites to their
charges, to praise and minister before the priests, as the duty of every
day required: the porters also by their courses at every gate: for so
had David the man of GOD[JESUS] commanded.

8:15 And they departed not from the commandment of the KING[JESUS] unto the
priests and Levites concerning any matter, or concerning the treasures.

8:16 Now all the work of Solomon was prepared unto the day of the
foundation of the house of the LORD[JESUS], and until it was finished. So the
house of the LORD[JESUS] was perfected.

8:17 Then went Solomon to Eziongeber, and to Eloth, at the sea side in
the land of Edom.

8:18 And Huram sent HIM[JESUS] by the hands of HIS[JESUS] servants ships, and servants
that had knowledge of the sea; and they went with the servants of
Solomon to Ophir, and took thence four hundred and fifty talents of
gold, and brought them to KING[JESUS] Solomon.


9:1 And when the queen of Sheba heard of the fame of Solomon, she came
to prove Solomon with hard questions at Jerusalem, with a very great
company, and camels that bare spices, and gold in abundance, and
precious stones: and when she was come to Solomon, she communed with HIM[JESUS]
of all that was in her heart.

9:2 And Solomon told her all her questions: and there was nothing hid
from Solomon which HE[JESUS] told her not.

9:3 And when the queen of Sheba had seen the wisdom of Solomon, and the
house that HE[JESUS] had built,

9:4 And the meat of HIS[JESUS] table, and the sitting of HIS[JESUS] servants, and the
attendance of HIS[JESUS] ministers, and their apparel; HIS[JESUS] cupbearers also, and
their apparel; and HIS[JESUS] ascent by which HE[JESUS] went up into the house of the
LORD[JESUS]; there was no more spirit in her.

9:5 And she said to the KING[JESUS], It was a true report which I heard in mine
own land of yours acts, and of your wisdom:

9:6 Howbeit I believed not their words, until I came, and mine eyes had
seen it: and, behold, the one half of the greatness of your wisdom was
not told me: for you exceedest the fame that I heard.

9:7 Happy are your men, and happy are these your servants, which stand
continually before you, and hear your wisdom.

9:8 Blessed be the LORD[JESUS] your GOD[JESUS], which delighted in you to set you on
HIS[JESUS] throne, to be KING[JESUS] for the LORD[JESUS] your GOD[JESUS]: because your GOD[JESUS] loved
Israel, to establish them for ever, therefore made HE[JESUS] you KING[JESUS] over
them, to do judgment and justice.

9:9 And she gave the KING[JESUS] an hundred and twenty talents of gold, and of
spices great abundance, and precious stones: neither was there any such
spice as the queen of Sheba gave KING[JESUS] Solomon.

9:10 And the servants also of Huram, and the servants of Solomon, which
brought gold from Ophir, brought algum trees and precious stones.

9:11 And the KING[JESUS] made of the algum trees terraces to the house of the
LORD[JESUS], and to the KING[JESUS]'s palace, and harps and psalteries for singers:
and there were none such seen before in the land of Judah.

9:12 And KING[JESUS] Solomon gave to the queen of Sheba all her desire,
whatsoever she asked, beside that which she had brought unto the KING[JESUS].
So she turned, and went away to her own land, she and her servants.

9:13 Now the weight of gold that came to Solomon in one year was six
hundred and threescore and six talents of gold;

9:14 Beside that which chapmen and merchants brought. And all the kings
of Arabia and governors of the country brought gold and silver to
Solomon.

9:15 And KING[JESUS] Solomon made two hundred targets of beaten gold: six
hundred shekels of beaten gold went to one target.

9:16 And three hundred shields made HE[JESUS] of beaten gold: three hundred
shekels of gold went to one shield. And the KING[JESUS] put them in the house
of the forest of Lebanon.

9:17 Moreover the KING[JESUS] made a great throne of ivory, and overlaid it
with pure gold.

9:18 And there were six steps to the throne, with a footstool of gold,
which were fastened to the throne, and stays on each side of the sitting
place, and two lions standing by the stays:

9:19 And twelve lions stood there on the one side and on the other upon
the six steps. There was not the like made in any kingdom.

9:20 And all the drinking vessels of KING[JESUS] Solomon were of gold, and all
the vessels of the house of the forest of Lebanon were of pure gold:
none were of silver; it was not any thing accounted of in the days of
Solomon.

9:21 For the KING[JESUS]'s ships went to Tarshish with the servants of Huram:
every three years once came the ships of Tarshish bringing gold, and
silver, ivory, and apes, and peacocks.

9:22 And KING[JESUS] Solomon passed all the kings of the earth in riches and
wisdom.

9:23 And all the kings of the earth sought the presence of Solomon, to
hear HIS[JESUS] wisdom, that GOD[JESUS] had put in HIS[JESUS] heart.

9:24 And they brought every man HIS[JESUS] present, vessels of silver, and
vessels of gold, and raiment, harness, and spices, horses, and mules, a
rate year by year.

9:25 And Solomon had four thousand stalls for horses and chariots, and
twelve thousand horsemen; whom HE[JESUS] bestowed in the chariot cities, and
with the KING[JESUS] at Jerusalem.

9:26 And HE[JESUS] reigned over all the kings from the river even unto the land
of the Philistines, and to the border of Egypt.

9:27 And the KING[JESUS] made silver in Jerusalem as stones, and cedar trees
made HE[JESUS] as the sycomore trees that are in the low plains in abundance.

9:28 And they brought unto Solomon horses out of Egypt, and out of all
lands.

9:29 Now the rest of the acts of Solomon, first and last, are they not
written in the book of Nathan the PROPHET[JESUS], and in the prophecy of Ahijah
the Shilonite, and in the visions of Iddo the seer against Jeroboam the
SON[JESUS] of Nebat?

9:30 And Solomon reigned in Jerusalem over all Israel forty years.

9:31 And Solomon slept with HIS[JESUS] fathers, and HE[JESUS] was buried in the city
of David HIS[JESUS] father: and Rehoboam HIS[JESUS] SON[JESUS] reigned in HIS[JESUS] stead.


10:1 And Rehoboam went to Shechem: for to Shechem were all Israel come
to make HIM[JESUS] KING[JESUS].

10:2 And it came to pass, when Jeroboam the SON[JESUS] of Nebat, who was in
Egypt, whither HE[JESUS] fled from the presence of Solomon the KING[JESUS], heard it,
that Jeroboam returned out of Egypt.

10:3 And they sent and called HIM[JESUS]. So Jeroboam and all Israel came and
spake to Rehoboam, saying,

10:4 your father made our yoke grievous: now therefore ease you somewhat
the grievous servitude of your father, and HIS[JESUS] heavy yoke that HE[JESUS] put
upon us, and we will serve you.

10:5 And HE[JESUS] said unto them, Come again unto me after three days. And the
people departed.

10:6 And KING[JESUS] Rehoboam took counsel with the old men that had stood
before Solomon HIS[JESUS] father while HE[JESUS] yet lived, saying, What counsel give
you me to return answer to this people?

10:7 And they spake unto HIM[JESUS], saying, If you be kind to this people,
and please them, and speak good words to them, they will be your servants
for ever.

10:8 But HE[JESUS] forsook the counsel which the old men gave HIM[JESUS], and took
counsel with the young men that were brought up with HIM[JESUS], that stood
before HIM[JESUS].

10:9 And HE[JESUS] said unto them, What advice give you that we may return
answer to this people, which have spoken to me, saying, Ease somewhat
the yoke that your father did put upon us?

10:10 And the young men that were brought up with HIM[JESUS] spake unto HIM[JESUS],
saying, Thus shalt you answer the people that spake unto you, saying,
your father made our yoke heavy, but make you it somewhat lighter for
us; thus shalt you say unto them, My little finger shall be thicker
than my father's loins.

10:11 For whereas my father put a heavy yoke upon you, I will put more
to your yoke: my father chastised you with whips, but I will chastise
you with scorpions.

10:12 So Jeroboam and all the people came to Rehoboam on the third day,
as the KING[JESUS] bade, saying, Come again to me on the third day.

10:13 And the KING[JESUS] answered them roughly; and KING[JESUS] Rehoboam forsook the
counsel of the old men,

10:14 And answered them after the advice of the young men, saying, My
father made your yoke heavy, but I will add thereto: my father chastised
you with whips, but I will chastise you with scorpions.

10:15 So the KING[JESUS] hearkened not unto the people: for the cause was of
GOD[JESUS], that the LORD[JESUS] might perform HIS[JESUS] WORD[JESUS], which HE[JESUS] spake by the hand of
Ahijah the Shilonite to Jeroboam the SON[JESUS] of Nebat.

10:16 And when all Israel saw that the KING[JESUS] would not hearken unto them,
the people answered the KING[JESUS], saying, What portion have we in David? and
we have none inheritance in the SON[JESUS] of Jesse: every man to your tents, O
Israel: and now, David, see to yours own house. So all Israel went to
their tents.

10:17 But as for the children of Israel that dwelt in the cities of
Judah, Rehoboam reigned over them.

10:18 Then KING[JESUS] Rehoboam sent Hadoram that was over the tribute; and the
children of Israel stoned HIM[JESUS] with stones, that HE[JESUS] died. But KING[JESUS]
Rehoboam made speed to get HIM[JESUS] up to HIS[JESUS] chariot, to flee to Jerusalem.

10:19 And Israel rebelled against the house of David unto this day.


11:1 And when Rehoboam was come to Jerusalem, HE[JESUS] gathered of the house
of Judah and Benjamin an hundred and fourscore thousand chosen men,
which were warriors, to fight against Israel, that HE[JESUS] might bring the
kingdom again to Rehoboam.

11:2 But the WORD[JESUS] of the LORD[JESUS] came to Shemaiah the man of GOD[JESUS], saying,

11:3 Speak unto Rehoboam the SON[JESUS] of Solomon, KING[JESUS] of Judah, and to all
Israel in Judah and Benjamin, saying,

11:4 Thus says the LORD[JESUS], you shall not go up, nor fight against your
brethren: return every man to HIS[JESUS] house: for this thing is done of me.
And they obeyed the words of the LORD[JESUS], and returned from going against
Jeroboam.

11:5 And Rehoboam dwelt in Jerusalem, and built cities for defence in
Judah.

11:6 HE[JESUS] built even Bethlehem, and Etam, and Tekoa,

11:7 And Bethzur, and Shoco, and Adullam,

11:8 And Gath, and Mareshah, and Ziph,

11:9 And Adoraim, and Lachish, and Azekah,

11:10 And Zorah, and Aijalon, and Hebron, which are in Judah and in
Benjamin fenced cities.

11:11 And HE[JESUS] fortified the strong holds, and put captains in them, and
store of victual, and of oil and wine.

11:12 And in every several city HE[JESUS] put shields and spears, and made them
exceeding strong, having Judah and Benjamin on HIS[JESUS] side.

11:13 And the priests and the Levites that were in all Israel resorted
to HIM[JESUS] out of all their coasts.

11:14 For the Levites left their suburbs and their possession, and came
to Judah and Jerusalem: for Jeroboam and HIS[JESUS] sons had cast them off from
executing the priest's office unto the LORD[JESUS]:

11:15 And HE[JESUS] ordained HIM[JESUS] priests for the high places, and for the
devils, and for the calves which HE[JESUS] had made.

11:16 And after them out of all the tribes of Israel such as set their
hearts to seek the LORD[JESUS] GOD[JESUS] of Israel came to Jerusalem, to sacrifice
unto the LORD[JESUS] GOD[JESUS] of their fathers.

11:17 So they strengthened the kingdom of Judah, and made Rehoboam the
SON[JESUS] of Solomon strong, three years: for three years they walked in the
way of David and Solomon.

11:18 And Rehoboam took HIM[JESUS] Mahalath the daughter of Jerimoth the SON[JESUS] of
David to wife, and Abihail the daughter of Eliab the SON[JESUS] of Jesse;

11:19 Which bare HIM[JESUS] children; Jeush, and Shamariah, and Zaham.

11:20 And after her HE[JESUS] took Maachah the daughter of Absalom; which bare
HIM[JESUS] Abijah, and Attai, and Ziza, and Shelomith.

11:21 And Rehoboam loved Maachah the daughter of Absalom above all HIS[JESUS]
wives and HIS[JESUS] concubines: (for HE[JESUS] took eighteen wives, and threescore
concubines; and begat twenty and eight sons, and threescore daughters.)

11:22 And Rehoboam made Abijah the SON[JESUS] of Maachah the chief, to be ruler
among HIS[JESUS] brethren: for HE[JESUS] thought to make HIM[JESUS] KING[JESUS].

11:23 And HE[JESUS] dealt wisely, and dispersed of all HIS[JESUS] children throughout
all the countries of Judah and Benjamin, unto every fenced city: and HE[JESUS]
gave them victual in abundance. And HE[JESUS] desired many wives.


12:1 And it came to pass, when Rehoboam had established the kingdom, and
had strengthened himself, HE[JESUS] forsook the law of the LORD[JESUS], and all Israel
with HIM[JESUS].

12:2 And it came to pass, that in the fifth year of KING[JESUS] Rehoboam
Shishak KING[JESUS] of Egypt came up against Jerusalem, because they had
transgressed against the LORD[JESUS],

12:3 With twelve hundred chariots, and threescore thousand horsemen: and
the people were without number that came with HIM[JESUS] out of Egypt; the
Lubims, the Sukkiims, and the Ethiopians.

12:4 And HE[JESUS] took the fenced cities which pertained to Judah, and came to
Jerusalem.

12:5 Then came Shemaiah the PROPHET[JESUS] to Rehoboam, and to the princes of
Judah, that were gathered together to Jerusalem because of Shishak, and
said unto them, Thus says the LORD[JESUS], you have forsaken me, and therefore
have I also left you in the hand of Shishak.

12:6 Whereupon the princes of Israel and the KING[JESUS] humbled themselves;
and they said, The LORD[JESUS] is righteous.

12:7 And when the LORD[JESUS] saw that they humbled themselves, the WORD[JESUS] of the
LORD[JESUS] came to Shemaiah, saying, They have humbled themselves; therefore I
will not destroy them, but I will grant them some deliverance; and my
wrath shall not be poured out upon Jerusalem by the hand of Shishak.

12:8 Nevertheless they shall be HIS[JESUS] servants; that they may know my
service, and the service of the kingdoms of the countries.

12:9 So Shishak KING[JESUS] of Egypt came up against Jerusalem, and took away
the treasures of the house of the LORD[JESUS], and the treasures of the KING[JESUS]'s
house; HE[JESUS] took all: HE[JESUS] carried away also the shields of gold which
Solomon had made.

12:10 Instead of which KING[JESUS] Rehoboam made shields of brass, and
committed them to the hands of the chief of the guard, that kept the
entrance of the KING[JESUS]'s house.

12:11 And when the KING[JESUS] entered into the house of the LORD[JESUS], the guard
came and fetched them, and brought them again into the guard chamber.

12:12 And when HE[JESUS] humbled himself, the wrath of the LORD[JESUS] turned from
HIM[JESUS], that HE[JESUS] would not destroy HIM[JESUS] altogether: and also in Judah things
went well.

12:13 So KING[JESUS] Rehoboam strengthened himself in Jerusalem, and reigned:
for Rehoboam was one and forty years old when HE[JESUS] began to reign, and HE[JESUS]
reigned seventeen years in Jerusalem, the city which the LORD[JESUS] had chosen
out of all the tribes of Israel, to put HIS[JESUS] name there. And HIS[JESUS] mother's
name was Naamah an Ammonitess.

12:14 And HE[JESUS] did evil, because HE[JESUS] prepared not HIS[JESUS] heart to seek the
LORD[JESUS].

12:15 Now the acts of Rehoboam, first and last, are they not written in
the book of Shemaiah the PROPHET[JESUS], and of Iddo the seer concerning
genealogies? And there were wars between Rehoboam and Jeroboam
continually.

12:16 And Rehoboam slept with HIS[JESUS] fathers, and was buried in the city of
David: and Abijah HIS[JESUS] SON[JESUS] reigned in HIS[JESUS] stead.


13:1 Now in the eighteenth year of KING[JESUS] Jeroboam began Abijah to reign
over Judah.

13:2 HE[JESUS] reigned three years in Jerusalem. HIS[JESUS] mother's name also was
Michaiah the daughter of Uriel of Gibeah. And there was war between
Abijah and Jeroboam.

13:3 And Abijah set the battle in array with an army of valiant men of
war, even four hundred thousand chosen men: Jeroboam also set the battle
in array against HIM[JESUS] with eight hundred thousand chosen men, being
mighty men of valour.

13:4 And Abijah stood up upon mount Zemaraim, which is in mount Ephraim,
and said, Hear me, you Jeroboam, and all Israel;

13:5 Ought you not to know that the LORD[JESUS] GOD[JESUS] of Israel gave the kingdom
over Israel to David for ever, even to HIM[JESUS] and to HIS[JESUS] sons by a covenant
of salt?

13:6 Yet Jeroboam the SON[JESUS] of Nebat, the SERVANT[JESUS] of Solomon the SON[JESUS] of
David, is risen up, and has rebelled against HIS[JESUS] LORD[JESUS].

13:7 And there are gathered unto HIM[JESUS] vain men, the children of Belial,
and have strengthened themselves against Rehoboam the SON[JESUS] of Solomon,
when Rehoboam was young and tenderhearted, and could not withstand them.

13:8 And now you think to withstand the kingdom of the LORD[JESUS] in the hand
of the sons of David; and you be a great multitude, and there are with
your golden calves, which Jeroboam made you for gods.

13:9 Have you not cast out the priests of the LORD[JESUS], the sons of Aaron,
and the Levites, and have made you priests after the manner of the
nations of other lands? so that whoever comes to consecrate himself
with a young bullock and seven rams, the same may be a priest of them
that are no gods.

13:10 But as for us, the LORD[JESUS] is our GOD[JESUS], and we have not forsaken HIM[JESUS];
and the priests, which minister unto the LORD[JESUS], are the sons of Aaron,
and the Levites wait upon their business:

13:11 And they burn unto the LORD[JESUS] every morning and every evening burnt
sacrifices and sweet incense: the shewbread also set they in order upon
the pure table; and the candlestick of gold with the lamps thereof, to
burn every evening: for we keep the charge of the LORD[JESUS] our GOD[JESUS]; but you
have forsaken HIM[JESUS].

13:12 And, behold, GOD[JESUS] himself is with us for our captain, and HIS[JESUS]
priests with sounding trumpets to cry alarm against you. O children of
Israel, fight you not against the LORD[JESUS] GOD[JESUS] of your fathers; for you shall
not prosper.

13:13 But Jeroboam caused an ambushment to come about behind them: so
they were before Judah, and the ambushment was behind them.

13:14 And when Judah looked back, behold, the battle was before and
behind: and they cried unto the LORD[JESUS], and the priests sounded with the
trumpets.

13:15 Then the men of Judah gave a shout: and as the men of Judah
shouted, it came to pass, that GOD[JESUS] smote Jeroboam and all Israel before
Abijah and Judah.

13:16 And the children of Israel fled before Judah: and GOD[JESUS] delivered
them into their hand.

13:17 And Abijah and HIS[JESUS] people slew them with a great slaughter: so
there fell down slain of Israel five hundred thousand chosen men.

13:18 Thus the children of Israel were brought under at that time, and
the children of Judah prevailed, because they relied upon the LORD[JESUS] GOD[JESUS]
of their fathers.

13:19 And Abijah pursued after Jeroboam, and took cities from HIM[JESUS],
Bethel with the towns thereof, and Jeshanah with the towns thereof, and
Ephraim with the towns thereof.

13:20 Neither did Jeroboam recover strength again in the days of Abijah:
and the LORD[JESUS] struck HIM[JESUS], and HE[JESUS] died.

13:21 But Abijah waxed mighty, and married fourteen wives, and begat
twenty and two sons, and sixteen daughters.

13:22 And the rest of the acts of Abijah, and HIS[JESUS] ways, and HIS[JESUS] sayings,
are written in the story of the PROPHET[JESUS] Iddo.


14:1 So Abijah slept with HIS[JESUS] fathers, and they buried HIM[JESUS] in the city
of David: and Asa HIS[JESUS] SON[JESUS] reigned in HIS[JESUS] stead. In HIS[JESUS] days the land was
quiet ten years.

14:2 And Asa did that which was good and right in the eyes of the LORD[JESUS]
HIS[JESUS] GOD[JESUS]:

14:3 For HE[JESUS] took away the altars of the strange gods, and the high
places, and brake down the images, and cut down the groves:

14:4 And commanded Judah to seek the LORD[JESUS] GOD[JESUS] of their fathers, and to
do the law and the commandment.

14:5 Also HE[JESUS] took away out of all the cities of Judah the high places
and the images: and the kingdom was quiet before HIM[JESUS].

14:6 And HE[JESUS] built fenced cities in Judah: for the land had rest, and HE[JESUS]
had no war in those years; because the LORD[JESUS] had given HIM[JESUS] rest.

14:7 Therefore HE[JESUS] said unto Judah, Let us build these cities, and make
about them walls, and towers, gates, and bars, while the land is yet
before us; because we have sought the LORD[JESUS] our GOD[JESUS], we have sought HIM[JESUS],
and HE[JESUS] has given us rest on every side. So they built and prospered.

14:8 And Asa had an army of men that bare targets and spears, out of
Judah three hundred thousand; and out of Benjamin, that bare shields and
drew bows, two hundred and fourscore thousand: all these were mighty men
of valour.

14:9 And there came out against them Zerah the Ethiopian with an host of
a thousand thousand, and three hundred chariots; and came unto Mareshah.

14:10 Then Asa went out against HIM[JESUS], and they set the battle in array in
the valley of Zephathah at Mareshah.

14:11 And Asa cried unto the LORD[JESUS] HIS[JESUS] GOD[JESUS], and said, LORD[JESUS], it is nothing
with you to help, whether with many, or with them that have no power:
help us, O LORD[JESUS] our GOD[JESUS]; for we rest on you, and in your name we go
against this multitude. O LORD[JESUS], you art our GOD[JESUS]; let no man prevail
against you.

14:12 So the LORD[JESUS] smote the Ethiopians before Asa, and before Judah; and
the Ethiopians fled.

14:13 And Asa and the people that were with HIM[JESUS] pursued them unto Gerar:
and the Ethiopians were overthrown, that they could not recover
themselves; for they were destroyed before the LORD[JESUS], and before HIS[JESUS]
host; and they carried away very much spoil.

14:14 And they smote all the cities round about Gerar; for the fear of
the LORD[JESUS] came upon them: and they spoiled all the cities; for there was
exceeding much spoil in them.

14:15 They smote also the tents of cattle, and carried away sheep and
camels in abundance, and returned to Jerusalem.


15:1 And the Spirit of GOD[JESUS] came upon Azariah the SON[JESUS] of Oded:

15:2 And HE[JESUS] went out to meet Asa, and said unto HIM[JESUS], Hear you me, Asa,
and all Judah and Benjamin; The LORD[JESUS] is with you, while you be with HIM[JESUS];
and if you seek HIM[JESUS], HE[JESUS] will be found of you; but if you forsake HIM[JESUS], HE[JESUS]
will forsake you.

15:3 Now for a long season Israel has been without the true GOD[JESUS], and
without a teaching priest, and without law.

15:4 But when they in their trouble did turn unto the LORD[JESUS] GOD[JESUS] of
Israel, and sought HIM[JESUS], HE[JESUS] was found of them.

15:5 And in those times there was no peace to HIM[JESUS] that went out, nor to
HIM[JESUS] that came in, but great vexations were upon all the inhabitants of
the countries.

15:6 And nation was destroyed of nation, and city of city: for GOD[JESUS] did
vex them with all adversity.

15:7 Be you strong therefore, and let not your hands be weak: for your
work shall be rewarded.

15:8 And when Asa heard these words, and the prophecy of Oded the
PROPHET[JESUS], HE[JESUS] took courage, and put away the abominable idols out of all
the land of Judah and Benjamin, and out of the cities which HE[JESUS] had taken
from mount Ephraim, and renewed the altar of the LORD[JESUS], that was before
the porch of the LORD[JESUS].

15:9 And HE[JESUS] gathered all Judah and Benjamin, and the strangers with them
out of Ephraim and Manasseh, and out of Simeon: for they fell to HIM[JESUS] out
of Israel in abundance, when they saw that the LORD[JESUS] HIS[JESUS] GOD[JESUS] was with
HIM[JESUS].

15:10 So they gathered themselves together at Jerusalem in the third
month, in the fifteenth year of the reign of Asa.

15:11 And they offered unto the LORD[JESUS] the same time, of the spoil which
they had brought, seven hundred oxen and seven thousand sheep.

15:12 And they entered into a covenant to seek the LORD[JESUS] GOD[JESUS] of their
fathers with all their heart and with all their soul;

15:13 That whoever would not seek the LORD[JESUS] GOD[JESUS] of Israel should be put
to death, whether small or great, whether man or woman.

15:14 And they sware unto the LORD[JESUS] with a loud voice, and with shouting,
and with trumpets, and with cornets.

15:15 And all Judah rejoiced at the oath: for they had sworn with all
their heart, and sought HIM[JESUS] with their whole desire; and HE[JESUS] was found of
them: and the LORD[JESUS] gave them rest round about.

15:16 And also concerning Maachah the mother of Asa the KING[JESUS], HE[JESUS] removed
her from being queen, because she had made an idol in a grove: and Asa
cut down her idol, and stamped it, and burnt it at the brook Kidron.

15:17 But the high places were not taken away out of Israel:
nevertheless the heart of Asa was perfect all HIS[JESUS] days.

15:18 And HE[JESUS] brought into the house of GOD[JESUS] the things that HIS[JESUS] father
had dedicated, and that HE[JESUS] himself had dedicated, silver, and gold, and
vessels.

15:19 And there was no more war unto the five and thirtieth year of the
reign of Asa.


16:1 In the six and thirtieth year of the reign of Asa Baasha KING[JESUS] of
Israel came up against Judah, and built Ramah, to the intent that HE[JESUS]
might let none go out or come in to Asa KING[JESUS] of Judah.

16:2 Then Asa brought out silver and gold out of the treasures of the
house of the LORD[JESUS] and of the KING[JESUS]'s house, and sent to Benhadad KING[JESUS] of
Syria, that dwelt at Damascus, saying,

16:3 There is a league between me and you, as there was between my
father and your father: behold, I have sent you silver and gold; go,
break your league with Baasha KING[JESUS] of Israel, that HE[JESUS] may depart from me.

16:4 And Benhadad hearkened unto KING[JESUS] Asa, and sent the captains of HIS[JESUS]
armies against the cities of Israel; and they smote Ijon, and Dan, and
Abelmaim, and all the store cities of Naphtali.

16:5 And it came to pass, when Baasha heard it, that HE[JESUS] left off
building of Ramah, and let HIS[JESUS] work cease.

16:6 Then Asa the KING[JESUS] took all Judah; and they carried away the stones
of Ramah, and the timber thereof, wherewith Baasha was building; and HE[JESUS]
built therewith Geba and Mizpah.

16:7 And at that time Hanani the seer came to Asa KING[JESUS] of Judah, and
said unto HIM[JESUS], Because you hast relied on the KING[JESUS] of Syria, and not
relied on the LORD[JESUS] your GOD[JESUS], therefore is the host of the KING[JESUS] of Syria
escaped out of yours hand.

16:8 Were not the Ethiopians and the Lubims a huge host, with very many
chariots and horsemen? yet, because you didst rely on the LORD[JESUS], HE[JESUS]
delivered them into yours hand.

16:9 For the eyes of the LORD[JESUS] run to and fro throughout the whole earth,
to shew himself strong in the behalf of them whose heart is perfect
toward HIM[JESUS]. Herein you hast done foolishly: therefore from henceforth
you shalt have wars.

16:10 Then Asa was wroth with the seer, and put HIM[JESUS] in a prison house;
for HE[JESUS] was in a rage with HIM[JESUS] because of this thing. And Asa oppressed
some of the people the same time.

16:11 And, behold, the acts of Asa, first and last, lo, they are written
in the book of the kings of Judah and Israel.

16:12 And Asa in the thirty and ninth year of HIS[JESUS] reign was diseased in
HIS[JESUS] feet, until HIS[JESUS] disease was exceeding great: yet in HIS[JESUS] disease HE[JESUS]
sought not to the LORD[JESUS], but to the physicians.

16:13 And Asa slept with HIS[JESUS] fathers, and died in the one and fortieth
year of HIS[JESUS] reign.

16:14 And they buried HIM[JESUS] in HIS[JESUS] own sepulchres, which HE[JESUS] had made for
himself in the city of David, and laid HIM[JESUS] in the bed which was filled
with sweet odours and divers kinds of spices prepared by the
apothecaries' art: and they made a very great burning for HIM[JESUS].


17:1 And Jehoshaphat HIS[JESUS] SON[JESUS] reigned in HIS[JESUS] stead, and strengthened
himself against Israel.

17:2 And HE[JESUS] placed forces in all the fenced cities of Judah, and set
garrisons in the land of Judah, and in the cities of Ephraim, which Asa
HIS[JESUS] father had taken.

17:3 And the LORD[JESUS] was with Jehoshaphat, because HE[JESUS] walked in the first
ways of HIS[JESUS] father David, and sought not unto Baalim;

17:4 But sought to the LORD[JESUS] GOD[JESUS] of HIS[JESUS] father, and walked in HIS[JESUS]
commandments, and not after the doings of Israel.

17:5 Therefore the LORD[JESUS] stablished the kingdom in HIS[JESUS] hand; and all
Judah brought to Jehoshaphat presents; and HE[JESUS] had riches and honour in
abundance.

17:6 And HIS[JESUS] heart was lifted up in the ways of the LORD[JESUS]: moreover HE[JESUS]
took away the high places and groves out of Judah.

17:7 Also in the third year of HIS[JESUS] reign HE[JESUS] sent to HIS[JESUS] princes, even to
Benhail, and to Obadiah, and to Zechariah, and to Nethaneel, and to
Michaiah, to teach in the cities of Judah.

17:8 And with them HE[JESUS] sent Levites, even Shemaiah, and Nethaniah, and
Zebadiah, and Asahel, and Shemiramoth, and Jehonathan, and Adonijah, and
Tobijah, and Tobadonijah, Levites; and with them Elishama and Jehoram,
priests.

17:9 And they taught in Judah, and had the book of the law of the LORD[JESUS]
with them, and went about throughout all the cities of Judah, and taught
the people.

17:10 And the fear of the LORD[JESUS] fell upon all the kingdoms of the lands
that were round about Judah, so that they made no war against
Jehoshaphat.

17:11 Also some of the Philistines brought Jehoshaphat presents, and
tribute silver; and the Arabians brought HIM[JESUS] flocks, seven thousand and
seven hundred rams, and seven thousand and seven hundred HE[JESUS] goats.

17:12 And Jehoshaphat waxed great exceedingly; and HE[JESUS] built in Judah
castles, and cities of store.

17:13 And HE[JESUS] had much business in the cities of Judah: and the men of
war, mighty men of valour, were in Jerusalem.

17:14 And these are the numbers of them according to the house of their
fathers: Of Judah, the captains of thousands; Adnah the chief, and with
HIM[JESUS] mighty men of valour three hundred thousand.

17:15 And next to HIM[JESUS] was Jehohanan the captain, and with HIM[JESUS] two
hundred and fourscore thousand.

17:16 And next HIM[JESUS] was Amasiah the SON[JESUS] of Zichri, who willingly offered
himself unto the LORD[JESUS]; and with HIM[JESUS] two hundred thousand mighty men of
valour.

17:17 And of Benjamin; Eliada a mighty man of valour, and with HIM[JESUS] armed
men with bow and shield two hundred thousand.

17:18 And next HIM[JESUS] was Jehozabad, and with HIM[JESUS] an hundred and fourscore
thousand ready prepared for the war.

17:19 These waited on the KING[JESUS], beside those whom the KING[JESUS] put in the
fenced cities throughout all Judah.


18:1 Now Jehoshaphat had riches and honour in abundance, and joined
affinity with Ahab.

18:2 And after certain years HE[JESUS] went down to Ahab to Samaria. And Ahab
killed sheep and oxen for HIM[JESUS] in abundance, and for the people that HE[JESUS]
had with HIM[JESUS], and persuaded HIM[JESUS] to go up with HIM[JESUS] to Ramothgilead.

18:3 And Ahab KING[JESUS] of Israel said unto Jehoshaphat KING[JESUS] of Judah, Wilt
you go with me to Ramothgilead? And HE[JESUS] answered HIM[JESUS], I am as you art,
and my people as your people; and we will be with you in the war.

18:4 And Jehoshaphat said unto the KING[JESUS] of Israel, Enquire, I pray you,
at the WORD[JESUS] of the LORD[JESUS] to day.

18:5 Therefore the KING[JESUS] of Israel gathered together of prophets four
hundred men, and said unto them, Shall we go to Ramothgilead to battle,
or shall I forbear? And they said, Go up; for GOD[JESUS] will deliver it into
the KING[JESUS]'s hand.

18:6 But Jehoshaphat said, Is there not here a PROPHET[JESUS] of the LORD[JESUS]
besides, that we might enquire of HIM[JESUS]?

18:7 And the KING[JESUS] of Israel said unto Jehoshaphat, There is yet one man,
by whom we may enquire of the LORD[JESUS]: but I hate HIM[JESUS]; for HE[JESUS] never
prophesied good unto me, but always evil: the same is Micaiah the SON[JESUS] of
Imla. And Jehoshaphat said, Let not the KING[JESUS] say so.

18:8 And the KING[JESUS] of Israel called for one of HIS[JESUS] officers, and said,
Fetch quickly Micaiah the SON[JESUS] of Imla.

18:9 And the KING[JESUS] of Israel and Jehoshaphat KING[JESUS] of Judah sat either of
them on HIS[JESUS] throne, clothed in their robes, and they sat in a void place
at the entering in of the gate of Samaria; and all the prophets
prophesied before them.

18:10 And Zedekiah the SON[JESUS] of Chenaanah had made HIM[JESUS] horns of iron, and
said, Thus says the LORD[JESUS], With these you shalt push Syria until they
be consumed.

18:11 And all the prophets prophesied so, saying, Go up to Ramothgilead,
and prosper: for the LORD[JESUS] shall deliver it into the hand of the KING[JESUS].

18:12 And the messenger that went to call Micaiah spake to HIM[JESUS], saying,
Behold, the words of the prophets declare good to the KING[JESUS] with one
assent; let your WORD[JESUS] therefore, I pray you, be like one of their's, and
speak you good.

18:13 And Micaiah said, As the LORD[JESUS] liveth, even what my GOD[JESUS] says, that
will I speak.

18:14 And when HE[JESUS] was come to the KING[JESUS], the KING[JESUS] said unto HIM[JESUS], Micaiah,
shall we go to Ramothgilead to battle, or shall I forbear? And HE[JESUS] said,
Go you up, and prosper, and they shall be delivered into your hand.

18:15 And the KING[JESUS] said to HIM[JESUS], How many times shall I adjure you that
you say nothing but the truth to me in the name of the LORD[JESUS]?

18:16 Then HE[JESUS] said, I did see all Israel scattered upon the mountains,
as sheep that have no SHEPHERD[JESUS]: and the LORD[JESUS] said, These have no master;
let them return therefore every man to HIS[JESUS] house in peace.

18:17 And the KING[JESUS] of Israel said to Jehoshaphat, Did I not tell you
that HE[JESUS] would not prophesy good unto me, but evil?

18:18 Again HE[JESUS] said, Therefore hear the WORD[JESUS] of the LORD[JESUS]; I saw the LORD[JESUS]
sitting upon HIS[JESUS] throne, and all the host of heaven standing on HIS[JESUS]
right hand and on HIS[JESUS] left.

18:19 And the LORD[JESUS] said, Who shall entice Ahab KING[JESUS] of Israel, that HE[JESUS]
may go up and fall at Ramothgilead? And one spake saying after this
manner, and another saying after that manner.

18:20 Then there came out a spirit, and stood before the LORD[JESUS], and said,
I will entice HIM[JESUS]. And the LORD[JESUS] said unto HIM[JESUS], Wherewith?

18:21 And HE[JESUS] said, I will go out, and be a lying spirit in the mouth of
all HIS[JESUS] prophets. And the LORD[JESUS] said, you shalt entice HIM[JESUS], and you
shalt also prevail: go out, and do even so.

18:22 Now therefore, behold, the LORD[JESUS] has put a lying spirit in the
mouth of these your prophets, and the LORD[JESUS] has spoken evil against you.

18:23 Then Zedekiah the SON[JESUS] of Chenaanah came near, and smote Micaiah
upon the cheek, and said, Which way went the Spirit of the LORD[JESUS] from me
to speak unto you?

18:24 And Micaiah said, Behold, you shalt see on that day when you
shalt go into an inner chamber to hide thyself.

18:25 Then the KING[JESUS] of Israel said, Take you Micaiah, and carry HIM[JESUS] back
to Amon the governor of the city, and to Joash the KING[JESUS]'s SON[JESUS];

18:26 And say, Thus says the KING[JESUS], Put this fellow in the prison, and
feed HIM[JESUS] with bread of affliction and with water of affliction, until I
return in peace.

18:27 And Micaiah said, If you certainly return in peace, then has not
the LORD[JESUS] spoken by me. And HE[JESUS] said, Hearken, all you people.

18:28 So the KING[JESUS] of Israel and Jehoshaphat the KING[JESUS] of Judah went up to
Ramothgilead.

18:29 And the KING[JESUS] of Israel said unto Jehoshaphat, I will disguise
myself, and I will go to the battle; but put you on your robes. So the
KING[JESUS] of Israel disguised himself; and they went to the battle.

18:30 Now the KING[JESUS] of Syria had commanded the captains of the chariots
that were with HIM[JESUS], saying, Fight you not with small or great, save only
with the KING[JESUS] of Israel.

18:31 And it came to pass, when the captains of the chariots saw
Jehoshaphat, that they said, It is the KING[JESUS] of Israel. Therefore they
compassed about HIM[JESUS] to fight: but Jehoshaphat cried out, and the LORD[JESUS]
helped HIM[JESUS]; and GOD[JESUS] moved them to depart from HIM[JESUS].

18:32 For it came to pass, that, when the captains of the chariots
perceived that it was not the KING[JESUS] of Israel, they turned back again
from pursuing HIM[JESUS].

18:33 And a certain man drew a bow at a venture, and smote the KING[JESUS] of
Israel between the joints of the harness: therefore HE[JESUS] said to HIS[JESUS]
chariot man, Turn yours hand, that you mayest carry me out of the host;
for I am wounded.

18:34 And the battle increased that day: howbeit the KING[JESUS] of Israel
stayed himself up in HIS[JESUS] chariot against the Syrians until the even: and
about the time of the sun going down HE[JESUS] died.


19:1 And Jehoshaphat the KING[JESUS] of Judah returned to HIS[JESUS] house in peace to
Jerusalem.

19:2 And Jehu the SON[JESUS] of Hanani the seer went out to meet HIM[JESUS], and said
to KING[JESUS] Jehoshaphat, Shouldest you help the ungodly, and love them that
hate the LORD[JESUS]? therefore is wrath upon you from before the LORD[JESUS].

19:3 Nevertheless there are good things found in you, in that you hast
taken away the groves out of the land, and hast prepared yours heart to
seek GOD[JESUS].

19:4 And Jehoshaphat dwelt at Jerusalem: and HE[JESUS] went out again through
the people from Beersheba to mount Ephraim, and brought them back unto
the LORD[JESUS] GOD[JESUS] of their fathers.

19:5 And HE[JESUS] set judges in the land throughout all the fenced cities of
Judah, city by city,

19:6 And said to the judges, Take heed what you do: for you judge not for
man, but for the LORD[JESUS], who is with you in the judgment.

19:7 Wherefore now let the fear of the LORD[JESUS] be upon you; take heed and
do it: for there is no iniquity with the LORD[JESUS] our GOD[JESUS], nor respect of
persons, nor taking of gifts.

19:8 Moreover in Jerusalem did Jehoshaphat set of the Levites, and of
the priests, and of the chief of the fathers of Israel, for the judgment
of the LORD[JESUS], and for controversies, when they returned to Jerusalem.

19:9 And HE[JESUS] charged them, saying, Thus shall you do in the fear of the
LORD[JESUS], faithfully, and with a perfect heart.

19:10 And what cause soever shall come to you of your brethren that
dwell in your cities, between blood and blood, between law and
commandment, statutes and judgments, you shall even warn them that they
trespass not against the LORD[JESUS], and so wrath come upon you, and upon your
brethren: this do, and you shall not trespass.

19:11 And, behold, Amariah the chief priest is over you in all matters
of the LORD[JESUS]; and Zebadiah the SON[JESUS] of Ishmael, the ruler of the house of
Judah, for all the KING[JESUS]'s matters: also the Levites shall be officers
before you. Deal courageously, and the LORD[JESUS] shall be with the good.


20:1 It came to pass after this also, that the children of Moab, and the
children of Ammon, and with them other beside the Ammonites, came
against Jehoshaphat to battle.

20:2 Then there came some that told Jehoshaphat, saying, There comes a
great multitude against you from beyond the sea on this side Syria;
and, behold, they be in Hazazontamar, which is Engedi.

20:3 And Jehoshaphat feared, and set himself to seek the LORD[JESUS], and
proclaimed a fast throughout all Judah.

20:4 And Judah gathered themselves together, to ask help of the LORD[JESUS]:
even out of all the cities of Judah they came to seek the LORD[JESUS].

20:5 And Jehoshaphat stood in the congregation of Judah and Jerusalem,
in the house of the LORD[JESUS], before the new court,

20:6 And said, O LORD[JESUS] GOD[JESUS] of our fathers, art not you GOD[JESUS] in heaven?
and rulest not you over all the kingdoms of the heathen? and in yours
hand is there not power and might, so that none is able to withstand
you?

20:7 Art not you our GOD[JESUS], who didst drive out the inhabitants of this
land before your people Israel, and gavest it to the SEED[JESUS] of Abraham your
friend for ever?

20:8 And they dwelt therein, and have built you a sanctuary therein for
your name, saying,

20:9 If, when evil comes upon us, as the sword, judgment, or
pestilence, or famine, we stand before this house, and in your presence,
(for your name is in this house,) and cry unto you in our affliction,
then you wilt hear and help.

20:10 And now, behold, the children of Ammon and Moab and mount Seir,
whom you wouldest not let Israel invade, when they came out of the land
of Egypt, but they turned from them, and destroyed them not;

20:11 Behold, I say, how they reward us, to come to cast us out of your
possession, which you hast given us to inherit.

20:12 O our GOD[JESUS], wilt you not judge them? for we have no might against
this great company that comes against us; neither know we what to do:
but our eyes are upon you.

20:13 And all Judah stood before the LORD[JESUS], with their little ones, their
wives, and their children.

20:14 Then upon Jahaziel the SON[JESUS] of Zechariah, the SON[JESUS] of Benaiah, the
SON[JESUS] of Jeiel, the SON[JESUS] of Mattaniah, a Levite of the sons of Asaph, came
the Spirit of the LORD[JESUS] in the midst of the congregation;

20:15 And HE[JESUS] said, Hearken you, all Judah, and you inhabitants of
Jerusalem, and you KING[JESUS] Jehoshaphat, Thus says the LORD[JESUS] unto you, Be
not afraid nor dismayed by reason of this great multitude; for the
battle is not yours, but GOD[JESUS]'s.

20:16 To morrow go you down against them: behold, they come up by the
cliff of Ziz; and you shall find them at the end of the brook, before the
wilderness of Jeruel.

20:17 you shall not need to fight in this battle: set yourselves, stand
you still, and see the salvation of the LORD[JESUS] with you, O Judah and
Jerusalem: fear not, nor be dismayed; to morrow go out against them: for
the LORD[JESUS] will be with you.

20:18 And Jehoshaphat bowed HIS[JESUS] head with HIS[JESUS] face to the ground: and
all Judah and the inhabitants of Jerusalem fell before the LORD[JESUS],
worshipping the LORD[JESUS].

20:19 And the Levites, of the children of the Kohathites, and of the
children of the Korhites, stood up to praise the LORD[JESUS] GOD[JESUS] of Israel with
a loud voice on high.

20:20 And they rose early in the morning, and went forth into the
wilderness of Tekoa: and as they went forth, Jehoshaphat stood and said,
Hear me, O Judah, and you inhabitants of Jerusalem; Believe in the LORD[JESUS]
your GOD[JESUS], so shall you be established; believe HIS[JESUS] prophets, so shall you
prosper.

20:21 And when HE[JESUS] had consulted with the people, HE[JESUS] appointed singers
unto the LORD[JESUS], and that should praise the beauty of holiness, as they
went out before the army, and to say, Praise the LORD[JESUS]; for HIS[JESUS] mercy
endureth for ever.

20:22 And when they began to sing and to praise, the LORD[JESUS] set
ambushments against the children of Ammon, Moab, and mount Seir, which
were come against Judah; and they were smitten.

20:23 For the children of Ammon and Moab stood up against the
inhabitants of mount Seir, utterly to slay and destroy them: and when
they had made an end of the inhabitants of Seir, every one helped to
destroy another.

20:24 And when Judah came toward the watch tower in the wilderness, they
looked unto the multitude, and, behold, they were dead bodies fallen to
the earth, and none escaped.

20:25 And when Jehoshaphat and HIS[JESUS] people came to take away the spoil of
them, they found among them in abundance both riches with the dead
bodies, and precious jewels, which they stripped off for themselves,
more than they could carry away: and they were three days in gathering
of the spoil, it was so much.

20:26 And on the fourth day they assembled themselves in the valley of
Berachah; for there they blessed the LORD[JESUS]: therefore the name of the
same place was called, The valley of Berachah, unto this day.

20:27 Then they returned, every man of Judah and Jerusalem, and
Jehoshaphat in the forefront of them, to go again to Jerusalem with joy;
for the LORD[JESUS] had made them to rejoice over their enemies.

20:28 And they came to Jerusalem with psalteries and harps and trumpets
unto the house of the LORD[JESUS].

20:29 And the fear of GOD[JESUS] was on all the kingdoms of those countries,
when they had heard that the LORD[JESUS] fought against the enemies of Israel.

20:30 So the realm of Jehoshaphat was quiet: for HIS[JESUS] GOD[JESUS] gave HIM[JESUS] rest
round about.

20:31 And Jehoshaphat reigned over Judah: HE[JESUS] was thirty and five years
old when HE[JESUS] began to reign, and HE[JESUS] reigned twenty and five years in
Jerusalem. And HIS[JESUS] mother's name was Azubah the daughter of Shilhi.

20:32 And HE[JESUS] walked in the way of Asa HIS[JESUS] father, and departed not from
it, doing that which was right in the sight of the LORD[JESUS].

20:33 Howbeit the high places were not taken away: for as yet the people
had not prepared their hearts unto the GOD[JESUS] of their fathers.

20:34 Now the rest of the acts of Jehoshaphat, first and last, behold,
they are written in the book of Jehu the SON[JESUS] of Hanani, who is mentioned
in the book of the kings of Israel.

20:35 And after this did Jehoshaphat KING[JESUS] of Judah join himself with
Ahaziah KING[JESUS] of Israel, who did very wickedly:

20:36 And HE[JESUS] joined himself with HIM[JESUS] to make ships to go to Tarshish:
and they made the ships in Eziongaber.

20:37 Then Eliezer the SON[JESUS] of Dodavah of Mareshah prophesied against
Jehoshaphat, saying, Because you hast joined thyself with Ahaziah, the
LORD[JESUS] has broken your works. And the ships were broken, that they were
not able to go to Tarshish.


21:1 Now Jehoshaphat slept with HIS[JESUS] fathers, and was buried with HIS[JESUS]
fathers in the city of David. And Jehoram HIS[JESUS] SON[JESUS] reigned in HIS[JESUS] stead.

21:2 And HE[JESUS] had brethren the sons of Jehoshaphat, Azariah, and Jehiel,
and Zechariah, and Azariah, and Michael, and Shephatiah: all these were
the sons of Jehoshaphat KING[JESUS] of Israel.

21:3 And their father gave them great gifts of silver, and of gold, and
of precious things, with fenced cities in Judah: but the kingdom gave HE[JESUS]
to Jehoram; because HE[JESUS] was the firstborn.

21:4 Now when Jehoram was risen up to the kingdom of HIS[JESUS] father, HE[JESUS]
strengthened himself, and slew all HIS[JESUS] brethren with the sword, and
divers also of the princes of Israel.

21:5 Jehoram was thirty and two years old when HE[JESUS] began to reign, and HE[JESUS]
reigned eight years in Jerusalem.

21:6 And HE[JESUS] walked in the way of the kings of Israel, like as did the
house of Ahab: for HE[JESUS] had the daughter of Ahab to wife: and HE[JESUS] wrought
that which was evil in the eyes of the LORD[JESUS].

21:7 Howbeit the LORD[JESUS] would not destroy the house of David, because of
the covenant that HE[JESUS] had made with David, and as HE[JESUS] promised to give a
light to HIM[JESUS] and to HIS[JESUS] sons for ever.

21:8 In HIS[JESUS] days the Edomites revolted from under the dominion of Judah,
and made themselves a KING[JESUS].

21:9 Then Jehoram went forth with HIS[JESUS] princes, and all HIS[JESUS] chariots with
HIM[JESUS]: and HE[JESUS] rose up by night, and smote the Edomites which compassed HIM[JESUS]
in, and the captains of the chariots.

21:10 So the Edomites revolted from under the hand of Judah unto this
day. The same time also did Libnah revolt from under HIS[JESUS] hand; because
HE[JESUS] had forsaken the LORD[JESUS] GOD[JESUS] of HIS[JESUS] fathers.

21:11 Moreover HE[JESUS] made high places in the mountains of Judah and caused
the inhabitants of Jerusalem to commit fornication, and compelled Judah
thereto.

21:12 And there came a writing to HIM[JESUS] from Elijah the PROPHET[JESUS], saying,
Thus says the LORD[JESUS] GOD[JESUS] of David your father, Because you hast not
walked in the ways of Jehoshaphat your father, nor in the ways of Asa
KING[JESUS] of Judah,

21:13 But hast walked in the way of the kings of Israel, and hast made
Judah and the inhabitants of Jerusalem to go a whoring, like to the
whoredoms of the house of Ahab, and also hast slain your brethren of your
father's house, which were better than thyself:

21:14 Behold, with a great plague will the LORD[JESUS] smite your people, and
your children, and your wives, and all your goods:

21:15 And you shalt have great sickness by disease of your bowels, until
your bowels fall out by reason of the sickness day by day.

21:16 Moreover the LORD[JESUS] stirred up against Jehoram the spirit of the
Philistines, and of the Arabians, that were near the Ethiopians:

21:17 And they came up into Judah, and brake into it, and carried away
all the substance that was found in the KING[JESUS]'s house, and HIS[JESUS] sons also,
and HIS[JESUS] wives; so that there was never a SON[JESUS] left HIM[JESUS], save Jehoahaz,
the youngest of HIS[JESUS] sons.

21:18 And after all this the LORD[JESUS] smote HIM[JESUS] in HIS[JESUS] bowels with an
incurable disease.

21:19 And it came to pass, that in process of time, after the end of two
years, HIS[JESUS] bowels fell out by reason of HIS[JESUS] sickness: so HE[JESUS] died of sore
diseases. And HIS[JESUS] people made no burning for HIM[JESUS], like the burning of
HIS[JESUS] fathers.

21:20 Thirty and two years old was HE[JESUS] when HE[JESUS] began to reign, and HE[JESUS]
reigned in Jerusalem eight years, and departed without being desired.
Howbeit they buried HIM[JESUS] in the city of David, but not in the sepulchres
of the kings.

in HIS[JESUS] stead: for the band of men that came with the Arabians to the
camp had slain all the eldest. So Ahaziah the SON[JESUS] of Jehoram KING[JESUS] of
Judah reigned.

22:2 Forty and two years old was Ahaziah when HE[JESUS] began to reign, and HE[JESUS]
reigned one year in Jerusalem. HIS[JESUS] mother's name also was Athaliah the
daughter of Omri.

22:3 HE[JESUS] also walked in the ways of the house of Ahab: for HIS[JESUS] mother was
HIS[JESUS] COUNSELLOR[JESUS] to do wickedly.

22:4 Wherefore HE[JESUS] did evil in the sight of the LORD[JESUS] like the house of
Ahab: for they were HIS[JESUS] counsellors after the death of HIS[JESUS] father to HIS[JESUS]
destruction.

22:5 HE[JESUS] walked also after their counsel, and went with Jehoram the SON[JESUS]
of Ahab KING[JESUS] of Israel to war against Hazael KING[JESUS] of Syria at
Ramothgilead: and the Syrians smote Joram.

22:6 And HE[JESUS] returned to be healed in Jezreel because of the wounds which
were given HIM[JESUS] at Ramah, when HE[JESUS] fought with Hazael KING[JESUS] of Syria. And
Azariah the SON[JESUS] of Jehoram KING[JESUS] of Judah went down to see Jehoram the
SON[JESUS] of Ahab at Jezreel, because HE[JESUS] was sick.

22:7 And the destruction of Ahaziah was of GOD[JESUS] by coming to Joram: for
when HE[JESUS] was come, HE[JESUS] went out with Jehoram against Jehu the SON[JESUS] of
Nimshi, whom the LORD[JESUS] had anointed to cut off the house of Ahab.

22:8 And it came to pass, that, when Jehu was executing judgment upon
the house of Ahab, and found the princes of Judah, and the sons of the

22:9 And HE[JESUS] sought Ahaziah: and they caught HIM[JESUS], (for HE[JESUS] was hid in

buried HIM[JESUS]: Because, said they, HE[JESUS] is the SON[JESUS] of Jehoshaphat, who sought
the LORD[JESUS] with all HIS[JESUS] heart. So the house of Ahaziah had no power to
keep still the kingdom.

22:10 But when Athaliah the mother of Ahaziah saw that her SON[JESUS] was dead,
she arose and destroyed all the SEED[JESUS] royal of the house of Judah.

22:11 But Jehoshabeath, the daughter of the KING[JESUS], took Joash the SON[JESUS] of
Ahaziah, and stole HIM[JESUS] from among the KING[JESUS]'s sons that were slain, and
put HIM[JESUS] and HIS[JESUS] nurse in a bedchamber. So Jehoshabeath, the daughter of
KING[JESUS] Jehoram, the wife of Jehoiada the priest, (for she was the sister
of Ahaziah,) hid HIM[JESUS] from Athaliah, so that she slew HIM[JESUS] not.

22:12 And HE[JESUS] was with them hid in the house of GOD[JESUS] six years: and
Athaliah reigned over the land.


23:1 And in the seventh year Jehoiada strengthened himself, and took the
captains of hundreds, Azariah the SON[JESUS] of Jeroham, and Ishmael the SON[JESUS] of
Jehohanan, and Azariah the SON[JESUS] of Obed, and Maaseiah the SON[JESUS] of Adaiah,
and Elishaphat the SON[JESUS] of Zichri, into covenant with HIM[JESUS].

23:2 And they went about in Judah, and gathered the Levites out of all
the cities of Judah, and the chief of the fathers of Israel, and they
came to Jerusalem.

23:3 And all the congregation made a covenant with the KING[JESUS] in the house
of GOD[JESUS]. And HE[JESUS] said unto them, Behold, the KING[JESUS]'s SON[JESUS] shall reign, as
the LORD[JESUS] has said of the sons of David.

23:4 This is the thing that you shall do; A third part of you entering on
the sabbath, of the priests and of the Levites, shall be porters of the
