23:5 And a third part shall be at the KING[JESUS]'s house; and a third part at
the gate of the foundation: and all the people shall be in the courts of
the house of the LORD[JESUS].

23:6 But let none come into the house of the LORD[JESUS], save the priests, and
they that minister of the Levites; they shall go in, for they are holy:
but all the people shall keep the watch of the LORD[JESUS].

23:7 And the Levites shall compass the KING[JESUS] round about, every man with
HIS[JESUS] weapons in HIS[JESUS] hand; and whoever else comes into the house, HE[JESUS]
shall be put to death: but be you with the KING[JESUS] when HE[JESUS] comes in, and
when HE[JESUS] goes out.

23:8 So the Levites and all Judah did according to all things that
Jehoiada the priest had commanded, and took every man HIS[JESUS] men that were
to come in on the sabbath, with them that were to go out on the sabbath:
for Jehoiada the priest dismissed not the courses.

23:9 Moreover Jehoiada the priest delivered to the captains of hundreds
spears, and bucklers, and shields, that had been KING[JESUS] David's, which
were in the house of GOD[JESUS].

23:10 And HE[JESUS] set all the people, every man having HIS[JESUS] weapon in HIS[JESUS]
hand, from the right side of the temple to the left side of the temple,
along by the altar and the temple, by the KING[JESUS] round about.

23:11 Then they brought out the KING[JESUS]'s SON[JESUS], and put upon HIM[JESUS] the crown,
and gave HIM[JESUS] the testimony, and made HIM[JESUS] KING[JESUS]. And Jehoiada and HIS[JESUS] sons
anointed HIM[JESUS], and said, GOD[JESUS] save the KING[JESUS].

23:12 Now when Athaliah heard the noise of the people running and
praising the KING[JESUS], she came to the people into the house of the LORD[JESUS]:

23:13 And she looked, and, behold, the KING[JESUS] stood at HIS[JESUS] pillar at the
entering in, and the princes and the trumpets by the KING[JESUS]: and all the
people of the land rejoiced, and sounded with trumpets, also the singers
with instruments of musick, and such as taught to sing praise. Then
Athaliah rent her clothes, and said, Treason, Treason.

23:14 Then Jehoiada the priest brought out the captains of hundreds that
were set over the host, and said unto them, Have her forth of the
ranges: and whoever followeth her, let HIM[JESUS] be slain with the sword. For
the priest said, Slay her not in the house of the LORD[JESUS].

23:15 So they laid hands on her; and when she was come to the entering
of the horse gate by the KING[JESUS]'s house, they slew her there.

23:16 And Jehoiada made a covenant between HIM[JESUS], and between all the
people, and between the KING[JESUS], that they should be the LORD[JESUS]'s people.

23:17 Then all the people went to the house of Baal, and brake it down,
and brake HIS[JESUS] altars and HIS[JESUS] images in pieces, and slew Mattan the
priest of Baal before the altars.

23:18 Also Jehoiada appointed the offices of the house of the LORD[JESUS] by
the hand of the priests the Levites, whom David had distributed in the
house of the LORD[JESUS], to offer the burnt offerings of the LORD[JESUS], as it is
written in the law of Moses, with rejoicing and with singing, as it was
ordained by David.

23:19 And HE[JESUS] set the porters at the gates of the house of the LORD[JESUS], that
none which was unclean in any thing should enter in.

23:20 And HE[JESUS] took the captains of hundreds, and the nobles, and the
governors of the people, and all the people of the land, and brought
down the KING[JESUS] from the house of the LORD[JESUS]: and they came through the high
gate into the KING[JESUS]'s house, and set the KING[JESUS] upon the throne of the
kingdom.

23:21 And all the people of the land rejoiced: and the city was quiet,
after that they had slain Athaliah with the sword.


24:1 Joash was seven years old when HE[JESUS] began to reign, and HE[JESUS] reigned
forty years in Jerusalem. HIS[JESUS] mother's name also was Zibiah of
Beersheba.

24:2 And Joash did that which was right in the sight of the LORD[JESUS] all the
days of Jehoiada the priest.

24:3 And Jehoiada took for HIM[JESUS] two wives; and HE[JESUS] begat sons and
daughters.

24:4 And it came to pass after this, that Joash was minded to repair the
house of the LORD[JESUS].

24:5 And HE[JESUS] gathered together the priests and the Levites, and said to
them, Go out unto the cities of Judah, and gather of all Israel money to
repair the house of your GOD[JESUS] from year to year, and see that you hasten
the matter. Howbeit the Levites hastened it not.

24:6 And the KING[JESUS] called for Jehoiada the chief, and said unto HIM[JESUS], Why
hast you not required of the Levites to bring in out of Judah and out
of Jerusalem the collection, according to the commandment of Moses the
SERVANT[JESUS] of the LORD[JESUS], and of the congregation of Israel, for the
tabernacle of witness?

24:7 For the sons of Athaliah, that wicked woman, had broken up the
house of GOD[JESUS]; and also all the dedicated things of the house of the LORD[JESUS]
did they bestow upon Baalim.

24:8 And at the KING[JESUS]'s commandment they made a chest, and set it without
at the gate of the house of the LORD[JESUS].

24:9 And they made a proclamation through Judah and Jerusalem, to bring
in to the LORD[JESUS] the collection that Moses the SERVANT[JESUS] of GOD[JESUS] laid upon
Israel in the wilderness.

24:10 And all the princes and all the people rejoiced, and brought in,
and cast into the chest, until they had made an end.

24:11 Now it came to pass, that at what time the chest was brought unto
the KING[JESUS]'s office by the hand of the Levites, and when they saw that
there was much money, the KING[JESUS]'s scribe and the high priest's officer
came and emptied the chest, and took it, and carried it to HIS[JESUS] place
again. Thus they did day by day, and gathered money in abundance.

24:12 And the KING[JESUS] and Jehoiada gave it to such as did the work of the
service of the house of the LORD[JESUS], and hired masons and carpenters to
repair the house of the LORD[JESUS], and also such as wrought iron and brass to
mend the house of the LORD[JESUS].

24:13 So the workmen wrought, and the work was perfected by them, and
they set the house of GOD[JESUS] in HIS[JESUS] state, and strengthened it.

24:14 And when they had finished it, they brought the rest of the money
before the KING[JESUS] and Jehoiada, whereof were made vessels for the house of
the LORD[JESUS], even vessels to minister, and to offer withal, and spoons, and
vessels of gold and silver. And they offered burnt offerings in the
house of the LORD[JESUS] continually all the days of Jehoiada.

24:15 But Jehoiada waxed old, and was full of days when HE[JESUS] died; an
hundred and thirty years old was HE[JESUS] when HE[JESUS] died.

24:16 And they buried HIM[JESUS] in the city of David among the kings, because
HE[JESUS] had done good in Israel, both toward GOD[JESUS], and toward HIS[JESUS] house.

24:17 Now after the death of Jehoiada came the princes of Judah, and
made obeisance to the KING[JESUS]. Then the KING[JESUS] hearkened unto them.

24:18 And they left the house of the LORD[JESUS] GOD[JESUS] of their fathers, and
served groves and idols: and wrath came upon Judah and Jerusalem for
this their trespass.

24:19 Yet HE[JESUS] sent prophets to them, to bring them again unto the LORD[JESUS];
and they testified against them: but they would not give ear.

24:20 And the Spirit of GOD[JESUS] came upon Zechariah the SON[JESUS] of Jehoiada the
priest, which stood above the people, and said unto them, Thus says
GOD[JESUS], Why transgress you the commandments of the LORD[JESUS], that you cannot
prosper? because you have forsaken the LORD[JESUS], HE[JESUS] has also forsaken you.

24:21 And they conspired against HIM[JESUS], and stoned HIM[JESUS] with stones at the
commandment of the KING[JESUS] in the court of the house of the LORD[JESUS].

24:22 Thus Joash the KING[JESUS] remembered not the kindness which Jehoiada HIS[JESUS]
father had done to HIM[JESUS], but slew HIS[JESUS] SON[JESUS]. And when HE[JESUS] died, HE[JESUS] said, The
LORD[JESUS] look upon it, and require it.

24:23 And it came to pass at the end of the year, that the host of Syria
came up against HIM[JESUS]: and they came to Judah and Jerusalem, and destroyed
all the princes of the people from among the people, and sent all the
spoil of them unto the KING[JESUS] of Damascus.

24:24 For the army of the Syrians came with a small company of men, and
the LORD[JESUS] delivered a very great host into their hand, because they had
forsaken the LORD[JESUS] GOD[JESUS] of their fathers. So they executed judgment
against Joash.

24:25 And when they were departed from HIM[JESUS], (for they left HIM[JESUS] in great
diseases,) HIS[JESUS] own servants conspired against HIM[JESUS] for the blood of the
sons of Jehoiada the priest, and slew HIM[JESUS] on HIS[JESUS] bed, and HE[JESUS] died: and
they buried HIM[JESUS] in the city of David, but they buried HIM[JESUS] not in the
sepulchres of the kings.

24:26 And these are they that conspired against HIM[JESUS]; Zabad the SON[JESUS] of
Shimeath an Ammonitess, and Jehozabad the SON[JESUS] of Shimrith a Moabitess.

24:27 Now concerning HIS[JESUS] sons, and the greatness of the burdens laid
upon HIM[JESUS], and the repairing of the house of GOD[JESUS], behold, they are
written in the story of the book of the kings. And Amaziah HIS[JESUS] SON[JESUS]
reigned in HIS[JESUS] stead.


25:1 Amaziah was twenty and five years old when HE[JESUS] began to reign, and
HE[JESUS] reigned twenty and nine years in Jerusalem. And HIS[JESUS] mother's name was
Jehoaddan of Jerusalem.

25:2 And HE[JESUS] did that which was right in the sight of the LORD[JESUS], but not
with a perfect heart.

25:3 Now it came to pass, when the kingdom was established to HIM[JESUS], that
HE[JESUS] slew HIS[JESUS] servants that had killed the KING[JESUS] HIS[JESUS] father.

25:4 But HE[JESUS] slew not their children, but did as it is written in the law
in the book of Moses, where the LORD[JESUS] commanded, saying, The fathers
shall not die for the children, neither shall the children die for the
fathers, but every man shall die for HIS[JESUS] own sin.

25:5 Moreover Amaziah gathered Judah together, and made them captains
over thousands, and captains over hundreds, according to the houses of
their fathers, throughout all Judah and Benjamin: and HE[JESUS] numbered them
from twenty years old and above, and found them three hundred thousand
choice men, able to go forth to war, that could handle spear and shield.

25:6 HE[JESUS] hired also an hundred thousand mighty men of valour out of
Israel for an hundred talents of silver.

25:7 But there came a man of GOD[JESUS] to HIM[JESUS], saying, O KING[JESUS], let not the
army of Israel go with you; for the LORD[JESUS] is not with Israel, to wit,
with all the children of Ephraim.

25:8 But if you wilt go, do it; be strong for the battle: GOD[JESUS] shall
make you fall before the enemy: for GOD[JESUS] has power to help, and to cast
down.

25:9 And Amaziah said to the man of GOD[JESUS], But what shall we do for the
hundred talents which I have given to the army of Israel? And the man of
GOD[JESUS] answered, The LORD[JESUS] is able to give you much more than this.

25:10 Then Amaziah separated them, to wit, the army that was come to HIM[JESUS]
out of Ephraim, to go home again: wherefore their anger was greatly
kindled against Judah, and they returned home in great anger.

25:11 And Amaziah strengthened himself, and led forth HIS[JESUS] people, and
went to the valley of salt, and smote of the children of Seir ten
thousand.

25:12 And other ten thousand left alive did the children of Judah carry
away captive, and brought them unto the top of the rock, and cast them
down from the top of the rock, that they all were broken in pieces.

25:13 But the soldiers of the army which Amaziah sent back, that they
should not go with HIM[JESUS] to battle, fell upon the cities of Judah, from
Samaria even unto Bethhoron, and smote three thousand of them, and took
much spoil.

25:14 Now it came to pass, after that Amaziah was come from the
slaughter of the Edomites, that HE[JESUS] brought the gods of the children of
Seir, and set them up to be HIS[JESUS] gods, and bowed down himself before
them, and burned incense unto them.

25:15 Wherefore the anger of the LORD[JESUS] was kindled against Amaziah, and
HE[JESUS] sent unto HIM[JESUS] a PROPHET[JESUS], which said unto HIM[JESUS], Why hast you sought
after the gods of the people, which could not deliver their own people
out of yours hand?

25:16 And it came to pass, as HE[JESUS] talked with HIM[JESUS], that the KING[JESUS] said
unto HIM[JESUS], Art you made of the KING[JESUS]'s counsel? forbear; why shouldest
you be smitten? Then the PROPHET[JESUS] forbare, and said, I know that GOD[JESUS]
has determined to destroy you, because you hast done this, and hast
not hearkened unto my counsel.

25:17 Then Amaziah KING[JESUS] of Judah took advice, and sent to Joash, the SON[JESUS]
of Jehoahaz, the SON[JESUS] of Jehu, KING[JESUS] of Israel, saying, Come, let us see
one another in the face.

25:18 And Joash KING[JESUS] of Israel sent to Amaziah KING[JESUS] of Judah, saying,
The thistle that was in Lebanon sent to the cedar that was in Lebanon,
saying, Give your daughter to my SON[JESUS] to wife: and there passed by a wild
beast that was in Lebanon, and trode down the thistle.

25:19 you sayest, Lo, you hast smitten the Edomites; and yours heart
lifteth you up to boast: abide now at home; why shouldest you meddle
to yours hurt, that you shouldest fall, even you, and Judah with you?

25:20 But Amaziah would not hear; for it came of GOD[JESUS], that HE[JESUS] might
deliver them into the hand of their enemies, because they sought after
the gods of Edom.

25:21 So Joash the KING[JESUS] of Israel went up; and they saw one another in
the face, both HE[JESUS] and Amaziah KING[JESUS] of Judah, at Bethshemesh, which
belongeth to Judah.

25:22 And Judah was put to the worse before Israel, and they fled every
man to HIS[JESUS] tent.

25:23 And Joash the KING[JESUS] of Israel took Amaziah KING[JESUS] of Judah, the SON[JESUS]
of Joash, the SON[JESUS] of Jehoahaz, at Bethshemesh, and brought HIM[JESUS] to
Jerusalem, and brake down the wall of Jerusalem from the gate of Ephraim
to the corner gate, four hundred cubits.

25:24 And HE[JESUS] took all the gold and the silver, and all the vessels that
were found in the house of GOD[JESUS] with Obededom, and the treasures of the
KING[JESUS]'s house, the hostages also, and returned to Samaria.

25:25 And Amaziah the SON[JESUS] of Joash KING[JESUS] of Judah lived after the death
of Joash SON[JESUS] of Jehoahaz KING[JESUS] of Israel fifteen years.

25:26 Now the rest of the acts of Amaziah, first and last, behold, are
they not written in the book of the kings of Judah and Israel?

25:27 Now after the time that Amaziah did turn away from following the
LORD[JESUS] they made a conspiracy against HIM[JESUS] in Jerusalem; and HE[JESUS] fled to
Lachish: but they sent to Lachish after HIM[JESUS], and slew HIM[JESUS] there.

25:28 And they brought HIM[JESUS] upon horses, and buried HIM[JESUS] with HIS[JESUS] fathers
in the city of Judah.


26:1 Then all the people of Judah took Uzziah, who was sixteen years
old, and made HIM[JESUS] KING[JESUS] in the room of HIS[JESUS] father Amaziah.

26:2 HE[JESUS] built Eloth, and restored it to Judah, after that the KING[JESUS] slept
with HIS[JESUS] fathers.

26:3 Sixteen years old was Uzziah when HE[JESUS] began to reign, and HE[JESUS] reigned
fifty and two years in Jerusalem. HIS[JESUS] mother's name also was Jecoliah of
Jerusalem.

26:4 And HE[JESUS] did that which was right in the sight of the LORD[JESUS], according
to all that HIS[JESUS] father Amaziah did.

26:5 And HE[JESUS] sought GOD[JESUS] in the days of Zechariah, who had understanding
in the visions of GOD[JESUS]: and as long as HE[JESUS] sought the LORD[JESUS], GOD[JESUS] made HIM[JESUS]
to prosper.

26:6 And HE[JESUS] went forth and warred against the Philistines, and brake
down the wall of Gath, and the wall of Jabneh, and the wall of Ashdod,
and built cities about Ashdod, and among the Philistines.

26:7 And GOD[JESUS] helped HIM[JESUS] against the Philistines, and against the
Arabians that dwelt in Gurbaal, and the Mehunims.

26:8 And the Ammonites gave gifts to Uzziah: and HIS[JESUS] name spread abroad
even to the entering in of Egypt; for HE[JESUS] strengthened himself
exceedingly.

26:9 Moreover Uzziah built towers in Jerusalem at the corner gate, and
at the valley gate, and at the turning of the wall, and fortified them.

26:10 Also HE[JESUS] built towers in the desert, and digged many wells: for HE[JESUS]
had much cattle, both in the low country, and in the plains: husbandmen
also, and vine dressers in the mountains, and in Carmel: for HE[JESUS] loved
husbandry.

26:11 Moreover Uzziah had an host of fighting men, that went out to war
by bands, according to the number of their account by the hand of Jeiel
the scribe and Maaseiah the ruler, under the hand of Hananiah, one of
the KING[JESUS]'s captains.

26:12 The whole number of the chief of the fathers of the mighty men of
valour were two thousand and six hundred.

26:13 And under their hand was an army, three hundred thousand and seven
thousand and five hundred, that made war with mighty power, to help the
KING[JESUS] against the enemy.

26:14 And Uzziah prepared for them throughout all the host shields, and
spears, and helmets, and habergeons, and bows, and slings to cast
stones.

26:15 And HE[JESUS] made in Jerusalem engines, invented by cunning men, to be
on the towers and upon the bulwarks, to shoot arrows and great stones
withal. And HIS[JESUS] name spread far abroad; for HE[JESUS] was marvellously helped,
till HE[JESUS] was strong.

26:16 But when HE[JESUS] was strong, HIS[JESUS] heart was lifted up to HIS[JESUS]
destruction: for HE[JESUS] transgressed against the LORD[JESUS] HIS[JESUS] GOD[JESUS], and went into
the temple of the LORD[JESUS] to burn incense upon the altar of incense.

26:17 And Azariah the priest went in after HIM[JESUS], and with HIM[JESUS] fourscore
priests of the LORD[JESUS], that were valiant men:

26:18 And they withstood Uzziah the KING[JESUS], and said unto HIM[JESUS], It
appertaineth not unto you, Uzziah, to burn incense unto the LORD[JESUS], but
to the priests the sons of Aaron, that are consecrated to burn incense:
go out of the sanctuary; for you hast trespassed; neither shall it be
for yours honour from the LORD[JESUS] GOD[JESUS].

26:19 Then Uzziah was wroth, and had a censer in HIS[JESUS] hand to burn
incense: and while HE[JESUS] was wroth with the priests, the leprosy even rose
up in HIS[JESUS] forehead before the priests in the house of the LORD[JESUS], from
beside the incense altar.

26:20 And Azariah the chief priest, and all the priests, looked upon
HIM[JESUS], and, behold, HE[JESUS] was leprous in HIS[JESUS] forehead, and they thrust HIM[JESUS]
out from thence; yea, himself hasted also to go out, because the LORD[JESUS]
had smitten HIM[JESUS].

26:21 And Uzziah the KING[JESUS] was a leper unto the day of HIS[JESUS] death, and
dwelt in a several house, being a leper; for HE[JESUS] was cut off from the
house of the LORD[JESUS]: and Jotham HIS[JESUS] SON[JESUS] was over the KING[JESUS]'s house, judging
the people of the land.

26:22 Now the rest of the acts of Uzziah, first and last, did Isaiah the
PROPHET[JESUS], the SON[JESUS] of Amoz, write.

26:23 So Uzziah slept with HIS[JESUS] fathers, and they buried HIM[JESUS] with HIS[JESUS]
fathers in the field of the burial which belonged to the kings; for they
said, HE[JESUS] is a leper: and Jotham HIS[JESUS] SON[JESUS] reigned in HIS[JESUS] stead.


27:1 Jotham was twenty and five years old when HE[JESUS] began to reign, and HE[JESUS]
reigned sixteen years in Jerusalem. HIS[JESUS] mother's name also was Jerushah,
the daughter of Zadok.

27:2 And HE[JESUS] did that which was right in the sight of the LORD[JESUS], according
to all that HIS[JESUS] father Uzziah did: howbeit HE[JESUS] entered not into the
temple of the LORD[JESUS]. And the people did yet corruptly.

27:3 HE[JESUS] built the high gate of the house of the LORD[JESUS], and on the wall of
Ophel HE[JESUS] built much.

27:4 Moreover HE[JESUS] built cities in the mountains of Judah, and in the
forests HE[JESUS] built castles and towers.

27:5 HE[JESUS] fought also with the KING[JESUS] of the Ammonites, and prevailed
against them. And the children of Ammon gave HIM[JESUS] the same year an
hundred talents of silver, and ten thousand measures of wheat, and ten
thousand of barley. So much did the children of Ammon pay unto HIM[JESUS], both
the second year, and the third.

27:6 So Jotham became mighty, because HE[JESUS] prepared HIS[JESUS] ways before the
LORD[JESUS] HIS[JESUS] GOD[JESUS].

27:7 Now the rest of the acts of Jotham, and all HIS[JESUS] wars, and HIS[JESUS] ways,
lo, they are written in the book of the kings of Israel and Judah.

27:8 HE[JESUS] was five and twenty years old when HE[JESUS] began to reign, and
reigned sixteen years in Jerusalem.

27:9 And Jotham slept with HIS[JESUS] fathers, and they buried HIM[JESUS] in the city
of David: and Ahaz HIS[JESUS] SON[JESUS] reigned in HIS[JESUS] stead.


28:1 Ahaz was twenty years old when HE[JESUS] began to reign, and HE[JESUS] reigned
sixteen years in Jerusalem: but HE[JESUS] did not that which was right in the
sight of the LORD[JESUS], like David HIS[JESUS] father:

28:2 For HE[JESUS] walked in the ways of the kings of Israel, and made also
molten images for Baalim.

28:3 Moreover HE[JESUS] burnt incense in the valley of the SON[JESUS] of Hinnom, and
burnt HIS[JESUS] children in the fire, after the abominations of the heathen
whom the LORD[JESUS] had cast out before the children of Israel.

28:4 HE[JESUS] sacrificed also and burnt incense in the high places, and on the
hills, and under every green tree.

28:5 Wherefore the LORD[JESUS] HIS[JESUS] GOD[JESUS] delivered HIM[JESUS] into the hand of the KING[JESUS]
of Syria; and they smote HIM[JESUS], and carried away a great multitude of them
captives, and brought them to Damascus. And HE[JESUS] was also delivered into
the hand of the KING[JESUS] of Israel, who smote HIM[JESUS] with a great slaughter.

28:6 For Pekah the SON[JESUS] of Remaliah slew in Judah an hundred and twenty
thousand in one day, which were all valiant men; because they had
forsaken the LORD[JESUS] GOD[JESUS] of their fathers.

28:7 And Zichri, a mighty man of Ephraim, slew Maaseiah the KING[JESUS]'s SON[JESUS],
and Azrikam the governor of the house, and Elkanah that was next to the
KING[JESUS].

28:8 And the children of Israel carried away captive of their brethren
two hundred thousand, women, sons, and daughters, and took also away
much spoil from them, and brought the spoil to Samaria.

28:9 But a PROPHET[JESUS] of the LORD[JESUS] was there, whose name was Oded: and HE[JESUS]
went out before the host that came to Samaria, and said unto them,
Behold, because the LORD[JESUS] GOD[JESUS] of your fathers was wroth with Judah, HE[JESUS]
has delivered them into your hand, and you have slain them in a rage
that reacheth up unto heaven.

28:10 And now you purpose to keep under the children of Judah and
Jerusalem for bondmen and bondwomen unto you: but are there not with
you, even with you, sins against the LORD[JESUS] your GOD[JESUS]?

28:11 Now hear me therefore, and deliver the captives again, which you
have taken captive of your brethren: for the fierce wrath of the LORD[JESUS] is
upon you.

28:12 Then certain of the heads of the children of Ephraim, Azariah the
SON[JESUS] of Johanan, Berechiah the SON[JESUS] of Meshillemoth, and Jehizkiah the SON[JESUS]
of Shallum, and Amasa the SON[JESUS] of Hadlai, stood up against them that came
from the war,

28:13 And said unto them, you shall not bring in the captives hither: for
whereas we have offended against the LORD[JESUS] already, you intend to add more
to our sins and to our trespass: for our trespass is great, and there is
fierce wrath against Israel.

28:14 So the armed men left the captives and the spoil before the
princes and all the congregation.

28:15 And the men which were expressed by name rose up, and took the
captives, and with the spoil clothed all that were naked among them, and
arrayed them, and shod them, and gave them to eat and to drink, and
anointed them, and carried all the feeble of them upon asses, and
brought them to Jericho, the city of palm trees, to their brethren: then
they returned to Samaria.

28:16 At that time did KING[JESUS] Ahaz send unto the kings of Assyria to help
HIM[JESUS].

28:17 For again the Edomites had come and smitten Judah, and carried
away captives.

28:18 The Philistines also had invaded the cities of the low country,
and of the south of Judah, and had taken Bethshemesh, and Ajalon, and
Gederoth, and Shocho with the villages thereof, and Timnah with the
villages thereof, Gimzo also and the villages thereof: and they dwelt
there.

28:19 For the LORD[JESUS] brought Judah low because of Ahaz KING[JESUS] of Israel; for
HE[JESUS] made Judah naked, and transgressed sore against the LORD[JESUS].

28:20 And Tilgathpilneser KING[JESUS] of Assyria came unto HIM[JESUS], and distressed
HIM[JESUS], but strengthened HIM[JESUS] not.

28:21 For Ahaz took away a portion out of the house of the LORD[JESUS], and out
of the house of the KING[JESUS], and of the princes, and gave it unto the KING[JESUS]
of Assyria: but HE[JESUS] helped HIM[JESUS] not.

28:22 And in the time of HIS[JESUS] distress did HE[JESUS] trespass yet more against
the LORD[JESUS]: this is that KING[JESUS] Ahaz.

28:23 For HE[JESUS] sacrificed unto the gods of Damascus, which smote HIM[JESUS]: and
HE[JESUS] said, Because the gods of the kings of Syria help them, therefore
will I sacrifice to them, that they may help me. But they were the ruin
of HIM[JESUS], and of all Israel.

28:24 And Ahaz gathered together the vessels of the house of GOD[JESUS], and
cut in pieces the vessels of the house of GOD[JESUS], and shut up the doors of
the house of the LORD[JESUS], and HE[JESUS] made HIM[JESUS] altars in every corner of
Jerusalem.

28:25 And in every several city of Judah HE[JESUS] made high places to burn
incense unto other gods, and provoked to anger the LORD[JESUS] GOD[JESUS] of HIS[JESUS]
fathers.

28:26 Now the rest of HIS[JESUS] acts and of all HIS[JESUS] ways, first and last,
behold, they are written in the book of the kings of Judah and Israel.

28:27 And Ahaz slept with HIS[JESUS] fathers, and they buried HIM[JESUS] in the city,
even in Jerusalem: but they brought HIM[JESUS] not into the sepulchres of the
kings of Israel: and Hezekiah HIS[JESUS] SON[JESUS] reigned in HIS[JESUS] stead.


29:1 Hezekiah began to reign when HE[JESUS] was five and twenty years old, and
HE[JESUS] reigned nine and twenty years in Jerusalem. And HIS[JESUS] mother's name was
Abijah, the daughter of Zechariah.

29:2 And HE[JESUS] did that which was right in the sight of the LORD[JESUS], according
to all that David HIS[JESUS] father had done.

29:3 HE[JESUS] in the first year of HIS[JESUS] reign, in the first month, opened the
doors of the house of the LORD[JESUS], and repaired them.

29:4 And HE[JESUS] brought in the priests and the Levites, and gathered them
together into the east street,

29:5 And said unto them, Hear me, you Levites, sanctify now yourselves,
and sanctify the house of the LORD[JESUS] GOD[JESUS] of your fathers, and carry forth
the filthiness out of the holy place.

29:6 For our fathers have trespassed, and done that which was evil in
the eyes of the LORD[JESUS] our GOD[JESUS], and have forsaken HIM[JESUS], and have turned
away their faces from the habitation of the LORD[JESUS], and turned their
backs.

29:7 Also they have shut up the doors of the porch, and put out the
lamps, and have not burned incense nor offered burnt offerings in the
holy place unto the GOD[JESUS] of Israel.

29:8 Wherefore the wrath of the LORD[JESUS] was upon Judah and Jerusalem, and
HE[JESUS] has delivered them to trouble, to astonishment, and to hissing, as
you see with your eyes.

29:9 For, lo, our fathers have fallen by the sword, and our sons and our
daughters and our wives are in captivity for this.

29:10 Now it is in mine heart to make a covenant with the LORD[JESUS] GOD[JESUS] of
Israel, that HIS[JESUS] fierce wrath may turn away from us.

29:11 My sons, be not now negligent: for the LORD[JESUS] has chosen you to
stand before HIM[JESUS], to serve HIM[JESUS], and that you should minister unto HIM[JESUS],
and burn incense.

29:12 Then the Levites arose, Mahath the SON[JESUS] of Amasai, and Joel the SON[JESUS]
of Azariah, of the sons of the Kohathites: and of the sons of Merari,
Kish the SON[JESUS] of Abdi, and Azariah the SON[JESUS] of Jehalelel: and of the
Gershonites; Joah the SON[JESUS] of Zimmah, and Eden the SON[JESUS] of Joah:

29:13 And of the sons of Elizaphan; Shimri, and Jeiel: and of the sons
of Asaph; Zechariah, and Mattaniah:

29:14 And of the sons of Heman; Jehiel, and Shimei: and of the sons of
Jeduthun; Shemaiah, and Uzziel.

29:15 And they gathered their brethren, and sanctified themselves, and
came, according to the commandment of the KING[JESUS], by the words of the
LORD[JESUS], to cleanse the house of the LORD[JESUS].

29:16 And the priests went into the inner part of the house of the LORD[JESUS],
to cleanse it, and brought out all the uncleanness that they found in
the temple of the LORD[JESUS] into the court of the house of the LORD[JESUS]. And the
Levites took it, to carry it out abroad into the brook Kidron.

29:17 Now they began on the first day of the first month to sanctify,
and on the eighth day of the month came they to the porch of the LORD[JESUS]:
so they sanctified the house of the LORD[JESUS] in eight days; and in the
sixteenth day of the first month they made an end.

29:18 Then they went in to Hezekiah the KING[JESUS], and said, We have cleansed
all the house of the LORD[JESUS], and the altar of burnt offering, with all the
vessels thereof, and the shewbread table, with all the vessels thereof.

29:19 Moreover all the vessels, which KING[JESUS] Ahaz in HIS[JESUS] reign did cast
away in HIS[JESUS] transgression, have we prepared and sanctified, and, behold,
they are before the altar of the LORD[JESUS].

29:20 Then Hezekiah the KING[JESUS] rose early, and gathered the rulers of the
city, and went up to the house of the LORD[JESUS].

29:21 And they brought seven bullocks, and seven rams, and seven lambs,
and seven HE[JESUS] goats, for a sin offering for the kingdom, and for the
sanctuary, and for Judah. And HE[JESUS] commanded the priests the sons of Aaron
to offer them on the altar of the LORD[JESUS].

29:22 So they killed the bullocks, and the priests received the blood,
and sprinkled it on the altar: likewise, when they had killed the rams,
they sprinkled the blood upon the altar: they killed also the lambs, and
they sprinkled the blood upon the altar.

29:23 And they brought forth the HE[JESUS] goats for the sin offering before
the KING[JESUS] and the congregation; and they laid their hands upon them:

29:24 And the priests killed them, and they made reconciliation with
their blood upon the altar, to make an atonement for all Israel: for the
KING[JESUS] commanded that the burnt offering and the sin offering should be
made for all Israel.

29:25 And HE[JESUS] set the Levites in the house of the LORD[JESUS] with cymbals, with
psalteries, and with harps, according to the commandment of David, and
of Gad the KING[JESUS]'s seer, and Nathan the PROPHET[JESUS]: for so was the
commandment of the LORD[JESUS] by HIS[JESUS] prophets.

29:26 And the Levites stood with the instruments of David, and the
priests with the trumpets.

29:27 And Hezekiah commanded to offer the burnt offering upon the altar.
And when the burnt offering began, the song of the LORD[JESUS] began also with
the trumpets, and with the instruments ordained by David KING[JESUS] of Israel.

29:28 And all the congregation worshipped, and the singers sang, and the
trumpeters sounded: and all this continued until the burnt offering was
finished.

29:29 And when they had made an end of offering, the KING[JESUS] and all that
were present with HIM[JESUS] bowed themselves, and worshipped.

29:30 Moreover Hezekiah the KING[JESUS] and the princes commanded the Levites
to sing praise unto the LORD[JESUS] with the words of David, and of Asaph the
seer. And they sang praises with gladness, and they bowed their heads
and worshipped.

29:31 Then Hezekiah answered and said, Now you have consecrated
yourselves unto the LORD[JESUS], come near and bring sacrifices and thank
offerings into the house of the LORD[JESUS]. And the congregation brought in
sacrifices and thank offerings; and as many as were of a free heart
burnt offerings.

29:32 And the number of the burnt offerings, which the congregation
brought, was threescore and ten bullocks, an hundred rams, and two
hundred lambs: all these were for a burnt offering to the LORD[JESUS].

29:33 And the consecrated things were six hundred oxen and three
thousand sheep.

29:34 But the priests were too few, so that they could not flay all the
burnt offerings: wherefore their brethren the Levites did help them,
till the work was ended, and until the other priests had sanctified
themselves: for the Levites were more upright in heart to sanctify
themselves than the priests.

29:35 And also the burnt offerings were in abundance, with the fat of
the peace offerings, and the drink offerings for every burnt offering.
So the service of the house of the LORD[JESUS] was set in order.

29:36 And Hezekiah rejoiced, and all the people, that GOD[JESUS] had prepared
the people: for the thing was done suddenly.


30:1 And Hezekiah sent to all Israel and Judah, and wrote letters also
to Ephraim and Manasseh, that they should come to the house of the LORD[JESUS]
at Jerusalem, to keep the passover unto the LORD[JESUS] GOD[JESUS] of Israel.

30:2 For the KING[JESUS] had taken counsel, and HIS[JESUS] princes, and all the
congregation in Jerusalem, to keep the passover in the second month.

30:3 For they could not keep it at that time, because the priests had
not sanctified themselves sufficiently, neither had the people gathered
themselves together to Jerusalem.

30:4 And the thing pleased the KING[JESUS] and all the congregation.

30:5 So they established a decree to make proclamation throughout all
Israel, from Beersheba even to Dan, that they should come to keep the
passover unto the LORD[JESUS] GOD[JESUS] of Israel at Jerusalem: for they had not done
it of a long time in such sort as it was written.

30:6 So the posts went with the letters from the KING[JESUS] and HIS[JESUS] princes
throughout all Israel and Judah, and according to the commandment of the
KING[JESUS], saying, you children of Israel, turn again unto the LORD[JESUS] GOD[JESUS] of
Abraham, Isaac, and Israel, and HE[JESUS] will return to the remnant of you,
that are escaped out of the hand of the kings of Assyria.

30:7 And be not you like your fathers, and like your brethren, which
trespassed against the LORD[JESUS] GOD[JESUS] of their fathers, who therefore gave
them up to desolation, as you see.

30:8 Now be you not stiffnecked, as your fathers were, but yield
yourselves unto the LORD[JESUS], and enter into HIS[JESUS] sanctuary, which HE[JESUS] has
sanctified for ever: and serve the LORD[JESUS] your GOD[JESUS], that the fierceness of
HIS[JESUS] wrath may turn away from you.

30:9 For if you turn again unto the LORD[JESUS], your brethren and your children
shall find compassion before them that lead them captive, so that they
shall come again into this land: for the LORD[JESUS] your GOD[JESUS] is gracious and
merciful, and will not turn away HIS[JESUS] face from you, if you return unto
HIM[JESUS].

30:10 So the posts passed from city to city through the country of
Ephraim and Manasseh even unto Zebulun: but they laughed them to scorn,
and mocked them.

30:11 Nevertheless divers of Asher and Manasseh and of Zebulun humbled
themselves, and came to Jerusalem.

30:12 Also in Judah the hand of GOD[JESUS] was to give them one heart to do the
commandment of the KING[JESUS] and of the princes, by the WORD[JESUS] of the LORD[JESUS].

30:13 And there assembled at Jerusalem much people to keep the feast of
unleavened bread in the second month, a very great congregation.

30:14 And they arose and took away the altars that were in Jerusalem,
and all the altars for incense took they away, and cast them into the
brook Kidron.

30:15 Then they killed the passover on the fourteenth day of the second
month: and the priests and the Levites were ashamed, and sanctified
themselves, and brought in the burnt offerings into the house of the
LORD[JESUS].

30:16 And they stood in their place after their manner, according to the
law of Moses the man of GOD[JESUS]: the priests sprinkled the blood, which they
received of the hand of the Levites.

30:17 For there were many in the congregation that were not sanctified:
therefore the Levites had the charge of the killing of the passovers for
every one that was not clean, to sanctify them unto the LORD[JESUS].

30:18 For a multitude of the people, even many of Ephraim, and Manasseh,
Issachar, and Zebulun, had not cleansed themselves, yet did they eat the
passover otherwise than it was written. But Hezekiah prayed for them,
saying, The good LORD[JESUS] pardon every one

30:19 That prepareth HIS[JESUS] heart to seek GOD[JESUS], the LORD[JESUS] GOD[JESUS] of HIS[JESUS] fathers,
though HE[JESUS] be not cleansed according to the purification of the
sanctuary.

30:20 And the LORD[JESUS] hearkened to Hezekiah, and healed the people.

30:21 And the children of Israel that were present at Jerusalem kept the
feast of unleavened bread seven days with great gladness: and the
Levites and the priests praised the LORD[JESUS] day by day, singing with loud
instruments unto the LORD[JESUS].

30:22 And Hezekiah spake comfortably unto all the Levites that taught
the good knowledge of the LORD[JESUS]: and they did eat throughout the feast
seven days, offering peace offerings, and making confession to the LORD[JESUS]
GOD[JESUS] of their fathers.

30:23 And the whole assembly took counsel to keep other seven days: and
they kept other seven days with gladness.

30:24 For Hezekiah KING[JESUS] of Judah did give to the congregation a thousand
bullocks and seven thousand sheep; and the princes gave to the
congregation a thousand bullocks and ten thousand sheep: and a great
number of priests sanctified themselves.

30:25 And all the congregation of Judah, with the priests and the
Levites, and all the congregation that came out of Israel, and the
strangers that came out of the land of Israel, and that dwelt in Judah,
rejoiced.

30:26 So there was great joy in Jerusalem: for since the time of Solomon
the SON[JESUS] of David KING[JESUS] of Israel there was not the like in Jerusalem.

30:27 Then the priests the Levites arose and blessed the people: and
their voice was heard, and their prayer came up to HIS[JESUS] holy dwelling
place, even unto heaven.


31:1 Now when all this was finished, all Israel that were present went
out to the cities of Judah, and brake the images in pieces, and cut down
the groves, and threw down the high places and the altars out of all
Judah and Benjamin, in Ephraim also and Manasseh, until they had utterly
destroyed them all. Then all the children of Israel returned, every man
to HIS[JESUS] possession, into their own cities.

31:2 And Hezekiah appointed the courses of the priests and the Levites
after their courses, every man according to HIS[JESUS] service, the priests and
Levites for burnt offerings and for peace offerings, to minister, and to
give thanks, and to praise in the gates of the tents of the LORD[JESUS].

31:3 HE[JESUS] appointed also the KING[JESUS]'s portion of HIS[JESUS] substance for the burnt
offerings, to wit, for the morning and evening burnt offerings, and the
burnt offerings for the sabbaths, and for the new moons, and for the set
feasts, as it is written in the law of the LORD[JESUS].

31:4 Moreover HE[JESUS] commanded the people that dwelt in Jerusalem to give
the portion of the priests and the Levites, that they might be
encouraged in the law of the LORD[JESUS].

31:5 And as soon as the commandment came abroad, the children of Israel
brought in abundance the firstfruits of corn, wine, and oil, and honey,
and of all the increase of the field; and the tithe of all things
brought they in abundantly.

31:6 And concerning the children of Israel and Judah, that dwelt in the
cities of Judah, they also brought in the tithe of oxen and sheep, and
the tithe of holy things which were consecrated unto the LORD[JESUS] their GOD[JESUS],
and laid them by heaps.

31:7 In the third month they began to lay the foundation of the heaps,
and finished them in the seventh month.

31:8 And when Hezekiah and the princes came and saw the heaps, they
blessed the LORD[JESUS], and HIS[JESUS] people Israel.

31:9 Then Hezekiah questioned with the priests and the Levites
concerning the heaps.

31:10 And Azariah the chief priest of the house of Zadok answered HIM[JESUS],
and said, Since the people began to bring the offerings into the house
of the LORD[JESUS], we have had enough to eat, and have left plenty: for the
LORD[JESUS] has blessed HIS[JESUS] people; and that which is left is this great
store.

31:11 Then Hezekiah commanded to prepare chambers in the house of the
LORD[JESUS]; and they prepared them,

31:12 And brought in the offerings and the tithes and the dedicated
things faithfully: over which Cononiah the Levite was ruler, and Shimei
HIS[JESUS] brother was the next.

31:13 And Jehiel, and Azaziah, and Nahath, and Asahel, and Jerimoth, and
Jozabad, and Eliel, and Ismachiah, and Mahath, and Benaiah, were
overseers under the hand of Cononiah and Shimei HIS[JESUS] brother, at the
commandment of Hezekiah the KING[JESUS], and Azariah the ruler of the house of
GOD[JESUS].

31:14 And Kore the SON[JESUS] of Imnah the Levite, the porter toward the east,
was over the freewill offerings of GOD[JESUS], to distribute the oblations of
the LORD[JESUS], and the most holy things.

31:15 And next HIM[JESUS] were Eden, and Miniamin, and Jeshua, and Shemaiah,
Amariah, and Shecaniah, in the cities of the priests, in their set
office, to give to their brethren by courses, as well to the great as to
the small:

31:16 Beside their genealogy of males, from three years old and upward,
even unto every one that entereth into the house of the LORD[JESUS], HIS[JESUS] daily
portion for their service in their charges according to their courses;

31:17 Both to the genealogy of the priests by the house of their
fathers, and the Levites from twenty years old and upward, in their
charges by their courses;

31:18 And to the genealogy of all their little ones, their wives, and
their sons, and their daughters, through all the congregation: for in
their set office they sanctified themselves in holiness:

31:19 Also of the sons of Aaron the priests, which were in the fields of
the suburbs of their cities, in every several city, the men that were
expressed by name, to give portions to all the males among the priests,
and to all that were reckoned by genealogies among the Levites.

31:20 And thus did Hezekiah throughout all Judah, and wrought that which
was good and right and truth before the LORD[JESUS] HIS[JESUS] GOD[JESUS].

31:21 And in every work that HE[JESUS] began in the service of the house of
GOD[JESUS], and in the law, and in the commandments, to seek HIS[JESUS] GOD[JESUS], HE[JESUS] did it
with all HIS[JESUS] heart, and prospered.


32:1 After these things, and the establishment thereof, Sennacherib KING[JESUS]
of Assyria came, and entered into Judah, and encamped against the fenced
cities, and thought to win them for himself.

32:2 And when Hezekiah saw that Sennacherib was come, and that HE[JESUS] was
purposed to fight against Jerusalem,

32:3 HE[JESUS] took counsel with HIS[JESUS] princes and HIS[JESUS] mighty men to stop the
waters of the fountains which were without the city: and they did help
HIM[JESUS].

32:4 So there was gathered much people together, who stopped all the
fountains, and the brook that ran through the midst of the land, saying,
Why should the kings of Assyria come, and find much water?

32:5 Also HE[JESUS] strengthened himself, and built up all the wall that was
broken, and raised it up to the towers, and another wall without, and
repaired Millo in the city of David, and made darts and shields in
abundance.

32:6 And HE[JESUS] set captains of war over the people, and gathered them
together to HIM[JESUS] in the street of the gate of the city, and spake
comfortably to them, saying,

32:7 Be strong and courageous, be not afraid nor dismayed for the KING[JESUS]
of Assyria, nor for all the multitude that is with HIM[JESUS]: for there be
more with us than with HIM[JESUS]:

32:8 With HIM[JESUS] is an arm of flesh; but with us is the LORD[JESUS] our GOD[JESUS] to
help us, and to fight our battles. And the people rested themselves upon
the words of Hezekiah KING[JESUS] of Judah.

32:9 After this did Sennacherib KING[JESUS] of Assyria send HIS[JESUS] servants to
Jerusalem, (but HE[JESUS] himself laid siege against Lachish, and all HIS[JESUS] power
with HIM[JESUS],) unto Hezekiah KING[JESUS] of Judah, and unto all Judah that were at
Jerusalem, saying,

32:10 Thus says Sennacherib KING[JESUS] of Assyria, Whereon do you trust, that
you abide in the siege in Jerusalem?

32:11 does not Hezekiah persuade you to give over yourselves to die by
famine and by thirst, saying, The LORD[JESUS] our GOD[JESUS] shall deliver us out of
the hand of the KING[JESUS] of Assyria?

32:12 has not the same Hezekiah taken away HIS[JESUS] high places and HIS[JESUS]
altars, and commanded Judah and Jerusalem, saying, you shall worship
before one altar, and burn incense upon it?

32:13 Know you not what I and my fathers have done unto all the people of
other lands? were the gods of the nations of those lands any ways able
to deliver their lands out of mine hand?

32:14 Who was there among all the gods of those nations that my fathers
utterly destroyed, that could deliver HIS[JESUS] people out of mine hand, that
your GOD[JESUS] should be able to deliver you out of mine hand?

32:15 Now therefore let not Hezekiah deceive you, nor persuade you on
this manner, neither yet believe HIM[JESUS]: for no GOD[JESUS] of any nation or
kingdom was able to deliver HIS[JESUS] people out of mine hand, and out of the
hand of my fathers: how much less shall your GOD[JESUS] deliver you out of mine
hand?

32:16 And HIS[JESUS] servants spake yet more against the LORD[JESUS] GOD[JESUS], and against
HIS[JESUS] SERVANT[JESUS] Hezekiah.

32:17 HE[JESUS] wrote also letters to rail on the LORD[JESUS] GOD[JESUS] of Israel, and to
speak against HIM[JESUS], saying, As the gods of the nations of other lands
have not delivered their people out of mine hand, so shall not the GOD[JESUS]
of Hezekiah deliver HIS[JESUS] people out of mine hand.

32:18 Then they cried with a loud voice in the Jews' speech unto the
people of Jerusalem that were on the wall, to affright them, and to
trouble them; that they might take the city.

32:19 And they spake against the GOD[JESUS] of Jerusalem, as against the gods
of the people of the earth, which were the work of the hands of man.

32:20 And for this cause Hezekiah the KING[JESUS], and the PROPHET[JESUS] Isaiah the
SON[JESUS] of Amoz, prayed and cried to heaven.

32:21 And the LORD[JESUS] sent an angel, which cut off all the mighty men of
valour, and the leaders and captains in the camp of the KING[JESUS] of Assyria.
So HE[JESUS] returned with shame of face to HIS[JESUS] own land. And when HE[JESUS] was come
into the house of HIS[JESUS] GOD[JESUS], they that came forth of HIS[JESUS] own bowels slew
HIM[JESUS] there with the sword.

32:22 Thus the LORD[JESUS] saved Hezekiah and the inhabitants of Jerusalem from
the hand of Sennacherib the KING[JESUS] of Assyria, and from the hand of all
other, and guided them on every side.

32:23 And many brought gifts unto the LORD[JESUS] to Jerusalem, and presents to
Hezekiah KING[JESUS] of Judah: so that HE[JESUS] was magnified in the sight of all
nations from thenceforth.

32:24 In those days Hezekiah was sick to the death, and prayed unto the
LORD[JESUS]: and HE[JESUS] spake unto HIM[JESUS], and HE[JESUS] gave HIM[JESUS] a sign.

32:25 But Hezekiah rendered not again according to the benefit done unto
HIM[JESUS]; for HIS[JESUS] heart was lifted up: therefore there was wrath upon HIM[JESUS],
and upon Judah and Jerusalem.

32:26 Notwithstanding Hezekiah humbled himself for the pride of HIS[JESUS]
heart, both HE[JESUS] and the inhabitants of Jerusalem, so that the wrath of
the LORD[JESUS] came not upon them in the days of Hezekiah.

32:27 And Hezekiah had exceeding much riches and honour: and HE[JESUS] made
himself treasuries for silver, and for gold, and for precious stones,
and for spices, and for shields, and for all manner of pleasant jewels;

32:28 Storehouses also for the increase of corn, and wine, and oil; and
stalls for all manner of beasts, and cotes for flocks.

32:29 Moreover HE[JESUS] provided HIM[JESUS] cities, and possessions of flocks and
herds in abundance: for GOD[JESUS] had given HIM[JESUS] substance very much.

32:30 This same Hezekiah also stopped the upper watercourse of Gihon,
and brought it straight down to the west side of the city of David. And
Hezekiah prospered in all HIS[JESUS] works.

32:31 Howbeit in the business of the ambassadors of the princes of
Babylon, who sent unto HIM[JESUS] to enquire of the wonder that was done in the
land, GOD[JESUS] left HIM[JESUS], to try HIM[JESUS], that HE[JESUS] might know all that was in HIS[JESUS]
heart.

32:32 Now the rest of the acts of Hezekiah, and HIS[JESUS] goodness, behold,
they are written in the vision of Isaiah the PROPHET[JESUS], the SON[JESUS] of Amoz,
and in the book of the kings of Judah and Israel.

32:33 And Hezekiah slept with HIS[JESUS] fathers, and they buried HIM[JESUS] in the
chiefest of the sepulchres of the sons of David: and all Judah and the
inhabitants of Jerusalem did HIM[JESUS] honour at HIS[JESUS] death. And Manasseh HIS[JESUS]
SON[JESUS] reigned in HIS[JESUS] stead.


33:1 Manasseh was twelve years old when HE[JESUS] began to reign, and HE[JESUS]
reigned fifty and five years in Jerusalem:

33:2 But did that which was evil in the sight of the LORD[JESUS], like unto the
abominations of the heathen, whom the LORD[JESUS] had cast out before the
children of Israel.

33:3 For HE[JESUS] built again the high places which Hezekiah HIS[JESUS] father had
broken down, and HE[JESUS] reared up altars for Baalim, and made groves, and
worshipped all the host of heaven, and served them.

33:4 Also HE[JESUS] built altars in the house of the LORD[JESUS], whereof the LORD[JESUS] had
said, In Jerusalem shall my name be for ever.

33:5 And HE[JESUS] built altars for all the host of heaven in the two courts of
the house of the LORD[JESUS].

33:6 And HE[JESUS] caused HIS[JESUS] children to pass through the fire in the valley
of the SON[JESUS] of Hinnom: also HE[JESUS] observed times, and used enchantments, and
used witchcraft, and dealt with a familiar spirit, and with wizards: HE[JESUS]
wrought much evil in the sight of the LORD[JESUS], to provoke HIM[JESUS] to anger.

33:7 And HE[JESUS] set a carved image, the idol which HE[JESUS] had made, in the house
of GOD[JESUS], of which GOD[JESUS] had said to David and to Solomon HIS[JESUS] SON[JESUS], In this
house, and in Jerusalem, which I have chosen before all the tribes of
Israel, will I put my name for ever:

33:8 Neither will I any more remove the foot of Israel from out of the
land which I have appointed for your fathers; so that they will take
heed to do all that I have commanded them, according to the whole law
and the statutes and the ordinances by the hand of Moses.

33:9 So Manasseh made Judah and the inhabitants of Jerusalem to err, and
to do worse than the heathen, whom the LORD[JESUS] had destroyed before the
children of Israel.

33:10 And the LORD[JESUS] spake to Manasseh, and to HIS[JESUS] people: but they would
not hearken.

33:11 Wherefore the LORD[JESUS] brought upon them the captains of the host of
the KING[JESUS] of Assyria, which took Manasseh among the thorns, and bound HIM[JESUS]
with fetters, and carried HIM[JESUS] to Babylon.

33:12 And when HE[JESUS] was in affliction, HE[JESUS] besought the LORD[JESUS] HIS[JESUS] GOD[JESUS], and
humbled himself greatly before the GOD[JESUS] of HIS[JESUS] fathers,

33:13 And prayed unto HIM[JESUS]: and HE[JESUS] was intreated of HIM[JESUS], and heard HIS[JESUS]
supplication, and brought HIM[JESUS] again to Jerusalem into HIS[JESUS] kingdom. Then
Manasseh knew that the LORD[JESUS] HE[JESUS] was GOD[JESUS].

33:14 Now after this HE[JESUS] built a wall without the city of David, on the
west side of Gihon, in the valley, even to the entering in at the fish
gate, and compassed about Ophel, and raised it up a very great height,
and put captains of war in all the fenced cities of Judah.

33:15 And HE[JESUS] took away the strange gods, and the idol out of the house
of the LORD[JESUS], and all the altars that HE[JESUS] had built in the mount of the
house of the LORD[JESUS], and in Jerusalem, and cast them out of the city.

33:16 And HE[JESUS] repaired the altar of the LORD[JESUS], and sacrificed thereon
peace offerings and thank offerings, and commanded Judah to serve the
LORD[JESUS] GOD[JESUS] of Israel.

33:17 Nevertheless the people did sacrifice still in the high places,
yet unto the LORD[JESUS] their GOD[JESUS] only.

33:18 Now the rest of the acts of Manasseh, and HIS[JESUS] prayer unto HIS[JESUS] GOD[JESUS],
and the words of the seers that spake to HIM[JESUS] in the name of the LORD[JESUS] GOD[JESUS]
of Israel, behold, they are written in the book of the kings of Israel.

33:19 HIS[JESUS] prayer also, and how GOD[JESUS] was intreated of HIM[JESUS], and all HIS[JESUS]
sins, and HIS[JESUS] trespass, and the places wherein HE[JESUS] built high places, and
set up groves and graven images, before HE[JESUS] was humbled: behold, they are
written among the sayings of the seers.

33:20 So Manasseh slept with HIS[JESUS] fathers, and they buried HIM[JESUS] in HIS[JESUS] own
house: and Amon HIS[JESUS] SON[JESUS] reigned in HIS[JESUS] stead.

33:21 Amon was two and twenty years old when HE[JESUS] began to reign, and
reigned two years in Jerusalem.

33:22 But HE[JESUS] did that which was evil in the sight of the LORD[JESUS], as did
Manasseh HIS[JESUS] father: for Amon sacrificed unto all the carved images
which Manasseh HIS[JESUS] father had made, and served them;

33:23 And humbled not himself before the LORD[JESUS], as Manasseh HIS[JESUS] father
had humbled himself; but Amon trespassed more and more.

33:24 And HIS[JESUS] servants conspired against HIM[JESUS], and slew HIM[JESUS] in HIS[JESUS] own
house.

33:25 But the people of the land slew all them that had conspired
against KING[JESUS] Amon; and the people of the land made Josiah HIS[JESUS] SON[JESUS] KING[JESUS]
in HIS[JESUS] stead.


34:1 Josiah was eight years old when HE[JESUS] began to reign, and HE[JESUS] reigned
in Jerusalem one and thirty years.

34:2 And HE[JESUS] did that which was right in the sight of the LORD[JESUS], and
walked in the ways of David HIS[JESUS] father, and declined neither to the
right hand, nor to the left.

34:3 For in the eighth year of HIS[JESUS] reign, while HE[JESUS] was yet young, HE[JESUS]
began to seek after the GOD[JESUS] of David HIS[JESUS] father: and in the twelfth year
HE[JESUS] began to purge Judah and Jerusalem from the high places, and the
groves, and the carved images, and the molten images.

34:4 And they brake down the altars of Baalim in HIS[JESUS] presence; and the
images, that were on high above them, HE[JESUS] cut down; and the groves, and
the carved images, and the molten images, HE[JESUS] brake in pieces, and made
dust of them, and strowed it upon the graves of them that had sacrificed
unto them.

34:5 And HE[JESUS] burnt the bones of the priests upon their altars, and
cleansed Judah and Jerusalem.

34:6 And so did HE[JESUS] in the cities of Manasseh, and Ephraim, and Simeon,
even unto Naphtali, with their mattocks round about.

34:7 And when HE[JESUS] had broken down the altars and the groves, and had
beaten the graven images into powder, and cut down all the idols
throughout all the land of Israel, HE[JESUS] returned to Jerusalem.

34:8 Now in the eighteenth year of HIS[JESUS] reign, when HE[JESUS] had purged the
land, and the house, HE[JESUS] sent Shaphan the SON[JESUS] of Azaliah, and Maaseiah
the governor of the city, and Joah the SON[JESUS] of Joahaz the recorder, to
repair the house of the LORD[JESUS] HIS[JESUS] GOD[JESUS].

34:9 And when they came to Hilkiah the high priest, they delivered the
money that was brought into the house of GOD[JESUS], which the Levites that
kept the doors had gathered of the hand of Manasseh and Ephraim, and of
all the remnant of Israel, and of all Judah and Benjamin; and they
returned to Jerusalem.

34:10 And they put it in the hand of the workmen that had the oversight
of the house of the LORD[JESUS], and they gave it to the workmen that wrought
in the house of the LORD[JESUS], to repair and amend the house:

34:11 Even to the artificers and builders gave they it, to buy hewn
stone, and timber for couplings, and to floor the houses which the kings
of Judah had destroyed.

34:12 And the men did the work faithfully: and the overseers of them
were Jahath and Obadiah, the Levites, of the sons of Merari; and
Zechariah and Meshullam, of the sons of the Kohathites, to set it
forward; and other of the Levites, all that could skill of instruments
of musick.

34:13 Also they were over the bearers of burdens, and were overseers of
all that wrought the work in any manner of service: and of the Levites
there were scribes, and officers, and porters.

34:14 And when they brought out the money that was brought into the
house of the LORD[JESUS], Hilkiah the priest found a book of the law of the
LORD[JESUS] given by Moses.

34:15 And Hilkiah answered and said to Shaphan the scribe, I have found
the book of the law in the house of the LORD[JESUS]. And Hilkiah delivered the
book to Shaphan.

34:16 And Shaphan carried the book to the KING[JESUS], and brought the KING[JESUS]
WORD[JESUS] back again, saying, All that was committed to your servants, they do
it.

34:17 And they have gathered together the money that was found in the
house of the LORD[JESUS], and have delivered it into the hand of the overseers,
and to the hand of the workmen.

34:18 Then Shaphan the scribe told the KING[JESUS], saying, Hilkiah the priest
has given me a book. And Shaphan read it before the KING[JESUS].

34:19 And it came to pass, when the KING[JESUS] had heard the words of the law,
that HE[JESUS] rent HIS[JESUS] clothes.

34:20 And the KING[JESUS] commanded Hilkiah, and Ahikam the SON[JESUS] of Shaphan, and
Abdon the SON[JESUS] of Micah, and Shaphan the scribe, and Asaiah a SERVANT[JESUS] of
the KING[JESUS]'s, saying,

34:21 Go, enquire of the LORD[JESUS] for me, and for them that are left in
Israel and in Judah, concerning the words of the book that is found: for
great is the wrath of the LORD[JESUS] that is poured out upon us, because our
fathers have not kept the WORD[JESUS] of the LORD[JESUS], to do after all that is
written in this book.

34:22 And Hilkiah, and they that the KING[JESUS] had appointed, went to Huldah
the prophetess, the wife of Shallum the SON[JESUS] of Tikvath, the SON[JESUS] of
Hasrah, keeper of the wardrobe; (now she dwelt in Jerusalem in the
college:) and they spake to her to that effect.

34:23 And she answered them, Thus says the LORD[JESUS] GOD[JESUS] of Israel, Tell you
the man that sent you to me,

34:24 Thus says the LORD[JESUS], Behold, I will bring evil upon this place,
and upon the inhabitants thereof, even all the curses that are written
in the book which they have read before the KING[JESUS] of Judah:

34:25 Because they have forsaken me, and have burned incense unto other
gods, that they might provoke me to anger with all the works of their
hands; therefore my wrath shall be poured out upon this place, and shall
not be quenched.

34:26 And as for the KING[JESUS] of Judah, who sent you to enquire of the LORD[JESUS],
so shall you say unto HIM[JESUS], Thus says the LORD[JESUS] GOD[JESUS] of Israel concerning
the words which you hast heard;

34:27 Because yours heart was tender, and you didst humble thyself
before GOD[JESUS], when you heardest HIS[JESUS] words against this place, and against
the inhabitants thereof, and humbledst thyself before me, and didst rend
your clothes, and weep before me; I have even heard you also, says the
LORD[JESUS].

34:28 Behold, I will gather you to your fathers, and you shalt be
gathered to your grave in peace, neither shall yours eyes see all the
evil that I will bring upon this place, and upon the inhabitants of the
same. So they brought the KING[JESUS] WORD[JESUS] again.

34:29 Then the KING[JESUS] sent and gathered together all the elders of Judah
and Jerusalem.

34:30 And the KING[JESUS] went up into the house of the LORD[JESUS], and all the men
of Judah, and the inhabitants of Jerusalem, and the priests, and the
Levites, and all the people, great and small: and HE[JESUS] read in their ears
all the words of the book of the covenant that was found in the house of
the LORD[JESUS].

34:31 And the KING[JESUS] stood in HIS[JESUS] place, and made a covenant before the
LORD[JESUS], to walk after the LORD[JESUS], and to keep HIS[JESUS] commandments, and HIS[JESUS]
testimonies, and HIS[JESUS] statutes, with all HIS[JESUS] heart, and with all HIS[JESUS]
soul, to perform the words of the covenant which are written in this
book.

34:32 And HE[JESUS] caused all that were present in Jerusalem and Benjamin to
stand to it. And the inhabitants of Jerusalem did according to the
covenant of GOD[JESUS], the GOD[JESUS] of their fathers.

34:33 And Josiah took away all the abominations out of all the countries
that pertained to the children of Israel, and made all that were present
in Israel to serve, even to serve the LORD[JESUS] their GOD[JESUS]. And all HIS[JESUS] days
they departed not from following the LORD[JESUS], the GOD[JESUS] of their fathers.


35:1 Moreover Josiah kept a passover unto the LORD[JESUS] in Jerusalem: and
they killed the passover on the fourteenth day of the first month.

35:2 And HE[JESUS] set the priests in their charges, and encouraged them to the
service of the house of the LORD[JESUS],

35:3 And said unto the Levites that taught all Israel, which were holy
unto the LORD[JESUS], Put the holy ark in the house which Solomon the SON[JESUS] of
David KING[JESUS] of Israel did build; it shall not be a burden upon your
shoulders: serve now the LORD[JESUS] your GOD[JESUS], and HIS[JESUS] people Israel,

35:4 And prepare yourselves by the houses of your fathers, after your
courses, according to the writing of David KING[JESUS] of Israel, and according
to the writing of Solomon HIS[JESUS] SON[JESUS].

35:5 And stand in the holy place according to the divisions of the
families of the fathers of your brethren the people, and after the
division of the families of the Levites.

35:6 So kill the passover, and sanctify yourselves, and prepare your
brethren, that they may do according to the WORD[JESUS] of the LORD[JESUS] by the hand
of Moses.

35:7 And Josiah gave to the people, of the flock, lambs and kids, all
for the passover offerings, for all that were present, to the number of
thirty thousand, and three thousand bullocks: these were of the KING[JESUS]'s
substance.

35:8 And HIS[JESUS] princes gave willingly unto the people, to the priests, and
to the Levites: Hilkiah and Zechariah and Jehiel, rulers of the house of
GOD[JESUS], gave unto the priests for the passover offerings two thousand and
six hundred small cattle and three hundred oxen.

35:9 Conaniah also, and Shemaiah and Nethaneel, HIS[JESUS] brethren, and
Hashabiah and Jeiel and Jozabad, chief of the Levites, gave unto the
Levites for passover offerings five thousand small cattle, and five
hundred oxen.

35:10 So the service was prepared, and the priests stood in their place,
and the Levites in their courses, according to the KING[JESUS]'s commandment.

35:11 And they killed the passover, and the priests sprinkled the blood
from their hands, and the Levites flayed them.

35:12 And they removed the burnt offerings, that they might give
according to the divisions of the families of the people, to offer unto
the LORD[JESUS], as it is written in the book of Moses. And so did they with
the oxen.

35:13 And they roasted the passover with fire according to the
ordinance: but the other holy offerings sod they in pots, and in
caldrons, and in pans, and divided them speedily among all the people.

35:14 And afterward they made ready for themselves, and for the priests:
because the priests the sons of Aaron were busied in offering of burnt
offerings and the fat until night; therefore the Levites prepared for
themselves, and for the priests the sons of Aaron.

35:15 And the singers the sons of Asaph were in their place, according
to the commandment of David, and Asaph, and Heman, and Jeduthun the
KING[JESUS]'s seer; and the porters waited at every gate; they might not depart
from their service; for their brethren the Levites prepared for them.

35:16 So all the service of the LORD[JESUS] was prepared the same day, to keep
the passover, and to offer burnt offerings upon the altar of the LORD[JESUS],
according to the commandment of KING[JESUS] Josiah.

35:17 And the children of Israel that were present kept the passover at
that time, and the feast of unleavened bread seven days.

35:18 And there was no passover like to that kept in Israel from the
days of Samuel the PROPHET[JESUS]; neither did all the kings of Israel keep
such a passover as Josiah kept, and the priests, and the Levites, and
all Judah and Israel that were present, and the inhabitants of
Jerusalem.

35:19 In the eighteenth year of the reign of Josiah was this passover
kept.

35:20 After all this, when Josiah had prepared the temple, Necho KING[JESUS] of
Egypt came up to fight against Charchemish by Euphrates: and Josiah went
out against HIM[JESUS].

35:21 But HE[JESUS] sent ambassadors to HIM[JESUS], saying, What have I to do with
you, you KING[JESUS] of Judah? I come not against you this day, but against
the house wherewith I have war: for GOD[JESUS] commanded me to make haste:
forbear you from meddling with GOD[JESUS], who is with me, that HE[JESUS] destroy
you not.

35:22 Nevertheless Josiah would not turn HIS[JESUS] face from HIM[JESUS], but
disguised himself, that HE[JESUS] might fight with HIM[JESUS], and hearkened not unto
the words of Necho from the mouth of GOD[JESUS], and came to fight in the
valley of Megiddo.

35:23 And the archers shot at KING[JESUS] Josiah; and the KING[JESUS] said to HIS[JESUS]
servants, Have me away; for I am sore wounded.

35:24 HIS[JESUS] servants therefore took HIM[JESUS] out of that chariot, and put HIM[JESUS]
in the second chariot that HE[JESUS] had; and they brought HIM[JESUS] to Jerusalem,
and HE[JESUS] died, and was buried in one of the sepulchres of HIS[JESUS] fathers. And
all Judah and Jerusalem mourned for Josiah.

35:25 And Jeremiah lamented for Josiah: and all the singing men and the
singing women spake of Josiah in their lamentations to this day, and
made them an ordinance in Israel: and, behold, they are written in the
lamentations.

35:26 Now the rest of the acts of Josiah, and HIS[JESUS] goodness, according to
that which was written in the law of the LORD[JESUS],

35:27 And HIS[JESUS] deeds, first and last, behold, they are written in the
book of the kings of Israel and Judah.


36:1 Then the people of the land took Jehoahaz the SON[JESUS] of Josiah, and
made HIM[JESUS] KING[JESUS] in HIS[JESUS] father's stead in Jerusalem.

36:2 Jehoahaz was twenty and three years old when HE[JESUS] began to reign, and
HE[JESUS] reigned three months in Jerusalem.

36:3 And the KING[JESUS] of Egypt put HIM[JESUS] down at Jerusalem, and condemned the
land in an hundred talents of silver and a talent of gold.

36:4 And the KING[JESUS] of Egypt made Eliakim HIS[JESUS] brother KING[JESUS] over Judah and
Jerusalem, and turned HIS[JESUS] name to Jehoiakim. And Necho took Jehoahaz HIS[JESUS]
brother, and carried HIM[JESUS] to Egypt.

36:5 Jehoiakim was twenty and five years old when HE[JESUS] began to reign, and
HE[JESUS] reigned eleven years in Jerusalem: and HE[JESUS] did that which was evil in
the sight of the LORD[JESUS] HIS[JESUS] GOD[JESUS].

36:6 Against HIM[JESUS] came up Nebuchadnezzar KING[JESUS] of Babylon, and bound HIM[JESUS]
in fetters, to carry HIM[JESUS] to Babylon.

36:7 Nebuchadnezzar also carried of the vessels of the house of the LORD[JESUS]
to Babylon, and put them in HIS[JESUS] temple at Babylon.

36:8 Now the rest of the acts of Jehoiakim, and HIS[JESUS] abominations which
HE[JESUS] did, and that which was found in HIM[JESUS], behold, they are written in the
book of the kings of Israel and Judah: and Jehoiachin HIS[JESUS] SON[JESUS] reigned in
HIS[JESUS] stead.

36:9 Jehoiachin was eight years old when HE[JESUS] began to reign, and HE[JESUS]
reigned three months and ten days in Jerusalem: and HE[JESUS] did that which
was evil in the sight of the LORD[JESUS].

36:10 And when the year was expired, KING[JESUS] Nebuchadnezzar sent, and
brought HIM[JESUS] to Babylon, with the goodly vessels of the house of the
LORD[JESUS], and made Zedekiah HIS[JESUS] brother KING[JESUS] over Judah and Jerusalem.

36:11 Zedekiah was one and twenty years old when HE[JESUS] began to reign, and
reigned eleven years in Jerusalem.

36:12 And HE[JESUS] did that which was evil in the sight of the LORD[JESUS] HIS[JESUS] GOD[JESUS],
and humbled not himself before Jeremiah the PROPHET[JESUS] speaking from the
mouth of the LORD[JESUS].

36:13 And HE[JESUS] also rebelled against KING[JESUS] Nebuchadnezzar, who had made HIM[JESUS]
swear by GOD[JESUS]: but HE[JESUS] stiffened HIS[JESUS] neck, and hardened HIS[JESUS] heart from
turning unto the LORD[JESUS] GOD[JESUS] of Israel.

36:14 Moreover all the chief of the priests, and the people,
transgressed very much after all the abominations of the heathen; and
polluted the house of the LORD[JESUS] which HE[JESUS] had hallowed in Jerusalem.

36:15 And the LORD[JESUS] GOD[JESUS] of their fathers sent to them by HIS[JESUS] messengers,
rising up betimes, and sending; because HE[JESUS] had compassion on HIS[JESUS] people,
and on HIS[JESUS] dwelling place:

36:16 But they mocked the messengers of GOD[JESUS], and despised HIS[JESUS] words, and
misused HIS[JESUS] prophets, until the wrath of the LORD[JESUS] arose against HIS[JESUS]
people, till there was no remedy.

36:17 Therefore HE[JESUS] brought upon them the KING[JESUS] of the Chaldees, who slew
their young men with the sword in the house of their sanctuary, and had
no compassion upon young man or maiden, old man, or HIM[JESUS] that stooped for
age: HE[JESUS] gave them all into HIS[JESUS] hand.

36:18 And all the vessels of the house of GOD[JESUS], great and small, and the
treasures of the house of the LORD[JESUS], and the treasures of the KING[JESUS], and
of HIS[JESUS] princes; all these HE[JESUS] brought to Babylon.

36:19 And they burnt the house of GOD[JESUS], and brake down the wall of
Jerusalem, and burnt all the palaces thereof with fire, and destroyed
all the goodly vessels thereof.

36:20 And them that had escaped from the sword carried HE[JESUS] away to
Babylon; where they were servants to HIM[JESUS] and HIS[JESUS] sons until the reign of
the kingdom of Persia:

36:21 To fulfil the WORD[JESUS] of the LORD[JESUS] by the mouth of Jeremiah, until the
land had enjoyed her sabbaths: for as long as she lay desolate she kept
sabbath, to fulfil threescore and ten years.

36:22 Now in the first year of Cyrus KING[JESUS] of Persia, that the WORD[JESUS] of
the LORD[JESUS] spoken by the mouth of Jeremiah might be accomplished, the LORD[JESUS]
stirred up the spirit of Cyrus KING[JESUS] of Persia, that HE[JESUS] made a
proclamation throughout all HIS[JESUS] kingdom, and put it also in writing,
saying,

36:23 Thus says Cyrus KING[JESUS] of Persia, All the kingdoms of the earth
has the LORD[JESUS] GOD[JESUS] of heaven given me; and HE[JESUS] has charged me to build
HIM[JESUS] an house in Jerusalem, which is in Judah. Who is there among you of
all HIS[JESUS] people? The LORD[JESUS] HIS[JESUS] GOD[JESUS] be with HIM[JESUS], and let HIM[JESUS] go up.

1:1 Now in the first year of Cyrus KING[JESUS] of Persia, that the WORD[JESUS] of the
LORD[JESUS] by the mouth of Jeremiah might be fulfilled, the LORD[JESUS] stirred up
the spirit of Cyrus KING[JESUS] of Persia, that HE[JESUS] made a proclamation
throughout all HIS[JESUS] kingdom, and put it also in writing, saying,

1:2 Thus says Cyrus KING[JESUS] of Persia, The LORD[JESUS] GOD[JESUS] of heaven has given
me all the kingdoms of the earth; and HE[JESUS] has charged me to build HIM[JESUS] an
house at Jerusalem, which is in Judah.

1:3 Who is there among you of all HIS[JESUS] people? HIS[JESUS] GOD[JESUS] be with HIM[JESUS], and
let HIM[JESUS] go up to Jerusalem, which is in Judah, and build the house of
the LORD[JESUS] GOD[JESUS] of Israel, (HE[JESUS] is the GOD[JESUS],) which is in Jerusalem.

1:4 And whoever remaineth in any place where HE[JESUS] sojourneth, let the
men of HIS[JESUS] place help HIM[JESUS] with silver, and with gold, and with goods,
and with beasts, beside the freewill offering for the house of GOD[JESUS] that
is in Jerusalem.

1:5 Then rose up the chief of the fathers of Judah and Benjamin, and the
priests, and the Levites, with all them whose spirit GOD[JESUS] had raised, to
go up to build the house of the LORD[JESUS] which is in Jerusalem.

1:6 And all they that were about them strengthened their hands with
vessels of silver, with gold, with goods, and with beasts, and with
precious things, beside all that was willingly offered.

1:7 Also Cyrus the KING[JESUS] brought forth the vessels of the house of the
LORD[JESUS], which Nebuchadnezzar had brought forth out of Jerusalem, and had
put them in the house of HIS[JESUS] gods;

1:8 Even those did Cyrus KING[JESUS] of Persia bring forth by the hand of
Mithredath the treasurer, and numbered them unto Sheshbazzar, the prince
of Judah.

1:9 And this is the number of them: thirty chargers of gold, a thousand
chargers of silver, nine and twenty knives,

1:10 Thirty basons of gold, silver basons of a second sort four hundred
and ten, and other vessels a thousand.

1:11 All the vessels of gold and of silver were five thousand and four
hundred. All these did Sheshbazzar bring up with them of the captivity
that were brought up from Babylon unto Jerusalem.

2:60 The children of Delaiah, the children of Tobiah, the children of
Nekoda, six hundred fifty and two.

2:61 And of the children of the priests: the children of Habaiah, the
children of Koz, the children of Barzillai; which took a wife of the
daughters of Barzillai the Gileadite, and was called after their name:

2:62 These sought their register among those that were reckoned by
genealogy, but they were not found: therefore were they, as polluted,
put from the priesthood.

2:63 And the Tirshatha said unto them, that they should not eat of the
most holy things, till there stood up a priest with Urim and with
Thummim.

2:64 The whole congregation together was forty and two thousand three
hundred and threescore,

2:65 Beside their servants and their maids, of whom there were seven
thousand three hundred thirty and seven: and there were among them two
hundred singing men and singing women.

2:66 Their horses were seven hundred thirty and six; their mules, two
hundred forty and five;

2:67 Their camels, four hundred thirty and five; their asses, six
thousand seven hundred and twenty.

2:68 And some of the chief of the fathers, when they came to the house
of the LORD[JESUS] which is at Jerusalem, offered freely for the house of GOD[JESUS]
to set it up in HIS[JESUS] place:

2:69 They gave after their ability unto the treasure of the work
threescore and one thousand drams of gold, and five thousand pound of
silver, and one hundred priests' garments.

2:70 So the priests, and the Levites, and some of the people, and the
singers, and the porters, and the Nethinims, dwelt in their cities, and
all Israel in their cities.


3:1 And when the seventh month was come, and the children of Israel were
in the cities, the people gathered themselves together as one man to
Jerusalem.

3:2 Then stood up Jeshua the SON[JESUS] of Jozadak, and HIS[JESUS] brethren the
priests, and Zerubbabel the SON[JESUS] of Shealtiel, and HIS[JESUS] brethren, and
builded the altar of the GOD[JESUS] of Israel, to offer burnt offerings
thereon, as it is written in the law of Moses the man of GOD[JESUS].

3:3 And they set the altar upon HIS[JESUS] bases; for fear was upon them
because of the people of those countries: and they offered burnt
offerings thereon unto the LORD[JESUS], even burnt offerings morning and
evening.

3:4 They kept also the feast of tabernacles, as it is written, and
offered the daily burnt offerings by number, according to the custom, as
the duty of every day required;

3:5 And afterward offered the continual burnt offering, both of the new
moons, and of all the set feasts of the LORD[JESUS] that were consecrated, and
of every one that willingly offered a freewill offering unto the LORD[JESUS].

3:6 From the first day of the seventh month began they to offer burnt
offerings unto the LORD[JESUS]. But the foundation of the temple of the LORD[JESUS]
was not yet laid.

3:7 They gave money also unto the masons, and to the carpenters; and
meat, and drink, and oil, unto them of Zidon, and to them of Tyre, to
bring cedar trees from Lebanon to the sea of Joppa, according to the
grant that they had of Cyrus KING[JESUS] of Persia.

3:8 Now in the second year of their coming unto the house of GOD[JESUS] at
Jerusalem, in the second month, began Zerubbabel the SON[JESUS] of Shealtiel,
and Jeshua the SON[JESUS] of Jozadak, and the remnant of their brethren the
priests and the Levites, and all they that were come out of the
captivity unto Jerusalem; and appointed the Levites, from twenty years
old and upward, to set forward the work of the house of the LORD[JESUS].

3:9 Then stood Jeshua with HIS[JESUS] sons and HIS[JESUS] brethren, Kadmiel and HIS[JESUS]
sons, the sons of Judah, together, to set forward the workmen in the
house of GOD[JESUS]: the sons of Henadad, with their sons and their brethren
the Levites.

3:10 And when the builders laid the foundation of the temple of the
LORD[JESUS], they set the priests in their apparel with trumpets, and the
Levites the sons of Asaph with cymbals, to praise the LORD[JESUS], after the
ordinance of David KING[JESUS] of Israel.

3:11 And they sang together by course in praising and giving thanks unto
the LORD[JESUS]; because HE[JESUS] is good, for HIS[JESUS] mercy endureth for ever toward
Israel. And all the people shouted with a great shout, when they praised
the LORD[JESUS], because the foundation of the house of the LORD[JESUS] was laid.

3:12 But many of the priests and Levites and chief of the fathers, who
were ancient men, that had seen the first house, when the foundation of
this house was laid before their eyes, wept with a loud voice; and many
shouted aloud for joy:
