13:12 Your remembrances are like unto ashes, your bodies to bodies of
clay.

13:13 Hold your peace, let me alone, that I may speak, and let come on
me what will.

13:14 Wherefore do I take my flesh in my teeth, and put my life in mine
hand?

13:15 Though HE[JESUS] slay me, yet will I trust in HIM[JESUS]: but I will maintain
mine own ways before HIM[JESUS].

13:16 HE[JESUS] also shall be my salvation: for an hypocrite shall not come
before HIM[JESUS].

13:17 Hear diligently my speech, and my declaration with your ears.

13:18 Behold now, I have ordered my cause; I know that I shall be
justified.

13:19 Who is HE[JESUS] that will plead with me? for now, if I hold my tongue, I
shall give up the ghost.

13:20 Only do not two things unto me: then will I not hide myself from
you.

13:21 Withdraw yours hand far from me: and let not your dread make me
afraid.

13:22 Then call you, and I will answer: or let me speak, and answer
you me.

13:23 How many are mine iniquities and sins? make me to know my
transgression and my sin.

13:24 Wherefore hidest you your face, and holdest me for yours enemy?

13:25 Wilt you break a leaf driven to and fro? and wilt you pursue the
dry stubble?

13:26 For you writest bitter things against me, and makest me to
possess the iniquities of my youth.

13:27 you puttest my feet also in the stocks, and lookest narrowly unto
all my paths; you settest a print upon the heels of my feet.

13:28 And HE[JESUS], as a rotten thing, consumeth, as a garment that is moth
eaten.


14:1 Man that is born of a woman is of few days and full of trouble.

14:2 HE[JESUS] comes forth like a flower, and is cut down: HE[JESUS] fleeth also as a
shadow, and continueth not.

14:3 And does you open yours eyes upon such an one, and bringest me
into judgment with you?

14:4 Who can bring a clean thing out of an unclean? not one.

14:5 Seeing HIS[JESUS] days are determined, the number of HIS[JESUS] months are with
you, you hast appointed HIS[JESUS] bounds that HE[JESUS] cannot pass;

14:6 Turn from HIM[JESUS], that HE[JESUS] may rest, till HE[JESUS] shall accomplish, as an
hireling, HIS[JESUS] day.

14:7 For there is hope of a tree, if it be cut down, that it will sprout
again, and that the tender BRANCH[JESUS] thereof will not cease.

14:8 Though the ROOT[JESUS] thereof wax old in the earth, and the stock thereof
die in the ground;

14:9 Yet through the scent of water it will bud, and bring forth boughs
like a plant.

14:10 But man dieth, and wasteth away: yea, man giveth up the ghost, and
where is HE[JESUS]?

14:11 As the waters fail from the sea, and the flood decayeth and drieth
up:

14:12 So man lieth down, and riseth not: till the heavens be no more,
they shall not awake, nor be raised out of their sleep.

14:13 O that you wouldest hide me in the grave, that you wouldest keep
me secret, until your wrath be past, that you wouldest appoint me a set
time, and remember me!

14:14 If a man die, shall HE[JESUS] live again? all the days of my appointed
time will I wait, till my change come.

14:15 you shalt call, and I will answer you: you wilt have a desire
to the work of yours hands.

14:16 For now you numberest my steps: dost you not watch over my sin?

14:17 My transgression is sealed up in a bag, and you sewest up mine
iniquity.

14:18 And surely the mountains falling comes to nought, and the rock is
removed out of HIS[JESUS] place.

14:19 The waters wear the stones: you washest away the things which
grow out of the dust of the earth; and you destroyest the hope of man.

14:20 you prevailest for ever against HIM[JESUS], and HE[JESUS] passeth: you
changest HIS[JESUS] countenance, and sendest HIM[JESUS] away.

14:21 HIS[JESUS] sons come to honour, and HE[JESUS] knoweth it not; and they are
brought low, but HE[JESUS] perceiveth it not of them.

14:22 But HIS[JESUS] flesh upon HIM[JESUS] shall have pain, and HIS[JESUS] soul within HIM[JESUS]
shall mourn.


15:1 Then answered Eliphaz the Temanite, and said,

15:2 Should a wise man utter vain knowledge, and fill HIS[JESUS] belly with the
east wind?

15:3 Should HE[JESUS] reason with unprofitable talk? or with speeches wherewith
HE[JESUS] can do no good?

15:4 Yea, you castest off fear, and restrainest prayer before GOD[JESUS].

15:5 For your mouth uttereth yours iniquity, and you choosest the tongue
of the crafty.

15:6 yours own mouth condemneth you, and not I: yea, yours own lips
testify against you.

15:7 Art you the first man that was born? or wast you made before the
hills?

15:8 Hast you heard the secret of GOD[JESUS]? and dost you restrain wisdom to
thyself?

15:9 What knowest you, that we know not? what understandest you, which
is not in us?

15:10 With us are both the grayheaded and very aged men, much elder than
your father.

15:11 Are the consolations of GOD[JESUS] small with you? is there any secret
thing with you?

15:12 Why does yours heart carry you away? and what do your eyes wink
at,

15:13 That you turnest your spirit against GOD[JESUS], and lettest such words
go out of your mouth?

15:14 What is man, that HE[JESUS] should be clean? and HE[JESUS] which is born of a
woman, that HE[JESUS] should be righteous?

15:15 Behold, HE[JESUS] putteth no trust in HIS[JESUS] saints; yea, the heavens are
not clean in HIS[JESUS] sight.

15:16 How much more abominable and filthy is man, which drinketh
iniquity like water?

15:17 I will shew you, hear me; and that which I have seen I will
declare;

15:18 Which wise men have told from their fathers, and have not hid it:

15:19 Unto whom alone the earth was given, and no stranger passed among
them.

15:20 The wicked man travaileth with pain all HIS[JESUS] days, and the number
of years is hidden to the oppressor.

15:21 A dreadful sound is in HIS[JESUS] ears: in prosperity the destroyer shall
come upon HIM[JESUS].

15:22 HE[JESUS] believes not that HE[JESUS] shall return out of darkness, and HE[JESUS] is
waited for of the sword.

15:23 HE[JESUS] wandereth abroad for bread, saying, Where is it? HE[JESUS] knoweth
that the day of darkness is ready at HIS[JESUS] hand.

15:24 Trouble and anguish shall make HIM[JESUS] afraid; they shall prevail
against HIM[JESUS], as a KING[JESUS] ready to the battle.

15:25 For HE[JESUS] stretcheth out HIS[JESUS] hand against GOD[JESUS], and strengtheneth
himself against the Almighty.

15:26 HE[JESUS] runneth upon HIM[JESUS], even on HIS[JESUS] neck, upon the thick bosses of
HIS[JESUS] bucklers:

15:27 Because HE[JESUS] covereth HIS[JESUS] face with HIS[JESUS] fatness, and makes collops
of fat on HIS[JESUS] flanks.

15:28 And HE[JESUS] dwelleth in desolate cities, and in houses which no man
inhabiteth, which are ready to become heaps.

15:29 HE[JESUS] shall not be rich, neither shall HIS[JESUS] substance continue,
neither shall HE[JESUS] prolong the perfection thereof upon the earth.

15:30 HE[JESUS] shall not depart out of darkness; the flame shall dry up HIS[JESUS]
branches, and by the breath of HIS[JESUS] mouth shall HE[JESUS] go away.

15:31 Let not HIM[JESUS] that is deceived trust in vanity: for vanity shall be
HIS[JESUS] recompence.

15:32 It shall be accomplished before HIS[JESUS] time, and HIS[JESUS] BRANCH[JESUS] shall not
be green.

15:33 HE[JESUS] shall shake off HIS[JESUS] unripe grape as the vine, and shall cast
off HIS[JESUS] flower as the olive.

15:34 For the congregation of hypocrites shall be desolate, and fire
shall consume the tabernacles of bribery.

15:35 They conceive mischief, and bring forth vanity, and their belly
prepareth deceit.


16:1 Then Job answered and said,

16:2 I have heard many such things: miserable comforters are you all.

16:3 Shall vain words have an end? or what emboldeneth you that you
answerest?

16:4 I also could speak as you do: if your soul were in my soul's stead,
I could heap up words against you, and shake mine head at you.

16:5 But I would strengthen you with my mouth, and the moving of my lips
should asswage your grief.

16:6 Though I speak, my grief is not asswaged: and though I forbear,
what am I eased?

16:7 But now HE[JESUS] has made me weary: you hast made desolate all my
company.

16:8 And you hast filled me with wrinkles, which is a witness against
me: and my leanness rising up in me beareth witness to my face.

16:9 HE[JESUS] teareth me in HIS[JESUS] wrath, who hateth me: HE[JESUS] gnasheth upon me with
HIS[JESUS] teeth; mine enemy sharpeneth HIS[JESUS] eyes upon me.

16:10 They have gaped upon me with their mouth; they have smitten me
upon the cheek reproachfully; they have gathered themselves together
against me.

16:11 GOD[JESUS] has delivered me to the ungodly, and turned me over into the
hands of the wicked.

16:12 I was at ease, but HE[JESUS] has broken me asunder: HE[JESUS] has also taken
me by my neck, and shaken me to pieces, and set me up for HIS[JESUS] mark.

16:13 HIS[JESUS] archers compass me round about, HE[JESUS] cleaveth my reins asunder,
and does not spare; HE[JESUS] poureth out my gall upon the ground.

16:14 HE[JESUS] breaketh me with breach upon breach, HE[JESUS] runneth upon me like a
giant.

16:15 I have sewed sackcloth upon my skin, and defiled my horn in the
dust.

16:16 My face is foul with weeping, and on my eyelids is the shadow of
death;

16:17 Not for any injustice in mine hands: also my prayer is pure.

16:18 O earth, cover not you my blood, and let my cry have no place.

16:19 Also now, behold, my witness is in heaven, and my record is on
high.

16:20 My friends scorn me: but mine eye poureth out tears unto GOD[JESUS].

16:21 O that one might plead for a man with GOD[JESUS], as a man pleadeth for
HIS[JESUS] neighbour!

16:22 When a few years are come, then I shall go the way whence I shall
not return.


17:1 My breath is corrupt, my days are extinct, the graves are ready for
me.

17:2 Are there not mockers with me? and does not mine eye continue in
their provocation?

17:3 Lay down now, put me in a surety with you; who is HE[JESUS] that will
strike hands with me?

17:4 For you hast hid their heart from understanding: therefore shalt
you not exalt them.

17:5 HE[JESUS] that speaketh flattery to HIS[JESUS] friends, even the eyes of HIS[JESUS]
children shall fail.

17:6 HE[JESUS] has made me also a byword of the people; and aforetime I was as
a tabret.

17:7 Mine eye also is dim by reason of sorrow, and all my members are as
a shadow.

17:8 Upright men shall be astonied at this, and the innocent shall stir
up himself against the hypocrite.

17:9 The righteous also shall hold on HIS[JESUS] way, and HE[JESUS] that has clean
hands shall be stronger and stronger.

17:10 But as for you all, do you return, and come now: for I cannot find
one wise man among you.

17:11 My days are past, my purposes are broken off, even the thoughts of
my heart.

17:12 They change the night into day: the light is short because of
darkness.

17:13 If I wait, the grave is mine house: I have made my bed in the
darkness.

17:14 I have said to corruption, you art my father: to the worm, you
art my mother, and my sister.

17:15 And where is now my hope? as for my hope, who shall see it?

17:16 They shall go down to the bars of the pit, when our rest together
is in the dust.


18:1 Then answered Bildad the Shuhite, and said,

18:2 How long will it be ere you make an end of words? mark, and
afterwards we will speak.

18:3 Wherefore are we counted as beasts, and reputed vile in your sight?

18:4 HE[JESUS] teareth himself in HIS[JESUS] anger: shall the earth be forsaken for
you? and shall the rock be removed out of HIS[JESUS] place?

18:5 Yea, the light of the wicked shall be put out, and the spark of HIS[JESUS]
fire shall not shine.

18:6 The light shall be dark in HIS[JESUS] tabernacle, and HIS[JESUS] candle shall be
put out with HIM[JESUS].

18:7 The steps of HIS[JESUS] strength shall be straitened, and HIS[JESUS] own counsel
shall cast HIM[JESUS] down.

18:8 For HE[JESUS] is cast into a net by HIS[JESUS] own feet, and HE[JESUS] walketh upon a
snare.

18:9 The gin shall take HIM[JESUS] by the heel, and the robber shall prevail
against HIM[JESUS].

18:10 The snare is laid for HIM[JESUS] in the ground, and a trap for HIM[JESUS] in the
way.

18:11 Terrors shall make HIM[JESUS] afraid on every side, and shall drive HIM[JESUS]
to HIS[JESUS] feet.

18:12 HIS[JESUS] strength shall be hungerbitten, and destruction shall be ready
at HIS[JESUS] side.

18:13 It shall devour the strength of HIS[JESUS] skin: even the firstborn of
death shall devour HIS[JESUS] strength.

18:14 HIS[JESUS] confidence shall be rooted out of HIS[JESUS] tabernacle, and it shall
bring HIM[JESUS] to the KING[JESUS] of terrors.

18:15 It shall dwell in HIS[JESUS] tabernacle, because it is none of HIS[JESUS]:
brimstone shall be scattered upon HIS[JESUS] habitation.

18:16 HIS[JESUS] roots shall be dried up beneath, and above shall HIS[JESUS] BRANCH[JESUS] be
cut off.

18:17 HIS[JESUS] remembrance shall perish from the earth, and HE[JESUS] shall have no
name in the street.

18:18 HE[JESUS] shall be driven from light into darkness, and chased out of the
world.

18:19 HE[JESUS] shall neither have SON[JESUS] nor nephew among HIS[JESUS] people, nor any
remaining in HIS[JESUS] dwellings.

18:20 They that come after HIM[JESUS] shall be astonied at HIS[JESUS] day, as they
that went before were affrighted.

18:21 Surely such are the dwellings of the wicked, and this is the place
of HIM[JESUS] that knoweth not GOD[JESUS].


19:1 Then Job answered and said,

19:2 How long will you vex my soul, and break me in pieces with words?

19:3 These ten times have you reproached me: you are not ashamed that you
make yourselves strange to me.

19:4 And be it indeed that I have erred, mine error remaineth with
myself.

19:5 If indeed you will magnify yourselves against me, and plead against
me my reproach:

19:6 Know now that GOD[JESUS] has overthrown me, and has compassed me with
HIS[JESUS] net.

19:7 Behold, I cry out of wrong, but I am not heard: I cry aloud, but
there is no judgment.

19:8 HE[JESUS] has fenced up my way that I cannot pass, and HE[JESUS] has set
darkness in my paths.

19:9 HE[JESUS] has stripped me of my glory, and taken the crown from my head.

19:10 HE[JESUS] has destroyed me on every side, and I am gone: and mine hope
has HE[JESUS] removed like a tree.

19:11 HE[JESUS] has also kindled HIS[JESUS] wrath against me, and HE[JESUS] counteth me unto
HIM[JESUS] as one of HIS[JESUS] enemies.

19:12 HIS[JESUS] troops come together, and raise up their way against me, and
encamp round about my tabernacle.

19:13 HE[JESUS] has put my brethren far from me, and mine acquaintance are
truly estranged from me.

19:14 My kinsfolk have failed, and my familiar friends have forgotten
me.

19:15 They that dwell in mine house, and my maids, count me for a
stranger: I am an alien in their sight.

19:16 I called my SERVANT[JESUS], and HE[JESUS] gave me no answer; I intreated HIM[JESUS]
with my mouth.

19:17 My breath is strange to my wife, though I intreated for the
children's sake of mine own body.

19:18 Yea, young children despised me; I arose, and they spake against
me.

19:19 All my inward friends abhorred me: and they whom I loved are
turned against me.

19:20 My bone cleaveth to my skin and to my flesh, and I am escaped with
the skin of my teeth.

19:21 Have pity upon me, have pity upon me, O you my friends; for the
hand of GOD[JESUS] has touched me.

19:22 Why do you persecute me as GOD[JESUS], and are not satisfied with my
flesh?

19:23 Oh that my words were now written! oh that they were printed in a
book!

19:24 That they were graven with an iron pen and lead in the rock for
ever!

19:25 For I know that my redeemer liveth, and that HE[JESUS] shall stand at the
latter day upon the earth:

19:26 And though after my skin worms destroy this body, yet in my flesh
shall I see GOD[JESUS]:

19:27 Whom I shall see for myself, and mine eyes shall behold, and not
another; though my reins be consumed within me.

19:28 But you should say, Why persecute we HIM[JESUS], seeing the ROOT[JESUS] of the
matter is found in me?

19:29 Be you afraid of the sword: for wrath bringeth the punishments of
the sword, that you may know there is a judgment.


20:1 Then answered Zophar the Naamathite, and said,

20:2 Therefore do my thoughts cause me to answer, and for this I make
haste.

20:3 I have heard the check of my reproach, and the spirit of my
understanding causeth me to answer.

20:4 Knowest you not this of old, since man was placed upon earth,

20:5 That the triumphing of the wicked is short, and the joy of the
hypocrite but for a moment?

20:6 Though HIS[JESUS] excellency mount up to the heavens, and HIS[JESUS] head reach
unto the clouds;

20:7 Yet HE[JESUS] shall perish for ever like HIS[JESUS] own dung: they which have
seen HIM[JESUS] shall say, Where is HE[JESUS]?

20:8 HE[JESUS] shall fly away as a dream, and shall not be found: yea, HE[JESUS] shall
be chased away as a vision of the night.

20:9 The eye also which saw HIM[JESUS] shall see HIM[JESUS] no more; neither shall HIS[JESUS]
place any more behold HIM[JESUS].

20:10 HIS[JESUS] children shall seek to please the poor, and HIS[JESUS] hands shall
restore their goods.

20:11 HIS[JESUS] bones are full of the sin of HIS[JESUS] youth, which shall lie down
with HIM[JESUS] in the dust.

20:12 Though wickedness be sweet in HIS[JESUS] mouth, though HE[JESUS] hide it under
HIS[JESUS] tongue;

20:13 Though HE[JESUS] spare it, and forsake it not; but keep it still within
HIS[JESUS] mouth:

20:14 Yet HIS[JESUS] meat in HIS[JESUS] bowels is turned, it is the gall of asps
within HIM[JESUS].

20:15 HE[JESUS] has swallowed down riches, and HE[JESUS] shall vomit them up again:
GOD[JESUS] shall cast them out of HIS[JESUS] belly.

20:16 HE[JESUS] shall suck the poison of asps: the viper's tongue shall slay
HIM[JESUS].

20:17 HE[JESUS] shall not see the rivers, the floods, the brooks of honey and
butter.

20:18 That which HE[JESUS] laboured for shall HE[JESUS] restore, and shall not swallow
it down: according to HIS[JESUS] substance shall the restitution be, and HE[JESUS]
shall not rejoice therein.

20:19 Because HE[JESUS] has oppressed and has forsaken the poor; because HE[JESUS]
has violently taken away an house which HE[JESUS] builded not;

20:20 Surely HE[JESUS] shall not feel quietness in HIS[JESUS] belly, HE[JESUS] shall not save
of that which HE[JESUS] desired.

20:21 There shall none of HIS[JESUS] meat be left; therefore shall no man look
for HIS[JESUS] goods.

20:22 In the fulness of HIS[JESUS] sufficiency HE[JESUS] shall be in straits: every
hand of the wicked shall come upon HIM[JESUS].

20:23 When HE[JESUS] is about to fill HIS[JESUS] belly, GOD[JESUS] shall cast the fury of HIS[JESUS]
wrath upon HIM[JESUS], and shall rain it upon HIM[JESUS] while HE[JESUS] is eating.

20:24 HE[JESUS] shall flee from the iron weapon, and the bow of steel shall
strike HIM[JESUS] through.

20:25 It is drawn, and comes out of the body; yea, the glittering sword
comes out of HIS[JESUS] gall: terrors are upon HIM[JESUS].

20:26 All darkness shall be hid in HIS[JESUS] secret places: a fire not blown
shall consume HIM[JESUS]; it shall go ill with HIM[JESUS] that is left in HIS[JESUS]
tabernacle.

20:27 The heaven shall reveal HIS[JESUS] iniquity; and the earth shall rise up
against HIM[JESUS].

20:28 The increase of HIS[JESUS] house shall depart, and HIS[JESUS] goods shall flow
away in the day of HIS[JESUS] wrath.

20:29 This is the portion of a wicked man from GOD[JESUS], and the heritage
appointed unto HIM[JESUS] by GOD[JESUS].


21:1 But Job answered and said,

21:2 Hear diligently my speech, and let this be your consolations.

21:3 let me that I may speak; and after that I have spoken, mock on.

21:4 As for me, is my complaint to man? and if it were so, why should
not my spirit be troubled?

21:5 Mark me, and be astonished, and lay your hand upon your mouth.

21:6 Even when I remember I am afraid, and trembling taketh hold on my
flesh.

21:7 Wherefore do the wicked live, become old, yea, are mighty in power?

21:8 Their SEED[JESUS] is established in their sight with them, and their
OFFSPRING[JESUS] before their eyes.

21:9 Their houses are safe from fear, neither is the rod of GOD[JESUS] upon
them.

21:10 Their bull gendereth, and faileth not; their cow calveth, and
casteth not her calf.

21:11 They send forth their little ones like a flock, and their children
dance.

21:12 They take the timbrel and harp, and rejoice at the sound of the
organ.

21:13 They spend their days in wealth, and in a moment go down to the
grave.

21:14 Therefore they say unto GOD[JESUS], Depart from us; for we desire not the
knowledge of your ways.

21:15 What is the Almighty, that we should serve HIM[JESUS]? and what profit
should we have, if we pray unto HIM[JESUS]?

21:16 Lo, their good is not in their hand: the counsel of the wicked is
far from me.

21:17 How oft is the candle of the wicked put out! and how oft comes
their destruction upon them! GOD[JESUS] distributeth sorrows in HIS[JESUS] anger.

21:18 They are as stubble before the wind, and as chaff that the storm
carrieth away.

21:19 GOD[JESUS] layeth up HIS[JESUS] iniquity for HIS[JESUS] children: HE[JESUS] rewardeth HIM[JESUS], and
HE[JESUS] shall know it.

21:20 HIS[JESUS] eyes shall see HIS[JESUS] destruction, and HE[JESUS] shall drink of the
wrath of the Almighty.

21:21 For what pleasure has HE[JESUS] in HIS[JESUS] house after HIM[JESUS], when the number
of HIS[JESUS] months is cut off in the midst?

21:22 Shall any teach GOD[JESUS] knowledge? seeing HE[JESUS] judgeth those that are
high.

21:23 One dieth in HIS[JESUS] full strength, being wholly at ease and quiet.

21:24 HIS[JESUS] breasts are full of milk, and HIS[JESUS] bones are moistened with
marrow.

21:25 And another dieth in the bitterness of HIS[JESUS] soul, and never eateth
with pleasure.

21:26 They shall lie down alike in the dust, and the worms shall cover
them.

21:27 Behold, I know your thoughts, and the devices which you wrongfully
imagine against me.

21:28 For you say, Where is the house of the prince? and where are the
dwelling places of the wicked?

21:29 Have you not asked them that go by the way? and do you not know
their tokens,

21:30 That the wicked is reserved to the day of destruction? they shall
be brought forth to the day of wrath.

21:31 Who shall declare HIS[JESUS] way to HIS[JESUS] face? and who shall repay HIM[JESUS]
what HE[JESUS] has done?

21:32 Yet shall HE[JESUS] be brought to the grave, and shall remain in the
tomb.

21:33 The clods of the valley shall be sweet unto HIM[JESUS], and every man
shall draw after HIM[JESUS], as there are innumerable before HIM[JESUS].

21:34 How then comfort you me in vain, seeing in your answers there
remaineth falsehood?


22:1 Then Eliphaz the Temanite answered and said,

22:2 Can a man be profitable unto GOD[JESUS], as HE[JESUS] that is wise may be
profitable unto himself?

22:3 Is it any pleasure to the Almighty, that you art righteous? or is
it gain to HIM[JESUS], that you makest your ways perfect?

22:4 Will HE[JESUS] reprove you for fear of you? will HE[JESUS] enter with you into
judgment?

22:5 Is not your wickedness great? and yours iniquities infinite?

22:6 For you hast taken a pledge from your brother for nought, and
stripped the naked of their clothing.

22:7 you hast not given water to the weary to drink, and you hast
withholden bread from the hungry.

22:8 But as for the mighty man, HE[JESUS] had the earth; and the honourable man
dwelt in it.

22:9 you hast sent widows away empty, and the arms of the fatherless
have been broken.

22:10 Therefore snares are round about you, and sudden fear troubleth
you;

22:11 Or darkness, that you canst not see; and abundance of waters
cover you.

22:12 Is not GOD[JESUS] in the height of heaven? and behold the height of the
stars, how high they are!

22:13 And you sayest, How does GOD[JESUS] know? can HE[JESUS] judge through the dark
cloud?

22:14 Thick clouds are a covering to HIM[JESUS], that HE[JESUS] seeth not; and HE[JESUS]
walketh in the circuit of heaven.

22:15 Hast you marked the old way which wicked men have trodden?

22:16 Which were cut down out of time, whose foundation was overflown
with a flood:

22:17 Which said unto GOD[JESUS], Depart from us: and what can the Almighty do
for them?

22:18 Yet HE[JESUS] filled their houses with good things: but the counsel of
the wicked is far from me.

22:19 The righteous see it, and are glad: and the innocent laugh them to
scorn.

22:20 Whereas our substance is not cut down, but the remnant of them the
fire consumeth.

22:21 Acquaint now thyself with HIM[JESUS], and be at peace: thereby good shall
come unto you.

22:22 Receive, I pray you, the law from HIS[JESUS] mouth, and lay up HIS[JESUS] words
in yours heart.

22:23 If you return to the Almighty, you shalt be built up, you shalt
put away iniquity far from your tabernacles.

22:24 Then shalt you lay up gold as dust, and the gold of Ophir as the
stones of the brooks.

22:25 Yea, the Almighty shall be your defence, and you shalt have plenty
of silver.

22:26 For then shalt you have your delight in the Almighty, and shalt
lift up your face unto GOD[JESUS].

22:27 you shalt make your prayer unto HIM[JESUS], and HE[JESUS] shall hear you, and
you shalt pay your vows.

22:28 you shalt also decree a thing, and it shall be established unto
you: and the light shall shine upon your ways.

22:29 When men are cast down, then you shalt say, There is lifting up;
and HE[JESUS] shall save the humble person.

22:30 HE[JESUS] shall deliver the island of the innocent: and it is delivered
by the pureness of yours hands.


23:1 Then Job answered and said,

23:2 Even to day is my complaint bitter: my stroke is heavier than my
groaning.

23:3 Oh that I knew where I might find HIM[JESUS]! that I might come even to
HIS[JESUS] seat!

23:4 I would order my cause before HIM[JESUS], and fill my mouth with
arguments.

23:5 I would know the words which HE[JESUS] would answer me, and understand
what HE[JESUS] would say unto me.

23:6 Will HE[JESUS] plead against me with HIS[JESUS] great power? No; but HE[JESUS] would put
strength in me.

23:7 There the righteous might dispute with HIM[JESUS]; so should I be
delivered for ever from my judge.

23:8 Behold, I go forward, but HE[JESUS] is not there; and backward, but I
cannot perceive HIM[JESUS]:

23:9 On the left hand, where HE[JESUS] does work, but I cannot behold HIM[JESUS]: HE[JESUS]
hideth himself on the right hand, that I cannot see HIM[JESUS]:

23:10 But HE[JESUS] knoweth the way that I take: when HE[JESUS] has tried me, I shall
come forth as gold.

23:11 My foot has held HIS[JESUS] steps, HIS[JESUS] way have I kept, and not
declined.

23:12 Neither have I gone back from the commandment of HIS[JESUS] lips; I have
esteemed the words of HIS[JESUS] mouth more than my necessary food.

23:13 But HE[JESUS] is in one mind, and who can turn HIM[JESUS]? and what HIS[JESUS] soul
desireth, even that HE[JESUS] doeth.

23:14 For HE[JESUS] performeth the thing that is appointed for me: and many
such things are with HIM[JESUS].

23:15 Therefore am I troubled at HIS[JESUS] presence: when I consider, I am
afraid of HIM[JESUS].

23:16 For GOD[JESUS] makes my heart soft, and the Almighty troubleth me:

23:17 Because I was not cut off before the darkness, neither has HE[JESUS]
covered the darkness from my face.


24:1 Why, seeing times are not hidden from the Almighty, do they that
know HIM[JESUS] not see HIS[JESUS] days?

24:2 Some remove the landmarks; they violently take away flocks, and
feed thereof.

24:3 They drive away the ass of the fatherless, they take the widow's ox
for a pledge.

24:4 They turn the needy out of the way: the poor of the earth hide
themselves together.

24:5 Behold, as wild asses in the desert, go they forth to their work;
rising betimes for a prey: the wilderness yieldeth food for them and for
their children.

24:6 They reap every one HIS[JESUS] corn in the field: and they gather the
vintage of the wicked.

24:7 They cause the naked to lodge without clothing, that they have no
covering in the cold.

24:8 They are wet with the showers of the mountains, and embrace the
rock for want of a shelter.

24:9 They pluck the fatherless from the breast, and take a pledge of the
poor.

24:10 They cause HIM[JESUS] to go naked without clothing, and they take away
the sheaf from the hungry;

24:11 Which make oil within their walls, and tread their winepresses,
and let thirst.

24:12 Men groan from out of the city, and the soul of the wounded crieth
out: yet GOD[JESUS] layeth not folly to them.

24:13 They are of those that rebel against the light; they know not the
ways thereof, nor abide in the paths thereof.

24:14 The murderer rising with the light killeth the poor and needy, and
in the night is as a thief.

24:15 The eye also of the adulterer waiteth for the twilight, saying, No
eye shall see me: and disguiseth HIS[JESUS] face.

24:16 In the dark they dig through houses, which they had marked for
themselves in the daytime: they know not the light.

24:17 For the morning is to them even as the shadow of death: if one
know them, they are in the terrors of the shadow of death.

24:18 HE[JESUS] is swift as the waters; their portion is cursed in the earth:
HE[JESUS] beholdeth not the way of the vineyards.

24:19 Drought and heat consume the snow waters: so does the grave those
which have sinned.

24:20 The womb shall forget HIM[JESUS]; the worm shall feed sweetly on HIM[JESUS]; HE[JESUS]
shall be no more remembered; and wickedness shall be broken as a tree.

24:21 HE[JESUS] evil entreateth the barren that beareth not: and doeth not good
to the widow.

24:22 HE[JESUS] draweth also the mighty with HIS[JESUS] power: HE[JESUS] riseth up, and no
man is sure of life.

24:23 Though it be given HIM[JESUS] to be in safety, whereon HE[JESUS] resteth; yet
HIS[JESUS] eyes are upon their ways.

24:24 They are exalted for a little while, but are gone and brought low;
they are taken out of the way as all other, and cut off as the tops of
the ears of corn.

24:25 And if it be not so now, who will make me a liar, and make my
speech nothing worth?


25:1 Then answered Bildad the Shuhite, and said,

25:2 Dominion and fear are with HIM[JESUS], HE[JESUS] makes peace in HIS[JESUS] high places.

25:3 Is there any number of HIS[JESUS] armies? and upon whom does not HIS[JESUS] light
arise?

25:4 How then can man be justified with GOD[JESUS]? or how can HE[JESUS] be clean that
is born of a woman?

25:5 Behold even to the moon, and it shineth not; yea, the stars are not
pure in HIS[JESUS] sight.

25:6 How much less man, that is a worm? and the SON[JESUS] OF MAN[JESUS], which is a
worm?


26:1 But Job answered and said,

26:2 How hast you helped HIM[JESUS] that is without power? how savest you the
arm that has no strength?

26:3 How hast you counselled HIM[JESUS] that has no wisdom? and how hast you
plentifully declared the thing as it is?

26:4 To whom hast you uttered words? and whose spirit came from you?

26:5 Dead things are formed from under the waters, and the inhabitants
thereof.

26:6 Hell is naked before HIM[JESUS], and destruction has no covering.

26:7 HE[JESUS] stretcheth out the north over the empty place, and hangeth the
earth upon nothing.

26:8 HE[JESUS] bindeth up the waters in HIS[JESUS] thick clouds; and the cloud is not
rent under them.

26:9 HE[JESUS] holdeth back the face of HIS[JESUS] throne, and spreadeth HIS[JESUS] cloud
upon it.

26:10 HE[JESUS] has compassed the waters with bounds, until the day and night
come to an end.

26:11 The pillars of heaven tremble and are astonished at HIS[JESUS] reproof.

26:12 HE[JESUS] divideth the sea with HIS[JESUS] power, and by HIS[JESUS] understanding HE[JESUS]
smiteth through the proud.

26:13 By HIS[JESUS] spirit HE[JESUS] has garnished the heavens; HIS[JESUS] hand has formed
the crooked serpent.

26:14 Lo, these are parts of HIS[JESUS] ways: but how little a portion is heard
of HIM[JESUS]? but the thunder of HIS[JESUS] power who can understand?


27:1 Moreover Job continued HIS[JESUS] parable, and said,

27:2 As GOD[JESUS] liveth, who has taken away my judgment; and the Almighty,
who has vexed my soul;

27:3 All the while my breath is in me, and the spirit of GOD[JESUS] is in my
nostrils;

27:4 My lips shall not speak wickedness, nor my tongue utter deceit.

27:5 GOD[JESUS] forbid that I should justify you: till I die I will not remove
mine integrity from me.

27:6 My righteousness I hold fast, and will not let it go: my heart
shall not reproach me so long as I live.

27:7 Let mine enemy be as the wicked, and HE[JESUS] that riseth up against me
as the unrighteous.

27:8 For what is the hope of the hypocrite, though HE[JESUS] has gained, when
GOD[JESUS] taketh away HIS[JESUS] soul?

27:9 Will GOD[JESUS] hear HIS[JESUS] cry when trouble comes upon HIM[JESUS]?

27:10 Will HE[JESUS] delight himself in the Almighty? will HE[JESUS] always call upon
GOD[JESUS]?

27:11 I will teach you by the hand of GOD[JESUS]: that which is with the
Almighty will I not conceal.

27:12 Behold, all you yourselves have seen it; why then are you thus
altogether vain?

27:13 This is the portion of a wicked man with GOD[JESUS], and the heritage of
oppressors, which they shall receive of the Almighty.

27:14 If HIS[JESUS] children be multiplied, it is for the sword: and HIS[JESUS]
OFFSPRING[JESUS] shall not be satisfied with bread.

27:15 Those that remain of HIM[JESUS] shall be buried in death: and HIS[JESUS] widows
shall not weep.

27:16 Though HE[JESUS] heap up silver as the dust, and prepare raiment as the
clay;

27:17 HE[JESUS] may prepare it, but the just shall put it on, and the innocent
shall divide the silver.

27:18 HE[JESUS] buildeth HIS[JESUS] house as a moth, and as a booth that the keeper
makes.

27:19 The rich man shall lie down, but HE[JESUS] shall not be gathered: HE[JESUS]
openeth HIS[JESUS] eyes, and HE[JESUS] is not.

27:20 Terrors take hold on HIM[JESUS] as waters, a tempest stealeth HIM[JESUS] away in
the night.

27:21 The east wind carrieth HIM[JESUS] away, and HE[JESUS] departeth: and as a storm
hurleth HIM[JESUS] out of HIS[JESUS] place.

27:22 For GOD[JESUS] shall cast upon HIM[JESUS], and not spare: HE[JESUS] would fain flee out
of HIS[JESUS] hand.

27:23 Men shall clap their hands at HIM[JESUS], and shall hiss HIM[JESUS] out of HIS[JESUS]
place.


28:1 Surely there is a vein for the silver, and a place for gold where
they fine it.

28:2 Iron is taken out of the earth, and brass is molten out of the
stone.

28:3 HE[JESUS] setteth an end to darkness, and searcheth out all perfection:
the stones of darkness, and the shadow of death.

28:4 The flood breaketh out from the inhabitant; even the waters
forgotten of the foot: they are dried up, they are gone away from men.

28:5 As for the earth, out of it comes bread: and under it is turned up
as it were fire.

28:6 The stones of it are the place of sapphires: and it has dust of
gold.

28:7 There is a path which no fowl knoweth, and which the vulture's eye
has not seen:

28:8 The lion's whelps have not trodden it, nor the fierce lion passed
by it.

28:9 HE[JESUS] putteth forth HIS[JESUS] hand upon the rock; HE[JESUS] overturneth the
mountains by the roots.

28:10 HE[JESUS] cutteth out rivers among the rocks; and HIS[JESUS] eye seeth every
precious thing.

28:11 HE[JESUS] bindeth the floods from overflowing; and the thing that is hid
bringeth HE[JESUS] forth to light.

28:12 But where shall wisdom be found? and where is the place of
understanding?

28:13 Man knoweth not the price thereof; neither is it found in the land
of the living.

28:14 The depth says, It is not in me: and the sea says, It is not
with me.

28:15 It cannot be gotten for gold, neither shall silver be weighed for
the price thereof.

28:16 It cannot be valued with the gold of Ophir, with the precious
onyx, or the sapphire.

28:17 The gold and the crystal cannot equal it: and the exchange of it
shall not be for jewels of fine gold.

28:18 No mention shall be made of coral, or of pearls: for the price of
wisdom is above rubies.

28:19 The topaz of Ethiopia shall not equal it, neither shall it be
valued with pure gold.

28:20 Whence then comes wisdom? and where is the place of
understanding?

28:21 Seeing it is hid from the eyes of all living, and kept close from
the fowls of the air.

28:22 Destruction and death say, We have heard the fame thereof with our
ears.

28:23 GOD[JESUS] understandeth the way thereof, and HE[JESUS] knoweth the place
thereof.

28:24 For HE[JESUS] looketh to the ends of the earth, and seeth under the whole
heaven;

28:25 To make the weight for the winds; and HE[JESUS] weigheth the waters by
measure.

28:26 When HE[JESUS] made a decree for the rain, and a way for the lightning of
the thunder:

28:27 Then did HE[JESUS] see it, and declare it; HE[JESUS] prepared it, yea, and
searched it out.

28:28 And unto man HE[JESUS] said, Behold, the fear of the LORD[JESUS], that is
wisdom; and to depart from evil is understanding.


29:1 Moreover Job continued HIS[JESUS] parable, and said,

29:2 Oh that I were as in months past, as in the days when GOD[JESUS] preserved
me;

29:3 When HIS[JESUS] candle shined upon my head, and when by HIS[JESUS] light I walked
through darkness;

29:4 As I was in the days of my youth, when the secret of GOD[JESUS] was upon
my tabernacle;

29:5 When the Almighty was yet with me, when my children were about me;

29:6 When I washed my steps with butter, and the rock poured me out
rivers of oil;

29:7 When I went out to the gate through the city, when I prepared my
seat in the street!

29:8 The young men saw me, and hid themselves: and the aged arose, and
stood up.

29:9 The princes refrained talking, and laid their hand on their mouth.

29:10 The nobles held their peace, and their tongue cleaved to the roof
of their mouth.

29:11 When the ear heard me, then it blessed me; and when the eye saw
me, it gave witness to me:

29:12 Because I delivered the poor that cried, and the fatherless, and
HIM[JESUS] that had none to help HIM[JESUS].

29:13 The blessing of HIM[JESUS] that was ready to perish came upon me: and I
caused the widow's heart to sing for joy.

29:14 I put on righteousness, and it clothed me: my judgment was as a
robe and a diadem.

29:15 I was eyes to the blind, and feet was I to the lame.

29:16 I was a father to the poor: and the cause which I knew not I
searched out.

29:17 And I brake the jaws of the wicked, and plucked the spoil out of
HIS[JESUS] teeth.

29:18 Then I said, I shall die in my nest, and I shall multiply my days
as the sand.

29:19 My ROOT[JESUS] was spread out by the waters, and the dew lay all night
upon my BRANCH[JESUS].

29:20 My glory was fresh in me, and my bow was renewed in my hand.

29:21 Unto me men gave ear, and waited, and kept silence at my counsel.

29:22 After my words they spake not again; and my speech dropped upon
them.

29:23 And they waited for me as for the rain; and they opened their
mouth wide as for the latter rain.

29:24 If I laughed on them, they believed it not; and the light of my
countenance they cast not down.

29:25 I chose out their way, and sat chief, and dwelt as a KING[JESUS] in the
army, as one that comforteth the mourners.


30:1 But now they that are younger than I have me in derision, whose
fathers I would have disdained to have set with the dogs of my flock.

30:2 Yea, whereto might the strength of their hands profit me, in whom
old age was perished?

30:3 For want and famine they were solitary; fleeing into the wilderness
in former time desolate and waste.

30:4 Who cut up mallows by the bushes, and juniper roots for their meat.

30:5 They were driven forth from among men, (they cried after them as
after a thief;)

30:6 To dwell in the cliffs of the valleys, in caves of the earth, and
in the rocks.

30:7 Among the bushes they brayed; under the nettles they were gathered
together.

30:8 They were children of fools, yea, children of base men: they were
viler than the earth.

30:9 And now am I their song, yea, I am their byword.

30:10 They abhor me, they flee far from me, and spare not to spit in my
face.

30:11 Because HE[JESUS] has loosed my cord, and afflicted me, they have also
let loose the bridle before me.

30:12 Upon my right hand rise the youth; they push away my feet, and
they raise up against me the ways of their destruction.

30:13 They mar my path, they set forward my calamity, they have no
helper.

30:14 They came upon me as a wide breaking in of waters: in the
desolation they rolled themselves upon me.

30:15 Terrors are turned upon me: they pursue my soul as the wind: and
my welfare passeth away as a cloud.

30:16 And now my soul is poured out upon me; the days of affliction have
taken hold upon me.

30:17 My bones are pierced in me in the night season: and my sinews take
no rest.

30:18 By the great force of my disease is my garment changed: it bindeth
me about as the collar of my coat.

30:19 HE[JESUS] has cast me into the mire, and I am become like dust and
ashes.

30:20 I cry unto you, and you dost not hear me: I stand up, and you
regardest me not.

30:21 you art become cruel to me: with your strong hand you opposest
thyself against me.

30:22 you liftest me up to the wind; you causest me to ride upon it,
and dissolvest my substance.

30:23 For I know that you wilt bring me to death, and to the house
appointed for all living.

30:24 Howbeit HE[JESUS] will not stretch out HIS[JESUS] hand to the grave, though they
cry in HIS[JESUS] destruction.

30:25 Did not I weep for HIM[JESUS] that was in trouble? was not my soul
grieved for the poor?

30:26 When I looked for good, then evil came unto me: and when I waited
for light, there came darkness.

30:27 My bowels boiled, and rested not: the days of affliction prevented
me.

30:28 I went mourning without the sun: I stood up, and I cried in the
congregation.

30:29 I am a brother to dragons, and a companion to owls.

30:30 My skin is black upon me, and my bones are burned with heat.

30:31 My harp also is turned to mourning, and my organ into the voice of
them that weep.


31:1 I made a covenant with mine eyes; why then should I think upon a
maid?

31:2 For what portion of GOD[JESUS] is there from above? and what inheritance
of the Almighty from on high?

31:3 Is not destruction to the wicked? and a strange punishment to the
workers of iniquity?

31:4 does not HE[JESUS] see my ways, and count all my steps?

31:5 If I have walked with vanity, or if my foot has hasted to deceit;

31:6 Let me be weighed in an even balance that GOD[JESUS] may know mine
integrity.

31:7 If my step has turned out of the way, and mine heart walked after
mine eyes, and if any blot has cleaved to mine hands;

31:8 Then let me sow, and let another eat; yea, let my OFFSPRING[JESUS] be
rooted out.

31:9 If mine heart have been deceived by a woman, or if I have laid wait
at my neighbour's door;

31:10 Then let my wife grind unto another, and let others bow down upon
her.

31:11 For this is an heinous crime; yea, it is an iniquity to be
punished by the judges.

31:12 For it is a fire that consumeth to destruction, and would ROOT[JESUS] out
all mine increase.

31:13 If I did despise the cause of my manservant or of my maidservant,
when they contended with me;

31:14 What then shall I do when GOD[JESUS] riseth up? and when HE[JESUS] visiteth,
what shall I answer HIM[JESUS]?

31:15 Did not HE[JESUS] that made me in the womb make HIM[JESUS]? and did not one
fashion us in the womb?

31:16 If I have withheld the poor from their desire, or have caused the
eyes of the widow to fail;

31:17 Or have eaten my morsel myself alone, and the fatherless has not
eaten thereof;

31:18 (For from my youth HE[JESUS] was brought up with me, as with a father,
and I have guided her from my mother's womb;)

31:19 If I have seen any perish for want of clothing, or any poor
without covering;

31:20 If HIS[JESUS] loins have not blessed me, and if HE[JESUS] were not warmed with
the fleece of my sheep;

31:21 If I have lifted up my hand against the fatherless, when I saw my
help in the gate:

31:22 Then let mine arm fall from my shoulder blade, and mine arm be
broken from the bone.

31:23 For destruction from GOD[JESUS] was a terror to me, and by reason of HIS[JESUS]
highness I could not endure.

31:24 If I have made gold my hope, or have said to the fine gold, you
art my confidence;

31:25 If I rejoice because my wealth was great, and because mine hand
had gotten much;

31:26 If I beheld the sun when it shined, or the moon walking in
brightness;

31:27 And my heart has been secretly enticed, or my mouth has kissed
my hand:

31:28 This also were an iniquity to be punished by the judge: for I
should have denied the GOD[JESUS] that is above.

31:29 If I rejoice at the destruction of HIM[JESUS] that hated me, or lifted up
myself when evil found HIM[JESUS]:

31:30 Neither have I suffered my mouth to sin by wishing a curse to HIS[JESUS]
soul.

31:31 If the men of my tabernacle said not, Oh that we had of HIS[JESUS] flesh!
we cannot be satisfied.

31:32 The stranger did not lodge in the street: but I opened my doors to
the traveller.

31:33 If I covered my transgressions as Adam, by hiding mine iniquity in
my bosom:

31:34 Did I fear a great multitude, or did the contempt of families
terrify me, that I kept silence, and went not out of the door?

31:35 Oh that one would hear me! behold, my desire is, that the Almighty
would answer me, and that mine adversary had written a book.

31:36 Surely I would take it upon my shoulder, and bind it as a crown to
me.

31:37 I would declare unto HIM[JESUS] the number of my steps; as a prince would
I go near unto HIM[JESUS].

31:38 If my land cry against me, or that the furrows likewise thereof
complain;

31:39 If I have eaten the fruits thereof without money, or have caused
the owners thereof to lose their life:

31:40 Let thistles grow instead of wheat, and cockle instead of barley.
The words of Job are ended.


32:1 So these three men ceased to answer Job, because HE[JESUS] was righteous
in HIS[JESUS] own eyes.

32:2 Then was kindled the wrath of Elihu the SON[JESUS] of Barachel the Buzite,
of the kindred of Ram: against Job was HIS[JESUS] wrath kindled, because HE[JESUS]
justified himself rather than GOD[JESUS].

32:3 Also against HIS[JESUS] three friends was HIS[JESUS] wrath kindled, because they
had found no answer, and yet had condemned Job.

32:4 Now Elihu had waited till Job had spoken, because they were elder
than HE[JESUS].

32:5 When Elihu saw that there was no answer in the mouth of these three
men, then HIS[JESUS] wrath was kindled.

32:6 And Elihu the SON[JESUS] of Barachel the Buzite answered and said, I am
young, and you are very old; wherefore I was afraid, and durst not shew
you mine opinion.

32:7 I said, Days should speak, and multitude of years should teach
wisdom.

32:8 But there is a spirit in man: and the inspiration of the Almighty
giveth them understanding.

32:9 Great men are not always wise: neither do the aged understand
judgment.

32:10 Therefore I said, Hearken to me; I also will shew mine opinion.

32:11 Behold, I waited for your words; I gave ear to your reasons,
whilst you searched out what to say.

32:12 Yea, I attended unto you, and, behold, there was none of you that
convinced Job, or that answered HIS[JESUS] words:

32:13 Lest you should say, We have found out wisdom: GOD[JESUS] thrusteth HIM[JESUS]
down, not man.

32:14 Now HE[JESUS] has not directed HIS[JESUS] words against me: neither will I
answer HIM[JESUS] with your speeches.

32:15 They were amazed, they answered no more: they left off speaking.

32:16 When I had waited, (for they spake not, but stood still, and
answered no more;)

32:17 I said, I will answer also my part, I also will shew mine opinion.

32:18 For I am full of matter, the spirit within me constraineth me.

32:19 Behold, my belly is as wine which has no vent; it is ready to
burst like new bottles.

32:20 I will speak, that I may be refreshed: I will open my lips and
answer.

32:21 Let me not, I pray you, accept any man's person, neither let me
give flattering titles unto man.

32:22 For I know not to give flattering titles; in so doing my maker
would soon take me away.


33:1 Wherefore, Job, I pray you, hear my speeches, and hearken to all
my words.

33:2 Behold, now I have opened my mouth, my tongue has spoken in my
mouth.

33:3 My words shall be of the uprightness of my heart: and my lips shall
utter knowledge clearly.

33:4 The spirit of GOD[JESUS] has made me, and the breath of the Almighty has
given me life.

33:5 If you canst answer me, set your words in order before me, stand
up.

33:6 Behold, I am according to your wish in GOD[JESUS]'s stead: I also am formed
out of the clay.

33:7 Behold, my terror shall not make you afraid, neither shall my hand
be heavy upon you.

33:8 Surely you hast spoken in mine hearing, and I have heard the voice
of your words, saying,

33:9 I am clean without transgression, I am innocent; neither is there
iniquity in me.

33:10 Behold, HE[JESUS] findeth occasions against me, HE[JESUS] counteth me for HIS[JESUS]
enemy,

33:11 HE[JESUS] putteth my feet in the stocks, HE[JESUS] marketh all my paths.

33:12 Behold, in this you art not just: I will answer you, that GOD[JESUS] is
greater than man.

33:13 Why dost you strive against HIM[JESUS]? for HE[JESUS] giveth not account of any
of HIS[JESUS] matters.

33:14 For GOD[JESUS] speaketh once, yea twice, yet man perceiveth it not.

33:15 In a dream, in a vision of the night, when deep sleep falleth upon
men, in slumberings upon the bed;

33:16 Then HE[JESUS] openeth the ears of men, and sealeth their instruction,

33:17 That HE[JESUS] may withdraw man from HIS[JESUS] purpose, and hide pride from
man.

33:18 HE[JESUS] keepeth back HIS[JESUS] soul from the pit, and HIS[JESUS] life from perishing
by the sword.

33:19 HE[JESUS] is chastened also with pain upon HIS[JESUS] bed, and the multitude of
HIS[JESUS] bones with strong pain:

33:20 So that HIS[JESUS] life abhorreth bread, and HIS[JESUS] soul dainty meat.

33:21 HIS[JESUS] flesh is consumed away, that it cannot be seen; and HIS[JESUS] bones
that were not seen stick out.

33:22 Yea, HIS[JESUS] soul draweth near unto the grave, and HIS[JESUS] life to the
destroyers.

33:23 If there be a messenger with HIM[JESUS], an interpreter, one among a
thousand, to shew unto man HIS[JESUS] uprightness:

33:24 Then HE[JESUS] is gracious unto HIM[JESUS], and says, Deliver HIM[JESUS] from going
down to the pit: I have found a ransom.

33:25 HIS[JESUS] flesh shall be fresher than a child's: HE[JESUS] shall return to the
days of HIS[JESUS] youth:

33:26 HE[JESUS] shall pray unto GOD[JESUS], and HE[JESUS] will be favourable unto HIM[JESUS]: and HE[JESUS]
shall see HIS[JESUS] face with joy: for HE[JESUS] will render unto man HIS[JESUS]
righteousness.

33:27 HE[JESUS] looketh upon men, and if any say, I have sinned, and perverted
that which was right, and it profited me not;

33:28 HE[JESUS] will deliver HIS[JESUS] soul from going into the pit, and HIS[JESUS] life
shall see the light.

33:29 Lo, all these things worketh GOD[JESUS] oftentimes with man,

33:30 To bring back HIS[JESUS] soul from the pit, to be enlightened with the
light of the living.

33:31 Mark well, O Job, hearken unto me: hold your peace, and I will
speak.

33:32 If you hast anything to say, answer me: speak, for I desire to
justify you.

33:33 If not, hearken unto me: hold your peace, and I shall teach you
wisdom.


34:1 Furthermore Elihu answered and said,

34:2 Hear my words, O you wise men; and give ear unto me, you that have
knowledge.

34:3 For the ear trieth words, as the mouth tasteth meat.

34:4 Let us choose to us judgment: let us know among ourselves what is
good.

34:5 For Job has said, I am righteous: and GOD[JESUS] has taken away my
judgment.

34:6 Should I lie against my right? my wound is incurable without
transgression.

34:7 What man is like Job, who drinketh up scorning like water?

34:8 Which goes in company with the workers of iniquity, and walketh
with wicked men.

34:9 For HE[JESUS] has said, It profiteth a man nothing that HE[JESUS] should delight
himself with GOD[JESUS].

34:10 Therefore hearken unto me you men of understanding: far be it from
GOD[JESUS], that HE[JESUS] should do wickedness; and from the Almighty, that HE[JESUS] should
commit iniquity.

34:11 For the work of a man shall HE[JESUS] render unto HIM[JESUS], and cause every
man to find according to HIS[JESUS] ways.

34:12 Yea, surely GOD[JESUS] will not do wickedly, neither will the Almighty
pervert judgment.

34:13 Who has given HIM[JESUS] a charge over the earth? or who has disposed
the whole world?

34:14 If HE[JESUS] set HIS[JESUS] heart upon man, if HE[JESUS] gather unto himself HIS[JESUS] spirit
and HIS[JESUS] breath;

34:15 All flesh shall perish together, and man shall turn again unto
dust.

34:16 If now you hast understanding, hear this: hearken to the voice of
my words.

34:17 Shall even HE[JESUS] that hateth right govern? and wilt you condemn HIM[JESUS]
that is most just?

34:18 Is it fit to say to a KING[JESUS], you art wicked? and to princes, you
are ungodly?

34:19 How much less to HIM[JESUS] that accepteth not the persons of princes,
nor regardeth the rich more than the poor? for they all are the work of
HIS[JESUS] hands.

34:20 In a moment shall they die, and the people shall be troubled at
midnight, and pass away: and the mighty shall be taken away without
hand.

34:21 For HIS[JESUS] eyes are upon the ways of man, and HE[JESUS] seeth all HIS[JESUS]
goings.

34:22 There is no darkness, nor shadow of death, where the workers of
iniquity may hide themselves.

34:23 For HE[JESUS] will not lay upon man more than right; that HE[JESUS] should enter
into judgment with GOD[JESUS].

34:24 HE[JESUS] shall break in pieces mighty men without number, and set others
in their stead.

34:25 Therefore HE[JESUS] knoweth their works, and HE[JESUS] overturneth them in the
night, so that they are destroyed.

34:26 HE[JESUS] striketh them as wicked men in the open sight of others;

34:27 Because they turned back from HIM[JESUS], and would not consider any of
HIS[JESUS] ways:

34:28 So that they cause the cry of the poor to come unto HIM[JESUS], and HE[JESUS]
heareth the cry of the afflicted.

34:29 When HE[JESUS] giveth quietness, who then can make trouble? and when HE[JESUS]
hideth HIS[JESUS] face, who then can behold HIM[JESUS]? whether it be done against a
nation, or against a man only:

34:30 That the hypocrite reign not, lest the people be ensnared.

34:31 Surely it is meet to be said unto GOD[JESUS], I have borne chastisement,
I will not offend any more:

34:32 That which I see not teach you me: if I have done iniquity, I
will do no more.

34:33 Should it be according to your mind? HE[JESUS] will recompense it, whether
you refuse, or whether you choose; and not I: therefore speak what
you knowest.

34:34 Let men of understanding tell me, and let a wise man hearken unto
me.

34:35 Job has spoken without knowledge, and HIS[JESUS] words were without
wisdom.

34:36 My desire is that Job may be tried unto the end because of HIS[JESUS]
answers for wicked men.

34:37 For HE[JESUS] addeth rebellion unto HIS[JESUS] sin, HE[JESUS] clappeth HIS[JESUS] hands among
us, and multiplieth HIS[JESUS] words against GOD[JESUS].


35:1 Elihu spake moreover, and said,

35:2 Thinkest you this to be right, that you saidst, My righteousness
is more than GOD[JESUS]'s?

35:3 For you saidst, What advantage will it be unto you? and, What
profit shall I have, if I be cleansed from my sin?

35:4 I will answer you, and your companions with you.

35:5 Look unto the heavens, and see; and behold the clouds which are
higher than you.

35:6 If you sinnest, what doest you against HIM[JESUS]? or if your
transgressions be multiplied, what doest you unto HIM[JESUS]?

35:7 If you be righteous, what givest you HIM[JESUS]? or what receiveth HE[JESUS] of
yours hand?

35:8 your wickedness may hurt a man as you art; and your righteousness
may profit the SON[JESUS] OF MAN[JESUS].

35:9 By reason of the multitude of oppressions they make the oppressed
to cry: they cry out by reason of the arm of the mighty.

35:10 But none says, Where is GOD[JESUS] my maker, who giveth songs in the
night;

35:11 Who teacheth us more than the beasts of the earth, and makes us
wiser than the fowls of heaven?

35:12 There they cry, but none giveth answer, because of the pride of
evil men.

35:13 Surely GOD[JESUS] will not hear vanity, neither will the Almighty regard
it.

35:14 Although you sayest you shalt not see HIM[JESUS], yet judgment is
before HIM[JESUS]; therefore trust you in HIM[JESUS].

35:15 But now, because it is not so, HE[JESUS] has visited in HIS[JESUS] anger; yet
HE[JESUS] knoweth it not in great extremity:

35:16 Therefore does Job open HIS[JESUS] mouth in vain; HE[JESUS] multiplieth words
without knowledge.


36:1 Elihu also proceeded, and said,

36:2 let me a little, and I will shew you that I have yet to speak
on GOD[JESUS]'s behalf.

36:3 I will fetch my knowledge from afar, and will ascribe righteousness
to my Maker.

36:4 For truly my words shall not be false: HE[JESUS] that is perfect in
knowledge is with you.

36:5 Behold, GOD[JESUS] is mighty, and despiseth not any: HE[JESUS] is mighty in
strength and wisdom.

36:6 HE[JESUS] preserveth not the life of the wicked: but giveth right to the
poor.

36:7 HE[JESUS] withdraweth not HIS[JESUS] eyes from the righteous: but with kings are
they on the throne; yea, HE[JESUS] does establish them for ever, and they are
exalted.

36:8 And if they be bound in fetters, and be holden in cords of
affliction;

36:9 Then HE[JESUS] sheweth them their work, and their transgressions that they
have exceeded.

36:10 HE[JESUS] openeth also their ear to discipline, and commandeth that they
return from iniquity.

36:11 If they obey and serve HIM[JESUS], they shall spend their days in
prosperity, and their years in pleasures.

36:12 But if they obey not, they shall perish by the sword, and they
shall die without knowledge.

36:13 But the hypocrites in heart heap up wrath: they cry not when HE[JESUS]
bindeth them.

36:14 They die in youth, and their life is among the unclean.

36:15 HE[JESUS] delivereth the poor in HIS[JESUS] affliction, and openeth their ears
in oppression.

36:16 Even so would HE[JESUS] have removed you out of the strait into a broad
place, where there is no straitness; and that which should be set on your
table should be full of fatness.

36:17 But you hast fulfilled the judgment of the wicked: judgment and
justice take hold on you.

36:18 Because there is wrath, beware lest HE[JESUS] take you away with HIS[JESUS]
stroke: then a great ransom cannot deliver you.

36:19 Will HE[JESUS] esteem your riches? no, not gold, nor all the forces of
strength.

36:20 Desire not the night, when people are cut off in their place.

36:21 Take heed, regard not iniquity: for this hast you chosen rather
than affliction.

36:22 Behold, GOD[JESUS] exalteth by HIS[JESUS] power: who teacheth like HIM[JESUS]?

36:23 Who has enjoined HIM[JESUS] HIS[JESUS] way? or who can say, you hast wrought
iniquity?

36:24 Remember that you magnify HIS[JESUS] work, which men behold.

36:25 Every man may see it; man may behold it afar off.

36:26 Behold, GOD[JESUS] is great, and we know HIM[JESUS] not, neither can the number
of HIS[JESUS] years be searched out.

36:27 For HE[JESUS] makes small the drops of water: they pour down rain
according to the vapour thereof:

36:28 Which the clouds do drop and distil upon man abundantly.

36:29 Also can any understand the spreadings of the clouds, or the noise
of HIS[JESUS] tabernacle?

36:30 Behold, HE[JESUS] spreadeth HIS[JESUS] light upon it, and covereth the bottom of
the sea.

36:31 For by them judgeth HE[JESUS] the people; HE[JESUS] giveth meat in abundance.

36:32 With clouds HE[JESUS] covereth the light; and commandeth it not to shine
by the cloud that comes betwixt.

36:33 The noise thereof sheweth concerning it, the cattle also
concerning the vapour.


37:1 At this also my heart trembleth, and is moved out of HIS[JESUS] place.

37:2 Hear attentively the noise of HIS[JESUS] voice, and the sound that goes
out of HIS[JESUS] mouth.

37:3 HE[JESUS] directeth it under the whole heaven, and HIS[JESUS] lightning unto the
ends of the earth.

37:4 After it a voice roareth: HE[JESUS] thundereth with the voice of HIS[JESUS]
excellency; and HE[JESUS] will not stay them when HIS[JESUS] voice is heard.

37:5 GOD[JESUS] thundereth marvellously with HIS[JESUS] voice; great things doeth HE[JESUS],
which we cannot comprehend.

37:6 For HE[JESUS] says to the snow, Be you on the earth; likewise to the
small rain, and to the great rain of HIS[JESUS] strength.

37:7 HE[JESUS] sealeth up the hand of every man; that all men may know HIS[JESUS]
work.

37:8 Then the beasts go into dens, and remain in their places.

37:9 Out of the south comes the whirlwind: and cold out of the north.

37:10 By the breath of GOD[JESUS] frost is given: and the breadth of the waters
is straitened.

37:11 Also by watering HE[JESUS] wearieth the thick cloud: HE[JESUS] scattereth HIS[JESUS]
bright cloud:

37:12 And it is turned round about by HIS[JESUS] counsels: that they may do
whatsoever HE[JESUS] commandeth them upon the face of the world in the earth.

37:13 HE[JESUS] causeth it to come, whether for correction, or for HIS[JESUS] land, or
for mercy.

37:14 Hearken unto this, O Job: stand still, and consider the wondrous
works of GOD[JESUS].

37:15 Dost you know when GOD[JESUS] disposed them, and caused the light of HIS[JESUS]
cloud to shine?

37:16 Dost you know the balancings of the clouds, the wondrous works of
HIM[JESUS] which is perfect in knowledge?

37:17 How your garments are warm, when HE[JESUS] quieteth the earth by the south
wind?

37:18 Hast you with HIM[JESUS] spread out the sky, which is strong, and as a
molten looking glass?

37:19 Teach us what we shall say unto HIM[JESUS]; for we cannot order our
speech by reason of darkness.

37:20 Shall it be told HIM[JESUS] that I speak? if a man speak, surely HE[JESUS] shall
be swallowed up.

37:21 And now men see not the bright light which is in the clouds: but
the wind passeth, and cleanseth them.

37:22 Fair weather comes out of the north: with GOD[JESUS] is terrible
majesty.

37:23 Touching the Almighty, we cannot find HIM[JESUS] out: HE[JESUS] is excellent in
power, and in judgment, and in plenty of justice: HE[JESUS] will not afflict.

37:24 Men do therefore fear HIM[JESUS]: HE[JESUS] respecteth not any that are wise of
heart.


38:1 Then the LORD[JESUS] answered Job out of the whirlwind, and said,

38:2 Who is this that darkeneth counsel by words without knowledge?

38:3 Gird up now your loins like a man; for I will demand of you, and
answer you me.

38:4 Where wast you when I laid the foundations of the earth? declare,
if you hast understanding.

38:5 Who has laid the measures thereof, if you knowest? or who has
stretched the line upon it?

38:6 Whereupon are the foundations thereof fastened? or who laid the
corner stone thereof;

38:7 When the morning stars sang together, and all the sons of GOD[JESUS]
shouted for joy?

38:8 Or who shut up the sea with doors, when it brake forth, as if it
had issued out of the womb?

38:9 When I made the cloud the garment thereof, and thick darkness a
swaddlingband for it,

38:10 And brake up for it my decreed place, and set bars and doors,

38:11 And said, Hitherto shalt you come, but no further: and here shall
your proud waves be stayed?

38:12 Hast you commanded the morning since your days; and caused the
dayspring to know HIS[JESUS] place;

38:13 That it might take hold of the ends of the earth, that the wicked
might be shaken out of it?

38:14 It is turned as clay to the seal; and they stand as a garment.

38:15 And from the wicked their light is withholden, and the high arm
shall be broken.

38:16 Hast you entered into the springs of the sea? or hast you walked
in the search of the depth?

38:17 Have the gates of death been opened unto you? or hast you seen
the doors of the shadow of death?

38:18 Hast you perceived the breadth of the earth? declare if you
knowest it all.

38:19 Where is the way where light dwelleth? and as for darkness, where
is the place thereof,

38:20 That you shouldest take it to the bound thereof, and that you
shouldest know the paths to the house thereof?

38:21 Knowest you it, because you wast then born? or because the
number of your days is great?

38:22 Hast you entered into the treasures of the snow? or hast you
seen the treasures of the hail,

38:23 Which I have reserved against the time of trouble, against the day
of battle and war?

38:24 By what way is the light parted, which scattereth the east wind
upon the earth?

38:25 Who has divided a watercourse for the overflowing of waters, or a
way for the lightning of thunder;

38:26 To cause it to rain on the earth, where no man is; on the
wilderness, wherein there is no man;

38:27 To satisfy the desolate and waste ground; and to cause the bud of
the tender herb to spring forth?

38:28 has the rain a father? or who has begotten the drops of dew?

38:29 Out of whose womb came the ice? and the hoary frost of heaven, who
has gendered it?

38:30 The waters are hid as with a stone, and the face of the deep is
frozen.

38:31 Canst you bind the sweet influences of Pleiades, or loose the
bands of Orion?

38:32 Canst you bring forth Mazzaroth in HIS[JESUS] season? or canst you
guide Arcturus with HIS[JESUS] sons?

38:33 Knowest you the ordinances of heaven? canst you set the dominion
thereof in the earth?

38:34 Canst you lift up your voice to the clouds, that abundance of
waters may cover you?

38:35 Canst you send lightnings, that they may go and say unto you,
Here we are?

38:36 Who has put wisdom in the inward parts? or who has given
understanding to the heart?

38:37 Who can number the clouds in wisdom? or who can stay the bottles
of heaven,

38:38 When the dust groweth into hardness, and the clods cleave fast
together?

38:39 Wilt you hunt the prey for the lion? or fill the appetite of the
young lions,

38:40 When they couch in their dens, and abide in the covert to lie in
wait?

38:41 Who provideth for the raven HIS[JESUS] food? when HIS[JESUS] young ones cry unto
GOD[JESUS], they wander for lack of meat.


39:1 Knowest you the time when the wild goats of the rock bring forth?
or canst you mark when the hinds do calve?

39:2 Canst you number the months that they fulfil? or knowest you the
time when they bring forth?

39:3 They bow themselves, they bring forth their young ones, they cast
out their sorrows.

39:4 Their young ones are in good liking, they grow up with corn; they
go forth, and return not unto them.

39:5 Who has sent out the wild ass free? or who has loosed the bands
of the wild ass?

39:6 Whose house I have made the wilderness, and the barren land HIS[JESUS]
dwellings.

39:7 HE[JESUS] scorneth the multitude of the city, neither regardeth HE[JESUS] the
crying of the driver.

39:8 The range of the mountains is HIS[JESUS] pasture, and HE[JESUS] searcheth after
every green thing.

39:9 Will the unicorn be willing to serve you, or abide by your crib?

39:10 Canst you bind the unicorn with HIS[JESUS] band in the furrow? or will
HE[JESUS] harrow the valleys after you?

39:11 Wilt you trust HIM[JESUS], because HIS[JESUS] strength is great? or wilt you
leave your labour to HIM[JESUS]?

39:12 Wilt you believe HIM[JESUS], that HE[JESUS] will bring home your SEED[JESUS], and
gather it into your barn?

39:13 Gavest you the goodly wings unto the peacocks? or wings and
feathers unto the ostrich?

39:14 Which leaveth her eggs in the earth, and warmeth them in dust,

39:15 And forgetteth that the foot may crush them, or that the wild
beast may break them.

39:16 She is hardened against her young ones, as though they were not
her's: her labour is in vain without fear;

39:17 Because GOD[JESUS] has deprived her of wisdom, neither has HE[JESUS] imparted
to her understanding.

39:18 What time she lifteth up herself on high, she scorneth the horse
and HIS[JESUS] rider.

39:19 Hast you given the horse strength? hast you clothed HIS[JESUS] neck
with thunder?

39:20 Canst you make HIM[JESUS] afraid as a grasshopper? the glory of HIS[JESUS]
nostrils is terrible.

39:21 HE[JESUS] paweth in the valley, and rejoiceth in HIS[JESUS] strength: HE[JESUS] goes
on to meet the armed men.

39:22 HE[JESUS] mocketh at fear, and is not affrighted; neither turneth HE[JESUS] back
from the sword.

39:23 The quiver rattleth against HIM[JESUS], the glittering spear and the
shield.

39:24 HE[JESUS] swalloweth the ground with fierceness and rage: neither
believes HE[JESUS] that it is the sound of the trumpet.

39:25 HE[JESUS] says among the trumpets, Ha, ha; and HE[JESUS] smelleth the battle
afar off, the thunder of the captains, and the shouting.

39:26 does the hawk fly by your wisdom, and stretch her wings toward the
south?

39:27 does the eagle mount up at your command, and make her nest on high?

39:28 She dwelleth and abideth on the rock, upon the crag of the rock,
and the strong place.

39:29 From thence she seeketh the prey, and her eyes behold afar off.

39:30 Her young ones also suck up blood: and where the slain are, there
is she.


40:1 Moreover the LORD[JESUS] answered Job, and said,

40:2 Shall HE[JESUS] that contendeth with the Almighty instruct HIM[JESUS]? HE[JESUS] that
reproveth GOD[JESUS], let HIM[JESUS] answer it.

40:3 Then Job answered the LORD[JESUS], and said,

40:4 Behold, I am vile; what shall I answer you? I will lay mine hand
upon my mouth.

40:5 Once have I spoken; but I will not answer: yea, twice; but I will
proceed no further.

40:6 Then answered the LORD[JESUS] unto Job out of the whirlwind, and said,

40:7 Gird up your loins now like a man: I will demand of you, and
declare you unto me.

40:8 Wilt you also disannul my judgment? wilt you condemn me, that
you mayest be righteous?

40:9 Hast you an arm like GOD[JESUS]? or canst you thunder with a voice like
HIM[JESUS]?

40:10 Deck thyself now with majesty and excellency; and array thyself
with glory and beauty.

40:11 Cast abroad the rage of your wrath: and behold every one that is
proud, and abase HIM[JESUS].

40:12 Look on every one that is proud, and bring HIM[JESUS] low; and tread down
the wicked in their place.

40:13 Hide them in the dust together; and bind their faces in secret.

40:14 Then will I also confess unto you that yours own right hand can
save you.

40:15 Behold now behemoth, which I made with you; HE[JESUS] eateth grass as an
ox.

40:16 Lo now, HIS[JESUS] strength is in HIS[JESUS] loins, and HIS[JESUS] force is in the
navel of HIS[JESUS] belly.

40:17 HE[JESUS] moveth HIS[JESUS] tail like a cedar: the sinews of HIS[JESUS] stones are
wrapped together.

40:18 HIS[JESUS] bones are as strong pieces of brass; HIS[JESUS] bones are like bars
of iron.

40:19 HE[JESUS] is the chief of the ways of GOD[JESUS]: HE[JESUS] that made HIM[JESUS] can make HIS[JESUS]
sword to approach unto HIM[JESUS].

40:20 Surely the mountains bring HIM[JESUS] forth food, where all the beasts of
the field play.

40:21 HE[JESUS] lieth under the shady trees, in the covert of the reed, and
fens.

40:22 The shady trees cover HIM[JESUS] with their shadow; the willows of the
brook compass HIM[JESUS] about.

40:23 Behold, HE[JESUS] drinketh up a river, and hasteth not: HE[JESUS] trusteth that
HE[JESUS] can draw up Jordan into HIS[JESUS] mouth.

40:24 HE[JESUS] taketh it with HIS[JESUS] eyes: HIS[JESUS] nose pierceth through snares.


41:1 Canst you draw out leviathan with an hook? or HIS[JESUS] tongue with a
cord which you lettest down?

41:2 Canst you put an hook into HIS[JESUS] nose? or bore HIS[JESUS] jaw through with
a thorn?

41:3 Will HE[JESUS] make many supplications unto you? will HE[JESUS] speak soft words
unto you?

41:4 Will HE[JESUS] make a covenant with you? wilt you take HIM[JESUS] for a SERVANT[JESUS]
for ever?

41:5 Wilt you play with HIM[JESUS] as with a bird? or wilt you bind HIM[JESUS] for
your maidens?

41:6 Shall the companions make a banquet of HIM[JESUS]? shall they part HIM[JESUS]
among the merchants?

41:7 Canst you fill HIS[JESUS] skin with barbed irons? or HIS[JESUS] head with fish
spears?

41:8 Lay yours hand upon HIM[JESUS], remember the battle, do no more.

41:9 Behold, the hope of HIM[JESUS] is in vain: shall not one be cast down even
at the sight of HIM[JESUS]?

41:10 None is so fierce that dare stir HIM[JESUS] up: who then is able to stand
before me?

41:11 Who has prevented me, that I should repay HIM[JESUS]? whatsoever is
under the whole heaven is mine.

41:12 I will not conceal HIS[JESUS] parts, nor HIS[JESUS] power, nor HIS[JESUS] comely
proportion.

41:13 Who can discover the face of HIS[JESUS] garment? or who can come to HIM[JESUS]
with HIS[JESUS] double bridle?

41:14 Who can open the doors of HIS[JESUS] face? HIS[JESUS] teeth are terrible round
about.

41:15 HIS[JESUS] scales are HIS[JESUS] pride, shut up together as with a close seal.

41:16 One is so near to another, that no air can come between them.

41:17 They are joined one to another, they stick together, that they
cannot be sundered.

41:18 By HIS[JESUS] neesings a light does shine, and HIS[JESUS] eyes are like the
eyelids of the morning.

41:19 Out of HIS[JESUS] mouth go burning lamps, and sparks of fire leap out.

41:20 Out of HIS[JESUS] nostrils goes smoke, as out of a seething pot or
caldron.

41:21 HIS[JESUS] breath kindleth coals, and a flame goes out of HIS[JESUS] mouth.

41:22 In HIS[JESUS] neck remaineth strength, and sorrow is turned into joy
before HIM[JESUS].

41:23 The flakes of HIS[JESUS] flesh are joined together: they are firm in
themselves; they cannot be moved.

41:24 HIS[JESUS] heart is as firm as a stone; yea, as hard as a piece of the
nether millstone.

41:25 When HE[JESUS] raiseth up himself, the mighty are afraid: by reason of
breakings they purify themselves.

41:26 The sword of HIM[JESUS] that layeth at HIM[JESUS] cannot hold: the spear, the
dart, nor the habergeon.

41:27 HE[JESUS] esteemeth iron as straw, and brass as rotten wood.

41:28 The arrow cannot make HIM[JESUS] flee: slingstones are turned with HIM[JESUS]
into stubble.

41:29 Darts are counted as stubble: HE[JESUS] laugheth at the shaking of a
spear.

41:30 Sharp stones are under HIM[JESUS]: HE[JESUS] spreadeth sharp pointed things upon
the mire.

41:31 HE[JESUS] makes the deep to boil like a pot: HE[JESUS] makes the sea like a
pot of ointment.

41:32 HE[JESUS] makes a path to shine after HIM[JESUS]; one would think the deep to
be hoary.

41:33 Upon earth there is not HIS[JESUS] like, who is made without fear.

41:34 HE[JESUS] beholdeth all high things: HE[JESUS] is a KING[JESUS] over all the children
of pride.


42:1 Then Job answered the LORD[JESUS], and said,

42:2 I know that you canst do every thing, and that no thought can be
withholden from you.

42:3 Who is HE[JESUS] that hideth counsel without knowledge? therefore have I
uttered that I understood not; things too WONDERFUL[JESUS] for me, which I knew
not.

42:4 Hear, I beseech you, and I will speak: I will demand of you, and
declare you unto me.

42:5 I have heard of you by the hearing of the ear: but now mine eye
seeth you.

42:6 Wherefore I abhor myself, and repent in dust and ashes.

42:7 And it was so, that after the LORD[JESUS] had spoken these words unto Job,
the LORD[JESUS] said to Eliphaz the Temanite, My wrath is kindled against you,
and against your two friends: for you have not spoken of me the thing that
is right, as my SERVANT[JESUS] Job has.

42:8 Therefore take unto you now seven bullocks and seven rams, and go
to my SERVANT[JESUS] Job, and offer up for yourselves a burnt offering; and my
SERVANT[JESUS] Job shall pray for you: for HIM[JESUS] will I accept: lest I deal with
you after your folly, in that you have not spoken of me the thing which
is right, like my SERVANT[JESUS] Job.

42:9 So Eliphaz the Temanite and Bildad the Shuhite and Zophar the
Naamathite went, and did according as the LORD[JESUS] commanded them: the LORD[JESUS]
also accepted Job.

42:10 And the LORD[JESUS] turned the captivity of Job, when HE[JESUS] prayed for HIS[JESUS]
friends: also the LORD[JESUS] gave Job twice as much as HE[JESUS] had before.

42:11 Then came there unto HIM[JESUS] all HIS[JESUS] brethren, and all HIS[JESUS] sisters,
and all they that had been of HIS[JESUS] acquaintance before, and did eat bread
with HIM[JESUS] in HIS[JESUS] house: and they bemoaned HIM[JESUS], and comforted HIM[JESUS] over all
the evil that the LORD[JESUS] had brought upon HIM[JESUS]: every man also gave HIM[JESUS] a
piece of money, and every one an earring of gold.

42:12 So the LORD[JESUS] blessed the latter end of Job more than HIS[JESUS] beginning:
for HE[JESUS] had fourteen thousand sheep, and six thousand camels, and a
thousand yoke of oxen, and a thousand she asses.

42:13 HE[JESUS] had also seven sons and three daughters.

42:14 And HE[JESUS] called the name of the first, Jemima; and the name of the
second, Kezia; and the name of the third, Kerenhappuch.

42:15 And in all the land were no women found so fair as the daughters
of Job: and their father gave them inheritance among their brethren.

42:16 After this lived Job an hundred and forty years, and saw HIS[JESUS] sons,
and HIS[JESUS] sons' sons, even four generations.

42:17 So Job died, being old and full of days.
