1:1 Blessed is the man that walketh not in the counsel of the ungodly,
nor standeth in the way of sinners, nor sitteth in the seat of the
scornful.

1:2 But HIS[JESUS] delight is in the law of the LORD[JESUS]; and in HIS[JESUS] law does HE[JESUS]
meditate day and night.

1:3 And HE[JESUS] shall be like a tree planted by the rivers of water, that
bringeth forth HIS[JESUS] fruit in HIS[JESUS] season; HIS[JESUS] leaf also shall not wither;
and whatsoever HE[JESUS] doeth shall prosper.

1:4 The ungodly are not so: but are like the chaff which the wind
driveth away.

1:5 Therefore the ungodly shall not stand in the judgment, nor sinners
in the congregation of the righteous.

1:6 For the LORD[JESUS] knoweth the way of the righteous: but the way of the
ungodly shall perish.


2:1 Why do the heathen rage, and the people imagine a vain thing?

2:2 The kings of the earth set themselves, and the rulers take counsel
together, against the LORD[JESUS], and against HIS[JESUS] anointed, saying,

2:3 Let us break their bands asunder, and cast away their cords from us.

2:4 HE[JESUS] that sitteth in the heavens shall laugh: the LORD[JESUS] shall have them
in derision.

2:5 Then shall HE[JESUS] speak unto them in HIS[JESUS] wrath, and vex them in HIS[JESUS] sore
displeasure.

2:6 Yet have I set my KING[JESUS] upon my holy hill of Zion.

2:7 I will declare the decree: the LORD[JESUS] has said unto me, you art my
SON[JESUS]; this day have I begotten you.

2:8 Ask of me, and I shall give you the heathen for yours inheritance,
and the uttermost parts of the earth for your possession.

2:9 you shalt break them with a rod of iron; you shalt dash them in
pieces like a potter's vessel.

2:10 Be wise now therefore, O you kings: be instructed, you judges of the
earth.

2:11 Serve the LORD[JESUS] with fear, and rejoice with trembling.

2:12 Kiss the SON[JESUS], lest HE[JESUS] be angry, and you perish from the way, when
HIS[JESUS] wrath is kindled but a little. Blessed are all they that put their
trust in HIM[JESUS].


3:1 LORD[JESUS], how are they increased that trouble me! many are they that
rise up against me.

3:2 Many there be which say of my soul, There is no help for HIM[JESUS] in GOD[JESUS].
Selah.

3:3 But you, O LORD[JESUS], art a shield for me; my glory, and the lifter up
of mine head.

3:4 I cried unto the LORD[JESUS] with my voice, and HE[JESUS] heard me out of HIS[JESUS] holy
hill. Selah.

3:5 I laid me down and slept; I awaked; for the LORD[JESUS] sustained me.

3:6 I will not be afraid of ten thousands of people, that have set
themselves against me round about.

3:7 Arise, O LORD[JESUS]; save me, O my GOD[JESUS]: for you hast smitten all mine
enemies upon the cheek bone; you hast broken the teeth of the ungodly.

3:8 Salvation belongeth unto the LORD[JESUS]: your blessing is upon your people.
Selah.


4:1 Hear me when I call, O GOD[JESUS] of my righteousness: you hast enlarged
me when I was in distress; have mercy upon me, and hear my prayer.

4:2 O you sons of men, how long will you turn my glory into shame? how
long will you love vanity, and seek after leasing? Selah.

4:3 But know that the LORD[JESUS] has set apart HIM[JESUS] that is godly for himself:
the LORD[JESUS] will hear when I call unto HIM[JESUS].

4:4 Stand in awe, and sin not: commune with your own heart upon your
bed, and be still. Selah.

4:5 Offer the sacrifices of righteousness, and put your trust in the
LORD[JESUS].

4:6 There be many that say, Who will shew us any good? LORD[JESUS], lift you
up the light of your countenance upon us.

4:7 you hast put gladness in my heart, more than in the time that their
corn and their wine increased.

4:8 I will both lay me down in peace, and sleep: for you, LORD[JESUS], only
makest me dwell in safety.


5:1 Give ear to my words, O LORD[JESUS], consider my meditation.

5:2 Hearken unto the voice of my cry, my KING[JESUS], and my GOD[JESUS]: for unto you
will I pray.

5:3 My voice shalt you hear in the morning, O LORD[JESUS]; in the morning will
I direct my prayer unto you, and will look up.

5:4 For you art not a GOD[JESUS] that has pleasure in wickedness: neither
shall evil dwell with you.

5:5 The foolish shall not stand in your sight: you hatest all workers of
iniquity.

5:6 you shalt destroy them that speak leasing: the LORD[JESUS] will abhor the
bloody and deceitful man.

5:7 But as for me, I will come into your house in the multitude of your
mercy: and in your fear will I worship toward your holy temple.

5:8 Lead me, O LORD[JESUS], in your righteousness because of mine enemies; make
your way straight before my face.

5:9 For there is no faithfulness in their mouth; their inward part is
very wickedness; their throat is an open sepulchre; they flatter with
their tongue.

5:10 Destroy you them, O GOD[JESUS]; let them fall by their own counsels; cast
them out in the multitude of their transgressions; for they have
rebelled against you.

5:11 But let all those that put their trust in you rejoice: let them
ever shout for joy, because you defendest them: let them also that love
your name be joyful in you.

5:12 For you, LORD[JESUS], wilt bless the righteous; with favour wilt you
compass HIM[JESUS] as with a shield.


6:1 O LORD[JESUS], rebuke me not in yours anger, neither chasten me in your hot
displeasure.

6:2 Have mercy upon me, O LORD[JESUS]; for I am weak: O LORD[JESUS], heal me; for my
bones are vexed.

6:3 My soul is also sore vexed: but you, O LORD[JESUS], how long?

6:4 Return, O LORD[JESUS], deliver my soul: oh save me for your mercies' sake.

6:5 For in death there is no remembrance of you: in the grave who shall
give you thanks?

6:6 I am weary with my groaning; all the night make I my bed to swim; I
water my couch with my tears.

6:7 Mine eye is consumed because of grief; it waxeth old because of all
mine enemies.

6:8 Depart from me, all you workers of iniquity; for the LORD[JESUS] has heard
the voice of my weeping.

6:9 The LORD[JESUS] has heard my supplication; the LORD[JESUS] will receive my
prayer.

6:10 Let all mine enemies be ashamed and sore vexed: let them return and
be ashamed suddenly.


7:1 O LORD[JESUS] my GOD[JESUS], in you do I put my trust: save me from all them that
persecute me, and deliver me:

7:2 Lest HE[JESUS] tear my soul like a lion, rending it in pieces, while there
is none to deliver.

7:3 O LORD[JESUS] my GOD[JESUS], If I have done this; if there be iniquity in my
hands;

7:4 If I have rewarded evil unto HIM[JESUS] that was at peace with me; (yea, I
have delivered HIM[JESUS] that without cause is mine enemy:)

7:5 Let the enemy persecute my soul, and take it; yea, let HIM[JESUS] tread
down my life upon the earth, and lay mine honour in the dust. Selah.

7:6 Arise, O LORD[JESUS], in yours anger, lift up thyself because of the rage
of mine enemies: and awake for me to the judgment that you hast
commanded.

7:7 So shall the congregation of the people compass you about: for
their sakes therefore return you on high.

7:8 The LORD[JESUS] shall judge the people: judge me, O LORD[JESUS], according to my
righteousness, and according to mine integrity that is in me.

7:9 Oh let the wickedness of the wicked come to an end; but establish
the just: for the righteous GOD[JESUS] trieth the hearts and reins.

7:10 My defence is of GOD[JESUS], which saveth the upright in heart.

7:11 GOD[JESUS] judgeth the righteous, and GOD[JESUS] is angry with the wicked every
day.

7:12 If HE[JESUS] turn not, HE[JESUS] will whet HIS[JESUS] sword; HE[JESUS] has bent HIS[JESUS] bow, and
made it ready.

7:13 HE[JESUS] has also prepared for HIM[JESUS] the instruments of death; HE[JESUS]
ordaineth HIS[JESUS] arrows against the persecutors.

7:14 Behold, HE[JESUS] travaileth with iniquity, and has conceived mischief,
and brought forth falsehood.

7:15 HE[JESUS] made a pit, and digged it, and is fallen into the ditch which HE[JESUS]
made.

7:16 HIS[JESUS] mischief shall return upon HIS[JESUS] own head, and HIS[JESUS] violent
dealing shall come down upon HIS[JESUS] own pate.

7:17 I will praise the LORD[JESUS] according to HIS[JESUS] righteousness: and will
sing praise to the name of the LORD[JESUS] most high.


8:1 O LORD[JESUS], our LORD[JESUS], how excellent is your name in all the earth! who
hast set your glory above the heavens.

8:2 Out of the mouth of babes and sucklings hast you ordained strength
because of yours enemies, that you mightest still the enemy and the
avenger.

8:3 When I consider your heavens, the work of your fingers, the moon and
the stars, which you hast ordained;

9:13 Have mercy upon me, O LORD[JESUS]; consider my trouble which I let of

which they hid is their own foot taken.

9:16 The LORD[JESUS] is known by the judgment which HE[JESUS] executeth: the wicked is

your sight.

9:20 Put them in fear, O LORD[JESUS]: that the nations may know themselves to
be but men. Selah.

times of trouble?

in the devices that they have imagined.

10:3 For the wicked boasteth of HIS[JESUS] heart's desire, and blesseth the

10:4 The wicked, through the pride of HIS[JESUS] countenance, will not seek
after GOD[JESUS]: GOD[JESUS] is not in all HIS[JESUS] thoughts.

10:5 HIS[JESUS] ways are always grievous; your judgments are far above out of
HIS[JESUS] sight: as for all HIS[JESUS] enemies, HE[JESUS] puffeth at them.

10:6 HE[JESUS] has said in HIS[JESUS] heart, I shall not be moved: for I shall never
be in adversity.

10:7 HIS[JESUS] mouth is full of cursing and deceit and fraud: under HIS[JESUS] tongue

10:8 HE[JESUS] sitteth in the lurking places of the villages: in the secret

10:9 HE[JESUS] lieth in wait secretly as a lion in HIS[JESUS] den: HE[JESUS] lieth in wait to

10:11 HE[JESUS] has said in HIS[JESUS] heart, GOD[JESUS] has forgotten: HE[JESUS] hideth HIS[JESUS] face;
HE[JESUS] will never see it.

10:12 Arise, O LORD[JESUS]; O GOD[JESUS], lift up yours hand: forget not the humble.

10:13 Wherefore does the wicked contemn GOD[JESUS]? HE[JESUS] has said in HIS[JESUS] heart,

10:14 you hast seen it; for you beholdest mischief and spite, to

10:15 Break you the arm of the wicked and the evil man: seek out HIS[JESUS]

10:16 The LORD[JESUS] is KING[JESUS] for ever and ever: the heathen are perished out
of HIS[JESUS] land.

to your mountain?

11:4 The LORD[JESUS] is in HIS[JESUS] holy temple, the LORD[JESUS]'s throne is in heaven: HIS[JESUS]

16:6 The lines are fallen unto me in pleasant places; yea, I have a

prayer, that goes not out of feigned lips.

17:2 Let my sentence come forth from your presence; let yours eyes behold
the things that are equal.

17:3 you hast proved mine heart; you hast visited me in the night;
you hast tried me, and shalt find nothing; I am purposed that my mouth
shall not transgress.

17:4 Concerning the works of men, by the WORD[JESUS] of your lips I have kept me
from the paths of the destroyer.

17:5 Hold up my goings in your paths, that my footsteps slip not.

17:6 I have called upon you, for you wilt hear me, O GOD[JESUS]: incline
yours ear unto me, and hear my speech.

17:7 Shew your marvellous lovingkindness, O you that savest by your right

17:8 Keep me as the apple of the eye, hide me under the shadow of your
wings,

17:9 From the wicked that oppress me, from my deadly enemies, who
compass me about.

17:10 They are inclosed in their own fat: with their mouth they speak
proudly.

17:11 They have now compassed us in our steps: they have set their eyes

17:12 Like as a lion that is greedy of HIS[JESUS] prey, and as it were a young
lion lurking in secret places.

17:13 Arise, O LORD[JESUS], disappoint HIM[JESUS], cast HIM[JESUS] down: deliver my soul from
the wicked, which is your sword:

17:14 From men which are your hand, O LORD[JESUS], from men of the world, which

substance to their babes.

satisfied, when I awake, with your likeness.

be saved from mine enemies.

18:4 The sorrows of death compassed me, and the floods of ungodly men

18:14 Yea, HE[JESUS] sent out HIS[JESUS] arrows, and scattered them; and HE[JESUS] shot out

18:16 HE[JESUS] sent from above, HE[JESUS] took me, HE[JESUS] drew me out of many waters.

18:17 HE[JESUS] delivered me from my strong enemy, and from them which hated
me: for they were too strong for me.

18:18 They prevented me in the day of my calamity: but the LORD[JESUS] was my
stay.

18:19 HE[JESUS] brought me forth also into a large place; HE[JESUS] delivered me,
because HE[JESUS] delighted in me.

18:20 The LORD[JESUS] rewarded me according to my righteousness; according to
the cleanness of my hands has HE[JESUS] recompensed me.

18:21 For I have kept the ways of the LORD[JESUS], and have not wickedly
departed from my GOD[JESUS].

18:22 For all HIS[JESUS] judgments were before me, and I did not put away HIS[JESUS]
statutes from me.

18:23 I was also upright before HIM[JESUS], and I kept myself from mine
iniquity.

18:24 Therefore has the LORD[JESUS] recompensed me according to my
righteousness, according to the cleanness of my hands in HIS[JESUS] eyesight.

18:25 With the merciful you wilt shew thyself merciful; with an upright
man you wilt shew thyself upright;

18:26 With the pure you wilt shew thyself pure; and with the froward
you wilt shew thyself froward.

18:27 For you wilt save the afflicted people; but wilt bring down high
looks.

18:28 For you wilt light my candle: the LORD[JESUS] my GOD[JESUS] will enlighten my
darkness.

18:29 For by you I have run through a troop; and by my GOD[JESUS] have I
leaped over a wall.

18:30 As for GOD[JESUS], HIS[JESUS] way is perfect: the WORD[JESUS] of the LORD[JESUS] is tried: HE[JESUS]
is a buckler to all those that trust in HIM[JESUS].

18:31 For who is GOD[JESUS] save the LORD[JESUS]? or who is a rock save our GOD[JESUS]?

18:32 It is GOD[JESUS] that girdeth me with strength, and makes my way
perfect.

18:33 HE[JESUS] makes my feet like hinds' feet, and setteth me upon my high
places.

18:34 HE[JESUS] teacheth my hands to war, so that a bow of steel is broken by
mine arms.

18:35 you hast also given me the shield of your salvation: and your right
hand has holden me up, and your gentleness has made me great.

18:36 you hast enlarged my steps under me, that my feet did not slip.

18:37 I have pursued mine enemies, and overtaken them: neither did I
turn again till they were consumed.

18:38 I have wounded them that they were not able to rise: they are
fallen under my feet.

18:39 For you hast girded me with strength unto the battle: you hast
subdued under me those that rose up against me.

18:40 you hast also given me the necks of mine enemies; that I might
destroy them that hate me.

18:41 They cried, but there was none to save them: even unto the LORD[JESUS],
but HE[JESUS] answered them not.

18:42 Then did I beat them small as the dust before the wind: I did cast
them out as the dirt in the streets.

18:43 you hast delivered me from the strivings of the people; and you
hast made me the head of the heathen: a people whom I have not known
shall serve me.

18:44 As soon as they hear of me, they shall obey me: the strangers
shall submit themselves unto me.

18:45 The strangers shall fade away, and be afraid out of their close
places.

18:46 The LORD[JESUS] liveth; and blessed be my rock; and let the GOD[JESUS] of my
salvation be exalted.

18:47 It is GOD[JESUS] that avengeth me, and subdueth the people under me.

18:48 HE[JESUS] delivereth me from mine enemies: yea, you liftest me up above
those that rise up against me: you hast delivered me from the violent

18:49 Therefore will I give thanks unto you, O LORD[JESUS], among the heathen,

anointed, to David, and to HIS[JESUS] SEED[JESUS] for evermore.

22:1 My GOD[JESUS], my GOD[JESUS], why hast you forsaken me? why art you so far from
helping me, and from the words of my roaring?

22:2 O my GOD[JESUS], I cry in the day time, but you hearest not; and in the
night season, and am not silent.

22:3 But you art holy, O you that inhabitest the praises of Israel.

22:4 Our fathers trusted in you: they trusted, and you didst deliver
them.

22:5 They cried unto you, and were delivered: they trusted in you, and
were not confounded.

22:6 But I am a worm, and no man; a reproach of men, and despised of the
people.

22:7 All they that see me laugh me to scorn: they shoot out the lip,
they shake the head, saying,

22:8 HE[JESUS] trusted on the LORD[JESUS] that HE[JESUS] would deliver HIM[JESUS]: let HIM[JESUS] deliver
HIM[JESUS], seeing HE[JESUS] delighted in HIM[JESUS].

22:9 But you art HE[JESUS] that took me out of the womb: you didst make me
hope when I was upon my mother's breasts.

22:10 I was cast upon you from the womb: you art my GOD[JESUS] from my
mother's belly.

22:11 Be not far from me; for trouble is near; for there is none to
help.

22:12 Many bulls have compassed me: strong bulls of Bashan have beset me
round.

22:13 They gaped upon me with their mouths, as a ravening and a roaring
lion.

22:14 I am poured out like water, and all my bones are out of joint: my
heart is like wax; it is melted in the midst of my bowels.

22:15 My strength is dried up like a potsherd; and my tongue cleaveth to
my jaws; and you hast brought me into the dust of death.

22:16 For dogs have compassed me: the assembly of the wicked have
inclosed me: they pierced my hands and my feet.

22:17 I may tell all my bones: they look and stare upon me.

22:18 They part my garments among them, and cast lots upon my vesture.

22:19 But be not you far from me, O LORD[JESUS]: O my strength, haste you to
help me.

22:20 Deliver my soul from the sword; my darling from the power of the
dog.

22:21 Save me from the lion's mouth: for you hast heard me from the
horns of the unicorns.

22:22 I will declare your name unto my brethren: in the midst of the
congregation will I praise you.

22:23 you that fear the LORD[JESUS], praise HIM[JESUS]; all you the SEED[JESUS] of Jacob,
glorify HIM[JESUS]; and fear HIM[JESUS], all you the SEED[JESUS] of Israel.

22:24 For HE[JESUS] has not despised nor abhorred the affliction of the
afflicted; neither has HE[JESUS] hid HIS[JESUS] face from HIM[JESUS]; but when HE[JESUS] cried unto
HIM[JESUS], HE[JESUS] heard.

22:25 My praise shall be of you in the great congregation: I will pay
my vows before them that fear HIM[JESUS].

22:26 The meek shall eat and be satisfied: they shall praise the LORD[JESUS]
that seek HIM[JESUS]: your heart shall live for ever.

22:27 All the ends of the world shall remember and turn unto the LORD[JESUS]:
and all the kindreds of the nations shall worship before you.

22:28 For the kingdom is the LORD[JESUS]'s: and HE[JESUS] is the governor among the
nations.

22:29 All they that be fat upon earth shall eat and worship: all they

that shall be born, that HE[JESUS] has done this.


23:1 The LORD[JESUS] is my SHEPHERD[JESUS]; I shall not want.

the still waters.

23:3 HE[JESUS] restores my soul: HE[JESUS] leads me in the paths of righteousness
for HIS[JESUS] name's sake.

23:4 Yea, though I walk through the valley of the shadow of death, I
will fear no evil: for you art with me; your rod and your staff they
comfort me.

23:5 you preparest a table before me in the presence of mine enemies:
you anointest my head with oil; my cup runneth over.

23:6 Surely goodness and mercy shall follow me all the days of my life:
and I will dwell in the house of the LORD[JESUS] for ever.

24:4 HE[JESUS] that has clean hands, and a pure heart; who has not lifted up
HIS[JESUS] soul unto vanity, nor sworn deceitfully.

24:5 HE[JESUS] shall receive the blessing from the LORD[JESUS], and righteousness from

25:1 Unto you, O LORD[JESUS], do I lift up my soul.

enemies triumph over me.

25:3 Yea, let none that wait on you be ashamed: let them be ashamed
which transgress without cause.

25:4 Shew me your ways, O LORD[JESUS]; teach me your paths.

25:5 Lead me in your truth, and teach me: for you art the GOD[JESUS] of my
salvation; on you do I wait all the day.

25:6 Remember, O LORD[JESUS], your tender mercies and your lovingkindnesses; for
they have been ever of old.

25:7 Remember not the sins of my youth, nor my transgressions: according
to your mercy remember you me for your goodness' sake, O LORD[JESUS].

25:8 Good and upright is the LORD[JESUS]: therefore will HE[JESUS] teach sinners in
the way.

25:9 The meek will HE[JESUS] guide in judgment: and the meek will HE[JESUS] teach HIS[JESUS]
way.

25:10 All the paths of the LORD[JESUS] are mercy and truth unto such as keep
HIS[JESUS] covenant and HIS[JESUS] testimonies.

25:11 For your name's sake, O LORD[JESUS], pardon mine iniquity; for it is
great.

25:12 What man is HE[JESUS] that feareth the LORD[JESUS]? HIM[JESUS] shall HE[JESUS] teach in the
way that HE[JESUS] shall choose.

25:13 HIS[JESUS] soul shall dwell at ease; and HIS[JESUS] SEED[JESUS] shall inherit the

25:14 The secret of the LORD[JESUS] is with them that fear HIM[JESUS]; and HE[JESUS] will
shew them HIS[JESUS] covenant.

25:15 Mine eyes are ever toward the LORD[JESUS]; for HE[JESUS] shall pluck my feet out
of the net.

25:16 Turn you unto me, and have mercy upon me; for I am desolate and
afflicted.

25:17 The troubles of my heart are enlarged: O bring you me out of my
distresses.

25:18 Look upon mine affliction and my pain; and forgive all my sins.

25:19 Consider mine enemies; for they are many; and they hate me with
cruel hatred.

25:20 O keep my soul, and deliver me: let me not be ashamed; for I put

25:21 Let integrity and uprightness preserve me; for I wait on you.

trusted also in the LORD[JESUS]; therefore I shall not slide.

26:2 Examine me, O LORD[JESUS], and prove me; try my reins and my heart.

26:3 For your lovingkindness is before mine eyes: and I have walked in
your truth.

26:4 I have not sat with vain persons, neither will I go in with

26:5 I have hated the congregation of evil doers; and will not sit with
the wicked.

26:6 I will wash mine hands in innocency: so will I compass yours altar,

26:7 That I may publish with the voice of thanksgiving, and tell of all
your wondrous works.

26:8 LORD[JESUS], I have loved the habitation of your house, and the place where

26:9 Gather not my soul with sinners, nor my life with bloody men:

27:1 The LORD[JESUS] is my light and my salvation; whom shall I fear? the LORD[JESUS]
is the strength of my life; of whom shall I be afraid?

27:2 When the wicked, even mine enemies and my foes, came upon me to eat
up my flesh, they stumbled and fell.

27:3 Though an host should encamp against me, my heart shall not fear:
though war should rise against me, in this will I be confident.

27:4 One thing have I desired of the LORD[JESUS], that will I seek after; that
I may dwell in the house of the LORD[JESUS] all the days of my life, to behold
the beauty of the LORD[JESUS], and to enquire in HIS[JESUS] temple.

27:5 For in the time of trouble HE[JESUS] shall hide me in HIS[JESUS] pavilion: in the
secret of HIS[JESUS] tabernacle shall HE[JESUS] hide me; HE[JESUS] shall set me up upon a
rock.

27:6 And now shall mine head be lifted up above mine enemies round about

27:7 Hear, O LORD[JESUS], when I cry with my voice: have mercy also upon me,
and answer me.

27:8 When you saidst, Seek you my face; my heart said unto you, your
face, LORD[JESUS], will I seek.

27:9 Hide not your face far from me; put not your SERVANT[JESUS] away in anger:

27:10 When my father and my mother forsake me, then the LORD[JESUS] will take

27:11 Teach me your way, O LORD[JESUS], and lead me in a plain path, because of
mine enemies.

27:12 Deliver me not over unto the will of mine enemies: for false

27:13 I had fainted, unless I had believed to see the goodness of the
LORD[JESUS] in the land of the living.

27:14 Wait on the LORD[JESUS]: be of good courage, and HE[JESUS] shall strengthen
yours heart: wait, I say, on the LORD[JESUS].


28:1 Unto you will I cry, O LORD[JESUS] my rock; be not silent to me: lest, if

lift up my hands toward your holy oracle.

28:3 Draw me not away with the wicked, and with the workers of iniquity,
which speak peace to their neighbours, but mischief is in their hearts.

28:4 Give them according to their deeds, and according to the wickedness
of their endeavours: give them after the work of their hands; render to

28:5 Because they regard not the works of the LORD[JESUS], nor the operation of
HIS[JESUS] hands, HE[JESUS] shall destroy them, and not build them up.

28:6 Blessed be the LORD[JESUS], because HE[JESUS] has heard the voice of my
supplications.

28:7 The LORD[JESUS] is my strength and my shield; my heart trusted in HIM[JESUS], and

28:8 The LORD[JESUS] is their strength, and HE[JESUS] is the saving strength of HIS[JESUS]
anointed.

28:9 Save your people, and bless yours inheritance: feed them also, and

made my foes to rejoice over me.

me alive, that I should not go down to the pit.

30:4 Sing unto the LORD[JESUS], O you saints of HIS[JESUS], and give thanks at the
remembrance of HIS[JESUS] holiness.

30:5 For HIS[JESUS] anger endureth but a moment; in HIS[JESUS] favour is life: weeping
may endure for a night, but joy comes in the morning.

30:6 And in my prosperity I said, I shall never be moved.

30:7 LORD[JESUS], by your favour you hast made my mountain to stand strong:
you didst hide your face, and I was troubled.

31:1 In you, O LORD[JESUS], do I put my trust; let me never be ashamed:
deliver me in your righteousness.

31:2 Bow down yours ear to me; deliver me speedily: be you my strong
rock, for an house of defence to save me.

31:3 For you art my rock and my fortress; therefore for your name's sake
lead me, and guide me.

31:4 Pull me out of the net that they have laid privily for me: for you
art my strength.

31:5 Into yours hand I commit my spirit: you hast redeemed me, O LORD[JESUS]
GOD[JESUS] of truth.

31:6 I have hated them that regard lying vanities: but I trust in the
LORD[JESUS].

31:7 I will be glad and rejoice in your mercy: for you hast considered
my trouble; you hast known my soul in adversities;

31:8 And hast not shut me up into the hand of the enemy: you hast set
my feet in a large room.

31:9 Have mercy upon me, O LORD[JESUS], for I am in trouble: mine eye is
consumed with grief, yea, my soul and my belly.

31:10 For my life is spent with grief, and my years with sighing: my
strength faileth because of mine iniquity, and my bones are consumed.

31:11 I was a reproach among all mine enemies, but especially among my
neighbours, and a fear to mine acquaintance: they that did see me
without fled from me.

31:12 I am forgotten as a dead man out of mind: I am like a broken
vessel.

31:13 For I have heard the slander of many: fear was on every side:
while they took counsel together against me, they devised to take away
my life.

31:14 But I trusted in you, O LORD[JESUS]: I said, you art my GOD[JESUS].

31:15 My times are in your hand: deliver me from the hand of mine
enemies, and from them that persecute me.

31:16 Make your face to shine upon your SERVANT[JESUS]: save me for your mercies'
sake.

31:17 Let me not be ashamed, O LORD[JESUS]; for I have called upon you: let
the wicked be ashamed, and let them be silent in the grave.

31:18 Let the lying lips be put to silence; which speak grievous things
proudly and contemptuously against the righteous.

31:19 Oh how great is your goodness, which you hast laid up for them
that fear you; which you hast wrought for them that trust in you
before the sons of men!

31:20 you shalt hide them in the secret of your presence from the pride
of man: you shalt keep them secretly in a pavilion from the strife of
tongues.

31:21 Blessed be the LORD[JESUS]: for HE[JESUS] has shewed me HIS[JESUS] marvellous kindness
in a strong city.

31:22 For I said in my haste, I am cut off from before yours eyes:
nevertheless you heardest the voice of my supplications when I cried
unto you.

31:23 O love the LORD[JESUS], all you HIS[JESUS] saints: for the LORD[JESUS] preserveth the
faithful, and plentifully rewardeth the proud doer.

31:24 Be of good courage, and HE[JESUS] shall strengthen your heart, all you
that hope in the LORD[JESUS].


32:1 Blessed is HE[JESUS] whose transgression is forgiven, whose sin is
covered.

32:2 Blessed is the man unto whom the LORD[JESUS] imputeth not iniquity, and in
whose spirit there is no guile.

32:3 When I kept silence, my bones waxed old through my roaring all the
day long.

32:4 For day and night your hand was heavy upon me: my moisture is turned
into the drought of summer. Selah.

32:5 I acknowledge my sin unto you, and mine iniquity have I not hid. I
said, I will confess my transgressions unto the LORD[JESUS]; and you forgavest
the iniquity of my sin. Selah.

32:6 For this shall every one that is godly pray unto you in a time
when you mayest be found: surely in the floods of great waters they

32:7 you art my hiding place; you shalt preserve me from trouble; you
shalt compass me about with songs of deliverance. Selah.

32:8 I will instruct you and teach you in the way which you shalt go:
I will guide you with mine eye.

32:9 Be you not as the horse, or as the mule, which have no
understanding: whose mouth must be held in with bit and bridle, lest
they come near unto you.

32:10 Many sorrows shall be to the wicked: but HE[JESUS] that trusteth in the
LORD[JESUS], mercy shall compass HIM[JESUS] about.

32:11 Be glad in the LORD[JESUS], and rejoice, you righteous: and shout for joy,

33:4 For the WORD[JESUS] of the LORD[JESUS] is right; and all HIS[JESUS] works are done in
truth.

33:5 HE[JESUS] loveth righteousness and judgment: the earth is full of the

33:6 By the WORD[JESUS] of the LORD[JESUS] were the heavens made; and all the host of

33:7 HE[JESUS] gathereth the waters of the sea together as an heap: HE[JESUS] layeth

HE[JESUS] has chosen for HIS[JESUS] own inheritance.

33:13 The LORD[JESUS] looketh from heaven; HE[JESUS] beholdeth all the sons of men.

33:14 From the place of HIS[JESUS] habitation HE[JESUS] looketh upon all the

33:15 HE[JESUS] fashioneth their hearts alike; HE[JESUS] considereth all their works.

33:16 There is no KING[JESUS] saved by the multitude of an host: a mighty man
is not delivered by much strength.

33:17 An horse is a vain thing for safety: neither shall HE[JESUS] deliver any

33:18 Behold, the eye of the LORD[JESUS] is upon them that fear HIM[JESUS], upon them
that hope in HIS[JESUS] mercy;

33:19 To deliver their soul from death, and to keep them alive in
famine.

33:20 Our soul waiteth for the LORD[JESUS]: HE[JESUS] is our help and our shield.

33:21 For our heart shall rejoice in HIM[JESUS], because we have trusted in HIS[JESUS]
holy name.

33:22 Let your mercy, O LORD[JESUS], be upon us, according as we hope in you.

in my mouth.

thereof, and be glad.

34:3 O magnify the LORD[JESUS] with me, and let us exalt HIS[JESUS] name together.

34:4 I sought the LORD[JESUS], and HE[JESUS] heard me, and delivered me from all my
fears.

34:5 They looked unto HIM[JESUS], and were lightened: and their faces were not
ashamed.

34:6 This poor man cried, and the LORD[JESUS] heard HIM[JESUS], and saved HIM[JESUS] out of
all HIS[JESUS] troubles.

34:7 The angel of the LORD[JESUS] encampeth round about them that fear HIM[JESUS], and
delivereth them.

34:8 O taste and see that the LORD[JESUS] is good: blessed is the man that
trusteth in HIM[JESUS].

34:9 O fear the LORD[JESUS], you HIS[JESUS] saints: for there is no want to them that
fear HIM[JESUS].

34:10 The young lions do lack, and let hunger: but they that seek the

34:11 Come, you children, hearken unto me: I will teach you the fear of

34:12 What man is HE[JESUS] that desireth life, and loveth many days, that HE[JESUS]
may see good?

34:13 Keep your tongue from evil, and your lips from speaking guile.

34:15 The eyes of the LORD[JESUS] are upon the righteous, and HIS[JESUS] ears are open

34:16 The face of the LORD[JESUS] is against them that do evil, to cut off the

34:17 The righteous cry, and the LORD[JESUS] heareth, and delivereth them out

34:18 The LORD[JESUS] is nigh unto them that are of a broken heart; and saveth

34:19 Many are the afflictions of the righteous: but the LORD[JESUS] delivereth
HIM[JESUS] out of them all.

34:20 HE[JESUS] keepeth all HIS[JESUS] bones: not one of them is broken.

34:21 Evil shall slay the wicked: and they that hate the righteous shall

34:22 The LORD[JESUS] redeemeth the soul of HIS[JESUS] servants: and none of them that
trust in HIM[JESUS] shall be desolate.


35:1 Plead my cause, O LORD[JESUS], with them that strive with me: fight
against them that fight against me.

35:2 Take hold of shield and buckler, and stand up for mine help.

35:3 Draw out also the spear, and stop the way against them that
persecute me: say unto my soul, I am your salvation.

35:4 Let them be confounded and put to shame that seek after my soul:
let them be turned back and brought to confusion that devise my hurt.

35:5 Let them be as chaff before the wind: and let the angel of the LORD[JESUS]
chase them.

35:6 Let their way be dark and slippery: and let the angel of the LORD[JESUS]
persecute them.

35:7 For without cause have they hid for me their net in a pit, which
without cause they have digged for my soul.

35:8 Let destruction come upon HIM[JESUS] at unawares; and let HIS[JESUS] net that HE[JESUS]
has hid catch himself: into that very destruction let HIM[JESUS] fall.

35:9 And my soul shall be joyful in the LORD[JESUS]: it shall rejoice in HIS[JESUS]
salvation.

35:10 All my bones shall say, LORD[JESUS], who is like unto you, which
deliverest the poor from HIM[JESUS] that is too strong for HIM[JESUS], yea, the poor
and the needy from HIM[JESUS] that spoileth HIM[JESUS]?

35:11 False witnesses did rise up; they laid to my charge things that I
knew not.

35:12 They rewarded me evil for good to the spoiling of my soul.

35:13 But as for me, when they were sick, my clothing was sackcloth: I
humbled my soul with fasting; and my prayer returned into mine own
bosom.

35:14 I behaved myself as though HE[JESUS] had been my friend or brother: I
bowed down heavily, as one that mourneth for HIS[JESUS] mother.

35:15 But in mine adversity they rejoiced, and gathered themselves
together: yea, the abjects gathered themselves together against me, and
I knew it not; they did tear me, and ceased not:

35:16 With hypocritical mockers in feasts, they gnashed upon me with
their teeth.

35:17 LORD[JESUS], how long wilt you look on? rescue my soul from their
destructions, my darling from the lions.

35:18 I will give you thanks in the great congregation: I will praise
you among much people.

35:19 Let not them that are mine enemies wrongfully rejoice over me:
neither let them wink with the eye that hate me without a cause.

35:20 For they speak not peace: but they devise deceitful matters
against them that are quiet in the land.

35:21 Yea, they opened their mouth wide against me, and said, Aha, aha,
our eye has seen it.

35:22 This you hast seen, O LORD[JESUS]: keep not silence: O LORD[JESUS], be not far
from me.

35:23 Stir up thyself, and awake to my judgment, even unto my cause, my
GOD[JESUS] and my LORD[JESUS].

35:24 Judge me, O LORD[JESUS] my GOD[JESUS], according to your righteousness; and let
them not rejoice over me.

35:25 Let them not say in their hearts, Ah, so would we have it: let
them not say, We have swallowed HIM[JESUS] up.

35:26 Let them be ashamed and brought to confusion together that rejoice
at mine hurt: let them be clothed with shame and dishonour that magnify
themselves against me.

35:27 Let them shout for joy, and be glad, that favour my righteous
cause: yea, let them say continually, Let the LORD[JESUS] be magnified, which
has pleasure in the prosperity of HIS[JESUS] SERVANT[JESUS].

35:28 And my tongue shall speak of your righteousness and of your praise
all the day long.

is no fear of GOD[JESUS] before HIS[JESUS] eyes.

36:2 For HE[JESUS] flattereth himself in HIS[JESUS] own eyes, until HIS[JESUS] iniquity be
found to be hateful.

36:3 The words of HIS[JESUS] mouth are iniquity and deceit: HE[JESUS] has left off to
be wise, and to do good.

36:4 HE[JESUS] deviseth mischief upon HIS[JESUS] bed; HE[JESUS] setteth himself in a way that
is not good; HE[JESUS] abhorreth not evil.

36:5 your mercy, O LORD[JESUS], is in the heavens; and your faithfulness reacheth
unto the clouds.

36:6 your righteousness is like the great mountains; your judgments are a
great deep: O LORD[JESUS], you preservest man and beast.

36:7 How excellent is your lovingkindness, O GOD[JESUS]! therefore the children
of men put their trust under the shadow of your wings.

36:8 They shall be abundantly satisfied with the fatness of your house;
and you shalt make them drink of the river of your pleasures.

36:9 For with you is the fountain of life: in your light shall we see
light.

36:10 O continue your lovingkindness unto them that know you; and your
righteousness to the upright in heart.

36:11 Let not the foot of pride come against me, and let not the hand of
the wicked remove me.

36:12 There are the workers of iniquity fallen: they are cast down, and
shall not be able to rise.


37:1 Fret not thyself because of evildoers, neither be you envious
against the workers of iniquity.

37:2 For they shall soon be cut down like the grass, and wither as the
green herb.

37:3 Trust in the LORD[JESUS], and do good; so shalt you dwell in the land,
and truly you shalt be fed.

37:4 Delight thyself also in the LORD[JESUS]: and HE[JESUS] shall give you the
desires of yours heart.

37:5 Commit your way unto the LORD[JESUS]; trust also in HIM[JESUS]; and HE[JESUS] shall bring
it to pass.

37:6 And HE[JESUS] shall bring forth your righteousness as the light, and your
judgment as the noonday.

37:7 Rest in the LORD[JESUS], and wait patiently for HIM[JESUS]: fret not thyself
because of HIM[JESUS] who prospereth in HIS[JESUS] way, because of the man who
bringeth wicked devices to pass.

37:8 Cease from anger, and forsake wrath: fret not thyself in any wise
to do evil.

37:9 For evildoers shall be cut off: but those that wait upon the LORD[JESUS],
they shall inherit the earth.

37:10 For yet a little while, and the wicked shall not be: yea, you
shalt diligently consider HIS[JESUS] place, and it shall not be.

37:11 But the meek shall inherit the earth; and shall delight themselves
in the abundance of peace.

37:12 The wicked plotteth against the just, and gnasheth upon HIM[JESUS] with
HIS[JESUS] teeth.

37:13 The LORD[JESUS] shall laugh at HIM[JESUS]: for HE[JESUS] seeth that HIS[JESUS] day is coming.

37:14 The wicked have drawn out the sword, and have bent their bow, to
cast down the poor and needy, and to slay such as be of upright
conduct.

37:15 Their sword shall enter into their own heart, and their bows shall
be broken.

37:16 A little that a righteous man has is better than the riches of
many wicked.

37:17 For the arms of the wicked shall be broken: but the LORD[JESUS] upholdeth
the righteous.

37:18 The LORD[JESUS] knoweth the days of the upright: and their inheritance
shall be for ever.

37:19 They shall not be ashamed in the evil time: and in the days of
famine they shall be satisfied.

37:20 But the wicked shall perish, and the enemies of the LORD[JESUS] shall be
as the fat of lambs: they shall consume; into smoke shall they consume
away.

37:21 The wicked borroweth, and payeth not again: but the righteous
sheweth mercy, and giveth.

37:22 For such as be blessed of HIM[JESUS] shall inherit the earth; and they
that be cursed of HIM[JESUS] shall be cut off.

37:23 The steps of a good man are ordered by the LORD[JESUS]: and HE[JESUS] delighteth
in HIS[JESUS] way.

37:24 Though HE[JESUS] fall, HE[JESUS] shall not be utterly cast down: for the LORD[JESUS]
upholdeth HIM[JESUS] with HIS[JESUS] hand.

37:25 I have been young, and now am old; yet have I not seen the
righteous forsaken, nor HIS[JESUS] SEED[JESUS] begging bread.

37:26 HE[JESUS] is ever merciful, and lendeth; and HIS[JESUS] SEED[JESUS] is blessed.

37:27 Depart from evil, and do good; and dwell for evermore.

37:28 For the LORD[JESUS] loveth judgment, and forsaketh not HIS[JESUS] saints; they
are preserved for ever: but the SEED[JESUS] of the wicked shall be cut off.

37:29 The righteous shall inherit the land, and dwell therein for ever.

37:30 The mouth of the righteous speaketh wisdom, and HIS[JESUS] tongue talketh
of judgment.

37:31 The law of HIS[JESUS] GOD[JESUS] is in HIS[JESUS] heart; none of HIS[JESUS] steps shall slide.

37:32 The wicked watcheth the righteous, and seeketh to slay HIM[JESUS].

37:33 The LORD[JESUS] will not leave HIM[JESUS] in HIS[JESUS] hand, nor condemn HIM[JESUS] when HE[JESUS]
is judged.

37:34 Wait on the LORD[JESUS], and keep HIS[JESUS] way, and HE[JESUS] shall exalt you to
inherit the land: when the wicked are cut off, you shalt see it.

37:35 I have seen the wicked in great power, and spreading himself like
a green bay tree.

37:36 Yet HE[JESUS] passed away, and, lo, HE[JESUS] was not: yea, I sought HIM[JESUS], but HE[JESUS]
could not be found.

37:37 Mark the perfect man, and behold the upright: for the end of that
man is peace.

37:38 But the transgressors shall be destroyed together: the end of the
wicked shall be cut off.

37:39 But the salvation of the righteous is of the LORD[JESUS]: HE[JESUS] is their
strength in the time of trouble.

37:40 And the LORD[JESUS] shall help them, and deliver them: HE[JESUS] shall deliver
them from the wicked, and save them, because they trust in HIM[JESUS].


38:1 O LORD[JESUS], rebuke me not in your wrath: neither chasten me in your hot
displeasure.

38:2 For yours arrows stick fast in me, and your hand presseth me sore.

38:3 There is no soundness in my flesh because of yours anger; neither
is there any rest in my bones because of my sin.

38:4 For mine iniquities are gone over mine head: as an heavy burden
they are too heavy for me.

38:5 My wounds stink and are corrupt because of my foolishness.

38:6 I am troubled; I am bowed down greatly; I go mourning all the day
long.

38:7 For my loins are filled with a loathsome disease: and there is no
soundness in my flesh.

38:8 I am feeble and sore broken: I have roared by reason of the
disquietness of my heart.

38:9 LORD[JESUS], all my desire is before you; and my groaning is not hid from
you.

38:10 My heart panteth, my strength faileth me: as for the light of mine
eyes, it also is gone from me.

38:11 My lovers and my friends stand aloof from my sore; and my kinsmen
stand afar off.

38:12 They also that seek after my life lay snares for me: and they that
seek my hurt speak mischievous things, and imagine deceits all the day
long.

38:13 But I, as a deaf man, heard not; and I was as a dumb man that
openeth not HIS[JESUS] mouth.

38:14 Thus I was as a man that heareth not, and in whose mouth are no
reproofs.

38:15 For in you, O LORD[JESUS], do I hope: you wilt hear, O LORD[JESUS] my GOD[JESUS].

38:16 For I said, Hear me, lest otherwise they should rejoice over me:
when my foot slippeth, they magnify themselves against me.

38:17 For I am ready to halt, and my sorrow is continually before me.

38:18 For I will declare mine iniquity; I will be sorry for my sin.

38:19 But mine enemies are lively, and they are strong: and they that
hate me wrongfully are multiplied.

38:20 They also that render evil for good are mine adversaries; because
I follow the thing that good is.

38:21 Forsake me not, O LORD[JESUS]: O my GOD[JESUS], be not far from me.

38:22 Make haste to help me, O LORD[JESUS] my salvation.


39:1 I said, I will take heed to my ways, that I sin not with my tongue:
I will keep my mouth with a bridle, while the wicked is before me.

39:2 I was dumb with silence, I held my peace, even from good; and my
sorrow was stirred.

39:3 My heart was hot within me, while I was musing the fire burned:
then spake I with my tongue,

39:4 LORD[JESUS], make me to know mine end, and the measure of my days, what it
is: that I may know how frail I am.

39:5 Behold, you hast made my days as an handbreadth; and mine age is
as nothing before you: truly every man at HIS[JESUS] best state is altogether
vanity. Selah.

39:6 Surely every man walketh in a vain shew: surely they are disquieted
in vain: HE[JESUS] heapeth up riches, and knoweth not who shall gather them.

39:7 And now, LORD[JESUS], what wait I for? my hope is in you.

39:8 Deliver me from all my transgressions: make me not the reproach of
the foolish.

39:9 I was dumb, I opened not my mouth; because you didst it.

39:10 Remove your stroke away from me: I am consumed by the blow of yours
hand.

39:11 When you with rebukes dost correct man for iniquity, you makest
HIS[JESUS] beauty to consume away like a moth: surely every man is vanity.
Selah.

39:12 Hear my prayer, O LORD[JESUS], and give ear unto my cry; hold not your
peace at my tears: for I am a stranger with you, and a sojourner, as
all my fathers were.

39:13 O spare me, that I may recover strength, before I go hence, and be
no more.


40:1 I waited patiently for the LORD[JESUS]; and HE[JESUS] inclined unto me, and heard
my cry.

40:2 HE[JESUS] brought me up also out of an horrible pit, out of the miry clay,
and set my feet upon a rock, and established my goings.

40:3 And HE[JESUS] has put a new song in my mouth, even praise unto our GOD[JESUS]:
many shall see it, and fear, and shall trust in the LORD[JESUS].

40:4 Blessed is that man that makes the LORD[JESUS] HIS[JESUS] trust, and respecteth
not the proud, nor such as turn aside to lies.

40:5 Many, O LORD[JESUS] my GOD[JESUS], are your WONDERFUL[JESUS] works which you hast done,
and your thoughts which are to us-ward: they cannot be reckoned up in
order unto you: if I would declare and speak of them, they are more
than can be numbered.

40:6 Sacrifice and offering you didst not desire; mine ears hast you
opened: burnt offering and sin offering hast you not required.

40:7 Then said I, Lo, I come: in the volume of the book it is written of
me,

40:8 I delight to do your will, O my GOD[JESUS]: yea, your law is within my
heart.

40:9 I have preached righteousness in the great congregation: lo, I have
not refrained my lips, O LORD[JESUS], you knowest.

40:10 I have not hid your righteousness within my heart; I have declared
your faithfulness and your salvation: I have not concealed your
lovingkindness and your truth from the great congregation.

40:11 Withhold not you your tender mercies from me, O LORD[JESUS]: let your
lovingkindness and your truth continually preserve me.

40:12 For innumerable evils have compassed me about: mine iniquities
have taken hold upon me, so that I am not able to look up; they are more
than the hairs of mine head: therefore my heart faileth me.

40:13 Be pleased, O LORD[JESUS], to deliver me: O LORD[JESUS], make haste to help me.

40:14 Let them be ashamed and confounded together that seek after my
soul to destroy it; let them be driven backward and put to shame that
wish me evil.

40:15 Let them be desolate for a reward of their shame that say unto me,
Aha, aha.

40:16 Let all those that seek you rejoice and be glad in you: let such
as love your salvation say continually, The LORD[JESUS] be magnified.

40:17 But I am poor and needy; yet the LORD[JESUS] thinketh upon me: you art
my help and my deliverer; make no tarrying, O my GOD[JESUS].


41:1 Blessed is HE[JESUS] that considereth the poor: the LORD[JESUS] will deliver HIM[JESUS]
in time of trouble.

41:2 The LORD[JESUS] will preserve HIM[JESUS], and keep HIM[JESUS] alive; and HE[JESUS] shall be
blessed upon the earth: and you wilt not deliver HIM[JESUS] unto the will of
HIS[JESUS] enemies.

41:3 The LORD[JESUS] will strengthen HIM[JESUS] upon the bed of languishing: you wilt
make all HIS[JESUS] bed in HIS[JESUS] sickness.

41:4 I said, LORD[JESUS], be merciful unto me: heal my soul; for I have sinned
against you.

41:5 Mine enemies speak evil of me, When shall HE[JESUS] die, and HIS[JESUS] name
perish?

41:6 And if HE[JESUS] come to see me, HE[JESUS] speaketh vanity: HIS[JESUS] heart gathereth
iniquity to itself; when HE[JESUS] goes abroad, HE[JESUS] telleth it.

41:7 All that hate me whisper together against me: against me do they
devise my hurt.

41:8 An evil disease, say they, cleaveth fast unto HIM[JESUS]: and now that HE[JESUS]
lieth HE[JESUS] shall rise up no more.

41:9 Yea, mine own familiar friend, in whom I trusted, which did eat of
my bread, has lifted up HIS[JESUS] heel against me.

41:10 But you, O LORD[JESUS], be merciful unto me, and raise me up, that I may
requite them.

41:11 By this I know that you favourest me, because mine enemy does not
triumph over me.

41:12 And as for me, you upholdest me in mine integrity, and settest me
before your face for ever.

41:13 Blessed be the LORD[JESUS] GOD[JESUS] of Israel from everlasting, and to
everlasting. Amen, and Amen.


42:1 As the hart panteth after the water brooks, so panteth my soul
after you, O GOD[JESUS].

42:2 My soul thirsteth for GOD[JESUS], for the living GOD[JESUS]: when shall I come
and appear before GOD[JESUS]?

42:3 My tears have been my meat day and night, while they continually
say unto me, Where is your GOD[JESUS]?

42:4 When I remember these things, I pour out my soul in me: for I had
gone with the multitude, I went with them to the house of GOD[JESUS], with the
voice of joy and praise, with a multitude that kept holyday.

42:5 Why art you cast down, O my soul? and why art you disquieted in
me? hope you in GOD[JESUS]: for I shall yet praise HIM[JESUS] for the help of HIS[JESUS]
countenance.

42:6 O my GOD[JESUS], my soul is cast down within me: therefore will I remember
you from the land of Jordan, and of the Hermonites, from the hill
Mizar.

42:7 Deep calleth unto deep at the noise of your waterspouts: all your
waves and your billows are gone over me.

42:8 Yet the LORD[JESUS] will command HIS[JESUS] lovingkindness in the day time, and
in the night HIS[JESUS] song shall be with me, and my prayer unto the GOD[JESUS] of my
life.

42:9 I will say unto GOD[JESUS] my rock, Why hast you forgotten me? why go I
mourning because of the oppression of the enemy?

42:10 As with a sword in my bones, mine enemies reproach me; while they
say daily unto me, Where is your GOD[JESUS]?

42:11 Why art you cast down, O my soul? and why art you disquieted
within me? hope you in GOD[JESUS]: for I shall yet praise HIM[JESUS], who is the
health of my countenance, and my GOD[JESUS].


43:1 Judge me, O GOD[JESUS], and plead my cause against an ungodly nation: O
deliver me from the deceitful and unjust man.

43:2 For you art the GOD[JESUS] of my strength: why dost you cast me off? why
go I mourning because of the oppression of the enemy?

43:3 O send out your light and your truth: let them lead me; let them
bring me unto your holy hill, and to your tabernacles.

43:4 Then will I go unto the altar of GOD[JESUS], unto GOD[JESUS] my exceeding joy:
yea, upon the harp will I praise you, O GOD[JESUS] my GOD[JESUS].

43:5 Why art you cast down, O my soul? and why art you disquieted
within me? hope in GOD[JESUS]: for I shall yet praise HIM[JESUS], who is the health of
my countenance, and my GOD[JESUS].


44:1 We have heard with our ears, O GOD[JESUS], our fathers have told us, what
work you didst in their days, in the times of old.

44:2 How you didst drive out the heathen with your hand, and plantedst
them; how you didst afflict the people, and cast them out.

44:3 For they got not the land in possession by their own sword, neither
did their own arm save them: but your right hand, and yours arm, and the
light of your countenance, because you hadst a favour unto them.

44:4 you art my KING[JESUS], O GOD[JESUS]: command deliverances for Jacob.

44:5 Through you will we push down our enemies: through your name will
we tread them under that rise up against us.

44:6 For I will not trust in my bow, neither shall my sword save me.

44:7 But you hast saved us from our enemies, and hast put them to shame
that hated us.

44:8 In GOD[JESUS] we boast all the day long, and praise your name for ever.
Selah.

44:9 But you hast cast off, and put us to shame; and goest not forth
with our armies.

44:10 you makest us to turn back from the enemy: and they which hate us
spoil for themselves.

44:11 you hast given us like sheep appointed for meat; and hast
scattered us among the heathen.

44:12 you sellest your people for nought, and dost not increase your
wealth by their price.

44:13 you makest us a reproach to our neighbours, a scorn and a
derision to them that are round about us.

44:14 you makest us a byword among the heathen, a shaking of the head
among the people.

44:15 My confusion is continually before me, and the shame of my face
has covered me,

44:16 For the voice of HIM[JESUS] that reproacheth and blasphemeth; by reason
of the enemy and avenger.

44:17 All this is come upon us; yet have we not forgotten you, neither
have we dealt falsely in your covenant.

44:18 Our heart is not turned back, neither have our steps declined from
your way;

44:19 Though you hast sore broken us in the place of dragons, and
covered us with the shadow of death.

44:20 If we have forgotten the name of our GOD[JESUS], or stretched out our
hands to a strange GOD[JESUS];

44:21 Shall not GOD[JESUS] search this out? for HE[JESUS] knoweth the secrets of the
heart.

44:22 Yea, for your sake are we killed all the day long; we are counted
as sheep for the slaughter.

44:23 Awake, why sleepest you, O LORD[JESUS]? arise, cast us not off for ever.

44:24 Wherefore hidest you your face, and forgettest our affliction and
our oppression?

44:25 For our soul is bowed down to the dust: our belly cleaveth unto
the earth.

44:26 Arise for our help, and redeem us for your mercies' sake.


45:1 My heart is inditing a good matter: I speak of the things which I
have made touching the KING[JESUS]: my tongue is the pen of a ready writer.

45:2 you art fairer than the children of men: grace is poured into your
lips: therefore GOD[JESUS] has blessed you for ever.

45:3 Gird your sword upon your thigh, O most mighty, with your glory and
your majesty.

45:4 And in your majesty ride prosperously because of truth and meekness
and righteousness; and your right hand shall teach you terrible things.

45:5 yours arrows are sharp in the heart of the KING[JESUS]'s enemies; whereby
the people fall under you.

45:6 your throne, O GOD[JESUS], is for ever and ever: the sceptre of your kingdom
is a right sceptre.

45:7 you lovest righteousness, and hatest wickedness: therefore GOD[JESUS],
your GOD[JESUS], has anointed you with the oil of gladness above your fellows.

45:8 All your garments smell of myrrh, and aloes, and cassia, out of the
ivory palaces, whereby they have made you glad.

45:9 Kings' daughters were among your honourable women: upon your right
hand did stand the queen in gold of Ophir.

45:10 Hearken, O daughter, and consider, and incline yours ear; forget
also yours own people, and your father's house;

45:11 So shall the KING[JESUS] greatly desire your beauty: for HE[JESUS] is your LORD[JESUS];
and worship you HIM[JESUS].

45:12 And the daughter of Tyre shall be there with a gift; even the rich
among the people shall intreat your favour.

45:13 The KING[JESUS]'s daughter is all glorious within: her clothing is of
wrought gold.

45:14 She shall be brought unto the KING[JESUS] in raiment of needlework: the
virgins her companions that follow her shall be brought unto you.

45:15 With gladness and rejoicing shall they be brought: they shall
enter into the KING[JESUS]'s palace.

45:16 Instead of your fathers shall be your children, whom you mayest
make princes in all the earth.

45:17 I will make your name to be remembered in all generations:
therefore shall the people praise you for ever and ever.


46:1 GOD[JESUS] is our refuge and strength, a very present help in trouble.

46:2 Therefore will not we fear, though the earth be removed, and though
the mountains be carried into the midst of the sea;

46:3 Though the waters thereof roar and be troubled, though the
mountains shake with the swelling thereof. Selah.

46:4 There is a river, the streams whereof shall make glad the city of
GOD[JESUS], the holy place of the tabernacles of the most High.

46:5 GOD[JESUS] is in the midst of her; she shall not be moved: GOD[JESUS] shall help
her, and that right early.

46:6 The heathen raged, the kingdoms were moved: HE[JESUS] uttered HIS[JESUS] voice,
the earth melted.

46:7 The LORD[JESUS] of hosts is with us; the GOD[JESUS] of Jacob is our refuge.
Selah.

46:8 Come, behold the works of the LORD[JESUS], what desolations HE[JESUS] has made
in the earth.

46:9 HE[JESUS] makes wars to cease unto the end of the earth; HE[JESUS] breaketh the
bow, and cutteth the spear in sunder; HE[JESUS] burneth the chariot in the
fire.

46:10 Be still, and know that I am GOD[JESUS]: I will be exalted among the
heathen, I will be exalted in the earth.

46:11 The LORD[JESUS] of hosts is with us; the GOD[JESUS] of Jacob is our refuge.
Selah.

49:1 Hear this, all you people; give ear, all you inhabitants of the
world:

49:2 Both low and high, rich and poor, together.

49:3 My mouth shall speak of wisdom; and the meditation of my heart
shall be of understanding.

49:4 I will incline mine ear to a parable: I will open my dark saying
upon the harp.

49:5 Wherefore should I fear in the days of evil, when the iniquity of
my heels shall compass me about?

49:6 They that trust in their wealth, and boast themselves in the
multitude of their riches;

49:7 None of them can by any means redeem HIS[JESUS] brother, nor give to GOD[JESUS] a
ransom for HIM[JESUS]:

49:8 (For the redemption of their soul is precious, and it ceaseth for
ever:)

49:9 That HE[JESUS] should still live for ever, and not see corruption.

49:10 For HE[JESUS] seeth that wise men die, likewise the fool and the brutish
person perish, and leave their wealth to others.

49:11 Their inward thought is, that their houses shall continue for
ever, and their dwelling places to all generations; they call their
lands after their own names.

49:12 Nevertheless man being in honour abideth not: HE[JESUS] is like the
beasts that perish.

49:13 This their way is their folly: yet their posterity approve their
sayings. Selah.

49:14 Like sheep they are laid in the grave; death shall feed on them;
and the upright shall have dominion over them in the morning; and their
beauty shall consume in the grave from their dwelling.

49:15 But GOD[JESUS] will redeem my soul from the power of the grave: for HE[JESUS]
shall receive me. Selah.

49:16 Be not you afraid when one is made rich, when the glory of HIS[JESUS]
house is increased;

49:17 For when HE[JESUS] dieth HE[JESUS] shall carry nothing away: HIS[JESUS] glory shall not
descend after HIM[JESUS].

49:18 Though while HE[JESUS] lived HE[JESUS] blessed HIS[JESUS] soul: and men will praise
you, when you doest well to thyself.

49:19 HE[JESUS] shall go to the generation of HIS[JESUS] fathers; they shall never see
light.

49:20 Man that is in honour, and understandeth not, is like the beasts
that perish.


50:1 The mighty GOD[JESUS], even the LORD[JESUS], has spoken, and called the earth
from the rising of the sun unto the going down thereof.

50:2 Out of Zion, the perfection of beauty, GOD[JESUS] has shined.

50:3 Our GOD[JESUS] shall come, and shall not keep silence: a fire shall devour
before HIM[JESUS], and it shall be very tempestuous round about HIM[JESUS].

50:4 HE[JESUS] shall call to the heavens from above, and to the earth, that HE[JESUS]
may judge HIS[JESUS] people.

50:5 Gather my saints together unto me; those that have made a covenant
with me by sacrifice.

50:6 And the heavens shall declare HIS[JESUS] righteousness: for GOD[JESUS] is judge
himself. Selah.

50:7 Hear, O my people, and I will speak; O Israel, and I will testify
against you: I am GOD[JESUS], even your GOD[JESUS].

50:8 I will not reprove you for your sacrifices or your burnt offerings,
to have been continually before me.

50:9 I will take no bullock out of your house, nor HE[JESUS] goats out of your
folds.

50:10 For every beast of the forest is mine, and the cattle upon a
thousand hills.

50:11 I know all the fowls of the mountains: and the wild beasts of the
field are mine.

50:12 If I were hungry, I would not tell you: for the world is mine,
and the fulness thereof.

50:13 Will I eat the flesh of bulls, or drink the blood of goats?

50:14 Offer unto GOD[JESUS] thanksgiving; and pay your vows unto the most High:

50:15 And call upon me in the day of trouble: I will deliver you, and
you shalt glorify me.

50:16 But unto the wicked GOD[JESUS] says, What hast you to do to declare my
statutes, or that you shouldest take my covenant in your mouth?

50:17 Seeing you hatest instruction, and casteth my words behind you.

50:18 When you sawest a thief, then you consentedst with HIM[JESUS], and hast
been partaker with adulterers.

50:19 you givest your mouth to evil, and your tongue frameth deceit.

50:20 you sittest and speakest against your brother; you slanderest
yours own mother's SON[JESUS].

50:21 These things hast you done, and I kept silence; you thoughtest
that I was altogether such an one as thyself: but I will reprove you,
and set them in order before yours eyes.

50:22 Now consider this, you that forget GOD[JESUS], lest I tear you in pieces,
and there be none to deliver.

50:23 whoever offereth praise glorifieth me: and to HIM[JESUS] that ordereth HIS[JESUS]
conduct aright will I shew the salvation of GOD[JESUS].


51:1 Have mercy upon me, O GOD[JESUS], according to your lovingkindness:
according unto the multitude of your tender mercies blot out my
transgressions.

51:2 Wash me throughly from mine iniquity, and cleanse me from my sin.

51:3 For I acknowledge my transgressions: and my sin is ever before me.

51:4 Against you, you only, have I sinned, and done this evil in your
sight: that you mightest be justified when you speakest, and be clear
when you judgest.

51:5 Behold, I was shapen in iniquity; and in sin did my mother conceive
me.

51:6 Behold, you desirest truth in the inward parts: and in the hidden
part you shalt make me to know wisdom.

51:7 Purge me with hyssop, and I shall be clean: wash me, and I shall be
whiter than snow.

51:8 Make me to hear joy and gladness; that the bones which you hast
broken may rejoice.

51:9 Hide your face from my sins, and blot out all mine iniquities.

51:10 Create in me a clean heart, O GOD[JESUS]; and renew a right spirit within
me.

51:11 Cast me not away from your presence; and take not your holy spirit
from me.

51:12 Restore unto me the joy of your salvation; and uphold me with your
free spirit.

51:13 Then will I teach transgressors your ways; and sinners shall be
converted unto you.

51:14 Deliver me from bloodguiltiness, O GOD[JESUS], you GOD[JESUS] of my salvation:
and my tongue shall sing aloud of your righteousness.

51:15 O LORD[JESUS], open you my lips; and my mouth shall shew forth your
praise.

51:16 For you desirest not sacrifice; else would I give it: you
delightest not in burnt offering.

51:17 The sacrifices of GOD[JESUS] are a broken spirit: a broken and a contrite
heart, O GOD[JESUS], you wilt not despise.

51:18 Do good in your good pleasure unto Zion: build you the walls of
Jerusalem.

51:19 Then shalt you be pleased with the sacrifices of righteousness,
with burnt offering and whole burnt offering: then shall they offer
bullocks upon yours altar.


52:1 Why boastest you thyself in mischief, O mighty man? the goodness
of GOD[JESUS] endureth continually.

52:2 The tongue deviseth mischiefs; like a sharp razor, working
deceitfully.

52:3 you lovest evil more than good; and lying rather than to speak
righteousness. Selah.

52:4 you lovest all devouring words, O you deceitful tongue.

52:5 GOD[JESUS] shall likewise destroy you for ever, HE[JESUS] shall take you away,
and pluck you out of your dwelling place, and ROOT[JESUS] you out of the land
of the living. Selah.

52:6 The righteous also shall see, and fear, and shall laugh at HIM[JESUS]:

52:7 Lo, this is the man that made not GOD[JESUS] HIS[JESUS] strength; but trusted in
the abundance of HIS[JESUS] riches, and strengthened himself in HIS[JESUS] wickedness.

52:8 But I am like a green olive tree in the house of GOD[JESUS]: I trust in
the mercy of GOD[JESUS] for ever and ever.

52:9 I will praise you for ever, because you hast done it: and I will
wait on your name; for it is good before your saints.


53:1 The fool has said in HIS[JESUS] heart, There is no GOD[JESUS]. Corrupt are they,
and have done abominable iniquity: there is none that doeth good.

53:2 GOD[JESUS] looked down from heaven upon the children of men, to see if
there were any that did understand, that did seek GOD[JESUS].

53:3 Every one of them is gone back: they are altogether become filthy;
there is none that doeth good, no, not one.

53:4 Have the workers of iniquity no knowledge? who eat up my people as
they eat bread: they have not called upon GOD[JESUS].

53:5 There were they in great fear, where no fear was: for GOD[JESUS] has
scattered the bones of HIM[JESUS] that encampeth against you: you hast put
them to shame, because GOD[JESUS] has despised them.

53:6 Oh that the salvation of Israel were come out of Zion! When GOD[JESUS]
bringeth back the captivity of HIS[JESUS] people, Jacob shall rejoice, and
Israel shall be glad.


54:1 Save me, O GOD[JESUS], by your name, and judge me by your strength.

54:2 Hear my prayer, O GOD[JESUS]; give ear to the words of my mouth.

54:3 For strangers are risen up against me, and oppressors seek after my
soul: they have not set GOD[JESUS] before them. Selah.

54:4 Behold, GOD[JESUS] is mine helper: the LORD[JESUS] is with them that uphold my
soul.

54:5 HE[JESUS] shall reward evil unto mine enemies: cut them off in your truth.

54:6 I will freely sacrifice unto you: I will praise your name, O LORD[JESUS];
for it is good.

54:7 For HE[JESUS] has delivered me out of all trouble: and mine eye has seen
HIS[JESUS] desire upon mine enemies.


55:1 Give ear to my prayer, O GOD[JESUS]; and hide not thyself from my
supplication.

55:2 Attend unto me, and hear me: I mourn in my complaint, and make a
noise;

55:3 Because of the voice of the enemy, because of the oppression of the
wicked: for they cast iniquity upon me, and in wrath they hate me.

55:4 My heart is sore pained within me: and the terrors of death are
fallen upon me.

55:5 Fearfulness and trembling are come upon me, and horror has
overwhelmed me.

55:6 And I said, Oh that I had wings like a dove! for then would I fly
away, and be at rest.

55:7 Lo, then would I wander far off, and remain in the wilderness.
Selah.

55:8 I would hasten my escape from the windy storm and tempest.

55:9 Destroy, O LORD[JESUS], and divide their tongues: for I have seen violence
and strife in the city.

55:10 Day and night they go about it upon the walls thereof: mischief
also and sorrow are in the midst of it.

55:11 Wickedness is in the midst thereof: deceit and guile depart not
from her streets.

55:12 For it was not an enemy that reproached me; then I could have
borne it: neither was it HE[JESUS] that hated me that did magnify himself
against me; then I would have hid myself from HIM[JESUS]:

55:13 But it was you, a man mine equal, my guide, and mine
acquaintance.

55:14 We took sweet counsel together, and walked unto the house of GOD[JESUS]
in company.

55:15 Let death seize upon them, and let them go down quick into hell:
for wickedness is in their dwellings, and among them.

55:16 As for me, I will call upon GOD[JESUS]; and the LORD[JESUS] shall save me.

55:17 Evening, and morning, and at noon, will I pray, and cry aloud: and
HE[JESUS] shall hear my voice.

55:18 HE[JESUS] has delivered my soul in peace from the battle that was
against me: for there were many with me.

55:19 GOD[JESUS] shall hear, and afflict them, even HE[JESUS] that abideth of old.
Selah. Because they have no changes, therefore they fear not GOD[JESUS].

55:20 HE[JESUS] has put forth HIS[JESUS] hands against such as be at peace with HIM[JESUS]:
HE[JESUS] has broken HIS[JESUS] covenant.

55:21 The words of HIS[JESUS] mouth were smoother than butter, but war was in
HIS[JESUS] heart: HIS[JESUS] words were softer than oil, yet were they drawn swords.

55:22 Cast your burden upon the LORD[JESUS], and HE[JESUS] shall sustain you: HE[JESUS] shall
never let the righteous to be moved.

55:23 But you, O GOD[JESUS], shalt bring them down into the pit of
destruction: bloody and deceitful men shall not live out half their
days; but I will trust in you.


56:1 Be merciful unto me, O GOD[JESUS]: for man would swallow me up; HE[JESUS]
fighting daily oppresseth me.

56:2 Mine enemies would daily swallow me up: for they be many that fight
against me, O you most High.

56:3 What time I am afraid, I will trust in you.

56:4 In GOD[JESUS] I will praise HIS[JESUS] WORD[JESUS], in GOD[JESUS] I have put my trust; I will
not fear what flesh can do unto me.

56:5 Every day they wrest my words: all their thoughts are against me
for evil.

56:6 They gather themselves together, they hide themselves, they mark my
steps, when they wait for my soul.

56:7 Shall they escape by iniquity? in yours anger cast down the people,
O GOD[JESUS].

56:8 you tellest my wanderings: put you my tears into your bottle: are
they not in your book?

56:9 When I cry unto you, then shall mine enemies turn back: this I
know; for GOD[JESUS] is for me.

56:10 In GOD[JESUS] will I praise HIS[JESUS] WORD[JESUS]: in the LORD[JESUS] will I praise HIS[JESUS] WORD[JESUS].

56:11 In GOD[JESUS] have I put my trust: I will not be afraid what man can do
unto me.

56:12 your vows are upon me, O GOD[JESUS]: I will render praises unto you.

56:13 For you hast delivered my soul from death: wilt not you deliver
my feet from falling, that I may walk before GOD[JESUS] in the light of the
living?


57:1 Be merciful unto me, O GOD[JESUS], be merciful unto me: for my soul
trusteth in you: yea, in the shadow of your wings will I make my refuge,
until these calamities be overpast.

57:2 I will cry unto GOD[JESUS] most high; unto GOD[JESUS] that performeth all things
for me.

57:3 HE[JESUS] shall send from heaven, and save me from the reproach of HIM[JESUS]
that would swallow me up. Selah. GOD[JESUS] shall send forth HIS[JESUS] mercy and HIS[JESUS]
truth.

57:4 My soul is among lions: and I lie even among them that are set on
fire, even the sons of men, whose teeth are spears and arrows, and their
tongue a sharp sword.

57:5 Be you exalted, O GOD[JESUS], above the heavens; let your glory be above
all the earth.

57:6 They have prepared a net for my steps; my soul is bowed down: they
have digged a pit before me, into the midst whereof they are fallen
themselves. Selah.

57:7 My heart is fixed, O GOD[JESUS], my heart is fixed: I will sing and give

57:8 Awake up, my glory; awake, psaltery and harp: I myself will awake
