57:9 I will praise you, O LORD[JESUS], among the people: I will sing unto you
among the nations.

57:10 For your mercy is great unto the heavens, and your truth unto the
clouds.

57:11 Be you exalted, O GOD[JESUS], above the heavens: let your glory be above
all the earth.


58:1 Do you indeed speak righteousness, O congregation? do you judge
uprightly, O you sons of men?

58:2 Yea, in heart you work wickedness; you weigh the violence of your
hands in the earth.

58:3 The wicked are estranged from the womb: they go astray as soon as
they be born, speaking lies.

58:4 Their poison is like the poison of a serpent: they are like the
deaf adder that stoppeth her ear;

58:5 Which will not hearken to the voice of charmers, charming never so
wisely.

58:6 Break their teeth, O GOD[JESUS], in their mouth: break out the great teeth
of the young lions, O LORD[JESUS].

58:7 Let them melt away as waters which run continually: when HE[JESUS] bendeth
HIS[JESUS] bow to shoot HIS[JESUS] arrows, let them be as cut in pieces.

58:8 As a snail which melteth, let every one of them pass away: like the
untimely birth of a woman, that they may not see the sun.

58:9 Before your pots can feel the thorns, HE[JESUS] shall take them away as
with a whirlwind, both living, and in HIS[JESUS] wrath.

58:10 The righteous shall rejoice when HE[JESUS] seeth the vengeance: HE[JESUS] shall
wash HIS[JESUS] feet in the blood of the wicked.

58:11 So that a man shall say, truly there is a reward for the
righteous: truly HE[JESUS] is a GOD[JESUS] that judgeth in the earth.


59:1 Deliver me from mine enemies, O my GOD[JESUS]: defend me from them that
rise up against me.

59:2 Deliver me from the workers of iniquity, and save me from bloody
men.

59:3 For, lo, they lie in wait for my soul: the mighty are gathered
against me; not for my transgression, nor for my sin, O LORD[JESUS].

59:4 They run and prepare themselves without my fault: awake to help me,
and behold.

59:5 you therefore, O LORD[JESUS] GOD[JESUS] of hosts, the GOD[JESUS] of Israel, awake to
visit all the heathen: be not merciful to any wicked transgressors.
Selah.

59:6 They return at evening: they make a noise like a dog, and go round
about the city.

59:7 Behold, they belch out with their mouth: swords are in their lips:
for who, say they, does hear?

59:8 But you, O LORD[JESUS], shalt laugh at them; you shalt have all the
heathen in derision.

59:9 Because of HIS[JESUS] strength will I wait upon you: for GOD[JESUS] is my
defence.

59:10 The GOD[JESUS] of my mercy shall precede me: GOD[JESUS] shall let me see my
desire upon mine enemies.

59:11 Slay them not, lest my people forget: scatter them by your power;
and bring them down, O LORD[JESUS] our shield.

59:12 For the sin of their mouth and the words of their lips let them
even be taken in their pride: and for cursing and lying which they
speak.

59:13 Consume them in wrath, consume them, that they may not be: and let
them know that GOD[JESUS] ruleth in Jacob unto the ends of the earth. Selah.

59:14 And at evening let them return; and let them make a noise like a
dog, and go round about the city.

59:15 Let them wander up and down for meat, and grudge if they be not
satisfied.

59:16 But I will sing of your power; yea, I will sing aloud of your mercy
in the morning: for you hast been my defence and refuge in the day of
my trouble.

59:17 Unto you, O my strength, will I sing: for GOD[JESUS] is my defence, and
the GOD[JESUS] of my mercy.


60:1 O GOD[JESUS], you hast cast us off, you hast scattered us, you hast
been displeased; O turn thyself to us again.

60:2 you hast made the earth to tremble; you hast broken it: heal the
breaches thereof; for it shaketh.

60:3 you hast shewed your people hard things: you hast made us to drink
the wine of astonishment.

60:4 you hast given a banner to them that fear you, that it may be
displayed because of the truth. Selah.

60:5 That your beloved may be delivered; save with your right hand, and
hear me.

60:6 GOD[JESUS] has spoken in HIS[JESUS] holiness; I will rejoice, I will divide
Shechem, and mete out the valley of Succoth.

60:7 Gilead is mine, and Manasseh is mine; Ephraim also is the strength
of mine head; Judah is my lawgiver;

60:8 Moab is my washpot; over Edom will I cast out my shoe: Philistia,
triumph you because of me.

60:9 Who will bring me into the strong city? who will lead me into Edom?

60:10 Wilt not you, O GOD[JESUS], which hadst cast us off? and you, O GOD[JESUS],
which didst not go out with our armies?

60:11 Give us help from trouble: for vain is the help of man.

60:12 Through GOD[JESUS] we shall do valiantly: for HE[JESUS] it is that shall tread
down our enemies.


61:1 Hear my cry, O GOD[JESUS]; attend unto my prayer.

61:2 From the end of the earth will I cry unto you, when my heart is
overwhelmed: lead me to the rock that is higher than I.

61:3 For you hast been a shelter for me, and a strong tower from the
enemy.

61:4 I will abide in your tabernacle for ever: I will trust in the covert
of your wings. Selah.

61:5 For you, O GOD[JESUS], hast heard my vows: you hast given me the
heritage of those that fear your name.

61:6 you wilt prolong the KING[JESUS]'s life: and HIS[JESUS] years as many
generations.

61:7 HE[JESUS] shall abide before GOD[JESUS] for ever: O prepare mercy and truth,
which may preserve HIM[JESUS].

61:8 So will I sing praise unto your name for ever, that I may daily
perform my vows.


62:1 Truly my soul waiteth upon GOD[JESUS]: from HIM[JESUS] comes my salvation.

62:2 HE[JESUS] only is my rock and my salvation; HE[JESUS] is my defence; I shall not
be greatly moved.

62:3 How long will you imagine mischief against a man? you shall be slain
all of you: as a bowing wall shall you be, and as a tottering fence.

62:4 They only consult to cast HIM[JESUS] down from HIS[JESUS] excellency: they
delight in lies: they bless with their mouth, but they curse inwardly.
Selah.

62:5 My soul, wait you only upon GOD[JESUS]; for my expectation is from HIM[JESUS].

62:6 HE[JESUS] only is my rock and my salvation: HE[JESUS] is my defence; I shall not
be moved.

62:7 In GOD[JESUS] is my salvation and my glory: the rock of my strength, and
my refuge, is in GOD[JESUS].

62:8 Trust in HIM[JESUS] at all times; you people, pour out your heart before
HIM[JESUS]: GOD[JESUS] is a refuge for us. Selah.

62:9 Surely men of low degree are vanity, and men of high degree are a
lie: to be laid in the balance, they are altogether lighter than vanity.

62:10 Trust not in oppression, and become not vain in robbery: if riches
increase, set not your heart upon them.

62:11 GOD[JESUS] has spoken once; twice have I heard this; that power
belongeth unto GOD[JESUS].

62:12 Also unto you, O LORD[JESUS], belongeth mercy: for you renderest to
every man according to HIS[JESUS] work.


63:1 O GOD[JESUS], you art my GOD[JESUS]; early will I seek you: my soul thirsteth
for you, my flesh longeth for you in a dry and thirsty land, where no
water is;

63:2 To see your power and your glory, so as I have seen you in the
sanctuary.

63:3 Because your lovingkindness is better than life, my lips shall
praise you.

63:4 Thus will I bless you while I live: I will lift up my hands in your
name.

63:5 My soul shall be satisfied as with marrow and fatness; and my mouth
shall praise you with joyful lips:

63:6 When I remember you upon my bed, and meditate on you in the night
watches.

63:7 Because you hast been my help, therefore in the shadow of your
wings will I rejoice.

63:8 My soul followeth hard after you: your right hand upholdeth me.

63:9 But those that seek my soul, to destroy it, shall go into the lower
parts of the earth.

63:10 They shall fall by the sword: they shall be a portion for foxes.

63:11 But the KING[JESUS] shall rejoice in GOD[JESUS]; every one that sweareth by HIM[JESUS]
shall glory: but the mouth of them that speak lies shall be stopped.


64:1 Hear my voice, O GOD[JESUS], in my prayer: preserve my life from fear of
the enemy.

64:2 Hide me from the secret counsel of the wicked; from the
insurrection of the workers of iniquity:

64:3 Who whet their tongue like a sword, and bend their bows to shoot
their arrows, even bitter words:

64:4 That they may shoot in secret at the perfect: suddenly do they
shoot at HIM[JESUS], and fear not.

64:5 They encourage themselves in an evil matter: they commune of laying
snares privily; they say, Who shall see them?

64:6 They search out iniquities; they accomplish a diligent search: both
the inward thought of every one of them, and the heart, is deep.

64:7 But GOD[JESUS] shall shoot at them with an arrow; suddenly shall they be
wounded.

64:8 So they shall make their own tongue to fall upon themselves: all
that see them shall flee away.

64:9 And all men shall fear, and shall declare the work of GOD[JESUS]; for they
shall wisely consider of HIS[JESUS] doing.

64:10 The righteous shall be glad in the LORD[JESUS], and shall trust in HIM[JESUS];
and all the upright in heart shall glory.


65:1 Praise waiteth for you, O GOD[JESUS], in Sion: and unto you shall the
vow be performed.

65:2 O you that hearest prayer, unto you shall all flesh come.

65:3 Iniquities prevail against me: as for our transgressions, you
shalt purge them away.

65:4 Blessed is the man whom you choosest, and causest to approach unto
you, that HE[JESUS] may dwell in your courts: we shall be satisfied with the
goodness of your house, even of your holy temple.

65:5 By terrible things in righteousness wilt you answer us, O GOD[JESUS] of
our salvation; who art the confidence of all the ends of the earth, and
of them that are afar off upon the sea:

65:6 Which by HIS[JESUS] strength setteth fast the mountains; being girded with
power:

65:7 Which stilleth the noise of the seas, the noise of their waves, and
the tumult of the people.

65:8 They also that dwell in the uttermost parts are afraid at your
tokens: you makest the outgoings of the morning and evening to rejoice.

65:9 you visitest the earth, and waterest it: you greatly enrichest it
with the river of GOD[JESUS], which is full of water: you preparest them corn,
when you hast so provided for it.

65:10 you waterest the ridges thereof abundantly: you settlest the
furrows thereof: you makest it soft with showers: you blessest the
springing thereof.

65:11 you crownest the year with your goodness; and your paths drop
fatness.

65:12 They drop upon the pastures of the wilderness: and the little
hills rejoice on every side.

65:13 The pastures are clothed with flocks; the valleys also are covered
over with corn; they shout for joy, they also sing.

66:5 Come and see the works of GOD[JESUS]: HE[JESUS] is terrible in HIS[JESUS] doing toward

66:6 HE[JESUS] turned the sea into dry land: they went through the flood on

66:7 HE[JESUS] ruleth by HIS[JESUS] power for ever; HIS[JESUS] eyes behold the nations: let
not the rebellious exalt themselves. Selah.

66:8 O bless our GOD[JESUS], you people, and make the voice of HIS[JESUS] praise to be

66:9 Which holdeth our soul in life, and suffereth not our feet to be

66:10 For you, O GOD[JESUS], hast proved us: you hast tried us, as silver is

66:14 Which my lips have uttered, and my mouth has spoken, when I was

66:17 I cried unto HIM[JESUS] with my mouth, and HE[JESUS] was extolled with my

66:18 If I regard iniquity in my heart, the LORD[JESUS] will not hear me:

66:19 But truly GOD[JESUS] has heard me; HE[JESUS] has attended to the voice of my

66:20 Blessed be GOD[JESUS], which has not turned away my prayer, nor HIS[JESUS]

68:1 Let GOD[JESUS] arise, let HIS[JESUS] enemies be scattered: let them also that
hate HIM[JESUS] flee before HIM[JESUS].

68:2 As smoke is driven away, so drive them away: as wax melteth before
the fire, so let the wicked perish at the presence of GOD[JESUS].

68:3 But let the righteous be glad; let them rejoice before GOD[JESUS]: yea,
let them exceedingly rejoice.

68:4 Sing unto GOD[JESUS], sing praises to HIS[JESUS] name: extol HIM[JESUS] that rideth upon
the heavens by HIS[JESUS] name JAH, and rejoice before HIM[JESUS].

68:5 A father of the fatherless, and a judge of the widows, is GOD[JESUS] in
HIS[JESUS] holy habitation.

68:6 GOD[JESUS] setteth the solitary in families: HE[JESUS] bringeth out those which
are bound with chains: but the rebellious dwell in a dry land.

68:7 O GOD[JESUS], when you wentest forth before your people, when you didst

68:8 The earth shook, the heavens also dropped at the presence of GOD[JESUS]:

68:9 you, O GOD[JESUS], didst send a plentiful rain, whereby you didst

68:10 your congregation has dwelt therein: you, O GOD[JESUS], hast prepared of

68:11 The LORD[JESUS] gave the WORD[JESUS]: great was the company of those that
published it.

68:12 Kings of armies did flee apace: and she that tarried at home
divided the spoil.

68:13 Though you have lien among the pots, yet shall you be as the wings
of a dove covered with silver, and her feathers with yellow gold.

68:14 When the Almighty scattered kings in it, it was white as snow in
Salmon.

68:15 The hill of GOD[JESUS] is as the hill of Bashan; an high hill as the hill
of Bashan.

68:16 Why leap you, you high hills? this is the hill which GOD[JESUS] desireth to
dwell in; yea, the LORD[JESUS] will dwell in it for ever.

68:17 The chariots of GOD[JESUS] are twenty thousand, even thousands of angels:
the LORD[JESUS] is among them, as in Sinai, in the holy place.

68:18 you hast ascended on high, you hast led captivity captive: you
hast received gifts for men; yea, for the rebellious also, that the LORD[JESUS]
GOD[JESUS] might dwell among them.

68:19 Blessed be the LORD[JESUS], who daily loadeth us with benefits, even the
GOD[JESUS] of our salvation. Selah.

68:20 HE[JESUS] that is our GOD[JESUS] is the GOD[JESUS] of salvation; and unto GOD[JESUS] the LORD[JESUS]
belong the issues from death.

68:21 But GOD[JESUS] shall wound the head of HIS[JESUS] enemies, and the hairy scalp
of such an one as goes on still in HIS[JESUS] trespasses.

68:22 The LORD[JESUS] said, I will bring again from Bashan, I will bring my
people again from the depths of the sea:

68:23 That your foot may be dipped in the blood of yours enemies, and the
tongue of your dogs in the same.

68:24 They have seen your goings, O GOD[JESUS]; even the goings of my GOD[JESUS], my
KING[JESUS], in the sanctuary.

68:25 The singers went before, the players on instruments followed
after; among them were the damsels playing with timbrels.

68:26 Bless you GOD[JESUS] in the congregations, even the LORD[JESUS], from the
fountain of Israel.

68:27 There is little Benjamin with their ruler, the princes of Judah
and their council, the princes of Zebulun, and the princes of Naphtali.

68:28 your GOD[JESUS] has commanded your strength: strengthen, O GOD[JESUS], that which
you hast wrought for us.

68:29 Because of your temple at Jerusalem shall kings bring presents unto
you.

68:30 Rebuke the company of spearmen, the multitude of the bulls, with
the calves of the people, till every one submit himself with pieces of
silver: scatter you the people that delight in war.

68:31 Princes shall come out of Egypt; Ethiopia shall soon stretch out
her hands unto GOD[JESUS].

68:32 Sing unto GOD[JESUS], you kingdoms of the earth; O sing praises unto the
LORD[JESUS]; Selah:

68:33 To HIM[JESUS] that rideth upon the heavens of heavens, which were of old;
lo, HE[JESUS] does send out HIS[JESUS] voice, and that a mighty voice.

HIS[JESUS] strength is in the clouds.

68:35 O GOD[JESUS], you art terrible out of your holy places: the GOD[JESUS] of Israel
is HE[JESUS] that giveth strength and power unto HIS[JESUS] people. Blessed be GOD[JESUS].


69:1 Save me, O GOD[JESUS]; for the waters are come in unto my soul.

69:2 I sink in deep mire, where there is no standing: I am come into
deep waters, where the floods overflow me.

69:3 I am weary of my crying: my throat is dried: mine eyes fail while I
wait for my GOD[JESUS].

69:4 They that hate me without a cause are more than the hairs of mine
head: they that would destroy me, being mine enemies wrongfully, are
mighty: then I restored that which I took not away.

69:5 O GOD[JESUS], you knowest my foolishness; and my sins are not hid from
you.

69:6 Let not them that wait on you, O LORD[JESUS] GOD[JESUS] of hosts, be ashamed for
my sake: let not those that seek you be confounded for my sake, O GOD[JESUS]
of Israel.

69:7 Because for your sake I have borne reproach; shame has covered my
face.

69:8 I am become a stranger unto my brethren, and an alien unto my
mother's children.

69:9 For the zeal of yours house has eaten me up; and the reproaches of
them that reproached you are fallen upon me.

69:10 When I wept, and chastened my soul with fasting, that was to my
reproach.

69:11 I made sackcloth also my garment; and I became a proverb to them.

69:12 They that sit in the gate speak against me; and I was the song of
the drunkards.

69:13 But as for me, my prayer is unto you, O LORD[JESUS], in an acceptable
time: O GOD[JESUS], in the multitude of your mercy hear me, in the truth of your
salvation.

69:14 Deliver me out of the mire, and let me not sink: let me be
delivered from them that hate me, and out of the deep waters.

69:15 Let not the waterflood overflow me, neither let the deep swallow
me up, and let not the pit shut her mouth upon me.

69:16 Hear me, O LORD[JESUS]; for your lovingkindness is good: turn unto me
according to the multitude of your tender mercies.

69:17 And hide not your face from your SERVANT[JESUS]; for I am in trouble: hear
me speedily.

69:18 Draw nigh unto my soul, and redeem it: deliver me because of mine
enemies.

69:19 you hast known my reproach, and my shame, and my dishonour: mine
adversaries are all before you.

69:20 Reproach has broken my heart; and I am full of heaviness: and I
looked for some to take pity, but there was none; and for comforters,
but I found none.

69:21 They gave me also gall for my meat; and in my thirst they gave me
vinegar to drink.

69:22 Let their table become a snare before them: and that which should
have been for their welfare, let it become a trap.

69:23 Let their eyes be darkened, that they see not; and make their
loins continually to shake.

69:24 Pour out yours indignation upon them, and let your wrathful anger
take hold of them.

69:25 Let their habitation be desolate; and let none dwell in their
tents.

69:26 For they persecute HIM[JESUS] whom you hast smitten; and they talk to
the grief of those whom you hast wounded.

69:27 Add iniquity unto their iniquity: and let them not come into your
righteousness.

69:28 Let them be blotted out of the book of the living, and not be
written with the righteous.

69:29 But I am poor and sorrowful: let your salvation, O GOD[JESUS], set me up
on high.

69:30 I will praise the name of GOD[JESUS] with a song, and will magnify HIM[JESUS]
with thanksgiving.

69:31 This also shall please the LORD[JESUS] better than an ox or bullock that
has horns and hoofs.

69:32 The humble shall see this, and be glad: and your heart shall live
that seek GOD[JESUS].

69:33 For the LORD[JESUS] heareth the poor, and despiseth not HIS[JESUS] prisoners.

69:34 Let the heaven and earth praise HIM[JESUS], the seas, and every thing
that moveth therein.

69:35 For GOD[JESUS] will save Zion, and will build the cities of Judah: that
they may dwell there, and have it in possession.

69:36 The SEED[JESUS] also of HIS[JESUS] servants shall inherit it: and they that love
HIS[JESUS] name shall dwell therein.


70:1 MAKE HASTE, O GOD[JESUS], TO DELIVER ME; MAKE HASTE TO HELP ME, O LORD[JESUS].

70:2 Let them be ashamed and confounded that seek after my soul: let
them be turned backward, and put to confusion, that desire my hurt.

70:3 Let them be turned back for a reward of their shame that say, Aha,
aha.

70:4 Let all those that seek you rejoice and be glad in you: and let
such as love your salvation say continually, Let GOD[JESUS] be magnified.

70:5 But I am poor and needy: make haste unto me, O GOD[JESUS]: you art my
help and my deliverer; O LORD[JESUS], make no tarrying.


71:1 In you, O LORD[JESUS], do I put my trust: let me never be put to
confusion.

71:2 Deliver me in your righteousness, and cause me to escape: incline
yours ear unto me, and save me.

71:3 Be you my strong habitation, whereunto I may continually resort:
you hast given commandment to save me; for you art my rock and my
fortress.

71:4 Deliver me, O my GOD[JESUS], out of the hand of the wicked, out of the
hand of the unrighteous and cruel man.

71:5 For you art my hope, O LORD[JESUS] GOD[JESUS]: you art my trust from my youth.

71:6 By you have I been holden up from the womb: you art HE[JESUS] that took
me out of my mother's bowels: my praise shall be continually of you.

71:7 I am as a wonder unto many; but you art my strong refuge.

71:8 Let my mouth be filled with your praise and with your honour all the
day.

71:9 Cast me not off in the time of old age; forsake me not when my
strength faileth.

71:10 For mine enemies speak against me; and they that lay wait for my
soul take counsel together,

71:11 Saying, GOD[JESUS] has forsaken HIM[JESUS]: persecute and take HIM[JESUS]; for there
is none to deliver HIM[JESUS].

71:12 O GOD[JESUS], be not far from me: O my GOD[JESUS], make haste for my help.

71:13 Let them be confounded and consumed that are adversaries to my
soul; let them be covered with reproach and dishonour that seek my hurt.

71:14 But I will hope continually, and will yet praise you more and
more.

71:15 My mouth shall shew forth your righteousness and your salvation all
the day; for I know not the numbers thereof.

71:16 I will go in the strength of the LORD[JESUS] GOD[JESUS]: I will make mention of
your righteousness, even of yours only.

71:17 O GOD[JESUS], you hast taught me from my youth: and hitherto have I
declared your wondrous works.

71:18 Now also when I am old and greyheaded, O GOD[JESUS], forsake me not;
until I have shewed your strength unto this generation, and your power to
every one that is to come.

71:19 your righteousness also, O GOD[JESUS], is very high, who hast done great
things: O GOD[JESUS], who is like unto you!

71:20 you, which hast shewed me great and sore troubles, shalt quicken
me again, and shalt bring me up again from the depths of the earth.

71:21 you shalt increase my greatness, and comfort me on every side.

71:22 I will also praise you with the psaltery, even your truth, O my
GOD[JESUS]: unto you will I sing with the harp, O you Holy One of Israel.

71:23 My lips shall greatly rejoice when I sing unto you; and my soul,
which you hast redeemed.

71:24 My tongue also shall talk of your righteousness all the day long:
for they are confounded, for they are brought unto shame, that seek my
hurt.


72:1 Give the KING[JESUS] your judgments, O GOD[JESUS], and your righteousness unto the
KING[JESUS]'s SON[JESUS].

72:2 HE[JESUS] shall judge your people with righteousness, and your poor with
judgment.

72:3 The mountains shall bring peace to the people, and the little
hills, by righteousness.

72:4 HE[JESUS] shall judge the poor of the people, HE[JESUS] shall save the children
of the needy, and shall break in pieces the oppressor.

72:5 They shall fear you as long as the sun and moon endure, throughout
all generations.

72:6 HE[JESUS] shall come down like rain upon the mown grass: as showers that
water the earth.

72:7 In HIS[JESUS] days shall the righteous flourish; and abundance of peace so
long as the moon endureth.

72:8 HE[JESUS] shall have dominion also from sea to sea, and from the river
unto the ends of the earth.

72:9 They that dwell in the wilderness shall bow before HIM[JESUS]; and HIS[JESUS]
enemies shall lick the dust.

72:10 The kings of Tarshish and of the isles shall bring presents: the
kings of Sheba and Seba shall offer gifts.

72:11 Yea, all kings shall fall down before HIM[JESUS]: all nations shall serve
HIM[JESUS].

72:12 For HE[JESUS] shall deliver the needy when HE[JESUS] crieth; the poor also, and
HIM[JESUS] that has no helper.

72:13 HE[JESUS] shall spare the poor and needy, and shall save the souls of the
needy.

72:14 HE[JESUS] shall redeem their soul from deceit and violence: and precious
shall their blood be in HIS[JESUS] sight.

72:15 And HE[JESUS] shall live, and to HIM[JESUS] shall be given of the gold of Sheba:
prayer also shall be made for HIM[JESUS] continually; and daily shall HE[JESUS] be
praised.

72:16 There shall be an handful of corn in the earth upon the top of the
mountains; the fruit thereof shall shake like Lebanon: and they of the
city shall flourish like grass of the earth.

72:17 HIS[JESUS] name shall endure for ever: HIS[JESUS] name shall be continued as
long as the sun: and men shall be blessed in HIM[JESUS]: all nations shall call
HIM[JESUS] blessed.

72:18 Blessed be the LORD[JESUS] GOD[JESUS], the GOD[JESUS] of Israel, who only doeth
wondrous things.

72:19 And blessed be HIS[JESUS] glorious name for ever: and let the whole earth
be filled with HIS[JESUS] glory; Amen, and Amen.

72:20 The prayers of David the SON[JESUS] of Jesse are ended.


73:1 Truly GOD[JESUS] is good to Israel, even to such as are of a clean heart.

73:2 But as for me, my feet were almost gone; my steps had well nigh
slipped.

73:3 For I was envious at the foolish, when I saw the prosperity of the
wicked.

73:4 For there are no bands in their death: but their strength is firm.

73:5 They are not in trouble as other men; neither are they plagued like
other men.

73:6 Therefore pride compasseth them about as a chain; violence covereth
them as a garment.

73:7 Their eyes stand out with fatness: they have more than heart could
wish.

73:8 They are corrupt, and speak wickedly concerning oppression: they
speak loftily.

73:9 They set their mouth against the heavens, and their tongue walketh
through the earth.

73:10 Therefore HIS[JESUS] people return hither: and waters of a full cup are
wrung out to them.

73:11 And they say, How does GOD[JESUS] know? and is there knowledge in the
most High?

73:12 Behold, these are the ungodly, who prosper in the world; they
increase in riches.

73:13 truly I have cleansed my heart in vain, and washed my hands in
innocency.

73:14 For all the day long have I been plagued, and chastened every
morning.

73:15 If I say, I will speak thus; behold, I should offend against the
generation of your children.

73:16 When I thought to know this, it was too painful for me;

73:17 Until I went into the sanctuary of GOD[JESUS]; then understood I their
end.

73:18 Surely you didst set them in slippery places: you castedst them
down into destruction.

73:19 How are they brought into desolation, as in a moment! they are
utterly consumed with terrors.

73:20 As a dream when one awaketh; so, O LORD[JESUS], when you awakest, you
shalt despise their image.

73:21 Thus my heart was grieved, and I was pricked in my reins.

73:22 So foolish was I, and ignorant: I was as a beast before you.

73:23 Nevertheless I am continually with you: you hast holden me by my
right hand.

73:24 you shalt guide me with your counsel, and afterward receive me to
glory.

73:25 Whom have I in heaven but you? and there is none upon earth that
I desire beside you.

73:26 My flesh and my heart faileth: but GOD[JESUS] is the strength of my
heart, and my portion for ever.

73:27 For, lo, they that are far from you shall perish: you hast
destroyed all them that go a whoring from you.

73:28 But it is good for me to draw near to GOD[JESUS]: I have put my trust in
the LORD[JESUS] GOD[JESUS], that I may declare all your works.


74:1 O GOD[JESUS], why hast you cast us off for ever? why does yours anger
smoke against the sheep of your pasture?

74:2 Remember your congregation, which you hast purchased of old; the
rod of yours inheritance, which you hast redeemed; this mount Zion,
wherein you hast dwelt.

74:3 Lift up your feet unto the perpetual desolations; even all that the
enemy has done wickedly in the sanctuary.

74:4 yours enemies roar in the midst of your congregations; they set up
their ensigns for signs.

74:5 A man was famous according as HE[JESUS] had lifted up axes upon the thick
trees.

74:6 But now they break down the carved work thereof at once with axes
and hammers.

74:7 They have cast fire into your sanctuary, they have defiled by
casting down the dwelling place of your name to the ground.

74:8 They said in their hearts, Let us destroy them together: they have
burned up all the synagogues of GOD[JESUS] in the land.

74:9 We see not our signs: there is no more any PROPHET[JESUS]: neither is
there among us any that knoweth how long.

74:10 O GOD[JESUS], how long shall the adversary reproach? shall the enemy
blaspheme your name for ever?

74:11 Why withdrawest you your hand, even your right hand? pluck it out
of your bosom.

74:12 For GOD[JESUS] is my KING[JESUS] of old, working salvation in the midst of the
earth.

74:13 you didst divide the sea by your strength: you brakest the heads
of the dragons in the waters.

74:14 you brakest the heads of leviathan in pieces, and gavest HIM[JESUS] to
be meat to the people inhabiting the wilderness.

74:15 you didst cleave the fountain and the flood: you driedst up
mighty rivers.

74:16 The day is yours, the night also is yours: you hast prepared the
light and the sun.

74:17 you hast set all the borders of the earth: you hast made summer
and winter.

74:18 Remember this, that the enemy has reproached, O LORD[JESUS], and that
the foolish people have blasphemed your name.

74:19 O deliver not the soul of your turtledove unto the multitude of the
wicked: forget not the congregation of your poor for ever.

74:20 Have respect unto the covenant: for the dark places of the earth
are full of the habitations of cruelty.

74:21 O let not the oppressed return ashamed: let the poor and needy
praise your name.

74:22 Arise, O GOD[JESUS], plead yours own cause: remember how the foolish man
reproacheth you daily.

74:23 Forget not the voice of yours enemies: the tumult of those that
rise up against you increaseth continually.


75:1 Unto you, O GOD[JESUS], do we give thanks, unto you do we give thanks:
for that your name is near your wondrous works declare.

75:2 When I shall receive the congregation I will judge uprightly.

75:3 The earth and all the inhabitants thereof are dissolved: I bear up
the pillars of it. Selah.

75:4 I said unto the fools, Deal not foolishly: and to the wicked, Lift
not up the horn:

75:5 Lift not up your horn on high: speak not with a stiff neck.

75:6 For promotion comes neither from the east, nor from the west, nor
from the south.

75:7 But GOD[JESUS] is the judge: HE[JESUS] putteth down one, and setteth up another.

75:8 For in the hand of the LORD[JESUS] there is a cup, and the wine is red; it
is full of mixture; and HE[JESUS] poureth out of the same: but the dregs
thereof, all the wicked of the earth shall wring them out, and drink
them.

75:9 But I will declare for ever; I will sing praises to the GOD[JESUS] of
Jacob.

75:10 All the horns of the wicked also will I cut off; but the horns of
the righteous shall be exalted.


76:1 In Judah is GOD[JESUS] known: HIS[JESUS] name is great in Israel.

76:2 In Salem also is HIS[JESUS] tabernacle, and HIS[JESUS] dwelling place in Zion.

76:3 There brake HE[JESUS] the arrows of the bow, the shield, and the sword,
and the battle. Selah.

76:4 you art more glorious and excellent than the mountains of prey.

76:5 The stouthearted are spoiled, they have slept their sleep: and none
of the men of might have found their hands.

76:6 At your rebuke, O GOD[JESUS] of Jacob, both the chariot and horse are cast
into a dead sleep.

76:7 you, even you, art to be feared: and who may stand in your sight

76:8 you didst cause judgment to be heard from heaven; the earth
feared, and was still,

76:9 When GOD[JESUS] arose to judgment, to save all the meek of the earth.
Selah.

76:10 Surely the wrath of man shall praise you: the remainder of wrath
shalt you restrain.

HIM[JESUS] bring presents unto HIM[JESUS] that ought to be feared.

76:12 HE[JESUS] shall cut off the spirit of princes: HE[JESUS] is terrible to the

gave ear unto me.

77:2 In the day of my trouble I sought the LORD[JESUS]: my sore ran in the
night, and ceased not: my soul refused to be comforted.

77:3 I remembered GOD[JESUS], and was troubled: I complained, and my spirit was
overwhelmed. Selah.

77:4 you holdest mine eyes waking: I am so troubled that I cannot
speak.

77:5 I have considered the days of old, the years of ancient times.

77:6 I call to remembrance my song in the night: I commune with mine own
heart: and my spirit made diligent search.

77:7 Will the LORD[JESUS] cast off for ever? and will HE[JESUS] be favourable no more?

77:8 Is HIS[JESUS] mercy clean gone for ever? does HIS[JESUS] promise fail for
evermore?

77:9 has GOD[JESUS] forgotten to be gracious? has HE[JESUS] in anger shut up HIS[JESUS]
tender mercies? Selah.

77:10 And I said, This is my infirmity: but I will remember the years of
the right hand of the most High.

77:11 I will remember the works of the LORD[JESUS]: surely I will remember your
wonders of old.

77:12 I will meditate also of all your work, and talk of your doings.

77:13 your way, O GOD[JESUS], is in the sanctuary: who is so great a GOD[JESUS] as our
GOD[JESUS]?

77:14 you art the GOD[JESUS] that doest wonders: you hast declared your
strength among the people.

77:15 you hast with yours arm redeemed your people, the sons of Jacob
and Joseph. Selah.

77:16 The waters saw you, O GOD[JESUS], the waters saw you; they were afraid:
the depths also were troubled.

77:17 The clouds poured out water: the skies sent out a sound: yours

77:18 The voice of your thunder was in the heaven: the lightnings

77:19 your way is in the sea, and your path in the great waters, and your
footsteps are not known.

77:20 you leddest your people like a flock by the hand of Moses and

my mouth.

78:2 I will open my mouth in a parable: I will utter dark sayings of
old:

78:3 Which we have heard and known, and our fathers have told us.

78:4 We will not hide them from their children, shewing to the
generation to come the praises of the LORD[JESUS], and HIS[JESUS] strength, and HIS[JESUS]
WONDERFUL[JESUS] works that HE[JESUS] has done.

78:5 For HE[JESUS] established a testimony in Jacob, and appointed a law in
Israel, which HE[JESUS] commanded our fathers, that they should make them known
to their children:

78:6 That the generation to come might know them, even the children
which should be born; who should arise and declare them to their
children:

78:7 That they might set their hope in GOD[JESUS], and not forget the works of
GOD[JESUS], but keep HIS[JESUS] commandments:

78:8 And might not be as their fathers, a stubborn and rebellious
generation; a generation that set not their heart aright, and whose

78:9 The children of Ephraim, being armed, and carrying bows, turned
back in the day of battle.

78:10 They kept not the covenant of GOD[JESUS], and refused to walk in HIS[JESUS] law;

78:11 And forgat HIS[JESUS] works, and HIS[JESUS] wonders that HE[JESUS] had shewed them.

78:12 Marvellous things did HE[JESUS] in the sight of their fathers, in the
land of Egypt, in the field of Zoan.

78:13 HE[JESUS] divided the sea, and caused them to pass through; and HE[JESUS] made
the waters to stand as an heap.

78:14 In the daytime also HE[JESUS] led them with a cloud, and all the night
with a light of fire.

78:15 HE[JESUS] clave the rocks in the wilderness, and gave them drink as out
of the great depths.

78:16 HE[JESUS] brought streams also out of the rock, and caused waters to run
down like rivers.

78:17 And they sinned yet more against HIM[JESUS] by provoking the most High in
the wilderness.

78:18 And they tempted GOD[JESUS] in their heart by asking meat for their lust.

78:19 Yea, they spake against GOD[JESUS]; they said, Can GOD[JESUS] furnish a table in
the wilderness?

78:20 Behold, HE[JESUS] smote the rock, that the waters gushed out, and the
streams overflowed; can HE[JESUS] give bread also? can HE[JESUS] provide flesh for HIS[JESUS]
people?

78:21 Therefore the LORD[JESUS] heard this, and was wroth: so a fire was
kindled against Jacob, and anger also came up against Israel;

78:22 Because they believed not in GOD[JESUS], and trusted not in HIS[JESUS]
salvation:

78:23 Though HE[JESUS] had commanded the clouds from above, and opened the
doors of heaven,

78:24 And had rained down manna upon them to eat, and had given them of
the corn of heaven.

78:25 Man did eat angels' food: HE[JESUS] sent them meat to the full.

78:26 HE[JESUS] caused an east wind to blow in the heaven: and by HIS[JESUS] power HE[JESUS]
brought in the south wind.

78:27 HE[JESUS] rained flesh also upon them as dust, and feathered fowls like
as the sand of the sea:

78:28 And HE[JESUS] let it fall in the midst of their camp, round about their
habitations.

78:29 So they did eat, and were well filled: for HE[JESUS] gave them their own
desire;

78:30 They were not estranged from their lust. But while their meat was
yet in their mouths,

78:31 The wrath of GOD[JESUS] came upon them, and slew the fattest of them, and
smote down the chosen men of Israel.

78:32 For all this they sinned still, and believed not for HIS[JESUS] wondrous
works.

78:33 Therefore their days did HE[JESUS] consume in vanity, and their years in
trouble.

78:34 When HE[JESUS] slew them, then they sought HIM[JESUS]: and they returned and
enquired early after GOD[JESUS].

78:35 And they remembered that GOD[JESUS] was their rock, and the high GOD[JESUS]
their redeemer.

78:36 Nevertheless they did flatter HIM[JESUS] with their mouth, and they lied
unto HIM[JESUS] with their tongues.

78:37 For their heart was not right with HIM[JESUS], neither were they stedfast
in HIS[JESUS] covenant.

78:38 But HE[JESUS], being full of compassion, forgave their iniquity, and
destroyed them not: yea, many a time turned HE[JESUS] HIS[JESUS] anger away, and did
not stir up all HIS[JESUS] wrath.

78:39 For HE[JESUS] remembered that they were but flesh; a wind that passeth
away, and comes not again.

78:40 How oft did they provoke HIM[JESUS] in the wilderness, and grieve HIM[JESUS] in
the desert!

78:41 Yea, they turned back and tempted GOD[JESUS], and limited the Holy One of
Israel.

78:42 They remembered not HIS[JESUS] hand, nor the day when HE[JESUS] delivered them
from the enemy.

78:43 How HE[JESUS] had wrought HIS[JESUS] signs in Egypt, and HIS[JESUS] wonders in the
field of Zoan.

78:44 And had turned their rivers into blood; and their floods, that
they could not drink.

78:45 HE[JESUS] sent divers sorts of flies among them, which devoured them; and
frogs, which destroyed them.

78:46 HE[JESUS] gave also their increase unto the caterpiller, and their labour
unto the locust.

78:47 HE[JESUS] destroyed their vines with hail, and their sycomore trees with
frost.

78:48 HE[JESUS] gave up their cattle also to the hail, and their flocks to hot
thunderbolts.

78:49 HE[JESUS] cast upon them the fierceness of HIS[JESUS] anger, wrath, and
indignation, and trouble, by sending evil angels among them.

78:50 HE[JESUS] made a way to HIS[JESUS] anger; HE[JESUS] spared not their soul from death,
but gave their life over to the pestilence;

78:51 And smote all the firstborn in Egypt; the chief of their strength
in the tabernacles of Ham:

78:52 But made HIS[JESUS] own people to go forth like sheep, and guided them in
the wilderness like a flock.

78:53 And HE[JESUS] led them on safely, so that they feared not: but the sea
overwhelmed their enemies.

78:54 And HE[JESUS] brought them to the border of HIS[JESUS] sanctuary, even to this
mountain, which HIS[JESUS] right hand had purchased.

78:55 HE[JESUS] cast out the heathen also before them, and divided them an
inheritance by line, and made the tribes of Israel to dwell in their
tents.

78:56 Yet they tempted and provoked the most high GOD[JESUS], and kept not HIS[JESUS]
testimonies:

78:57 But turned back, and dealt unfaithfully like their fathers: they
were turned aside like a deceitful bow.

78:58 For they provoked HIM[JESUS] to anger with their high places, and moved
HIM[JESUS] to jealousy with their graven images.

78:59 When GOD[JESUS] heard this, HE[JESUS] was wroth, and greatly abhorred Israel:

78:60 So that HE[JESUS] forsook the tabernacle of SHILOH[JESUS], the tent which HE[JESUS]
placed among men;

78:61 And delivered HIS[JESUS] strength into captivity, and HIS[JESUS] glory into the
enemy's hand.

78:62 HE[JESUS] gave HIS[JESUS] people over also unto the sword; and was wroth with
HIS[JESUS] inheritance.

78:63 The fire consumed their young men; and their maidens were not
given to marriage.

78:64 Their priests fell by the sword; and their widows made no
lamentation.

78:65 Then the LORD[JESUS] awaked as one out of sleep, and like a mighty man
that shouteth by reason of wine.

78:66 And HE[JESUS] smote HIS[JESUS] enemies in the hinder parts: HE[JESUS] put them to a
perpetual reproach.

78:67 Moreover HE[JESUS] refused the tabernacle of Joseph, and chose not the
tribe of Ephraim:

78:68 But chose the tribe of Judah, the mount Zion which HE[JESUS] loved.

78:69 And HE[JESUS] built HIS[JESUS] sanctuary like high palaces, like the earth which
HE[JESUS] has established for ever.

78:70 HE[JESUS] chose David also HIS[JESUS] SERVANT[JESUS], and took HIM[JESUS] from the sheepfolds:

78:71 From following the ewes great with young HE[JESUS] brought HIM[JESUS] to feed
Jacob HIS[JESUS] people, and Israel HIS[JESUS] inheritance.

78:72 So HE[JESUS] fed them according to the integrity of HIS[JESUS] heart; and guided
them by the skilfulness of HIS[JESUS] hands.


79:1 O GOD[JESUS], the heathen are come into yours inheritance; your holy temple
have they defiled; they have laid Jerusalem on heaps.

79:2 The dead bodies of your servants have they given to be meat unto the
fowls of the heaven, the flesh of your saints unto the beasts of the
earth.

79:3 Their blood have they shed like water round about Jerusalem; and
there was none to bury them.

79:4 We are become a reproach to our neighbours, a scorn and derision to
them that are round about us.

79:5 How long, LORD[JESUS]? wilt you be angry for ever? shall your jealousy
burn like fire?

79:6 Pour out your wrath upon the heathen that have not known you, and
upon the kingdoms that have not called upon your name.

79:7 For they have devoured Jacob, and laid waste HIS[JESUS] dwelling place.

79:8 O remember not against us former iniquities: let your tender mercies
speedily precede us: for we are brought very low.

79:9 Help us, O GOD[JESUS] of our salvation, for the glory of your name: and
deliver us, and purge away our sins, for your name's sake.

79:10 Wherefore should the heathen say, Where is their GOD[JESUS]? let HIM[JESUS] be
known among the heathen in our sight by the revenging of the blood of
your servants which is shed.

79:11 Let the sighing of the prisoner come before you; according to the
greatness of your power preserve you those that are appointed to die;

79:12 And render unto our neighbours sevenfold into their bosom their
reproach, wherewith they have reproached you, O LORD[JESUS].

79:13 So we your people and sheep of your pasture will give you thanks
for ever: we will shew forth your praise to all generations.

80:7 Turn us again, O GOD[JESUS] of hosts, and cause your face to shine; and we

80:17 Let your hand be upon the man of your right hand, upon the SON[JESUS] of

80:18 So will not we go back from you: quicken us, and we will call

80:19 Turn us again, O LORD[JESUS] GOD[JESUS] of hosts, cause your face to shine; and
we shall be saved.

90:1 LORD[JESUS], you hast been our dwelling place in all generations.

90:2 Before the mountains were brought forth, or ever you hadst formed
the earth and the world, even from everlasting to everlasting, you art
GOD[JESUS].

90:3 you turnest man to destruction; and sayest, Return, you children of
men.

90:4 For a thousand years in your sight are but as yesterday when it is
past, and as a watch in the night.

90:5 you carriest them away as with a flood; they are as a sleep: in
the morning they are like grass which groweth up.

90:6 In the morning it flourisheth, and groweth up; in the evening it is
cut down, and withereth.

90:7 For we are consumed by yours anger, and by your wrath are we
troubled.

90:8 you hast set our iniquities before you, our secret sins in the
light of your countenance.

90:9 For all our days are passed away in your wrath: we spend our years
as a tale that is told.

90:10 The days of our years are threescore years and ten; and if by
reason of strength they be fourscore years, yet is their strength labour
and sorrow; for it is soon cut off, and we fly away.

90:11 Who knoweth the power of yours anger? even according to your fear,
so is your wrath.

90:12 So teach us to number our days, that we may apply our hearts unto
wisdom.

90:13 Return, O LORD[JESUS], how long? and let it repent you concerning your
servants.

90:14 O satisfy us early with your mercy; that we may rejoice and be glad
all our days.

90:15 Make us glad according to the days wherein you hast afflicted us,
and the years wherein we have seen evil.

90:16 Let your work appear unto your servants, and your glory unto their
children.

102:2 Hide not your face from me in the day when I am in trouble; incline
yours ear unto me: in the day when I call answer me speedily.

102:3 For my days are consumed like smoke, and my bones are burned as an
hearth.

102:4 My heart is smitten, and withered like grass; so that I forget to
eat my bread.

102:5 By reason of the voice of my groaning my bones cleave to my skin.

102:6 I am like a pelican of the wilderness: I am like an owl of the
desert.

102:7 I watch, and am as a sparrow alone upon the house top.

102:8 Mine enemies reproach me all the day; and they that are mad
against me are sworn against me.

102:9 For I have eaten ashes like bread, and mingled my drink with
weeping.

102:10 Because of yours indignation and your wrath: for you hast lifted
me up, and cast me down.

all generations.

102:17 HE[JESUS] will regard the prayer of the destitute, and not despise their

102:22 When the people are gathered together, and the kingdoms, to serve

102:23 HE[JESUS] weakened my strength in the way; HE[JESUS] shortened my days.

102:24 I said, O my GOD[JESUS], take me not away in the midst of my days: your

104:24 O LORD[JESUS], how manifold are your works! in wisdom hast you made them

105:20 The KING[JESUS] sent and loosed HIM[JESUS]; even the ruler of the people, and
let HIM[JESUS] go free.

105:21 HE[JESUS] made HIM[JESUS] LORD[JESUS] of HIS[JESUS] house, and ruler of all HIS[JESUS] substance:

105:22 To bind HIS[JESUS] princes at HIS[JESUS] pleasure; and teach HIS[JESUS] senators
wisdom.

105:23 Israel also came into Egypt; and Jacob sojourned in the land of
Ham.

105:24 And HE[JESUS] increased HIS[JESUS] people greatly; and made them stronger than
their enemies.

105:25 HE[JESUS] turned their heart to hate HIS[JESUS] people, to deal subtilly with
HIS[JESUS] servants.

105:26 HE[JESUS] sent Moses HIS[JESUS] SERVANT[JESUS]; and Aaron whom HE[JESUS] had chosen.

105:27 They shewed HIS[JESUS] signs among them, and wonders in the land of Ham.

105:28 HE[JESUS] sent darkness, and made it dark; and they rebelled not against
HIS[JESUS] WORD[JESUS].

105:29 HE[JESUS] turned their waters into blood, and slew their fish.

105:30 Their land brought forth frogs in abundance, in the chambers of
their kings.

105:31 HE[JESUS] spake, and there came divers sorts of flies, and lice in all
their coasts.

105:32 HE[JESUS] gave them hail for rain, and flaming fire in their land.

105:33 HE[JESUS] smote their vines also and their fig trees; and brake the
trees of their coasts.

105:34 HE[JESUS] spake, and the locusts came, and caterpillers, and that
without number,

105:35 And did eat up all the herbs in their land, and devoured the
fruit of their ground.

105:36 HE[JESUS] smote also all the firstborn in their land, the chief of all
their strength.

105:37 HE[JESUS] brought them forth also with silver and gold: and there was
not one feeble person among their tribes.

105:38 Egypt was glad when they departed: for the fear of them fell upon
them.

105:39 HE[JESUS] spread a cloud for a covering; and fire to give light in the
night.

105:40 The people asked, and HE[JESUS] brought quails, and satisfied them with
the bread of heaven.

105:41 HE[JESUS] opened the rock, and the waters gushed out; they ran in the
dry places like a river.

105:42 For HE[JESUS] remembered HIS[JESUS] holy promise, and Abraham HIS[JESUS] SERVANT[JESUS].

105:43 And HE[JESUS] brought forth HIS[JESUS] people with joy, and HIS[JESUS] chosen with
gladness:

105:44 And gave them the lands of the heathen: and they inherited the
labour of the people;

105:45 That they might observe HIS[JESUS] statutes, and keep HIS[JESUS] laws. Praise
you the LORD[JESUS].


106:1 Praise you the LORD[JESUS]. O give thanks unto the LORD[JESUS]; for HE[JESUS] is good:
for HIS[JESUS] mercy endureth for ever.

106:2 Who can utter the mighty acts of the LORD[JESUS]? who can shew forth all
HIS[JESUS] praise?

106:3 Blessed are they that keep judgment, and HE[JESUS] that doeth
righteousness at all times.

106:4 Remember me, O LORD[JESUS], with the favour that you bearest unto your
people: O visit me with your salvation;

106:5 That I may see the good of your chosen, that I may rejoice in the
gladness of your nation, that I may glory with yours inheritance.

106:6 We have sinned with our fathers, we have committed iniquity, we
have done wickedly.

106:7 Our fathers understood not your wonders in Egypt; they remembered
not the multitude of your mercies; but provoked HIM[JESUS] at the sea, even at
the Red sea.

106:8 Nevertheless HE[JESUS] saved them for HIS[JESUS] name's sake, that HE[JESUS] might make
HIS[JESUS] mighty power to be known.

106:9 HE[JESUS] rebuked the Red sea also, and it was dried up: so HE[JESUS] led them
through the depths, as through the wilderness.

106:10 And HE[JESUS] saved them from the hand of HIM[JESUS] that hated them, and
redeemed them from the hand of the enemy.

106:11 And the waters covered their enemies: there was not one of them
left.

106:12 Then believed they HIS[JESUS] words; they sang HIS[JESUS] praise.

106:13 They soon forgat HIS[JESUS] works; they waited not for HIS[JESUS] counsel:

106:14 But lusted exceedingly in the wilderness, and tempted GOD[JESUS] in the
desert.

106:15 And HE[JESUS] gave them their request; but sent leanness into their
soul.

106:16 They envied Moses also in the camp, and Aaron the saint of the
LORD[JESUS].

106:17 The earth opened and swallowed up Dathan and covered the company
of Abiram.

106:18 And a fire was kindled in their company; the flame burned up the
wicked.

106:19 They made a calf in Horeb, and worshipped the molten image.

106:20 Thus they changed their glory into the similitude of an ox that
eateth grass.

106:21 They forgat GOD[JESUS] their saviour, which had done great things in
Egypt;

106:22 Wondrous works in the land of Ham, and terrible things by the Red
sea.

106:23 Therefore HE[JESUS] said that HE[JESUS] would destroy them, had not Moses HIS[JESUS]
chosen stood before HIM[JESUS] in the breach, to turn away HIS[JESUS] wrath, lest HE[JESUS]
should destroy them.

106:24 Yea, they despised the pleasant land, they believed not HIS[JESUS] WORD[JESUS]:

106:25 But murmured in their tents, and hearkened not unto the voice of
the LORD[JESUS].

106:26 Therefore HE[JESUS] lifted up HIS[JESUS] hand against them, to overthrow them
in the wilderness:

106:27 To overthrow their SEED[JESUS] also among the nations, and to scatter
them in the lands.

106:28 They joined themselves also unto Baalpeor, and ate the sacrifices
of the dead.

106:29 Thus they provoked HIM[JESUS] to anger with their inventions: and the
plague brake in upon them.

106:30 Then stood up Phinehas, and executed judgment: and so the plague
was stayed.

106:31 And that was counted unto HIM[JESUS] for righteousness unto all
generations for evermore.

106:32 They angered HIM[JESUS] also at the waters of strife, so that it went
ill with Moses for their sakes:

106:33 Because they provoked HIS[JESUS] spirit, so that HE[JESUS] spake unadvisedly
with HIS[JESUS] lips.

106:34 They did not destroy the nations, concerning whom the LORD[JESUS]
commanded them:

106:35 But were mingled among the heathen, and learned their works.

106:36 And they served their idols: which were a snare unto them.

106:37 Yea, they sacrificed their sons and their daughters unto devils,

106:38 And shed innocent blood, even the blood of their sons and of
their daughters, whom they sacrificed unto the idols of Canaan: and the
land was polluted with blood.

106:39 Thus were they defiled with their own works, and went a whoring
with their own inventions.

106:40 Therefore was the wrath of the LORD[JESUS] kindled against HIS[JESUS] people,
insomuch that HE[JESUS] abhorred HIS[JESUS] own inheritance.

106:41 And HE[JESUS] gave them into the hand of the heathen; and they that
hated them ruled over them.

106:42 Their enemies also oppressed them, and they were brought into
subjection under their hand.

106:43 Many times did HE[JESUS] deliver them; but they provoked HIM[JESUS] with their
counsel, and were brought low for their iniquity.

106:44 Nevertheless HE[JESUS] regarded their affliction, when HE[JESUS] heard their
cry:

106:45 And HE[JESUS] remembered for them HIS[JESUS] covenant, and repented according
to the multitude of HIS[JESUS] mercies.

106:46 HE[JESUS] made them also to be pitied of all those that carried them
captives.

106:47 Save us, O LORD[JESUS] our GOD[JESUS], and gather us from among the heathen, to
give thanks unto your holy name, and to triumph in your praise.

106:48 Blessed be the LORD[JESUS] GOD[JESUS] of Israel from everlasting to
everlasting: and let all the people say, Amen. Praise you the LORD[JESUS].


107:1 O give thanks unto the LORD[JESUS], for HE[JESUS] is good: for HIS[JESUS] mercy
endureth for ever.

107:2 Let the redeemed of the LORD[JESUS] say so, whom HE[JESUS] has redeemed from
the hand of the enemy;

107:3 And gathered them out of the lands, from the east, and from the
west, from the north, and from the south.

107:4 They wandered in the wilderness in a solitary way; they found no
city to dwell in.

107:5 Hungry and thirsty, their soul fainted in them.

107:6 Then they cried unto the LORD[JESUS] in their trouble, and HE[JESUS] delivered
them out of their distresses.

107:7 And HE[JESUS] led them forth by the right way, that they might go to a
city of habitation.

107:8 Oh that men would praise the LORD[JESUS] for HIS[JESUS] goodness, and for HIS[JESUS]
WONDERFUL[JESUS] works to the children of men!

107:9 For HE[JESUS] satisfieth the longing soul, and filleth the hungry soul
with goodness.

107:10 Such as sit in darkness and in the shadow of death, being bound
in affliction and iron;

107:11 Because they rebelled against the words of GOD[JESUS], and contemned the
counsel of the most High:

107:12 Therefore HE[JESUS] brought down their heart with labour; they fell
down, and there was none to help.

107:13 Then they cried unto the LORD[JESUS] in their trouble, and HE[JESUS] saved them
out of their distresses.

107:14 HE[JESUS] brought them out of darkness and the shadow of death, and
brake their bands in sunder.

107:15 Oh that men would praise the LORD[JESUS] for HIS[JESUS] goodness, and for HIS[JESUS]
WONDERFUL[JESUS] works to the children of men!

107:16 For HE[JESUS] has broken the gates of brass, and cut the bars of iron
in sunder.

107:17 Fools because of their transgression, and because of their
iniquities, are afflicted.

107:18 Their soul abhorreth all manner of meat; and they draw near unto
the gates of death.

107:19 Then they cry unto the LORD[JESUS] in their trouble, and HE[JESUS] saveth them
out of their distresses.

107:20 HE[JESUS] sent HIS[JESUS] WORD[JESUS], and healed them, and delivered them from their
destructions.

107:21 Oh that men would praise the LORD[JESUS] for HIS[JESUS] goodness, and for HIS[JESUS]
WONDERFUL[JESUS] works to the children of men!

107:22 And let them sacrifice the sacrifices of thanksgiving, and
declare HIS[JESUS] works with rejoicing.

107:23 They that go down to the sea in ships, that do business in great
waters;

107:24 These see the works of the LORD[JESUS], and HIS[JESUS] wonders in the deep.

107:25 For HE[JESUS] commandeth, and raiseth the stormy wind, which lifteth up
the waves thereof.

107:26 They mount up to the heaven, they go down again to the depths:
their soul is melted because of trouble.

107:27 They reel to and fro, and stagger like a drunken man, and are at
their wit's end.

107:28 Then they cry unto the LORD[JESUS] in their trouble, and HE[JESUS] bringeth
them out of their distresses.

107:29 HE[JESUS] makes the storm a calm, so that the waves thereof are still.

107:30 Then are they glad because they be quiet; so HE[JESUS] bringeth them
unto their desired haven.

107:31 Oh that men would praise the LORD[JESUS] for HIS[JESUS] goodness, and for HIS[JESUS]
WONDERFUL[JESUS] works to the children of men!

107:32 Let them exalt HIM[JESUS] also in the congregation of the people, and
praise HIM[JESUS] in the assembly of the elders.

107:33 HE[JESUS] turneth rivers into a wilderness, and the watersprings into
dry ground;

107:34 A fruitful land into barrenness, for the wickedness of them that
dwell therein.

107:35 HE[JESUS] turneth the wilderness into a standing water, and dry ground
into watersprings.

107:36 And there HE[JESUS] makes the hungry to dwell, that they may prepare a
city for habitation;

107:37 And sow the fields, and plant vineyards, which may yield fruits
of increase.

107:38 HE[JESUS] blesseth them also, so that they are multiplied greatly; and
suffereth not their cattle to decrease.

107:39 Again, they are minished and brought low through oppression,
affliction, and sorrow.

107:40 HE[JESUS] poureth contempt upon princes, and causeth them to wander in
the wilderness, where there is no way.

107:41 Yet setteth HE[JESUS] the poor on high from affliction, and makes HIM[JESUS]
families like a flock.

107:42 The righteous shall see it, and rejoice: and all iniquity shall
stop her mouth.

107:43 whoever is wise, and will observe these things, even they shall
understand the lovingkindness of the LORD[JESUS].

my glory.

praises unto you among the nations.

108:4 For your mercy is great above the heavens: and your truth reacheth
unto the clouds.

108:5 Be you exalted, O GOD[JESUS], above the heavens: and your glory above all
the earth;

108:6 That your beloved may be delivered: save with your right hand, and

108:7 GOD[JESUS] has spoken in HIS[JESUS] holiness; I will rejoice, I will divide

108:12 Give us help from trouble: for vain is the help of man.

109:1 Hold not your peace, O GOD[JESUS] of my praise;

109:2 For the mouth of the wicked and the mouth of the deceitful are
opened against me: they have spoken against me with a lying tongue.

109:3 They compassed me about also with words of hatred; and fought
against me without a cause.

109:4 For my love they are my adversaries: but I give myself unto
prayer.

109:5 And they have rewarded me evil for good, and hatred for my love.

109:6 Set you a wicked man over HIM[JESUS]: and let Satan stand at HIS[JESUS] right
hand.

109:7 When HE[JESUS] shall be judged, let HIM[JESUS] be condemned: and let HIS[JESUS] prayer
become sin.

109:8 Let HIS[JESUS] days be few; and let another take HIS[JESUS] office.

109:9 Let HIS[JESUS] children be fatherless, and HIS[JESUS] wife a widow.

109:10 Let HIS[JESUS] children be continually vagabonds, and beg: let them seek
their bread also out of their desolate places.

109:11 Let the extortioner catch all that HE[JESUS] has; and let the strangers
spoil HIS[JESUS] labour.

109:12 Let there be none to extend mercy unto HIM[JESUS]: neither let there be
any to favour HIS[JESUS] fatherless children.

109:13 Let HIS[JESUS] posterity be cut off; and in the generation following let
their name be blotted out.

109:14 Let the iniquity of HIS[JESUS] fathers be remembered with the LORD[JESUS]; and
let not the sin of HIS[JESUS] mother be blotted out.

109:15 Let them be before the LORD[JESUS] continually, that HE[JESUS] may cut off the
memory of them from the earth.

109:16 Because that HE[JESUS] remembered not to shew mercy, but persecuted the
poor and needy man, that HE[JESUS] might even slay the broken in heart.

109:17 As HE[JESUS] loved cursing, so let it come unto HIM[JESUS]: as HE[JESUS] delighted not
in blessing, so let it be far from HIM[JESUS].

109:18 As HE[JESUS] clothed himself with cursing like as with HIS[JESUS] garment, so
let it come into HIS[JESUS] bowels like water, and like oil into HIS[JESUS] bones.

109:19 Let it be unto HIM[JESUS] as the garment which covereth HIM[JESUS], and for a
girdle wherewith HE[JESUS] is girded continually.

109:20 Let this be the reward of mine adversaries from the LORD[JESUS], and of
them that speak evil against my soul.

109:21 But do you for me, O GOD[JESUS] the LORD[JESUS], for your name's sake: because
your mercy is good, deliver you me.

109:22 For I am poor and needy, and my heart is wounded within me.

109:23 I am gone like the shadow when it declineth: I am tossed up and
down as the locust.

109:24 My knees are weak through fasting; and my flesh faileth of
fatness.

109:25 I became also a reproach unto them: when they looked upon me they
shaked their heads.

109:26 Help me, O LORD[JESUS] my GOD[JESUS]: O save me according to your mercy:

109:27 That they may know that this is your hand; that you, LORD[JESUS], hast
done it.

109:28 Let them curse, but bless you: when they arise, let them be
ashamed; but let your SERVANT[JESUS] rejoice.

109:29 Let mine adversaries be clothed with shame, and let them cover
themselves with their own confusion, as with a mantle.

109:30 I will greatly praise the LORD[JESUS] with my mouth; yea, I will praise
HIM[JESUS] among the multitude.

109:31 For HE[JESUS] shall stand at the right hand of the poor, to save HIM[JESUS]
from those that condemn HIS[JESUS] soul.

supplications.

upon HIM[JESUS] as long as I live.

yours handmaid: you hast loosed my bonds.

118:1 O give thanks unto the LORD[JESUS]; for HE[JESUS] is good: because HIS[JESUS] mercy
endureth for ever.

118:5 I called upon the LORD[JESUS] in distress: the LORD[JESUS] answered me, and set
me in a large place.

118:6 The LORD[JESUS] is on my side; I will not fear: what can man do unto me?

118:7 The LORD[JESUS] taketh my part with them that help me: therefore shall I
see my desire upon them that hate me.

118:8 It is better to trust in the LORD[JESUS] than to put confidence in man.

118:9 It is better to trust in the LORD[JESUS] than to put confidence in
princes.

I destroy them.

118:11 They compassed me about; yea, they compassed me about: but in the
name of the LORD[JESUS] I will destroy them.

118:12 They compassed me about like bees: they are quenched as the fire
of thorns: for in the name of the LORD[JESUS] I will destroy them.

118:13 you hast thrust sore at me that I might fall: but the LORD[JESUS]
helped me.

118:14 The LORD[JESUS] is my strength and song, and is become my salvation.

118:15 The voice of rejoicing and salvation is in the tabernacles of the

118:16 The right hand of the LORD[JESUS] is exalted: the right hand of the LORD[JESUS]
doeth valiantly.

118:17 I shall not die, but live, and declare the works of the LORD[JESUS].

118:18 The LORD[JESUS] has chastened me sore: but HE[JESUS] has not given me over
unto death.

118:19 Open to me the gates of righteousness: I will go into them, and I
will praise the LORD[JESUS]:

118:20 This gate of the LORD[JESUS], into which the righteous shall enter.

118:21 I will praise you: for you hast heard me, and art become my
salvation.

118:22 The stone which the builders refused is become the head stone of
the corner.

118:23 This is the LORD[JESUS]'s doing; it is marvellous in our eyes.

118:24 This is the day which the LORD[JESUS] has made; we will rejoice and be
glad in it.

118:25 Save now, I beseech you, O LORD[JESUS]: O LORD[JESUS], I beseech you, send
now prosperity.

118:26 Blessed be HE[JESUS] that comes in the name of the LORD[JESUS]: we have
blessed you out of the house of the LORD[JESUS].

118:27 GOD[JESUS] is the LORD[JESUS], which has shewed us light: bind the sacrifice
with cords, even unto the horns of the altar.

118:28 you art my GOD[JESUS], and I will praise you: you art my GOD[JESUS], I will
exalt you.

118:29 O give thanks unto the LORD[JESUS]; for HE[JESUS] is good: for HIS[JESUS] mercy
endureth for ever.


119:1 Blessed are the undefiled in the way, who walk in the law of the
LORD[JESUS].

119:2 Blessed are they that keep HIS[JESUS] testimonies, and that seek HIM[JESUS] with
the whole heart.

119:3 They also do no iniquity: they walk in HIS[JESUS] ways.

119:4 you hast commanded us to keep your precepts diligently.

119:5 O that my ways were directed to keep your statutes!

119:6 Then shall I not be ashamed, when I have respect unto all your
commandments.

119:7 I will praise you with uprightness of heart, when I shall have
learned your righteous judgments.

119:8 I will keep your statutes: O forsake me not utterly.

119:9 Wherewithal shall a young man cleanse HIS[JESUS] way? by taking heed
thereto according to your WORD[JESUS].

119:10 With my whole heart have I sought you: O let me not wander from
your commandments.

119:11 your WORD[JESUS] have I hid in mine heart, that I might not sin against
you.

119:12 Blessed art you, O LORD[JESUS]: teach me your statutes.

119:13 With my lips have I declared all the judgments of your mouth.

119:14 I have rejoiced in the way of your testimonies, as much as in all
riches.

119:15 I will meditate in your precepts, and have respect unto your ways.

119:16 I will delight myself in your statutes: I will not forget your
WORD[JESUS].

119:17 Deal bountifully with your SERVANT[JESUS], that I may live, and keep your
WORD[JESUS].

119:18 Open you mine eyes, that I may behold wondrous things out of your

119:19 I am a stranger in the earth: hide not your commandments from me.

119:20 My soul breaketh for the longing that it has unto your judgments
at all times.

119:21 you hast rebuked the proud that are cursed, which do err from
your commandments.

119:22 Remove from me reproach and contempt; for I have kept your
testimonies.

119:23 Princes also did sit and speak against me: but your SERVANT[JESUS] did
meditate in your statutes.

119:24 your testimonies also are my delight and my counsellors.

119:25 My soul cleaveth unto the dust: quicken you me according to your
WORD[JESUS].

119:26 I have declared my ways, and you heardest me: teach me your

119:27 Make me to understand the way of your precepts: so shall I talk of
your wondrous works.

119:28 My soul melteth for heaviness: strengthen you me according unto
your WORD[JESUS].

119:29 Remove from me the way of lying: and grant me your law graciously.

119:30 I have chosen the way of truth: your judgments have I laid before
me.

119:31 I have stuck unto your testimonies: O LORD[JESUS], put me not to shame.

119:32 I will run the way of your commandments, when you shalt enlarge
my heart.

119:33 Teach me, O LORD[JESUS], the way of your statutes; and I shall keep it
unto the end.

119:34 Give me understanding, and I shall keep your law; yea, I shall
observe it with my whole heart.

119:35 Make me to go in the path of your commandments; for therein do I
delight.

119:36 Incline my heart unto your testimonies, and not to covetousness.

119:37 Turn away mine eyes from beholding vanity; and quicken you me in
your way.

119:38 Stablish your WORD[JESUS] unto your SERVANT[JESUS], who is devoted to your fear.

119:39 Turn away my reproach which I fear: for your judgments are good.

119:40 Behold, I have longed after your precepts: quicken me in your
righteousness.

119:41 Let your mercies come also unto me, O LORD[JESUS], even your salvation,
according to your WORD[JESUS].

119:42 So shall I have wherewith to answer HIM[JESUS] that reproacheth me: for
I trust in your WORD[JESUS].

119:43 And take not the WORD[JESUS] of truth utterly out of my mouth; for I
have hoped in your judgments.

119:44 So shall I keep your law continually for ever and ever.

119:45 And I will walk at liberty: for I seek your precepts.

119:46 I will speak of your testimonies also before kings, and will not
be ashamed.

119:47 And I will delight myself in your commandments, which I have
loved.

119:48 My hands also will I lift up unto your commandments, which I have
loved; and I will meditate in your statutes.

119:49 Remember the WORD[JESUS] unto your SERVANT[JESUS], upon which you hast caused
me to hope.

119:50 This is my comfort in my affliction: for your WORD[JESUS] has quickened
me.

119:51 The proud have had me greatly in derision: yet have I not
declined from your law.

119:52 I remembered your judgments of old, O LORD[JESUS]; and have comforted

119:53 Horror has taken hold upon me because of the wicked that forsake

119:54 your statutes have been my songs in the house of my pilgrimage.

119:55 I have remembered your name, O LORD[JESUS], in the night, and have kept
your law.

119:56 This I had, because I kept your precepts.

119:57 you art my portion, O LORD[JESUS]: I have said that I would keep your

119:58 I intreated your favour with my whole heart: be merciful unto me
according to your WORD[JESUS].

119:59 I thought on my ways, and turned my feet unto your testimonies.

119:60 I made haste, and delayed not to keep your commandments.

119:61 The bands of the wicked have robbed me: but I have not forgotten
your law.

119:62 At midnight I will rise to give thanks unto you because of your

119:63 I am a companion of all them that fear you, and of them that

119:64 The earth, O LORD[JESUS], is full of your mercy: teach me your statutes.

119:68 you art good, and doest good; teach me your statutes.

119:69 The proud have forged a lie against me: but I will keep your

119:70 Their heart is as fat as grease; but I delight in your law.

119:71 It is good for me that I have been afflicted; that I might learn
your statutes.

119:72 The law of your mouth is better unto me than thousands of gold and

119:78 Let the proud be ashamed; for they dealt perversely with me

119:93 I will never forget your precepts: for with them you hast

119:94 I am yours, save me: for I have sought your precepts.

119:96 I have seen an end of all perfection: but your commandment is

119:97 O how I love your law! it is my meditation all the day.

119:98 you through your commandments hast made me wiser than mine

119:99 I have more understanding than all my teachers: for your

119:100 I understand more than the ancients, because I keep your

119:101 I have refrained my feet from every evil way, that I might keep

119:102 I have not departed from your judgments: for you hast taught me.

119:104 Through your precepts I get understanding: therefore I hate every

119:105 your WORD[JESUS] is a lamp unto my feet, and a light unto my path.

119:111 your testimonies have I taken as an heritage for ever: for they
are the rejoicing of my heart.

119:112 I have inclined mine heart to perform your statutes alway, even

119:113 I hate vain thoughts: but your law do I love.

119:119 you puttest away all the wicked of the earth like dross:

119:120 My flesh trembleth for fear of you; and I am afraid of your

119:121 I have done judgment and justice: leave me not to mine

119:126 It is time for you, LORD[JESUS], to work: for they have made void your

119:129 your testimonies are WONDERFUL[JESUS]: therefore does my soul keep them.

119:137 Righteous art you, O LORD[JESUS], and upright are your judgments.

119:141 I am small and despised: yet do not I forget your precepts.

119:144 The righteousness of your testimonies is everlasting: give me

119:145 I cried with my whole heart; hear me, O LORD[JESUS]: I will keep your

119:146 I cried unto you; save me, and I shall keep your testimonies.

119:147 I prevented the dawning of the morning, and cried: I hoped in

119:148 Mine eyes precede the night watches, that I might meditate in

119:149 Hear my voice according unto your lovingkindness: O LORD[JESUS], quicken

119:150 They draw nigh that follow after mischief: they are far from your

119:151 you art near, O LORD[JESUS]; and all your commandments are truth.

119:152 Concerning your testimonies, I have known of old that you hast

119:153 Consider mine affliction, and deliver me: for I do not forget

119:154 Plead my cause, and deliver me: quicken me according to your

119:155 Salvation is far from the wicked: for they seek not your

119:156 Great are your tender mercies, O LORD[JESUS]: quicken me according to

119:157 Many are my persecutors and mine enemies; yet do I not decline

119:159 Consider how I love your precepts: quicken me, O LORD[JESUS], according

119:160 your WORD[JESUS] is true from the beginning: and every one of your

119:161 Princes have persecuted me without a cause: but my heart

119:162 I rejoice at your WORD[JESUS], as one that findeth great spoil.

119:165 Great peace have they which love your law: and nothing shall

119:167 My soul has kept your testimonies; and I love them exceedingly.

139:1 O LORD[JESUS], you hast searched me, and known me.

139:2 you knowest my downsitting and mine uprising, you understandest
my thought afar off.

139:3 you compassest my path and my lying down, and art acquainted with
all my ways.

139:4 For there is not a WORD[JESUS] in my tongue, but, lo, O LORD[JESUS], you
knowest it altogether.

139:5 you hast beset me behind and before, and laid yours hand upon me.

139:6 Such knowledge is too WONDERFUL[JESUS] for me; it is high, I cannot
attain unto it.

139:7 Whither shall I go from your spirit? or whither shall I flee from
your presence?

139:8 If I ascend up into heaven, you art there: if I make my bed in
hell, behold, you art there.

139:9 If I take the wings of the morning, and dwell in the uttermost
parts of the sea;

139:10 Even there shall your hand lead me, and your right hand shall hold
me.

139:11 If I say, Surely the darkness shall cover me; even the night
shall be light about me.

139:12 Yea, the darkness hideth not from you; but the night shineth as
the day: the darkness and the light are both alike to you.

139:13 For you hast possessed my reins: you hast covered me in my
mother's womb.

139:14 I will praise you; for I am fearfully and wonderfully made:
marvellous are your works; and that my soul knoweth right well.

139:15 My substance was not hid from you, when I was made in secret,
and curiously wrought in the lowest parts of the earth.

139:16 yours eyes did see my substance, yet being unperfect; and in your
book all my members were written, which in continuance were fashioned,
when as yet there was none of them.

139:17 How precious also are your thoughts unto me, O GOD[JESUS]! how great is
the sum of them!

139:18 If I should count them, they are more in number than the sand:
when I awake, I am still with you.

therefore, you bloody men.

name in vain.

with those that rise up against you?

139:22 I hate them with perfect hatred: I count them mine enemies.

thoughts:

139:24 And see if there be any wicked way in me, and lead me in the way

saints; even of the children of Israel, a people near unto HIM[JESUS]. Praise
you the LORD[JESUS].


149:1 Praise you the LORD[JESUS]. Sing unto the LORD[JESUS] a new song, and HIS[JESUS] praise
in the congregation of saints.

149:2 Let Israel rejoice in HIM[JESUS] that made HIM[JESUS]: let the children of Zion
be joyful in their KING[JESUS].

149:3 Let them praise HIS[JESUS] name in the dance: let them sing praises unto
HIM[JESUS] with the timbrel and harp.

149:4 For the LORD[JESUS] taketh pleasure in HIS[JESUS] people: HE[JESUS] will beautify the
meek with salvation.

149:5 Let the saints be joyful in glory: let them sing aloud upon their
beds.

149:6 Let the high praises of GOD[JESUS] be in their mouth, and a two-edged
sword in their hand;

149:7 To execute vengeance upon the heathen, and punishments upon the
people;

149:8 To bind their kings with chains, and their nobles with fetters of
iron;

149:9 To execute upon them the judgment written: this honour have all
HIS[JESUS] saints. Praise you the LORD[JESUS].


150:1 Praise you the LORD[JESUS]. Praise GOD[JESUS] in HIS[JESUS] sanctuary: praise HIM[JESUS] in the
firmament of HIS[JESUS] power.

150:2 Praise HIM[JESUS] for HIS[JESUS] mighty acts: praise HIM[JESUS] according to HIS[JESUS]
excellent greatness.

150:3 Praise HIM[JESUS] with the sound of the trumpet: praise HIM[JESUS] with the
psaltery and harp.

150:4 Praise HIM[JESUS] with the timbrel and dance: praise HIM[JESUS] with stringed
instruments and organs.

150:5 Praise HIM[JESUS] upon the loud cymbals: praise HIM[JESUS] upon the high
sounding cymbals.

150:6 Let every thing that has breath praise the LORD[JESUS]. Praise you the
LORD[JESUS].










Proverbs

Chapter

1:1 The proverbs of Solomon the SON[JESUS] of David, KING[JESUS] of Israel;

1:2 To know wisdom and instruction; to perceive the words of
understanding;

1:3 To receive the instruction of wisdom, justice, and judgment, and
equity;

1:4 To give subtilty to the simple, to the young man knowledge and
discretion.

1:5 A wise man will hear, and will increase learning; and a man of
understanding shall attain unto wise counsels:

1:6 To understand a proverb, and the interpretation; the words of the
wise, and their dark sayings.

1:7 The fear of the LORD[JESUS] is the beginning of knowledge: but fools
despise wisdom and instruction.

1:8 My SON[JESUS], hear the instruction of your father, and forsake not the law
of your mother:

1:9 For they shall be an ornament of grace unto your head, and chains
about your neck.

1:10 My SON[JESUS], if sinners entice you, consent you not.

1:11 If they say, Come with us, let us lay wait for blood, let us lurk
privily for the innocent without cause:

1:12 Let us swallow them up alive as the grave; and whole, as those that
go down into the pit:

1:13 We shall find all precious substance, we shall fill our houses with
spoil:

1:14 Cast in your lot among us; let us all have one purse:

1:15 My SON[JESUS], walk not you in the way with them; refrain your foot from
their path:

1:16 For their feet run to evil, and make haste to shed blood.

1:17 Surely in vain the net is spread in the sight of any bird.

1:18 And they lay wait for their own blood; they lurk privily for their
own lives.

1:19 So are the ways of every one that is greedy of gain; which taketh
away the life of the owners thereof.

1:20 Wisdom crieth without; she uttereth her voice in the streets:

1:21 She crieth in the chief place of concourse, in the openings of the
gates: in the city she uttereth her words, saying,

1:22 How long, you simple ones, will you love simplicity? and the scorners
delight in their scorning, and fools hate knowledge?

1:23 Turn you at my reproof: behold, I will pour out my spirit unto you,
I will make known my words unto you.

1:24 Because I have called, and you refused; I have stretched out my
hand, and no man regarded;

1:25 But you have set at nought all my counsel, and would none of my
reproof:

1:26 I also will laugh at your calamity; I will mock when your fear
comes;

1:27 When your fear comes as desolation, and your destruction comes as
a whirlwind; when distress and anguish comes upon you.

1:28 Then shall they call upon me, but I will not answer; they shall
seek me early, but they shall not find me:

1:29 For that they hated knowledge, and did not choose the fear of the
LORD[JESUS]:

1:30 They would none of my counsel: they despised all my reproof.
