1:31 Therefore shall they eat of the fruit of their own way, and be
filled with their own devices.

1:32 For the turning away of the simple shall slay them, and the
prosperity of fools shall destroy them.

1:33 But whoever hearkeneth unto me shall dwell safely, and shall be quiet
from fear of evil.


2:1 My SON[JESUS], if you wilt receive my words, and hide my commandments with
you;

2:2 So that you incline yours ear unto wisdom, and apply yours heart to
understanding;

2:3 Yea, if you criest after knowledge, and liftest up your voice for
understanding;

2:4 If you seekest her as silver, and searchest for her as for hid
treasures;

2:5 Then shalt you understand the fear of the LORD[JESUS], and find the
knowledge of GOD[JESUS].

2:6 For the LORD[JESUS] giveth wisdom: out of HIS[JESUS] mouth comes knowledge and
understanding.

2:7 HE[JESUS] layeth up sound wisdom for the righteous: HE[JESUS] is a buckler to them
that walk uprightly.

2:8 HE[JESUS] keepeth the paths of judgment, and preserveth the way of HIS[JESUS]
saints.

2:9 Then shalt you understand righteousness, and judgment, and equity;
yea, every good path.

2:10 When wisdom entereth into yours heart, and knowledge is pleasant
unto your soul;

2:11 Discretion shall preserve you, understanding shall keep you:

2:12 To deliver you from the way of the evil man, from the man that
speaketh froward things;

2:13 Who leave the paths of uprightness, to walk in the ways of
darkness;

2:14 Who rejoice to do evil, and delight in the frowardness of the
wicked;

2:15 Whose ways are crooked, and they froward in their paths:

2:16 To deliver you from the strange woman, even from the stranger
which flattereth with her words;

2:17 Which forsaketh the guide of her youth, and forgetteth the covenant
of her GOD[JESUS].

2:18 For her house inclineth unto death, and her paths unto the dead.

2:19 None that go unto her return again, neither take they hold of the
paths of life.

2:20 That you mayest walk in the way of good men, and keep the paths of
the righteous.

2:21 For the upright shall dwell in the land, and the perfect shall
remain in it.

2:22 But the wicked shall be cut off from the earth, and the
transgressors shall be rooted out of it.


3:1 My SON[JESUS], forget not my law; but let yours heart keep my commandments:

3:2 For length of days, and long life, and peace, shall they add to
you.

3:3 Let not mercy and truth forsake you: bind them about your neck;
write them upon the table of yours heart:

3:4 So shalt you find favour and good understanding in the sight of GOD[JESUS]
and man.

3:5 Trust in the LORD[JESUS] with all yours heart; and lean not unto yours own
understanding.

3:6 In all your ways acknowledge HIM[JESUS], and HE[JESUS] shall direct your paths.

3:7 Be not wise in yours own eyes: fear the LORD[JESUS], and depart from evil.

3:8 It shall be health to your navel, and marrow to your bones.

3:9 Honour the LORD[JESUS] with your substance, and with the firstfruits of all
yours increase:

3:10 So shall your barns be filled with plenty, and your presses shall
burst out with new wine.

3:11 My SON[JESUS], despise not the chastening of the LORD[JESUS]; neither be weary of
HIS[JESUS] correction:

3:12 For whom the LORD[JESUS] loveth HE[JESUS] correcteth; even as a father the SON[JESUS] in
whom HE[JESUS] delighteth.

3:13 Happy is the man that findeth wisdom, and the man that getteth
understanding.

3:14 For the merchandise of it is better than the merchandise of silver,
and the gain thereof than fine gold.

3:15 She is more precious than rubies: and all the things you canst
desire are not to be compared unto her.

3:16 Length of days is in her right hand; and in her left hand riches
and honour.

3:17 Her ways are ways of pleasantness, and all her paths are peace.

3:18 She is a tree of life to them that lay hold upon her: and happy is
every one that retaineth her.

3:19 The LORD[JESUS] by wisdom has founded the earth; by understanding has HE[JESUS]
established the heavens.

3:20 By HIS[JESUS] knowledge the depths are broken up, and the clouds drop down
the dew.

3:21 My SON[JESUS], let not them depart from yours eyes: keep sound wisdom and
discretion:

3:22 So shall they be life unto your soul, and grace to your neck.

3:23 Then shalt you walk in your way safely, and your foot shall not
stumble.

3:24 When you liest down, you shalt not be afraid: yea, you shalt lie
down, and your sleep shall be sweet.

3:25 Be not afraid of sudden fear, neither of the desolation of the
wicked, when it comes.

3:26 For the LORD[JESUS] shall be your confidence, and shall keep your foot from
being taken.

3:27 Withhold not good from them to whom it is due, when it is in the
power of yours hand to do it.

3:28 Say not unto your neighbour, Go, and come again, and to morrow I
will give; when you hast it by you.

3:29 Devise not evil against your neighbour, seeing HE[JESUS] dwelleth securely
by you.

3:30 Strive not with a man without cause, if HE[JESUS] have done you no harm.

3:31 Envy you not the oppressor, and choose none of HIS[JESUS] ways.

3:32 For the froward is abomination to the LORD[JESUS]: but HIS[JESUS] secret is with
the righteous.

3:33 The curse of the LORD[JESUS] is in the house of the wicked: but HE[JESUS]
blesseth the habitation of the just.

3:34 Surely HE[JESUS] scorneth the scorners: but HE[JESUS] giveth grace unto the
lowly.

3:35 The wise shall inherit glory: but shame shall be the promotion of
fools.


4:1 Hear, you children, the instruction of a father, and attend to know
understanding.

4:2 For I give you good doctrine, forsake you not my law.

4:3 For I was my father's SON[JESUS], tender and only beloved in the sight of
my mother.

4:4 HE[JESUS] taught me also, and said unto me, Let yours heart retain my
words: keep my commandments, and live.

4:5 Get wisdom, get understanding: forget it not; neither decline from
the words of my mouth.

4:6 Forsake her not, and she shall preserve you: love her, and she
shall keep you.

4:7 Wisdom is the principal thing; therefore get wisdom: and with all
your getting get understanding.

4:8 Exalt her, and she shall promote you: she shall bring you to
honour, when you dost embrace her.

4:9 She shall give to yours head an ornament of grace: a crown of glory
shall she deliver to you.

4:10 Hear, O my SON[JESUS], and receive my sayings; and the years of your life
shall be many.

4:11 I have taught you in the way of wisdom; I have led you in right
paths.

4:12 When you goest, your steps shall not be straitened; and when you
runnest, you shalt not stumble.

4:13 Take fast hold of instruction; let her not go: keep her; for she is
your life.

4:14 Enter not into the path of the wicked, and go not in the way of
evil men.

4:15 Avoid it, pass not by it, turn from it, and pass away.

4:16 For they sleep not, except they have done mischief; and their sleep
is taken away, unless they cause some to fall.

4:17 For they eat the bread of wickedness, and drink the wine of
violence.

4:18 But the path of the just is as the shining light, that shineth more
and more unto the perfect day.

4:19 The way of the wicked is as darkness: they know not at what they
stumble.

4:20 My SON[JESUS], attend to my words; incline yours ear unto my sayings.

4:21 Let them not depart from yours eyes; keep them in the midst of
yours heart.

4:22 For they are life unto those that find them, and health to all
their flesh.

4:23 Keep your heart with all diligence; for out of it are the issues of
life.

4:24 Put away from you a froward mouth, and perverse lips put far from
you.

4:25 Let yours eyes look right on, and let yours eyelids look straight
before you.

4:26 Ponder the path of your feet, and let all your ways be established.

4:27 Turn not to the right hand nor to the left: remove your foot from
evil.


5:1 My SON[JESUS], attend unto my wisdom, and bow yours ear to my
understanding:

5:2 That you mayest regard discretion, and that your lips may keep
knowledge.

5:3 For the lips of a strange woman drop as an honeycomb, and her mouth
is smoother than oil:

5:4 But her end is bitter as wormwood, sharp as a two-edged sword.

5:5 Her feet go down to death; her steps take hold on hell.

5:6 Lest you shouldest ponder the path of life, her ways are moveable,
that you canst not know them.

5:7 Hear me now therefore, O you children, and depart not from the words
of my mouth.

5:8 Remove your way far from her, and come not nigh the door of her
house:

5:9 Lest you give yours honour unto others, and your years unto the
cruel:

5:10 Lest strangers be filled with your wealth; and your labours be in the
house of a stranger;

5:11 And you mourn at the last, when your flesh and your body are
consumed,

5:12 And say, How have I hated instruction, and my heart despised
reproof;

5:13 And have not obeyed the voice of my teachers, nor inclined mine ear
to them that instructed me!

5:14 I was almost in all evil in the midst of the congregation and
assembly.

5:15 Drink waters out of yours own cistern, and running waters out of
yours own well.

5:16 Let your fountains be dispersed abroad, and rivers of waters in the
streets.

5:17 Let them be only yours own, and not strangers' with you.

5:18 Let your fountain be blessed: and rejoice with the wife of your
youth.

5:19 Let her be as the loving hind and pleasant roe; let her breasts
satisfy you at all times; and be you ravished always with her love.

5:20 And why wilt you, my SON[JESUS], be ravished with a strange woman, and
embrace the bosom of a stranger?

5:21 For the ways of man are before the eyes of the LORD[JESUS], and HE[JESUS]
pondereth all HIS[JESUS] goings.

5:22 HIS[JESUS] own iniquities shall take the wicked himself, and HE[JESUS] shall be
holden with the cords of HIS[JESUS] sins.

5:23 HE[JESUS] shall die without instruction; and in the greatness of HIS[JESUS] folly
HE[JESUS] shall go astray.


6:1 My SON[JESUS], if you be surety for your friend, if you hast stricken your
hand with a stranger,

6:2 you art snared with the words of your mouth, you art taken with the
words of your mouth.

6:3 Do this now, my SON[JESUS], and deliver thyself, when you art come into
the hand of your friend; go, humble thyself, and make sure your friend.

6:4 Give not sleep to yours eyes, nor slumber to yours eyelids.

6:5 Deliver thyself as a roe from the hand of the hunter, and as a bird
from the hand of the fowler.

6:6 Go to the ant, you sluggard; consider her ways, and be wise:

6:7 Which having no guide, overseer, or ruler,

6:8 Provideth her meat in the summer, and gathereth her food in the
harvest.

6:9 How long wilt you sleep, O sluggard? when wilt you arise out of
your sleep?

6:10 Yet a little sleep, a little slumber, a little folding of the hands
to sleep:

6:11 So shall your poverty come as one that travelleth, and your want as
an armed man.

6:12 A naughty person, a wicked man, walketh with a froward mouth.

6:13 HE[JESUS] winketh with HIS[JESUS] eyes, HE[JESUS] speaketh with HIS[JESUS] feet, HE[JESUS] teacheth
with HIS[JESUS] fingers;

6:14 Frowardness is in HIS[JESUS] heart, HE[JESUS] deviseth mischief continually; HE[JESUS]
soweth discord.

6:15 Therefore shall HIS[JESUS] calamity come suddenly; suddenly shall HE[JESUS] be
broken without remedy.

6:16 These six things does the LORD[JESUS] hate: yea, seven are an abomination
unto HIM[JESUS]:

6:17 A proud look, a lying tongue, and hands that shed innocent blood,

6:18 An heart that deviseth wicked imaginations, feet that be swift in
running to mischief,

6:19 A false witness that speaketh lies, and HE[JESUS] that soweth discord
among brethren.

6:20 My SON[JESUS], keep your father's commandment, and forsake not the law of
your mother:

6:21 Bind them continually upon yours heart, and tie them about your
neck.

6:22 When you goest, it shall lead you; when you sleepest, it shall
keep you; and when you awakest, it shall talk with you.

6:23 For the commandment is a lamp; and the law is light; and reproofs
of instruction are the way of life:

6:24 To keep you from the evil woman, from the flattery of the tongue
of a strange woman.

6:25 Lust not after her beauty in yours heart; neither let her take you
with her eyelids.

6:26 For by means of a whorish woman a man is brought to a piece of
bread: and the adultress will hunt for the precious life.

6:27 Can a man take fire in HIS[JESUS] bosom, and HIS[JESUS] clothes not be burned?

6:28 Can one go upon hot coals, and HIS[JESUS] feet not be burned?

6:29 So HE[JESUS] that goes in to HIS[JESUS] neighbour's wife; whoever toucheth her
shall not be innocent.

6:30 Men do not despise a thief, if HE[JESUS] steal to satisfy HIS[JESUS] soul when HE[JESUS]
is hungry;

6:31 But if HE[JESUS] be found, HE[JESUS] shall restore sevenfold; HE[JESUS] shall give all
the substance of HIS[JESUS] house.

6:32 But whoever committeth adultery with a woman lacketh understanding:
HE[JESUS] that doeth it destroyeth HIS[JESUS] own soul.

6:33 A wound and dishonour shall HE[JESUS] get; and HIS[JESUS] reproach shall not be
wiped away.

6:34 For jealousy is the rage of a man: therefore HE[JESUS] will not spare in
the day of vengeance.

6:35 HE[JESUS] will not regard any ransom; neither will HE[JESUS] rest content, though
you givest many gifts.


7:1 My SON[JESUS], keep my words, and lay up my commandments with you.

7:2 Keep my commandments, and live; and my law as the apple of yours
eye.

7:3 Bind them upon your fingers, write them upon the table of yours
heart.

7:4 Say unto wisdom, you art my sister; and call understanding your
kinswoman:

7:5 That they may keep you from the strange woman, from the stranger
which flattereth with her words.

7:6 For at the window of my house I looked through my casement,

7:7 And beheld among the simple ones, I discerned among the youths, a
young man void of understanding,

7:8 Passing through the street near her corner; and HE[JESUS] went the way to
her house,

7:9 In the twilight, in the evening, in the black and dark night:

7:10 And, behold, there met HIM[JESUS] a woman with the attire of an harlot,
and subtil of heart.

7:11 (She is loud and stubborn; her feet abide not in her house:

7:12 Now is she without, now in the streets, and lieth in wait at every
corner.)

7:13 So she caught HIM[JESUS], and kissed HIM[JESUS], and with an impudent face said
unto HIM[JESUS],

7:14 I have peace offerings with me; this day have I payed my vows.

7:15 Therefore came I forth to meet you, diligently to seek your face,
and I have found you.

7:16 I have decked my bed with coverings of tapestry, with carved works,
with fine linen of Egypt.

7:17 I have perfumed my bed with myrrh, aloes, and cinnamon.

7:18 Come, let us take our fill of love until the morning: let us solace
ourselves with loves.

7:19 For the goodman is not at home, HE[JESUS] is gone a long journey:

7:20 HE[JESUS] has taken a bag of money with HIM[JESUS], and will come home at the
day appointed.

7:21 With her much fair speech she caused HIM[JESUS] to yield, with the
flattering of her lips she forced HIM[JESUS].

7:22 HE[JESUS] goes after her straightway, as an ox goes to the slaughter, or
as a fool to the correction of the stocks;

7:23 Till a dart strike through HIS[JESUS] liver; as a bird hasteth to the
snare, and knoweth not that it is for HIS[JESUS] life.

7:24 Hearken unto me now therefore, O you children, and attend to the
words of my mouth.

7:25 Let not yours heart decline to her ways, go not astray in her
paths.

7:26 For she has cast down many wounded: yea, many strong men have been
slain by her.

7:27 Her house is the way to hell, going down to the chambers of death.


8:1 does not wisdom cry? and understanding put forth her voice?

8:2 She standeth in the top of high places, by the way in the places of
the paths.

8:3 She crieth at the gates, at the entry of the city, at the coming in
at the doors.

8:4 Unto you, O men, I call; and my voice is to the sons of man.

8:5 O you simple, understand wisdom: and, you fools, be you of an
understanding heart.

8:6 Hear; for I will speak of excellent things; and the opening of my
lips shall be right things.

8:7 For my mouth shall speak truth; and wickedness is an abomination to
my lips.

8:8 All the words of my mouth are in righteousness; there is nothing
froward or perverse in them.

8:9 They are all plain to HIM[JESUS] that understandeth, and right to them that
find knowledge.

8:10 Receive my instruction, and not silver; and knowledge rather than
choice gold.

8:11 For wisdom is better than rubies; and all the things that may be
desired are not to be compared to it.

8:12 I wisdom dwell with prudence, and find out knowledge of witty
inventions.

8:13 The fear of the LORD[JESUS] is to hate evil: pride, and arrogancy, and the
evil way, and the froward mouth, do I hate.

8:14 Counsel is mine, and sound wisdom: I am understanding; I have
strength.

8:15 By me kings reign, and princes decree justice.

8:16 By me princes rule, and nobles, even all the judges of the earth.

8:17 I love them that love me; and those that seek me early shall find
me.

8:18 Riches and honour are with me; yea, durable riches and
righteousness.

8:19 My fruit is better than gold, yea, than fine gold; and my revenue
than choice silver.

8:20 I lead in the way of righteousness, in the midst of the paths of
judgment:

8:21 That I may cause those that love me to inherit substance; and I
will fill their treasures.

8:22 The LORD[JESUS] possessed me in the beginning of HIS[JESUS] way, before HIS[JESUS] works
of old.

8:23 I was set up from everlasting, from the beginning, or ever the
earth was.

8:24 When there were no depths, I was brought forth; when there were no
fountains abounding with water.

8:25 Before the mountains were settled, before the hills was I brought
forth:

8:26 While as yet HE[JESUS] had not made the earth, nor the fields, nor the
highest part of the dust of the world.

8:27 When HE[JESUS] prepared the heavens, I was there: when HE[JESUS] set a compass
upon the face of the depth:

8:28 When HE[JESUS] established the clouds above: when HE[JESUS] strengthened the
fountains of the deep:

8:29 When HE[JESUS] gave to the sea HIS[JESUS] decree, that the waters should not pass
HIS[JESUS] commandment: when HE[JESUS] appointed the foundations of the earth:

8:30 Then I was by HIM[JESUS], as one brought up with HIM[JESUS]: and I was daily HIS[JESUS]
delight, rejoicing always before HIM[JESUS];

8:31 Rejoicing in the habitable part of HIS[JESUS] earth; and my delights were
with the sons of men.

8:32 Now therefore hearken unto me, O you children: for blessed are they
that keep my ways.

8:33 Hear instruction, and be wise, and refuse it not.

8:34 Blessed is the man that heareth me, watching daily at my gates,
waiting at the posts of my doors.

8:35 For whoever findeth me findeth life, and shall obtain favour of the
LORD[JESUS].

8:36 But HE[JESUS] that sinneth against me wrongeth HIS[JESUS] own soul: all they that
hate me love death.


9:1 Wisdom has builded her house, she has hewn out her seven pillars:

9:2 She has killed her beasts; she has mingled her wine; she has also
furnished her table.

9:3 She has sent forth her maidens: she crieth upon the highest places
of the city,

9:4 whoever is simple, let HIM[JESUS] turn in hither: as for HIM[JESUS] that wanteth
understanding, she says to HIM[JESUS],

9:5 Come, eat of my bread, and drink of the wine which I have mingled.

9:6 Forsake the foolish, and live; and go in the way of understanding.

9:7 HE[JESUS] that reproveth a scorner getteth to himself shame: and HE[JESUS] that
rebuketh a wicked man getteth himself a blot.

9:8 Reprove not a scorner, lest HE[JESUS] hate you: rebuke a wise man, and HE[JESUS]
will love you.

9:9 Give instruction to a wise man, and HE[JESUS] will be yet wiser: teach a
just man, and HE[JESUS] will increase in learning.

9:10 The fear of the LORD[JESUS] is the beginning of wisdom: and the knowledge
of the holy is understanding.

9:11 For by me your days shall be multiplied, and the years of your life
shall be increased.

9:12 If you be wise, you shalt be wise for thyself: but if you
scornest, you alone shalt bear it.

9:13 A foolish woman is clamorous: she is simple, and knoweth nothing.

9:14 For she sitteth at the door of her house, on a seat in the high
places of the city,

9:15 To call passengers who go right on their ways:

9:16 whoever is simple, let HIM[JESUS] turn in hither: and as for HIM[JESUS] that
wanteth understanding, she says to HIM[JESUS],

9:17 Stolen waters are sweet, and bread eaten in secret is pleasant.

9:18 But HE[JESUS] knoweth not that the dead are there; and that her guests are
in the depths of hell.


10:1 The proverbs of Solomon. A wise SON[JESUS] makes a glad father: but a
foolish SON[JESUS] is the heaviness of HIS[JESUS] mother.

10:2 Treasures of wickedness profit nothing: but righteousness
delivereth from death.

10:3 The LORD[JESUS] will not let the soul of the righteous to famish: but
HE[JESUS] casteth away the substance of the wicked.

10:4 HE[JESUS] becometh poor that dealeth with a slack hand: but the hand of
the diligent makes rich.

10:5 HE[JESUS] that gathereth in summer is a wise SON[JESUS]: but HE[JESUS] that sleepeth in
harvest is a SON[JESUS] that causeth shame.

10:6 Blessings are upon the head of the just: but violence covereth the
mouth of the wicked.

10:7 The memory of the just is blessed: but the name of the wicked shall
rot.

10:8 The wise in heart will receive commandments: but a prating fool
shall fall.

10:9 HE[JESUS] that walketh uprightly walketh surely: but HE[JESUS] that perverteth
HIS[JESUS] ways shall be known.

10:10 HE[JESUS] that winketh with the eye causeth sorrow: but a prating fool
shall fall.

10:11 The mouth of a righteous man is a well of life: but violence
covereth the mouth of the wicked.

10:12 Hatred stirreth up strifes: but love covereth all sins.

10:13 In the lips of HIM[JESUS] that has understanding wisdom is found: but a
rod is for the back of HIM[JESUS] that is void of understanding.

10:14 Wise men lay up knowledge: but the mouth of the foolish is near
destruction.

10:15 The rich man's wealth is HIS[JESUS] strong city: the destruction of the
poor is their poverty.

10:16 The labour of the righteous tendeth to life: the fruit of the
wicked to sin.

10:17 HE[JESUS] is in the way of life that keepeth instruction: but HE[JESUS] that
refuseth reproof erreth.

10:18 HE[JESUS] that hideth hatred with lying lips, and HE[JESUS] that uttereth a
slander, is a fool.

10:19 In the multitude of words there wanteth not sin: but HE[JESUS] that
refraineth HIS[JESUS] lips is wise.

10:20 The tongue of the just is as choice silver: the heart of the
wicked is little worth.

10:21 The lips of the righteous feed many: but fools die for want of
wisdom.

10:22 The blessing of the LORD[JESUS], it makes rich, and HE[JESUS] addeth no sorrow
with it.

10:23 It is as sport to a fool to do mischief: but a man of
understanding has wisdom.

10:24 The fear of the wicked, it shall come upon HIM[JESUS]: but the desire of
the righteous shall be granted.

10:25 As the whirlwind passeth, so is the wicked no more: but the
righteous is an everlasting foundation.

10:26 As vinegar to the teeth, and as smoke to the eyes, so is the
sluggard to them that send HIM[JESUS].

10:27 The fear of the LORD[JESUS] prolongeth days: but the years of the wicked
shall be shortened.

10:28 The hope of the righteous shall be gladness: but the expectation
of the wicked shall perish.

10:29 The way of the LORD[JESUS] is strength to the upright: but destruction
shall be to the workers of iniquity.

10:30 The righteous shall never be removed: but the wicked shall not
inhabit the earth.

10:31 The mouth of the just bringeth forth wisdom: but the froward
tongue shall be cut out.

10:32 The lips of the righteous know what is acceptable: but the mouth
of the wicked speaketh frowardness.


11:1 A false balance is abomination to the LORD[JESUS]: but a just weight is
HIS[JESUS] delight.

11:2 When pride comes, then comes shame: but with the lowly is wisdom.

11:3 The integrity of the upright shall guide them: but the perverseness
of transgressors shall destroy them.

11:4 Riches profit not in the day of wrath: but righteousness delivereth
from death.

11:5 The righteousness of the perfect shall direct HIS[JESUS] way: but the
wicked shall fall by HIS[JESUS] own wickedness.

11:6 The righteousness of the upright shall deliver them: but
transgressors shall be taken in their own naughtiness.

11:7 When a wicked man dieth, HIS[JESUS] expectation shall perish: and the hope
of unjust men perisheth.

11:8 The righteous is delivered out of trouble, and the wicked comes in
HIS[JESUS] stead.

11:9 An hypocrite with HIS[JESUS] mouth destroyeth HIS[JESUS] neighbour: but through
knowledge shall the just be delivered.

11:10 When it goes well with the righteous, the city rejoiceth: and
when the wicked perish, there is shouting.

11:11 By the blessing of the upright the city is exalted: but it is
overthrown by the mouth of the wicked.

11:12 HE[JESUS] that is void of wisdom despiseth HIS[JESUS] neighbour: but a man of
understanding holdeth HIS[JESUS] peace.

11:13 A talebearer revealeth secrets: but HE[JESUS] that is of a faithful
spirit concealeth the matter.

11:14 Where no counsel is, the people fall: but in the multitude of
counsellors there is safety.

11:15 HE[JESUS] that is surety for a stranger shall smart for it: and HE[JESUS] that
hateth suretiship is sure.

11:16 A gracious woman retaineth honour: and strong men retain riches.

11:17 The merciful man doeth good to HIS[JESUS] own soul: but HE[JESUS] that is cruel
troubleth HIS[JESUS] own flesh.

11:18 The wicked worketh a deceitful work: but to HIM[JESUS] that soweth
righteousness shall be a sure reward.

11:19 As righteousness tendeth to life: so HE[JESUS] that pursueth evil
pursueth it to HIS[JESUS] own death.

11:20 They that are of a froward heart are abomination to the LORD[JESUS]: but
such as are upright in their way are HIS[JESUS] delight.

11:21 Though hand join in hand, the wicked shall not be unpunished: but
the SEED[JESUS] of the righteous shall be delivered.

11:22 As a jewel of gold in a swine's snout, so is a fair woman which is
without discretion.

11:23 The desire of the righteous is only good: but the expectation of
the wicked is wrath.

11:24 There is that scattereth, and yet increaseth; and there is that
withholdeth more than is meet, but it tendeth to poverty.

11:25 The liberal soul shall be made fat: and HE[JESUS] that watereth shall be
watered also himself.

11:26 HE[JESUS] that withholdeth corn, the people shall curse HIM[JESUS]: but blessing
shall be upon the head of HIM[JESUS] that selleth it.

11:27 HE[JESUS] that diligently seeketh good procureth favour: but HE[JESUS] that
seeketh mischief, it shall come unto HIM[JESUS].

11:28 HE[JESUS] that trusteth in HIS[JESUS] riches shall fall; but the righteous shall
flourish as a BRANCH[JESUS].

11:29 HE[JESUS] that troubleth HIS[JESUS] own house shall inherit the wind: and the
fool shall be SERVANT[JESUS] to the wise of heart.

11:30 The fruit of the righteous is a tree of life; and HE[JESUS] that winneth
souls is wise.

11:31 Behold, the righteous shall be recompensed in the earth: much more
the wicked and the sinner.


12:1 whoever loveth instruction loveth knowledge: but HE[JESUS] that hateth
reproof is brutish.

12:2 A good man obtaineth favour of the LORD[JESUS]: but a man of wicked
devices will HE[JESUS] condemn.

12:3 A man shall not be established by wickedness: but the ROOT[JESUS] of the
righteous shall not be moved.

12:4 A virtuous woman is a crown to her husband: but she that makes
ashamed is as rottenness in HIS[JESUS] bones.

12:5 The thoughts of the righteous are right: but the counsels of the
wicked are deceit.

12:6 The words of the wicked are to lie in wait for blood: but the mouth
of the upright shall deliver them.

12:7 The wicked are overthrown, and are not: but the house of the
righteous shall stand.

12:8 A man shall be commended according to HIS[JESUS] wisdom: but HE[JESUS] that is of
a perverse heart shall be despised.

12:9 HE[JESUS] that is despised, and has a SERVANT[JESUS], is better than HE[JESUS] that
honoureth himself, and lacketh bread.

12:10 A righteous man regardeth the life of HIS[JESUS] beast: but the tender
mercies of the wicked are cruel.

12:11 HE[JESUS] that tilleth HIS[JESUS] land shall be satisfied with bread: but HE[JESUS]
that followeth vain persons is void of understanding.

12:12 The wicked desireth the net of evil men: but the ROOT[JESUS] of the
righteous yieldeth fruit.

12:13 The wicked is snared by the transgression of HIS[JESUS] lips: but the
just shall come out of trouble.

12:14 A man shall be satisfied with good by the fruit of HIS[JESUS] mouth: and
the recompence of a man's hands shall be rendered unto HIM[JESUS].

12:15 The way of a fool is right in HIS[JESUS] own eyes: but HE[JESUS] that hearkeneth
unto counsel is wise.

12:16 A fool's wrath is presently known: but a prudent man covereth
shame.

12:17 HE[JESUS] that speaketh truth sheweth forth righteousness: but a false
witness deceit.

12:18 There is that speaketh like the piercings of a sword: but the
tongue of the wise is health.

12:19 The lip of truth shall be established for ever: but a lying tongue
is but for a moment.

12:20 Deceit is in the heart of them that imagine evil: but to the
counsellors of peace is joy.

12:21 There shall no evil happen to the just: but the wicked shall be
filled with mischief.

12:22 Lying lips are abomination to the LORD[JESUS]: but they that deal truly
are HIS[JESUS] delight.

12:23 A prudent man concealeth knowledge: but the heart of fools
proclaimeth foolishness.

12:24 The hand of the diligent shall bear rule: but the slothful shall
be under tribute.

12:25 Heaviness in the heart of man makes it stoop: but a good WORD[JESUS]
makes it glad.

12:26 The righteous is more excellent than HIS[JESUS] neighbour: but the way of
the wicked seduceth them.

12:27 The slothful man roasteth not that which HE[JESUS] took in hunting: but
the substance of a diligent man is precious.

12:28 In the way of righteousness is life: and in the pathway thereof
there is no death.


13:1 A wise SON[JESUS] heareth HIS[JESUS] father's instruction: but a scorner heareth
not rebuke.

13:2 A man shall eat good by the fruit of HIS[JESUS] mouth: but the soul of the
transgressors shall eat violence.

13:3 HE[JESUS] that keepeth HIS[JESUS] mouth keepeth HIS[JESUS] life: but HE[JESUS] that openeth
wide HIS[JESUS] lips shall have destruction.

13:4 The soul of the sluggard desireth, and has nothing: but the soul
of the diligent shall be made fat.

13:5 A righteous man hateth lying: but a wicked man is loathsome, and
comes to shame.

13:6 Righteousness keepeth HIM[JESUS] that is upright in the way: but
wickedness overthroweth the sinner.

13:7 There is that makes himself rich, yet has nothing: there is that
makes himself poor, yet has great riches.

13:8 The ransom of a man's life are HIS[JESUS] riches: but the poor heareth not
rebuke.

13:9 The light of the righteous rejoiceth: but the lamp of the wicked
shall be put out.

13:10 Only by pride comes contention: but with the well advised is
wisdom.

13:11 Wealth gotten by vanity shall be diminished: but HE[JESUS] that gathereth
by labour shall increase.

13:12 Hope deferred makes the heart sick: but when the desire comes,
it is a tree of life.

13:13 whoever despiseth the WORD[JESUS] shall be destroyed: but HE[JESUS] that feareth
the commandment shall be rewarded.

13:14 The law of the wise is a fountain of life, to depart from the
snares of death.

13:15 Good understanding giveth favour: but the way of transgressors is
hard.

13:16 Every prudent man dealeth with knowledge: but a fool layeth open
HIS[JESUS] folly.

13:17 A wicked messenger falleth into mischief: but a faithful
ambassador is health.

13:18 Poverty and shame shall be to HIM[JESUS] that refuseth instruction: but
HE[JESUS] that regardeth reproof shall be honoured.

13:19 The desire accomplished is sweet to the soul: but it is
abomination to fools to depart from evil.

13:20 HE[JESUS] that walketh with wise men shall be wise: but a companion of
fools shall be destroyed.

13:21 Evil pursueth sinners: but to the righteous good shall be repayed.

13:22 A good man leaveth an inheritance to HIS[JESUS] children's children: and
the wealth of the sinner is laid up for the just.

13:23 Much food is in the tillage of the poor: but there is that is
destroyed for want of judgment.

13:24 HE[JESUS] that spareth HIS[JESUS] rod hateth HIS[JESUS] SON[JESUS]: but HE[JESUS] that loveth HIM[JESUS]
chasteneth HIM[JESUS] betimes.

13:25 The righteous eateth to the satisfying of HIS[JESUS] soul: but the belly
of the wicked shall want.


14:1 Every wise woman buildeth her house: but the foolish plucketh it
down with her hands.

14:2 HE[JESUS] that walketh in HIS[JESUS] uprightness feareth the LORD[JESUS]: but HE[JESUS] that is
perverse in HIS[JESUS] ways despiseth HIM[JESUS].

14:3 In the mouth of the foolish is a rod of pride: but the lips of the
wise shall preserve them.

14:4 Where no oxen are, the crib is clean: but much increase is by the
strength of the ox.

14:5 A faithful witness will not lie: but a false witness will utter
lies.

14:6 A scorner seeketh wisdom, and findeth it not: but knowledge is easy
unto HIM[JESUS] that understandeth.

14:7 Go from the presence of a foolish man, when you perceivest not in
HIM[JESUS] the lips of knowledge.

14:8 The wisdom of the prudent is to understand HIS[JESUS] way: but the folly
of fools is deceit.

14:9 Fools make a mock at sin: but among the righteous there is favour.

14:10 The heart knoweth HIS[JESUS] own bitterness; and a stranger does not
intermeddle with HIS[JESUS] joy.

14:11 The house of the wicked shall be overthrown: but the tabernacle of
the upright shall flourish.

14:12 There is a way which seemeth right unto a man, but the end thereof
are the ways of death.

14:13 Even in laughter the heart is sorrowful; and the end of that mirth
is heaviness.

14:14 The backslider in heart shall be filled with HIS[JESUS] own ways: and a
good man shall be satisfied from himself.

14:15 The simple believes every WORD[JESUS]: but the prudent man looketh well
to HIS[JESUS] going.

14:16 A wise man feareth, and departeth from evil: but the fool rageth,
and is confident.

14:17 HE[JESUS] that is soon angry dealeth foolishly: and a man of wicked
devices is hated.

14:18 The simple inherit folly: but the prudent are crowned with
knowledge.

14:19 The evil bow before the good; and the wicked at the gates of the
righteous.

14:20 The poor is hated even of HIS[JESUS] own neighbour: but the rich has
many friends.

14:21 HE[JESUS] that despiseth HIS[JESUS] neighbour sinneth: but HE[JESUS] that has mercy on
the poor, happy is HE[JESUS].

14:22 Do they not err that devise evil? but mercy and truth shall be to
them that devise good.

14:23 In all labour there is profit: but the talk of the lips tendeth
only to penury.

14:24 The crown of the wise is their riches: but the foolishness of
fools is folly.

14:25 A true witness delivereth souls: but a deceitful witness speaketh
lies.

14:26 In the fear of the LORD[JESUS] is strong confidence: and HIS[JESUS] children
shall have a place of refuge.

14:27 The fear of the LORD[JESUS] is a fountain of life, to depart from the
snares of death.

14:28 In the multitude of people is the KING[JESUS]'s honour: but in the want
of people is the destruction of the prince.

14:29 HE[JESUS] that is slow to wrath is of great understanding: but HE[JESUS] that is
hasty of spirit exalteth folly.

14:30 A sound heart is the life of the flesh: but envy the rottenness of
the bones.

14:31 HE[JESUS] that oppresseth the poor reproacheth HIS[JESUS] Maker: but HE[JESUS] that
honoureth HIM[JESUS] has mercy on the poor.

14:32 The wicked is driven away in HIS[JESUS] wickedness: but the righteous
has hope in HIS[JESUS] death.

14:33 Wisdom resteth in the heart of HIM[JESUS] that has understanding: but
that which is in the midst of fools is made known.

14:34 Righteousness exalteth a nation: but sin is a reproach to any
people.

14:35 The KING[JESUS]'s favour is toward a wise SERVANT[JESUS]: but HIS[JESUS] wrath is
against HIM[JESUS] that causeth shame.


15:1 A soft answer turneth away wrath: but grievous words stir up anger.

15:2 The tongue of the wise useth knowledge aright: but the mouth of
fools poureth out foolishness.

15:3 The eyes of the LORD[JESUS] are in every place, beholding the evil and the
good.

15:4 A wholesome tongue is a tree of life: but perverseness therein is a
breach in the spirit.

15:5 A fool despiseth HIS[JESUS] father's instruction: but HE[JESUS] that regardeth
reproof is prudent.

15:6 In the house of the righteous is much treasure: but in the revenues
of the wicked is trouble.

15:7 The lips of the wise disperse knowledge: but the heart of the
foolish doeth not so.

15:8 The sacrifice of the wicked is an abomination to the LORD[JESUS]: but the
prayer of the upright is HIS[JESUS] delight.

15:9 The way of the wicked is an abomination unto the LORD[JESUS]: but HE[JESUS]
loveth HIM[JESUS] that followeth after righteousness.

15:10 Correction is grievous unto HIM[JESUS] that forsaketh the way: and HE[JESUS]
that hateth reproof shall die.

15:11 Hell and destruction are before the LORD[JESUS]: how much more then the
hearts of the children of men?

15:12 A scorner loveth not one that reproveth HIM[JESUS]: neither will HE[JESUS] go
unto the wise.

15:13 A merry heart makes a cheerful countenance: but by sorrow of the
heart the spirit is broken.

15:14 The heart of HIM[JESUS] that has understanding seeketh knowledge: but
the mouth of fools feedeth on foolishness.

15:15 All the days of the afflicted are evil: but HE[JESUS] that is of a merry
heart has a continual feast.

15:16 Better is little with the fear of the LORD[JESUS] than great treasure and
trouble therewith.

15:17 Better is a dinner of herbs where love is, than a stalled ox and
hatred therewith.

15:18 A wrathful man stirreth up strife: but HE[JESUS] that is slow to anger
appeaseth strife.

15:19 The way of the slothful man is as an hedge of thorns: but the way
of the righteous is made plain.

15:20 A wise SON[JESUS] makes a glad father: but a foolish man despiseth HIS[JESUS]
mother.

15:21 Folly is joy to HIM[JESUS] that is destitute of wisdom: but a man of
understanding walketh uprightly.

15:22 Without counsel purposes are disappointed: but in the multitude of
counsellors they are established.

15:23 A man has joy by the answer of HIS[JESUS] mouth: and a WORD[JESUS] spoken in
due season, how good is it!

15:24 The way of life is above to the wise, that HE[JESUS] may depart from hell
beneath.

15:25 The LORD[JESUS] will destroy the house of the proud: but HE[JESUS] will
establish the border of the widow.

15:26 The thoughts of the wicked are an abomination to the LORD[JESUS]: but the
words of the pure are pleasant words.

15:27 HE[JESUS] that is greedy of gain troubleth HIS[JESUS] own house; but HE[JESUS] that
hateth gifts shall live.

15:28 The heart of the righteous studieth to answer: but the mouth of
the wicked poureth out evil things.

15:29 The LORD[JESUS] is far from the wicked: but HE[JESUS] heareth the prayer of the
righteous.

15:30 The light of the eyes rejoiceth the heart: and a good report
makes the bones fat.

15:31 The ear that heareth the reproof of life abideth among the wise.

15:32 HE[JESUS] that refuseth instruction despiseth HIS[JESUS] own soul: but HE[JESUS] that
heareth reproof getteth understanding.

15:33 The fear of the LORD[JESUS] is the instruction of wisdom; and before
honour is humility.


16:1 The preparations of the heart in man, and the answer of the tongue,
is from the LORD[JESUS].

16:2 All the ways of a man are clean in HIS[JESUS] own eyes; but the LORD[JESUS]
weigheth the spirits.

16:3 Commit your works unto the LORD[JESUS], and your thoughts shall be
established.

16:4 The LORD[JESUS] has made all things for himself: yea, even the wicked for
the day of evil.

16:5 Every one that is proud in heart is an abomination to the LORD[JESUS]:
though hand join in hand, HE[JESUS] shall not be unpunished.

16:6 By mercy and truth iniquity is purged: and by the fear of the LORD[JESUS]
men depart from evil.

16:7 When a man's ways please the LORD[JESUS], HE[JESUS] makes even HIS[JESUS] enemies to be
at peace with HIM[JESUS].

16:8 Better is a little with righteousness than great revenues without
right.

16:9 A man's heart deviseth HIS[JESUS] way: but the LORD[JESUS] directeth HIS[JESUS] steps.

16:10 A divine sentence is in the lips of the KING[JESUS]: HIS[JESUS] mouth
transgresseth not in judgment.

16:11 A just weight and balance are the LORD[JESUS]'s: all the weights of the
bag are HIS[JESUS] work.

16:12 It is an abomination to kings to commit wickedness: for the throne
is established by righteousness.

16:13 Righteous lips are the delight of kings; and they love HIM[JESUS] that
speaketh right.

16:14 The wrath of a KING[JESUS] is as messengers of death: but a wise man will
pacify it.

16:15 In the light of the KING[JESUS]'s countenance is life; and HIS[JESUS] favour is
as a cloud of the latter rain.

16:16 How much better is it to get wisdom than gold! and to get
understanding rather to be chosen than silver!

16:17 The highway of the upright is to depart from evil: HE[JESUS] that keepeth
HIS[JESUS] way preserveth HIS[JESUS] soul.

16:18 Pride goes before destruction, and an haughty spirit before a
fall.

16:19 Better it is to be of an humble spirit with the lowly, than to
divide the spoil with the proud.

16:20 HE[JESUS] that handleth a matter wisely shall find good: and whoever
trusteth in the LORD[JESUS], happy is HE[JESUS].

16:21 The wise in heart shall be called prudent: and the sweetness of
the lips increaseth learning.

16:22 Understanding is a wellspring of life unto HIM[JESUS] that has it: but
the instruction of fools is folly.

16:23 The heart of the wise teacheth HIS[JESUS] mouth, and addeth learning to
HIS[JESUS] lips.

16:24 Pleasant words are as an honeycomb, sweet to the soul, and health
to the bones.

16:25 There is a way that seemeth right unto a man, but the end thereof
are the ways of death.

16:26 HE[JESUS] that laboureth laboureth for himself; for HIS[JESUS] mouth craveth it
of HIM[JESUS].

16:27 An ungodly man diggeth up evil: and in HIS[JESUS] lips there is as a
burning fire.

16:28 A froward man soweth strife: and a whisperer separateth chief
friends.

16:29 A violent man enticeth HIS[JESUS] neighbour, and leads HIM[JESUS] into the way
that is not good.

16:30 HE[JESUS] shutteth HIS[JESUS] eyes to devise froward things: moving HIS[JESUS] lips HE[JESUS]
bringeth evil to pass.

16:31 The hoary head is a crown of glory, if it be found in the way of
righteousness.

16:32 HE[JESUS] that is slow to anger is better than the mighty; and HE[JESUS] that
ruleth HIS[JESUS] spirit than HE[JESUS] that taketh a city.

16:33 The lot is cast into the lap; but the whole disposing thereof is
of the LORD[JESUS].


17:1 Better is a dry morsel, and quietness therewith, than an house full
of sacrifices with strife.

17:2 A wise SERVANT[JESUS] shall have rule over a SON[JESUS] that causeth shame, and
shall have part of the inheritance among the brethren.

17:3 The fining pot is for silver, and the furnace for gold: but the
LORD[JESUS] trieth the hearts.

17:4 A wicked doer giveth heed to false lips; and a liar giveth ear to a
naughty tongue.

17:5 whoever mocketh the poor reproacheth HIS[JESUS] Maker: and HE[JESUS] that is glad
at calamities shall not be unpunished.

17:6 Children's children are the crown of old men; and the glory of
children are their fathers.

17:7 Excellent speech becometh not a fool: much less do lying lips a
prince.

17:8 A gift is as a precious stone in the eyes of HIM[JESUS] that has it:
whithersoever it turneth, it prospereth.

17:9 HE[JESUS] that covereth a transgression seeketh love; but HE[JESUS] that
repeateth a matter separateth very friends.

17:10 A reproof entereth more into a wise man than an hundred stripes
into a fool.

17:11 An evil man seeketh only rebellion: therefore a cruel messenger
shall be sent against HIM[JESUS].

17:12 Let a bear robbed of her whelps meet a man, rather than a fool in
HIS[JESUS] folly.

17:13 whoever rewardeth evil for good, evil shall not depart from HIS[JESUS]
house.

17:14 The beginning of strife is as when one letteth out water:
therefore leave off contention, before it be meddled with.

17:15 HE[JESUS] that justifieth the wicked, and HE[JESUS] that condemneth the just,
even they both are abomination to the LORD[JESUS].

17:16 Wherefore is there a price in the hand of a fool to get wisdom,
seeing HE[JESUS] has no heart to it?

17:17 A friend loveth at all times, and a brother is born for adversity.

17:18 A man void of understanding striketh hands, and becometh surety in
the presence of HIS[JESUS] friend.

17:19 HE[JESUS] loveth transgression that loveth strife: and HE[JESUS] that exalteth
HIS[JESUS] gate seeketh destruction.

17:20 HE[JESUS] that has a froward heart findeth no good: and HE[JESUS] that has a
perverse tongue falleth into mischief.

17:21 HE[JESUS] that begetteth a fool doeth it to HIS[JESUS] sorrow: and the father of
a fool has no joy.

17:22 A merry heart doeth good like a medicine: but a broken spirit
drieth the bones.

17:23 A wicked man taketh a gift out of the bosom to pervert the ways of
judgment.

17:24 Wisdom is before HIM[JESUS] that has understanding; but the eyes of a
fool are in the ends of the earth.

17:25 A foolish SON[JESUS] is a grief to HIS[JESUS] father, and bitterness to her that
bare HIM[JESUS].

17:26 Also to punish the just is not good, nor to strike princes for
equity.

17:27 HE[JESUS] that has knowledge spareth HIS[JESUS] words: and a man of
understanding is of an excellent spirit.

17:28 Even a fool, when HE[JESUS] holdeth HIS[JESUS] peace, is counted wise: and HE[JESUS]
that shutteth HIS[JESUS] lips is esteemed a man of understanding.


18:1 Through desire a man, having separated himself, seeketh and
intermeddleth with all wisdom.

18:2 A fool has no delight in understanding, but that HIS[JESUS] heart may
discover itself.

18:3 When the wicked comes, then comes also contempt, and with
ignominy reproach.

18:4 The words of a man's mouth are as deep waters, and the wellspring
of wisdom as a flowing brook.

18:5 It is not good to accept the person of the wicked, to overthrow the
righteous in judgment.

18:6 A fool's lips enter into contention, and HIS[JESUS] mouth calleth for
strokes.

18:7 A fool's mouth is HIS[JESUS] destruction, and HIS[JESUS] lips are the snare of
HIS[JESUS] soul.

18:8 The words of a talebearer are as wounds, and they go down into the
innermost parts of the belly.

18:9 HE[JESUS] also that is slothful in HIS[JESUS] work is brother to HIM[JESUS] that is a
great waster.

18:10 The name of the LORD[JESUS] is a strong tower: the righteous runneth into
it, and is safe.

18:11 The rich man's wealth is HIS[JESUS] strong city, and as an high wall in
HIS[JESUS] own conceit.

18:12 Before destruction the heart of man is haughty, and before honour
is humility.

18:13 HE[JESUS] that answereth a matter before HE[JESUS] heareth it, it is folly and
shame unto HIM[JESUS].

18:14 The spirit of a man will sustain HIS[JESUS] infirmity; but a wounded
spirit who can bear?

18:15 The heart of the prudent getteth knowledge; and the ear of the
wise seeketh knowledge.

18:16 A man's gift makes room for HIM[JESUS], and bringeth HIM[JESUS] before great
men.

18:17 HE[JESUS] that is first in HIS[JESUS] own cause seemeth just; but HIS[JESUS] neighbour
comes and searcheth HIM[JESUS].

18:18 The lot causeth contentions to cease, and parteth between the
mighty.

18:19 A brother offended is harder to be won than a strong city: and
their contentions are like the bars of a castle.

18:20 A man's belly shall be satisfied with the fruit of HIS[JESUS] mouth; and
with the increase of HIS[JESUS] lips shall HE[JESUS] be filled.

18:21 Death and life are in the power of the tongue: and they that love
it shall eat the fruit thereof.

18:22 whoever findeth a wife findeth a good thing, and obtaineth favour of
the LORD[JESUS].

18:23 The poor useth intreaties; but the rich answereth roughly.

18:24 A man that has friends must shew himself friendly: and there is a
friend that sticketh closer than a brother.


19:1 Better is the poor that walketh in HIS[JESUS] integrity, than HE[JESUS] that is
perverse in HIS[JESUS] lips, and is a fool.

19:2 Also, that the soul be without knowledge, it is not good; and HE[JESUS]
that hasteth with HIS[JESUS] feet sinneth.

19:3 The foolishness of man perverteth HIS[JESUS] way: and HIS[JESUS] heart fretteth
against the LORD[JESUS].

19:4 Wealth makes many friends; but the poor is separated from HIS[JESUS]
neighbour.

19:5 A false witness shall not be unpunished, and HE[JESUS] that speaketh lies
shall not escape.

19:6 Many will intreat the favour of the prince: and every man is a
friend to HIM[JESUS] that giveth gifts.

19:7 All the brethren of the poor do hate HIM[JESUS]: how much more do HIS[JESUS]
friends go far from HIM[JESUS]? HE[JESUS] pursueth them with words, yet they are
wanting to HIM[JESUS].

19:8 HE[JESUS] that getteth wisdom loveth HIS[JESUS] own soul: HE[JESUS] that keepeth
understanding shall find good.

19:9 A false witness shall not be unpunished, and HE[JESUS] that speaketh lies
shall perish.

19:10 Delight is not seemly for a fool; much less for a SERVANT[JESUS] to have
rule over princes.

19:11 The discretion of a man deferreth HIS[JESUS] anger; and it is HIS[JESUS] glory
to pass over a transgression.

19:12 The KING[JESUS]'s wrath is as the roaring of a lion; but HIS[JESUS] favour is as
dew upon the grass.

19:13 A foolish SON[JESUS] is the calamity of HIS[JESUS] father: and the contentions
of a wife are a continual dropping.

19:14 House and riches are the inheritance of fathers: and a prudent
wife is from the LORD[JESUS].

19:15 Slothfulness casteth into a deep sleep; and an idle soul shall
let hunger.

19:16 HE[JESUS] that keepeth the commandment keepeth HIS[JESUS] own soul; but HE[JESUS] that
despiseth HIS[JESUS] ways shall die.

19:17 HE[JESUS] that has pity upon the poor lendeth unto the LORD[JESUS]; and that
which HE[JESUS] has given will HE[JESUS] pay HIM[JESUS] again.

19:18 Chasten your SON[JESUS] while there is hope, and let not your soul spare
for HIS[JESUS] crying.

19:19 A man of great wrath shall let punishment: for if you deliver
HIM[JESUS], yet you must do it again.

19:20 Hear counsel, and receive instruction, that you mayest be wise in
your latter end.

19:21 There are many devices in a man's heart; nevertheless the counsel
of the LORD[JESUS], that shall stand.

19:22 The desire of a man is HIS[JESUS] kindness: and a poor man is better than
a liar.

19:23 The fear of the LORD[JESUS] tendeth to life: and HE[JESUS] that has it shall
abide satisfied; HE[JESUS] shall not be visited with evil.

19:24 A slothful man hideth HIS[JESUS] hand in HIS[JESUS] bosom, and will not so much
as bring it to HIS[JESUS] mouth again.

19:25 Smite a scorner, and the simple will beware: and reprove one that
has understanding, and HE[JESUS] will understand knowledge.

19:26 HE[JESUS] that wasteth HIS[JESUS] father, and chaseth away HIS[JESUS] mother, is a SON[JESUS]
that causeth shame, and bringeth reproach.

19:27 Cease, my SON[JESUS], to hear the instruction that causeth to err from
the words of knowledge.

19:28 An ungodly witness scorneth judgment: and the mouth of the wicked
devoureth iniquity.

19:29 Judgments are prepared for scorners, and stripes for the back of
fools.


20:1 Wine is a mocker, strong drink is raging: and whoever is deceived
thereby is not wise.

20:2 The fear of a KING[JESUS] is as the roaring of a lion: whoever provoketh HIM[JESUS]
to anger sinneth against HIS[JESUS] own soul.

20:3 It is an honour for a man to cease from strife: but every fool will
be meddling.

20:4 The sluggard will not plow by reason of the cold; therefore shall
HE[JESUS] beg in harvest, and have nothing.

20:5 Counsel in the heart of man is like deep water; but a man of
understanding will draw it out.

20:6 Most men will proclaim every one HIS[JESUS] own goodness: but a faithful
man who can find?

20:7 The just man walketh in HIS[JESUS] integrity: HIS[JESUS] children are blessed
after HIM[JESUS].

20:8 A KING[JESUS] that sitteth in the throne of judgment scattereth away all
evil with HIS[JESUS] eyes.

20:9 Who can say, I have made my heart clean, I am pure from my sin?

20:10 Divers weights, and divers measures, both of them are alike
abomination to the LORD[JESUS].

20:11 Even a child is known by HIS[JESUS] doings, whether HIS[JESUS] work be pure, and
whether it be right.

20:12 The hearing ear, and the seeing eye, the LORD[JESUS] has made even both
of them.

20:13 Love not sleep, lest you come to poverty; open yours eyes, and
you shalt be satisfied with bread.

20:14 It is naught, it is naught, says the buyer: but when HE[JESUS] is gone
HIS[JESUS] way, then HE[JESUS] boasteth.

20:15 There is gold, and a multitude of rubies: but the lips of
knowledge are a precious jewel.

20:16 Take HIS[JESUS] garment that is surety for a stranger: and take a pledge
of HIM[JESUS] for a strange woman.

20:17 Bread of deceit is sweet to a man; but afterwards HIS[JESUS] mouth shall
be filled with gravel.

20:18 Every purpose is established by counsel: and with good advice make
war.

20:19 HE[JESUS] that goes about as a talebearer revealeth secrets: therefore
meddle not with HIM[JESUS] that flattereth with HIS[JESUS] lips.

20:20 whoever curseth HIS[JESUS] father or HIS[JESUS] mother, HIS[JESUS] lamp shall be put out
in obscure darkness.

20:21 An inheritance may be gotten hastily at the beginning; but the end
thereof shall not be blessed.

20:22 Say not you, I will recompense evil; but wait on the LORD[JESUS], and HE[JESUS]
shall save you.

20:23 Divers weights are an abomination unto the LORD[JESUS]; and a false
balance is not good.

20:24 Man's goings are of the LORD[JESUS]; how can a man then understand HIS[JESUS]
own way?

20:25 It is a snare to the man who devoureth that which is holy, and
after vows to make enquiry.

20:26 A wise KING[JESUS] scattereth the wicked, and bringeth the wheel over
them.

20:27 The spirit of man is the candle of the LORD[JESUS], searching all the
inward parts of the belly.

20:28 Mercy and truth preserve the KING[JESUS]: and HIS[JESUS] throne is upholden by
mercy.

20:29 The glory of young men is their strength: and the beauty of old
men is the grey head.

20:30 The blueness of a wound cleanseth away evil: so do stripes the
inward parts of the belly.


21:1 The KING[JESUS]'s heart is in the hand of the LORD[JESUS], as the rivers of
water: HE[JESUS] turneth it whithersoever HE[JESUS] will.

21:2 Every way of a man is right in HIS[JESUS] own eyes: but the LORD[JESUS] pondereth
the hearts.

21:3 To do justice and judgment is more acceptable to the LORD[JESUS] than
sacrifice.

21:4 An high look, and a proud heart, and the plowing of the wicked, is
sin.

21:5 The thoughts of the diligent tend only to plenteousness; but of
every one that is hasty only to want.

21:6 The getting of treasures by a lying tongue is a vanity tossed to
and fro of them that seek death.

21:7 The robbery of the wicked shall destroy them; because they refuse
to do judgment.

21:8 The way of man is froward and strange: but as for the pure, HIS[JESUS]
work is right.

21:9 It is better to dwell in a corner of the housetop, than with a
brawling woman in a wide house.

21:10 The soul of the wicked desireth evil: HIS[JESUS] neighbour findeth no
favour in HIS[JESUS] eyes.

21:11 When the scorner is punished, the simple is made wise: and when
the wise is instructed, HE[JESUS] receiveth knowledge.

21:12 The righteous man wisely considereth the house of the wicked: but
GOD[JESUS] overthroweth the wicked for their wickedness.

21:13 whoever stoppeth HIS[JESUS] ears at the cry of the poor, HE[JESUS] also shall cry
himself, but shall not be heard.

21:14 A gift in secret pacifieth anger: and a reward in the bosom strong
wrath.

21:15 It is joy to the just to do judgment: but destruction shall be to
the workers of iniquity.

21:16 The man that wandereth out of the way of understanding shall
remain in the congregation of the dead.

21:17 HE[JESUS] that loveth pleasure shall be a poor man: HE[JESUS] that loveth wine
and oil shall not be rich.

21:18 The wicked shall be a ransom for the righteous, and the
transgressor for the upright.

21:19 It is better to dwell in the wilderness, than with a contentious
and an angry woman.

21:20 There is treasure to be desired and oil in the dwelling of the
wise; but a foolish man spendeth it up.

21:21 HE[JESUS] that followeth after righteousness and mercy findeth life,
righteousness, and honour.

21:22 A wise man scaleth the city of the mighty, and casteth down the
strength of the confidence thereof.

21:23 whoever keepeth HIS[JESUS] mouth and HIS[JESUS] tongue keepeth HIS[JESUS] soul from
troubles.

21:24 Proud and haughty scorner is HIS[JESUS] name, who dealeth in proud wrath.

21:25 The desire of the slothful killeth HIM[JESUS]; for HIS[JESUS] hands refuse to
labour.

21:26 HE[JESUS] coveteth greedily all the day long: but the righteous giveth
and spareth not.

21:27 The sacrifice of the wicked is abomination: how much more, when HE[JESUS]
bringeth it with a wicked mind?

21:28 A false witness shall perish: but the man that heareth speaketh
constantly.

21:29 A wicked man hardeneth HIS[JESUS] face: but as for the upright, HE[JESUS]
directeth HIS[JESUS] way.

21:30 There is no wisdom nor understanding nor counsel against the LORD[JESUS].

21:31 The horse is prepared against the day of battle: but safety is of
the LORD[JESUS].


22:1 A GOOD name is rather to be chosen than great riches, and loving
favour rather than silver and gold.

22:2 The rich and poor meet together: the LORD[JESUS] is the maker of them all.

22:3 A prudent man foreseeth the evil, and hideth himself: but the
simple pass on, and are punished.

22:4 By humility and the fear of the LORD[JESUS] are riches, and honour, and
life.

22:5 Thorns and snares are in the way of the froward: HE[JESUS] that does keep
HIS[JESUS] soul shall be far from them.

22:6 Train up a child in the way HE[JESUS] should go: and when HE[JESUS] is old, HE[JESUS]
will not depart from it.

22:7 The rich ruleth over the poor, and the borrower is SERVANT[JESUS] to the
lender.

22:8 HE[JESUS] that soweth iniquity shall reap vanity: and the rod of HIS[JESUS] anger
shall fail.

22:9 HE[JESUS] that has a bountiful eye shall be blessed; for HE[JESUS] giveth of HIS[JESUS]
bread to the poor.

22:10 Cast out the scorner, and contention shall go out; yea, strife and
reproach shall cease.

22:11 HE[JESUS] that loveth pureness of heart, for the grace of HIS[JESUS] lips the
KING[JESUS] shall be HIS[JESUS] friend.

22:12 The eyes of the LORD[JESUS] preserve knowledge, and HE[JESUS] overthroweth the
words of the transgressor.

22:13 The slothful man says, There is a lion without, I shall be slain
in the streets.

22:14 The mouth of strange women is a deep pit: HE[JESUS] that is abhorred of
the LORD[JESUS] shall fall therein.

22:15 Foolishness is bound in the heart of a child; but the rod of
correction shall drive it far from HIM[JESUS].

22:16 HE[JESUS] that oppresseth the poor to increase HIS[JESUS] riches, and HE[JESUS] that
giveth to the rich, shall surely come to want.

22:17 Bow down yours ear, and hear the words of the wise, and apply
yours heart unto my knowledge.

22:18 For it is a pleasant thing if you keep them within you; they
shall withal be fitted in your lips.

22:19 That your trust may be in the LORD[JESUS], I have made known to you this
day, even to you.

22:20 Have not I written to you excellent things in counsels and
knowledge,

22:21 That I might make you know the certainty of the words of truth;
that you mightest answer the words of truth to them that send unto
you?

22:22 Rob not the poor, because HE[JESUS] is poor: neither oppress the
afflicted in the gate:

22:23 For the LORD[JESUS] will plead their cause, and spoil the soul of those
that spoiled them.

22:24 Make no friendship with an angry man; and with a furious man you
shalt not go:

22:25 Lest you learn HIS[JESUS] ways, and get a snare to your soul.

22:26 Be not you one of them that strike hands, or of them that are
sureties for debts.

22:27 If you hast nothing to pay, why should HE[JESUS] take away your bed from
under you?

22:28 Remove not the ancient landmark, which your fathers have set.

22:29 Seest you a man diligent in HIS[JESUS] business? HE[JESUS] shall stand before
kings; HE[JESUS] shall not stand before mean men.


23:1 When you sittest to eat with a ruler, consider diligently what is
before you:

23:2 And put a knife to your throat, if you be a man given to appetite.

23:3 Be not desirous of HIS[JESUS] dainties: for they are deceitful meat.

23:4 Labour not to be rich: cease from yours own wisdom.

23:5 Wilt you set yours eyes upon that which is not? for riches
certainly make themselves wings; they fly away as an eagle toward
heaven.

23:6 Eat you not the bread of HIM[JESUS] that has an evil eye, neither desire
you HIS[JESUS] dainty meats:

23:7 For as HE[JESUS] thinketh in HIS[JESUS] heart, so is HE[JESUS]: Eat and drink, says HE[JESUS]
to you; but HIS[JESUS] heart is not with you.

23:8 The morsel which you hast eaten shalt you vomit up, and lose your
sweet words.

23:9 Speak not in the ears of a fool: for HE[JESUS] will despise the wisdom of
your words.

23:10 Remove not the old landmark; and enter not into the fields of the
fatherless:

23:11 For their redeemer is mighty; HE[JESUS] shall plead their cause with
you.

23:12 Apply yours heart unto instruction, and yours ears to the words of
knowledge.

23:13 Withhold not correction from the child: for if you beatest HIM[JESUS]
with the rod, HE[JESUS] shall not die.

23:14 you shalt beat HIM[JESUS] with the rod, and shalt deliver HIS[JESUS] soul from
hell.

23:15 My SON[JESUS], if yours heart be wise, my heart shall rejoice, even mine.

23:16 Yea, my reins shall rejoice, when your lips speak right things.

23:17 Let not yours heart envy sinners: but be you in the fear of the
LORD[JESUS] all the day long.

23:18 For surely there is an end; and yours expectation shall not be cut
off.

23:19 Hear you, my SON[JESUS], and be wise, and guide yours heart in the way.

23:20 Be not among winebibbers; among riotous eaters of flesh:

23:21 For the drunkard and the glutton shall come to poverty: and
drowsiness shall clothe a man with rags.

23:22 Hearken unto your father that begat you, and despise not your
mother when she is old.

23:23 Buy the truth, and sell it not; also wisdom, and instruction, and
understanding.

23:24 The father of the righteous shall greatly rejoice: and HE[JESUS] that
begetteth a wise child shall have joy of HIM[JESUS].

23:25 your father and your mother shall be glad, and she that bare you
shall rejoice.

23:26 My SON[JESUS], give me yours heart, and let yours eyes observe my ways.

23:27 For a whore is a deep ditch; and a strange woman is a narrow pit.

23:28 She also lieth in wait as for a prey, and increaseth the
transgressors among men.

23:29 Who has woe? who has sorrow? who has contentions? who has
babbling? who has wounds without cause? who has redness of eyes?

23:30 They that tarry long at the wine; they that go to seek mixed wine.

23:31 Look not you upon the wine when it is red, when it giveth HIS[JESUS]
colour in the cup, when it moveth itself aright.

23:32 At the last it biteth like a serpent, and stingeth like an adder.

23:33 yours eyes shall behold strange women, and yours heart shall utter
perverse things.

23:34 Yea, you shalt be as HE[JESUS] that lieth down in the midst of the sea,
or as HE[JESUS] that lieth upon the top of a mast.

23:35 They have stricken me, shalt you say, and I was not sick; they
have beaten me, and I felt it not: when shall I awake? I will seek it
yet again.


24:1 Be not you envious against evil men, neither desire to be with
them.

24:2 For their heart studieth destruction, and their lips talk of
mischief.

24:3 Through wisdom is an house builded; and by understanding it is
established:

24:4 And by knowledge shall the chambers be filled with all precious and
pleasant riches.

24:5 A wise man is strong; yea, a man of knowledge increaseth strength.

24:6 For by wise counsel you shalt make your war: and in multitude of
counsellors there is safety.

24:7 Wisdom is too high for a fool: HE[JESUS] openeth not HIS[JESUS] mouth in the
gate.

24:8 HE[JESUS] that deviseth to do evil shall be called a mischievous person.

24:9 The thought of foolishness is sin: and the scorner is an
abomination to men.

24:10 If you faint in the day of adversity, your strength is small.

24:11 If you forbear to deliver them that are drawn unto death, and
those that are ready to be slain;

24:12 If you sayest, Behold, we knew it not; does not HE[JESUS] that pondereth
the heart consider it? and HE[JESUS] that keepeth your soul, does not HE[JESUS] know
it? and shall not HE[JESUS] render to every man according to HIS[JESUS] works?

24:13 My SON[JESUS], eat you honey, because it is good; and the honeycomb,
which is sweet to your taste:

24:14 So shall the knowledge of wisdom be unto your soul: when you hast
found it, then there shall be a reward, and your expectation shall not be
cut off.

24:15 Lay not wait, O wicked man, against the dwelling of the righteous;
spoil not HIS[JESUS] resting place:

24:16 For a just man falleth seven times, and riseth up again: but the
wicked shall fall into mischief.

24:17 Rejoice not when yours enemy falleth, and let not yours heart be
glad when HE[JESUS] stumbleth:

24:18 Lest the LORD[JESUS] see it, and it displease HIM[JESUS], and HE[JESUS] turn away HIS[JESUS]
wrath from HIM[JESUS].

24:19 Fret not thyself because of evil men, neither be you envious at
the wicked:

24:20 For there shall be no reward to the evil man; the candle of the
wicked shall be put out.

24:21 My SON[JESUS], fear you the LORD[JESUS] and the KING[JESUS]: and meddle not with them
that are given to change:

24:22 For their calamity shall rise suddenly; and who knoweth the ruin
of them both?

24:23 These things also belong to the wise. It is not good to have
respect of persons in judgment.

24:24 HE[JESUS] that says unto the wicked, you are righteous; HIM[JESUS] shall the
people curse, nations shall abhor HIM[JESUS]:

24:25 But to them that rebuke HIM[JESUS] shall be delight, and a good blessing
shall come upon them.

24:26 Every man shall kiss HIS[JESUS] lips that giveth a right answer.

24:27 Prepare your work without, and make it fit for thyself in the
field; and afterwards build yours house.

24:28 Be not a witness against your neighbour without cause; and deceive
not with your lips.

24:29 Say not, I will do so to HIM[JESUS] as HE[JESUS] has done to me: I will render
to the man according to HIS[JESUS] work.

24:30 I went by the field of the slothful, and by the vineyard of the
man void of understanding;

24:31 And, lo, it was all grown over with thorns, and nettles had
covered the face thereof, and the stone wall thereof was broken down.

24:32 Then I saw, and considered it well: I looked upon it, and received
instruction.

24:33 Yet a little sleep, a little slumber, a little folding of the
hands to sleep:

24:34 So shall your poverty come as one that travelleth; and your want as
an armed man.


25:1 These are also proverbs of Solomon, which the men of Hezekiah KING[JESUS]
of Judah copied out.

25:2 It is the glory of GOD[JESUS] to conceal a thing: but the honour of kings
is to search out a matter.

25:3 The heaven for height, and the earth for depth, and the heart of
kings is unsearchable.

25:4 Take away the dross from the silver, and there shall come forth a
vessel for the finer.

25:5 Take away the wicked from before the KING[JESUS], and HIS[JESUS] throne shall be
established in righteousness.

25:6 Put not forth thyself in the presence of the KING[JESUS], and stand not in
the place of great men:

25:7 For better it is that it be said unto you, Come up hither; than
that you shouldest be put lower in the presence of the prince whom
yours eyes have seen.

25:8 Go not forth hastily to strive, lest you know not what to do in
the end thereof, when your neighbour has put you to shame.

25:9 Debate your cause with your neighbour himself; and discover not a
secret to another:

25:10 Lest HE[JESUS] that heareth it put you to shame, and yours infamy turn
not away.

25:11 A WORD[JESUS] fitly spoken is like apples of gold in pictures of silver.

25:12 As an earring of gold, and an ornament of fine gold, so is a wise
reprover upon an obedient ear.

25:13 As the cold of snow in the time of harvest, so is a faithful
messenger to them that send HIM[JESUS]: for HE[JESUS] refresheth the soul of HIS[JESUS]
masters.

25:14 whoever boasteth himself of a false gift is like clouds and wind
without rain.

25:15 By long forbearing is a prince persuaded, and a soft tongue
breaketh the bone.

25:16 Hast you found honey? eat so much as is sufficient for you, lest
you be filled therewith, and vomit it.

25:17 Withdraw your foot from your neighbour's house; lest HE[JESUS] be weary of
you, and so hate you.

25:18 A man that beareth false witness against HIS[JESUS] neighbour is a maul,
and a sword, and a sharp arrow.

25:19 Confidence in an unfaithful man in time of trouble is like a
broken tooth, and a foot out of joint.

25:20 As HE[JESUS] that taketh away a garment in cold weather, and as vinegar
upon nitre, so is HE[JESUS] that singeth songs to an heavy heart.

25:21 If yours enemy be hungry, give HIM[JESUS] bread to eat; and if HE[JESUS] be
thirsty, give HIM[JESUS] water to drink:

25:22 For you shalt heap coals of fire upon HIS[JESUS] head, and the LORD[JESUS]
shall reward you.

25:23 The north wind driveth away rain: so does an angry countenance a
backbiting tongue.

25:24 It is better to dwell in the corner of the housetop, than with a
brawling woman and in a wide house.

25:25 As cold waters to a thirsty soul, so is good news from a far
country.

25:26 A righteous man falling down before the wicked is as a troubled
fountain, and a corrupt spring.

25:27 It is not good to eat much honey: so for men to search their own
glory is not glory.

25:28 HE[JESUS] that has no rule over HIS[JESUS] own spirit is like a city that is
broken down, and without walls.


26:1 As snow in summer, and as rain in harvest, so honour is not seemly
for a fool.

26:2 As the bird by wandering, as the swallow by flying, so the curse
causeless shall not come.

26:3 A whip for the horse, a bridle for the ass, and a rod for the
fool's back.

26:4 Answer not a fool according to HIS[JESUS] folly, lest you also be like
unto HIM[JESUS].

26:5 Answer a fool according to HIS[JESUS] folly, lest HE[JESUS] be wise in HIS[JESUS] own
conceit.

26:6 HE[JESUS] that sendeth a message by the hand of a fool cutteth off the
feet, and drinketh damage.

26:7 The legs of the lame are not equal: so is a parable in the mouth of
fools.

26:8 As HE[JESUS] that bindeth a stone in a sling, so is HE[JESUS] that giveth honour
to a fool.

26:9 As a thorn goes up into the hand of a drunkard, so is a parable in
the mouths of fools.

26:10 The great GOD[JESUS] that formed all things both rewardeth the fool, and
rewardeth transgressors.

26:11 As a dog returneth to HIS[JESUS] vomit, so a fool returneth to HIS[JESUS] folly.

26:12 Seest you a man wise in HIS[JESUS] own conceit? there is more hope of a
fool than of HIM[JESUS].

26:13 The slothful man says, There is a lion in the way; a lion is in
the streets.

26:14 As the door turneth upon HIS[JESUS] hinges, so does the slothful upon HIS[JESUS]
bed.

26:15 The slothful hideth HIS[JESUS] hand in HIS[JESUS] bosom; it grieveth HIM[JESUS] to
bring it again to HIS[JESUS] mouth.

26:16 The sluggard is wiser in HIS[JESUS] own conceit than seven men that can
render a reason.

26:17 HE[JESUS] that passeth by, and meddleth with strife belonging not to HIM[JESUS],
is like one that taketh a dog by the ears.

26:18 As a mad man who casteth firebrands, arrows, and death,

26:19 So is the man that deceiveth HIS[JESUS] neighbour, and says, Am not I in
sport?

26:20 Where no wood is, there the fire goes out: so where there is no
talebearer, the strife ceaseth.

26:21 As coals are to burning coals, and wood to fire; so is a
contentious man to kindle strife.

26:22 The words of a talebearer are as wounds, and they go down into the
innermost parts of the belly.

26:23 Burning lips and a wicked heart are like a potsherd covered with
silver dross.

26:24 HE[JESUS] that hateth dissembleth with HIS[JESUS] lips, and layeth up deceit
within HIM[JESUS];

26:25 When HE[JESUS] speaketh fair, believe HIM[JESUS] not: for there are seven
abominations in HIS[JESUS] heart.

26:26 Whose hatred is covered by deceit, HIS[JESUS] wickedness shall be shewed
before the whole congregation.

26:27 whoever diggeth a pit shall fall therein: and HE[JESUS] that rolleth a
stone, it will return upon HIM[JESUS].

26:28 A lying tongue hateth those that are afflicted by it; and a
flattering mouth worketh ruin.


27:1 Boast not thyself of to morrow; for you knowest not what a day may
bring forth.

27:2 Let another man praise you, and not yours own mouth; a stranger,
and not yours own lips.

27:3 A stone is heavy, and the sand weighty; but a fool's wrath is
heavier than them both.

27:4 Wrath is cruel, and anger is outrageous; but who is able to stand
before envy?

27:5 Open rebuke is better than secret love.

27:6 Faithful are the wounds of a friend; but the kisses of an enemy are
deceitful.

27:7 The full soul loatheth an honeycomb; but to the hungry soul every
bitter thing is sweet.

27:8 As a bird that wandereth from her nest, so is a man that wandereth
from HIS[JESUS] place.

27:9 Ointment and perfume rejoice the heart: so does the sweetness of a
man's friend by hearty counsel.

27:10 yours own friend, and your father's friend, forsake not; neither go
into your brother's house in the day of your calamity: for better is a
neighbour that is near than a brother far off.

27:11 My SON[JESUS], be wise, and make my heart glad, that I may answer HIM[JESUS]
that reproacheth me.

27:12 A prudent man foreseeth the evil, and hideth himself; but the
simple pass on, and are punished.

27:13 Take HIS[JESUS] garment that is surety for a stranger, and take a pledge
of HIM[JESUS] for a strange woman.

27:14 HE[JESUS] that blesseth HIS[JESUS] friend with a loud voice, rising early in the
morning, it shall be counted a curse to HIM[JESUS].

27:15 A continual dropping in a very rainy day and a contentious woman
are alike.

27:16 whoever hideth her hideth the wind, and the ointment of HIS[JESUS]
right hand, which bewrayeth itself.

27:17 Iron sharpeneth iron; so a man sharpeneth the countenance of HIS[JESUS]
friend.

27:18 whoever keepeth the fig tree shall eat the fruit thereof: so HE[JESUS] that
waiteth on HIS[JESUS] master shall be honoured.

27:19 As in water face answereth to face, so the heart of man to man.

27:20 Hell and destruction are never full; so the eyes of man are never
satisfied.

27:21 As the fining pot for silver, and the furnace for gold; so is a
man to HIS[JESUS] praise.

27:22 Though you shouldest bray a fool in a mortar among wheat with a
pestle, yet will not HIS[JESUS] foolishness depart from HIM[JESUS].

27:23 Be you diligent to know the state of your flocks, and look well to
your herds.

27:24 For riches are not for ever: and does the crown endure to every
generation?

27:25 The hay appeareth, and the tender grass sheweth itself, and herbs
of the mountains are gathered.

27:26 The lambs are for your clothing, and the goats are the price of the
field.

27:27 And you shalt have goats' milk enough for your food, for the food
of your household, and for the maintenance for your maidens.


28:1 The wicked flee when no man pursueth: but the righteous are bold as
a lion.

28:2 For the transgression of a land many are the princes thereof: but
by a man of understanding and knowledge the state thereof shall be
prolonged.

28:3 A poor man that oppresseth the poor is like a sweeping rain which
leaveth no food.

28:4 They that forsake the law praise the wicked: but such as keep the
law contend with them.

28:5 Evil men understand not judgment: but they that seek the LORD[JESUS]
understand all things.

28:6 Better is the poor that walketh in HIS[JESUS] uprightness, than HE[JESUS] that is
perverse in HIS[JESUS] ways, though HE[JESUS] be rich.

28:7 whoever keepeth the law is a wise SON[JESUS]: but HE[JESUS] that is a companion of
riotous men shameth HIS[JESUS] father.

28:8 HE[JESUS] that by usury and unjust gain increaseth HIS[JESUS] substance, HE[JESUS] shall
gather it for HIM[JESUS] that will pity the poor.

28:9 HE[JESUS] that turneth away HIS[JESUS] ear from hearing the law, even HIS[JESUS] prayer
shall be abomination.

28:10 whoever causeth the righteous to go astray in an evil way, HE[JESUS] shall
fall himself into HIS[JESUS] own pit: but the upright shall have good things in
possession.

28:11 The rich man is wise in HIS[JESUS] own conceit; but the poor that has
understanding searcheth HIM[JESUS] out.

28:12 When righteous men do rejoice, there is great glory: but when the
wicked rise, a man is hidden.

28:13 HE[JESUS] that covereth HIS[JESUS] sins shall not prosper: but whoever confesseth
and forsaketh them shall have mercy.

28:14 Happy is the man that feareth alway: but HE[JESUS] that hardeneth HIS[JESUS]
heart shall fall into mischief.

28:15 As a roaring lion, and a ranging bear; so is a wicked ruler over
the poor people.

28:16 The prince that wanteth understanding is also a great oppressor:
but HE[JESUS] that hateth covetousness shall prolong HIS[JESUS] days.

28:17 A man that doeth violence to the blood of any person shall flee to
the pit; let no man stay HIM[JESUS].

28:18 whoever walketh uprightly shall be saved: but HE[JESUS] that is perverse in
HIS[JESUS] ways shall fall at once.

28:19 HE[JESUS] that tilleth HIS[JESUS] land shall have plenty of bread: but HE[JESUS] that
followeth after vain persons shall have poverty enough.

28:20 A faithful man shall abound with blessings: but HE[JESUS] that makes
haste to be rich shall not be innocent.

28:21 To have respect of persons is not good: for for a piece of bread
that man will transgress.

28:22 HE[JESUS] that hasteth to be rich has an evil eye, and considereth not
that poverty shall come upon HIM[JESUS].

28:23 HE[JESUS] that rebuketh a man afterwards shall find more favour than HE[JESUS]
that flattereth with the tongue.

28:24 whoever robbeth HIS[JESUS] father or HIS[JESUS] mother, and says, It is no
transgression; the same is the companion of a destroyer.

28:25 HE[JESUS] that is of a proud heart stirreth up strife: but HE[JESUS] that
putteth HIS[JESUS] trust in the LORD[JESUS] shall be made fat.

28:26 HE[JESUS] that trusteth in HIS[JESUS] own heart is a fool: but whoever walketh
wisely, HE[JESUS] shall be delivered.

28:27 HE[JESUS] that giveth unto the poor shall not lack: but HE[JESUS] that hideth
HIS[JESUS] eyes shall have many a curse.

28:28 When the wicked rise, men hide themselves: but when they perish,
the righteous increase.


29:1 HE[JESUS], that being often reproved hardeneth HIS[JESUS] neck, shall suddenly be
destroyed, and that without remedy.

29:2 When the righteous are in authority, the people rejoice: but when
the wicked beareth rule, the people mourn.

29:3 whoever loveth wisdom rejoiceth HIS[JESUS] father: but HE[JESUS] that keepeth
