recompences for the controversy of Zion.

34:9 And the streams thereof shall be turned into pitch, and the dust
thereof into brimstone, and the land thereof shall become burning pitch.

34:10 It shall not be quenched night nor day; the smoke thereof shall go
up for ever: from generation to generation it shall lie waste; none
shall pass through it for ever and ever.

34:11 But the cormorant and the bittern shall possess it; the owl also
and the raven shall dwell in it: and HE[JESUS] shall stretch out upon it the
line of confusion, and the stones of emptiness.

34:12 They shall call the nobles thereof to the kingdom, but none shall
be there, and all her princes shall be nothing.

34:13 And thorns shall come up in her palaces, nettles and brambles in
the fortresses thereof: and it shall be an habitation of dragons, and a
court for owls.

34:14 The wild beasts of the desert shall also meet with the wild beasts
of the island, and the satyr shall cry to HIS[JESUS] fellow; the screech owl
also shall rest there, and find for herself a place of rest.

34:15 There shall the great owl make her nest, and lay, and hatch, and
gather under her shadow: there shall the vultures also be gathered,
every one with her mate.

34:16 Seek you out of the book of the LORD[JESUS], and read: no one of these
shall fail, none shall want her mate: for my mouth it has commanded,
and HIS[JESUS] spirit it has gathered them.

34:17 And HE[JESUS] has cast the lot for them, and HIS[JESUS] hand has divided it
unto them by line: they shall possess it for ever, from generation to
generation shall they dwell therein.


35:1 The wilderness and the solitary place shall be glad for them; and
the desert shall rejoice, and blossom as the rose.

35:2 It shall blossom abundantly, and rejoice even with joy and singing:
the glory of Lebanon shall be given unto it, the excellency of Carmel
and Sharon, they shall see the glory of the LORD[JESUS], and the excellency of
our GOD[JESUS].

35:3 Strengthen you the weak hands, and confirm the feeble knees.

35:4 Say to them that are of a fearful heart, Be strong, fear not:
behold, your GOD[JESUS] will come with vengeance, even GOD[JESUS] with a recompence;
HE[JESUS] will come and save you.

35:5 Then the eyes of the blind shall be opened, and the ears of the
deaf shall be unstopped.

35:6 Then shall the lame man leap as an hart, and the tongue of the dumb
sing: for in the wilderness shall waters break out, and streams in the
desert.

35:7 And the parched ground shall become a pool, and the thirsty land
springs of water: in the habitation of dragons, where each lay, shall be
grass with reeds and rushes.

35:8 And an highway shall be there, and a way, and it shall be called
The way of holiness; the unclean shall not pass over it; but it shall be
for those: the wayfaring men, though fools, shall not err therein.

35:9 No lion shall be there, nor any ravenous beast shall go up thereon,
it shall not be found there; but the redeemed shall walk there:

35:10 And the ransomed of the LORD[JESUS] shall return, and come to Zion with
songs and everlasting joy upon their heads: they shall obtain joy and
gladness, and sorrow and sighing shall flee away.


36:1 Now it came to pass in the fourteenth year of KING[JESUS] Hezekiah, that
Sennacherib KING[JESUS] of Assyria came up against all the defenced cities of
Judah, and took them.

36:2 And the KING[JESUS] of Assyria sent Rabshakeh from Lachish to Jerusalem
unto KING[JESUS] Hezekiah with a great army. And HE[JESUS] stood by the conduit of the
upper pool in the highway of the fuller's field.

36:3 Then came forth unto HIM[JESUS] Eliakim, Hilkiah's SON[JESUS], which was over the
house, and Shebna the scribe, and Joah, Asaph's SON[JESUS], the recorder.

36:4 And Rabshakeh said unto them, Say you now to Hezekiah, Thus says
the great KING[JESUS], the KING[JESUS] of Assyria, What confidence is this wherein
you trustest?

36:5 I say, sayest you, (but they are but vain words) I have counsel
and strength for war: now on whom dost you trust, that you rebellest
against me?

36:6 Lo, you trustest in the staff of this broken reed, on Egypt;
whereon if a man lean, it will go into HIS[JESUS] hand, and pierce it: so is
Pharaoh KING[JESUS] of Egypt to all that trust in HIM[JESUS].

36:7 But if you say to me, We trust in the LORD[JESUS] our GOD[JESUS]: is it not HE[JESUS],
whose high places and whose altars Hezekiah has taken away, and said to
Judah and to Jerusalem, you shall worship before this altar?

36:8 Now therefore give pledges, I pray you, to my master the KING[JESUS] of
Assyria, and I will give you two thousand horses, if you be able on
your part to set riders upon them.

36:9 How then wilt you turn away the face of one captain of the least
of my master's servants, and put your trust on Egypt for chariots and for
horsemen?

36:10 And am I now come up without the LORD[JESUS] against this land to destroy
it? the LORD[JESUS] said unto me, Go up against this land, and destroy it.

36:11 Then said Eliakim and Shebna and Joah unto Rabshakeh, Speak, I
pray you, unto your servants in the Syrian language; for we understand
it: and speak not to us in the Jews' language, in the ears of the people
that are on the wall.

36:12 But Rabshakeh said, has my master sent me to your master and to
you to speak these words? has HE[JESUS] not sent me to the men that sit upon
the wall, that they may eat their own dung, and drink their own piss
with you?

36:13 Then Rabshakeh stood, and cried with a loud voice in the Jews'
language, and said, Hear you the words of the great KING[JESUS], the KING[JESUS] of
Assyria.

36:14 Thus says the KING[JESUS], Let not Hezekiah deceive you: for HE[JESUS] shall
not be able to deliver you.

36:15 Neither let Hezekiah make you trust in the LORD[JESUS], saying, The LORD[JESUS]
will surely deliver us: this city shall not be delivered into the hand
of the KING[JESUS] of Assyria.

36:16 Hearken not to Hezekiah: for thus says the KING[JESUS] of Assyria, Make
an agreement with me by a present, and come out to me: and eat you every
one of HIS[JESUS] vine, and every one of HIS[JESUS] fig tree, and drink you every one
the waters of HIS[JESUS] own cistern;

36:17 Until I come and take you away to a land like your own land, a
land of corn and wine, a land of bread and vineyards.

36:18 Beware lest Hezekiah persuade you, saying, the LORD[JESUS] will deliver
us. has any of the gods of the nations delivered HIS[JESUS] land out of the
hand of the KING[JESUS] of Assyria?

36:19 Where are the gods of Hamath and Arphad? where are the gods of
Sepharvaim? and have they delivered Samaria out of my hand?

36:20 Who are they among all the gods of these lands, that have
delivered their land out of my hand, that the LORD[JESUS] should deliver
Jerusalem out of my hand?

36:21 But they held their peace, and answered HIM[JESUS] not a WORD[JESUS]: for the
KING[JESUS]'s commandment was, saying, Answer HIM[JESUS] not.

36:22 Then came Eliakim, the SON[JESUS] of Hilkiah, that was over the
household, and Shebna the scribe, and Joah, the SON[JESUS] of Asaph, the
recorder, to Hezekiah with their clothes rent, and told HIM[JESUS] the words of
Rabshakeh.


37:1 And it came to pass, when KING[JESUS] Hezekiah heard it, that HE[JESUS] rent HIS[JESUS]
clothes, and covered himself with sackcloth, and went into the house of
the LORD[JESUS].

37:2 And HE[JESUS] sent Eliakim, who was over the household, and Shebna the
scribe, and the elders of the priests covered with sackcloth, unto
Isaiah the PROPHET[JESUS] the SON[JESUS] of Amoz.

37:3 And they said unto HIM[JESUS], Thus says Hezekiah, This day is a day of
trouble, and of rebuke, and of blasphemy: for the children are come to
the birth, and there is not strength to bring forth.

37:4 It may be the LORD[JESUS] your GOD[JESUS] will hear the words of Rabshakeh, whom
the KING[JESUS] of Assyria HIS[JESUS] master has sent to reproach the living GOD[JESUS], and
will reprove the words which the LORD[JESUS] your GOD[JESUS] has heard: wherefore lift
up your prayer for the remnant that is left.

37:5 So the servants of KING[JESUS] Hezekiah came to Isaiah.

37:6 And Isaiah said unto them, Thus shall you say unto your master, Thus
says the LORD[JESUS], Be not afraid of the words that you hast heard,
wherewith the servants of the KING[JESUS] of Assyria have blasphemed me.

37:7 Behold, I will send a blast upon HIM[JESUS], and HE[JESUS] shall hear a rumour,
and return to HIS[JESUS] own land; and I will cause HIM[JESUS] to fall by the sword in
HIS[JESUS] own land.

37:8 So Rabshakeh returned, and found the KING[JESUS] of Assyria warring
against Libnah: for HE[JESUS] had heard that HE[JESUS] was departed from Lachish.

37:9 And HE[JESUS] heard say concerning Tirhakah KING[JESUS] of Ethiopia, HE[JESUS] is come
forth to make war with you. And when HE[JESUS] heard it, HE[JESUS] sent messengers to
Hezekiah, saying,

37:10 Thus shall you speak to Hezekiah KING[JESUS] of Judah, saying, Let not your
GOD[JESUS], in whom you trustest, deceive you, saying, Jerusalem shall not be
given into the hand of the KING[JESUS] of Assyria.

37:11 Behold, you hast heard what the kings of Assyria have done to all
lands by destroying them utterly; and shalt you be delivered?

37:12 Have the gods of the nations delivered them which my fathers have
destroyed, as Gozan, and Haran, and Rezeph, and the children of Eden
which were in Telassar?

37:13 Where is the KING[JESUS] of Hamath, and the KING[JESUS] of Arphad, and the KING[JESUS]
of the city of Sepharvaim, Hena, and Ivah?

37:14 And Hezekiah received the letter from the hand of the messengers,
and read it: and Hezekiah went up unto the house of the LORD[JESUS], and spread
it before the LORD[JESUS].

37:15 And Hezekiah prayed unto the LORD[JESUS], saying,

37:16 O LORD[JESUS] of hosts, GOD[JESUS] of Israel, that dwellest between the
cherubims, you art the GOD[JESUS], even you alone, of all the kingdoms of the
earth: you hast made heaven and earth.

37:17 Incline yours ear, O LORD[JESUS], and hear; open yours eyes, O LORD[JESUS], and
see: and hear all the words of Sennacherib, which has sent to reproach
the living GOD[JESUS].

37:18 Of a truth, LORD[JESUS], the kings of Assyria have laid waste all the
nations, and their countries,

37:19 And have cast their gods into the fire: for they were no gods, but
the work of men's hands, wood and stone: therefore they have destroyed
them.

37:20 Now therefore, O LORD[JESUS] our GOD[JESUS], save us from HIS[JESUS] hand, that all the
kingdoms of the earth may know that you art the LORD[JESUS], even you only.

37:21 Then Isaiah the SON[JESUS] of Amoz sent unto Hezekiah, saying, Thus says
the LORD[JESUS] GOD[JESUS] of Israel, Whereas you hast prayed to me against
Sennacherib KING[JESUS] of Assyria:

37:22 This is the WORD[JESUS] which the LORD[JESUS] has spoken concerning HIM[JESUS]; The
virgin, the daughter of Zion, has despised you, and laughed you to
scorn; the daughter of Jerusalem has shaken her head at you.

37:23 Whom hast you reproached and blasphemed? and against whom hast
you exalted your voice, and lifted up yours eyes on high? even against
the Holy One of Israel.

37:24 By your servants hast you reproached the LORD[JESUS], and hast said, By
the multitude of my chariots am I come up to the height of the
mountains, to the sides of Lebanon; and I will cut down the tall cedars
thereof, and the choice fir trees thereof: and I will enter into the
height of HIS[JESUS] border, and the forest of HIS[JESUS] Carmel.

37:25 I have digged, and drunk water; and with the sole of my feet have
I dried up all the rivers of the besieged places.

37:26 Hast you not heard long ago, how I have done it; and of ancient
times, that I have formed it? now have I brought it to pass, that you
shouldest be to lay waste defenced cities into ruinous heaps.

37:27 Therefore their inhabitants were of small power, they were
dismayed and confounded: they were as the grass of the field, and as the
green herb, as the grass on the housetops, and as corn blasted before it
be grown up.

37:28 But I know your abode, and your going out, and your coming in, and
your rage against me.

37:29 Because your rage against me, and your tumult, is come up into mine
ears, therefore will I put my hook in your nose, and my bridle in your
lips, and I will turn you back by the way by which you camest.

37:30 And this shall be a sign unto you, you shall eat this year such as
groweth of itself; and the second year that which springeth of the same:
and in the third year sow you, and reap, and plant vineyards, and eat the
fruit thereof.

37:31 And the remnant that is escaped of the house of Judah shall again
take ROOT[JESUS] downward, and bear fruit upward:

37:32 For out of Jerusalem shall go forth a remnant, and they that
escape out of mount Zion: the zeal of the LORD[JESUS] of hosts shall do this.

37:33 Therefore thus says the LORD[JESUS] concerning the KING[JESUS] of Assyria, HE[JESUS]
shall not come into this city, nor shoot an arrow there, nor come before
it with shields, nor cast a bank against it.

37:34 By the way that HE[JESUS] came, by the same shall HE[JESUS] return, and shall
not come into this city, says the LORD[JESUS].

37:35 For I will defend this city to save it for mine own sake, and for
my SERVANT[JESUS] David's sake.

37:36 Then the angel of the LORD[JESUS] went forth, and smote in the camp of
the Assyrians a hundred and fourscore and five thousand: and when they
arose early in the morning, behold, they were all dead corpses.

37:37 So Sennacherib KING[JESUS] of Assyria departed, and went and returned,
and dwelt at Nineveh.

37:38 And it came to pass, as HE[JESUS] was worshipping in the house of Nisroch
HIS[JESUS] GOD[JESUS], that Adrammelech and Sharezer HIS[JESUS] sons smote HIM[JESUS] with the
sword; and they escaped into the land of Armenia: and Esarhaddon HIS[JESUS] SON[JESUS]
reigned in HIS[JESUS] stead.


38:1 In those days was Hezekiah sick unto death. And Isaiah the PROPHET[JESUS]
the SON[JESUS] of Amoz came unto HIM[JESUS], and said unto HIM[JESUS], Thus says the LORD[JESUS],
Set yours house in order: for you shalt die, and not live.

38:2 Then Hezekiah turned HIS[JESUS] face toward the wall, and prayed unto the
LORD[JESUS],

38:3 And said, Remember now, O LORD[JESUS], I beseech you, how I have walked
before you in truth and with a perfect heart, and have done that which
is good in your sight. And Hezekiah wept sore.

38:4 Then came the WORD[JESUS] of the LORD[JESUS] to Isaiah, saying,

38:5 Go, and say to Hezekiah, Thus says the LORD[JESUS], the GOD[JESUS] of David your
father, I have heard your prayer, I have seen your tears: behold, I will
add unto your days fifteen years.

38:6 And I will deliver you and this city out of the hand of the KING[JESUS]
of Assyria: and I will defend this city.

38:7 And this shall be a sign unto you from the LORD[JESUS], that the LORD[JESUS]
will do this thing that HE[JESUS] has spoken;

38:8 Behold, I will bring again the shadow of the degrees, which is gone
down in the sun dial of Ahaz, ten degrees backward. So the sun returned
ten degrees, by which degrees it was gone down.

38:9 The writing of Hezekiah KING[JESUS] of Judah, when HE[JESUS] had been sick, and
was recovered of HIS[JESUS] sickness:

38:10 I said in the cutting off of my days, I shall go to the gates of
the grave: I am deprived of the residue of my years.

38:11 I said, I shall not see the LORD[JESUS], even the LORD[JESUS], in the land of
the living: I shall behold man no more with the inhabitants of the
world.

38:12 Mine age is departed, and is removed from me as a SHEPHERD[JESUS]'s tent:
I have cut off like a weaver my life: HE[JESUS] will cut me off with pining
sickness: from day even to night wilt you make an end of me.

38:13 I reckoned till morning, that, as a lion, so will HE[JESUS] break all my
bones: from day even to night wilt you make an end of me.

38:14 Like a crane or a swallow, so did I chatter: I did mourn as a
dove: mine eyes fail with looking upward: O LORD[JESUS], I am oppressed;
undertake for me.

38:15 What shall I say? HE[JESUS] has both spoken unto me, and himself has
done it: I shall go softly all my years in the bitterness of my soul.

38:16 O LORD[JESUS], by these things men live, and in all these things is the
life of my spirit: so wilt you recover me, and make me to live.

38:17 Behold, for peace I had great bitterness: but you hast in love to
my soul delivered it from the pit of corruption: for you hast cast all
my sins behind your back.

38:18 For the grave cannot praise you, death can not celebrate you:
they that go down into the pit cannot hope for your truth.

38:19 The living, the living, HE[JESUS] shall praise you, as I do this day:
the father to the children shall make known your truth.

38:20 The LORD[JESUS] was ready to save me: therefore we will sing my songs to
the stringed instruments all the days of our life in the house of the
LORD[JESUS].

38:21 For Isaiah had said, Let them take a lump of figs, and lay it for
a plaister upon the boil, and HE[JESUS] shall recover.

38:22 Hezekiah also had said, What is the sign that I shall go up to the
house of the LORD[JESUS]?


39:1 At that time Merodachbaladan, the SON[JESUS] of Baladan, KING[JESUS] of Babylon,
sent letters and a present to Hezekiah: for HE[JESUS] had heard that HE[JESUS] had
been sick, and was recovered.

39:2 And Hezekiah was glad of them, and shewed them the house of HIS[JESUS]
precious things, the silver, and the gold, and the spices, and the
precious ointment, and all the house of HIS[JESUS] armour, and all that was
found in HIS[JESUS] treasures: there was nothing in HIS[JESUS] house, nor in all HIS[JESUS]
dominion, that Hezekiah shewed them not.

39:3 Then came Isaiah the PROPHET[JESUS] unto KING[JESUS] Hezekiah, and said unto HIM[JESUS],
What said these men? and from whence came they unto you? And Hezekiah
said, They are come from a far country unto me, even from Babylon.

39:4 Then said HE[JESUS], What have they seen in yours house? And Hezekiah
answered, All that is in mine house have they seen: there is nothing
among my treasures that I have not shewed them.

39:5 Then said Isaiah to Hezekiah, Hear the WORD[JESUS] of the LORD[JESUS] of hosts:

39:6 Behold, the days come, that all that is in yours house, and that
which your fathers have laid up in store until this day, shall be carried
to Babylon: nothing shall be left, says the LORD[JESUS].

39:7 And of your sons that shall issue from you, which you shalt beget,
shall they take away; and they shall be eunuchs in the palace of the
KING[JESUS] of Babylon.

39:8 Then said Hezekiah to Isaiah, Good is the WORD[JESUS] of the LORD[JESUS] which
you hast spoken. HE[JESUS] said moreover, For there shall be peace and truth
in my days.


40:1 Comfort you, comfort you my people, says your GOD[JESUS].

40:2 Speak you comfortably to Jerusalem, and cry unto her, that her
warfare is accomplished, that her iniquity is pardoned: for she has
received of the LORD[JESUS]'s hand double for all her sins.

40:3 The voice of HIM[JESUS] that crieth in the wilderness, Prepare you the way
of the LORD[JESUS], make straight in the desert a highway for our GOD[JESUS].

40:4 Every valley shall be exalted, and every mountain and hill shall be
made low: and the crooked shall be made straight, and the rough places
plain:

40:5 And the glory of the LORD[JESUS] shall be revealed, and all flesh shall
see it together: for the mouth of the LORD[JESUS] has spoken it.

40:6 The voice said, Cry. And HE[JESUS] said, What shall I cry? All flesh is
grass, and all the goodliness thereof is as the flower of the field:

40:7 The grass withereth, the flower fadeth: because the spirit of the
LORD[JESUS] bloweth upon it: surely the people is grass.

40:8 The grass withereth, the flower fadeth: but the WORD[JESUS] of our GOD[JESUS]
shall stand for ever.

40:9 O Zion, that bringest good tidings, get you up into the high
mountain; O Jerusalem, that bringest good tidings, lift up your voice
with strength; lift it up, be not afraid; say unto the cities of Judah,
Behold your GOD[JESUS]!

40:10 Behold, the LORD[JESUS] GOD[JESUS] will come with strong hand, and HIS[JESUS] arm shall
rule for HIM[JESUS]: behold, HIS[JESUS] reward is with HIM[JESUS], and HIS[JESUS] work before HIM[JESUS].

40:11 HE[JESUS] shall feed HIS[JESUS] flock like a SHEPHERD[JESUS]: HE[JESUS] shall gather the lambs
with HIS[JESUS] arm, and carry them in HIS[JESUS] bosom, and shall gently lead those
that are with young.

40:12 Who has measured the waters in the hollow of HIS[JESUS] hand, and meted
out heaven with the span, and comprehended the dust of the earth in a
measure, and weighed the mountains in scales, and the hills in a
balance?

40:13 Who has directed the Spirit of the LORD[JESUS], or being HIS[JESUS] COUNSELLOR[JESUS]
has taught HIM[JESUS]?

40:14 With whom took HE[JESUS] counsel, and who instructed HIM[JESUS], and taught HIM[JESUS]
in the path of judgment, and taught HIM[JESUS] knowledge, and shewed to HIM[JESUS] the
way of understanding?

40:15 Behold, the nations are as a drop of a bucket, and are counted as
the small dust of the balance: behold, HE[JESUS] taketh up the isles as a very
little thing.

40:16 And Lebanon is not sufficient to burn, nor the beasts thereof
sufficient for a burnt offering.

40:17 All nations before HIM[JESUS] are as nothing; and they are counted to HIM[JESUS]
less than nothing, and vanity.

40:18 To whom then will you liken GOD[JESUS]? or what likeness will you compare
unto HIM[JESUS]?

40:19 The workman melteth a graven image, and the goldsmith spreadeth it
over with gold, and casteth silver chains.

40:20 HE[JESUS] that is so impoverished that HE[JESUS] has no oblation chooseth a
tree that will not rot; HE[JESUS] seeketh unto HIM[JESUS] a cunning workman to prepare
a graven image, that shall not be moved.

40:21 Have you not known? have you not heard? has it not been told you
from the beginning? have you not understood from the foundations of the
earth?

40:22 It is HE[JESUS] that sitteth upon the circle of the earth, and the
inhabitants thereof are as grasshoppers; that stretcheth out the heavens
as a curtain, and spreadeth them out as a tent to dwell in:

40:23 That bringeth the princes to nothing; HE[JESUS] makes the judges of the
earth as vanity.

40:24 Yea, they shall not be planted; yea, they shall not be sown: yea,
their stock shall not take ROOT[JESUS] in the earth: and HE[JESUS] shall also blow
upon them, and they shall wither, and the whirlwind shall take them away
as stubble.

40:25 To whom then will you liken me, or shall I be equal? says the Holy
One.

40:26 Lift up your eyes on high, and behold who has created these
things, that bringeth out their host by number: HE[JESUS] calleth them all by
names by the greatness of HIS[JESUS] might, for that HE[JESUS] is strong in power; not
one faileth.

40:27 Why sayest you, O Jacob, and speakest, O Israel, My way is hid
from the LORD[JESUS], and my judgment is passed over from my GOD[JESUS]?

40:28 Hast you not known? hast you not heard, that the everlasting
GOD[JESUS], the LORD[JESUS], the Creator of the ends of the earth, fainteth not,
neither is weary? there is no searching of HIS[JESUS] understanding.

40:29 HE[JESUS] giveth power to the faint; and to them that have no might HE[JESUS]
increaseth strength.

40:30 Even the youths shall faint and be weary, and the young men shall
utterly fall:

40:31 But they that wait upon the LORD[JESUS] shall renew their strength; they
shall mount up with wings as eagles; they shall run, and not be weary;
and they shall walk, and not faint.


41:1 Keep silence before me, O islands; and let the people renew their
strength: let them come near; then let them speak: let us come near
together to judgment.

41:2 Who raised up the righteous man from the east, called HIM[JESUS] to HIS[JESUS]
foot, gave the nations before HIM[JESUS], and made HIM[JESUS] rule over kings? HE[JESUS] gave
them as the dust to HIS[JESUS] sword, and as driven stubble to HIS[JESUS] bow.

41:3 HE[JESUS] pursued them, and passed safely; even by the way that HE[JESUS] had not
gone with HIS[JESUS] feet.

41:4 Who has wrought and done it, calling the generations from the
beginning? I the LORD[JESUS], the first, and with the last; I am HE[JESUS].

41:5 The isles saw it, and feared; the ends of the earth were afraid,
drew near, and came.

41:6 They helped every one HIS[JESUS] neighbour; and every one said to HIS[JESUS]
brother, Be of good courage.

41:7 So the carpenter encouraged the goldsmith, and HE[JESUS] that smootheth
with the hammer HIM[JESUS] that smote the anvil, saying, It is ready for the
sodering: and HE[JESUS] fastened it with nails, that it should not be moved.

41:8 But you, Israel, art my SERVANT[JESUS], Jacob whom I have chosen, the
SEED[JESUS] of Abraham my friend.

41:9 you whom I have taken from the ends of the earth, and called you
from the chief men thereof, and said unto you, you art my SERVANT[JESUS]; I
have chosen you, and not cast you away.

41:10 Fear you not; for I am with you: be not dismayed; for I am your
GOD[JESUS]: I will strengthen you; yea, I will help you; yea, I will uphold
you with the right hand of my righteousness.

41:11 Behold, all they that were incensed against you shall be ashamed
and confounded: they shall be as nothing; and they that strive with you
shall perish.

41:12 you shalt seek them, and shalt not find them, even them that
contended with you: they that war against you shall be as nothing, and
as a thing of nought.

41:13 For I the LORD[JESUS] your GOD[JESUS] will hold your right hand, saying unto you,
Fear not; I will help you.

41:14 Fear not, you worm Jacob, and you men of Israel; I will help you,
says the LORD[JESUS], and your redeemer, the Holy One of Israel.

41:15 Behold, I will make you a new sharp threshing instrument having
teeth: you shalt thresh the mountains, and beat them small, and shalt
make the hills as chaff.

41:16 you shalt fan them, and the wind shall carry them away, and the
whirlwind shall scatter them: and you shalt rejoice in the LORD[JESUS], and
shalt glory in the Holy One of Israel.

41:17 When the poor and needy seek water, and there is none, and their
tongue faileth for thirst, I the LORD[JESUS] will hear them, I the GOD[JESUS] of
Israel will not forsake them.

41:18 I will open rivers in high places, and fountains in the midst of
the valleys: I will make the wilderness a pool of water, and the dry
land springs of water.

41:19 I will plant in the wilderness the cedar, the shittah tree, and
the myrtle, and the oil tree; I will set in the desert the fir tree, and
the pine, and the box tree together:

41:20 That they may see, and know, and consider, and understand
together, that the hand of the LORD[JESUS] has done this, and the Holy One of
Israel has created it.

41:21 Produce your cause, says the LORD[JESUS]; bring forth your strong
reasons, says the KING[JESUS] of Jacob.

41:22 Let them bring them forth, and shew us what shall happen: let them
shew the former things, what they be, that we may consider them, and
know the latter end of them; or declare us things for to come.

41:23 Shew the things that are to come hereafter, that we may know that
you are gods: yea, do good, or do evil, that we may be dismayed, and
behold it together.

41:24 Behold, you are of nothing, and your work of nought: an abomination
is HE[JESUS] that chooseth you.

41:25 I have raised up one from the north, and HE[JESUS] shall come: from the
rising of the sun shall HE[JESUS] call upon my name: and HE[JESUS] shall come upon
princes as upon morter, and as the potter treadeth clay.

41:26 Who has declared from the beginning, that we may know? and
beforetime, that we may say, HE[JESUS] is righteous? yea, there is none that
sheweth, yea, there is none that declareth, yea, there is none that
heareth your words.

41:27 The first shall say to Zion, Behold, behold them: and I will give
to Jerusalem one that bringeth good tidings.

41:28 For I beheld, and there was no man; even among them, and there was
no COUNSELLOR[JESUS], that, when I asked of them, could answer a WORD[JESUS].

41:29 Behold, they are all vanity; their works are nothing: their molten
images are wind and confusion.


42:1 Behold my SERVANT[JESUS], whom I uphold; mine elect, in whom my soul
delighteth; I have put my spirit upon HIM[JESUS]: HE[JESUS] shall bring forth judgment
to the Gentiles.

42:2 HE[JESUS] shall not cry, nor lift up, nor cause HIS[JESUS] voice to be heard in
the street.

42:3 A bruised reed shall HE[JESUS] not break, and the smoking flax shall HE[JESUS]
not quench: HE[JESUS] shall bring forth judgment unto truth.

42:4 HE[JESUS] shall not fail nor be discouraged, till HE[JESUS] have set judgment in
the earth: and the isles shall wait for HIS[JESUS] law.

42:5 Thus says GOD[JESUS] the LORD[JESUS], HE[JESUS] that created the heavens, and stretched
them out; HE[JESUS] that spread forth the earth, and that which comes out of
it; HE[JESUS] that giveth breath unto the people upon it, and spirit to them
that walk therein:

42:6 I the LORD[JESUS] have called you in righteousness, and will hold yours
hand, and will keep you, and give you for a covenant of the people,
for a light of the Gentiles;

42:7 To open the blind eyes, to bring out the prisoners from the prison,
and them that sit in darkness out of the prison house.

42:8 I am the LORD[JESUS]: that is my name: and my glory will I not give to
another, neither my praise to graven images.

42:9 Behold, the former things are come to pass, and new things do I
declare: before they spring forth I tell you of them.

42:10 Sing unto the LORD[JESUS] a new song, and HIS[JESUS] praise from the end of the
earth, you that go down to the sea, and all that is therein; the isles,
and the inhabitants thereof.

42:11 Let the wilderness and the cities thereof lift up their voice, the
villages that Kedar does inhabit: let the inhabitants of the rock sing,
let them shout from the top of the mountains.

42:12 Let them give glory unto the LORD[JESUS], and declare HIS[JESUS] praise in the
islands.

42:13 The LORD[JESUS] shall go forth as a mighty man, HE[JESUS] shall stir up jealousy
like a man of war: HE[JESUS] shall cry, yea, roar; HE[JESUS] shall prevail against HIS[JESUS]
enemies.

42:14 I have long time holden my peace; I have been still, and refrained
myself: now will I cry like a travailing woman; I will destroy and
devour at once.

42:15 I will make waste mountains and hills, and dry up all their herbs;
and I will make the rivers islands, and I will dry up the pools.

42:16 And I will bring the blind by a way that they knew not; I will
lead them in paths that they have not known: I will make darkness light
before them, and crooked things straight. These things will I do unto
them, and not forsake them.

42:17 They shall be turned back, they shall be greatly ashamed, that
trust in graven images, that say to the molten images, you are our gods.

42:18 Hear, you deaf; and look, you blind, that you may see.

42:19 Who is blind, but my SERVANT[JESUS]? or deaf, as my messenger that I
sent? who is blind as HE[JESUS] that is perfect, and blind as the LORD[JESUS]'s
SERVANT[JESUS]?

42:20 Seeing many things, but you observest not; opening the ears, but
HE[JESUS] heareth not.

42:21 The LORD[JESUS] is well pleased for HIS[JESUS] righteousness' sake; HE[JESUS] will
magnify the law, and make it honourable.

42:22 But this is a people robbed and spoiled; they are all of them
snared in holes, and they are hid in prison houses: they are for a prey,
and none delivereth; for a spoil, and none says, Restore.

42:23 Who among you will give ear to this? who will hearken and hear for
the time to come?

42:24 Who gave Jacob for a spoil, and Israel to the robbers? did not the
LORD[JESUS], HE[JESUS] against whom we have sinned? for they would not walk in HIS[JESUS]
ways, neither were they obedient unto HIS[JESUS] law.

42:25 Therefore HE[JESUS] has poured upon HIM[JESUS] the fury of HIS[JESUS] anger, and the
strength of battle: and it has set HIM[JESUS] on fire round about, yet HE[JESUS] knew
not; and it burned HIM[JESUS], yet HE[JESUS] laid it not to heart.


43:1 But now thus says the LORD[JESUS] that created you, O Jacob, and HE[JESUS] that
formed you, O Israel, Fear not: for I have redeemed you, I have called
you by your name; you art mine.

43:2 When you passest through the waters, I will be with you; and
through the rivers, they shall not overflow you: when you walkest
through the fire, you shalt not be burned; neither shall the flame
kindle upon you.

43:3 For I am the LORD[JESUS] your GOD[JESUS], the Holy One of Israel, your Saviour: I
gave Egypt for your ransom, Ethiopia and Seba for you.

43:4 Since you wast precious in my sight, you hast been honourable,
and I have loved you: therefore will I give men for you, and people
for your life.

43:5 Fear not: for I am with you: I will bring your SEED[JESUS] from the east,
and gather you from the west;

43:6 I will say to the north, Give up; and to the south, Keep not back:
bring my sons from far, and my daughters from the ends of the earth;

43:7 Even every one that is called by my name: for I have created HIM[JESUS]
for my glory, I have formed HIM[JESUS]; yea, I have made HIM[JESUS].

43:8 Bring forth the blind people that have eyes, and the deaf that have
ears.

43:9 Let all the nations be gathered together, and let the people be
assembled: who among them can declare this, and shew us former things?
let them bring forth their witnesses, that they may be justified: or let
them hear, and say, It is truth.

43:10 you are my witnesses, says the LORD[JESUS], and my SERVANT[JESUS] whom I have
chosen: that you may know and believe me, and understand that I am HE[JESUS]:
before me there was no GOD[JESUS] formed, neither shall there be after me.

43:11 I, even I, am the LORD[JESUS]; and beside me there is no saviour.

43:12 I have declared, and have saved, and I have shewed, when there was
no strange GOD[JESUS] among you: therefore you are my witnesses, says the LORD[JESUS],
that I am GOD[JESUS].

43:13 Yea, before the day was I am HE[JESUS]; and there is none that can
deliver out of my hand: I will work, and who shall let it?

43:14 Thus says the LORD[JESUS], your redeemer, the Holy One of Israel; For
your sake I have sent to Babylon, and have brought down all their
nobles, and the Chaldeans, whose cry is in the ships.

43:15 I am the LORD[JESUS], your Holy One, the creator of Israel, your KING[JESUS].

43:16 Thus says the LORD[JESUS], which makes a way in the sea, and a path in
the mighty waters;

43:17 Which bringeth forth the chariot and horse, the army and the
power; they shall lie down together, they shall not rise: they are
extinct, they are quenched as tow.

43:18 Remember you not the former things, neither consider the things of
old.

43:19 Behold, I will do a new thing; now it shall spring forth; shall you
not know it? I will even make a way in the wilderness, and rivers in the
desert.

43:20 The beast of the field shall honour me, the dragons and the owls:
because I give waters in the wilderness, and rivers in the desert, to
give drink to my people, my chosen.

43:21 This people have I formed for myself; they shall shew forth my
praise.

43:22 But you hast not called upon me, O Jacob; but you hast been
weary of me, O Israel.

43:23 you hast not brought me the small cattle of your burnt offerings;
neither hast you honoured me with your sacrifices. I have not caused
you to serve with an offering, nor wearied you with incense.

43:24 you hast bought me no sweet cane with money, neither hast you
filled me with the fat of your sacrifices: but you hast made me to serve
with your sins, you hast wearied me with yours iniquities.

43:25 I, even I, am HE[JESUS] that blotteth out your transgressions for mine own
sake, and will not remember your sins.

43:26 Put me in remembrance: let us plead together: declare you, that
you mayest be justified.

43:27 your first father has sinned, and your teachers have transgressed
against me.

43:28 Therefore I have profaned the princes of the sanctuary, and have
given Jacob to the curse, and Israel to reproaches.


44:1 Yet now hear, O Jacob my SERVANT[JESUS]; and Israel, whom I have chosen:

44:2 Thus says the LORD[JESUS] that made you, and formed you from the womb,
which will help you; Fear not, O Jacob, my SERVANT[JESUS]; and you, Jesurun,
whom I have chosen.

44:3 For I will pour water upon HIM[JESUS] that is thirsty, and floods upon the
dry ground: I will pour my spirit upon your SEED[JESUS], and my blessing upon
yours OFFSPRING[JESUS]:

44:4 And they shall spring up as among the grass, as willows by the
water courses.

44:5 One shall say, I am the LORD[JESUS]'s; and another shall call himself by
the name of Jacob; and another shall subscribe with HIS[JESUS] hand unto the
LORD[JESUS], and surname himself by the name of Israel.

44:6 Thus says the LORD[JESUS] the KING[JESUS] of Israel, and HIS[JESUS] redeemer the LORD[JESUS]
of hosts; I am the first, and I am the last; and beside me there is no
GOD[JESUS].

44:7 And who, as I, shall call, and shall declare it, and set it in
order for me, since I appointed the ancient people? and the things that
are coming, and shall come, let them shew unto them.

44:8 Fear you not, neither be afraid: have not I told you from that
time, and have declared it? you are even my witnesses. Is there a GOD[JESUS]
beside me? yea, there is no GOD[JESUS]; I know not any.

44:9 They that make a graven image are all of them vanity; and their
delectable things shall not profit; and they are their own witnesses;
they see not, nor know; that they may be ashamed.

44:10 Who has formed a GOD[JESUS], or molten a graven image that is profitable
for nothing?

44:11 Behold, all HIS[JESUS] fellows shall be ashamed: and the workmen, they
are of men: let them all be gathered together, let them stand up; yet
they shall fear, and they shall be ashamed together.

44:12 The smith with the tongs both worketh in the coals, and fashioneth
it with hammers, and worketh it with the strength of HIS[JESUS] arms: yea, HE[JESUS]
is hungry, and HIS[JESUS] strength faileth: HE[JESUS] drinketh no water, and is faint.

44:13 The carpenter stretcheth out HIS[JESUS] rule; HE[JESUS] marketh it out with a
line; HE[JESUS] fitteth it with planes, and HE[JESUS] marketh it out with the compass,
and makes it after the figure of a man, according to the beauty of a
man; that it may remain in the house.

44:14 HE[JESUS] heweth HIM[JESUS] down cedars, and taketh the cypress and the oak,
which HE[JESUS] strengtheneth for himself among the trees of the forest: HE[JESUS]
planteth an ash, and the rain does nourish it.

44:15 Then shall it be for a man to burn: for HE[JESUS] will take thereof, and
warm himself; yea, HE[JESUS] kindleth it, and baketh bread; yea, HE[JESUS] makes a
GOD[JESUS], and worshippeth it; HE[JESUS] makes it a graven image, and falleth down
thereto.

44:16 HE[JESUS] burneth part thereof in the fire; with part thereof HE[JESUS] eateth
flesh; HE[JESUS] roasteth roast, and is satisfied: yea, HE[JESUS] warmeth himself, and
says, Aha, I am warm, I have seen the fire:

44:17 And the residue thereof HE[JESUS] makes a GOD[JESUS], even HIS[JESUS] graven image: HE[JESUS]
falleth down unto it, and worshippeth it, and prayeth unto it, and
says, Deliver me; for you art my GOD[JESUS].

44:18 They have not known nor understood: for HE[JESUS] has shut their eyes,
that they cannot see; and their hearts, that they cannot understand.

44:19 And none considereth in HIS[JESUS] heart, neither is there knowledge nor
understanding to say, I have burned part of it in the fire; yea, also I
have baked bread upon the coals thereof; I have roasted flesh, and eaten
it: and shall I make the residue thereof an abomination? shall I fall
down to the stock of a tree?

44:20 HE[JESUS] feedeth on ashes: a deceived heart has turned HIM[JESUS] aside, that
HE[JESUS] cannot deliver HIS[JESUS] soul, nor say, Is there not a lie in my right
hand?

44:21 Remember these, O Jacob and Israel; for you art my SERVANT[JESUS]: I
have formed you; you art my SERVANT[JESUS]: O Israel, you shalt not be
forgotten of me.

44:22 I have blotted out, as a thick cloud, your transgressions, and, as
a cloud, your sins: return unto me; for I have redeemed you.

44:23 Sing, O you heavens; for the LORD[JESUS] has done it: shout, you lower
parts of the earth: break forth into singing, you mountains, O forest,
and every tree therein: for the LORD[JESUS] has redeemed Jacob, and glorified
himself in Israel.

44:24 Thus says the LORD[JESUS], your redeemer, and HE[JESUS] that formed you from
the womb, I am the LORD[JESUS] that makes all things; that stretcheth forth
the heavens alone; that spreadeth abroad the earth by myself;

44:25 That frustrateth the tokens of the liars, and makes diviners mad;
that turneth wise men backward, and makes their knowledge foolish;

44:26 That confirmeth the WORD[JESUS] of HIS[JESUS] SERVANT[JESUS], and performeth the
counsel of HIS[JESUS] messengers; that says to Jerusalem, you shalt be
inhabited; and to the cities of Judah, you shall be built, and I will
raise up the decayed places thereof:

44:27 That says to the deep, Be dry, and I will dry up your rivers:

44:28 That says of Cyrus, HE[JESUS] is my SHEPHERD[JESUS], and shall perform all my
pleasure: even saying to Jerusalem, you shalt be built; and to the
temple, your foundation shall be laid.


45:1 Thus says the LORD[JESUS] to HIS[JESUS] anointed, to Cyrus, whose right hand I
have holden, to subdue nations before HIM[JESUS]; and I will loose the loins of
kings, to open before HIM[JESUS] the two leaved gates; and the gates shall not
be shut;

45:2 I will go before you, and make the crooked places straight: I will
break in pieces the gates of brass, and cut in sunder the bars of iron:

45:3 And I will give you the treasures of darkness, and hidden riches
of secret places, that you mayest know that I, the LORD[JESUS], which call
you by your name, am the GOD[JESUS] of Israel.

45:4 For Jacob my SERVANT[JESUS]'s sake, and Israel mine elect, I have even
called you by your name: I have surnamed you, though you hast not
known me.

45:5 I am the LORD[JESUS], and there is none else, there is no GOD[JESUS] beside me: I
girded you, though you hast not known me:

45:6 That they may know from the rising of the sun, and from the west,
that there is none beside me. I am the LORD[JESUS], and there is none else.

45:7 I form the light, and create darkness: I make peace, and create
evil: I the LORD[JESUS] do all these things.

45:8 Drop down, you heavens, from above, and let the skies pour down
righteousness: let the earth open, and let them bring forth salvation,
and let righteousness spring up together; I the LORD[JESUS] have created it.

45:9 Woe unto HIM[JESUS] that striveth with HIS[JESUS] Maker! Let the potsherd strive
with the potsherds of the earth. Shall the clay say to HIM[JESUS] that
fashioneth it, What makest you? or your work, HE[JESUS] has no hands?

45:10 Woe unto HIM[JESUS] that says unto HIS[JESUS] father, What begettest you? or
to the woman, What hast you brought forth?

45:11 Thus says the LORD[JESUS], the Holy One of Israel, and HIS[JESUS] Maker, Ask me
of things to come concerning my sons, and concerning the work of my
hands command you me.

45:12 I have made the earth, and created man upon it: I, even my hands,
have stretched out the heavens, and all their host have I commanded.

45:13 I have raised HIM[JESUS] up in righteousness, and I will direct all HIS[JESUS]
ways: HE[JESUS] shall build my city, and HE[JESUS] shall let go my captives, not for
price nor reward, says the LORD[JESUS] of hosts.

45:14 Thus says the LORD[JESUS], The labour of Egypt, and merchandise of
Ethiopia and of the Sabeans, men of stature, shall come over unto you,
and they shall be yours: they shall come after you; in chains they
shall come over, and they shall fall down unto you, they shall make
supplication unto you, saying, Surely GOD[JESUS] is in you; and there is none
else, there is no GOD[JESUS].

45:15 truly you art a GOD[JESUS] that hidest thyself, O GOD[JESUS] of Israel, the
Saviour.

45:16 They shall be ashamed, and also confounded, all of them: they
shall go to confusion together that are makers of idols.

45:17 But Israel shall be saved in the LORD[JESUS] with an everlasting
salvation: you shall not be ashamed nor confounded world without end.

45:18 For thus says the LORD[JESUS] that created the heavens; GOD[JESUS] himself that
formed the earth and made it; HE[JESUS] has established it, HE[JESUS] created it not
in vain, HE[JESUS] formed it to be inhabited: I am the LORD[JESUS]; and there is none
else.

45:19 I have not spoken in secret, in a dark place of the earth: I said
not unto the SEED[JESUS] of Jacob, Seek you me in vain: I the LORD[JESUS] speak
righteousness, I declare things that are right.

45:20 Assemble yourselves and come; draw near together, you that are
escaped of the nations: they have no knowledge that set up the wood of
their graven image, and pray unto a GOD[JESUS] that cannot save.

45:21 Tell you, and bring them near; yea, let them take counsel together:
who has declared this from ancient time? who has told it from that
time? have not I the LORD[JESUS]? and there is no GOD[JESUS] else beside me; a just
GOD[JESUS] and a Saviour; there is none beside me.

45:22 Look unto me, and be you saved, all the ends of the earth: for I am
GOD[JESUS], and there is none else.

45:23 I have sworn by myself, the WORD[JESUS] is gone out of my mouth in
righteousness, and shall not return, That unto me every knee shall bow,
every tongue shall swear.

45:24 Surely, shall one say, in the LORD[JESUS] have I righteousness and
strength: even to HIM[JESUS] shall men come; and all that are incensed against
HIM[JESUS] shall be ashamed.

45:25 In the LORD[JESUS] shall all the SEED[JESUS] of Israel be justified, and shall
glory.


46:1 Bel boweth down, Nebo stoopeth, their idols were upon the beasts,
and upon the cattle: your carriages were heavy loaden; they are a burden
to the weary beast.

46:2 They stoop, they bow down together; they could not deliver the
burden, but themselves are gone into captivity.

46:3 Hearken unto me, O house of Jacob, and all the remnant of the house
of Israel, which are borne by me from the belly, which are carried from
the womb:

46:4 And even to your old age I am HE[JESUS]; and even to hoar hairs will I
carry you: I have made, and I will bear; even I will carry, and will
deliver you.

46:5 To whom will you liken me, and make me equal, and compare me, that
we may be like?

46:6 They lavish gold out of the bag, and weigh silver in the balance,
and hire a goldsmith; and HE[JESUS] makes it a GOD[JESUS]: they fall down, yea, they
worship.

46:7 They bear HIM[JESUS] upon the shoulder, they carry HIM[JESUS], and set HIM[JESUS] in HIS[JESUS]
place, and HE[JESUS] standeth; from HIS[JESUS] place shall HE[JESUS] not remove: yea, one
shall cry unto HIM[JESUS], yet can HE[JESUS] not answer, nor save HIM[JESUS] out of HIS[JESUS]
trouble.

46:8 Remember this, and shew yourselves men: bring it again to mind, O
you transgressors.

46:9 Remember the former things of old: for I am GOD[JESUS], and there is none
else; I am GOD[JESUS], and there is none like me,

46:10 Declaring the end from the beginning, and from ancient times the
things that are not yet done, saying, My counsel shall stand, and I will
do all my pleasure:

46:11 Calling a ravenous bird from the east, the man that executeth my
counsel from a far country: yea, I have spoken it, I will also bring it
to pass; I have purposed it, I will also do it.

46:12 Hearken unto me, you stouthearted, that are far from righteousness:

46:13 I bring near my righteousness; it shall not be far off, and my
salvation shall not tarry: and I will place salvation in Zion for Israel
my glory.


47:1 Come down, and sit in the dust, O virgin daughter of Babylon, sit
on the ground: there is no throne, O daughter of the Chaldeans: for you
shalt no more be called tender and delicate.

47:2 Take the millstones, and grind meal: uncover your locks, make bare
the leg, uncover the thigh, pass over the rivers.

47:3 your nakedness shall be uncovered, yea, your shame shall be seen: I
will take vengeance, and I will not meet you as a man.

47:4 As for our redeemer, the LORD[JESUS] of hosts is HIS[JESUS] name, the Holy One of
Israel.

47:5 Sit you silent, and get you into darkness, O daughter of the
Chaldeans: for you shalt no more be called, The lady of kingdoms.

47:6 I was wroth with my people, I have polluted mine inheritance, and
given them into yours hand: you didst shew them no mercy; upon the
ancient hast you very heavily laid your yoke.

47:7 And you saidst, I shall be a lady for ever: so that you didst not
lay these things to your heart, neither didst remember the latter end of
it.

47:8 Therefore hear now this, you that art given to pleasures, that
dwellest carelessly, that sayest in yours heart, I am, and none else
beside me; I shall not sit as a widow, neither shall I know the loss of
children:

47:9 But these two things shall come to you in a moment in one day, the
loss of children, and widowhood: they shall come upon you in their
perfection for the multitude of your sorceries, and for the great
abundance of yours enchantments.

47:10 For you hast trusted in your wickedness: you hast said, None
seeth me. your wisdom and your knowledge, it has perverted you; and you
hast said in yours heart, I am, and none else beside me.

47:11 Therefore shall evil come upon you; you shalt not know from
whence it riseth: and mischief shall fall upon you; you shalt not be
able to put it off: and desolation shall come upon you suddenly, which
you shalt not know.

47:12 Stand now with yours enchantments, and with the multitude of your
sorceries, wherein you hast laboured from your youth; if so be you
shalt be able to profit, if so be you mayest prevail.

47:13 you art wearied in the multitude of your counsels. Let now the
astrologers, the stargazers, the monthly prognosticators, stand up, and
save you from these things that shall come upon you.

47:14 Behold, they shall be as stubble; the fire shall burn them; they
shall not deliver themselves from the power of the flame: there shall
not be a coal to warm at, nor fire to sit before it.

47:15 Thus shall they be unto you with whom you hast laboured, even
your merchants, from your youth: they shall wander every one to HIS[JESUS]
quarter; none shall save you.


48:1 Hear you this, O house of Jacob, which are called by the name of
Israel, and are come forth out of the waters of Judah, which swear by
the name of the LORD[JESUS], and make mention of the GOD[JESUS] of Israel, but not in
truth, nor in righteousness.

48:2 For they call themselves of the holy city, and stay themselves upon
the GOD[JESUS] of Israel; The LORD[JESUS] of hosts is HIS[JESUS] name.

48:3 I have declared the former things from the beginning; and they went
forth out of my mouth, and I shewed them; I did them suddenly, and they
came to pass.

48:4 Because I knew that you art obstinate, and your neck is an iron
sinew, and your brow brass;

48:5 I have even from the beginning declared it to you; before it came
to pass I shewed it you: lest you shouldest say, Mine idol has done
them, and my graven image, and my molten image, has commanded them.

48:6 you hast heard, see all this; and will not you declare it? I have
shewed you new things from this time, even hidden things, and you
didst not know them.

48:7 They are created now, and not from the beginning; even before the
day when you heardest them not; lest you shouldest say, Behold, I knew
them.

48:8 Yea, you heardest not; yea, you knewest not; yea, from that time
that yours ear was not opened: for I knew that you wouldest deal very
treacherously, and wast called a transgressor from the womb.

48:9 For my name's sake will I defer mine anger, and for my praise will
I refrain for you, that I cut you not off.

48:10 Behold, I have refined you, but not with silver; I have chosen
you in the furnace of affliction.

48:11 For mine own sake, even for mine own sake, will I do it: for how
should my name be polluted? and I will not give my glory unto another.

48:12 Hearken unto me, O Jacob and Israel, my called; I am HE[JESUS]; I am the
first, I also am the last.

48:13 Mine hand also has laid the foundation of the earth, and my right
hand has spanned the heavens: when I call unto them, they stand up
together.

48:14 All you, assemble yourselves, and hear; which among them has
declared these things? The LORD[JESUS] has loved HIM[JESUS]: HE[JESUS] will do HIS[JESUS] pleasure
on Babylon, and HIS[JESUS] arm shall be on the Chaldeans.

48:15 I, even I, have spoken; yea, I have called HIM[JESUS]: I have brought
HIM[JESUS], and HE[JESUS] shall make HIS[JESUS] way prosperous.

48:16 Come you near unto me, hear you this; I have not spoken in secret
from the beginning; from the time that it was, there am I: and now the
LORD[JESUS] GOD[JESUS], and HIS[JESUS] Spirit, has sent me.

48:17 Thus says the LORD[JESUS], your Redeemer, the Holy One of Israel; I am
the LORD[JESUS] your GOD[JESUS] which teacheth you to profit, which leads you by
the way that you shouldest go.

48:18 O that you hadst hearkened to my commandments! then had your peace
been as a river, and your righteousness as the waves of the sea:

48:19 your SEED[JESUS] also had been as the sand, and the OFFSPRING[JESUS] of your
bowels like the gravel thereof; HIS[JESUS] name should not have been cut off
nor destroyed from before me.

48:20 Go you forth of Babylon, flee you from the Chaldeans, with a voice
of singing declare you, tell this, utter it even to the end of the earth;
say you, The LORD[JESUS] has redeemed HIS[JESUS] SERVANT[JESUS] Jacob.

48:21 And they thirsted not when HE[JESUS] led them through the deserts: HE[JESUS]
caused the waters to flow out of the rock for them: HE[JESUS] clave the rock
also, and the waters gushed out.

48:22 There is no peace, says the LORD[JESUS], unto the wicked.


49:1 Listen, O isles, unto me; and hearken, you people, from far; The
LORD[JESUS] has called me from the womb; from the bowels of my mother has HE[JESUS]
made mention of my name.

49:2 And HE[JESUS] has made my mouth like a sharp sword; in the shadow of HIS[JESUS]
hand has HE[JESUS] hid me, and made me a polished shaft; in HIS[JESUS] quiver has HE[JESUS]
hid me;

49:3 And said unto me, you art my SERVANT[JESUS], O Israel, in whom I will be
glorified.

49:4 Then I said, I have laboured in vain, I have spent my strength for
nought, and in vain: yet surely my judgment is with the LORD[JESUS], and my
work with my GOD[JESUS].

49:5 And now, says the LORD[JESUS] that formed me from the womb to be HIS[JESUS]
SERVANT[JESUS], to bring Jacob again to HIM[JESUS], Though Israel be not gathered, yet
shall I be glorious in the eyes of the LORD[JESUS], and my GOD[JESUS] shall be my
strength.

49:6 And HE[JESUS] said, It is a light thing that you shouldest be my SERVANT[JESUS]
to raise up the tribes of Jacob, and to restore the preserved of Israel:
I will also give you for a light to the Gentiles, that you mayest be
my salvation unto the end of the earth.

49:7 Thus says the LORD[JESUS], the Redeemer of Israel, and HIS[JESUS] Holy One, to
HIM[JESUS] whom man despiseth, to HIM[JESUS] whom the nation abhorreth, to a SERVANT[JESUS]
of rulers, Kings shall see and arise, princes also shall worship,
because of the LORD[JESUS] that is faithful, and the Holy One of Israel, and HE[JESUS]
shall choose you.

49:8 Thus says the LORD[JESUS], In an acceptable time have I heard you, and
in a day of salvation have I helped you: and I will preserve you, and
give you for a covenant of the people, to establish the earth, to cause
to inherit the desolate heritages;

49:9 That you mayest say to the prisoners, Go forth; to them that are
in darkness, Shew yourselves. They shall feed in the ways, and their
pastures shall be in all high places.

49:10 They shall not hunger nor thirst; neither shall the heat nor sun
smite them: for HE[JESUS] that has mercy on them shall lead them, even by the
springs of water shall HE[JESUS] guide them.

49:11 And I will make all my mountains a way, and my highways shall be
exalted.

49:12 Behold, these shall come from far: and, lo, these from the north
and from the west; and these from the land of Sinim.

49:13 Sing, O heavens; and be joyful, O earth; and break forth into
singing, O mountains: for the LORD[JESUS] has comforted HIS[JESUS] people, and will
have mercy upon HIS[JESUS] afflicted.

49:14 But Zion said, The LORD[JESUS] has forsaken me, and my LORD[JESUS] has
forgotten me.

49:15 Can a woman forget her sucking child, that she should not have
compassion on the SON[JESUS] of her womb? yea, they may forget, yet will I not
forget you.

49:16 Behold, I have graven you upon the palms of my hands; your walls
are continually before me.

49:17 your children shall make haste; your destroyers and they that made
you waste shall go forth of you.

49:18 Lift up yours eyes round about, and behold: all these gather
themselves together, and come to you. As I live, says the LORD[JESUS], you
shalt surely clothe you with them all, as with an ornament, and bind
them on you, as a bride doeth.

49:19 For your waste and your desolate places, and the land of your
destruction, shall even now be too narrow by reason of the inhabitants,
and they that swallowed you up shall be far away.

49:20 The children which you shalt have, after you hast lost the
other, shall say again in yours ears, The place is too strait for me:
give place to me that I may dwell.

49:21 Then shalt you say in yours heart, Who has begotten me these,
seeing I have lost my children, and am desolate, a captive, and removing
to and fro? and who has brought up these? Behold, I was left alone;
these, where had they been?

49:22 Thus says the LORD[JESUS] GOD[JESUS], Behold, I will lift up mine hand to the
Gentiles, and set up my standard to the people: and they shall bring your
sons in their arms, and your daughters shall be carried upon their
shoulders.

49:23 And kings shall be your nursing fathers, and their queens your
nursing mothers: they shall bow down to you with their face toward the
earth, and lick up the dust of your feet; and you shalt know that I am
the LORD[JESUS]: for they shall not be ashamed that wait for me.

49:24 Shall the prey be taken from the mighty, or the lawful captive
delivered?

49:25 But thus says the LORD[JESUS], Even the captives of the mighty shall be
taken away, and the prey of the terrible shall be delivered: for I will
contend with HIM[JESUS] that contendeth with you, and I will save your
children.

49:26 And I will feed them that oppress you with their own flesh; and
they shall be drunken with their own blood, as with sweet wine: and all
flesh shall know that I the LORD[JESUS] am your Saviour and your Redeemer, the
mighty One of Jacob.


50:1 Thus says the LORD[JESUS], Where is the bill of your mother's
divorcement, whom I have put away? or which of my creditors is it to
whom I have sold you? Behold, for your iniquities have you sold
yourselves, and for your transgressions is your mother put away.

50:2 Wherefore, when I came, was there no man? when I called, was there
none to answer? Is my hand shortened at all, that it cannot redeem? or
have I no power to deliver? behold, at my rebuke I dry up the sea, I
make the rivers a wilderness: their fish stinketh, because there is no
water, and dieth for thirst.

50:3 I clothe the heavens with blackness, and I make sackcloth their
covering.

50:4 The LORD[JESUS] GOD[JESUS] has given me the tongue of the learned, that I should
know how to speak a WORD[JESUS] in season to HIM[JESUS] that is weary: HE[JESUS] wakeneth
morning by morning, HE[JESUS] wakeneth mine ear to hear as the learned.

50:5 The LORD[JESUS] GOD[JESUS] has opened mine ear, and I was not rebellious,
neither turned away back.

50:6 I gave my back to the smiters, and my cheeks to them that plucked
off the hair: I hid not my face from shame and spitting.

50:7 For the LORD[JESUS] GOD[JESUS] will help me; therefore shall I not be confounded:
therefore have I set my face like a flint, and I know that I shall not
be ashamed.

50:8 HE[JESUS] is near that justifieth me; who will contend with me? let us
stand together: who is mine adversary? let HIM[JESUS] come near to me.

50:9 Behold, the LORD[JESUS] GOD[JESUS] will help me; who is HE[JESUS] that shall condemn me?
lo, they all shall wax old as a garment; the moth shall eat them up.

50:10 Who is among you that feareth the LORD[JESUS], that obeyeth the voice of
HIS[JESUS] SERVANT[JESUS], that walketh in darkness, and has no light? let HIM[JESUS] trust
in the name of the LORD[JESUS], and stay upon HIS[JESUS] GOD[JESUS].

50:11 Behold, all you that kindle a fire, that compass yourselves about
with sparks: walk in the light of your fire, and in the sparks that you
have kindled. This shall you have of mine hand; you shall lie down in
sorrow.


51:1 Hearken to me, you that follow after righteousness, you that seek the
LORD[JESUS]: look unto the rock whence you are hewn, and to the hole of the pit
whence you are digged.

51:2 Look unto Abraham your father, and unto Sarah that bare you: for I
called HIM[JESUS] alone, and blessed HIM[JESUS], and increased HIM[JESUS].

51:3 For the LORD[JESUS] shall comfort Zion: HE[JESUS] will comfort all her waste
places; and HE[JESUS] will make her wilderness like Eden, and her desert like
the garden of the LORD[JESUS]; joy and gladness shall be found therein,
thanksgiving, and the voice of melody.

51:4 Hearken unto me, my people; and give ear unto me, O my nation: for
a law shall proceed from me, and I will make my judgment to rest for a
light of the people.

51:5 My righteousness is near; my salvation is gone forth, and mine arms
shall judge the people; the isles shall wait upon me, and on mine arm
shall they trust.

51:6 Lift up your eyes to the heavens, and look upon the earth beneath:
for the heavens shall vanish away like smoke, and the earth shall wax
old like a garment, and they that dwell therein shall die in like
manner: but my salvation shall be for ever, and my righteousness shall
not be abolished.

51:7 Hearken unto me, you that know righteousness, the people in whose
heart is my law; fear you not the reproach of men, neither be you afraid
of their revilings.

51:8 For the moth shall eat them up like a garment, and the worm shall
eat them like wool: but my righteousness shall be for ever, and my
salvation from generation to generation.

51:9 Awake, awake, put on strength, O arm of the LORD[JESUS]; awake, as in the
ancient days, in the generations of old. Art you not it that has cut
Rahab, and wounded the dragon?

51:10 Art you not it which has dried the sea, the waters of the great
deep; that has made the depths of the sea a way for the ransomed to
pass over?

51:11 Therefore the redeemed of the LORD[JESUS] shall return, and come with
singing unto Zion; and everlasting joy shall be upon their head: they
shall obtain gladness and joy; and sorrow and mourning shall flee away.

51:12 I, even I, am HE[JESUS] that comforteth you: who art you, that you
shouldest be afraid of a man that shall die, and of the SON[JESUS] OF MAN[JESUS] which
shall be made as grass;

51:13 And forgettest the LORD[JESUS] your maker, that has stretched forth the
heavens, and laid the foundations of the earth; and hast feared
continually every day because of the fury of the oppressor, as if HE[JESUS]
were ready to destroy? and where is the fury of the oppressor?

51:14 The captive exile hasteneth that HE[JESUS] may be loosed, and that HE[JESUS]
should not die in the pit, nor that HIS[JESUS] bread should fail.

51:15 But I am the LORD[JESUS] your GOD[JESUS], that divided the sea, whose waves
roared: The LORD[JESUS] of hosts is HIS[JESUS] name.

51:16 And I have put my words in your mouth, and I have covered you in
the shadow of mine hand, that I may plant the heavens, and lay the
foundations of the earth, and say unto Zion, you art my people.

51:17 Awake, awake, stand up, O Jerusalem, which hast drunk at the hand
of the LORD[JESUS] the cup of HIS[JESUS] fury; you hast drunken the dregs of the cup
of trembling, and wrung them out.

51:18 There is none to guide her among all the sons whom she has
brought forth; neither is there any that taketh her by the hand of all
the sons that she has brought up.

51:19 These two things are come unto you; who shall be sorry for you?
desolation, and destruction, and the famine, and the sword: by whom
shall I comfort you?

51:20 your sons have fainted, they lie at the head of all the streets, as
a wild bull in a net: they are full of the fury of the LORD[JESUS], the rebuke
of your GOD[JESUS].

51:21 Therefore hear now this, you afflicted, and drunken, but not with
wine:

51:22 Thus says your LORD[JESUS] the LORD[JESUS], and your GOD[JESUS] that pleadeth the cause
of HIS[JESUS] people, Behold, I have taken out of yours hand the cup of
trembling, even the dregs of the cup of my fury; you shalt no more
drink it again:

51:23 But I will put it into the hand of them that afflict you; which
have said to your soul, Bow down, that we may go over: and you hast laid
your body as the ground, and as the street, to them that went over.


52:1 Awake, awake; put on your strength, O Zion; put on your beautiful
garments, O Jerusalem, the holy city: for henceforth there shall no more
come into you the uncircumcised and the unclean.

52:2 Shake thyself from the dust; arise, and sit down, O Jerusalem:
loose thyself from the bands of your neck, O captive daughter of Zion.

52:3 For thus says the LORD[JESUS], you have sold yourselves for nought; and you
shall be redeemed without money.

52:4 For thus says the LORD[JESUS] GOD[JESUS], My people went down aforetime into
Egypt to sojourn there; and the Assyrian oppressed them without cause.

52:5 Now therefore, what have I here, says the LORD[JESUS], that my people is
taken away for nought? they that rule over them make them to howl, says
the LORD[JESUS]; and my name continually every day is blasphemed.

52:6 Therefore my people shall know my name: therefore they shall know
in that day that I am HE[JESUS] that does speak: behold, it is I.

52:7 How beautiful upon the mountains are the feet of HIM[JESUS] that bringeth
good tidings, that publisheth peace; that bringeth good tidings of good,
that publisheth salvation; that says unto Zion, your GOD[JESUS] reigneth!

52:8 your watchmen shall lift up the voice; with the voice together shall
they sing: for they shall see eye to eye, when the LORD[JESUS] shall bring
again Zion.

52:9 Break forth into joy, sing together, you waste places of Jerusalem:
for the LORD[JESUS] has comforted HIS[JESUS] people, HE[JESUS] has redeemed Jerusalem.

52:10 The LORD[JESUS] has made bare HIS[JESUS] holy arm in the eyes of all the
nations; and all the ends of the earth shall see the salvation of our
GOD[JESUS].

52:11 Depart you, depart you, go you out from thence, touch no unclean
thing; go you out of the midst of her; be you clean, that bear the vessels
of the LORD[JESUS].

52:12 For you shall not go out with haste, nor go by flight: for the LORD[JESUS]
will go before you; and the GOD[JESUS] of Israel will be your rereward.

52:13 Behold, my SERVANT[JESUS] shall deal prudently, HE[JESUS] shall be exalted and
extolled, and be very high.

52:14 As many were astonied at you; HIS[JESUS] visage was so marred more than
any man, and HIS[JESUS] form more than the sons of men:

52:15 So shall HE[JESUS] sprinkle many nations; the kings shall shut their
mouths at HIM[JESUS]: for that which had not been told them shall they see; and
that which they had not heard shall they consider.


53:1 Who has believed our report? and to whom is the arm of the LORD[JESUS]
revealed?

53:2 For HE[JESUS] shall grow up before HIM[JESUS] as a tender plant, and as a ROOT[JESUS]
out of a dry ground: HE[JESUS] has no form nor comeliness; and when we shall
see HIM[JESUS], there is no beauty that we should desire HIM[JESUS].

53:3 HE[JESUS] is despised and rejected of men; a man of sorrows, and
acquainted with grief: and we hid as it were our faces from HIM[JESUS]; HE[JESUS] was
despised, and we esteemed HIM[JESUS] not.

53:4 Surely HE[JESUS] has borne our griefs, and carried our sorrows: yet we
did esteem HIM[JESUS] stricken, smitten of GOD[JESUS], and afflicted.

53:5 But HE[JESUS] was wounded for our transgressions, HE[JESUS] was bruised for our
iniquities: the chastisement of our peace was upon HIM[JESUS]; and with HIS[JESUS]
stripes we are healed.

53:6 All we like sheep have gone astray; we have turned every one to HIS[JESUS]
own way; and the LORD[JESUS] has laid on HIM[JESUS] the iniquity of us all.

53:7 HE[JESUS] was oppressed, and HE[JESUS] was afflicted, yet HE[JESUS] opened not HIS[JESUS]
mouth: HE[JESUS] is brought as a LAMB[JESUS] to the slaughter, and as a sheep before
her shearers is dumb, so HE[JESUS] openeth not HIS[JESUS] mouth.

53:8 HE[JESUS] was taken from prison and from judgment: and who shall declare
HIS[JESUS] generation? for HE[JESUS] was cut off out of the land of the living: for
the transgression of my people was HE[JESUS] stricken.

53:9 And HE[JESUS] made HIS[JESUS] grave with the wicked, and with the rich in HIS[JESUS]
death; because HE[JESUS] had done no violence, neither was any deceit in HIS[JESUS]
mouth.

53:10 Yet it pleased the LORD[JESUS] to bruise HIM[JESUS]; HE[JESUS] has put HIM[JESUS] to grief:
when you shalt make HIS[JESUS] soul an offering for sin, HE[JESUS] shall see HIS[JESUS]
SEED[JESUS], HE[JESUS] shall prolong HIS[JESUS] days, and the pleasure of the LORD[JESUS] shall
prosper in HIS[JESUS] hand.

53:11 HE[JESUS] shall see of the travail of HIS[JESUS] soul, and shall be satisfied:
by HIS[JESUS] knowledge shall my righteous SERVANT[JESUS] justify many; for HE[JESUS] shall
bear their iniquities.

53:12 Therefore will I divide HIM[JESUS] a portion with the great, and HE[JESUS] shall
divide the spoil with the strong; because HE[JESUS] has poured out HIS[JESUS] soul
unto death: and HE[JESUS] was numbered with the transgressors; and HE[JESUS] bare the
sin of many, and made intercession for the transgressors.


54:1 Sing, O barren, you that didst not bear; break forth into singing,
and cry aloud, you that didst not travail with child: for more are the
children of the desolate than the children of the married wife, says
the LORD[JESUS].

54:2 Enlarge the place of your tent, and let them stretch forth the
curtains of yours habitations: spare not, lengthen your cords, and
strengthen your stakes;

54:3 For you shalt break forth on the right hand and on the left; and
your SEED[JESUS] shall inherit the Gentiles, and make the desolate cities to be
inhabited.

54:4 Fear not; for you shalt not be ashamed: neither be you
confounded; for you shalt not be put to shame: for you shalt forget
the shame of your youth, and shalt not remember the reproach of your
widowhood any more.

54:5 For your Maker is yours husband; the LORD[JESUS] of hosts is HIS[JESUS] name; and
your Redeemer the Holy One of Israel; The GOD[JESUS] of the whole earth shall HE[JESUS]
be called.

54:6 For the LORD[JESUS] has called you as a woman forsaken and grieved in
spirit, and a wife of youth, when you wast refused, says your GOD[JESUS].

54:7 For a small moment have I forsaken you; but with great mercies
will I gather you.

54:8 In a little wrath I hid my face from you for a moment; but with
everlasting kindness will I have mercy on you, says the LORD[JESUS] your
Redeemer.

54:9 For this is as the waters of Noah unto me: for as I have sworn that
the waters of Noah should no more go over the earth; so have I sworn
that I would not be wroth with you, nor rebuke you.

54:10 For the mountains shall depart, and the hills be removed; but my
kindness shall not depart from you, neither shall the covenant of my
peace be removed, says the LORD[JESUS] that has mercy on you.

54:11 O you afflicted, tossed with tempest, and not comforted, behold,
I will lay your stones with fair colours, and lay your foundations with
sapphires.

54:12 And I will make your windows of agates, and your gates of
carbuncles, and all your borders of pleasant stones.

54:13 And all your children shall be taught of the LORD[JESUS]; and great shall
be the peace of your children.

54:14 In righteousness shalt you be established: you shalt be far from
oppression; for you shalt not fear: and from terror; for it shall not
come near you.

54:15 Behold, they shall surely gather together, but not by me:
whoever shall gather together against you shall fall for your sake.

54:16 Behold, I have created the smith that bloweth the coals in the
fire, and that bringeth forth an instrument for HIS[JESUS] work; and I have
created the waster to destroy.

54:17 No weapon that is formed against you shall prosper; and every
tongue that shall rise against you in judgment you shalt condemn. This
is the heritage of the servants of the LORD[JESUS], and their righteousness is
of me, says the LORD[JESUS].


55:1 Ho, every one that thirsteth, come you to the waters, and HE[JESUS] that
has no money; come you, buy, and eat; yea, come, buy wine and milk
without money and without price.

55:2 Wherefore do you spend money for that which is not bread? and your
labour for that which satisfieth not? hearken diligently unto me, and
eat you that which is good, and let your soul delight itself in fatness.

55:3 Incline your ear, and come unto me: hear, and your soul shall live;
and I will make an everlasting covenant with you, even the sure mercies
of David.

55:4 Behold, I have given HIM[JESUS] for a witness to the people, a leader and
commander to the people.

55:5 Behold, you shalt call a nation that you knowest not, and nations
that knew not you shall run unto you because of the LORD[JESUS] your GOD[JESUS], and
for the Holy One of Israel; for HE[JESUS] has glorified you.

55:6 Seek you the LORD[JESUS] while HE[JESUS] may be found, call you upon HIM[JESUS] while HE[JESUS]
is near:

55:7 Let the wicked forsake HIS[JESUS] way, and the unrighteous man HIS[JESUS]
thoughts: and let HIM[JESUS] return unto the LORD[JESUS], and HE[JESUS] will have mercy upon
HIM[JESUS]; and to our GOD[JESUS], for HE[JESUS] will abundantly pardon.

55:8 For my thoughts are not your thoughts, neither are your ways my
ways, says the LORD[JESUS].

55:9 For as the heavens are higher than the earth, so are my ways higher
than your ways, and my thoughts than your thoughts.

55:10 For as the rain comes down, and the snow from heaven, and
returneth not thither, but watereth the earth, and makes it bring forth
and bud, that it may give SEED[JESUS] to the sower, and bread to the eater:

55:11 So shall my WORD[JESUS] be that goes forth out of my mouth: it shall not
return unto me void, but it shall accomplish that which I please, and it
shall prosper in the thing whereto I sent it.

55:12 For you shall go out with joy, and be led forth with peace: the
mountains and the hills shall break forth before you into singing, and
all the trees of the field shall clap their hands.

55:13 Instead of the thorn shall come up the fir tree, and instead of
the brier shall come up the myrtle tree: and it shall be to the LORD[JESUS] for
a name, for an everlasting sign that shall not be cut off.


56:1 Thus says the LORD[JESUS], Keep you judgment, and do justice: for my
salvation is near to come, and my righteousness to be revealed.

56:2 Blessed is the man that doeth this, and the SON[JESUS] OF MAN[JESUS] that layeth
hold on it; that keepeth the sabbath from polluting it, and keepeth HIS[JESUS]
hand from doing any evil.

56:3 Neither let the SON[JESUS] of the stranger, that has joined himself to
the LORD[JESUS], speak, saying, The LORD[JESUS] has utterly separated me from HIS[JESUS]
people: neither let the eunuch say, Behold, I am a dry tree.

56:4 For thus says the LORD[JESUS] unto the eunuchs that keep my sabbaths, and
choose the things that please me, and take hold of my covenant;

56:5 Even unto them will I give in mine house and within my walls a
place and a name better than of sons and of daughters: I will give them
an everlasting name, that shall not be cut off.

56:6 Also the sons of the stranger, that join themselves to the LORD[JESUS], to
serve HIM[JESUS], and to love the name of the LORD[JESUS], to be HIS[JESUS] servants, every
one that keepeth the sabbath from polluting it, and taketh hold of my
covenant;

56:7 Even them will I bring to my holy mountain, and make them joyful in
my house of prayer: their burnt offerings and their sacrifices shall be
accepted upon mine altar; for mine house shall be called an house of
prayer for all people.

56:8 The LORD[JESUS] GOD[JESUS], which gathereth the outcasts of Israel says, Yet
will I gather others to HIM[JESUS], beside those that are gathered unto HIM[JESUS].

56:9 All you beasts of the field, come to devour, yea, all you beasts in
the forest.

56:10 HIS[JESUS] watchmen are blind: they are all ignorant, they are all dumb
dogs, they cannot bark; sleeping, lying down, loving to slumber.

56:11 Yea, they are greedy dogs which can never have enough, and they
are shepherds that cannot understand: they all look to their own way,
every one for HIS[JESUS] gain, from HIS[JESUS] quarter.

56:12 Come you, say they, I will fetch wine, and we will fill ourselves
with strong drink; and to morrow shall be as this day, and much more
abundant.


57:1 The righteous perisheth, and no man layeth it to heart: and
merciful men are taken away, none considering that the righteous is
taken away from the evil to come.

57:2 HE[JESUS] shall enter into peace: they shall rest in their beds, each one
walking in HIS[JESUS] uprightness.

57:3 But draw near hither, you sons of the sorceress, the SEED[JESUS] of the
adulterer and the whore.

57:4 Against whom do you sport yourselves? against whom make you a wide
mouth, and draw out the tongue? are you not children of transgression, a
SEED[JESUS] of falsehood.

57:5 Enflaming yourselves with idols under every green tree, slaying the
children in the valleys under the clifts of the rocks?

57:6 Among the smooth stones of the stream is your portion; they, they
are your lot: even to them hast you poured a drink offering, you hast
offered a meat offering. Should I receive comfort in these?

57:7 Upon a lofty and high mountain hast you set your bed: even thither
wentest you up to offer sacrifice.

57:8 Behind the doors also and the posts hast you set up your
remembrance: for you hast discovered thyself to another than me, and
art gone up; you hast enlarged your bed, and made you a covenant with
them; you lovedst their bed where you sawest it.

57:9 And you wentest to the KING[JESUS] with ointment, and didst increase your
perfumes, and didst send your messengers far off, and didst debase
thyself even unto hell.

57:10 you art wearied in the greatness of your way; yet saidst you not,
There is no hope: you hast found the life of yours hand; therefore you
wast not grieved.

57:11 And of whom hast you been afraid or feared, that you hast lied,
and hast not remembered me, nor laid it to your heart? have not I held my
peace even of old, and you fearest me not?

57:12 I will declare your righteousness, and your works; for they shall
not profit you.

57:13 When you criest, let your companies deliver you; but the wind
shall carry them all away; vanity shall take them: but HE[JESUS] that putteth
HIS[JESUS] trust in me shall possess the land, and shall inherit my holy
mountain;

57:14 And shall say, Cast you up, cast you up, prepare the way, take up
the stumblingblock out of the way of my people.
