31:3 The LORD[JESUS] has appeared of old unto me, saying, Yea, I have loved
you with an everlasting love: therefore with lovingkindness have I
drawn you.

31:4 Again I will build you, and you shalt be built, O virgin of
Israel: you shalt again be adorned with your tabrets, and shalt go forth
in the dances of them that make merry.

31:5 you shalt yet plant vines upon the mountains of Samaria: the
planters shall plant, and shall eat them as common things.

31:6 For there shall be a day, that the watchmen upon the mount Ephraim
shall cry, Arise you, and let us go up to Zion unto the LORD[JESUS] our GOD[JESUS].

31:7 For thus says the LORD[JESUS]; Sing with gladness for Jacob, and shout
among the chief of the nations: publish you, praise you, and say, O LORD[JESUS],
save your people, the remnant of Israel.

31:8 Behold, I will bring them from the north country, and gather them
from the coasts of the earth, and with them the blind and the lame, the
woman with child and her that travaileth with child together: a great
company shall return thither.

31:9 They shall come with weeping, and with supplications will I lead
them: I will cause them to walk by the rivers of waters in a straight
way, wherein they shall not stumble: for I am a father to Israel, and
Ephraim is my firstborn.

31:10 Hear the WORD[JESUS] of the LORD[JESUS], O you nations, and declare it in the
isles afar off, and say, HE[JESUS] that scattered Israel will gather HIM[JESUS], and
keep HIM[JESUS], as a SHEPHERD[JESUS] does HIS[JESUS] flock.

31:11 For the LORD[JESUS] has redeemed Jacob, and ransomed HIM[JESUS] from the hand
of HIM[JESUS] that was stronger than HE[JESUS].

31:12 Therefore they shall come and sing in the height of Zion, and
shall flow together to the goodness of the LORD[JESUS], for wheat, and for
wine, and for oil, and for the young of the flock and of the herd: and
their soul shall be as a watered garden; and they shall not sorrow any
more at all.

31:13 Then shall the virgin rejoice in the dance, both young men and old
together: for I will turn their mourning into joy, and will comfort
them, and make them rejoice from their sorrow.

31:14 And I will satiate the soul of the priests with fatness, and my
people shall be satisfied with my goodness, says the LORD[JESUS].

31:15 Thus says the LORD[JESUS]; A voice was heard in Ramah, lamentation, and
bitter weeping; Rahel weeping for her children refused to be comforted
for her children, because they were not.

31:16 Thus says the LORD[JESUS]; Refrain your voice from weeping, and yours
eyes from tears: for your work shall be rewarded, says the LORD[JESUS]; and
they shall come again from the land of the enemy.

31:17 And there is hope in yours end, says the LORD[JESUS], that your children
shall come again to their own border.

31:18 I have surely heard Ephraim bemoaning himself thus; you hast
chastised me, and I was chastised, as a bullock unaccustomed to the
yoke: turn you me, and I shall be turned; for you art the LORD[JESUS] my GOD[JESUS].

31:19 Surely after that I was turned, I repented; and after that I was
instructed, I smote upon my thigh: I was ashamed, yea, even confounded,
because I did bear the reproach of my youth.

31:20 Is Ephraim my dear SON[JESUS]? is HE[JESUS] a pleasant child? for since I spake
against HIM[JESUS], I do earnestly remember HIM[JESUS] still: therefore my bowels are
troubled for HIM[JESUS]; I will surely have mercy upon HIM[JESUS], says the LORD[JESUS].

31:21 Set you up waymarks, make you high heaps: set yours heart toward
the highway, even the way which you wentest: turn again, O virgin of
Israel, turn again to these your cities.

31:22 How long wilt you go about, O you backsliding daughter? for the
LORD[JESUS] has created a new thing in the earth, A woman shall compass a man.

31:23 Thus says the LORD[JESUS] of hosts, the GOD[JESUS] of Israel; As yet they shall
use this speech in the land of Judah and in the cities thereof, when I
shall bring again their captivity; The LORD[JESUS] bless you, O habitation of
justice, and mountain of holiness.

31:24 And there shall dwell in Judah itself, and in all the cities
thereof together, husbandmen, and they that go forth with flocks.

31:25 For I have satiated the weary soul, and I have replenished every
sorrowful soul.

31:26 Upon this I awaked, and beheld; and my sleep was sweet unto me.

31:27 Behold, the days come, says the LORD[JESUS], that I will sow the house
of Israel and the house of Judah with the SEED[JESUS] of man, and with the SEED[JESUS]
of beast.

31:28 And it shall come to pass, that like as I have watched over them,
to pluck up, and to break down, and to throw down, and to destroy, and
to afflict; so will I watch over them, to build, and to plant, says the
LORD[JESUS].

31:29 In those days they shall say no more, The fathers have eaten a
sour grape, and the children's teeth are set on edge.

31:30 But every one shall die for HIS[JESUS] own iniquity: every man that
eateth the sour grape, HIS[JESUS] teeth shall be set on edge.

31:31 Behold, the days come, says the LORD[JESUS], that I will make a new
covenant with the house of Israel, and with the house of Judah:

31:32 Not according to the covenant that I made with their fathers in
the day that I took them by the hand to bring them out of the land of
Egypt; which my covenant they brake, although I was an husband unto
them, says the LORD[JESUS]:

31:33 But this shall be the covenant that I will make with the house of
Israel; After those days, says the LORD[JESUS], I will put my law in their
inward parts, and write it in their hearts; and will be their GOD[JESUS], and
they shall be my people.

31:34 And they shall teach no more every man HIS[JESUS] neighbour, and every
man HIS[JESUS] brother, saying, Know the LORD[JESUS]: for they shall all know me, from
the least of them unto the greatest of them, says the LORD[JESUS]: for I will
forgive their iniquity, and I will remember their sin no more.

31:35 Thus says the LORD[JESUS], which giveth the sun for a light by day, and
the ordinances of the moon and of the stars for a light by night, which
divideth the sea when the waves thereof roar; The LORD[JESUS] of hosts is HIS[JESUS]
name:

31:36 If those ordinances depart from before me, says the LORD[JESUS], then
the SEED[JESUS] of Israel also shall cease from being a nation before me for
ever.

31:37 Thus says the LORD[JESUS]; If heaven above can be measured, and the
foundations of the earth searched out beneath, I will also cast off all
the SEED[JESUS] of Israel for all that they have done, says the LORD[JESUS].

31:38 Behold, the days come, says the LORD[JESUS], that the city shall be
built to the LORD[JESUS] from the tower of Hananeel unto the gate of the
corner.

31:39 And the measuring line shall yet go forth over against it upon the
hill Gareb, and shall compass about to Goath.

31:40 And the whole valley of the dead bodies, and of the ashes, and all
the fields unto the brook of Kidron, unto the corner of the horse gate
toward the east, shall be holy unto the LORD[JESUS]; it shall not be plucked
up, nor thrown down any more for ever.


32:1 The WORD[JESUS] that came to Jeremiah from the LORD[JESUS] in the tenth year of
Zedekiah KING[JESUS] of Judah, which was the eighteenth year of Nebuchadrezzar.

32:2 For then the KING[JESUS] of Babylon's army besieged Jerusalem: and
Jeremiah the PROPHET[JESUS] was shut up in the court of the prison, which was
in the KING[JESUS] of Judah's house.

32:3 For Zedekiah KING[JESUS] of Judah had shut HIM[JESUS] up, saying, Wherefore dost
you prophesy, and say, Thus says the LORD[JESUS], Behold, I will give this
city into the hand of the KING[JESUS] of Babylon, and HE[JESUS] shall take it;

32:4 And Zedekiah KING[JESUS] of Judah shall not escape out of the hand of the
Chaldeans, but shall surely be delivered into the hand of the KING[JESUS] of
Babylon, and shall speak with HIM[JESUS] mouth to mouth, and HIS[JESUS] eyes shall
behold HIS[JESUS] eyes;

32:5 And HE[JESUS] shall lead Zedekiah to Babylon, and there shall HE[JESUS] be until
I visit HIM[JESUS], says the LORD[JESUS]: though you fight with the Chaldeans, you
shall not prosper.

32:6 And Jeremiah said, The WORD[JESUS] of the LORD[JESUS] came unto me, saying,

32:7 Behold, Hanameel the SON[JESUS] of Shallum yours uncle shall come unto
you saying, Buy you my field that is in Anathoth: for the right of
redemption is yours to buy it.

32:8 So Hanameel mine uncle's SON[JESUS] came to me in the court of the prison
according to the WORD[JESUS] of the LORD[JESUS], and said unto me, Buy my field, I
pray you, that is in Anathoth, which is in the country of Benjamin: for
the right of inheritance is yours, and the redemption is yours; buy it
for thyself. Then I knew that this was the WORD[JESUS] of the LORD[JESUS].

32:9 And I bought the field of Hanameel my uncle's SON[JESUS], that was in
Anathoth, and weighed HIM[JESUS] the money, even seventeen shekels of silver.

32:10 And I subscribed the evidence, and sealed it, and took witnesses,
and weighed HIM[JESUS] the money in the balances.

32:11 So I took the evidence of the purchase, both that which was sealed
according to the law and custom, and that which was open:

32:12 And I gave the evidence of the purchase unto Baruch the SON[JESUS] of
Neriah, the SON[JESUS] of Maaseiah, in the sight of Hanameel mine uncle's SON[JESUS],
and in the presence of the witnesses that subscribed the book of the
purchase, before all the Jews that sat in the court of the prison.

32:13 And I charged Baruch before them, saying,

32:14 Thus says the LORD[JESUS] of hosts, the GOD[JESUS] of Israel; Take these
evidences, this evidence of the purchase, both which is sealed, and this
evidence which is open; and put them in an earthen vessel, that they may
continue many days.

32:15 For thus says the LORD[JESUS] of hosts, the GOD[JESUS] of Israel; Houses and
fields and vineyards shall be possessed again in this land.

32:16 Now when I had delivered the evidence of the purchase unto Baruch
the SON[JESUS] of Neriah, I prayed unto the LORD[JESUS], saying,

32:17 Ah LORD[JESUS] GOD[JESUS]! behold, you hast made the heaven and the earth by
your great power and stretched out arm, and there is nothing too hard for
you:

32:18 you shewest lovingkindness unto thousands, and recompensest the
iniquity of the fathers into the bosom of their children after them: the
Great, the Mighty GOD[JESUS], the LORD[JESUS] of hosts, is HIS[JESUS] name,

32:19 Great in counsel, and mighty in work: for yours eyes are open upon
all the ways of the sons of men: to give every one according to HIS[JESUS]
ways, and according to the fruit of HIS[JESUS] doings:

32:20 Which hast set signs and wonders in the land of Egypt, even unto
this day, and in Israel, and among other men; and hast made you a name,
as at this day;

32:21 And hast brought forth your people Israel out of the land of Egypt
with signs, and with wonders, and with a strong hand, and with a
stretched out arm, and with great terror;

32:22 And hast given them this land, which you didst swear to their
fathers to give them, a land flowing with milk and honey;

32:23 And they came in, and possessed it; but they obeyed not your voice,
neither walked in your law; they have done nothing of all that you
commandedst them to do: therefore you hast caused all this evil to come
upon them:

32:24 Behold the mounts, they are come unto the city to take it; and the
city is given into the hand of the Chaldeans, that fight against it,
because of the sword, and of the famine, and of the pestilence: and what
you hast spoken is come to pass; and, behold, you seest it.

32:25 And you hast said unto me, O LORD[JESUS] GOD[JESUS], Buy you the field for
money, and take witnesses; for the city is given into the hand of the
Chaldeans.

32:26 Then came the WORD[JESUS] of the LORD[JESUS] unto Jeremiah, saying,

32:27 Behold, I am the LORD[JESUS], the GOD[JESUS] of all flesh: is there any thing
too hard for me?

32:28 Therefore thus says the LORD[JESUS]; Behold, I will give this city into
the hand of the Chaldeans, and into the hand of Nebuchadrezzar KING[JESUS] of
Babylon, and HE[JESUS] shall take it:

32:29 And the Chaldeans, that fight against this city, shall come and
set fire on this city, and burn it with the houses, upon whose roofs
they have offered incense unto Baal, and poured out drink offerings unto
other gods, to provoke me to anger.

32:30 For the children of Israel and the children of Judah have only
done evil before me from their youth: for the children of Israel have
only provoked me to anger with the work of their hands, says the LORD[JESUS].

32:31 For this city has been to me as a provocation of mine anger and
of my fury from the day that they built it even unto this day; that I
should remove it from before my face,

32:32 Because of all the evil of the children of Israel and of the
children of Judah, which they have done to provoke me to anger, they,
their kings, their princes, their priests, and their prophets, and the
men of Judah, and the inhabitants of Jerusalem.

32:33 And they have turned unto me the back, and not the face: though I
taught them, rising up early and teaching them, yet they have not
hearkened to receive instruction.

32:34 But they set their abominations in the house, which is called by
my name, to defile it.

32:35 And they built the high places of Baal, which are in the valley of
the SON[JESUS] of Hinnom, to cause their sons and their daughters to pass
through the fire unto Molech; which I commanded them not, neither came
it into my mind, that they should do this abomination, to cause Judah to
sin.

32:36 And now therefore thus says the LORD[JESUS], the GOD[JESUS] of Israel,
concerning this city, whereof you say, It shall be delivered into the
hand of the KING[JESUS] of Babylon by the sword, and by the famine, and by the
pestilence;

32:37 Behold, I will gather them out of all countries, whither I have
driven them in mine anger, and in my fury, and in great wrath; and I
will bring them again unto this place, and I will cause them to dwell
safely:

32:38 And they shall be my people, and I will be their GOD[JESUS]:

32:39 And I will give them one heart, and one way, that they may fear me
for ever, for the good of them, and of their children after them:

32:40 And I will make an everlasting covenant with them, that I will not
turn away from them, to do them good; but I will put my fear in their
hearts, that they shall not depart from me.

32:41 Yea, I will rejoice over them to do them good, and I will plant
them in this land assuredly with my whole heart and with my whole soul.

32:42 For thus says the LORD[JESUS]; Like as I have brought all this great
evil upon this people, so will I bring upon them all the good that I
have promised them.

32:43 And fields shall be bought in this land, whereof you say, It is
desolate without man or beast; it is given into the hand of the
Chaldeans.

32:44 Men shall buy fields for money, and subscribe evidences, and seal
them, and take witnesses in the land of Benjamin, and in the places
about Jerusalem, and in the cities of Judah, and in the cities of the
mountains, and in the cities of the valley, and in the cities of the
south: for I will cause their captivity to return, says the LORD[JESUS].


33:1 Moreover the WORD[JESUS] of the LORD[JESUS] came unto Jeremiah the second time,
while HE[JESUS] was yet shut up in the court of the prison, saying,

33:2 Thus says the LORD[JESUS] the maker thereof, the LORD[JESUS] that formed it, to
establish it; the LORD[JESUS] is HIS[JESUS] name;

33:3 Call unto me, and I will answer you, and shew you great and
mighty things, which you knowest not.

33:4 For thus says the LORD[JESUS], the GOD[JESUS] of Israel, concerning the houses
of this city, and concerning the houses of the kings of Judah, which are
thrown down by the mounts, and by the sword;

33:5 They come to fight with the Chaldeans, but it is to fill them with
the dead bodies of men, whom I have slain in mine anger and in my fury,
and for all whose wickedness I have hid my face from this city.

33:6 Behold, I will bring it health and cure, and I will cure them, and
will reveal unto them the abundance of peace and truth.

33:7 And I will cause the captivity of Judah and the captivity of Israel
to return, and will build them, as at the first.

33:8 And I will cleanse them from all their iniquity, whereby they have
sinned against me; and I will pardon all their iniquities, whereby they
have sinned, and whereby they have transgressed against me.

33:9 And it shall be to me a name of joy, a praise and an honour before
all the nations of the earth, which shall hear all the good that I do
unto them: and they shall fear and tremble for all the goodness and for
all the prosperity that I procure unto it.

33:10 Thus says the LORD[JESUS]; Again there shall be heard in this place,
which you say shall be desolate without man and without beast, even in
the cities of Judah, and in the streets of Jerusalem, that are desolate,
without man, and without inhabitant, and without beast,

33:11 The voice of joy, and the voice of gladness, the voice of the
bridegroom, and the voice of the bride, the voice of them that shall
say, Praise the LORD[JESUS] of hosts: for the LORD[JESUS] is good; for HIS[JESUS] mercy
endureth for ever: and of them that shall bring the sacrifice of praise
into the house of the LORD[JESUS]. For I will cause to return the captivity of
the land, as at the first, says the LORD[JESUS].

33:12 Thus says the LORD[JESUS] of hosts; Again in this place, which is
desolate without man and without beast, and in all the cities thereof,
shall be an habitation of shepherds causing their flocks to lie down.

33:13 In the cities of the mountains, in the cities of the vale, and in
the cities of the south, and in the land of Benjamin, and in the places
about Jerusalem, and in the cities of Judah, shall the flocks pass again
under the hands of HIM[JESUS] that telleth them, says the LORD[JESUS].

33:14 Behold, the days come, says the LORD[JESUS], that I will perform that
good thing which I have promised unto the house of Israel and to the
house of Judah.

33:15 In those days, and at that time, will I cause the BRANCH[JESUS] of
righteousness to grow up unto David; and HE[JESUS] shall execute judgment and
righteousness in the land.

33:16 In those days shall Judah be saved, and Jerusalem shall dwell
safely: and this is the name wherewith she shall be called, The LORD[JESUS] our
righteousness.

33:17 For thus says the LORD[JESUS]; David shall never want a man to sit upon
the throne of the house of Israel;

33:18 Neither shall the priests the Levites want a man before me to
offer burnt offerings, and to kindle meat offerings, and to do sacrifice
continually.

33:19 And the WORD[JESUS] of the LORD[JESUS] came unto Jeremiah, saying,

33:20 Thus says the LORD[JESUS]; If you can break my covenant of the day, and
my covenant of the night, and that there should not be day and night in
their season;

33:21 Then may also my covenant be broken with David my SERVANT[JESUS], that HE[JESUS]
should not have a SON[JESUS] to reign upon HIS[JESUS] throne; and with the Levites the
priests, my ministers.

33:22 As the host of heaven cannot be numbered, neither the sand of the
sea measured: so will I multiply the SEED[JESUS] of David my SERVANT[JESUS], and the
Levites that minister unto me.

33:23 Moreover the WORD[JESUS] of the LORD[JESUS] came to Jeremiah, saying,

33:24 Considerest you not what this people have spoken, saying, The two
families which the LORD[JESUS] has chosen, HE[JESUS] has even cast them off? thus
they have despised my people, that they should be no more a nation
before them.

33:25 Thus says the LORD[JESUS]; If my covenant be not with day and night, and
if I have not appointed the ordinances of heaven and earth;

33:26 Then will I cast away the SEED[JESUS] of Jacob and David my SERVANT[JESUS], so
that I will not take any of HIS[JESUS] SEED[JESUS] to be rulers over the SEED[JESUS] of
Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob: for I will cause their captivity to return,
and have mercy on them.


34:1 The WORD[JESUS] which came unto Jeremiah from the LORD[JESUS], when
Nebuchadnezzar KING[JESUS] of Babylon, and all HIS[JESUS] army, and all the kingdoms
of the earth of HIS[JESUS] dominion, and all the people, fought against
Jerusalem, and against all the cities thereof, saying,

34:2 Thus says the LORD[JESUS], the GOD[JESUS] of Israel; Go and speak to Zedekiah
KING[JESUS] of Judah, and tell HIM[JESUS], Thus says the LORD[JESUS]; Behold, I will give
this city into the hand of the KING[JESUS] of Babylon, and HE[JESUS] shall burn it
with fire:

34:3 And you shalt not escape out of HIS[JESUS] hand, but shalt surely be
taken, and delivered into HIS[JESUS] hand; and yours eyes shall behold the eyes
of the KING[JESUS] of Babylon, and HE[JESUS] shall speak with you mouth to mouth, and
you shalt go to Babylon.

34:4 Yet hear the WORD[JESUS] of the LORD[JESUS], O Zedekiah KING[JESUS] of Judah; Thus says
the LORD[JESUS] of you, you shalt not die by the sword:

34:5 But you shalt die in peace: and with the burnings of your fathers,
the former kings which were before you, so shall they burn odours for
you; and they will lament you, saying, Ah LORD[JESUS]! for I have pronounced
the WORD[JESUS], says the LORD[JESUS].

34:6 Then Jeremiah the PROPHET[JESUS] spake all these words unto Zedekiah KING[JESUS]
of Judah in Jerusalem,

34:7 When the KING[JESUS] of Babylon's army fought against Jerusalem, and
against all the cities of Judah that were left, against Lachish, and
against Azekah: for these defenced cities remained of the cities of
Judah.

34:8 This is the WORD[JESUS] that came unto Jeremiah from the LORD[JESUS], after that
the KING[JESUS] Zedekiah had made a covenant with all the people which were at
Jerusalem, to proclaim liberty unto them;

34:9 That every man should let HIS[JESUS] manservant, and every man HIS[JESUS]
maidservant, being an Hebrew or an Hebrewess, go free; that none should
serve himself of them, to wit, of a Jew HIS[JESUS] brother.

34:10 Now when all the princes, and all the people, which had entered
into the covenant, heard that every one should let HIS[JESUS] manservant, and
every one HIS[JESUS] maidservant, go free, that none should serve themselves of
them any more, then they obeyed, and let them go.

34:11 But afterward they turned, and caused the servants and the
handmaids, whom they had let go free, to return, and brought them into
subjection for servants and for handmaids.

34:12 Therefore the WORD[JESUS] of the LORD[JESUS] came to Jeremiah from the LORD[JESUS],
saying,

34:13 Thus says the LORD[JESUS], the GOD[JESUS] of Israel; I made a covenant with
your fathers in the day that I brought them forth out of the land of
Egypt, out of the house of bondmen, saying,

34:14 At the end of seven years let you go every man HIS[JESUS] brother an
Hebrew, which has been sold unto you; and when HE[JESUS] has served you six
years, you shalt let HIM[JESUS] go free from you: but your fathers hearkened
not unto me, neither inclined their ear.

34:15 And you were now turned, and had done right in my sight, in
proclaiming liberty every man to HIS[JESUS] neighbour; and you had made a
covenant before me in the house which is called by my name:

34:16 But you turned and polluted my name, and caused every man HIS[JESUS]
SERVANT[JESUS], and every man HIS[JESUS] handmaid, whom HE[JESUS] had set at liberty at their
pleasure, to return, and brought them into subjection, to be unto you
for servants and for handmaids.

34:17 Therefore thus says the LORD[JESUS]; you have not hearkened unto me, in
proclaiming liberty, every one to HIS[JESUS] brother, and every man to HIS[JESUS]
neighbour: behold, I proclaim a liberty for you, says the LORD[JESUS], to the
sword, to the pestilence, and to the famine; and I will make you to be
removed into all the kingdoms of the earth.

34:18 And I will give the men that have transgressed my covenant, which
have not performed the words of the covenant which they had made before
me, when they cut the calf in twain, and passed between the parts
thereof,

34:19 The princes of Judah, and the princes of Jerusalem, the eunuchs,
and the priests, and all the people of the land, which passed between
the parts of the calf;

34:20 I will even give them into the hand of their enemies, and into the
hand of them that seek their life: and their dead bodies shall be for
meat unto the fowls of the heaven, and to the beasts of the earth.

34:21 And Zedekiah KING[JESUS] of Judah and HIS[JESUS] princes will I give into the
hand of their enemies, and into the hand of them that seek their life,
and into the hand of the KING[JESUS] of Babylon's army, which are gone up from
you.

34:22 Behold, I will command, says the LORD[JESUS], and cause them to return
to this city; and they shall fight against it, and take it, and burn it
with fire: and I will make the cities of Judah a desolation without an
inhabitant.


35:1 The WORD[JESUS] which came unto Jeremiah from the LORD[JESUS] in the days of
Jehoiakim the SON[JESUS] of Josiah KING[JESUS] of Judah, saying,

35:2 Go unto the house of the Rechabites, and speak unto them, and bring
them into the house of the LORD[JESUS], into one of the chambers, and give them
wine to drink.

35:3 Then I took Jaazaniah the SON[JESUS] of Jeremiah, the SON[JESUS] of Habaziniah,
and HIS[JESUS] brethren, and all HIS[JESUS] sons, and the whole house of the
Rechabites;

35:4 And I brought them into the house of the LORD[JESUS], into the chamber of
the sons of Hanan, the SON[JESUS] of Igdaliah, a man of GOD[JESUS], which was by the
chamber of the princes, which was above the chamber of Maaseiah the SON[JESUS]
of Shallum, the keeper of the door:

35:5 And I set before the sons of the house of the Rechabites pots full
of wine, and cups, and I said unto them, Drink you wine.

35:6 But they said, We will drink no wine: for Jonadab the SON[JESUS] of Rechab
our father commanded us, saying, you shall drink no wine, neither you, nor
your sons for ever:

35:7 Neither shall you build house, nor sow SEED[JESUS], nor plant vineyard, nor
have any: but all your days you shall dwell in tents; that you may live
many days in the land where you be strangers.

35:8 Thus have we obeyed the voice of Jonadab the SON[JESUS] of Rechab our
father in all that HE[JESUS] has charged us, to drink no wine all our days,
we, our wives, our sons, nor our daughters;

35:9 Nor to build houses for us to dwell in: neither have we vineyard,
nor field, nor SEED[JESUS]:

35:10 But we have dwelt in tents, and have obeyed, and done according to
all that Jonadab our father commanded us.

35:11 But it came to pass, when Nebuchadrezzar KING[JESUS] of Babylon came up
into the land, that we said, Come, and let us go to Jerusalem for fear
of the army of the Chaldeans, and for fear of the army of the Syrians:
so we dwell at Jerusalem.

35:12 Then came the WORD[JESUS] of the LORD[JESUS] unto Jeremiah, saying,

35:13 Thus says the LORD[JESUS] of hosts, the GOD[JESUS] of Israel; Go and tell the
men of Judah and the inhabitants of Jerusalem, Will you not receive
instruction to hearken to my words? says the LORD[JESUS].

35:14 The words of Jonadab the SON[JESUS] of Rechab, that HE[JESUS] commanded HIS[JESUS] sons
not to drink wine, are performed; for unto this day they drink none, but
obey their father's commandment: notwithstanding I have spoken unto you,
rising early and speaking; but you hearkened not unto me.

35:15 I have sent also unto you all my servants the prophets, rising up
early and sending them, saying, Return you now every man from HIS[JESUS] evil
way, and amend your doings, and go not after other gods to serve them,
and you shall dwell in the land which I have given to you and to your
fathers: but you have not inclined your ear, nor hearkened unto me.

35:16 Because the sons of Jonadab the SON[JESUS] of Rechab have performed the
commandment of their father, which HE[JESUS] commanded them; but this people
has not hearkened unto me:

35:17 Therefore thus says the LORD[JESUS] GOD[JESUS] of hosts, the GOD[JESUS] of Israel;
Behold, I will bring upon Judah and upon all the inhabitants of
Jerusalem all the evil that I have pronounced against them: because I
have spoken unto them, but they have not heard; and I have called unto
them, but they have not answered.

35:18 And Jeremiah said unto the house of the Rechabites, Thus says the
LORD[JESUS] of hosts, the GOD[JESUS] of Israel; Because you have obeyed the commandment
of Jonadab your father, and kept all HIS[JESUS] precepts, and done according
unto all that HE[JESUS] has commanded you:

35:19 Therefore thus says the LORD[JESUS] of hosts, the GOD[JESUS] of Israel; Jonadab
the SON[JESUS] of Rechab shall not want a man to stand before me for ever.


36:1 And it came to pass in the fourth year of Jehoiakim the SON[JESUS] of
Josiah KING[JESUS] of Judah, that this WORD[JESUS] came unto Jeremiah from the LORD[JESUS],
saying,

36:2 Take you a roll of a book, and write therein all the words that I
have spoken unto you against Israel, and against Judah, and against all
the nations, from the day I spake unto you, from the days of Josiah,
even unto this day.

36:3 It may be that the house of Judah will hear all the evil which I
purpose to do unto them; that they may return every man from HIS[JESUS] evil
way; that I may forgive their iniquity and their sin.

36:4 Then Jeremiah called Baruch the SON[JESUS] of Neriah: and Baruch wrote
from the mouth of Jeremiah all the words of the LORD[JESUS], which HE[JESUS] had
spoken unto HIM[JESUS], upon a roll of a book.

36:5 And Jeremiah commanded Baruch, saying, I am shut up; I cannot go
into the house of the LORD[JESUS]:

36:6 Therefore go you, and read in the roll, which you hast written
from my mouth, the words of the LORD[JESUS] in the ears of the people in the
LORD[JESUS]'s house upon the fasting day: and also you shalt read them in the
ears of all Judah that come out of their cities.

36:7 It may be they will present their supplication before the LORD[JESUS], and
will return every one from HIS[JESUS] evil way: for great is the anger and the
fury that the LORD[JESUS] has pronounced against this people.

36:8 And Baruch the SON[JESUS] of Neriah did according to all that Jeremiah the
PROPHET[JESUS] commanded HIM[JESUS], reading in the book the words of the LORD[JESUS] in the
LORD[JESUS]'s house.

36:9 And it came to pass in the fifth year of Jehoiakim the SON[JESUS] of
Josiah KING[JESUS] of Judah, in the ninth month, that they proclaimed a fast
before the LORD[JESUS] to all the people in Jerusalem, and to all the people
that came from the cities of Judah unto Jerusalem.

36:10 Then read Baruch in the book the words of Jeremiah in the house of
the LORD[JESUS], in the chamber of Gemariah the SON[JESUS] of Shaphan the scribe, in
the higher court, at the entry of the new gate of the LORD[JESUS]'s house, in
the ears of all the people.

36:11 When Michaiah the SON[JESUS] of Gemariah, the SON[JESUS] of Shaphan, had heard
out of the book all the words of the LORD[JESUS],

36:12 Then HE[JESUS] went down into the KING[JESUS]'s house, into the scribe's
chamber: and, lo, all the princes sat there, even Elishama the scribe,
and Delaiah the SON[JESUS] of Shemaiah, and Elnathan the SON[JESUS] of Achbor, and
Gemariah the SON[JESUS] of Shaphan, and Zedekiah the SON[JESUS] of Hananiah, and all
the princes.

36:13 Then Michaiah declared unto them all the words that HE[JESUS] had heard,
when Baruch read the book in the ears of the people.

36:14 Therefore all the princes sent Jehudi the SON[JESUS] of Nethaniah, the
SON[JESUS] of Shelemiah, the SON[JESUS] of Cushi, unto Baruch, saying, Take in yours
hand the roll wherein you hast read in the ears of the people, and
come. So Baruch the SON[JESUS] of Neriah took the roll in HIS[JESUS] hand, and came
unto them.

36:15 And they said unto HIM[JESUS], Sit down now, and read it in our ears. So
Baruch read it in their ears.

36:16 Now it came to pass, when they had heard all the words, they were
afraid both one and other, and said unto Baruch, We will surely tell the
KING[JESUS] of all these words.

36:17 And they asked Baruch, saying, Tell us now, How didst you write
all these words at HIS[JESUS] mouth?

36:18 Then Baruch answered them, HE[JESUS] pronounced all these words unto me
with HIS[JESUS] mouth, and I wrote them with ink in the book.

36:19 Then said the princes unto Baruch, Go, hide you, you and
Jeremiah; and let no man know where you be.

36:20 And they went in to the KING[JESUS] into the court, but they laid up the
roll in the chamber of Elishama the scribe, and told all the words in
the ears of the KING[JESUS].

36:21 So the KING[JESUS] sent Jehudi to fetch the roll: and HE[JESUS] took it out of
Elishama the scribe's chamber. And Jehudi read it in the ears of the
KING[JESUS], and in the ears of all the princes which stood beside the KING[JESUS].

36:22 Now the KING[JESUS] sat in the winterhouse in the ninth month: and there
was a fire on the hearth burning before HIM[JESUS].

36:23 And it came to pass, that when Jehudi had read three or four
leaves, HE[JESUS] cut it with the penknife, and cast it into the fire that was
on the hearth, until all the roll was consumed in the fire that was on
the hearth.

36:24 Yet they were not afraid, nor rent their garments, neither the
KING[JESUS], nor any of HIS[JESUS] servants that heard all these words.

36:25 Nevertheless Elnathan and Delaiah and Gemariah had made
intercession to the KING[JESUS] that HE[JESUS] would not burn the roll: but HE[JESUS] would
not hear them.

36:26 But the KING[JESUS] commanded Jerahmeel the SON[JESUS] of Hammelech, and Seraiah
the SON[JESUS] of Azriel, and Shelemiah the SON[JESUS] of Abdeel, to take Baruch the
scribe and Jeremiah the PROPHET[JESUS]: but the LORD[JESUS] hid them.

36:27 Then the WORD[JESUS] of the LORD[JESUS] came to Jeremiah, after that the KING[JESUS]
had burned the roll, and the words which Baruch wrote at the mouth of
Jeremiah, saying,

36:28 Take you again another roll, and write in it all the former words
that were in the first roll, which Jehoiakim the KING[JESUS] of Judah has
burned.

36:29 And you shalt say to Jehoiakim KING[JESUS] of Judah, Thus says the
LORD[JESUS]; you hast burned this roll, saying, Why hast you written therein,
saying, The KING[JESUS] of Babylon shall certainly come and destroy this land,
and shall cause to cease from thence man and beast?

36:30 Therefore thus says the LORD[JESUS] of Jehoiakim KING[JESUS] of Judah; HE[JESUS] shall
have none to sit upon the throne of David: and HIS[JESUS] dead body shall be
cast out in the day to the heat, and in the night to the frost.

36:31 And I will punish HIM[JESUS] and HIS[JESUS] SEED[JESUS] and HIS[JESUS] servants for their
iniquity; and I will bring upon them, and upon the inhabitants of
Jerusalem, and upon the men of Judah, all the evil that I have
pronounced against them; but they hearkened not.

36:32 Then took Jeremiah another roll, and gave it to Baruch the scribe,
the SON[JESUS] of Neriah; who wrote therein from the mouth of Jeremiah all the
words of the book which Jehoiakim KING[JESUS] of Judah had burned in the fire:
and there were added besides unto them many like words.


37:1 And KING[JESUS] Zedekiah the SON[JESUS] of Josiah reigned instead of Coniah the
SON[JESUS] of Jehoiakim, whom Nebuchadrezzar KING[JESUS] of Babylon made KING[JESUS] in the
land of Judah.

37:2 But neither HE[JESUS], nor HIS[JESUS] servants, nor the people of the land, did
hearken unto the words of the LORD[JESUS], which HE[JESUS] spake by the PROPHET[JESUS]
Jeremiah.

37:3 And Zedekiah the KING[JESUS] sent Jehucal the SON[JESUS] of Shelemiah and
Zephaniah the SON[JESUS] of Maaseiah the priest to the PROPHET[JESUS] Jeremiah,
saying, Pray now unto the LORD[JESUS] our GOD[JESUS] for us.

37:4 Now Jeremiah came in and went out among the people: for they had
not put HIM[JESUS] into prison.

37:5 Then Pharaoh's army was come forth out of Egypt: and when the
Chaldeans that besieged Jerusalem heard tidings of them, they departed
from Jerusalem.

37:6 Then came the WORD[JESUS] of the LORD[JESUS] unto the PROPHET[JESUS] Jeremiah saying,

37:7 Thus says the LORD[JESUS], the GOD[JESUS] of Israel; Thus shall you say to the
KING[JESUS] of Judah, that sent you unto me to enquire of me; Behold, Pharaoh's
army, which is come forth to help you, shall return to Egypt into their
own land.

37:8 And the Chaldeans shall come again, and fight against this city,
and take it, and burn it with fire.

37:9 Thus says the LORD[JESUS]; Deceive not yourselves, saying, The Chaldeans
shall surely depart from us: for they shall not depart.

37:10 For though you had smitten the whole army of the Chaldeans that
fight against you, and there remained but wounded men among them, yet
should they rise up every man in HIS[JESUS] tent, and burn this city with fire.

37:11 And it came to pass, that when the army of the Chaldeans was
broken up from Jerusalem for fear of Pharaoh's army,

37:12 Then Jeremiah went forth out of Jerusalem to go into the land of
Benjamin, to separate himself thence in the midst of the people.

37:13 And when HE[JESUS] was in the gate of Benjamin, a captain of the ward was
there, whose name was Irijah, the SON[JESUS] of Shelemiah, the SON[JESUS] of Hananiah;
and HE[JESUS] took Jeremiah the PROPHET[JESUS], saying, you fallest away to the
Chaldeans.

37:14 Then said Jeremiah, It is false; I fall not away to the Chaldeans.
But HE[JESUS] hearkened not to HIM[JESUS]: so Irijah took Jeremiah, and brought HIM[JESUS] to
the princes.

37:15 Wherefore the princes were wroth with Jeremiah, and smote HIM[JESUS], and
put HIM[JESUS] in prison in the house of Jonathan the scribe: for they had made
that the prison.

37:16 When Jeremiah was entered into the dungeon, and into the cabins,
and Jeremiah had remained there many days;

37:17 Then Zedekiah the KING[JESUS] sent, and took HIM[JESUS] out: and the KING[JESUS] asked
HIM[JESUS] secretly in HIS[JESUS] house, and said, Is there any WORD[JESUS] from the LORD[JESUS]?
And Jeremiah said, There is: for, said HE[JESUS], you shalt be delivered into
the hand of the KING[JESUS] of Babylon.

37:18 Moreover Jeremiah said unto KING[JESUS] Zedekiah, What have I offended
against you, or against your servants, or against this people, that you
have put me in prison?

37:19 Where are now your prophets which prophesied unto you, saying, The
KING[JESUS] of Babylon shall not come against you, nor against this land?

37:20 Therefore hear now, I pray you, O my LORD[JESUS] the KING[JESUS]: let my
supplication, I pray you, be accepted before you; that you cause me
not to return to the house of Jonathan the scribe, lest I die there.

37:21 Then Zedekiah the KING[JESUS] commanded that they should commit Jeremiah
into the court of the prison, and that they should give HIM[JESUS] daily a
piece of bread out of the bakers' street, until all the bread in the
city were spent. Thus Jeremiah remained in the court of the prison.


38:1 Then Shephatiah the SON[JESUS] of Mattan, and Gedaliah the SON[JESUS] of Pashur,
and Jucal the SON[JESUS] of Shelemiah, and Pashur the SON[JESUS] of Malchiah, heard
the words that Jeremiah had spoken unto all the people, saying,

38:2 Thus says the LORD[JESUS], HE[JESUS] that remaineth in this city shall die by
the sword, by the famine, and by the pestilence: but HE[JESUS] that goes forth
to the Chaldeans shall live; for HE[JESUS] shall have HIS[JESUS] life for a prey, and
shall live.

38:3 Thus says the LORD[JESUS], This city shall surely be given into the hand
of the KING[JESUS] of Babylon's army, which shall take it.

38:4 Therefore the princes said unto the KING[JESUS], We beseech you, let this
man be put to death: for thus HE[JESUS] weakeneth the hands of the men of war
that remain in this city, and the hands of all the people, in speaking
such words unto them: for this man seeketh not the welfare of this
people, but the hurt.

38:5 Then Zedekiah the KING[JESUS] said, Behold, HE[JESUS] is in your hand: for the
KING[JESUS] is not HE[JESUS] that can do any thing against you.

38:6 Then took they Jeremiah, and cast HIM[JESUS] into the dungeon of Malchiah
the SON[JESUS] of Hammelech, that was in the court of the prison: and they let
down Jeremiah with cords. And in the dungeon there was no water, but
mire: so Jeremiah sunk in the mire.

38:7 Now when Ebedmelech the Ethiopian, one of the eunuchs which was in
the KING[JESUS]'s house, heard that they had put Jeremiah in the dungeon; the
KING[JESUS] then sitting in the gate of Benjamin;

38:8 Ebedmelech went forth out of the KING[JESUS]'s house, and spake to the
KING[JESUS] saying,

38:9 My LORD[JESUS] the KING[JESUS], these men have done evil in all that they have
done to Jeremiah the PROPHET[JESUS], whom they have cast into the dungeon; and
HE[JESUS] is like to die for hunger in the place where HE[JESUS] is: for there is no
more bread in the city.

38:10 Then the KING[JESUS] commanded Ebedmelech the Ethiopian, saying, Take
from hence thirty men with you, and take up Jeremiah the PROPHET[JESUS] out of
the dungeon, before HE[JESUS] die.

38:11 So Ebedmelech took the men with HIM[JESUS], and went into the house of
the KING[JESUS] under the treasury, and took thence old cast clouts and old
rotten rags, and let them down by cords into the dungeon to Jeremiah.

38:12 And Ebedmelech the Ethiopian said unto Jeremiah, Put now these old
cast clouts and rotten rags under yours armholes under the cords. And
Jeremiah did so.

38:13 So they drew up Jeremiah with cords, and took HIM[JESUS] up out of the
dungeon: and Jeremiah remained in the court of the prison.

38:14 Then Zedekiah the KING[JESUS] sent, and took Jeremiah the PROPHET[JESUS] unto
HIM[JESUS] into the third entry that is in the house of the LORD[JESUS]: and the KING[JESUS]
said unto Jeremiah, I will ask you a thing; hide nothing from me.

38:15 Then Jeremiah said unto Zedekiah, If I declare it unto you, wilt
you not surely put me to death? and if I give you counsel, wilt you
not hearken unto me?

38:16 So Zedekiah the KING[JESUS] sware secretly unto Jeremiah, saying, As the
LORD[JESUS] liveth, that made us this soul, I will not put you to death,
neither will I give you into the hand of these men that seek your life.

38:17 Then said Jeremiah unto Zedekiah, Thus says the LORD[JESUS], the GOD[JESUS] of
hosts, the GOD[JESUS] of Israel; If you wilt assuredly go forth unto the KING[JESUS]
of Babylon's princes, then your soul shall live, and this city shall not
be burned with fire; and you shalt live, and yours house:

38:18 But if you wilt not go forth to the KING[JESUS] of Babylon's princes,
then shall this city be given into the hand of the Chaldeans, and they
shall burn it with fire, and you shalt not escape out of their hand.

38:19 And Zedekiah the KING[JESUS] said unto Jeremiah, I am afraid of the Jews
that are fallen to the Chaldeans, lest they deliver me into their hand,
and they mock me.

38:20 But Jeremiah said, They shall not deliver you. Obey, I beseech
you, the voice of the LORD[JESUS], which I speak unto you: so it shall be
well unto you, and your soul shall live.

38:21 But if you refuse to go forth, this is the WORD[JESUS] that the LORD[JESUS]
has shewed me:

38:22 And, behold, all the women that are left in the KING[JESUS] of Judah's
house shall be brought forth to the KING[JESUS] of Babylon's princes, and those
women shall say, your friends have set you on, and have prevailed
against you: your feet are sunk in the mire, and they are turned away
back.

38:23 So they shall bring out all your wives and your children to the
Chaldeans: and you shalt not escape out of their hand, but shalt be
taken by the hand of the KING[JESUS] of Babylon: and you shalt cause this city
to be burned with fire.

38:24 Then said Zedekiah unto Jeremiah, Let no man know of these words,
and you shalt not die.

38:25 But if the princes hear that I have talked with you, and they
come unto you, and say unto you, Declare unto us now what you hast
said unto the KING[JESUS], hide it not from us, and we will not put you to
death; also what the KING[JESUS] said unto you:

38:26 Then you shalt say unto them, I presented my supplication before
the KING[JESUS], that HE[JESUS] would not cause me to return to Jonathan's house, to
die there.

38:27 Then came all the princes unto Jeremiah, and asked HIM[JESUS]: and HE[JESUS]
told them according to all these words that the KING[JESUS] had commanded. So
they left off speaking with HIM[JESUS]; for the matter was not perceived.

38:28 So Jeremiah abode in the court of the prison until the day that
Jerusalem was taken: and HE[JESUS] was there when Jerusalem was taken.


39:1 In the ninth year of Zedekiah KING[JESUS] of Judah, in the tenth month,
came Nebuchadrezzar KING[JESUS] of Babylon and all HIS[JESUS] army against Jerusalem,
and they besieged it.

39:2 And in the eleventh year of Zedekiah, in the fourth month, the
ninth day of the month, the city was broken up.

39:3 And all the princes of the KING[JESUS] of Babylon came in, and sat in the
middle gate, even Nergalsharezer, Samgarnebo, Sarsechim, Rabsaris,
Nergalsharezer, Rabmag, with all the residue of the princes of the KING[JESUS]
of Babylon.

39:4 And it came to pass, that when Zedekiah the KING[JESUS] of Judah saw them,
and all the men of war, then they fled, and went forth out of the city
by night, by the way of the KING[JESUS]'s garden, by the gate betwixt the two
walls: and HE[JESUS] went out the way of the plain.

39:5 But the Chaldeans' army pursued after them, and overtook Zedekiah
in the plains of Jericho: and when they had taken HIM[JESUS], they brought HIM[JESUS]
up to Nebuchadnezzar KING[JESUS] of Babylon to Riblah in the land of Hamath,
where HE[JESUS] gave judgment upon HIM[JESUS].

39:6 Then the KING[JESUS] of Babylon slew the sons of Zedekiah in Riblah before
HIS[JESUS] eyes: also the KING[JESUS] of Babylon slew all the nobles of Judah.

39:7 Moreover HE[JESUS] put out Zedekiah's eyes, and bound HIM[JESUS] with chains, to
carry HIM[JESUS] to Babylon.

39:8 And the Chaldeans burned the KING[JESUS]'s house, and the houses of the
people, with fire, and brake down the walls of Jerusalem.

39:9 Then Nebuzaradan the captain of the guard carried away captive into
Babylon the remnant of the people that remained in the city, and those
that fell away, that fell to HIM[JESUS], with the rest of the people that
remained.

39:10 But Nebuzaradan the captain of the guard left of the poor of the
people, which had nothing, in the land of Judah, and gave them vineyards
and fields at the same time.

39:11 Now Nebuchadrezzar KING[JESUS] of Babylon gave charge concerning Jeremiah
to Nebuzaradan the captain of the guard, saying,

39:12 Take HIM[JESUS], and look well to HIM[JESUS], and do HIM[JESUS] no harm; but do unto
HIM[JESUS] even as HE[JESUS] shall say unto you.

39:13 So Nebuzaradan the captain of the guard sent, and Nebushasban,
Rabsaris, and Nergalsharezer, Rabmag, and all the KING[JESUS] of Babylon's
princes;

39:14 Even they sent, and took Jeremiah out of the court of the prison,
and committed HIM[JESUS] unto Gedaliah the SON[JESUS] of Ahikam the SON[JESUS] of Shaphan,
that HE[JESUS] should carry HIM[JESUS] home: so HE[JESUS] dwelt among the people.

39:15 Now the WORD[JESUS] of the LORD[JESUS] came unto Jeremiah, while HE[JESUS] was shut up
in the court of the prison, saying,

39:16 Go and speak to Ebedmelech the Ethiopian, saying, Thus says the
LORD[JESUS] of hosts, the GOD[JESUS] of Israel; Behold, I will bring my words upon
this city for evil, and not for good; and they shall be accomplished in
that day before you.

39:17 But I will deliver you in that day, says the LORD[JESUS]: and you
shalt not be given into the hand of the men of whom you art afraid.

39:18 For I will surely deliver you, and you shalt not fall by the
sword, but your life shall be for a prey unto you: because you hast put
your trust in me, says the LORD[JESUS].


40:1 The WORD[JESUS] that came to Jeremiah from the LORD[JESUS], after that
Nebuzaradan the captain of the guard had let HIM[JESUS] go from Ramah, when HE[JESUS]
had taken HIM[JESUS] being bound in chains among all that were carried away
captive of Jerusalem and Judah, which were carried away captive unto
Babylon.

40:2 And the captain of the guard took Jeremiah, and said unto HIM[JESUS], The
LORD[JESUS] your GOD[JESUS] has pronounced this evil upon this place.

40:3 Now the LORD[JESUS] has brought it, and done according as HE[JESUS] has said:
because you have sinned against the LORD[JESUS], and have not obeyed HIS[JESUS] voice,
therefore this thing is come upon you.

40:4 And now, behold, I loose you this day from the chains which were
upon yours hand. If it seem good unto you to come with me into Babylon,
come; and I will look well unto you: but if it seem ill unto you to
come with me into Babylon, forbear: behold, all the land is before you:
whither it seemeth good and convenient for you to go, thither go.

40:5 Now while HE[JESUS] was not yet gone back, HE[JESUS] said, Go back also to
Gedaliah the SON[JESUS] of Ahikam the SON[JESUS] of Shaphan, whom the KING[JESUS] of Babylon
has made governor over the cities of Judah, and dwell with HIM[JESUS] among
the people: or go wheresoever it seemeth convenient unto you to go. So
the captain of the guard gave HIM[JESUS] victuals and a reward, and let HIM[JESUS] go.

40:6 Then went Jeremiah unto Gedaliah the SON[JESUS] of Ahikam to Mizpah; and
dwelt with HIM[JESUS] among the people that were left in the land.

40:7 Now when all the captains of the forces which were in the fields,
even they and their men, heard that the KING[JESUS] of Babylon had made
Gedaliah the SON[JESUS] of Ahikam governor in the land, and had committed unto
HIM[JESUS] men, and women, and children, and of the poor of the land, of them
that were not carried away captive to Babylon;

40:8 Then they came to Gedaliah to Mizpah, even Ishmael the SON[JESUS] of
Nethaniah, and Johanan and Jonathan the sons of Kareah, and Seraiah the
SON[JESUS] of Tanhumeth, and the sons of Ephai the Netophathite, and Jezaniah
the SON[JESUS] of a Maachathite, they and their men.

40:9 And Gedaliah the SON[JESUS] of Ahikam the SON[JESUS] of Shaphan sware unto them
and to their men, saying, Fear not to serve the Chaldeans: dwell in the
land, and serve the KING[JESUS] of Babylon, and it shall be well with you.

40:10 As for me, behold, I will dwell at Mizpah, to serve the Chaldeans,
which will come unto us: but you, gather you wine, and summer fruits, and
oil, and put them in your vessels, and dwell in your cities that you have
taken.

40:11 Likewise when all the Jews that were in Moab, and among the
Ammonites, and in Edom, and that were in all the countries, heard that
the KING[JESUS] of Babylon had left a remnant of Judah, and that HE[JESUS] had set
over them Gedaliah the SON[JESUS] of Ahikam the SON[JESUS] of Shaphan;

40:12 Even all the Jews returned out of all places whither they were
driven, and came to the land of Judah, to Gedaliah, unto Mizpah, and
gathered wine and summer fruits very much.

40:13 Moreover Johanan the SON[JESUS] of Kareah, and all the captains of the
forces that were in the fields, came to Gedaliah to Mizpah,

40:14 And said unto HIM[JESUS], Dost you certainly know that Baalis the KING[JESUS]
of the Ammonites has sent Ishmael the SON[JESUS] of Nethaniah to slay you?
But Gedaliah the SON[JESUS] of Ahikam believed them not.

40:15 Then Johanan the SON[JESUS] of Kareah spake to Gedaliah in Mizpah
secretly saying, Let me go, I pray you, and I will slay Ishmael the SON[JESUS]
of Nethaniah, and no man shall know it: wherefore should HE[JESUS] slay you,
that all the Jews which are gathered unto you should be scattered, and
the remnant in Judah perish?

40:16 But Gedaliah the SON[JESUS] of Ahikam said unto Johanan the SON[JESUS] of
Kareah, you shalt not do this thing: for you speakest falsely of
Ishmael.


41:1 Now it came to pass in the seventh month, that Ishmael the SON[JESUS] of
Nethaniah the SON[JESUS] of Elishama, of the SEED[JESUS] royal, and the princes of the
KING[JESUS], even ten men with HIM[JESUS], came unto Gedaliah the SON[JESUS] of Ahikam to
Mizpah; and there they did eat bread together in Mizpah.

41:2 Then arose Ishmael the SON[JESUS] of Nethaniah, and the ten men that were
with HIM[JESUS], and smote Gedaliah the SON[JESUS] of Ahikam the SON[JESUS] of Shaphan with
the sword, and slew HIM[JESUS], whom the KING[JESUS] of Babylon had made governor over
the land.

41:3 Ishmael also slew all the Jews that were with HIM[JESUS], even with
Gedaliah, at Mizpah, and the Chaldeans that were found there, and the
men of war.

41:4 And it came to pass the second day after HE[JESUS] had slain Gedaliah, and
no man knew it,

41:5 That there came certain from Shechem, from SHILOH[JESUS], and from
Samaria, even fourscore men, having their beards shaven, and their
clothes rent, and having cut themselves, with offerings and incense in
their hand, to bring them to the house of the LORD[JESUS].

41:6 And Ishmael the SON[JESUS] of Nethaniah went forth from Mizpah to meet
them, weeping all along as HE[JESUS] went: and it came to pass, as HE[JESUS] met them,
HE[JESUS] said unto them, Come to Gedaliah the SON[JESUS] of Ahikam.

41:7 And it was so, when they came into the midst of the city, that
Ishmael the SON[JESUS] of Nethaniah slew them, and cast them into the midst of
the pit, HE[JESUS], and the men that were with HIM[JESUS].

41:8 But ten men were found among them that said unto Ishmael, Slay us
not: for we have treasures in the field, of wheat, and of barley, and of
oil, and of honey. So HE[JESUS] forbare, and slew them not among their
brethren.

41:9 Now the pit wherein Ishmael had cast all the dead bodies of the
men, whom HE[JESUS] had slain because of Gedaliah, was it which Asa the KING[JESUS]
had made for fear of Baasha KING[JESUS] of Israel: and Ishmael the SON[JESUS] of
Nethaniah filled it with them that were slain.

41:10 Then Ishmael carried away captive all the residue of the people
that were in Mizpah, even the KING[JESUS]'s daughters, and all the people that
remained in Mizpah, whom Nebuzaradan the captain of the guard had
committed to Gedaliah the SON[JESUS] of Ahikam: and Ishmael the SON[JESUS] of
Nethaniah carried them away captive, and departed to go over to the
Ammonites.

41:11 But when Johanan the SON[JESUS] of Kareah, and all the captains of the
forces that were with HIM[JESUS], heard of all the evil that Ishmael the SON[JESUS] of
Nethaniah had done,

41:12 Then they took all the men, and went to fight with Ishmael the SON[JESUS]
of Nethaniah, and found HIM[JESUS] by the great waters that are in Gibeon.

41:13 Now it came to pass, that when all the people which were with
Ishmael saw Johanan the SON[JESUS] of Kareah, and all the captains of the
forces that were with HIM[JESUS], then they were glad.

41:14 So all the people that Ishmael had carried away captive from
Mizpah cast about and returned, and went unto Johanan the SON[JESUS] of Kareah.

41:15 But Ishmael the SON[JESUS] of Nethaniah escaped from Johanan with eight
men, and went to the Ammonites.

41:16 Then took Johanan the SON[JESUS] of Kareah, and all the captains of the
forces that were with HIM[JESUS], all the remnant of the people whom HE[JESUS] had
recovered from Ishmael the SON[JESUS] of Nethaniah, from Mizpah, after that HE[JESUS]
had slain Gedaliah the SON[JESUS] of Ahikam, even mighty men of war, and the
women, and the children, and the eunuchs, whom HE[JESUS] had brought again from
Gibeon:

41:17 And they departed, and dwelt in the habitation of Chimham, which
is by Bethlehem, to go to enter into Egypt,

41:18 Because of the Chaldeans: for they were afraid of them, because
Ishmael the SON[JESUS] of Nethaniah had slain Gedaliah the SON[JESUS] of Ahikam, whom
the KING[JESUS] of Babylon made governor in the land.


42:1 Then all the captains of the forces, and Johanan the SON[JESUS] of Kareah,
and Jezaniah the SON[JESUS] of Hoshaiah, and all the people from the least even
unto the greatest, came near,

42:2 And said unto Jeremiah the PROPHET[JESUS], Let, we beseech you, our
supplication be accepted before you, and pray for us unto the LORD[JESUS] your
GOD[JESUS], even for all this remnant; (for we are left but a few of many, as
yours eyes do behold us:)

42:3 That the LORD[JESUS] your GOD[JESUS] may shew us the way wherein we may walk, and
the thing that we may do.

42:4 Then Jeremiah the PROPHET[JESUS] said unto them, I have heard you; behold,
I will pray unto the LORD[JESUS] your GOD[JESUS] according to your words; and it shall
come to pass, that whatsoever thing the LORD[JESUS] shall answer you, I will
declare it unto you; I will keep nothing back from you.

42:5 Then they said to Jeremiah, The LORD[JESUS] be a true and faithful witness
between us, if we do not even according to all things for the which the
LORD[JESUS] your GOD[JESUS] shall send you to us.

42:6 Whether it be good, or whether it be evil, we will obey the voice
of the LORD[JESUS] our GOD[JESUS], to whom we send you; that it may be well with us,
when we obey the voice of the LORD[JESUS] our GOD[JESUS].

42:7 And it came to pass after ten days, that the WORD[JESUS] of the LORD[JESUS] came
unto Jeremiah.

42:8 Then called HE[JESUS] Johanan the SON[JESUS] of Kareah, and all the captains of
the forces which were with HIM[JESUS], and all the people from the least even
to the greatest,

42:9 And said unto them, Thus says the LORD[JESUS], the GOD[JESUS] of Israel, unto
whom you sent me to present your supplication before HIM[JESUS];

42:10 If you will still abide in this land, then will I build you, and
not pull you down, and I will plant you, and not pluck you up: for I
repent me of the evil that I have done unto you.

42:11 Be not afraid of the KING[JESUS] of Babylon, of whom you are afraid; be
not afraid of HIM[JESUS], says the LORD[JESUS]: for I am with you to save you, and to
deliver you from HIS[JESUS] hand.

42:12 And I will shew mercies unto you, that HE[JESUS] may have mercy upon you,
and cause you to return to your own land.

42:13 But if you say, We will not dwell in this land, neither obey the
voice of the LORD[JESUS] your GOD[JESUS],

42:14 Saying, No; but we will go into the land of Egypt, where we shall
see no war, nor hear the sound of the trumpet, nor have hunger of bread;
and there will we dwell:

42:15 And now therefore hear the WORD[JESUS] of the LORD[JESUS], you remnant of Judah;
Thus says the LORD[JESUS] of hosts, the GOD[JESUS] of Israel; If you wholly set your
faces to enter into Egypt, and go to sojourn there;

42:16 Then it shall come to pass, that the sword, which you feared, shall
overtake you there in the land of Egypt, and the famine, whereof you were
afraid, shall follow close after you there in Egypt; and there you shall
die.

42:17 So shall it be with all the men that set their faces to go into
Egypt to sojourn there; they shall die by the sword, by the famine, and
by the pestilence: and none of them shall remain or escape from the evil
that I will bring upon them.

42:18 For thus says the LORD[JESUS] of hosts, the GOD[JESUS] of Israel; As mine anger
and my fury has been poured forth upon the inhabitants of Jerusalem; so
shall my fury be poured forth upon you, when you shall enter into Egypt:
and you shall be an execration, and an astonishment, and a curse, and a
reproach; and you shall see this place no more.

42:19 The LORD[JESUS] has said concerning you, O you remnant of Judah; Go you
not into Egypt: know certainly that I have admonished you this day.

42:20 For you dissembled in your hearts, when you sent me unto the LORD[JESUS]
your GOD[JESUS], saying, Pray for us unto the LORD[JESUS] our GOD[JESUS]; and according unto
all that the LORD[JESUS] our GOD[JESUS] shall say, so declare unto us, and we will do
it.

42:21 And now I have this day declared it to you; but you have not obeyed
the voice of the LORD[JESUS] your GOD[JESUS], nor any thing for the which HE[JESUS] has sent
me unto you.

42:22 Now therefore know certainly that you shall die by the sword, by
the famine, and by the pestilence, in the place whither you desire to go
and to sojourn.


43:1 And it came to pass, that when Jeremiah had made an end of speaking
unto all the people all the words of the LORD[JESUS] their GOD[JESUS], for which the
LORD[JESUS] their GOD[JESUS] had sent HIM[JESUS] to them, even all these words,

43:2 Then spake Azariah the SON[JESUS] of Hoshaiah, and Johanan the SON[JESUS] of
Kareah, and all the proud men, saying unto Jeremiah, you speakest
falsely: the LORD[JESUS] our GOD[JESUS] has not sent you to say, Go not into Egypt
to sojourn there:

43:3 But Baruch the SON[JESUS] of Neriah setteth you on against us, for to
deliver us into the hand of the Chaldeans, that they might put us to
death, and carry us away captives into Babylon.

43:4 So Johanan the SON[JESUS] of Kareah, and all the captains of the forces,
and all the people, obeyed not the voice of the LORD[JESUS], to dwell in the
land of Judah.

43:5 But Johanan the SON[JESUS] of Kareah, and all the captains of the forces,
took all the remnant of Judah, that were returned from all nations,
whither they had been driven, to dwell in the land of Judah;

43:6 Even men, and women, and children, and the KING[JESUS]'s daughters, and
every person that Nebuzaradan the captain of the guard had left with
Gedaliah the SON[JESUS] of Ahikam the SON[JESUS] of Shaphan, and Jeremiah the PROPHET[JESUS],
and Baruch the SON[JESUS] of Neriah.

43:7 So they came into the land of Egypt: for they obeyed not the voice
of the LORD[JESUS]: thus came they even to Tahpanhes.

43:8 Then came the WORD[JESUS] of the LORD[JESUS] unto Jeremiah in Tahpanhes, saying,

43:9 Take great stones in yours hand, and hide them in the clay in the
brickkiln, which is at the entry of Pharaoh's house in Tahpanhes, in the
sight of the men of Judah;

43:10 And say unto them, Thus says the LORD[JESUS] of hosts, the GOD[JESUS] of
Israel; Behold, I will send and take Nebuchadrezzar the KING[JESUS] of Babylon,
my SERVANT[JESUS], and will set HIS[JESUS] throne upon these stones that I have hid;
and HE[JESUS] shall spread HIS[JESUS] royal pavilion over them.

43:11 And when HE[JESUS] comes, HE[JESUS] shall smite the land of Egypt, and deliver
such as are for death to death; and such as are for captivity to
captivity; and such as are for the sword to the sword.

43:12 And I will kindle a fire in the houses of the gods of Egypt; and
HE[JESUS] shall burn them, and carry them away captives: and HE[JESUS] shall array
himself with the land of Egypt, as a SHEPHERD[JESUS] putteth on HIS[JESUS] garment;
and HE[JESUS] shall go forth from thence in peace.

43:13 HE[JESUS] shall break also the images of Bethshemesh, that is in the land
of Egypt; and the houses of the gods of the Egyptians shall HE[JESUS] burn with
fire.


44:1 The WORD[JESUS] that came to Jeremiah concerning all the Jews which dwell
in the land of Egypt, which dwell at Migdol, and at Tahpanhes, and at
Noph, and in the country of Pathros, saying,

44:2 Thus says the LORD[JESUS] of hosts, the GOD[JESUS] of Israel; you have seen all
the evil that I have brought upon Jerusalem, and upon all the cities of
Judah; and, behold, this day they are a desolation, and no man dwelleth
therein,

44:3 Because of their wickedness which they have committed to provoke me
to anger, in that they went to burn incense, and to serve other gods,
whom they knew not, neither they, you, nor your fathers.

44:4 Howbeit I sent unto you all my servants the prophets, rising early
and sending them, saying, Oh, do not this abominable thing that I hate.

44:5 But they hearkened not, nor inclined their ear to turn from their
wickedness, to burn no incense unto other gods.

44:6 Wherefore my fury and mine anger was poured forth, and was kindled
in the cities of Judah and in the streets of Jerusalem; and they are
wasted and desolate, as at this day.

44:7 Therefore now thus says the LORD[JESUS], the GOD[JESUS] of hosts, the GOD[JESUS] of
Israel; Wherefore commit you this great evil against your souls, to cut
off from you man and woman, child and suckling, out of Judah, to leave
you none to remain;

44:8 In that you provoke me unto wrath with the works of your hands,
burning incense unto other gods in the land of Egypt, whither you be gone
to dwell, that you might cut yourselves off, and that you might be a curse
and a reproach among all the nations of the earth?

44:9 Have you forgotten the wickedness of your fathers, and the
wickedness of the kings of Judah, and the wickedness of their wives, and
your own wickedness, and the wickedness of your wives, which they have
committed in the land of Judah, and in the streets of Jerusalem?

44:10 They are not humbled even unto this day, neither have they feared,
nor walked in my law, nor in my statutes, that I set before you and
before your fathers.

44:11 Therefore thus says the LORD[JESUS] of hosts, the GOD[JESUS] of Israel; Behold,
I will set my face against you for evil, and to cut off all Judah.

44:12 And I will take the remnant of Judah, that have set their faces to
go into the land of Egypt to sojourn there, and they shall all be
consumed, and fall in the land of Egypt; they shall even be consumed by
the sword and by the famine: they shall die, from the least even unto
the greatest, by the sword and by the famine: and they shall be an
execration, and an astonishment, and a curse, and a reproach.

44:13 For I will punish them that dwell in the land of Egypt, as I have
punished Jerusalem, by the sword, by the famine, and by the pestilence:

44:14 So that none of the remnant of Judah, which are gone into the land
of Egypt to sojourn there, shall escape or remain, that they should
return into the land of Judah, to the which they have a desire to return
to dwell there: for none shall return but such as shall escape.

44:15 Then all the men which knew that their wives had burned incense
unto other gods, and all the women that stood by, a great multitude,
even all the people that dwelt in the land of Egypt, in Pathros,
answered Jeremiah, saying,

44:16 As for the WORD[JESUS] that you hast spoken unto us in the name of the
LORD[JESUS], we will not hearken unto you.

44:17 But we will certainly do whatsoever thing goes forth out of our
own mouth, to burn incense unto the queen of heaven, and to pour out
drink offerings unto her, as we have done, we, and our fathers, our
kings, and our princes, in the cities of Judah, and in the streets of
Jerusalem: for then had we plenty of victuals, and were well, and saw no
evil.

44:18 But since we left off to burn incense to the queen of heaven, and
to pour out drink offerings unto her, we have wanted all things, and
have been consumed by the sword and by the famine.

44:19 And when we burned incense to the queen of heaven, and poured out
drink offerings unto her, did we make her cakes to worship her, and pour
out drink offerings unto her, without our men?

44:20 Then Jeremiah said unto all the people, to the men, and to the
women, and to all the people which had given HIM[JESUS] that answer, saying,

44:21 The incense that you burned in the cities of Judah, and in the
streets of Jerusalem, you, and your fathers, your kings, and your
princes, and the people of the land, did not the LORD[JESUS] remember them, and
came it not into HIS[JESUS] mind?

44:22 So that the LORD[JESUS] could no longer bear, because of the evil of your
doings, and because of the abominations which you have committed;
therefore is your land a desolation, and an astonishment, and a curse,
without an inhabitant, as at this day.

44:23 Because you have burned incense, and because you have sinned against
the LORD[JESUS], and have not obeyed the voice of the LORD[JESUS], nor walked in HIS[JESUS]
law, nor in HIS[JESUS] statutes, nor in HIS[JESUS] testimonies; therefore this evil is
happened unto you, as at this day.

44:24 Moreover Jeremiah said unto all the people, and to all the women,
Hear the WORD[JESUS] of the LORD[JESUS], all Judah that are in the land of Egypt:

44:25 Thus says the LORD[JESUS] of hosts, the GOD[JESUS] of Israel, saying; you and
your wives have both spoken with your mouths, and fulfilled with your
hand, saying, We will surely perform our vows that we have vowed, to
burn incense to the queen of heaven, and to pour out drink offerings
unto her: you will surely accomplish your vows, and surely perform your
vows.

44:26 Therefore hear you the WORD[JESUS] of the LORD[JESUS], all Judah that dwell in
the land of Egypt; Behold, I have sworn by my great name, says the
LORD[JESUS], that my name shall no more be named in the mouth of any man of
Judah in all the land of Egypt, saying, The LORD[JESUS] GOD[JESUS] liveth.

44:27 Behold, I will watch over them for evil, and not for good: and all
the men of Judah that are in the land of Egypt shall be consumed by the
sword and by the famine, until there be an end of them.

44:28 Yet a small number that escape the sword shall return out of the
land of Egypt into the land of Judah, and all the remnant of Judah, that
are gone into the land of Egypt to sojourn there, shall know whose words
shall stand, mine, or their's.

44:29 And this shall be a sign unto you, says the LORD[JESUS], that I will
punish you in this place, that you may know that my words shall surely
stand against you for evil:

44:30 Thus says the LORD[JESUS]; Behold, I will give Pharaohhophra KING[JESUS] of
Egypt into the hand of HIS[JESUS] enemies, and into the hand of them that seek
HIS[JESUS] life; as I gave Zedekiah KING[JESUS] of Judah into the hand of
Nebuchadrezzar KING[JESUS] of Babylon, HIS[JESUS] enemy, and that sought HIS[JESUS] life.


45:1 The WORD[JESUS] that Jeremiah the PROPHET[JESUS] spake unto Baruch the SON[JESUS] of
Neriah, when HE[JESUS] had written these words in a book at the mouth of
Jeremiah, in the fourth year of Jehoiakim the SON[JESUS] of Josiah KING[JESUS] of
Judah, saying,

45:2 Thus says the LORD[JESUS], the GOD[JESUS] of Israel, unto you, O Baruch:

45:3 you didst say, Woe is me now! for the LORD[JESUS] has added grief to my
sorrow; I fainted in my sighing, and I find no rest.

45:4 Thus shalt you say unto HIM[JESUS], The LORD[JESUS] says thus; Behold, that
which I have built will I break down, and that which I have planted I
will pluck up, even this whole land.

45:5 And seekest you great things for thyself? seek them not: for,
behold, I will bring evil upon all flesh, says the LORD[JESUS]: but your life
will I give unto you for a prey in all places whither you goest.


46:1 The WORD[JESUS] of the LORD[JESUS] which came to Jeremiah the PROPHET[JESUS] against the
Gentiles;

46:2 Against Egypt, against the army of Pharaohnecho KING[JESUS] of Egypt,
which was by the river Euphrates in Carchemish, which Nebuchadrezzar
KING[JESUS] of Babylon smote in the fourth year of Jehoiakim the SON[JESUS] of Josiah
KING[JESUS] of Judah.

46:3 Order you the buckler and shield, and draw near to battle.

46:4 Harness the horses; and get up, you horsemen, and stand forth with
your helmets; furbish the spears, and put on the brigandines.

46:5 Wherefore have I seen them dismayed and turned away back? and their
mighty ones are beaten down, and are fled apace, and look not back: for
fear was round about, says the LORD[JESUS].

46:6 Let not the swift flee away, nor the mighty man escape; they shall
stumble, and fall toward the north by the river Euphrates.

46:7 Who is this that comes up as a flood, whose waters are moved as
the rivers?

46:8 Egypt riseth up like a flood, and HIS[JESUS] waters are moved like the
rivers; and HE[JESUS] says, I will go up, and will cover the earth; I will
destroy the city and the inhabitants thereof.

46:9 Come up, you horses; and rage, you chariots; and let the mighty men
come forth; the Ethiopians and the Libyans, that handle the shield; and
the Lydians, that handle and bend the bow.

46:10 For this is the day of the LORD[JESUS] GOD[JESUS] of hosts, a day of vengeance,
that HE[JESUS] may avenge HIM[JESUS] of HIS[JESUS] adversaries: and the sword shall devour,
and it shall be satiate and made drunk with their blood: for the LORD[JESUS]
GOD[JESUS] of hosts has a sacrifice in the north country by the river
Euphrates.

46:11 Go up into Gilead, and take balm, O virgin, the daughter of Egypt:
in vain shalt you use many medicines; for you shalt not be cured.

46:12 The nations have heard of your shame, and your cry has filled the
land: for the mighty man has stumbled against the mighty, and they are
fallen both together.

46:13 The WORD[JESUS] that the LORD[JESUS] spake to Jeremiah the PROPHET[JESUS], how
Nebuchadrezzar KING[JESUS] of Babylon should come and smite the land of Egypt.

46:14 Declare you in Egypt, and publish in Migdol, and publish in Noph
and in Tahpanhes: say you, Stand fast, and prepare you; for the sword
shall devour round about you.

46:15 Why are your valiant men swept away? they stood not, because the
LORD[JESUS] did drive them.

46:16 HE[JESUS] made many to fall, yea, one fell upon another: and they said,
Arise, and let us go again to our own people, and to the land of our
nativity, from the oppressing sword.

46:17 They did cry there, Pharaoh KING[JESUS] of Egypt is but a noise; HE[JESUS] has
passed the time appointed.

46:18 As I live, says the KING[JESUS], whose name is the LORD[JESUS] of hosts, Surely
as Tabor is among the mountains, and as Carmel by the sea, so shall HE[JESUS]
come.

46:19 O you daughter dwelling in Egypt, furnish thyself to go into
captivity: for Noph shall be waste and desolate without an inhabitant.

46:20 Egypt is like a very fair heifer, but destruction comes; it
comes out of the north.

46:21 Also her hired men are in the midst of her like fatted bullocks;
for they also are turned back, and are fled away together: they did not
stand, because the day of their calamity was come upon them, and the
time of their visitation.

46:22 The voice thereof shall go like a serpent; for they shall march
with an army, and come against her with axes, as hewers of wood.

46:23 They shall cut down her forest, says the LORD[JESUS], though it cannot
be searched; because they are more than the grasshoppers, and are
innumerable.

46:24 The daughter of Egypt shall be confounded; she shall be delivered
into the hand of the people of the north.

46:25 The LORD[JESUS] of hosts, the GOD[JESUS] of Israel, says; Behold, I will punish
the multitude of No, and Pharaoh, and Egypt, with their gods, and their
kings; even Pharaoh, and all them that trust in HIM[JESUS]:

46:26 And I will deliver them into the hand of those that seek their
lives, and into the hand of Nebuchadrezzar KING[JESUS] of Babylon, and into the
hand of HIS[JESUS] servants: and afterward it shall be inhabited, as in the
days of old, says the LORD[JESUS].

46:27 But fear not you, O my SERVANT[JESUS] Jacob, and be not dismayed, O
Israel: for, behold, I will save you from afar off, and your SEED[JESUS] from
the land of their captivity; and Jacob shall return, and be in rest and
at ease, and none shall make HIM[JESUS] afraid.

46:28 Fear you not, O Jacob my SERVANT[JESUS], says the LORD[JESUS]: for I am with
you; for I will make a full end of all the nations whither I have
driven you: but I will not make a full end of you, but correct you in
measure; yet will I not leave you wholly unpunished.


47:1 The WORD[JESUS] of the LORD[JESUS] that came to Jeremiah the PROPHET[JESUS] against the
Philistines, before that Pharaoh smote Gaza.

47:2 Thus says the LORD[JESUS]; Behold, waters rise up out of the north, and
shall be an overflowing flood, and shall overflow the land, and all that
is therein; the city, and them that dwell therein: then the men shall
cry, and all the inhabitants of the land shall howl.

47:3 At the noise of the stamping of the hoofs of HIS[JESUS] strong horses, at
the rushing of HIS[JESUS] chariots, and at the rumbling of HIS[JESUS] wheels, the
fathers shall not look back to their children for feebleness of hands;

47:4 Because of the day that comes to spoil all the Philistines, and to
cut off from Tyrus and Zidon every helper that remaineth: for the LORD[JESUS]
will spoil the Philistines, the remnant of the country of Caphtor.

47:5 Baldness is come upon Gaza; Ashkelon is cut off with the remnant of
their valley: how long wilt you cut thyself?

47:6 O you sword of the LORD[JESUS], how long will it be ere you be quiet?
put up thyself into your scabbard, rest, and be still.

47:7 How can it be quiet, seeing the LORD[JESUS] has given it a charge against
Ashkelon, and against the sea shore? there has HE[JESUS] appointed it.


48:1 Against Moab thus says the LORD[JESUS] of hosts, the GOD[JESUS] of Israel; Woe
unto Nebo! for it is spoiled: Kiriathaim is confounded and taken: Misgab
is confounded and dismayed.

48:2 There shall be no more praise of Moab: in Heshbon they have devised
evil against it; come, and let us cut it off from being a nation. Also
you shalt be cut down, O Madmen; the sword shall pursue you.

48:3 A voice of crying shall be from Horonaim, spoiling and great
destruction.

48:4 Moab is destroyed; her little ones have caused a cry to be heard.

48:5 For in the going up of Luhith continual weeping shall go up; for in
the going down of Horonaim the enemies have heard a cry of destruction.

48:6 Flee, save your lives, and be like the heath in the wilderness.

48:7 For because you hast trusted in your works and in your treasures,
you shalt also be taken: and Chemosh shall go forth into captivity with
HIS[JESUS] priests and HIS[JESUS] princes together.

48:8 And the spoiler shall come upon every city, and no city shall
escape: the valley also shall perish, and the plain shall be destroyed,
as the LORD[JESUS] has spoken.

48:9 Give wings unto Moab, that it may flee and get away: for the cities
thereof shall be desolate, without any to dwell therein.

48:10 Cursed be HE[JESUS] that doeth the work of the LORD[JESUS] deceitfully, and
cursed be HE[JESUS] that keepeth back HIS[JESUS] sword from blood.

48:11 Moab has been at ease from HIS[JESUS] youth, and HE[JESUS] has settled on HIS[JESUS]
lees, and has not been emptied from vessel to vessel, neither has HE[JESUS]
gone into captivity: therefore HIS[JESUS] taste remained in HIM[JESUS], and HIS[JESUS] scent
is not changed.

48:12 Therefore, behold, the days come, says the LORD[JESUS], that I will send
unto HIM[JESUS] wanderers, that shall cause HIM[JESUS] to wander, and shall empty HIS[JESUS]
vessels, and break their bottles.

48:13 And Moab shall be ashamed of Chemosh, as the house of Israel was
ashamed of Bethel their confidence.

48:14 How say you, We are mighty and strong men for the war?

48:15 Moab is spoiled, and gone up out of her cities, and HIS[JESUS] chosen
young men are gone down to the slaughter, says the KING[JESUS], whose name is
the LORD[JESUS] of hosts.

48:16 The calamity of Moab is near to come, and HIS[JESUS] affliction hasteth
fast.

48:17 All you that are about HIM[JESUS], bemoan HIM[JESUS]; and all you that know HIS[JESUS]
name, say, How is the strong staff broken, and the beautiful rod!

48:18 you daughter that dost inhabit Dibon, come down from your glory,
and sit in thirst; for the spoiler of Moab shall come upon you, and HE[JESUS]
shall destroy your strong holds.

48:19 O inhabitant of Aroer, stand by the way, and espy; ask HIM[JESUS] that
fleeth, and her that escapeth, and say, What is done?

48:20 Moab is confounded; for it is broken down: howl and cry; tell you
it in Arnon, that Moab is spoiled,

48:21 And judgment is come upon the plain country; upon Holon, and upon
Jahazah, and upon Mephaath,

48:22 And upon Dibon, and upon Nebo, and upon Bethdiblathaim,
