25:6 And at midnight there was a cry made, Behold, the bridegroom
comes; go you out to meet HIM[JESUS].

25:7 Then all those virgins arose, and trimmed their lamps.

25:8 And the foolish said unto the wise, Give us of your oil; for our
lamps are gone out.

25:9 But the wise answered, saying, Not so; lest there be not enough for
us and you: but go you rather to them that sell, and buy for yourselves.

25:10 And while they went to buy, the bridegroom came; and they that
were ready went in with HIM[JESUS] to the marriage: and the door was shut.

25:11 Afterward came also the other virgins, saying, LORD[JESUS], LORD[JESUS], open to
us.

25:12 But HE[JESUS] answered and said, truly I say unto you, I know you not.

25:13 Watch therefore, for you know neither the day nor the hour wherein
the SON[JESUS] OF MAN[JESUS] comes.

25:14 For the kingdom of heaven is as a man travelling into a far
country, who called HIS[JESUS] own servants, and delivered unto them HIS[JESUS] goods.

25:15 And unto one HE[JESUS] gave five talents, to another two, and to another
one; to every man according to HIS[JESUS] several ability; and straightway took
HIS[JESUS] journey.

25:16 Then HE[JESUS] that had received the five talents went and traded with
the same, and made them other five talents.

25:17 And likewise HE[JESUS] that had received two, HE[JESUS] also gained other two.

25:18 But HE[JESUS] that had received one went and digged in the earth, and hid
HIS[JESUS] LORD[JESUS]'s money.

25:19 After a long time the LORD[JESUS] of those servants comes, and reckoneth
with them.

25:20 And so HE[JESUS] that had received five talents came and brought other
five talents, saying, LORD[JESUS], you deliveredst unto me five talents:
behold, I have gained beside them five talents more.

25:21 HIS[JESUS] LORD[JESUS] said unto HIM[JESUS], Well done, you good and faithful SERVANT[JESUS]:
you hast been faithful over a few things, I will make you ruler over
many things: enter you into the joy of your LORD[JESUS].

25:22 HE[JESUS] also that had received two talents came and said, LORD[JESUS], you
deliveredst unto me two talents: behold, I have gained two other talents
beside them.

25:23 HIS[JESUS] LORD[JESUS] said unto HIM[JESUS], Well done, good and faithful SERVANT[JESUS]; you
hast been faithful over a few things, I will make you ruler over many
things: enter you into the joy of your LORD[JESUS].

25:24 Then HE[JESUS] which had received the one talent came and said, LORD[JESUS], I
knew you that you art an hard man, reaping where you hast not sown,
and gathering where you hast not strawed:

25:25 And I was afraid, and went and hid your talent in the earth: lo,
there you hast that is yours.

25:26 HIS[JESUS] LORD[JESUS] answered and said unto HIM[JESUS], you wicked and slothful
SERVANT[JESUS], you knewest that I reap where I sowed not, and gather where I
have not strawed:

25:27 you oughtest therefore to have put my money to the exchangers,
and then at my coming I should have received mine own with usury.

25:28 Take therefore the talent from HIM[JESUS], and give it unto HIM[JESUS] which
has ten talents.

25:29 For unto every one that has shall be given, and HE[JESUS] shall have
abundance: but from HIM[JESUS] that has not shall be taken away even that
which HE[JESUS] has.

25:30 And cast you the unprofitable SERVANT[JESUS] into outer darkness: there
shall be weeping and gnashing of teeth.

25:31 When the SON[JESUS] OF MAN[JESUS] shall come in HIS[JESUS] glory, and all the holy
angels with HIM[JESUS], then shall HE[JESUS] sit upon the throne of HIS[JESUS] glory:

25:32 And before HIM[JESUS] shall be gathered all nations: and HE[JESUS] shall
separate them one from another, as a SHEPHERD[JESUS] divideth HIS[JESUS] sheep from
the goats:

25:33 And HE[JESUS] shall set the sheep on HIS[JESUS] right hand, but the goats on the
left.

25:34 Then shall the KING[JESUS] say unto them on HIS[JESUS] right hand, Come, you
blessed of my Father, inherit the kingdom prepared for you from the
foundation of the world:

25:35 For I was an hungred, and you gave me meat: I was thirsty, and you
gave me drink: I was a stranger, and you took me in:

25:36 Naked, and you clothed me: I was sick, and you visited me: I was in
prison, and you came unto me.

25:37 Then shall the righteous answer HIM[JESUS], saying, LORD[JESUS], when saw we
you an hungred, and fed you? or thirsty, and gave you drink?

25:38 When saw we you a stranger, and took you in? or naked, and
clothed you?

25:39 Or when saw we you sick, or in prison, and came unto you?

25:40 And the KING[JESUS] shall answer and say unto them, truly I say unto
you, Inasmuch as you have done it unto one of the least of these my
brethren, you have done it unto me.

25:41 Then shall HE[JESUS] say also unto them on the left hand, Depart from me,
you cursed, into everlasting fire, prepared for the devil and HIS[JESUS] angels:

25:42 For I was an hungred, and you gave me no meat: I was thirsty, and
you gave me no drink:

25:43 I was a stranger, and you took me not in: naked, and you clothed me
not: sick, and in prison, and you visited me not.

25:44 Then shall they also answer HIM[JESUS], saying, LORD[JESUS], when saw we you an
hungred, or athirst, or a stranger, or naked, or sick, or in prison, and
did not minister unto you?

25:45 Then shall HE[JESUS] answer them, saying, truly I say unto you, Inasmuch
as you did it not to one of the least of these, you did it not to me.

25:46 And these shall go away into everlasting punishment: but the
righteous into life eternal.


26:1 And it came to pass, when JESUS had finished all these sayings, HE[JESUS]
said unto HIS[JESUS] disciples,

26:2 you know that after two days is the feast of the passover, and the
SON[JESUS] OF MAN[JESUS] is betrayed to be crucified.

26:3 Then assembled together the chief priests, and the scribes, and the
elders of the people, unto the palace of the high priest, who was called
Caiaphas,

26:4 And consulted that they might take JESUS by subtilty, and kill HIM[JESUS].

26:5 But they said, Not on the feast day, lest there be an uproar among
the people.

26:6 Now when JESUS was in Bethany, in the house of Simon the leper,

26:7 There came unto HIM[JESUS] a woman having an alabaster box of very
precious ointment, and poured it on HIS[JESUS] head, as HE[JESUS] sat at meat.

26:8 But when HIS[JESUS] disciples saw it, they had indignation, saying, To
what purpose is this waste?

26:9 For this ointment might have been sold for much, and given to the
poor.

26:10 When JESUS understood it, HE[JESUS] said unto them, Why trouble you the
woman? for she has wrought a good work upon me.

26:11 For you have the poor always with you; but me you have not always.

26:12 For in that she has poured this ointment on my body, she did it
for my burial.

26:13 truly I say unto you, Wheresoever this gospel shall be preached
in the whole world, there shall also this, that this woman has done, be
told for a memorial of her.

26:14 Then one of the twelve, called Judas Iscariot, went unto the chief
priests,

26:15 And said unto them, What will you give me, and I will deliver HIM[JESUS]
unto you? And they covenanted with HIM[JESUS] for thirty pieces of silver.

26:16 And from that time HE[JESUS] sought opportunity to betray HIM[JESUS].

26:17 Now the first day of the feast of unleavened bread the disciples
came to JESUS, saying unto HIM[JESUS], Where wilt you that we prepare for you
to eat the passover?

26:18 And HE[JESUS] said, Go into the city to such a man, and say unto HIM[JESUS], The
Master says, My time is at hand; I will keep the passover at your house
with my disciples.

26:19 And the disciples did as JESUS had appointed them; and they made
ready the passover.

26:20 Now when the even was come, HE[JESUS] sat down with the twelve.

26:21 And as they did eat, HE[JESUS] said, truly I say unto you, that one of
you shall betray me.

26:22 And they were exceeding sorrowful, and began every one of them to
say unto HIM[JESUS], LORD[JESUS], is it I?

26:23 And HE[JESUS] answered and said, HE[JESUS] that dippeth HIS[JESUS] hand with me in the
dish, the same shall betray me.

26:24 The SON[JESUS] OF MAN[JESUS] goes as it is written of HIM[JESUS]: but woe unto that
man by whom the SON[JESUS] OF MAN[JESUS] is betrayed! it had been good for that man if
HE[JESUS] had not been born.

26:25 Then Judas, which betrayed HIM[JESUS], answered and said, Master, is it
I? HE[JESUS] said unto HIM[JESUS], you hast said.

26:26 And as they were eating, JESUS took bread, and blessed it, and
brake it, and gave it to the disciples, and said, Take, eat; this is my
body.

26:27 And HE[JESUS] took the cup, and gave thanks, and gave it to them, saying,
Drink you all of it;

26:28 For this is my blood of the new testament, which is shed for many
for the remission of sins.

26:29 But I say unto you, I will not drink henceforth of this fruit of
the vine, until that day when I drink it new with you in my Father's
kingdom.

26:30 And when they had sung an hymn, they went out into the mount of
Olives.

26:31 Then says JESUS unto them, All you shall be offended because of me
this night: for it is written, I will smite the SHEPHERD[JESUS], and the sheep
of the flock shall be scattered abroad.

26:32 But after I am risen again, I will go before you into Galilee.

26:33 Peter answered and said unto HIM[JESUS], Though all men shall be offended
because of you, yet will I never be offended.

26:34 JESUS said unto HIM[JESUS], truly I say unto you, That this night,
before the cock crow, you shalt deny me thrice.

26:35 Peter said unto HIM[JESUS], Though I should die with you, yet will I not
deny you. Likewise also said all the disciples.

26:36 Then comes JESUS with them unto a place called Gethsemane, and
says unto the disciples, Sit you here, while I go and pray yonder.

26:37 And HE[JESUS] took with HIM[JESUS] Peter and the two sons of Zebedee, and began
to be sorrowful and very heavy.

26:38 Then says HE[JESUS] unto them, My soul is exceeding sorrowful, even unto
death: tarry you here, and watch with me.

26:39 And HE[JESUS] went a little farther, and fell on HIS[JESUS] face, and prayed,
saying, O my Father, if it be possible, let this cup pass from me:
nevertheless not as I will, but as you wilt.

26:40 And HE[JESUS] comes unto the disciples, and findeth them asleep, and
says unto Peter, What, could you not watch with me one hour?

26:41 Watch and pray, that you enter not into temptation: the spirit
indeed is willing, but the flesh is weak.

26:42 HE[JESUS] went away again the second time, and prayed, saying, O my
Father, if this cup may not pass away from me, except I drink it, your
will be done.

26:43 And HE[JESUS] came and found them asleep again: for their eyes were
heavy.

26:44 And HE[JESUS] left them, and went away again, and prayed the third time,
saying the same words.

26:45 Then comes HE[JESUS] to HIS[JESUS] disciples, and says unto them, Sleep on
now, and take your rest: behold, the hour is at hand, and the SON[JESUS] OF MAN[JESUS]
is betrayed into the hands of sinners.

26:46 Rise, let us be going: behold, HE[JESUS] is at hand that does betray me.

26:47 And while HE[JESUS] yet spake, lo, Judas, one of the twelve, came, and
with HIM[JESUS] a great multitude with swords and staves, from the chief
priests and elders of the people.

26:48 Now HE[JESUS] that betrayed HIM[JESUS] gave them a sign, saying, Whomsoever I
shall kiss, that same is HE[JESUS]: hold HIM[JESUS] fast.

26:49 And forthwith HE[JESUS] came to JESUS, and said, Hail, master; and kissed
HIM[JESUS].

26:50 And JESUS said unto HIM[JESUS], Friend, wherefore art you come? Then
came they, and laid hands on JESUS and took HIM[JESUS].

26:51 And, behold, one of them which were with JESUS stretched out HIS[JESUS]
hand, and drew HIS[JESUS] sword, and struck a SERVANT[JESUS] of the high priest's, and
smote off HIS[JESUS] ear.

26:52 Then said JESUS unto HIM[JESUS], Put up again your sword into HIS[JESUS] place:
for all they that take the sword shall perish with the sword.

26:53 Thinkest you that I cannot now pray to my Father, and HE[JESUS] shall
presently give me more than twelve legions of angels?

26:54 But how then shall the scriptures be fulfilled, that thus it must
be?

26:55 In that same hour said JESUS to the multitudes, Are you come out as
against a thief with swords and staves for to take me? I sat daily with
you teaching in the temple, and you laid no hold on me.

26:56 But all this was done, that the scriptures of the prophets might
be fulfilled. Then all the disciples forsook HIM[JESUS], and fled.

26:57 And they that had laid hold on JESUS led HIM[JESUS] away to Caiaphas the
high priest, where the scribes and the elders were assembled.

26:58 But Peter followed HIM[JESUS] afar off unto the high priest's palace, and
went in, and sat with the servants, to see the end.

26:59 Now the chief priests, and elders, and all the council, sought
false witness against JESUS, to put HIM[JESUS] to death;

26:60 But found none: yea, though many false witnesses came, yet found
they none. At the last came two false witnesses,

26:61 And said, This fellow said, I am able to destroy the temple of
GOD[JESUS], and to build it in three days.

26:62 And the high priest arose, and said unto HIM[JESUS], Answerest you
nothing? what is it which these witness against you?

26:63 But JESUS held HIS[JESUS] peace, And the high priest answered and said
unto HIM[JESUS], I adjure you by the living GOD[JESUS], that you tell us whether
you be the CHRIST[JESUS], the SON[JESUS] OF GOD[JESUS][JESUS].

26:64 JESUS says unto HIM[JESUS], you hast said: nevertheless I say unto you,
Hereafter shall you see the SON[JESUS] OF MAN[JESUS] sitting on the right hand of
power, and coming in the clouds of heaven.

26:65 Then the high priest rent HIS[JESUS] clothes, saying, HE[JESUS] has spoken
blasphemy; what further need have we of witnesses? behold, now you have
heard HIS[JESUS] blasphemy.

26:66 What think you? They answered and said, HE[JESUS] is guilty of death.

26:67 Then did they spit in HIS[JESUS] face, and buffeted HIM[JESUS]; and others smote
HIM[JESUS] with the palms of their hands,

26:68 Saying, Prophesy unto us, you CHRIST[JESUS], Who is HE[JESUS] that smote you?

26:69 Now Peter sat without in the palace: and a damsel came unto HIM[JESUS],
saying, you also wast with JESUS of Galilee.

26:70 But HE[JESUS] denied before them all, saying, I know not what you
sayest.

26:71 And when HE[JESUS] was gone out into the porch, another maid saw HIM[JESUS], and
said unto them that were there, This fellow was also with JESUS of
Nazareth.

26:72 And again HE[JESUS] denied with an oath, I do not know the man.

26:73 And after a while came unto HIM[JESUS] they that stood by, and said to
Peter, Surely you also art one of them; for your speech bewrayeth you.

26:74 Then began HE[JESUS] to curse and to swear, saying, I know not the man.
And immediately the cock crew.

26:75 And Peter remembered the WORD[JESUS] of JESUS, which said unto HIM[JESUS],
Before the cock crow, you shalt deny me thrice. And HE[JESUS] went out, and
wept bitterly.


27:1 When the morning was come, all the chief priests and elders of the
people took counsel against JESUS to put HIM[JESUS] to death:

27:2 And when they had bound HIM[JESUS], they led HIM[JESUS] away, and delivered HIM[JESUS]
to Pontius Pilate the governor.

27:3 Then Judas, which had betrayed HIM[JESUS], when HE[JESUS] saw that HE[JESUS] was
condemned, repented himself, and brought again the thirty pieces of
silver to the chief priests and elders,

27:4 Saying, I have sinned in that I have betrayed the innocent blood.
And they said, What is that to us? see you to that.

27:5 And HE[JESUS] cast down the pieces of silver in the temple, and departed,
and went and hanged himself.

27:6 And the chief priests took the silver pieces, and said, It is not
lawful for to put them into the treasury, because it is the price of
blood.

27:7 And they took counsel, and bought with them the potter's field, to
bury strangers in.

27:8 Wherefore that field was called, The field of blood, unto this day.

27:9 Then was fulfilled that which was spoken by Jeremy the PROPHET[JESUS],
saying, And they took the thirty pieces of silver, the price of HIM[JESUS] that
was valued, whom they of the children of Israel did value;

27:10 And gave them for the potter's field, as the LORD[JESUS] appointed me.

27:11 And JESUS stood before the governor: and the governor asked HIM[JESUS],
saying, Art you the KING[JESUS] of the Jews? And JESUS said unto HIM[JESUS], you
sayest.

27:12 And when HE[JESUS] was accused of the chief priests and elders, HE[JESUS]
answered nothing.

27:13 Then said Pilate unto HIM[JESUS], Hearest you not how many things they
witness against you?

27:14 And HE[JESUS] answered HIM[JESUS] to never a WORD[JESUS]; insomuch that the governor
marvelled greatly.

27:15 Now at that feast the governor was wont to release unto the people
a prisoner, whom they would.

27:16 And they had then a notable prisoner, called Barabbas.

27:17 Therefore when they were gathered together, Pilate said unto them,
Whom will you that I release unto you? Barabbas, or JESUS which is called
CHRIST[JESUS]?

27:18 For HE[JESUS] knew that for envy they had delivered HIM[JESUS].

27:19 When HE[JESUS] was set down on the judgment seat, HIS[JESUS] wife sent unto HIM[JESUS],
saying, Have you nothing to do with that just man: for I have suffered
many things this day in a dream because of HIM[JESUS].

27:20 But the chief priests and elders persuaded the multitude that they
should ask Barabbas, and destroy JESUS.

27:21 The governor answered and said unto them, Whether of the twain
will you that I release unto you? They said, Barabbas.

27:22 Pilate says unto them, What shall I do then with JESUS which is
called CHRIST[JESUS]? They all say unto HIM[JESUS], Let HIM[JESUS] be crucified.

27:23 And the governor said, Why, what evil has HE[JESUS] done? But they cried
out the more, saying, Let HIM[JESUS] be crucified.

27:24 When Pilate saw that HE[JESUS] could prevail nothing, but that rather a
tumult was made, HE[JESUS] took water, and washed HIS[JESUS] hands before the
multitude, saying, I am innocent of the blood of this just person: see
you to it.

27:25 Then answered all the people, and said, HIS[JESUS] blood be on us, and on
our children.

27:26 Then released HE[JESUS] Barabbas unto them: and when HE[JESUS] had scourged
JESUS, HE[JESUS] delivered HIM[JESUS] to be crucified.

27:27 Then the soldiers of the governor took JESUS into the common hall,
and gathered unto HIM[JESUS] the whole band of soldiers.

27:28 And they stripped HIM[JESUS], and put on HIM[JESUS] a scarlet robe.

27:29 And when they had platted a crown of thorns, they put it upon HIS[JESUS]
head, and a reed in HIS[JESUS] right hand: and they bowed the knee before HIM[JESUS],
and mocked HIM[JESUS], saying, Hail, KING[JESUS] of the Jews!

27:30 And they spit upon HIM[JESUS], and took the reed, and smote HIM[JESUS] on the
head.

27:31 And after that they had mocked HIM[JESUS], they took the robe off from
HIM[JESUS], and put HIS[JESUS] own raiment on HIM[JESUS], and led HIM[JESUS] away to crucify HIM[JESUS].

27:32 And as they came out, they found a man of Cyrene, Simon by name:
HIM[JESUS] they compelled to bear HIS[JESUS] cross.

27:33 And when they were come unto a place called Golgotha, that is to
say, a place of a skull,

27:34 They gave HIM[JESUS] vinegar to drink mingled with gall: and when HE[JESUS] had
tasted thereof, HE[JESUS] would not drink.

27:35 And they crucified HIM[JESUS], and parted HIS[JESUS] garments, casting lots:
that it might be fulfilled which was spoken by the PROPHET[JESUS], They parted
my garments among them, and upon my vesture did they cast lots.

27:36 And sitting down they watched HIM[JESUS] there;

27:37 And set up over HIS[JESUS] head HIS[JESUS] accusation written, THIS IS JESUS THE
KING[JESUS] OF THE JEWS.

27:38 Then were there two thieves crucified with HIM[JESUS], one on the right
hand, and another on the left.

27:39 And they that passed by reviled HIM[JESUS], wagging their heads,

27:40 And saying, you that destroyest the temple, and buildest it in
three days, save thyself. If you be the SON[JESUS] OF GOD[JESUS][JESUS], come down from the
cross.

27:41 Likewise also the chief priests mocking HIM[JESUS], with the scribes and
elders, said,

27:42 HE[JESUS] saved others; himself HE[JESUS] cannot save. If HE[JESUS] be the KING[JESUS] of
Israel, let HIM[JESUS] now come down from the cross, and we will believe HIM[JESUS].

27:43 HE[JESUS] trusted in GOD[JESUS]; let HIM[JESUS] deliver HIM[JESUS] now, if HE[JESUS] will have HIM[JESUS]:
for HE[JESUS] said, I am the SON[JESUS] OF GOD[JESUS][JESUS].

27:44 The thieves also, which were crucified with HIM[JESUS], cast the same in
HIS[JESUS] teeth.

27:45 Now from the sixth hour there was darkness over all the land unto
the ninth hour.

27:46 And about the ninth hour JESUS cried with a loud voice, saying,
Eli, Eli, lama sabachthani? that is to say, My GOD[JESUS], my GOD[JESUS], why hast
you forsaken me?

27:47 Some of them that stood there, when they heard that, said, This
man calleth for Elias.

27:48 And straightway one of them ran, and took a spunge, and filled it
with vinegar, and put it on a reed, and gave HIM[JESUS] to drink.

27:49 The rest said, Let be, let us see whether Elias will come to save
HIM[JESUS].

27:50 JESUS, when HE[JESUS] had cried again with a loud voice, yielded up the
ghost.

27:51 And, behold, the veil of the temple was rent in twain from the top
to the bottom; and the earth did quake, and the rocks rent;

27:52 And the graves were opened; and many bodies of the saints which
slept arose,

27:53 And came out of the graves after HIS[JESUS] resurrection, and went into
the holy city, and appeared unto many.

27:54 Now when the centurion, and they that were with HIM[JESUS], watching
JESUS, saw the earthquake, and those things that were done, they feared
greatly, saying, Truly this was the SON[JESUS] OF GOD[JESUS][JESUS].

27:55 And many women were there beholding afar off, which followed JESUS
from Galilee, ministering unto HIM[JESUS]:

27:56 Among which was Mary Magdalene, and Mary the mother of James and
Joses, and the mother of Zebedees children.

27:57 When the even was come, there came a rich man of Arimathaea, named
Joseph, who also himself was JESUS' disciple:

27:58 HE[JESUS] went to Pilate, and begged the body of JESUS. Then Pilate
commanded the body to be delivered.

27:59 And when Joseph had taken the body, HE[JESUS] wrapped it in a clean linen
cloth,

27:60 And laid it in HIS[JESUS] own new tomb, which HE[JESUS] had hewn out in the
rock: and HE[JESUS] rolled a great stone to the door of the sepulchre, and
departed.

27:61 And there was Mary Magdalene, and the other Mary, sitting over
against the sepulchre.

27:62 Now the next day, that followed the day of the preparation, the
chief priests and Pharisees came together unto Pilate,

27:63 Saying, Sir, we remember that that deceiver said, while HE[JESUS] was yet
alive, After three days I will rise again.

27:64 Command therefore that the sepulchre be made sure until the third
day, lest HIS[JESUS] disciples come by night, and steal HIM[JESUS] away, and say unto
the people, HE[JESUS] is risen from the dead: so the last error shall be worse
than the first.

27:65 Pilate said unto them, you have a watch: go your way, make it as
sure as you can.

27:66 So they went, and made the sepulchre sure, sealing the stone, and
setting a watch.


28:1 In the end of the sabbath, as it began to dawn toward the first day
of the week, came Mary Magdalene and the other Mary to see the
sepulchre.

28:2 And, behold, there was a great earthquake: for the angel of the
LORD[JESUS] descended from heaven, and came and rolled back the stone from the
door, and sat upon it.

28:3 HIS[JESUS] countenance was like lightning, and HIS[JESUS] raiment white as snow:

28:4 And for fear of HIM[JESUS] the keepers did shake, and became as dead men.

28:5 And the angel answered and said unto the women, Fear not you: for I
know that you seek JESUS, which was crucified.

28:6 HE[JESUS] is not here: for HE[JESUS] is risen, as HE[JESUS] said. Come, see the place
where the LORD[JESUS] lay.

28:7 And go quickly, and tell HIS[JESUS] disciples that HE[JESUS] is risen from the
dead; and, behold, HE[JESUS] goes before you into Galilee; there shall you see
HIM[JESUS]: lo, I have told you.

28:8 And they departed quickly from the sepulchre with fear and great
joy; and did run to bring HIS[JESUS] disciples WORD[JESUS].

28:9 And as they went to tell HIS[JESUS] disciples, behold, JESUS met them,
saying, All hail. And they came and held HIM[JESUS] by the feet, and worshipped
HIM[JESUS].

28:10 Then said JESUS unto them, Be not afraid: go tell my brethren that
they go into Galilee, and there shall they see me.

28:11 Now when they were going, behold, some of the watch came into the
city, and shewed unto the chief priests all the things that were done.

28:12 And when they were assembled with the elders, and had taken
counsel, they gave large money unto the soldiers,

28:13 Saying, Say you, HIS[JESUS] disciples came by night, and stole HIM[JESUS] away
while we slept.

28:14 And if this come to the governor's ears, we will persuade HIM[JESUS], and
secure you.

28:15 So they took the money, and did as they were taught: and this
saying is commonly reported among the Jews until this day.

28:16 Then the eleven disciples went away into Galilee, into a mountain
where JESUS had appointed them.

28:17 And when they saw HIM[JESUS], they worshipped HIM[JESUS]: but some doubted.

28:18 And JESUS came and spake unto them, saying, All power is given
unto me in heaven and in earth.

28:19 Go you therefore, and teach all nations, baptizing them in the name
of the Father, and of the SON[JESUS], and of the Holy Ghost:

28:20 Teaching them to observe all things whatsoever I have commanded
you: and, lo, I am with you alway, even unto the end of the world. Amen.

1:1 The beginning of the gospel of JESUS CHRIST[JESUS], the SON[JESUS] OF GOD[JESUS][JESUS];

1:2 As it is written in the prophets, Behold, I send my messenger before
your face, which shall prepare your way before you.

1:3 The voice of one crying in the wilderness, Prepare you the way of the
LORD[JESUS], make HIS[JESUS] paths straight.

1:4 John did baptize in the wilderness, and preach the baptism of
repentance for the remission of sins.

1:5 And there went out unto HIM[JESUS] all the land of Judaea, and they of
Jerusalem, and were all baptized of HIM[JESUS] in the river of Jordan,
confessing their sins.

1:6 And John was clothed with camel's hair, and with a girdle of a skin
about HIS[JESUS] loins; and HE[JESUS] did eat locusts and wild honey;

1:7 And preached, saying, There comes one mightier than I after me, the
latchet of whose shoes I am not worthy to stoop down and unloose.

1:8 I indeed have baptized you with water: but HE[JESUS] shall baptize you with
the Holy Ghost.

1:9 And it came to pass in those days, that JESUS came from Nazareth of
Galilee, and was baptized of John in Jordan.

1:10 And straightway coming up out of the water, HE[JESUS] saw the heavens
opened, and the Spirit like a dove descending upon HIM[JESUS]:

1:11 And there came a voice from heaven, saying, you art my beloved
SON[JESUS], in whom I am well pleased.

1:12 And immediately the spirit driveth HIM[JESUS] into the wilderness.

1:13 And HE[JESUS] was there in the wilderness forty days, tempted of Satan;
and was with the wild beasts; and the angels ministered unto HIM[JESUS].

1:14 Now after that John was put in prison, JESUS came into Galilee,
preaching the gospel of the kingdom of GOD[JESUS],

1:15 And saying, The time is fulfilled, and the kingdom of GOD[JESUS] is at
hand: repent you, and believe the gospel.

1:16 Now as HE[JESUS] walked by the sea of Galilee, HE[JESUS] saw Simon and Andrew HIS[JESUS]
brother casting a net into the sea: for they were fishers.

1:17 And JESUS said unto them, Come you after me, and I will make you to
become fishers of men.

1:18 And straightway they forsook their nets, and followed HIM[JESUS].

1:19 And when HE[JESUS] had gone a little farther thence, HE[JESUS] saw James the SON[JESUS]
of Zebedee, and John HIS[JESUS] brother, who also were in the ship mending
their nets.

1:20 And straightway HE[JESUS] called them: and they left their father Zebedee
in the ship with the hired servants, and went after HIM[JESUS].

1:21 And they went into Capernaum; and straightway on the sabbath day HE[JESUS]
entered into the synagogue, and taught.

1:22 And they were astonished at HIS[JESUS] doctrine: for HE[JESUS] taught them as one
that had authority, and not as the scribes.

1:23 And there was in their synagogue a man with an unclean spirit; and
HE[JESUS] cried out,

1:24 Saying, Let us alone; what have we to do with you, you JESUS of
Nazareth? art you come to destroy us? I know you who you art, the
Holy One of GOD[JESUS].

1:25 And JESUS rebuked HIM[JESUS], saying, Hold your peace, and come out of HIM[JESUS].

1:26 And when the unclean spirit had torn HIM[JESUS], and cried with a loud
voice, HE[JESUS] came out of HIM[JESUS].

1:27 And they were all amazed, insomuch that they questioned among
themselves, saying, What thing is this? what new doctrine is this? for
with authority commandeth HE[JESUS] even the unclean spirits, and they do obey
HIM[JESUS].

1:28 And immediately HIS[JESUS] fame spread abroad throughout all the region
round about Galilee.

1:29 And forthwith, when they were come out of the synagogue, they
entered into the house of Simon and Andrew, with James and John.

1:30 But Simon's wife's mother lay sick of a fever, and anon they tell
HIM[JESUS] of her.

1:31 And HE[JESUS] came and took her by the hand, and lifted her up; and
immediately the fever left her, and she ministered unto them.

1:32 And at even, when the sun did set, they brought unto HIM[JESUS] all that
were diseased, and them that were possessed with devils.

1:33 And all the city was gathered together at the door.

1:34 And HE[JESUS] healed many that were sick of divers diseases, and cast out
many devils; and suffered not the devils to speak, because they knew
HIM[JESUS].

1:35 And in the morning, rising up a great while before day, HE[JESUS] went
out, and departed into a solitary place, and there prayed.

1:36 And Simon and they that were with HIM[JESUS] followed after HIM[JESUS].

1:37 And when they had found HIM[JESUS], they said unto HIM[JESUS], All men seek for
you.

1:38 And HE[JESUS] said unto them, Let us go into the next towns, that I may
preach there also: for therefore came I forth.

1:39 And HE[JESUS] preached in their synagogues throughout all Galilee, and
cast out devils.

1:40 And there came a leper to HIM[JESUS], beseeching HIM[JESUS], and kneeling down to
HIM[JESUS], and saying unto HIM[JESUS], If you wilt, you canst make me clean.

1:41 And JESUS, moved with compassion, put forth HIS[JESUS] hand, and touched
HIM[JESUS], and says unto HIM[JESUS], I will; be you clean.

1:42 And as soon as HE[JESUS] had spoken, immediately the leprosy departed from
HIM[JESUS], and HE[JESUS] was cleansed.

1:43 And HE[JESUS] straitly charged HIM[JESUS], and forthwith sent HIM[JESUS] away;

1:44 And says unto HIM[JESUS], See you say nothing to any man: but go your
way, shew thyself to the priest, and offer for your cleansing those
things which Moses commanded, for a testimony unto them.

1:45 But HE[JESUS] went out, and began to publish it much, and to blaze abroad
the matter, insomuch that JESUS could no more openly enter into the
city, but was without in desert places: and they came to HIM[JESUS] from every
quarter.


2:1 And again HE[JESUS] entered into Capernaum after some days; and it was
noised that HE[JESUS] was in the house.

2:2 And straightway many were gathered together, insomuch that there was
no room to receive them, no, not so much as about the door: and HE[JESUS]
preached the WORD[JESUS] unto them.

2:3 And they come unto HIM[JESUS], bringing one sick of the palsy, which was
borne of four.

2:4 And when they could not come nigh unto HIM[JESUS] for the press, they
uncovered the roof where HE[JESUS] was: and when they had broken it up, they
let down the bed wherein the sick of the palsy lay.

2:5 When JESUS saw their faith, HE[JESUS] said unto the sick of the palsy, SON[JESUS],
your sins be forgiven you.

2:6 But there was certain of the scribes sitting there, and reasoning in
their hearts,

2:7 Why does this man thus speak blasphemies? who can forgive sins but
GOD[JESUS] only?

2:8 And immediately when JESUS perceived in HIS[JESUS] spirit that they so
reasoned within themselves, HE[JESUS] said unto them, Why reason you these
things in your hearts?

2:9 Whether is it easier to say to the sick of the palsy, your sins be
forgiven you; or to say, Arise, and take up your bed, and walk?

2:10 But that you may know that the SON[JESUS] OF MAN[JESUS] has power on earth to
forgive sins, (HE[JESUS] says to the sick of the palsy,)

2:11 I say unto you, Arise, and take up your bed, and go your way into
yours house.

2:12 And immediately HE[JESUS] arose, took up the bed, and went forth before
them all; insomuch that they were all amazed, and glorified GOD[JESUS], saying,
We never saw it on this fashion.

2:13 And HE[JESUS] went forth again by the sea side; and all the multitude
resorted unto HIM[JESUS], and HE[JESUS] taught them.

2:14 And as HE[JESUS] passed by, HE[JESUS] saw Levi the SON[JESUS] of Alphaeus sitting at the
receipt of custom, and said unto HIM[JESUS], Follow me. And HE[JESUS] arose and
followed HIM[JESUS].

2:15 And it came to pass, that, as JESUS sat at meat in HIS[JESUS] house, many
publicans and sinners sat also together with JESUS and HIS[JESUS] disciples:
for there were many, and they followed HIM[JESUS].

2:16 And when the scribes and Pharisees saw HIM[JESUS] eat with publicans and
sinners, they said unto HIS[JESUS] disciples, How is it that HE[JESUS] eateth and
drinketh with publicans and sinners?

2:17 When JESUS heard it, HE[JESUS] says unto them, They that are whole have
no need of the physician, but they that are sick: I came not to call the
righteous, but sinners to repentance.

2:18 And the disciples of John and of the Pharisees used to fast: and
they come and say unto HIM[JESUS], Why do the disciples of John and of the
Pharisees fast, but your disciples fast not?

2:19 And JESUS said unto them, Can the children of the bridechamber
fast, while the bridegroom is with them? as long as they have the
bridegroom with them, they cannot fast.

2:20 But the days will come, when the bridegroom shall be taken away
from them, and then shall they fast in those days.

2:21 No man also seweth a piece of new cloth on an old garment: else the
new piece that filled it up taketh away from the old, and the rent is
made worse.

2:22 And no man putteth new wine into old bottles: else the new wine
does burst the bottles, and the wine is spilled, and the bottles will be
marred: but new wine must be put into new bottles.

2:23 And it came to pass, that HE[JESUS] went through the corn fields on the
sabbath day; and HIS[JESUS] disciples began, as they went, to pluck the ears of
corn.

2:24 And the Pharisees said unto HIM[JESUS], Behold, why do they on the sabbath
day that which is not lawful?

2:25 And HE[JESUS] said unto them, Have you never read what David did, when HE[JESUS]
had need, and was an hungred, HE[JESUS], and they that were with HIM[JESUS]?

2:26 How HE[JESUS] went into the house of GOD[JESUS] in the days of Abiathar the high
priest, and did eat the shewbread, which is not lawful to eat but for
the priests, and gave also to them which were with HIM[JESUS]?

2:27 And HE[JESUS] said unto them, The sabbath was made for man, and not man
for the sabbath:

2:28 Therefore the SON[JESUS] OF MAN[JESUS] is LORD[JESUS] also of the sabbath.


3:1 And HE[JESUS] entered again into the synagogue; and there was a man there
which had a withered hand.

3:2 And they watched HIM[JESUS], whether HE[JESUS] would heal HIM[JESUS] on the sabbath day;
that they might accuse HIM[JESUS].

3:3 And HE[JESUS] says unto the man which had the withered hand, Stand forth.

3:4 And HE[JESUS] says unto them, Is it lawful to do good on the sabbath days,
or to do evil? to save life, or to kill? But they held their peace.

3:5 And when HE[JESUS] had looked round about on them with anger, being grieved
for the hardness of their hearts, HE[JESUS] says unto the man, Stretch forth
yours hand. And HE[JESUS] stretched it out: and HIS[JESUS] hand was restored whole as
the other.

3:6 And the Pharisees went forth, and straightway took counsel with the
Herodians against HIM[JESUS], how they might destroy HIM[JESUS].

3:7 But JESUS withdrew himself with HIS[JESUS] disciples to the sea: and a
great multitude from Galilee followed HIM[JESUS], and from Judaea,

3:8 And from Jerusalem, and from Idumaea, and from beyond Jordan; and
they about Tyre and Sidon, a great multitude, when they had heard what
great things HE[JESUS] did, came unto HIM[JESUS].

3:9 And HE[JESUS] spake to HIS[JESUS] disciples, that a small ship should wait on HIM[JESUS]
because of the multitude, lest they should throng HIM[JESUS].

3:10 For HE[JESUS] had healed many; insomuch that they pressed upon HIM[JESUS] for to
touch HIM[JESUS], as many as had plagues.

3:11 And unclean spirits, when they saw HIM[JESUS], fell down before HIM[JESUS], and
cried, saying, you art the SON[JESUS] OF GOD[JESUS][JESUS].

3:12 And HE[JESUS] straitly charged them that they should not make HIM[JESUS] known.

3:13 And HE[JESUS] goes up into a mountain, and calleth unto HIM[JESUS] whom HE[JESUS]
would: and they came unto HIM[JESUS].

3:14 And HE[JESUS] ordained twelve, that they should be with HIM[JESUS], and that HE[JESUS]
might send them forth to preach,

3:15 And to have power to heal sicknesses, and to cast out devils:

3:16 And Simon HE[JESUS] surnamed Peter;

3:17 And James the SON[JESUS] of Zebedee, and John the brother of James; and HE[JESUS]
surnamed them Boanerges, which is, The sons of thunder:

3:18 And Andrew, and Philip, and Bartholomew, and Matthew, and Thomas,
and James the SON[JESUS] of Alphaeus, and Thaddaeus, and Simon the Canaanite,

3:19 And Judas Iscariot, which also betrayed HIM[JESUS]: and they went into an
house.

3:20 And the multitude comes together again, so that they could not so
much as eat bread.

3:21 And when HIS[JESUS] friends heard of it, they went out to lay hold on HIM[JESUS]:
for they said, HE[JESUS] is beside himself.

3:22 And the scribes which came down from Jerusalem said, HE[JESUS] has
Beelzebub, and by the prince of the devils casteth HE[JESUS] out devils.

3:23 And HE[JESUS] called them unto HIM[JESUS], and said unto them in parables, How
can Satan cast out Satan?

3:24 And if a kingdom be divided against itself, that kingdom cannot
stand.

3:25 And if a house be divided against itself, that house cannot stand.

3:26 And if Satan rise up against himself, and be divided, HE[JESUS] cannot
stand, but has an end.

3:27 No man can enter into a strong man's house, and spoil HIS[JESUS] goods,
except HE[JESUS] will first bind the strong man; and then HE[JESUS] will spoil HIS[JESUS]
house.

3:28 truly I say unto you, All sins shall be forgiven unto the sons of
men, and blasphemies wherewith soever they shall blaspheme:

3:29 But HE[JESUS] that shall blaspheme against the Holy Ghost has never
forgiveness, but is in danger of eternal damnation.

3:30 Because they said, HE[JESUS] has an unclean spirit.

3:31 There came then HIS[JESUS] brethren and HIS[JESUS] mother, and, standing without,
sent unto HIM[JESUS], calling HIM[JESUS].

3:32 And the multitude sat about HIM[JESUS], and they said unto HIM[JESUS], Behold,
your mother and your brethren without seek for you.

3:33 And HE[JESUS] answered them, saying, Who is my mother, or my brethren?

3:34 And HE[JESUS] looked round about on them which sat about HIM[JESUS], and said,
Behold my mother and my brethren!

3:35 For whoever shall do the will of GOD[JESUS], the same is my brother, and
my sister, and mother.


4:1 And HE[JESUS] began again to teach by the sea side: and there was gathered
unto HIM[JESUS] a great multitude, so that HE[JESUS] entered into a ship, and sat in
the sea; and the whole multitude was by the sea on the land.

4:2 And HE[JESUS] taught them many things by parables, and said unto them in
HIS[JESUS] doctrine,

4:3 Hearken; Behold, there went out a sower to sow:

4:4 And it came to pass, as HE[JESUS] sowed, some fell by the way side, and the
fowls of the air came and devoured it up.

4:5 And some fell on stony ground, where it had not much earth; and
immediately it sprang up, because it had no depth of earth:

4:6 But when the sun was up, it was scorched; and because it had no
ROOT[JESUS], it withered away.

4:7 And some fell among thorns, and the thorns grew up, and choked it,
and it yielded no fruit.

4:8 And other fell on good ground, and did yield fruit that sprang up
and increased; and brought forth, some thirty, and some sixty, and some
an hundred.

4:9 And HE[JESUS] said unto them, HE[JESUS] that has ears to hear, let HIM[JESUS] hear.

4:10 And when HE[JESUS] was alone, they that were about HIM[JESUS] with the twelve
asked of HIM[JESUS] the parable.

4:11 And HE[JESUS] said unto them, Unto you it is given to know the mystery of
the kingdom of GOD[JESUS]: but unto them that are without, all these things are
done in parables:

4:12 That seeing they may see, and not perceive; and hearing they may
hear, and not understand; lest at any time they should be converted, and
their sins should be forgiven them.

4:13 And HE[JESUS] said unto them, Know you not this parable? and how then will
you know all parables?

4:14 The sower soweth the WORD[JESUS].

4:15 And these are they by the way side, where the WORD[JESUS] is sown; but
when they have heard, Satan comes immediately, and taketh away the WORD[JESUS]
that was sown in their hearts.

4:16 And these are they likewise which are sown on stony ground; who,
when they have heard the WORD[JESUS], immediately receive it with gladness;

4:17 And have no ROOT[JESUS] in themselves, and so endure but for a time:
afterward, when affliction or persecution ariseth for the WORD[JESUS]'s sake,
immediately they are offended.

4:18 And these are they which are sown among thorns; such as hear the
WORD[JESUS],

4:19 And the cares of this world, and the deceitfulness of riches, and
the lusts of other things entering in, choke the WORD[JESUS], and it becometh
unfruitful.

4:20 And these are they which are sown on good ground; such as hear the
WORD[JESUS], and receive it, and bring forth fruit, some thirtyfold, some
sixty, and some an hundred.

4:21 And HE[JESUS] said unto them, Is a candle brought to be put under a
bushel, or under a bed? and not to be set on a candlestick?

4:22 For there is nothing hid, which shall not be manifested; neither
was any thing kept secret, but that it should come abroad.

4:23 If any man have ears to hear, let HIM[JESUS] hear.

4:24 And HE[JESUS] said unto them, Take heed what you hear: with what measure you
mete, it shall be measured to you: and unto you that hear shall more be
given.

4:25 For HE[JESUS] that has, to HIM[JESUS] shall be given: and HE[JESUS] that has not, from
HIM[JESUS] shall be taken even that which HE[JESUS] has.

4:26 And HE[JESUS] said, So is the kingdom of GOD[JESUS], as if a man should cast SEED[JESUS]
into the ground;

4:27 And should sleep, and rise night and day, and the SEED[JESUS] should
spring and grow up, HE[JESUS] knoweth not how.

4:28 For the earth bringeth forth fruit of herself; first the blade,
then the ear, after that the full corn in the ear.

4:29 But when the fruit is brought forth, immediately HE[JESUS] putteth in the
sickle, because the harvest is come.

4:30 And HE[JESUS] said, Whereunto shall we liken the kingdom of GOD[JESUS]? or with
what comparison shall we compare it?

4:31 It is like a grain of mustard SEED[JESUS], which, when it is sown in the
earth, is less than all the seeds that be in the earth:

4:32 But when it is sown, it groweth up, and becometh greater than all
herbs, and shooteth out great branches; so that the fowls of the air may
lodge under the shadow of it.

4:33 And with many such parables spake HE[JESUS] the WORD[JESUS] unto them, as they
were able to hear it.

4:34 But without a parable spake HE[JESUS] not unto them: and when they were
alone, HE[JESUS] expounded all things to HIS[JESUS] disciples.

4:35 And the same day, when the even was come, HE[JESUS] says unto them, Let
us pass over unto the other side.

4:36 And when they had sent away the multitude, they took HIM[JESUS] even as HE[JESUS]
was in the ship. And there were also with HIM[JESUS] other little ships.

4:37 And there arose a great storm of wind, and the waves beat into the
ship, so that it was now full.

4:38 And HE[JESUS] was in the hinder part of the ship, asleep on a pillow: and
they awake HIM[JESUS], and say unto HIM[JESUS], Master, carest you not that we
perish?

4:39 And HE[JESUS] arose, and rebuked the wind, and said unto the sea, Peace,
be still. And the wind ceased, and there was a great calm.

4:40 And HE[JESUS] said unto them, Why are you so fearful? how is it that you
have no faith?

4:41 And they feared exceedingly, and said one to another, What manner
of man is this, that even the wind and the sea obey HIM[JESUS]?


5:1 And they came over unto the other side of the sea, into the country
of the Gadarenes.

5:2 And when HE[JESUS] was come out of the ship, immediately there met HIM[JESUS] out
of the tombs a man with an unclean spirit,

5:3 Who had HIS[JESUS] dwelling among the tombs; and no man could bind HIM[JESUS], no,
not with chains:

5:4 Because that HE[JESUS] had been often bound with fetters and chains, and
the chains had been plucked asunder by HIM[JESUS], and the fetters broken in
pieces: neither could any man tame HIM[JESUS].

5:5 And always, night and day, HE[JESUS] was in the mountains, and in the
tombs, crying, and cutting himself with stones.

5:6 But when HE[JESUS] saw JESUS afar off, HE[JESUS] ran and worshipped HIM[JESUS],

5:7 And cried with a loud voice, and said, What have I to do with you,
JESUS, you SON[JESUS] of the most high GOD[JESUS]? I adjure you by GOD[JESUS], that you
torment me not.

5:8 For HE[JESUS] said unto HIM[JESUS], Come out of the man, you unclean spirit.

5:9 And HE[JESUS] asked HIM[JESUS], What is your name? And HE[JESUS] answered, saying, My name
is Legion: for we are many.

5:10 And HE[JESUS] besought HIM[JESUS] much that HE[JESUS] would not send them away out of
the country.

5:11 Now there was there nigh unto the mountains a great herd of swine
feeding.

5:12 And all the devils besought HIM[JESUS], saying, Send us into the swine,
that we may enter into them.

5:13 And forthwith JESUS gave them leave. And the unclean spirits went
out, and entered into the swine: and the herd ran violently down a steep
place into the sea, (they were about two thousand;) and were choked in
the sea.

5:14 And they that fed the swine fled, and told it in the city, and in
the country. And they went out to see what it was that was done.

5:15 And they come to JESUS, and see HIM[JESUS] that was possessed with the
devil, and had the legion, sitting, and clothed, and in HIS[JESUS] right mind:
and they were afraid.

5:16 And they that saw it told them how it befell to HIM[JESUS] that was
possessed with the devil, and also concerning the swine.

5:17 And they began to pray HIM[JESUS] to depart out of their coasts.

5:18 And when HE[JESUS] was come into the ship, HE[JESUS] that had been possessed with
the devil prayed HIM[JESUS] that HE[JESUS] might be with HIM[JESUS].

5:19 Howbeit JESUS suffered HIM[JESUS] not, but says unto HIM[JESUS], Go home to your
friends, and tell them how great things the LORD[JESUS] has done for you, and
has had compassion on you.

5:20 And HE[JESUS] departed, and began to publish in Decapolis how great things
JESUS had done for HIM[JESUS]: and all men did marvel.

5:21 And when JESUS was passed over again by ship unto the other side,
much people gathered unto HIM[JESUS]: and HE[JESUS] was nigh unto the sea.

5:22 And, behold, there comes one of the rulers of the synagogue,
Jairus by name; and when HE[JESUS] saw HIM[JESUS], HE[JESUS] fell at HIS[JESUS] feet,

5:23 And besought HIM[JESUS] greatly, saying, My little daughter lieth at the
point of death: I pray you, come and lay your hands on her, that she may
be healed; and she shall live.

5:24 And JESUS went with HIM[JESUS]; and much people followed HIM[JESUS], and thronged
HIM[JESUS].

5:25 And a certain woman, which had an issue of blood twelve years,

5:26 And had suffered many things of many physicians, and had spent all
that she had, and was nothing bettered, but rather grew worse,

5:27 When she had heard of JESUS, came in the press behind, and touched
HIS[JESUS] garment.

5:28 For she said, If I may touch but HIS[JESUS] clothes, I shall be whole.

5:29 And straightway the fountain of her blood was dried up; and she
felt in her body that she was healed of that plague.

5:30 And JESUS, immediately knowing in himself that virtue had gone out
of HIM[JESUS], turned HIM[JESUS] about in the press, and said, Who touched my clothes?

5:31 And HIS[JESUS] disciples said unto HIM[JESUS], you seest the multitude thronging
you, and sayest you, Who touched me?

5:32 And HE[JESUS] looked round about to see her that had done this thing.

5:33 But the woman fearing and trembling, knowing what was done in her,
came and fell down before HIM[JESUS], and told HIM[JESUS] all the truth.

5:34 And HE[JESUS] said unto her, Daughter, your faith has made you whole; go
in peace, and be whole of your plague.

5:35 While HE[JESUS] yet spake, there came from the ruler of the synagogue's
house certain which said, your daughter is dead: why troublest you the
Master any further?

5:36 As soon as JESUS heard the WORD[JESUS] that was spoken, HE[JESUS] says unto the
ruler of the synagogue, Be not afraid, only believe.

5:37 And HE[JESUS] suffered no man to follow HIM[JESUS], save Peter, and James, and
John the brother of James.

5:38 And HE[JESUS] comes to the house of the ruler of the synagogue, and seeth
the tumult, and them that wept and wailed greatly.

5:39 And when HE[JESUS] was come in, HE[JESUS] says unto them, Why make you this ado,
and weep? the damsel is not dead, but sleepeth.

5:40 And they laughed HIM[JESUS] to scorn. But when HE[JESUS] had put them all out, HE[JESUS]
taketh the father and the mother of the damsel, and them that were with
HIM[JESUS], and entereth in where the damsel was lying.

5:41 And HE[JESUS] took the damsel by the hand, and said unto her, Talitha
cumi; which is, being interpreted, Damsel, I say unto you, arise.

5:42 And straightway the damsel arose, and walked; for she was of the
age of twelve years. And they were astonished with a great astonishment.

5:43 And HE[JESUS] charged them straitly that no man should know it; and
commanded that something should be given her to eat.


6:1 And HE[JESUS] went out from thence, and came into HIS[JESUS] own country; and HIS[JESUS]
disciples follow HIM[JESUS].

6:2 And when the sabbath day was come, HE[JESUS] began to teach in the
synagogue: and many hearing HIM[JESUS] were astonished, saying, From whence
has this man these things? and what wisdom is this which is given unto
HIM[JESUS], that even such mighty works are wrought by HIS[JESUS] hands?

6:3 Is not this the carpenter, the SON[JESUS] of Mary, the brother of James,
and Joses, and of Juda, and Simon? and are not HIS[JESUS] sisters here with us?
And they were offended at HIM[JESUS].

6:4 But JESUS, said unto them, A PROPHET[JESUS] is not without honour, but in
HIS[JESUS] own country, and among HIS[JESUS] own kin, and in HIS[JESUS] own house.

6:5 And HE[JESUS] could there do no mighty work, save that HE[JESUS] laid HIS[JESUS] hands
upon a few sick folk, and healed them.

6:6 And HE[JESUS] marvelled because of their unbelief. And HE[JESUS] went round about
the villages, teaching.

6:7 And HE[JESUS] called unto HIM[JESUS] the twelve, and began to send them forth by
two and two; and gave them power over unclean spirits;

6:8 And commanded them that they should take nothing for their journey,
save a staff only; no scrip, no bread, no money in their purse:

6:9 But be shod with sandals; and not put on two coats.

6:10 And HE[JESUS] said unto them, In what place soever you enter into an house,
there abide till you depart from that place.

6:11 And whoever shall not receive you, nor hear you, when you depart
thence, shake off the dust under your feet for a testimony against them.
truly I say unto you, It shall be more tolerable for Sodom and Gomorrha
in the day of judgment, than for that city.

6:12 And they went out, and preached that men should repent.

6:13 And they cast out many devils, and anointed with oil many that were
sick, and healed them.

6:14 And KING[JESUS] Herod heard of HIM[JESUS]; (for HIS[JESUS] name was spread abroad:) and
HE[JESUS] said, That John the Baptist was risen from the dead, and therefore
mighty works do shew forth themselves in HIM[JESUS].

6:15 Others said, That it is Elias. And others said, That it is a
PROPHET[JESUS], or as one of the prophets.

6:16 But when Herod heard thereof, HE[JESUS] said, It is John, whom I beheaded:
HE[JESUS] is risen from the dead.

6:17 For Herod himself had sent forth and laid hold upon John, and bound
HIM[JESUS] in prison for Herodias' sake, HIS[JESUS] brother Philip's wife: for HE[JESUS] had
married her.

6:18 For John had said unto Herod, It is not lawful for you to have your
brother's wife.

6:19 Therefore Herodias had a quarrel against HIM[JESUS], and would have killed
HIM[JESUS]; but she could not:

6:20 For Herod feared John, knowing that HE[JESUS] was a just man and an holy,
and observed HIM[JESUS]; and when HE[JESUS] heard HIM[JESUS], HE[JESUS] did many things, and heard
HIM[JESUS] gladly.

6:21 And when a convenient day was come, that Herod on HIS[JESUS] birthday made
a supper to HIS[JESUS] lords, high captains, and chief estates of Galilee;

6:22 And when the daughter of the said Herodias came in, and danced, and
pleased Herod and them that sat with HIM[JESUS], the KING[JESUS] said unto the damsel,
Ask of me whatsoever you wilt, and I will give it you.

6:23 And HE[JESUS] sware unto her, Whatsoever you shalt ask of me, I will give
it you, unto the half of my kingdom.

6:24 And she went forth, and said unto her mother, What shall I ask? And
she said, The head of John the Baptist.

6:25 And she came in straightway with haste unto the KING[JESUS], and asked,
saying, I will that you give me by and by in a charger the head of John
the Baptist.

6:26 And the KING[JESUS] was exceeding sorry; yet for HIS[JESUS] oath's sake, and for
their sakes which sat with HIM[JESUS], HE[JESUS] would not reject her.

6:27 And immediately the KING[JESUS] sent an executioner, and commanded HIS[JESUS]
head to be brought: and HE[JESUS] went and beheaded HIM[JESUS] in the prison,

6:28 And brought HIS[JESUS] head in a charger, and gave it to the damsel: and
the damsel gave it to her mother.

6:29 And when HIS[JESUS] disciples heard of it, they came and took up HIS[JESUS]
corpse, and laid it in a tomb.

6:30 And the apostles gathered themselves together unto JESUS, and told
HIM[JESUS] all things, both what they had done, and what they had taught.

6:31 And HE[JESUS] said unto them, Come you yourselves apart into a desert
place, and rest a while: for there were many coming and going, and they
had no leisure so much as to eat.

6:32 And they departed into a desert place by ship privately.

6:33 And the people saw them departing, and many knew HIM[JESUS], and ran afoot
thither out of all cities, and outwent them, and came together unto HIM[JESUS].

6:34 And JESUS, when HE[JESUS] came out, saw much people, and was moved with
compassion toward them, because they were as sheep not having a
SHEPHERD[JESUS]: and HE[JESUS] began to teach them many things.

6:35 And when the day was now far spent, HIS[JESUS] disciples came unto HIM[JESUS],
and said, This is a desert place, and now the time is far passed:

6:36 Send them away, that they may go into the country round about, and
into the villages, and buy themselves bread: for they have nothing to
eat.

6:37 HE[JESUS] answered and said unto them, Give you them to eat. And they say
unto HIM[JESUS], Shall we go and buy two hundred pennyworth of bread, and give
them to eat?

6:38 HE[JESUS] says unto them, How many loaves have you? go and see. And when
they knew, they say, Five, and two fishes.

6:39 And HE[JESUS] commanded them to make all sit down by companies upon the
green grass.

6:40 And they sat down in ranks, by hundreds, and by fifties.

6:41 And when HE[JESUS] had taken the five loaves and the two fishes, HE[JESUS] looked
up to heaven, and blessed, and brake the loaves, and gave them to HIS[JESUS]
disciples to set before them; and the two fishes divided HE[JESUS] among them
all.

6:42 And they did all eat, and were filled.

6:43 And they took up twelve baskets full of the fragments, and of the
fishes.

6:44 And they that did eat of the loaves were about five thousand men.

6:45 And straightway HE[JESUS] constrained HIS[JESUS] disciples to get into the ship,
and to go to the other side before unto Bethsaida, while HE[JESUS] sent away
the people.

6:46 And when HE[JESUS] had sent them away, HE[JESUS] departed into a mountain to
pray.

6:47 And when even was come, the ship was in the midst of the sea, and
HE[JESUS] alone on the land.

6:48 And HE[JESUS] saw them toiling in rowing; for the wind was contrary unto
them: and about the fourth watch of the night HE[JESUS] comes unto them,
walking upon the sea, and would have passed by them.

6:49 But when they saw HIM[JESUS] walking upon the sea, they supposed it had
been a spirit, and cried out:

6:50 For they all saw HIM[JESUS], and were troubled. And immediately HE[JESUS] talked
with them, and says unto them, Be of good cheer: it is I; be not
afraid.

6:51 And HE[JESUS] went up unto them into the ship; and the wind ceased: and
they were sore amazed in themselves beyond measure, and wondered.

6:52 For they considered not the miracle of the loaves: for their heart
was hardened.

6:53 And when they had passed over, they came into the land of
Gennesaret, and drew to the shore.

6:54 And when they were come out of the ship, straightway they knew HIM[JESUS],

6:55 And ran through that whole region round about, and began to carry
about in beds those that were sick, where they heard HE[JESUS] was.

6:56 And whithersoever HE[JESUS] entered, into villages, or cities, or country,
they laid the sick in the streets, and besought HIM[JESUS] that they might
touch if it were but the border of HIS[JESUS] garment: and as many as touched
HIM[JESUS] were made whole.


7:1 Then came together unto HIM[JESUS] the Pharisees, and certain of the
scribes, which came from Jerusalem.

7:2 And when they saw some of HIS[JESUS] disciples eat bread with defiled, that
is to say, with unwashen, hands, they found fault.

7:3 For the Pharisees, and all the Jews, except they wash their hands
oft, eat not, holding the tradition of the elders.

7:4 And when they come from the market, except they wash, they eat not.
And many other things there be, which they have received to hold, as the
washing of cups, and pots, brasen vessels, and of tables.

7:5 Then the Pharisees and scribes asked HIM[JESUS], Why walk not your disciples
according to the tradition of the elders, but eat bread with unwashen
hands?

7:6 HE[JESUS] answered and said unto them, Well has Esaias prophesied of you
hypocrites, as it is written, This people honoureth me with their lips,
but their heart is far from me.

7:7 Howbeit in vain do they worship me, teaching for doctrines the
commandments of men.

7:8 For laying aside the commandment of GOD[JESUS], you hold the tradition of
men, as the washing of pots and cups: and many other such like things you
do.

7:9 And HE[JESUS] said unto them, Full well you reject the commandment of GOD[JESUS],
that you may keep your own tradition.

7:10 For Moses said, Honour your father and your mother; and, whoever
curseth father or mother, let HIM[JESUS] die the death:

7:11 But you say, If a man shall say to HIS[JESUS] father or mother, It is
Corban, that is to say, a gift, by whatsoever you mightest be profited
by me; HE[JESUS] shall be free.

7:12 And you let HIM[JESUS] no more to do ought for HIS[JESUS] father or HIS[JESUS] mother;

7:13 Making the WORD[JESUS] of GOD[JESUS] of none effect through your tradition, which
you have delivered: and many such like things do you.

7:14 And when HE[JESUS] had called all the people unto HIM[JESUS], HE[JESUS] said unto them,
Hearken unto me every one of you, and understand:

7:15 There is nothing from without a man, that entering into HIM[JESUS] can
defile HIM[JESUS]: but the things which come out of HIM[JESUS], those are they that
defile the man.

7:16 If any man have ears to hear, let HIM[JESUS] hear.

7:17 And when HE[JESUS] was entered into the house from the people, HIS[JESUS]
disciples asked HIM[JESUS] concerning the parable.

7:18 And HE[JESUS] says unto them, Are you so without understanding also? Do you
not perceive, that whatsoever thing from without entereth into the man,
it cannot defile HIM[JESUS];

7:19 Because it entereth not into HIS[JESUS] heart, but into the belly, and
goes out into the draught, purging all meats?

7:20 And HE[JESUS] said, That which comes out of the man, that defileth the
man.

7:21 For from within, out of the heart of men, proceed evil thoughts,
adulteries, fornications, murders,

7:22 Thefts, covetousness, wickedness, deceit, lasciviousness, an evil
eye, blasphemy, pride, foolishness:

7:23 All these evil things come from within, and defile the man.

7:24 And from thence HE[JESUS] arose, and went into the borders of Tyre and
Sidon, and entered into an house, and would have no man know it: but HE[JESUS]
could not be hid.

7:25 For a certain woman, whose young daughter had an unclean spirit,
heard of HIM[JESUS], and came and fell at HIS[JESUS] feet:

7:26 The woman was a Greek, a Syrophenician by nation; and she besought
HIM[JESUS] that HE[JESUS] would cast forth the devil out of her daughter.

7:27 But JESUS said unto her, Let the children first be filled: for it
is not meet to take the children's bread, and to cast it unto the dogs.

7:28 And she answered and said unto HIM[JESUS], Yes, LORD[JESUS]: yet the dogs under
the table eat of the children's crumbs.

7:29 And HE[JESUS] said unto her, For this saying go your way; the devil is gone
out of your daughter.

7:30 And when she was come to her house, she found the devil gone out,
and her daughter laid upon the bed.

7:31 And again, departing from the coasts of Tyre and Sidon, HE[JESUS] came
unto the sea of Galilee, through the midst of the coasts of Decapolis.

7:32 And they bring unto HIM[JESUS] one that was deaf, and had an impediment in
HIS[JESUS] speech; and they beseech HIM[JESUS] to put HIS[JESUS] hand upon HIM[JESUS].

7:33 And HE[JESUS] took HIM[JESUS] aside from the multitude, and put HIS[JESUS] fingers into
HIS[JESUS] ears, and HE[JESUS] spit, and touched HIS[JESUS] tongue;

7:34 And looking up to heaven, HE[JESUS] sighed, and says unto HIM[JESUS], Ephphatha,
that is, Be opened.

7:35 And straightway HIS[JESUS] ears were opened, and the string of HIS[JESUS] tongue
was loosed, and HE[JESUS] spake plain.

7:36 And HE[JESUS] charged them that they should tell no man: but the more HE[JESUS]
charged them, so much the more a great deal they published it;

7:37 And were beyond measure astonished, saying, HE[JESUS] has done all things
well: HE[JESUS] makes both the deaf to hear, and the dumb to speak.


8:1 In those days the multitude being very great, and having nothing to
eat, JESUS called HIS[JESUS] disciples unto HIM[JESUS], and says unto them,

8:2 I have compassion on the multitude, because they have now been with
me three days, and have nothing to eat:

8:3 And if I send them away fasting to their own houses, they will faint
by the way: for divers of them came from far.

8:4 And HIS[JESUS] disciples answered HIM[JESUS], From whence can a man satisfy these
men with bread here in the wilderness?

8:5 And HE[JESUS] asked them, How many loaves have you? And they said, Seven.

8:6 And HE[JESUS] commanded the people to sit down on the ground: and HE[JESUS] took
the seven loaves, and gave thanks, and brake, and gave to HIS[JESUS] disciples
to set before them; and they did set them before the people.

8:7 And they had a few small fishes: and HE[JESUS] blessed, and commanded to
set them also before them.

8:8 So they did eat, and were filled: and they took up of the broken
meat that was left seven baskets.

8:9 And they that had eaten were about four thousand: and HE[JESUS] sent them
away.

8:10 And straightway HE[JESUS] entered into a ship with HIS[JESUS] disciples, and came
into the parts of Dalmanutha.

8:11 And the Pharisees came forth, and began to question with HIM[JESUS],
seeking of HIM[JESUS] a sign from heaven, tempting HIM[JESUS].

8:12 And HE[JESUS] sighed deeply in HIS[JESUS] spirit, and says, Why does this
generation seek after a sign? truly I say unto you, There shall no sign
be given unto this generation.

8:13 And HE[JESUS] left them, and entering into the ship again departed to the
other side.

8:14 Now the disciples had forgotten to take bread, neither had they in
the ship with them more than one loaf.

8:15 And HE[JESUS] charged them, saying, Take heed, beware of the leaven of the
Pharisees, and of the leaven of Herod.

8:16 And they reasoned among themselves, saying, It is because we have
no bread.

8:17 And when JESUS knew it, HE[JESUS] says unto them, Why reason you, because
you have no bread? perceive you not yet, neither understand? have you your
heart yet hardened?

8:18 Having eyes, see you not? and having ears, hear you not? and do you
not remember?

8:19 When I brake the five loaves among five thousand, how many baskets
full of fragments took you up? They say unto HIM[JESUS], Twelve.

8:20 And when the seven among four thousand, how many baskets full of
fragments took you up? And they said, Seven.

8:21 And HE[JESUS] said unto them, How is it that you do not understand?

8:22 And HE[JESUS] comes to Bethsaida; and they bring a blind man unto HIM[JESUS],
and besought HIM[JESUS] to touch HIM[JESUS].

8:23 And HE[JESUS] took the blind man by the hand, and led HIM[JESUS] out of the town;
and when HE[JESUS] had spit on HIS[JESUS] eyes, and put HIS[JESUS] hands upon HIM[JESUS], HE[JESUS] asked
HIM[JESUS] if HE[JESUS] saw ought.

8:24 And HE[JESUS] looked up, and said, I see men as trees, walking.

8:25 After that HE[JESUS] put HIS[JESUS] hands again upon HIS[JESUS] eyes, and made HIM[JESUS] look
up: and HE[JESUS] was restored, and saw every man clearly.

8:26 And HE[JESUS] sent HIM[JESUS] away to HIS[JESUS] house, saying, Neither go into the
town, nor tell it to any in the town.

8:27 And JESUS went out, and HIS[JESUS] disciples, into the towns of Caesarea
Philippi: and by the way HE[JESUS] asked HIS[JESUS] disciples, saying unto them, Whom
do men say that I am?

8:28 And they answered, John the Baptist; but some say, Elias; and
others, One of the prophets.

8:29 And HE[JESUS] says unto them, But whom say you that I am? And Peter
answereth and says unto HIM[JESUS], you art the CHRIST[JESUS].

8:30 And HE[JESUS] charged them that they should tell no man of HIM[JESUS].

8:31 And HE[JESUS] began to teach them, that the SON[JESUS] OF MAN[JESUS] must let many
things, and be rejected of the elders, and of the chief priests, and
scribes, and be killed, and after three days rise again.

8:32 And HE[JESUS] spake that saying openly. And Peter took HIM[JESUS], and began to
rebuke HIM[JESUS].

8:33 But when HE[JESUS] had turned about and looked on HIS[JESUS] disciples, HE[JESUS]
rebuked Peter, saying, Get you behind me, Satan: for you savourest not
the things that be of GOD[JESUS], but the things that be of men.

8:34 And when HE[JESUS] had called the people unto HIM[JESUS] with HIS[JESUS] disciples also,
HE[JESUS] said unto them, whoever will come after me, let HIM[JESUS] deny himself,
and take up HIS[JESUS] cross, and follow me.

8:35 For whoever will save HIS[JESUS] life shall lose it; but whoever shall
lose HIS[JESUS] life for my sake and the gospel's, the same shall save it.

8:36 For what shall it profit a man, if HE[JESUS] shall gain the whole world,
and lose HIS[JESUS] own soul?

8:37 Or what shall a man give in exchange for HIS[JESUS] soul?

8:38 whoever therefore shall be ashamed of me and of my words in this
adulterous and sinful generation; of HIM[JESUS] also shall the SON[JESUS] OF MAN[JESUS] be
ashamed, when HE[JESUS] comes in the glory of HIS[JESUS] Father with the holy angels.


9:1 And HE[JESUS] said unto them, truly I say unto you, That there be some of
them that stand here, which shall not taste of death, till they have
seen the kingdom of GOD[JESUS] come with power.

9:2 And after six days JESUS taketh with HIM[JESUS] Peter, and James, and John,
and leads them up into an high mountain apart by themselves: and HE[JESUS]
was transfigured before them.

9:3 And HIS[JESUS] raiment became shining, exceeding white as snow; so as no
fuller on earth can white them.

9:4 And there appeared unto them Elias with Moses: and they were talking
with JESUS.

9:5 And Peter answered and said to JESUS, Master, it is good for us to
be here: and let us make three tabernacles; one for you, and one for
Moses, and one for Elias.

9:6 For HE[JESUS] wist not what to say; for they were sore afraid.

9:7 And there was a cloud that overshadowed them: and a voice came out
of the cloud, saying, This is my beloved SON[JESUS]: hear HIM[JESUS].

9:8 And suddenly, when they had looked round about, they saw no man any
more, save JESUS only with themselves.

9:9 And as they came down from the mountain, HE[JESUS] charged them that they
should tell no man what things they had seen, till the SON[JESUS] OF MAN[JESUS] were
risen from the dead.

9:10 And they kept that saying with themselves, questioning one with
another what the rising from the dead should mean.

9:11 And they asked HIM[JESUS], saying, Why say the scribes that Elias must
first come?

9:12 And HE[JESUS] answered and told them, Elias truly comes first, and
restores all things; and how it is written of the SON[JESUS] OF MAN[JESUS], that HE[JESUS]
must let many things, and be set at nought.

9:13 But I say unto you, That Elias is indeed come, and they have done
unto HIM[JESUS] whatsoever they listed, as it is written of HIM[JESUS].

9:14 And when HE[JESUS] came to HIS[JESUS] disciples, HE[JESUS] saw a great multitude about
them, and the scribes questioning with them.

9:15 And straightway all the people, when they beheld HIM[JESUS], were greatly
amazed, and running to HIM[JESUS] saluted HIM[JESUS].

9:16 And HE[JESUS] asked the scribes, What question you with them?

9:17 And one of the multitude answered and said, Master, I have brought
unto you my SON[JESUS], which has a dumb spirit;

9:18 And wheresoever HE[JESUS] taketh HIM[JESUS], HE[JESUS] teareth HIM[JESUS]: and HE[JESUS] foameth, and
gnasheth with HIS[JESUS] teeth, and pineth away: and I spake to your disciples
that they should cast HIM[JESUS] out; and they could not.

9:19 HE[JESUS] answereth HIM[JESUS], and says, O faithless generation, how long shall
I be with you? how long shall I let you? bring HIM[JESUS] unto me.

9:20 And they brought HIM[JESUS] unto HIM[JESUS]: and when HE[JESUS] saw HIM[JESUS], straightway the
spirit tare HIM[JESUS]; and HE[JESUS] fell on the ground, and wallowed foaming.

9:21 And HE[JESUS] asked HIS[JESUS] father, How long is it ago since this came unto
HIM[JESUS]? And HE[JESUS] said, Of a child.

9:22 And ofttimes it has cast HIM[JESUS] into the fire, and into the waters,
to destroy HIM[JESUS]: but if you canst do any thing, have compassion on us,
and help us.

9:23 JESUS said unto HIM[JESUS], If you canst believe, all things are possible
to HIM[JESUS] that believes.

9:24 And straightway the father of the child cried out, and said with
tears, LORD[JESUS], I believe; help you mine unbelief.

9:25 When JESUS saw that the people came running together, HE[JESUS] rebuked
the foul spirit, saying unto HIM[JESUS], you dumb and deaf spirit, I charge
you, come out of HIM[JESUS], and enter no more into HIM[JESUS].

9:26 And the spirit cried, and rent HIM[JESUS] sore, and came out of HIM[JESUS]: and
HE[JESUS] was as one dead; insomuch that many said, HE[JESUS] is dead.

9:27 But JESUS took HIM[JESUS] by the hand, and lifted HIM[JESUS] up; and HE[JESUS] arose.

9:28 And when HE[JESUS] was come into the house, HIS[JESUS] disciples asked HIM[JESUS]
privately, Why could not we cast HIM[JESUS] out?

9:29 And HE[JESUS] said unto them, This kind can come forth by nothing, but by
prayer and fasting.

9:30 And they departed thence, and passed through Galilee; and HE[JESUS] would
not that any man should know it.

9:31 For HE[JESUS] taught HIS[JESUS] disciples, and said unto them, The SON[JESUS] OF MAN[JESUS] is
delivered into the hands of men, and they shall kill HIM[JESUS]; and after that
HE[JESUS] is killed, HE[JESUS] shall rise the third day.

9:32 But they understood not that saying, and were afraid to ask HIM[JESUS].

9:33 And HE[JESUS] came to Capernaum: and being in the house HE[JESUS] asked them,
What was it that you disputed among yourselves by the way?

9:34 But they held their peace: for by the way they had disputed among
themselves, who should be the greatest.

9:35 And HE[JESUS] sat down, and called the twelve, and says unto them, If any
man desire to be first, the same shall be last of all, and SERVANT[JESUS] of
all.

9:36 And HE[JESUS] took a child, and set HIM[JESUS] in the midst of them: and when HE[JESUS]
had taken HIM[JESUS] in HIS[JESUS] arms, HE[JESUS] said unto them,

9:37 whoever shall receive one of such children in my name, receiveth
me: and whoever shall receive me, receiveth not me, but HIM[JESUS] that sent
me.

9:38 And John answered HIM[JESUS], saying, Master, we saw one casting out
devils in your name, and HE[JESUS] followeth not us: and we forbad HIM[JESUS], because
HE[JESUS] followeth not us.

9:39 But JESUS said, Forbid HIM[JESUS] not: for there is no man which shall do
a miracle in my name, that can lightly speak evil of me.

9:40 For HE[JESUS] that is not against us is on our part.

9:41 For whoever shall give you a cup of water to drink in my name,
because you belong to CHRIST[JESUS], truly I say unto you, HE[JESUS] shall not lose
HIS[JESUS] reward.

9:42 And whoever shall offend one of these little ones that believe in
me, it is better for HIM[JESUS] that a millstone were hanged about HIS[JESUS] neck,
and HE[JESUS] were cast into the sea.

9:43 And if your hand offend you, cut it off: it is better for you to
enter into life maimed, than having two hands to go into hell, into the
fire that never shall be quenched:

9:44 Where their worm dieth not, and the fire is not quenched.

9:45 And if your foot offend you, cut it off: it is better for you to
enter halt into life, than having two feet to be cast into hell, into
the fire that never shall be quenched:

9:46 Where their worm dieth not, and the fire is not quenched.

9:47 And if yours eye offend you, pluck it out: it is better for you
to enter into the kingdom of GOD[JESUS] with one eye, than having two eyes to
be cast into hell fire:

9:48 Where their worm dieth not, and the fire is not quenched.

9:49 For every one shall be salted with fire, and every sacrifice shall
be salted with salt.

9:50 Salt is good: but if the salt have lost HIS[JESUS] saltness, wherewith
will you season it? Have salt in yourselves, and have peace one with
another.


10:1 And HE[JESUS] arose from thence, and comes into the coasts of Judaea by
the farther side of Jordan: and the people resort unto HIM[JESUS] again; and,
as HE[JESUS] was wont, HE[JESUS] taught them again.

10:2 And the Pharisees came to HIM[JESUS], and asked HIM[JESUS], Is it lawful for a
man to put away HIS[JESUS] wife? tempting HIM[JESUS].

10:3 And HE[JESUS] answered and said unto them, What did Moses command you?

10:4 And they said, Moses suffered to write a bill of divorcement, and
to put her away.

10:5 And JESUS answered and said unto them, For the hardness of your
heart HE[JESUS] wrote you this precept.

10:6 But from the beginning of the creation GOD[JESUS] made them male and
female.

10:7 For this cause shall a man leave HIS[JESUS] father and mother, and cleave
to HIS[JESUS] wife;

10:8 And they twain shall be one flesh: so then they are no more twain,
but one flesh.

10:9 What therefore GOD[JESUS] has joined together, let not man put asunder.

10:10 And in the house HIS[JESUS] disciples asked HIM[JESUS] again of the same matter.

10:11 And HE[JESUS] says unto them, whoever shall put away HIS[JESUS] wife, and
marry another, committeth adultery against her.

10:12 And if a woman shall put away her husband, and be married to
another, she committeth adultery.

10:13 And they brought young children to HIM[JESUS], that HE[JESUS] should touch them:
and HIS[JESUS] disciples rebuked those that brought them.

10:14 But when JESUS saw it, HE[JESUS] was much displeased, and said unto them,
let the little children to come unto me, and forbid them not: for of
such is the kingdom of GOD[JESUS].

10:15 truly I say unto you, whoever shall not receive the kingdom of
GOD[JESUS] as a little child, HE[JESUS] shall not enter therein.

10:16 And HE[JESUS] took them up in HIS[JESUS] arms, put HIS[JESUS] hands upon them, and
blessed them.

10:17 And when HE[JESUS] was gone forth into the way, there came one running,
and kneeled to HIM[JESUS], and asked HIM[JESUS], Good Master, what shall I do that I
may inherit eternal life?

10:18 And JESUS said unto HIM[JESUS], Why callest you me good? there is none
good but one, that is, GOD[JESUS].

10:19 you knowest the commandments, Do not commit adultery, Do not
kill, Do not steal, Do not bear false witness, Defraud not, Honour your
father and mother.

10:20 And HE[JESUS] answered and said unto HIM[JESUS], Master, all these have I
observed from my youth.

10:21 Then JESUS beholding HIM[JESUS] loved HIM[JESUS], and said unto HIM[JESUS], One thing
you lackest: go your way, sell whatsoever you hast, and give to the
poor, and you shalt have treasure in heaven: and come, take up the
cross, and follow me.

10:22 And HE[JESUS] was sad at that saying, and went away grieved: for HE[JESUS] had
great possessions.

10:23 And JESUS looked round about, and says unto HIS[JESUS] disciples, How
hardly shall they that have riches enter into the kingdom of GOD[JESUS]!

10:24 And the disciples were astonished at HIS[JESUS] words. But JESUS
answereth again, and says unto them, Children, how hard is it for them
that trust in riches to enter into the kingdom of GOD[JESUS]!

10:25 It is easier for a camel to go through the eye of a needle, than
for a rich man to enter into the kingdom of GOD[JESUS].

10:26 And they were astonished out of measure, saying among themselves,
Who then can be saved?

10:27 And JESUS looking upon them says, With men it is impossible, but
not with GOD[JESUS]: for with GOD[JESUS] all things are possible.

10:28 Then Peter began to say unto HIM[JESUS], Lo, we have left all, and have
followed you.

10:29 And JESUS answered and said, truly I say unto you, There is no
man that has left house, or brethren, or sisters, or father, or mother,
or wife, or children, or lands, for my sake, and the gospel's,

10:30 But HE[JESUS] shall receive an hundredfold now in this time, houses, and
