brethren, and sisters, and mothers, and children, and lands, with
persecutions; and in the world to come eternal life.

10:31 But many that are first shall be last; and the last first.

10:32 And they were in the way going up to Jerusalem; and JESUS went
before them: and they were amazed; and as they followed, they were
afraid. And HE[JESUS] took again the twelve, and began to tell them what things
should happen unto HIM[JESUS],

10:33 Saying, Behold, we go up to Jerusalem; and the SON[JESUS] OF MAN[JESUS] shall be
delivered unto the chief priests, and unto the scribes; and they shall
condemn HIM[JESUS] to death, and shall deliver HIM[JESUS] to the Gentiles:

10:34 And they shall mock HIM[JESUS], and shall scourge HIM[JESUS], and shall spit
upon HIM[JESUS], and shall kill HIM[JESUS]: and the third day HE[JESUS] shall rise again.

10:35 And James and John, the sons of Zebedee, come unto HIM[JESUS], saying,
Master, we would that you shouldest do for us whatsoever we shall
desire.

10:36 And HE[JESUS] said unto them, What would you that I should do for you?

10:37 They said unto HIM[JESUS], Grant unto us that we may sit, one on your
right hand, and the other on your left hand, in your glory.

10:38 But JESUS said unto them, you know not what you ask: can you drink of
the cup that I drink of? and be baptized with the baptism that I am
baptized with?

10:39 And they said unto HIM[JESUS], We can. And JESUS said unto them, you shall
indeed drink of the cup that I drink of; and with the baptism that I am
baptized withal shall you be baptized:

10:40 But to sit on my right hand and on my left hand is not mine to
give; but it shall be given to them for whom it is prepared.

10:41 And when the ten heard it, they began to be much displeased with
James and John.

10:42 But JESUS called them to HIM[JESUS], and says unto them, you know that
they which are accounted to rule over the Gentiles exercise lordship
over them; and their great ones exercise authority upon them.

10:43 But so shall it not be among you: but whoever will be great
among you, shall be your minister:

10:44 And whoever of you will be the chiefest, shall be SERVANT[JESUS] of
all.

10:45 For even the SON[JESUS] OF MAN[JESUS] came not to be ministered unto, but to
minister, and to give HIS[JESUS] life a ransom for many.

10:46 And they came to Jericho: and as HE[JESUS] went out of Jericho with HIS[JESUS]
disciples and a great number of people, blind Bartimaeus, the SON[JESUS] of
Timaeus, sat by the highway side begging.

10:47 And when HE[JESUS] heard that it was JESUS of Nazareth, HE[JESUS] began to cry
out, and say, JESUS, you SON[JESUS] of David, have mercy on me.

10:48 And many charged HIM[JESUS] that HE[JESUS] should hold HIS[JESUS] peace: but HE[JESUS] cried
the more a great deal, you SON[JESUS] of David, have mercy on me.

10:49 And JESUS stood still, and commanded HIM[JESUS] to be called. And they
call the blind man, saying unto HIM[JESUS], Be of good comfort, rise; HE[JESUS]
calleth you.

10:50 And HE[JESUS], casting away HIS[JESUS] garment, rose, and came to JESUS.

10:51 And JESUS answered and said unto HIM[JESUS], What wilt you that I should
do unto you? The blind man said unto HIM[JESUS], LORD[JESUS], that I might receive my
sight.

10:52 And JESUS said unto HIM[JESUS], Go your way; your faith has made you
whole. And immediately HE[JESUS] received HIS[JESUS] sight, and followed JESUS in the
way.


11:1 And when they came nigh to Jerusalem, unto Bethphage and Bethany,
at the mount of Olives, HE[JESUS] sendeth forth two of HIS[JESUS] disciples,

11:2 And says unto them, Go your way into the village over against you:
and as soon as you be entered into it, you shall find a colt tied, whereon
never man sat; loose HIM[JESUS], and bring HIM[JESUS].

11:3 And if any man say unto you, Why do you this? say you that the LORD[JESUS]
has need of HIM[JESUS]; and straightway HE[JESUS] will send HIM[JESUS] hither.

11:4 And they went their way, and found the colt tied by the door
without in a place where two ways met; and they loose HIM[JESUS].

11:5 And certain of them that stood there said unto them, What do you,
loosing the colt?

11:6 And they said unto them even as JESUS had commanded: and they let
them go.

11:7 And they brought the colt to JESUS, and cast their garments on HIM[JESUS];
and HE[JESUS] sat upon HIM[JESUS].

11:8 And many spread their garments in the way: and others cut down
branches off the trees, and strawed them in the way.

11:9 And they that went before, and they that followed, cried, saying,
Hosanna; Blessed is HE[JESUS] that comes in the name of the LORD[JESUS]:

11:10 Blessed be the kingdom of our father David, that comes in the
name of the LORD[JESUS]: Hosanna in the highest.

11:11 And JESUS entered into Jerusalem, and into the temple: and when HE[JESUS]
had looked round about upon all things, and now the eventide was come,
HE[JESUS] went out unto Bethany with the twelve.

11:12 And on the morrow, when they were come from Bethany, HE[JESUS] was
hungry:

11:13 And seeing a fig tree afar off having leaves, HE[JESUS] came, if haply HE[JESUS]
might find any thing thereon: and when HE[JESUS] came to it, HE[JESUS] found nothing
but leaves; for the time of figs was not yet.

11:14 And JESUS answered and said unto it, No man eat fruit of you
hereafter for ever. And HIS[JESUS] disciples heard it.

11:15 And they come to Jerusalem: and JESUS went into the temple, and
began to cast out them that sold and bought in the temple, and overthrew
the tables of the moneychangers, and the seats of them that sold doves;

11:16 And would not let that any man should carry any vessel through
the temple.

11:17 And HE[JESUS] taught, saying unto them, Is it not written, My house shall
be called of all nations the house of prayer? but you have made it a den
of thieves.

11:18 And the scribes and chief priests heard it, and sought how they
might destroy HIM[JESUS]: for they feared HIM[JESUS], because all the people was
astonished at HIS[JESUS] doctrine.

11:19 And when even was come, HE[JESUS] went out of the city.

11:20 And in the morning, as they passed by, they saw the fig tree dried
up from the roots.

11:21 And Peter calling to remembrance says unto HIM[JESUS], Master, behold,
the fig tree which you cursedst is withered away.

11:22 And JESUS answering says unto them, Have faith in GOD[JESUS].

11:23 For truly I say unto you, That whoever shall say unto this
mountain, Be you removed, and be you cast into the sea; and shall not
doubt in HIS[JESUS] heart, but shall believe that those things which HE[JESUS] says
shall come to pass; HE[JESUS] shall have whatsoever HE[JESUS] says.

11:24 Therefore I say unto you, What things soever you desire, when you
pray, believe that you receive them, and you shall have them.

11:25 And when you stand praying, forgive, if you have ought against any:
that your Father also which is in heaven may forgive you your
trespasses.

11:26 But if you do not forgive, neither will your Father which is in
heaven forgive your trespasses.

11:27 And they come again to Jerusalem: and as HE[JESUS] was walking in the
temple, there come to HIM[JESUS] the chief priests, and the scribes, and the
elders,

11:28 And say unto HIM[JESUS], By what authority doest you these things? and
who gave you this authority to do these things?

11:29 And JESUS answered and said unto them, I will also ask of you one
question, and answer me, and I will tell you by what authority I do
these things.

11:30 The baptism of John, was it from heaven, or of men? answer me.

11:31 And they reasoned with themselves, saying, If we shall say, From
heaven; HE[JESUS] will say, Why then did you not believe HIM[JESUS]?

11:32 But if we shall say, Of men; they feared the people: for all men
counted John, that HE[JESUS] was a PROPHET[JESUS] indeed.

11:33 And they answered and said unto JESUS, We cannot tell. And JESUS
answering says unto them, Neither do I tell you by what authority I do
these things.


12:1 And HE[JESUS] began to speak unto them by parables. A certain man planted
a vineyard, and set an hedge about it, and digged a place for the
winefat, and built a tower, and let it out to husbandmen, and went into
a far country.

12:2 And at the season HE[JESUS] sent to the husbandmen a SERVANT[JESUS], that HE[JESUS]
might receive from the husbandmen of the fruit of the vineyard.

12:3 And they caught HIM[JESUS], and beat HIM[JESUS], and sent HIM[JESUS] away empty.

12:4 And again HE[JESUS] sent unto them another SERVANT[JESUS]; and at HIM[JESUS] they cast
stones, and wounded HIM[JESUS] in the head, and sent HIM[JESUS] away shamefully
handled.

12:5 And again HE[JESUS] sent another; and HIM[JESUS] they killed, and many others;
beating some, and killing some.

12:6 Having yet therefore one SON[JESUS], HIS[JESUS] wellbeloved, HE[JESUS] sent HIM[JESUS] also
last unto them, saying, They will reverence my SON[JESUS].

12:7 But those husbandmen said among themselves, This is the heir; come,
let us kill HIM[JESUS], and the inheritance shall be our's.

12:8 And they took HIM[JESUS], and killed HIM[JESUS], and cast HIM[JESUS] out of the
vineyard.

12:9 What shall therefore the LORD[JESUS] of the vineyard do? HE[JESUS] will come and
destroy the husbandmen, and will give the vineyard unto others.

12:10 And have you not read this scripture; The stone which the builders
rejected is become the head of the corner:

12:11 This was the LORD[JESUS]'s doing, and it is marvellous in our eyes?

12:12 And they sought to lay hold on HIM[JESUS], but feared the people: for
they knew that HE[JESUS] had spoken the parable against them: and they left
HIM[JESUS], and went their way.

12:13 And they send unto HIM[JESUS] certain of the Pharisees and of the
Herodians, to catch HIM[JESUS] in HIS[JESUS] words.

12:14 And when they were come, they say unto HIM[JESUS], Master, we know that
you art true, and carest for no man: for you regardest not the person
of men, but teachest the way of GOD[JESUS] in truth: Is it lawful to give
tribute to Caesar, or not?

12:15 Shall we give, or shall we not give? But HE[JESUS], knowing their
hypocrisy, said unto them, Why tempt you me? bring me a penny, that I may
see it.

12:16 And they brought it. And HE[JESUS] says unto them, Whose is this image
and superscription? And they said unto HIM[JESUS], Caesar's.

12:17 And JESUS answering said unto them, Render to Caesar the things
that are Caesar's, and to GOD[JESUS] the things that are GOD[JESUS]'s. And they
marvelled at HIM[JESUS].

12:18 Then come unto HIM[JESUS] the Sadducees, which say there is no
resurrection; and they asked HIM[JESUS], saying,

12:19 Master, Moses wrote unto us, If a man's brother die, and leave HIS[JESUS]
wife behind HIM[JESUS], and leave no children, that HIS[JESUS] brother should take HIS[JESUS]
wife, and raise up SEED[JESUS] unto HIS[JESUS] brother.

12:20 Now there were seven brethren: and the first took a wife, and
dying left no SEED[JESUS].

12:21 And the second took her, and died, neither left HE[JESUS] any SEED[JESUS]: and
the third likewise.

12:22 And the seven had her, and left no SEED[JESUS]: last of all the woman
died also.

12:23 In the resurrection therefore, when they shall rise, whose wife
shall she be of them? for the seven had her to wife.

12:24 And JESUS answering said unto them, Do you not therefore err,
because you know not the scriptures, neither the power of GOD[JESUS]?

12:25 For when they shall rise from the dead, they neither marry, nor
are given in marriage; but are as the angels which are in heaven.

12:26 And as touching the dead, that they rise: have you not read in the
book of Moses, how in the bush GOD[JESUS] spake unto HIM[JESUS], saying, I am the GOD[JESUS]
of Abraham, and the GOD[JESUS] of Isaac, and the GOD[JESUS] of Jacob?

12:27 HE[JESUS] is not the GOD[JESUS] of the dead, but the GOD[JESUS] of the living: you
therefore do greatly err.

12:28 And one of the scribes came, and having heard them reasoning
together, and perceiving that HE[JESUS] had answered them well, asked HIM[JESUS],
Which is the first commandment of all?

12:29 And JESUS answered HIM[JESUS], The first of all the commandments is,
Hear, O Israel; The LORD[JESUS] our GOD[JESUS] is one LORD[JESUS]:

12:30 And you shalt love the LORD[JESUS] your GOD[JESUS] with all your heart, and with
all your soul, and with all your mind, and with all your strength: this is
the first commandment.

12:31 And the second is like, namely this, you shalt love your neighbour
as thyself. There is none other commandment greater than these.

12:32 And the scribe said unto HIM[JESUS], Well, Master, you hast said the
truth: for there is one GOD[JESUS]; and there is none other but HE[JESUS]:

12:33 And to love HIM[JESUS] with all the heart, and with all the
understanding, and with all the soul, and with all the strength, and to
love HIS[JESUS] neighbour as himself, is more than all whole burnt offerings
and sacrifices.

12:34 And when JESUS saw that HE[JESUS] answered discreetly, HE[JESUS] said unto HIM[JESUS],
you art not far from the kingdom of GOD[JESUS]. And no man after that durst
ask HIM[JESUS] any question.

12:35 And JESUS answered and said, while HE[JESUS] taught in the temple, How
say the scribes that CHRIST[JESUS] is the SON[JESUS] of David?

12:36 For David himself said by the Holy Ghost, The LORD[JESUS] said to my
LORD[JESUS], Sit you on my right hand, till I make yours enemies your
footstool.

12:37 David therefore himself calleth HIM[JESUS] LORD[JESUS]; and whence is HE[JESUS] then
HIS[JESUS] SON[JESUS]? And the common people heard HIM[JESUS] gladly.

12:38 And HE[JESUS] said unto them in HIS[JESUS] doctrine, Beware of the scribes,
which love to go in long clothing, and love salutations in the
marketplaces,

12:39 And the chief seats in the synagogues, and the uppermost rooms at
feasts:

12:40 Which devour widows' houses, and for a pretence make long prayers:
these shall receive greater damnation.

12:41 And JESUS sat over against the treasury, and beheld how the people
cast money into the treasury: and many that were rich cast in much.

12:42 And there came a certain poor widow, and she threw in two mites,
which make a farthing.

12:43 And HE[JESUS] called unto HIM[JESUS] HIS[JESUS] disciples, and says unto them, truly
I say unto you, That this poor widow has cast more in, than all they
which have cast into the treasury:

12:44 For all they did cast in of their abundance; but she of her want
did cast in all that she had, even all her living.


13:1 And as HE[JESUS] went out of the temple, one of HIS[JESUS] disciples says unto
HIM[JESUS], Master, see what manner of stones and what buildings are here!

13:2 And JESUS answering said unto HIM[JESUS], Seest you these great
buildings? there shall not be left one stone upon another, that shall
not be thrown down.

13:3 And as HE[JESUS] sat upon the mount of Olives over against the temple,
Peter and James and John and Andrew asked HIM[JESUS] privately,

13:4 Tell us, when shall these things be? and what shall be the sign
when all these things shall be fulfilled?

13:5 And JESUS answering them began to say, Take heed lest any man
deceive you:

13:6 For many shall come in my name, saying, I am CHRIST[JESUS]; and shall
deceive many.

13:7 And when you shall hear of wars and rumours of wars, be you not
troubled: for such things must needs be; but the end shall not be yet.

13:8 For nation shall rise against nation, and kingdom against kingdom:
and there shall be earthquakes in divers places, and there shall be
famines and troubles: these are the beginnings of sorrows.

13:9 But take heed to yourselves: for they shall deliver you up to
councils; and in the synagogues you shall be beaten: and you shall be
brought before rulers and kings for my sake, for a testimony against
them.

13:10 And the gospel must first be published among all nations.

13:11 But when they shall lead you, and deliver you up, take no thought
beforehand what you shall speak, neither do you premeditate: but
whatsoever shall be given you in that hour, that speak you: for it is not
you that speak, but the Holy Ghost.

13:12 Now the brother shall betray the brother to death, and the father
the SON[JESUS]; and children shall rise up against their parents, and shall
cause them to be put to death.

13:13 And you shall be hated of all men for my name's sake: but HE[JESUS] that
shall endure unto the end, the same shall be saved.

13:14 But when you shall see the abomination of desolation, spoken of by
Daniel the PROPHET[JESUS], standing where it ought not, (let HIM[JESUS] that readeth
understand,) then let them that be in Judaea flee to the mountains:

13:15 And let HIM[JESUS] that is on the housetop not go down into the house,
neither enter therein, to take any thing out of HIS[JESUS] house:

13:16 And let HIM[JESUS] that is in the field not turn back again for to take
up HIS[JESUS] garment.

13:17 But woe to them that are with child, and to them that give suck in
those days!

13:18 And pray you that your flight be not in the winter.

13:19 For in those days shall be affliction, such as was not from the
beginning of the creation which GOD[JESUS] created unto this time, neither
shall be.

13:20 And except that the LORD[JESUS] had shortened those days, no flesh should
be saved: but for the elect's sake, whom HE[JESUS] has chosen, HE[JESUS] has
shortened the days.

13:21 And then if any man shall say to you, Lo, here is CHRIST[JESUS]; or, lo,
HE[JESUS] is there; believe HIM[JESUS] not:

13:22 For false Christs and false prophets shall rise, and shall shew
signs and wonders, to seduce, if it were possible, even the elect.

13:23 But take you heed: behold, I have foretold you all things.

13:24 But in those days, after that tribulation, the sun shall be
darkened, and the moon shall not give her light,

13:25 And the stars of heaven shall fall, and the powers that are in
heaven shall be shaken.

13:26 And then shall they see the SON[JESUS] OF MAN[JESUS] coming in the clouds with
great power and glory.

13:27 And then shall HE[JESUS] send HIS[JESUS] angels, and shall gather together HIS[JESUS]
elect from the four winds, from the uttermost part of the earth to the
uttermost part of heaven.

13:28 Now learn a parable of the fig tree; When her BRANCH[JESUS] is yet
tender, and putteth forth leaves, you know that summer is near:

13:29 So you in like manner, when you shall see these things come to pass,
know that it is nigh, even at the doors.

13:30 truly I say unto you, that this generation shall not pass, till
all these things be done.

13:31 Heaven and earth shall pass away: but my words shall not pass
away.

13:32 But of that day and that hour knoweth no man, no, not the angels
which are in heaven, neither the SON[JESUS], but the Father.

13:33 Take you heed, watch and pray: for you know not when the time is.

13:34 For the SON[JESUS] OF MAN[JESUS] is as a man taking a far journey, who left HIS[JESUS]
house, and gave authority to HIS[JESUS] servants, and to every man HIS[JESUS] work,
and commanded the porter to watch.

13:35 Watch you therefore: for you know not when the master of the house
comes, at even, or at midnight, or at the cockcrowing, or in the
morning:

13:36 Lest coming suddenly HE[JESUS] find you sleeping.

13:37 And what I say unto you I say unto all, Watch.


14:1 After two days was the feast of the passover, and of unleavened
bread: and the chief priests and the scribes sought how they might take
HIM[JESUS] by craft, and put HIM[JESUS] to death.

14:2 But they said, Not on the feast day, lest there be an uproar of the
people.

14:3 And being in Bethany in the house of Simon the leper, as HE[JESUS] sat at
meat, there came a woman having an alabaster box of ointment of
spikenard very precious; and she brake the box, and poured it on HIS[JESUS]
head.

14:4 And there were some that had indignation within themselves, and
said, Why was this waste of the ointment made?

14:5 For it might have been sold for more than three hundred pence, and
have been given to the poor. And they murmured against her.

14:6 And JESUS said, Let her alone; why trouble you her? she has wrought
a good work on me.

14:7 For you have the poor with you always, and whensoever you will you may
do them good: but me you have not always.

14:8 She has done what she could: she is come aforehand to anoint my
body to the burying.

14:9 truly I say unto you, Wheresoever this gospel shall be preached
throughout the whole world, this also that she has done shall be spoken
of for a memorial of her.

14:10 And Judas Iscariot, one of the twelve, went unto the chief
priests, to betray HIM[JESUS] unto them.

14:11 And when they heard it, they were glad, and promised to give HIM[JESUS]
money. And HE[JESUS] sought how HE[JESUS] might conveniently betray HIM[JESUS].

14:12 And the first day of unleavened bread, when they killed the
passover, HIS[JESUS] disciples said unto HIM[JESUS], Where wilt you that we go and
prepare that you mayest eat the passover?

14:13 And HE[JESUS] sendeth forth two of HIS[JESUS] disciples, and says unto them, Go
you into the city, and there shall meet you a man bearing a pitcher of
water: follow HIM[JESUS].

14:14 And wheresoever HE[JESUS] shall go in, say you to the goodman of the
house, The Master says, Where is the guestchamber, where I shall eat
the passover with my disciples?

14:15 And HE[JESUS] will shew you a large upper room furnished and prepared:
there make ready for us.

14:16 And HIS[JESUS] disciples went forth, and came into the city, and found as
HE[JESUS] had said unto them: and they made ready the passover.

14:17 And in the evening HE[JESUS] comes with the twelve.

14:18 And as they sat and did eat, JESUS said, truly I say unto you,
One of you which eateth with me shall betray me.

14:19 And they began to be sorrowful, and to say unto HIM[JESUS] one by one, Is
it I? and another said, Is it I?

14:20 And HE[JESUS] answered and said unto them, It is one of the twelve, that
dippeth with me in the dish.

14:21 The SON[JESUS] OF MAN[JESUS] indeed goes, as it is written of HIM[JESUS]: but woe to
that man by whom the SON[JESUS] OF MAN[JESUS] is betrayed! good were it for that man
if HE[JESUS] had never been born.

14:22 And as they did eat, JESUS took bread, and blessed, and brake it,
and gave to them, and said, Take, eat: this is my body.

14:23 And HE[JESUS] took the cup, and when HE[JESUS] had given thanks, HE[JESUS] gave it to
them: and they all drank of it.

14:24 And HE[JESUS] said unto them, This is my blood of the new testament,
which is shed for many.

14:25 truly I say unto you, I will drink no more of the fruit of the
vine, until that day that I drink it new in the kingdom of GOD[JESUS].

14:26 And when they had sung an hymn, they went out into the mount of
Olives.

14:27 And JESUS says unto them, All you shall be offended because of me
this night: for it is written, I will smite the SHEPHERD[JESUS], and the sheep
shall be scattered.

14:28 But after that I am risen, I will go before you into Galilee.

14:29 But Peter said unto HIM[JESUS], Although all shall be offended, yet will
not I.

14:30 And JESUS says unto HIM[JESUS], truly I say unto you, That this day,
even in this night, before the cock crow twice, you shalt deny me
thrice.

14:31 But HE[JESUS] spake the more vehemently, If I should die with you, I
will not deny you in any wise. Likewise also said they all.

14:32 And they came to a place which was named Gethsemane: and HE[JESUS] says
to HIS[JESUS] disciples, Sit you here, while I shall pray.

14:33 And HE[JESUS] taketh with HIM[JESUS] Peter and James and John, and began to be
sore amazed, and to be very heavy;

14:34 And says unto them, My soul is exceeding sorrowful unto death:
tarry you here, and watch.

14:35 And HE[JESUS] went forward a little, and fell on the ground, and prayed
that, if it were possible, the hour might pass from HIM[JESUS].

14:36 And HE[JESUS] said, Abba, Father, all things are possible unto you; take
away this cup from me: nevertheless not what I will, but what you wilt.

14:37 And HE[JESUS] comes, and findeth them sleeping, and says unto Peter,
Simon, sleepest you? couldest not you watch one hour?

14:38 Watch you and pray, lest you enter into temptation. The spirit truly
is ready, but the flesh is weak.

14:39 And again HE[JESUS] went away, and prayed, and spake the same words.

14:40 And when HE[JESUS] returned, HE[JESUS] found them asleep again, (for their eyes
were heavy,) neither wist they what to answer HIM[JESUS].

14:41 And HE[JESUS] comes the third time, and says unto them, Sleep on now,
and take your rest: it is enough, the hour is come; behold, the SON[JESUS] of
man is betrayed into the hands of sinners.

14:42 Rise up, let us go; lo, HE[JESUS] that betrayeth me is at hand.

14:43 And immediately, while HE[JESUS] yet spake, comes Judas, one of the
twelve, and with HIM[JESUS] a great multitude with swords and staves, from the
chief priests and the scribes and the elders.

14:44 And HE[JESUS] that betrayed HIM[JESUS] had given them a token, saying,
Whomsoever I shall kiss, that same is HE[JESUS]; take HIM[JESUS], and lead HIM[JESUS] away
safely.

14:45 And as soon as HE[JESUS] was come, HE[JESUS] goes straightway to HIM[JESUS], and
says, Master, master; and kissed HIM[JESUS].

14:46 And they laid their hands on HIM[JESUS], and took HIM[JESUS].

14:47 And one of them that stood by drew a sword, and smote a SERVANT[JESUS] of
the high priest, and cut off HIS[JESUS] ear.

14:48 And JESUS answered and said unto them, Are you come out, as against
a thief, with swords and with staves to take me?

14:49 I was daily with you in the temple teaching, and you took me not:
but the scriptures must be fulfilled.

14:50 And they all forsook HIM[JESUS], and fled.

14:51 And there followed HIM[JESUS] a certain young man, having a linen cloth
cast about HIS[JESUS] naked body; and the young men laid hold on HIM[JESUS]:

14:52 And HE[JESUS] left the linen cloth, and fled from them naked.

14:53 And they led JESUS away to the high priest: and with HIM[JESUS] were
assembled all the chief priests and the elders and the scribes.

14:54 And Peter followed HIM[JESUS] afar off, even into the palace of the high
priest: and HE[JESUS] sat with the servants, and warmed himself at the fire.

14:55 And the chief priests and all the council sought for witness
against JESUS to put HIM[JESUS] to death; and found none.

14:56 For many bare false witness against HIM[JESUS], but their witness agreed
not together.

14:57 And there arose certain, and bare false witness against HIM[JESUS],
saying,

14:58 We heard HIM[JESUS] say, I will destroy this temple that is made with
hands, and within three days I will build another made without hands.

14:59 But neither so did their witness agree together.

14:60 And the high priest stood up in the midst, and asked JESUS,
saying, Answerest you nothing? what is it which these witness against
you?

14:61 But HE[JESUS] held HIS[JESUS] peace, and answered nothing. Again the high priest
asked HIM[JESUS], and said unto HIM[JESUS], Art you the CHRIST[JESUS], the SON[JESUS] of the
Blessed?

14:62 And JESUS said, I am: and you shall see the SON[JESUS] OF MAN[JESUS] sitting on
the right hand of power, and coming in the clouds of heaven.

14:63 Then the high priest rent HIS[JESUS] clothes, and says, What need we any
further witnesses?

14:64 you have heard the blasphemy: what think you? And they all condemned
HIM[JESUS] to be guilty of death.

14:65 And some began to spit on HIM[JESUS], and to cover HIS[JESUS] face, and to
buffet HIM[JESUS], and to say unto HIM[JESUS], Prophesy: and the servants did strike
HIM[JESUS] with the palms of their hands.

14:66 And as Peter was beneath in the palace, there comes one of the
maids of the high priest:

14:67 And when she saw Peter warming himself, she looked upon HIM[JESUS], and
said, And you also wast with JESUS of Nazareth.

14:68 But HE[JESUS] denied, saying, I know not, neither understand I what you
sayest. And HE[JESUS] went out into the porch; and the cock crew.

14:69 And a maid saw HIM[JESUS] again, and began to say to them that stood by,
This is one of them.

14:70 And HE[JESUS] denied it again. And a little after, they that stood by
said again to Peter, Surely you art one of them: for you art a
Galilaean, and your speech agreeth thereto.

14:71 But HE[JESUS] began to curse and to swear, saying, I know not this man of
whom you speak.

14:72 And the second time the cock crew. And Peter called to mind the
WORD[JESUS] that JESUS said unto HIM[JESUS], Before the cock crow twice, you shalt
deny me thrice. And when HE[JESUS] thought thereon, HE[JESUS] wept.


15:1 And straightway in the morning the chief priests held a
consultation with the elders and scribes and the whole council, and
bound JESUS, and carried HIM[JESUS] away, and delivered HIM[JESUS] to Pilate.

15:2 And Pilate asked HIM[JESUS], Art you the KING[JESUS] of the Jews? And HE[JESUS]
answering said unto them, you sayest it.

15:3 And the chief priests accused HIM[JESUS] of many things: but HE[JESUS] answered
nothing.

15:4 And Pilate asked HIM[JESUS] again, saying, Answerest you nothing? behold
how many things they witness against you.

15:5 But JESUS yet answered nothing; so that Pilate marvelled.

15:6 Now at that feast HE[JESUS] released unto them one prisoner, whomsoever
they desired.

15:7 And there was one named Barabbas, which lay bound with them that
had made insurrection with HIM[JESUS], who had committed murder in the
insurrection.

15:8 And the multitude crying aloud began to desire HIM[JESUS] to do as HE[JESUS] had
ever done unto them.

15:9 But Pilate answered them, saying, Will you that I release unto you
the KING[JESUS] of the Jews?

15:10 For HE[JESUS] knew that the chief priests had delivered HIM[JESUS] for envy.

15:11 But the chief priests moved the people, that HE[JESUS] should rather
release Barabbas unto them.

15:12 And Pilate answered and said again unto them, What will you then
that I shall do unto HIM[JESUS] whom you call the KING[JESUS] of the Jews?

15:13 And they cried out again, Crucify HIM[JESUS].

15:14 Then Pilate said unto them, Why, what evil has HE[JESUS] done? And they
cried out the more exceedingly, Crucify HIM[JESUS].

15:15 And so Pilate, willing to content the people, released Barabbas
unto them, and delivered JESUS, when HE[JESUS] had scourged HIM[JESUS], to be
crucified.

15:16 And the soldiers led HIM[JESUS] away into the hall, called Praetorium;
and they call together the whole band.

15:17 And they clothed HIM[JESUS] with purple, and platted a crown of thorns,
and put it about HIS[JESUS] head,

15:18 And began to salute HIM[JESUS], Hail, KING[JESUS] of the Jews!

15:19 And they smote HIM[JESUS] on the head with a reed, and did spit upon HIM[JESUS],
and bowing their knees worshipped HIM[JESUS].

15:20 And when they had mocked HIM[JESUS], they took off the purple from HIM[JESUS],
and put HIS[JESUS] own clothes on HIM[JESUS], and led HIM[JESUS] out to crucify HIM[JESUS].

15:21 And they compel one Simon a Cyrenian, who passed by, coming out of
the country, the father of Alexander and Rufus, to bear HIS[JESUS] cross.

15:22 And they bring HIM[JESUS] unto the place Golgotha, which is, being
interpreted, The place of a skull.

15:23 And they gave HIM[JESUS] to drink wine mingled with myrrh: but HE[JESUS]
received it not.

15:24 And when they had crucified HIM[JESUS], they parted HIS[JESUS] garments, casting
lots upon them, what every man should take.

15:25 And it was the third hour, and they crucified HIM[JESUS].

15:26 And the superscription of HIS[JESUS] accusation was written over, THE
KING[JESUS] OF THE JEWS.

15:27 And with HIM[JESUS] they crucify two thieves; the one on HIS[JESUS] right hand,
and the other on HIS[JESUS] left.

15:28 And the scripture was fulfilled, which says, And HE[JESUS] was numbered
with the transgressors.

15:29 And they that passed by railed on HIM[JESUS], wagging their heads, and
saying, Ah, you that destroyest the temple, and buildest it in three
days,

15:30 Save thyself, and come down from the cross.

15:31 Likewise also the chief priests mocking said among themselves with
the scribes, HE[JESUS] saved others; himself HE[JESUS] cannot save.

15:32 Let CHRIST[JESUS] the KING[JESUS] of Israel descend now from the cross, that we
may see and believe. And they that were crucified with HIM[JESUS] reviled HIM[JESUS].

15:33 And when the sixth hour was come, there was darkness over the
whole land until the ninth hour.

15:34 And at the ninth hour JESUS cried with a loud voice, saying, Eloi,
Eloi, lama sabachthani? which is, being interpreted, My GOD[JESUS], my GOD[JESUS], why
hast you forsaken me?

15:35 And some of them that stood by, when they heard it, said, Behold,
HE[JESUS] calleth Elias.

15:36 And one ran and filled a spunge full of vinegar, and put it on a
reed, and gave HIM[JESUS] to drink, saying, Let alone; let us see whether Elias
will come to take HIM[JESUS] down.

15:37 And JESUS cried with a loud voice, and gave up the ghost.

15:38 And the veil of the temple was rent in twain from the top to the
bottom.

15:39 And when the centurion, which stood over against HIM[JESUS], saw that HE[JESUS]
so cried out, and gave up the ghost, HE[JESUS] said, Truly this man was the SON[JESUS]
of GOD[JESUS].

15:40 There were also women looking on afar off: among whom was Mary
Magdalene, and Mary the mother of James the less and of Joses, and
Salome;

15:41 (Who also, when HE[JESUS] was in Galilee, followed HIM[JESUS], and ministered
unto HIM[JESUS];) and many other women which came up with HIM[JESUS] unto Jerusalem.

15:42 And now when the even was come, because it was the preparation,
that is, the day before the sabbath,

15:43 Joseph of Arimathaea, an honourable COUNSELLOR[JESUS], which also waited
for the kingdom of GOD[JESUS], came, and went in boldly unto Pilate, and craved
the body of JESUS.

15:44 And Pilate marvelled if HE[JESUS] were already dead: and calling unto HIM[JESUS]
the centurion, HE[JESUS] asked HIM[JESUS] whether HE[JESUS] had been any while dead.

15:45 And when HE[JESUS] knew it of the centurion, HE[JESUS] gave the body to Joseph.

15:46 And HE[JESUS] bought fine linen, and took HIM[JESUS] down, and wrapped HIM[JESUS] in
the linen, and laid HIM[JESUS] in a sepulchre which was hewn out of a rock, and
rolled a stone unto the door of the sepulchre.

15:47 And Mary Magdalene and Mary the mother of Joses beheld where HE[JESUS]
was laid.


16:1 And when the sabbath was past, Mary Magdalene, and Mary the mother
of James, and Salome, had bought sweet spices, that they might come and
anoint HIM[JESUS].

16:2 And very early in the morning the first day of the week, they came
unto the sepulchre at the rising of the sun.

16:3 And they said among themselves, Who shall roll us away the stone
from the door of the sepulchre?

16:4 And when they looked, they saw that the stone was rolled away: for
it was very great.

16:5 And entering into the sepulchre, they saw a young man sitting on
the right side, clothed in a long white garment; and they were
affrighted.

16:6 And HE[JESUS] says unto them, Be not affrighted: you seek JESUS of
Nazareth, which was crucified: HE[JESUS] is risen; HE[JESUS] is not here: behold the
place where they laid HIM[JESUS].

16:7 But go your way, tell HIS[JESUS] disciples and Peter that HE[JESUS] goes before
you into Galilee: there shall you see HIM[JESUS], as HE[JESUS] said unto you.

16:8 And they went out quickly, and fled from the sepulchre; for they
trembled and were amazed: neither said they any thing to any man; for
they were afraid.

16:9 Now when JESUS was risen early the first day of the week, HE[JESUS]
appeared first to Mary Magdalene, out of whom HE[JESUS] had cast seven devils.

16:10 And she went and told them that had been with HIM[JESUS], as they mourned
and wept.

16:11 And they, when they had heard that HE[JESUS] was alive, and had been seen
of her, believed not.

16:12 After that HE[JESUS] appeared in another form unto two of them, as they
walked, and went into the country.

16:13 And they went and told it unto the residue: neither believed they
them.

16:14 Afterward HE[JESUS] appeared unto the eleven as they sat at meat, and
upbraided them with their unbelief and hardness of heart, because they
believed not them which had seen HIM[JESUS] after HE[JESUS] was risen.

16:15 And HE[JESUS] said unto them, Go you into all the world, and preach the
gospel to every creature.

16:16 HE[JESUS] that believes and is baptized shall be saved; but HE[JESUS] that
believes not shall be damned.

16:17 And these signs shall follow them that believe; In my name shall
they cast out devils; they shall speak with new tongues;

16:18 They shall take up serpents; and if they drink any deadly thing,
it shall not hurt them; they shall lay hands on the sick, and they shall
recover.

16:19 So then after the LORD[JESUS] had spoken unto them, HE[JESUS] was received up
into heaven, and sat on the right hand of GOD[JESUS].

16:20 And they went forth, and preached every where, the LORD[JESUS] working
with them, and confirming the WORD[JESUS] with signs following. Amen.

1:1 Forasmuch as many have taken in hand to set forth in order a
declaration of those things which are most surely believed among us,

1:2 Even as they delivered them unto us, which from the beginning were
eyewitnesses, and ministers of the WORD[JESUS];

1:3 It seemed good to me also, having had perfect understanding of all
things from the very first, to write unto you in order, most excellent
Theophilus,

1:4 That you mightest know the certainty of those things, wherein you
hast been instructed.

1:5 THERE was in the days of Herod, the KING[JESUS] of Judaea, a certain priest
named Zacharias, of the course of Abia: and HIS[JESUS] wife was of the
daughters of Aaron, and her name was Elisabeth.

1:6 And they were both righteous before GOD[JESUS], walking in all the
commandments and ordinances of the LORD[JESUS] blameless.

1:7 And they had no child, because that Elisabeth was barren, and they
both were now well stricken in years.

1:8 And it came to pass, that while HE[JESUS] executed the priest's office
before GOD[JESUS] in the order of HIS[JESUS] course,

1:9 According to the custom of the priest's office, HIS[JESUS] lot was to burn
incense when HE[JESUS] went into the temple of the LORD[JESUS].

1:10 And the whole multitude of the people were praying without at the
time of incense.

1:11 And there appeared unto HIM[JESUS] an angel of the LORD[JESUS] standing on the
right side of the altar of incense.

1:12 And when Zacharias saw HIM[JESUS], HE[JESUS] was troubled, and fear fell upon
HIM[JESUS].

1:13 But the angel said unto HIM[JESUS], Fear not, Zacharias: for your prayer is
heard; and your wife Elisabeth shall bear you a SON[JESUS], and you shalt call
HIS[JESUS] name John.

1:14 And you shalt have joy and gladness; and many shall rejoice at HIS[JESUS]
birth.

1:15 For HE[JESUS] shall be great in the sight of the LORD[JESUS], and shall drink
neither wine nor strong drink; and HE[JESUS] shall be filled with the Holy
Ghost, even from HIS[JESUS] mother's womb.

1:16 And many of the children of Israel shall HE[JESUS] turn to the LORD[JESUS] their
GOD[JESUS].

1:17 And HE[JESUS] shall go before HIM[JESUS] in the spirit and power of Elias, to
turn the hearts of the fathers to the children, and the disobedient to
the wisdom of the just; to make ready a people prepared for the LORD[JESUS].

1:18 And Zacharias said unto the angel, Whereby shall I know this? for I
am an old man, and my wife well stricken in years.

1:19 And the angel answering said unto HIM[JESUS], I am Gabriel, that stand in
the presence of GOD[JESUS]; and am sent to speak unto you, and to shew you
these glad tidings.

1:20 And, behold, you shalt be dumb, and not able to speak, until the
day that these things shall be performed, because you believest not my
words, which shall be fulfilled in their season.

1:21 And the people waited for Zacharias, and marvelled that HE[JESUS] tarried
so long in the temple.

1:22 And when HE[JESUS] came out, HE[JESUS] could not speak unto them: and they
perceived that HE[JESUS] had seen a vision in the temple: for HE[JESUS] beckoned unto
them, and remained speechless.

1:23 And it came to pass, that, as soon as the days of HIS[JESUS] ministration
were accomplished, HE[JESUS] departed to HIS[JESUS] own house.

1:24 And after those days HIS[JESUS] wife Elisabeth conceived, and hid herself
five months, saying,

1:25 Thus has the LORD[JESUS] dealt with me in the days wherein HE[JESUS] looked on
me, to take away my reproach among men.

1:26 And in the sixth month the angel Gabriel was sent from GOD[JESUS] unto a
city of Galilee, named Nazareth,

1:27 To a virgin espoused to a man whose name was Joseph, of the house
of David; and the virgin's name was Mary.

1:28 And the angel came in unto her, and said, Hail, you that art
highly favoured, the LORD[JESUS] is with you: blessed art you among women.

1:29 And when she saw HIM[JESUS], she was troubled at HIS[JESUS] saying, and cast in
her mind what manner of salutation this should be.

1:30 And the angel said unto her, Fear not, Mary: for you hast found
favour with GOD[JESUS].

1:31 And, behold, you shalt conceive in your womb, and bring forth a
SON[JESUS], and shalt call HIS[JESUS] name JESUS.

1:32 HE[JESUS] shall be great, and shall be called the SON[JESUS] of the Highest: and
the LORD[JESUS] GOD[JESUS] shall give unto HIM[JESUS] the throne of HIS[JESUS] father David:

1:33 And HE[JESUS] shall reign over the house of Jacob for ever; and of HIS[JESUS]
kingdom there shall be no end.

1:34 Then said Mary unto the angel, How shall this be, seeing I know not
a man?

1:35 And the angel answered and said unto her, The Holy Ghost shall come
upon you, and the power of the Highest shall overshadow you: therefore
also that holy thing which shall be born of you shall be called the SON[JESUS]
of GOD[JESUS].

1:36 And, behold, your cousin Elisabeth, she has also conceived a SON[JESUS] in
her old age: and this is the sixth month with her, who was called
barren.

1:37 For with GOD[JESUS] nothing shall be impossible.

1:38 And Mary said, Behold the handmaid of the LORD[JESUS]; be it unto me
according to your WORD[JESUS]. And the angel departed from her.

1:39 And Mary arose in those days, and went into the hill country with
haste, into a city of Juda;

1:40 And entered into the house of Zacharias, and saluted Elisabeth.

1:41 And it came to pass, that, when Elisabeth heard the salutation of
Mary, the babe leaped in her womb; and Elisabeth was filled with the
Holy Ghost:

1:42 And she spake out with a loud voice, and said, Blessed art you
among women, and blessed is the fruit of your womb.

1:43 And whence is this to me, that the mother of my LORD[JESUS] should come to
me?

1:44 For, lo, as soon as the voice of your salutation sounded in mine
ears, the babe leaped in my womb for joy.

1:45 And blessed is she that believed: for there shall be a performance
of those things which were told her from the LORD[JESUS].

1:46 And Mary said, My soul does magnify the LORD[JESUS],

1:47 And my spirit has rejoiced in GOD[JESUS] my Saviour.

1:48 For HE[JESUS] has regarded the low estate of HIS[JESUS] handmaiden: for, behold,
from henceforth all generations shall call me blessed.

1:49 For HE[JESUS] that is mighty has done to me great things; and holy is HIS[JESUS]
name.

1:50 And HIS[JESUS] mercy is on them that fear HIM[JESUS] from generation to
generation.

1:51 HE[JESUS] has shewed strength with HIS[JESUS] arm; HE[JESUS] has scattered the proud
in the imagination of their hearts.

1:52 HE[JESUS] has put down the mighty from their seats, and exalted them of
low degree.

1:53 HE[JESUS] has filled the hungry with good things; and the rich HE[JESUS] has
sent empty away.

1:54 HE[JESUS] has holpen HIS[JESUS] SERVANT[JESUS] Israel, in remembrance of HIS[JESUS] mercy;

1:55 As HE[JESUS] spake to our fathers, to Abraham, and to HIS[JESUS] SEED[JESUS] for ever.

1:56 And Mary abode with her about three months, and returned to her own
house.

1:57 Now Elisabeth's full time came that she should be delivered; and
she brought forth a SON[JESUS].

1:58 And her neighbours and her cousins heard how the LORD[JESUS] had shewed
great mercy upon her; and they rejoiced with her.

1:59 And it came to pass, that on the eighth day they came to circumcise
the child; and they called HIM[JESUS] Zacharias, after the name of HIS[JESUS] father.

1:60 And HIS[JESUS] mother answered and said, Not so; but HE[JESUS] shall be called
John.

1:61 And they said unto her, There is none of your kindred that is called
by this name.

1:62 And they made signs to HIS[JESUS] father, how HE[JESUS] would have HIM[JESUS] called.

1:63 And HE[JESUS] asked for a writing table, and wrote, saying, HIS[JESUS] name is
John. And they marvelled all.

1:64 And HIS[JESUS] mouth was opened immediately, and HIS[JESUS] tongue loosed, and HE[JESUS]
spake, and praised GOD[JESUS].

1:65 And fear came on all that dwelt round about them: and all these
sayings were noised abroad throughout all the hill country of Judaea.

1:66 And all they that heard them laid them up in their hearts, saying,
What manner of child shall this be! And the hand of the LORD[JESUS] was with
HIM[JESUS].

1:67 And HIS[JESUS] father Zacharias was filled with the Holy Ghost, and
prophesied, saying,

1:68 Blessed be the LORD[JESUS] GOD[JESUS] of Israel; for HE[JESUS] has visited and redeemed
HIS[JESUS] people,

1:69 And has raised up an horn of salvation for us in the house of HIS[JESUS]
SERVANT[JESUS] David;

1:70 As HE[JESUS] spake by the mouth of HIS[JESUS] holy prophets, which have been
since the world began:

1:71 That we should be saved from our enemies, and from the hand of all
that hate us;

1:72 To perform the mercy promised to our fathers, and to remember HIS[JESUS]
holy covenant;

1:73 The oath which HE[JESUS] sware to our father Abraham,

1:74 That HE[JESUS] would grant unto us, that we being delivered out of the
hand of our enemies might serve HIM[JESUS] without fear,

1:75 In holiness and righteousness before HIM[JESUS], all the days of our life.

1:76 And you, child, shalt be called the PROPHET[JESUS] of the Highest: for
you shalt go before the face of the LORD[JESUS] to prepare HIS[JESUS] ways;

1:77 To give knowledge of salvation unto HIS[JESUS] people by the remission of
their sins,

1:78 Through the tender mercy of our GOD[JESUS]; whereby the dayspring from on
high has visited us,

1:79 To give light to them that sit in darkness and in the shadow of
death, to guide our feet into the way of peace.

1:80 And the child grew, and waxed strong in spirit, and was in the
deserts till the day of HIS[JESUS] shewing unto Israel.


2:1 And it came to pass in those days, that there went out a decree from
Caesar Augustus that all the world should be taxed.

2:2 (And this taxing was first made when Cyrenius was governor of
Syria.)

2:3 And all went to be taxed, every one into HIS[JESUS] own city.

2:4 And Joseph also went up from Galilee, out of the city of Nazareth,
into Judaea, unto the city of David, which is called Bethlehem; (because
HE[JESUS] was of the house and lineage of David:)

2:5 To be taxed with Mary HIS[JESUS] espoused wife, being great with child.

2:6 And so it was, that, while they were there, the days were
accomplished that she should be delivered.

2:7 And she brought forth her firstborn SON[JESUS], and wrapped HIM[JESUS] in
swaddling clothes, and laid HIM[JESUS] in a manger; because there was no room
for them in the inn.

2:8 And there were in the same country shepherds abiding in the field,
keeping watch over their flock by night.

2:9 And, lo, the angel of the LORD[JESUS] came upon them, and the glory of the
LORD[JESUS] shone round about them: and they were sore afraid.

2:10 And the angel said unto them, Fear not: for, behold, I bring you
good tidings of great joy, which shall be to all people.

2:11 For unto you is born this day in the city of David a Saviour, which
is CHRIST[JESUS] the LORD[JESUS].

2:12 And this shall be a sign unto you; you shall find the babe wrapped
in swaddling clothes, lying in a manger.

2:13 And suddenly there was with the angel a multitude of the heavenly
host praising GOD[JESUS], and saying,

2:14 Glory to GOD[JESUS] in the highest, and on earth peace, good will toward
men.

2:15 And it came to pass, as the angels were gone away from them into
heaven, the shepherds said one to another, Let us now go even unto
Bethlehem, and see this thing which is come to pass, which the LORD[JESUS] has
made known unto us.

2:16 And they came with haste, and found Mary, and Joseph, and the babe
lying in a manger.

2:17 And when they had seen it, they made known abroad the saying which
was told them concerning this child.

2:18 And all they that heard it wondered at those things which were told
them by the shepherds.

2:19 But Mary kept all these things, and pondered them in her heart.

2:20 And the shepherds returned, glorifying and praising GOD[JESUS] for all the
things that they had heard and seen, as it was told unto them.

2:21 And when eight days were accomplished for the circumcising of the
child, HIS[JESUS] name was called JESUS, which was so named of the angel before
HE[JESUS] was conceived in the womb.

2:22 And when the days of her purification according to the law of Moses
were accomplished, they brought HIM[JESUS] to Jerusalem, to present HIM[JESUS] to the
LORD[JESUS];

2:23 (As it is written in the law of the LORD[JESUS], Every male that openeth
the womb shall be called holy to the LORD[JESUS];)

2:24 And to offer a sacrifice according to that which is said in the law
of the LORD[JESUS], A pair of turtledoves, or two young pigeons.

2:25 And, behold, there was a man in Jerusalem, whose name was Simeon;
and the same man was just and devout, waiting for the consolation of
Israel: and the Holy Ghost was upon HIM[JESUS].

2:26 And it was revealed unto HIM[JESUS] by the Holy Ghost, that HE[JESUS] should not
see death, before HE[JESUS] had seen the LORD[JESUS]'s CHRIST[JESUS].

2:27 And HE[JESUS] came by the Spirit into the temple: and when the parents
brought in the child JESUS, to do for HIM[JESUS] after the custom of the law,

2:28 Then took HE[JESUS] HIM[JESUS] up in HIS[JESUS] arms, and blessed GOD[JESUS], and said,

2:29 LORD[JESUS], now lettest you your SERVANT[JESUS] depart in peace, according to
your WORD[JESUS]:

2:30 For mine eyes have seen your salvation,

2:31 Which you hast prepared before the face of all people;

2:32 A light to lighten the Gentiles, and the glory of your people
Israel.

2:33 And Joseph and HIS[JESUS] mother marvelled at those things which were
spoken of HIM[JESUS].

2:34 And Simeon blessed them, and said unto Mary HIS[JESUS] mother, Behold,
this child is set for the fall and rising again of many in Israel; and
for a sign which shall be spoken against;

2:35 (Yea, a sword shall pierce through your own soul also,) that the
thoughts of many hearts may be revealed.

2:36 And there was one Anna, a prophetess, the daughter of Phanuel, of
the tribe of Aser: she was of a great age, and had lived with an husband
seven years from her virginity;

2:37 And she was a widow of about fourscore and four years, which
departed not from the temple, but served GOD[JESUS] with fastings and prayers
night and day.

2:38 And she coming in that instant gave thanks likewise unto the LORD[JESUS],
and spake of HIM[JESUS] to all them that looked for redemption in Jerusalem.

2:39 And when they had performed all things according to the law of the
LORD[JESUS], they returned into Galilee, to their own city Nazareth.

2:40 And the child grew, and waxed strong in spirit, filled with wisdom:
and the grace of GOD[JESUS] was upon HIM[JESUS].

2:41 Now HIS[JESUS] parents went to Jerusalem every year at the feast of the
passover.

2:42 And when HE[JESUS] was twelve years old, they went up to Jerusalem after
the custom of the feast.

2:43 And when they had fulfilled the days, as they returned, the child
JESUS tarried behind in Jerusalem; and Joseph and HIS[JESUS] mother knew not of
it.

2:44 But they, supposing HIM[JESUS] to have been in the company, went a day's
journey; and they sought HIM[JESUS] among their kinsfolk and acquaintance.

2:45 And when they found HIM[JESUS] not, they turned back again to Jerusalem,
seeking HIM[JESUS].

2:46 And it came to pass, that after three days they found HIM[JESUS] in the
temple, sitting in the midst of the doctors, both hearing them, and
asking them questions.

2:47 And all that heard HIM[JESUS] were astonished at HIS[JESUS] understanding and
answers.

2:48 And when they saw HIM[JESUS], they were amazed: and HIS[JESUS] mother said unto
HIM[JESUS], SON[JESUS], why hast you thus dealt with us? behold, your father and I
have sought you sorrowing.

2:49 And HE[JESUS] said unto them, How is it that you sought me? wist you not
that I must be about my Father's business?

2:50 And they understood not the saying which HE[JESUS] spake unto them.

2:51 And HE[JESUS] went down with them, and came to Nazareth, and was subject
unto them: but HIS[JESUS] mother kept all these sayings in her heart.

2:52 And JESUS increased in wisdom and stature, and in favour with GOD[JESUS]
and man.


3:1 Now in the fifteenth year of the reign of Tiberius Caesar, Pontius
Pilate being governor of Judaea, and Herod being tetrarch of Galilee,
and HIS[JESUS] brother Philip tetrarch of Ituraea and of the region of
Trachonitis, and Lysanias the tetrarch of Abilene,

3:2 Annas and Caiaphas being the high priests, the WORD[JESUS] of GOD[JESUS] came unto
John the SON[JESUS] of Zacharias in the wilderness.

3:3 And HE[JESUS] came into all the country about Jordan, preaching the baptism
of repentance for the remission of sins;

3:4 As it is written in the book of the words of Esaias the PROPHET[JESUS],
saying, The voice of one crying in the wilderness, Prepare you the way of
the LORD[JESUS], make HIS[JESUS] paths straight.

3:5 Every valley shall be filled, and every mountain and hill shall be
brought low; and the crooked shall be made straight, and the rough ways
shall be made smooth;

3:6 And all flesh shall see the salvation of GOD[JESUS].

3:7 Then said HE[JESUS] to the multitude that came forth to be baptized of HIM[JESUS],
O generation of vipers, who has warned you to flee from the wrath to
come?

3:8 Bring forth therefore fruits worthy of repentance, and begin not to
say within yourselves, We have Abraham to our father: for I say unto
you, That GOD[JESUS] is able of these stones to raise up children unto Abraham.

3:9 And now also the axe is laid unto the ROOT[JESUS] of the trees: every tree
therefore which bringeth not forth good fruit is hewn down, and cast
into the fire.

3:10 And the people asked HIM[JESUS], saying, What shall we do then?

3:11 HE[JESUS] answereth and says unto them, HE[JESUS] that has two coats, let HIM[JESUS]
impart to HIM[JESUS] that has none; and HE[JESUS] that has meat, let HIM[JESUS] do
likewise.

3:12 Then came also publicans to be baptized, and said unto HIM[JESUS], Master,
what shall we do?

3:13 And HE[JESUS] said unto them, Exact no more than that which is appointed
you.

3:14 And the soldiers likewise demanded of HIM[JESUS], saying, And what shall
we do? And HE[JESUS] said unto them, Do violence to no man, neither accuse any
falsely; and be content with your wages.

3:15 And as the people were in expectation, and all men mused in their
hearts of John, whether HE[JESUS] were the CHRIST[JESUS], or not;

3:16 John answered, saying unto them all, I indeed baptize you with
water; but one mightier than I comes, the latchet of whose shoes I am
not worthy to unloose: HE[JESUS] shall baptize you with the Holy Ghost and with
fire:

3:17 Whose fan is in HIS[JESUS] hand, and HE[JESUS] will throughly purge HIS[JESUS] floor,
and will gather the wheat into HIS[JESUS] garner; but the chaff HE[JESUS] will burn
with fire unquenchable.

3:18 And many other things in HIS[JESUS] exhortation preached HE[JESUS] unto the
people.

3:19 But Herod the tetrarch, being reproved by HIM[JESUS] for Herodias HIS[JESUS]
brother Philip's wife, and for all the evils which Herod had done,

3:20 Added yet this above all, that HE[JESUS] shut up John in prison.

3:21 Now when all the people were baptized, it came to pass, that JESUS
also being baptized, and praying, the heaven was opened,

3:22 And the Holy Ghost descended in a bodily shape like a dove upon
HIM[JESUS], and a voice came from heaven, which said, you art my beloved SON[JESUS];
in you I am well pleased.

3:23 And JESUS himself began to be about thirty years of age, being (as
was supposed) the SON[JESUS] of Joseph, which was the SON[JESUS] of Heli,

3:24 Which was the SON[JESUS] of Matthat, which was the SON[JESUS] of Levi, which was
the SON[JESUS] of Melchi, which was the SON[JESUS] of Janna, which was the SON[JESUS] of
Joseph,

3:25 Which was the SON[JESUS] of Mattathias, which was the SON[JESUS] of Amos, which
was the SON[JESUS] of Naum, which was the SON[JESUS] of Esli, which was the SON[JESUS] of
Nagge,

3:26 Which was the SON[JESUS] of Maath, which was the SON[JESUS] of Mattathias, which
was the SON[JESUS] of Semei, which was the SON[JESUS] of Joseph, which was the SON[JESUS] of
Juda,

3:27 Which was the SON[JESUS] of Joanna, which was the SON[JESUS] of Rhesa, which was
the SON[JESUS] of Zorobabel, which was the SON[JESUS] of Salathiel, which was the SON[JESUS]
of Neri,

3:28 Which was the SON[JESUS] of Melchi, which was the SON[JESUS] of Addi, which was
the SON[JESUS] of Cosam, which was the SON[JESUS] of Elmodam, which was the SON[JESUS] of Er,

3:29 Which was the SON[JESUS] of Jose, which was the SON[JESUS] of Eliezer, which was
the SON[JESUS] of Jorim, which was the SON[JESUS] of Matthat, which was the SON[JESUS] of
Levi,

3:30 Which was the SON[JESUS] of Simeon, which was the SON[JESUS] of Juda, which was
the SON[JESUS] of Joseph, which was the SON[JESUS] of Jonan, which was the SON[JESUS] of
Eliakim,

3:31 Which was the SON[JESUS] of Melea, which was the SON[JESUS] of Menan, which was
the SON[JESUS] of Mattatha, which was the SON[JESUS] of Nathan, which was the SON[JESUS] of
David,

3:32 Which was the SON[JESUS] of Jesse, which was the SON[JESUS] of Obed, which was
the SON[JESUS] of Booz, which was the SON[JESUS] of Salmon, which was the SON[JESUS] of
Naasson,

3:33 Which was the SON[JESUS] of Aminadab, which was the SON[JESUS] of Aram, which was
the SON[JESUS] of Esrom, which was the SON[JESUS] of Phares, which was the SON[JESUS] of
Juda,

3:34 Which was the SON[JESUS] of Jacob, which was the SON[JESUS] of Isaac, which was
the SON[JESUS] of Abraham, which was the SON[JESUS] of Thara, which was the SON[JESUS] of
Nachor,

3:35 Which was the SON[JESUS] of Saruch, which was the SON[JESUS] of Ragau, which was
the SON[JESUS] of Phalec, which was the SON[JESUS] of Heber, which was the SON[JESUS] of
Sala,

3:36 Which was the SON[JESUS] of Cainan, which was the SON[JESUS] of Arphaxad, which
was the SON[JESUS] of Sem, which was the SON[JESUS] of Noe, which was the SON[JESUS] of
Lamech,

3:37 Which was the SON[JESUS] of Mathusala, which was the SON[JESUS] of Enoch, which
was the SON[JESUS] of Jared, which was the SON[JESUS] of Maleleel, which was the SON[JESUS]
of Cainan,

3:38 Which was the SON[JESUS] of Enos, which was the SON[JESUS] of Seth, which was the
SON[JESUS] of Adam, which was the SON[JESUS] OF GOD[JESUS][JESUS].


4:1 And JESUS being full of the Holy Ghost returned from Jordan, and was
led by the Spirit into the wilderness,

4:2 Being forty days tempted of the devil. And in those days HE[JESUS] did eat
nothing: and when they were ended, HE[JESUS] afterward hungered.

4:3 And the devil said unto HIM[JESUS], If you be the SON[JESUS] OF GOD[JESUS][JESUS], command this
stone that it be made bread.

4:4 And JESUS answered HIM[JESUS], saying, It is written, That man shall not
live by bread alone, but by every WORD[JESUS] of GOD[JESUS].

4:5 And the devil, taking HIM[JESUS] up into an high mountain, shewed unto HIM[JESUS]
all the kingdoms of the world in a moment of time.

4:6 And the devil said unto HIM[JESUS], All this power will I give you, and
the glory of them: for that is delivered unto me; and to whomsoever I
will I give it.

4:7 If you therefore wilt worship me, all shall be yours.

4:8 And JESUS answered and said unto HIM[JESUS], Get you behind me, Satan: for
it is written, you shalt worship the LORD[JESUS] your GOD[JESUS], and HIM[JESUS] only shalt
you serve.

4:9 And HE[JESUS] brought HIM[JESUS] to Jerusalem, and set HIM[JESUS] on a pinnacle of the
temple, and said unto HIM[JESUS], If you be the SON[JESUS] OF GOD[JESUS][JESUS], cast thyself down
from hence:

4:10 For it is written, HE[JESUS] shall give HIS[JESUS] angels charge over you, to
keep you:

4:11 And in their hands they shall bear you up, lest at any time you
dash your foot against a stone.

4:12 And JESUS answering said unto HIM[JESUS], It is said, you shalt not tempt
the LORD[JESUS] your GOD[JESUS].

4:13 And when the devil had ended all the temptation, HE[JESUS] departed from
HIM[JESUS] for a season.

4:14 And JESUS returned in the power of the Spirit into Galilee: and
there went out a fame of HIM[JESUS] through all the region round about.

4:15 And HE[JESUS] taught in their synagogues, being glorified of all.

4:16 And HE[JESUS] came to Nazareth, where HE[JESUS] had been brought up: and, as HIS[JESUS]
custom was, HE[JESUS] went into the synagogue on the sabbath day, and stood up
for to read.

4:17 And there was delivered unto HIM[JESUS] the book of the PROPHET[JESUS] Esaias.
And when HE[JESUS] had opened the book, HE[JESUS] found the place where it was
written,

4:18 The Spirit of the LORD[JESUS] is upon me, because HE[JESUS] has anointed me to
preach the gospel to the poor; HE[JESUS] has sent me to heal the
brokenhearted, to preach deliverance to the captives, and recovering of
sight to the blind, to set at liberty them that are bruised,

4:19 To preach the acceptable year of the LORD[JESUS].

4:20 And HE[JESUS] closed the book, and HE[JESUS] gave it again to the minister, and
sat down. And the eyes of all them that were in the synagogue were
fastened on HIM[JESUS].

4:21 And HE[JESUS] began to say unto them, This day is this scripture fulfilled
in your ears.

4:22 And all bare HIM[JESUS] witness, and wondered at the gracious words which
proceeded out of HIS[JESUS] mouth. And they said, Is not this Joseph's SON[JESUS]?

4:23 And HE[JESUS] said unto them, you will surely say unto me this proverb,
Physician, heal thyself: whatsoever we have heard done in Capernaum, do
also here in your country.

4:24 And HE[JESUS] said, truly I say unto you, No PROPHET[JESUS] is accepted in HIS[JESUS]
own country.

4:25 But I tell you of a truth, many widows were in Israel in the days
of Elias, when the heaven was shut up three years and six months, when
great famine was throughout all the land;

4:26 But unto none of them was Elias sent, save unto Sarepta, a city of
Sidon, unto a woman that was a widow.

4:27 And many lepers were in Israel in the time of Eliseus the PROPHET[JESUS];
and none of them was cleansed, saving Naaman the Syrian.

4:28 And all they in the synagogue, when they heard these things, were
filled with wrath,

4:29 And rose up, and thrust HIM[JESUS] out of the city, and led HIM[JESUS] unto the
brow of the hill whereon their city was built, that they might cast HIM[JESUS]
down headlong.

4:30 But HE[JESUS] passing through the midst of them went HIS[JESUS] way,

4:31 And came down to Capernaum, a city of Galilee, and taught them on
the sabbath days.

4:32 And they were astonished at HIS[JESUS] doctrine: for HIS[JESUS] WORD[JESUS] was with
power.

4:33 And in the synagogue there was a man, which had a spirit of an
unclean devil, and cried out with a loud voice,

4:34 Saying, Let us alone; what have we to do with you, you JESUS of
Nazareth? art you come to destroy us? I know you who you art; the
Holy One of GOD[JESUS].

4:35 And JESUS rebuked HIM[JESUS], saying, Hold your peace, and come out of HIM[JESUS].
And when the devil had thrown HIM[JESUS] in the midst, HE[JESUS] came out of HIM[JESUS], and
hurt HIM[JESUS] not.

4:36 And they were all amazed, and spake among themselves, saying, What
a WORD[JESUS] is this! for with authority and power HE[JESUS] commandeth the unclean
spirits, and they come out.

4:37 And the fame of HIM[JESUS] went out into every place of the country round
about.

4:38 And HE[JESUS] arose out of the synagogue, and entered into Simon's house.
And Simon's wife's mother was taken with a great fever; and they
besought HIM[JESUS] for her.

4:39 And HE[JESUS] stood over her, and rebuked the fever; and it left her: and
immediately she arose and ministered unto them.

4:40 Now when the sun was setting, all they that had any sick with
divers diseases brought them unto HIM[JESUS]; and HE[JESUS] laid HIS[JESUS] hands on every
one of them, and healed them.

4:41 And devils also came out of many, crying out, and saying, you art
CHRIST[JESUS] the SON[JESUS] OF GOD[JESUS][JESUS]. And HE[JESUS] rebuking them suffered them not to speak:
for they knew that HE[JESUS] was CHRIST[JESUS].

4:42 And when it was day, HE[JESUS] departed and went into a desert place: and
the people sought HIM[JESUS], and came unto HIM[JESUS], and stayed HIM[JESUS], that HE[JESUS] should
not depart from them.

4:43 And HE[JESUS] said unto them, I must preach the kingdom of GOD[JESUS] to other
cities also: for therefore am I sent.

4:44 And HE[JESUS] preached in the synagogues of Galilee.


5:1 And it came to pass, that, as the people pressed upon HIM[JESUS] to hear
the WORD[JESUS] of GOD[JESUS], HE[JESUS] stood by the lake of Gennesaret,

5:2 And saw two ships standing by the lake: but the fishermen were gone
out of them, and were washing their nets.

5:3 And HE[JESUS] entered into one of the ships, which was Simon's, and prayed
HIM[JESUS] that HE[JESUS] would thrust out a little from the land. And HE[JESUS] sat down,
and taught the people out of the ship.

5:4 Now when HE[JESUS] had left speaking, HE[JESUS] said unto Simon, Launch out into
the deep, and let down your nets for a draught.

5:5 And Simon answering said unto HIM[JESUS], Master, we have toiled all the
night, and have taken nothing: nevertheless at your WORD[JESUS] I will let down
the net.

5:6 And when they had this done, they inclosed a great multitude of
fishes: and their net brake.

5:7 And they beckoned unto their partners, which were in the other ship,
that they should come and help them. And they came, and filled both the
ships, so that they began to sink.

5:8 When Simon Peter saw it, HE[JESUS] fell down at JESUS' knees, saying,
Depart from me; for I am a sinful man, O LORD[JESUS].

5:9 For HE[JESUS] was astonished, and all that were with HIM[JESUS], at the draught of
the fishes which they had taken:

5:10 And so was also James, and John, the sons of Zebedee, which were
partners with Simon. And JESUS said unto Simon, Fear not; from
henceforth you shalt catch men.

5:11 And when they had brought their ships to land, they forsook all,
and followed HIM[JESUS].

5:12 And it came to pass, when HE[JESUS] was in a certain city, behold a man
full of leprosy: who seeing JESUS fell on HIS[JESUS] face, and besought HIM[JESUS],
saying, LORD[JESUS], if you wilt, you canst make me clean.

5:13 And HE[JESUS] put forth HIS[JESUS] hand, and touched HIM[JESUS], saying, I will: be you
clean. And immediately the leprosy departed from HIM[JESUS].

5:14 And HE[JESUS] charged HIM[JESUS] to tell no man: but go, and shew thyself to the
priest, and offer for your cleansing, according as Moses commanded, for a
testimony unto them.

5:15 But so much the more went there a fame abroad of HIM[JESUS]: and great
multitudes came together to hear, and to be healed by HIM[JESUS] of their
infirmities.

5:16 And HE[JESUS] withdrew himself into the wilderness, and prayed.

5:17 And it came to pass on a certain day, as HE[JESUS] was teaching, that
there were Pharisees and doctors of the law sitting by, which were come
out of every town of Galilee, and Judaea, and Jerusalem: and the power
of the LORD[JESUS] was present to heal them.

5:18 And, behold, men brought in a bed a man which was taken with a
palsy: and they sought means to bring HIM[JESUS] in, and to lay HIM[JESUS] before HIM[JESUS].

5:19 And when they could not find by what way they might bring HIM[JESUS] in
because of the multitude, they went upon the housetop, and let HIM[JESUS] down
through the tiling with HIS[JESUS] couch into the midst before JESUS.

5:20 And when HE[JESUS] saw their faith, HE[JESUS] said unto HIM[JESUS], Man, your sins are
forgiven you.

5:21 And the scribes and the Pharisees began to reason, saying, Who is
this which speaketh blasphemies? Who can forgive sins, but GOD[JESUS] alone?

5:22 But when JESUS perceived their thoughts, HE[JESUS] answering said unto
them, What reason you in your hearts?

5:23 Whether is easier, to say, your sins be forgiven you; or to say,
Rise up and walk?

5:24 But that you may know that the SON[JESUS] OF MAN[JESUS] has power upon earth to
forgive sins, (HE[JESUS] said unto the sick of the palsy,) I say unto you,
Arise, and take up your couch, and go into yours house.

5:25 And immediately HE[JESUS] rose up before them, and took up that whereon HE[JESUS]
lay, and departed to HIS[JESUS] own house, glorifying GOD[JESUS].

5:26 And they were all amazed, and they glorified GOD[JESUS], and were filled
with fear, saying, We have seen strange things to day.

5:27 And after these things HE[JESUS] went forth, and saw a publican, named
Levi, sitting at the receipt of custom: and HE[JESUS] said unto HIM[JESUS], Follow me.

5:28 And HE[JESUS] left all, rose up, and followed HIM[JESUS].

5:29 And Levi made HIM[JESUS] a great feast in HIS[JESUS] own house: and there was a
great company of publicans and of others that sat down with them.

5:30 But their scribes and Pharisees murmured against HIS[JESUS] disciples,
saying, Why do you eat and drink with publicans and sinners?

5:31 And JESUS answering said unto them, They that are whole need not a
physician; but they that are sick.

5:32 I came not to call the righteous, but sinners to repentance.

5:33 And they said unto HIM[JESUS], Why do the disciples of John fast often,
and make prayers, and likewise the disciples of the Pharisees; but yours
eat and drink?

5:34 And HE[JESUS] said unto them, Can you make the children of the bridechamber
fast, while the bridegroom is with them?

5:35 But the days will come, when the bridegroom shall be taken away
from them, and then shall they fast in those days.

5:36 And HE[JESUS] spake also a parable unto them; No man putteth a piece of a
new garment upon an old; if otherwise, then both the new makes a rent,
and the piece that was taken out of the new agreeth not with the old.

5:37 And no man putteth new wine into old bottles; else the new wine
will burst the bottles, and be spilled, and the bottles shall perish.

5:38 But new wine must be put into new bottles; and both are preserved.

5:39 No man also having drunk old wine straightway desireth new: for HE[JESUS]
says, The old is better.


6:1 And it came to pass on the second sabbath after the first, that HE[JESUS]
went through the corn fields; and HIS[JESUS] disciples plucked the ears of
corn, and did eat, rubbing them in their hands.

6:2 And certain of the Pharisees said unto them, Why do you that which is
not lawful to do on the sabbath days?

6:3 And JESUS answering them said, Have you not read so much as this,
what David did, when himself was an hungred, and they which were with
HIM[JESUS];

6:4 How HE[JESUS] went into the house of GOD[JESUS], and did take and eat the
shewbread, and gave also to them that were with HIM[JESUS]; which it is not
lawful to eat but for the priests alone?

6:5 And HE[JESUS] said unto them, That the SON[JESUS] OF MAN[JESUS] is LORD[JESUS] also of the
sabbath.

6:6 And it came to pass also on another sabbath, that HE[JESUS] entered into
the synagogue and taught: and there was a man whose right hand was
withered.

6:7 And the scribes and Pharisees watched HIM[JESUS], whether HE[JESUS] would heal on
the sabbath day; that they might find an accusation against HIM[JESUS].

6:8 But HE[JESUS] knew their thoughts, and said to the man which had the
withered hand, Rise up, and stand forth in the midst. And HE[JESUS] arose and
stood forth.

6:9 Then said JESUS unto them, I will ask you one thing; Is it lawful on
the sabbath days to do good, or to do evil? to save life, or to destroy
it?

6:10 And looking round about upon them all, HE[JESUS] said unto the man,
Stretch forth your hand. And HE[JESUS] did so: and HIS[JESUS] hand was restored whole
as the other.

6:11 And they were filled with madness; and communed one with another
what they might do to JESUS.

6:12 And it came to pass in those days, that HE[JESUS] went out into a mountain
to pray, and continued all night in prayer to GOD[JESUS].

6:13 And when it was day, HE[JESUS] called unto HIM[JESUS] HIS[JESUS] disciples: and of them
HE[JESUS] chose twelve, whom also HE[JESUS] named apostles;

6:14 Simon, (whom HE[JESUS] also named Peter,) and Andrew HIS[JESUS] brother, James
and John, Philip and Bartholomew,

6:15 Matthew and Thomas, James the SON[JESUS] of Alphaeus, and Simon called
Zelotes,

6:16 And Judas the brother of James, and Judas Iscariot, which also was
the traitor.

6:17 And HE[JESUS] came down with them, and stood in the plain, and the company
of HIS[JESUS] disciples, and a great multitude of people out of all Judaea and
Jerusalem, and from the sea coast of Tyre and Sidon, which came to hear
HIM[JESUS], and to be healed of their diseases;

6:18 And they that were vexed with unclean spirits: and they were
healed.

6:19 And the whole multitude sought to touch HIM[JESUS]: for there went virtue
out of HIM[JESUS], and healed them all.

6:20 And HE[JESUS] lifted up HIS[JESUS] eyes on HIS[JESUS] disciples, and said, Blessed be you
poor: for yours is the kingdom of GOD[JESUS].

6:21 Blessed are you that hunger now: for you shall be filled. Blessed are
you that weep now: for you shall laugh.

6:22 Blessed are you, when men shall hate you, and when they shall
separate you from their company, and shall reproach you, and cast out
your name as evil, for the SON[JESUS] OF MAN[JESUS]'s sake.

6:23 Rejoice you in that day, and leap for joy: for, behold, your reward
is great in heaven: for in the like manner did their fathers unto the
prophets.

6:24 But woe unto you that are rich! for you have received your
consolation.

6:25 Woe unto you that are full! for you shall hunger. Woe unto you that
laugh now! for you shall mourn and weep.

6:26 Woe unto you, when all men shall speak well of you! for so did
their fathers to the false prophets.

6:27 But I say unto you which hear, Love your enemies, do good to them
which hate you,

6:28 Bless them that curse you, and pray for them which despitefully use
you.

6:29 And unto HIM[JESUS] that smiteth you on the one cheek offer also the
other; and HIM[JESUS] that taketh away your cloak forbid not to take your coat
also.

6:30 Give to every man that asketh of you; and of HIM[JESUS] that taketh away
your goods ask them not again.

6:31 And as you would that men should do to you, do you also to them
likewise.

6:32 For if you love them which love you, what thank have you? for sinners
also love those that love them.

6:33 And if you do good to them which do good to you, what thank have you?
for sinners also do even the same.

6:34 And if you lend to them of whom you hope to receive, what thank have
you? for sinners also lend to sinners, to receive as much again.

6:35 But love you your enemies, and do good, and lend, hoping for nothing
again; and your reward shall be great, and you shall be the children of
the Highest: for HE[JESUS] is kind unto the unthankful and to the evil.

6:36 Be you therefore merciful, as your Father also is merciful.

6:37 Judge not, and you shall not be judged: condemn not, and you shall
not be condemned: forgive, and you shall be forgiven:

6:38 Give, and it shall be given unto you; good measure, pressed down,
and shaken together, and running over, shall men give into your bosom.
For with the same measure that you mete withal it shall be measured to
you again.

6:39 And HE[JESUS] spake a parable unto them, Can the blind lead the blind?
shall they not both fall into the ditch?

6:40 The disciple is not above HIS[JESUS] master: but every one that is perfect
shall be as HIS[JESUS] master.

6:41 And why beholdest you the mote that is in your brother's eye, but
perceivest not the beam that is in yours own eye?

6:42 Either how canst you say to your brother, Brother, let me pull out
the mote that is in yours eye, when you thyself beholdest not the beam
that is in yours own eye? you hypocrite, cast out first the beam out of
yours own eye, and then shalt you see clearly to pull out the mote that
is in your brother's eye.

6:43 For a good tree bringeth not forth corrupt fruit; neither does a
corrupt tree bring forth good fruit.

6:44 For every tree is known by HIS[JESUS] own fruit. For of thorns men do not
gather figs, nor of a bramble bush gather they grapes.

6:45 A good man out of the good treasure of HIS[JESUS] heart bringeth forth
that which is good; and an evil man out of the evil treasure of HIS[JESUS]
heart bringeth forth that which is evil: for of the abundance of the
heart HIS[JESUS] mouth speaketh.

6:46 And why call you me, LORD[JESUS], LORD[JESUS], and do not the things which I say?

6:47 whoever comes to me, and heareth my sayings, and doeth them, I
will shew you to whom HE[JESUS] is like:

6:48 HE[JESUS] is like a man which built an house, and digged deep, and laid
the foundation on a rock: and when the flood arose, the stream beat
vehemently upon that house, and could not shake it: for it was founded
upon a rock.

6:49 But HE[JESUS] that heareth, and doeth not, is like a man that without a
foundation built an house upon the earth; against which the stream did
beat vehemently, and immediately it fell; and the ruin of that house was
great.


7:1 Now when HE[JESUS] had ended all HIS[JESUS] sayings in the audience of the people,
HE[JESUS] entered into Capernaum.

7:2 And a certain centurion's SERVANT[JESUS], who was dear unto HIM[JESUS], was sick,
and ready to die.

7:3 And when HE[JESUS] heard of JESUS, HE[JESUS] sent unto HIM[JESUS] the elders of the Jews,
beseeching HIM[JESUS] that HE[JESUS] would come and heal HIS[JESUS] SERVANT[JESUS].

7:4 And when they came to JESUS, they besought HIM[JESUS] instantly, saying,
That HE[JESUS] was worthy for whom HE[JESUS] should do this:

7:5 For HE[JESUS] loveth our nation, and HE[JESUS] has built us a synagogue.

7:6 Then JESUS went with them. And when HE[JESUS] was now not far from the
house, the centurion sent friends to HIM[JESUS], saying unto HIM[JESUS], LORD[JESUS], trouble
not thyself: for I am not worthy that you shouldest enter under my
roof:

7:7 Wherefore neither thought I myself worthy to come unto you: but say
in a WORD[JESUS], and my SERVANT[JESUS] shall be healed.

7:8 For I also am a man set under authority, having under me soldiers,
and I say unto one, Go, and HE[JESUS] goes; and to another, Come, and HE[JESUS]
comes; and to my SERVANT[JESUS], Do this, and HE[JESUS] doeth it.

7:9 When JESUS heard these things, HE[JESUS] marvelled at HIM[JESUS], and turned HIM[JESUS]
about, and said unto the people that followed HIM[JESUS], I say unto you, I
have not found so great faith, no, not in Israel.

7:10 And they that were sent, returning to the house, found the SERVANT[JESUS]
whole that had been sick.

7:11 And it came to pass the day after, that HE[JESUS] went into a city called
