Nain; and many of HIS[JESUS] disciples went with HIM[JESUS], and much people.

7:12 Now when HE[JESUS] came nigh to the gate of the city, behold, there was a
dead man carried out, the only SON[JESUS] of HIS[JESUS] mother, and she was a widow:
and much people of the city was with her.

7:13 And when the LORD[JESUS] saw her, HE[JESUS] had compassion on her, and said unto
her, Weep not.

7:14 And HE[JESUS] came and touched the bier: and they that bare HIM[JESUS] stood
still. And HE[JESUS] said, Young man, I say unto you, Arise.

7:15 And HE[JESUS] that was dead sat up, and began to speak. And HE[JESUS] delivered
HIM[JESUS] to HIS[JESUS] mother.

7:16 And there came a fear on all: and they glorified GOD[JESUS], saying, That
a great PROPHET[JESUS] is risen up among us; and, That GOD[JESUS] has visited HIS[JESUS]
people.

7:17 And this rumour of HIM[JESUS] went forth throughout all Judaea, and
throughout all the region round about.

7:18 And the disciples of John shewed HIM[JESUS] of all these things.

7:19 And John calling unto HIM[JESUS] two of HIS[JESUS] disciples sent them to JESUS,
saying, Art you HE[JESUS] that should come? or look we for another?

7:20 When the men were come unto HIM[JESUS], they said, John Baptist has sent
us unto you, saying, Art you HE[JESUS] that should come? or look we for
another?

7:21 And in that same hour HE[JESUS] cured many of their infirmities and
plagues, and of evil spirits; and unto many that were blind HE[JESUS] gave
sight.

7:22 Then JESUS answering said unto them, Go your way, and tell John
what things you have seen and heard; how that the blind see, the lame
walk, the lepers are cleansed, the deaf hear, the dead are raised, to
the poor the gospel is preached.

7:23 And blessed is HE[JESUS], whoever shall not be offended in me.

7:24 And when the messengers of John were departed, HE[JESUS] began to speak
unto the people concerning John, What went you out into the wilderness
for to see? A reed shaken with the wind?

7:25 But what went you out for to see? A man clothed in soft raiment?
Behold, they which are gorgeously apparelled, and live delicately, are
in kings' courts.

7:26 But what went you out for to see? A PROPHET[JESUS]? Yea, I say unto you,
and much more than a PROPHET[JESUS].

7:27 This is HE[JESUS], of whom it is written, Behold, I send my messenger
before your face, which shall prepare your way before you.

7:28 For I say unto you, Among those that are born of women there is not
a greater PROPHET[JESUS] than John the Baptist: but HE[JESUS] that is least in the
kingdom of GOD[JESUS] is greater than HE[JESUS].

7:29 And all the people that heard HIM[JESUS], and the publicans, justified
GOD[JESUS], being baptized with the baptism of John.

7:30 But the Pharisees and lawyers rejected the counsel of GOD[JESUS] against
themselves, being not baptized of HIM[JESUS].

7:31 And the LORD[JESUS] said, Whereunto then shall I liken the men of this
generation? and to what are they like?

7:32 They are like unto children sitting in the marketplace, and calling
one to another, and saying, We have piped unto you, and you have not
danced; we have mourned to you, and you have not wept.

7:33 For John the Baptist came neither eating bread nor drinking wine;
and you say, HE[JESUS] has a devil.

7:34 The SON[JESUS] OF MAN[JESUS] is come eating and drinking; and you say, Behold a
gluttonous man, and a winebibber, a friend of publicans and sinners!

7:35 But wisdom is justified of all her children.

7:36 And one of the Pharisees desired HIM[JESUS] that HE[JESUS] would eat with HIM[JESUS].
And HE[JESUS] went into the Pharisee's house, and sat down to meat.

7:37 And, behold, a woman in the city, which was a sinner, when she knew
that JESUS sat at meat in the Pharisee's house, brought an alabaster box
of ointment,

7:38 And stood at HIS[JESUS] feet behind HIM[JESUS] weeping, and began to wash HIS[JESUS]
feet with tears, and did wipe them with the hairs of her head, and
kissed HIS[JESUS] feet, and anointed them with the ointment.

7:39 Now when the Pharisee which had bidden HIM[JESUS] saw it, HE[JESUS] spake within
himself, saying, This man, if HE[JESUS] were a PROPHET[JESUS], would have known who
and what manner of woman this is that toucheth HIM[JESUS]: for she is a sinner.

7:40 And JESUS answering said unto HIM[JESUS], Simon, I have somewhat to say
unto you. And HE[JESUS] says, Master, say on.

7:41 There was a certain creditor which had two debtors: the one owed
five hundred pence, and the other fifty.

7:42 And when they had nothing to pay, HE[JESUS] frankly forgave them both.
Tell me therefore, which of them will love HIM[JESUS] most?

7:43 Simon answered and said, I suppose that HE[JESUS], to whom HE[JESUS] forgave
most. And HE[JESUS] said unto HIM[JESUS], you hast rightly judged.

7:44 And HE[JESUS] turned to the woman, and said unto Simon, Seest you this
woman? I entered into yours house, you gavest me no water for my feet:
but she has washed my feet with tears, and wiped them with the hairs of
her head.

7:45 you gavest me no kiss: but this woman since the time I came in
has not ceased to kiss my feet.

7:46 My head with oil you didst not anoint: but this woman has
anointed my feet with ointment.

7:47 Wherefore I say unto you, Her sins, which are many, are forgiven;
for she loved much: but to whom little is forgiven, the same loveth
little.

7:48 And HE[JESUS] said unto her, your sins are forgiven.

7:49 And they that sat at meat with HIM[JESUS] began to say within themselves,
Who is this that forgiveth sins also?

7:50 And HE[JESUS] said to the woman, your faith has saved you; go in peace.


8:1 And it came to pass afterward, that HE[JESUS] went throughout every city
and village, preaching and shewing the glad tidings of the kingdom of
GOD[JESUS]: and the twelve were with HIM[JESUS],

8:2 And certain women, which had been healed of evil spirits and
infirmities, Mary called Magdalene, out of whom went seven devils,

8:3 And Joanna the wife of Chuza Herod's steward, and Susanna, and many
others, which ministered unto HIM[JESUS] of their substance.

8:4 And when much people were gathered together, and were come to HIM[JESUS]
out of every city, HE[JESUS] spake by a parable:

8:5 A sower went out to sow HIS[JESUS] SEED[JESUS]: and as HE[JESUS] sowed, some fell by the
way side; and it was trodden down, and the fowls of the air devoured it.

8:6 And some fell upon a rock; and as soon as it was sprung up, it
withered away, because it lacked moisture.

8:7 And some fell among thorns; and the thorns sprang up with it, and
choked it.

8:8 And other fell on good ground, and sprang up, and bare fruit an
hundredfold. And when HE[JESUS] had said these things, HE[JESUS] cried, HE[JESUS] that has
ears to hear, let HIM[JESUS] hear.

8:9 And HIS[JESUS] disciples asked HIM[JESUS], saying, What might this parable be?

8:10 And HE[JESUS] said, Unto you it is given to know the mysteries of the
kingdom of GOD[JESUS]: but to others in parables; that seeing they might not
see, and hearing they might not understand.

8:11 Now the parable is this: The SEED[JESUS] is the WORD[JESUS] of GOD[JESUS].

8:12 Those by the way side are they that hear; then comes the devil,
and taketh away the WORD[JESUS] out of their hearts, lest they should believe
and be saved.

8:13 They on the rock are they, which, when they hear, receive the WORD[JESUS]
with joy; and these have no ROOT[JESUS], which for a while believe, and in time
of temptation fall away.

8:14 And that which fell among thorns are they, which, when they have
heard, go forth, and are choked with cares and riches and pleasures of
this life, and bring no fruit to perfection.

8:15 But that on the good ground are they, which in an honest and good
heart, having heard the WORD[JESUS], keep it, and bring forth fruit with
patience.

8:16 No man, when HE[JESUS] has lighted a candle, covereth it with a vessel,
or putteth it under a bed; but setteth it on a candlestick, that they
which enter in may see the light.

8:17 For nothing is secret, that shall not be made manifest; neither any
thing hid, that shall not be known and come abroad.

8:18 Take heed therefore how you hear: for whoever has, to HIM[JESUS] shall
be given; and whoever has not, from HIM[JESUS] shall be taken even that
which HE[JESUS] seemeth to have.

8:19 Then came to HIM[JESUS] HIS[JESUS] mother and HIS[JESUS] brethren, and could not come at
HIM[JESUS] for the press.

8:20 And it was told HIM[JESUS] by certain which said, your mother and your
brethren stand without, desiring to see you.

8:21 And HE[JESUS] answered and said unto them, My mother and my brethren are
these which hear the WORD[JESUS] of GOD[JESUS], and do it.

8:22 Now it came to pass on a certain day, that HE[JESUS] went into a ship with
HIS[JESUS] disciples: and HE[JESUS] said unto them, Let us go over unto the other side
of the lake. And they launched forth.

8:23 But as they sailed HE[JESUS] fell asleep: and there came down a storm of
wind on the lake; and they were filled with water, and were in jeopardy.

8:24 And they came to HIM[JESUS], and awoke HIM[JESUS], saying, Master, master, we
perish. Then HE[JESUS] arose, and rebuked the wind and the raging of the water:
and they ceased, and there was a calm.

8:25 And HE[JESUS] said unto them, Where is your faith? And they being afraid
wondered, saying one to another, What manner of man is this! for HE[JESUS]
commandeth even the winds and water, and they obey HIM[JESUS].

8:26 And they arrived at the country of the Gadarenes, which is over
against Galilee.

8:27 And when HE[JESUS] went forth to land, there met HIM[JESUS] out of the city a
certain man, which had devils long time, and ware no clothes, neither
abode in any house, but in the tombs.

8:28 When HE[JESUS] saw JESUS, HE[JESUS] cried out, and fell down before HIM[JESUS], and with
a loud voice said, What have I to do with you, JESUS, you SON[JESUS] OF GOD[JESUS][JESUS]
most high? I beseech you, torment me not.

8:29 (For HE[JESUS] had commanded the unclean spirit to come out of the man.
For oftentimes it had caught HIM[JESUS]: and HE[JESUS] was kept bound with chains and
in fetters; and HE[JESUS] brake the bands, and was driven of the devil into the
wilderness.)

8:30 And JESUS asked HIM[JESUS], saying, What is your name? And HE[JESUS] said, Legion:
because many devils were entered into HIM[JESUS].

8:31 And they besought HIM[JESUS] that HE[JESUS] would not command them to go out into
the deep.

8:32 And there was there an herd of many swine feeding on the mountain:
and they besought HIM[JESUS] that HE[JESUS] would let them to enter into them. And
HE[JESUS] suffered them.

8:33 Then went the devils out of the man, and entered into the swine:
and the herd ran violently down a steep place into the lake, and were
choked.

8:34 When they that fed them saw what was done, they fled, and went and
told it in the city and in the country.

8:35 Then they went out to see what was done; and came to JESUS, and
found the man, out of whom the devils were departed, sitting at the feet
of JESUS, clothed, and in HIS[JESUS] right mind: and they were afraid.

8:36 They also which saw it told them by what means HE[JESUS] that was
possessed of the devils was healed.

8:37 Then the whole multitude of the country of the Gadarenes round
about besought HIM[JESUS] to depart from them; for they were taken with great
fear: and HE[JESUS] went up into the ship, and returned back again.

8:38 Now the man out of whom the devils were departed besought HIM[JESUS] that
HE[JESUS] might be with HIM[JESUS]: but JESUS sent HIM[JESUS] away, saying,

8:39 Return to yours own house, and shew how great things GOD[JESUS] has done
unto you. And HE[JESUS] went HIS[JESUS] way, and published throughout the whole city
how great things JESUS had done unto HIM[JESUS].

8:40 And it came to pass, that, when JESUS was returned, the people
gladly received HIM[JESUS]: for they were all waiting for HIM[JESUS].

8:41 And, behold, there came a man named Jairus, and HE[JESUS] was a ruler of
the synagogue: and HE[JESUS] fell down at JESUS' feet, and besought HIM[JESUS] that HE[JESUS]
would come into HIS[JESUS] house:

8:42 For HE[JESUS] had one only daughter, about twelve years of age, and she
lay a dying. But as HE[JESUS] went the people thronged HIM[JESUS].

8:43 And a woman having an issue of blood twelve years, which had spent
all her living upon physicians, neither could be healed of any,

8:44 Came behind HIM[JESUS], and touched the border of HIS[JESUS] garment: and
immediately her issue of blood stanched.

8:45 And JESUS said, Who touched me? When all denied, Peter and they
that were with HIM[JESUS] said, Master, the multitude throng you and press
you, and sayest you, Who touched me?

8:46 And JESUS said, Somebody has touched me: for I perceive that
virtue is gone out of me.

8:47 And when the woman saw that she was not hid, she came trembling,
and falling down before HIM[JESUS], she declared unto HIM[JESUS] before all the people
for what cause she had touched HIM[JESUS], and how she was healed immediately.

8:48 And HE[JESUS] said unto her, Daughter, be of good comfort: your faith has
made you whole; go in peace.

8:49 While HE[JESUS] yet spake, there comes one from the ruler of the
synagogue's house, saying to HIM[JESUS], your daughter is dead; trouble not the
Master.

8:50 But when JESUS heard it, HE[JESUS] answered HIM[JESUS], saying, Fear not: believe
only, and she shall be made whole.

8:51 And when HE[JESUS] came into the house, HE[JESUS] suffered no man to go in, save
Peter, and James, and John, and the father and the mother of the maiden.

8:52 And all wept, and bewailed her: but HE[JESUS] said, Weep not; she is not
dead, but sleepeth.

8:53 And they laughed HIM[JESUS] to scorn, knowing that she was dead.

8:54 And HE[JESUS] put them all out, and took her by the hand, and called,
saying, Maid, arise.

8:55 And her spirit came again, and she arose straightway: and HE[JESUS]
commanded to give her meat.

8:56 And her parents were astonished: but HE[JESUS] charged them that they
should tell no man what was done.


9:1 Then HE[JESUS] called HIS[JESUS] twelve disciples together, and gave them power
and authority over all devils, and to cure diseases.

9:2 And HE[JESUS] sent them to preach the kingdom of GOD[JESUS], and to heal the sick.

9:3 And HE[JESUS] said unto them, Take nothing for your journey, neither
staves, nor scrip, neither bread, neither money; neither have two coats
apiece.

9:4 And whatsoever house you enter into, there abide, and thence depart.

9:5 And whoever will not receive you, when you go out of that city,
shake off the very dust from your feet for a testimony against them.

9:6 And they departed, and went through the towns, preaching the gospel,
and healing every where.

9:7 Now Herod the tetrarch heard of all that was done by HIM[JESUS]: and HE[JESUS] was
perplexed, because that it was said of some, that John was risen from
the dead;

9:8 And of some, that Elias had appeared; and of others, that one of the
old prophets was risen again.

9:9 And Herod said, John have I beheaded: but who is this, of whom I
hear such things? And HE[JESUS] desired to see HIM[JESUS].

9:10 And the apostles, when they were returned, told HIM[JESUS] all that they
had done. And HE[JESUS] took them, and went aside privately into a desert place
belonging to the city called Bethsaida.

9:11 And the people, when they knew it, followed HIM[JESUS]: and HE[JESUS] received
them, and spake unto them of the kingdom of GOD[JESUS], and healed them that
had need of healing.

9:12 And when the day began to wear away, then came the twelve, and said
unto HIM[JESUS], Send the multitude away, that they may go into the towns and
country round about, and lodge, and get victuals: for we are here in a
desert place.

9:13 But HE[JESUS] said unto them, Give you them to eat. And they said, We have
no more but five loaves and two fishes; except we should go and buy meat
for all this people.

9:14 For they were about five thousand men. And HE[JESUS] said to HIS[JESUS]
disciples, Make them sit down by fifties in a company.

9:15 And they did so, and made them all sit down.

9:16 Then HE[JESUS] took the five loaves and the two fishes, and looking up to
heaven, HE[JESUS] blessed them, and brake, and gave to the disciples to set
before the multitude.

9:17 And they did eat, and were all filled: and there was taken up of
fragments that remained to them twelve baskets.

9:18 And it came to pass, as HE[JESUS] was alone praying, HIS[JESUS] disciples were
with HIM[JESUS]: and HE[JESUS] asked them, saying, Whom say the people that I am?

9:19 They answering said, John the Baptist; but some say, Elias; and
others say, that one of the old prophets is risen again.

9:20 HE[JESUS] said unto them, But whom say you that I am? Peter answering said,
The CHRIST[JESUS] of GOD[JESUS].

9:21 And HE[JESUS] straitly charged them, and commanded them to tell no man
that thing;

9:22 Saying, The SON[JESUS] OF MAN[JESUS] must let many things, and be rejected of
the elders and chief priests and scribes, and be slain, and be raised
the third day.

9:23 And HE[JESUS] said to them all, If any man will come after me, let HIM[JESUS]
deny himself, and take up HIS[JESUS] cross daily, and follow me.

9:24 For whoever will save HIS[JESUS] life shall lose it: but whoever will
lose HIS[JESUS] life for my sake, the same shall save it.

9:25 For what is a man advantaged, if HE[JESUS] gain the whole world, and lose
himself, or be cast away?

9:26 For whoever shall be ashamed of me and of my words, of HIM[JESUS] shall
the SON[JESUS] OF MAN[JESUS] be ashamed, when HE[JESUS] shall come in HIS[JESUS] own glory, and in
HIS[JESUS] Father's, and of the holy angels.

9:27 But I tell you of a truth, there be some standing here, which shall
not taste of death, till they see the kingdom of GOD[JESUS].

9:28 And it came to pass about an eight days after these sayings, HE[JESUS]
took Peter and John and James, and went up into a mountain to pray.

9:29 And as HE[JESUS] prayed, the fashion of HIS[JESUS] countenance was altered, and
HIS[JESUS] raiment was white and glistering.

9:30 And, behold, there talked with HIM[JESUS] two men, which were Moses and
Elias:

9:31 Who appeared in glory, and spake of HIS[JESUS] decease which HE[JESUS] should
accomplish at Jerusalem.

9:32 But Peter and they that were with HIM[JESUS] were heavy with sleep: and
when they were awake, they saw HIS[JESUS] glory, and the two men that stood
with HIM[JESUS].

9:33 And it came to pass, as they departed from HIM[JESUS], Peter said unto
JESUS, Master, it is good for us to be here: and let us make three
tabernacles; one for you, and one for Moses, and one for Elias: not
knowing what HE[JESUS] said.

9:34 While HE[JESUS] thus spake, there came a cloud, and overshadowed them: and
they feared as they entered into the cloud.

9:35 And there came a voice out of the cloud, saying, This is my beloved
SON[JESUS]: hear HIM[JESUS].

9:36 And when the voice was past, JESUS was found alone. And they kept
it close, and told no man in those days any of those things which they
had seen.

9:37 And it came to pass, that on the next day, when they were come down
from the hill, much people met HIM[JESUS].

9:38 And, behold, a man of the company cried out, saying, Master, I
beseech you, look upon my SON[JESUS]: for HE[JESUS] is mine only child.

9:39 And, lo, a spirit taketh HIM[JESUS], and HE[JESUS] suddenly crieth out; and it
teareth HIM[JESUS] that HE[JESUS] foameth again, and bruising HIM[JESUS] hardly departeth
from HIM[JESUS].

9:40 And I besought your disciples to cast HIM[JESUS] out; and they could not.

9:41 And JESUS answering said, O faithless and perverse generation, how
long shall I be with you, and let you? Bring your SON[JESUS] hither.

9:42 And as HE[JESUS] was yet a coming, the devil threw HIM[JESUS] down, and tare HIM[JESUS].
And JESUS rebuked the unclean spirit, and healed the child, and
delivered HIM[JESUS] again to HIS[JESUS] father.

9:43 And they were all amazed at the mighty power of GOD[JESUS]. But while they
wondered every one at all things which JESUS did, HE[JESUS] said unto HIS[JESUS]
disciples,

9:44 Let these sayings sink down into your ears: for the SON[JESUS] OF MAN[JESUS]
shall be delivered into the hands of men.

9:45 But they understood not this saying, and it was hid from them, that
they perceived it not: and they feared to ask HIM[JESUS] of that saying.

9:46 Then there arose a reasoning among them, which of them should be
greatest.

9:47 And JESUS, perceiving the thought of their heart, took a child, and
set HIM[JESUS] by HIM[JESUS],

9:48 And said unto them, whoever shall receive this child in my name
receiveth me: and whoever shall receive me receiveth HIM[JESUS] that sent me:
for HE[JESUS] that is least among you all, the same shall be great.

9:49 And John answered and said, Master, we saw one casting out devils
in your name; and we forbad HIM[JESUS], because HE[JESUS] followeth not with us.

9:50 And JESUS said unto HIM[JESUS], Forbid HIM[JESUS] not: for HE[JESUS] that is not against
us is for us.

9:51 And it came to pass, when the time was come that HE[JESUS] should be
received up, HE[JESUS] stedfastly set HIS[JESUS] face to go to Jerusalem,

9:52 And sent messengers before HIS[JESUS] face: and they went, and entered
into a village of the Samaritans, to make ready for HIM[JESUS].

9:53 And they did not receive HIM[JESUS], because HIS[JESUS] face was as though HE[JESUS]
would go to Jerusalem.

9:54 And when HIS[JESUS] disciples James and John saw this, they said, LORD[JESUS],
wilt you that we command fire to come down from heaven, and consume
them, even as Elias did?

9:55 But HE[JESUS] turned, and rebuked them, and said, you know not what manner
of spirit you are of.

9:56 For the SON[JESUS] OF MAN[JESUS] is not come to destroy men's lives, but to save
them. And they went to another village.

9:57 And it came to pass, that, as they went in the way, a certain man
said unto HIM[JESUS], LORD[JESUS], I will follow you whithersoever you goest.

9:58 And JESUS said unto HIM[JESUS], Foxes have holes, and birds of the air
have nests; but the SON[JESUS] OF MAN[JESUS] has not where to lay HIS[JESUS] head.

9:59 And HE[JESUS] said unto another, Follow me. But HE[JESUS] said, LORD[JESUS], let me
first to go and bury my father.

9:60 JESUS said unto HIM[JESUS], Let the dead bury their dead: but go you and
preach the kingdom of GOD[JESUS].

9:61 And another also said, LORD[JESUS], I will follow you; but let me first
go bid them farewell, which are at home at my house.

9:62 And JESUS said unto HIM[JESUS], No man, having put HIS[JESUS] hand to the plough,
and looking back, is fit for the kingdom of GOD[JESUS].


10:1 After these things the LORD[JESUS] appointed other seventy also, and sent
them two and two before HIS[JESUS] face into every city and place, whither HE[JESUS]
himself would come.

10:2 Therefore said HE[JESUS] unto them, The harvest truly is great, but the
labourers are few: pray you therefore the LORD[JESUS] of the harvest, that HE[JESUS]
would send forth labourers into HIS[JESUS] harvest.

10:3 Go your ways: behold, I send you forth as lambs among wolves.

10:4 Carry neither purse, nor scrip, nor shoes: and salute no man by the
way.

10:5 And into whatsoever house you enter, first say, Peace be to this
house.

10:6 And if the SON[JESUS] of peace be there, your peace shall rest upon it: if
not, it shall turn to you again.

10:7 And in the same house remain, eating and drinking such things as
they give: for the labourer is worthy of HIS[JESUS] hire. Go not from house to
house.

10:8 And into whatsoever city you enter, and they receive you, eat such
things as are set before you:

10:9 And heal the sick that are therein, and say unto them, The kingdom
of GOD[JESUS] is come nigh unto you.

10:10 But into whatsoever city you enter, and they receive you not, go
your ways out into the streets of the same, and say,

10:11 Even the very dust of your city, which cleaveth on us, we do wipe
off against you: notwithstanding be you sure of this, that the kingdom of
GOD[JESUS] is come nigh unto you.

10:12 But I say unto you, that it shall be more tolerable in that day
for Sodom, than for that city.

10:13 Woe unto you, Chorazin! woe unto you, Bethsaida! for if the
mighty works had been done in Tyre and Sidon, which have been done in
you, they had a great while ago repented, sitting in sackcloth and
ashes.

10:14 But it shall be more tolerable for Tyre and Sidon at the judgment,
than for you.

10:15 And you, Capernaum, which art exalted to heaven, shalt be thrust
down to hell.

10:16 HE[JESUS] that heareth you heareth me; and HE[JESUS] that despiseth you
despiseth me; and HE[JESUS] that despiseth me despiseth HIM[JESUS] that sent me.

10:17 And the seventy returned again with joy, saying, LORD[JESUS], even the
devils are subject unto us through your name.

10:18 And HE[JESUS] said unto them, I beheld Satan as lightning fall from
heaven.

10:19 Behold, I give unto you power to tread on serpents and scorpions,
and over all the power of the enemy: and nothing shall by any means hurt
you.

10:20 Notwithstanding in this rejoice not, that the spirits are subject
unto you; but rather rejoice, because your names are written in heaven.

10:21 In that hour JESUS rejoiced in spirit, and said, I thank you, O
Father, LORD[JESUS] of heaven and earth, that you hast hid these things from
the wise and prudent, and hast revealed them unto babes: even so,
Father; for so it seemed good in your sight.

10:22 All things are delivered to me of my Father: and no man knoweth
who the SON[JESUS] is, but the Father; and who the Father is, but the SON[JESUS], and
HE[JESUS] to whom the SON[JESUS] will reveal HIM[JESUS].

10:23 And HE[JESUS] turned HIM[JESUS] unto HIS[JESUS] disciples, and said privately, Blessed
are the eyes which see the things that you see:

10:24 For I tell you, that many prophets and kings have desired to see
those things which you see, and have not seen them; and to hear those
things which you hear, and have not heard them.

10:25 And, behold, a certain lawyer stood up, and tempted HIM[JESUS], saying,
Master, what shall I do to inherit eternal life?

10:26 HE[JESUS] said unto HIM[JESUS], What is written in the law? how readest you?

10:27 And HE[JESUS] answering said, you shalt love the LORD[JESUS] your GOD[JESUS] with all
your heart, and with all your soul, and with all your strength, and with
all your mind; and your neighbour as thyself.

10:28 And HE[JESUS] said unto HIM[JESUS], you hast answered right: this do, and you
shalt live.

10:29 But HE[JESUS], willing to justify himself, said unto JESUS, And who is my
neighbour?

10:30 And JESUS answering said, A certain man went down from Jerusalem
to Jericho, and fell among thieves, which stripped HIM[JESUS] of HIS[JESUS] raiment,
and wounded HIM[JESUS], and departed, leaving HIM[JESUS] half dead.

10:31 And by chance there came down a certain priest that way: and when
HE[JESUS] saw HIM[JESUS], HE[JESUS] passed by on the other side.

10:32 And likewise a Levite, when HE[JESUS] was at the place, came and looked
on HIM[JESUS], and passed by on the other side.

10:33 But a certain Samaritan, as HE[JESUS] journeyed, came where HE[JESUS] was: and
when HE[JESUS] saw HIM[JESUS], HE[JESUS] had compassion on HIM[JESUS],

10:34 And went to HIM[JESUS], and bound up HIS[JESUS] wounds, pouring in oil and wine,
and set HIM[JESUS] on HIS[JESUS] own beast, and brought HIM[JESUS] to an inn, and took care
of HIM[JESUS].

10:35 And on the morrow when HE[JESUS] departed, HE[JESUS] took out two pence, and
gave them to the host, and said unto HIM[JESUS], Take care of HIM[JESUS]; and
whatsoever you spendest more, when I come again, I will repay you.

10:36 Which now of these three, thinkest you, was neighbour unto HIM[JESUS]
that fell among the thieves?

10:37 And HE[JESUS] said, HE[JESUS] that shewed mercy on HIM[JESUS]. Then said JESUS unto
HIM[JESUS], Go, and do you likewise.

10:38 Now it came to pass, as they went, that HE[JESUS] entered into a certain
village: and a certain woman named Martha received HIM[JESUS] into her house.

10:39 And she had a sister called Mary, which also sat at JESUS' feet,
and heard HIS[JESUS] WORD[JESUS].

10:40 But Martha was cumbered about much serving, and came to HIM[JESUS], and
said, LORD[JESUS], dost you not care that my sister has left me to serve
alone? bid her therefore that she help me.

10:41 And JESUS answered and said unto her, Martha, Martha, you art
careful and troubled about many things:

10:42 But one thing is needful: and Mary has chosen that good part,
which shall not be taken away from her.


11:1 And it came to pass, that, as HE[JESUS] was praying in a certain place,
when HE[JESUS] ceased, one of HIS[JESUS] disciples said unto HIM[JESUS], LORD[JESUS], teach us to
pray, as John also taught HIS[JESUS] disciples.

11:2 And HE[JESUS] said unto them, When you pray, say, Our Father which art in
heaven, Hallowed be your name. your kingdom come. your will be done, as in
heaven, so in earth.

11:3 Give us day by day our daily bread.

11:4 And forgive us our sins; for we also forgive every one that is
indebted to us. And lead us not into temptation; but deliver us from
evil.

11:5 And HE[JESUS] said unto them, Which of you shall have a friend, and shall
go unto HIM[JESUS] at midnight, and say unto HIM[JESUS], Friend, lend me three loaves;

11:6 For a friend of mine in HIS[JESUS] journey is come to me, and I have
nothing to set before HIM[JESUS]?

11:7 And HE[JESUS] from within shall answer and say, Trouble me not: the door
is now shut, and my children are with me in bed; I cannot rise and give
you.

11:8 I say unto you, Though HE[JESUS] will not rise and give HIM[JESUS], because HE[JESUS] is
HIS[JESUS] friend, yet because of HIS[JESUS] importunity HE[JESUS] will rise and give HIM[JESUS] as
many as HE[JESUS] needeth.

11:9 And I say unto you, Ask, and it shall be given you; seek, and you
shall find; knock, and it shall be opened unto you.

11:10 For every one that asketh receiveth; and HE[JESUS] that seeketh findeth;
and to HIM[JESUS] that knocketh it shall be opened.

11:11 If a SON[JESUS] shall ask bread of any of you that is a father, will HE[JESUS]
give HIM[JESUS] a stone? or if HE[JESUS] ask a fish, will HE[JESUS] for a fish give HIM[JESUS] a
serpent?

11:12 Or if HE[JESUS] shall ask an egg, will HE[JESUS] offer HIM[JESUS] a scorpion?

11:13 If you then, being evil, know how to give good gifts unto your
children: how much more shall your heavenly Father give the Holy Spirit
to them that ask HIM[JESUS]?

11:14 And HE[JESUS] was casting out a devil, and it was dumb. And it came to
pass, when the devil was gone out, the dumb spake; and the people
wondered.

11:15 But some of them said, HE[JESUS] casteth out devils through Beelzebub the
chief of the devils.

11:16 And others, tempting HIM[JESUS], sought of HIM[JESUS] a sign from heaven.

11:17 But HE[JESUS], knowing their thoughts, said unto them, Every kingdom
divided against itself is brought to desolation; and a house divided
against a house falleth.

11:18 If Satan also be divided against himself, how shall HIS[JESUS] kingdom
stand? because you say that I cast out devils through Beelzebub.

11:19 And if I by Beelzebub cast out devils, by whom do your sons cast
them out? therefore shall they be your judges.

11:20 But if I with the finger of GOD[JESUS] cast out devils, no doubt the
kingdom of GOD[JESUS] is come upon you.

11:21 When a strong man armed keepeth HIS[JESUS] palace, HIS[JESUS] goods are in
peace:

11:22 But when a stronger than HE[JESUS] shall come upon HIM[JESUS], and overcome HIM[JESUS],
HE[JESUS] taketh from HIM[JESUS] all HIS[JESUS] armour wherein HE[JESUS] trusted, and divideth HIS[JESUS]
spoils.

11:23 HE[JESUS] that is not with me is against me: and HE[JESUS] that gathereth not
with me scattereth.

11:24 When the unclean spirit is gone out of a man, HE[JESUS] walketh through
dry places, seeking rest; and finding none, HE[JESUS] says, I will return unto
my house whence I came out.

11:25 And when HE[JESUS] comes, HE[JESUS] findeth it swept and garnished.

11:26 Then goes HE[JESUS], and taketh to HIM[JESUS] seven other spirits more wicked
than himself; and they enter in, and dwell there: and the last state of
that man is worse than the first.

11:27 And it came to pass, as HE[JESUS] spake these things, a certain woman of
the company lifted up her voice, and said unto HIM[JESUS], Blessed is the womb
that bare you, and the paps which you hast sucked.

11:28 But HE[JESUS] said, Yea rather, blessed are they that hear the WORD[JESUS] of
GOD[JESUS], and keep it.

11:29 And when the people were gathered thick together, HE[JESUS] began to say,
This is an evil generation: they seek a sign; and there shall no sign be
given it, but the sign of Jonas the PROPHET[JESUS].

11:30 For as Jonas was a sign unto the Ninevites, so shall also the SON[JESUS]
of man be to this generation.

11:31 The queen of the south shall rise up in the judgment with the men
of this generation, and condemn them: for she came from the utmost parts
of the earth to hear the wisdom of Solomon; and, behold, a greater than
Solomon is here.

11:32 The men of Nineve shall rise up in the judgment with this
generation, and shall condemn it: for they repented at the preaching of
Jonas; and, behold, a greater than Jonas is here.

11:33 No man, when HE[JESUS] has lighted a candle, putteth it in a secret
place, neither under a bushel, but on a candlestick, that they which
come in may see the light.

11:34 The light of the body is the eye: therefore when yours eye is
single, your whole body also is full of light; but when yours eye is
evil, your body also is full of darkness.

11:35 Take heed therefore that the light which is in you be not
darkness.

11:36 If your whole body therefore be full of light, having no part dark,
the whole shall be full of light, as when the bright shining of a candle
does give you light.

11:37 And as HE[JESUS] spake, a certain Pharisee besought HIM[JESUS] to dine with HIM[JESUS]:
and HE[JESUS] went in, and sat down to meat.

11:38 And when the Pharisee saw it, HE[JESUS] marvelled that HE[JESUS] had not first
washed before dinner.

11:39 And the LORD[JESUS] said unto HIM[JESUS], Now do you Pharisees make clean the
outside of the cup and the platter; but your inward part is full of
ravening and wickedness.

11:40 you fools, did not HE[JESUS] that made that which is without make that
which is within also?

11:41 But rather give alms of such things as you have; and, behold, all
things are clean unto you.

11:42 But woe unto you, Pharisees! for you tithe mint and rue and all
manner of herbs, and pass over judgment and the love of GOD[JESUS]: these ought
you to have done, and not to leave the other undone.

11:43 Woe unto you, Pharisees! for you love the uppermost seats in the
synagogues, and greetings in the markets.

11:44 Woe unto you, scribes and Pharisees, hypocrites! for you are as
graves which appear not, and the men that walk over them are not aware
of them.

11:45 Then answered one of the lawyers, and said unto HIM[JESUS], Master, thus
saying you reproachest us also.

11:46 And HE[JESUS] said, Woe unto you also, you lawyers! for you lade men with
burdens grievous to be borne, and you yourselves touch not the burdens
with one of your fingers.

11:47 Woe unto you! for you build the sepulchres of the prophets, and
your fathers killed them.

11:48 Truly you bear witness that you allow the deeds of your fathers: for
they indeed killed them, and you build their sepulchres.

11:49 Therefore also said the wisdom of GOD[JESUS], I will send them prophets
and apostles, and some of them they shall slay and persecute:

11:50 That the blood of all the prophets, which was shed from the
foundation of the world, may be required of this generation;

11:51 From the blood of Abel unto the blood of Zacharias which perished
between the altar and the temple: truly I say unto you, It shall be
required of this generation.

11:52 Woe unto you, lawyers! for you have taken away the key of
knowledge: you entered not in yourselves, and them that were entering in
you hindered.

11:53 And as HE[JESUS] said these things unto them, the scribes and the
Pharisees began to urge HIM[JESUS] vehemently, and to provoke HIM[JESUS] to speak of
many things:

11:54 Laying wait for HIM[JESUS], and seeking to catch something out of HIS[JESUS]
mouth, that they might accuse HIM[JESUS].


12:1 In the mean time, when there were gathered together an innumerable
multitude of people, insomuch that they trode one upon another, HE[JESUS] began
to say unto HIS[JESUS] disciples first of all, Beware you of the leaven of the
Pharisees, which is hypocrisy.

12:2 For there is nothing covered, that shall not be revealed; neither
hid, that shall not be known.

12:3 Therefore whatsoever you have spoken in darkness shall be heard in
the light; and that which you have spoken in the ear in closets shall be
proclaimed upon the housetops.

12:4 And I say unto you my friends, Be not afraid of them that kill the
body, and after that have no more that they can do.

12:5 But I will forewarn you whom you shall fear: Fear HIM[JESUS], which after
HE[JESUS] has killed has power to cast into hell; yea, I say unto you, Fear
HIM[JESUS].

12:6 Are not five sparrows sold for two farthings, and not one of them
is forgotten before GOD[JESUS]?

12:7 But even the very hairs of your head are all numbered. Fear not
therefore: you are of more value than many sparrows.

12:8 Also I say unto you, whoever shall confess me before men, HIM[JESUS]
shall the SON[JESUS] OF MAN[JESUS] also confess before the angels of GOD[JESUS]:

12:9 But HE[JESUS] that denieth me before men shall be denied before the angels
of GOD[JESUS].

12:10 And whoever shall speak a WORD[JESUS] against the SON[JESUS] OF MAN[JESUS], it shall
be forgiven HIM[JESUS]: but unto HIM[JESUS] that blasphemeth against the Holy Ghost it
shall not be forgiven.

12:11 And when they bring you unto the synagogues, and unto magistrates,
and powers, take you no thought how or what thing you shall answer, or
what you shall say:

12:12 For the Holy Ghost shall teach you in the same hour what you ought
to say.

12:13 And one of the company said unto HIM[JESUS], Master, speak to my brother,
that HE[JESUS] divide the inheritance with me.

12:14 And HE[JESUS] said unto HIM[JESUS], Man, who made me a judge or a divider over
you?

12:15 And HE[JESUS] said unto them, Take heed, and beware of covetousness: for
a man's life consisteth not in the abundance of the things which HE[JESUS]
possesseth.

12:16 And HE[JESUS] spake a parable unto them, saying, The ground of a certain
rich man brought forth plentifully:

12:17 And HE[JESUS] thought within himself, saying, What shall I do, because I
have no room where to bestow my fruits?

12:18 And HE[JESUS] said, This will I do: I will pull down my barns, and build
greater; and there will I bestow all my fruits and my goods.

12:19 And I will say to my soul, Soul, you hast much goods laid up for
many years; take yours ease, eat, drink, and be merry.

12:20 But GOD[JESUS] said unto HIM[JESUS], you fool, this night your soul shall be
required of you: then whose shall those things be, which you hast
provided?

12:21 So is HE[JESUS] that layeth up treasure for himself, and is not rich
toward GOD[JESUS].

12:22 And HE[JESUS] said unto HIS[JESUS] disciples, Therefore I say unto you, Take no
thought for your life, what you shall eat; neither for the body, what you
shall put on.

12:23 The life is more than meat, and the body is more than raiment.

12:24 Consider the ravens: for they neither sow nor reap; which neither
have storehouse nor barn; and GOD[JESUS] feedeth them: how much more are you
better than the fowls?

12:25 And which of you with taking thought can add to HIS[JESUS] stature one
cubit?

12:26 If you then be not able to do that thing which is least, why take
you thought for the rest?

12:27 Consider the lilies how they grow: they toil not, they spin not;
and yet I say unto you, that Solomon in all HIS[JESUS] glory was not arrayed
like one of these.

12:28 If then GOD[JESUS] so clothe the grass, which is to day in the field, and
to morrow is cast into the oven; how much more will HE[JESUS] clothe you, O you
of little faith?

12:29 And seek not you what you shall eat, or what you shall drink, neither
be you of doubtful mind.

12:30 For all these things do the nations of the world seek after: and
your Father knoweth that you have need of these things.

12:31 But rather seek you the kingdom of GOD[JESUS]; and all these things shall
be added unto you.

12:32 Fear not, little flock; for it is your Father's good pleasure to
give you the kingdom.

12:33 Sell that you have, and give alms; provide yourselves bags which
wax not old, a treasure in the heavens that faileth not, where no thief
approacheth, neither moth corrupteth.

12:34 For where your treasure is, there will your heart be also.

12:35 Let your loins be girded about, and your lights burning;

12:36 And you yourselves like unto men that wait for their LORD[JESUS], when HE[JESUS]
will return from the wedding; that when HE[JESUS] comes and knocketh, they may
open unto HIM[JESUS] immediately.

12:37 Blessed are those servants, whom the LORD[JESUS] when HE[JESUS] comes shall
find watching: truly I say unto you, that HE[JESUS] shall gird himself, and
make them to sit down to meat, and will come forth and serve them.

12:38 And if HE[JESUS] shall come in the second watch, or come in the third
watch, and find them so, blessed are those servants.

12:39 And this know, that if the goodman of the house had known what
hour the thief would come, HE[JESUS] would have watched, and not have suffered
HIS[JESUS] house to be broken through.

12:40 Be you therefore ready also: for the SON[JESUS] OF MAN[JESUS] comes at an hour
when you think not.

12:41 Then Peter said unto HIM[JESUS], LORD[JESUS], speakest you this parable unto
us, or even to all?

12:42 And the LORD[JESUS] said, Who then is that faithful and wise steward,
whom HIS[JESUS] LORD[JESUS] shall make ruler over HIS[JESUS] household, to give them their
portion of meat in due season?

12:43 Blessed is that SERVANT[JESUS], whom HIS[JESUS] LORD[JESUS] when HE[JESUS] comes shall find
so doing.

12:44 Of a truth I say unto you, that HE[JESUS] will make HIM[JESUS] ruler over all
that HE[JESUS] has.

12:45 But and if that SERVANT[JESUS] say in HIS[JESUS] heart, My LORD[JESUS] delayeth HIS[JESUS]
coming; and shall begin to beat the menservants and maidens, and to eat
and drink, and to be drunken;

12:46 The LORD[JESUS] of that SERVANT[JESUS] will come in a day when HE[JESUS] looketh not
for HIM[JESUS], and at an hour when HE[JESUS] is not aware, and will cut HIM[JESUS] in
sunder, and will appoint HIM[JESUS] HIS[JESUS] portion with the unbelievers.

12:47 And that SERVANT[JESUS], which knew HIS[JESUS] LORD[JESUS]'s will, and prepared not
himself, neither did according to HIS[JESUS] will, shall be beaten with many
stripes.

12:48 But HE[JESUS] that knew not, and did commit things worthy of stripes,
shall be beaten with few stripes. For unto whomsoever much is given, of
HIM[JESUS] shall be much required: and to whom men have committed much, of HIM[JESUS]
they will ask the more.

12:49 I am come to send fire on the earth; and what will I, if it be
already kindled?

12:50 But I have a baptism to be baptized with; and how am I straitened
till it be accomplished!

12:51 Suppose you that I am come to give peace on earth? I tell you, Nay;
but rather division:

12:52 For from henceforth there shall be five in one house divided,
three against two, and two against three.

12:53 The father shall be divided against the SON[JESUS], and the SON[JESUS] against
the father; the mother against the daughter, and the daughter against
the mother; the mother in law against her daughter in law, and the
daughter in law against her mother in law.

12:54 And HE[JESUS] said also to the people, When you see a cloud rise out of
the west, straightway you say, There comes a shower; and so it is.

12:55 And when you see the south wind blow, you say, There will be heat;
and it comes to pass.

12:56 you hypocrites, you can discern the face of the sky and of the
earth; but how is it that you do not discern this time?

12:57 Yea, and why even of yourselves judge you not what is right?

12:58 When you goest with yours adversary to the magistrate, as you
art in the way, give diligence that you mayest be delivered from HIM[JESUS];
lest HE[JESUS] hale you to the judge, and the judge deliver you to the
officer, and the officer cast you into prison.

12:59 I tell you, you shalt not depart thence, till you hast paid the
very last mite.


13:1 There were present at that season some that told HIM[JESUS] of the
Galilaeans, whose blood Pilate had mingled with their sacrifices.

13:2 And JESUS answering said unto them, Suppose you that these
Galilaeans were sinners above all the Galilaeans, because they suffered
such things?

13:3 I tell you, Nay: but, except you repent, you shall all likewise
perish.

13:4 Or those eighteen, upon whom the tower in Siloam fell, and slew
them, think you that they were sinners above all men that dwelt in
Jerusalem?

13:5 I tell you, Nay: but, except you repent, you shall all likewise
perish.

13:6 HE[JESUS] spake also this parable; A certain man had a fig tree planted in
HIS[JESUS] vineyard; and HE[JESUS] came and sought fruit thereon, and found none.

13:7 Then said HE[JESUS] unto the dresser of HIS[JESUS] vineyard, Behold, these three
years I come seeking fruit on this fig tree, and find none: cut it down;
why cumbereth it the ground?

13:8 And HE[JESUS] answering said unto HIM[JESUS], LORD[JESUS], let it alone this year also,
till I shall dig about it, and dung it:

13:9 And if it bear fruit, well: and if not, then after that you shalt
cut it down.

13:10 And HE[JESUS] was teaching in one of the synagogues on the sabbath.

13:11 And, behold, there was a woman which had a spirit of infirmity
eighteen years, and was bowed together, and could in no wise lift up
herself.

13:12 And when JESUS saw her, HE[JESUS] called her to HIM[JESUS], and said unto her,
Woman, you art loosed from yours infirmity.

13:13 And HE[JESUS] laid HIS[JESUS] hands on her: and immediately she was made
straight, and glorified GOD[JESUS].

13:14 And the ruler of the synagogue answered with indignation, because
that JESUS had healed on the sabbath day, and said unto the people,
There are six days in which men ought to work: in them therefore come
and be healed, and not on the sabbath day.

13:15 The LORD[JESUS] then answered HIM[JESUS], and said, you hypocrite, does not
each one of you on the sabbath loose HIS[JESUS] ox or HIS[JESUS] ass from the stall,
and lead HIM[JESUS] away to watering?

13:16 And ought not this woman, being a daughter of Abraham, whom Satan
has bound, lo, these eighteen years, be loosed from this bond on the
sabbath day?

13:17 And when HE[JESUS] had said these things, all HIS[JESUS] adversaries were
ashamed: and all the people rejoiced for all the glorious things that
were done by HIM[JESUS].

13:18 Then said HE[JESUS], Unto what is the kingdom of GOD[JESUS] like? and whereunto
shall I resemble it?

13:19 It is like a grain of mustard SEED[JESUS], which a man took, and cast
into HIS[JESUS] garden; and it grew, and waxed a great tree; and the fowls of
the air lodged in the branches of it.

13:20 And again HE[JESUS] said, Whereunto shall I liken the kingdom of GOD[JESUS]?

13:21 It is like leaven, which a woman took and hid in three measures of
meal, till the whole was leavened.

13:22 And HE[JESUS] went through the cities and villages, teaching, and
journeying toward Jerusalem.

13:23 Then said one unto HIM[JESUS], LORD[JESUS], are there few that be saved? And HE[JESUS]
said unto them,

13:24 Strive to enter in at the strait gate: for many, I say unto you,
will seek to enter in, and shall not be able.

13:25 When once the master of the house is risen up, and has shut to
the door, and you begin to stand without, and to knock at the door,
saying, LORD[JESUS], LORD[JESUS], open unto us; and HE[JESUS] shall answer and say unto you,
I know you not whence you are:

13:26 Then shall you begin to say, We have eaten and drunk in your
presence, and you hast taught in our streets.

13:27 But HE[JESUS] shall say, I tell you, I know you not whence you are; depart
from me, all you workers of iniquity.

13:28 There shall be weeping and gnashing of teeth, when you shall see
Abraham, and Isaac, and Jacob, and all the prophets, in the kingdom of
GOD[JESUS], and you yourselves thrust out.

13:29 And they shall come from the east, and from the west, and from the
north, and from the south, and shall sit down in the kingdom of GOD[JESUS].

13:30 And, behold, there are last which shall be first, and there are
first which shall be last.

13:31 The same day there came certain of the Pharisees, saying unto HIM[JESUS],
Get you out, and depart hence: for Herod will kill you.

13:32 And HE[JESUS] said unto them, Go you, and tell that fox, Behold, I cast
out devils, and I do cures to day and to morrow, and the third day I
shall be perfected.

13:33 Nevertheless I must walk to day, and to morrow, and the day
following: for it cannot be that a PROPHET[JESUS] perish out of Jerusalem.

13:34 O Jerusalem, Jerusalem, which killest the prophets, and stonest
them that are sent unto you; how often would I have gathered your
children together, as a hen does gather her brood under her wings, and
you would not!

13:35 Behold, your house is left unto you desolate: and truly I say
unto you, you shall not see me, until the time come when you shall say,
Blessed is HE[JESUS] that comes in the name of the LORD[JESUS].


14:1 And it came to pass, as HE[JESUS] went into the house of one of the chief
Pharisees to eat bread on the sabbath day, that they watched HIM[JESUS].

14:2 And, behold, there was a certain man before HIM[JESUS] which had the
dropsy.

14:3 And JESUS answering spake unto the lawyers and Pharisees, saying,
Is it lawful to heal on the sabbath day?

14:4 And they held their peace. And HE[JESUS] took HIM[JESUS], and healed HIM[JESUS], and let
HIM[JESUS] go;

14:5 And answered them, saying, Which of you shall have an ass or an ox
fallen into a pit, and will not straightway pull HIM[JESUS] out on the sabbath
day?

14:6 And they could not answer HIM[JESUS] again to these things.

14:7 And HE[JESUS] put forth a parable to those which were bidden, when HE[JESUS]
marked how they chose out the chief rooms; saying unto them.

14:8 When you art bidden of any man to a wedding, sit not down in the
highest room; lest a more honourable man than you be bidden of HIM[JESUS];

14:9 And HE[JESUS] that bade you and HIM[JESUS] come and say to you, Give this man
place; and you begin with shame to take the lowest room.

14:10 But when you art bidden, go and sit down in the lowest room; that
when HE[JESUS] that bade you comes, HE[JESUS] may say unto you, Friend, go up
higher: then shalt you have worship in the presence of them that sit at
meat with you.

14:11 For whoever exalteth himself shall be abased; and HE[JESUS] that
humbleth himself shall be exalted.

14:12 Then said HE[JESUS] also to HIM[JESUS] that bade HIM[JESUS], When you makest a dinner
or a supper, call not your friends, nor your brethren, neither your
kinsmen, nor your rich neighbours; lest they also bid you again, and a
recompence be made you.

14:13 But when you makest a feast, call the poor, the maimed, the lame,
the blind:

14:14 And you shalt be blessed; for they cannot recompense you: for
you shalt be recompensed at the resurrection of the just.

14:15 And when one of them that sat at meat with HIM[JESUS] heard these things,
HE[JESUS] said unto HIM[JESUS], Blessed is HE[JESUS] that shall eat bread in the kingdom of
GOD[JESUS].

14:16 Then said HE[JESUS] unto HIM[JESUS], A certain man made a great supper, and bade
many:

14:17 And sent HIS[JESUS] SERVANT[JESUS] at supper time to say to them that were
bidden, Come; for all things are now ready.

14:18 And they all with one consent began to make excuse. The first said
unto HIM[JESUS], I have bought a piece of ground, and I must needs go and see
it: I pray you have me excused.

14:19 And another said, I have bought five yoke of oxen, and I go to
prove them: I pray you have me excused.

14:20 And another said, I have married a wife, and therefore I cannot
come.

14:21 So that SERVANT[JESUS] came, and shewed HIS[JESUS] LORD[JESUS] these things. Then the
master of the house being angry said to HIS[JESUS] SERVANT[JESUS], Go out quickly into
the streets and lanes of the city, and bring in hither the poor, and the
maimed, and the halt, and the blind.

14:22 And the SERVANT[JESUS] said, LORD[JESUS], it is done as you hast commanded, and
yet there is room.

14:23 And the LORD[JESUS] said unto the SERVANT[JESUS], Go out into the highways and
hedges, and compel them to come in, that my house may be filled.

14:24 For I say unto you, That none of those men which were bidden shall
taste of my supper.

14:25 And there went great multitudes with HIM[JESUS]: and HE[JESUS] turned, and said
unto them,

14:26 If any man come to me, and hate not HIS[JESUS] father, and mother, and
wife, and children, and brethren, and sisters, yea, and HIS[JESUS] own life
also, HE[JESUS] cannot be my disciple.

14:27 And whoever does not bear HIS[JESUS] cross, and come after me, cannot
be my disciple.

14:28 For which of you, intending to build a tower, sitteth not down
first, and counteth the cost, whether HE[JESUS] have sufficient to finish it?

14:29 Lest haply, after HE[JESUS] has laid the foundation, and is not able to
finish it, all that behold it begin to mock HIM[JESUS],

14:30 Saying, This man began to build, and was not able to finish.

14:31 Or what KING[JESUS], going to make war against another KING[JESUS], sitteth not
down first, and consulteth whether HE[JESUS] be able with ten thousand to meet
HIM[JESUS] that comes against HIM[JESUS] with twenty thousand?

14:32 Or else, while the other is yet a great way off, HE[JESUS] sendeth an
ambassage, and desireth conditions of peace.

14:33 So likewise, whoever HE[JESUS] be of you that forsaketh not all that HE[JESUS]
has, HE[JESUS] cannot be my disciple.

14:34 Salt is good: but if the salt have lost HIS[JESUS] savour, wherewith
shall it be seasoned?

14:35 It is neither fit for the land, nor yet for the dunghill; but men
cast it out. HE[JESUS] that has ears to hear, let HIM[JESUS] hear.


15:1 Then drew near unto HIM[JESUS] all the publicans and sinners for to hear
HIM[JESUS].

15:2 And the Pharisees and scribes murmured, saying, This man receiveth
sinners, and eateth with them.

15:3 And HE[JESUS] spake this parable unto them, saying,

15:4 What man of you, having an hundred sheep, if HE[JESUS] lose one of them,
does not leave the ninety and nine in the wilderness, and go after that
which is lost, until HE[JESUS] find it?

15:5 And when HE[JESUS] has found it, HE[JESUS] layeth it on HIS[JESUS] shoulders,
rejoicing.

15:6 And when HE[JESUS] comes home, HE[JESUS] calleth together HIS[JESUS] friends and
neighbours, saying unto them, Rejoice with me; for I have found my sheep
which was lost.

15:7 I say unto you, that likewise joy shall be in heaven over one
sinner that repenteth, more than over ninety and nine just persons,
which need no repentance.

15:8 Either what woman having ten pieces of silver, if she lose one
piece, does not light a candle, and sweep the house, and seek diligently
till she find it?

15:9 And when she has found it, she calleth her friends and her
neighbours together, saying, Rejoice with me; for I have found the piece
which I had lost.

15:10 Likewise, I say unto you, there is joy in the presence of the
angels of GOD[JESUS] over one sinner that repenteth.

15:11 And HE[JESUS] said, A certain man had two sons:

15:12 And the younger of them said to HIS[JESUS] father, Father, give me the
portion of goods that falleth to me. And HE[JESUS] divided unto them HIS[JESUS]
living.

15:13 And not many days after the younger SON[JESUS] gathered all together, and
took HIS[JESUS] journey into a far country, and there wasted HIS[JESUS] substance with
riotous living.

15:14 And when HE[JESUS] had spent all, there arose a mighty famine in that
land; and HE[JESUS] began to be in want.

15:15 And HE[JESUS] went and joined himself to a citizen of that country; and
HE[JESUS] sent HIM[JESUS] into HIS[JESUS] fields to feed swine.

15:16 And HE[JESUS] would fain have filled HIS[JESUS] belly with the husks that the
swine did eat: and no man gave unto HIM[JESUS].

15:17 And when HE[JESUS] came to himself, HE[JESUS] said, How many hired servants of
my father's have bread enough and to spare, and I perish with hunger!

15:18 I will arise and go to my father, and will say unto HIM[JESUS], Father, I
have sinned against heaven, and before you,

15:19 And am no more worthy to be called your SON[JESUS]: make me as one of your
hired servants.

15:20 And HE[JESUS] arose, and came to HIS[JESUS] father. But when HE[JESUS] was yet a great
way off, HIS[JESUS] father saw HIM[JESUS], and had compassion, and ran, and fell on
HIS[JESUS] neck, and kissed HIM[JESUS].

15:21 And the SON[JESUS] said unto HIM[JESUS], Father, I have sinned against heaven,
and in your sight, and am no more worthy to be called your SON[JESUS].

15:22 But the father said to HIS[JESUS] servants, Bring forth the best robe,
and put it on HIM[JESUS]; and put a ring on HIS[JESUS] hand, and shoes on HIS[JESUS] feet:

15:23 And bring hither the fatted calf, and kill it; and let us eat, and
be merry:

15:24 For this my SON[JESUS] was dead, and is alive again; HE[JESUS] was lost, and is
found. And they began to be merry.

15:25 Now HIS[JESUS] elder SON[JESUS] was in the field: and as HE[JESUS] came and drew nigh
to the house, HE[JESUS] heard musick and dancing.

15:26 And HE[JESUS] called one of the servants, and asked what these things
meant.

15:27 And HE[JESUS] said unto HIM[JESUS], your brother is come; and your father has
killed the fatted calf, because HE[JESUS] has received HIM[JESUS] safe and sound.

15:28 And HE[JESUS] was angry, and would not go in: therefore came HIS[JESUS] father
out, and intreated HIM[JESUS].

15:29 And HE[JESUS] answering said to HIS[JESUS] father, Lo, these many years do I
serve you, neither transgressed I at any time your commandment: and yet
you never gavest me a kid, that I might make merry with my friends:

15:30 But as soon as this your SON[JESUS] was come, which has devoured your
living with harlots, you hast killed for HIM[JESUS] the fatted calf.

15:31 And HE[JESUS] said unto HIM[JESUS], SON[JESUS], you art ever with me, and all that I
have is yours.

15:32 It was meet that we should make merry, and be glad: for this your
brother was dead, and is alive again; and was lost, and is found.


16:1 And HE[JESUS] said also unto HIS[JESUS] disciples, There was a certain rich man,
which had a steward; and the same was accused unto HIM[JESUS] that HE[JESUS] had
wasted HIS[JESUS] goods.

16:2 And HE[JESUS] called HIM[JESUS], and said unto HIM[JESUS], How is it that I hear this of
you? give an account of your stewardship; for you mayest be no longer
steward.

16:3 Then the steward said within himself, What shall I do? for my LORD[JESUS]
taketh away from me the stewardship: I cannot dig; to beg I am ashamed.

16:4 I am resolved what to do, that, when I am put out of the
stewardship, they may receive me into their houses.

16:5 So HE[JESUS] called every one of HIS[JESUS] LORD[JESUS]'s debtors unto HIM[JESUS], and said
unto the first, How much owest you unto my LORD[JESUS]?

16:6 And HE[JESUS] said, An hundred measures of oil. And HE[JESUS] said unto HIM[JESUS], Take
your bill, and sit down quickly, and write fifty.

16:7 Then said HE[JESUS] to another, And how much owest you? And HE[JESUS] said, An
hundred measures of wheat. And HE[JESUS] said unto HIM[JESUS], Take your bill, and
write fourscore.

16:8 And the LORD[JESUS] commended the unjust steward, because HE[JESUS] had done
wisely: for the children of this world are in their generation wiser
than the children of light.

16:9 And I say unto you, Make to yourselves friends of the mammon of
unrighteousness; that, when you fail, they may receive you into
everlasting habitations.

16:10 HE[JESUS] that is faithful in that which is least is faithful also in
much: and HE[JESUS] that is unjust in the least is unjust also in much.

16:11 If therefore you have not been faithful in the unrighteous mammon,
who will commit to your trust the true riches?

16:12 And if you have not been faithful in that which is another man's,
who shall give you that which is your own?

16:13 No SERVANT[JESUS] can serve two masters: for either HE[JESUS] will hate the one,
and love the other; or else HE[JESUS] will hold to the one, and despise the
other. you cannot serve GOD[JESUS] and mammon.

16:14 And the Pharisees also, who were covetous, heard all these things:
and they derided HIM[JESUS].

16:15 And HE[JESUS] said unto them, you are they which justify yourselves before
men; but GOD[JESUS] knoweth your hearts: for that which is highly esteemed
among men is abomination in the sight of GOD[JESUS].

16:16 The law and the prophets were until John: since that time the
kingdom of GOD[JESUS] is preached, and every man presseth into it.

16:17 And it is easier for heaven and earth to pass, than one tittle of
the law to fail.

16:18 whoever putteth away HIS[JESUS] wife, and marrieth another, committeth
adultery: and whoever marrieth her that is put away from her husband
committeth adultery.

16:19 There was a certain rich man, which was clothed in purple and fine
linen, and fared sumptuously every day:

16:20 And there was a certain beggar named Lazarus, which was laid at
HIS[JESUS] gate, full of sores,

16:21 And desiring to be fed with the crumbs which fell from the rich
man's table: moreover the dogs came and licked HIS[JESUS] sores.

16:22 And it came to pass, that the beggar died, and was carried by the
angels into Abraham's bosom: the rich man also died, and was buried;

16:23 And in hell HE[JESUS] lift up HIS[JESUS] eyes, being in torments, and seeth
Abraham afar off, and Lazarus in HIS[JESUS] bosom.

16:24 And HE[JESUS] cried and said, Father Abraham, have mercy on me, and send
Lazarus, that HE[JESUS] may dip the tip of HIS[JESUS] finger in water, and cool my
tongue; for I am tormented in this flame.

16:25 But Abraham said, SON[JESUS], remember that you in your lifetime
receivedst your good things, and likewise Lazarus evil things: but now HE[JESUS]
is comforted, and you art tormented.

16:26 And beside all this, between us and you there is a great gulf
fixed: so that they which would pass from hence to you cannot; neither
can they pass to us, that would come from thence.

16:27 Then HE[JESUS] said, I pray you therefore, father, that you wouldest
send HIM[JESUS] to my father's house:

16:28 For I have five brethren; that HE[JESUS] may testify unto them, lest they
also come into this place of torment.

16:29 Abraham says unto HIM[JESUS], They have Moses and the prophets; let them
hear them.

16:30 And HE[JESUS] said, Nay, father Abraham: but if one went unto them from
the dead, they will repent.

16:31 And HE[JESUS] said unto HIM[JESUS], If they hear not Moses and the prophets,
neither will they be persuaded, though one rose from the dead.


17:1 Then said HE[JESUS] unto the disciples, It is impossible but that offences
will come: but woe unto HIM[JESUS], through whom they come!

17:2 It were better for HIM[JESUS] that a millstone were hanged about HIS[JESUS] neck,
and HE[JESUS] cast into the sea, than that HE[JESUS] should offend one of these little
ones.

17:3 Take heed to yourselves: If your brother trespass against you,
rebuke HIM[JESUS]; and if HE[JESUS] repent, forgive HIM[JESUS].

17:4 And if HE[JESUS] trespass against you seven times in a day, and seven
times in a day turn again to you, saying, I repent; you shalt forgive
HIM[JESUS].

17:5 And the apostles said unto the LORD[JESUS], Increase our faith.

17:6 And the LORD[JESUS] said, If you had faith as a grain of mustard SEED[JESUS], you
might say unto this sycamine tree, Be you plucked up by the ROOT[JESUS], and
be you planted in the sea; and it should obey you.

17:7 But which of you, having a SERVANT[JESUS] plowing or feeding cattle, will
say unto HIM[JESUS] by and by, when HE[JESUS] is come from the field, Go and sit down
to meat?

17:8 And will not rather say unto HIM[JESUS], Make ready wherewith I may sup,
and gird thyself, and serve me, till I have eaten and drunken; and
afterward you shalt eat and drink?

17:9 does HE[JESUS] thank that SERVANT[JESUS] because HE[JESUS] did the things that were
commanded HIM[JESUS]? I trow not.

17:10 So likewise you, when you shall have done all those things which are
commanded you, say, We are unprofitable servants: we have done that
which was our duty to do.

17:11 And it came to pass, as HE[JESUS] went to Jerusalem, that HE[JESUS] passed
through the midst of Samaria and Galilee.

17:12 And as HE[JESUS] entered into a certain village, there met HIM[JESUS] ten men
that were lepers, which stood afar off:

17:13 And they lifted up their voices, and said, JESUS, Master, have
mercy on us.

17:14 And when HE[JESUS] saw them, HE[JESUS] said unto them, Go shew yourselves unto
the priests. And it came to pass, that, as they went, they were
cleansed.

17:15 And one of them, when HE[JESUS] saw that HE[JESUS] was healed, turned back, and
with a loud voice glorified GOD[JESUS],

17:16 And fell down on HIS[JESUS] face at HIS[JESUS] feet, giving HIM[JESUS] thanks: and HE[JESUS]
was a Samaritan.

17:17 And JESUS answering said, Were there not ten cleansed? but where
are the nine?

17:18 There are not found that returned to give glory to GOD[JESUS], save this
stranger.

17:19 And HE[JESUS] said unto HIM[JESUS], Arise, go your way: your faith has made you
whole.

17:20 And when HE[JESUS] was demanded of the Pharisees, when the kingdom of GOD[JESUS]
should come, HE[JESUS] answered them and said, The kingdom of GOD[JESUS] comes not
with observation:

17:21 Neither shall they say, Lo here! or, lo there! for, behold, the
kingdom of GOD[JESUS] is within you.

17:22 And HE[JESUS] said unto the disciples, The days will come, when you shall
desire to see one of the days of the SON[JESUS] OF MAN[JESUS], and you shall not see
it.

17:23 And they shall say to you, See here; or, see there: go not after
them, nor follow them.

17:24 For as the lightning, that lighteneth out of the one part under
heaven, shineth unto the other part under heaven; so shall also the SON[JESUS]
of man be in HIS[JESUS] day.

17:25 But first must HE[JESUS] let many things, and be rejected of this
generation.

17:26 And as it was in the days of Noe, so shall it be also in the days
of the SON[JESUS] OF MAN[JESUS].

17:27 They did eat, they drank, they married wives, they were given in
marriage, until the day that Noe entered into the ark, and the flood
came, and destroyed them all.

17:28 Likewise also as it was in the days of Lot; they did eat, they
drank, they bought, they sold, they planted, they builded;

17:29 But the same day that Lot went out of Sodom it rained fire and
brimstone from heaven, and destroyed them all.

17:30 Even thus shall it be in the day when the SON[JESUS] OF MAN[JESUS] is revealed.

17:31 In that day, HE[JESUS] which shall be upon the housetop, and HIS[JESUS] stuff in
the house, let HIM[JESUS] not come down to take it away: and HE[JESUS] that is in the
field, let HIM[JESUS] likewise not return back.

17:32 Remember Lot's wife.

17:33 whoever shall seek to save HIS[JESUS] life shall lose it; and whoever
shall lose HIS[JESUS] life shall preserve it.

17:34 I tell you, in that night there shall be two men in one bed; the
one shall be taken, and the other shall be left.

17:35 Two women shall be grinding together; the one shall be taken, and
the other left.

17:36 Two men shall be in the field; the one shall be taken, and the
other left.

17:37 And they answered and said unto HIM[JESUS], Where, LORD[JESUS]? And HE[JESUS] said unto
them, Wheresoever the body is, thither will the eagles be gathered
together.


18:1 And HE[JESUS] spake a parable unto them to this end, that men ought always
to pray, and not to faint;

18:2 Saying, There was in a city a judge, which feared not GOD[JESUS], neither
regarded man:

18:3 And there was a widow in that city; and she came unto HIM[JESUS], saying,
Avenge me of mine adversary.

18:4 And HE[JESUS] would not for a while: but afterward HE[JESUS] said within himself,
Though I fear not GOD[JESUS], nor regard man;

18:5 Yet because this widow troubleth me, I will avenge her, lest by her
continual coming she weary me.

18:6 And the LORD[JESUS] said, Hear what the unjust judge says.

18:7 And shall not GOD[JESUS] avenge HIS[JESUS] own elect, which cry day and night
unto HIM[JESUS], though HE[JESUS] bear long with them?

18:8 I tell you that HE[JESUS] will avenge them speedily. Nevertheless when the
SON[JESUS] OF MAN[JESUS] comes, shall HE[JESUS] find faith on the earth?

18:9 And HE[JESUS] spake this parable unto certain which trusted in themselves
that they were righteous, and despised others:

18:10 Two men went up into the temple to pray; the one a Pharisee, and
the other a publican.

18:11 The Pharisee stood and prayed thus with himself, GOD[JESUS], I thank
you, that I am not as other men are, extortioners, unjust, adulterers,
or even as this publican.

18:12 I fast twice in the week, I give tithes of all that I possess.

18:13 And the publican, standing afar off, would not lift up so much as
HIS[JESUS] eyes unto heaven, but smote upon HIS[JESUS] breast, saying, GOD[JESUS] be merciful
to me a sinner.

18:14 I tell you, this man went down to HIS[JESUS] house justified rather than
the other: for every one that exalteth himself shall be abased; and HE[JESUS]
that humbleth himself shall be exalted.

18:15 And they brought unto HIM[JESUS] also infants, that HE[JESUS] would touch them:
but when HIS[JESUS] disciples saw it, they rebuked them.

18:16 But JESUS called them unto HIM[JESUS], and said, let little children
to come unto me, and forbid them not: for of such is the kingdom of GOD[JESUS].

18:17 truly I say unto you, whoever shall not receive the kingdom of
GOD[JESUS] as a little child shall in no wise enter therein.

18:18 And a certain ruler asked HIM[JESUS], saying, Good Master, what shall I
do to inherit eternal life?

18:19 And JESUS said unto HIM[JESUS], Why callest you me good? none is good,
save one, that is, GOD[JESUS].

18:20 you knowest the commandments, Do not commit adultery, Do not
kill, Do not steal, Do not bear false witness, Honour your father and your
mother.

18:21 And HE[JESUS] said, All these have I kept from my youth up.

18:22 Now when JESUS heard these things, HE[JESUS] said unto HIM[JESUS], Yet lackest
you one thing: sell all that you hast, and distribute unto the poor,
and you shalt have treasure in heaven: and come, follow me.

18:23 And when HE[JESUS] heard this, HE[JESUS] was very sorrowful: for HE[JESUS] was very
rich.

18:24 And when JESUS saw that HE[JESUS] was very sorrowful, HE[JESUS] said, How hardly
shall they that have riches enter into the kingdom of GOD[JESUS]!

18:25 For it is easier for a camel to go through a needle's eye, than
for a rich man to enter into the kingdom of GOD[JESUS].

18:26 And they that heard it said, Who then can be saved?

18:27 And HE[JESUS] said, The things which are impossible with men are possible
with GOD[JESUS].

18:28 Then Peter said, Lo, we have left all, and followed you.

18:29 And HE[JESUS] said unto them, truly I say unto you, There is no man that
has left house, or parents, or brethren, or wife, or children, for the
kingdom of GOD[JESUS]'s sake,

18:30 Who shall not receive manifold more in this present time, and in
the world to come life everlasting.

18:31 Then HE[JESUS] took unto HIM[JESUS] the twelve, and said unto them, Behold, we
go up to Jerusalem, and all things that are written by the prophets
concerning the SON[JESUS] OF MAN[JESUS] shall be accomplished.

18:32 For HE[JESUS] shall be delivered unto the Gentiles, and shall be mocked,
and spitefully entreated, and spitted on:

18:33 And they shall scourge HIM[JESUS], and put HIM[JESUS] to death: and the third
day HE[JESUS] shall rise again.

18:34 And they understood none of these things: and this saying was hid
from them, neither knew they the things which were spoken.

18:35 And it came to pass, that as HE[JESUS] was come nigh unto Jericho, a
certain blind man sat by the way side begging:

18:36 And hearing the multitude pass by, HE[JESUS] asked what it meant.

18:37 And they told HIM[JESUS], that JESUS of Nazareth passeth by.

18:38 And HE[JESUS] cried, saying, JESUS, you SON[JESUS] of David, have mercy on me.

18:39 And they which went before rebuked HIM[JESUS], that HE[JESUS] should hold HIS[JESUS]
peace: but HE[JESUS] cried so much the more, you SON[JESUS] of David, have mercy on
me.

18:40 And JESUS stood, and commanded HIM[JESUS] to be brought unto HIM[JESUS]: and
when HE[JESUS] was come near, HE[JESUS] asked HIM[JESUS],

18:41 Saying, What wilt you that I shall do unto you? And HE[JESUS] said,
LORD[JESUS], that I may receive my sight.

18:42 And JESUS said unto HIM[JESUS], Receive your sight: your faith has saved
you.

18:43 And immediately HE[JESUS] received HIS[JESUS] sight, and followed HIM[JESUS],
glorifying GOD[JESUS]: and all the people, when they saw it, gave praise unto
GOD[JESUS].


19:1 And JESUS entered and passed through Jericho.

19:2 And, behold, there was a man named Zacchaeus, which was the chief
among the publicans, and HE[JESUS] was rich.

19:3 And HE[JESUS] sought to see JESUS who HE[JESUS] was; and could not for the press,
because HE[JESUS] was little of stature.

19:4 And HE[JESUS] ran before, and climbed up into a sycomore tree to see HIM[JESUS]:
for HE[JESUS] was to pass that way.

19:5 And when JESUS came to the place, HE[JESUS] looked up, and saw HIM[JESUS], and
said unto HIM[JESUS], Zacchaeus, make haste, and come down; for to day I must
abide at your house.

19:6 And HE[JESUS] made haste, and came down, and received HIM[JESUS] joyfully.

19:7 And when they saw it, they all murmured, saying, That HE[JESUS] was gone
to be guest with a man that is a sinner.

19:8 And Zacchaeus stood, and said unto the LORD[JESUS]: Behold, LORD[JESUS], the half
of my goods I give to the poor; and if I have taken any thing from any
man by false accusation, I restore HIM[JESUS] fourfold.

19:9 And JESUS said unto HIM[JESUS], This day is salvation come to this house,
forsomuch as HE[JESUS] also is a SON[JESUS] of Abraham.

19:10 For the SON[JESUS] OF MAN[JESUS] is come to seek and to save that which was
lost.

19:11 And as they heard these things, HE[JESUS] added and spake a parable,
because HE[JESUS] was nigh to Jerusalem, and because they thought that the
kingdom of GOD[JESUS] should immediately appear.

19:12 HE[JESUS] said therefore, A certain nobleman went into a far country to
receive for himself a kingdom, and to return.

19:13 And HE[JESUS] called HIS[JESUS] ten servants, and delivered them ten pounds, and
said unto them, Occupy till I come.

19:14 But HIS[JESUS] citizens hated HIM[JESUS], and sent a message after HIM[JESUS], saying,
We will not have this man to reign over us.

19:15 And it came to pass, that when HE[JESUS] was returned, having received
the kingdom, then HE[JESUS] commanded these servants to be called unto HIM[JESUS], to
whom HE[JESUS] had given the money, that HE[JESUS] might know how much every man had
gained by trading.

19:16 Then came the first, saying, LORD[JESUS], your pound has gained ten
pounds.

19:17 And HE[JESUS] said unto HIM[JESUS], Well, you good SERVANT[JESUS]: because you hast
been faithful in a very little, have you authority over ten cities.

19:18 And the second came, saying, LORD[JESUS], your pound has gained five
pounds.

19:19 And HE[JESUS] said likewise to HIM[JESUS], Be you also over five cities.

19:20 And another came, saying, LORD[JESUS], behold, here is your pound, which I
have kept laid up in a napkin:

19:21 For I feared you, because you art an austere man: you takest up
that you layedst not down, and reapest that you didst not sow.

19:22 And HE[JESUS] says unto HIM[JESUS], Out of yours own mouth will I judge you,
you wicked SERVANT[JESUS]. you knewest that I was an austere man, taking up
that I laid not down, and reaping that I did not sow:

19:23 Wherefore then gavest not you my money into the bank, that at my
coming I might have required mine own with usury?

19:24 And HE[JESUS] said unto them that stood by, Take from HIM[JESUS] the pound, and
give it to HIM[JESUS] that has ten pounds.

19:25 (And they said unto HIM[JESUS], LORD[JESUS], HE[JESUS] has ten pounds.)

19:26 For I say unto you, That unto every one which has shall be given;
and from HIM[JESUS] that has not, even that HE[JESUS] has shall be taken away from
HIM[JESUS].

19:27 But those mine enemies, which would not that I should reign over
them, bring hither, and slay them before me.

19:28 And when HE[JESUS] had thus spoken, HE[JESUS] went before, ascending up to
Jerusalem.

19:29 And it came to pass, when HE[JESUS] was come nigh to Bethphage and
Bethany, at the mount called the mount of Olives, HE[JESUS] sent two of HIS[JESUS]
disciples,

19:30 Saying, Go you into the village over against you; in the which at
your entering you shall find a colt tied, whereon yet never man sat:
loose HIM[JESUS], and bring HIM[JESUS] hither.

19:31 And if any man ask you, Why do you loose HIM[JESUS]? thus shall you say
unto HIM[JESUS], Because the LORD[JESUS] has need of HIM[JESUS].

19:32 And they that were sent went their way, and found even as HE[JESUS] had
said unto them.

19:33 And as they were loosing the colt, the owners thereof said unto
them, Why loose you the colt?

19:34 And they said, The LORD[JESUS] has need of HIM[JESUS].

19:35 And they brought HIM[JESUS] to JESUS: and they cast their garments upon
the colt, and they set JESUS thereon.

19:36 And as HE[JESUS] went, they spread their clothes in the way.

19:37 And when HE[JESUS] was come nigh, even now at the descent of the mount of
Olives, the whole multitude of the disciples began to rejoice and praise
GOD[JESUS] with a loud voice for all the mighty works that they had seen;

19:38 Saying, Blessed be the KING[JESUS] that comes in the name of the LORD[JESUS]:
peace in heaven, and glory in the highest.

19:39 And some of the Pharisees from among the multitude said unto HIM[JESUS],
Master, rebuke your disciples.

19:40 And HE[JESUS] answered and said unto them, I tell you that, if these
should hold their peace, the stones would immediately cry out.

19:41 And when HE[JESUS] was come near, HE[JESUS] beheld the city, and wept over it,

19:42 Saying, If you hadst known, even you, at least in this your day,
the things which belong unto your peace! but now they are hid from yours
eyes.

19:43 For the days shall come upon you, that yours enemies shall cast a
trench about you, and compass you round, and keep you in on every
side,

19:44 And shall lay you even with the ground, and your children within
you; and they shall not leave in you one stone upon another; because
you knewest not the time of your visitation.

19:45 And HE[JESUS] went into the temple, and began to cast out them that sold
therein, and them that bought;

19:46 Saying unto them, It is written, My house is the house of prayer:
but you have made it a den of thieves.

19:47 And HE[JESUS] taught daily in the temple. But the chief priests and the
