scribes and the chief of the people sought to destroy HIM[JESUS],

19:48 And could not find what they might do: for all the people were
very attentive to hear HIM[JESUS].


20:1 And it came to pass, that on one of those days, as HE[JESUS] taught the
people in the temple, and preached the gospel, the chief priests and the
scribes came upon HIM[JESUS] with the elders,

20:2 And spake unto HIM[JESUS], saying, Tell us, by what authority doest you
these things? or who is HE[JESUS] that gave you this authority?

20:3 And HE[JESUS] answered and said unto them, I will also ask you one thing;
and answer me:

20:4 The baptism of John, was it from heaven, or of men?

20:5 And they reasoned with themselves, saying, If we shall say, From
heaven; HE[JESUS] will say, Why then believed you HIM[JESUS] not?

20:6 But and if we say, Of men; all the people will stone us: for they
be persuaded that John was a PROPHET[JESUS].

20:7 And they answered, that they could not tell whence it was.

20:8 And JESUS said unto them, Neither tell I you by what authority I do
these things.

20:9 Then began HE[JESUS] to speak to the people this parable; A certain man
planted a vineyard, and let it forth to husbandmen, and went into a far
country for a long time.

20:10 And at the season HE[JESUS] sent a SERVANT[JESUS] to the husbandmen, that they
should give HIM[JESUS] of the fruit of the vineyard: but the husbandmen beat
HIM[JESUS], and sent HIM[JESUS] away empty.

20:11 And again HE[JESUS] sent another SERVANT[JESUS]: and they beat HIM[JESUS] also, and
entreated HIM[JESUS] shamefully, and sent HIM[JESUS] away empty.

20:12 And again HE[JESUS] sent a third: and they wounded HIM[JESUS] also, and cast HIM[JESUS]
out.

20:13 Then said the LORD[JESUS] of the vineyard, What shall I do? I will send
my beloved SON[JESUS]: it may be they will reverence HIM[JESUS] when they see HIM[JESUS].

20:14 But when the husbandmen saw HIM[JESUS], they reasoned among themselves,
saying, This is the heir: come, let us kill HIM[JESUS], that the inheritance
may be ours.

20:15 So they cast HIM[JESUS] out of the vineyard, and killed HIM[JESUS]. What
therefore shall the LORD[JESUS] of the vineyard do unto them?

20:16 HE[JESUS] shall come and destroy these husbandmen, and shall give the
vineyard to others. And when they heard it, they said, GOD[JESUS] forbid.

20:17 And HE[JESUS] beheld them, and said, What is this then that is written,
The stone which the builders rejected, the same is become the head of
the corner?

20:18 whoever shall fall upon that stone shall be broken; but on
whomsoever it shall fall, it will grind HIM[JESUS] to powder.

20:19 And the chief priests and the scribes the same hour sought to lay
hands on HIM[JESUS]; and they feared the people: for they perceived that HE[JESUS] had
spoken this parable against them.

20:20 And they watched HIM[JESUS], and sent forth spies, which should feign
themselves just men, that they might take hold of HIS[JESUS] words, that so
they might deliver HIM[JESUS] unto the power and authority of the governor.

20:21 And they asked HIM[JESUS], saying, Master, we know that you sayest and
teachest rightly, neither acceptest you the person of any, but teachest
the way of GOD[JESUS] truly:

20:22 Is it lawful for us to give tribute unto Caesar, or no?

20:23 But HE[JESUS] perceived their craftiness, and said unto them, Why tempt
you me?

20:24 Shew me a penny. Whose image and superscription has it? They
answered and said, Caesar's.

20:25 And HE[JESUS] said unto them, Render therefore unto Caesar the things
which be Caesar's, and unto GOD[JESUS] the things which be GOD[JESUS]'s.

20:26 And they could not take hold of HIS[JESUS] words before the people: and
they marvelled at HIS[JESUS] answer, and held their peace.

20:27 Then came to HIM[JESUS] certain of the Sadducees, which deny that there
is any resurrection; and they asked HIM[JESUS],

20:28 Saying, Master, Moses wrote unto us, If any man's brother die,
having a wife, and HE[JESUS] die without children, that HIS[JESUS] brother should take
HIS[JESUS] wife, and raise up SEED[JESUS] unto HIS[JESUS] brother.

20:29 There were therefore seven brethren: and the first took a wife,
and died without children.

20:30 And the second took her to wife, and HE[JESUS] died childless.

20:31 And the third took her; and in like manner the seven also: and
they left no children, and died.

20:32 Last of all the woman died also.

20:33 Therefore in the resurrection whose wife of them is she? for seven
had her to wife.

20:34 And JESUS answering said unto them, The children of this world
marry, and are given in marriage:

20:35 But they which shall be accounted worthy to obtain that world, and
the resurrection from the dead, neither marry, nor are given in
marriage:

20:36 Neither can they die any more: for they are equal unto the angels;
and are the children of GOD[JESUS], being the children of the resurrection.

20:37 Now that the dead are raised, even Moses shewed at the bush, when
HE[JESUS] calleth the LORD[JESUS] the GOD[JESUS] of Abraham, and the GOD[JESUS] of Isaac, and the
GOD[JESUS] of Jacob.

20:38 For HE[JESUS] is not a GOD[JESUS] of the dead, but of the living: for all live
unto HIM[JESUS].

20:39 Then certain of the scribes answering said, Master, you hast well
said.

20:40 And after that they durst not ask HIM[JESUS] any question at all.

20:41 And HE[JESUS] said unto them, How say they that CHRIST[JESUS] is David's SON[JESUS]?

20:42 And David himself says in the book of Psalms, The LORD[JESUS] said unto
my LORD[JESUS], Sit you on my right hand,

20:43 Till I make yours enemies your footstool.

20:44 David therefore calleth HIM[JESUS] LORD[JESUS], how is HE[JESUS] then HIS[JESUS] SON[JESUS]?

20:45 Then in the audience of all the people HE[JESUS] said unto HIS[JESUS] disciples,

20:46 Beware of the scribes, which desire to walk in long robes, and
love greetings in the markets, and the highest seats in the synagogues,
and the chief rooms at feasts;

20:47 Which devour widows' houses, and for a shew make long prayers: the
same shall receive greater damnation.


21:1 And HE[JESUS] looked up, and saw the rich men casting their gifts into the
treasury.

21:2 And HE[JESUS] saw also a certain poor widow casting in thither two mites.

21:3 And HE[JESUS] said, Of a truth I say unto you, that this poor widow has
cast in more than they all:

21:4 For all these have of their abundance cast in unto the offerings of
GOD[JESUS]: but she of her penury has cast in all the living that she had.

21:5 And as some spake of the temple, how it was adorned with goodly
stones and gifts, HE[JESUS] said,

21:6 As for these things which you behold, the days will come, in the
which there shall not be left one stone upon another, that shall not be
thrown down.

21:7 And they asked HIM[JESUS], saying, Master, but when shall these things be?
and what sign will there be when these things shall come to pass?

21:8 And HE[JESUS] said, Take heed that you be not deceived: for many shall come
in my name, saying, I am CHRIST[JESUS]; and the time draweth near: go you not
therefore after them.

21:9 But when you shall hear of wars and commotions, be not terrified:
for these things must first come to pass; but the end is not by and by.

21:10 Then said HE[JESUS] unto them, Nation shall rise against nation, and
kingdom against kingdom:

21:11 And great earthquakes shall be in divers places, and famines, and
pestilences; and fearful sights and great signs shall there be from
heaven.

21:12 But before all these, they shall lay their hands on you, and
persecute you, delivering you up to the synagogues, and into prisons,
being brought before kings and rulers for my name's sake.

21:13 And it shall turn to you for a testimony.

21:14 Settle it therefore in your hearts, not to meditate before what you
shall answer:

21:15 For I will give you a mouth and wisdom, which all your adversaries
shall not be able to gainsay nor resist.

21:16 And you shall be betrayed both by parents, and brethren, and
kinsfolks, and friends; and some of you shall they cause to be put to
death.

21:17 And you shall be hated of all men for my name's sake.

21:18 But there shall not an hair of your head perish.

21:19 In your patience possess you your souls.

21:20 And when you shall see Jerusalem compassed with armies, then know
that the desolation thereof is nigh.

21:21 Then let them which are in Judaea flee to the mountains; and let
them which are in the midst of it depart out; and let not them that are
in the countries enter thereinto.

21:22 For these be the days of vengeance, that all things which are
written may be fulfilled.

21:23 But woe unto them that are with child, and to them that give suck,
in those days! for there shall be great distress in the land, and wrath
upon this people.

21:24 And they shall fall by the edge of the sword, and shall be led
away captive into all nations: and Jerusalem shall be trodden down of
the Gentiles, until the times of the Gentiles be fulfilled.

21:25 And there shall be signs in the sun, and in the moon, and in the
stars; and upon the earth distress of nations, with perplexity; the sea
and the waves roaring;

21:26 Men's hearts failing them for fear, and for looking after those
things which are coming on the earth: for the powers of heaven shall be
shaken.

21:27 And then shall they see the SON[JESUS] OF MAN[JESUS] coming in a cloud with
power and great glory.

21:28 And when these things begin to come to pass, then look up, and
lift up your heads; for your redemption draweth nigh.

21:29 And HE[JESUS] spake to them a parable; Behold the fig tree, and all the
trees;

21:30 When they now shoot forth, you see and know of your own selves that
summer is now nigh at hand.

21:31 So likewise you, when you see these things come to pass, know you
that the kingdom of GOD[JESUS] is nigh at hand.

21:32 truly I say unto you, This generation shall not pass away, till
all be fulfilled.

21:33 Heaven and earth shall pass away: but my words shall not pass
away.

21:34 And take heed to yourselves, lest at any time your hearts be
overcharged with surfeiting, and drunkenness, and cares of this life,
and so that day come upon you unawares.

21:35 For as a snare shall it come on all them that dwell on the face of
the whole earth.

21:36 Watch you therefore, and pray always, that you may be accounted
worthy to escape all these things that shall come to pass, and to stand
before the SON[JESUS] OF MAN[JESUS].

21:37 And in the day time HE[JESUS] was teaching in the temple; and at night HE[JESUS]
went out, and abode in the mount that is called the mount of Olives.

21:38 And all the people came early in the morning to HIM[JESUS] in the temple,
for to hear HIM[JESUS].


22:1 Now the feast of unleavened bread drew nigh, which is called the
Passover.

22:2 And the chief priests and scribes sought how they might kill HIM[JESUS];
for they feared the people.

22:3 Then entered Satan into Judas surnamed Iscariot, being of the
number of the twelve.

22:4 And HE[JESUS] went HIS[JESUS] way, and communed with the chief priests and
captains, how HE[JESUS] might betray HIM[JESUS] unto them.

22:5 And they were glad, and covenanted to give HIM[JESUS] money.

22:6 And HE[JESUS] promised, and sought opportunity to betray HIM[JESUS] unto them in
the absence of the multitude.

22:7 Then came the day of unleavened bread, when the passover must be
killed.

22:8 And HE[JESUS] sent Peter and John, saying, Go and prepare us the passover,
that we may eat.

22:9 And they said unto HIM[JESUS], Where wilt you that we prepare?

22:10 And HE[JESUS] said unto them, Behold, when you are entered into the city,
there shall a man meet you, bearing a pitcher of water; follow HIM[JESUS] into
the house where HE[JESUS] entereth in.

22:11 And you shall say unto the goodman of the house, The Master says
unto you, Where is the guestchamber, where I shall eat the passover
with my disciples?

22:12 And HE[JESUS] shall shew you a large upper room furnished: there make
ready.

22:13 And they went, and found as HE[JESUS] had said unto them: and they made
ready the passover.

22:14 And when the hour was come, HE[JESUS] sat down, and the twelve apostles
with HIM[JESUS].

22:15 And HE[JESUS] said unto them, With desire I have desired to eat this
passover with you before I let:

22:16 For I say unto you, I will not any more eat thereof, until it be
fulfilled in the kingdom of GOD[JESUS].

22:17 And HE[JESUS] took the cup, and gave thanks, and said, Take this, and
divide it among yourselves:

22:18 For I say unto you, I will not drink of the fruit of the vine,
until the kingdom of GOD[JESUS] shall come.

22:19 And HE[JESUS] took bread, and gave thanks, and brake it, and gave unto
them, saying, This is my body which is given for you: this do in
remembrance of me.

22:20 Likewise also the cup after supper, saying, This cup is the new
testament in my blood, which is shed for you.

22:21 But, behold, the hand of HIM[JESUS] that betrayeth me is with me on the
table.

22:22 And truly the SON[JESUS] OF MAN[JESUS] goes, as it was determined: but woe unto
that man by whom HE[JESUS] is betrayed!

22:23 And they began to enquire among themselves, which of them it was
that should do this thing.

22:24 And there was also a strife among them, which of them should be
accounted the greatest.

22:25 And HE[JESUS] said unto them, The kings of the Gentiles exercise lordship
over them; and they that exercise authority upon them are called
benefactors.

22:26 But you shall not be so: but HE[JESUS] that is greatest among you, let HIM[JESUS]
be as the younger; and HE[JESUS] that is chief, as HE[JESUS] that does serve.

22:27 For whether is greater, HE[JESUS] that sitteth at meat, or HE[JESUS] that
serveth? is not HE[JESUS] that sitteth at meat? but I am among you as HE[JESUS] that
serveth.

22:28 you are they which have continued with me in my temptations.

22:29 And I appoint unto you a kingdom, as my Father has appointed unto
me;

22:30 That you may eat and drink at my table in my kingdom, and sit on
thrones judging the twelve tribes of Israel.

22:31 And the LORD[JESUS] said, Simon, Simon, behold, Satan has desired to
have you, that HE[JESUS] may sift you as wheat:

22:32 But I have prayed for you, that your faith fail not: and when you
art converted, strengthen your brethren.

22:33 And HE[JESUS] said unto HIM[JESUS], LORD[JESUS], I am ready to go with you, both into
prison, and to death.

22:34 And HE[JESUS] said, I tell you, Peter, the cock shall not crow this day,
before that you shalt thrice deny that you knowest me.

22:35 And HE[JESUS] said unto them, When I sent you without purse, and scrip,
and shoes, lacked you any thing? And they said, Nothing.

22:36 Then said HE[JESUS] unto them, But now, HE[JESUS] that has a purse, let HIM[JESUS]
take it, and likewise HIS[JESUS] scrip: and HE[JESUS] that has no sword, let HIM[JESUS] sell
HIS[JESUS] garment, and buy one.

22:37 For I say unto you, that this that is written must yet be
accomplished in me, And HE[JESUS] was reckoned among the transgressors: for the
things concerning me have an end.

22:38 And they said, LORD[JESUS], behold, here are two swords. And HE[JESUS] said unto
them, It is enough.

22:39 And HE[JESUS] came out, and went, as HE[JESUS] was wont, to the mount of Olives;
and HIS[JESUS] disciples also followed HIM[JESUS].

22:40 And when HE[JESUS] was at the place, HE[JESUS] said unto them, Pray that you
enter not into temptation.

22:41 And HE[JESUS] was withdrawn from them about a stone's cast, and kneeled
down, and prayed,

22:42 Saying, Father, if you be willing, remove this cup from me:
nevertheless not my will, but yours, be done.

22:43 And there appeared an angel unto HIM[JESUS] from heaven, strengthening
HIM[JESUS].

22:44 And being in an agony HE[JESUS] prayed more earnestly: and HIS[JESUS] sweat was
as it were great drops of blood falling down to the ground.

22:45 And when HE[JESUS] rose up from prayer, and was come to HIS[JESUS] disciples, HE[JESUS]
found them sleeping for sorrow,

22:46 And said unto them, Why sleep you? rise and pray, lest you enter
into temptation.

22:47 And while HE[JESUS] yet spake, behold a multitude, and HE[JESUS] that was called
Judas, one of the twelve, went before them, and drew near unto JESUS to
kiss HIM[JESUS].

22:48 But JESUS said unto HIM[JESUS], Judas, betrayest you the SON[JESUS] OF MAN[JESUS] with
a kiss?

22:49 When they which were about HIM[JESUS] saw what would follow, they said
unto HIM[JESUS], LORD[JESUS], shall we smite with the sword?

22:50 And one of them smote the SERVANT[JESUS] of the high priest, and cut off
HIS[JESUS] right ear.

22:51 And JESUS answered and said, let you thus far. And HE[JESUS] touched
HIS[JESUS] ear, and healed HIM[JESUS].

22:52 Then JESUS said unto the chief priests, and captains of the
temple, and the elders, which were come to HIM[JESUS], Be you come out, as
against a thief, with swords and staves?

22:53 When I was daily with you in the temple, you stretched forth no
hands against me: but this is your hour, and the power of darkness.

22:54 Then took they HIM[JESUS], and led HIM[JESUS], and brought HIM[JESUS] into the high
priest's house. And Peter followed afar off.

22:55 And when they had kindled a fire in the midst of the hall, and
were set down together, Peter sat down among them.

22:56 But a certain maid beheld HIM[JESUS] as HE[JESUS] sat by the fire, and earnestly
looked upon HIM[JESUS], and said, This man was also with HIM[JESUS].

22:57 And HE[JESUS] denied HIM[JESUS], saying, Woman, I know HIM[JESUS] not.

22:58 And after a little while another saw HIM[JESUS], and said, you art also
of them. And Peter said, Man, I am not.

22:59 And about the space of one hour after another confidently
affirmed, saying, Of a truth this fellow also was with HIM[JESUS]: for HE[JESUS] is a
Galilaean.

22:60 And Peter said, Man, I know not what you sayest. And immediately,
while HE[JESUS] yet spake, the cock crew.

22:61 And the LORD[JESUS] turned, and looked upon Peter. And Peter remembered
the WORD[JESUS] of the LORD[JESUS], how HE[JESUS] had said unto HIM[JESUS], Before the cock crow,
you shalt deny me thrice.

22:62 And Peter went out, and wept bitterly.

22:63 And the men that held JESUS mocked HIM[JESUS], and smote HIM[JESUS].

22:64 And when they had blindfolded HIM[JESUS], they struck HIM[JESUS] on the face,
and asked HIM[JESUS], saying, Prophesy, who is it that smote you?

22:65 And many other things blasphemously spake they against HIM[JESUS].

22:66 And as soon as it was day, the elders of the people and the chief
priests and the scribes came together, and led HIM[JESUS] into their council,
saying,

22:67 Art you the CHRIST[JESUS]? tell us. And HE[JESUS] said unto them, If I tell
you, you will not believe:

22:68 And if I also ask you, you will not answer me, nor let me go.

22:69 Hereafter shall the SON[JESUS] OF MAN[JESUS] sit on the right hand of the power
of GOD[JESUS].

22:70 Then said they all, Art you then the SON[JESUS] OF GOD[JESUS][JESUS]? And HE[JESUS] said unto
them, you say that I am.

22:71 And they said, What need we any further witness? for we ourselves
have heard of HIS[JESUS] own mouth.


23:1 And the whole multitude of them arose, and led HIM[JESUS] unto Pilate.

23:2 And they began to accuse HIM[JESUS], saying, We found this fellow
perverting the nation, and forbidding to give tribute to Caesar, saying
that HE[JESUS] himself is CHRIST[JESUS] a KING[JESUS].

23:3 And Pilate asked HIM[JESUS], saying, Art you the KING[JESUS] of the Jews? And HE[JESUS]
answered HIM[JESUS] and said, you sayest it.

23:4 Then said Pilate to the chief priests and to the people, I find no
fault in this man.

23:5 And they were the more fierce, saying, HE[JESUS] stirreth up the people,
teaching throughout all Jewry, beginning from Galilee to this place.

23:6 When Pilate heard of Galilee, HE[JESUS] asked whether the man were a
Galilaean.

23:7 And as soon as HE[JESUS] knew that HE[JESUS] belonged unto Herod's jurisdiction,
HE[JESUS] sent HIM[JESUS] to Herod, who himself also was at Jerusalem at that time.

23:8 And when Herod saw JESUS, HE[JESUS] was exceeding glad: for HE[JESUS] was
desirous to see HIM[JESUS] of a long season, because HE[JESUS] had heard many things
of HIM[JESUS]; and HE[JESUS] hoped to have seen some miracle done by HIM[JESUS].

23:9 Then HE[JESUS] questioned with HIM[JESUS] in many words; but HE[JESUS] answered HIM[JESUS]
nothing.

23:10 And the chief priests and scribes stood and vehemently accused
HIM[JESUS].

23:11 And Herod with HIS[JESUS] men of war set HIM[JESUS] at nought, and mocked HIM[JESUS],
and arrayed HIM[JESUS] in a gorgeous robe, and sent HIM[JESUS] again to Pilate.

23:12 And the same day Pilate and Herod were made friends together: for
before they were at enmity between themselves.

23:13 And Pilate, when HE[JESUS] had called together the chief priests and the
rulers and the people,

23:14 Said unto them, you have brought this man unto me, as one that
perverteth the people: and, behold, I, having examined HIM[JESUS] before you,
have found no fault in this man touching those things whereof you accuse
HIM[JESUS]:

23:15 No, nor yet Herod: for I sent you to HIM[JESUS]; and, lo, nothing worthy
of death is done unto HIM[JESUS].

23:16 I will therefore chastise HIM[JESUS], and release HIM[JESUS].

23:17 (For of necessity HE[JESUS] must release one unto them at the feast.)

23:18 And they cried out all at once, saying, Away with this man, and
release unto us Barabbas:

23:19 (Who for a certain sedition made in the city, and for murder, was
cast into prison.)

23:20 Pilate therefore, willing to release JESUS, spake again to them.

23:21 But they cried, saying, Crucify HIM[JESUS], crucify HIM[JESUS].

23:22 And HE[JESUS] said unto them the third time, Why, what evil has HE[JESUS] done?
I have found no cause of death in HIM[JESUS]: I will therefore chastise HIM[JESUS],
and let HIM[JESUS] go.

23:23 And they were instant with loud voices, requiring that HE[JESUS] might be
crucified. And the voices of them and of the chief priests prevailed.

23:24 And Pilate gave sentence that it should be as they required.

23:25 And HE[JESUS] released unto them HIM[JESUS] that for sedition and murder was
cast into prison, whom they had desired; but HE[JESUS] delivered JESUS to their
will.

23:26 And as they led HIM[JESUS] away, they laid hold upon one Simon, a
Cyrenian, coming out of the country, and on HIM[JESUS] they laid the cross,
that HE[JESUS] might bear it after JESUS.

23:27 And there followed HIM[JESUS] a great company of people, and of women,
which also bewailed and lamented HIM[JESUS].

23:28 But JESUS turning unto them said, Daughters of Jerusalem, weep not
for me, but weep for yourselves, and for your children.

23:29 For, behold, the days are coming, in the which they shall say,
Blessed are the barren, and the wombs that never bare, and the paps
which never gave suck.

23:30 Then shall they begin to say to the mountains, Fall on us; and to
the hills, Cover us.

23:31 For if they do these things in a green tree, what shall be done in
the dry?

23:32 And there were also two other, malefactors, led with HIM[JESUS] to be put
to death.

23:33 And when they were come to the place, which is called Calvary,
there they crucified HIM[JESUS], and the malefactors, one on the right hand,
and the other on the left.

23:34 Then said JESUS, Father, forgive them; for they know not what they
do. And they parted HIS[JESUS] raiment, and cast lots.

23:35 And the people stood beholding. And the rulers also with them
derided HIM[JESUS], saying, HE[JESUS] saved others; let HIM[JESUS] save himself, if HE[JESUS] be
CHRIST[JESUS], the chosen of GOD[JESUS].

23:36 And the soldiers also mocked HIM[JESUS], coming to HIM[JESUS], and offering HIM[JESUS]
vinegar,

23:37 And saying, If you be the KING[JESUS] of the Jews, save thyself.

23:38 And a superscription also was written over HIM[JESUS] in letters of
Greek, and Latin, and Hebrew, THIS IS THE KING[JESUS] OF THE JEWS.

23:39 And one of the malefactors which were hanged railed on HIM[JESUS],
saying, If you be CHRIST[JESUS], save thyself and us.

23:40 But the other answering rebuked HIM[JESUS], saying, Dost not you fear
GOD[JESUS], seeing you art in the same condemnation?

23:41 And we indeed justly; for we receive the due reward of our deeds:
but this man has done nothing amiss.

23:42 And HE[JESUS] said unto JESUS, LORD[JESUS], remember me when you comest into
your kingdom.

23:43 And JESUS said unto HIM[JESUS], truly I say unto you, To day shalt you
be with me in paradise.

23:44 And it was about the sixth hour, and there was a darkness over all
the earth until the ninth hour.

23:45 And the sun was darkened, and the veil of the temple was rent in
the midst.

23:46 And when JESUS had cried with a loud voice, HE[JESUS] said, Father, into
your hands I commend my spirit: and having said thus, HE[JESUS] gave up the
ghost.

23:47 Now when the centurion saw what was done, HE[JESUS] glorified GOD[JESUS],
saying, Certainly this was a righteous man.

23:48 And all the people that came together to that sight, beholding the
things which were done, smote their breasts, and returned.

23:49 And all HIS[JESUS] acquaintance, and the women that followed HIM[JESUS] from
Galilee, stood afar off, beholding these things.

23:50 And, behold, there was a man named Joseph, a COUNSELLOR[JESUS]; and HE[JESUS]
was a good man, and a just:

23:51 (The same had not consented to the counsel and deed of them;) HE[JESUS]
was of Arimathaea, a city of the Jews: who also himself waited for the
kingdom of GOD[JESUS].

23:52 This man went unto Pilate, and begged the body of JESUS.

23:53 And HE[JESUS] took it down, and wrapped it in linen, and laid it in a
sepulchre that was hewn in stone, wherein never man before was laid.

23:54 And that day was the preparation, and the sabbath drew on.

23:55 And the women also, which came with HIM[JESUS] from Galilee, followed
after, and beheld the sepulchre, and how HIS[JESUS] body was laid.

23:56 And they returned, and prepared spices and ointments; and rested
the sabbath day according to the commandment.


24:1 Now upon the first day of the week, very early in the morning, they
came unto the sepulchre, bringing the spices which they had prepared,
and certain others with them.

24:2 And they found the stone rolled away from the sepulchre.

24:3 And they entered in, and found not the body of the LORD[JESUS] JESUS.

24:4 And it came to pass, as they were much perplexed thereabout,
behold, two men stood by them in shining garments:

24:5 And as they were afraid, and bowed down their faces to the earth,
they said unto them, Why seek you the living among the dead?

24:6 HE[JESUS] is not here, but is risen: remember how HE[JESUS] spake unto you when
HE[JESUS] was yet in Galilee,

24:7 Saying, The SON[JESUS] OF MAN[JESUS] must be delivered into the hands of sinful
men, and be crucified, and the third day rise again.

24:8 And they remembered HIS[JESUS] words,

24:9 And returned from the sepulchre, and told all these things unto the
eleven, and to all the rest.

24:10 It was Mary Magdalene and Joanna, and Mary the mother of James,
and other women that were with them, which told these things unto the
apostles.

24:11 And their words seemed to them as idle tales, and they believed
them not.

24:12 Then arose Peter, and ran unto the sepulchre; and stooping down,
HE[JESUS] beheld the linen clothes laid by themselves, and departed, wondering
in himself at that which was come to pass.

24:13 And, behold, two of them went that same day to a village called
Emmaus, which was from Jerusalem about threescore furlongs.

24:14 And they talked together of all these things which had happened.

24:15 And it came to pass, that, while they communed together and
reasoned, JESUS himself drew near, and went with them.

24:16 But their eyes were holden that they should not know HIM[JESUS].

24:17 And HE[JESUS] said unto them, What manner of communications are these
that you have one to another, as you walk, and are sad?

24:18 And the one of them, whose name was Cleopas, answering said unto
HIM[JESUS], Art you only a stranger in Jerusalem, and hast not known the
things which are come to pass there in these days?

24:19 And HE[JESUS] said unto them, What things? And they said unto HIM[JESUS],
Concerning JESUS of Nazareth, which was a PROPHET[JESUS] mighty in deed and
WORD[JESUS] before GOD[JESUS] and all the people:

24:20 And how the chief priests and our rulers delivered HIM[JESUS] to be
condemned to death, and have crucified HIM[JESUS].

24:21 But we trusted that it had been HE[JESUS] which should have redeemed
Israel: and beside all this, to day is the third day since these things
were done.

24:22 Yea, and certain women also of our company made us astonished,
which were early at the sepulchre;

24:23 And when they found not HIS[JESUS] body, they came, saying, that they had
also seen a vision of angels, which said that HE[JESUS] was alive.

24:24 And certain of them which were with us went to the sepulchre, and
found it even so as the women had said: but HIM[JESUS] they saw not.

24:25 Then HE[JESUS] said unto them, O fools, and slow of heart to believe all
that the prophets have spoken:

24:26 Ought not CHRIST[JESUS] to have suffered these things, and to enter into
HIS[JESUS] glory?

24:27 And beginning at Moses and all the prophets, HE[JESUS] expounded unto
them in all the scriptures the things concerning himself.

24:28 And they drew nigh unto the village, whither they went: and HE[JESUS]
made as though HE[JESUS] would have gone further.

24:29 But they constrained HIM[JESUS], saying, Abide with us: for it is toward
evening, and the day is far spent. And HE[JESUS] went in to tarry with them.

24:30 And it came to pass, as HE[JESUS] sat at meat with them, HE[JESUS] took bread,
and blessed it, and brake, and gave to them.

24:31 And their eyes were opened, and they knew HIM[JESUS]; and HE[JESUS] vanished out
of their sight.

24:32 And they said one to another, Did not our heart burn within us,
while HE[JESUS] talked with us by the way, and while HE[JESUS] opened to us the
scriptures?

24:33 And they rose up the same hour, and returned to Jerusalem, and
found the eleven gathered together, and them that were with them,

24:34 Saying, The LORD[JESUS] is risen indeed, and has appeared to Simon.

24:35 And they told what things were done in the way, and how HE[JESUS] was
known of them in breaking of bread.

24:36 And as they thus spake, JESUS himself stood in the midst of them,
and says unto them, Peace be unto you.

24:37 But they were terrified and affrighted, and supposed that they had
seen a spirit.

24:38 And HE[JESUS] said unto them, Why are you troubled? and why do thoughts
arise in your hearts?

24:39 Behold my hands and my feet, that it is I myself: handle me, and
see; for a spirit has not flesh and bones, as you see me have.

24:40 And when HE[JESUS] had thus spoken, HE[JESUS] shewed them HIS[JESUS] hands and HIS[JESUS]
feet.

24:41 And while they yet believed not for joy, and wondered, HE[JESUS] said
unto them, Have you here any meat?

24:42 And they gave HIM[JESUS] a piece of a broiled fish, and of an honeycomb.

24:43 And HE[JESUS] took it, and did eat before them.

24:44 And HE[JESUS] said unto them, These are the words which I spake unto you,
while I was yet with you, that all things must be fulfilled, which were
written in the law of Moses, and in the prophets, and in the psalms,
concerning me.

24:45 Then opened HE[JESUS] their understanding, that they might understand the
scriptures,

24:46 And said unto them, Thus it is written, and thus it behoved CHRIST[JESUS]
to let, and to rise from the dead the third day:

24:47 And that repentance and remission of sins should be preached in
HIS[JESUS] name among all nations, beginning at Jerusalem.

24:48 And you are witnesses of these things.

24:49 And, behold, I send the promise of my Father upon you: but tarry
you in the city of Jerusalem, until you be endued with power from on high.

24:50 And HE[JESUS] led them out as far as to Bethany, and HE[JESUS] lifted up HIS[JESUS]
hands, and blessed them.

24:51 And it came to pass, while HE[JESUS] blessed them, HE[JESUS] was parted from
them, and carried up into heaven.

24:52 And they worshipped HIM[JESUS], and returned to Jerusalem with great joy:

24:53 And were continually in the temple, praising and blessing GOD[JESUS].
Amen.










John

Chapter

1:1 In the beginning was the WORD[JESUS], and the WORD[JESUS] was with GOD[JESUS], and the
WORD[JESUS] was GOD[JESUS].

1:2 The same was in the beginning with GOD[JESUS].

1:3 All things were made by HIM[JESUS]; and without HIM[JESUS] was not any thing made
that was made.

1:4 In HIM[JESUS] was life; and the life was the light of men.

1:5 And the light shineth in darkness; and the darkness comprehended it
not.

1:6 There was a man sent from GOD[JESUS], whose name was John.

1:7 The same came for a witness, to bear witness of the Light, that all
men through HIM[JESUS] might believe.

1:8 HE[JESUS] was not that Light, but was sent to bear witness of that Light.

1:9 That was the true Light, which lighteth every man that comes into
the world.

1:10 HE[JESUS] was in the world, and the world was made by HIM[JESUS], and the world
knew HIM[JESUS] not.

1:11 HE[JESUS] came unto HIS[JESUS] own, and HIS[JESUS] own received HIM[JESUS] not.

1:12 But as many as received HIM[JESUS], to them gave HE[JESUS] power to become the
sons of GOD[JESUS], even to them that believe on HIS[JESUS] name:

1:13 Which were born, not of blood, nor of the will of the flesh, nor of
the will of man, but of GOD[JESUS].

1:14 And the WORD[JESUS] was made flesh, and dwelt among us, (and we beheld HIS[JESUS]
glory, the glory as of the only begotten of the Father,) full of grace
and truth.

1:15 John bare witness of HIM[JESUS], and cried, saying, This was HE[JESUS] of whom I
spake, HE[JESUS] that comes after me is preferred before me: for HE[JESUS] was before
me.

1:16 And of HIS[JESUS] fulness have all we received, and grace for grace.

1:17 For the law was given by Moses, but grace and truth came by JESUS
CHRIST[JESUS].

1:18 No man has seen GOD[JESUS] at any time, the only begotten SON[JESUS], which is
in the bosom of the Father, HE[JESUS] has declared HIM[JESUS].

1:19 And this is the record of John, when the Jews sent priests and
Levites from Jerusalem to ask HIM[JESUS], Who art you?

1:20 And HE[JESUS] confessed, and denied not; but confessed, I am not the
CHRIST[JESUS].

1:21 And they asked HIM[JESUS], What then? Art you Elias? And HE[JESUS] says, I am
not. Art you that PROPHET[JESUS]? And HE[JESUS] answered, No.

1:22 Then said they unto HIM[JESUS], Who art you? that we may give an answer
to them that sent us. What sayest you of thyself?

1:23 HE[JESUS] said, I am the voice of one crying in the wilderness, Make
straight the way of the LORD[JESUS], as said the PROPHET[JESUS] Esaias.

1:24 And they which were sent were of the Pharisees.

1:25 And they asked HIM[JESUS], and said unto HIM[JESUS], Why baptizest you then, if
you be not that CHRIST[JESUS], nor Elias, neither that PROPHET[JESUS]?

1:26 John answered them, saying, I baptize with water: but there
standeth one among you, whom you know not;

1:27 HE[JESUS] it is, who coming after me is preferred before me, whose shoe's
latchet I am not worthy to unloose.

1:28 These things were done in Bethabara beyond Jordan, where John was
baptizing.

1:29 The next day John seeth JESUS coming unto HIM[JESUS], and says, Behold
the LAMB[JESUS] of GOD[JESUS], which taketh away the sin of the world.

1:30 This is HE[JESUS] of whom I said, After me comes a man which is preferred
before me: for HE[JESUS] was before me.

1:31 And I knew HIM[JESUS] not: but that HE[JESUS] should be made manifest to Israel,
therefore am I come baptizing with water.

1:32 And John bare record, saying, I saw the Spirit descending from
heaven like a dove, and it abode upon HIM[JESUS].

1:33 And I knew HIM[JESUS] not: but HE[JESUS] that sent me to baptize with water, the
same said unto me, Upon whom you shalt see the Spirit descending, and
remaining on HIM[JESUS], the same is HE[JESUS] which baptizeth with the Holy Ghost.

1:34 And I saw, and bare record that this is the SON[JESUS] OF GOD[JESUS][JESUS].

1:35 Again the next day after John stood, and two of HIS[JESUS] disciples;

1:36 And looking upon JESUS as HE[JESUS] walked, HE[JESUS] says, Behold the LAMB[JESUS] of
GOD[JESUS]!

1:37 And the two disciples heard HIM[JESUS] speak, and they followed JESUS.

1:38 Then JESUS turned, and saw them following, and says unto them,
What seek you? They said unto HIM[JESUS], Rabbi, (which is to say, being
interpreted, Master,) where dwellest you?

1:39 HE[JESUS] says unto them, Come and see. They came and saw where HE[JESUS] dwelt,
and abode with HIM[JESUS] that day: for it was about the tenth hour.

1:40 One of the two which heard John speak, and followed HIM[JESUS], was
Andrew, Simon Peter's brother.

1:41 HE[JESUS] first findeth HIS[JESUS] own brother Simon, and says unto HIM[JESUS], We have
found the Messias, which is, being interpreted, the CHRIST[JESUS].

1:42 And HE[JESUS] brought HIM[JESUS] to JESUS. And when JESUS beheld HIM[JESUS], HE[JESUS] said,
you art Simon the SON[JESUS] of Jona: you shalt be called Cephas, which is by
interpretation, A stone.

1:43 The day following JESUS would go forth into Galilee, and findeth
Philip, and says unto HIM[JESUS], Follow me.

1:44 Now Philip was of Bethsaida, the city of Andrew and Peter.

1:45 Philip findeth Nathanael, and says unto HIM[JESUS], We have found HIM[JESUS], of
whom Moses in the law, and the prophets, did write, JESUS of Nazareth,
the SON[JESUS] of Joseph.

1:46 And Nathanael said unto HIM[JESUS], Can there any good thing come out of
Nazareth? Philip says unto HIM[JESUS], Come and see.

1:47 JESUS saw Nathanael coming to HIM[JESUS], and says of HIM[JESUS], Behold an
Israelite indeed, in whom is no guile!

1:48 Nathanael says unto HIM[JESUS], Whence knowest you me? JESUS answered
and said unto HIM[JESUS], Before that Philip called you, when you wast under
the fig tree, I saw you.

1:49 Nathanael answered and says unto HIM[JESUS], Rabbi, you art the SON[JESUS] of
GOD[JESUS]; you art the KING[JESUS] of Israel.

1:50 JESUS answered and said unto HIM[JESUS], Because I said unto you, I saw
you under the fig tree, believest you? you shalt see greater things
than these.

1:51 And HE[JESUS] says unto HIM[JESUS], truly, truly, I say unto you, Hereafter you
shall see heaven open, and the angels of GOD[JESUS] ascending and descending
upon the SON[JESUS] OF MAN[JESUS].


2:1 And the third day there was a marriage in Cana of Galilee; and the
mother of JESUS was there:

2:2 And both JESUS was called, and HIS[JESUS] disciples, to the marriage.

2:3 And when they wanted wine, the mother of JESUS says unto HIM[JESUS], They
have no wine.

2:4 JESUS says unto her, Woman, what have I to do with you? mine hour
is not yet come.

2:5 HIS[JESUS] mother says unto the servants, Whatsoever HE[JESUS] says unto you, do
it.

2:6 And there were set there six waterpots of stone, after the manner of
the purifying of the Jews, containing two or three firkins apiece.

2:7 JESUS says unto them, Fill the waterpots with water. And they
filled them up to the brim.

2:8 And HE[JESUS] says unto them, Draw out now, and bear unto the governor of
the feast. And they bare it.

2:9 When the ruler of the feast had tasted the water that was made wine,
and knew not whence it was: (but the servants which drew the water
knew;) the governor of the feast called the bridegroom,

2:10 And says unto HIM[JESUS], Every man at the beginning does set forth good
wine; and when men have well drunk, then that which is worse: but you
hast kept the good wine until now.

2:11 This beginning of miracles did JESUS in Cana of Galilee, and
manifested forth HIS[JESUS] glory; and HIS[JESUS] disciples believed on HIM[JESUS].

2:12 After this HE[JESUS] went down to Capernaum, HE[JESUS], and HIS[JESUS] mother, and HIS[JESUS]
brethren, and HIS[JESUS] disciples: and they continued there not many days.

2:13 And the Jews' passover was at hand, and JESUS went up to Jerusalem.

2:14 And found in the temple those that sold oxen and sheep and doves,
and the changers of money sitting:

2:15 And when HE[JESUS] had made a scourge of small cords, HE[JESUS] drove them all
out of the temple, and the sheep, and the oxen; and poured out the
changers' money, and overthrew the tables;

2:16 And said unto them that sold doves, Take these things hence; make
not my Father's house an house of merchandise.

2:17 And HIS[JESUS] disciples remembered that it was written, The zeal of yours
house has eaten me up.

2:18 Then answered the Jews and said unto HIM[JESUS], What sign shewest you
unto us, seeing that you doest these things?

2:19 JESUS answered and said unto them, Destroy this temple, and in
three days I will raise it up.

2:20 Then said the Jews, Forty and six years was this temple in
building, and wilt you rear it up in three days?

2:21 But HE[JESUS] spake of the temple of HIS[JESUS] body.

2:22 When therefore HE[JESUS] was risen from the dead, HIS[JESUS] disciples remembered
that HE[JESUS] had said this unto them; and they believed the scripture, and
the WORD[JESUS] which JESUS had said.

2:23 Now when HE[JESUS] was in Jerusalem at the passover, in the feast day,
many believed in HIS[JESUS] name, when they saw the miracles which HE[JESUS] did.

2:24 But JESUS did not commit himself unto them, because HE[JESUS] knew all
men,

2:25 And needed not that any should testify of man: for HE[JESUS] knew what was
in man.


3:1 There was a man of the Pharisees, named Nicodemus, a ruler of the
Jews:

3:2 The same came to JESUS by night, and said unto HIM[JESUS], Rabbi, we know
that you art a teacher come from GOD[JESUS]: for no man can do these miracles
that you doest, except GOD[JESUS] be with HIM[JESUS].

3:3 JESUS answered and said unto HIM[JESUS], truly, truly, I say unto you,
Except a man be born again, HE[JESUS] cannot see the kingdom of GOD[JESUS].

3:4 Nicodemus says unto HIM[JESUS], How can a man be born when HE[JESUS] is old? can
HE[JESUS] enter the second time into HIS[JESUS] mother's womb, and be born?

3:5 JESUS answered, truly, truly, I say unto you, Except a man be
born of water and of the Spirit, HE[JESUS] cannot enter into the kingdom of
GOD[JESUS].

3:6 That which is born of the flesh is flesh; and that which is born of
the Spirit is spirit.

3:7 Marvel not that I said unto you, you must be born again.

3:8 The wind bloweth where it listeth, and you hearest the sound
thereof, but canst not tell whence it comes, and whither it goes: so
is every one that is born of the Spirit.

3:9 Nicodemus answered and said unto HIM[JESUS], How can these things be?

3:10 JESUS answered and said unto HIM[JESUS], Art you a master of Israel, and
knowest not these things?

3:11 truly, truly, I say unto you, We speak that we do know, and
testify that we have seen; and you receive not our witness.

3:12 If I have told you earthly things, and you believe not, how shall you
believe, if I tell you of heavenly things?

3:13 And no man has ascended up to heaven, but HE[JESUS] that came down from
heaven, even the SON[JESUS] OF MAN[JESUS] which is in heaven.

3:14 And as Moses lifted up the serpent in the wilderness, even so must
the SON[JESUS] OF MAN[JESUS] be lifted up:

3:15 That whoever believes in HIM[JESUS] should not perish, but have eternal
life.

3:16 For GOD[JESUS] so loved the world, that HE[JESUS] gave HIS[JESUS] only begotten SON[JESUS],
that whoever believes in HIM[JESUS] should not perish, but have everlasting
life.

3:17 For GOD[JESUS] sent not HIS[JESUS] SON[JESUS] into the world to condemn the world; but
that the world through HIM[JESUS] might be saved.

3:18 HE[JESUS] that believes on HIM[JESUS] is not condemned: but HE[JESUS] that believes
not is condemned already, because HE[JESUS] has not believed in the name of
the only begotten SON[JESUS] OF GOD[JESUS][JESUS].

3:19 And this is the condemnation, that light is come into the world,
and men loved darkness rather than light, because their deeds were evil.

3:20 For every one that doeth evil hateth the light, neither comes to
the light, lest HIS[JESUS] deeds should be reproved.

3:21 But HE[JESUS] that doeth truth comes to the light, that HIS[JESUS] deeds may be
made manifest, that they are wrought in GOD[JESUS].

3:22 After these things came JESUS and HIS[JESUS] disciples into the land of
Judaea; and there HE[JESUS] tarried with them, and baptized.

3:23 And John also was baptizing in Aenon near to Salim, because there
was much water there: and they came, and were baptized.

3:24 For John was not yet cast into prison.

3:25 Then there arose a question between some of John's disciples and
the Jews about purifying.

3:26 And they came unto John, and said unto HIM[JESUS], Rabbi, HE[JESUS] that was with
you beyond Jordan, to whom you barest witness, behold, the same
baptizeth, and all men come to HIM[JESUS].

3:27 John answered and said, A man can receive nothing, except it be
given HIM[JESUS] from heaven.

3:28 you yourselves bear me witness, that I said, I am not the CHRIST[JESUS],
but that I am sent before HIM[JESUS].

3:29 HE[JESUS] that has the bride is the bridegroom: but the friend of the
bridegroom, which standeth and heareth HIM[JESUS], rejoiceth greatly because of
the bridegroom's voice: this my joy therefore is fulfilled.

3:30 HE[JESUS] must increase, but I must decrease.

3:31 HE[JESUS] that comes from above is above all: HE[JESUS] that is of the earth is
earthly, and speaketh of the earth: HE[JESUS] that comes from heaven is above
all.

3:32 And what HE[JESUS] has seen and heard, that HE[JESUS] testifieth; and no man
receiveth HIS[JESUS] testimony.

3:33 HE[JESUS] that has received HIS[JESUS] testimony has set to HIS[JESUS] seal that GOD[JESUS]
is true.

3:34 For HE[JESUS] whom GOD[JESUS] has sent speaketh the words of GOD[JESUS]: for GOD[JESUS] giveth
not the Spirit by measure unto HIM[JESUS].

3:35 The Father loveth the SON[JESUS], and has given all things into HIS[JESUS] hand.

3:36 HE[JESUS] that believes on the SON[JESUS] has everlasting life: and HE[JESUS] that
believes not the SON[JESUS] shall not see life; but the wrath of GOD[JESUS] abideth
on HIM[JESUS].


4:1 When therefore the LORD[JESUS] knew how the Pharisees had heard that JESUS
made and baptized more disciples than John,

4:2 (Though JESUS himself baptized not, but HIS[JESUS] disciples,)

4:3 HE[JESUS] left Judaea, and departed again into Galilee.

4:4 And HE[JESUS] must needs go through Samaria.

4:5 Then comes HE[JESUS] to a city of Samaria, which is called Sychar, near to
the parcel of ground that Jacob gave to HIS[JESUS] SON[JESUS] Joseph.

4:6 Now Jacob's well was there. JESUS therefore, being wearied with HIS[JESUS]
journey, sat thus on the well: and it was about the sixth hour.

4:7 There comes a woman of Samaria to draw water: JESUS says unto her,
Give me to drink.

4:8 (For HIS[JESUS] disciples were gone away unto the city to buy meat.)

4:9 Then says the woman of Samaria unto HIM[JESUS], How is it that you, being
a Jew, askest drink of me, which am a woman of Samaria? for the Jews
have no dealings with the Samaritans.

4:10 JESUS answered and said unto her, If you knewest the gift of GOD[JESUS],
and who it is that says to you, Give me to drink; you wouldest have
asked of HIM[JESUS], and HE[JESUS] would have given you living water.

4:11 The woman says unto HIM[JESUS], Sir, you hast nothing to draw with, and
the well is deep: from whence then hast you that living water?

4:12 Art you greater than our father Jacob, which gave us the well, and
drank thereof himself, and HIS[JESUS] children, and HIS[JESUS] cattle?

4:13 JESUS answered and said unto her, whoever drinketh of this water
shall thirst again:

4:14 But whoever drinketh of the water that I shall give HIM[JESUS] shall
never thirst; but the water that I shall give HIM[JESUS] shall be in HIM[JESUS] a well
of water springing up into everlasting life.

4:15 The woman says unto HIM[JESUS], Sir, give me this water, that I thirst
not, neither come hither to draw.

4:16 JESUS says unto her, Go, call your husband, and come hither.

4:17 The woman answered and said, I have no husband. JESUS said unto
her, you hast well said, I have no husband:

4:18 For you hast had five husbands; and HE[JESUS] whom you now hast is not
your husband: in that saidst you truly.

4:19 The woman says unto HIM[JESUS], Sir, I perceive that you art a PROPHET[JESUS].

4:20 Our fathers worshipped in this mountain; and you say, that in
Jerusalem is the place where men ought to worship.

4:21 JESUS says unto her, Woman, believe me, the hour comes, when you
shall neither in this mountain, nor yet at Jerusalem, worship the
Father.

4:22 you worship you know not what: we know what we worship: for salvation
is of the Jews.

4:23 But the hour comes, and now is, when the true worshippers shall
worship the Father in spirit and in truth: for the Father seeketh such
to worship HIM[JESUS].

4:24 GOD[JESUS] is a Spirit: and they that worship HIM[JESUS] must worship HIM[JESUS] in
spirit and in truth.

4:25 The woman says unto HIM[JESUS], I know that Messias comes, which is
called CHRIST[JESUS]: when HE[JESUS] is come, HE[JESUS] will tell us all things.

4:26 JESUS says unto her, I that speak unto you am HE[JESUS].

4:27 And upon this came HIS[JESUS] disciples, and marvelled that HE[JESUS] talked with
the woman: yet no man said, What seekest you? or, Why talkest you with
her?

4:28 The woman then left her waterpot, and went her way into the city,
and says to the men,

4:29 Come, see a man, which told me all things that ever I did: is not
this the CHRIST[JESUS]?

4:30 Then they went out of the city, and came unto HIM[JESUS].

4:31 In the mean while HIS[JESUS] disciples prayed HIM[JESUS], saying, Master, eat.

4:32 But HE[JESUS] said unto them, I have meat to eat that you know not of.

4:33 Therefore said the disciples one to another, has any man brought
HIM[JESUS] ought to eat?

4:34 JESUS says unto them, My meat is to do the will of HIM[JESUS] that sent
me, and to finish HIS[JESUS] work.

4:35 Say not you, There are yet four months, and then comes harvest?
behold, I say unto you, Lift up your eyes, and look on the fields; for
they are white already to harvest.

4:36 And HE[JESUS] that reapeth receiveth wages, and gathereth fruit unto life
eternal: that both HE[JESUS] that soweth and HE[JESUS] that reapeth may rejoice
together.

4:37 And herein is that saying true, One soweth, and another reapeth.

4:38 I sent you to reap that whereon you bestowed no labour: other men
laboured, and you are entered into their labours.

4:39 And many of the Samaritans of that city believed on HIM[JESUS] for the
saying of the woman, which testified, HE[JESUS] told me all that ever I did.

4:40 So when the Samaritans were come unto HIM[JESUS], they besought HIM[JESUS] that
HE[JESUS] would tarry with them: and HE[JESUS] abode there two days.

4:41 And many more believed because of HIS[JESUS] own WORD[JESUS];

4:42 And said unto the woman, Now we believe, not because of your saying:
for we have heard HIM[JESUS] ourselves, and know that this is indeed the
CHRIST[JESUS], the Saviour of the world.

4:43 Now after two days HE[JESUS] departed thence, and went into Galilee.

4:44 For JESUS himself testified, that a PROPHET[JESUS] has no honour in HIS[JESUS]
own country.

4:45 Then when HE[JESUS] was come into Galilee, the Galilaeans received HIM[JESUS],
having seen all the things that HE[JESUS] did at Jerusalem at the feast: for
they also went unto the feast.

4:46 So JESUS came again into Cana of Galilee, where HE[JESUS] made the water
wine. And there was a certain nobleman, whose SON[JESUS] was sick at Capernaum.

4:47 When HE[JESUS] heard that JESUS was come out of Judaea into Galilee, HE[JESUS]
went unto HIM[JESUS], and besought HIM[JESUS] that HE[JESUS] would come down, and heal HIS[JESUS]
SON[JESUS]: for HE[JESUS] was at the point of death.

4:48 Then said JESUS unto HIM[JESUS], Except you see signs and wonders, you will
not believe.

4:49 The nobleman says unto HIM[JESUS], Sir, come down ere my child die.

4:50 JESUS says unto HIM[JESUS], Go your way; your SON[JESUS] liveth. And the man
believed the WORD[JESUS] that JESUS had spoken unto HIM[JESUS], and HE[JESUS] went HIS[JESUS] way.

4:51 And as HE[JESUS] was now going down, HIS[JESUS] servants met HIM[JESUS], and told HIM[JESUS],
saying, your SON[JESUS] liveth.

4:52 Then enquired HE[JESUS] of them the hour when HE[JESUS] began to amend. And they
said unto HIM[JESUS], Yesterday at the seventh hour the fever left HIM[JESUS].

4:53 So the father knew that it was at the same hour, in the which JESUS
said unto HIM[JESUS], your SON[JESUS] liveth: and himself believed, and HIS[JESUS] whole
house.

4:54 This is again the second miracle that JESUS did, when HE[JESUS] was come
out of Judaea into Galilee.


5:1 After this there was a feast of the Jews; and JESUS went up to
Jerusalem.

5:2 Now there is at Jerusalem by the sheep market a pool, which is
called in the Hebrew tongue Bethesda, having five porches.

5:3 In these lay a great multitude of impotent folk, of blind, halt,
withered, waiting for the moving of the water.

5:4 For an angel went down at a certain season into the pool, and
troubled the water: whoever then first after the troubling of the
water stepped in was made whole of whatsoever disease HE[JESUS] had.

5:5 And a certain man was there, which had an infirmity thirty and eight
years.

5:6 When JESUS saw HIM[JESUS] lie, and knew that HE[JESUS] had been now a long time in
that case, HE[JESUS] says unto HIM[JESUS], Wilt you be made whole?

5:7 The impotent man answered HIM[JESUS], Sir, I have no man, when the water is
troubled, to put me into the pool: but while I am coming, another
steppeth down before me.

5:8 JESUS says unto HIM[JESUS], Rise, take up your bed, and walk.

5:9 And immediately the man was made whole, and took up HIS[JESUS] bed, and
walked: and on the same day was the sabbath.

5:10 The Jews therefore said unto HIM[JESUS] that was cured, It is the sabbath
day: it is not lawful for you to carry your bed.

5:11 HE[JESUS] answered them, HE[JESUS] that made me whole, the same said unto me,
Take up your bed, and walk.

5:12 Then asked they HIM[JESUS], What man is that which said unto you, Take up
your bed, and walk?

5:13 And HE[JESUS] that was healed wist not who it was: for JESUS had conveyed
himself away, a multitude being in that place.

5:14 Afterward JESUS findeth HIM[JESUS] in the temple, and said unto HIM[JESUS],
Behold, you art made whole: sin no more, lest a worse thing come unto
you.

5:15 The man departed, and told the Jews that it was JESUS, which had
made HIM[JESUS] whole.

5:16 And therefore did the Jews persecute JESUS, and sought to slay HIM[JESUS],
because HE[JESUS] had done these things on the sabbath day.

5:17 But JESUS answered them, My Father worketh hitherto, and I work.

5:18 Therefore the Jews sought the more to kill HIM[JESUS], because HE[JESUS] not only
had broken the sabbath, but said also that GOD[JESUS] was HIS[JESUS] Father, making
himself equal with GOD[JESUS].

5:19 Then answered JESUS and said unto them, truly, truly, I say unto
you, The SON[JESUS] can do nothing of himself, but what HE[JESUS] seeth the Father do:
for what things soever HE[JESUS] doeth, these also doeth the SON[JESUS] likewise.

5:20 For the Father loveth the SON[JESUS], and sheweth HIM[JESUS] all things that
himself doeth: and HE[JESUS] will shew HIM[JESUS] greater works than these, that you
may marvel.

5:21 For as the Father raiseth up the dead, and quickeneth them; even so
the SON[JESUS] quickeneth whom HE[JESUS] will.

5:22 For the Father judgeth no man, but has committed all judgment unto
the SON[JESUS]:

5:23 That all men should honour the SON[JESUS], even as they honour the Father.
HE[JESUS] that honoureth not the SON[JESUS] honoureth not the Father which has sent
HIM[JESUS].

5:24 truly, truly, I say unto you, HE[JESUS] that heareth my WORD[JESUS], and
believes on HIM[JESUS] that sent me, has everlasting life, and shall not come
into condemnation; but is passed from death unto life.

5:25 truly, truly, I say unto you, The hour is coming, and now is,
when the dead shall hear the voice of the SON[JESUS] OF GOD[JESUS][JESUS]: and they that hear
shall live.

5:26 For as the Father has life in himself; so has HE[JESUS] given to the SON[JESUS]
to have life in himself;

5:27 And has given HIM[JESUS] authority to execute judgment also, because HE[JESUS]
is the SON[JESUS] OF MAN[JESUS].

5:28 Marvel not at this: for the hour is coming, in the which all that
are in the graves shall hear HIS[JESUS] voice,

5:29 And shall come forth; they that have done good, unto the
resurrection of life; and they that have done evil, unto the
resurrection of damnation.

5:30 I can of mine own self do nothing: as I hear, I judge: and my
judgment is just; because I seek not mine own will, but the will of the
Father which has sent me.

5:31 If I bear witness of myself, my witness is not true.

5:32 There is another that beareth witness of me; and I know that the
witness which HE[JESUS] witnesseth of me is true.

5:33 you sent unto John, and HE[JESUS] bare witness unto the truth.

5:34 But I receive not testimony from man: but these things I say, that
you might be saved.

5:35 HE[JESUS] was a burning and a shining light: and you were willing for a
season to rejoice in HIS[JESUS] light.

5:36 But I have greater witness than that of John: for the works which
the Father has given me to finish, the same works that I do, bear
witness of me, that the Father has sent me.

5:37 And the Father himself, which has sent me, has borne witness of
me. you have neither heard HIS[JESUS] voice at any time, nor seen HIS[JESUS] shape.

5:38 And you have not HIS[JESUS] WORD[JESUS] abiding in you: for whom HE[JESUS] has sent, HIM[JESUS]
you believe not.

5:39 Search the scriptures; for in them you think you have eternal life:
and they are they which testify of me.

5:40 And you will not come to me, that you might have life.

5:41 I receive not honour from men.

5:42 But I know you, that you have not the love of GOD[JESUS] in you.

5:43 I am come in my Father's name, and you receive me not: if another
shall come in HIS[JESUS] own name, HIM[JESUS] you will receive.

5:44 How can you believe, which receive honour one of another, and seek
not the honour that comes from GOD[JESUS] only?

5:45 Do not think that I will accuse you to the Father: there is one
that accuseth you, even Moses, in whom you trust.

5:46 For had you believed Moses, you would have believed me; for HE[JESUS] wrote
of me.

5:47 But if you believe not HIS[JESUS] writings, how shall you believe my words?


6:1 After these things JESUS went over the sea of Galilee, which is the
sea of Tiberias.

6:2 And a great multitude followed HIM[JESUS], because they saw HIS[JESUS] miracles
which HE[JESUS] did on them that were diseased.

6:3 And JESUS went up into a mountain, and there HE[JESUS] sat with HIS[JESUS]
disciples.

6:4 And the passover, a feast of the Jews, was nigh.

6:5 When JESUS then lifted up HIS[JESUS] eyes, and saw a great company come
unto HIM[JESUS], HE[JESUS] says unto Philip, Whence shall we buy bread, that these
may eat?

6:6 And this HE[JESUS] said to prove HIM[JESUS]: for HE[JESUS] himself knew what HE[JESUS] would do.

6:7 Philip answered HIM[JESUS], Two hundred pennyworth of bread is not
sufficient for them, that every one of them may take a little.

6:8 One of HIS[JESUS] disciples, Andrew, Simon Peter's brother, says unto HIM[JESUS],

6:9 There is a lad here, which has five barley loaves, and two small
fishes: but what are they among so many?

6:10 And JESUS said, Make the men sit down. Now there was much grass in
the place. So the men sat down, in number about five thousand.

6:11 And JESUS took the loaves; and when HE[JESUS] had given thanks, HE[JESUS]
distributed to the disciples, and the disciples to them that were set
down; and likewise of the fishes as much as they would.

6:12 When they were filled, HE[JESUS] said unto HIS[JESUS] disciples, Gather up the
fragments that remain, that nothing be lost.

6:13 Therefore they gathered them together, and filled twelve baskets
with the fragments of the five barley loaves, which remained over and
above unto them that had eaten.

6:14 Then those men, when they had seen the miracle that JESUS did,
said, This is of a truth that PROPHET[JESUS] that should come into the world.

6:15 When JESUS therefore perceived that they would come and take HIM[JESUS] by
force, to make HIM[JESUS] a KING[JESUS], HE[JESUS] departed again into a mountain himself
alone.

6:16 And when even was now come, HIS[JESUS] disciples went down unto the sea,

6:17 And entered into a ship, and went over the sea toward Capernaum.
And it was now dark, and JESUS was not come to them.

6:18 And the sea arose by reason of a great wind that blew.

6:19 So when they had rowed about five and twenty or thirty furlongs,
they see JESUS walking on the sea, and drawing nigh unto the ship: and
they were afraid.

6:20 But HE[JESUS] says unto them, It is I; be not afraid.

6:21 Then they willingly received HIM[JESUS] into the ship: and immediately the
ship was at the land whither they went.

6:22 The day following, when the people which stood on the other side of
the sea saw that there was none other boat there, save that one
whereinto HIS[JESUS] disciples were entered, and that JESUS went not with HIS[JESUS]
disciples into the boat, but that HIS[JESUS] disciples were gone away alone;

6:23 (Howbeit there came other boats from Tiberias nigh unto the place
where they did eat bread, after that the LORD[JESUS] had given thanks:)

6:24 When the people therefore saw that JESUS was not there, neither HIS[JESUS]
disciples, they also took shipping, and came to Capernaum, seeking for
JESUS.

6:25 And when they had found HIM[JESUS] on the other side of the sea, they said
unto HIM[JESUS], Rabbi, when camest you hither?

6:26 JESUS answered them and said, truly, truly, I say unto you, you
seek me, not because you saw the miracles, but because you did eat of the
loaves, and were filled.

6:27 Labour not for the meat which perisheth, but for that meat which
endureth unto everlasting life, which the SON[JESUS] OF MAN[JESUS] shall give unto
you: for HIM[JESUS] has GOD[JESUS] the Father sealed.

6:28 Then said they unto HIM[JESUS], What shall we do, that we might work the
works of GOD[JESUS]?

6:29 JESUS answered and said unto them, This is the work of GOD[JESUS], that you
believe on HIM[JESUS] whom HE[JESUS] has sent.

6:30 They said therefore unto HIM[JESUS], What sign shewest you then, that we
may see, and believe you? what dost you work?

6:31 Our fathers did eat manna in the desert; as it is written, HE[JESUS] gave
them bread from heaven to eat.

6:32 Then JESUS said unto them, truly, truly, I say unto you, Moses
gave you not that bread from heaven; but my Father giveth you the true
bread from heaven.

6:33 For the bread of GOD[JESUS] is HE[JESUS] which comes down from heaven, and
giveth life unto the world.

6:34 Then said they unto HIM[JESUS], LORD[JESUS], evermore give us this bread.

6:35 And JESUS said unto them, I am the bread of life: HE[JESUS] that comes to
me shall never hunger; and HE[JESUS] that believes on me shall never thirst.

6:36 But I said unto you, That you also have seen me, and believe not.

6:37 All that the Father giveth me shall come to me; and HIM[JESUS] that comes
to me I will in no wise cast out.

6:38 For I came down from heaven, not to do mine own will, but the will
of HIM[JESUS] that sent me.

6:39 And this is the Father's will which has sent me, that of all which
HE[JESUS] has given me I should lose nothing, but should raise it up again at
the last day.

6:40 And this is the will of HIM[JESUS] that sent me, that every one which
seeth the SON[JESUS], and believes on HIM[JESUS], may have everlasting life: and I
will raise HIM[JESUS] up at the last day.

6:41 The Jews then murmured at HIM[JESUS], because HE[JESUS] said, I am the bread
which came down from heaven.

6:42 And they said, Is not this JESUS, the SON[JESUS] of Joseph, whose father
and mother we know? how is it then that HE[JESUS] says, I came down from
heaven?

6:43 JESUS therefore answered and said unto them, Murmur not among
yourselves.

6:44 No man can come to me, except the Father which has sent me draw
HIM[JESUS]: and I will raise HIM[JESUS] up at the last day.

6:45 It is written in the prophets, And they shall be all taught of GOD[JESUS].
Every man therefore that has heard, and has learned of the Father,
comes unto me.

6:46 Not that any man has seen the Father, save HE[JESUS] which is of GOD[JESUS], HE[JESUS]
has seen the Father.

6:47 truly, truly, I say unto you, HE[JESUS] that believes on me has
everlasting life.

6:48 I am that bread of life.

6:49 Your fathers did eat manna in the wilderness, and are dead.

6:50 This is the bread which comes down from heaven, that a man may eat
thereof, and not die.

6:51 I am the living bread which came down from heaven: if any man eat
of this bread, HE[JESUS] shall live for ever: and the bread that I will give is
my flesh, which I will give for the life of the world.

6:52 The Jews therefore strove among themselves, saying, How can this
man give us HIS[JESUS] flesh to eat?

6:53 Then JESUS said unto them, truly, truly, I say unto you, Except
you eat the flesh of the SON[JESUS] OF MAN[JESUS], and drink HIS[JESUS] blood, you have no life
in you.

6:54 whoever eateth my flesh, and drinketh my blood, has eternal life;
and I will raise HIM[JESUS] up at the last day.

6:55 For my flesh is meat indeed, and my blood is drink indeed.

6:56 HE[JESUS] that eateth my flesh, and drinketh my blood, dwelleth in me, and
I in HIM[JESUS].

6:57 As the living Father has sent me, and I live by the Father: so HE[JESUS]
that eateth me, even HE[JESUS] shall live by me.

6:58 This is that bread which came down from heaven: not as your fathers
did eat manna, and are dead: HE[JESUS] that eateth of this bread shall live for
ever.

6:59 These things said HE[JESUS] in the synagogue, as HE[JESUS] taught in Capernaum.

6:60 Many therefore of HIS[JESUS] disciples, when they had heard this, said,
This is an hard saying; who can hear it?

6:61 When JESUS knew in himself that HIS[JESUS] disciples murmured at it, HE[JESUS]
said unto them, does this offend you?

6:62 What and if you shall see the SON[JESUS] OF MAN[JESUS] ascend up where HE[JESUS] was
before?

6:63 It is the spirit that quickeneth; the flesh profiteth nothing: the
words that I speak unto you, they are spirit, and they are life.

6:64 But there are some of you that believe not. For JESUS knew from the
beginning who they were that believed not, and who should betray HIM[JESUS].

6:65 And HE[JESUS] said, Therefore said I unto you, that no man can come unto
me, except it were given unto HIM[JESUS] of my Father.

6:66 From that time many of HIS[JESUS] disciples went back, and walked no more
with HIM[JESUS].

6:67 Then said JESUS unto the twelve, Will you also go away?

6:68 Then Simon Peter answered HIM[JESUS], LORD[JESUS], to whom shall we go? you hast
the words of eternal life.

6:69 And we believe and are sure that you art that CHRIST[JESUS], the SON[JESUS] of
the living GOD[JESUS].

6:70 JESUS answered them, Have not I chosen you twelve, and one of you
is a devil?

6:71 HE[JESUS] spake of Judas Iscariot the SON[JESUS] of Simon: for HE[JESUS] it was that
should betray HIM[JESUS], being one of the twelve.


7:1 After these things JESUS walked in Galilee: for HE[JESUS] would not walk in
Jewry, because the Jews sought to kill HIM[JESUS].

7:2 Now the Jew's feast of tabernacles was at hand.

7:3 HIS[JESUS] brethren therefore said unto HIM[JESUS], Depart hence, and go into
Judaea, that your disciples also may see the works that you doest.

7:4 For there is no man that doeth any thing in secret, and HE[JESUS] himself
seeketh to be known openly. If you do these things, shew thyself to the
world.

7:5 For neither did HIS[JESUS] brethren believe in HIM[JESUS].

7:6 Then JESUS said unto them, My time is not yet come: but your time is
alway ready.

7:7 The world cannot hate you; but me it hateth, because I testify of
it, that the works thereof are evil.

7:8 Go you up unto this feast: I go not up yet unto this feast: for my
time is not yet full come.

7:9 When HE[JESUS] had said these words unto them, HE[JESUS] abode still in Galilee.

7:10 But when HIS[JESUS] brethren were gone up, then went HE[JESUS] also up unto the
feast, not openly, but as it were in secret.

7:11 Then the Jews sought HIM[JESUS] at the feast, and said, Where is HE[JESUS]?

7:12 And there was much murmuring among the people concerning HIM[JESUS]: for
some said, HE[JESUS] is a good man: others said, Nay; but HE[JESUS] deceiveth the
people.

7:13 Howbeit no man spake openly of HIM[JESUS] for fear of the Jews.

7:14 Now about the midst of the feast JESUS went up into the temple, and
taught.

7:15 And the Jews marvelled, saying, How knoweth this man letters,
having never learned?

7:16 JESUS answered them, and said, My doctrine is not mine, but HIS[JESUS]
that sent me.

7:17 If any man will do HIS[JESUS] will, HE[JESUS] shall know of the doctrine, whether
it be of GOD[JESUS], or whether I speak of myself.

7:18 HE[JESUS] that speaketh of himself seeketh HIS[JESUS] own glory: but HE[JESUS] that
seeketh HIS[JESUS] glory that sent HIM[JESUS], the same is true, and no
unrighteousness is in HIM[JESUS].

7:19 Did not Moses give you the law, and yet none of you keepeth the
law? Why go you about to kill me?

7:20 The people answered and said, you hast a devil: who goes about to
kill you?

7:21 JESUS answered and said unto them, I have done one work, and you all
marvel.

7:22 Moses therefore gave unto you circumcision; (not because it is of
Moses, but of the fathers;) and you on the sabbath day circumcise a man.

7:23 If a man on the sabbath day receive circumcision, that the law of
Moses should not be broken; are you angry at me, because I have made a
man every whit whole on the sabbath day?

7:24 Judge not according to the appearance, but judge righteous
judgment.

7:25 Then said some of them of Jerusalem, Is not this HE[JESUS], whom they seek
to kill?

7:26 But, lo, HE[JESUS] speaketh boldly, and they say nothing unto HIM[JESUS]. Do the
rulers know indeed that this is the very CHRIST[JESUS]?

7:27 Howbeit we know this man whence HE[JESUS] is: but when CHRIST[JESUS] comes, no
man knoweth whence HE[JESUS] is.

7:28 Then cried JESUS in the temple as HE[JESUS] taught, saying, you both know
me, and you know whence I am: and I am not come of myself, but HE[JESUS] that
sent me is true, whom you know not.

7:29 But I know HIM[JESUS]: for I am from HIM[JESUS], and HE[JESUS] has sent me.

7:30 Then they sought to take HIM[JESUS]: but no man laid hands on HIM[JESUS], because
HIS[JESUS] hour was not yet come.

7:31 And many of the people believed on HIM[JESUS], and said, When CHRIST[JESUS]
comes, will HE[JESUS] do more miracles than these which this man has done?

7:32 The Pharisees heard that the people murmured such things concerning
HIM[JESUS]; and the Pharisees and the chief priests sent officers to take HIM[JESUS].

7:33 Then said JESUS unto them, Yet a little while am I with you, and
then I go unto HIM[JESUS] that sent me.

7:34 you shall seek me, and shall not find me: and where I am, thither you
cannot come.

7:35 Then said the Jews among themselves, Whither will HE[JESUS] go, that we
shall not find HIM[JESUS]? will HE[JESUS] go unto the dispersed among the Gentiles,
and teach the Gentiles?

7:36 What manner of saying is this that HE[JESUS] said, you shall seek me, and
shall not find me: and where I am, thither you cannot come?

7:37 In the last day, that great day of the feast, JESUS stood and
cried, saying, If any man thirst, let HIM[JESUS] come unto me, and drink.

7:38 HE[JESUS] that believes on me, as the scripture has said, out of HIS[JESUS]
belly shall flow rivers of living water.

7:39 (But this spake HE[JESUS] of the Spirit, which they that believe on HIM[JESUS]
should receive: for the Holy Ghost was not yet given; because that JESUS
was not yet glorified.)

7:40 Many of the people therefore, when they heard this saying, said, Of
a truth this is the PROPHET[JESUS].

7:41 Others said, This is the CHRIST[JESUS]. But some said, Shall CHRIST[JESUS] come
out of Galilee?

7:42 has not the scripture said, That CHRIST[JESUS] comes of the SEED[JESUS] of
David, and out of the town of Bethlehem, where David was?

7:43 So there was a division among the people because of HIM[JESUS].

7:44 And some of them would have taken HIM[JESUS]; but no man laid hands on
HIM[JESUS].

7:45 Then came the officers to the chief priests and Pharisees; and they
said unto them, Why have you not brought HIM[JESUS]?

7:46 The officers answered, Never man spake like this man.

7:47 Then answered them the Pharisees, Are you also deceived?

7:48 Have any of the rulers or of the Pharisees believed on HIM[JESUS]?

7:49 But this people who knoweth not the law are cursed.

7:50 Nicodemus says unto them, (HE[JESUS] that came to JESUS by night, being
one of them,)

7:51 does our law judge any man, before it hear HIM[JESUS], and know what HE[JESUS]
doeth?

7:52 They answered and said unto HIM[JESUS], Art you also of Galilee? Search,
and look: for out of Galilee ariseth no PROPHET[JESUS].

7:53 And every man went unto HIS[JESUS] own house.


8:1 JESUS went unto the mount of Olives.

8:2 And early in the morning HE[JESUS] came again into the temple, and all the
people came unto HIM[JESUS]; and HE[JESUS] sat down, and taught them.

8:3 And the scribes and Pharisees brought unto HIM[JESUS] a woman taken in
adultery; and when they had set her in the midst,

8:4 They say unto HIM[JESUS], Master, this woman was taken in adultery, in the
very act.

8:5 Now Moses in the law commanded us, that such should be stoned: but
what sayest you?

8:6 This they said, tempting HIM[JESUS], that they might have to accuse HIM[JESUS].
But JESUS stooped down, and with HIS[JESUS] finger wrote on the ground, as
though HE[JESUS] heard them not.

8:7 So when they continued asking HIM[JESUS], HE[JESUS] lifted up himself, and said
unto them, HE[JESUS] that is without sin among you, let HIM[JESUS] first cast a stone
at her.

8:8 And again HE[JESUS] stooped down, and wrote on the ground.

8:9 And they which heard it, being convicted by their own conscience,
went out one by one, beginning at the eldest, even unto the last: and
JESUS was left alone, and the woman standing in the midst.

8:10 When JESUS had lifted up himself, and saw none but the woman, HE[JESUS]
said unto her, Woman, where are those yours accusers? has no man
condemned you?

8:11 She said, No man, LORD[JESUS]. And JESUS said unto her, Neither do I
condemn you: go, and sin no more.

8:12 Then spake JESUS again unto them, saying, I am the light of the
world: HE[JESUS] that followeth me shall not walk in darkness, but shall have
the light of life.

8:13 The Pharisees therefore said unto HIM[JESUS], you bearest record of
thyself; your record is not true.

8:14 JESUS answered and said unto them, Though I bear record of myself,
yet my record is true: for I know whence I came, and whither I go; but
you cannot tell whence I come, and whither I go.

8:15 you judge after the flesh; I judge no man.

8:16 And yet if I judge, my judgment is true: for I am not alone, but I
and the Father that sent me.

8:17 It is also written in your law, that the testimony of two men is
true.

8:18 I am one that bear witness of myself, and the Father that sent me
beareth witness of me.

8:19 Then said they unto HIM[JESUS], Where is your Father? JESUS answered, you
neither know me, nor my Father: if you had known me, you should have known
my Father also.

8:20 These words spake JESUS in the treasury, as HE[JESUS] taught in the
temple: and no man laid hands on HIM[JESUS]; for HIS[JESUS] hour was not yet come.

8:21 Then said JESUS again unto them, I go my way, and you shall seek me,
and shall die in your sins: whither I go, you cannot come.

8:22 Then said the Jews, Will HE[JESUS] kill himself? because HE[JESUS] says, Whither
I go, you cannot come.

8:23 And HE[JESUS] said unto them, you are from beneath; I am from above: you are
of this world; I am not of this world.

8:24 I said therefore unto you, that you shall die in your sins: for if
you believe not that I am HE[JESUS], you shall die in your sins.

8:25 Then said they unto HIM[JESUS], Who art you? And JESUS says unto them,
Even the same that I said unto you from the beginning.

8:26 I have many things to say and to judge of you: but HE[JESUS] that sent me
is true; and I speak to the world those things which I have heard of
HIM[JESUS].

8:27 They understood not that HE[JESUS] spake to them of the Father.

8:28 Then said JESUS unto them, When you have lifted up the SON[JESUS] OF MAN[JESUS],
then shall you know that I am HE[JESUS], and that I do nothing of myself; but as
my Father has taught me, I speak these things.

8:29 And HE[JESUS] that sent me is with me: the Father has not left me alone;
for I do always those things that please HIM[JESUS].

8:30 As HE[JESUS] spake these words, many believed on HIM[JESUS].

8:31 Then said JESUS to those Jews which believed on HIM[JESUS], If you continue
in my WORD[JESUS], then are you my disciples indeed;

8:32 And you shall know the truth, and the truth shall make you free.

8:33 They answered HIM[JESUS], We be Abraham's SEED[JESUS], and were never in bondage
to any man: how sayest you, you shall be made free?

8:34 JESUS answered them, truly, truly, I say unto you, whoever
committeth sin is the SERVANT[JESUS] of sin.

8:35 And the SERVANT[JESUS] abideth not in the house for ever: but the SON[JESUS]
abideth ever.

8:36 If the SON[JESUS] therefore shall make you free, you shall be free indeed.

8:37 I know that you are Abraham's SEED[JESUS]; but you seek to kill me, because
my WORD[JESUS] has no place in you.

8:38 I speak that which I have seen with my Father: and you do that which
you have seen with your father.

8:39 They answered and said unto HIM[JESUS], Abraham is our father. JESUS says
unto them, If you were Abraham's children, you would do the works of
Abraham.

8:40 But now you seek to kill me, a man that has told you the truth,
which I have heard of GOD[JESUS]: this did not Abraham.

8:41 you do the deeds of your father. Then said they to HIM[JESUS], We be not
born of fornication; we have one Father, even GOD[JESUS].

8:42 JESUS said unto them, If GOD[JESUS] were your Father, you would love me:
for I proceeded forth and came from GOD[JESUS]; neither came I of myself, but
HE[JESUS] sent me.

8:43 Why do you not understand my speech? even because you cannot hear my
WORD[JESUS].

8:44 you are of your father the devil, and the lusts of your father you
will do. HE[JESUS] was a murderer from the beginning, and abode not in the
truth, because there is no truth in HIM[JESUS]. When HE[JESUS] speaketh a lie, HE[JESUS]
speaketh of HIS[JESUS] own: for HE[JESUS] is a liar, and the father of it.

8:45 And because I tell you the truth, you believe me not.

8:46 Which of you convinceth me of sin? And if I say the truth, why do
you not believe me?

8:47 HE[JESUS] that is of GOD[JESUS] heareth GOD[JESUS]'s words: you therefore hear them not,
because you are not of GOD[JESUS].

8:48 Then answered the Jews, and said unto HIM[JESUS], Say we not well that
you art a Samaritan, and hast a devil?

8:49 JESUS answered, I have not a devil; but I honour my Father, and you
do dishonour me.
