8:50 And I seek not mine own glory: there is one that seeketh and
judgeth.

8:51 truly, truly, I say unto you, If a man keep my saying, HE[JESUS] shall
never see death.

8:52 Then said the Jews unto HIM[JESUS], Now we know that you hast a devil.
Abraham is dead, and the prophets; and you sayest, If a man keep my
saying, HE[JESUS] shall never taste of death.

8:53 Art you greater than our father Abraham, which is dead? and the
prophets are dead: whom makest you thyself?

8:54 JESUS answered, If I honour myself, my honour is nothing: it is my
Father that honoureth me; of whom you say, that HE[JESUS] is your GOD[JESUS]:

8:55 Yet you have not known HIM[JESUS]; but I know HIM[JESUS]: and if I should say, I
know HIM[JESUS] not, I shall be a liar like unto you: but I know HIM[JESUS], and keep
HIS[JESUS] saying.

8:56 Your father Abraham rejoiced to see my day: and HE[JESUS] saw it, and was
glad.

8:57 Then said the Jews unto HIM[JESUS], you art not yet fifty years old, and
hast you seen Abraham?

8:58 JESUS said unto them, truly, truly, I say unto you, Before
Abraham was, I am.

8:59 Then took they up stones to cast at HIM[JESUS]: but JESUS hid himself, and
went out of the temple, going through the midst of them, and so passed
by.


9:1 And as JESUS passed by, HE[JESUS] saw a man which was blind from HIS[JESUS] birth.

9:2 And HIS[JESUS] disciples asked HIM[JESUS], saying, Master, who did sin, this man,
or HIS[JESUS] parents, that HE[JESUS] was born blind?

9:3 JESUS answered, Neither has this man sinned, nor HIS[JESUS] parents: but
that the works of GOD[JESUS] should be made manifest in HIM[JESUS].

9:4 I must work the works of HIM[JESUS] that sent me, while it is day: the
night comes, when no man can work.

9:5 As long as I am in the world, I am the light of the world.

9:6 When HE[JESUS] had thus spoken, HE[JESUS] spat on the ground, and made clay of the
spittle, and HE[JESUS] anointed the eyes of the blind man with the clay,

9:7 And said unto HIM[JESUS], Go, wash in the pool of Siloam, (which is by
interpretation, Sent.) HE[JESUS] went HIS[JESUS] way therefore, and washed, and came
seeing.

9:8 The neighbours therefore, and they which before had seen HIM[JESUS] that HE[JESUS]
was blind, said, Is not this HE[JESUS] that sat and begged?

9:9 Some said, This is HE[JESUS]: others said, HE[JESUS] is like HIM[JESUS]: but HE[JESUS] said, I
am HE[JESUS].

9:10 Therefore said they unto HIM[JESUS], How were yours eyes opened?

9:11 HE[JESUS] answered and said, A man that is called JESUS made clay, and
anointed mine eyes, and said unto me, Go to the pool of Siloam, and
wash: and I went and washed, and I received sight.

9:12 Then said they unto HIM[JESUS], Where is HE[JESUS]? HE[JESUS] said, I know not.

9:13 They brought to the Pharisees HIM[JESUS] that aforetime was blind.

9:14 And it was the sabbath day when JESUS made the clay, and opened HIS[JESUS]
eyes.

9:15 Then again the Pharisees also asked HIM[JESUS] how HE[JESUS] had received HIS[JESUS]
sight. HE[JESUS] said unto them, HE[JESUS] put clay upon mine eyes, and I washed, and
do see.

9:16 Therefore said some of the Pharisees, This man is not of GOD[JESUS],
because HE[JESUS] keepeth not the sabbath day. Others said, How can a man that
is a sinner do such miracles? And there was a division among them.

9:17 They say unto the blind man again, What sayest you of HIM[JESUS], that HE[JESUS]
has opened yours eyes? HE[JESUS] said, HE[JESUS] is a PROPHET[JESUS].

9:18 But the Jews did not believe concerning HIM[JESUS], that HE[JESUS] had been
blind, and received HIS[JESUS] sight, until they called the parents of HIM[JESUS] that
had received HIS[JESUS] sight.

9:19 And they asked them, saying, Is this your SON[JESUS], who you say was born
blind? how then does HE[JESUS] now see?

9:20 HIS[JESUS] parents answered them and said, We know that this is our SON[JESUS],
and that HE[JESUS] was born blind:

9:21 But by what means HE[JESUS] now seeth, we know not; or who has opened HIS[JESUS]
eyes, we know not: HE[JESUS] is of age; ask HIM[JESUS]: HE[JESUS] shall speak for himself.

9:22 These words spake HIS[JESUS] parents, because they feared the Jews: for
the Jews had agreed already, that if any man did confess that HE[JESUS] was
CHRIST[JESUS], HE[JESUS] should be put out of the synagogue.

9:23 Therefore said HIS[JESUS] parents, HE[JESUS] is of age; ask HIM[JESUS].

9:24 Then again called they the man that was blind, and said unto HIM[JESUS],
Give GOD[JESUS] the praise: we know that this man is a sinner.

9:25 HE[JESUS] answered and said, Whether HE[JESUS] be a sinner or no, I know not: one
thing I know, that, whereas I was blind, now I see.

9:26 Then said they to HIM[JESUS] again, What did HE[JESUS] to you? how opened HE[JESUS]
yours eyes?

9:27 HE[JESUS] answered them, I have told you already, and you did not hear:
wherefore would you hear it again? will you also be HIS[JESUS] disciples?

9:28 Then they reviled HIM[JESUS], and said, you art HIS[JESUS] disciple; but we are
Moses' disciples.

9:29 We know that GOD[JESUS] spake unto Moses: as for this fellow, we know not
from whence HE[JESUS] is.

9:30 The man answered and said unto them, Why herein is a marvellous
thing, that you know not from whence HE[JESUS] is, and yet HE[JESUS] has opened mine
eyes.

9:31 Now we know that GOD[JESUS] heareth not sinners: but if any man be a
worshipper of GOD[JESUS], and doeth HIS[JESUS] will, HIM[JESUS] HE[JESUS] heareth.

9:32 Since the world began was it not heard that any man opened the eyes
of one that was born blind.

9:33 If this man were not of GOD[JESUS], HE[JESUS] could do nothing.

9:34 They answered and said unto HIM[JESUS], you wast altogether born in sins,
and dost you teach us? And they cast HIM[JESUS] out.

9:35 JESUS heard that they had cast HIM[JESUS] out; and when HE[JESUS] had found HIM[JESUS],
HE[JESUS] said unto HIM[JESUS], Dost you believe on the SON[JESUS] OF GOD[JESUS][JESUS]?

9:36 HE[JESUS] answered and said, Who is HE[JESUS], LORD[JESUS], that I might believe on HIM[JESUS]?

9:37 And JESUS said unto HIM[JESUS], you hast both seen HIM[JESUS], and it is HE[JESUS] that
talketh with you.

9:38 And HE[JESUS] said, LORD[JESUS], I believe. And HE[JESUS] worshipped HIM[JESUS].

9:39 And JESUS said, For judgment I am come into this world, that they
which see not might see; and that they which see might be made blind.

9:40 And some of the Pharisees which were with HIM[JESUS] heard these words,
and said unto HIM[JESUS], Are we blind also?

9:41 JESUS said unto them, If you were blind, you should have no sin: but
now you say, We see; therefore your sin remaineth.


10:1 truly, truly, I say unto you, HE[JESUS] that entereth not by the door
into the sheepfold, but climbeth up some other way, the same is a thief
and a robber.

10:2 But HE[JESUS] that entereth in by the door is the SHEPHERD[JESUS] of the sheep.

10:3 To HIM[JESUS] the porter openeth; and the sheep hear HIS[JESUS] voice: and HE[JESUS]
calleth HIS[JESUS] own sheep by name, and leads them out.

10:4 And when HE[JESUS] putteth forth HIS[JESUS] own sheep, HE[JESUS] goes before them, and
the sheep follow HIM[JESUS]: for they know HIS[JESUS] voice.

10:5 And a stranger will they not follow, but will flee from HIM[JESUS]: for
they know not the voice of strangers.

10:6 This parable spake JESUS unto them: but they understood not what
things they were which HE[JESUS] spake unto them.

10:7 Then said JESUS unto them again, truly, truly, I say unto you, I
am the door of the sheep.

10:8 All that ever came before me are thieves and robbers: but the sheep
did not hear them.

10:9 I am the door: by me if any man enter in, HE[JESUS] shall be saved, and
shall go in and out, and find pasture.

10:10 The thief comes not, but for to steal, and to kill, and to
destroy: I am come that they might have life, and that they might have
it more abundantly.

10:11 I am the good SHEPHERD[JESUS]: the good SHEPHERD[JESUS] giveth HIS[JESUS] life for the
sheep.

10:12 But HE[JESUS] that is an hireling, and not the SHEPHERD[JESUS], whose own the
sheep are not, seeth the wolf coming, and leaveth the sheep, and fleeth:
and the wolf catcheth them, and scattereth the sheep.

10:13 The hireling fleeth, because HE[JESUS] is an hireling, and careth not for
the sheep.

10:14 I am the good SHEPHERD[JESUS], and know my sheep, and am known of mine.

10:15 As the Father knoweth me, even so know I the Father: and I lay
down my life for the sheep.

10:16 And other sheep I have, which are not of this fold: them also I
must bring, and they shall hear my voice; and there shall be one fold,
and one SHEPHERD[JESUS].

10:17 Therefore does my Father love me, because I lay down my life, that
I might take it again.

10:18 No man taketh it from me, but I lay it down of myself. I have
power to lay it down, and I have power to take it again. This
commandment have I received of my Father.

10:19 There was a division therefore again among the Jews for these
sayings.

10:20 And many of them said, HE[JESUS] has a devil, and is mad; why hear you
HIM[JESUS]?

10:21 Others said, These are not the words of HIM[JESUS] that has a devil. Can
a devil open the eyes of the blind?

10:22 And it was at Jerusalem the feast of the dedication, and it was
winter.

10:23 And JESUS walked in the temple in Solomon's porch.

10:24 Then came the Jews round about HIM[JESUS], and said unto HIM[JESUS], How long
dost you make us to doubt? If you be the CHRIST[JESUS], tell us plainly.

10:25 JESUS answered them, I told you, and you believed not: the works
that I do in my Father's name, they bear witness of me.

10:26 But you believe not, because you are not of my sheep, as I said unto
you.

10:27 My sheep hear my voice, and I know them, and they follow me:

10:28 And I give unto them eternal life; and they shall never perish,
neither shall any man pluck them out of my hand.

10:29 My Father, which gave them me, is greater than all; and no man is
able to pluck them out of my Father's hand.

10:30 I and my Father are one.

10:31 Then the Jews took up stones again to stone HIM[JESUS].

10:32 JESUS answered them, Many good works have I shewed you from my
Father; for which of those works do you stone me?

10:33 The Jews answered HIM[JESUS], saying, For a good work we stone you not;
but for blasphemy; and because that you, being a man, makest thyself
GOD[JESUS].

10:34 JESUS answered them, Is it not written in your law, I said, you are
gods?

10:35 If HE[JESUS] called them gods, unto whom the WORD[JESUS] of GOD[JESUS] came, and the
scripture cannot be broken;

10:36 Say you of HIM[JESUS], whom the Father has sanctified, and sent into the
world, you blasphemest; because I said, I am the SON[JESUS] OF GOD[JESUS][JESUS]?

10:37 If I do not the works of my Father, believe me not.

10:38 But if I do, though you believe not me, believe the works: that you
may know, and believe, that the Father is in me, and I in HIM[JESUS].

10:39 Therefore they sought again to take HIM[JESUS]: but HE[JESUS] escaped out of
their hand,

10:40 And went away again beyond Jordan into the place where John at
first baptized; and there HE[JESUS] abode.

10:41 And many resorted unto HIM[JESUS], and said, John did no miracle: but all
things that John spake of this man were true.

10:42 And many believed on HIM[JESUS] there.


11:1 Now a certain man was sick, named Lazarus, of Bethany, the town of
Mary and her sister Martha.

11:2 (It was that Mary which anointed the LORD[JESUS] with ointment, and wiped
HIS[JESUS] feet with her hair, whose brother Lazarus was sick.)

11:3 Therefore HIS[JESUS] sisters sent unto HIM[JESUS], saying, LORD[JESUS], behold, HE[JESUS] whom
you lovest is sick.

11:4 When JESUS heard that, HE[JESUS] said, This sickness is not unto death,
but for the glory of GOD[JESUS], that the SON[JESUS] OF GOD[JESUS][JESUS] might be glorified
thereby.

11:5 Now JESUS loved Martha, and her sister, and Lazarus.

11:6 When HE[JESUS] had heard therefore that HE[JESUS] was sick, HE[JESUS] abode two days
still in the same place where HE[JESUS] was.

11:7 Then after that says HE[JESUS] to HIS[JESUS] disciples, Let us go into Judaea
again.

11:8 HIS[JESUS] disciples say unto HIM[JESUS], Master, the Jews of late sought to
stone you; and goest you thither again?

11:9 JESUS answered, Are there not twelve hours in the day? If any man
walk in the day, HE[JESUS] stumbleth not, because HE[JESUS] seeth the light of this
world.

11:10 But if a man walk in the night, HE[JESUS] stumbleth, because there is no
light in HIM[JESUS].

11:11 These things said HE[JESUS]: and after that HE[JESUS] says unto them, Our
friend Lazarus sleepeth; but I go, that I may awake HIM[JESUS] out of sleep.

11:12 Then said HIS[JESUS] disciples, LORD[JESUS], if HE[JESUS] sleep, HE[JESUS] shall do well.

11:13 Howbeit JESUS spake of HIS[JESUS] death: but they thought that HE[JESUS] had
spoken of taking of rest in sleep.

11:14 Then said JESUS unto them plainly, Lazarus is dead.

11:15 And I am glad for your sakes that I was not there, to the intent
you may believe; nevertheless let us go unto HIM[JESUS].

11:16 Then said Thomas, which is called Didymus, unto HIS[JESUS]
fellowdisciples, Let us also go, that we may die with HIM[JESUS].

11:17 Then when JESUS came, HE[JESUS] found that HE[JESUS] had lain in the grave four
days already.

11:18 Now Bethany was nigh unto Jerusalem, about fifteen furlongs off:

11:19 And many of the Jews came to Martha and Mary, to comfort them
concerning their brother.

11:20 Then Martha, as soon as she heard that JESUS was coming, went and
met HIM[JESUS]: but Mary sat still in the house.

11:21 Then said Martha unto JESUS, LORD[JESUS], if you hadst been here, my
brother had not died.

11:22 But I know, that even now, whatsoever you wilt ask of GOD[JESUS], GOD[JESUS]
will give it you.

11:23 JESUS says unto her, your brother shall rise again.

11:24 Martha says unto HIM[JESUS], I know that HE[JESUS] shall rise again in the
resurrection at the last day.

11:25 JESUS said unto her, I am the resurrection, and the life: HE[JESUS] that
believes in me, though HE[JESUS] were dead, yet shall HE[JESUS] live:

11:26 And whoever liveth and believes in me shall never die.
Believest you this?

11:27 She says unto HIM[JESUS], Yea, LORD[JESUS]: I believe that you art the CHRIST[JESUS],
the SON[JESUS] OF GOD[JESUS][JESUS], which should come into the world.

11:28 And when she had so said, she went her way, and called Mary her
sister secretly, saying, The Master is come, and calleth for you.

11:29 As soon as she heard that, she arose quickly, and came unto HIM[JESUS].

11:30 Now JESUS was not yet come into the town, but was in that place
where Martha met HIM[JESUS].

11:31 The Jews then which were with her in the house, and comforted her,
when they saw Mary, that she rose up hastily and went out, followed her,
saying, She goes unto the grave to weep there.

11:32 Then when Mary was come where JESUS was, and saw HIM[JESUS], she fell
down at HIS[JESUS] feet, saying unto HIM[JESUS], LORD[JESUS], if you hadst been here, my
brother had not died.

11:33 When JESUS therefore saw her weeping, and the Jews also weeping
which came with her, HE[JESUS] groaned in the spirit, and was troubled.

11:34 And said, Where have you laid HIM[JESUS]? They said unto HIM[JESUS], LORD[JESUS], come
and see.

11:35 JESUS wept.

11:36 Then said the Jews, Behold how HE[JESUS] loved HIM[JESUS]!

11:37 And some of them said, Could not this man, which opened the eyes
of the blind, have caused that even this man should not have died?

11:38 JESUS therefore again groaning in himself comes to the grave. It
was a cave, and a stone lay upon it.

11:39 JESUS said, Take you away the stone. Martha, the sister of HIM[JESUS] that
was dead, says unto HIM[JESUS], LORD[JESUS], by this time HE[JESUS] stinketh: for HE[JESUS] has
been dead four days.

11:40 JESUS says unto her, Said I not unto you, that, if you wouldest
believe, you shouldest see the glory of GOD[JESUS]?

11:41 Then they took away the stone from the place where the dead was
laid. And JESUS lifted up HIS[JESUS] eyes, and said, Father, I thank you that
you hast heard me.

11:42 And I knew that you hearest me always: but because of the people
which stand by I said it, that they may believe that you hast sent me.

11:43 And when HE[JESUS] thus had spoken, HE[JESUS] cried with a loud voice, Lazarus,
come forth.

11:44 And HE[JESUS] that was dead came forth, bound hand and foot with
graveclothes: and HIS[JESUS] face was bound about with a napkin. JESUS says
unto them, Loose HIM[JESUS], and let HIM[JESUS] go.

11:45 Then many of the Jews which came to Mary, and had seen the things
which JESUS did, believed on HIM[JESUS].

11:46 But some of them went their ways to the Pharisees, and told them
what things JESUS had done.

11:47 Then gathered the chief priests and the Pharisees a council, and
said, What do we? for this man doeth many miracles.

11:48 If we let HIM[JESUS] thus alone, all men will believe on HIM[JESUS]: and the
Romans shall come and take away both our place and nation.

11:49 And one of them, named Caiaphas, being the high priest that same
year, said unto them, you know nothing at all,

11:50 Nor consider that it is expedient for us, that one man should die
for the people, and that the whole nation perish not.

11:51 And this spake HE[JESUS] not of himself: but being high priest that year,
HE[JESUS] prophesied that JESUS should die for that nation;

11:52 And not for that nation only, but that also HE[JESUS] should gather
together in one the children of GOD[JESUS] that were scattered abroad.

11:53 Then from that day forth they took counsel together for to put HIM[JESUS]
to death.

11:54 JESUS therefore walked no more openly among the Jews; but went
thence unto a country near to the wilderness, into a city called
Ephraim, and there continued with HIS[JESUS] disciples.

11:55 And the Jews' passover was nigh at hand: and many went out of the
country up to Jerusalem before the passover, to purify themselves.

11:56 Then sought they for JESUS, and spake among themselves, as they
stood in the temple, What think you, that HE[JESUS] will not come to the feast?

11:57 Now both the chief priests and the Pharisees had given a
commandment, that, if any man knew where HE[JESUS] were, HE[JESUS] should shew it,
that they might take HIM[JESUS].


12:1 Then JESUS six days before the passover came to Bethany, where
Lazarus was, which had been dead, whom HE[JESUS] raised from the dead.

12:2 There they made HIM[JESUS] a supper; and Martha served: but Lazarus was
one of them that sat at the table with HIM[JESUS].

12:3 Then took Mary a pound of ointment of spikenard, very costly, and
anointed the feet of JESUS, and wiped HIS[JESUS] feet with her hair: and the
house was filled with the odour of the ointment.

12:4 Then says one of HIS[JESUS] disciples, Judas Iscariot, Simon's SON[JESUS], which
should betray HIM[JESUS],

12:5 Why was not this ointment sold for three hundred pence, and given
to the poor?

12:6 This HE[JESUS] said, not that HE[JESUS] cared for the poor; but because HE[JESUS] was a
thief, and had the bag, and bare what was put therein.

12:7 Then said JESUS, Let her alone: against the day of my burying has
she kept this.

12:8 For the poor always you have with you; but me you have not always.

12:9 Much people of the Jews therefore knew that HE[JESUS] was there: and they
came not for JESUS' sake only, but that they might see Lazarus also,
whom HE[JESUS] had raised from the dead.

12:10 But the chief priests consulted that they might put Lazarus also
to death;

12:11 Because that by reason of HIM[JESUS] many of the Jews went away, and
believed on JESUS.

12:12 On the next day much people that were come to the feast, when they
heard that JESUS was coming to Jerusalem,

12:13 Took branches of palm trees, and went forth to meet HIM[JESUS], and
cried, Hosanna: Blessed is the KING[JESUS] of Israel that comes in the name of
the LORD[JESUS].

12:14 And JESUS, when HE[JESUS] had found a young ass, sat thereon; as it is
written,

12:15 Fear not, daughter of Sion: behold, your KING[JESUS] comes, sitting on an
ass's colt.

12:16 These things understood not HIS[JESUS] disciples at the first: but when
JESUS was glorified, then remembered they that these things were written
of HIM[JESUS], and that they had done these things unto HIM[JESUS].

12:17 The people therefore that was with HIM[JESUS] when HE[JESUS] called Lazarus out
of HIS[JESUS] grave, and raised HIM[JESUS] from the dead, bare record.

12:18 For this cause the people also met HIM[JESUS], for that they heard that
HE[JESUS] had done this miracle.

12:19 The Pharisees therefore said among themselves, Perceive you how you
prevail nothing? behold, the world is gone after HIM[JESUS].

12:20 And there were certain Greeks among them that came up to worship
at the feast:

12:21 The same came therefore to Philip, which was of Bethsaida of
Galilee, and desired HIM[JESUS], saying, Sir, we would see JESUS.

12:22 Philip comes and telleth Andrew: and again Andrew and Philip tell
JESUS.

12:23 And JESUS answered them, saying, The hour is come, that the SON[JESUS] of
man should be glorified.

12:24 truly, truly, I say unto you, Except a corn of wheat fall into
the ground and die, it abideth alone: but if it die, it bringeth forth
much fruit.

12:25 HE[JESUS] that loveth HIS[JESUS] life shall lose it; and HE[JESUS] that hateth HIS[JESUS] life
in this world shall keep it unto life eternal.

12:26 If any man serve me, let HIM[JESUS] follow me; and where I am, there
shall also my SERVANT[JESUS] be: if any man serve me, HIM[JESUS] will my Father
honour.

12:27 Now is my soul troubled; and what shall I say? Father, save me
from this hour: but for this cause came I unto this hour.

12:28 Father, glorify your name. Then came there a voice from heaven,
saying, I have both glorified it, and will glorify it again.

12:29 The people therefore, that stood by, and heard it, said that it
thundered: others said, An angel spake to HIM[JESUS].

12:30 JESUS answered and said, This voice came not because of me, but
for your sakes.

12:31 Now is the judgment of this world: now shall the prince of this
world be cast out.

12:32 And I, if I be lifted up from the earth, will draw all men unto
me.

12:33 This HE[JESUS] said, signifying what death HE[JESUS] should die.

12:34 The people answered HIM[JESUS], We have heard out of the law that CHRIST[JESUS]
abideth for ever: and how sayest you, The SON[JESUS] OF MAN[JESUS] must be lifted up?
who is this SON[JESUS] OF MAN[JESUS]?

12:35 Then JESUS said unto them, Yet a little while is the light with
you. Walk while you have the light, lest darkness come upon you: for HE[JESUS]
that walketh in darkness knoweth not whither HE[JESUS] goes.

12:36 While you have light, believe in the light, that you may be the
children of light. These things spake JESUS, and departed, and did hide
himself from them.

12:37 But though HE[JESUS] had done so many miracles before them, yet they
believed not on HIM[JESUS]:

12:38 That the saying of Esaias the PROPHET[JESUS] might be fulfilled, which HE[JESUS]
spake, LORD[JESUS], who has believed our report? and to whom has the arm of
the LORD[JESUS] been revealed?

12:39 Therefore they could not believe, because that Esaias said again,

12:40 HE[JESUS] has blinded their eyes, and hardened their heart; that they
should not see with their eyes, nor understand with their heart, and be
converted, and I should heal them.

12:41 These things said Esaias, when HE[JESUS] saw HIS[JESUS] glory, and spake of HIM[JESUS].

12:42 Nevertheless among the chief rulers also many believed on HIM[JESUS]; but
because of the Pharisees they did not confess HIM[JESUS], lest they should be
put out of the synagogue:

12:43 For they loved the praise of men more than the praise of GOD[JESUS].

12:44 JESUS cried and said, HE[JESUS] that believes on me, believes not on
me, but on HIM[JESUS] that sent me.

12:45 And HE[JESUS] that seeth me seeth HIM[JESUS] that sent me.

12:46 I am come a light into the world, that whoever believes on me
should not abide in darkness.

12:47 And if any man hear my words, and believe not, I judge HIM[JESUS] not:
for I came not to judge the world, but to save the world.

12:48 HE[JESUS] that rejecteth me, and receiveth not my words, has one that
judgeth HIM[JESUS]: the WORD[JESUS] that I have spoken, the same shall judge HIM[JESUS] in
the last day.

12:49 For I have not spoken of myself; but the Father which sent me, HE[JESUS]
gave me a commandment, what I should say, and what I should speak.

12:50 And I know that HIS[JESUS] commandment is life everlasting: whatsoever I
speak therefore, even as the Father said unto me, so I speak.


13:1 Now before the feast of the passover, when JESUS knew that HIS[JESUS] hour
was come that HE[JESUS] should depart out of this world unto the Father, having
loved HIS[JESUS] own which were in the world, HE[JESUS] loved them unto the end.

13:2 And supper being ended, the devil having now put into the heart of
Judas Iscariot, Simon's SON[JESUS], to betray HIM[JESUS];

13:3 JESUS knowing that the Father had given all things into HIS[JESUS] hands,
and that HE[JESUS] was come from GOD[JESUS], and went to GOD[JESUS];

13:4 HE[JESUS] riseth from supper, and laid aside HIS[JESUS] garments; and took a
towel, and girded himself.

13:5 After that HE[JESUS] poureth water into a bason, and began to wash the
disciples' feet, and to wipe them with the towel wherewith HE[JESUS] was
girded.

13:6 Then comes HE[JESUS] to Simon Peter: and Peter says unto HIM[JESUS], LORD[JESUS], dost
you wash my feet?

13:7 JESUS answered and said unto HIM[JESUS], What I do you knowest not now;
but you shalt know hereafter.

13:8 Peter says unto HIM[JESUS], you shalt never wash my feet. JESUS answered
HIM[JESUS], If I wash you not, you hast no part with me.

13:9 Simon Peter says unto HIM[JESUS], LORD[JESUS], not my feet only, but also my
hands and my head.

13:10 JESUS says to HIM[JESUS], HE[JESUS] that is washed needeth not save to wash HIS[JESUS]
feet, but is clean every whit: and you are clean, but not all.

13:11 For HE[JESUS] knew who should betray HIM[JESUS]; therefore said HE[JESUS], you are not
all clean.

13:12 So after HE[JESUS] had washed their feet, and had taken HIS[JESUS] garments, and
was set down again, HE[JESUS] said unto them, Know you what I have done to you?

13:13 you call me Master and LORD[JESUS]: and you say well; for so I am.

13:14 If I then, your LORD[JESUS] and Master, have washed your feet; you also
ought to wash one another's feet.

13:15 For I have given you an example, that you should do as I have done
to you.

13:16 truly, truly, I say unto you, The SERVANT[JESUS] is not greater than
HIS[JESUS] LORD[JESUS]; neither HE[JESUS] that is sent greater than HE[JESUS] that sent HIM[JESUS].

13:17 If you know these things, happy are you if you do them.

13:18 I speak not of you all: I know whom I have chosen: but that the
scripture may be fulfilled, HE[JESUS] that eateth bread with me has lifted up
HIS[JESUS] heel against me.

13:19 Now I tell you before it come, that, when it is come to pass, you
may believe that I am HE[JESUS].

13:20 truly, truly, I say unto you, HE[JESUS] that receiveth whomsoever I
send receiveth me; and HE[JESUS] that receiveth me receiveth HIM[JESUS] that sent me.

13:21 When JESUS had thus said, HE[JESUS] was troubled in spirit, and
testified, and said, truly, truly, I say unto you, that one of you
shall betray me.

13:22 Then the disciples looked one on another, doubting of whom HE[JESUS]
spake.

13:23 Now there was leaning on JESUS' bosom one of HIS[JESUS] disciples, whom
JESUS loved.

13:24 Simon Peter therefore beckoned to HIM[JESUS], that HE[JESUS] should ask who it
should be of whom HE[JESUS] spake.

13:25 HE[JESUS] then lying on JESUS' breast says unto HIM[JESUS], LORD[JESUS], who is it?

13:26 JESUS answered, HE[JESUS] it is, to whom I shall give a sop, when I have
dipped it. And when HE[JESUS] had dipped the sop, HE[JESUS] gave it to Judas Iscariot,
the SON[JESUS] of Simon.

13:27 And after the sop Satan entered into HIM[JESUS]. Then said JESUS unto
HIM[JESUS], That you doest, do quickly.

13:28 Now no man at the table knew for what intent HE[JESUS] spake this unto
HIM[JESUS].

13:29 For some of them thought, because Judas had the bag, that JESUS
had said unto HIM[JESUS], Buy those things that we have need of against the
feast; or, that HE[JESUS] should give something to the poor.

13:30 HE[JESUS] then having received the sop went immediately out: and it was
night.

13:31 Therefore, when HE[JESUS] was gone out, JESUS said, Now is the SON[JESUS] OF MAN[JESUS]
glorified, and GOD[JESUS] is glorified in HIM[JESUS].

13:32 If GOD[JESUS] be glorified in HIM[JESUS], GOD[JESUS] shall also glorify HIM[JESUS] in himself,
and shall straightway glorify HIM[JESUS].

13:33 Little children, yet a little while I am with you. you shall seek
me: and as I said unto the Jews, Whither I go, you cannot come; so now I
say to you.

13:34 A new commandment I give unto you, That you love one another; as I
have loved you, that you also love one another.

13:35 By this shall all men know that you are my disciples, if you have
love one to another.

13:36 Simon Peter said unto HIM[JESUS], LORD[JESUS], whither goest you? JESUS
answered HIM[JESUS], Whither I go, you canst not follow me now; but you shalt
follow me afterwards.

13:37 Peter said unto HIM[JESUS], LORD[JESUS], why cannot I follow you now? I will
lay down my life for your sake.

13:38 JESUS answered HIM[JESUS], Wilt you lay down your life for my sake?
truly, truly, I say unto you, The cock shall not crow, till you hast
denied me thrice.


14:1 Let not your heart be troubled: you believe in GOD[JESUS], believe also in
me.

14:2 In my Father's house are many mansions: if it were not so, I would
have told you. I go to prepare a place for you.

14:3 And if I go and prepare a place for you, I will come again, and
receive you unto myself; that where I am, there you may be also.

14:4 And whither I go you know, and the way you know.

14:5 Thomas says unto HIM[JESUS], LORD[JESUS], we know not whither you goest; and
how can we know the way?

14:6 JESUS says unto HIM[JESUS], I am the way, the truth, and the life: no man
comes unto the Father, but by me.

14:7 If you had known me, you should have known my Father also: and from
henceforth you know HIM[JESUS], and have seen HIM[JESUS].

14:8 Philip says unto HIM[JESUS], LORD[JESUS], shew us the Father, and it sufficeth
us.

14:9 JESUS says unto HIM[JESUS], Have I been so long time with you, and yet
hast you not known me, Philip? HE[JESUS] that has seen me has seen the
Father; and how sayest you then, Shew us the Father?

14:10 Believest you not that I am in the Father, and the Father in me?
the words that I speak unto you I speak not of myself: but the Father
that dwelleth in me, HE[JESUS] doeth the works.

14:11 Believe me that I am in the Father, and the Father in me: or else
believe me for the very works' sake.

14:12 truly, truly, I say unto you, HE[JESUS] that believes on me, the works
that I do shall HE[JESUS] do also; and greater works than these shall HE[JESUS] do;
because I go unto my Father.

14:13 And whatsoever you shall ask in my name, that will I do, that the
Father may be glorified in the SON[JESUS].

14:14 If you shall ask any thing in my name, I will do it.

14:15 If you love me, keep my commandments.

14:16 And I will pray the Father, and HE[JESUS] shall give you another
Comforter, that HE[JESUS] may abide with you for ever;

14:17 Even the Spirit of truth; whom the world cannot receive, because
it seeth HIM[JESUS] not, neither knoweth HIM[JESUS]: but you know HIM[JESUS]; for HE[JESUS] dwelleth
with you, and shall be in you.

14:18 I will not leave you comfortless: I will come to you.

14:19 Yet a little while, and the world seeth me no more; but you see me:
because I live, you shall live also.

14:20 At that day you shall know that I am in my Father, and you in me,
and I in you.

14:21 HE[JESUS] that has my commandments, and keepeth them, HE[JESUS] it is that
loveth me: and HE[JESUS] that loveth me shall be loved of my Father, and I will
love HIM[JESUS], and will manifest myself to HIM[JESUS].

14:22 Judas says unto HIM[JESUS], not Iscariot, LORD[JESUS], how is it that you wilt
manifest thyself unto us, and not unto the world?

14:23 JESUS answered and said unto HIM[JESUS], If a man love me, HE[JESUS] will keep
my words: and my Father will love HIM[JESUS], and we will come unto HIM[JESUS], and
make our abode with HIM[JESUS].

14:24 HE[JESUS] that loveth me not keepeth not my sayings: and the WORD[JESUS] which
you hear is not mine, but the Father's which sent me.

14:25 These things have I spoken unto you, being yet present with you.

14:26 But the Comforter, which is the Holy Ghost, whom the Father will
send in my name, HE[JESUS] shall teach you all things, and bring all things to
your remembrance, whatsoever I have said unto you.

14:27 Peace I leave with you, my peace I give unto you: not as the world
giveth, give I unto you. Let not your heart be troubled, neither let it
be afraid.

14:28 you have heard how I said unto you, I go away, and come again unto
you. If you loved me, you would rejoice, because I said, I go unto the
Father: for my Father is greater than I.

14:29 And now I have told you before it come to pass, that, when it is
come to pass, you might believe.

14:30 Hereafter I will not talk much with you: for the prince of this
world comes, and has nothing in me.

14:31 But that the world may know that I love the Father; and as the
Father gave me commandment, even so I do. Arise, let us go hence.


15:1 I am the true vine, and my Father is the husbandman.

15:2 Every BRANCH[JESUS] in me that beareth not fruit HE[JESUS] taketh away: and every
BRANCH[JESUS] that beareth fruit, HE[JESUS] purgeth it, that it may bring forth more
fruit.

15:3 Now you are clean through the WORD[JESUS] which I have spoken unto you.

15:4 Abide in me, and I in you. As the BRANCH[JESUS] cannot bear fruit of
itself, except it abide in the vine; no more can you, except you abide in
me.

15:5 I am the vine, you are the branches: HE[JESUS] that abideth in me, and I in
HIM[JESUS], the same bringeth forth much fruit: for without me you can do
nothing.

15:6 If a man abide not in me, HE[JESUS] is cast forth as a BRANCH[JESUS], and is
withered; and men gather them, and cast them into the fire, and they are
burned.

15:7 If you abide in me, and my words abide in you, you shall ask what you
will, and it shall be done unto you.

15:8 Herein is my Father glorified, that you bear much fruit; so shall you
be my disciples.

15:9 As the Father has loved me, so have I loved you: continue you in my
love.

15:10 If you keep my commandments, you shall abide in my love; even as I
have kept my Father's commandments, and abide in HIS[JESUS] love.

15:11 These things have I spoken unto you, that my joy might remain in
you, and that your joy might be full.

15:12 This is my commandment, That you love one another, as I have loved
you.

15:13 Greater love has no man than this, that a man lay down HIS[JESUS] life
for HIS[JESUS] friends.

15:14 you are my friends, if you do whatsoever I command you.

15:15 Henceforth I call you not servants; for the SERVANT[JESUS] knoweth not
what HIS[JESUS] LORD[JESUS] doeth: but I have called you friends; for all things that
I have heard of my Father I have made known unto you.

15:16 you have not chosen me, but I have chosen you, and ordained you,
that you should go and bring forth fruit, and that your fruit should
remain: that whatsoever you shall ask of the Father in my name, HE[JESUS] may
give it you.

15:17 These things I command you, that you love one another.

15:18 If the world hate you, you know that it hated me before it hated
you.

15:19 If you were of the world, the world would love HIS[JESUS] own: but because
you are not of the world, but I have chosen you out of the world,
therefore the world hateth you.

15:20 Remember the WORD[JESUS] that I said unto you, The SERVANT[JESUS] is not greater
than HIS[JESUS] LORD[JESUS]. If they have persecuted me, they will also persecute you;
if they have kept my saying, they will keep yours also.

15:21 But all these things will they do unto you for my name's sake,
because they know not HIM[JESUS] that sent me.

15:22 If I had not come and spoken unto them, they had not had sin: but
now they have no cloak for their sin.

15:23 HE[JESUS] that hateth me hateth my Father also.

15:24 If I had not done among them the works which none other man did,
they had not had sin: but now have they both seen and hated both me and
my Father.

15:25 But this comes to pass, that the WORD[JESUS] might be fulfilled that is
written in their law, They hated me without a cause.

15:26 But when the Comforter is come, whom I will send unto you from the
Father, even the Spirit of truth, which proceedeth from the Father, HE[JESUS]
shall testify of me:

15:27 And you also shall bear witness, because you have been with me from
the beginning.


16:1 These things have I spoken unto you, that you should not be
offended.

16:2 They shall put you out of the synagogues: yea, the time comes,
that whoever killeth you will think that HE[JESUS] doeth GOD[JESUS] service.

16:3 And these things will they do unto you, because they have not known
the Father, nor me.

16:4 But these things have I told you, that when the time shall come, you
may remember that I told you of them. And these things I said not unto
you at the beginning, because I was with you.

16:5 But now I go my way to HIM[JESUS] that sent me; and none of you asketh me,
Whither goest you?

16:6 But because I have said these things unto you, sorrow has filled
your heart.

16:7 Nevertheless I tell you the truth; It is expedient for you that I
go away: for if I go not away, the Comforter will not come unto you; but
if I depart, I will send HIM[JESUS] unto you.

16:8 And when HE[JESUS] is come, HE[JESUS] will reprove the world of sin, and of
righteousness, and of judgment:

16:9 Of sin, because they believe not on me;

16:10 Of righteousness, because I go to my Father, and you see me no
more;

16:11 Of judgment, because the prince of this world is judged.

16:12 I have yet many things to say unto you, but you cannot bear them
now.

16:13 Howbeit when HE[JESUS], the Spirit of truth, is come, HE[JESUS] will guide you
into all truth: for HE[JESUS] shall not speak of himself; but whatsoever HE[JESUS]
shall hear, that shall HE[JESUS] speak: and HE[JESUS] will shew you things to come.

16:14 HE[JESUS] shall glorify me: for HE[JESUS] shall receive of mine, and shall shew
it unto you.

16:15 All things that the Father has are mine: therefore said I, that
HE[JESUS] shall take of mine, and shall shew it unto you.

16:16 A little while, and you shall not see me: and again, a little
while, and you shall see me, because I go to the Father.

16:17 Then said some of HIS[JESUS] disciples among themselves, What is this
that HE[JESUS] says unto us, A little while, and you shall not see me: and
again, a little while, and you shall see me: and, Because I go to the
Father?

16:18 They said therefore, What is this that HE[JESUS] says, A little while?
we cannot tell what HE[JESUS] says.

16:19 Now JESUS knew that they were desirous to ask HIM[JESUS], and said unto
them, Do you enquire among yourselves of that I said, A little while, and
you shall not see me: and again, a little while, and you shall see me?

16:20 truly, truly, I say unto you, That you shall weep and lament, but
the world shall rejoice: and you shall be sorrowful, but your sorrow
shall be turned into joy.

16:21 A woman when she is in travail has sorrow, because her hour is
come: but as soon as she is delivered of the child, she remembereth no
more the anguish, for joy that a man is born into the world.

16:22 And you now therefore have sorrow: but I will see you again, and
your heart shall rejoice, and your joy no man taketh from you.

16:23 And in that day you shall ask me nothing. truly, truly, I say
unto you, Whatsoever you shall ask the Father in my name, HE[JESUS] will give it
you.

16:24 Hitherto have you asked nothing in my name: ask, and you shall
receive, that your joy may be full.

16:25 These things have I spoken unto you in proverbs: but the time
comes, when I shall no more speak unto you in proverbs, but I shall
shew you plainly of the Father.

16:26 At that day you shall ask in my name: and I say not unto you, that
I will pray the Father for you:

16:27 For the Father himself loveth you, because you have loved me, and
have believed that I came out from GOD[JESUS].

16:28 I came forth from the Father, and am come into the world: again, I
leave the world, and go to the Father.

16:29 HIS[JESUS] disciples said unto HIM[JESUS], Lo, now speakest you plainly, and
speakest no proverb.

16:30 Now are we sure that you knowest all things, and needest not that
any man should ask you: by this we believe that you camest forth from
GOD[JESUS].

16:31 JESUS answered them, Do you now believe?

16:32 Behold, the hour comes, yea, is now come, that you shall be
scattered, every man to HIS[JESUS] own, and shall leave me alone: and yet I am
not alone, because the Father is with me.

16:33 These things I have spoken unto you, that in me you might have
peace. In the world you shall have tribulation: but be of good cheer; I
have overcome the world.


17:1 These words spake JESUS, and lifted up HIS[JESUS] eyes to heaven, and
said, Father, the hour is come; glorify your SON[JESUS], that your SON[JESUS] also may
glorify you:

17:2 As you hast given HIM[JESUS] power over all flesh, that HE[JESUS] should give
eternal life to as many as you hast given HIM[JESUS].

17:3 And this is life eternal, that they might know you the only true
GOD[JESUS], and JESUS CHRIST[JESUS], whom you hast sent.

17:4 I have glorified you on the earth: I have finished the work which
you gavest me to do.

17:5 And now, O Father, glorify you me with yours own self with the
glory which I had with you before the world was.

17:6 I have manifested your name unto the men which you gavest me out of
the world: yours they were, and you gavest them me; and they have kept
your WORD[JESUS].

17:7 Now they have known that all things whatsoever you hast given me
are of you.

17:8 For I have given unto them the words which you gavest me; and they
have received them, and have known surely that I came out from you, and
they have believed that you didst send me.

17:9 I pray for them: I pray not for the world, but for them which you
hast given me; for they are yours.

17:10 And all mine are yours, and yours are mine; and I am glorified in
them.

17:11 And now I am no more in the world, but these are in the world, and
I come to you. Holy Father, keep through yours own name those whom you
hast given me, that they may be one, as we are.

17:12 While I was with them in the world, I kept them in your name: those
that you gavest me I have kept, and none of them is lost, but the SON[JESUS]
of perdition; that the scripture might be fulfilled.

17:13 And now come I to you; and these things I speak in the world,
that they might have my joy fulfilled in themselves.

17:14 I have given them your WORD[JESUS]; and the world has hated them, because
they are not of the world, even as I am not of the world.

17:15 I pray not that you shouldest take them out of the world, but
that you shouldest keep them from the evil.

17:16 They are not of the world, even as I am not of the world.

17:17 Sanctify them through your truth: your WORD[JESUS] is truth.

17:18 As you hast sent me into the world, even so have I also sent them
into the world.

17:19 And for their sakes I sanctify myself, that they also might be
sanctified through the truth.

17:20 Neither pray I for these alone, but for them also which shall
believe on me through their WORD[JESUS];

17:21 That they all may be one; as you, Father, art in me, and I in
you, that they also may be one in us: that the world may believe that
you hast sent me.

17:22 And the glory which you gavest me I have given them; that they
may be one, even as we are one:

17:23 I in them, and you in me, that they may be made perfect in one;
and that the world may know that you hast sent me, and hast loved them,
as you hast loved me.

17:24 Father, I will that they also, whom you hast given me, be with me
where I am; that they may behold my glory, which you hast given me: for
you lovedst me before the foundation of the world.

17:25 O righteous Father, the world has not known you: but I have
known you, and these have known that you hast sent me.

17:26 And I have declared unto them your name, and will declare it: that
the love wherewith you hast loved me may be in them, and I in them.


18:1 When JESUS had spoken these words, HE[JESUS] went forth with HIS[JESUS] disciples
over the brook Cedron, where was a garden, into the which HE[JESUS] entered,
and HIS[JESUS] disciples.

18:2 And Judas also, which betrayed HIM[JESUS], knew the place: for JESUS
ofttimes resorted thither with HIS[JESUS] disciples.

18:3 Judas then, having received a band of men and officers from the
chief priests and Pharisees, comes thither with lanterns and torches
and weapons.

18:4 JESUS therefore, knowing all things that should come upon HIM[JESUS], went
forth, and said unto them, Whom seek you?

18:5 They answered HIM[JESUS], JESUS of Nazareth. JESUS says unto them, I am
HE[JESUS]. And Judas also, which betrayed HIM[JESUS], stood with them.

18:6 As soon then as HE[JESUS] had said unto them, I am HE[JESUS], they went backward,
and fell to the ground.

18:7 Then asked HE[JESUS] them again, Whom seek you? And they said, JESUS of
Nazareth.

18:8 JESUS answered, I have told you that I am HE[JESUS]: if therefore you seek
me, let these go their way:

18:9 That the saying might be fulfilled, which HE[JESUS] spake, Of them which
you gavest me have I lost none.

18:10 Then Simon Peter having a sword drew it, and smote the high
priest's SERVANT[JESUS], and cut off HIS[JESUS] right ear. The SERVANT[JESUS]'s name was
Malchus.

18:11 Then said JESUS unto Peter, Put up your sword into the sheath: the
cup which my Father has given me, shall I not drink it?

18:12 Then the band and the captain and officers of the Jews took JESUS,
and bound HIM[JESUS],

18:13 And led HIM[JESUS] away to Annas first; for HE[JESUS] was father in law to
Caiaphas, which was the high priest that same year.

18:14 Now Caiaphas was HE[JESUS], which gave counsel to the Jews, that it was
expedient that one man should die for the people.

18:15 And Simon Peter followed JESUS, and so did another disciple: that
disciple was known unto the high priest, and went in with JESUS into the
palace of the high priest.

18:16 But Peter stood at the door without. Then went out that other
disciple, which was known unto the high priest, and spake unto her that
kept the door, and brought in Peter.

18:17 Then says the damsel that kept the door unto Peter, Art not you
also one of this man's disciples? HE[JESUS] says, I am not.

18:18 And the servants and officers stood there, who had made a fire of
coals; for it was cold: and they warmed themselves: and Peter stood with
them, and warmed himself.

18:19 The high priest then asked JESUS of HIS[JESUS] disciples, and of HIS[JESUS]
doctrine.

18:20 JESUS answered HIM[JESUS], I spake openly to the world; I ever taught in
the synagogue, and in the temple, whither the Jews always resort; and in
secret have I said nothing.

18:21 Why askest you me? ask them which heard me, what I have said unto
them: behold, they know what I said.

18:22 And when HE[JESUS] had thus spoken, one of the officers which stood by
struck JESUS with the palm of HIS[JESUS] hand, saying, Answerest you the high
priest so?

18:23 JESUS answered HIM[JESUS], If I have spoken evil, bear witness of the
evil: but if well, why smitest you me?

18:24 Now Annas had sent HIM[JESUS] bound unto Caiaphas the high priest.

18:25 And Simon Peter stood and warmed himself. They said therefore unto
HIM[JESUS], Art not you also one of HIS[JESUS] disciples? HE[JESUS] denied it, and said, I
am not.

18:26 One of the servants of the high priest, being HIS[JESUS] kinsman whose
ear Peter cut off, says, Did not I see you in the garden with HIM[JESUS]?

18:27 Peter then denied again: and immediately the cock crew.

18:28 Then led they JESUS from Caiaphas unto the hall of judgment: and
it was early; and they themselves went not into the judgment hall, lest
they should be defiled; but that they might eat the passover.

18:29 Pilate then went out unto them, and said, What accusation bring you
against this man?

18:30 They answered and said unto HIM[JESUS], If HE[JESUS] were not a malefactor, we
would not have delivered HIM[JESUS] up unto you.

18:31 Then said Pilate unto them, Take you HIM[JESUS], and judge HIM[JESUS] according
to your law. The Jews therefore said unto HIM[JESUS], It is not lawful for us
to put any man to death:

18:32 That the saying of JESUS might be fulfilled, which HE[JESUS] spake,
signifying what death HE[JESUS] should die.

18:33 Then Pilate entered into the judgment hall again, and called
JESUS, and said unto HIM[JESUS], Art you the KING[JESUS] of the Jews?

18:34 JESUS answered HIM[JESUS], Sayest you this thing of thyself, or did
others tell it you of me?

18:35 Pilate answered, Am I a Jew? yours own nation and the chief
priests have delivered you unto me: what hast you done?

18:36 JESUS answered, My kingdom is not of this world: if my kingdom
were of this world, then would my servants fight, that I should not be
delivered to the Jews: but now is my kingdom not from hence.

18:37 Pilate therefore said unto HIM[JESUS], Art you a KING[JESUS] then? JESUS
answered, you sayest that I am a KING[JESUS]. To this end was I born, and for
this cause came I into the world, that I should bear witness unto the
truth. Every one that is of the truth heareth my voice.

18:38 Pilate says unto HIM[JESUS], What is truth? And when HE[JESUS] had said this,
HE[JESUS] went out again unto the Jews, and says unto them, I find in HIM[JESUS] no
fault at all.

18:39 But you have a custom, that I should release unto you one at the
passover: will you therefore that I release unto you the KING[JESUS] of the
Jews?

18:40 Then cried they all again, saying, Not this man, but Barabbas. Now
Barabbas was a robber.


19:1 Then Pilate therefore took JESUS, and scourged HIM[JESUS].

19:2 And the soldiers platted a crown of thorns, and put it on HIS[JESUS] head,
and they put on HIM[JESUS] a purple robe,

19:3 And said, Hail, KING[JESUS] of the Jews! and they smote HIM[JESUS] with their
hands.

19:4 Pilate therefore went forth again, and says unto them, Behold, I
bring HIM[JESUS] forth to you, that you may know that I find no fault in HIM[JESUS].

19:5 Then came JESUS forth, wearing the crown of thorns, and the purple
robe. And Pilate says unto them, Behold the man!

19:6 When the chief priests therefore and officers saw HIM[JESUS], they cried
out, saying, Crucify HIM[JESUS], crucify HIM[JESUS]. Pilate says unto them, Take you
HIM[JESUS], and crucify HIM[JESUS]: for I find no fault in HIM[JESUS].

19:7 The Jews answered HIM[JESUS], We have a law, and by our law HE[JESUS] ought to
die, because HE[JESUS] made himself the SON[JESUS] OF GOD[JESUS][JESUS].

19:8 When Pilate therefore heard that saying, HE[JESUS] was the more afraid;

19:9 And went again into the judgment hall, and says unto JESUS, Whence
art you? But JESUS gave HIM[JESUS] no answer.

19:10 Then says Pilate unto HIM[JESUS], Speakest you not unto me? knowest
you not that I have power to crucify you, and have power to release
you?

19:11 JESUS answered, you couldest have no power at all against me,
except it were given you from above: therefore HE[JESUS] that delivered me
unto you has the greater sin.

19:12 And from thenceforth Pilate sought to release HIM[JESUS]: but the Jews
cried out, saying, If you let this man go, you art not Caesar's
friend: whoever makes himself a KING[JESUS] speaketh against Caesar.

19:13 When Pilate therefore heard that saying, HE[JESUS] brought JESUS forth,
and sat down in the judgment seat in a place that is called the
Pavement, but in the Hebrew, Gabbatha.

19:14 And it was the preparation of the passover, and about the sixth
hour: and HE[JESUS] says unto the Jews, Behold your KING[JESUS]!

19:15 But they cried out, Away with HIM[JESUS], away with HIM[JESUS], crucify HIM[JESUS].
Pilate says unto them, Shall I crucify your KING[JESUS]? The chief priests
answered, We have no KING[JESUS] but Caesar.

19:16 Then delivered HE[JESUS] HIM[JESUS] therefore unto them to be crucified. And
they took JESUS, and led HIM[JESUS] away.

19:17 And HE[JESUS] bearing HIS[JESUS] cross went forth into a place called the place
of a skull, which is called in the Hebrew Golgotha:

19:18 Where they crucified HIM[JESUS], and two other with HIM[JESUS], on either side
one, and JESUS in the midst.

19:19 And Pilate wrote a title, and put it on the cross. And the writing
was JESUS OF NAZARETH THE KING[JESUS] OF THE JEWS.

19:20 This title then read many of the Jews: for the place where JESUS
was crucified was nigh to the city: and it was written in Hebrew, and
Greek, and Latin.

19:21 Then said the chief priests of the Jews to Pilate, Write not, The
KING[JESUS] of the Jews; but that HE[JESUS] said, I am KING[JESUS] of the Jews.

19:22 Pilate answered, What I have written I have written.

19:23 Then the soldiers, when they had crucified JESUS, took HIS[JESUS]
garments, and made four parts, to every soldier a part; and also HIS[JESUS]
coat: now the coat was without seam, woven from the top throughout.

19:24 They said therefore among themselves, Let us not rend it, but cast
lots for it, whose it shall be: that the scripture might be fulfilled,
which says, They parted my raiment among them, and for my vesture they
did cast lots. These things therefore the soldiers did.

19:25 Now there stood by the cross of JESUS HIS[JESUS] mother, and HIS[JESUS] mother's
sister, Mary the wife of Cleophas, and Mary Magdalene.

19:26 When JESUS therefore saw HIS[JESUS] mother, and the disciple standing by,
whom HE[JESUS] loved, HE[JESUS] says unto HIS[JESUS] mother, Woman, behold your SON[JESUS]!

19:27 Then says HE[JESUS] to the disciple, Behold your mother! And from that
hour that disciple took her unto HIS[JESUS] own home.

19:28 After this, JESUS knowing that all things were now accomplished,
that the scripture might be fulfilled, says, I thirst.

19:29 Now there was set a vessel full of vinegar: and they filled a
spunge with vinegar, and put it upon hyssop, and put it to HIS[JESUS] mouth.

19:30 When JESUS therefore had received the vinegar, HE[JESUS] said, It is
finished: and HE[JESUS] bowed HIS[JESUS] head, and gave up the ghost.

19:31 The Jews therefore, because it was the preparation, that the
bodies should not remain upon the cross on the sabbath day, (for that
sabbath day was an high day,) besought Pilate that their legs might be
broken, and that they might be taken away.

19:32 Then came the soldiers, and brake the legs of the first, and of
the other which was crucified with HIM[JESUS].

19:33 But when they came to JESUS, and saw that HE[JESUS] was dead already,
they brake not HIS[JESUS] legs:

19:34 But one of the soldiers with a spear pierced HIS[JESUS] side, and
forthwith came there out blood and water.

19:35 And HE[JESUS] that saw it bare record, and HIS[JESUS] record is true: and HE[JESUS]
knoweth that HE[JESUS] says true, that you might believe.

19:36 For these things were done, that the scripture should be
fulfilled, A bone of HIM[JESUS] shall not be broken.

19:37 And again another scripture says, They shall look on HIM[JESUS] whom
they pierced.

19:38 And after this Joseph of Arimathaea, being a disciple of JESUS,
but secretly for fear of the Jews, besought Pilate that HE[JESUS] might take
away the body of JESUS: and Pilate gave HIM[JESUS] leave. HE[JESUS] came therefore,
and took the body of JESUS.

19:39 And there came also Nicodemus, which at the first came to JESUS by
night, and brought a mixture of myrrh and aloes, about an hundred pound
weight.

19:40 Then took they the body of JESUS, and wound it in linen clothes
with the spices, as the manner of the Jews is to bury.

19:41 Now in the place where HE[JESUS] was crucified there was a garden; and in
the garden a new sepulchre, wherein was never man yet laid.

19:42 There laid they JESUS therefore because of the Jews' preparation
day; for the sepulchre was nigh at hand.


20:1 The first day of the week comes Mary Magdalene early, when it was
yet dark, unto the sepulchre, and seeth the stone taken away from the
sepulchre.

20:2 Then she runneth, and comes to Simon Peter, and to the other
disciple, whom JESUS loved, and says unto them, They have taken away
the LORD[JESUS] out of the sepulchre, and we know not where they have laid HIM[JESUS].

20:3 Peter therefore went forth, and that other disciple, and came to
the sepulchre.

20:4 So they ran both together: and the other disciple did outrun Peter,
and came first to the sepulchre.

20:5 And HE[JESUS] stooping down, and looking in, saw the linen clothes lying;
yet went HE[JESUS] not in.

20:6 Then comes Simon Peter following HIM[JESUS], and went into the sepulchre,
and seeth the linen clothes lie,

20:7 And the napkin, that was about HIS[JESUS] head, not lying with the linen
clothes, but wrapped together in a place by itself.

20:8 Then went in also that other disciple, which came first to the
sepulchre, and HE[JESUS] saw, and believed.

20:9 For as yet they knew not the scripture, that HE[JESUS] must rise again
from the dead.

20:10 Then the disciples went away again unto their own home.

20:11 But Mary stood without at the sepulchre weeping: and as she wept,
she stooped down, and looked into the sepulchre,

20:12 And seeth two angels in white sitting, the one at the head, and
the other at the feet, where the body of JESUS had lain.

20:13 And they say unto her, Woman, why weepest you? She says unto
them, Because they have taken away my LORD[JESUS], and I know not where they
have laid HIM[JESUS].

20:14 And when she had thus said, she turned herself back, and saw JESUS
standing, and knew not that it was JESUS.

20:15 JESUS says unto her, Woman, why weepest you? whom seekest you?
She, supposing HIM[JESUS] to be the gardener, says unto HIM[JESUS], Sir, if you have
borne HIM[JESUS] hence, tell me where you hast laid HIM[JESUS], and I will take HIM[JESUS]
away.

20:16 JESUS says unto her, Mary. She turned herself, and says unto
HIM[JESUS], Rabboni; which is to say, Master.

20:17 JESUS says unto her, Touch me not; for I am not yet ascended to
my Father: but go to my brethren, and say unto them, I ascend unto my
Father, and your Father; and to my GOD[JESUS], and your GOD[JESUS].

20:18 Mary Magdalene came and told the disciples that she had seen the
LORD[JESUS], and that HE[JESUS] had spoken these things unto her.

20:19 Then the same day at evening, being the first day of the week,
when the doors were shut where the disciples were assembled for fear of
the Jews, came JESUS and stood in the midst, and says unto them, Peace
be unto you.

20:20 And when HE[JESUS] had so said, HE[JESUS] shewed unto them HIS[JESUS] hands and HIS[JESUS]
side. Then were the disciples glad, when they saw the LORD[JESUS].

20:21 Then said JESUS to them again, Peace be unto you: as my Father
has sent me, even so send I you.

20:22 And when HE[JESUS] had said this, HE[JESUS] breathed on them, and says unto
them, Receive you the Holy Ghost:

20:23 Whose soever sins you remit, they are remitted unto them; and whose
soever sins you retain, they are retained.

20:24 But Thomas, one of the twelve, called Didymus, was not with them
when JESUS came.

20:25 The other disciples therefore said unto HIM[JESUS], We have seen the
LORD[JESUS]. But HE[JESUS] said unto them, Except I shall see in HIS[JESUS] hands the print
of the nails, and put my finger into the print of the nails, and thrust
my hand into HIS[JESUS] side, I will not believe.

20:26 And after eight days again HIS[JESUS] disciples were within, and Thomas
with them: then came JESUS, the doors being shut, and stood in the
midst, and said, Peace be unto you.

20:27 Then says HE[JESUS] to Thomas, Reach hither your finger, and behold my
hands; and reach hither your hand, and thrust it into my side: and be not
faithless, but believing.

20:28 And Thomas answered and said unto HIM[JESUS], My LORD[JESUS] and my GOD[JESUS].

20:29 JESUS says unto HIM[JESUS], Thomas, because you hast seen me, you hast
believed: blessed are they that have not seen, and yet have believed.

20:30 And many other signs truly did JESUS in the presence of HIS[JESUS]
disciples, which are not written in this book:

20:31 But these are written, that you might believe that JESUS is the
CHRIST[JESUS], the SON[JESUS] OF GOD[JESUS][JESUS]; and that believing you might have life through
HIS[JESUS] name.


21:1 After these things JESUS shewed himself again to the disciples at
the sea of Tiberias; and on this wise shewed HE[JESUS] himself.

21:2 There were together Simon Peter, and Thomas called Didymus, and
Nathanael of Cana in Galilee, and the sons of Zebedee, and two other of
HIS[JESUS] disciples.

21:3 Simon Peter says unto them, I go a fishing. They say unto HIM[JESUS], We
also go with you. They went forth, and entered into a ship immediately;
and that night they caught nothing.

21:4 But when the morning was now come, JESUS stood on the shore: but
the disciples knew not that it was JESUS.

21:5 Then JESUS says unto them, Children, have you any meat? They
answered HIM[JESUS], No.

21:6 And HE[JESUS] said unto them, Cast the net on the right side of the ship,
and you shall find. They cast therefore, and now they were not able to
draw it for the multitude of fishes.

21:7 Therefore that disciple whom JESUS loved says unto Peter, It is
the LORD[JESUS]. Now when Simon Peter heard that it was the LORD[JESUS], HE[JESUS] girt HIS[JESUS]
fisher's coat unto HIM[JESUS], (for HE[JESUS] was naked,) and did cast himself into
the sea.

21:8 And the other disciples came in a little ship; (for they were not
far from land, but as it were two hundred cubits,) dragging the net with
fishes.

21:9 As soon then as they were come to land, they saw a fire of coals
there, and fish laid thereon, and bread.

21:10 JESUS says unto them, Bring of the fish which you have now caught.

21:11 Simon Peter went up, and drew the net to land full of great
fishes, an hundred and fifty and three: and for all there were so many,
yet was not the net broken.

21:12 JESUS says unto them, Come and dine. And none of the disciples
durst ask HIM[JESUS], Who art you? knowing that it was the LORD[JESUS].

21:13 JESUS then comes, and taketh bread, and giveth them, and fish
likewise.

21:14 This is now the third time that JESUS shewed himself to HIS[JESUS]
disciples, after that HE[JESUS] was risen from the dead.

21:15 So when they had dined, JESUS says to Simon Peter, Simon, SON[JESUS] of
Jonas, lovest you me more than these? HE[JESUS] says unto HIM[JESUS], Yea, LORD[JESUS];
you knowest that I love you. HE[JESUS] says unto HIM[JESUS], Feed my lambs.

21:16 HE[JESUS] says to HIM[JESUS] again the second time, Simon, SON[JESUS] of Jonas, lovest
you me? HE[JESUS] says unto HIM[JESUS], Yea, LORD[JESUS]; you knowest that I love you. HE[JESUS]
says unto HIM[JESUS], Feed my sheep.

21:17 HE[JESUS] says unto HIM[JESUS] the third time, Simon, SON[JESUS] of Jonas, lovest you
me? Peter was grieved because HE[JESUS] said unto HIM[JESUS] the third time, Lovest
you me? And HE[JESUS] said unto HIM[JESUS], LORD[JESUS], you knowest all things; you
knowest that I love you. JESUS says unto HIM[JESUS], Feed my sheep.

21:18 truly, truly, I say unto you, When you wast young, you
girdest thyself, and walkedst whither you wouldest: but when you shalt
be old, you shalt stretch forth your hands, and another shall gird you,
and carry you whither you wouldest not.

21:19 This spake HE[JESUS], signifying by what death HE[JESUS] should glorify GOD[JESUS]. And
when HE[JESUS] had spoken this, HE[JESUS] says unto HIM[JESUS], Follow me.

21:20 Then Peter, turning about, seeth the disciple whom JESUS loved
following; which also leaned on HIS[JESUS] breast at supper, and said, LORD[JESUS],
which is HE[JESUS] that betrayeth you?

21:21 Peter seeing HIM[JESUS] says to JESUS, LORD[JESUS], and what shall this man do?

21:22 JESUS says unto HIM[JESUS], If I will that HE[JESUS] tarry till I come, what is
that to you? follow you me.

21:23 Then went this saying abroad among the brethren, that that
disciple should not die: yet JESUS said not unto HIM[JESUS], HE[JESUS] shall not die;
but, If I will that HE[JESUS] tarry till I come, what is that to you?

21:24 This is the disciple which testifieth of these things, and wrote
these things: and we know that HIS[JESUS] testimony is true.

21:25 And there are also many other things which JESUS did, the which,
if they should be written every one, I suppose that even the world
itself could not contain the books that should be written. Amen.










Acts

Chapter

1:1 The former treatise have I made, O Theophilus, of all that JESUS
began both to do and teach,

1:2 Until the day in which HE[JESUS] was taken up, after that HE[JESUS] through the
Holy Ghost had given commandments unto the apostles whom HE[JESUS] had chosen:

1:3 To whom also HE[JESUS] shewed himself alive after HIS[JESUS] passion by many
infallible proofs, being seen of them forty days, and speaking of the
things pertaining to the kingdom of GOD[JESUS]:

1:4 And, being assembled together with them, commanded them that they
should not depart from Jerusalem, but wait for the promise of the
Father, which, says HE[JESUS], you have heard of me.

1:5 For John truly baptized with water; but you shall be baptized with
the Holy Ghost not many days hence.

1:6 When they therefore were come together, they asked of HIM[JESUS], saying,
LORD[JESUS], wilt you at this time restore again the kingdom to Israel?

1:7 And HE[JESUS] said unto them, It is not for you to know the times or the
seasons, which the Father has put in HIS[JESUS] own power.

1:8 But you shall receive power, after that the Holy Ghost is come upon
you: and you shall be witnesses unto me both in Jerusalem, and in all
Judaea, and in Samaria, and unto the uttermost part of the earth.

1:9 And when HE[JESUS] had spoken these things, while they beheld, HE[JESUS] was taken
up; and a cloud received HIM[JESUS] out of their sight.

1:10 And while they looked stedfastly toward heaven as HE[JESUS] went up,
behold, two men stood by them in white apparel;

1:11 Which also said, you men of Galilee, why stand you gazing up into
heaven? this same JESUS, which is taken up from you into heaven, shall
so come in like manner as you have seen HIM[JESUS] go into heaven.

1:12 Then returned they unto Jerusalem from the mount called Olivet,
which is from Jerusalem a sabbath day's journey.

1:13 And when they were come in, they went up into an upper room, where
abode both Peter, and James, and John, and Andrew, Philip, and Thomas,
Bartholomew, and Matthew, James the SON[JESUS] of Alphaeus, and Simon Zelotes,
and Judas the brother of James.

1:14 These all continued with one accord in prayer and supplication,
with the women, and Mary the mother of JESUS, and with HIS[JESUS] brethren.

1:15 And in those days Peter stood up in the midst of the disciples, and
said, (the number of names together were about an hundred and twenty,)

1:16 Men and brethren, this scripture must needs have been fulfilled,
which the Holy Ghost by the mouth of David spake before concerning
Judas, which was guide to them that took JESUS.

1:17 For HE[JESUS] was numbered with us, and had obtained part of this
ministry.

1:18 Now this man purchased a field with the reward of iniquity; and
falling headlong, HE[JESUS] burst asunder in the midst, and all HIS[JESUS] bowels
gushed out.

1:19 And it was known unto all the dwellers at Jerusalem; insomuch as
that field is called in their proper tongue, Aceldama, that is to say,
The field of blood.

1:20 For it is written in the book of Psalms, Let HIS[JESUS] habitation be
desolate, and let no man dwell therein: and HIS[JESUS] bishoprick let another
take.

1:21 Wherefore of these men which have companied with us all the time
that the LORD[JESUS] JESUS went in and out among us,

1:22 Beginning from the baptism of John, unto that same day that HE[JESUS] was
taken up from us, must one be ordained to be a witness with us of HIS[JESUS]
resurrection.

1:23 And they appointed two, Joseph called Barsabas, who was surnamed
Justus, and Matthias.

1:24 And they prayed, and said, you, LORD[JESUS], which knowest the hearts of
all men, shew whether of these two you hast chosen,

1:25 That HE[JESUS] may take part of this ministry and apostleship, from which
Judas by transgression fell, that HE[JESUS] might go to HIS[JESUS] own place.

1:26 And they gave forth their lots; and the lot fell upon Matthias; and
HE[JESUS] was numbered with the eleven apostles.


2:1 And when the day of Pentecost was fully come, they were all with one
accord in one place.

2:2 And suddenly there came a sound from heaven as of a rushing mighty
wind, and it filled all the house where they were sitting.

2:3 And there appeared unto them cloven tongues like as of fire, and it
sat upon each of them.

2:4 And they were all filled with the Holy Ghost, and began to speak
with other tongues, as the Spirit gave them utterance.

2:5 And there were dwelling at Jerusalem Jews, devout men, out of every
nation under heaven.

2:6 Now when this was noised abroad, the multitude came together, and
were confounded, because that every man heard them speak in HIS[JESUS] own
language.

2:7 And they were all amazed and marvelled, saying one to another,
Behold, are not all these which speak Galilaeans?

2:8 And how hear we every man in our own tongue, wherein we were born?

2:9 Parthians, and Medes, and Elamites, and the dwellers in Mesopotamia,
and in Judaea, and Cappadocia, in Pontus, and Asia,

2:10 Phrygia, and Pamphylia, in Egypt, and in the parts of Libya about
Cyrene, and strangers of Rome, Jews and proselytes,

2:11 Cretes and Arabians, we do hear them speak in our tongues the
WONDERFUL[JESUS] works of GOD[JESUS].

2:12 And they were all amazed, and were in doubt, saying one to another,
What meaneth this?

2:13 Others mocking said, These men are full of new wine.

2:14 But Peter, standing up with the eleven, lifted up HIS[JESUS] voice, and
said unto them, you men of Judaea, and all you that dwell at Jerusalem, be
this known unto you, and hearken to my words:

2:15 For these are not drunken, as you suppose, seeing it is but the
third hour of the day.

2:16 But this is that which was spoken by the PROPHET[JESUS] Joel;

2:17 And it shall come to pass in the last days, says GOD[JESUS], I will pour
out of my Spirit upon all flesh: and your sons and your daughters shall
prophesy, and your young men shall see visions, and your old men shall
dream dreams:

2:18 And on my servants and on my handmaidens I will pour out in those
days of my Spirit; and they shall prophesy:

2:19 And I will shew wonders in heaven above, and signs in the earth
beneath; blood, and fire, and vapour of smoke:

2:20 The sun shall be turned into darkness, and the moon into blood,
before the great and notable day of the LORD[JESUS] come:

2:21 And it shall come to pass, that whoever shall call on the name of
the LORD[JESUS] shall be saved.

2:22 you men of Israel, hear these words; JESUS of Nazareth, a man
approved of GOD[JESUS] among you by miracles and wonders and signs, which GOD[JESUS]
did by HIM[JESUS] in the midst of you, as you yourselves also know:

2:23 HIM[JESUS], being delivered by the determinate counsel and foreknowledge
of GOD[JESUS], you have taken, and by wicked hands have crucified and slain:

2:24 Whom GOD[JESUS] has raised up, having loosed the pains of death: because
it was not possible that HE[JESUS] should be holden of it.

2:25 For David speaketh concerning HIM[JESUS], I foresaw the LORD[JESUS] always before
my face, for HE[JESUS] is on my right hand, that I should not be moved:

2:26 Therefore did my heart rejoice, and my tongue was glad; moreover
also my flesh shall rest in hope:

2:27 Because you wilt not leave my soul in hell, neither wilt you
let yours Holy One to see corruption.

2:28 you hast made known to me the ways of life; you shalt make me
full of joy with your countenance.

2:29 Men and brethren, let me freely speak unto you of the patriarch
David, that HE[JESUS] is both dead and buried, and HIS[JESUS] sepulchre is with us
unto this day.

2:30 Therefore being a PROPHET[JESUS], and knowing that GOD[JESUS] had sworn with an
oath to HIM[JESUS], that of the fruit of HIS[JESUS] loins, according to the flesh, HE[JESUS]
would raise up CHRIST[JESUS] to sit on HIS[JESUS] throne;

2:31 HE[JESUS] seeing this before spake of the resurrection of CHRIST[JESUS], that HIS[JESUS]
soul was not left in hell, neither HIS[JESUS] flesh did see corruption.

2:32 This JESUS has GOD[JESUS] raised up, whereof we all are witnesses.

2:33 Therefore being by the right hand of GOD[JESUS] exalted, and having
received of the Father the promise of the Holy Ghost, HE[JESUS] has shed forth
this, which you now see and hear.

2:34 For David is not ascended into the heavens: but HE[JESUS] says himself,
The LORD[JESUS] said unto my LORD[JESUS], Sit you on my right hand,

2:35 Until I make your foes your footstool.

2:36 Therefore let all the house of Israel know assuredly, that GOD[JESUS] has
made the same JESUS, whom you have crucified, both LORD[JESUS] and CHRIST[JESUS].

2:37 Now when they heard this, they were pricked in their heart, and
said unto Peter and to the rest of the apostles, Men and brethren, what
shall we do?

2:38 Then Peter said unto them, Repent, and be baptized every one of you
in the name of JESUS CHRIST[JESUS] for the remission of sins, and you shall
receive the gift of the Holy Ghost.

2:39 For the promise is unto you, and to your children, and to all that
are afar off, even as many as the LORD[JESUS] our GOD[JESUS] shall call.

2:40 And with many other words did HE[JESUS] testify and exhort, saying, Save
yourselves from this untoward generation.

2:41 Then they that gladly received HIS[JESUS] WORD[JESUS] were baptized: and the same
day there were added unto them about three thousand souls.

2:42 And they continued stedfastly in the apostles' doctrine and
fellowship, and in breaking of bread, and in prayers.

2:43 And fear came upon every soul: and many wonders and signs were done
by the apostles.

2:44 And all that believed were together, and had all things common;

2:45 And sold their possessions and goods, and parted them to all men,
as every man had need.

2:46 And they, continuing daily with one accord in the temple, and
breaking bread from house to house, did eat their meat with gladness and
singleness of heart,

2:47 Praising GOD[JESUS], and having favour with all the people. And the LORD[JESUS]
added to the church daily such as should be saved.


3:1 Now Peter and John went up together into the temple at the hour of
prayer, being the ninth hour.

3:2 And a certain man lame from HIS[JESUS] mother's womb was carried, whom they
laid daily at the gate of the temple which is called Beautiful, to ask
alms of them that entered into the temple;

3:3 Who seeing Peter and John about to go into the temple asked an alms.

3:4 And Peter, fastening HIS[JESUS] eyes upon HIM[JESUS] with John, said, Look on us.

3:5 And HE[JESUS] gave heed unto them, expecting to receive something of them.

3:6 Then Peter said, Silver and gold have I none; but such as I have
give I you: In the name of JESUS CHRIST[JESUS] of Nazareth rise up and walk.

3:7 And HE[JESUS] took HIM[JESUS] by the right hand, and lifted HIM[JESUS] up: and
immediately HIS[JESUS] feet and ankle bones received strength.

3:8 And HE[JESUS] leaping up stood, and walked, and entered with them into the
temple, walking, and leaping, and praising GOD[JESUS].

3:9 And all the people saw HIM[JESUS] walking and praising GOD[JESUS]:

3:10 And they knew that it was HE[JESUS] which sat for alms at the Beautiful
gate of the temple: and they were filled with wonder and amazement at
that which had happened unto HIM[JESUS].

3:11 And as the lame man which was healed held Peter and John, all the
people ran together unto them in the porch that is called Solomon's,
greatly wondering.

3:12 And when Peter saw it, HE[JESUS] answered unto the people, you men of
Israel, why marvel you at this? or why look you so earnestly on us, as
though by our own power or holiness we had made this man to walk?

3:13 The GOD[JESUS] of Abraham, and of Isaac, and of Jacob, the GOD[JESUS] of our
fathers, has glorified HIS[JESUS] SON[JESUS] JESUS; whom you delivered up, and denied
HIM[JESUS] in the presence of Pilate, when HE[JESUS] was determined to let HIM[JESUS] go.

3:14 But you denied the Holy One and the Just, and desired a murderer to
be granted unto you;

3:15 And killed the Prince of life, whom GOD[JESUS] has raised from the dead;
whereof we are witnesses.

3:16 And HIS[JESUS] name through faith in HIS[JESUS] name has made this man strong,
whom you see and know: yea, the faith which is by HIM[JESUS] has given HIM[JESUS] this
perfect soundness in the presence of you all.

3:17 And now, brethren, I wot that through ignorance you did it, as did
also your rulers.

3:18 But those things, which GOD[JESUS] before had shewed by the mouth of all
HIS[JESUS] prophets, that CHRIST[JESUS] should let, HE[JESUS] has so fulfilled.

3:19 Repent you therefore, and be converted, that your sins may be
blotted out, when the times of refreshing shall come from the presence
of the LORD[JESUS].

3:20 And HE[JESUS] shall send JESUS CHRIST[JESUS], which before was preached unto you:

3:21 Whom the heaven must receive until the times of restitution of all
things, which GOD[JESUS] has spoken by the mouth of all HIS[JESUS] holy prophets
since the world began.

3:22 For Moses truly said unto the fathers, A PROPHET[JESUS] shall the LORD[JESUS]
your GOD[JESUS] raise up unto you of your brethren, like unto me; HIM[JESUS] shall you
hear in all things whatsoever HE[JESUS] shall say unto you.

3:23 And it shall come to pass, that every soul, which will not hear
that PROPHET[JESUS], shall be destroyed from among the people.

3:24 Yea, and all the prophets from Samuel and those that follow after,
as many as have spoken, have likewise foretold of these days.

3:25 you are the children of the prophets, and of the covenant which GOD[JESUS]
made with our fathers, saying unto Abraham, And in your SEED[JESUS] shall all
the kindreds of the earth be blessed.

3:26 Unto you first GOD[JESUS], having raised up HIS[JESUS] SON[JESUS] JESUS, sent HIM[JESUS] to
bless you, in turning away every one of you from HIS[JESUS] iniquities.


4:1 And as they spake unto the people, the priests, and the captain of
the temple, and the Sadducees, came upon them,

4:2 Being grieved that they taught the people, and preached through
JESUS the resurrection from the dead.

4:3 And they laid hands on them, and put them in hold unto the next day:
for it was now eventide.

4:4 Howbeit many of them which heard the WORD[JESUS] believed; and the number
of the men was about five thousand.

4:5 And it came to pass on the morrow, that their rulers, and elders,
and scribes,

4:6 And Annas the high priest, and Caiaphas, and John, and Alexander,
and as many as were of the kindred of the high priest, were gathered
together at Jerusalem.

4:7 And when they had set them in the midst, they asked, By what power,
or by what name, have you done this?
