4:8 Then Peter, filled with the Holy Ghost, said unto them, you rulers of
the people, and elders of Israel,

4:9 If we this day be examined of the good deed done to the impotent
man, by what means HE[JESUS] is made whole;

4:10 Be it known unto you all, and to all the people of Israel, that by
the name of JESUS CHRIST[JESUS] of Nazareth, whom you crucified, whom GOD[JESUS] raised
from the dead, even by HIM[JESUS] does this man stand here before you whole.

4:11 This is the stone which was set at nought of you builders, which is
become the head of the corner.

4:12 Neither is there salvation in any other: for there is none other
name under heaven given among men, whereby we must be saved.

4:13 Now when they saw the boldness of Peter and John, and perceived
that they were unlearned and ignorant men, they marvelled; and they took
knowledge of them, that they had been with JESUS.

4:14 And beholding the man which was healed standing with them, they
could say nothing against it.

4:15 But when they had commanded them to go aside out of the council,
they conferred among themselves,

4:16 Saying, What shall we do to these men? for that indeed a notable
miracle has been done by them is manifest to all them that dwell in
Jerusalem; and we cannot deny it.

4:17 But that it spread no further among the people, let us straitly
threaten them, that they speak henceforth to no man in this name.

4:18 And they called them, and commanded them not to speak at all nor
teach in the name of JESUS.

4:19 But Peter and John answered and said unto them, Whether it be right
in the sight of GOD[JESUS] to hearken unto you more than unto GOD[JESUS], judge you.

4:20 For we cannot but speak the things which we have seen and heard.

4:21 So when they had further threatened them, they let them go, finding
nothing how they might punish them, because of the people: for all men
glorified GOD[JESUS] for that which was done.

4:22 For the man was above forty years old, on whom this miracle of
healing was shewed.

4:23 And being let go, they went to their own company, and reported all
that the chief priests and elders had said unto them.

4:24 And when they heard that, they lifted up their voice to GOD[JESUS] with
one accord, and said, LORD[JESUS], you art GOD[JESUS], which hast made heaven, and
earth, and the sea, and all that in them is:

4:25 Who by the mouth of your SERVANT[JESUS] David hast said, Why did the
heathen rage, and the people imagine vain things?

4:26 The kings of the earth stood up, and the rulers were gathered
together against the LORD[JESUS], and against HIS[JESUS] CHRIST[JESUS].

4:27 For of a truth against your holy child JESUS, whom you hast
anointed, both Herod, and Pontius Pilate, with the Gentiles, and the
people of Israel, were gathered together,

4:28 For to do whatsoever your hand and your counsel determined before to
be done.

4:29 And now, LORD[JESUS], behold their threatenings: and grant unto your
servants, that with all boldness they may speak your WORD[JESUS],

4:30 By stretching forth yours hand to heal; and that signs and wonders
may be done by the name of your holy child JESUS.

4:31 And when they had prayed, the place was shaken where they were
assembled together; and they were all filled with the Holy Ghost, and
they spake the WORD[JESUS] of GOD[JESUS] with boldness.

4:32 And the multitude of them that believed were of one heart and of
one soul: neither said any of them that ought of the things which HE[JESUS]
possessed was HIS[JESUS] own; but they had all things common.

4:33 And with great power gave the apostles witness of the resurrection
of the LORD[JESUS] JESUS: and great grace was upon them all.

4:34 Neither was there any among them that lacked: for as many as were
possessors of lands or houses sold them, and brought the prices of the
things that were sold,

4:35 And laid them down at the apostles' feet: and distribution was made
unto every man according as HE[JESUS] had need.

4:36 And Joses, who by the apostles was surnamed Barnabas, (which is,
being interpreted, The SON[JESUS] of consolation,) a Levite, and of the country
of Cyprus,

4:37 Having land, sold it, and brought the money, and laid it at the
apostles' feet.


5:1 But a certain man named Ananias, with Sapphira HIS[JESUS] wife, sold a
possession,

5:2 And kept back part of the price, HIS[JESUS] wife also being privy to it,
and brought a certain part, and laid it at the apostles' feet.

5:3 But Peter said, Ananias, why has Satan filled yours heart to lie to
the Holy Ghost, and to keep back part of the price of the land?

5:4 Whiles it remained, was it not yours own? and after it was sold, was
it not in yours own power? why hast you conceived this thing in yours
heart? you hast not lied unto men, but unto GOD[JESUS].

5:5 And Ananias hearing these words fell down, and gave up the ghost:
and great fear came on all them that heard these things.

5:6 And the young men arose, wound HIM[JESUS] up, and carried HIM[JESUS] out, and
buried HIM[JESUS].

5:7 And it was about the space of three hours after, when HIS[JESUS] wife, not
knowing what was done, came in.

5:8 And Peter answered unto her, Tell me whether you sold the land for so
much? And she said, Yea, for so much.

5:9 Then Peter said unto her, How is it that you have agreed together to
tempt the Spirit of the LORD[JESUS]? behold, the feet of them which have buried
your husband are at the door, and shall carry you out.

5:10 Then fell she down straightway at HIS[JESUS] feet, and yielded up the
ghost: and the young men came in, and found her dead, and, carrying her
forth, buried her by her husband.

5:11 And great fear came upon all the church, and upon as many as heard
these things.

5:12 And by the hands of the apostles were many signs and wonders
wrought among the people; (and they were all with one accord in
Solomon's porch.

5:13 And of the rest durst no man join himself to them: but the people
magnified them.

5:14 And believers were the more added to the LORD[JESUS], multitudes both of
men and women.)

5:15 Insomuch that they brought forth the sick into the streets, and
laid them on beds and couches, that at the least the shadow of Peter
passing by might overshadow some of them.

5:16 There came also a multitude out of the cities round about unto
Jerusalem, bringing sick folks, and them which were vexed with unclean
spirits: and they were healed every one.

5:17 Then the high priest rose up, and all they that were with HIM[JESUS],
(which is the sect of the Sadducees,) and were filled with indignation,

5:18 And laid their hands on the apostles, and put them in the common
prison.

5:19 But the angel of the LORD[JESUS] by night opened the prison doors, and
brought them forth, and said,

5:20 Go, stand and speak in the temple to the people all the words of
this life.

5:21 And when they heard that, they entered into the temple early in the
morning, and taught. But the high priest came, and they that were with
HIM[JESUS], and called the council together, and all the senate of the children
of Israel, and sent to the prison to have them brought.

5:22 But when the officers came, and found them not in the prison, they
returned and told,

5:23 Saying, The prison truly found we shut with all safety, and the
keepers standing without before the doors: but when we had opened, we
found no man within.

5:24 Now when the high priest and the captain of the temple and the
chief priests heard these things, they doubted of them whereunto this
would grow.

5:25 Then came one and told them, saying, Behold, the men whom you put in
prison are standing in the temple, and teaching the people.

5:26 Then went the captain with the officers, and brought them without
violence: for they feared the people, lest they should have been stoned.

5:27 And when they had brought them, they set them before the council:
and the high priest asked them,

5:28 Saying, Did not we straitly command you that you should not teach in
this name? and, behold, you have filled Jerusalem with your doctrine, and
intend to bring this man's blood upon us.

5:29 Then Peter and the other apostles answered and said, We ought to
obey GOD[JESUS] rather than men.

5:30 The GOD[JESUS] of our fathers raised up JESUS, whom you slew and hanged on
a tree.

5:31 HIM[JESUS] has GOD[JESUS] exalted with HIS[JESUS] right hand to be a Prince and a
Saviour, for to give repentance to Israel, and forgiveness of sins.

5:32 And we are HIS[JESUS] witnesses of these things; and so is also the Holy
Ghost, whom GOD[JESUS] has given to them that obey HIM[JESUS].

5:33 When they heard that, they were cut to the heart, and took counsel
to slay them.

5:34 Then stood there up one in the council, a Pharisee, named Gamaliel,
a doctor of the law, had in reputation among all the people, and
commanded to put the apostles forth a little space;

5:35 And said unto them, you men of Israel, take heed to yourselves what
you intend to do as touching these men.

5:36 For before these days rose up Theudas, boasting himself to be
somebody; to whom a number of men, about four hundred, joined
themselves: who was slain; and all, as many as obeyed HIM[JESUS], were
scattered, and brought to nought.

5:37 After this man rose up Judas of Galilee in the days of the taxing,
and drew away much people after HIM[JESUS]: HE[JESUS] also perished; and all, even as
many as obeyed HIM[JESUS], were dispersed.

5:38 And now I say unto you, Refrain from these men, and let them alone:
for if this counsel or this work be of men, it will come to nought:

5:39 But if it be of GOD[JESUS], you cannot overthrow it; lest haply you be found
even to fight against GOD[JESUS].

5:40 And to HIM[JESUS] they agreed: and when they had called the apostles, and
beaten them, they commanded that they should not speak in the name of
JESUS, and let them go.

5:41 And they departed from the presence of the council, rejoicing that
they were counted worthy to let shame for HIS[JESUS] name.

5:42 And daily in the temple, and in every house, they ceased not to
teach and preach JESUS CHRIST[JESUS].


6:1 And in those days, when the number of the disciples was multiplied,
there arose a murmuring of the Grecians against the Hebrews, because
their widows were neglected in the daily ministration.

6:2 Then the twelve called the multitude of the disciples unto them, and
said, It is not reason that we should leave the WORD[JESUS] of GOD[JESUS], and serve
tables.

6:3 Wherefore, brethren, look you out among you seven men of honest
report, full of the Holy Ghost and wisdom, whom we may appoint over this
business.

6:4 But we will give ourselves continually to prayer, and to the
ministry of the WORD[JESUS].

6:5 And the saying pleased the whole multitude: and they chose Stephen,
a man full of faith and of the Holy Ghost, and Philip, and Prochorus,
and Nicanor, and Timon, and Parmenas, and Nicolas a proselyte of
Antioch:

6:6 Whom they set before the apostles: and when they had prayed, they
laid their hands on them.

6:7 And the WORD[JESUS] of GOD[JESUS] increased; and the number of the disciples
multiplied in Jerusalem greatly; and a great company of the priests were
obedient to the faith.

6:8 And Stephen, full of faith and power, did great wonders and miracles
among the people.

6:9 Then there arose certain of the synagogue, which is called the
synagogue of the Libertines, and Cyrenians, and Alexandrians, and of
them of Cilicia and of Asia, disputing with Stephen.

6:10 And they were not able to resist the wisdom and the spirit by which
HE[JESUS] spake.

6:11 Then they suborned men, which said, We have heard HIM[JESUS] speak
blasphemous words against Moses, and against GOD[JESUS].

6:12 And they stirred up the people, and the elders, and the scribes,
and came upon HIM[JESUS], and caught HIM[JESUS], and brought HIM[JESUS] to the council,

6:13 And set up false witnesses, which said, This man ceaseth not to
speak blasphemous words against this holy place, and the law:

6:14 For we have heard HIM[JESUS] say, that this JESUS of Nazareth shall
destroy this place, and shall change the customs which Moses delivered
us.

6:15 And all that sat in the council, looking stedfastly on HIM[JESUS], saw HIS[JESUS]
face as it had been the face of an angel.


7:1 Then said the high priest, Are these things so?

7:2 And HE[JESUS] said, Men, brethren, and fathers, hearken; The GOD[JESUS] of glory
appeared unto our father Abraham, when HE[JESUS] was in Mesopotamia, before HE[JESUS]
dwelt in Charran,

7:3 And said unto HIM[JESUS], Get you out of your country, and from your
kindred, and come into the land which I shall shew you.

7:4 Then came HE[JESUS] out of the land of the Chaldaeans, and dwelt in
Charran: and from thence, when HIS[JESUS] father was dead, HE[JESUS] removed HIM[JESUS] into
this land, wherein you now dwell.

7:5 And HE[JESUS] gave HIM[JESUS] none inheritance in it, no, not so much as to set
HIS[JESUS] foot on: yet HE[JESUS] promised that HE[JESUS] would give it to HIM[JESUS] for a
possession, and to HIS[JESUS] SEED[JESUS] after HIM[JESUS], when as yet HE[JESUS] had no child.

7:6 And GOD[JESUS] spake on this wise, That HIS[JESUS] SEED[JESUS] should sojourn in a
strange land; and that they should bring them into bondage, and entreat
them evil four hundred years.

7:7 And the nation to whom they shall be in bondage will I judge, said
GOD[JESUS]: and after that shall they come forth, and serve me in this place.

7:8 And HE[JESUS] gave HIM[JESUS] the covenant of circumcision: and so Abraham begat
Isaac, and circumcised HIM[JESUS] the eighth day; and Isaac begat Jacob; and
Jacob begat the twelve patriarchs.

7:9 And the patriarchs, moved with envy, sold Joseph into Egypt: but GOD[JESUS]
was with HIM[JESUS],

7:10 And delivered HIM[JESUS] out of all HIS[JESUS] afflictions, and gave HIM[JESUS] favour
and wisdom in the sight of Pharaoh KING[JESUS] of Egypt; and HE[JESUS] made HIM[JESUS]
governor over Egypt and all HIS[JESUS] house.

7:11 Now there came a dearth over all the land of Egypt and Chanaan, and
great affliction: and our fathers found no sustenance.

7:12 But when Jacob heard that there was corn in Egypt, HE[JESUS] sent out our
fathers first.

7:13 And at the second time Joseph was made known to HIS[JESUS] brethren; and
Joseph's kindred was made known unto Pharaoh.

7:14 Then sent Joseph, and called HIS[JESUS] father Jacob to HIM[JESUS], and all HIS[JESUS]
kindred, threescore and fifteen souls.

7:15 So Jacob went down into Egypt, and died, HE[JESUS], and our fathers,

7:16 And were carried over into Sychem, and laid in the sepulchre that
Abraham bought for a sum of money of the sons of Emmor the father of
Sychem.

7:17 But when the time of the promise drew nigh, which GOD[JESUS] had sworn to
Abraham, the people grew and multiplied in Egypt,

7:18 Till another KING[JESUS] arose, which knew not Joseph.

7:19 The same dealt subtilly with our kindred, and evil entreated our
fathers, so that they cast out their young children, to the end they
might not live.

7:20 In which time Moses was born, and was exceeding fair, and nourished
up in HIS[JESUS] father's house three months:

7:21 And when HE[JESUS] was cast out, Pharaoh's daughter took HIM[JESUS] up, and
nourished HIM[JESUS] for her own SON[JESUS].

7:22 And Moses was learned in all the wisdom of the Egyptians, and was
mighty in words and in deeds.

7:23 And when HE[JESUS] was full forty years old, it came into HIS[JESUS] heart to
visit HIS[JESUS] brethren the children of Israel.

7:24 And seeing one of them let wrong, HE[JESUS] defended HIM[JESUS], and avenged
HIM[JESUS] that was oppressed, and smote the Egyptian:

7:25 For HE[JESUS] supposed HIS[JESUS] brethren would have understood how that GOD[JESUS] by
HIS[JESUS] hand would deliver them: but they understood not.

7:26 And the next day HE[JESUS] shewed himself unto them as they strove, and
would have set them at one again, saying, Sirs, you are brethren; why do
you wrong one to another?

7:27 But HE[JESUS] that did HIS[JESUS] neighbour wrong thrust HIM[JESUS] away, saying, Who
made you a ruler and a judge over us?

7:28 Wilt you kill me, as you diddest the Egyptian yesterday?

7:29 Then fled Moses at this saying, and was a stranger in the land of
Madian, where HE[JESUS] begat two sons.

7:30 And when forty years were expired, there appeared to HIM[JESUS] in the
wilderness of mount Sina an angel of the LORD[JESUS] in a flame of fire in a
bush.

7:31 When Moses saw it, HE[JESUS] wondered at the sight: and as HE[JESUS] drew near to
behold it, the voice of the LORD[JESUS] came unto HIM[JESUS],

7:32 Saying, I am the GOD[JESUS] of your fathers, the GOD[JESUS] of Abraham, and the
GOD[JESUS] of Isaac, and the GOD[JESUS] of Jacob. Then Moses trembled, and durst not
behold.

7:33 Then said the LORD[JESUS] to HIM[JESUS], Put off your shoes from your feet: for the
place where you standest is holy ground.

7:34 I have seen, I have seen the affliction of my people which is in
Egypt, and I have heard their groaning, and am come down to deliver
them. And now come, I will send you into Egypt.

7:35 This Moses whom they refused, saying, Who made you a ruler and a
judge? the same did GOD[JESUS] send to be a ruler and a deliverer by the hand
of the angel which appeared to HIM[JESUS] in the bush.

7:36 HE[JESUS] brought them out, after that HE[JESUS] had shewed wonders and signs in
the land of Egypt, and in the Red sea, and in the wilderness forty
years.

7:37 This is that Moses, which said unto the children of Israel, A
PROPHET[JESUS] shall the LORD[JESUS] your GOD[JESUS] raise up unto you of your brethren, like
unto me; HIM[JESUS] shall you hear.

7:38 This is HE[JESUS], that was in the church in the wilderness with the angel
which spake to HIM[JESUS] in the mount Sina, and with our fathers: who received
the lively oracles to give unto us:

7:39 To whom our fathers would not obey, but thrust HIM[JESUS] from them, and
in their hearts turned back again into Egypt,

7:40 Saying unto Aaron, Make us gods to go before us: for as for this
Moses, which brought us out of the land of Egypt, we wot not what is
become of HIM[JESUS].

7:41 And they made a calf in those days, and offered sacrifice unto the
idol, and rejoiced in the works of their own hands.

7:42 Then GOD[JESUS] turned, and gave them up to worship the host of heaven; as
it is written in the book of the prophets, O you house of Israel, have you
offered to me slain beasts and sacrifices by the space of forty years in
the wilderness?

7:43 Yea, you took up the tabernacle of Moloch, and the STAR[JESUS] of your GOD[JESUS]
Remphan, figures which you made to worship them: and I will carry you
away beyond Babylon.

7:44 Our fathers had the tabernacle of witness in the wilderness, as HE[JESUS]
had appointed, speaking unto Moses, that HE[JESUS] should make it according to
the fashion that HE[JESUS] had seen.

7:45 Which also our fathers that came after brought in with JESUS into
the possession of the Gentiles, whom GOD[JESUS] drave out before the face of
our fathers, unto the days of David;

7:46 Who found favour before GOD[JESUS], and desired to find a tabernacle for
the GOD[JESUS] of Jacob.

7:47 But Solomon built HIM[JESUS] an house.

7:48 Howbeit the most High dwelleth not in temples made with hands; as
says the PROPHET[JESUS],

7:49 Heaven is my throne, and earth is my footstool: what house will you
build me? says the LORD[JESUS]: or what is the place of my rest?

7:50 has not my hand made all these things?

7:51 you stiffnecked and uncircumcised in heart and ears, you do always
resist the Holy Ghost: as your fathers did, so do you.

7:52 Which of the prophets have not your fathers persecuted? and they
have slain them which shewed before of the coming of the Just One; of
whom you have been now the betrayers and murderers:

7:53 Who have received the law by the disposition of angels, and have
not kept it.

7:54 When they heard these things, they were cut to the heart, and they
gnashed on HIM[JESUS] with their teeth.

7:55 But HE[JESUS], being full of the Holy Ghost, looked up stedfastly into
heaven, and saw the glory of GOD[JESUS], and JESUS standing on the right hand
of GOD[JESUS],

7:56 And said, Behold, I see the heavens opened, and the SON[JESUS] OF MAN[JESUS]
standing on the right hand of GOD[JESUS].

7:57 Then they cried out with a loud voice, and stopped their ears, and
ran upon HIM[JESUS] with one accord,

7:58 And cast HIM[JESUS] out of the city, and stoned HIM[JESUS]: and the witnesses
laid down their clothes at a young man's feet, whose name was Saul.

7:59 And they stoned Stephen, calling upon GOD[JESUS], and saying, LORD[JESUS] JESUS,
receive my spirit.

7:60 And HE[JESUS] kneeled down, and cried with a loud voice, LORD[JESUS], lay not
this sin to their charge. And when HE[JESUS] had said this, HE[JESUS] fell asleep.


8:1 And Saul was consenting unto HIS[JESUS] death. And at that time there was a
great persecution against the church which was at Jerusalem; and they
were all scattered abroad throughout the regions of Judaea and Samaria,
except the apostles.

8:2 And devout men carried Stephen to HIS[JESUS] burial, and made great
lamentation over HIM[JESUS].

8:3 As for Saul, HE[JESUS] made havock of the church, entering into every
house, and haling men and women committed them to prison.

8:4 Therefore they that were scattered abroad went every where preaching
the WORD[JESUS].

8:5 Then Philip went down to the city of Samaria, and preached CHRIST[JESUS]
unto them.

8:6 And the people with one accord gave heed unto those things which
Philip spake, hearing and seeing the miracles which HE[JESUS] did.

8:7 For unclean spirits, crying with loud voice, came out of many that
were possessed with them: and many taken with palsies, and that were
lame, were healed.

8:8 And there was great joy in that city.

8:9 But there was a certain man, called Simon, which beforetime in the
same city used sorcery, and bewitched the people of Samaria, giving out
that himself was some great one:

8:10 To whom they all gave heed, from the least to the greatest, saying,
This man is the great power of GOD[JESUS].

8:11 And to HIM[JESUS] they had regard, because that of long time HE[JESUS] had
bewitched them with sorceries.

8:12 But when they believed Philip preaching the things concerning the
kingdom of GOD[JESUS], and the name of JESUS CHRIST[JESUS], they were baptized, both
men and women.

8:13 Then Simon himself believed also: and when HE[JESUS] was baptized, HE[JESUS]
continued with Philip, and wondered, beholding the miracles and signs
which were done.

8:14 Now when the apostles which were at Jerusalem heard that Samaria
had received the WORD[JESUS] of GOD[JESUS], they sent unto them Peter and John:

8:15 Who, when they were come down, prayed for them, that they might
receive the Holy Ghost:

8:16 (For as yet HE[JESUS] was fallen upon none of them: only they were
baptized in the name of the LORD[JESUS] JESUS.)

8:17 Then laid they their hands on them, and they received the Holy
Ghost.

8:18 And when Simon saw that through laying on of the apostles' hands
the Holy Ghost was given, HE[JESUS] offered them money,

8:19 Saying, Give me also this power, that on whomsoever I lay hands, HE[JESUS]
may receive the Holy Ghost.

8:20 But Peter said unto HIM[JESUS], your money perish with you, because you
hast thought that the gift of GOD[JESUS] may be purchased with money.

8:21 you hast neither part nor lot in this matter: for your heart is not
right in the sight of GOD[JESUS].

8:22 Repent therefore of this your wickedness, and pray GOD[JESUS], if perhaps
the thought of yours heart may be forgiven you.

8:23 For I perceive that you art in the gall of bitterness, and in the
bond of iniquity.

8:24 Then answered Simon, and said, Pray you to the LORD[JESUS] for me, that
none of these things which you have spoken come upon me.

8:25 And they, when they had testified and preached the WORD[JESUS] of the
LORD[JESUS], returned to Jerusalem, and preached the gospel in many villages of
the Samaritans.

8:26 And the angel of the LORD[JESUS] spake unto Philip, saying, Arise, and go
toward the south unto the way that goes down from Jerusalem unto Gaza,
which is desert.

8:27 And HE[JESUS] arose and went: and, behold, a man of Ethiopia, an eunuch of
great authority under Candace queen of the Ethiopians, who had the
charge of all her treasure, and had come to Jerusalem for to worship,

8:28 Was returning, and sitting in HIS[JESUS] chariot read Esaias the PROPHET[JESUS].

8:29 Then the Spirit said unto Philip, Go near, and join thyself to this
chariot.

8:30 And Philip ran thither to HIM[JESUS], and heard HIM[JESUS] read the PROPHET[JESUS]
Esaias, and said, Understandest you what you readest?

8:31 And HE[JESUS] said, How can I, except some man should guide me? And HE[JESUS]
desired Philip that HE[JESUS] would come up and sit with HIM[JESUS].

8:32 The place of the scripture which HE[JESUS] read was this, HE[JESUS] was led as a
sheep to the slaughter; and like a LAMB[JESUS] dumb before HIS[JESUS] shearer, so
opened HE[JESUS] not HIS[JESUS] mouth:

8:33 In HIS[JESUS] humiliation HIS[JESUS] judgment was taken away: and who shall
declare HIS[JESUS] generation? for HIS[JESUS] life is taken from the earth.

8:34 And the eunuch answered Philip, and said, I pray you, of whom
speaketh the PROPHET[JESUS] this? of himself, or of some other man?

8:35 Then Philip opened HIS[JESUS] mouth, and began at the same scripture, and
preached unto HIM[JESUS] JESUS.

8:36 And as they went on their way, they came unto a certain water: and
the eunuch said, See, here is water; what does hinder me to be baptized?

8:37 And Philip said, If you believest with all yours heart, you
mayest. And HE[JESUS] answered and said, I believe that JESUS CHRIST[JESUS] is the SON[JESUS]
of GOD[JESUS].

8:38 And HE[JESUS] commanded the chariot to stand still: and they went down
both into the water, both Philip and the eunuch; and HE[JESUS] baptized HIM[JESUS].

8:39 And when they were come up out of the water, the Spirit of the LORD[JESUS]
caught away Philip, that the eunuch saw HIM[JESUS] no more: and HE[JESUS] went on HIS[JESUS]
way rejoicing.

8:40 But Philip was found at Azotus: and passing through HE[JESUS] preached in
all the cities, till HE[JESUS] came to Caesarea.


9:1 And Saul, yet breathing out threatenings and slaughter against the
disciples of the LORD[JESUS], went unto the high priest,

9:2 And desired of HIM[JESUS] letters to Damascus to the synagogues, that if HE[JESUS]
found any of this way, whether they were men or women, HE[JESUS] might bring
them bound unto Jerusalem.

9:3 And as HE[JESUS] journeyed, HE[JESUS] came near Damascus: and suddenly there
shined round about HIM[JESUS] a light from heaven:

9:4 And HE[JESUS] fell to the earth, and heard a voice saying unto HIM[JESUS], Saul,
Saul, why persecutest you me?

9:5 And HE[JESUS] said, Who art you, LORD[JESUS]? And the LORD[JESUS] said, I am JESUS whom
you persecutest: it is hard for you to kick against the pricks.

9:6 And HE[JESUS] trembling and astonished said, LORD[JESUS], what wilt you have me
to do? And the LORD[JESUS] said unto HIM[JESUS], Arise, and go into the city, and it
shall be told you what you must do.

9:7 And the men which journeyed with HIM[JESUS] stood speechless, hearing a
voice, but seeing no man.

9:8 And Saul arose from the earth; and when HIS[JESUS] eyes were opened, HE[JESUS] saw
no man: but they led HIM[JESUS] by the hand, and brought HIM[JESUS] into Damascus.

9:9 And HE[JESUS] was three days without sight, and neither did eat nor drink.

9:10 And there was a certain disciple at Damascus, named Ananias; and to
HIM[JESUS] said the LORD[JESUS] in a vision, Ananias. And HE[JESUS] said, Behold, I am here,
LORD[JESUS].

9:11 And the LORD[JESUS] said unto HIM[JESUS], Arise, and go into the street which is
called Straight, and enquire in the house of Judas for one called Saul,
of Tarsus: for, behold, HE[JESUS] prayeth,

9:12 And has seen in a vision a man named Ananias coming in, and
putting HIS[JESUS] hand on HIM[JESUS], that HE[JESUS] might receive HIS[JESUS] sight.

9:13 Then Ananias answered, LORD[JESUS], I have heard by many of this man, how
much evil HE[JESUS] has done to your saints at Jerusalem:

9:14 And here HE[JESUS] has authority from the chief priests to bind all that
call on your name.

9:15 But the LORD[JESUS] said unto HIM[JESUS], Go your way: for HE[JESUS] is a chosen vessel
unto me, to bear my name before the Gentiles, and kings, and the
children of Israel:

9:16 For I will shew HIM[JESUS] how great things HE[JESUS] must let for my name's
sake.

9:17 And Ananias went HIS[JESUS] way, and entered into the house; and putting
HIS[JESUS] hands on HIM[JESUS] said, Brother Saul, the LORD[JESUS], even JESUS, that appeared
unto you in the way as you camest, has sent me, that you mightest
receive your sight, and be filled with the Holy Ghost.

9:18 And immediately there fell from HIS[JESUS] eyes as it had been scales: and
HE[JESUS] received sight forthwith, and arose, and was baptized.

9:19 And when HE[JESUS] had received meat, HE[JESUS] was strengthened. Then was Saul
certain days with the disciples which were at Damascus.

9:20 And straightway HE[JESUS] preached CHRIST[JESUS] in the synagogues, that HE[JESUS] is
the SON[JESUS] OF GOD[JESUS][JESUS].

9:21 But all that heard HIM[JESUS] were amazed, and said; Is not this HE[JESUS] that
destroyed them which called on this name in Jerusalem, and came hither
for that intent, that HE[JESUS] might bring them bound unto the chief priests?

9:22 But Saul increased the more in strength, and confounded the Jews
which dwelt at Damascus, proving that this is very CHRIST[JESUS].

9:23 And after that many days were fulfilled, the Jews took counsel to
kill HIM[JESUS]:

9:24 But their laying await was known of Saul. And they watched the
gates day and night to kill HIM[JESUS].

9:25 Then the disciples took HIM[JESUS] by night, and let HIM[JESUS] down by the wall
in a basket.

9:26 And when Saul was come to Jerusalem, HE[JESUS] assayed to join himself to
the disciples: but they were all afraid of HIM[JESUS], and believed not that HE[JESUS]
was a disciple.

9:27 But Barnabas took HIM[JESUS], and brought HIM[JESUS] to the apostles, and
declared unto them how HE[JESUS] had seen the LORD[JESUS] in the way, and that HE[JESUS] had
spoken to HIM[JESUS], and how HE[JESUS] had preached boldly at Damascus in the name of
JESUS.

9:28 And HE[JESUS] was with them coming in and going out at Jerusalem.

9:29 And HE[JESUS] spake boldly in the name of the LORD[JESUS] JESUS, and disputed
against the Grecians: but they went about to slay HIM[JESUS].

9:30 Which when the brethren knew, they brought HIM[JESUS] down to Caesarea,
and sent HIM[JESUS] forth to Tarsus.

9:31 Then had the churches rest throughout all Judaea and Galilee and
Samaria, and were edified; and walking in the fear of the LORD[JESUS], and in
the comfort of the Holy Ghost, were multiplied.

9:32 And it came to pass, as Peter passed throughout all quarters, HE[JESUS]
came down also to the saints which dwelt at Lydda.

9:33 And there HE[JESUS] found a certain man named Aeneas, which had kept HIS[JESUS]
bed eight years, and was sick of the palsy.

9:34 And Peter said unto HIM[JESUS], Aeneas, JESUS CHRIST[JESUS] makes you whole:
arise, and make your bed. And HE[JESUS] arose immediately.

9:35 And all that dwelt at Lydda and Saron saw HIM[JESUS], and turned to the
LORD[JESUS].

9:36 Now there was at Joppa a certain disciple named Tabitha, which by
interpretation is called Dorcas: this woman was full of good works and
almsdeeds which she did.

9:37 And it came to pass in those days, that she was sick, and died:
whom when they had washed, they laid her in an upper chamber.

9:38 And forasmuch as Lydda was nigh to Joppa, and the disciples had
heard that Peter was there, they sent unto HIM[JESUS] two men, desiring HIM[JESUS]
that HE[JESUS] would not delay to come to them.

9:39 Then Peter arose and went with them. When HE[JESUS] was come, they brought
HIM[JESUS] into the upper chamber: and all the widows stood by HIM[JESUS] weeping, and
shewing the coats and garments which Dorcas made, while she was with
them.

9:40 But Peter put them all forth, and kneeled down, and prayed; and
turning HIM[JESUS] to the body said, Tabitha, arise. And she opened her eyes:
and when she saw Peter, she sat up.

9:41 And HE[JESUS] gave her HIS[JESUS] hand, and lifted her up, and when HE[JESUS] had called
the saints and widows, presented her alive.

9:42 And it was known throughout all Joppa; and many believed in the
LORD[JESUS].

9:43 And it came to pass, that HE[JESUS] tarried many days in Joppa with one
Simon a tanner.


10:1 There was a certain man in Caesarea called Cornelius, a centurion
of the band called the Italian band,

10:2 A devout man, and one that feared GOD[JESUS] with all HIS[JESUS] house, which
gave much alms to the people, and prayed to GOD[JESUS] alway.

10:3 HE[JESUS] saw in a vision evidently about the ninth hour of the day an
angel of GOD[JESUS] coming in to HIM[JESUS], and saying unto HIM[JESUS], Cornelius.

10:4 And when HE[JESUS] looked on HIM[JESUS], HE[JESUS] was afraid, and said, What is it,
LORD[JESUS]? And HE[JESUS] said unto HIM[JESUS], your prayers and yours alms are come up for a
memorial before GOD[JESUS].

10:5 And now send men to Joppa, and call for one Simon, whose surname is
Peter:

10:6 HE[JESUS] lodgeth with one Simon a tanner, whose house is by the sea side:
HE[JESUS] shall tell you what you oughtest to do.

10:7 And when the angel which spake unto Cornelius was departed, HE[JESUS]
called two of HIS[JESUS] household servants, and a devout soldier of them that
waited on HIM[JESUS] continually;

10:8 And when HE[JESUS] had declared all these things unto them, HE[JESUS] sent them
to Joppa.

10:9 On the morrow, as they went on their journey, and drew nigh unto
the city, Peter went up upon the housetop to pray about the sixth hour:

10:10 And HE[JESUS] became very hungry, and would have eaten: but while they
made ready, HE[JESUS] fell into a trance,

10:11 And saw heaven opened, and a certain vessel descending upon HIM[JESUS],
as it had been a great sheet knit at the four corners, and let down to
the earth:

10:12 Wherein were all manner of fourfooted beasts of the earth, and
wild beasts, and creeping things, and fowls of the air.

10:13 And there came a voice to HIM[JESUS], Rise, Peter; kill, and eat.

10:14 But Peter said, Not so, LORD[JESUS]; for I have never eaten any thing
that is common or unclean.

10:15 And the voice spake unto HIM[JESUS] again the second time, What GOD[JESUS] has
cleansed, that call not you common.

10:16 This was done thrice: and the vessel was received up again into
heaven.

10:17 Now while Peter doubted in himself what this vision which HE[JESUS] had
seen should mean, behold, the men which were sent from Cornelius had
made enquiry for Simon's house, and stood before the gate,

10:18 And called, and asked whether Simon, which was surnamed Peter,
were lodged there.

10:19 While Peter thought on the vision, the Spirit said unto HIM[JESUS],
Behold, three men seek you.

10:20 Arise therefore, and get you down, and go with them, doubting
nothing: for I have sent them.

10:21 Then Peter went down to the men which were sent unto HIM[JESUS] from
Cornelius; and said, Behold, I am HE[JESUS] whom you seek: what is the cause
wherefore you are come?

10:22 And they said, Cornelius the centurion, a just man, and one that
feareth GOD[JESUS], and of good report among all the nation of the Jews, was
warned from GOD[JESUS] by an holy angel to send for you into HIS[JESUS] house, and to
hear words of you.

10:23 Then called HE[JESUS] them in, and lodged them. And on the morrow Peter
went away with them, and certain brethren from Joppa accompanied HIM[JESUS].

10:24 And the morrow after they entered into Caesarea. And Cornelius
waited for them, and HE[JESUS] had called together HIS[JESUS] kinsmen and near
friends.

10:25 And as Peter was coming in, Cornelius met HIM[JESUS], and fell down at
HIS[JESUS] feet, and worshipped HIM[JESUS].

10:26 But Peter took HIM[JESUS] up, saying, Stand up; I myself also am a man.

10:27 And as HE[JESUS] talked with HIM[JESUS], HE[JESUS] went in, and found many that were
come together.

10:28 And HE[JESUS] said unto them, you know how that it is an unlawful thing
for a man that is a Jew to keep company, or come unto one of another
nation; but GOD[JESUS] has shewed me that I should not call any man common or
unclean.

10:29 Therefore came I unto you without gainsaying, as soon as I was
sent for: I ask therefore for what intent you have sent for me?

10:30 And Cornelius said, Four days ago I was fasting until this hour;
and at the ninth hour I prayed in my house, and, behold, a man stood
before me in bright clothing,

10:31 And said, Cornelius, your prayer is heard, and yours alms are had
in remembrance in the sight of GOD[JESUS].

10:32 Send therefore to Joppa, and call hither Simon, whose surname is
Peter; HE[JESUS] is lodged in the house of one Simon a tanner by the sea side:
who, when HE[JESUS] comes, shall speak unto you.

10:33 Immediately therefore I sent to you; and you hast well done that
you art come. Now therefore are we all here present before GOD[JESUS], to hear
all things that are commanded you of GOD[JESUS].

10:34 Then Peter opened HIS[JESUS] mouth, and said, Of a truth I perceive that
GOD[JESUS] is no respecter of persons:

10:35 But in every nation HE[JESUS] that feareth HIM[JESUS], and worketh
righteousness, is accepted with HIM[JESUS].

10:36 The WORD[JESUS] which GOD[JESUS] sent unto the children of Israel, preaching
peace by JESUS CHRIST[JESUS]: (HE[JESUS] is LORD[JESUS] of all:)

10:37 That WORD[JESUS], I say, you know, which was published throughout all
Judaea, and began from Galilee, after the baptism which John preached;

10:38 How GOD[JESUS] anointed JESUS of Nazareth with the Holy Ghost and with
power: who went about doing good, and healing all that were oppressed of
the devil; for GOD[JESUS] was with HIM[JESUS].

10:39 And we are witnesses of all things which HE[JESUS] did both in the land
of the Jews, and in Jerusalem; whom they slew and hanged on a tree:

10:40 HIM[JESUS] GOD[JESUS] raised up the third day, and shewed HIM[JESUS] openly;

10:41 Not to all the people, but unto witnesses chosen before GOD[JESUS], even
to us, who did eat and drink with HIM[JESUS] after HE[JESUS] rose from the dead.

10:42 And HE[JESUS] commanded us to preach unto the people, and to testify that
it is HE[JESUS] which was ordained of GOD[JESUS] to be the Judge of quick and dead.

10:43 To HIM[JESUS] give all the prophets witness, that through HIS[JESUS] name
whoever believes in HIM[JESUS] shall receive remission of sins.

10:44 While Peter yet spake these words, the Holy Ghost fell on all them
which heard the WORD[JESUS].

10:45 And they of the circumcision which believed were astonished, as
many as came with Peter, because that on the Gentiles also was poured
out the gift of the Holy Ghost.

10:46 For they heard them speak with tongues, and magnify GOD[JESUS]. Then
answered Peter,

10:47 Can any man forbid water, that these should not be baptized, which
have received the Holy Ghost as well as we?

10:48 And HE[JESUS] commanded them to be baptized in the name of the LORD[JESUS]. Then
prayed they HIM[JESUS] to tarry certain days.


11:1 And the apostles and brethren that were in Judaea heard that the
Gentiles had also received the WORD[JESUS] of GOD[JESUS].

11:2 And when Peter was come up to Jerusalem, they that were of the
circumcision contended with HIM[JESUS],

11:3 Saying, you wentest in to men uncircumcised, and didst eat with
them.

11:4 But Peter rehearsed the matter from the beginning, and expounded it
by order unto them, saying,

11:5 I was in the city of Joppa praying: and in a trance I saw a vision,
A certain vessel descend, as it had been a great sheet, let down from
heaven by four corners; and it came even to me:

11:6 Upon the which when I had fastened mine eyes, I considered, and saw
fourfooted beasts of the earth, and wild beasts, and creeping things,
and fowls of the air.

11:7 And I heard a voice saying unto me, Arise, Peter; slay and eat.

11:8 But I said, Not so, LORD[JESUS]: for nothing common or unclean has at any
time entered into my mouth.

11:9 But the voice answered me again from heaven, What GOD[JESUS] has
cleansed, that call not you common.

11:10 And this was done three times: and all were drawn up again into
heaven.

11:11 And, behold, immediately there were three men already come unto
the house where I was, sent from Caesarea unto me.

11:12 And the Spirit bade me go with them, nothing doubting. Moreover
these six brethren accompanied me, and we entered into the man's house:

11:13 And HE[JESUS] shewed us how HE[JESUS] had seen an angel in HIS[JESUS] house, which
stood and said unto HIM[JESUS], Send men to Joppa, and call for Simon, whose
surname is Peter;

11:14 Who shall tell you words, whereby you and all your house shall be
saved.

11:15 And as I began to speak, the Holy Ghost fell on them, as on us at
the beginning.

11:16 Then remembered I the WORD[JESUS] of the LORD[JESUS], how that HE[JESUS] said, John
indeed baptized with water; but you shall be baptized with the Holy
Ghost.

11:17 Forasmuch then as GOD[JESUS] gave them the like gift as HE[JESUS] did unto us,
who believed on the LORD[JESUS] JESUS CHRIST[JESUS]; what was I, that I could
withstand GOD[JESUS]?

11:18 When they heard these things, they held their peace, and glorified
GOD[JESUS], saying, Then has GOD[JESUS] also to the Gentiles granted repentance unto
life.

11:19 Now they which were scattered abroad upon the persecution that
arose about Stephen travelled as far as Phenice, and Cyprus, and
Antioch, preaching the WORD[JESUS] to none but unto the Jews only.

11:20 And some of them were men of Cyprus and Cyrene, which, when they
were come to Antioch, spake unto the Grecians, preaching the LORD[JESUS] JESUS.

11:21 And the hand of the LORD[JESUS] was with them: and a great number
believed, and turned unto the LORD[JESUS].

11:22 Then tidings of these things came unto the ears of the church
which was in Jerusalem: and they sent forth Barnabas, that HE[JESUS] should go
as far as Antioch.

11:23 Who, when HE[JESUS] came, and had seen the grace of GOD[JESUS], was glad, and
exhorted them all, that with purpose of heart they would cleave unto the
LORD[JESUS].

11:24 For HE[JESUS] was a good man, and full of the Holy Ghost and of faith:
and much people was added unto the LORD[JESUS].

11:25 Then departed Barnabas to Tarsus, for to seek Saul:

11:26 And when HE[JESUS] had found HIM[JESUS], HE[JESUS] brought HIM[JESUS] unto Antioch. And it
came to pass, that a whole year they assembled themselves with the
church, and taught much people. And the disciples were called Christians
first in Antioch.

11:27 And in these days came prophets from Jerusalem unto Antioch.

11:28 And there stood up one of them named Agabus, and signified by the
Spirit that there should be great dearth throughout all the world: which
came to pass in the days of Claudius Caesar.

11:29 Then the disciples, every man according to HIS[JESUS] ability, determined
to send relief unto the brethren which dwelt in Judaea:

11:30 Which also they did, and sent it to the elders by the hands of
Barnabas and Saul.


12:1 Now about that time Herod the KING[JESUS] stretched forth HIS[JESUS] hands to vex
certain of the church.

12:2 And HE[JESUS] killed James the brother of John with the sword.

12:3 And because HE[JESUS] saw it pleased the Jews, HE[JESUS] proceeded further to
take Peter also. (Then were the days of unleavened bread.)

12:4 And when HE[JESUS] had apprehended HIM[JESUS], HE[JESUS] put HIM[JESUS] in prison, and
delivered HIM[JESUS] to four quaternions of soldiers to keep HIM[JESUS]; intending
after Easter to bring HIM[JESUS] forth to the people.

12:5 Peter therefore was kept in prison: but prayer was made without
ceasing of the church unto GOD[JESUS] for HIM[JESUS].

12:6 And when Herod would have brought HIM[JESUS] forth, the same night Peter
was sleeping between two soldiers, bound with two chains: and the
keepers before the door kept the prison.

12:7 And, behold, the angel of the LORD[JESUS] came upon HIM[JESUS], and a light
shined in the prison: and HE[JESUS] smote Peter on the side, and raised HIM[JESUS] up,
saying, Arise up quickly. And HIS[JESUS] chains fell off from HIS[JESUS] hands.

12:8 And the angel said unto HIM[JESUS], Gird thyself, and bind on your sandals.
And so HE[JESUS] did. And HE[JESUS] says unto HIM[JESUS], Cast your garment about you, and
follow me.

12:9 And HE[JESUS] went out, and followed HIM[JESUS]; and wist not that it was true
which was done by the angel; but thought HE[JESUS] saw a vision.

12:10 When they were past the first and the second ward, they came unto
the iron gate that leads unto the city; which opened to them of HIS[JESUS]
own accord: and they went out, and passed on through one street; and
forthwith the angel departed from HIM[JESUS].

12:11 And when Peter was come to himself, HE[JESUS] said, Now I know of a
surety, that the LORD[JESUS] has sent HIS[JESUS] angel, and has delivered me out of
the hand of Herod, and from all the expectation of the people of the
Jews.

12:12 And when HE[JESUS] had considered the thing, HE[JESUS] came to the house of Mary
the mother of John, whose surname was Mark; where many were gathered
together praying.

12:13 And as Peter knocked at the door of the gate, a damsel came to
hearken, named Rhoda.

12:14 And when she knew Peter's voice, she opened not the gate for
gladness, but ran in, and told how Peter stood before the gate.

12:15 And they said unto her, you art mad. But she constantly affirmed
that it was even so. Then said they, It is HIS[JESUS] angel.

12:16 But Peter continued knocking: and when they had opened the door,
and saw HIM[JESUS], they were astonished.

12:17 But HE[JESUS], beckoning unto them with the hand to hold their peace,
declared unto them how the LORD[JESUS] had brought HIM[JESUS] out of the prison. And
HE[JESUS] said, Go shew these things unto James, and to the brethren. And HE[JESUS]
departed, and went into another place.

12:18 Now as soon as it was day, there was no small stir among the
soldiers, what was become of Peter.

12:19 And when Herod had sought for HIM[JESUS], and found HIM[JESUS] not, HE[JESUS] examined
the keepers, and commanded that they should be put to death. And HE[JESUS] went
down from Judaea to Caesarea, and there abode.

12:20 And Herod was highly displeased with them of Tyre and Sidon: but
they came with one accord to HIM[JESUS], and, having made Blastus the KING[JESUS]'s
chamberlain their friend, desired peace; because their country was
nourished by the KING[JESUS]'s country.

12:21 And upon a set day Herod, arrayed in royal apparel, sat upon HIS[JESUS]
throne, and made an oration unto them.

12:22 And the people gave a shout, saying, It is the voice of a GOD[JESUS], and
not of a man.

12:23 And immediately the angel of the LORD[JESUS] smote HIM[JESUS], because HE[JESUS] gave
not GOD[JESUS] the glory: and HE[JESUS] was eaten of worms, and gave up the ghost.

12:24 But the WORD[JESUS] of GOD[JESUS] grew and multiplied.

12:25 And Barnabas and Saul returned from Jerusalem, when they had
fulfilled their ministry, and took with them John, whose surname was
Mark.


13:1 Now there were in the church that was at Antioch certain prophets
and teachers; as Barnabas, and Simeon that was called Niger, and Lucius
of Cyrene, and Manaen, which had been brought up with Herod the
tetrarch, and Saul.

13:2 As they ministered to the LORD[JESUS], and fasted, the Holy Ghost said,
Separate me Barnabas and Saul for the work whereunto I have called them.

13:3 And when they had fasted and prayed, and laid their hands on them,
they sent them away.

13:4 So they, being sent forth by the Holy Ghost, departed unto
Seleucia; and from thence they sailed to Cyprus.

13:5 And when they were at Salamis, they preached the WORD[JESUS] of GOD[JESUS] in the
synagogues of the Jews: and they had also John to their minister.

13:6 And when they had gone through the isle unto Paphos, they found a
certain sorcerer, a false PROPHET[JESUS], a Jew, whose name was Barjesus:

13:7 Which was with the deputy of the country, Sergius Paulus, a prudent
man; who called for Barnabas and Saul, and desired to hear the WORD[JESUS] of
GOD[JESUS].

13:8 But Elymas the sorcerer (for so is HIS[JESUS] name by interpretation)
withstood them, seeking to turn away the deputy from the faith.

13:9 Then Saul, (who also is called Paul,) filled with the Holy Ghost,
set HIS[JESUS] eyes on HIM[JESUS].

13:10 And said, O full of all subtilty and all mischief, you child of
the devil, you enemy of all righteousness, wilt you not cease to
pervert the right ways of the LORD[JESUS]?

13:11 And now, behold, the hand of the LORD[JESUS] is upon you, and you shalt
be blind, not seeing the sun for a season. And immediately there fell on
HIM[JESUS] a mist and a darkness; and HE[JESUS] went about seeking some to lead HIM[JESUS] by
the hand.

13:12 Then the deputy, when HE[JESUS] saw what was done, believed, being
astonished at the doctrine of the LORD[JESUS].

13:13 Now when Paul and HIS[JESUS] company loosed from Paphos, they came to
Perga in Pamphylia: and John departing from them returned to Jerusalem.

13:14 But when they departed from Perga, they came to Antioch in
Pisidia, and went into the synagogue on the sabbath day, and sat down.

13:15 And after the reading of the law and the prophets the rulers of
the synagogue sent unto them, saying, you men and brethren, if you have
any WORD[JESUS] of exhortation for the people, say on.

13:16 Then Paul stood up, and beckoning with HIS[JESUS] hand said, Men of
Israel, and you that fear GOD[JESUS], give audience.

13:17 The GOD[JESUS] of this people of Israel chose our fathers, and exalted
the people when they dwelt as strangers in the land of Egypt, and with
an high arm brought HE[JESUS] them out of it.

13:18 And about the time of forty years suffered HE[JESUS] their manners in the
wilderness.

13:19 And when HE[JESUS] had destroyed seven nations in the land of Chanaan, HE[JESUS]
divided their land to them by lot.

13:20 And after that HE[JESUS] gave unto them judges about the space of four
hundred and fifty years, until Samuel the PROPHET[JESUS].

13:21 And afterward they desired a KING[JESUS]: and GOD[JESUS] gave unto them Saul the
SON[JESUS] of Cis, a man of the tribe of Benjamin, by the space of forty years.

13:22 And when HE[JESUS] had removed HIM[JESUS], HE[JESUS] raised up unto them David to be
their KING[JESUS]; to whom also HE[JESUS] gave their testimony, and said, I have found
David the SON[JESUS] of Jesse, a man after mine own heart, which shall fulfil
all my will.

13:23 Of this man's SEED[JESUS] has GOD[JESUS] according to HIS[JESUS] promise raised unto
Israel a Saviour, JESUS:

13:24 When John had first preached before HIS[JESUS] coming the baptism of
repentance to all the people of Israel.

13:25 And as John fulfilled HIS[JESUS] course, HE[JESUS] said, Whom think you that I
am? I am not HE[JESUS]. But, behold, there comes one after me, whose shoes of
HIS[JESUS] feet I am not worthy to loose.

13:26 Men and brethren, children of the stock of Abraham, and whoever
among you feareth GOD[JESUS], to you is the WORD[JESUS] of this salvation sent.

13:27 For they that dwell at Jerusalem, and their rulers, because they
knew HIM[JESUS] not, nor yet the voices of the prophets which are read every
sabbath day, they have fulfilled them in condemning HIM[JESUS].

13:28 And though they found no cause of death in HIM[JESUS], yet desired they
Pilate that HE[JESUS] should be slain.

13:29 And when they had fulfilled all that was written of HIM[JESUS], they took
HIM[JESUS] down from the tree, and laid HIM[JESUS] in a sepulchre.

13:30 But GOD[JESUS] raised HIM[JESUS] from the dead:

13:31 And HE[JESUS] was seen many days of them which came up with HIM[JESUS] from
Galilee to Jerusalem, who are HIS[JESUS] witnesses unto the people.

13:32 And we declare unto you glad tidings, how that the promise which
was made unto the fathers,

13:33 GOD[JESUS] has fulfilled the same unto us their children, in that HE[JESUS]
has raised up JESUS again; as it is also written in the second psalm,
you art my SON[JESUS], this day have I begotten you.

13:34 And as concerning that HE[JESUS] raised HIM[JESUS] up from the dead, now no more
to return to corruption, HE[JESUS] said on this wise, I will give you the sure
mercies of David.

13:35 Wherefore HE[JESUS] says also in another psalm, you shalt not let
yours Holy One to see corruption.

13:36 For David, after HE[JESUS] had served HIS[JESUS] own generation by the will of
GOD[JESUS], fell on sleep, and was laid unto HIS[JESUS] fathers, and saw corruption:

13:37 But HE[JESUS], whom GOD[JESUS] raised again, saw no corruption.

13:38 Be it known unto you therefore, men and brethren, that through
this man is preached unto you the forgiveness of sins:

13:39 And by HIM[JESUS] all that believe are justified from all things, from
which you could not be justified by the law of Moses.

13:40 Beware therefore, lest that come upon you, which is spoken of in
the prophets;

13:41 Behold, you despisers, and wonder, and perish: for I work a work in
your days, a work which you shall in no wise believe, though a man
declare it unto you.

13:42 And when the Jews were gone out of the synagogue, the Gentiles
besought that these words might be preached to them the next sabbath.

13:43 Now when the congregation was broken up, many of the Jews and
religious proselytes followed Paul and Barnabas: who, speaking to them,
persuaded them to continue in the grace of GOD[JESUS].

13:44 And the next sabbath day came almost the whole city together to
hear the WORD[JESUS] of GOD[JESUS].

13:45 But when the Jews saw the multitudes, they were filled with envy,
and spake against those things which were spoken by Paul, contradicting
and blaspheming.

13:46 Then Paul and Barnabas waxed bold, and said, It was necessary that
the WORD[JESUS] of GOD[JESUS] should first have been spoken to you: but seeing you put
it from you, and judge yourselves unworthy of everlasting life, lo, we
turn to the Gentiles.

13:47 For so has the LORD[JESUS] commanded us, saying, I have set you to be a
light of the Gentiles, that you shouldest be for salvation unto the
ends of the earth.

13:48 And when the Gentiles heard this, they were glad, and glorified
the WORD[JESUS] of the LORD[JESUS]: and as many as were ordained to eternal life
believed.

13:49 And the WORD[JESUS] of the LORD[JESUS] was published throughout all the region.

13:50 But the Jews stirred up the devout and honourable women, and the
chief men of the city, and raised persecution against Paul and Barnabas,
and expelled them out of their coasts.

13:51 But they shook off the dust of their feet against them, and came
unto Iconium.

13:52 And the disciples were filled with joy, and with the Holy Ghost.


14:1 And it came to pass in Iconium, that they went both together into
the synagogue of the Jews, and so spake, that a great multitude both of
the Jews and also of the Greeks believed.

14:2 But the unbelieving Jews stirred up the Gentiles, and made their
minds evil affected against the brethren.

14:3 Long time therefore abode they speaking boldly in the LORD[JESUS], which
gave testimony unto the WORD[JESUS] of HIS[JESUS] grace, and granted signs and wonders
to be done by their hands.

14:4 But the multitude of the city was divided: and part held with the
Jews, and part with the apostles.

14:5 And when there was an assault made both of the Gentiles, and also
of the Jews with their rulers, to use them despitefully, and to stone
them,

14:6 They were ware of it, and fled unto Lystra and Derbe, cities of
Lycaonia, and unto the region that lieth round about:

14:7 And there they preached the gospel.

14:8 And there sat a certain man at Lystra, impotent in HIS[JESUS] feet, being
a cripple from HIS[JESUS] mother's womb, who never had walked:

14:9 The same heard Paul speak: who stedfastly beholding HIM[JESUS], and
perceiving that HE[JESUS] had faith to be healed,

14:10 Said with a loud voice, Stand upright on your feet. And HE[JESUS] leaped
and walked.

14:11 And when the people saw what Paul had done, they lifted up their
voices, saying in the speech of Lycaonia, The gods are come down to us
in the likeness of men.

14:12 And they called Barnabas, Jupiter; and Paul, Mercurius, because HE[JESUS]
was the chief speaker.

14:13 Then the priest of Jupiter, which was before their city, brought
oxen and garlands unto the gates, and would have done sacrifice with the
people.

14:14 Which when the apostles, Barnabas and Paul, heard of, they rent
their clothes, and ran in among the people, crying out,

14:15 And saying, Sirs, why do you these things? We also are men of like
passions with you, and preach unto you that you should turn from these
vanities unto the living GOD[JESUS], which made heaven, and earth, and the sea,
and all things that are therein:

14:16 Who in times past suffered all nations to walk in their own ways.

14:17 Nevertheless HE[JESUS] left not himself without witness, in that HE[JESUS] did
good, and gave us rain from heaven, and fruitful seasons, filling our
hearts with food and gladness.

14:18 And with these sayings scarce restrained they the people, that
they had not done sacrifice unto them.

14:19 And there came thither certain Jews from Antioch and Iconium, who
persuaded the people, and having stoned Paul, drew HIM[JESUS] out of the city,
supposing HE[JESUS] had been dead.

14:20 Howbeit, as the disciples stood round about HIM[JESUS], HE[JESUS] rose up, and
came into the city: and the next day HE[JESUS] departed with Barnabas to Derbe.

14:21 And when they had preached the gospel to that city, and had taught
many, they returned again to Lystra, and to Iconium, and Antioch,

14:22 Confirming the souls of the disciples, and exhorting them to
continue in the faith, and that we must through much tribulation enter
into the kingdom of GOD[JESUS].

14:23 And when they had ordained them elders in every church, and had
prayed with fasting, they commended them to the LORD[JESUS], on whom they
believed.

14:24 And after they had passed throughout Pisidia, they came to
Pamphylia.

14:25 And when they had preached the WORD[JESUS] in Perga, they went down into
Attalia:

14:26 And thence sailed to Antioch, from whence they had been
recommended to the grace of GOD[JESUS] for the work which they fulfilled.

14:27 And when they were come, and had gathered the church together,
they rehearsed all that GOD[JESUS] had done with them, and how HE[JESUS] had opened
the door of faith unto the Gentiles.

14:28 And there they abode long time with the disciples.


15:1 And certain men which came down from Judaea taught the brethren,
and said, Except you be circumcised after the manner of Moses, you cannot
be saved.

15:2 When therefore Paul and Barnabas had no small dissension and
disputation with them, they determined that Paul and Barnabas, and
certain other of them, should go up to Jerusalem unto the apostles and
elders about this question.

15:3 And being brought on their way by the church, they passed through
Phenice and Samaria, declaring the conversion of the Gentiles: and they
caused great joy unto all the brethren.

15:4 And when they were come to Jerusalem, they were received of the
church, and of the apostles and elders, and they declared all things
that GOD[JESUS] had done with them.

15:5 But there rose up certain of the sect of the Pharisees which
believed, saying, That it was needful to circumcise them, and to command
them to keep the law of Moses.

15:6 And the apostles and elders came together for to consider of this
matter.

15:7 And when there had been much disputing, Peter rose up, and said
unto them, Men and brethren, you know how that a good while ago GOD[JESUS] made
choice among us, that the Gentiles by my mouth should hear the WORD[JESUS] of
the gospel, and believe.

15:8 And GOD[JESUS], which knoweth the hearts, bare them witness, giving them
the Holy Ghost, even as HE[JESUS] did unto us;

15:9 And put no difference between us and them, purifying their hearts
by faith.

15:10 Now therefore why tempt you GOD[JESUS], to put a yoke upon the neck of the
disciples, which neither our fathers nor we were able to bear?

15:11 But we believe that through the grace of the LORD[JESUS] JESUS CHRIST[JESUS] we
shall be saved, even as they.

15:12 Then all the multitude kept silence, and gave audience to Barnabas
and Paul, declaring what miracles and wonders GOD[JESUS] had wrought among the
Gentiles by them.

15:13 And after they had held their peace, James answered, saying, Men
and brethren, hearken unto me:

15:14 Simeon has declared how GOD[JESUS] at the first did visit the Gentiles,
to take out of them a people for HIS[JESUS] name.

15:15 And to this agree the words of the prophets; as it is written,

15:16 After this I will return, and will build again the tabernacle of
David, which is fallen down; and I will build again the ruins thereof,
and I will set it up:

15:17 That the residue of men might seek after the LORD[JESUS], and all the
Gentiles, upon whom my name is called, says the LORD[JESUS], who doeth all
these things.

15:18 Known unto GOD[JESUS] are all HIS[JESUS] works from the beginning of the world.

15:19 Wherefore my sentence is, that we trouble not them, which from
among the Gentiles are turned to GOD[JESUS]:

15:20 But that we write unto them, that they abstain from pollutions of
idols, and from fornication, and from things strangled, and from blood.

15:21 For Moses of old time has in every city them that preach HIM[JESUS],
being read in the synagogues every sabbath day.

15:22 Then pleased it the apostles and elders with the whole church, to
send chosen men of their own company to Antioch with Paul and Barnabas;
namely, Judas surnamed Barsabas and Silas, chief men among the brethren:

15:23 And they wrote letters by them after this manner; The apostles and
elders and brethren send greeting unto the brethren which are of the
Gentiles in Antioch and Syria and Cilicia.

15:24 Forasmuch as we have heard, that certain which went out from us
have troubled you with words, subverting your souls, saying, you must be
circumcised, and keep the law: to whom we gave no such commandment:

15:25 It seemed good unto us, being assembled with one accord, to send
chosen men unto you with our beloved Barnabas and Paul,

15:26 Men that have hazarded their lives for the name of our LORD[JESUS] JESUS
CHRIST[JESUS].

15:27 We have sent therefore Judas and Silas, who shall also tell you
the same things by mouth.

15:28 For it seemed good to the Holy Ghost, and to us, to lay upon you
no greater burden than these necessary things;

15:29 That you abstain from meats offered to idols, and from blood, and
from things strangled, and from fornication: from which if you keep
yourselves, you shall do well. Fare you well.

15:30 So when they were dismissed, they came to Antioch: and when they
had gathered the multitude together, they delivered the epistle:

15:31 Which when they had read, they rejoiced for the consolation.

15:32 And Judas and Silas, being prophets also themselves, exhorted the
brethren with many words, and confirmed them.

15:33 And after they had tarried there a space, they were let go in
peace from the brethren unto the apostles.

15:34 Notwithstanding it pleased Silas to abide there still.

15:35 Paul also and Barnabas continued in Antioch, teaching and
preaching the WORD[JESUS] of the LORD[JESUS], with many others also.

15:36 And some days after Paul said unto Barnabas, Let us go again and
visit our brethren in every city where we have preached the WORD[JESUS] of the
LORD[JESUS], and see how they do.

15:37 And Barnabas determined to take with them John, whose surname was
Mark.

15:38 But Paul thought not good to take HIM[JESUS] with them, who departed from
them from Pamphylia, and went not with them to the work.

15:39 And the contention was so sharp between them, that they departed
asunder one from the other: and so Barnabas took Mark, and sailed unto
Cyprus;

15:40 And Paul chose Silas, and departed, being recommended by the
brethren unto the grace of GOD[JESUS].

15:41 And HE[JESUS] went through Syria and Cilicia, confirming the churches.


16:1 Then came HE[JESUS] to Derbe and Lystra: and, behold, a certain disciple
was there, named Timotheus, the SON[JESUS] of a certain woman, which was a
Jewess, and believed; but HIS[JESUS] father was a Greek:

16:2 Which was well reported of by the brethren that were at Lystra and
Iconium.

16:3 HIM[JESUS] would Paul have to go forth with HIM[JESUS]; and took and circumcised
HIM[JESUS] because of the Jews which were in those quarters: for they knew all
that HIS[JESUS] father was a Greek.

16:4 And as they went through the cities, they delivered them the
decrees for to keep, that were ordained of the apostles and elders which
were at Jerusalem.

16:5 And so were the churches established in the faith, and increased in
number daily.

16:6 Now when they had gone throughout Phrygia and the region of
Galatia, and were forbidden of the Holy Ghost to preach the WORD[JESUS] in
Asia,

16:7 After they were come to Mysia, they assayed to go into Bithynia:
but the Spirit suffered them not.

16:8 And they passing by Mysia came down to Troas.

16:9 And a vision appeared to Paul in the night; There stood a man of
Macedonia, and prayed HIM[JESUS], saying, Come over into Macedonia, and help
us.

16:10 And after HE[JESUS] had seen the vision, immediately we endeavoured to go
into Macedonia, assuredly gathering that the LORD[JESUS] had called us for to
preach the gospel unto them.

16:11 Therefore loosing from Troas, we came with a straight course to
Samothracia, and the next day to Neapolis;

16:12 And from thence to Philippi, which is the chief city of that part
of Macedonia, and a colony: and we were in that city abiding certain
days.

16:13 And on the sabbath we went out of the city by a river side, where
prayer was wont to be made; and we sat down, and spake unto the women
which resorted thither.

16:14 And a certain woman named Lydia, a seller of purple, of the city
of Thyatira, which worshipped GOD[JESUS], heard us: whose heart the LORD[JESUS]
opened, that she attended unto the things which were spoken of Paul.

16:15 And when she was baptized, and her household, she besought us,
saying, If you have judged me to be faithful to the LORD[JESUS], come into my
house, and abide there. And she constrained us.

16:16 And it came to pass, as we went to prayer, a certain damsel
possessed with a spirit of divination met us, which brought her masters
much gain by soothsaying:

16:17 The same followed Paul and us, and cried, saying, These men are
the servants of the most high GOD[JESUS], which shew unto us the way of
salvation.

16:18 And this did she many days. But Paul, being grieved, turned and
said to the spirit, I command you in the name of JESUS CHRIST[JESUS] to come
out of her. And HE[JESUS] came out the same hour.

16:19 And when her masters saw that the hope of their gains was gone,
they caught Paul and Silas, and drew them into the marketplace unto the
rulers,

16:20 And brought them to the magistrates, saying, These men, being
Jews, do exceedingly trouble our city,

16:21 And teach customs, which are not lawful for us to receive, neither
to observe, being Romans.

16:22 And the multitude rose up together against them: and the
magistrates rent off their clothes, and commanded to beat them.

16:23 And when they had laid many stripes upon them, they cast them into
prison, charging the jailor to keep them safely:

16:24 Who, having received such a charge, thrust them into the inner
prison, and made their feet fast in the stocks.

16:25 And at midnight Paul and Silas prayed, and sang praises unto GOD[JESUS]:
and the prisoners heard them.

16:26 And suddenly there was a great earthquake, so that the foundations
of the prison were shaken: and immediately all the doors were opened,
and every one's bands were loosed.

16:27 And the keeper of the prison awaking out of HIS[JESUS] sleep, and seeing
the prison doors open, HE[JESUS] drew out HIS[JESUS] sword, and would have killed
himself, supposing that the prisoners had been fled.

16:28 But Paul cried with a loud voice, saying, Do thyself no harm: for
we are all here.

16:29 Then HE[JESUS] called for a light, and sprang in, and came trembling, and
fell down before Paul and Silas,

16:30 And brought them out, and said, Sirs, what must I do to be saved?

16:31 And they said, Believe on the LORD[JESUS] JESUS CHRIST[JESUS], and you shalt be
saved, and your house.

16:32 And they spake unto HIM[JESUS] the WORD[JESUS] of the LORD[JESUS], and to all that were
in HIS[JESUS] house.

16:33 And HE[JESUS] took them the same hour of the night, and washed their
stripes; and was baptized, HE[JESUS] and all HIS[JESUS], straightway.

16:34 And when HE[JESUS] had brought them into HIS[JESUS] house, HE[JESUS] set meat before
them, and rejoiced, believing in GOD[JESUS] with all HIS[JESUS] house.

16:35 And when it was day, the magistrates sent the serjeants, saying,
Let those men go.

16:36 And the keeper of the prison told this saying to Paul, The
magistrates have sent to let you go: now therefore depart, and go in
peace.

16:37 But Paul said unto them, They have beaten us openly uncondemned,
being Romans, and have cast us into prison; and now do they thrust us
out privily? nay truly; but let them come themselves and fetch us out.

16:38 And the serjeants told these words unto the magistrates: and they
feared, when they heard that they were Romans.

16:39 And they came and besought them, and brought them out, and desired
them to depart out of the city.

16:40 And they went out of the prison, and entered into the house of
Lydia: and when they had seen the brethren, they comforted them, and
departed.


17:1 Now when they had passed through Amphipolis and Apollonia, they
came to Thessalonica, where was a synagogue of the Jews:

17:2 And Paul, as HIS[JESUS] manner was, went in unto them, and three sabbath
days reasoned with them out of the scriptures,

17:3 Opening and alleging, that CHRIST[JESUS] must needs have suffered, and
risen again from the dead; and that this JESUS, whom I preach unto you,
is CHRIST[JESUS].

17:4 And some of them believed, and consorted with Paul and Silas; and
of the devout Greeks a great multitude, and of the chief women not a
few.

17:5 But the Jews which believed not, moved with envy, took unto them
certain lewd fellows of the baser sort, and gathered a company, and set
all the city on an uproar, and assaulted the house of Jason, and sought
to bring them out to the people.

17:6 And when they found them not, they drew Jason and certain brethren
unto the rulers of the city, crying, These that have turned the world
upside down are come hither also;

17:7 Whom Jason has received: and these all do contrary to the decrees
of Caesar, saying that there is another KING[JESUS], one JESUS.

17:8 And they troubled the people and the rulers of the city, when they
heard these things.

17:9 And when they had taken security of Jason, and of the other, they
let them go.

17:10 And the brethren immediately sent away Paul and Silas by night
unto Berea: who coming thither went into the synagogue of the Jews.

17:11 These were more noble than those in Thessalonica, in that they
received the WORD[JESUS] with all readiness of mind, and searched the
scriptures daily, whether those things were so.

17:12 Therefore many of them believed; also of honourable women which
were Greeks, and of men, not a few.

17:13 But when the Jews of Thessalonica had knowledge that the WORD[JESUS] of
GOD[JESUS] was preached of Paul at Berea, they came thither also, and stirred
up the people.

17:14 And then immediately the brethren sent away Paul to go as it were
to the sea: but Silas and Timotheus abode there still.

17:15 And they that conducted Paul brought HIM[JESUS] unto Athens: and
receiving a commandment unto Silas and Timotheus for to come to HIM[JESUS] with
all speed, they departed.

17:16 Now while Paul waited for them at Athens, HIS[JESUS] spirit was stirred
in HIM[JESUS], when HE[JESUS] saw the city wholly given to idolatry.

17:17 Therefore disputed HE[JESUS] in the synagogue with the Jews, and with the
devout persons, and in the market daily with them that met with HIM[JESUS].

17:18 Then certain philosophers of the Epicureans, and of the Stoicks,
encountered HIM[JESUS]. And some said, What will this babbler say? other some,
HE[JESUS] seemeth to be a setter forth of strange gods: because HE[JESUS] preached
unto them JESUS, and the resurrection.

17:19 And they took HIM[JESUS], and brought HIM[JESUS] unto Areopagus, saying, May we
know what this new doctrine, whereof you speakest, is?

17:20 For you bringest certain strange things to our ears: we would
know therefore what these things mean.

17:21 (For all the Athenians and strangers which were there spent their
time in nothing else, but either to tell, or to hear some new thing.)

17:22 Then Paul stood in the midst of Mars' hill, and said, you men of
Athens, I perceive that in all things you are too superstitious.

17:23 For as I passed by, and beheld your devotions, I found an altar
with this inscription, TO THE UNKNOWN GOD[JESUS]. Whom therefore you ignorantly
worship, HIM[JESUS] declare I unto you.

17:24 GOD[JESUS] that made the world and all things therein, seeing that HE[JESUS] is
LORD[JESUS] of heaven and earth, dwelleth not in temples made with hands;

17:25 Neither is worshipped with men's hands, as though HE[JESUS] needed any
thing, seeing HE[JESUS] giveth to all life, and breath, and all things;

17:26 And has made of one blood all nations of men for to dwell on all
the face of the earth, and has determined the times before appointed,
and the bounds of their habitation;

17:27 That they should seek the LORD[JESUS], if haply they might feel after
HIM[JESUS], and find HIM[JESUS], though HE[JESUS] be not far from every one of us:

17:28 For in HIM[JESUS] we live, and move, and have our being; as certain also
of your own poets have said, For we are also HIS[JESUS] OFFSPRING[JESUS].

17:29 Forasmuch then as we are the OFFSPRING[JESUS] of GOD[JESUS], we ought not to
think that the Godhead is like unto gold, or silver, or stone, graven by
art and man's device.

17:30 And the times of this ignorance GOD[JESUS] winked at; but now commandeth
all men every where to repent:

17:31 Because HE[JESUS] has appointed a day, in the which HE[JESUS] will judge the
world in righteousness by that man whom HE[JESUS] has ordained; whereof HE[JESUS]
has given assurance unto all men, in that HE[JESUS] has raised HIM[JESUS] from the
dead.

17:32 And when they heard of the resurrection of the dead, some mocked:
and others said, We will hear you again of this matter.

17:33 So Paul departed from among them.

17:34 Howbeit certain men clave unto HIM[JESUS], and believed: among the which
was Dionysius the Areopagite, and a woman named Damaris, and others with
them.


18:1 After these things Paul departed from Athens, and came to Corinth;

18:2 And found a certain Jew named Aquila, born in Pontus, lately come
from Italy, with HIS[JESUS] wife Priscilla; (because that Claudius had
commanded all Jews to depart from Rome:) and came unto them.

18:3 And because HE[JESUS] was of the same craft, HE[JESUS] abode with them, and
wrought: for by their occupation they were tentmakers.

18:4 And HE[JESUS] reasoned in the synagogue every sabbath, and persuaded the
Jews and the Greeks.

18:5 And when Silas and Timotheus were come from Macedonia, Paul was
pressed in the spirit, and testified to the Jews that JESUS was CHRIST[JESUS].

18:6 And when they opposed themselves, and blasphemed, HE[JESUS] shook HIS[JESUS]
raiment, and said unto them, Your blood be upon your own heads; I am
clean; from henceforth I will go unto the Gentiles.

18:7 And HE[JESUS] departed thence, and entered into a certain man's house,
named Justus, one that worshipped GOD[JESUS], whose house joined hard to the
synagogue.

18:8 And Crispus, the chief ruler of the synagogue, believed on the LORD[JESUS]
with all HIS[JESUS] house; and many of the Corinthians hearing believed, and
were baptized.

18:9 Then spake the LORD[JESUS] to Paul in the night by a vision, Be not
afraid, but speak, and hold not your peace:

18:10 For I am with you, and no man shall set on you to hurt you: for
I have much people in this city.

18:11 And HE[JESUS] continued there a year and six months, teaching the WORD[JESUS] of
GOD[JESUS] among them.

18:12 And when Gallio was the deputy of Achaia, the Jews made
insurrection with one accord against Paul, and brought HIM[JESUS] to the
judgment seat,

18:13 Saying, This fellow persuadeth men to worship GOD[JESUS] contrary to the
law.

18:14 And when Paul was now about to open HIS[JESUS] mouth, Gallio said unto
the Jews, If it were a matter of wrong or wicked lewdness, O you Jews,
reason would that I should bear with you:

18:15 But if it be a question of words and names, and of your law, look
you to it; for I will be no judge of such matters.

18:16 And HE[JESUS] drave them from the judgment seat.

18:17 Then all the Greeks took Sosthenes, the chief ruler of the
synagogue, and beat HIM[JESUS] before the judgment seat. And Gallio cared for
none of those things.

18:18 And Paul after this tarried there yet a good while, and then took
HIS[JESUS] leave of the brethren, and sailed thence into Syria, and with HIM[JESUS]
Priscilla and Aquila; having shorn HIS[JESUS] head in Cenchrea: for HE[JESUS] had a
vow.

18:19 And HE[JESUS] came to Ephesus, and left them there: but HE[JESUS] himself
entered into the synagogue, and reasoned with the Jews.

18:20 When they desired HIM[JESUS] to tarry longer time with them, HE[JESUS] consented
not;

18:21 But bade them farewell, saying, I must by all means keep this
feast that comes in Jerusalem: but I will return again unto you, if GOD[JESUS]
will. And HE[JESUS] sailed from Ephesus.

18:22 And when HE[JESUS] had landed at Caesarea, and gone up, and saluted the
church, HE[JESUS] went down to Antioch.

18:23 And after HE[JESUS] had spent some time there, HE[JESUS] departed, and went over
all the country of Galatia and Phrygia in order, strengthening all the
disciples.

18:24 And a certain Jew named Apollos, born at Alexandria, an eloquent
man, and mighty in the scriptures, came to Ephesus.

18:25 This man was instructed in the way of the LORD[JESUS]; and being fervent
in the spirit, HE[JESUS] spake and taught diligently the things of the LORD[JESUS],
knowing only the baptism of John.

18:26 And HE[JESUS] began to speak boldly in the synagogue: whom when Aquila
and Priscilla had heard, they took HIM[JESUS] unto them, and expounded unto HIM[JESUS]
the way of GOD[JESUS] more perfectly.

18:27 And when HE[JESUS] was disposed to pass into Achaia, the brethren wrote,
exhorting the disciples to receive HIM[JESUS]: who, when HE[JESUS] was come, helped
them much which had believed through grace:

18:28 For HE[JESUS] mightily convinced the Jews, and that publickly, shewing by
the scriptures that JESUS was CHRIST[JESUS].


19:1 And it came to pass, that, while Apollos was at Corinth, Paul
having passed through the upper coasts came to Ephesus: and finding
certain disciples,

19:2 HE[JESUS] said unto them, Have you received the Holy Ghost since you
believed? And they said unto HIM[JESUS], We have not so much as heard whether
there be any Holy Ghost.

19:3 And HE[JESUS] said unto them, Unto what then were you baptized? And they
